--!nonstrict
-- V6 single-script launcher: stage the same build in the Delta workspace.
-- Only writes the V6 bundle, never reads/overwrites handoff state or starts raid jobs.
-- V6 .14h.9 Delta: managed Sandworm V3.8 + Totem close/return recovery V2.
local staged = [=======[--!nonstrict
-- GENERATED: PlaneRNG V6. Edit src/, then rebuild.
-- Inert entrypoint: platform effects require explicit service calls.
local __factories, __cache, __loading = {}, {}, {}
local function __require(name)
    if __cache[name] ~= nil then return __cache[name] end
    assert(not __loading[name], "Circular module: " .. name)
    local factory = assert(__factories[name], "Missing module: " .. name)
    __loading[name] = true
    local ok, value = pcall(factory, __require)
    __loading[name] = nil
    if not ok then error(value, 0) end
    assert(value ~= nil, "Module returned nil: " .. name)
    __cache[name] = value
    return value
end

-- BEGIN MODULE dungeon.AutoCard
__factories["dungeon.AutoCard"] = function(require)
-- PlaneRNG stable feature module: AutoCard
-- Extracted from V2.6.1, lines 245-319 (feature code unchanged).
-- Factory returns a module interface. Built locally for PC/Potassium via tools/build_stable.py.
-- Module factory; execute a generated dist file instead.
return function(ctx)
    local state = ctx.state
    local config = ctx.config
    local player = ctx.player

-- V3 scoring that had been live-tested for 50 Picks.
local priorities = {
    Tesla = 120,
    Flak = 110,
    Cannons = 108,
    Designator = 105,
    Precision = 100,
    Tungsten = 92,
    Finisher = 82,
    CounterEW = 78,
    BackupSquadron = 76,
    TailGunner = 74,
    PreFlight = 65,
    MaintenanceBay = 60,
    Ablative = 55,
    Desperation = 48,
}

local rarityFallback = {
    Common = 40,
    Uncommon = 50,
    Rare = 65,
    Epic = 80,
    Legendary = 95,
    Mythic = 115,
}

-- Same visual-only HP heuristic as V3; nil means unavailable.
local function squadronHP()
    local visuals = workspace:FindFirstChild("PlayerPlaneVisuals")
    local folder = visuals and visuals:FindFirstChild(tostring(player.UserId))
    if not folder then return nil end
    local hp, maximum = 0, 0
    for _, plane in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
        if plane:IsA("Model") then
            local a = tonumber(plane:GetAttribute("CurrentHP"))
            local b = tonumber(plane:GetAttribute("MaxHP"))
            if a and b and b > 0 then
                hp = hp + math.clamp(a, 0, b)
                maximum = maximum + b
            end
        end
    end
    return maximum > 0 and hp / maximum or nil
end

local function scoreCard(id, stacks)
    if type(id) ~= "string" then return -math.huge, 0, 0 end
    local card = config.UpgradeById(id)
    if type(card) ~= "table" then return -math.huge, 0, 0 end
    local count = tonumber(stacks[id]) or 0
    local max = tonumber(card.Max) or 1
    if count >= max then return -math.huge, count, max end

    local score = priorities[id] or rarityFallback[card.Rarity] or 30
    local nextWave = state.Wave > 0 and (state.Wave + 1) or nil
    local bossNext = nextWave and (nextWave % 10 == 0 or nextWave % 10 == 5)
    if bossNext then
        if id == "Tungsten" then score = score + 24
        elseif id == "Designator" then score = score + 14
        elseif id == "Finisher" then score = score + 10 end
    end
    local hp = squadronHP()
    if hp then
        if hp < 0.50 then
            local extra = {BackupSquadron=50, MaintenanceBay=30, PreFlight=30,
                           Ablative=25, Desperation=30}
            score = score + (extra[id] or 0)
        elseif hp < 0.75 then
            local extra = {BackupSquadron=20, MaintenanceBay=15}
            score = score + (extra[id] or 0)
        end
    end
    return score, count, max
end

    return {
        scoreCard = scoreCard,
    }
end

end

-- BEGIN MODULE dungeon.Dungeon
__factories["dungeon.Dungeon"] = function(require)
-- PlaneRNG stable feature module: Dungeon
-- Based on V2.6.1, lines 321-579; V6 replaces the Home repeat with a scheduler yield.
-- Factory returns a module interface. Built locally for PC/Potassium via tools/build_stable.py.
-- Module factory; execute a generated dist file instead.
return function(ctx)
    local state = ctx.state
    local SETTINGS = ctx.SETTINGS
    local components = ctx.components
    local now = ctx.now
    local isRunning = ctx.isRunning
    local status = ctx.status
    local currentRun = ctx.currentRun
    local log = ctx.log
    local logWarn = ctx.logWarn
    local fail = ctx.fail
    local clearRunState = ctx.clearRunState
    local config = ctx.config
    local dungeonRemote = ctx.remotes:WaitForChild("PrototypeDungeon")
    local prototypeRemote = ctx.remotes:WaitForChild("PrototypeRemote")
    local player = ctx.player
    local scoreCard = ctx.AutoCard.scoreCard

local function launchSolo()
    if not isRunning() or currentRun() then return end
    if state.StartingSolo then return end
    state.StartingSolo = true
    state.StartRefusal = nil
    status("STARTING SOLO")
    -- Exactly one Solo request for this managed job; late Enter is ambiguous.
    state.SoloAttempted = true
    local ok, err = pcall(function()
        dungeonRemote:FireServer({K = "Solo"})
    end)
    if not ok then
        state.StartingSolo = false
        fail("SOLO request error: " .. tostring(err))
        return
    end
    log("SOLO sent once")
    local t0 = now()
    while isRunning() and now() - t0 < SETTINGS.SoloEnterTimeout do
        if state.RunId and state.SoloVerified then
            state.StartingSolo = false
            return
        end
        if state.StartRefusal then
            local reason = state.StartRefusal
            state.StartingSolo = false
            fail("SOLO rejected: " .. reason)
            return
        end
        task.wait(0.15)
    end
    if isRunning() then
        state.StartingSolo = false
        fail("SOLO Enter not verified; not retrying")
    end
end


local function expectedDungeonForWave(wave)
    local maps = {"Lab", "Assembly", "Range", "WindTunnel"}
    return maps[math.floor((wave - 1) / 10) % 4 + 1]
end

local function maybeLeave()
    if not isRunning() or state.LeaveSent or not state.SoloVerified then return end
    if state.LastClearedWave ~= SETTINGS.TargetWave then return end
    if not state.CheckpointCleared or not state.RewardAward then return end
    if state.RewardAward.Dungeon ~= expectedDungeonForWave(SETTINGS.TargetWave) then return end

    local earned = tonumber(state.RewardAward.Components)
    local checkpointBefore = state.BeforeCheckpointBalance
    local current = components()
    local serverTotal = tonumber(state.RewardAward.Total)
    if not earned or earned <= 0 or not checkpointBefore then return end
    if current < checkpointBefore + earned then return end
    if serverTotal and current < serverTotal then return end
    if currentRun() == nil or state.RunId == nil then return end

    -- Single, guarded Leave. No automatic repeated calls.
    state.LeaveSent = true
    state.LeaveAt = now()
    status("AWARD VERIFIED - LEAVING W" .. SETTINGS.TargetWave)
    log("Award", earned, "Dungeon", state.RewardAward.Dungeon,
        "Before", checkpointBefore, "Current", current)
    local ok, err = pcall(function()
        dungeonRemote:FireServer({K = "Leave"})
    end)
    if not ok then fail("Leave FireServer failed: " .. tostring(err)) return end
    log("LEAVE sent ONCE")

    local expectedRun = state.RunId
    task.delay(SETTINGS.HomeConfirmTimeout, function()
        if state.Destroyed or not state.Enabled then return end
        if state.LeaveSent and state.RunId == expectedRun and currentRun() ~= nil then
            fail("Leave sent, but no Home confirmed; no retry")
        end
    end)
end

local function handleEnter(data)
    if not isRunning() then return end
    local roster = data.Roster
    local solo = data.Party == 1 and type(roster) == "table"
        and #roster == 1 and type(roster[1]) == "table"
        and tonumber(roster[1].UserId) == player.UserId
    if not solo then
        fail("Enter received but SOLO roster not verified")
        return
    end
    if type(data.RunId) ~= "string" or data.RunId == "" then
        fail("Enter received without RunId")
        return
    end
    clearRunState()
    state.RunId = data.RunId
    state.SoloVerified = true
    state.StartingSolo = false
    state.NextStartAt = math.huge
    state.Stacks = type(data.Stacks) == "table" and data.Stacks or {}
    if not state.CycleStart then
        state.CycleStart = now()
        state.CycleStartBalance = components()
        state.CycleIsPartial = true
    end
    status("SOLO VERIFIED - RUN " .. state.RunId)
end

local function handleHome()
    if not state.RunId and not state.StartingSolo then return end
    local oldRun = state.RunId
    local byAutomation = state.LeaveSent
    local payoutVerified = state.CheckpointCleared and state.RewardAward ~= nil
        and state.LastClearedWave == SETTINGS.TargetWave
    local elapsed = state.CycleStart and math.max(now() - state.CycleStart, 0.001) or nil
    local gained = state.CycleStartBalance and (components() - state.CycleStartBalance) or 0
    if oldRun then
        state.RunsFinished = state.RunsFinished + 1
        state.LastEarned = gained
        state.LastCyclePartial = state.CycleIsPartial
        state.LastDuration = elapsed
        state.LastRate = elapsed and gained * 60 / elapsed or nil
        log("HOME", oldRun, "AutoLeave:", byAutomation,
            "Earned:", gained, "Seconds:", elapsed,
            "C/min:", state.LastRate, "Partial:", state.CycleIsPartial)
    end
    clearRunState()
    -- Managed V6 must return control to P1 Totem after Home, not restart Solo here.
    if ctx.onHome then ctx.onHome(oldRun, byAutomation, payoutVerified) end
    state.CycleStart = now() -- counts restart overhead in NEXT cycle
    state.CycleStartBalance = components()
    state.CycleIsPartial = false
    -- V6-managed mode never restarts inside the Home callback. The owning
    -- scheduler must yield to a fresh Totem P1 query before another Solo.
    state.NextStartAt = math.huge
    if isRunning() then status("HOME - YIELD TO P1 SCHEDULER") end
end

local function handleWave(data)
    if not isRunning() then return end
    local snap = type(data.Snapshot) == "table" and data.Snapshot or {}
    local wave = tonumber(snap.Wave or data.Wave)
    if not wave then return end
    if not state.RunId or not state.SoloVerified then
        fail("Wave observed without verified SOLO Enter; refusing to take over unknown run")
        return
    end
    state.Wave = wave
    if wave == SETTINGS.TargetWave then
        state.BeforeCheckpointBalance = components()
        log("Target WAVE START", wave, "Pre-award balance", state.BeforeCheckpointBalance)
    elseif wave > SETTINGS.TargetWave and not state.LeaveSent then
        -- Already missed the target; never leave without payout proof.
        fail("Passed target wave without verified Award; no automatic Leave")
        return
    end
    if wave % 5 == 0 or wave <= 2 then log("Wave", wave) end
end

local function handleOffer(data)
    if not isRunning() or state.LeaveSent then return end
    if not state.RunId or not state.SoloVerified then return end
    if state.CheckpointCleared then return end -- no more picks after milestone
    local cards = data.Cards
    if type(cards) ~= "table" or #cards == 0 then return end
    local keys = {}
    for i, id in ipairs(cards) do keys[i] = tostring(id) end
    local offerId = tostring(data.Deadline) .. ":" .. table.concat(keys, "|")
    if state.LastOffer == offerId then return end
    state.LastOffer = offerId
    if type(data.Deadline) == "number"
        and workspace:GetServerTimeNow() >= data.Deadline then
        logWarn("Offer expired, skipping")
        return
    end
    local stacks = type(data.Stacks) == "table" and data.Stacks or state.Stacks
    state.Stacks = stacks
    local best, maxScore = nil, -math.huge
    for i, id in ipairs(cards) do
        local score, count, maximum = scoreCard(id, stacks)
        log("CARD", i, id, "score", score, "stack", count, "/", maximum)
        if score > maxScore then best, maxScore = i, score end
    end
    if not best then
        logWarn("No eligible cards")
        return
    end
    local chosen = cards[best]
    state.LastChosen = tostring(chosen)
    state.PendingCard = {Id = chosen, Before = tonumber(stacks[chosen]) or 0}
    local ok, err = pcall(function()
        dungeonRemote:FireServer({K = "Pick", Index = best})
    end)
    if not ok then
        state.PendingCard = nil
        fail("Pick failed: " .. tostring(err))
        return
    end
    log("PICK sent", chosen, "Index", best, "Wave", state.Wave)
end

local function handlePicked(data)
    if not isRunning() then return end
    if type(data.Stacks) == "table" then state.Stacks = data.Stacks end
    local pending = state.PendingCard
    if pending then
        local after = tonumber(state.Stacks[pending.Id])
        if after and after > pending.Before then
            log("PICK VERIFIED", pending.Id, pending.Before, "->", after)
        else
            logWarn("Picked received, stack increase not independently verified", pending.Id)
        end
        state.PendingCard = nil
    end
    state.Picks = state.Picks + 1
end

local function handleAward(data)
    if not isRunning() or state.LeaveSent then return end
    log("AWARD", "Map", data.Dungeon, "Amount", data.Components,
        "Total", data.Total, "Wave", state.Wave)
    if state.Wave == SETTINGS.TargetWave
        and data.Dungeon == expectedDungeonForWave(SETTINGS.TargetWave)
        and (tonumber(data.Components) or 0) > 0 then
        state.RewardAward = data
        maybeLeave()
    end
end

local addConnection = ctx.addConnection

addConnection(dungeonRemote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(data)
    if state.Destroyed or type(data) ~= "table" then return end
    local kind = data.K
    if kind == "Enter" then
        handleEnter(data)
    elseif kind == "Home" then
        handleHome()
    elseif kind == "Notice" and isRunning() then
        logWarn("SERVER NOTICE", data.Text)
        if state.StartingSolo then
            state.StartRefusal = tostring(data.Text)
        end
    elseif kind == "Wave" then
        handleWave(data)
    elseif kind == "Cleared" and isRunning() then
        local wave = state.Wave
        if wave > 0 then
            state.LastClearedWave = math.max(state.LastClearedWave, wave)
            if wave == SETTINGS.TargetWave then
                state.CheckpointCleared = true
                log("CHECKPOINT CLEARED", wave)
                maybeLeave()
                task.delay(SETTINGS.RewardConfirmTimeout, function()
                    if isRunning() and state.CheckpointCleared and not state.LeaveSent then
                        fail("Checkpoint cleared but Award/balance not verified")
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
    elseif kind == "Offer" then
        handleOffer(data)
    elseif kind == "Picked" then
        handlePicked(data)
    elseif kind == "Ended" and isRunning() then
        logWarn("RUN ENDED", data.Reason)
        if not state.LeaveSent and not state.ReturnSent then
            state.ReturnSent = true
            task.delay(1, function()
                if not isRunning() or not state.ReturnSent then return end
                status("ENDED - REQUEST RETURN")
                dungeonRemote:FireServer({K = "Return"})
                local expectedRun = state.RunId
                task.delay(SETTINGS.HomeConfirmTimeout, function()
                    if isRunning() and state.ReturnSent
                        and state.RunId == expectedRun and currentRun() then
                        fail("Return sent but Home not confirmed; no retry")
                    end
                end)
            end)
        end
    end
end))

addConnection(prototypeRemote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(data)
    if state.Destroyed or type(data) ~= "table" then return end
    if data.K == "Award" then handleAward(data) end
end))

addConnection(player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Components"):Connect(function()
    if state.Destroyed then return end
    if isRunning() and state.RunId then
        log("BALANCE", components(), "Wave", state.Wave)
        maybeLeave()
    end
end))

    return {
        launchSolo = launchSolo,
    }
end

end
-- END MODULE dungeon.Dungeon
-- BEGIN MODULE dungeon.Readiness
__factories["dungeon.Readiness"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Passive client-readiness only. This does not claim server Solo eligibility.
local DungeonReadiness = {}
function DungeonReadiness.new(player, clock)
    clock = clock or os.clock
    local reader = {}
    local function observe(query)
        local now = clock()
        local state, reason = "READY", "DUNGEON_HOME_IDLE"
        local shared = type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv() or _G
        local legacy = shared and shared.PlaneRNGPrototypeAutoV1
        if legacy and legacy.Enabled == true and not legacy.Destroyed then
            state, reason = "BLOCKED", "STANDALONE_DUNGEON_ALREADY_RUNNING"
        elseif player:GetAttribute("PrototypeDungeonRun") ~= nil then
            state, reason = "BLOCKED", "DUNGEON_EXISTING_RUN"
        elseif player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true or player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") == true
            or player:GetAttribute("RiftTier") ~= nil or player:GetAttribute("BossResultsOpen") == true then
            state, reason = "BLOCKED", "DUNGEON_PLAYER_NOT_IDLE"
        elseif not tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")) then
            state, reason = "UNKNOWN", "DUNGEON_WORLD_UNVERIFIED"
        end
        return {kind = "DUNGEON", state = state, reason = reason,
            observedAt = now, validUntil = now + 1.5, nextCheckAt = now + 1.5}
    end
    function reader:observe(query) return observe(query) end
    function reader:peek(query) return observe(query) end
    return reader
end
return DungeonReadiness

end
-- END MODULE dungeon.Readiness
-- BEGIN MODULE dungeon.ManagedController
__factories["dungeon.ManagedController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- PlaneRNG V6 .14h.8: stable V2.6.1 Dungeon run, central P1/P2/P3 scheduler ownership.
-- The original Dungeon and AutoCard modules own their remote state machine.
-- This adapter only owns one scheduler job and never implements an independent repeat loop.
local Contracts = require("main.core.Contracts")
local StableDungeon = require("dungeon.Dungeon")
local AutoCard = require("dungeon.AutoCard")
local DungeonConfig = require("dungeon.Config")
local Controller = {}

local function log(event, ...)
    print("[V6 DUNGEON]", event, ...)
end
local function notify(event, ...)
    warn("[V6 DUNGEON]", event, ...)
end
local function isWorld(worldId)
    return tonumber(game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")) == worldId
end

function Controller.new(services, options)
    options = options or {}
    local obj = {active = nil, last = nil, completed = 0, nextAt = 0, environment = nil}
    local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local remotes, nativeConfig

    function obj:initialize(env)
        self.environment = env
        remotes = RS:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        local dungeon = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("PrototypeDungeon")
        local prototype = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("PrototypeRemote")
        if not dungeon or not dungeon:IsA("RemoteEvent")
            or not prototype or not prototype:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
            return false, "DUNGEON_NATIVE_REMOTES_UNAVAILABLE"
        end
        local modules = RS:FindFirstChild("Modules")
        local folder = modules and modules:FindFirstChild("PrototypeDungeon")
        local config = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("Config")
        if not config or not config:IsA("ModuleScript") then
            return false, "DUNGEON_CONFIG_UNAVAILABLE"
        end
        local ok, value = pcall(DungeonConfig, {RS = RS})
        if not ok or type(value) ~= "table" or type(value.UpgradeById) ~= "function" then
            return false, "DUNGEON_CONFIG_INVALID"
        end
        nativeConfig = value
        log("MANAGED_INITIALIZED", "nativeRemote", dungeon:GetFullName())
        return true
    end
    function obj:cooldown() return self.nextAt end
    function obj:status()
        local active = self.active
        return {running = active ~= nil, wave = active and active.Wave or 0,
            runId = active and active.RunId, targetWave = active and active.TargetWave,
            checkpoint = active and active.CheckpointCleared,
            leaveSent = active and active.LeaveSent,
            homeObserved = active and active.HomeObserved or false,
            soloAttempted = active and active.SoloAttempted or false,
            nativeRunActive = player:GetAttribute("PrototypeDungeonRun") ~= nil,
            nextAt = self.nextAt,
            completed = self.completed, last = self.last}
    end
    function obj:cancel(context, reason)
        local state = self.active
        if state then
            state.Enabled = false
            notify("CANCELLED", tostring(reason), "run", tostring(state.RunId),
                "nativeRun", tostring(player:GetAttribute("PrototypeDungeonRun")))
        end
        -- Force Reset is local: no native Return/Leave is invented here.
        -- The stale cooldown must not survive the explicitly new scheduler generation.
        if reason == "LIVE_SCHEDULER_STOPPED" or reason == "UNIVERSAL_FORCE_RESET" then
            self.nextAt = 0
        end
    end
    function obj:cleanup(context)
        local state = self.active
        if not state then return end
        state.Enabled, state.Destroyed = false, true
        for _, conn in ipairs(state.Connections or {}) do
            if conn then pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end) end
        end
        table.clear(state.Connections)
        self.active = nil
    end

    local function navigateToVega(context)
        local npc
        for _ = 1, 20 do
            if context:isCancelled() then return false, "CANCELLED" end
            local newWorld = workspace:FindFirstChild("NewWorld")
            local done = newWorld and newWorld:FindFirstChild("Done")
            local world4 = done and done:FindFirstChild("World4New")
            npc = world4 and world4:FindFirstChild("PROTOTYPE NPC")
                or workspace:FindFirstChild("PROTOTYPE NPC", true)
            if npc and npc:IsA("Model") then break end
            npc = nil
            for _, item in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                if item:IsA("Model") and item:GetAttribute("NpcKind") == "Prototype" then
                    npc = item
                    break
                end
            end
            if npc then break end
            if not context:wait(0.5) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        end
        if not npc then return false, "DUNGEON_NPC_NOT_STREAMED" end
        local anchor = npc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart", true) or npc.PrimaryPart
            or npc:FindFirstChild("Head", true) or npc:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
        if not anchor or not anchor:IsA("BasePart") then return false, "DUNGEON_NPC_ANCHOR_MISSING" end
        local character = player.Character
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not root or not isWorld(4) then return false, "DUNGEON_CHARACTER_WORLD_UNVERIFIED" end
        local raw = anchor.Position + anchor.CFrame.LookVector * 8
        local goal = services.movement:ground(raw, {exclude = {npc}})
        if not goal then
            local params = RaycastParams.new()
            params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
            params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character, npc}
            local hit = workspace:Raycast(raw + Vector3.new(0, 20, 0), Vector3.new(0, -100, 0), params)
            goal = hit and hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0) or raw
        end
        local lease, code = services.movement:acquire(context)
        if not lease then return false, code or "DUNGEON_MOVEMENT_BUSY" end
        local ok, moveCode = services.movement:relocate(context, lease, goal, root)
        local released, releaseCode = services.movement:release(lease)
        if not released then return false, releaseCode or "DUNGEON_LEASE_RELEASE_FAILED" end
        if not ok then return false, moveCode or "DUNGEON_NPC_RELOCATION_FAILED" end
        if not context:wait(2) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        if not root.Parent or (root.Position - anchor.Position).Magnitude > 20 then
            return false, "DUNGEON_NPC_APPROACH_UNVERIFIED"
        end
        return true
    end

    function obj:run(context, request)
        local function result(status, code, fields)
            local detail = fields or {}
            detail.stage = detail.stage or "RUN"
            return Contracts.result(status, code, detail)
        end
        if context:isCancelled() then return result("CANCELLED", "DUNGEON_CANCELLED") end
        if request.stage ~= "RUN" then return result("HELD", "DUNGEON_RECOVERY_REQUIRED", {stage=request.stage}) end
        if self.active then return result("HELD", "DUNGEON_CONCURRENT_JOB") end
        local settings = request.settings or {}
        local target = tonumber((settings.preferences and settings.preferences.dungeon or {}).targetWave) or 40
        if target < 10 or target % 10 ~= 0 or target > 1000 then
            notify("INVALID_TARGET", target, "supported checkpoint waves: 10,20,30,...")
            return result("FAILED", "DUNGEON_INVALID_TARGET_WAVE", {stopFeature = true})
        end
        local home = request.homeWorld
        if not Contracts.isHomeWorld(home) then return result("HELD", "DUNGEON_HOME_WORLD_REQUIRED") end
        local legacyEnv = type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv() or _G
        local legacy = legacyEnv and legacyEnv.PlaneRNGPrototypeAutoV1
        if legacy and legacy.Enabled and not legacy.Destroyed then
            return result("DEFERRED", "DUNGEON_LEGACY_RUNNING", {retryAt=os.clock()+10})
        end
        if player:GetAttribute("PrototypeDungeonRun") ~= nil then
            return result("HELD", "DUNGEON_EXISTING_RUN_UNVERIFIED")
        end

        local connections = {}
        local state = {Enabled = true, Destroyed = false, Connections = connections,
            RunId = nil, SoloVerified = false, SoloAttempted = false,
            StartingSolo = false, StartRefusal = nil, Wave = 0, LastClearedWave = 0,
            Stacks = {}, LastOffer = nil, PendingCard = nil, Picks = 0,
            RewardAward = nil, BeforeCheckpointBalance = nil, CheckpointCleared = false,
            LeaveSent = false, ReturnSent = false, TargetWave = target, HomeObserved = false,
            HomeWasAuto = false, HomeAward = false,
            RunsFinished = 0, CycleStart = os.clock(),
            CycleStartBalance = tonumber(player:GetAttribute("Components")) or 0,
            CycleIsPartial = false, NextStartAt = math.huge}
        self.active = state
        context:deferCleanup(function()
            state.Enabled, state.Destroyed = false, true
            for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
                if connection then pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end) end
            end
            table.clear(connections)
            if self.active == state then self.active = nil end
        end)
        local function running()
            return state.Enabled and not state.Destroyed and not context:isCancelled()
        end
        local function clearRun()
            state.RunId, state.SoloVerified, state.StartingSolo = nil, false, false
            state.Wave, state.LastClearedWave = 0, 0
            state.RewardAward, state.CheckpointCleared, state.BeforeCheckpointBalance = nil, false, nil
            state.LeaveSent, state.ReturnSent, state.LeaveAt = false, false, nil
            state.PendingCard, state.LastOffer, state.StartRefusal = nil, nil, nil
            state.Stacks, state.Picks = {}, 0
        end
        local engineCtx = {state=state, SETTINGS={TargetWave=target,
                SoloEnterTimeout=16, RewardConfirmTimeout=20, HomeConfirmTimeout=20},
            config=nativeConfig, remotes=remotes, player=player,
            now=os.clock, isRunning=running, currentRun=function()
                return player:GetAttribute("PrototypeDungeonRun")
            end, components=function() return tonumber(player:GetAttribute("Components")) or 0 end,
            log=log, logWarn=notify, status=function(message)
                state.Status=message
                log("STATUS", message)
                context:reportProgress("DUNGEON_" .. tostring(state.Wave))
            end,
            fail=function(message)
                state.Failed = tostring(message)
                state.Enabled = false
                notify("STABLE_GUARD", state.Failed)
            end,
            clearRunState=clearRun,
            onHome=function(oldRun, byAutomation, award)
                if oldRun then
                    state.HomeObserved = true
                    state.HomeWasAuto = byAutomation == true
                    state.HomeAward = award == true
                    state.CompletedRunId = oldRun
                    log("HOME_EVENT", oldRun, "auto", byAutomation, "award", award)
                end
            end,
            addConnection=function(conn) connections[#connections+1] = conn end}
        engineCtx.AutoCard = AutoCard(engineCtx)
        local engine = StableDungeon(engineCtx)

        log("START", "targetWave", target, "home", home, "scheduler", "P3")
        if not isWorld(4) or player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") == true then
            local travel = services.world:travel(4, context)
            if not travel or not travel.ok then
                -- Only definite non-dispatch/rejection may retry. Ambiguous
                -- travel could arrive late: never start a second transition.
                local code = travel and travel.code or "WORLD_TRAVEL_RESULT_MISSING"
                if code == "DIRECT_WORLD_REJECTED" or code == "DIRECT_WORLD_PREPARE_FAILED"
                    or code == "DIRECT_WORLD_REMOTES_MISSING" then
                    return result("DEFERRED", "DUNGEON_WORLD4_TRAVEL_RETRY", {
                        retryAt = os.clock()+15, evidence=travel})
                end
                return result("HELD", "DUNGEON_WORLD4_TRAVEL_UNVERIFIED", {evidence=travel})
            end
        end
        if not isWorld(4) then
            local confirmed = context:await(function() return isWorld(4) end, 8)
            if not confirmed then return result("HELD", "DUNGEON_WORLD4_UNVERIFIED") end
        end
        local near, why = navigateToVega(context)
        if not near then
            if context:isCancelled() then return result("CANCELLED", "DUNGEON_CANCELLED") end
            return result("DEFERRED", why or "DUNGEON_NPC_RETRY", {retryAt=os.clock()+12})
        end
        if not running() or player:GetAttribute("PrototypeDungeonRun") ~= nil then
            return result("HELD", "DUNGEON_PRE_SOLO_UNVERIFIED")
        end
        context:reportProgress("DUNGEON_ENTER")
        engine.launchSolo()
        if not state.SoloVerified then
            if context:isCancelled() then return result("CANCELLED", "DUNGEON_CANCELLED") end
            if state.StartRefusal and player:GetAttribute("PrototypeDungeonRun") == nil then
                return result("DEFERRED", "DUNGEON_SOLO_REJECTED", {retryAt=os.clock()+20})
            end
            -- Late Enter may still arrive; do not start another Solo on an unknown run.
            return result("HELD", "DUNGEON_SOLO_ENTRY_UNVERIFIED")
        end
        log("SOLO_CONFIRMED", tostring(state.RunId))
        context:reportProgress("DUNGEON_COMBAT")
        local lastProgress, lastWave = os.clock(), -1
        while running() and not state.HomeObserved do
            if state.Wave ~= lastWave then
                lastWave, lastProgress = state.Wave, os.clock()
                if state.Wave % 5 == 0 or state.Wave == target then
                    context:reportProgress("DUNGEON_WAVE_" .. tostring(state.Wave))
                end
            end
            if os.clock() - lastProgress > 360 then
                state.Failed = "DUNGEON_STALLED_NO_WAVE_PROGRESS"
                break
            end
            if not context:wait(0.25) then break end
        end
        if context:isCancelled() then return result("CANCELLED", "DUNGEON_CANCELLED") end
        if not state.HomeObserved then
            -- Never release scheduler ownership after an unverified active run.
            return result("HELD", state.Failed and "DUNGEON_GUARD_FAILED" or "DUNGEON_HOME_MISSING",
                {evidence = state.Failed})
        end
        -- Home is an event, not proof of the native run attribute clearing.
        -- Always record why the scheduler is still owned after an early Home.
        log("HOME_SETTLEMENT_START", "run", tostring(state.CompletedRunId),
            "auto", state.HomeWasAuto, "award", state.HomeAward,
            "nativeRun", tostring(player:GetAttribute("PrototypeDungeonRun")),
            "currentWorld", tostring(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")), "home", home)
        local clear = context:await(function()
            return player:GetAttribute("PrototypeDungeonRun") == nil
        end, 20)
        if not clear then
            if context:isCancelled() then return result("CANCELLED", "DUNGEON_CANCELLED") end
            notify("HOME_NATIVE_RUN_PENDING", tostring(player:GetAttribute("PrototypeDungeonRun")))
            return result("HELD", "DUNGEON_HOME_ATTR_UNVERIFIED")
        end
        log("NATIVE_HOME_VERIFIED", tostring(state.CompletedRunId),
            "world", tostring(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")))

        local snapshot = self.environment.state:snapshot()
        local feature = snapshot and snapshot.features and snapshot.features.DUNGEON
        if feature and feature.enabled == false then
            -- OFF after verified Home must not wait for optional travel to an
            -- earlier world. The server has ended the dungeon and the next
            -- scheduler tick may inspect the now-idle player safely.
            self.nextAt = 0
            log("TOGGLE_OFF_RELEASE", tostring(state.CompletedRunId),
                "targetAward", state.HomeAward, "currentWorld",
                tostring(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")))
            return result("DEFERRED", "DUNGEON_DISABLED_HOME_VERIFIED", {
                retryAt=os.clock()+25,
                evidence={runId=state.CompletedRunId, nativeRunCleared=true,
                    currentWorld=player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"), targetAward=state.HomeAward}})
        end
        context:reportProgress("DUNGEON_RETURN_HOME")
        if not isWorld(home) then
            log("RETURN_START", "from", tostring(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")), "to", home)
            local travel = services.world:travel(home, context, {purpose="RETURN"})
            log("RETURN_RESULT", "ok", tostring(travel and travel.ok),
                "code", tostring(travel and travel.code),
                "world", tostring(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")))
            if context:isCancelled() then return result("CANCELLED", "DUNGEON_CANCELLED") end
            if not travel or not travel.ok or not isWorld(home) then
                notify("RETURN_UNVERIFIED", "target", home,
                    "code", tostring(travel and travel.code))
                return result("HELD", state.HomeAward and "DUNGEON_WORLD_RETURN_UNVERIFIED"
                    or "DUNGEON_EARLY_RETURN_UNVERIFIED", {evidence=travel})
            end
        end
        if not state.HomeWasAuto or not state.HomeAward then
            -- Target was NOT reached. Never credit this as a completed cycle.
            self.nextAt = os.clock()+25
            log("EARLY_END_VERIFIED", tostring(state.CompletedRunId), "retryAfter", 25)
            if settings.totemEnabled then
                self.environment.state:port("scheduler"):schedule("TOTEM", 0)
                if options.totemEvidence and type(options.totemEvidence.refreshAfterDungeon)=="function" then
                    options.totemEvidence:refreshAfterDungeon()
                end
            end
            return result("DEFERRED", "DUNGEON_EARLY_END", {retryAt=self.nextAt})
        end
        self.completed = self.completed + 1
        self.last = {target=target, completedRun=state.CompletedRunId, home=home,
            completedAt=os.clock(), award=true}
        self.nextAt = os.clock() + 3
        log("CYCLE_VERIFIED", "wave", target, "home", home, "completed", self.completed)
        -- P1 re-query must complete before the next P3 selection. An active
        -- server travel cooldown is preserved by State.scheduler:schedule.
        if settings.totemEnabled then
            self.environment.state:port("scheduler"):schedule("TOTEM", 0)
            if options.totemEvidence and type(options.totemEvidence.refreshAfterDungeon) == "function" then
                options.totemEvidence:refreshAfterDungeon()
            end
            log("TOTEM_P1_REFRESH_REQUESTED", "before next Dungeon")
        end
        return result("COMPLETED", "DUNGEON_TARGET_HOME_VERIFIED", {
            stage="RETURN", retryAt=self.nextAt,
            evidence={targetWave=target, runId=state.CompletedRunId, home=home}})
    end
    return obj
end
return Controller

end
-- END MODULE dungeon.ManagedController
-- BEGIN MODULE boss.AC130.AC130
__factories["boss.AC130.AC130"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Register AC-130 in BossManager without altering existing boss definitions.
local Config = require("boss.AC130.Config")
local ArenaObserver = require("boss.AC130.ArenaObserver")
local CommandController = require("boss.AC130.CommandController")
local CombatController = require("boss.AC130.CombatController")
local DodgeController = require("boss.AC130.DodgeController")
local ReportController = require("boss.AC130.ReportController")
local RepeatPolicy = require("boss.AC130.RepeatPolicy")
local AC130 = {}
function AC130.definition()
    return {bossId = Config.bossId, displayName = Config.displayName, create = function(env)
        local observer = ArenaObserver.new(env, Config)
        local dodge = DodgeController.new(env, Config, observer)
        local repeatPolicy = RepeatPolicy.new(env)
        local report = ReportController.new(env, Config, repeatPolicy, dodge)
        return {config = Config, observer = observer, dodge = dodge,
            report = report, repeatPolicy = repeatPolicy,
            command = CommandController.new(env, Config, observer, report),
            combat = CombatController.new(env, Config, observer, report, dodge)}
    end}
end
return AC130
end
-- END MODULE boss.AC130.AC130

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.AC130.ArenaObserver
__factories["boss.AC130.ArenaObserver"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local ArenaObserver = {}
function ArenaObserver.new(env, config)
    local platform = env.services.roblox
    local player, workspace = platform:player(), platform:workspace()
    local observer = {}
    function observer:participating()
        return player:GetAttribute("AC130Participant") == true
    end
    function observer:inArenaPosition()
        local p = platform:position()
        if not p then return false end
        local dx, dz = p.X - config.arenaCenter.x, p.Z - config.arenaCenter.z
        return dx*dx + dz*dz < config.arenaRadius * config.arenaRadius
    end
    function observer:inArena()
        return self:participating() or
            (workspace:GetAttribute("AC130FightActive") == true and self:inArenaPosition()
                and player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true)
    end
    function observer:state()
        return {phase = workspace:GetAttribute("AC130Phase"),
            fightState = workspace:GetAttribute("AC130FightState"),
            active = workspace:GetAttribute("AC130FightActive"),
            participant = player:GetAttribute("AC130Participant"),
            inBossFight = player:GetAttribute("InBossFight")}
    end
    return observer
end
return ArenaObserver
end
-- END MODULE boss.AC130.ArenaObserver

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.AC130.CombatController
__factories["boss.AC130.CombatController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Active suppression avoidance and outcome tracking.
local CombatController = {}
function CombatController.new(env, config, observer, report, dodge)
    local runtime, telemetry = env.runtime, env.services.telemetry
    local combat = {}
    function combat:run(ctx, encounter)
        local watching, why = report:watch(ctx)
        if not watching then return {code = why} end
        dodge:start(ctx)
        local deadline = runtime:now() + config.maxFightSeconds
        local lastKey, lastLog, code = nil, 0, "OUTCOME_NOT_OBSERVED_TIMEOUT"
        while not ctx:isCancelled() and runtime:now() < deadline do
            local evidence = report:inspect()
            if evidence.outcome then code = "OUTCOME_OBSERVED"; break end
            local state = observer:state()
            local key = tostring(state.fightState) .. "/" .. tostring(state.phase) .. "/"
                .. tostring(state.active) .. "/" .. tostring(state.participant)
            if key ~= lastKey or runtime:now() - lastLog > 25 then
                if telemetry then telemetry:emit("AC130_STATE", state) end
                lastKey, lastLog = key, runtime:now()
            end
            if not ctx:wait(0.4) then break end
        end
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return {code = "CANCELLED"} end
        if code == "OUTCOME_OBSERVED" then
            -- Standalone V1 retains gunfire avoidance briefly after death.
            dodge:waitForGunfireClear(ctx)
        end
        return {code = code}
    end
    return combat
end
return CombatController
end
-- END MODULE boss.AC130.CombatController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.AC130.CommandController
__factories["boss.AC130.CommandController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- AC130 standalone V1 flow: Hideout -> Boss Command pass -> ONE Solo -> combat.
-- Adaptive report may open in arena OR after exit; never request return before Continue.
local DirectBossTravel = require("main.navigation.DirectBossTravel")
local CommandController = {}

function CommandController.new(env, config, observer, report)
    local platform, runtime = env.services.roblox, env.runtime
    local player, workspace = platform:player(), platform:workspace()
    local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
    local travel = DirectBossTravel.new(env)
    local command = {}
    local function emit(name, data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit(name, data or {}) end
    end
    local function remote(name)
        local storage = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage")
        local folder = storage:FindFirstChild("Remotes") or storage:WaitForChild("Remotes", 10)
        local item = folder and (folder:FindFirstChild(name) or folder:WaitForChild(name, 7))
        return item and item:IsA("RemoteEvent") and item or nil
    end
    local function active(ctx) return runtime:isActive(ctx) and not ctx:isCancelled() end
    local function cooldownLeft()
        local raw = player:GetAttribute("BossStartCooldowns")
        if type(raw) ~= "string" or raw == "" then return 0 end
        local ok, data = pcall(function() return platform:service("HttpService"):JSONDecode(raw) end)
        if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then return 0 end
        return math.max(0, (tonumber(data[config.gameBossKey]) or 0) - workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
    end

    function command:prepare(ctx)
        local watching, why = report:watch(ctx) -- watch BEFORE sending any boss request
        if not watching then return false, why end
        if observer:inArena() then return true, "AC130_ALREADY_IN_ARENA" end
        if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true then return false, "OTHER_BOSS_ACTIVE" end
        if not active(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        local entered = travel:enterHideout(ctx)
        emit("AC130_DIRECT_HIDEOUT", {ok = entered.ok, code = entered.code, reason = entered.reason})
        if not entered.ok then return false, entered.code end
        local positioned = travel:moveToKnownPoint(ctx, config.commandSafePosition, {
            requireHideout = true, radius = 6, settle = 0.85,
        })
        emit("AC130_COMMAND_POSITION", {ok = positioned.ok, code = positioned.code})
        if not positioned.ok then return false, positioned.code end
        return true, "AC130_COMMAND_READY"
    end

    function command:readiness()
        if observer:inArena() then return "READY" end
        if not travel:inHideout() then return "UNKNOWN" end
        local secs = cooldownLeft()
        if secs > 0 then
            secs = math.ceil(secs)
            return string.format("%d:%02d", math.floor(secs / 60), secs % 60)
        end
        -- The server pass remains authoritative for unlock/eligibility.
        return "READY"
    end

    function command:startSolo(ctx, markAttempt)
        if not active(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        if observer:participating() then return true, "AC130_ALREADY_FIGHTING" end
        if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true then return false, "OTHER_BOSS_ACTIVE" end
        if not travel:inHideout() then return false, "NOT_IN_HIDEOUT" end
        if self:readiness() ~= "READY" then return false, "AC130_NOT_READY" end
        local watching, why = report:watch(ctx)
        if not watching then return false, why end
        local hideout, accept = remote("PersonalHideoutRemote"), remote("AC130CommanderAccept")
        if not hideout or not accept then return false, "AC130_COMMAND_REMOTES_MISSING" end
        local passReply, acceptReply
        local passConnection = hideout.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
            if type(e) == "table" and e.Kind == "BossCommand" and e.Op == "Start"
                and e.BossKey == config.gameBossKey then passReply = e end
        end)
        local acceptConnection = accept.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
            if type(e) == "table" and e.Accepted ~= nil then acceptReply = e end
        end)
        local function finish(ok, code)
            passConnection:Disconnect()
            acceptConnection:Disconnect()
            return ok, code
        end
        local sent, err = pcall(function()
            hideout:FireServer({Action = "StartBoss", BossKey = config.gameBossKey, Solo = true})
        end)
        if not sent then return finish(false, "AC130_PASS_SEND_FAILED: " .. tostring(err)) end
        local gotPass = ctx:await(function() return passReply end, 10)
        if not active(ctx) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
        if not gotPass then return finish(false, "AC130_PASS_TIMEOUT_NO_RETRY") end
        emit("AC130_PASS_RESULT", {ok = gotPass.Ok == true, reason = gotPass.Reason})
        if gotPass.Ok ~= true then return finish(false, "AC130_PASS_REJECTED: " .. tostring(gotPass.Reason)) end
        -- Mark before firing the irreversible Solo request; never blind retry.
        if not markAttempt() then return finish(false, "AC130_SOLO_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED") end
        sent, err = pcall(function() accept:FireServer({Solo = true}) end)
        if not sent then return finish(false, "AC130_SOLO_SEND_FAILED: " .. tostring(err)) end
        local observed = ctx:await(function()
            if acceptReply and acceptReply.Accepted == false then return "REJECTED" end
            if observer:participating() then return "ENTERED" end
        end, config.arenaTimeout)
        if not active(ctx) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
        emit("AC130_SOLO_RESULT", {code = observed or "AMBIGUOUS", accepted = acceptReply and acceptReply.Accepted})
        if observed == "ENTERED" then return finish(true, "AC130_FIGHT_VERIFIED") end
        if observed == "REJECTED" then
            return finish(false, "AC130_SOLO_REJECTED: " .. tostring(acceptReply.Reason))
        end
        return finish(false, "AC130_SOLO_AMBIGUOUS_NO_RETRY")
    end

    function command:close(_) return true end -- No command GUI was opened.

    function command:returnHome(ctx, home)
        if not active(ctx) then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        if type(home) ~= "number" or home < 1 or home % 1 ~= 0 then
            return {ok = false, code = "INVALID_HOME_WORLD"}
        end
        if report:inspect().active then return {ok = false, code = "AC130_REPORT_STILL_OPEN"} end
        -- Preserve standalone V1 lock checks before return, regardless of report location.
        local released = ctx:await(function()
            if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true
                and player:GetAttribute("AC130Participant") ~= true then return true end
        end, config.returnLockTimeoutSeconds)
        if not released then
            emit("AC130_RETURN_LOCK_PENDING", {world = home})
            return {ok = false, code = "AC130_RETURN_LOCK_PENDING", reason = "BossFight"}
        end
        local exit = ctx:await(function()
            if player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") == true then return "BOSS_COMMAND_HIDEOUT" end
            if not observer:inArenaPosition() then return "OUTSIDE_ARENA" end
        end, config.exitTimeoutSeconds)
        emit("AC130_ARENA_EXIT", {code = exit or "LOCK_RELEASED_STILL_IN_ARENA"})
        -- As in tested standalone V1, a released lock permits a direct verified travel even
        -- if the game has not repositioned the player outside the arena yet.
        if not ctx:wait(1.5) then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        local request, prepare, result = remote("RequestWorldTravel"), remote("NavPrepareWorlds"), remote("WorldTravelResult")
        if not request or not prepare then return {ok = false, code = "AC130_WORLD_TRAVEL_REMOTES_MISSING"} end
        local position = platform:position()
        if not position then return {ok = false, code = "CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE"} end
        if tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")) == home
            and player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") ~= true
            and not observer:inArenaPosition() then
            return {ok = true, code = "ALREADY_IN_HOME", world = home}
        end
        local reply
        local connection = result and result.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
            if type(e) == "table" and e.Kind == "Result" and tonumber(e.WorldId) == home then reply = e end
        end) or nil
        local function finish(ok, code, reason)
            if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
            emit("AC130_DIRECT_RETURN", {ok = ok, code = code, reason = reason, world = home})
            return {ok = ok, code = code, reason = reason, world = home}
        end
        for attempt = 1, config.returnRetries do
            if not active(ctx) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            reply = nil
            local prior = platform:position()
            if not prior then return finish(false, "CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE") end
            local sent, err = pcall(function() prepare:FireServer("stream", home) end)
            if not sent then return finish(false, "WORLD_PREPARE_SEND_FAILED", tostring(err)) end
            if not ctx:wait(0.12) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            sent, err = pcall(function() request:FireServer(home) end)
            if not sent then return finish(false, "WORLD_REQUEST_SEND_FAILED", tostring(err)) end
            local observed = ctx:await(function()
                if reply and reply.Ok == false then return "REJECTED" end
                local current = platform:position()
                if current and platform:distance(current, prior) > 50
                    and tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")) == home
                    and player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") ~= true
                    and player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true
                    and not observer:inArenaPosition() then return "VERIFIED" end
            end, 17)
            emit("AC130_RETURN_ATTEMPT", {attempt = attempt, code = observed or "AMBIGUOUS",
                reason = reply and reply.Reason})
            if observed == "VERIFIED" then return finish(true, "AC130_HOME_VERIFIED") end
            if observed ~= "REJECTED" then return finish(false, "AC130_RETURN_AMBIGUOUS_NO_RETRY") end
            local why = tostring(reply.Reason or "UNKNOWN")
            if why ~= "BossFight" or attempt == config.returnRetries then
                return finish(false, "AC130_WORLD_RETURN_REJECTED", why)
            end
            if not ctx:wait(12) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            local settled = ctx:await(function()
                if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true then return true end
            end, 40)
            if not settled then return finish(false, "AC130_LOCK_STILL_ACTIVE", "BossFight") end
        end
        return finish(false, "AC130_WORLD_RETURN_EXHAUSTED")
    end
    return command
end
return CommandController
end
-- END MODULE boss.AC130.CommandController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.AC130.Config
__factories["boss.AC130.Config"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- AC-130 Spectre / World 48, ported from confirmed standalone AC130 V1.
-- Gun/Burst aim samples are NOT guaranteed bullet impact coordinates.
return {
    bossId = "AC130", displayName = "AC-130 Spectre", gameBossKey = "AC130",
    arenaCenter = {x = 16384, y = 2, z = -16385}, arenaRadius = 380,
    arenaFloorY = 2.5,
    commandSafePosition = {x = -31962.1074, y = 344.357483, z = 32887.3203},
    arenaTimeout = 48, maxFightSeconds = 1020,
    reportTimeoutSeconds = 110, reportHoldSeconds = 3,
    reportCloseTimeoutSeconds = 125, exitTimeoutSeconds = 85,
    returnLockTimeoutSeconds = 80, returnRetries = 3,
    autoDodge = true, dodgeMargin = 18, dodgeMinInterval = 1.5,
    dodgeMaxStep = 110, dodgeLookaheadSeconds = 7,
    dodgeGunfireClearTimeoutSeconds = 4.5,
}
end
-- END MODULE boss.AC130.Config

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.AC130.DodgeController
__factories["boss.AC130.DodgeController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- AC-130 standalone V1 suppression dodge port.
-- Gun/Burst targeting is heuristic, not authoritative bullet impact coordinates.
local DodgeController = {}
function DodgeController.new(env, config, observer)
    local runtime, platform = env.runtime, env.services.roblox
    local player, workspace = platform:player(), platform:workspace()
    local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
    local riftHazards = env.services.riftHazards
    local center = Vector3.new(config.arenaCenter.x, config.arenaCenter.y, config.arenaCenter.z)
    local floorY = config.arenaFloorY
    local radii = {Gun25 = 5.5, Gun40 = 15, Gun105 = 27}
    local threats = {clockT0=nil, tracks={}, points={}, moves=0, burstCount=0,
        nextWarn=0, lastMove=-math.huge, lastGate=nil, lastGateAt=-math.huge,
        gateCounts={}, active=0, lastClearance=nil}
    local controller, runningContext = {}, nil
    local completed = false
    local function emit(kind, data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit("AC130_" .. kind, data or {}) end
    end
    local function root()
        local ch = player.Character
        return ch, ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    end
    local function horizontal(a,b)
        local dx,dz=a.X-b.X, a.Z-b.Z
        return math.sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz)
    end
    local function inArena(pos)
        return pos and horizontal(pos,center) < config.arenaRadius - 12
            and pos.Y > floorY - 27 and pos.Y < floorY + 170
    end
    local function gate(reason, details)
        threats.lastGate=reason
        threats.gateCounts[reason]=(threats.gateCounts[reason] or 0)+1
        local now=os.clock()
        if threats.lastReportedGate==reason and now-threats.lastGateAt<3.5 then return end
        threats.lastReportedGate,threats.lastGateAt=reason,now
        local data=details or {}
        data.reason,data.tracked=reason,#threats.points
        emit("DODGE_GATE",data)
    end
    local function addThreat(pos,gun,first,last,source)
        if typeof(pos)~="Vector3" then return false end
        if horizontal(pos,center) >= config.arenaRadius+35 then return false end
        threats.points[#threats.points+1]={pos=pos,radius=radii[gun] or 15,
            startTau=first,stopTau=last,source=source,gun=gun}
        return true
    end
    local function hitPoint(v)
        if typeof(v)=="Vector3" then return v end
        if type(v)=="table" then
            for _,key in ipairs({"P","Point","Aim","Position"}) do
                if typeof(v[key])=="Vector3" then return v[key] end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function currentTau()
        if type(threats.clockT0)~="number" then return nil end
        return workspace:GetServerTimeNow()-threats.clockT0
    end
    local function onBurst(e)
        if type(e.Gun)~="string" or not radii[e.Gun] or e.NoDamage==true then return end
        threats.burstCount=threats.burstCount+1
        local tau=currentTau() or 0
        local first=tonumber(e.T0) or tau
        first=first+(tonumber(e.Offset) or 0)*(tonumber(e.Interval) or 0.1)
        local last=first+math.clamp(tonumber(e.Count) or 1,1,80)
            *math.clamp(tonumber(e.Interval) or 0.1,0.01,2)
        if first>tau+30 or last<tau-8 then
            emit("BURST_CLOCK_UNKNOWN",{gun=e.Gun,first=first,tau=tau})
            first,last=tau,tau+3
        end
        local count=0
        if type(e.Points)=="table" then
            for _,v in pairs(e.Points) do
                if count>=24 then break end
                local p=hitPoint(v)
                if p and addThreat(p,e.Gun,first-1,last+3,"AIM") then count=count+1 end
            end
        end
        local track=threats.tracks[e.Gun]
        local trackedSelf=track and track.userId==player.UserId and track.mode=="Track"
            and os.clock()-track.seenAt<8
        if trackedSelf then
            local _,hrp=root()
            if hrp and inArena(hrp.Position) then
                if addThreat(hrp.Position,e.Gun,first-0.5,last+2.5,"TRACK_SELF") then
                    count=count+1
                end
            end
        end
        if threats.burstCount<=8 or threats.burstCount%10==0 or count>0 then
            emit("DODGE_BURST",{gun=e.Gun,count=e.Count,points=count,
                directSamples=type(e.Points)=="table" and #e.Points or 0,
                trackedSelf=trackedSelf==true,first=first,last=last,tau=tau,
                noDamage=e.NoDamage})
        end
        if #threats.points>450 then
            local newest={}
            for i=math.max(1,#threats.points-310),#threats.points do
                newest[#newest+1]=threats.points[i]
            end
            threats.points=newest
        end
    end
    local function threatsNow()
        local tau=currentTau() or 0
        local active={}
        for i=#threats.points,1,-1 do
            local v=threats.points[i]
            if v.stopTau<tau-0.7 then table.remove(threats.points,i)
            elseif v.startTau<=tau+config.dodgeLookaheadSeconds
                and v.stopTau>=tau-0.3 then
                active[#active+1]=v
            end
        end
        -- On-foot Rift Strikes use the native AC-130 safe-ground planner.
        if riftHazards and type(riftHazards.groundFootprints)=="function" then
            local ok,spots=pcall(riftHazards.groundFootprints,riftHazards,config.dodgeLookaheadSeconds)
            if ok and type(spots)=="table" then
                local ch,rootPart=root()
                for _,spot in ipairs(spots) do
                    if rootPart and typeof(spot.p)=="Vector3" and type(spot.r)=="number"
                        and math.abs(rootPart.Position.Y-spot.p.Y)<=32 then
                        active[#active+1]={pos=spot.p,radius=spot.r,gun="RIFT",
                            source=spot.name or "RIFT_STRIKE"}
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        threats.active=#active
        return active,tau
    end
    local function clearance(pos,active)
        local best=math.huge
        for _,hazard in ipairs(active) do
            local d=horizontal(pos,hazard.pos)-hazard.radius-config.dodgeMargin
            if d<best then best=d end
        end
        return best
    end
    local function groundAt(ch,x,z)
        local loc=Vector3.new(x,floorY,z)
        if horizontal(loc,center)>config.arenaRadius-35 then return nil end
        local rp=RaycastParams.new()
        rp.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        rp.FilterDescendantsInstances={ch}
        rp.IgnoreWater=true
        local hit=workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(x,floorY+125,z),Vector3.new(0,-180,0),rp)
        if not hit or not hit.Instance.CanCollide or hit.Normal.Y<0.7 then return nil end
        if math.abs(hit.Position.Y-floorY)>13 then return nil end
        return Vector3.new(x,hit.Position.Y+3.5,z)
    end
    local function safePosition(ch,pos,active)
        local best,score,bestGap=nil,-math.huge,-math.huge
        for _,dist in ipairs({28,45,65,85,110,145,config.dodgeMaxStep}) do
            if dist<=config.dodgeMaxStep then
                for i=0,15 do
                    local angle=(2*math.pi*i)/16
                    local x,z=pos.X+dist*math.cos(angle),pos.Z+dist*math.sin(angle)
                    local gap=clearance(Vector3.new(x,pos.Y,z),active)
                    if gap>3 then
                        local val=math.min(gap,90)*0.5-dist*0.12
                        if val>score then
                            local grounded=groundAt(ch,x,z)
                            if grounded then best,score,bestGap=grounded,val,gap end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return best,bestGap
    end
    local function dodgeStep(ctx)
        if ctx:isCancelled() or not config.autoDodge then return end
        local ch,hrp=root()
        if not ch or not hrp then gate("NO_CHARACTER");return end
        if not inArena(hrp.Position) then gate("OUTSIDE_ARENA",{y=math.floor(hrp.Position.Y)});return end
        if not observer:participating() and player:GetAttribute("InBossFight")~=true then
            if not completed then gate("NOT_PARTICIPATING");return end
        end
        if player:GetAttribute("BossResultsOpen")==true then
            gate("REPORT_OPEN_NO_MOVE");return
        end
        local active,tau=threatsNow()
        if not tau then gate("CLOCK_NOT_READY");return end
        if #active==0 then gate("NO_IMMINENT_BURST",{tau=math.floor(tau)});return end
        local gap=clearance(hrp.Position,active)
        threats.lastClearance=math.floor(gap*10)/10
        if gap>0 then gate("SAFE_POSITION",{clearance=threats.lastClearance,active=#active});return end
        if os.clock()-threats.lastMove<config.dodgeMinInterval then return end
        local target,safeGap=safePosition(ch,hrp.Position,active)
        if not target then gate("NO_SAFE_GROUND",{active=#active});return end
        threats.lastMove=os.clock()
        local original=hrp.Position
        gate("MOVE_ATTEMPT",{gun=active[1].gun,source=active[1].source,active=#active})
        local ok,why=pcall(function()
            ch:PivotTo(CFrame.new(target)*(hrp.CFrame-hrp.Position))
        end)
        if not ok then emit("DODGE_ERROR",{reason=tostring(why)});return end
        if not ctx:wait(0.12) then return end
        local _,after=root()
        local verified=after and horizontal(after.Position,target)<10
        if verified then threats.moves=threats.moves+1 end
        emit("DODGE_MOVE",{verified=verified==true,
            distance=math.floor(horizontal(original,target)),
            clearance=threats.lastClearance,safeClearance=math.floor(safeGap*10)/10,
            source=active[1].source,gun=active[1].gun,active=#active})
    end
    function controller:observe(e)
        if type(e)~="table" or type(e.K)~="string" then return end
        local k=e.K
        if (k=="Launch" or k=="Resync" or k=="Session" or k=="Begin")
            and type(e.T0)=="number" then
            if not threats.clockT0 or k=="Resync" then
                threats.clockT0=e.T0
                emit("DODGE_CLOCK",{source=k,t0=e.T0})
            end
        end
        if k=="Gun" then
            local name=tostring(e.Gun or "")
            if radii[name] then
                threats.tracks[name]={mode=e.Mode,userId=e.UserId,seenAt=os.clock(),point=e.Point}
                emit("GUN_TRACK",{gun=name,mode=e.Mode,trackedSelf=e.UserId==player.UserId,
                    point=typeof(e.Point)=="Vector3"})
            end
        elseif k=="Burst" then
            onBurst(e)
        elseif k=="Outcome" then
            completed=true
        end
    end
    function controller:start(ctx)
        if not config.autoDodge or runningContext==ctx then return end
        runningContext=ctx
        ctx:deferCleanup(function()
            if runningContext==ctx then runningContext=nil end
        end)
        task.spawn(function()
            while runningContext==ctx and runtime:isActive(ctx) and not ctx:isCancelled() do
                local ok,why=pcall(dodgeStep,ctx)
                if not ok and os.clock()-threats.nextWarn>2 then
                    threats.nextWarn=os.clock()
                    emit("DODGE_SCAN_ERROR",{reason=tostring(why)})
                end
                task.wait(0.15)
            end
        end)
    end
    function controller:waitForGunfireClear(ctx)
        if not config.autoDodge or #threats.points==0 then return end
        local active=threatsNow()
        if #active==0 then return end
        emit("GUNFIRE_CLEAR_WAIT",{active=#active})
        local deadline=runtime:now()+config.dodgeGunfireClearTimeoutSeconds
        while not ctx:isCancelled() and runtime:now()<deadline do
            local current=threatsNow()
            if #current==0 then return end
            if not ctx:wait(0.2) then break end
        end
        emit("GUNFIRE_CLEAR_TIMEOUT",{note="Continue report; dodge remains active"})
    end
    function controller:reset()
        if runningContext then return false,"DODGE_ACTIVE" end
        threats.clockT0,threats.tracks,threats.points=nil,{},{}
        threats.moves,threats.burstCount,threats.active=0,0,0
        threats.lastMove,threats.nextWarn=-math.huge,0
        threats.lastGate,threats.lastReportedGate,threats.lastGateAt=nil,nil,-math.huge
        threats.gateCounts={}
        completed=false
        return true
    end
    function controller:status()
        return {tracked=#threats.points,active=threats.active,moves=threats.moves,
            burstCount=threats.burstCount,lastGate=threats.lastGate,
            gateCounts=threats.gateCounts,lastClearance=threats.lastClearance}
    end
    return controller
end
return DodgeController
end
-- END MODULE boss.AC130.DodgeController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.AC130.RepeatPolicy
__factories["boss.AC130.RepeatPolicy"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local SharedRepeatPolicy = require("boss.shared.RepeatPolicy")
local RepeatPolicy = {}
function RepeatPolicy.new(env)
    return SharedRepeatPolicy.new(env, "Expected confirmed AC130 outcome")
end
return RepeatPolicy
end
-- END MODULE boss.AC130.RepeatPolicy

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.AC130.ReportController
__factories["boss.AC130.ReportController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local DeferredOutcome = require("boss.shared.DeferredOutcome")
-- AC130 adaptive report: Outcome -> report (any location) -> Continue -> exit -> return.
-- Port of standalone V1; never treat Outcome alone as a completed report.
local ReportController = {}

function ReportController.new(env, config, repeatPolicy, dodge)
    local platform, gui, runtime = env.services.roblox, env.services.gui, env.runtime
    local player = platform:player()
    local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
    local writer = env.state:port("boss")
    local report = {}
    local terminal = DeferredOutcome.new(env, config.bossId, "AC130FightGeneration")
    local confirmedOutcome, outcomeAt = nil, nil
    local lastHealthAt = 0
    local seenReport, firstOpenedAt = false, nil
    local listeningContext, connection, resultsController = nil, nil, nil
    local function emit(name, data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit(name, data or {}) end
    end
    local function loadController()
        if resultsController then return resultsController end
        local folder = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("ClientModules")
        local mod = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("BossResultsController")
        if not mod or not mod:IsA("ModuleScript") then return nil end
        -- The build bundler replaces project requires. Invoke Roblox require only
        -- dynamically for the game's own ModuleScript, as the B21 controller does.
        local loader = getfenv(0)["require"]
        local ok, value = pcall(loader, mod)
        if not ok or type(value) ~= "table" then return nil end
        if type(value.IsOpen) ~= "function" or type(value.Dismiss) ~= "function" then return nil end
        resultsController = value
        return value
    end
    local function officialOpen()
        local ctrl = loadController()
        if ctrl and type(ctrl.IsOpen) == "function" then
            local ok, result = pcall(ctrl.IsOpen)
            if ok and result == true then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function isOpen()
        return player:GetAttribute("BossResultsOpen") == true or officialOpen()
    end
    local function matchingReport(guiRoot)
        if not guiRoot then return nil end
        local isAC130, won, lost = false, false, false
        for _, node in ipairs(guiRoot:GetDescendants()) do
            if node:IsA("TextLabel") then
                local value = string.upper(tostring(node.Text or ""))
                if value:find("AC-130", 1, true) or value:find("AC130", 1, true)
                    or value:find("SPECTRE", 1, true) then isAC130 = true end
                if value:find("DEFEATED", 1, true) or value:find("VICTORY", 1, true) then won = true end
                if value:find("MISSION FAILED", 1, true) then lost = true end
            end
        end
        if isAC130 and won ~= lost then return won and "WIN" or "LOSS" end
        return nil
    end

    function report:watch(ctx)
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        if listeningContext == ctx and connection then return true end
        if connection then connection:Disconnect(); connection = nil end
        local folder = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        local remote = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("AC130Event")
        if not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then return false, "AC130_EVENT_MISSING" end
        local current = remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(packet)
            if type(packet) ~= "table" or type(packet.K) ~= "string" then return end
            terminal:observe(packet)
            -- Event listener is active before Solo; read gun targeting and bursts before combat loop.
            dodge:observe(packet)
            local kind = packet.K
            if kind == "Outcome" and type(packet.Victory) == "boolean" then
                confirmedOutcome = packet.Victory and "WIN" or "LOSS"
                outcomeAt = runtime:now()
            end
            if kind == "Start" or kind == "Begin" or kind == "Phase" or kind == "Attack"
                or kind == "Gun" or kind == "Burst" or kind == "Death" or kind == "Resync" or kind == "Health" or kind == "Escorts"
                or kind == "End" or kind == "Outcome" then
                if kind == "Burst" or kind == "Gun" then
                    -- DodgeController emits compact suppression diagnostics.
                    return
                end
                if kind == "Health" then
                    if runtime:now() - lastHealthAt < 4 then return end
                    lastHealthAt = runtime:now()
                end
                local detail = {kind = kind}
                for _, field in ipairs({"Phase", "Name", "Reason", "EndReason", "Victory",
                    "Kind", "State", "Index", "From", "To", "HP", "MaxHP", "Generation"}) do
                    local value = packet[field]
                    if type(value) == "string" or type(value) == "number" or type(value) == "boolean" then
                        detail[field] = value
                    end
                end
                if kind == "Gun" or kind == "Burst" then
                    detail.gun = packet.Gun
                    detail.mode = packet.Mode
                    detail.count = packet.Count
                    detail.noDamage = packet.NoDamage
                    detail.samples = type(packet.Points) == "table" and #packet.Points or nil
                elseif kind == "Escorts" then
                    detail.units = type(packet.Units) == "table" and #packet.Units or nil
                end
                emit("AC130_EVENT", detail)
            end
        end)
        connection, listeningContext = current, ctx
        ctx:deferCleanup(function()
            if connection == current then
                current:Disconnect()
                connection, listeningContext = nil, nil
            end
        end)
        return true
    end
    function report:cleanup()
        if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
        connection, listeningContext = nil, nil
        -- Keep outcome and report evidence across RETURN/REPORT retries.
    end
    function report:verifiedDeferredOutcome(encounter)
        return terminal:verified(encounter, "LOSS")
    end
    function report:resetOutcome()
        terminal:reset()
        confirmedOutcome, outcomeAt, seenReport, firstOpenedAt = nil, nil, false, nil
        dodge:reset()
    end
    function report:inspect()
        local root = gui:find(env.profile.paths.bossReport)
        local active = isOpen() -- Same verified V2 signal: BossResultsOpen or official controller.IsOpen()
        if active then
            seenReport = true
            firstOpenedAt = firstOpenedAt or runtime:now()
        end
        local guiOutcome = active and matchingReport(root) or nil
        local outcome = confirmedOutcome or guiOutcome
        return {
            active = active, matchesBoss = confirmedOutcome ~= nil or guiOutcome ~= nil,
            outcome = outcome, report = root, seen = seenReport,
            pendingPresentation = confirmedOutcome ~= nil and not seenReport
                and outcomeAt ~= nil and runtime:now() - outcomeAt < config.reportTimeoutSeconds,
        }
    end
    function report:reconcile(encounter)
        local evidence = self:inspect()
        if evidence.matchesBoss and evidence.outcome
            and (not encounter.outcome or encounter.outcome == evidence.outcome) then return true end
        return encounter.outcome ~= nil and seenReport and not evidence.active
    end
    function report:resolve(ctx, encounter)
        local watching, why = self:watch(ctx)
        if not watching then return {ok = false, code = why} end
        -- V2 REQUIREMENT: Outcome alone never authorizes return/Continue.
        local evidence = ctx:await(function()
            local current = self:inspect()
            if current.active and current.matchesBoss and current.outcome then return current end
            if seenReport and not current.active and (encounter.outcome or current.outcome) then
                return current -- manually dismissed report after previously observing it
            end
        end, config.reportTimeoutSeconds)
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        if not evidence then return {ok = false, code = "AC130_REPORT_NOT_OBSERVED"} end
        if evidence.outcome and encounter.outcome and evidence.outcome ~= encounter.outcome then
            return {ok = false, held = true, code = "BOSS_OUTCOME_CONFLICT"}
        end
        local outcome = evidence.outcome or encounter.outcome
        if not outcome then return {ok = false, code = "AC130_OUTCOME_UNVERIFIED"} end
        if not encounter.outcome then
            local accepted = writer:recordBossReport(outcome,
                runtime:epoch() + repeatPolicy:outcomeDelay(outcome))
            if not accepted then return {ok = false, held = true, code = "BOSS_OUTCOME_CONFLICT"} end
            encounter = env.state:snapshot().boss.encounter
        end
        if not evidence.active then
            writer:closeReport()
            return {ok = true, code = "AC130_REPORT_MANUALLY_CLOSED"}
        end
        local at = platform:position()
        local place = player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") == true and "HIDEOUT" or "OTHER"
        if place == "OTHER" and at then
            local dx, dz = at.X - config.arenaCenter.x, at.Z - config.arenaCenter.z
            if dx * dx + dz * dz < config.arenaRadius * config.arenaRadius then
                place = "ARENA"
            end
        end
        emit("AC130_REPORT_OPEN", {outcome = outcome, location = place,
            inBossFight = player:GetAttribute("InBossFight")})
        local controller = loadController()
        if not controller then return {ok = false, code = "AC130_RESULT_CONTROLLER_MISSING_MANUAL_CONTINUE"} end
        if not encounter.continueAttempted then
            local ready = ctx:await(function()
                if not isOpen() then return "MANUALLY_CLOSED" end
                local armed = false
                if type(controller.Debug) == "function" then
                    local ok, message = pcall(controller.Debug)
                    armed = ok and type(message) == "string"
                        and message:find("armed=true", 1, true) ~= nil
                end
                if armed and firstOpenedAt
                    and runtime:now() - firstOpenedAt >= config.reportHoldSeconds then return "ARMED" end
            end, config.reportTimeoutSeconds)
            if ctx:isCancelled() then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
            if ready == "MANUALLY_CLOSED" then
                writer:closeReport()
                return {ok = true, code = "AC130_REPORT_MANUALLY_CLOSED"}
            end
            if ready ~= "ARMED" then return {ok = false, code = "AC130_REPORT_NOT_ARMED_MANUAL_CONTINUE"} end
            if not writer:markContinueAttempt() then return {ok = false, code = "AC130_CONTINUE_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED"} end
            local sent, err = pcall(function() controller.Dismiss("continue") end)
            if not sent then return {ok = false, code = "AC130_CONTINUE_FAILED: " .. tostring(err)} end
            emit("AC130_REPORT_CONTINUE", {code = "CONTINUE_REQUESTED"})
        end
        local closed = ctx:await(function() if not self:inspect().active then return true end end,
            config.reportCloseTimeoutSeconds)
        if not closed then return {ok = false, code = "AC130_REPORT_STILL_OPEN_MANUAL_CONTINUE"} end
        writer:closeReport()
        return {ok = true, code = "AC130_REPORT_CLOSED"}
    end
    return report
end
return ReportController
end
-- END MODULE boss.AC130.ReportController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.AirRaid.AirRaid
__factories["boss.AirRaid.AirRaid"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local Config=require("boss.AirRaid.Config")
local ArenaObserver=require("boss.AirRaid.ArenaObserver")
local StationController=require("boss.AirRaid.StationController")
local CommandController=require("boss.AirRaid.CommandController")
local CombatController=require("boss.AirRaid.CombatController")
