local ReportController=require("boss.AirRaid.ReportController")
local RepeatPolicy=require("boss.AirRaid.RepeatPolicy")
local AirRaid={}
function AirRaid.definition()
    return {bossId=Config.bossId,displayName=Config.displayName,create=function(env)
        local observer=ArenaObserver.new(env,Config)
        local stations=StationController.new(env,Config,observer)
        local repeatPolicy=RepeatPolicy.new(env)
        local report=ReportController.new(env,Config,repeatPolicy,stations)
        return {config=Config,observer=observer,stations=stations,report=report,
            repeatPolicy=repeatPolicy,
            command=CommandController.new(env,Config,observer,report),
            combat=CombatController.new(env,Config,observer,report,stations)}
    end}
end
return AirRaid
end
-- END MODULE boss.AirRaid.AirRaid

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.AirRaid.ArenaObserver
__factories["boss.AirRaid.ArenaObserver"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local ArenaObserver = {}
function ArenaObserver.new(env, config)
    local platform = env.services.roblox
    local player, workspace = platform:player(), platform:workspace()
    local observer = {}
    function observer:participating() return player:GetAttribute("AirRaidParticipant") == true end
    function observer:inArenaPosition(pos)
        pos = pos or platform:position()
        if typeof(pos) ~= "Vector3" then return false end
        local dx, dz = pos.X - config.arenaCenter.x, pos.Z - config.arenaCenter.z
        return dx*dx + dz*dz < (config.arenaRadius + 55)^2
            and pos.Y > config.arenaMinY and pos.Y < config.arenaMaxY
    end
    function observer:inArena()
        return self:participating() or
            (workspace:GetAttribute("AirRaidFightActive") == true
                and player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true and self:inArenaPosition())
    end
    function observer:state()
        return {phase=workspace:GetAttribute("AirRaidStage"),
            fightState=workspace:GetAttribute("AirRaidFightState"),
            active=workspace:GetAttribute("AirRaidFightActive"),
            participant=player:GetAttribute("AirRaidParticipant"),
            inBossFight=player:GetAttribute("InBossFight")}
    end
    return observer
end
return ArenaObserver
end
-- END MODULE boss.AirRaid.ArenaObserver

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.AirRaid.CombatController
__factories["boss.AirRaid.CombatController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local CombatController={}
function CombatController.new(env, config, observer, report, stations)
    local runtime=env.runtime
    local telemetry=env.services.telemetry
    local combat={}
    function combat:nativeEncounter() return report:nativeEncounter() end
    function combat:ownedNativeGeneration() return report:ownedNativeGeneration() end
    local function emit(name,data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit("AIRRAID_"..name,data or {}) end
    end
    function combat:run(ctx,encounter)
        local watching,why=report:watch(ctx)
        if not watching then return {code=why} end
        stations:start(ctx)
        local deadline=runtime:now()+config.maxFightSeconds
        local previous,lastLog=nil,0
        local code="OUTCOME_NOT_OBSERVED_TIMEOUT"
        while not ctx:isCancelled() and runtime:now()<deadline do
            if report:inspect().outcome then code="OUTCOME_OBSERVED";break end
            local state=observer:state()
            local key=tostring(state.fightState).."/"..tostring(state.phase)
                .."/"..tostring(state.active).."/"..tostring(state.participant)
            if key~=previous or runtime:now()-lastLog>25 then
                emit("STATE",state);previous,lastLog=key,runtime:now()
            end
            if not ctx:wait(.4) then break end
        end
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return {code="CANCELLED"} end
        emit("DEFENCE_SUMMARY",stations:status())
        return {code=code}
    end
    return combat
end
return CombatController
end
-- END MODULE boss.AirRaid.CombatController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.AirRaid.CommandController
__factories["boss.AirRaid.CommandController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- AirRaid standalone V1 flow: Hideout -> Boss Command pass -> ONE Solo -> combat.
-- Adaptive report may open in arena OR after exit; never request return before Continue.
local DirectBossTravel = require("main.navigation.DirectBossTravel")
local NativeBossEntry = require("boss.shared.NativeBossEntry")
local CommandController = {}

function CommandController.new(env, config, observer, report)
    local platform, runtime = env.services.roblox, env.runtime
    local player, workspace = platform:player(), platform:workspace()
    local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
    local travel = DirectBossTravel.new(env)
    local command = {}
    local function emit(name, data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit(name, data or {}) end
    end
    local function remote(name)
        local storage = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage")
        local folder = storage:FindFirstChild("Remotes") or storage:WaitForChild("Remotes", 10)
        local item = folder and (folder:FindFirstChild(name) or folder:WaitForChild(name, 7))
        return item and item:IsA("RemoteEvent") and item or nil
    end
    local function active(ctx) return runtime:isActive(ctx) and not ctx:isCancelled() end
    local function cooldownLeft()
        local raw = player:GetAttribute("BossStartCooldowns")
        if type(raw) ~= "string" or raw == "" then return 0 end
        local ok, data = pcall(function() return platform:service("HttpService"):JSONDecode(raw) end)
        if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then return 0 end
        return math.max(0, (tonumber(data[config.gameBossKey]) or 0) - workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
    end

    function command:prepare(ctx)
        if observer:inArena() then return true, "AirRaid_ALREADY_IN_ARENA" end
        if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true then return false, "OTHER_BOSS_ACTIVE" end
        if not active(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        -- V3: wait for AirRaid cooldown BEFORE issuing Boss Command requests.
        local left = cooldownLeft()
        if left > 0 and config.waitForCooldown then
            if left > config.maxCooldownWaitSeconds then
                emit("AirRaid_COOLDOWN_GATE", {remaining = math.ceil(left), code = "WAIT_LIMIT"})
                return false, "AirRaid_COOLDOWN_ABOVE_WAIT_LIMIT"
            end
            emit("AirRaid_COOLDOWN_WAIT", {remaining = math.ceil(left)})
            local untilTime = runtime:now() + config.maxCooldownWaitSeconds
            local lastTick = runtime:now()
            while active(ctx) and cooldownLeft() > 0 and runtime:now() < untilTime do
                if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true then
                    return false, "OTHER_ENCOUNTER_BECAME_ACTIVE"
                end
                if runtime:now() - lastTick >= 25 then
                    lastTick = runtime:now()
                    emit("AirRaid_COOLDOWN_WAITING", {remaining = math.ceil(cooldownLeft())})
                end
                if not ctx:wait(math.min(3, math.max(0.5, cooldownLeft()))) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
            end
            if not active(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
            if cooldownLeft() > 0 then return false, "AirRaid_COOLDOWN_WAIT_LIMIT_REACHED" end
            emit("AirRaid_COOLDOWN_READY", {remaining = 0})
        end
        local entered = travel:enterHideout(ctx)
        emit("AirRaid_DIRECT_HIDEOUT", {ok = entered.ok, code = entered.code, reason = entered.reason})
        if not entered.ok then return false, entered.code end
        local positioned = travel:moveToKnownPoint(ctx, config.commandSafePosition, {
            requireHideout = true, radius = 6, settle = 0.85,
        })
        emit("AirRaid_COMMAND_POSITION", {ok = positioned.ok, code = positioned.code})
        if not positioned.ok then return false, positioned.code end
        return true, "AirRaid_COMMAND_READY"
    end

    function command:readiness()
        if observer:inArena() then return "READY" end
        if not travel:inHideout() then return "UNKNOWN" end
        local secs = cooldownLeft()
        if secs > 0 then
            secs = math.ceil(secs)
            return string.format("%d:%02d", math.floor(secs / 60), secs % 60)
        end
        -- The server pass remains authoritative for unlock/eligibility.
        return "READY"
    end

    local entry = NativeBossEntry.new(env, config, observer, report, "AirRaidCommanderAccept", remote)
    function command:entryStatus() return entry:status() end
    function command:combatStarted() report.entry:combatStarted() end

    function command:startSolo(ctx, markAttempt)
        if not active(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        if observer:participating() then return false, "BOSS_ENTRY_PREEXISTING_PARTICIPATION" end
        if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true then return false, "OTHER_BOSS_ACTIVE" end
        if not travel:inHideout() then return false, "NOT_IN_HIDEOUT" end
        if self:readiness() ~= "READY" then return false, "AirRaid_NOT_READY" end
        local watching, why = report:watch(ctx)
        if not watching then return false, why end
        return entry:start(ctx, markAttempt)
    end

    function command:close(_) return true end -- No command GUI was opened.

    function command:returnHome(ctx, home)
        if not active(ctx) then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        if type(home) ~= "number" or home < 1 or home % 1 ~= 0 then
            return {ok = false, code = "INVALID_HOME_WORLD"}
        end
        if report:inspect().active then return {ok = false, code = "AirRaid_REPORT_STILL_OPEN"} end
        -- Preserve standalone V1 lock checks before return, regardless of report location.
        local released = ctx:await(function()
            if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true
                and player:GetAttribute("AirRaidParticipant") ~= true then return true end
        end, config.returnLockTimeoutSeconds)
        if not released then
            emit("AirRaid_RETURN_LOCK_PENDING", {world = home})
            return {ok = false, code = "AirRaid_RETURN_LOCK_PENDING", reason = "BossFight"}
        end
        local exit = ctx:await(function()
            if player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") == true then return "BOSS_COMMAND_HIDEOUT" end
            if not observer:inArenaPosition() then return "OUTSIDE_ARENA" end
        end, config.exitTimeoutSeconds)
        emit("AirRaid_ARENA_EXIT", {code = exit or "LOCK_RELEASED_STILL_IN_ARENA"})
        -- As in tested standalone V1, a released lock permits a direct verified travel even
        -- if the game has not repositioned the player outside the arena yet.
        if not ctx:wait(1.5) then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        local request, prepare, result = remote("RequestWorldTravel"), remote("NavPrepareWorlds"), remote("WorldTravelResult")
        if not request or not prepare then return {ok = false, code = "AirRaid_WORLD_TRAVEL_REMOTES_MISSING"} end
        local position = platform:position()
        if not position then return {ok = false, code = "CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE"} end
        if tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")) == home
            and player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") ~= true
            and not observer:inArenaPosition() then
            return {ok = true, code = "ALREADY_IN_HOME", world = home}
        end
        local reply
        local connection = result and result.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
            if type(e) == "table" and e.Kind == "Result" and tonumber(e.WorldId) == home then reply = e end
        end) or nil
        local function finish(ok, code, reason)
            if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
            emit("AirRaid_DIRECT_RETURN", {ok = ok, code = code, reason = reason, world = home})
            return {ok = ok, code = code, reason = reason, world = home}
        end
        for attempt = 1, config.returnRetries do
            if not active(ctx) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            reply = nil
            local prior = platform:position()
            if not prior then return finish(false, "CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE") end
            local sent, err = pcall(function() prepare:FireServer("stream", home) end)
            if not sent then return finish(false, "WORLD_PREPARE_SEND_FAILED", tostring(err)) end
            if not ctx:wait(0.12) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            sent, err = pcall(function() request:FireServer(home) end)
            if not sent then return finish(false, "WORLD_REQUEST_SEND_FAILED", tostring(err)) end
            local observed = ctx:await(function()
                if reply and reply.Ok == false then return "REJECTED" end
                local current = platform:position()
                if current and platform:distance(current, prior) > 50
                    and tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")) == home
                    and player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") ~= true
                    and player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true
                    and not observer:inArenaPosition() then return "VERIFIED" end
            end, 17)
            emit("AirRaid_RETURN_ATTEMPT", {attempt = attempt, code = observed or "AMBIGUOUS",
                reason = reply and reply.Reason})
            if observed == "VERIFIED" then return finish(true, "AirRaid_HOME_VERIFIED") end
            if observed ~= "REJECTED" then return finish(false, "AirRaid_RETURN_AMBIGUOUS_NO_RETRY") end
            local why = tostring(reply.Reason or "UNKNOWN")
            if why ~= "BossFight" or attempt == config.returnRetries then
                return finish(false, "AirRaid_WORLD_RETURN_REJECTED", why)
            end
            if not ctx:wait(12) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            local settled = ctx:await(function()
                if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true then return true end
            end, 40)
            if not settled then return finish(false, "AirRaid_LOCK_STILL_ACTIVE", "BossFight") end
        end
        return finish(false, "AirRaid_WORLD_RETURN_EXHAUSTED")
    end
    return command
end
return CommandController
end
-- END MODULE boss.AirRaid.CommandController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.AirRaid.Config

--!nonstrict

return {
    bossId="AIRRAID", displayName="Air Raid", gameBossKey="AirRaid",
    arenaCenter={x=0,y=-15.2,z=-32766}, arenaRadius=620,
    arenaMinY=-85, arenaMaxY=330,
    commandSafePosition={x=-31962.1074,y=344.357483,z=32887.3203},
    arenaTimeout=55, maxFightSeconds=760,
    reportTimeoutSeconds=140, reportHoldSeconds=3,
    reportCloseTimeoutSeconds=125, exitTimeoutSeconds=115,
    returnLockTimeoutSeconds=80, returnRetries=3,
    waitForCooldown=true, maxCooldownWaitSeconds=720,
    autoPreparation=true, autoRepair=true, autoGunFire=false,
    autoSceneRecovery=true, maxSceneProbes=2,
    stationActionInterval=2, maxStationAttempts=3,
}
end

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.AirRaid.ReportController
__factories["boss.AirRaid.ReportController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- AirRaid adaptive report: Outcome -> report (arena or hideout) -> Continue -> exit -> return.
-- Port of standalone V1; never treat Outcome alone as a completed report.
local NativeEncounterReport = require("boss.shared.NativeEncounterReport")
local ReportController = {}

function ReportController.new(env, config, repeatPolicy, stations)
    local platform, gui, runtime = env.services.roblox, env.services.gui, env.runtime
    local player = platform:player()
    local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
    local writer = env.state:port("boss")
    local report = {}
    local native = NativeEncounterReport.new(env, config.bossId, "AirRaid")
    report.entry = native
    local confirmedOutcome, outcomeAt = nil, nil
    local lastHealthAt = 0
    local seenReport, firstOpenedAt = false, nil
    local resultsController
    local function emit(name, data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit(name, data or {}) end
    end
    local function loadController()
        if resultsController then return resultsController end
        local folder = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("ClientModules")
        local mod = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("BossResultsController")
        if not mod or not mod:IsA("ModuleScript") then return nil end
        -- The build bundler replaces project requires. Invoke Roblox require only
        -- dynamically for the game's own ModuleScript, as the B21 controller does.
        local loader = getfenv(0)["require"]
        local ok, value = pcall(loader, mod)
        if not ok or type(value) ~= "table" then return nil end
        if type(value.IsOpen) ~= "function" or type(value.Dismiss) ~= "function" then return nil end
        resultsController = value
        return value
    end
    local function officialOpen()
        local ctrl = loadController()
        if ctrl and type(ctrl.IsOpen) == "function" then
            local ok, result = pcall(ctrl.IsOpen)
            if ok and result == true then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function isOpen()
        return player:GetAttribute("BossResultsOpen") == true or officialOpen()
    end
    local function matchingReport(guiRoot)
        if not guiRoot then return nil end
        local isAirRaid, won, lost = false, false, false
        for _,node in ipairs(guiRoot:GetDescendants()) do
            if node:IsA("TextLabel") then
                local value = string.upper(tostring(node.Text or ""))
                if value:find("AIR RAID", 1, true) or value:find("AIRRAID", 1, true)
                    or value:find("STUKA", 1, true) then isAirRaid = true end
                if value:find("DEFEATED", 1, true) or value:find("VICTORY", 1, true)
                    or value:find("CITY DEFENDED", 1, true) then won = true end
                if value:find("MISSION FAILED", 1, true) or value:find("DEFEAT", 1, true) then lost = true end
            end
        end
        if isAirRaid and won ~= lost then return won and "WIN" or "LOSS" end
        return nil
    end

    function report:watch(ctx)
        return native:watch(ctx, function(listen)
            local folder = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
            local remote = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("AirRaidEvent")
            if not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then return false, "AirRaid_EVENT_MISSING" end
            listen(remote.OnClientEvent, function(packet)
                if type(packet) ~= "table" or type(packet.K) ~= "string" then return end
                local kind = packet.K
                local forward, matched = native:accept(packet, kind == "Start" or kind == "Session")
                if not forward and not matched then return end
                if forward then stations:observe(packet) end
                if matched then native:observeTerminal(packet, kind) end
                if matched and kind == "End" and packet.Reason == "Exited" then native:endSession() end
                if matched and kind == "Outcome" and type(packet.Victory) == "boolean" and not confirmedOutcome then
                    confirmedOutcome = packet.Victory and "WIN" or "LOSS"
                    outcomeAt = runtime:now()
                end
                if not forward and kind ~= "End" and kind ~= "Outcome" then return end
                if kind == "Start" or kind == "Launch" or kind == "Session"
                    or kind == "Begin" or kind == "Resync" or kind == "Phase"
                    or kind == "Integrity" or kind == "Prep" or kind == "Formation"
                    or kind == "Raider" or kind == "DiveWarn" or kind == "Bomb"
                    or kind == "Impact" or kind == "Fire" or kind == "Repaired"
                    or kind == "Gun" or kind == "Balloon" or kind == "Eliminated" or kind == "Death"
                    or kind == "End" or kind == "Outcome" then
                    if kind == "Integrity" then
                        if runtime:now() - lastHealthAt < 4 then return end
                        lastHealthAt = runtime:now()
                    end
                    local detail = {kind = kind}
                    for _, field in ipairs({"Phase", "Name", "Kind", "State", "Stage",
                        "At", "I", "Max", "TimeLeft", "T0", "Reason", "Victory",
                        "Generation", "Outcome", "RewardEligible", "Damage", "Id", "Site",
                        "Target", "I", "Damage", "Stage", "Raiders"}) do
                        local value = packet[field]
                        if type(value) == "string" then
                            detail[field] = value:sub(1, 80)
                        elseif type(value) == "number" or type(value) == "boolean" then
                            detail[field] = value
                        end
                    end
                    emit("AirRaid_EVENT", detail)
                end
            end)
            return true
        end)
    end
    function report:cleanup(ctx) native:cleanup(ctx) end
    function report:verifiedDeferredOutcome(encounter) return native:verifiedDefeat(encounter) end
    function report:releaseEncounter(id) native:release(id) end
    function report:nativeEncounter() return native:nativeEncounter() end
    function report:ownedNativeGeneration() return native:ownedNativeGeneration() end
    function report:resetOutcome()
        native:reset()
        confirmedOutcome, outcomeAt, seenReport, firstOpenedAt = nil, nil, false, nil
        stations:reset()
    end
    function report:inspect()
        local root = gui:find(env.profile.paths.bossReport)
        local active = isOpen() -- Same verified V2 signal: BossResultsOpen or official controller.IsOpen()
        if active then
            seenReport = true
            firstOpenedAt = firstOpenedAt or runtime:now()
        end
        local guiOutcome = active and matchingReport(root) or nil
        local outcome = confirmedOutcome or guiOutcome
        local seen = seenReport or confirmedOutcome ~= nil and native:wasReportSeen()
        return {
            active = active, matchesBoss = confirmedOutcome ~= nil or guiOutcome ~= nil,
            outcome = outcome, report = root, seen = seen,
            pendingPresentation = confirmedOutcome ~= nil and not seen
                and outcomeAt ~= nil and runtime:now() - outcomeAt < config.reportTimeoutSeconds,
        }
    end
    function report:reconcile(encounter)
        local evidence = self:inspect()
        if evidence.matchesBoss and evidence.outcome
            and (not encounter.outcome or encounter.outcome == evidence.outcome) then return true end
        return encounter.outcome ~= nil and evidence.seen and not evidence.active
    end
    function report:resolve(ctx, encounter)
        local watching, why = self:watch(ctx)
        if not watching then return {ok = false, code = why} end
        -- V2 REQUIREMENT: Outcome alone never authorizes return/Continue.
        local evidence = ctx:await(function()
            local current = self:inspect()
            if current.active and current.matchesBoss and current.outcome then return current end
            if current.seen and not current.active and (encounter.outcome or current.outcome) then
                return current -- manually dismissed report after previously observing it
            end
        end, config.reportTimeoutSeconds)
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        if not evidence then return {ok = false, code = "AirRaid_REPORT_NOT_OBSERVED"} end
        if evidence.outcome and encounter.outcome and evidence.outcome ~= encounter.outcome then
            return {ok = false, held = true, code = "BOSS_OUTCOME_CONFLICT"}
        end
        local outcome = evidence.outcome or encounter.outcome
        if not outcome then return {ok = false, code = "AirRaid_OUTCOME_UNVERIFIED"} end
        if not encounter.outcome then
            local accepted = writer:recordBossReport(outcome,
                runtime:epoch() + repeatPolicy:outcomeDelay(outcome))
            if not accepted then return {ok = false, held = true, code = "BOSS_OUTCOME_CONFLICT"} end
            encounter = env.state:snapshot().boss.encounter
        end
        if not evidence.active then
            writer:closeReport()
            return {ok = true, code = "AirRaid_REPORT_MANUALLY_CLOSED"}
        end
        local at = platform:position()
        local place = player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") == true and "HIDEOUT" or "OTHER"
        if place == "OTHER" and at then
            local dx, dz = at.X - config.arenaCenter.x, at.Z - config.arenaCenter.z
            if dx * dx + dz * dz < (config.arenaRadius + 55) * (config.arenaRadius + 55) then
                place = "ARENA"
            end
        end
        emit("AirRaid_REPORT_OPEN", {outcome = outcome, location = place,
            inBossFight = player:GetAttribute("InBossFight")})
        local controller = loadController()
        if not controller then return {ok = false, code = "AirRaid_RESULT_CONTROLLER_MISSING_MANUAL_CONTINUE"} end
        if not encounter.continueAttempted then
            local ready = ctx:await(function()
                if not isOpen() then return "MANUALLY_CLOSED" end
                local armed = false
                if type(controller.Debug) == "function" then
                    local ok, message = pcall(controller.Debug)
                    armed = ok and type(message) == "string"
                        and message:find("armed=true", 1, true) ~= nil
                end
                if armed and firstOpenedAt
                    and runtime:now() - firstOpenedAt >= config.reportHoldSeconds then return "ARMED" end
            end, config.reportTimeoutSeconds)
            if ctx:isCancelled() then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
            if ready == "MANUALLY_CLOSED" then
                writer:closeReport()
                return {ok = true, code = "AirRaid_REPORT_MANUALLY_CLOSED"}
            end
            if ready ~= "ARMED" then return {ok = false, code = "AirRaid_REPORT_NOT_ARMED_MANUAL_CONTINUE"} end
            if not writer:markContinueAttempt() then return {ok = false, code = "AirRaid_CONTINUE_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED"} end
            local sent, err = pcall(function() controller.Dismiss("continue") end)
            if not sent then return {ok = false, code = "AirRaid_CONTINUE_FAILED: " .. tostring(err)} end
            emit("AirRaid_REPORT_CONTINUE", {code = "CONTINUE_REQUESTED"})
        end
        local closed = ctx:await(function() if not self:inspect().active then return true end end,
            config.reportCloseTimeoutSeconds)
        if not closed then return {ok = false, code = "AirRaid_REPORT_STILL_OPEN_MANUAL_CONTINUE"} end
        writer:closeReport()
        return {ok = true, code = "AirRaid_REPORT_CLOSED"}
    end
    return report
end
return ReportController
end
-- END MODULE boss.AirRaid.ReportController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.AirRaid.StationController
__factories["boss.AirRaid.StationController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Port of confirmed V4 DirectPrompt AirRaid. Prompt dispatch now delegated to core.
local StationController={}
function StationController.new(env, config, observer)
    local platform, runtime, services = env.services.roblox, env.runtime, env.services
    local W, P = platform:workspace(), platform:player()
    local RS=platform:service("ReplicatedStorage")
    local stations = {lastAttempt=-math.huge, actions=0, successes=0, gate=nil,
        lastGateAt=-math.huge,lastGate=nil,attempts={},lastScan=0,lastTarget=nil,
        wrapper=nil,config=nil,misses=0,lastScanLog=-math.huge,lastSceneDiag=-math.huge,
        lastRecovery=-math.huge,sceneProbes=0,streamBusy=false,lastStreamResult=nil,
        promptCache=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"}),promptCacheSeeded=false}
    local raid={prepared={},activeFires={},disabledSites={},repairProof={},raiderSeen={},
        integrity=nil,max=nil,raiders=0,bombs=0,impacts=0,fires=0,formations=0,
        prepBegun=false,raidBegun=false,prepEndsAt=nil,repairEvents=0}
    local settings=config
    local completed=false
    local connections={}
    local currentContext=nil
    local controller={}
    local function active()
        return currentContext and runtime:isActive(currentContext)
            and not currentContext:isCancelled() and not currentContext:isClosing()
    end
    local function log(kind, data)
        if services.telemetry then services.telemetry:emit("AIRRAID_"..kind, data or {}) end
    end
    local function root()
        local ch=P.Character
        return ch, ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    end
    local function isParticipating() return P:GetAttribute("AirRaidParticipant")==true end
    local ARENA_CENTER=Vector3.new(config.arenaCenter.x,config.arenaCenter.y,config.arenaCenter.z)
    local ARENA_RADIUS=config.arenaRadius+55
    local function inArena(pos)
        if not pos then return false end
        local d=pos-ARENA_CENTER
        return d.X*d.X+d.Z*d.Z<ARENA_RADIUS^2 and pos.Y>config.arenaMinY
            and pos.Y<config.arenaMaxY
    end
    local function gate(why, fields)
        stations.gate=why
        if stations.lastGate==why and os.clock()-stations.lastGateAt<5 then return end
        stations.lastGate,stations.lastGateAt=why,os.clock()
        local data=fields or {};data.reason=why;log("STATION_GATE",data)
    end
    local function keyFor(kind,id)
        if kind=="Radar" then return "Radar" end
        return kind..":"..tostring(id or "?")
    end
    local function markPrepared(kind,id,source)
        if type(kind)~="string" then return end
        local k=keyFor(kind,id)
        if not raid.prepared[k] then
            raid.prepared[k]=true
            stations.successes+=1
            log("PREP_CONFIRMED",{site=k,source=source})
        end
    end
    local function activeFireCount()
        local n=0; for _ in pairs(raid.activeFires) do n+=1 end
        return n
    end
    function controller:observe(e)
        if type(e)~="table" or type(e.K)~="string" then return end
        local k=e.K
        if k=="Prep" then
            if e.Kind=="Begin" then
                raid.prepBegun=true;raid.raidBegun=false
                raid.prepEndsAt=tonumber(e.T0) and (tonumber(e.T0)+35) or P:GetAttribute("AirRaidPrepEndsAt")
                log("PREP_BEGIN",{endsAt=raid.prepEndsAt})
            elseif e.Kind=="All" then
                log("PREP_ALL",{})
            else
                markPrepared(tostring(e.Kind),e.Id,"EVENT_PREP")
            end
        elseif k=="Begin" then
            raid.raidBegun=true
            log("RAID_BEGIN",{})
        elseif k=="Session" or k=="Launch" or k=="Resync" then
            raid.generation=e.Generation or raid.generation
            raid.prepEndsAt=e.PrepStart and (e.PrepStart+35) or raid.prepEndsAt
            if type(e.World)=="table" then
                local world=e.World
                if type(world.Guns)=="table" then
                    for id,v in pairs(world.Guns) do
                        if type(v)=="table" and v.Ready then markPrepared("Gun",id,"SESSION") end
                    end
                end
                if type(world.Balloons)=="table" then
                    for id,v in pairs(world.Balloons) do
                        if type(v)=="table" and v.Deployed then markPrepared("Balloon",id,"SESSION") end
                    end
                end
                if type(world.Crews)=="table" then
                    for id,v in pairs(world.Crews) do if v==true then markPrepared("Crew",id,"SESSION") end end
                end
                if world.Radar then markPrepared("Radar",nil,"SESSION") end
            end
        elseif k=="Stage" then
            raid.stage=e.Stage or e.Phase or raid.stage
            log("RAID_STAGE",{stage=raid.stage})
        elseif k=="Integrity" then
            raid.integrity=e.I or raid.integrity
            raid.max=e.Max or raid.max
            raid.raiders=e.Raiders or raid.raiders
            log("CITY_INTEGRITY",{value=raid.integrity,max=raid.max,raiders=raid.raiders})
        elseif k=="Formation" then
            raid.formations+=1
            log("FORMATION",{stage=e.Stage,final=e.Final,from=e.From,size=e.Size})
        elseif k=="Raider" then
            raid.raiders+=1
            if e.Id then raid.raiderSeen[tostring(e.Id)]=true end
            if raid.raiders<=8 or raid.raiders%10==0 then
                log("RAIDER",{id=e.Id,kind=e.Kind,stage=e.Stage})
            end
        elseif k=="DiveWarn" then
            log("DIVE_WARNING",{id=e.Id,releaseAt=e.ReleaseAt,target=e.Target})
        elseif k=="Bomb" then
            raid.bombs+=1
            log("BOMB",{target=e.Target,raider=e.Raider,impactAt=e.ImpactAt})
        elseif k=="Impact" then
            raid.impacts+=1
            for _,item in ipairs(e.Disabled or {}) do
                if type(item)=="table" and item.Kind and item.Id then
                    raid.disabledSites[keyFor(item.Kind,item.Id)]=true
                end
            end
            log("CITY_IMPACT",{target=e.Target,damage=e.Damage,state=e.State,
                disabledCount=#(e.Disabled or {})})
        elseif k=="Fire" then
            if e.Target~=nil then
                if e.On then raid.activeFires[tostring(e.Target)]=e
                else
                    raid.activeFires[tostring(e.Target)]=nil
                    local site=keyFor("Fire",e.Target)
                    stations.attempts["Repair:"..site]=nil
                end
            end
            raid.fires=activeFireCount()
            log("CITY_FIRE",{target=e.Target,on=e.On,smoulder=e.Smoulder,fires=raid.fires})
        elseif k=="Repaired" then
            raid.repairEvents+=1
            if e.Kind and e.Id then raid.disabledSites[keyFor(e.Kind,e.Id)]=nil end
            if e.Target~=nil then raid.activeFires[tostring(e.Target)]=nil end
            raid.fires=activeFireCount()
            if e.Kind and e.Id then
                local site=keyFor(e.Kind,e.Id)
                raid.repairProof[site]=(raid.repairProof[site] or 0)+1
                stations.attempts["Repair:"..site]=nil
            end
            log("REPAIR_CONFIRMED",{repairKind=e.Kind,id=e.Id,target=e.Target})
        elseif k=="Gun" and e.Ready and e.Id then
            markPrepared("Gun",e.Id,"EVENT_GUN")
        elseif k=="Balloon" and e.Deployed and e.Id then
            markPrepared("Balloon",e.Id,"EVENT_BALLOON")
        elseif k=="Eliminated" then
            log("ELIMINATED",{id=e.UserId})
        elseif k=="End" then
            log("ENCOUNTER_END",{victory=e.Victory,reason=e.Reason,endedAt=e.EndedAt})
        elseif k=="Outcome" then
            
            completed=true
            log("OUTCOME",{victory=e.Victory,reason=e.Reason})
        end
    end
    function controller:reset()
        raid.prepared={};raid.activeFires={};raid.disabledSites={};raid.repairProof={}
        raid.prepBegun=false;raid.raidBegun=false;completed=false
        raid.raiderSeen={};raid.bombs=0;raid.impacts=0;raid.fires=0;raid.formations=0;raid.repairEvents=0
        raid.integrity=nil;raid.max=nil;raid.raiders=0;raid.prepEndsAt=nil
        stations.attempts={};stations.successes=0;stations.actions=0;stations.gate=nil
        stations.lastAttempt=-math.huge;stations.lastScan=0;stations.lastRecovery=-math.huge
        stations.sceneProbes=0;stations.lastStreamResult=nil;stations.wrapper=nil
    end
-- Prep station locations are from Config.Site.ToWorld and DEFENCES anchors; no world-fixed guesses.
local function loadConfig()
    if stations.config then return stations.config end
    local folder=RS:FindFirstChild("Modules")
    local air=folder and folder:FindFirstChild("AirRaid")
    local mod=air and air:FindFirstChild("Config")
    if not mod then return nil end
    local loader=getfenv(0)["require"]
    local ok,c=pcall(loader,mod)
    if ok and type(c)=="table" then stations.config=c;return c end
    return nil
end
-- Air Raid may stream its city model and individual prompts after the Solo request.
-- The client Controller uses workspace.RuntimeScenes[WrapperName] WITHOUT
-- requiring a direct Defences child (V1 was more restrictive than the client).
local function scanWrapper()
    if stations.wrapper and stations.wrapper.Parent then return stations.wrapper end
    local scenes=W:FindFirstChild("RuntimeScenes")
    local exact=scenes and scenes:FindFirstChild("AirRaidCity")
    if scenes and not exact then
        for _,v in ipairs(scenes:GetChildren()) do
            if v.Name:match("^AirRaidCity_%d+$") then exact=v;break end
        end
    end
    if exact then stations.wrapper=exact;return exact end
    local direct=W:FindFirstChild("AirRaidCity")
    if direct then stations.wrapper=direct;return direct end
    local arenas=W:FindFirstChild("BossArenas")
    if arenas then
        local candidate=arenas:FindFirstChild("AirRaidCity",true)
        if candidate then stations.wrapper=candidate;return candidate end
    end
    -- Some streamed instances temporarily appear under a nested runtime folder.
    if scenes then
        local candidate=scenes:FindFirstChild("AirRaidCity",true)
        if candidate then stations.wrapper=candidate;return candidate end
    end
    return nil
end
local function anchorOf(inst)
    if not inst then return nil end
    local node=inst.Parent
    for _=1,6 do
        if not node then break end
        if node:IsA("Attachment") then return node.WorldPosition end
        if node:IsA("BasePart") then return node.Position end
        if node:IsA("Model") then
            local ok,pos=pcall(function() return node:GetPivot().Position end)
            if ok then return pos end
        end
        node=node.Parent
    end
    return nil
end
local function cachePrompt(inst)
    if inst:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
        stations.promptCache[inst]=true
    end
end
local function seedPromptCache()
    if stations.promptCacheSeeded then return end
    stations.promptCacheSeeded=true
    -- One initial inventory; subsequent prompts are maintained by DescendantAdded.
    for _,v in ipairs(W:GetDescendants()) do cachePrompt(v) end
    table.insert(connections,W.DescendantAdded:Connect(cachePrompt))
    table.insert(connections,W.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(inst)
        if inst:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then stations.promptCache[inst]=nil end
    end))
end
local function sceneDiagnostic(reason, promptCount)
    if os.clock()-stations.lastSceneDiag<6 then return end
    stations.lastSceneDiag=os.clock()
    local scenes=W:FindFirstChild("RuntimeScenes")
    local wrapper=scanWrapper()
    local ch,hrp=root()
    local names={}
    if scenes then
        for i,v in ipairs(scenes:GetChildren()) do
            if i>18 then break end
            table.insert(names,v.Name)
        end
    end
    local cfg=loadConfig()
    log("SCENE_SCAN",{reason=reason,hasRuntimeScenes=scenes~=nil,
        runtimeChildren=names,wrapper=wrapper and wrapper:GetFullName() or nil,
        defences=wrapper and wrapper:FindFirstChild("Defences")~=nil or false,
        promptCount=promptCount or 0,configReady=cfg~=nil,
        playerPosition=hrp and tostring(hrp.Position) or nil,
        inExpectedArena=hrp and inArena(hrp.Position) or false,
        participating=isParticipating()})
end
local function findPrompts()
    seedPromptCache()
    local wrapper=scanWrapper()
    -- No dependency on AirRaidCity/Defences: some prompts stream independently.
    local out={}
    for inst in pairs(stations.promptCache) do
        if inst.Parent and inst:IsDescendantOf(W) and inst.Enabled then
            local pos=anchorOf(inst)
            if pos and inArena(pos) then
                local parent=inst.Parent
                local attributeKind=inst:GetAttribute("AirRaidKind")
                local attributeId=inst:GetAttribute("AirRaidId") or inst:GetAttribute("StationId")
                table.insert(out,{prompt=inst,pos=pos,kind=attributeKind,id=attributeId,
                    labels=(inst.Name.." "..inst.ActionText.." "..inst.ObjectText.." "..(parent and parent.Name or "")):lower()})
            end
        end
    end
    if not wrapper or #out==0 then sceneDiagnostic(wrapper and "PROMPTS_NOT_STREAMED" or "CITY_NOT_STREAMED",#out) end
    return out
end
local function candidateStations()
    local c=loadConfig()
    if not c or type(c.ToWorld)~="function" then return {} end
    local out={}
    local function insert(kind,id,pos,priority)
        if typeof(pos)~="Vector3" then return end
        local ok,loc=pcall(c.ToWorld,pos)
        if ok and typeof(loc)=="Vector3" then
            table.insert(out,{kind=kind,id=id,key=keyFor(kind,id),pos=loc,priority=priority})
        end
    end
    if type(c.Radar)=="table" then insert("Radar",c.Radar.Id,c.Radar.Position,100) end
    for _,v in ipairs(c.Crews or {}) do insert("Crew",v.Id,v.Position,82) end
    for _,v in ipairs(c.Balloons or {}) do insert("Balloon",v.Id,v.Position,62) end
    for _,v in ipairs(c.Guns or {}) do insert("Gun",v.Id,v.Position,42) end
    return out
end
-- Resolve identity from the real prompt attribute and server model names.
-- No label/distance-only pairing: a gun's operator prompt is not preparation.
local function identifyPrompt(item)
    local kind=item.kind
    if type(kind)~="string" then return end
    local repair=kind=="RepairGun" or kind=="RepairBalloon" or kind=="Fire"
    local base=(kind=="Ready" or kind=="RepairGun") and "Gun" or kind=="RepairBalloon" and "Balloon" or kind
    local id=item.id
    local node=item.prompt.Parent
    while node and node~=W do
        if base=="Gun" then id=id or node.Name:match("^Gun_(.+)$")
        elseif base=="Balloon" then id=id or node.Name:match("^Balloon_(.+)$")
        elseif base=="Crew" then id=id or node.Name:match("^FirePost_(.+)$")
        elseif base=="Fire" then id=id or node.Name:match("^Fire_(.+)$") end
        node=node.Parent
    end
    local c=loadConfig()
    if not c then return end
    if base=="Radar" then id=c.Radar.Id
    elseif base=="Gun" and not (c.GunById and c.GunById[id]) then return
    elseif base=="Balloon" and not (c.BalloonById and c.BalloonById[id]) then return
    elseif base=="Crew" and not (c.CrewById and c.CrewById[id]) then return
    elseif base=="Fire" and not (c.TargetById and c.TargetById[id]) then return
    elseif base~="Gun" and base~="Balloon" and base~="Crew" and base~="Fire" then return end
    if not id then return end
    return base,id,repair
end
local function selectStationPrompt(prompts,forRepair)
    local best,bestScore
    local _,hrp=root()
    if not hrp then return end
    for _,item in ipairs(prompts) do
        local base,id,repair=identifyPrompt(item)
        if base and repair==forRepair then
            local proofKey=keyFor(base,id)
            local site=repair and ("Repair:"..proofKey) or proofKey
            if (repair or not raid.prepared[site])
                and (stations.attempts[site] or 0)<settings.maxStationAttempts then
                local priority=base=="Radar" and 100 or base=="Crew" and 82 or base=="Balloon" and 62 or 42
                local score=priority-(hrp.Position-item.pos).Magnitude*.025
                if not bestScore or score>bestScore then
                    best,bestScore={item=item,site=site,kind=repair and "Repair" or base,
                        base=base,id=id,proofKey=proofKey},score
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return best
end
local function prepAcknowledged(target, before)
    if target.kind=="Repair" then
        return (raid.repairProof[target.proofKey] or 0)>before
    end
    return raid.prepared[target.site]==true
end
    local function doStationAction(target)
        local ctx=currentContext
        if not active() or completed then return end
        local prompt=target.item.prompt
        if not prompt or not prompt.Parent or not prompt.Enabled then return end
        local ch,hrp=root()
        if not ch or not hrp or not isParticipating() then return end
        local dest=target.item.pos+Vector3.new(0,2.5,0)
        if not inArena(dest) then gate("TARGET_OUTSIDE_ARENA",{site=target.site});return end
        if (hrp.Position-dest).Magnitude>3 then
            local ok,err=pcall(function() ch:PivotTo(CFrame.new(dest)) end)
            if not ok then gate("TELEPORT_EXCEPTION",{detail=tostring(err)});return end
            if not ctx:wait(.25) then return end
        end
        local _,part=root()
        local distance=part and (part.Position-target.item.pos).Magnitude or math.huge
        if distance>math.min(13,prompt.MaxActivationDistance-0.5) then
            gate("POSITION_NOT_VERIFIED",{site=target.site,distance=distance});return
        end
        if not active() or completed or not prompt.Parent or not prompt.Enabled then return end
        stations.lastAttempt=os.clock()
        stations.lastTarget=target.site
        stations.attempts[target.site]=(stations.attempts[target.site] or 0)+1
        stations.actions+=1
        local before=raid.repairProof[target.proofKey] or 0
        local atChar=ch
        log("STATION_ATTEMPT",{site=target.site,action=prompt.ActionText,
            hold=prompt.HoldDuration,promptKind=target.item.kind,id=target.id,
            attempt=stations.attempts[target.site]})
        local sent=services.interaction:prompt(prompt,{
            allowLegacyFallback=false, -- V4 verified direct-only path; never use the camera
            wait=function(seconds) return ctx:wait(seconds) end,
            valid=function()
                if not active() or completed or not isParticipating() then return false,"CANCELLED" end
                if P.Character~=atChar then return false,"CHARACTER_CHANGED" end
                local currentCh,part=root()
                local hum=currentCh and currentCh:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if not hum or hum.Health<=0 then return false,"CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE" end
                if not part or (part.Position-target.item.pos).Magnitude>prompt.MaxActivationDistance then
                    return false,"PROMPT_OUT_OF_RANGE" end
                return true
            end,
        })
        log("PROMPT_INPUT",{site=target.site,method=sent.method,dispatched=sent.dispatched,
            code=sent.code,reason=sent.detail})
        local deadline=runtime:now()+1
        while sent.ok and active() and not completed and runtime:now()<deadline do
            if prepAcknowledged(target,before) then break end
            if not ctx:wait(.1) then break end
        end
        local confirmed=prepAcknowledged(target,before)
        log("STATION_ACK",{site=target.site,confirmed=confirmed,
            dispatched=sent.dispatched,method=sent.method})
        if confirmed then stations.gate=nil
        elseif not sent.ok then gate(sent.code,{site=target.site})
        else gate("DIRECT_PROMPT_UNCONFIRMED",{site=target.site}) end
    end
-- Scene streaming recovery uses real positions from AirRaid.Config, never guessed coordinates.
-- A position probe is made only if a raycast proves a walkable physical surface.
local function recoverScene(phase)
    if not settings.autoSceneRecovery or not isParticipating() then return end
    if os.clock()-stations.lastRecovery<7 then return end
    if stations.streamBusy then return end
    if stations.sceneProbes>=settings.maxSceneProbes and stations.lastStreamResult=="NO_GROUND" then
        return
    end
    stations.lastRecovery=os.clock()
    local ch,hrp=root()
    if not ch or not hrp then gate("RECOVERY_CHARACTER_MISSING");return end
    local cfg=loadConfig()
    if not cfg then gate("AIRRAID_CONFIG_MISSING");return end
    local candidates=candidateStations()
    local closest
    local best=math.huge
    for _,v in ipairs(candidates) do
        if not raid.prepared[v.key] and inArena(v.pos) then
            local d=(hrp.Position-v.pos).Magnitude
            -- Prefer the nearest real preparation site, not the same radar every time.
            if d<best then closest=v;best=d end
        end
    end
    if not closest then gate("NO_CONFIG_STATIONS");return end
    stations.streamBusy=true
    local recoveryContext=currentContext
    local desired=closest.pos
    log("STREAM_REQUEST",{site=closest.key,position=tostring(desired),distance=best,phase=phase})
    task.spawn(function()
        local ok,err=pcall(function() P:RequestStreamAroundAsync(desired,3) end)
        stations.lastStreamResult=ok and "REQUESTED" or ("FAILED:"..tostring(err))
        log("STREAM_RESULT",{site=closest.key,status=stations.lastStreamResult})
        if currentContext~=recoveryContext or not active()
            or raid.raidBegun or not isParticipating() then
            stations.streamBusy=false;return
        end
        task.wait(.15)
        if scanWrapper() then
            log("SCENE_RECOVERED",{source="STREAM_REQUEST",site=closest.key})
        end
        -- If still no prompt, get the station streamed via a verified ground probe.
        local prompts=findPrompts()
        if #prompts==0 and stations.sceneProbes<settings.maxSceneProbes then
            local result=W:Raycast(desired+Vector3.new(0,18,0),Vector3.new(0,-75,0))
            local surface=result and result.Instance
            if result and result.Normal.Y>0.45 and surface and surface.CanCollide and inArena(result.Position) then
                local nowCh,nowHrp=root()
                if currentContext==recoveryContext and active() and nowCh and nowHrp
                    and isParticipating() and not raid.raidBegun then
                    local dest=result.Position+Vector3.new(0,3.5,0)
                    stations.sceneProbes+=1
                    local moved,why=pcall(function() nowCh:PivotTo(CFrame.new(dest)) end)
                    task.wait(.25)
                    local _,newHrp=root()
                    local actual=newHrp and (newHrp.Position-dest).Magnitude or math.huge
                    log("SCENE_PROBE_MOVE",{site=closest.key,attempt=stations.sceneProbes,
                        success=moved and actual<9,distance=actual,
                        reason=moved and nil or tostring(why),surface=surface.Name})
                end
            else
                stations.lastStreamResult="NO_GROUND"
                gate("SCENE_PROBE_NO_GROUND",{site=closest.key,groundPart=surface and surface.Name or nil})
            end
        end
        stations.streamBusy=false
    end)
end
function controller:start(ctx)
    currentContext=ctx
    seedPromptCache()
    ctx:deferCleanup(function()
        if currentContext==ctx then currentContext=nil end
        for _,connection in ipairs(connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(connections)
        stations.promptCacheSeeded=false
        stations.promptCache=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
    end)
    task.spawn(function()
        while active() and not completed do
            if isParticipating() and P:GetAttribute("InBossFight")==true then
                local state=tostring(W:GetAttribute("AirRaidFightState"))
                local prep=(raid.prepBegun or raid.raidBegun or isParticipating())
                    and state~="Idle" and state~="Ended"
                -- Actual enabled repair prompts remain usable when attaching
                -- mid-fight, even if earlier Impact/Fire packets were missed.
                local repair=settings.autoRepair and state=="Active"
                if os.clock()-stations.lastAttempt>=settings.stationActionInterval
                    and os.clock()-stations.lastScan>=1.7 then
                    if (prep and settings.autoPreparation) or repair then
                        stations.lastScan=os.clock()
                        local prompts,err=findPrompts()
                        if #prompts==0 then
                            gate("NO_STREAMED_STATION_PROMPTS")
                            if prep or repair then recoverScene(prep and "PREPARATION" or "REPAIR") end
                        end
                        do
                            if os.clock()-stations.lastScanLog>9 then
                                stations.lastScanLog=os.clock()
                                log("STATION_SCAN",{promptCount=#prompts,
                                    prep=prep, repair=repair, confirmed=stations.successes,
                                    fireCount=raid.fires})
                            end
                            local choice=repair and selectStationPrompt(prompts,true) or nil
                            if not choice and settings.autoPreparation then choice=selectStationPrompt(prompts,false) end
                            if choice then
                                -- Prevent revisiting a repair prompt endlessly: each action has a bounded attempt count.
                                if (stations.attempts[choice.site] or 0)>=settings.maxStationAttempts then
                                    gate("REPAIR_ATTEMPT_LIMIT")
                                else
                                    doStationAction(choice)
                                end
                            else
                                gate(repair and "NO_REPAIR_PROMPT" or "NO_PREP_PROMPT",{promptCount=#prompts})
                                if prep or repair then recoverScene(prep and "NO_MATCHING_PREP_PROMPT" or "NO_MATCHING_REPAIR_PROMPT") end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if not ctx:wait(.35) then break end
        end
    end)
    end
    function controller:status()
        return {actions=stations.actions,confirmed=stations.successes,
            gate=stations.gate,lastTarget=stations.lastTarget,
            prepared=raid.prepared,repairs=raid.repairEvents,integrity=raid.integrity,
            raiders=raid.raiders,fires=raid.fires,bombs=raid.bombs,autoGunFire=false}
    end
    return controller
end
return StationController
end
-- END MODULE boss.AirRaid.StationController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.B17.ArenaObserver
__factories["boss.B17.ArenaObserver"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- B-17's private participant attribute distinguishes our fight from other players'.
local ArenaObserver = {}
function ArenaObserver.new(env, config)
    local platform = env.services.roblox
    local player = platform:player()
    local workspace = platform:workspace()
    local observer = {}
    function observer:inArenaPosition()
        local pos = platform:position()
        if not pos then return false end
        local dx, dz = pos.X - config.arenaCenter.x, pos.Z - config.arenaCenter.z
        return dx * dx + dz * dz < config.arenaRadius * config.arenaRadius
    end
    function observer:participating()
        return player:GetAttribute("B17Participant") == true
    end
    function observer:inArena()
        return self:participating()
            or (workspace:GetAttribute("B17FightActive") == true and self:inArenaPosition()
                and player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true)
    end
    function observer:state()
        return {phase = workspace:GetAttribute("B17Phase"),
            fightState = workspace:GetAttribute("B17FightState"),
            active = workspace:GetAttribute("B17FightActive"),
            participant = player:GetAttribute("B17Participant"),
            inBossFight = player:GetAttribute("InBossFight")}
    end
    return observer
end
return ArenaObserver
end
-- END MODULE boss.B17.ArenaObserver

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.B17.B17
__factories["boss.B17.B17"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Registration entrypoint for BossManager; port of live-verified B17 standalone V1.
local Config = require("boss.B17.Config")
local ArenaObserver = require("boss.B17.ArenaObserver")
local CommandController = require("boss.B17.CommandController")
local CombatController = require("boss.B17.CombatController")
local ReportController = require("boss.B17.ReportController")
local RepeatPolicy = require("boss.B17.RepeatPolicy")
local B17 = {}
function B17.definition()
    return {bossId = Config.bossId, displayName = Config.displayName, create = function(env)
        local observer = ArenaObserver.new(env, Config)
        local repeatPolicy = RepeatPolicy.new(env)
        local report = ReportController.new(env, Config, repeatPolicy)
        return {config = Config, observer = observer, report = report, repeatPolicy = repeatPolicy,
            command = CommandController.new(env, Config, observer, report),
            combat = CombatController.new(env, Config, observer, report)}
    end}
end
return B17
end
-- END MODULE boss.B17.B17

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.B17.CombatController
__factories["boss.B17.CombatController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- B-17 standalone V1 was verified without a trench navigation/dodge algorithm.
-- Observe combat and objective events only; never invent movement or attacks.
local CombatController = {}
function CombatController.new(env, config, observer, report)
    local runtime = env.runtime
    local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
    local combat = {}
    function combat:run(ctx, encounter)
        local ready, why = report:watch(ctx)
        if not ready then return {code = why} end
        local lastKey, lastLog = nil, 0
        local deadline = runtime:now() + config.maxFightSeconds
        local code = "OUTCOME_NOT_OBSERVED_TIMEOUT"
        while not ctx:isCancelled() and runtime:now() < deadline do
            local result = report:inspect()
            if result.outcome then code = "OUTCOME_OBSERVED"; break end
            local state = observer:state()
            local key = tostring(state.fightState) .. "/" .. tostring(state.phase) .. "/"
                .. tostring(state.active) .. "/" .. tostring(state.participant)
            if key ~= lastKey or runtime:now() - lastLog >= 25 then
                if telemetry then telemetry:emit("B17_STATE", state) end
                lastKey, lastLog = key, runtime:now()
            end
            if not ctx:wait(0.4) then break end
        end
        if ctx:isCancelled() then code = "CANCELLED" end
        return {code = code}
    end
    return combat
end
return CombatController
end
-- END MODULE boss.B17.CombatController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.B17.CommandController
__factories["boss.B17.CommandController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- B-17 standalone V1 flow: Hideout -> Boss Command pass -> ONE Solo -> combat.
-- Adaptive report may open in arena OR after exit; never request return before Continue.
local DirectBossTravel = require("main.navigation.DirectBossTravel")
local CommandController = {}

function CommandController.new(env, config, observer, report)
    local platform, runtime = env.services.roblox, env.runtime
    local player, workspace = platform:player(), platform:workspace()
    local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
    local travel = DirectBossTravel.new(env)
    local command = {}
    local function emit(name, data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit(name, data or {}) end
    end
    local function remote(name)
        local storage = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage")
        local folder = storage:FindFirstChild("Remotes") or storage:WaitForChild("Remotes", 10)
        local item = folder and (folder:FindFirstChild(name) or folder:WaitForChild(name, 7))
        return item and item:IsA("RemoteEvent") and item or nil
    end
    local function active(ctx) return runtime:isActive(ctx) and not ctx:isCancelled() end
    local function cooldownLeft()
        local raw = player:GetAttribute("BossStartCooldowns")
        if type(raw) ~= "string" or raw == "" then return 0 end
        local ok, data = pcall(function() return platform:service("HttpService"):JSONDecode(raw) end)
        if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then return 0 end
        return math.max(0, (tonumber(data[config.gameBossKey]) or 0) - workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
    end

    function command:prepare(ctx)
        local watching, why = report:watch(ctx) -- watch BEFORE sending any boss request
        if not watching then return false, why end
        if observer:inArena() then return true, "B17_ALREADY_IN_ARENA" end
        if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true then return false, "OTHER_BOSS_ACTIVE" end
        if not active(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        local entered = travel:enterHideout(ctx)
        emit("B17_DIRECT_HIDEOUT", {ok = entered.ok, code = entered.code, reason = entered.reason})
        if not entered.ok then return false, entered.code end
        local positioned = travel:moveToKnownPoint(ctx, config.commandSafePosition, {
            requireHideout = true, radius = 6, settle = 0.85,
        })
        emit("B17_COMMAND_POSITION", {ok = positioned.ok, code = positioned.code})
        if not positioned.ok then return false, positioned.code end
        return true, "B17_COMMAND_READY"
    end

    function command:readiness()
        if observer:inArena() then return "READY" end
        if not travel:inHideout() then return "UNKNOWN" end
        local secs = cooldownLeft()
        if secs > 0 then
            secs = math.ceil(secs)
            return string.format("%d:%02d", math.floor(secs / 60), secs % 60)
        end
        -- The server pass remains authoritative for unlock/eligibility.
        return "READY"
    end

    function command:startSolo(ctx, markAttempt)
        if not active(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        if observer:participating() then return true, "B17_ALREADY_FIGHTING" end
        if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true then return false, "OTHER_BOSS_ACTIVE" end
        if not travel:inHideout() then return false, "NOT_IN_HIDEOUT" end
        if self:readiness() ~= "READY" then return false, "B17_NOT_READY" end
        local watching, why = report:watch(ctx)
        if not watching then return false, why end
        local hideout, accept = remote("PersonalHideoutRemote"), remote("B17CommanderAccept")
        if not hideout or not accept then return false, "B17_COMMAND_REMOTES_MISSING" end
        local passReply, acceptReply
        local passConnection = hideout.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
            if type(e) == "table" and e.Kind == "BossCommand" and e.Op == "Start"
                and e.BossKey == config.gameBossKey then passReply = e end
        end)
        local acceptConnection = accept.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
            if type(e) == "table" and e.Accepted ~= nil then acceptReply = e end
        end)
        local function finish(ok, code)
            passConnection:Disconnect()
            acceptConnection:Disconnect()
            return ok, code
        end
        local sent, err = pcall(function()
            hideout:FireServer({Action = "StartBoss", BossKey = config.gameBossKey, Solo = true})
        end)
        if not sent then return finish(false, "B17_PASS_SEND_FAILED: " .. tostring(err)) end
        local gotPass = ctx:await(function() return passReply end, 10)
        if not active(ctx) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
        if not gotPass then return finish(false, "B17_PASS_TIMEOUT_NO_RETRY") end
        emit("B17_PASS_RESULT", {ok = gotPass.Ok == true, reason = gotPass.Reason})
        if gotPass.Ok ~= true then return finish(false, "B17_PASS_REJECTED: " .. tostring(gotPass.Reason)) end
        -- Mark before firing the irreversible Solo request; never blind retry.
        if not markAttempt() then return finish(false, "B17_SOLO_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED") end
        sent, err = pcall(function() accept:FireServer({Solo = true}) end)
        if not sent then return finish(false, "B17_SOLO_SEND_FAILED: " .. tostring(err)) end
        local observed = ctx:await(function()
            if acceptReply and acceptReply.Accepted == false then return "REJECTED" end
            if observer:participating() then return "ENTERED" end
        end, config.arenaTimeout)
        if not active(ctx) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
        emit("B17_SOLO_RESULT", {code = observed or "AMBIGUOUS", accepted = acceptReply and acceptReply.Accepted})
        if observed == "ENTERED" then return finish(true, "B17_FIGHT_VERIFIED") end
        if observed == "REJECTED" then
            return finish(false, "B17_SOLO_REJECTED: " .. tostring(acceptReply.Reason))
        end
        return finish(false, "B17_SOLO_AMBIGUOUS_NO_RETRY")
    end

    function command:close(_) return true end -- No command GUI was opened.

    function command:returnHome(ctx, home)
        if not active(ctx) then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        if type(home) ~= "number" or home < 1 or home % 1 ~= 0 then
            return {ok = false, code = "INVALID_HOME_WORLD"}
        end
        if report:inspect().active then return {ok = false, code = "B17_REPORT_STILL_OPEN"} end
        -- Preserve standalone V1 lock checks before return, regardless of report location.
        local released = ctx:await(function()
            if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true
                and player:GetAttribute("B17Participant") ~= true then return true end
        end, config.returnLockTimeoutSeconds)
        if not released then
            emit("B17_RETURN_LOCK_PENDING", {world = home})
            return {ok = false, code = "B17_RETURN_LOCK_PENDING", reason = "BossFight"}
        end
        local exit = ctx:await(function()
            if player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") == true then return "BOSS_COMMAND_HIDEOUT" end
            if not observer:inArenaPosition() then return "OUTSIDE_ARENA" end
        end, config.exitTimeoutSeconds)
        emit("B17_ARENA_EXIT", {code = exit or "LOCK_RELEASED_STILL_IN_ARENA"})
        -- As in tested standalone V1, a released lock permits a direct verified travel even
        -- if the game has not repositioned the player outside the arena yet.
        if not ctx:wait(1.5) then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        local request, prepare, result = remote("RequestWorldTravel"), remote("NavPrepareWorlds"), remote("WorldTravelResult")
        if not request or not prepare then return {ok = false, code = "B17_WORLD_TRAVEL_REMOTES_MISSING"} end
        local position = platform:position()
        if not position then return {ok = false, code = "CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE"} end
        if tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")) == home
            and player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") ~= true
            and not observer:inArenaPosition() then
            return {ok = true, code = "ALREADY_IN_HOME", world = home}
        end
        local reply
        local connection = result and result.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
            if type(e) == "table" and e.Kind == "Result" and tonumber(e.WorldId) == home then reply = e end
        end) or nil
        local function finish(ok, code, reason)
            if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
            emit("B17_DIRECT_RETURN", {ok = ok, code = code, reason = reason, world = home})
            return {ok = ok, code = code, reason = reason, world = home}
        end
        for attempt = 1, config.returnRetries do
            if not active(ctx) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            reply = nil
            local prior = platform:position()
            if not prior then return finish(false, "CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE") end
            local sent, err = pcall(function() prepare:FireServer("stream", home) end)
            if not sent then return finish(false, "WORLD_PREPARE_SEND_FAILED", tostring(err)) end
            if not ctx:wait(0.12) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            sent, err = pcall(function() request:FireServer(home) end)
            if not sent then return finish(false, "WORLD_REQUEST_SEND_FAILED", tostring(err)) end
            local observed = ctx:await(function()
                if reply and reply.Ok == false then return "REJECTED" end
                local current = platform:position()
                if current and platform:distance(current, prior) > 50
                    and tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")) == home
                    and player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") ~= true
                    and player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true
                    and not observer:inArenaPosition() then return "VERIFIED" end
            end, 17)
            emit("B17_RETURN_ATTEMPT", {attempt = attempt, code = observed or "AMBIGUOUS",
                reason = reply and reply.Reason})
            if observed == "VERIFIED" then return finish(true, "B17_HOME_VERIFIED") end
            if observed ~= "REJECTED" then return finish(false, "B17_RETURN_AMBIGUOUS_NO_RETRY") end
            local why = tostring(reply.Reason or "UNKNOWN")
            if why ~= "BossFight" or attempt == config.returnRetries then
                return finish(false, "B17_WORLD_RETURN_REJECTED", why)
            end
            if not ctx:wait(12) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            local settled = ctx:await(function()
                if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true then return true end
            end, 40)
            if not settled then return finish(false, "B17_LOCK_STILL_ACTIVE", "BossFight") end
        end
        return finish(false, "B17_WORLD_RETURN_EXHAUSTED")
    end
    return command
end
return CommandController
end
-- END MODULE boss.B17.CommandController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.B17.Config

return {
    bossId = "B17", displayName = "B-17 Flying Fortress", gameBossKey = "B17",
    arenaCenter = {x = -16384, z = -16376}, arenaRadius = 650,
    commandSafePosition = {x = -31962.1074, y = 344.357483, z = 32887.3203},
    arenaTimeout = 48, maxFightSeconds = 690,
    reportTimeoutSeconds = 75, reportHoldSeconds = 3,
    reportCloseTimeoutSeconds = 125, exitTimeoutSeconds = 65,
    returnLockTimeoutSeconds = 80, returnRetries = 3,
}
end

end
