-- BEGIN MODULE boss.B17.ReportController
__factories["boss.B17.ReportController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local DeferredOutcome = require("boss.shared.DeferredOutcome")
-- B-17 adaptive report: Outcome -> report (any location) -> Continue -> exit -> return.
-- Port of standalone V1; never treat Outcome alone as a completed report.
local ReportController = {}

function ReportController.new(env, config, repeatPolicy)
    local platform, gui, runtime = env.services.roblox, env.services.gui, env.runtime
    local player = platform:player()
    local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
    local writer = env.state:port("boss")
    local report = {}
    local terminal = DeferredOutcome.new(env, config.bossId, "B17FightGeneration")
    local confirmedOutcome, outcomeAt = nil, nil
    local lastHealthAt = 0
    local seenReport, firstOpenedAt = false, nil
    local listeningContext, connection, resultsController = nil, nil, nil
    local function emit(name, data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit(name, data or {}) end
    end
    local function loadController()
        if resultsController then return resultsController end
        local folder = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("ClientModules")
        local mod = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("BossResultsController")
        if not mod or not mod:IsA("ModuleScript") then return nil end
        -- The build bundler replaces project requires. Invoke Roblox require only
        -- dynamically for the game's own ModuleScript, as the B21 controller does.
        local loader = getfenv(0)["require"]
        local ok, value = pcall(loader, mod)
        if not ok or type(value) ~= "table" then return nil end
        if type(value.IsOpen) ~= "function" or type(value.Dismiss) ~= "function" then return nil end
        resultsController = value
        return value
    end
    local function officialOpen()
        local ctrl = loadController()
        if ctrl and type(ctrl.IsOpen) == "function" then
            local ok, result = pcall(ctrl.IsOpen)
            if ok and result == true then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function isOpen()
        return player:GetAttribute("BossResultsOpen") == true or officialOpen()
    end
    local function matchingReport(guiRoot)
        if not guiRoot then return nil end
        local b17, won, lost = false, false, false
        for _, node in ipairs(guiRoot:GetDescendants()) do
            if node:IsA("TextLabel") then
                local value = string.upper(tostring(node.Text or ""))
                if value:find("B-17", 1, true) or value:find("B17", 1, true)
                    or value:find("FLYING FORTRESS", 1, true) then b17 = true end
                if value:find("DEFEATED", 1, true) or value:find("VICTORY", 1, true) then won = true end
                if value:find("MISSION FAILED", 1, true) then lost = true end
            end
        end
        if b17 and won ~= lost then return won and "WIN" or "LOSS" end
        return nil
    end

    function report:watch(ctx)
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        if listeningContext == ctx and connection then return true end
        if connection then connection:Disconnect(); connection = nil end
        local folder = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        local remote = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("B17Event")
        if not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then return false, "B17_EVENT_MISSING" end
        local current = remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(packet)
            if type(packet) ~= "table" or type(packet.K) ~= "string" then return end
            terminal:observe(packet)
            local kind = packet.K
            if kind == "Outcome" and type(packet.Victory) == "boolean" then
                confirmedOutcome = packet.Victory and "WIN" or "LOSS"
                outcomeAt = runtime:now()
            end
            if kind == "Start" or kind == "Begin" or kind == "Phase" or kind == "Attack"
                or kind == "Objective" or kind == "Frenzy" or kind == "Health"
                or kind == "End" or kind == "Outcome" then
                if kind == "Health" then
                    if runtime:now() - lastHealthAt < 4 then return end
                    lastHealthAt = runtime:now()
                end
                local detail = {kind = kind}
                for _, field in ipairs({"Phase", "Name", "Reason", "EndReason", "Victory",
                    "Kind", "State", "Index", "From", "To", "HP", "MaxHP", "Generation"}) do
                    local value = packet[field]
                    if type(value) == "string" or type(value) == "number" or type(value) == "boolean" then
                        detail[field] = value
                    end
                end
                if kind == "Attack" and type(packet.Bombs) == "table" then
                    detail.bombs = #packet.Bombs
                end
                emit("B17_EVENT", detail)
            end
        end)
        connection, listeningContext = current, ctx
        ctx:deferCleanup(function()
            if connection == current then
                current:Disconnect()
                connection, listeningContext = nil, nil
            end
        end)
        return true
    end
    function report:cleanup()
        if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
        connection, listeningContext = nil, nil
        -- Keep outcome and report evidence across RETURN/REPORT retries.
    end
    function report:verifiedDeferredOutcome(encounter)
        return terminal:verified(encounter, "LOSS")
    end
    function report:resetOutcome()
        terminal:reset()
        confirmedOutcome, outcomeAt, seenReport, firstOpenedAt = nil, nil, false, nil
    end
    function report:inspect()
        local root = gui:find(env.profile.paths.bossReport)
        local active = isOpen() -- Same verified V2 signal: BossResultsOpen or official controller.IsOpen()
        if active then
            seenReport = true
            firstOpenedAt = firstOpenedAt or runtime:now()
        end
        local guiOutcome = active and matchingReport(root) or nil
        local outcome = confirmedOutcome or guiOutcome
        return {
            active = active, matchesBoss = confirmedOutcome ~= nil or guiOutcome ~= nil,
            outcome = outcome, report = root, seen = seenReport,
            pendingPresentation = confirmedOutcome ~= nil and not seenReport
                and outcomeAt ~= nil and runtime:now() - outcomeAt < config.reportTimeoutSeconds,
        }
    end
    function report:reconcile(encounter)
        local evidence = self:inspect()
        if evidence.matchesBoss and evidence.outcome
            and (not encounter.outcome or encounter.outcome == evidence.outcome) then return true end
        return encounter.outcome ~= nil and seenReport and not evidence.active
    end
    function report:resolve(ctx, encounter)
        local watching, why = self:watch(ctx)
        if not watching then return {ok = false, code = why} end
        -- V2 REQUIREMENT: Outcome alone never authorizes return/Continue.
        local evidence = ctx:await(function()
            local current = self:inspect()
            if current.active and current.matchesBoss and current.outcome then return current end
            if seenReport and not current.active and (encounter.outcome or current.outcome) then
                return current -- manually dismissed report after previously observing it
            end
        end, config.reportTimeoutSeconds)
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        if not evidence then return {ok = false, code = "B17_REPORT_NOT_OBSERVED"} end
        if evidence.outcome and encounter.outcome and evidence.outcome ~= encounter.outcome then
            return {ok = false, held = true, code = "BOSS_OUTCOME_CONFLICT"}
        end
        local outcome = evidence.outcome or encounter.outcome
        if not outcome then return {ok = false, code = "B17_OUTCOME_UNVERIFIED"} end
        if not encounter.outcome then
            local accepted = writer:recordBossReport(outcome,
                runtime:epoch() + repeatPolicy:outcomeDelay(outcome))
            if not accepted then return {ok = false, held = true, code = "BOSS_OUTCOME_CONFLICT"} end
            encounter = env.state:snapshot().boss.encounter
        end
        if not evidence.active then
            writer:closeReport()
            return {ok = true, code = "B17_REPORT_MANUALLY_CLOSED"}
        end
        local at = platform:position()
        local place = player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") == true and "HIDEOUT" or "OTHER"
        if place == "OTHER" and at then
            local dx, dz = at.X - config.arenaCenter.x, at.Z - config.arenaCenter.z
            if dx * dx + dz * dz < config.arenaRadius * config.arenaRadius then
                place = "ARENA"
            end
        end
        emit("B17_REPORT_OPEN", {outcome = outcome, location = place,
            inBossFight = player:GetAttribute("InBossFight")})
        local controller = loadController()
        if not controller then return {ok = false, code = "B17_RESULT_CONTROLLER_MISSING_MANUAL_CONTINUE"} end
        if not encounter.continueAttempted then
            local ready = ctx:await(function()
                if not isOpen() then return "MANUALLY_CLOSED" end
                local armed = false
                if type(controller.Debug) == "function" then
                    local ok, message = pcall(controller.Debug)
                    armed = ok and type(message) == "string"
                        and message:find("armed=true", 1, true) ~= nil
                end
                if armed and firstOpenedAt
                    and runtime:now() - firstOpenedAt >= config.reportHoldSeconds then return "ARMED" end
            end, config.reportTimeoutSeconds)
            if ctx:isCancelled() then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
            if ready == "MANUALLY_CLOSED" then
                writer:closeReport()
                return {ok = true, code = "B17_REPORT_MANUALLY_CLOSED"}
            end
            if ready ~= "ARMED" then return {ok = false, code = "B17_REPORT_NOT_ARMED_MANUAL_CONTINUE"} end
            if not writer:markContinueAttempt() then return {ok = false, code = "B17_CONTINUE_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED"} end
            local sent, err = pcall(function() controller.Dismiss("continue") end)
            if not sent then return {ok = false, code = "B17_CONTINUE_FAILED: " .. tostring(err)} end
            emit("B17_REPORT_CONTINUE", {code = "CONTINUE_REQUESTED"})
        end
        local closed = ctx:await(function() if not self:inspect().active then return true end end,
            config.reportCloseTimeoutSeconds)
        if not closed then return {ok = false, code = "B17_REPORT_STILL_OPEN_MANUAL_CONTINUE"} end
        writer:closeReport()
        return {ok = true, code = "B17_REPORT_CLOSED"}
    end
    return report
end
return ReportController
end
-- END MODULE boss.B17.ReportController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.B21.ArenaObserver
__factories["boss.B21.ArenaObserver"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local GuiAdapter = require("main.adapters.GuiAdapter")
local ArenaObserver = {}

function ArenaObserver.new(env, config)
    local platform, gui, runtime = env.services.roblox, env.services.gui, env.runtime
    local observer = {}
    local caches = {}
    local function descendants(key, root, predicate)
        if not root then return {} end
        local ctx, character = runtime:activeJob(), platform:character().character
        -- Read-only inspection without a job installs no persistent observers.
        if not ctx or ctx.readOnly then return root:GetDescendants() end
        local cache = caches[key]
        if not cache or cache.root ~= root or cache.ctx ~= ctx or cache.character ~= character then
            if cache then for _, connection in ipairs(cache.connections) do connection:Disconnect() end end
            cache = {root = root, ctx = ctx, character = character, dirty = true, connections = {}}
            caches[key] = cache
            local function invalidate() cache.dirty = true end
            for _, name in ipairs({"DescendantAdded", "DescendantRemoving"}) do
                if root[name] then cache.connections[#cache.connections + 1] = root[name]:Connect(invalidate) end
            end
            ctx:deferCleanup(function()
                for _, connection in ipairs(cache.connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
                if caches[key] == cache then caches[key] = nil end
            end)
        end
        if cache.dirty or runtime:now() >= (cache.expires or 0) then
            local started, found = runtime:now(), {}
            for _, item in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do if predicate(item) then found[#found + 1] = item end end
            cache.items, cache.dirty, cache.expires = found, false, runtime:now() + (config.cacheTTL or 1)
            if env.services.telemetry then env.services.telemetry:sample("arenaScan", runtime:now() - started) end
        end
        local live = {}
        for _, item in ipairs(cache.items) do
            if item:IsDescendantOf(root) and predicate(item) then live[#live + 1] = item end
        end
        return live
    end
    function observer:inArena()
        local p, b = platform:position(), config.arenaBounds
        return p ~= nil and p.X > b.minX and p.X < b.maxX and p.Z > b.minZ and p.Z < b.maxZ
    end
    function observer:folders()
        local visuals = platform:findWorld(config.visuals)
        return visuals, visuals and visuals:FindFirstChild(config.radars), visuals and visuals:FindFirstChild(config.bombs)
    end
    function observer:phase()
        if not self:inArena() then return nil end
        local root, phase = platform:playerGui(), nil
        for _, label in ipairs(descendants("phase", root, function(item) return item.Name == config.phaseLabel and item:IsA("TextLabel") end)) do
            if label.Name == config.phaseLabel and label:IsA("TextLabel") then
                -- Reading the TextLabel property does not require it to be enabled,
                -- visible, or within the camera viewport. Treat this as a hint:
                -- when the HUD has not been created, radar maintenance still runs.
                local text = GuiAdapter.normalize(label.Text)
                if text:find("PHASE III", 1, true) then return 3 end
                if text:find("PHASE II", 1, true) then phase = 2
                elseif text:find("PHASE I", 1, true) then phase = phase or 1 end
            end
        end
        return phase
    end
    function observer:action(prompt)
        return tostring(prompt.ActionText or ""):lower():gsub("[%s%-]", "")
    end
    function observer:radars(includeDisabled)
        local _, folder = self:folders()
        local found = {}
        if not self:inArena() or not folder then return found end
        local position = platform:position()
        for _, prompt in ipairs(descendants("radars", folder, function(item) return item:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and item.Name == config.radarPrompt end)) do
            if prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and prompt.Name == config.radarPrompt and (includeDisabled or prompt.Enabled) then
                local part = prompt:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BasePart")
                if part then found[#found + 1] = {prompt = prompt, part = part,
                    action = self:action(prompt), distance = platform:distance(position, part.Position)} end
            end
        end
        table.sort(found, function(a, b) return a.distance < b.distance end)
        return found
    end
    function observer:radarState(item)
        local _, folder = self:folders()
        local node = item.prompt
        if not folder or not node:IsDescendantOf(folder) then
            return {status = "UNAVAILABLE", observedAt = runtime:now(), epoch = runtime:epoch()}
        end
        while node.Parent ~= folder do node = node.Parent end
        local parts, ancestor = {}, node
        while ancestor do table.insert(parts, 1, ancestor.Name); ancestor = ancestor.Parent end
        local root, feed = node:FindFirstChild("Root"), node:FindFirstChild("Feed")
        -- Also accept a radar whose top-level object is itself the root part.
        root = root or (node:IsA("BasePart") and node or nil)
        local beacon = root and root:FindFirstChild("Beacon")
        local lock = feed and feed:FindFirstChild("Lock")
        local b = beacon and beacon:IsA("Beam") and beacon.Enabled
        local l = lock and lock:IsA("Beam") and lock.Enabled
        local p = item.prompt.Enabled
        local status = "UNKNOWN"
        local action = self:action(item.prompt)
        -- The client game maps Iced -> De-ice and Down -> Repair. Beams alone
        -- cannot distinguish the two. This is client evidence, not server state.
        if beacon and beacon:IsA("Beam") and lock and lock:IsA("Beam") then
            if b == true and l == false and p == true then
                if action == "deice" then status = "FROZEN"
                elseif action == "repair" then status = "DOWN" end
            elseif b == false and l == true and p == false then status = "TRACKING" end
        end
        return {radar = node, radarPath = table.concat(parts, "/"), prompt = item.prompt,
            part = item.prompt:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BasePart"), beacon = beacon, lock = lock,
            beaconEnabled = b, lockEnabled = l, promptEnabled = p, status = status,
            action = action, maintenance = status == "FROZEN" and "DEICE" or status == "DOWN" and "REPAIR" or nil,
            observedAt = runtime:now(), epoch = runtime:epoch()}
    end
    function observer:observe(session)
        local started = runtime:now()
        if not self:inArena() then return nil, {} end
        session.radarObservations = session.radarObservations or {}
        local exact, states, seen = self:phase(), {}, {}
        for _, item in ipairs(self:radars(true)) do
            local state = self:radarState(item)
            local old = session.radarObservations[state.radar]
            local same = old and old.prompt == state.prompt and old.part == state.part
                and old.beacon == state.beacon and old.lock == state.lock
            local needs = state.status == "FROZEN" or state.status == "DOWN"
            local wasReady = old and (old.status == "TRACKING" or old.status == "UNKNOWN" and old.lastStatus == "TRACKING")
            local freshCycle = needs and (not same or wasReady or old.status ~= state.status)
            state.generation = same and old.generation or 0
            if freshCycle then state.generation = state.generation + 1 end
            -- Preserve coherent status across a transient visual gap only for diagnostics.
            if state.status == "UNKNOWN" and same then state.lastStatus = old.lastStatus or old.status end
            if state.radar then session.radarObservations[state.radar], seen[state.radar] = state, true end
            states[item.prompt] = state
        end
        -- Streaming gaps/replacements cannot establish a new phase from old status alone.
        for node in pairs(session.radarObservations) do
            if not seen[node] then session.radarObservations[node] = nil end
        end
        -- Only a HUD phase is phase evidence. A periodic squall may freeze a
        -- radar without advancing phase. If the HUD is not created/on-screen,
        -- keep servicing B21 radar objects with a provisional Phase 1 token.
        -- This token is for navigation identity only, NOT proof of game phase.
        if exact then
            if not session.confirmedPhase or exact > session.confirmedPhase then
                session.confirmedPhase = exact
            end
            session.hasHudPhase = true
            session.phaseSource = "HUD_TEXT"
        elseif session.hasHudPhase and session.confirmedPhase then
            session.phaseSource = "LAST_HUD"
        else
            session.confirmedPhase = session.confirmedPhase or 1
            session.phaseSource = "ARENA_FALLBACK_UNVERIFIED"
        end
        session.hudPhase = exact
        session.observedPhase = session.confirmedPhase
        if env.services.telemetry then env.services.telemetry:sample("arenaObservation", runtime:now() - started) end
        return session.confirmedPhase, states
    end
    function observer:resolvedPhase(session)
        local phase = self:observe(session)
        return phase
    end
    local function distanceXZ(a, b)
        return math.sqrt((a.X - b.X)^2 + (a.Z - b.Z)^2)
    end
    function observer:rings(position)
        local _, _, bombs = self:folders()
        local found = {}
        if not self:inArena() or not bombs then return found end
        for _, ring in ipairs(descendants("rings", bombs, function(item) return item:IsA("CylinderHandleAdornment") and item.Name == config.ring end)) do
            if ring:IsA("CylinderHandleAdornment") and ring.Name == config.ring and ring.Visible then
                local anchor = ring.Adornee
                if not anchor or not anchor:IsA("BasePart") then anchor = ring:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BasePart") end
                local ok, center = pcall(function() return anchor and (anchor.CFrame * ring.CFrame).Position end)
                if ok and center and type(ring.Radius) == "number" and ring.Radius >= 0
                    and math.abs(center.Y - position.Y) < 35 and distanceXZ(position, center) < ring.Radius + 125 then
                    found[#found + 1] = {center = center, radius = ring.Radius}
                end
            end
        end
        return found
    end
    function observer:clearance(position, rings)
        local nearest = math.huge
        for _, ring in ipairs(rings) do nearest = math.min(nearest, distanceXZ(position, ring.center) - ring.radius) end
        return nearest
    end
    function observer:reviveState()
        local root = platform:playerGui()
        for _, screen in ipairs(root and root:GetChildren() or {}) do
            if screen:IsA("ScreenGui") and screen.Enabled then
                local context, exhausted, buttons, seen = false, false, 0, {}
                for _, item in ipairs(descendants(screen, screen, function(item)
                    return item:IsA("TextLabel") or item:IsA("GuiButton") or item:IsA("TextBox")
                end)) do
                    local record = gui:readText(item)
                    if record then
                        local text = record.value:gsub("[%c%p]+", " "):gsub("%s+", " ")
                        if text:find("STORM OVERWHELMED", 1, true) or text == "REVIVE"
                            or text:find("REVIVES LEFT", 1, true) or text:find("GIVING UP IN", 1, true) then context = true end
                        if text:find("REVIVES UNAVAILABLE", 1, true) or text:find("NO REVIVES REMAINING", 1, true)
                            or text == "CONTINUE" then exhausted = true end
                        if text == "GIVE UP" then
                            local button = item:IsA("GuiButton") and item or item:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("GuiButton")
                            if button and gui:visible(button) and button.Active and not seen[button] then
                                seen[button], buttons = true, buttons + 1
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if context and exhausted then return "EXHAUSTED" end
                if context and buttons == 1 then return "DOWNED" end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    -- Compatibility for older diagnostics. This is NOT a final LOSS indication.
    function observer:defeatPopup() return self:reviveState() ~= nil end
    return observer
end

return ArenaObserver
end
-- END MODULE boss.B21.ArenaObserver

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.B21.B21Raider
__factories["boss.B21.B21Raider"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local Contracts = require("main.core.Contracts")
local CommandController = require("boss.B21.CommandController")
local ArenaObserver = require("boss.B21.ArenaObserver")
local RadarController = require("boss.B21.RadarController")
local DodgeController = require("boss.B21.DodgeController")
local CombatController = require("boss.B21.CombatController")
local ReportController = require("boss.B21.ReportController")
local RepeatPolicy = require("boss.B21.RepeatPolicy")
local WeatherObserver = require("boss.B21.WeatherObserver")
local B21Config = require("boss.B21.Config")
local B21Raider = {}
function B21Raider.definition()
    return {bossId = "B21_RAIDER", displayName = "B-21 Raider", create = function(env)
        local config = B21Config.forProfile(Contracts.copy(env.profile.b21))
        local observer = ArenaObserver.new(env, config)
        local repeatPolicy = RepeatPolicy.new(env)
        local report = ReportController.new(env, repeatPolicy)
        local radar = RadarController.new(env, config, observer)
        local dodge = DodgeController.new(env, observer)
        local weather = WeatherObserver.new(env, config)
        return {config = config, observer = observer, repeatPolicy = repeatPolicy, report = report, weather = weather,
            command = CommandController.new(env, config, observer),
            combat = CombatController.new(env, config, observer, radar, dodge, report, weather)}
    end}
end
return B21Raider
end
