-- BEGIN MODULE boss.B21.CombatController
__factories["boss.B21.CombatController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local Contracts = require("main.core.Contracts")
local CombatController = {}
function CombatController.new(env, config, observer, radar, dodge, report, weather)
    local platform, movement, runtime = env.services.roblox, env.services.movement, env.runtime
    local combat = {}
    function combat:run(ctx, encounter)
        if not ctx:await(function() return observer:inArena() and true or nil end, config.arenaTimeout) then
            return {code = "ARENA_UNVERIFIED"}
        end
        if not ctx:await(function() local visuals = observer:folders(); return visuals end, config.visualsTimeout) then
            return {code = "ARENA_NOT_STREAMED"}
        end
        if not ctx:await(function() local _, radars = observer:folders(); return radars end, config.childrenTimeout)
            or not ctx:await(function() local _, _, bombs = observer:folders(); return bombs end, config.childrenTimeout) then
            return {code = "ARENA_NOT_STREAMED"}
        end
        local character = platform:character()
        if not character.ready or ctx:isCancelled() then return {code = "CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE"} end
        local lease, leaseCode = movement:acquire(ctx)
        if not lease then return {code = leaseCode} end
        -- This is the only combat lease. All radar paths, holds, and Dodge calls are serial.
        local speedSet, speedCode = movement:setSpeed(ctx, lease, env.profile.boss.walkSpeed)
        if not speedSet then assert(movement:release(lease)); return {code = speedCode} end
        local session = {
            character = character.character, root = character.root, humanoid = character.humanoid,
            completed = Contracts.copy(encounter.completedPhases or {}),
            -- Old checkpoints may have inferred phases from radar refreeze.
            -- Demand a fresh HUD observation before acting on a phase.
            observedPhase = nil, confirmedPhase = nil,
            nextAttempt = {}, failures = {}, lastDodgeAt = -math.huge,
            lastDeiceAt = runtime:now() - math.max(0, runtime:epoch() - (encounter.lastDeiceAt or 0)),
            deadline = runtime:now() + (config.maxRuntime or env.profile.boss.maxRuntime),
            ending = function()
                local evidence = report:inspect()
                return evidence.active or evidence.outcome ~= nil or observer:reviveState() ~= nil
            end,
        }
        local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
        local stopFrames = telemetry and telemetry:startFrames(ctx, platform)
        -- Radar/Repair owns the movement lease during maintenance. Dodge must
        -- not interrupt a required 1.6s/3s hold or repeatedly starve navigation.
        -- Character death, cancellation and encounter end remain checked by radar.
        session.radarFocus = false
        session.immediateThreat = function()
            return not session.radarFocus and dodge:threat()
        end
        session.navigationInterrupt = function()
            if session.radarFocus or not dodge:threat() then return nil end
            movement:stop(ctx, lease)
            local ok, dodgeCode = dodge:step(ctx, lease, session, true)
            if not ok then return dodgeCode end
            if session.dodgeTarget and dodgeCode == "TARGET_RETAINED" then
                local moved, moveCode = movement:moveTo(ctx, lease, session.dodgeTarget, true)
                if not moved then return moveCode end
            end
            if telemetry then telemetry:emit("DODGE_INTERRUPT", {phase = session.observedPhase, code = dodgeCode}, 0.5) end
            return "DODGE_INTERRUPTED"
        end
        -- Stage through the normal combat tick, only after the first danger scan.
        -- Actionable radar maintenance still takes priority immediately.
        local staged = false
        local code = "COMBAT_TIMEOUT"
        local weatherSnapshot, lastWeatherSignature, nextWeatherLog = nil, nil, 0
        while not ctx:isCancelled() and runtime:now() < session.deadline do
            local evidence = report:inspect()
            if evidence.active or evidence.outcome then code = "AWAIT_REPORT"; break end
            -- Downed/revive is NOT final defeat. Stop movement and wait for the
            -- actual result, manual revive, or a character change.
            local revive = observer:reviveState()
            if revive then
                movement:stop(ctx, lease)
                if telemetry then telemetry:emit("B21_REVIVE_PENDING", {state = revive}, 4) end
                if not ctx:wait(config.combatPoll) then break end
            else
            local current = platform:character()
            if current.character ~= session.character or current.root ~= session.root or current.humanoid ~= session.humanoid
                or not current.ready then code = "CHARACTER_CHANGED"; break end
            if not observer:inArena() then code = "ARENA_LEFT"; break end
            local phase = observer:resolvedPhase(session)
            -- Weather inspection is advisory only; no unverified altitude teleport.
            if weather then
                weatherSnapshot = weather:inspect()
                local signature = weatherSnapshot and (weatherSnapshot.kind .. ":" .. weatherSnapshot.stage) or "UNKNOWN"
                if signature ~= lastWeatherSignature or runtime:now() >= nextWeatherLog then
                    if telemetry then telemetry:emit("B21_WEATHER", weatherSnapshot or {kind = "UNKNOWN"}, 1) end
                    lastWeatherSignature, nextWeatherLog = signature, runtime:now() + 8
                end
            end
            -- Select maintenance FIRST, even if the HUD is absent/offscreen.
            -- Radar selection uses the world prompt + Beacon/Lock, never GUI.
            local item = radar:select(session, false)
            if item then
                session.radarFocus = true
                movement:stop(ctx, lease)
                if telemetry then telemetry:emit("B21_RADAR_PRIORITY", {phase = phase,
                    phaseSource = session.phaseSource, radar = item.part.Name}, 1) end
                local ran, radarOK, radarCode = pcall(radar.step, radar, ctx, lease, session, phase, item)
                session.radarFocus = false
                if not ran then
                    code = "RADAR_STEP_EXCEPTION:" .. tostring(radarOK)
                    break
                end
                if session.fatalInputCode then code = session.fatalInputCode; break end
                if radarCode == "CHARACTER_CHANGED" or radarCode == "DEAD" or radarCode == "CANCELLED" then
                    code = radarCode; break
                end
            else
                -- Only dodge after radar has no actionable maintenance this tick.
                local interruption = session.navigationInterrupt()
                if interruption and interruption ~= "DODGE_INTERRUPTED" then code = interruption; break end
                if interruption ~= "DODGE_INTERRUPTED" then
                    -- Without actionable maintenance, hazard avoidance runs in EVERY
                    -- phase. Optional Phase-I staging must never suppress dodge.
                    local ok, dodgeCode = dodge:step(ctx, lease, session)
                    if not ok then code = dodgeCode; break end
                    if phase == 1 and not staged and dodgeCode == "SAFE" then
                        staged = radar:preposition(ctx, lease, session)
                    end
                end
            end
            if telemetry then telemetry:flush(false) end
            if not ctx:wait(config.combatPoll) then break end
            end -- non-downed branch
        end
        movement:stop(ctx, lease)
        local released, releaseCode = movement:release(lease)
        assert(released, releaseCode or "Combat movement release failed")
        if stopFrames then stopFrames() end
        if telemetry then telemetry:flush(true) end
        return {code = ctx:isCancelled() and "CANCELLED" or code, completedPhases = Contracts.copy(session.completed)}
    end
    return combat
end
return CombatController
end
-- END MODULE boss.B21.CombatController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.B21.CommandController
__factories["boss.B21.CommandController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- B21 DIRECT entry. No Worlds GUI, Boss Command GUI, prompt, camera or mouse.
-- The server pass (StartBoss) must approve BEFORE the single Solo accept.
local DirectBossTravel = require("main.navigation.DirectBossTravel")
local CommandController = {}

function CommandController.new(env, config, observer)
    local platform, runtime = env.services.roblox, env.runtime
    local player = platform:player()
    local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
    local function emit(event, data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit(event, data or {}) end
    end
    local travel = DirectBossTravel.new(env)
    local command = {}
    local remotes = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
    local function remote(name)
        local item = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild(name)
        return item and item:IsA("RemoteEvent") and item or nil
    end
    local function active(ctx) return runtime:isActive(ctx) and not ctx:isCancelled() end
    local function safeDisconnect(connection)
        if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
    end

    function command:prepare(ctx)
        if observer:inArena() then return true, "B21_ALREADY_IN_ARENA" end
        if not active(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        local entered = travel:enterHideout(ctx)
        emit("B21_DIRECT_HIDEOUT", {code = entered.code, ok = entered.ok, reason = entered.reason})
        if not entered.ok then return false, entered.code .. (entered.reason and (": " .. entered.reason) or "") end
        local positioned = travel:moveToKnownPoint(ctx, config.commandSafePosition, {
            requireHideout = true, radius = 5, settle = 0.8,
        })
        emit("B21_DIRECT_COMMAND_POSITION", {code = positioned.code, ok = positioned.ok})
        if not positioned.ok then return false, positioned.code end
        return true, "B21_DIRECT_COMMAND_READY"
    end

    function command:readiness()
        if observer:inArena() then return "READY" end
        if not travel:inHideout() then return "UNKNOWN" end
        -- Server-side cooldown remains authoritative. Parse only the replicated estimate.
        local raw = player:GetAttribute("BossStartCooldowns")
        if type(raw) == "string" and raw ~= "" then
            local ok, decoded = pcall(function()
                return platform:service("HttpService"):JSONDecode(raw)
            end)
            if ok and type(decoded) == "table" then
                local expires = tonumber(decoded[config.gameBossKey or "B21"])
                if expires and expires > platform:workspace():GetServerTimeNow() then
                    local seconds = math.ceil(expires - platform:workspace():GetServerTimeNow())
                    return string.format("%d:%02d", math.floor(seconds / 60), seconds % 60)
                end
            end
        end
        -- The pass request is still required and may reject other eligibility checks.
        return "READY"
    end

    function command:startSolo(ctx, markAttempt)
        if not active(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        if not travel:inHideout() then return false, "NOT_IN_HIDEOUT" end
        if self:readiness() ~= "READY" then return false, "BOSS_NOT_READY" end
        local hideoutRemote = remote("PersonalHideoutRemote")
        local acceptRemote = remote("B21CommanderAccept")
        if not hideoutRemote or not acceptRemote then return false, "DIRECT_B21_REMOTES_MISSING" end

        local passReply, acceptReply
        local passConnection = hideoutRemote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(packet)
            if type(packet) == "table" and packet.Kind == "BossCommand" and packet.Op == "Start"
                and packet.BossKey == (config.gameBossKey or "B21") then
                passReply = packet
            end
        end)
        local acceptConnection = acceptRemote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(packet)
            if type(packet) == "table" and packet.Accepted ~= nil then acceptReply = packet end
        end)
        local function finish(ok, code)
            safeDisconnect(passConnection)
            safeDisconnect(acceptConnection)
            return ok, code
        end

        local sent, why = pcall(function()
            hideoutRemote:FireServer({Action = "StartBoss", BossKey = config.gameBossKey or "B21", Solo = true})
        end)
        if not sent then return finish(false, "BOSS_PASS_SEND_ERROR: " .. tostring(why)) end
        local passResult = ctx:await(function()
            if passReply then return passReply end
        end, 9)
        if not active(ctx) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
        if not passResult then
            emit("B21_DIRECT_PASS", {code = "AMBIGUOUS"})
            return finish(false, "BOSS_PASS_AMBIGUOUS_NO_RETRY")
        end
        emit("B21_DIRECT_PASS", {ok = passResult.Ok, reason = passResult.Reason})
        if passResult.Ok ~= true then
            return finish(false, "BOSS_PASS_REJECTED: " .. tostring(passResult.Reason))
        end
        if not markAttempt() then return finish(false, "SOLO_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED") end
        sent, why = pcall(function()
            acceptRemote:FireServer({Solo = true})
        end)
        if not sent then return finish(false, "B21_ACCEPT_SEND_ERROR: " .. tostring(why)) end
        local observed = ctx:await(function()
            if observer:inArena() then return "ARENA" end
            if acceptReply and acceptReply.Accepted == false then return "REJECTED" end
            -- Accepted can arrive before arena streaming; keep waiting.
        end, config.arenaTimeout)
        if not active(ctx) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
        emit("B21_DIRECT_SOLO", {code = observed or "AMBIGUOUS", accepted = acceptReply and acceptReply.Accepted})
        if observed == "ARENA" then return finish(true, "B21_ARENA_VERIFIED") end
        if observed == "REJECTED" then
            return finish(false, "B21_ACCEPT_REJECTED: " .. tostring(acceptReply.Reason))
        end
        return finish(false, "B21_ACCEPT_AMBIGUOUS_NO_RETRY")
    end

    function command:close(_) return true end -- No GUI opened by this module.
    function command:returnHome(ctx, homeWorld)
        local result = travel:travelWorld(ctx, homeWorld)
        emit("B21_DIRECT_RETURN", {code = result.code, ok = result.ok, world = homeWorld,
            reason = result.reason, inBossFight = player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true})
        return result
    end
    return command
end

return CommandController
end
-- END MODULE boss.B21.CommandController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.B21.Config
__factories["boss.B21.Config"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- B21-only overrides; no global profile mutation and no imports of other features.
local Config = {}
function Config.forProfile(base)
    local output = {}
    for key, value in pairs(base) do output[key] = value end
    output.gameBossKey = "B21"
    output.maxRuntime = 1200 -- game encounter timer, source/client config
    output.repairTimeout = 5 -- room for 3s hold + verification
    output.maintenanceSettle = 1.25
    output.enableRepair = true -- enable Iced/De-ice and Down/Repair actions; verify TRACKING
    -- User-tested safe position adjacent to B21 Boss Command in Hideout.
    output.commandSafePosition = {x = -31962.1074, y = 344.357483, z = 32887.3203}
    output.floorY = -65.2
    return output
end
return Config
end
-- END MODULE boss.B21.Config

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.B21.DodgeController
__factories["boss.B21.DodgeController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local DodgeController = {}
function DodgeController.new(env, observer)
    local platform, movement, runtime = env.services.roblox, env.services.movement, env.runtime
    local settings = env.profile.dodge
    local dodge = {}
    function dodge:threat()
        local position = platform:position()
        return position and observer:clearance(position, observer:rings(position)) <= settings.margin
    end
    function dodge:reset(session) session.dodgeTarget = nil end
    function dodge:step(ctx, lease, session, priority)
        local character = platform:character()
        if not character.ready or character.character ~= session.character or character.root ~= session.root
            or character.humanoid ~= session.humanoid then return false, "CHARACTER_CHANGED" end
        local position, rings = character.position, observer:rings(character.position)
        local danger = observer:clearance(position, rings)
        if danger > settings.caution then
            session.dodgeTarget = nil
            if env.services.telemetry then env.services.telemetry:emit("DODGE_SCAN", {
                clearance = danger == math.huge and -1 or danger,
                ringCount = #rings, code = "SAFE"}, 1) end
            return true, "SAFE"
        end
        if session.dodgeTarget and observer:clearance(session.dodgeTarget, rings) >= settings.margin
            and platform:distance(position, session.dodgeTarget) > 4
            and runtime:now() - session.lastDodgeAt < settings.targetRetention then
            -- The radar owner may have stopped movement after the target was
            -- chosen. Reissue the retained escape goal when dodge runs normally.
            if not priority then
                local moved, code = movement:moveTo(ctx, lease, session.dodgeTarget)
                if not moved then return false, code end
            end
            return true, "TARGET_RETAINED"
        end
        if runtime:now() - session.lastDodgeAt < (priority and 0.18 or settings.minInterval) then return true, "DODGE_THROTTLED" end
        session.lastDodgeAt = runtime:now()
        local _, radars, bombs = observer:folders()
        local exclude = {character.character}
        local candidates = {}
        for _, radius in ipairs(settings.radii) do
            for i = 1, settings.directions do
                local angle = i * 2 * math.pi / settings.directions
                local raw = position + platform:vector(math.cos(angle) * radius, 0, math.sin(angle) * radius)
                local clearance = observer:clearance(raw, rings)
                if clearance >= settings.margin then
                    -- Dodge chooses safety, never proximity to the radar.
                    -- The existing radarFocus priority is handled by CombatController.
                    candidates[#candidates + 1] = {raw = raw, score = math.min(clearance, 35) - radius * 0.35}
                end
            end
        end
        table.sort(candidates, function(a, b) return a.score > b.score end)
        local best
        -- Rank cheap geometry first; at most eight grounded/corridor candidates per pass.
        for i = 1, math.min(#candidates, settings.raycastCandidates or 8) do
            local ground = movement:ground(candidates[i].raw, {mode = "radar", exclude = {bombs, radars}})
            if ground and math.abs(ground.Y - position.Y) < 12 and observer:clearance(ground, rings) >= settings.margin then
                local origin = position + platform:vector(0, 1, 0)
                local direction = platform:vector(ground.X - position.X, 0, ground.Z - position.Z)
                local hit = platform:raycast(origin, direction, exclude)
                local pass = not hit or platform:distance(hit.Position, origin) >= direction.Magnitude - 2
                if pass then
                    for _, fraction in ipairs({0.35, 0.7}) do
                        if observer:clearance(position:Lerp(ground, fraction), rings) < math.min(danger - 2, -2) then pass = false end
                    end
                end
                if pass then best = ground; break end
            end
        end
        if env.services.telemetry then
            env.services.telemetry:emit("DODGE", {clearance = danger, ringCount = #rings, candidateCount = #candidates,
                code = best and "DODGED" or "NO_SAFE_PATH", priority = priority or false}, 0.5)
        end
        if not best then session.dodgeTarget = nil; return true, "NO_SAFE_PATH" end
        local moved, code = movement:moveTo(ctx, lease, best)
        if moved then session.dodgeTarget = best end
        return moved, moved and "DODGED" or code
    end
    return dodge
end
return DodgeController
end
-- END MODULE boss.B21.DodgeController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.B21.RadarController
__factories["boss.B21.RadarController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local RadarController = {}
function RadarController.new(env, config, observer)
    local platform, movement, runtime = env.services.roblox, env.services.movement, env.runtime
    local radar, navigationSequence = {}, 0
    local function valid(ctx, session, item, phase, staging)
        if ctx:isCancelled() or not runtime:isActive(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        local current = platform:character()
        if current.character ~= session.character or current.root ~= session.root or current.humanoid ~= session.humanoid
            or not current.ready then return false, "CHARACTER_CHANGED" end
        if session.ending and session.ending() then return false, "COMBAT_ENDED" end
        local _, folder = observer:folders()
        if not folder or not item.prompt:IsDescendantOf(folder) or item.prompt:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BasePart") ~= item.part then
            return false, "RADAR_REPLACED"
        end
        if not observer:inArena() or observer:resolvedPhase(session) ~= phase then return false, "PHASE_CHANGED" end
        if not staging then
            local state = observer:radarState(item)
            if not (state.status == "FROZEN" and state.action == "deice"
                or state.status == "DOWN" and state.action == "repair") then
                return false, "RADAR_INACTIVE"
            end
        end
        return true
    end
    function radar:select(session, staging)
        local _, states = observer:observe(session)
        session.attemptGenerations = session.attemptGenerations or {}
        for _, item in ipairs(observer:radars(staging)) do
            local state = states[item.prompt]
            if staging then return item end
            if state and state.generation ~= session.attemptGenerations[item.prompt] then
                session.attemptGenerations[item.prompt] = state.generation
                session.nextAttempt[item.prompt], session.failures[item.prompt] = nil, nil
            end
            local eligible = state and (state.status == "FROZEN" and state.action == "deice"
                or state.status == "DOWN" and state.action == "repair" and config.enableRepair == true)
            -- Failure counts only control retry backoff, never eligibility.
            -- A frozen radar remains serviceable in every phase and freeze cycle.
            if eligible and (session.nextAttempt[item.prompt] or 0) <= runtime:now() then return item end
        end
    end
    local function reached(item, staging)
        local reach = staging and math.max(3.5, math.min(7, item.prompt.MaxActivationDistance - 2))
            or math.max(2, item.prompt.MaxActivationDistance - 0.4)
        local position = platform:position()
        return position and platform:distance(position, item.part.Position) <= reach
    end
    -- User-tested direct radar hop. One PivotTo at most per radar maintenance cycle.
    -- Ground and in-arena verification are mandatory; NAV remains a safe fallback
    -- when no ground-verified destination exists.
    local function tryDirectHop(ctx, lease, session, item, phase, staging)
        session.directRadarHops = session.directRadarHops or {}
        local state = observer:radarState(item)
        local cycle = staging and "STAGING" or tostring(phase) .. ":" .. tostring(state.generation)
        if session.directRadarHops[item.prompt] == cycle then return false, "DIRECT_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED" end
        session.directRadarHops[item.prompt] = cycle
        local permitted, reason = valid(ctx, session, item, phase, staging)
        if not permitted then return false, reason end
        if session.immediateThreat and session.immediateThreat() then return false, "DODGE_INTERRUPTED" end
        local before = platform:character()
        if not before.ready then return false, "CHARACTER_CHANGED" end
        local at = item.part.Position
        if item.prompt.Parent and item.prompt.Parent:IsA("Attachment") then
            at = item.prompt.Parent.WorldPosition
        end
        local reference = platform:vector(before.position.X - at.X, 0, before.position.Z - at.Z)
        if reference.Magnitude < 0.01 then reference = platform:vector(1, 0, 0) end
        reference = reference.Unit
        local _, radars, bombs = observer:folders()
        local reach = staging and math.max(3.5, math.min(7, item.prompt.MaxActivationDistance - 2))
            or math.max(2, item.prompt.MaxActivationDistance - 0.4)
        for index = 0, 7 do
            permitted, reason = valid(ctx, session, item, phase, staging)
            if not permitted then return false, reason end
            if session.immediateThreat and session.immediateThreat() then return false, "DODGE_INTERRUPTED" end
            local angle = index * math.pi / 4
            local direction = platform:vector(reference.X * math.cos(angle) - reference.Z * math.sin(angle), 0,
                reference.X * math.sin(angle) + reference.Z * math.cos(angle))
            local destination = movement:ground(at + direction * 4, {mode = "radar", exclude = {radars, bombs}})
            if destination and platform:distance(destination, at) <= reach then
                movement:stop(ctx, lease)
                local wrote, err = pcall(function() session.character:PivotTo(CFrame.new(destination)) end)
                if not wrote then return false, "DIRECT_RADAR_WRITE_FAILED: " .. tostring(err) end
                if not ctx:wait(0.5) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
                local current = platform:character()
                if current.ready and current.character == session.character and observer:inArena()
                    and current.humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air
                    and platform:distance(current.position, destination) <= 5
                    and platform:distance(current.position, at) <= reach then
                    return true, "DIRECT_RADAR_VERIFIED"
                end
                -- Position changed but was not confirmed: never blindly PivotTo again.
                return false, "DIRECT_RADAR_AMBIGUOUS"
            end
        end
        return false, "DIRECT_NO_SAFE_GROUND"
    end

    function radar:travel(ctx, lease, session, item, phase, staging)
        session.navigationGoal = item.part.Position
        local started, telemetry = runtime:now(), env.services.telemetry
        local origin = platform:position()
        navigationSequence = navigationSequence + 1
        local stats = {phase = phase, staging = staging or false, distance = origin and platform:distance(origin, item.part.Position),
            pathComputations = 0, pathMs = 0, waypointCount = 0, mode = "DIRECT", leaseJob = ctx.jobId,
            navId = tostring(ctx.jobId) .. ":" .. navigationSequence, radarPath = observer:radarState(item).radarPath}
        stats.requestedMode = env.profile.navigation.movementMode
        -- Direct radar hop is attempted before walking; do not depend on a HYBRID flag.
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit("NAV_BEGIN", stats) end
        local deadline = math.min(session.deadline, runtime:now() + (staging and env.profile.boss.stageTimeout or 30))
        local function check()
            local permitted, code = valid(ctx, session, item, phase, staging)
            if not permitted then return false, code end
            if runtime:now() >= deadline then return false, "RADAR_TIMEOUT" end
            if session.navigationInterrupt then
                local reason = session.navigationInterrupt()
                if reason then return false, reason end
            end
            return true
        end
        local function travel()
            if not reached(item, staging) then
                local directOk, directCode = tryDirectHop(ctx, lease, session, item, phase, staging)
                if directOk then stats.mode = "TELEPORT"; return true, directCode end
                stats.teleportFallback = directCode
                if directCode == "DIRECT_RADAR_AMBIGUOUS" or directCode == "DODGE_INTERRUPTED"
                    or directCode == "CANCELLED" or directCode == "PHASE_CHANGED" then
                    return false, directCode
                end
            end
            for attempt = 1, env.profile.radar.attempts do
                local permitted, code = check()
                if not permitted then return false, code end
                if reached(item, staging) then return true, "REACHED" end
                local position = platform:position()
                local reference = platform:vector(position.X - item.part.Position.X, 0, position.Z - item.part.Position.Z)
                if reference.Magnitude < 0.01 then reference = platform:vector(1, 0, 0) end
                reference = reference.Unit
                local radius = math.max(2, math.min(5, item.prompt.MaxActivationDistance - 1.5))
                local _, radars, bombs = observer:folders()
                local pathBudget = env.profile.radar.pathBudget or 2
                -- Nearest approach first. Stop at the first usable route, bounded to two computes per attempt.
                for i = 0, pathBudget - 1 do
                    permitted, code = check()
                    if not permitted then return false, code end
                    local angle = ((i + (attempt - 1) * 2) % 8) * math.pi / 4
                    local offset = platform:vector(reference.X * math.cos(angle) - reference.Z * math.sin(angle), 0,
                        reference.X * math.sin(angle) + reference.Z * math.cos(angle))
                    local goal = movement:ground(item.part.Position + offset * radius, {mode = "radar", exclude = {bombs, radars}})
                    if goal and platform:distance(goal, item.part.Position) <= item.prompt.MaxActivationDistance - 0.25 then
                        local options = {mode = "radar", deadline = deadline, exclude = {bombs, radars},
                            waypointReach = staging and 1 or 4,
                            stop = function() return reached(item, staging) end,
                            valid = function() return valid(ctx, session, item, phase, staging) end,
                            interrupt = session.navigationInterrupt}
                        local result = movement:followDirect(ctx, lease, goal, options)
                        if result.code == "DIRECT_BLOCKED" or result.code == "STUCK" then
                            movement:stop(ctx, lease)
                            permitted, code = check()
                            if not permitted then return false, code end
                            stats.mode = "PATH"
                            local computeAt = runtime:now()
                            local path, pathCode = platform:computePath(platform:position(), goal, {AgentRadius = 2, AgentHeight = 5,
                                AgentCanJump = true, WaypointSpacing = env.profile.radar.waypointSpacing})
                            stats.pathComputations, stats.pathMs = stats.pathComputations + 1, stats.pathMs + (runtime:now() - computeAt) * 1000
                            -- ComputeAsync yields; no movement before identity/phase/danger/deadline checks.
                            permitted, code = check()
                            if not permitted then return false, code end
                            if path then
                                stats.waypointCount = stats.waypointCount + #path:GetWaypoints()
                                result = movement:followPath(ctx, lease, path, options)
                            else result = {code = pathCode or "NO_PATH"} end
                        end
                        if result.ok then return true, "REACHED" end
                        if result.code == "PATH_CLEANUP_FAILED" then error(result.code, 0) end
                        if result.code ~= "NO_PATH" and result.code ~= "PATH_ERROR" and result.code ~= "BLOCKED"
                            and result.code ~= "STUCK" and result.code ~= "WAYPOINT_TIMEOUT" and result.code ~= "GOAL_UNVERIFIED"
                            and result.code ~= "NO_WAYPOINTS" then return false, result.code end
                    end
                end
                -- Even immediate NoPath responses must yield before a retry.
                local remaining = deadline - runtime:now()
                if attempt < env.profile.radar.attempts and remaining > 0 then ctx:wait(math.min(env.profile.navigation.radarPoll, remaining)) end
            end
            return false, "RADAR_UNREACHABLE"
        end
        local ran, ok, code = pcall(travel)
        -- A Dodge interruption has already stopped radar and issued the escape MoveTo on this lease.
        if code ~= "DODGE_INTERRUPTED" then movement:stop(ctx, lease) end
        stats.elapsedMs, stats.ok, stats.code = (runtime:now() - started) * 1000, ran and ok or false, ran and code or "NAVIGATION_ERROR"
        stats.remainingDistance = platform:position() and platform:distance(platform:position(), item.part.Position) or nil
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit("NAV_END", stats) end
        if not ran then error(ok, 0) end
        return ok, code
    end
    function radar:preposition(ctx, lease, session)
        local item = self:select(session, true)
        if not item then return false, "RADAR_NOT_STREAMED" end
        return self:travel(ctx, lease, session, item, 1, true)
    end
    function radar:deice(ctx, lease, session, item, phase)
        -- Completion is per maintenance cycle, never latched for the whole phase.
        -- Repeat freezes may happen in the same phase (squall).
        local permitted, code = valid(ctx, session, item, phase, false)
        if not permitted then return false, code end
        if session.immediateThreat and session.immediateThreat() then return false, "DODGE_INTERRUPTED" end
        if not reached(item, false) then return false, "PROMPT_OUT_OF_RANGE" end
        movement:stop(ctx, lease)
        local function snapshot()
            local currentPhase, states = observer:observe(session)
            local state = states[item.prompt] or {status = "UNAVAILABLE", observedAt = runtime:now(), epoch = runtime:epoch()}
            state.phase, state.phaseSource, state.hudPhase = currentPhase, session.phaseSource, session.hudPhase
            return state
        end
        local start = snapshot()
        local action = start.status == "FROZEN" and "DEICE" or start.status == "DOWN" and "REPAIR" or nil
        if start.phase ~= phase or not action then return false, "RADAR_INACTIVE" end
        if action == "REPAIR" and not config.enableRepair then return false, "REPAIR_NOT_ENABLED" end
        local transaction = {phase = phase, action = action, start = start}
        local function sameRadar(state)
            return state.radar == start.radar and state.prompt == start.prompt and state.part == start.part
                and state.beacon == start.beacon and state.lock == start.lock and state.generation == start.generation
        end
        local function observeCompletion()
            local state = snapshot()
            local current = platform:character()
            if current.character == session.character and current.root == session.root and current.humanoid == session.humanoid
                and current.ready and sameRadar(state) and state.phase == phase and state.status == "TRACKING"
                and (not transaction.reconcileDeadline or state.observedAt <= transaction.reconcileDeadline) then
                transaction.proof = transaction.proof or state
            end
            return state
        end
        local function verify()
            observeCompletion()
            return transaction.proof
        end
        -- The game client normally converts prompt hold begin/end into
        -- B21Radar:FireServer("Begin"/"End", radarId). Send that protocol
        -- directly so camera focus and prompt GUI rendering are irrelevant.
        -- One Begin and one End maximum per transaction, with End cleanup even
        -- if the character changes or the job is cancelled mid-hold.
        local result = {code = "DIRECT_RADAR_NOT_SENT", dispatched = false,
            diagnostics = {path = "B21Radar_REMOTE_HOLD", action = action}}
        local id = tonumber((start.radar and start.radar.Name or ""):match("^B21Radar(%d+)$"))
        local remotes = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        local remote = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("B21Radar")
        if not id or not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
            result.code = "B21_RADAR_REMOTE_OR_ID_MISSING"
        else
            local beginOK, beginError = pcall(function() remote:FireServer("Begin", id) end)
            if not beginOK then
                result.code = "B21_RADAR_BEGIN_FAILED"
                result.diagnostics.beginError = tostring(beginError)
            else
                result.dispatched = true
                result.diagnostics.radarId = id
                local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
                if telemetry then telemetry:emit("B21_DIRECT_RADAR_BEGIN", {id = id, action = action,
                    phase = phase, phaseSource = start.phaseSource}, 0.5) end
                local started = runtime:now()
                local duration = math.max(0, tonumber(item.prompt.HoldDuration) or
                    (action == "REPAIR" and 3 or 1.6)) + 0.25
                local holdCode = nil
                while runtime:isActive(ctx) and not ctx:isCancelled() and runtime:now() - started < duration do
                    local state = observeCompletion()
                    if transaction.proof then break end
                    if not sameRadar(state) then holdCode = "RADAR_REPLACED"; break end
                    local permitted, reason = valid(ctx, session, item, phase, false)
                    if not permitted then holdCode = reason; break end
                    if not ctx:wait(math.min(env.profile.scheduler.poll, duration - (runtime:now() - started))) then
                        holdCode = "CANCELLED"; break
                    end
                end
                -- ALWAYS attempt End after a successful Begin. The server
                -- validates real hold duration, distance and radar state.
                local endOK, endError = pcall(function() remote:FireServer("End", id) end)
                result.diagnostics.holdSeconds = runtime:now() - started
                if telemetry then telemetry:emit("B21_DIRECT_RADAR_END", {id = id, action = action,
                    seconds = result.diagnostics.holdSeconds, sent = endOK}, 0.5) end
                if not endOK then
                    result.code = "INPUT_CLEANUP_FAILED"
                    result.diagnostics.endError = tostring(endError)
                elseif ctx:isCancelled() or not runtime:isActive(ctx) then
                    result.code = "CANCELLED"
                else
                    result.code = holdCode or "DIRECT_RADAR_HOLD_SENT"
                end
            end
        end
        transaction.inputCode, transaction.inputDiagnostics = result.code, result.diagnostics
        if result.code == "B21_RADAR_BEGIN_FAILED" or result.code == "INPUT_CLEANUP_FAILED" then
            session.fatalInputCode = result.code
        end
        -- No input retries in this window: late replication may follow a partial dispatch.
        local reconcileUntil = math.min(session.deadline, runtime:now() + (config.reconcileWindow or 0.75))
        transaction.reconcileDeadline = reconcileUntil
        if result.dispatched and result.code ~= "INPUT_CLEANUP_FAILED" then
            while not transaction.proof and runtime:isActive(ctx) and not ctx:isCancelled() do
                local state = observeCompletion()
                if transaction.proof or not sameRadar(state) or state.phase ~= phase then break end
                local current = platform:character()
                if not current.ready or current.character ~= session.character or current.root ~= session.root
                    or current.humanoid ~= session.humanoid then break end
                local remaining = reconcileUntil - runtime:now()
                if remaining <= 0 then break end
                if not ctx:wait(math.min(env.profile.scheduler.poll, remaining)) then break end
            end
        end
        transaction.finish = observeCompletion()
        local current = platform:character()
        local safe = not ctx:isCancelled() and runtime:isActive(ctx) and current.ready
            and current.character == session.character and current.root == session.root and current.humanoid == session.humanoid
        local verified = transaction.proof ~= nil and safe and result.code ~= "INPUT_CLEANUP_FAILED"
        code = result.code
        if verified then code = action .. "_VERIFIED"
        elseif not safe then
            code = (ctx:isCancelled() or not runtime:isActive(ctx)) and "CANCELLED" or "CHARACTER_CHANGED"
        elseif transaction.finish.phase ~= phase then code = "PHASE_CHANGED" end
        transaction.code, transaction.completed = code, verified and true or false
        session.lastDeiceTransaction = transaction
        local function summary(state)
            return {phase = state.phase, phaseSource = state.phaseSource, hudPhase = state.hudPhase, status = state.status,
                radarPath = state.radarPath, generation = state.generation,
                beaconEnabled = state.beaconEnabled, lockEnabled = state.lockEnabled, promptEnabled = state.promptEnabled,
                observedAt = state.observedAt, epoch = state.epoch}
        end
        env.state:port("boss"):recordDeiceTransaction({phase = phase, action = action, start = summary(start),
            finish = summary(transaction.finish), proof = transaction.proof and summary(transaction.proof),
            code = code, completed = transaction.completed, inputCode = result.code,
            inputDiagnostics = result.diagnostics,
            reconcileDeadline = reconcileUntil,
            inputException = session.fatalInputCode and result.evidence or nil})
        if verified then
            session.completed[tostring(phase)], session.lastDeiceAt = true, runtime:now()
            session.failures[item.prompt] = nil
            session.nextAttempt[item.prompt] = runtime:now() + (config.maintenanceSettle or 1)
            env.state:port("boss"):recordRadar(phase, runtime:epoch())
            observer:observe(session)
            return true, action .. "_VERIFIED"
        end
        return false, code
    end
    function radar:step(ctx, lease, session, phase, item)
        local arrived, code = self:travel(ctx, lease, session, item, phase, false)
        local ok = false
        if arrived then ok, code = self:deice(ctx, lease, session, item, phase) end
        if not ok and code ~= "PHASE_CHANGED" and code ~= "REPAIR_NOT_ENABLED" and code ~= "RADAR_INACTIVE" and code ~= "RADAR_REPLACED" and code ~= "DODGE_INTERRUPTED" then
            session.nextAttempt[item.prompt] = runtime:now() + env.profile.radar.retry
            if code == "RADAR_UNREACHABLE" then
                local failures = (session.failures[item.prompt] or 0) + 1
                if failures >= env.profile.radar.maxFailures then
                    -- This is a temporary navigation backoff, NOT a permanent
                    -- ban on De-ice in the same phase or the same freeze cycle.
                    -- The game can ice a radar again at any time.
                    session.failures[item.prompt] = 0
                    session.nextAttempt[item.prompt] = runtime:now() + env.profile.radar.retry * 3
                    if env.services.telemetry then env.services.telemetry:emit("B21_RADAR_RETRY_RESET", {
                        radar = item.part.Name, failures = failures,
                        retrySeconds = env.profile.radar.retry * 3}, 1) end
                else
                    session.failures[item.prompt] = failures
                end
            end
        end
        return ok, code
    end
    return radar
end
return RadarController
end
-- END MODULE boss.B21.RadarController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.B21.RepeatPolicy
__factories["boss.B21.RepeatPolicy"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local RepeatPolicy = {}
function RepeatPolicy.new(env)
    local policy = {}
    function policy:outcomeDelay(outcome)
        assert(outcome == "WIN" or outcome == "LOSS", "Report outcome required")
        return outcome == "WIN" and env.profile.boss.winRetry or env.profile.boss.lossRetry
    end
    function policy:readinessDelay(readiness)
        local minutes, seconds = tostring(readiness):match("^(%d+):(%d%d)$")
        if minutes and tonumber(seconds) < 60 then return math.max(2, tonumber(minutes) * 60 + tonumber(seconds) + 1) end
        return env.profile.boss.unknownRetry
    end
    function policy:deadline(cooldownUntil)
        return env.runtime:now() + math.max(0, (cooldownUntil or env.runtime:epoch()) - env.runtime:epoch())
    end
    function policy:repeatEnabled() return env.state:snapshot().config.bossRepeat end
    return policy
end
return RepeatPolicy
end
-- END MODULE boss.B21.RepeatPolicy

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.B21.ReportController
__factories["boss.B21.ReportController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local DeferredOutcome = require("boss.shared.DeferredOutcome")
local ReportController = {}
function ReportController.new(env, repeatPolicy)
    local gui, input, runtime, platform = env.services.gui, env.services.input, env.runtime, env.services.roblox
    local writer = env.state:port("boss")
    local terminal = DeferredOutcome.new(env, "B21_RAIDER", "B21FightGeneration")
    local report = {}
    local boundId, boundReport
    local directOutcome, outcomeAt, deferredReportSeen
    local resultsController, outcomeListener, witness
    local function watchOutcome()
        if outcomeListener then return end
        local remotes = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        local b21Event = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("B21Event")
        if not b21Event or not b21Event:IsA("RemoteEvent") then return end
        local token = {}
        witness = token
        outcomeListener = b21Event.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(packet)
            if witness ~= token then return end
            if type(packet) == "table" then terminal:observe(packet) end
            if type(packet) == "table" and packet.K == "Outcome" and type(packet.Victory) == "boolean" then
                directOutcome = packet.Victory and "WIN" or "LOSS"
                outcomeAt = runtime:now()
            end
        end)
    end
    local function loadResultsController()
        if resultsController then return end
        local modules = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("ClientModules")
        local controllerScript = modules and modules:FindFirstChild("BossResultsController")
        if not controllerScript then return end
        -- Bundler treats local require(...) as imports; dynamically load this *game* module.
        local loader = getfenv(0)["require"]
        local ok, module = pcall(loader, controllerScript)
        if ok and type(module) == "table" and type(module.IsOpen) == "function"
            and type(module.Dismiss) == "function" then
            resultsController = module
        end
    end
    local function directResultsOpen()
        if not resultsController then return false end
        local ok, isOpen = pcall(resultsController.IsOpen)
        if ok and type(isOpen) == "boolean" then return isOpen end
        return nil
    end
    loadResultsController()
    watchOutcome()
    function report:resetOutcome()
        terminal:reset()
        directOutcome, outcomeAt, deferredReportSeen = nil, nil, nil
        boundId, boundReport = nil, nil
        loadResultsController()
        -- BossManager cleans up the report listener after every job.
        watchOutcome()
    end
    function report:verifiedDeferredOutcome(encounter)
        return deferredReportSeen == encounter.outcome and terminal:verified(encounter, encounter.outcome)
    end
    function report:watch(ctx)
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return false end
        loadResultsController()
        watchOutcome()
        return outcomeListener ~= nil
    end
    function report:cleanup()
        witness = nil
        if outcomeListener then outcomeListener:Disconnect(); outcomeListener = nil end
    end
    function report:inspect()
        local current = gui:find(env.profile.paths.bossReport)
        local player = platform:player()
        local flagged = player and player:GetAttribute("BossResultsOpen") == true
        local nativeOpen = directResultsOpen()
        local evidence = {active = (current ~= nil and current.Enabled == true) or flagged == true or nativeOpen ~= false,
            report = current, nativeOpen = nativeOpen}
        if directOutcome then
            evidence.outcome = directOutcome
            evidence.matchesBoss = true
            -- The server Outcome arrives BEFORE the result controller animates in.
            -- Do not treat absent GUI/IsOpen as a closed report immediately.
            evidence.pendingPresentation = not evidence.active and outcomeAt ~= nil
                and runtime:now() - outcomeAt < 15
        end
        if not evidence.active then return evidence end
        local win, loss, b21 = false, false, false
        for _, item in ipairs(current and current:GetDescendants() or {}) do
            local record = item:IsA("TextLabel") and gui:readText(item) or nil
            if record then
                local value = record.value
                if value:find("B-21", 1, true) or value:find("B21", 1, true) then b21 = true end
                if value:find("B-21 RAIDER DEFEATED", 1, true) then win = true end
                if value:find("MISSION FAILED", 1, true) then loss = true end
            end
        end
        evidence.matchesBoss = evidence.matchesBoss or b21
        if b21 and win ~= loss and not evidence.outcome then evidence.outcome = win and "WIN" or "LOSS" end
        if evidence.outcome == "WIN" and (nativeOpen == true or b21 and win and not loss) then
            deferredReportSeen = "WIN"
        elseif evidence.outcome == "LOSS" and (nativeOpen == true or b21 and loss and not win) then
            deferredReportSeen = "LOSS"
        end
        return evidence
    end
    function report:continueButton(expected)
        if not expected or gui:find(env.profile.paths.bossReport) ~= expected or not expected.Enabled then return nil end
        local function eligible(button)
            if not button or not button:IsA("GuiButton") or not gui:canActivate(button) then return false end
            local current = button
            while current and current ~= expected do
                local name = current.Name:lower()
                if name:find("revive", 1, true) or name:find("robux", 1, true) or name:find("purchase", 1, true) then return false end
                current = current.Parent
            end
            return current == expected
        end
        local exact = gui:path(expected, env.profile.paths.reportContinue)
        if eligible(exact) then return exact end
        local found, seen = {}, {}
        local function continueText(record)
            return record and (record.value == "CONTINUE" or record.value:match("^CONTINUE%s*%[[^%]]+%]$"))
        end
        local function add(button)
            if eligible(button) and not seen[button] then found[#found + 1], seen[button] = button, true end
        end
        for _, item in ipairs(expected:GetDescendants()) do
            if item:IsA("GuiButton") then
                local text = item:IsA("TextButton") and gui:readText(item) or nil
                if item.Name:lower() == "continue" or continueText(text) then add(item) end
            elseif item:IsA("TextLabel") then
                local text = gui:readText(item)
                if continueText(text) then add(item:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("GuiButton")) end
            end
        end
        return #found == 1 and found[1] or nil
    end
    local function closed()
        local current = report:inspect()
        return not current.active
    end
    function report:verifyClosed() return closed() end
    local function diagnostic(ok, code, detail)
        print("[B21 Report]", code, detail or "")
        return {ok = ok, code = "BOSS_CONTINUE_" .. code}
    end
    local function verified(method)
        writer:closeReport()
        return diagnostic(true, "DISMISS_VERIFIED", method)
    end
    function report:reconcile(encounter)
        -- Explicit read-only recovery may bind a replacement report, but never resets Continue.
        local current = self:inspect()
        if current.outcome and (not encounter.outcome or encounter.outcome == current.outcome) then
            boundId, boundReport = encounter.encounterId, current.report
            return true
        end
        return encounter.outcome ~= nil and not current.active
    end
    function report:resolve(ctx, encounter)
        local evidence = ctx:await(function()
            local current = self:inspect()
            if current.outcome and not current.pendingPresentation then return current end
            if encounter.outcome and not current.active and (encounter.continueAttempted or not current.pendingPresentation) then
                return current
            end
        end, env.profile.boss.reportTimeout)
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        if not evidence then return {ok = false, code = "BOSS_REPORT_PENDING"} end
        if evidence.outcome and encounter.outcome and evidence.outcome ~= encounter.outcome then
            return {ok = false, held = true, code = "BOSS_OUTCOME_CONFLICT"}
        end
        if boundId == encounter.encounterId and evidence.active and boundReport and evidence.report ~= boundReport then
            return {ok = false, held = true, code = "BOSS_REPORT_CHANGED"}
        end
        if evidence.outcome then
            local ok = writer:recordBossReport(evidence.outcome, runtime:epoch() + repeatPolicy:outcomeDelay(evidence.outcome))
            if not ok then return {ok = false, held = true, code = "BOSS_OUTCOME_CONFLICT"} end
            encounter = env.state:snapshot().boss.encounter
        end
        if not evidence.active then return verified("already closed") end
        if encounter.continueAttempted then
            if ctx:await(closed, env.profile.boss.reportCloseTimeout) then return verified("previous attempt") end
            if ctx:isCancelled() then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
            return diagnostic(false, "REPORT_STILL_OPEN", "previous attempt")
        end
        local expected = evidence.report and evidence.report.Enabled and evidence.report or nil
        local function target(current)
            if not current.active then return "MANUAL_CLOSE" end
            if (expected and current.report ~= expected) or current.outcome ~= encounter.outcome then return "REPORT_CHANGED" end
            local button = self:continueButton(current.report)
            -- Native dismissal belongs to the current confirmed B21 outcome. A visible
            -- Continue also verifies that an existing report GUI finished presenting.
            if directOutcome and current.nativeOpen == true and directOutcome == encounter.outcome and (button or not current.report) then
                return "NATIVE"
            end
            return button
        end
        local chosen = ctx:await(function()
            local current = self:inspect()
            return target(current)
        end, env.profile.boss.continueTimeout)
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        if not chosen then return diagnostic(false, "BUTTON_NOT_FOUND") end
        if chosen == "REPORT_CHANGED" then return {ok = false, held = true, code = "BOSS_REPORT_CHANGED"} end
        local current = self:inspect()
        chosen = target(current)
        if chosen == "MANUAL_CLOSE" then return verified("manual close") end
        if chosen == "REPORT_CHANGED" then return {ok = false, held = true, code = "BOSS_REPORT_CHANGED"} end
        if not chosen then return diagnostic(false, "BUTTON_NOT_FOUND") end
        if chosen ~= "NATIVE" and type(input.canActivateGui) == "function" and not input:canActivateGui() then
            return diagnostic(false, "ACTIVATION_FAILED", "GUI_SIGNAL_UNAVAILABLE")
        end
        boundId, boundReport = encounter.encounterId, current.report
        if not writer:markContinueAttempt() then return diagnostic(false, "REPORT_STILL_OPEN", "attempt already recorded") end
        if chosen == "NATIVE" then
            local ok, why = pcall(resultsController.Dismiss, "automation-continue")
            if ctx:isCancelled() then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
            if not ok then return diagnostic(false, "ACTIVATION_FAILED", tostring(why)) end
            if ctx:await(closed, env.profile.boss.reportCloseTimeout) then return verified("native") end
            if ctx:isCancelled() then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
            return diagnostic(false, "REPORT_STILL_OPEN", "native")
        end
        local result = input:dispatch(ctx, {kind = "GUI", target = chosen, event = "Activated",
            verify = closed, timeout = env.profile.boss.reportCloseTimeout,
            valid = function() return self:inspect().report == boundReport, "BOSS_REPORT_CHANGED" end})
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        if result.ok and result.verified and closed() then return verified("GUI Activated") end
        if not result.dispatched then return diagnostic(false, "ACTIVATION_FAILED", result.code) end
        return diagnostic(false, "REPORT_STILL_OPEN", result.code)
    end
    return report
end
return ReportController
end
-- END MODULE boss.B21.ReportController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.B21.WeatherObserver
__factories["boss.B21.WeatherObserver"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- B21 V2: advisory-only weather observation. No movement, remote, or world mutation.
local WeatherObserver = {}
function WeatherObserver.new(env, config)
    local platform, gui = env.services.roblox, env.services.gui
    local observer = {}
    local messages = {
        {phrase = "FREEZING FOG", kind = "FOG", stage = "WARNING", advice = "HIGH_GROUND"},
        {phrase = "FOG ON THE FLOOR", kind = "FOG", stage = "ONSET", advice = "HIGH_GROUND"},
        {phrase = "FREEZING GET UP", kind = "FOG", stage = "ACTIVE_HINT", advice = "HIGH_GROUND"},
        {phrase = "ICE GALE", kind = "GALE", stage = "WARNING", advice = "LOW_GROUND"},
        {phrase = "GALE ON THE HIGH GROUND", kind = "GALE", stage = "ONSET", advice = "LOW_GROUND"},
        {phrase = "EXPOSED GET DOWN", kind = "GALE", stage = "ACTIVE_HINT", advice = "LOW_GROUND"},
    }
    function observer:inspect()
        local position = platform:position()
        local record = {kind = "UNKNOWN", stage = "UNVERIFIED", source = "HUD_VISIBLE_TEXT",
            relativeAltitude = position and position.Y - (config.floorY or -65.2) or nil}
        local root = platform:playerGui()
        if not root then return record end
        for _, item in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
            if item:IsA("TextLabel") and item.Visible then
                local text = gui:readText(item)
                local value = text and text.value or ""
                value = string.upper(value):gsub("[%c%p]+", " "):gsub("%s+", " ")
                for _, rule in ipairs(messages) do
                    if value:find(rule.phrase, 1, true) then
                        record.kind, record.stage, record.advice = rule.kind, rule.stage, rule.advice
                        return record
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return record
    end
    return observer
end
return WeatherObserver
end
-- END MODULE boss.B21.WeatherObserver

__factories["boss.B29.ArenaObserver"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local ArenaObserver = {}
function ArenaObserver.new(env, config)
    local platform = env.services.roblox
    local player, workspace = platform:player(), platform:workspace()
    local observer = {}
    function observer:participating()
        return player:GetAttribute("B29Participant") == true
    end
    function observer:inArenaPosition()
        local pos = platform:position()
        if not pos then return false end
        local dx, dz = pos.X-config.arenaCenter.x, pos.Z-config.arenaCenter.z
        return dx*dx+dz*dz < config.arenaRadius*config.arenaRadius
    end
    function observer:inArena()
        return self:participating() or (workspace:GetAttribute("B29FightActive") == true
            and self:inArenaPosition() and player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true)
    end
    function observer:state()
        return {phase = workspace:GetAttribute("B29Phase"),
            fightState = workspace:GetAttribute("B29FightState"),
            active = workspace:GetAttribute("B29FightActive"),
            participant = player:GetAttribute("B29Participant"),
            inBossFight = player:GetAttribute("InBossFight")}
    end
    return observer
end
return ArenaObserver
end
