-- BEGIN MODULE boss.B29.AtomicCoverController
__factories["boss.B29.AtomicCoverController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Standalone B29 V1 atomic cover, scoped to one BossManager encounter.
-- Raycast cover is a conservative heuristic and NOT server-confirmed blast protection.
local AtomicCoverController = {}
function AtomicCoverController.new(env, config, observer)
    local platform, runtime = env.services.roblox, env.runtime
    local player, workspace = platform:player(), platform:workspace()
    local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
    local riftHazards = env.services.riftHazards
    local state = {clockT0 = nil, stage = nil, point = nil, detonateAt = nil,
        releasedAt = nil, moved = 0, lastMove = -math.huge,
        lastScan = -math.huge, gate = nil, gateAt = -math.huge,
        gateCounts = {}, lastCovered = nil, active = false, lastErrorAt = -math.huge}
    local runningContext
    local controller = {}
    local center = Vector3.new(config.arenaCenter.x,config.arenaCenter.y,config.arenaCenter.z)

    local function emit(name,data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit(name,data or {}) end
    end
    local function root()
        local ch = player.Character
        return ch,ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    end
    local function horizontal(a,b)
        local dx,dz=a.X-b.X,a.Z-b.Z
        return math.sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz)
    end
    local function inArena(pos)
        return pos and horizontal(pos,center) < config.arenaRadius-8
            and pos.Y > config.arenaFloorY-65 and pos.Y < config.arenaFloorY+190
    end
    local function gate(reason,data)
        state.gate=reason
        state.gateCounts[reason]=(state.gateCounts[reason] or 0)+1
        local now=os.clock()
        if state.lastGate==reason and now-state.gateAt<3 then return end
        state.lastGate=reason
        state.gateAt=now
        local payload=data or {}
        payload.reason=reason
        emit("B29_ATOMIC_COVER_GATE",payload)
    end
    local function currentTau()
        if type(state.clockT0)~="number" then return nil end
        return workspace:GetServerTimeNow()-state.clockT0
    end
    local function raySheltered(pos,ch)
        if typeof(state.point)~="Vector3" then return false,0 end
        local blast=state.point+Vector3.new(0,config.atomicBurstHeight,0)
        local n=0
        local params=RaycastParams.new()
        params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances={ch}
        params.IgnoreWater=true
        for _,height in ipairs({2,4.5,6.2}) do
            local target=Vector3.new(pos.X,pos.Y+height,pos.Z)
            local delta=target-blast
            if delta.Magnitude>14 then
                local hit=workspace:Raycast(blast,delta,params)
                if hit and hit.Instance and hit.Instance.CanCollide
                    and (hit.Position-blast).Magnitude>4
                    and (hit.Position-target).Magnitude>4 then n=n+1 end
            end
        end
        return n>=2,n
    end
    local function groundCandidate(ch,x,z)
        if horizontal(Vector3.new(x,config.arenaFloorY,z),center)>config.arenaRadius-30 then return nil end
        local params=RaycastParams.new()
        params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances={ch}
        params.IgnoreWater=true
        local hit=workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(x,config.arenaFloorY+120,z),
            Vector3.new(0,-230,0),params)
        if not hit or not hit.Instance or not hit.Instance.CanCollide or hit.Normal.Y<0.75 then return nil end
        if math.abs(hit.Position.Y-config.arenaFloorY)>48 then return nil end
        return Vector3.new(x,hit.Position.Y+3.2,z)
    end
    local function riftPoints()
        if not riftHazards or type(riftHazards.groundFootprints)~="function" then return {} end
        local ok,points=pcall(riftHazards.groundFootprints,riftHazards,1.6)
        return ok and type(points)=="table" and points or {}
    end
    local function riftClear(pos,points)
        for _,spot in ipairs(points) do
            if typeof(spot.p)=="Vector3" and math.abs(pos.Y-spot.p.Y)<=32
                and horizontal(pos,spot.p) <= (spot.r or 10)+7 then return false end
        end
        return true
    end
    local function bestCover(ch,pos,points,atomic)
        local best,bestScore,marks=nil,-math.huge,0
        for _,dist in ipairs({18,30,45,60,80,95,config.coverMaxStep}) do
            if dist<=config.coverMaxStep then
                for i=0,17 do
                    local a=i*(2*math.pi/18)
                    local candidate=groundCandidate(ch,pos.X+math.cos(a)*dist,pos.Z+math.sin(a)*dist)
                    if candidate then
                        local sheltered,rays=true,0
                        if atomic then sheltered,rays=raySheltered(candidate,ch) end
                        if sheltered and riftClear(candidate,points) then
                            local score=rays*30-dist*0.28
                            if score>bestScore then best,bestScore,marks=candidate,score,rays end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return best,marks
    end
    local function onAtomic(e,source)
        local stage=tostring(e.Stage or source or "UNKNOWN")
        state.stage=stage
        if stage=="Released" then
            state.point=typeof(e.Point)=="Vector3" and e.Point or nil
            state.detonateAt=tonumber(e.DetonateAt)
            state.releasedAt=os.clock()
            state.active=state.point~=nil
        elseif stage=="Detonated" then
            state.active=false
        end
        emit("B29_ATOMIC_EVENT",{stage=stage,source=source,
            pointKnown=typeof(e.Point)=="Vector3",detonateAt=e.DetonateAt,
            releaseAt=e.ReleaseAt,threshold=e.Threshold,
            onTarget=e.OnTarget,disruption=e.Disruption})
    end
    function controller:observe(e)
        if type(e)~="table" or type(e.K)~="string" then return end
        local kind=e.K
        if (kind=="Launch" or kind=="Resync" or kind=="Session" or kind=="Begin")
            and type(e.T0)=="number" and (not state.clockT0 or kind=="Resync") then
            state.clockT0=e.T0
            emit("B29_ATOMIC_CLOCK",{source=kind,t0=e.T0})
        end
        if kind=="Atomic" then
            onAtomic(e,"EVENT")
        elseif kind=="Session" and type(e.Atomic)=="table" then
            if type(e.Atomic.Released)=="table" then
                local released=table.clone(e.Atomic.Released)
                released.Stage="Released"
                onAtomic(released,"SESSION_RELEASED")
            else
                onAtomic({Stage=e.Atomic.ReleaseAt and "Run" or "Warn",
                    ReleaseAt=e.Atomic.ReleaseAt,Threshold=e.Atomic.Threshold},"SESSION")
            end
        end
    end
    local function coverStep(ctx)
        if ctx:isCancelled() or not config.autoAtomicCover then return end
        local rift=riftPoints()
        if not state.active and #rift==0 then return end
        if player:GetAttribute("BossResultsOpen")==true then gate("REPORT_OPEN");return end
        if not observer:participating() and player:GetAttribute("InBossFight")~=true then
            gate("NOT_PARTICIPATING");return
        end
        local tau=currentTau()
        if not tau and state.active then gate("CLOCK_UNAVAILABLE");return end
        if state.active and type(state.detonateAt)=="number" and tau>state.detonateAt+1 then
            state.active=false
            emit("B29_ATOMIC_CLEAR",{tau=tau,detonateAt=state.detonateAt})
            return
        end
        local ch,hrp=root()
        if not ch or not hrp then gate("NO_CHARACTER");return end
        if not inArena(hrp.Position) then
            gate("OUTSIDE_ARENA",{y=math.floor(hrp.Position.Y)});return
        end
        local atomicDanger=state.active and typeof(state.point)=="Vector3"
            and horizontal(hrp.Position,state.point)<=config.atomicExposureRange
        if state.active and typeof(state.point)~="Vector3" then
            gate("IMPACT_POINT_UNKNOWN");return
        end
        local covered,rays=true,0
        if atomicDanger then covered,rays=raySheltered(hrp.Position,ch) end
        state.lastCovered=covered
        if covered and riftClear(hrp.Position,rift) then
            gate("CURRENT_POSITION_SAFE",{rays=rays,rift=#rift});return
        end
        if os.clock()-state.lastMove<config.coverMinInterval then return end
        -- Limit repeated heavy ray scans when no cover is found.
        if os.clock()-state.lastScan<0.7 then return end
        state.lastScan=os.clock()
        local target,shade=bestCover(ch,hrp.Position,rift,atomicDanger)
        if not target then gate("NO_VERIFIED_COVER");return end
        state.lastMove=os.clock()
        local before=hrp.Position
        gate("MOVE_ATTEMPT",{shelterRays=shade})
        local orientation=hrp.CFrame-hrp.Position
        local ok,err=pcall(function()ch:PivotTo(CFrame.new(target)*orientation)end)
        if not ok then emit("B29_ATOMIC_COVER_ERROR",{reason=tostring(err)});return end
        if not ctx:wait(0.18) then return end
        local _,after=root()
        local verified=after and horizontal(after.Position,target)<9
        if verified then state.moved=state.moved+1 end
        emit("B29_ATOMIC_COVER_MOVE",{verified=verified==true,
            distance=math.floor(horizontal(before,target)),shadeRays=shade})
    end
    function controller:start(ctx)
        if not config.autoAtomicCover or runningContext==ctx then return end
        runningContext=ctx
        ctx:deferCleanup(function()
            if runningContext==ctx then runningContext=nil end
        end)
        task.spawn(function()
            while runningContext==ctx and not ctx:isCancelled() do
                local ok,err=pcall(coverStep,ctx)
                if not ok and os.clock()-state.lastErrorAt>2 then
                    state.lastErrorAt=os.clock()
                    emit("B29_ATOMIC_COVER_SCAN_ERROR",{reason=tostring(err)})
                end
                task.wait(0.25)
            end
        end)
    end
    function controller:waitForAtomicClear(ctx)
        if not config.autoAtomicCover or not state.active then return end
        local deadline=runtime:now()+config.atomicClearTimeoutSeconds
        emit("B29_ATOMIC_CLEAR_WAIT",{detonateAt=state.detonateAt})
        while not ctx:isCancelled() and state.active and runtime:now()<deadline do
            if not ctx:wait(0.2) then break end
        end
        emit("B29_ATOMIC_CLEAR_WAIT_END",{active=state.active})
    end
    function controller:reset()
        if runningContext~=nil then return false,"COVER_ACTIVE" end
        state.clockT0,state.stage,state.point,state.detonateAt=nil,nil,nil,nil
        state.releasedAt,state.active,state.moved=nil,false,0
        state.lastMove,state.lastScan=-math.huge,-math.huge
        state.gate,state.lastGate,state.gateAt=nil,nil,-math.huge
        state.gateCounts={}
        return true
    end
    function controller:status()
        return {stage=state.stage,active=state.active,detonateAt=state.detonateAt,
            moves=state.moved,lastGate=state.gate,gateCounts=state.gateCounts,
            covered=state.lastCovered,clockReady=state.clockT0~=nil}
    end
    return controller
end
return AtomicCoverController
end
-- END MODULE boss.B29.AtomicCoverController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.B29.B29
__factories["boss.B29.B29"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Register B-29 without touching existing B21 / RedBaron / B17 / Vulcan / AC130.
local Config = require("boss.B29.Config")
local ArenaObserver = require("boss.B29.ArenaObserver")
local CommandController = require("boss.B29.CommandController")
local CombatController = require("boss.B29.CombatController")
local AtomicCoverController = require("boss.B29.AtomicCoverController")
local ReportController = require("boss.B29.ReportController")
local RepeatPolicy = require("boss.B29.RepeatPolicy")
local B29 = {}
function B29.definition()
    return {bossId = Config.bossId, displayName = Config.displayName, create = function(env)
        local observer = ArenaObserver.new(env, Config)
        local cover = AtomicCoverController.new(env, Config, observer)
        local repeatPolicy = RepeatPolicy.new(env)
        local report = ReportController.new(env, Config, repeatPolicy, cover)
        return {config = Config, observer = observer, atomicCover = cover,
            report = report, repeatPolicy = repeatPolicy,
            command = CommandController.new(env, Config, observer, report),
            combat = CombatController.new(env, Config, observer, report, cover)}
    end}
end
return B29
end
-- END MODULE boss.B29.B29

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.B29.CombatController
__factories["boss.B29.CombatController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Monitor B-29 fight and shelter against already-released atomic payloads.
local CombatController = {}
function CombatController.new(env, config, observer, report, cover)
    local runtime, telemetry = env.runtime, env.services.telemetry
    local combat = {}
    function combat:run(ctx, encounter)
        local watching, why = report:watch(ctx)
        if not watching then return {code = why} end
        cover:start(ctx)
        local deadline = runtime:now() + config.maxFightSeconds
        local previous, lastEmit = nil, 0
        local code = "OUTCOME_NOT_OBSERVED_TIMEOUT"
        while not ctx:isCancelled() and runtime:now() < deadline do
            if report:inspect().outcome then code = "OUTCOME_OBSERVED"; break end
            local state = observer:state()
            local key = tostring(state.fightState).."/"..tostring(state.phase).."/"
                ..tostring(state.active).."/"..tostring(state.participant)
            if key ~= previous or runtime:now() - lastEmit > 25 then
                if telemetry then telemetry:emit("B29_STATE",state) end
                previous, lastEmit = key, runtime:now()
            end
            if not ctx:wait(0.4) then break end
        end
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return {code = "CANCELLED"} end
        if code == "OUTCOME_OBSERVED" then
            -- Standalone V1 waits (bounded) for a released nuke before report.
            cover:waitForAtomicClear(ctx)
        end
        return {code = code}
    end
    return combat
end
return CombatController
end
-- END MODULE boss.B29.CombatController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.B29.CommandController
__factories["boss.B29.CommandController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- B-29 standalone V1: Hideout -> Boss Command -> exactly one Solo -> combat.
-- Adaptive report may open in arena OR after exit; never request return before Continue.
local DirectBossTravel = require("main.navigation.DirectBossTravel")
local CommandController = {}

function CommandController.new(env, config, observer, report)
    local platform, runtime = env.services.roblox, env.runtime
    local player, workspace = platform:player(), platform:workspace()
    local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
    local travel = DirectBossTravel.new(env)
    local command = {}
    local function emit(name, data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit(name, data or {}) end
    end
    local function remote(name)
        local storage = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage")
        local folder = storage:FindFirstChild("Remotes") or storage:WaitForChild("Remotes", 10)
        local item = folder and (folder:FindFirstChild(name) or folder:WaitForChild(name, 7))
        return item and item:IsA("RemoteEvent") and item or nil
    end
    local function active(ctx) return runtime:isActive(ctx) and not ctx:isCancelled() end
    local function cooldownLeft()
        local raw = player:GetAttribute("BossStartCooldowns")
        if type(raw) ~= "string" or raw == "" then return 0 end
        local ok, data = pcall(function() return platform:service("HttpService"):JSONDecode(raw) end)
        if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then return 0 end
        return math.max(0, (tonumber(data[config.gameBossKey]) or 0) - workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
    end

    function command:prepare(ctx)
        local watching, why = report:watch(ctx) -- watch BEFORE sending any boss request
        if not watching then return false, why end
        if observer:inArena() then return true, "B29_ALREADY_IN_ARENA" end
        if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true then return false, "OTHER_BOSS_ACTIVE" end
        if not active(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        local entered = travel:enterHideout(ctx)
        emit("B29_DIRECT_HIDEOUT", {ok = entered.ok, code = entered.code, reason = entered.reason})
        if not entered.ok then return false, entered.code end
        local positioned = travel:moveToKnownPoint(ctx, config.commandSafePosition, {
            requireHideout = true, radius = 6, settle = 0.85,
        })
        emit("B29_COMMAND_POSITION", {ok = positioned.ok, code = positioned.code})
        if not positioned.ok then return false, positioned.code end
        return true, "B29_COMMAND_READY"
    end

    function command:readiness()
        if observer:inArena() then return "READY" end
        if not travel:inHideout() then return "UNKNOWN" end
        local secs = cooldownLeft()
        if secs > 0 then
            secs = math.ceil(secs)
            return string.format("%d:%02d", math.floor(secs / 60), secs % 60)
        end
        -- The server pass remains authoritative for unlock/eligibility.
        return "READY"
    end

    function command:startSolo(ctx, markAttempt)
        if not active(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        if observer:participating() then return true, "B29_ALREADY_FIGHTING" end
        if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true then return false, "OTHER_BOSS_ACTIVE" end
        if not travel:inHideout() then return false, "NOT_IN_HIDEOUT" end
        if self:readiness() ~= "READY" then return false, "B29_NOT_READY" end
        local watching, why = report:watch(ctx)
        if not watching then return false, why end
        local hideout, accept = remote("PersonalHideoutRemote"), remote("B29CommanderAccept")
        if not hideout or not accept then return false, "B29_COMMAND_REMOTES_MISSING" end
        local passReply, acceptReply
        local passConnection = hideout.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
            if type(e) == "table" and e.Kind == "BossCommand" and e.Op == "Start"
                and e.BossKey == config.gameBossKey then passReply = e end
        end)
        local acceptConnection = accept.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
            if type(e) == "table" and e.Accepted ~= nil then acceptReply = e end
        end)
        local function finish(ok, code)
            passConnection:Disconnect()
            acceptConnection:Disconnect()
            return ok, code
        end
        local sent, err = pcall(function()
            hideout:FireServer({Action = "StartBoss", BossKey = config.gameBossKey, Solo = true})
        end)
        if not sent then return finish(false, "B29_PASS_SEND_FAILED: " .. tostring(err)) end
        local gotPass = ctx:await(function() return passReply end, 10)
        if not active(ctx) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
        if not gotPass then return finish(false, "B29_PASS_TIMEOUT_NO_RETRY") end
        emit("B29_PASS_RESULT", {ok = gotPass.Ok == true, reason = gotPass.Reason})
        if gotPass.Ok ~= true then return finish(false, "B29_PASS_REJECTED: " .. tostring(gotPass.Reason)) end
        -- Mark before firing the irreversible Solo request; never blind retry.
        if not markAttempt() then return finish(false, "B29_SOLO_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED") end
        sent, err = pcall(function() accept:FireServer({Solo = true}) end)
        if not sent then return finish(false, "B29_SOLO_SEND_FAILED: " .. tostring(err)) end
        local observed = ctx:await(function()
            if acceptReply and acceptReply.Accepted == false then return "REJECTED" end
            if observer:participating() then return "ENTERED" end
        end, config.arenaTimeout)
        if not active(ctx) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
        emit("B29_SOLO_RESULT", {code = observed or "AMBIGUOUS", accepted = acceptReply and acceptReply.Accepted})
        if observed == "ENTERED" then return finish(true, "B29_FIGHT_VERIFIED") end
        if observed == "REJECTED" then
            return finish(false, "B29_SOLO_REJECTED: " .. tostring(acceptReply.Reason))
        end
        return finish(false, "B29_SOLO_AMBIGUOUS_NO_RETRY")
    end

    function command:close(_) return true end -- No command GUI was opened.

    function command:returnHome(ctx, home)
        if not active(ctx) then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        if type(home) ~= "number" or home < 1 or home % 1 ~= 0 then
            return {ok = false, code = "INVALID_HOME_WORLD"}
        end
        if report:inspect().active then return {ok = false, code = "B29_REPORT_STILL_OPEN"} end
        -- Preserve standalone V1 lock checks before return, regardless of report location.
        local released = ctx:await(function()
            if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true
                and player:GetAttribute("B29Participant") ~= true then return true end
        end, config.returnLockTimeoutSeconds)
        if not released then
            emit("B29_RETURN_LOCK_PENDING", {world = home})
            return {ok = false, code = "B29_RETURN_LOCK_PENDING", reason = "BossFight"}
        end
        local exit = ctx:await(function()
            if player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") == true then return "BOSS_COMMAND_HIDEOUT" end
            if not observer:inArenaPosition() then return "OUTSIDE_ARENA" end
        end, config.exitTimeoutSeconds)
        emit("B29_ARENA_EXIT", {code = exit or "LOCK_RELEASED_STILL_IN_ARENA"})
        -- As in tested standalone V1, a released lock permits a direct verified travel even
        -- if the game has not repositioned the player outside the arena yet.
        if not ctx:wait(1.5) then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        local request, prepare, result = remote("RequestWorldTravel"), remote("NavPrepareWorlds"), remote("WorldTravelResult")
        if not request or not prepare then return {ok = false, code = "B29_WORLD_TRAVEL_REMOTES_MISSING"} end
        local position = platform:position()
        if not position then return {ok = false, code = "CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE"} end
        if tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")) == home
            and player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") ~= true
            and not observer:inArenaPosition() then
            return {ok = true, code = "ALREADY_IN_HOME", world = home}
        end
        local reply
        local connection = result and result.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
            if type(e) == "table" and e.Kind == "Result" and tonumber(e.WorldId) == home then reply = e end
        end) or nil
        local function finish(ok, code, reason)
            if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
            emit("B29_DIRECT_RETURN", {ok = ok, code = code, reason = reason, world = home})
            return {ok = ok, code = code, reason = reason, world = home}
        end
        for attempt = 1, config.returnRetries do
            if not active(ctx) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            reply = nil
            local prior = platform:position()
            if not prior then return finish(false, "CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE") end
            local sent, err = pcall(function() prepare:FireServer("stream", home) end)
            if not sent then return finish(false, "WORLD_PREPARE_SEND_FAILED", tostring(err)) end
            if not ctx:wait(0.12) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            sent, err = pcall(function() request:FireServer(home) end)
            if not sent then return finish(false, "WORLD_REQUEST_SEND_FAILED", tostring(err)) end
            local observed = ctx:await(function()
                if reply and reply.Ok == false then return "REJECTED" end
                local current = platform:position()
                if current and platform:distance(current, prior) > 50
                    and tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")) == home
                    and player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") ~= true
                    and player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true
                    and not observer:inArenaPosition() then return "VERIFIED" end
            end, 17)
            emit("B29_RETURN_ATTEMPT", {attempt = attempt, code = observed or "AMBIGUOUS",
                reason = reply and reply.Reason})
            if observed == "VERIFIED" then return finish(true, "B29_HOME_VERIFIED") end
            if observed ~= "REJECTED" then return finish(false, "B29_RETURN_AMBIGUOUS_NO_RETRY") end
            local why = tostring(reply.Reason or "UNKNOWN")
            if why ~= "BossFight" or attempt == config.returnRetries then
                return finish(false, "B29_WORLD_RETURN_REJECTED", why)
            end
            if not ctx:wait(12) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            local settled = ctx:await(function()
                if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true then return true end
            end, 40)
            if not settled then return finish(false, "B29_LOCK_STILL_ACTIVE", "BossFight") end
        end
        return finish(false, "B29_WORLD_RETURN_EXHAUSTED")
    end
    return command
end
return CommandController
end
-- END MODULE boss.B29.CommandController

    coverMaxStep = 95, atomicClearTimeoutSeconds = 8,
}

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.B29.ReportController
__factories["boss.B29.ReportController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local DeferredOutcome = require("boss.shared.DeferredOutcome")
-- B-29 adaptive report: Outcome -> report (any location) -> Continue -> exit -> return.
-- Port of standalone V1; never treat Outcome alone as a completed report.
local ReportController = {}

function ReportController.new(env, config, repeatPolicy, cover)
    local platform, gui, runtime = env.services.roblox, env.services.gui, env.runtime
    local player = platform:player()
    local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
    local writer = env.state:port("boss")
    local report = {}
    local terminal = DeferredOutcome.new(env, config.bossId, "B29FightGeneration")
    local confirmedOutcome, outcomeAt = nil, nil
    local lastHealthAt = 0
    local seenReport, firstOpenedAt = false, nil
    local listeningContext, connection, resultsController = nil, nil, nil
    local function emit(name, data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit(name, data or {}) end
    end
    local function loadController()
        if resultsController then return resultsController end
        local folder = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("ClientModules")
        local mod = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("BossResultsController")
        if not mod or not mod:IsA("ModuleScript") then return nil end
        -- The build bundler replaces project requires. Invoke Roblox require only
        -- dynamically for the game's own ModuleScript, as the B21 controller does.
        local loader = getfenv(0)["require"]
        local ok, value = pcall(loader, mod)
        if not ok or type(value) ~= "table" then return nil end
        if type(value.IsOpen) ~= "function" or type(value.Dismiss) ~= "function" then return nil end
        resultsController = value
        return value
    end
    local function officialOpen()
        local ctrl = loadController()
        if ctrl and type(ctrl.IsOpen) == "function" then
            local ok, result = pcall(ctrl.IsOpen)
            if ok and result == true then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function isOpen()
        return player:GetAttribute("BossResultsOpen") == true or officialOpen()
    end
    local function matchingReport(guiRoot)
        if not guiRoot then return nil end
        local isB29, won, lost = false, false, false
        for _, node in ipairs(guiRoot:GetDescendants()) do
            if node:IsA("TextLabel") then
                local value = string.upper(tostring(node.Text or ""))
                if value:find("B-29", 1, true) or value:find("B29", 1, true)
                    or value:find("SUPERFORTRESS", 1, true) then isB29 = true end
                if value:find("DEFEATED", 1, true) or value:find("VICTORY", 1, true) then won = true end
                if value:find("MISSION FAILED", 1, true) then lost = true end
            end
        end
        if isB29 and won ~= lost then return won and "WIN" or "LOSS" end
        return nil
    end

    function report:watch(ctx)
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        if listeningContext == ctx and connection then return true end
        if connection then connection:Disconnect(); connection = nil end
        local folder = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        local remote = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("B29Event")
        if not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then return false, "B29_EVENT_MISSING" end
        local current = remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(packet)
            if type(packet) ~= "table" or type(packet.K) ~= "string" then return end
            terminal:observe(packet)
            -- Subscribe before Solo. Cover observes atomic timing and bomb release immediately.
            cover:observe(packet)
            local kind = packet.K
            if kind == "Outcome" and type(packet.Victory) == "boolean" then
                confirmedOutcome = packet.Victory and "WIN" or "LOSS"
                outcomeAt = runtime:now()
            end
            if kind == "Start" or kind == "Launch" or kind == "Session"
                or kind == "Begin" or kind == "Phase" or kind == "Attack"
                or kind == "Systems" or kind == "Engine" or kind == "Disruption"
                or kind == "Atomic" or kind == "Withdraw" or kind == "Death"
                or kind == "Resync" or kind == "Health" or kind == "End"
                or kind == "Outcome" then
                if kind == "Health" then
                    if runtime:now() - lastHealthAt < 4 then return end
                    lastHealthAt = runtime:now()
                end
                local detail = {kind = kind}
                for _, field in ipairs({"Phase", "Name", "Reason", "EndReason", "Victory",
                    "Kind", "State", "Stage", "At", "T0", "ReleaseAt", "DetonateAt",
                    "HP", "MaxHP", "Generation", "TimeLeft", "RewardEligible"}) do
                    local value = packet[field]
                    if type(value) == "string" or type(value) == "number" or type(value) == "boolean" then
                        detail[field] = value
                    end
                end
                emit("B29_EVENT", detail)
            end
        end)
        connection, listeningContext = current, ctx
        ctx:deferCleanup(function()
            if connection == current then
                current:Disconnect()
                connection, listeningContext = nil, nil
            end
        end)
        return true
    end
    function report:cleanup()
        if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
        connection, listeningContext = nil, nil
        -- Keep outcome and report evidence across RETURN/REPORT retries.
    end
    function report:verifiedDeferredOutcome(encounter)
        return terminal:verified(encounter, "LOSS")
    end
    function report:resetOutcome()
        terminal:reset()
        confirmedOutcome, outcomeAt, seenReport, firstOpenedAt = nil, nil, false, nil
        cover:reset()
    end
    function report:inspect()
        local root = gui:find(env.profile.paths.bossReport)
        local active = isOpen() -- Same verified V2 signal: BossResultsOpen or official controller.IsOpen()
        if active then
            seenReport = true
            firstOpenedAt = firstOpenedAt or runtime:now()
        end
        local guiOutcome = active and matchingReport(root) or nil
        local outcome = confirmedOutcome or guiOutcome
        return {
            active = active, matchesBoss = confirmedOutcome ~= nil or guiOutcome ~= nil,
            outcome = outcome, report = root, seen = seenReport,
            pendingPresentation = confirmedOutcome ~= nil and not seenReport
                and outcomeAt ~= nil and runtime:now() - outcomeAt < config.reportTimeoutSeconds,
        }
    end
    function report:reconcile(encounter)
        local evidence = self:inspect()
        if evidence.matchesBoss and evidence.outcome
            and (not encounter.outcome or encounter.outcome == evidence.outcome) then return true end
        return encounter.outcome ~= nil and seenReport and not evidence.active
    end
    function report:resolve(ctx, encounter)
        local watching, why = self:watch(ctx)
        if not watching then return {ok = false, code = why} end
        -- V2 REQUIREMENT: Outcome alone never authorizes return/Continue.
        local evidence = ctx:await(function()
            local current = self:inspect()
            if current.active and current.matchesBoss and current.outcome then return current end
            if seenReport and not current.active and (encounter.outcome or current.outcome) then
                return current -- manually dismissed report after previously observing it
            end
        end, config.reportTimeoutSeconds)
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        if not evidence then return {ok = false, code = "B29_REPORT_NOT_OBSERVED"} end
        if evidence.outcome and encounter.outcome and evidence.outcome ~= encounter.outcome then
            return {ok = false, held = true, code = "BOSS_OUTCOME_CONFLICT"}
        end
        local outcome = evidence.outcome or encounter.outcome
        if not outcome then return {ok = false, code = "B29_OUTCOME_UNVERIFIED"} end
        if not encounter.outcome then
            local accepted = writer:recordBossReport(outcome,
                runtime:epoch() + repeatPolicy:outcomeDelay(outcome))
            if not accepted then return {ok = false, held = true, code = "BOSS_OUTCOME_CONFLICT"} end
            encounter = env.state:snapshot().boss.encounter
        end
        if not evidence.active then
            writer:closeReport()
            return {ok = true, code = "B29_REPORT_MANUALLY_CLOSED"}
        end
        local at = platform:position()
        local place = player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") == true and "HIDEOUT" or "OTHER"
        if place == "OTHER" and at then
            local dx, dz = at.X - config.arenaCenter.x, at.Z - config.arenaCenter.z
            if dx * dx + dz * dz < config.arenaRadius * config.arenaRadius then
                place = "ARENA"
            end
        end
        emit("B29_REPORT_OPEN", {outcome = outcome, location = place,
            inBossFight = player:GetAttribute("InBossFight")})
        local controller = loadController()
        if not controller then return {ok = false, code = "B29_RESULT_CONTROLLER_MISSING_MANUAL_CONTINUE"} end
        if not encounter.continueAttempted then
            local ready = ctx:await(function()
                if not isOpen() then return "MANUALLY_CLOSED" end
                local armed = false
                if type(controller.Debug) == "function" then
                    local ok, message = pcall(controller.Debug)
                    armed = ok and type(message) == "string"
                        and message:find("armed=true", 1, true) ~= nil
                end
                if armed and firstOpenedAt
                    and runtime:now() - firstOpenedAt >= config.reportHoldSeconds then return "ARMED" end
            end, config.reportTimeoutSeconds)
            if ctx:isCancelled() then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
            if ready == "MANUALLY_CLOSED" then
                writer:closeReport()
                return {ok = true, code = "B29_REPORT_MANUALLY_CLOSED"}
            end
            if ready ~= "ARMED" then return {ok = false, code = "B29_REPORT_NOT_ARMED_MANUAL_CONTINUE"} end
            if not writer:markContinueAttempt() then return {ok = false, code = "B29_CONTINUE_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED"} end
            local sent, err = pcall(function() controller.Dismiss("continue") end)
            if not sent then return {ok = false, code = "B29_CONTINUE_FAILED: " .. tostring(err)} end
            emit("B29_REPORT_CONTINUE", {code = "CONTINUE_REQUESTED"})
        end
        local closed = ctx:await(function() if not self:inspect().active then return true end end,
            config.reportCloseTimeoutSeconds)
        if not closed then return {ok = false, code = "B29_REPORT_STILL_OPEN_MANUAL_CONTINUE"} end
        writer:closeReport()
        return {ok = true, code = "B29_REPORT_CLOSED"}
    end
    return report
end
return ReportController
end
-- END MODULE boss.B29.ReportController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.B2Spirit.ArenaObserver
__factories["boss.B2Spirit.ArenaObserver"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Arena geometry is delivered by B2FightStart, not a fixed world coordinate.
local ArenaObserver = {}
function ArenaObserver.new(env, config)
    local platform = env.services.roblox
    local player, workspace = platform:player(),platform:workspace()
    local observer = {}
    local centre, radius, stations, sessionId = nil,300,{},nil
    function observer:reset()
        centre,radius,stations,sessionId = nil,300,{},nil
    end
    function observer:start(packet)
        if type(packet)~="table" or packet.BossId~=config.gameBossId then return false end
        if sessionId~=nil and sessionId==packet.SessionId then return false end
        sessionId = packet.SessionId
        centre = typeof(packet.ArenaCentre)=="Vector3" and packet.ArenaCentre or nil
        radius = math.clamp(tonumber(packet.ArenaRadius) or 300,100,600)
        stations = {}
        if type(packet.RadarStations)=="table" then
            for i=1,3 do
                if typeof(packet.RadarStations[i])=="Vector3" then stations[i]=packet.RadarStations[i] end
            end
        end
        return true
    end
    function observer:sessionMatches(packet)
        return sessionId~=nil and packet~=nil and packet.SessionId==sessionId
    end
    function observer:sessionId() return sessionId end
    function observer:center() return centre end
    function observer:radius() return radius end
    function observer:stations() return stations end
    function observer:participating() return player:GetAttribute("B2Participant")==true end
    function observer:inArenaPosition(pos)
        pos = pos or platform:position()
        if typeof(pos)~="Vector3" or typeof(centre)~="Vector3" then return false end
        local dx,dz=pos.X-centre.X,pos.Z-centre.Z
        return dx*dx+dz*dz <= (radius+50)^2 and math.abs(pos.Y-centre.Y)<200
    end
    function observer:inArena()
        return self:participating() or
            (workspace:GetAttribute("B2FightActive")==true
            and player:GetAttribute("InBossFight")==true and self:inArenaPosition())
    end
    function observer:state()
        return {phase=workspace:GetAttribute("B2Phase"),
            fightState=workspace:GetAttribute("B2FightState"),
            active=workspace:GetAttribute("B2FightActive"),
            participant=player:GetAttribute("B2Participant"),
            inBossFight=player:GetAttribute("InBossFight")}
    end
    return observer
end
return ArenaObserver
end
-- END MODULE boss.B2Spirit.ArenaObserver

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.B2Spirit.B2Spirit
__factories["boss.B2Spirit.B2Spirit"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local Config=require("boss.B2Spirit.Config")
local ArenaObserver=require("boss.B2Spirit.ArenaObserver")
local CommandController=require("boss.B2Spirit.CommandController")
local CombatController=require("boss.B2Spirit.CombatController")
local MechanicsController=require("boss.B2Spirit.MechanicsController")
local ReportController=require("boss.B2Spirit.ReportController")
local RepeatPolicy=require("boss.B2Spirit.RepeatPolicy")
local B2Spirit={}
function B2Spirit.definition()
    return {bossId=Config.bossId,displayName=Config.displayName,create=function(env)
        local observer=ArenaObserver.new(env,Config)
        local mechanics=MechanicsController.new(env,Config,observer)
        local repeatPolicy=RepeatPolicy.new(env)
        local report=ReportController.new(env,Config,repeatPolicy,mechanics,observer)
        return {config=Config,observer=observer,mechanics=mechanics,report=report,
            repeatPolicy=repeatPolicy,
            command=CommandController.new(env,Config,observer,report),
            combat=CombatController.new(env,Config,observer,report,mechanics)}
    end}
end
return B2Spirit
end

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.B2Spirit.CombatController
__factories["boss.B2Spirit.CombatController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- B-2 combat monitors native outcome while one scoped tick coordinates movement.
local CombatController={}
function CombatController.new(env,config,observer,report,mechanics)
    local runtime,telemetry=env.runtime,env.services.telemetry
    local combat={supportsContinuation=true}
    function combat:nativeEncounter()
        return report:nativeEncounter()
    end
    local function emit(name,data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit("B2SPIRIT_"..name,data or {}) end
    end
    function combat:run(ctx,encounter,rebound)
        local watching,why=report:watch(ctx)
        if not watching then return {code=why} end
        mechanics:start(ctx,encounter)
        if rebound and not ctx:isCancelled() then
            ctx:reportProgress("ACTIVE_COMBAT")
            if telemetry then
                telemetry:emit("COMBAT_RESUMED", {encounterId=encounter.encounterId,bossId=encounter.bossId,
                    characterGeneration=encounter.characterGeneration,reason="B2_SESSION_UPDATE_VERIFIED"})
            end
        end
        local deadline=runtime:now()+config.maxFightSeconds
        local lastKey,lastLog=nil,0
        local code="OUTCOME_NOT_OBSERVED_TIMEOUT"
        while not ctx:isCancelled() and runtime:now()<deadline do
            local outcome=report:inspect().outcome
            if outcome then code="OUTCOME_OBSERVED";break end
            local state=observer:state()
            local key=tostring(state.fightState).."/"..tostring(state.phase).."/"..
                tostring(state.active).."/"..tostring(state.participant)
            if key~=lastKey or runtime:now()-lastLog>25 then
                emit("STATE",state);lastKey,lastLog=key,runtime:now()
            end
            if not ctx:wait(0.4) then break end
        end
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return {code="CANCELLED"} end
        if code=="OUTCOME_OBSERVED" then
            -- V3 keeps dodging for up to four seconds after victory.
            if report:inspect().outcome=="WIN" and mechanics:hazardCount()>0 then
                emit("HAZARD_CLEAR_WAIT",{count=mechanics:hazardCount()})
                local untilTime=runtime:now()+config.dodgeAfterVictorySeconds
                while not ctx:isCancelled() and runtime:now()<untilTime do
                    if mechanics:hazardCount()==0 then break end
                    if not ctx:wait(0.2) then break end
                end
            end
            emit("MECHANICS_SUMMARY",mechanics:status())
        end
        mechanics:stop(ctx)
        return {code=code}
    end
    return combat
end
return CombatController
end
-- END MODULE boss.B2Spirit.CombatController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.B2Spirit.CommandController
__factories["boss.B2Spirit.CommandController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- B2Spirit standalone V3 flow: Hideout -> Boss Command pass -> ONE Solo -> combat.
-- Adaptive report may open in arena OR after exit; never request return before Continue.
local DirectBossTravel = require("main.navigation.DirectBossTravel")
local LocationEvidence = require("main.world.LocationEvidence")
local CommandController = {}

function CommandController.new(env, config, observer, report)
    local platform, runtime = env.services.roblox, env.runtime
    local player, workspace = platform:player(), platform:workspace()
    local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
    local travel = DirectBossTravel.new(env)
    local command = {}
    local uncertainHideout, uncertainWorld
    local function emit(name, data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit(name, data or {}) end
    end
    local function remote(name)
        local storage = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage")
        local folder = storage:FindFirstChild("Remotes") or storage:WaitForChild("Remotes", 10)
        local item = folder and (folder:FindFirstChild(name) or folder:WaitForChild(name, 7))
        return item and item:IsA("RemoteEvent") and item or nil
    end
    local function active(ctx) return runtime:isActive(ctx) and not ctx:isCancelled() end
    local function cooldownLeft()
        local raw = player:GetAttribute("BossStartCooldowns")
        if type(raw) ~= "string" or raw == "" then return 0 end
        local ok, data = pcall(function() return platform:service("HttpService"):JSONDecode(raw) end)
        if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then return 0 end
        return math.max(0, (tonumber(data[config.gameBossKey]) or 0) - workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
    end

    function command:prepare(ctx)
        local watching, why = report:watch(ctx) -- watch BEFORE sending any boss request
        if not watching then return false, why end
        if observer:inArena() then return true, "B2SPIRIT_ALREADY_IN_ARENA" end
        if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true then return false, "OTHER_BOSS_ACTIVE" end
        if not active(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        local entered = travel:enterHideout(ctx)
        emit("B2SPIRIT_DIRECT_HIDEOUT", {ok = entered.ok, code = entered.code, reason = entered.reason})
        if not entered.ok then return false, entered.code end
        local positioned = travel:moveToKnownPoint(ctx, config.commandSafePosition, {
            requireHideout = true, radius = 6, settle = 0.85,
        })
        emit("B2SPIRIT_COMMAND_POSITION", {ok = positioned.ok, code = positioned.code})
        if not positioned.ok then return false, positioned.code end
        return true, "B2SPIRIT_COMMAND_READY"
    end

    function command:readiness()
        if observer:inArena() then return "READY" end
        if not travel:inHideout() then return "UNKNOWN" end
        local secs = cooldownLeft()
        if secs > 0 then
            secs = math.ceil(secs)
            return string.format("%d:%02d", math.floor(secs / 60), secs % 60)
        end
        -- The server pass remains authoritative for unlock/eligibility.
        return "READY"
    end

    function command:startSolo(ctx, markAttempt)
        if not active(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        if observer:participating() then return true, "B2SPIRIT_ALREADY_FIGHTING" end
        if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true then return false, "OTHER_BOSS_ACTIVE" end
        if not travel:inHideout() then return false, "NOT_IN_HIDEOUT" end
        if self:readiness() ~= "READY" then return false, "B2SPIRIT_NOT_READY" end
        local watching, why = report:watch(ctx)
        if not watching then return false, why end
        local hideout, accept = remote("PersonalHideoutRemote"), remote("B2CommanderAccept")
        if not hideout or not accept then return false, "B2SPIRIT_COMMAND_REMOTES_MISSING" end
        local passReply, acceptReply
        local passConnection = hideout.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
            if type(e) == "table" and e.Kind == "BossCommand" and e.Op == "Start"
                and e.BossKey == config.gameBossKey then passReply = e end
        end)
        local acceptConnection = accept.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
            if type(e) == "table" and e.Accepted ~= nil then acceptReply = e end
        end)
        local function finish(ok, code)
            passConnection:Disconnect()
            acceptConnection:Disconnect()
            return ok, code
        end
        local sent, err = pcall(function()
            hideout:FireServer({Action = "StartBoss", BossKey = config.gameBossKey, Solo = true})
        end)
        if not sent then return finish(false, "B2SPIRIT_PASS_SEND_FAILED: " .. tostring(err)) end
        local gotPass = ctx:await(function() return passReply end, 10)
        if not active(ctx) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
        if not gotPass then return finish(false, "B2SPIRIT_PASS_TIMEOUT_NO_RETRY") end
        emit("B2SPIRIT_PASS_RESULT", {ok = gotPass.Ok == true, reason = gotPass.Reason})
        if gotPass.Ok ~= true then return finish(false, "B2SPIRIT_PASS_REJECTED: " .. tostring(gotPass.Reason)) end
        -- Mark before firing the irreversible Solo request; never blind retry.
        if not markAttempt() then return finish(false, "B2SPIRIT_SOLO_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED") end
        sent, err = pcall(function() accept:FireServer({Solo = true}) end)
        if not sent then return finish(false, "B2SPIRIT_SOLO_SEND_FAILED: " .. tostring(err)) end
        local observed = ctx:await(function()
            if acceptReply and acceptReply.Accepted == false then return "REJECTED" end
            if observer:participating() then return "ENTERED" end
        end, config.arenaTimeout)
        if not active(ctx) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
        emit("B2SPIRIT_SOLO_RESULT", {code = observed or "AMBIGUOUS", accepted = acceptReply and acceptReply.Accepted})
        if observed == "ENTERED" then return finish(true, "B2SPIRIT_FIGHT_VERIFIED") end
        if observed == "REJECTED" then
            return finish(false, "B2SPIRIT_SOLO_REJECTED: " .. tostring(acceptReply.Reason))
        end
        return finish(false, "B2SPIRIT_SOLO_AMBIGUOUS_NO_RETRY")
    end

    function command:close(_) return true end -- No command GUI was opened.

    function command:nativeLossDestination(encounter, evidence)
        if encounter.outcome ~= "LOSS" then return nil end
        if evidence.location == "PERSONAL_HIDEOUT" then return "PERSONAL_HIDEOUT" end
        local settings = env.state:settingsSnapshot()
        if settings.bossEnabled and settings.bossRepeat
            and evidence.location == "UNVERIFIED_HIDEOUT" and evidence.atHideoutSite then
            return "PERSONAL_HIDEOUT"
        end
    end

    function command:returnHome(ctx, home)
        if not active(ctx) then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        if type(home) ~= "number" or home < 1 or home % 1 ~= 0 then
            return {ok = false, code = "INVALID_HOME_WORLD"}
        end
        local encounter = env.state:snapshot().boss.encounter
        if not encounter or not encounter.reportClosed then return {ok = false, code = "B2SPIRIT_REPORT_UNRESOLVED"} end
        if report:inspect().active then return {ok = false, code = "B2SPIRIT_REPORT_STILL_OPEN"} end

        local function settled()
            return player.GameplayPaused~=true and player:GetAttribute("BossReviveDowned")~=true
                and player:GetAttribute("InBossFight")~=true and player:GetAttribute("B2Participant")~=true
                and not report:inspect().active and report:nativeReturnSettled() and platform:character().ready
        end
        local function location()
            local observed = platform:observeLocation(env.profile, runtime:now())
            local hideout, atSite = LocationEvidence.hideout(platform, observed)
            if observer:inArenaPosition() then return "BOSS_ARENA", observed end
            if hideout then return hideout, observed, atSite end
            if LocationEvidence.matchesWorld(platform, observed, player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")) then
                return "WORLD", observed
            end
            return "UNKNOWN", observed
        end
        local released = ctx:await(settled, config.returnLockTimeoutSeconds)
        if not released then
            emit("B2SPIRIT_RETURN_LOCK_PENDING", {world = home})
            return {ok = false, code = "B2SPIRIT_RETURN_LOCK_PENDING", reason = "Respawn, report or return transition"}
        end
        local exit = ctx:await(function()
            if not settled() then return end
            local region = location()
            if region~="BOSS_ARENA" and region~="UNKNOWN" then return region end
        end, config.exitTimeoutSeconds)
        emit("B2SPIRIT_ARENA_EXIT", {code = exit or "EXIT_UNVERIFIED"})
        if not ctx:wait(1.5) then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        if not settled() then return {ok = false, code = "B2SPIRIT_RESPAWN_UNSETTLED"} end

        local region, observed, atSite = location()
        if uncertainHideout==encounter.encounterId and region~="PERSONAL_HIDEOUT" then
            return {ok = false, code = "B2SPIRIT_HIDEOUT_ENTRY_PENDING"}
        end
        if region=="WORLD" and LocationEvidence.matchesWorld(platform, observed, home)
            and player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")==home then
            return {ok = true, code = "ALREADY_IN_HOME", world = home}
        end
        if uncertainWorld==encounter.encounterId then return {ok = false, code = "B2SPIRIT_WORLD_RETURN_PENDING"} end

        local settings = env.state:settingsSnapshot()
        local recoverHideout = encounter.outcome=="LOSS" and settings.bossEnabled and settings.bossRepeat
        if recoverHideout then
            if region=="PERSONAL_HIDEOUT" then
                return {ok = true, code = "B2SPIRIT_PERSONAL_HIDEOUT_VERIFIED"}
            end
            if region=="UNVERIFIED_HIDEOUT" and (atSite
                or LocationEvidence.matchesWorld(platform, observed, player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"))) then
                -- Only the owned return stage reaches here. An ambiguous Enter is never replayed.
                uncertainHideout=encounter.encounterId
                local entered=travel:enterHideout(ctx)
                if entered.ok and settled() and location()=="PERSONAL_HIDEOUT" then
                    return {ok = true, code = "B2SPIRIT_PERSONAL_HIDEOUT_VERIFIED"}
                end
                if entered.code=="DIRECT_HIDEOUT_REJECTED" or entered.code=="DIRECT_HIDEOUT_REMOTE_MISSING" then
                    uncertainHideout=nil
                end
                return {ok = false, code = "B2SPIRIT_HIDEOUT_RECOVERY_UNVERIFIED", reason = entered.code}
            end
        end
        if region=="UNKNOWN" or (region=="UNVERIFIED_HIDEOUT" and not atSite) then
            return {ok = false, code = "B2SPIRIT_RETURN_ORIGIN_UNVERIFIED"}
        end
        local request, prepare, result = remote("RequestWorldTravel"), remote("NavPrepareWorlds"), remote("WorldTravelResult")
        if not request or not prepare then return {ok = false, code = "B2SPIRIT_WORLD_TRAVEL_REMOTES_MISSING"} end
        local reply
        local connection = result and result.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
            if type(e) == "table" and e.Kind == "Result" and tonumber(e.WorldId) == home then reply = e end
        end) or nil
        local function finish(ok, code, reason)
            if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
            emit("B2SPIRIT_DIRECT_RETURN", {ok = ok, code = code, reason = reason, world = home})
            return {ok = ok, code = code, reason = reason, world = home}
        end
        for attempt = 1, config.returnRetries do
            if not active(ctx) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            if not settled() then return finish(false, "B2SPIRIT_RESPAWN_UNSETTLED") end
            reply = nil
            local prior = platform:position()
            if not prior then return finish(false, "CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE") end
            local sent, err = pcall(function() prepare:FireServer("stream", home) end)
            if not sent then return finish(false, "WORLD_PREPARE_SEND_FAILED", tostring(err)) end
            if not ctx:wait(0.12) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            if not settled() then return finish(false, "B2SPIRIT_RESPAWN_UNSETTLED") end
            uncertainWorld = encounter.encounterId
            sent, err = pcall(function() request:FireServer(home) end)
            if not sent then return finish(false, "WORLD_REQUEST_SEND_FAILED", tostring(err)) end
            local observed = ctx:await(function()
                if reply and reply.Ok == false then return "REJECTED" end
                local current = platform:position()
                if current and platform:distance(current, prior) > 50 and settled() then
                    local region, observed = location()
                    if region=="WORLD" and player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")==home
                        and LocationEvidence.matchesWorld(platform, observed, home) then return "VERIFIED" end
                end
            end, 17)
            emit("B2SPIRIT_RETURN_ATTEMPT", {attempt = attempt, code = observed or "AMBIGUOUS",
                reason = reply and reply.Reason})
            if observed == "VERIFIED" then return finish(true, "B2SPIRIT_HOME_VERIFIED") end
            if observed ~= "REJECTED" then return finish(false, "B2SPIRIT_RETURN_AMBIGUOUS_NO_RETRY") end
            uncertainWorld = nil
            local why = tostring(reply.Reason or "UNKNOWN")
            if why ~= "BossFight" or attempt == config.returnRetries then
                return finish(false, "B2SPIRIT_WORLD_RETURN_REJECTED", why)
            end
            if not ctx:wait(12) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            local settled = ctx:await(function()
                if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true then return true end
            end, 40)
            if not settled then return finish(false, "B2SPIRIT_LOCK_STILL_ACTIVE", "BossFight") end
        end
        return finish(false, "B2SPIRIT_WORLD_RETURN_EXHAUSTED")
    end
    return command
end
return CommandController
end
-- END MODULE boss.B2Spirit.CommandController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.B2Spirit.Config

--!nonstrict

return {
    bossId = "B2SPIRIT", displayName = "B-2 Spirit", gameBossKey = "B2Spirit",
    gameBossId = "World10B2Spirit",
    commandSafePosition = {x = -31962.1074, y = 344.357483, z = 32887.3203},
    arenaTimeout = 48, maxFightSeconds = 900,
    reportTimeoutSeconds = 130, reportHoldSeconds = 3,
    reportCloseTimeoutSeconds = 125, exitTimeoutSeconds = 110,
    returnLockTimeoutSeconds = 80, returnRetries = 3,
    autoRadar = true, requiredStations = 2,
    radarStandRadius = 14, radarDwellSeconds = 5,
    radarMoveInterval = 2.5, radarAttemptsPerStation = 2,
    autoDodge = true, dodgeMargin = 12,
    dodgeInterval = 0.75, dodgeLeadSeconds = 0.75,
    dodgeAfterVictorySeconds = 4,
}
