-- BEGIN MODULE boss.B2Spirit.MechanicsController
__factories["boss.B2Spirit.MechanicsController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- B-2 radar progress comes from proximity. Movement and dodges share one job tick.
local MechanicsController = {}
function MechanicsController.new(env, config, observer)
    local platform, movement = env.services.roblox, env.services.movement
    local P,W=platform:player(),platform:workspace()
    local settings=config
    local telemetry=env.services.telemetry
    -- Optional only in Rift; Solo B-2 does not have this service.
    local riftHazards=env.services.riftHazards
    local lastRiftFusionLog=-math.huge
    local T={running=false,outcome=nil}
    local arenaCenter,arenaRadius,stationPositions=nil,300,{}
    local radar={meter=nil,scanned={},manned=nil,total=nil,dark=false,
        phase=1,lastUpdate=0,
        visits={},moves=0,verified=0,rejected=0,lastGate="WAITING"}
    local hazards, seenWarnings, warningOrder={},{},{}
    local dodge={attempts=0,verified=0,gate="WAITING",lastMove=nil,
        outcomeAt=nil,
        releaseRadar=false,releaseTries=0,nextReleaseTry=0,
        detected=0,groundRejects=0}
    local lastRadarLog,lastGateLog,lastMoved=nil,-math.huge,-math.huge
    local lastDodgeAt,lastDodgeLog,lastDodgeLogAt=-math.huge,nil,-math.huge
    local runningContext, movementLease, boundCharacter, boundRoot, pendingMove, encounterId
    local tickSeconds=.18
    local function isParticipating()
        return observer:participating() == true
    end
    local mechanics={}
    local function log(kind,row)
        if telemetry then
            row=row or {}
            row.jobId=runningContext and runningContext.jobId
            row.encounterId=encounterId
            row.sessionId=observer:sessionId()
            telemetry:emit("B2_"..kind,row)
        end
    end
    local function root()
        local current=platform:character()
        if current.ready then return current.character,current.root end
        return nil,nil
    end
    local function isRunning(ctx)
        return T.running and runningContext == ctx and not ctx:isCancelled()
            and not (ctx.isClosing and ctx:isClosing())
    end
    local function canMove(ctx, part)
        local character,current=root()
        local downed=P:GetAttribute("BossReviveDowned")
        return isRunning(ctx) and character==boundCharacter and current==boundRoot and part==current
            and isParticipating() and P:GetAttribute("InBossFight")==true
            and P:GetAttribute("B2Eliminated")~=true
            and downed~=true and (type(downed)~="string" or downed=="")
            and not (env.services.revivePending and env.services.revivePending())
    end
    local function requestMove(ctx, part, goal)
        if not canMove(ctx,part) then return false,"MOVEMENT_OWNER_CHANGED" end
        if not movement then return false,"MOVEMENT_UNAVAILABLE" end
        if not movementLease then
            local reason
            movementLease,reason=movement:acquire(ctx)
            if not movementLease then return false,reason end
        end
        if not canMove(ctx,part) then return false,"MOVEMENT_OWNER_CHANGED" end
        local ok,requested,reason=pcall(movement.relocate,movement,ctx,movementLease,goal,part)
        if not ok then return false,tostring(requested) end
        return requested,reason
    end
    local function observedMove(ctx, part, goal)
        if not canMove(ctx,part) then return nil end
        local _,after=root()
        if after==part and (after.Position-goal).Magnitude<=8 then return after end
    end
    -- B-2 radar objective is passive proximity occupancy, NOT B21 de-ice.
    -- The server releases the objective after scans or stealth reveal.
    -- Research config: 3 possible stations; >=2 scans required, StandRadius=14 studs.
    -- Source may vary in a live session; log observed values instead of asserting success.
    local function inArena(pos)
        if typeof(pos) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(arenaCenter) ~= "Vector3" then return false end
        local dx, dz = pos.X-arenaCenter.X, pos.Z-arenaCenter.Z
        return dx*dx + dz*dz <= (arenaRadius+50)^2 and math.abs(pos.Y-arenaCenter.Y) < 200
    end
    local function anyScanned(i)
        return radar.scanned[i] == true or radar.scanned[tostring(i)] == true
    end
    local function scannedCount()
        local count=0
        for i=1,3 do
            if anyScanned(i) then count+=1 end
        end
        return count
    end
    local function gate(reason, more)
        radar.lastGate=reason
        if radar.lastGate==lastRadarLog and os.clock()-lastGateLog<4 then return end
        lastRadarLog,lastGateLog=reason,os.clock()
        local info=more or {}
        info.reason=reason
        info.meter=radar.meter
        info.scanned=scannedCount()
        log("RADAR_GATE",info)
    end
    local function storeStationList(v, source)
        if type(v)~="table" then return end
        local pos={}
        for i=1,3 do
            if typeof(v[i])=="Vector3" then pos[i]=v[i] end
        end
        if #pos>0 then
            stationPositions=pos
            log("RADAR_STATIONS",{source=source,found=#pos,required=settings.requiredStations})
        end
    end
    local function findStationModels()
        local folder=W:FindFirstChild("RadarStations",true)
        if not folder then return end
        local modelPositions={}
        for i=1,3 do
            local child=folder:FindFirstChild(("RadarStation%02d"):format(i))
            if child then
                local pos
                if child:IsA("BasePart") then pos=child.Position
                elseif child:IsA("Model") then pos=child:GetPivot().Position end
                if pos and (not arenaCenter or (pos-arenaCenter).Magnitude < arenaRadius+120) then
                    modelPositions[i]=pos
                end
            end
        end
        if #modelPositions>0 then
            if #stationPositions==0 then storeStationList(modelPositions,"ARENA_MODEL") end
        end
    end
    local function safeStandingPoint(center, character)
        -- Ground raycast avoids moving into a void or hovering above a station.
        local ray=RaycastParams.new()
        ray.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        ray.FilterDescendantsInstances={character}
        ray.RespectCanCollide=true
        local hit=W:Raycast(center+Vector3.new(0,35,0),Vector3.new(0,-90,0),ray)
        if not hit or not hit.Instance or not hit.Instance.CanCollide then return nil,"NO_GROUND" end
        if hit.Normal.Y<0.65 then return nil,"GROUND_TOO_STEEP" end
        if (Vector3.new(hit.Position.X,0,hit.Position.Z)-Vector3.new(center.X,0,center.Z)).Magnitude > settings.radarStandRadius-3 then
            return nil,"OUTSIDE_STAND_RADIUS"
        end
        local candidate=Vector3.new(center.X,hit.Position.Y+3.25,center.Z)
        if math.abs(candidate.Y-center.Y)>settings.radarStandRadius then return nil,"STATION_HEIGHT_MISMATCH" end
        if not inArena(candidate) then return nil,"OUTSIDE_ARENA" end
        if W:Raycast(hit.Position+Vector3.new(0,.1,0),Vector3.new(0,6,0),ray) then
            return nil,"STATION_CLEARANCE_BLOCKED"
        end
        return candidate,nil
    end
    local function chooseStation(pos)
        local options={}
        for i=1,3 do
            local s=stationPositions[i]
            if s and not anyScanned(i) and (radar.visits[i] or 0)<settings.radarAttemptsPerStation then
                table.insert(options,{i=i, p=s, visits=radar.visits[i] or 0,
                    distance=(Vector3.new(pos.X,0,pos.Z)-Vector3.new(s.X,0,s.Z)).Magnitude})
            end
        end
        table.sort(options,function(a,b)
            if a.visits~=b.visits then return a.visits<b.visits end
            return a.distance<b.distance
        end)
        return options[1]
    end
    -- Evaluate native zones, lanes and locks before choosing one movement action.
    local function logDodgeGate(why, extra)
        dodge.gate=why
        if why==lastDodgeLog and os.clock()-lastDodgeLogAt<3 then return end
        lastDodgeLog,lastDodgeLogAt=why,os.clock()
        local row=extra or {};row.reason=why
        log("DODGE_GATE",row)
        if why~="NO_IMMEDIATE_DANGER" and why~="DODGE_MOVE_INTERVAL" then log("DODGE_BLOCKED",row) end
    end
    local function planarDist(a,b)
        return (Vector3.new(a.X-b.X,0,a.Z-b.Z)).Magnitude
    end
    local attackRadius = {
        TargetedBomb=14, ClusterStrike=20, Penetrator=16, Incendiary=12,
        FuelAir=88, RingStrike=9, SpiralBarrage=8, WalkingBarrage=10,
        CrossStrike=10, ScorchedBarrage=18, StealthFlyover=20,
        Bullseye=8, PincerLanes=10, CarpetRun=17, FinalPayload=24,
    }
    local function eventImpact(e, delay)
        local impact, at, telegraph=tonumber(e.ImpactAt),tonumber(e.At),tonumber(e.TelegraphSeconds)
        if not impact and at and telegraph then impact=at+telegraph end
        if not impact then return end
        impact=impact+(delay or 0)
        if impact==impact and math.abs(impact)<math.huge then return impact end
    end
    local function addCircle(e,pos,radius,attack,source,impact,lastImpact)
        if typeof(pos)~="Vector3" or type(radius)~="number" or not (radius>0 and radius<=180) then return false end
        local now,serverNow=os.clock(),W:GetServerTimeNow()
        local snapshot=source:match("^Hazards")~=nil and type(e.Zones)=="table"
        local tail=source=="AttackLock" and attack=="TargetedBomb" and tickSeconds or 2.5
        local telegraph=tonumber(e.TelegraphSeconds)
        if not telegraph or not (telegraph>=0 and telegraph<math.huge) then telegraph=4 end
        local remaining=impact and (lastImpact or impact)-serverNow+tail or telegraph+2.5
        if not snapshot and not (remaining>0) then return false end
        local id=e.AttackId
        local key=table.concat({tostring(id or ""),source,attack,tostring(impact or ""),
            pos.X,pos.Y,pos.Z,radius},":")
        if not snapshot then
            local seen=seenWarnings[key]
            if seen and (id~=nil or impact or now-seen<remaining) then
                seenWarnings[key]=now
                return false
            end
            if not seen then
                warningOrder[#warningOrder+1]=key
                if #warningOrder>440 then seenWarnings[table.remove(warningOrder,1)]=nil end
            end
            seenWarnings[key]=now
        end
        hazards[#hazards+1]={p=pos,r=radius,untilTime=snapshot and math.huge or now+(impact and remaining or math.min(30,remaining)),
            impact=not snapshot and impact or nil,id=id,key=key,name=attack,source=source}
        if #hazards>220 then table.remove(hazards,1) end
        return true
    end
    local function addHazards(e,source)
        if source=="Hazards" and type(e.Zones)=="table" then
            -- Native Hazards.Zones replaces the active zone set.
            for i=#hazards,1,-1 do
                if hazards[i].source:match("^Hazards") then table.remove(hazards,i) end
            end
        end
        local attack=tostring(e.AttackKind or e.PatternKind or e.Pattern
            or (source=="AttackLock" and "TargetedBomb") or source)
        local fallback=attackRadius[attack]
        local amount=0
        local impact=eventImpact(e)
        local radius=tonumber(e.Radius or e.BlastRadius or e.ShockwaveRadius or e.ZoneRadius) or fallback
        local direct=e.Position or e.P or e.Center
        if addCircle(e,direct,radius,attack,source,impact) then
            amount+=1
            if source=="AttackLock" and e.AttackId~=nil then
                for i=#hazards,1,-1 do
                    local h=hazards[i]
                    if h.id==e.AttackId and h.source=="Attack.LOCAL_TARGET" then table.remove(hazards,i) end
                end
            end
        end
        -- Keep zone timings separate. The native B-2 client adds DetonateAfter
        -- to the telegraph endpoint for staggered attacks.
        for _,key in ipairs({"Zones","Hazards","Circles","Bombs","BurningZones","OilZones"}) do
            local list=e[key]
            if type(list)=="table" then
                for _,zone in pairs(list) do
                    if type(zone)=="table" then
                        local p=zone.Position or zone.P or zone.Center or zone.Point
                        local r=tonumber(zone.Radius or zone.ZoneRadius or zone.BlastRadius)
                            or tonumber(e.ZoneRadius) or fallback
                        local impactAt=eventImpact(zone) or eventImpact(e,tonumber(zone.DetonateAfter))
                        if addCircle(e,p,r,attack,source.."."..key,impactAt) then amount+=1 end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        local laneStart=e.LaneStart or e.Start
        local laneEnd=e.LaneEnd or e.Finish
        if typeof(laneStart)=="Vector3" and typeof(laneEnd)=="Vector3" then
            local width=tonumber(e.LaneWidth or e.Width) or (attack=="StealthFlyover" and 40 or 34)
            local steps=math.clamp(math.ceil(planarDist(laneStart,laneEnd)/13),1,40)
            local segments,seconds=tonumber(e.Segments),tonumber(e.SegmentSeconds)
            -- Without segment timing, keep the full lane conservative.
            local lastImpact=impact and segments and seconds and impact+segments*seconds or nil
            for i=0,steps do
                if addCircle(e,laneStart:Lerp(laneEnd,i/steps),width/2,attack,source..".LANE",
                    lastImpact and impact,lastImpact) then
                    amount+=1
                end
            end
        end
        if not direct and type(e.Zones)~="table" and not laneStart and tonumber(e.TargetUserId)==P.UserId then
            local _,part=root()
            local at,tracking,lock=tonumber(e.At),tonumber(e.TrackSeconds),tonumber(e.LockToImpactSeconds)
            local estimated=at and tracking and lock and at+tracking+lock or nil
            if part and addCircle(e,part.Position,radius or 18,attack,source..".LOCAL_TARGET",estimated) then amount+=1 end
        end
        if source=="Hazards" and type(e.Zones)=="table" then
            local keys={}
            for _,hazard in ipairs(hazards) do
                if hazard.source:match("^Hazards") then keys[#keys+1]=hazard.key end
            end
            table.sort(keys)
            local signature=table.concat(keys,"|")
            if dodge.snapshotSignature==signature then return end
            dodge.snapshotSignature=signature
        end
        if amount>0 then
            dodge.lastAttack=attack
            dodge.detected+=amount
            log("ATTACK_DETECTED",{attack=attack,source=source,added=amount,total=#hazards})
        end
    end
    local function dangerAt(pos, imminentOnly, now, serverNow, episode)
        local score, strongest, strongestRisk=0,nil,0
        now=now or os.clock()
        if imminentOnly and not serverNow then serverNow=W:GetServerTimeNow() end
        for i=#hazards,1,-1 do
            local h=hazards[i]
            if h.untilTime<=now then
                table.remove(hazards,i)
            elseif not imminentOnly or not h.impact or h.impact-serverNow<=settings.dodgeLeadSeconds then
                local clearance=planarDist(pos,h.p)-h.r-settings.dodgeMargin
                if clearance<0 then
                    local risk=1-clearance/30
                    score+=risk
                    if risk>strongestRisk then strongest,strongestRisk=h,risk end
                    if episode then episode[#episode+1]=h.key end
                end
            end
        end
        -- Rift Strikes are a second hazard source, NOT a second movement owner.
        -- Include them in the SAME candidate scoring, radar hold/exit check,
        -- and movement lease used by native B-2 bomb Dodge.
        if riftHazards and type(riftHazards.groundFootprints)=="function" then
            local ok,riftPoints=pcall(riftHazards.groundFootprints,riftHazards,1.6)
            if ok and type(riftPoints)=="table" then
                if episode and #riftPoints>0 and now-lastRiftFusionLog>=2 then
                    lastRiftFusionLog=now
                    log("RIFT_HAZARD_FUSED",{tracked=#riftPoints,owner="B2_MECHANICS"})
                end
                for _,h in ipairs(riftPoints) do
                    if typeof(h.p)=="Vector3" and type(h.r)=="number"
                        and math.abs(pos.Y-h.p.Y)<=32 then
                        local clearance=planarDist(pos,h.p)-h.r-settings.dodgeMargin
                        if clearance<0 then
                            local risk=1-clearance/30
                            score+=risk
                            if risk>strongestRisk then strongest,strongestRisk=h,risk end
                            if episode then episode[#episode+1]=h.key end
                        end
                    end
                end
            elseif episode then
                log("RIFT_HAZARD_FUSION_UNAVAILABLE",{reason=ok and "INVALID_RESULTS" or tostring(riftPoints)})
            end
        end
        return score,strongest
    end
    local function safeDodgeGround(pos,character,originY)
        if not inArena(pos) then return nil,"OUTSIDE_ARENA" end
        local ray=RaycastParams.new()
        ray.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        ray.FilterDescendantsInstances={character}
        ray.RespectCanCollide=true
        -- Sample from current character height: V2 used the proposed point's height
        -- then rejected valid platforms due to a strict 28-stud height difference.
        local castY=math.max(pos.Y,originY or pos.Y)+38
        local hit=W:Raycast(Vector3.new(pos.X,castY,pos.Z),Vector3.new(0,-150,0),ray)
        if not hit or not hit.Instance or not hit.Instance.CanCollide then return nil,"NO_GROUND" end
        if hit.Normal.Y<0.65 then return nil,"GROUND_TOO_STEEP" end
        local point=Vector3.new(pos.X,hit.Position.Y+3.5,pos.Z)
        if math.abs(point.Y-(originY or pos.Y))>65 then return nil,"UNSAFE_HEIGHT" end
        if not inArena(point) then return nil,"GROUND_OUTSIDE_ARENA" end
        if W:Raycast(hit.Position+Vector3.new(0,.1,0),Vector3.new(0,6,0),ray) then
            return nil,"DODGE_CLEARANCE_BLOCKED"
        end
        return point,nil
    end
    local function nearStation(pos, station)
        return planarDist(pos,station)<=settings.radarStandRadius-3
            and math.abs(pos.Y-station.Y)<=settings.radarStandRadius
    end
    local function clearRepair()
        radar.repair=nil
    end
    local function stall(why, repair)
        if not repair or repair.stallReason~=why then
            log("REPAIR_STALLED",{reason=why,station=repair and repair.station,meter=radar.meter,
                interruptions=repair and repair.interruptions,decays=repair and repair.decays})
        end
        if repair then repair.stallReason=why end
    end
    local function failStation(why, repair)
        stall(why,repair)
        radar.visits[repair.station]=(radar.visits[repair.station] or 0)+1
        clearRepair()
    end
    local function repairTarget(part)
        if not settings.autoRadar then gate("DISABLED"); return end
        if T.outcome or not radar.dark then
            clearRepair()
            gate(T.outcome and "FIGHT_ENDED" or "STEALTH_NOT_DARK")
            return
        end
        local scanned=scannedCount()
        if scanned>=settings.requiredStations then
            clearRepair()
            gate("MINIMUM_STATIONS_SCANNED",{required=settings.requiredStations})
            return
        end
        if next(stationPositions)==nil then findStationModels() end
        local repair=radar.repair
        if repair and not anyScanned(repair.station) then return repair end
        clearRepair()
        local selected=chooseStation(part.Position)
        if not selected then
            local reason=next(stationPositions) and "RADAR_ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED" or "STATIONS_NOT_FOUND"
            if radar.lastGate~=reason then stall(reason) end
            gate(reason)
            return
        end
        repair={station=selected.i,position=selected.p,peak=radar.meter,interruptions=0,decays=0}
        radar.repair=repair
        log("RADAR_FOCUS",{station=selected.i,distance=selected.distance,scanned=scanned})
        return repair
    end
    local function verifyPending(ctx)
        local move=pendingMove
        pendingMove=nil
        if not move then return end
        local after=observedMove(ctx,move.part,move.goal)
        local pos=after and after.Position
        if move.kind=="RADAR" then
            local repair=move.repair
            if T.outcome or radar.repair~=repair then return end
            local verified=pos and inArena(pos) and nearStation(pos,repair.position)
            if verified then radar.verified+=1
            else
                radar.rejected+=1
                failStation("RADAR_MOVE_UNVERIFIED",repair)
            end
            log("RADAR_MOVE",{station=repair.station,code=verified and "VERIFIED" or "NOT_VERIFIED"})
        elseif move.kind=="DODGE" then
            local risk=pos and dangerAt(pos,move.repair~=nil)
            local verified=pos and inArena(pos) and risk<move.risk
            if verified then
                dodge.verified+=1
                log("DODGE_MOVE_VERIFIED",{position=pos,risk=risk})
            else logDodgeGate("DODGE_POSITION_UNVERIFIED") end
            local repair=move.repair
            if pos and repair and radar.repair==repair and not repair.awayAt and not nearStation(pos,repair.position) then
                repair.interruptions+=1
                repair.awayAt=os.clock()
                repair.noGainInterruptions=repair.interruptionPeak==repair.peak and (repair.noGainInterruptions or 0)+1 or 1
                repair.interruptionPeak=repair.peak
            end
            log("DODGE_COMPLETED",{verified=verified==true,hazardId=move.hazardId,position=pos,risk=risk})
            dodge.lastMove=verified and "VERIFIED" or "NOT_VERIFIED"
        elseif pos then
            dodge.releaseRadar=false
            log("RADAR_EXIT_MOVE",{code="VERIFIED"})
        else logDodgeGate("RADAR_RELEASE_UNVERIFIED") end
    end
    local function move(ctx,part,goal,details)
        local sent,reason=requestMove(ctx,part,goal)
        if not sent then return false,reason end
        details.part,details.goal=part,goal
        pendingMove=details
        return true
    end
    local function repairStep(ctx, character, part, repair)
        local now=os.clock()
        if nearStation(part.Position,repair.position) then
            if not repair.occupiedAt then
                repair.occupiedAt,repair.lastAdvance=now,now
                log("REPAIR_STARTED",{station=repair.station,meter=radar.meter})
            end
            if repair.awayAt then
                repair.awayDuration=now-repair.awayAt
                repair.awayAt=nil
                repair.awaitingResume=true
                repair.lastAdvance=now
            end
            if now-repair.lastAdvance>=settings.radarDwellSeconds then
                failStation(radar.lastUpdate<repair.occupiedAt and "RADAR_PROGRESS_UNOBSERVED"
                    or "RADAR_PROGRESS_NOT_ADVANCING",repair)
                return
            end
            gate("STANDING_NEAR_RADAR",{station=repair.station})
            return
        end
        if not repair.awayAt and now-lastMoved<settings.radarMoveInterval then
            gate("MOVE_INTERVAL",{station=repair.station})
            return
        end
        local standing,why=safeStandingPoint(repair.position,character)
        if not standing then
            lastMoved=now
            failStation(why or "NO_STAND_POINT",repair)
            return
        end
        if dangerAt(standing,true)>0 then
            if repair.awayAt and now-repair.awayAt>=settings.radarDwellSeconds then
                stall("RADAR_BLOCKED_BY_ACTIVE_HAZARD",repair)
            end
            gate("RADAR_DESTINATION_UNSAFE",{station=repair.station})
            return
        end
        if repair.awayAt and (repair.noGainInterruptions or 0)>=3 and repair.decays>0 then
            lastMoved=now
            failStation("RADAR_INTERRUPTED_WITHOUT_NET_PROGRESS",repair)
            return
        end
        if not canMove(ctx,part) or T.outcome or not radar.dark then return end
        lastMoved=now
        radar.moves+=1
        local sent,reason=move(ctx,part,standing,{kind="RADAR",repair=repair})
        if not sent then
            radar.rejected+=1
            failStation(reason or "RADAR_MOVE_REJECTED",repair)
        end
    end
    local function safeDodge(part, character, risk, repair)
        local best,bestRisk,bestDistance=nil,risk,math.huge
        local rejected,lastReject=0,nil
        local distances=repair and {8,14,22,38,58,85,112,145,185} or {22,38,58,85,112,145,185}
        local now,serverNow=os.clock(),W:GetServerTimeNow()
        for _,distance in ipairs(distances) do
            for i=0,15 do
                local angle=i*math.pi/8
                local candidate=part.Position+Vector3.new(math.cos(angle)*distance,0,math.sin(angle)*distance)
                local candidateRisk=dangerAt(candidate,repair~=nil,now,serverNow)
                if candidateRisk<risk and candidateRisk<=bestRisk then
                    local grounded,why=safeDodgeGround(candidate,character,part.Position.Y)
                    if grounded then
                        candidateRisk=dangerAt(grounded,repair~=nil,now,serverNow)
                        local traveled=(grounded-part.Position).Magnitude
                        if candidateRisk<bestRisk or candidateRisk==bestRisk and traveled<bestDistance then
                            best,bestRisk,bestDistance=grounded,candidateRisk,traveled
                        end
                    else
                        rejected+=1
                        lastReject=why
                    end
                end
            end
            if bestRisk==0 then break end
        end
        return best,bestRisk,rejected,lastReject
    end
    local function dodgeStep(ctx, character, part, risk, threat, repair, episode)
        gate("DODGE_PRIORITY",{risk=risk,station=repair and repair.station})
        local fresh=dodge.threatKey~=episode
        if fresh then
            dodge.threatKey,dodge.threatTries=episode,0
            log("DODGE_REQUIRED",{risk=risk,attack=threat.name})
            log("DODGE_THREAT_EVALUATED",{hazardId=threat.id,attack=threat.name,
                impactIn=threat.impact and threat.impact-W:GetServerTimeNow(),
                reason=threat.impact and "IMMINENT_INTERSECTION" or "ACTIVE_OR_UNTIMED_INTERSECTION"})
        end
        if not (fresh and repair) and os.clock()-lastDodgeAt<settings.dodgeInterval then
            logDodgeGate("DODGE_MOVE_INTERVAL")
            return
        end
        if dodge.threatTries>=2 then
            logDodgeGate("UNCHANGED_THREAT_MOVE_LIMIT",{hazardId=threat.id})
            return
        end
        lastDodgeAt=os.clock()
        local best,bestRisk,rejected,lastReject=safeDodge(part,character,risk,repair)
        if not best then
            dodge.groundRejects+=rejected
            logDodgeGate("NO_LOWER_RISK_GROUND",{risk=risk,tracked=#hazards,
                groundRejected=rejected,lastReject=lastReject})
            return
        end
        -- Sample again before relocating. There is no waiting callback that
        -- can issue a movement after recovery gives up this job.
        local liveRisk=dangerAt(part.Position,repair~=nil)
        if liveRisk<=0 or dangerAt(best,repair~=nil)>=liveRisk then return end
        dodge.threatTries+=1
        dodge.attempts+=1
        log("DODGE_MOVE_REQUESTED",{position=best,risk=liveRisk})
        if repair then log("EMERGENCY_DODGE",{station=repair.station,hazardId=threat.id,
            risk=liveRisk,candidateRisk=bestRisk,position=best}) end
        local sent,reason=move(ctx,part,best,{kind="DODGE",risk=liveRisk,repair=repair,hazardId=threat.id})
        if not sent then logDodgeGate(reason or "DODGE_MOVE_REJECTED") end
    end
    local function releaseRadar(ctx, character, part)
        if os.clock()<dodge.nextReleaseTry then return end
        if dodge.releaseTries>=3 then
            dodge.releaseRadar=false
            logDodgeGate("RADAR_RELEASE_ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED")
            return
        end
        local near=false
        for _,station in pairs(stationPositions) do
            if planarDist(part.Position,station)<settings.radarStandRadius+12 then near=true end
        end
        if not near then
            dodge.releaseRadar=false
            log("RADAR_RELEASE",{code="ALREADY_CLEAR"})
            return
        end
        dodge.nextReleaseTry=os.clock()+3
        dodge.releaseTries+=1
        for _,distance in ipairs({38,52,68}) do
            for i=0,15 do
                local angle=i*math.pi/8
                local point=part.Position+Vector3.new(math.cos(angle)*distance,0,math.sin(angle)*distance)
                local clear=true
                for _,station in pairs(stationPositions) do
                    if planarDist(point,station)<settings.radarStandRadius+14 then clear=false;break end
                end
                if clear and dangerAt(point)<=0 then
                    local ground=safeDodgeGround(point,character,part.Position.Y)
                    if ground and dangerAt(ground)<=0 then
                        local sent,reason=move(ctx,part,ground,{kind="RELEASE"})
                        if not sent then logDodgeGate(reason or "RADAR_RELEASE_REJECTED") end
                        return
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        logDodgeGate("RADAR_RELEASE_NO_SAFE_GROUND")
    end
    local function movementLoop(ctx)
        task.spawn(function()
            local wasFighting=false
            log("DODGE_LOOP_STARTED",{participant=isParticipating()})
            while isRunning(ctx) do
                local character,part=root()
                if not character or character~=boundCharacter or part~=boundRoot then
                    log("MOVEMENT_OWNER_LOST")
                    mechanics:stop(ctx)
                    break
                end
                local fighting=canMove(ctx,part)
                if wasFighting and not fighting then log("PARTICIPATION_LOST") end
                wasFighting=fighting
                local postVictory=T.outcome and T.outcome.victory and dodge.outcomeAt
                    and os.clock()-dodge.outcomeAt<=settings.dodgeAfterVictorySeconds
                if fighting and inArena(part.Position)
                    and (W:GetAttribute("B2FightState")=="Active" or postVictory) then
                    verifyPending(ctx)
                    local repair=repairTarget(part)
                    local episode={}
                    local risk,threat=dangerAt(part.Position,repair~=nil,nil,nil,episode)
                    if risk>0 and settings.autoDodge and (not T.outcome or postVictory) then
                        table.sort(episode)
                        dodgeStep(ctx,character,part,risk,threat,repair,table.concat(episode,"|"))
                    else
                        dodge.threatKey=nil
                        if repair then
                            local _,forecast=dangerAt(part.Position)
                            local key=forecast and forecast.key
                            if key and repair.forecastKey~=key then
                                log("DODGE_THREAT_EVALUATED",{hazardId=forecast.id,attack=forecast.name,
                                    impactIn=forecast.impact and forecast.impact-W:GetServerTimeNow(),
                                    reason="REPAIR_CONTINUES"})
                            end
                            repair.forecastKey=key
                            repairStep(ctx,character,part,repair)
                        elseif settings.autoDodge and dodge.releaseRadar and not radar.dark and not T.outcome then
                            releaseRadar(ctx,character,part)
                        end
                    end
                else
                    pendingMove=nil
                    if not fighting then gate("NOT_PARTICIPANT") else gate("NO_ACTIVE_ARENA_POSITION") end
                end
                task.wait(tickSeconds)
            end
        end)
    end

    function mechanics:reset()
        -- Called by BossManager before the next Solo; preserve no previous encounter hazards.
        T.outcome=nil
        arenaCenter,arenaRadius,stationPositions=nil,300,{}
        radar={meter=nil,scanned={},manned=nil,total=nil,dark=false,
            phase=1,lastUpdate=0,
            visits={},moves=0,verified=0,rejected=0,lastGate="WAITING"}
        hazards,seenWarnings,warningOrder={},{},{}
        dodge={attempts=0,verified=0,gate="WAITING",lastMove=nil,
            outcomeAt=nil,
            releaseRadar=false,releaseTries=0,nextReleaseTry=0,
            detected=0,groundRejects=0}
        lastRadarLog,lastGateLog,lastMoved=nil,-math.huge,-math.huge
        lastDodgeAt,lastDodgeLog,lastDodgeLogAt=-math.huge,nil,-math.huge
        pendingMove=nil
        observer:reset()
    end
    function mechanics:observeStart(e)
        if not observer:start(e) then return end
        arenaCenter,arenaRadius=observer:center(),observer:radius()
        stationPositions={}
        radar.phase=1;radar.dark=false;radar.scanned={};radar.visits={}
        clearRepair()
        dodge.releaseRadar=false;dodge.releaseTries=0
        dodge.threatKey,dodge.snapshotSignature=nil,nil
        hazards,seenWarnings,warningOrder={},{},{}
        radar.meter,radar.lastUpdate=nil,0
        storeStationList(observer:stations(),"FIGHT_START")
        log("B2_START",{stationCount=#stationPositions,radius=arenaRadius,
            centerKnown=arenaCenter~=nil})
    end
    function mechanics:observeSession(e)
        if type(e)~="table" or not observer:sessionMatches(e) then return end
        local k=tostring(e.Kind or "UNKNOWN")
        if k=="Radar" then
            local previous=radar.meter
            local oldScanned=scannedCount()
            radar.meter=tonumber(e.Meter) or radar.meter
            radar.manned=tonumber(e.Manned)
            radar.total=tonumber(e.Total) or radar.total
            radar.lastUpdate=os.clock()
            if type(e.Scanned)=="table" then radar.scanned=table.clone(e.Scanned) end
            local repair=radar.repair
            local _,part=root()
            local occupied=repair and part==boundRoot and part and nearStation(part.Position,repair.position)
            if repair and previous and radar.meter~=previous then
                if radar.meter>previous and occupied then
                    repair.lastAdvance=radar.lastUpdate
                    repair.peak=math.max(repair.peak or radar.meter,radar.meter)
                    if repair.awaitingResume or repair.awayAt then
                        log("REPAIR_RESUMED",{station=repair.station,meter=radar.meter,
                            timeAway=repair.awayAt and radar.lastUpdate-repair.awayAt or repair.awayDuration})
                        repair.awaitingResume,repair.awayAt=nil,nil
                    end
                elseif radar.meter<previous and repair.awayAt then
                    repair.decays+=1
                end
                if not repair.lastProgressLog or radar.lastUpdate-repair.lastProgressLog>=1 then
                    repair.lastProgressLog=radar.lastUpdate
                    log("REPAIR_PROGRESS",{station=repair.station,meter=radar.meter,
                        delta=radar.meter-previous,occupied=occupied==true})
                end
            end
            if scannedCount()>oldScanned then
                radar.visits={}
                if repair and (anyScanned(repair.station) or scannedCount()>=settings.requiredStations) then
                    log("REPAIR_COMPLETED",{station=repair.station,scanned=scannedCount(),meter=radar.meter,
                        objectiveComplete=scannedCount()>=settings.requiredStations})
                    clearRepair()
                end
            end
            local key=tostring(scannedCount()).."/"..tostring(math.floor((radar.meter or 0)/10)).."/"..tostring(radar.manned)
            if key~=radar.lastStatusKey or os.clock()-(radar.lastStatusTime or 0)>7 then
                log("RADAR_STATUS",{meter=radar.meter,scanned=scannedCount(),
                    manned=radar.manned,total=radar.total})
                radar.lastStatusKey=key;radar.lastStatusTime=os.clock()
            end
        elseif k=="Stealth" then
            local wasDark=radar.dark
            radar.dark=e.State=="Dark"
            if radar.dark then dodge.releaseRadar=false end
            log("STEALTH",{state=tostring(e.State),reason=tostring(e.Reason or ""),phase=radar.phase})
            if not radar.dark then
                clearRepair()
                radar.visits,radar.scanned={},{}
                if wasDark then
                    dodge.releaseRadar=true;dodge.releaseTries=0;dodge.nextReleaseTry=os.clock()
                end
                log("RADAR_FOCUS_RELEASED",{reason="STEALTH_VISIBLE",phase=radar.phase})
            end
        elseif k=="Phase" then
            radar.phase=tonumber(e.Phase) or radar.phase
            log("PHASE",{phase=radar.phase,name=tostring(e.Name or "")})
        elseif k=="Attack" or k=="AttackLock" or k=="FinalPayload" or k=="Hazards" then
            -- V3 fix: Attack.Zones / Position MUST be scored, not just logged.
            addHazards(e,k)
        end
    end
    function mechanics:observeEnd(e)
        if type(e)~="table" or e.BossId~=config.gameBossId then return end
        T.outcome={victory=e.Victory==true,reason=tostring(e.Reason or "UNKNOWN")}
        dodge.outcomeAt=os.clock()
        clearRepair()
        pendingMove=nil
        log("B2_FIGHT_END",{victory=T.outcome.victory,reason=T.outcome.reason,
            rewardEligible=e.RewardEligible,returnDelay=e.ReturnDelay})
    end
    function mechanics:stop(ctx)
        if runningContext~=ctx then return end
        T.running,runningContext=false,nil
        local lease=movementLease
        movementLease,boundCharacter,boundRoot,pendingMove,encounterId=nil,nil,nil,nil,nil
        clearRepair()
        if lease then movement:release(lease) end
    end
    function mechanics:start(ctx, encounter)
        if runningContext==ctx then return end
        if runningContext then return end
        runningContext=ctx
        boundCharacter,boundRoot=root()
        encounterId=encounter and encounter.encounterId
        T.running=true
        ctx:deferCleanup(function()
            self:stop(ctx)
        end)
        movementLoop(ctx)
    end
    function mechanics:hazardCount()
        dangerAt(Vector3.new(0,-100000,0)) -- removes expired entries
        return #hazards
    end
    function mechanics:status()
        return {dodgeAttempts=dodge.attempts,dodgeVerified=dodge.verified,
            dodgeDetected=dodge.detected,dodgeGate=dodge.gate,
            radarMoves=radar.moves,radarVerified=radar.verified,
            radarScanned=scannedCount(),radarDark=radar.dark,
            radarGate=radar.lastGate,radarMeter=radar.meter,activeHazards=#hazards}
    end
    return mechanics
end
return MechanicsController
end
-- END MODULE boss.B2Spirit.MechanicsController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.B2Spirit.RepeatPolicy
__factories["boss.B2Spirit.RepeatPolicy"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local SharedRepeatPolicy = require("boss.shared.RepeatPolicy")
local RepeatPolicy = {}
function RepeatPolicy.new(env)
    return SharedRepeatPolicy.new(env, "Expected confirmed B2Spirit outcome")
end
return RepeatPolicy
end
-- END MODULE boss.B2Spirit.RepeatPolicy

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.B2Spirit.ReportController
__factories["boss.B2Spirit.ReportController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local DeferredOutcome = require("boss.shared.DeferredOutcome")
-- B2Spirit adaptive report: Outcome -> report (arena or hideout) -> Continue -> exit -> return.
-- Port of standalone V1; never treat Outcome alone as a completed report.
local ReportController = {}

function ReportController.new(env, config, repeatPolicy, mechanics, observer)
    local platform, gui, runtime = env.services.roblox, env.services.gui, env.runtime
    local player = platform:player()
    local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
    local writer = env.state:port("boss")
    local report = {}
    local confirmedOutcome, outcomeAt, nativeReturnAt
    local victoryEncounter, victorySession, startEncounter, lossEncounter, lossSession
    local lastHealthAt = 0
    local activePacketAt, activeCharacter
    local seenReport, firstOpenedAt = false, nil
    local listeningContext, connection, resultsController = nil, nil, nil
    local function canResume()
        local downed=player:GetAttribute("BossReviveDowned")
        return player:GetAttribute("B2Eliminated")~=true and downed~=true
            and not (type(downed)=="string" and downed~="")
            and not (env.services.revivePending and env.services.revivePending())
    end
    local function emit(name, data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit(name, data or {}) end
    end
    local function loadController()
        if resultsController then return resultsController end
        local folder = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("ClientModules")
        local mod = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("BossResultsController")
        if not mod or not mod:IsA("ModuleScript") then return nil end
        -- The build bundler replaces project requires. Invoke Roblox require only
        -- dynamically for the game's own ModuleScript, as the B21 controller does.
        local loader = getfenv(0)["require"]
        local ok, value = pcall(loader, mod)
        if not ok or type(value) ~= "table" then return nil end
        if type(value.IsOpen) ~= "function" or type(value.Dismiss) ~= "function" then return nil end
        resultsController = value
        return value
    end
    local function officialOpen()
        local ctrl = loadController()
        if ctrl and type(ctrl.IsOpen) == "function" then
            local ok, result = pcall(ctrl.IsOpen)
            if ok and result == true then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function isOpen(root)
        root = root or gui:find(env.profile.paths.bossReport)
        return player:GetAttribute("BossResultsOpen") == true or officialOpen() or (root and root.Enabled == true) or false
    end
    local function matchingReport(guiRoot)
        if not guiRoot then return nil end
        local isB2Spirit, won, lost = false, false, false
        for _, node in ipairs(guiRoot:GetDescendants()) do
            if node:IsA("TextLabel") then
                local value = string.upper(tostring(node.Text or ""))
                if value:find("B-2", 1, true) or value:find("B2 SPIRIT", 1, true)
                    or value:find("B2SPIRIT", 1, true) then isB2Spirit = true end
                if value:find("DEFEATED", 1, true) or value:find("VICTORY", 1, true) then won = true end
                if value:find("MISSION FAILED", 1, true) then lost = true end
            end
        end
        if isB2Spirit and won ~= lost then return won and "WIN" or "LOSS" end
        return nil
    end

    function report:watch(ctx)
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return false,"CANCELLED" end
        if listeningContext==ctx and connection then return true end
        if connection then
            for _,c in ipairs(connection) do c:Disconnect() end
        end
        local storage=platform:service("ReplicatedStorage")
        local folder=storage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        local begin=folder and folder:FindFirstChild("B2FightStart")
        local session=folder and folder:FindFirstChild("B2SessionUpdate")
        local finish=folder and folder:FindFirstChild("B2FightEnd")
        local health=folder and folder:FindFirstChild("B2HealthUpdate")
        if not (begin and session and finish) then return false,"B2SPIRIT_EVENT_REMOTES_MISSING" end
        local links={}
        links[#links+1]=begin.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
            if listeningContext ~= ctx then return end
            if type(e)~="table" or e.BossId~=config.gameBossId then return end
            mechanics:observeStart(e)
            local encounter=type(env.state.snapshot)=="function" and env.state:snapshot().boss.encounter
            if encounter and encounter.bossId==config.bossId and encounter.soloAttempted
                and observer:sessionMatches(e) then startEncounter=encounter.encounterId end
        end)
        links[#links+1]=session.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
            if listeningContext ~= ctx then return end
            if type(e)~="table" or not observer:sessionMatches(e) then return end
            local avatar=platform:character()
            if avatar.ready and canResume() then
                activePacketAt,activeCharacter=runtime:now(),avatar.character
                if e.State=="Active" then lossEncounter,lossSession=nil,nil end
            else activePacketAt,activeCharacter=nil,nil end
            mechanics:observeSession(e)
        end)
        links[#links+1]=finish.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
            if listeningContext ~= ctx then return end
            if type(e)~="table" or e.BossId~=config.gameBossId or type(e.Victory)~="boolean"
                or (e.SessionId~=nil and not observer:sessionMatches(e)) then return end
            mechanics:observeEnd(e)
            confirmedOutcome=e.Victory==true and "WIN" or "LOSS"
            victoryEncounter=e.Victory and observer:sessionMatches(e) and startEncounter or nil
            victorySession=victoryEncounter and e.SessionId or nil
            lossEncounter=DeferredOutcome.isDefeat(e) and observer:sessionMatches(e) and startEncounter or nil
            lossSession=lossEncounter and e.SessionId or nil
            outcomeAt=runtime:now()
            local delay=tonumber(e.ReturnDelay)
            nativeReturnAt=outcomeAt+(delay and delay>=0 and delay<math.huge and delay or 9.5)+0.7
            emit("B2SPIRIT_OUTCOME",{outcome=confirmedOutcome,reason=e.Reason,
                rewardEligible=e.RewardEligible})
        end)
        if health and health:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
            links[#links+1]=health.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
                if listeningContext ~= ctx then return end
                if type(e)~="table" or e.BossId~=config.gameBossId then return end
                if runtime:now()-lastHealthAt<8 and (tonumber(e.CurrentHP) or 1)>0 then return end
                lastHealthAt=runtime:now()
                emit("B2SPIRIT_HP",{current=e.CurrentHP,max=e.MaxHP})
            end)
        end
        connection,listeningContext=links,ctx
        ctx:deferCleanup(function()
            if connection==links then
                for _,c in ipairs(links) do c:Disconnect() end
                connection,listeningContext=nil,nil
            end
        end)
        return true
    end
    function report:cleanup()
        if connection then for _,c in ipairs(connection) do c:Disconnect() end end
        connection, listeningContext = nil, nil
        -- Keep outcome and report evidence across RETURN/REPORT retries.
    end
    function report:resetOutcome()
        victoryEncounter,victorySession,startEncounter,lossEncounter,lossSession=nil,nil,nil,nil,nil
        confirmedOutcome, outcomeAt, nativeReturnAt, seenReport, firstOpenedAt = nil, nil, nil, false, nil
        activePacketAt,activeCharacter=nil,nil
        mechanics:reset()
    end
    function report:verifiedDeferredOutcome(encounter)
        if encounter.outcome == "LOSS" then
            return lossEncounter == encounter.encounterId and lossSession == observer:sessionId()
        end
        return victoryEncounter == encounter.encounterId and victorySession == observer:sessionId()
    end
    function report:nativeEncounter()
        local id=observer:sessionId()
        if not id then return nil end
        if not canResume() then
            activePacketAt,activeCharacter=nil,nil
            return id, "PENDING"
        end
        local state=observer:state()
        if state.active==true and state.participant==true and state.inBossFight==true
            and activePacketAt
            and player.Character==activeCharacter then
            return id, "ACTIVE", activePacketAt
        end
        return id, "PENDING"
    end
    function report:inspect()
        local root = gui:find(env.profile.paths.bossReport)
        local active = isOpen(root)
        local guiOutcome = active and matchingReport(root) or nil
        if active and (confirmedOutcome or guiOutcome) then
            seenReport = true
            firstOpenedAt = firstOpenedAt or runtime:now()
        end
        local outcome = confirmedOutcome or guiOutcome
        return {
            active = active, matchesBoss = confirmedOutcome ~= nil or guiOutcome ~= nil,
            outcome = outcome, report = root, seen = seenReport,
            pendingPresentation = confirmedOutcome ~= nil and not seenReport
                and outcomeAt ~= nil and runtime:now() - outcomeAt < config.reportTimeoutSeconds,
        }
    end
    function report:verifyClosed()
        return not isOpen()
    end
    function report:nativeReturnSettled()
        return not nativeReturnAt or runtime:now() >= nativeReturnAt
    end
    function report:reconcile(encounter)
        local evidence = self:inspect()
        if evidence.matchesBoss and evidence.outcome
            and (not encounter.outcome or encounter.outcome == evidence.outcome) then return true end
        return encounter.outcome ~= nil and seenReport and not evidence.active
    end
    function report:resolve(ctx, encounter)
        local watching, why = self:watch(ctx)
        if not watching then return {ok = false, code = why} end
        -- V2 REQUIREMENT: Outcome alone never authorizes return/Continue.
        local evidence = ctx:await(function()
            local current = self:inspect()
            if current.active and current.matchesBoss and current.outcome then return current end
            if seenReport and not current.active and (encounter.outcome or current.outcome) then
                return current -- manually dismissed report after previously observing it
            end
        end, config.reportTimeoutSeconds)
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        if not evidence then return {ok = false, code = "B2SPIRIT_REPORT_NOT_OBSERVED"} end
        if evidence.outcome and encounter.outcome and evidence.outcome ~= encounter.outcome then
            return {ok = false, held = true, code = "BOSS_OUTCOME_CONFLICT"}
        end
        local outcome = evidence.outcome or encounter.outcome
        if not outcome then return {ok = false, code = "B2SPIRIT_OUTCOME_UNVERIFIED"} end
        if not encounter.outcome then
            local accepted = writer:recordBossReport(outcome,
                runtime:epoch() + repeatPolicy:outcomeDelay(outcome))
            if not accepted then return {ok = false, held = true, code = "BOSS_OUTCOME_CONFLICT"} end
            encounter = env.state:snapshot().boss.encounter
        end
        if not evidence.active then
            writer:closeReport()
            return {ok = true, code = "B2SPIRIT_REPORT_MANUALLY_CLOSED"}
        end
        local at = platform:position()
        local place = player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") == true and "HIDEOUT" or "OTHER"
        if place == "OTHER" and at then
            if observer:inArenaPosition(at) then place = "ARENA" end
        end
        emit("B2SPIRIT_REPORT_OPEN", {outcome = outcome, location = place,
            inBossFight = player:GetAttribute("InBossFight")})
        local controller = loadController()
        if not controller then return {ok = false, code = "B2SPIRIT_RESULT_CONTROLLER_MISSING_MANUAL_CONTINUE"} end
        if not encounter.continueAttempted then
            local ready = ctx:await(function()
                if not isOpen() then return "MANUALLY_CLOSED" end
                local armed = false
                if type(controller.Debug) == "function" then
                    local ok, message = pcall(controller.Debug)
                    armed = ok and type(message) == "string"
                        and message:find("armed=true", 1, true) ~= nil
                end
                if armed and firstOpenedAt
                    and runtime:now() - firstOpenedAt >= config.reportHoldSeconds then return "ARMED" end
            end, config.reportTimeoutSeconds)
            if ctx:isCancelled() then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
            if ready == "MANUALLY_CLOSED" then
                writer:closeReport()
                return {ok = true, code = "B2SPIRIT_REPORT_MANUALLY_CLOSED"}
            end
            if ready ~= "ARMED" then return {ok = false, code = "B2SPIRIT_REPORT_NOT_ARMED_MANUAL_CONTINUE"} end
            if not writer:markContinueAttempt() then return {ok = false, code = "B2SPIRIT_CONTINUE_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED"} end
            local sent, err = pcall(function() controller.Dismiss("continue") end)
            if not sent then return {ok = false, code = "B2SPIRIT_CONTINUE_FAILED: " .. tostring(err)} end
            emit("B2SPIRIT_REPORT_CONTINUE", {code = "CONTINUE_REQUESTED"})
        end
        local closed = ctx:await(function() if not self:inspect().active then return true end end,
            config.reportCloseTimeoutSeconds)
        if not closed then return {ok = false, code = "B2SPIRIT_REPORT_STILL_OPEN_MANUAL_CONTINUE"} end
        writer:closeReport()
        return {ok = true, code = "B2SPIRIT_REPORT_CLOSED"}
    end
    return report
end
return ReportController
end
-- END MODULE boss.B2Spirit.ReportController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.B52.ArenaObserver
__factories["boss.B52.ArenaObserver"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local ArenaObserver = {}
function ArenaObserver.new(env, config)
    local platform = env.services.roblox
    local player, workspace = platform:player(), platform:workspace()
    local observer = {}
    function observer:participating() return player:GetAttribute("B52Participant") == true end
    function observer:inArenaPosition(pos)
        pos = pos or platform:position()
        if typeof(pos) ~= "Vector3" then return false end
        local dx, dz = pos.X - config.arenaCenter.x, pos.Z - config.arenaCenter.z
        return dx*dx + dz*dz < (config.arenaRadius + 25)^2
            and pos.Y > config.arenaMinY and pos.Y < config.arenaMaxY
    end
    function observer:inArena()
        return self:participating() or
            (workspace:GetAttribute("B52FightActive") == true
                and player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true and self:inArenaPosition())
    end
    function observer:state()
        return {phase=workspace:GetAttribute("B52Phase"),
            fightState=workspace:GetAttribute("B52FightState"),
            active=workspace:GetAttribute("B52FightActive"),
            participant=player:GetAttribute("B52Participant"),
            inBossFight=player:GetAttribute("InBossFight")}
    end
    return observer
end
return ArenaObserver
end
-- END MODULE boss.B52.ArenaObserver

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.B52.B52
__factories["boss.B52.B52"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local Config = require("boss.B52.Config")
local ArenaObserver = require("boss.B52.ArenaObserver")
local CommandController = require("boss.B52.CommandController")
local CombatController = require("boss.B52.CombatController")
local RepairController = require("boss.B52.RepairController")
local ReportController = require("boss.B52.ReportController")
local RepeatPolicy = require("boss.B52.RepeatPolicy")
local B52 = {}
function B52.definition()
    return {bossId=Config.bossId,displayName=Config.displayName,create=function(env)
        local observer = ArenaObserver.new(env, Config)
        local repair = RepairController.new(env, Config, observer)
        local repeatPolicy = RepeatPolicy.new(env)
        local report = ReportController.new(env, Config, repeatPolicy, repair)
        return {config=Config, observer=observer, repair=repair, report=report,
            repeatPolicy=repeatPolicy,
            command=CommandController.new(env, Config, observer, report),
            combat=CombatController.new(env, Config, observer, report, repair)}
    end}
end
return B52
end
-- END MODULE boss.B52.B52

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.B52.CombatController
__factories["boss.B52.CombatController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local CombatController = {}
function CombatController.new(env, config, observer, report, repair)
    local runtime, telemetry = env.runtime, env.services.telemetry
    local combat = {}
    function combat:nativeEncounter() return report:nativeEncounter() end
    function combat:ownedNativeGeneration() return report:ownedNativeGeneration() end
    local function emit(name, data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit("B52_" .. name, data or {}) end
    end
    function combat:run(ctx, encounter)
        local watching, why = report:watch(ctx)
        if not watching then return {code = why} end
        repair:start(ctx)
        local deadline = runtime:now() + config.maxFightSeconds
        local previous, lastLog = nil, 0
        local code = "OUTCOME_NOT_OBSERVED_TIMEOUT"
        while not ctx:isCancelled() and runtime:now() < deadline do
            if report:inspect().outcome then code = "OUTCOME_OBSERVED"; break end
            local state = observer:state()
            local key = tostring(state.fightState) .. "/" .. tostring(state.phase) .. "/"
                .. tostring(state.active) .. "/" .. tostring(state.participant)
            if key ~= previous or runtime:now() - lastLog > 25 then
                emit("STATE", state); previous, lastLog = key, runtime:now()
            end
            if not ctx:wait(0.4) then break end
        end
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return {code = "CANCELLED"} end
        emit("ESCORT_SUMMARY", repair:status())
        return {code = code}
    end
    return combat
end
return CombatController
end
-- END MODULE boss.B52.CombatController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.B52.CommandController
__factories["boss.B52.CommandController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- B52 standalone V1 flow: Hideout -> Boss Command pass -> ONE Solo -> combat.
-- Adaptive report may open in arena OR after exit; never request return before Continue.
local DirectBossTravel = require("main.navigation.DirectBossTravel")
local NativeBossEntry = require("boss.shared.NativeBossEntry")
local CommandController = {}

function CommandController.new(env, config, observer, report)
    local platform, runtime = env.services.roblox, env.runtime
    local player, workspace = platform:player(), platform:workspace()
    local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
    local travel = DirectBossTravel.new(env)
    local command = {reconcileSameWorldReturn = true}
    local function emit(name, data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit(name, data or {}) end
    end
    local function remote(name)
        local storage = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage")
        local folder = storage:FindFirstChild("Remotes") or storage:WaitForChild("Remotes", 10)
        local item = folder and (folder:FindFirstChild(name) or folder:WaitForChild(name, 7))
        return item and item:IsA("RemoteEvent") and item or nil
    end
    local function active(ctx) return runtime:isActive(ctx) and not ctx:isCancelled() end
    local function cooldownLeft()
        local raw = player:GetAttribute("BossStartCooldowns")
        if type(raw) ~= "string" or raw == "" then return 0 end
        local ok, data = pcall(function() return platform:service("HttpService"):JSONDecode(raw) end)
        if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then return 0 end
        return math.max(0, (tonumber(data[config.gameBossKey]) or 0) - workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
    end

    function command:prepare(ctx)
        if observer:inArena() then return true, "B52_ALREADY_IN_ARENA" end
        if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true then return false, "OTHER_BOSS_ACTIVE" end
        if not active(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        -- V3: wait for B52 cooldown BEFORE issuing Boss Command requests.
        local left = cooldownLeft()
        if left > 0 and config.waitForCooldown then
            if left > config.maxCooldownWaitSeconds then
                emit("B52_COOLDOWN_GATE", {remaining = math.ceil(left), code = "WAIT_LIMIT"})
                return false, "B52_COOLDOWN_ABOVE_WAIT_LIMIT"
            end
            emit("B52_COOLDOWN_WAIT", {remaining = math.ceil(left)})
            local untilTime = runtime:now() + config.maxCooldownWaitSeconds
            local lastTick = runtime:now()
            while active(ctx) and cooldownLeft() > 0 and runtime:now() < untilTime do
                if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true then
                    return false, "OTHER_ENCOUNTER_BECAME_ACTIVE"
                end
                if runtime:now() - lastTick >= 25 then
                    lastTick = runtime:now()
                    emit("B52_COOLDOWN_WAITING", {remaining = math.ceil(cooldownLeft())})
                end
                if not ctx:wait(math.min(3, math.max(0.5, cooldownLeft()))) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
            end
            if not active(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
            if cooldownLeft() > 0 then return false, "B52_COOLDOWN_WAIT_LIMIT_REACHED" end
            emit("B52_COOLDOWN_READY", {remaining = 0})
        end
        local entered = travel:enterHideout(ctx)
        emit("B52_DIRECT_HIDEOUT", {ok = entered.ok, code = entered.code, reason = entered.reason})
        if not entered.ok then return false, entered.code end
        local positioned = travel:moveToKnownPoint(ctx, config.commandSafePosition, {
            requireHideout = true, radius = 6, settle = 0.85,
        })
        emit("B52_COMMAND_POSITION", {ok = positioned.ok, code = positioned.code})
        if not positioned.ok then return false, positioned.code end
        return true, "B52_COMMAND_READY"
    end

    function command:readiness()
        if observer:inArena() then return "READY" end
        if not travel:inHideout() then return "UNKNOWN" end
        local secs = cooldownLeft()
        if secs > 0 then
            secs = math.ceil(secs)
            return string.format("%d:%02d", math.floor(secs / 60), secs % 60)
        end
        -- The server pass remains authoritative for unlock/eligibility.
        return "READY"
    end

    local entry = NativeBossEntry.new(env, config, observer, report, "B52CommanderAccept", remote)
    function command:entryStatus() return entry:status() end
    function command:combatStarted() report.entry:combatStarted() end

    function command:startSolo(ctx, markAttempt)
        if not active(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        if observer:participating() then return false, "BOSS_ENTRY_PREEXISTING_PARTICIPATION" end
        if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true then return false, "OTHER_BOSS_ACTIVE" end
        if not travel:inHideout() then return false, "NOT_IN_HIDEOUT" end
        if self:readiness() ~= "READY" then return false, "B52_NOT_READY" end
        local watching, why = report:watch(ctx)
        if not watching then return false, why end
        return entry:start(ctx, markAttempt)
    end

    function command:close(_) return true end -- No command GUI was opened.

    function command:returnHome(ctx, home)
        if not active(ctx) then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        if type(home) ~= "number" or home < 1 or home % 1 ~= 0 then
            return {ok = false, code = "INVALID_HOME_WORLD"}
        end
        if report:inspect().active then return {ok = false, code = "B52_REPORT_STILL_OPEN"} end
        -- Preserve standalone V1 lock checks before return, regardless of report location.
        local released = ctx:await(function()
            if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true
                and player:GetAttribute("B52Participant") ~= true then return true end
        end, config.returnLockTimeoutSeconds)
        if not released then
            emit("B52_RETURN_LOCK_PENDING", {world = home})
            return {ok = false, code = "B52_RETURN_LOCK_PENDING", reason = "BossFight"}
        end
        local exit = ctx:await(function()
            if player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") == true then return "BOSS_COMMAND_HIDEOUT" end
            if not observer:inArenaPosition() then return "OUTSIDE_ARENA" end
        end, config.exitTimeoutSeconds)
        emit("B52_ARENA_EXIT", {code = exit or "LOCK_RELEASED_STILL_IN_ARENA"})
        -- As in tested standalone V1, a released lock permits a direct verified travel even
        -- if the game has not repositioned the player outside the arena yet.
        if not ctx:wait(1.5) then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        local request, prepare, result = remote("RequestWorldTravel"), remote("NavPrepareWorlds"), remote("WorldTravelResult")
        if not request or not prepare then return {ok = false, code = "B52_WORLD_TRAVEL_REMOTES_MISSING"} end
        local position = platform:position()
        if not position then return {ok = false, code = "CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE"} end
        if tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")) == home
            and player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") ~= true
            and not observer:inArenaPosition() then
            return {ok = true, code = "ALREADY_IN_HOME", world = home}
        end
        local reply
        local connection = result and result.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
            if type(e) == "table" and e.Kind == "Result" and tonumber(e.WorldId) == home then reply = e end
        end) or nil
        local function finish(ok, code, reason)
            if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
            emit("B52_DIRECT_RETURN", {ok = ok, code = code, reason = reason, world = home})
            return {ok = ok, code = code, reason = reason, world = home}
        end
        for attempt = 1, config.returnRetries do
            if not active(ctx) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            reply = nil
            local prior = platform:position()
            if not prior then return finish(false, "CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE") end
            local sent, err = pcall(function() prepare:FireServer("stream", home) end)
            if not sent then return finish(false, "WORLD_PREPARE_SEND_FAILED", tostring(err)) end
            if not ctx:wait(0.12) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            sent, err = pcall(function() request:FireServer(home) end)
            if not sent then return finish(false, "WORLD_REQUEST_SEND_FAILED", tostring(err)) end
            local observed = ctx:await(function()
                if reply and reply.Ok == false then return "REJECTED" end
                local current = platform:position()
                if current and platform:distance(current, prior) > 50
                    and tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")) == home
                    and player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") ~= true
                    and player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true
                    and not observer:inArenaPosition() then return "VERIFIED" end
            end, 17)
            emit("B52_RETURN_ATTEMPT", {attempt = attempt, code = observed or "AMBIGUOUS",
                reason = reply and reply.Reason})
            if observed == "VERIFIED" then return finish(true, "B52_HOME_VERIFIED") end
            if observed ~= "REJECTED" then return finish(false, "B52_RETURN_AMBIGUOUS_NO_RETRY") end
            local why = tostring(reply.Reason or "UNKNOWN")
            if why ~= "BossFight" or attempt == config.returnRetries then
                return finish(false, "B52_WORLD_RETURN_REJECTED", why)
            end
            if not ctx:wait(12) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            local settled = ctx:await(function()
                if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true then return true end
            end, 40)
            if not settled then return finish(false, "B52_LOCK_STILL_ACTIVE", "BossFight") end
        end
        return finish(false, "B52_WORLD_RETURN_EXHAUSTED")
    end
    return command
end
return CommandController
end
-- END MODULE boss.B52.CommandController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.B52.Config

--!nonstrict

return {
    bossId = "B52", displayName = "B-52 Stratofortress", gameBossKey = "B52",
    arenaCenter = {x = 4096, y = 2600, z = 32768}, arenaRadius = 260,
    arenaMinY = 2400, arenaMaxY = 3100,
    commandSafePosition = {x = -31962.1074, y = 344.357483, z = 32887.3203},
    arenaTimeout = 48, maxFightSeconds = 570,
    reportTimeoutSeconds = 120, reportHoldSeconds = 3,
    reportCloseTimeoutSeconds = 125, exitTimeoutSeconds = 110,

    waitForCooldown = true, maxCooldownWaitSeconds = 720,
