-- BEGIN MODULE boss.B52.RepairController
__factories["boss.B52.RepairController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Port of tested B52 Standalone V3 repair/brace mechanics (V2 runtime site fix).
-- Event observation starts BEFORE Solo; the action loop starts only during combat.
local RepairController = {}
function RepairController.new(env, config, observer)
    local platform, runtime = env.services.roblox, env.runtime
    local player, workspace = platform:player(), platform:workspace()
    local Http = platform:service("HttpService")
    local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
    local riftHazards = env.services.riftHazards
    local ReplicatedStorage = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage")
    local controller = {}
    local activeContext = nil
    local ended = false
    local integrity = {value = nil, max = 1000, phase = nil, endsAt = nil}
    local incidents = {}
    local repair = {}
    local wrapper, activeWrapperName, cachedWrapperName = nil, nil, nil
    local lastFindAt = -math.huge
    local priority = {Fire = 100, Electrical = 85, Fuselage = 70, Wing = 55}
    local braceRetryInterval, braceMaxAttempts, braceWindow = 0.85, 2, 1.5

    local function emit(kind, data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit("B52_" .. kind, data or {}) end
    end
    local function resetCounters()
        repair = {active = nil, lastPrompt = -math.huge, lastMove = -math.huge,
            lastTarget = nil, lastGate = nil, lastGateAt = -math.huge,
            lastIncidentPoll = -math.huge, lastSiteDiagAt = -math.huge,
            requests = 0, progressed = 0, resolved = 0, opens = 0,
            blocked = {}}
    end
    local function incidentCount()
        local count = 0
        for _ in pairs(incidents) do count += 1 end
        return count
    end
    function controller:reset()
        -- Do not reset the running battle's progress on reattachment.
        if activeContext and not activeContext:isCancelled() then return end
        ended, incidents = false, {}
        wrapper, activeWrapperName, cachedWrapperName = nil, nil, nil
        lastFindAt = -math.huge
        integrity = {value = nil, max = 1000, phase = nil, endsAt = nil}
        resetCounters()
    end
    resetCounters()
    function controller:status()
        return {integrity = integrity.value, maxIntegrity = integrity.max,
            phase = integrity.phase, endsAt = integrity.endsAt,
            repairsOpened = repair.opens, stepsSent = repair.requests,
            serverProgress = repair.progressed, incidentsResolved = repair.resolved,
            remaining = incidentCount(), activeSite = repair.active and repair.active.site,
            lastGate = repair.lastGate, lastTarget = repair.lastTarget,
            autoRepair = config.autoRepair, autoBrace = config.autoBrace}
    end
    local function gate(reason, details)
        local now = runtime:now()
        if repair.lastGate == reason and now - repair.lastGateAt < 5 then return end
        repair.lastGate, repair.lastGateAt = reason, now
        local row = details or {}
        row.reason = reason
        emit("REPAIR_GATE", row)
    end
    local function updateIncidents(list, source)
        if type(list) ~= "table" then return end
        local new = {}
        for _, inc in ipairs(list) do
            if type(inc) == "table" and inc.Id ~= nil and type(inc.Site) == "string" then
                new[tostring(inc.Id)] = inc
            end
        end
        local added, removed = 0, 0
        for id in pairs(new) do if not incidents[id] then added += 1 end end
        for id in pairs(incidents) do if not new[id] then removed += 1 end end
        incidents = new
        if added > 0 or removed > 0 then
            emit("INCIDENTS", {source = source, active = incidentCount(), added = added, removed = removed})
        end
    end
    local function bestIncident()
        local pick, score = nil, nil
        for id, inc in pairs(incidents) do
            if not repair.blocked[id] or runtime:now() > repair.blocked[id] then
                local rank = priority[tostring(inc.Kind)] or 20
                if not score or rank > score then pick, score = inc, rank end
            end
        end
        return pick
    end
    local function siteFromWrapper(candidate, site)
        if not candidate then return nil end
        local sites = candidate:FindFirstChild("Sites") or candidate:FindFirstChild("Sites", true)
        local anchor = sites and sites:FindFirstChild(site)
        if not anchor then return nil end
        if anchor:IsA("BasePart") or anchor:IsA("Attachment") or anchor:IsA("Model") then
            return anchor
        end
        if anchor:IsA("Folder") then
            local part = anchor:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
            if part then return part end
            for _, desc in ipairs(anchor:GetDescendants()) do
                if desc:IsA("Attachment") then return desc end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function siteAnchor(site)
        if type(site) ~= "string" or site == "" then return nil end
        if wrapper and wrapper.Parent then
            local anchor = siteFromWrapper(wrapper, site)
            if anchor then return anchor end
        end
        local now = runtime:now()
        if now - lastFindAt < 0.7 then return nil end
        lastFindAt = now
        local scenes = workspace:FindFirstChild("RuntimeScenes")
        if scenes then
            if type(activeWrapperName) == "string" then
                local active = scenes:FindFirstChild(activeWrapperName)
                local anchor = siteFromWrapper(active, site)
                if anchor then
                    wrapper, cachedWrapperName = active, active.Name
                    return anchor
                end
            end
            for _, child in ipairs(scenes:GetChildren()) do
                if child.Name:find("B52") or child:FindFirstChild("Sites") then
                    local anchor = siteFromWrapper(child, site)
                    if anchor then
                        wrapper, cachedWrapperName = child, child.Name
                        return anchor
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        local exact = workspace:FindFirstChild("B52Escort", true)
        local anchor = siteFromWrapper(exact, site)
        if anchor then
            wrapper, cachedWrapperName = exact, exact.Name
            return anchor
        end
        if now - repair.lastSiteDiagAt > 6 then
            repair.lastSiteDiagAt = now
            local names = {}
            if scenes then
                for _, child in ipairs(scenes:GetChildren()) do
                    if #names < 12 then table.insert(names, child.Name) end
                end
            end
            emit("REPAIR_SITE_SCAN", {requested = site, runtimeScenes = scenes ~= nil,
                wrappers = names, cachedWrapper = cachedWrapperName, sessionWrapper = activeWrapperName})
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function anchorPosition(anchor)
        if not anchor then return nil end
        if anchor:IsA("Attachment") then return anchor.WorldPosition end
        if anchor:IsA("BasePart") then return anchor.Position end
        if anchor:IsA("Model") then
            local prompt = anchor:FindFirstChild("B52Repair", true)
            if prompt and prompt.Parent then
                local host = prompt.Parent
                if host:IsA("Attachment") then return host.WorldPosition end
                if host:IsA("BasePart") then return host.Position end
            end
            return anchor:GetPivot().Position
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function root()
        local char = player.Character
        return char, char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    end
    local function inArena(pos)
        return observer:inArenaPosition(pos)
    end
    local function pollIncidentAttribute()
        if incidentCount() ~= 0 or not observer:participating() then return end
        if runtime:now() - repair.lastIncidentPoll < 1.5 then return end
        repair.lastIncidentPoll = runtime:now()
        local raw = player:GetAttribute("B52Incidents")
        if raw == nil then raw = workspace:GetAttribute("B52Incidents") end
        if type(raw) ~= "string" or raw == "" then return end
        local ok, decoded = pcall(function() return Http:JSONDecode(raw) end)
        if ok and type(decoded) == "table" and #decoded > 0 then
            updateIncidents(decoded, "ATTRIBUTE_RECOVERY")
        end
    end
    local function triggerPrompt(prompt)
        local ctx = activeContext
        local character = player.Character
        local interaction = env.services.interaction
        if interaction then
            local sent = interaction:prompt(prompt, {
                allowLegacyFallback = false,
                wait = function(seconds) return ctx:wait(seconds) end,
                valid = function()
                    if activeContext ~= ctx or ctx:isCancelled() or ctx:isClosing()
                        or not runtime:isActive(ctx) or player.Character ~= character then return false, "CANCELLED" end
                    if not platform:character().ready then return false, "CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE" end
                    if not observer:participating() or not prompt.Parent or not prompt.Enabled then
                        return false,"PROMPT_INACTIVE" end
                    local _,part = root()
                    local anchor=prompt.Parent
                    local pos=anchor and anchor:IsA("Attachment") and anchor.WorldPosition
                        or anchor and anchor:IsA("BasePart") and anchor.Position
                    if not pos then
                        local ancestor=prompt:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BasePart")
                        if ancestor then pos=ancestor.Position end
                    end
                    if not pos and anchor and anchor:IsA("Model") then
                        pos=anchor:GetPivot().Position
                    end
                    if not part or not pos or (part.Position-pos).Magnitude>prompt.MaxActivationDistance then
                        return false,"PROMPT_OUT_OF_RANGE" end
                    return true
                end,
            })
            emit("DIRECT_PROMPT", {ok=sent.ok,code=sent.code,method=sent.method})
            if sent.ok then return true end
            if sent.code~="DIRECT_PROMPT_CAPABILITY_MISSING" then
                return false,sent.code end
        end
        local f=platform:capability("firePrompt")
        if type(f)=="function" then return pcall(function() f(prompt) end) end
        return pcall(function()
            prompt:InputHoldBegin()
            task.wait(math.max(.12,prompt.HoldDuration)+.12)
            prompt:InputHoldEnd()
        end)
    end
    local function watchBrace(ctx, owner)
        if activeContext ~= ctx or not runtime:isActive(ctx) or ctx:isCancelled() or ctx:isClosing() then return end
        local input = env.services.input
        local challenge
        local function finish(reason)
            if not challenge then return end
            emit("BRACE_OUTCOME", {jobId = ctx.jobId, reason = reason, attempts = challenge.attempts})
            challenge = nil
        end
        ctx:deferCleanup(function() finish("JOB_CLOSED") end)
        while activeContext == ctx and runtime:isActive(ctx) and not ctx:isCancelled() and not ctx:isClosing() do
            if ended then finish("ENCOUNTER_ENDED"); break end
            local avatar = platform:character()
            if not avatar.ready or avatar.character ~= owner.character or avatar.humanoid ~= owner.humanoid then
                finish("CHARACTER_CHANGED")
                break
            end
            local gui = platform:playerGui()
            local braceGui = gui and gui:FindFirstChild("B52Brace")
            local root = braceGui and braceGui:FindFirstChild("Root")
            local title = root and root:FindFirstChild("Title")
            local state = braceGui and braceGui.Enabled and title and title.Text
            if not observer:participating() then
                if challenge then finish("PARTICIPATION_LOST"); break end
            elseif challenge and (braceGui ~= challenge.gui or state ~= "BRACE!") then
                local same = braceGui == challenge.gui
                finish(same and state == "STEADY" and "COMPLETED"
                    or same and state == "THROWN!" and "FAILED" or "OUTCOME_UNOBSERVED")
            elseif state == "BRACE!" then
                local now = runtime:now()
                if not challenge then
                    local available = type(input.canBraceB52) == "function" and input:canBraceB52()
                    challenge = {gui = braceGui, attempts = 0, retryAt = now,
                        deadline = now + braceWindow, available = available}
                    emit("BRACE_DETECTED", {jobId = ctx.jobId, available = available})
                end
                if now >= challenge.deadline then
                    if not challenge.expired then
                        challenge.expired = true
                        emit("BRACE_UNVERIFIED", {jobId = ctx.jobId, reason = "NO_NATIVE_OUTCOME",
                            attempts = challenge.attempts})
                    end
                elseif challenge.available and challenge.attempts < braceMaxAttempts and now >= challenge.retryAt then
                    challenge.attempts += 1
                    challenge.retryAt = now + braceRetryInterval
                    local attempt = challenge.attempts
                    local sent = input:dispatch(ctx, {kind = "B52_BRACE", target = braceGui,
                        character = owner.character, humanoid = owner.humanoid})
                    emit("BRACE_INPUT", {jobId = ctx.jobId, attempt = attempt, ok = sent.ok,
                        dispatched = sent.dispatched, reason = sent.code,
                        method = sent.diagnostics and sent.diagnostics.method})
                end
            end
            if not ctx:wait(0.2) then break end
        end
        finish("JOB_ENDED")
    end
    local function repairTick(ctx, remote)
        if activeContext ~= ctx or ctx:isCancelled() or ctx:isClosing() or ended then return end
        pollIncidentAttribute()
        if not config.autoRepair then gate("DISABLED"); return end
        if not observer:participating() then gate("NOT_PARTICIPATING"); return end
        if workspace:GetAttribute("B52FightState") ~= "Active" then
            gate("WAIT_ACTIVE", {state=workspace:GetAttribute("B52FightState"),
                inBossFight=player:GetAttribute("InBossFight")})
            return
        end
        if repair.active then
            local active = repair.active
            local inc = incidents[active.id]
            local anchor = inc and siteAnchor(inc.Site)
            local _, part = root()
            if not inc then
                repair.active = nil
            elseif not anchor or not part or not anchorPosition(anchor) then
                gate("REPAIR_SESSION_SITE_LOST", {site=active.site})
                repair.active = nil
            elseif (part.Position - anchorPosition(anchor)).Magnitude > 15 then
                -- Turbulence can shift the player; the movement branch will navigate again.
                gate("REPAIR_SESSION_OUT_OF_REACH", {site=active.site})
                repair.active = nil
            elseif active.progress >= active.steps then
                gate("REPAIR_WAIT_RESOLVED", {site=active.site, progress=active.progress})
            elseif active.sent >= config.repairMaxRequests then
                repair.blocked[active.id] = runtime:now() + 15
                gate("REPAIR_REQUEST_LIMIT", {site=active.site, sent=active.sent})
                repair.active = nil
            elseif not active.lastSentAt and runtime:now() - active.openedAt < 0.72 then
                -- Server OpenLock after a RepairOpen event.
            elseif active.lastSentAt and runtime:now() - active.lastSentAt < config.repairStepInterval then
            elseif active.awaiting and runtime:now() - active.lastSentAt < 2 then
            elseif active.awaiting and active.noAck >= 2 then
                repair.blocked[active.id] = runtime:now() + 18
                gate("REPAIR_PROGRESS_TIMEOUT", {site=active.site, sent=active.sent})
                repair.active = nil
            elseif not remote then
                gate("STEP_REMOTE_MISSING")
            else
                if active.awaiting then active.noAck += 1 end
                active.lastSentAt = runtime:now()
                active.awaiting = true
                active.sent += 1
                repair.requests += 1
                local ok, why = pcall(function() remote:FireServer(inc.Id) end)
                emit("REPAIR_STEP", {id=active.id, site=active.site,
                    request=active.sent, progress=active.progress, ok=ok,
                    error=not ok and tostring(why) or nil})
            end
        else
            local inc = bestIncident()
            if not inc then
                gate("NO_INCIDENT")
                -- One serial movement writer: only the repair owner may trigger
                -- Rift evasion when there is no active native maintenance.
                if riftHazards and type(riftHazards.step)=="function" then
                    local ok,err=pcall(riftHazards.step,riftHazards,ctx,"B52_IDLE")
                    if not ok then emit("RIFT_IDLE_DODGE_ERROR",{error=tostring(err)}) end
                end
                return
            end
            local anchor = siteAnchor(inc.Site)
            local character, part = root()
            if not anchor then
                gate("SITE_NOT_FOUND", {site=inc.Site, id=inc.Id,
                    expectedScenes="workspace.RuntimeScenes"})
                return
            end
            if not character or not part then gate("CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE"); return end
            local pos = anchorPosition(anchor)
            if not pos then
                gate("SITE_POSITION_MISSING", {site=inc.Site, class=anchor.ClassName})
                return
            end
            local distance = (part.Position - pos).Magnitude
            if not inArena(pos) then
                gate("SITE_OUTSIDE_B52_ARENA", {site=inc.Site,
                    x=math.floor(pos.X), y=math.floor(pos.Y), z=math.floor(pos.Z)})
            elseif distance > config.repairMaxTeleportDistance then
                gate("SITE_TOO_FAR", {site=inc.Site, distance=math.floor(distance),
                    limit=config.repairMaxTeleportDistance})
            elseif distance > 10 and runtime:now() - repair.lastMove >= config.repairMoveInterval then
                repair.lastMove = runtime:now()
                local target = pos + Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0)
                repair.lastTarget = {site=inc.Site, x=target.X, y=target.Y, z=target.Z}
                emit("REPAIR_MOVE_ATTEMPT", {site=inc.Site, id=inc.Id,
                    fromDistance=math.floor(distance), anchorClass=anchor.ClassName,
                    wrapper=cachedWrapperName})
                local ok, why = pcall(function() character:PivotTo(CFrame.new(target)) end)
                task.wait(0.18)
                local _, after = root()
                local remaining = after and (after.Position - pos).Magnitude or math.huge
                emit("REPAIR_MOVE", {site=inc.Site, id=inc.Id,
                    fromDistance=math.floor(distance), ok=ok,
                    verified=remaining<=14, remaining=after and math.floor(remaining) or -1,
                    error=not ok and tostring(why) or nil})
            elseif distance <= 13 and runtime:now() - repair.lastPrompt >= 2.4 then
                local prompt = anchor:FindFirstChild("B52Repair", true)
                if prompt and prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and prompt.Enabled then
                    repair.lastPrompt = runtime:now()
                    local ok, why = triggerPrompt(prompt)
                    emit("REPAIR_PROMPT", {site=inc.Site, id=inc.Id,
                        ok=ok, reason=not ok and tostring(why) or nil})
                else
                    gate("PROMPT_NOT_AVAILABLE", {site=inc.Site, id=inc.Id,
                        anchorClass=anchor.ClassName, hasPrompt=prompt ~= nil})
                end
            end
        end
    end
    function controller:observe(e)
        if type(e) ~= "table" or type(e.K) ~= "string" then return end
        local k = e.K
        if (k == "Start" or k == "Session") and type(e.Wrapper) == "string" then
            activeWrapperName = e.Wrapper
            emit("REPAIR_RUNTIME", {wrapper=activeWrapperName, source=k})
        end
        if k == "End" or k == "Death" then ended = true end
        if k == "Session" or k == "Integrity" then
            local val = tonumber(e.I or e.Integrity)
            if val then integrity.value = val end
            if tonumber(e.Max) then integrity.max = tonumber(e.Max) end
            if tonumber(e.Phase) then integrity.phase = tonumber(e.Phase) end
            if type(e.Incidents) == "table" then updateIncidents(e.Incidents, k) end
            if tonumber(e.TimeLeft) then integrity.endsAt = workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + e.TimeLeft end
        end
        if k == "Incidents" then updateIncidents(e.List, k) end
        if k == "IncidentResolved" then
            local id = tostring(e.Id or "UNKNOWN")
            incidents[id] = nil
            if e.Reason == "Repaired" then repair.resolved += 1 end
            emit("INCIDENT_RESOLVED", {id=id, reason=e.Reason, by=e.By,
                remaining=incidentCount()})
            if repair.active and repair.active.id == id then repair.active = nil end
        end
        if k == "Phase" then integrity.phase = tonumber(e.Phase) or integrity.phase end
        if k == "RepairOpen" and e.Id ~= nil then
            repair.opens += 1
            repair.active = {id=tostring(e.Id), site=e.Site, kind=e.Kind,
                progress=tonumber(e.Progress) or 0, steps=tonumber(e.Steps) or 3,
                sent=0, noAck=0, awaiting=false, lastSentAt=nil,
                openedAt=runtime:now()}
            emit("REPAIR_OPEN", {id=e.Id, site=e.Site, kind=e.Kind,
                steps=repair.active.steps, progress=repair.active.progress})
        elseif k == "RepairProgress" then
            local active = repair.active
            if active and tostring(e.Id) == active.id then
                local incoming = tonumber(e.Progress)
                if incoming and incoming > active.progress then
                    repair.progressed += incoming - active.progress
                    active.noAck = 0
                    active.awaiting = false
                end
                active.progress = incoming or active.progress
                active.steps = tonumber(e.Steps) or active.steps
            end
            emit("REPAIR_PROGRESS", {id=e.Id, site=e.Site,
                progress=e.Progress, steps=e.Steps})
        elseif k == "RepairClosed" then
            emit("REPAIR_CLOSED", {id=e.Id, reason=e.Reason})
            if repair.active and tostring(e.Id) == repair.active.id then repair.active = nil end
        end
    end
    function controller:start(ctx)
        if activeContext == ctx then return end
        activeContext = ctx
        local folder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        local remote = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("B52RepairStep")
        if not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
            emit("REPAIR_WARNING", {reason="REPAIR_STEP_REMOTE_MISSING"})
            remote = nil
        end
        ctx:deferCleanup(function()
            if activeContext == ctx then activeContext = nil end
        end)
        -- A repair prompt can hold longer than the native brace window.
        if config.autoBrace then
            local owner = platform:character()
            if owner.ready then
                task.spawn(watchBrace, ctx, owner)
            end
        end
        task.spawn(function()
            while activeContext == ctx and not ctx:isCancelled() and not ctx:isClosing() and not ended do
                -- Per-tick errors must not kill the whole combat controller.
                local ok, why = pcall(repairTick, ctx, remote)
                if not ok then gate("REPAIR_TICK_ERROR", {error=tostring(why)}) end
                if not ctx:wait(0.25) then break end
            end
        end)
    end
    return controller
end
return RepairController
end
-- END MODULE boss.B52.RepairController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.B52.RepeatPolicy

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.B52.ReportController
__factories["boss.B52.ReportController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- B52 adaptive report: Outcome -> report (arena or hideout) -> Continue -> exit -> return.
-- Port of standalone V1; never treat Outcome alone as a completed report.
local NativeEncounterReport = require("boss.shared.NativeEncounterReport")
local ReportController = {}

function ReportController.new(env, config, repeatPolicy, repair)
    local platform, gui, runtime = env.services.roblox, env.services.gui, env.runtime
    local player = platform:player()
    local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
    local writer = env.state:port("boss")
    local report = {}
    local native = NativeEncounterReport.new(env, config.bossId, "B52")
    report.entry = native
    local confirmedOutcome, outcomeAt = nil, nil
    local lastHealthAt = 0
    local seenReport, firstOpenedAt = false, nil
    local resultsController
    local function emit(name, data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit(name, data or {}) end
    end
    local function traceContinue(ctx, encounter, reason)
        local data = {jobId=ctx.jobId, encounterId=encounter.encounterId, nativeGeneration=native:ownedNativeGeneration(),
            reason=reason, position=platform:position(), observedWorld=player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")}
        if telemetry then
            pcall(telemetry.emit, telemetry, "B52_REPORT_TRANSITION", data)
        else
            print("[PlaneRNG navigation]", "B52_REPORT_TRANSITION", reason, "job", data.jobId,
                "encounter", data.encounterId, "native generation", data.nativeGeneration,
                "world", data.observedWorld, "root", data.position)
        end
    end
    local function loadController()
        if resultsController then return resultsController end
        local folder = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("ClientModules")
        local mod = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("BossResultsController")
        if not mod or not mod:IsA("ModuleScript") then return nil end
        -- The build bundler replaces project requires. Invoke Roblox require only
        -- dynamically for the game's own ModuleScript, as the B21 controller does.
        local loader = getfenv(0)["require"]
        local ok, value = pcall(loader, mod)
        if not ok or type(value) ~= "table" then return nil end
        if type(value.IsOpen) ~= "function" or type(value.Dismiss) ~= "function" then return nil end
        resultsController = value
        return value
    end
    local function officialOpen()
        local ctrl = loadController()
        if ctrl and type(ctrl.IsOpen) == "function" then
            local ok, result = pcall(ctrl.IsOpen)
            if ok and result == true then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function isOpen()
        return player:GetAttribute("BossResultsOpen") == true or officialOpen()
    end
    local function matchingReport(guiRoot)
        if not guiRoot then return nil end
        local isB52, won, lost = false, false, false
        for _,node in ipairs(guiRoot:GetDescendants()) do
            if node:IsA("TextLabel") then
                local value = string.upper(tostring(node.Text or ""))
                if value:find("B-52", 1, true) or value:find("B52", 1, true)
                    or value:find("STRATOFORTRESS", 1, true) then isB52 = true end
                if value:find("DEFEATED", 1, true) or value:find("VICTORY", 1, true)
                    or value:find("ESCORT COMPLETE", 1, true) then won = true end
                if value:find("MISSION FAILED", 1, true) or value:find("DEFEAT", 1, true) then lost = true end
            end
        end
        if isB52 and won ~= lost then return won and "WIN" or "LOSS" end
        return nil
    end

    function report:watch(ctx)
        return native:watch(ctx, function(listen)
            local folder = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
            local remote = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("B52Event")
            if not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then return false, "B52_EVENT_MISSING" end
            listen(remote.OnClientEvent, function(packet)
                if type(packet) ~= "table" or type(packet.K) ~= "string" then return end
                local kind = packet.K
                local forward, matched = native:accept(packet, kind == "Start" or kind == "Session")
                if not forward and not matched then return end
                if forward then repair:observe(packet) end
                if matched then native:observeTerminal(packet, kind) end
                if matched and kind == "End" and packet.Reason == "Exited" then native:endSession() end
                if matched and kind == "Outcome" and type(packet.Victory) == "boolean" and not confirmedOutcome then
                    confirmedOutcome = packet.Victory and "WIN" or "LOSS"
                    outcomeAt = runtime:now()
                end
                if not forward and kind ~= "End" and kind ~= "Outcome" then return end
                if kind == "Start" or kind == "Launch" or kind == "Session"
                    or kind == "Begin" or kind == "Resync" or kind == "Phase"
                    or kind == "Integrity" or kind == "Incidents" or kind == "IncidentResolved"
                    or kind == "RepairOpen" or kind == "RepairProgress" or kind == "RepairClosed"
                    or kind == "Mig" or kind == "MigDown" or kind == "MigCut"
                    or kind == "TailGun" or kind == "Turbulence" or kind == "Falling"
                    or kind == "Recovered" or kind == "Eliminated" or kind == "Death"
                    or kind == "End" or kind == "Outcome" then
                    if kind == "Integrity" then
                        if runtime:now() - lastHealthAt < 4 then return end
                        lastHealthAt = runtime:now()
                    end
                    local detail = {kind = kind}
                    for _, field in ipairs({"Phase", "Name", "Kind", "State", "Stage",
                        "At", "I", "Max", "TimeLeft", "T0", "Reason", "Victory",
                        "Generation", "Outcome", "RewardEligible", "Damage", "Id", "Site",
                        "Progress", "Steps", "WarnAt", "Seconds"}) do
                        local value = packet[field]
                        if type(value) == "string" then
                            detail[field] = value:sub(1, 80)
                        elseif type(value) == "number" or type(value) == "boolean" then
                            detail[field] = value
                        end
                    end
                    emit("B52_EVENT", detail)
                end
            end)
            return true
        end)
    end
    function report:cleanup(ctx) native:cleanup(ctx) end
    function report:releaseEncounter(id) native:release(id) end
    function report:nativeEncounter() return native:nativeEncounter() end
    function report:ownedNativeGeneration() return native:ownedNativeGeneration() end
    function report:verifiedDeferredOutcome(encounter)
        if encounter.outcome == "LOSS" then return native:verifiedDefeat(encounter) end
        local generation = native:ownedNativeGeneration()
        local current = platform:workspace():GetAttribute("B52FightGeneration")
        return confirmedOutcome == "WIN" and generation ~= nil and (current == nil or current == generation)
    end
    function report:nativeReturnSettled()
        -- Native B-52 teardown releases the film and camera after the End sequence.
        return player:GetAttribute("BossFilmHold") ~= true
            and platform:workspace():GetAttribute("B52CameraOwned") ~= true
    end
    function report:resetOutcome()
        native:reset()
        confirmedOutcome, outcomeAt, seenReport, firstOpenedAt = nil, nil, false, nil
        repair:reset()
    end
    function report:inspect()
        local root = gui:find(env.profile.paths.bossReport)
        local active = isOpen() -- Same verified V2 signal: BossResultsOpen or official controller.IsOpen()
        if active then
            seenReport = true
            firstOpenedAt = firstOpenedAt or runtime:now()
        end
        local guiOutcome = active and matchingReport(root) or nil
        local outcome = confirmedOutcome or guiOutcome
        local seen = seenReport or confirmedOutcome ~= nil and native:wasReportSeen()
        return {
            active = active, matchesBoss = confirmedOutcome ~= nil or guiOutcome ~= nil,
            outcome = outcome, report = root, seen = seen,
            pendingPresentation = confirmedOutcome ~= nil and not seen
                and outcomeAt ~= nil and runtime:now() - outcomeAt < config.reportTimeoutSeconds,
        }
    end
    function report:reconcile(encounter)
        local evidence = self:inspect()
        if evidence.matchesBoss and evidence.outcome
            and (not encounter.outcome or encounter.outcome == evidence.outcome) then return true end
        return encounter.outcome ~= nil and evidence.seen and not evidence.active
    end
    function report:resolve(ctx, encounter)
        local watching, why = self:watch(ctx)
        if not watching then return {ok = false, code = why} end
        -- V2 REQUIREMENT: Outcome alone never authorizes return/Continue.
        local evidence = ctx:await(function()
            local current = self:inspect()
            if current.active and current.matchesBoss and current.outcome then return current end
            if current.seen and not current.active and (encounter.outcome or current.outcome) then
                return current -- manually dismissed report after previously observing it
            end
        end, config.reportTimeoutSeconds)
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        if not evidence then return {ok = false, code = "B52_REPORT_NOT_OBSERVED"} end
        if evidence.outcome and encounter.outcome and evidence.outcome ~= encounter.outcome then
            return {ok = false, held = true, code = "BOSS_OUTCOME_CONFLICT"}
        end
        local outcome = evidence.outcome or encounter.outcome
        if not outcome then return {ok = false, code = "B52_OUTCOME_UNVERIFIED"} end
        if not encounter.outcome then
            local accepted = writer:recordBossReport(outcome,
                runtime:epoch() + repeatPolicy:outcomeDelay(outcome))
            if not accepted then return {ok = false, held = true, code = "BOSS_OUTCOME_CONFLICT"} end
            encounter = env.state:snapshot().boss.encounter
        end
        if not evidence.active then
            writer:closeReport()
            return {ok = true, code = "B52_REPORT_MANUALLY_CLOSED"}
        end
        local at = platform:position()
        local place = player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") == true and "HIDEOUT" or "OTHER"
        if place == "OTHER" and at then
            local dx, dz = at.X - config.arenaCenter.x, at.Z - config.arenaCenter.z
            if dx * dx + dz * dz < config.arenaRadius * config.arenaRadius then
                place = "ARENA"
            end
        end
        emit("B52_REPORT_OPEN", {outcome = outcome, location = place,
            inBossFight = player:GetAttribute("InBossFight")})
        local controller = loadController()
        if not controller then return {ok = false, code = "B52_RESULT_CONTROLLER_MISSING_MANUAL_CONTINUE"} end
        if not encounter.continueAttempted then
            local ready = ctx:await(function()
                if not isOpen() then return "MANUALLY_CLOSED" end
                local armed = false
                if type(controller.Debug) == "function" then
                    local ok, message = pcall(controller.Debug)
                    armed = ok and type(message) == "string"
                        and message:find("armed=true", 1, true) ~= nil
                end
                if armed and firstOpenedAt
                    and runtime:now() - firstOpenedAt >= config.reportHoldSeconds then return "ARMED" end
            end, config.reportTimeoutSeconds)
            if ctx:isCancelled() then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
            if ready == "MANUALLY_CLOSED" then
                writer:closeReport()
                return {ok = true, code = "B52_REPORT_MANUALLY_CLOSED"}
            end
            if ready ~= "ARMED" then return {ok = false, code = "B52_REPORT_NOT_ARMED_MANUAL_CONTINUE"} end
            if not writer:markContinueAttempt() then return {ok = false, code = "B52_CONTINUE_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED"} end
            traceContinue(ctx, encounter, "NATIVE_DISMISS_REQUESTED")
            local sent, err = pcall(function() controller.Dismiss("continue") end)
            if not sent then return {ok = false, code = "B52_CONTINUE_FAILED: " .. tostring(err)} end
            emit("B52_REPORT_CONTINUE", {code = "CONTINUE_REQUESTED"})
        end
        local closed = ctx:await(function() if not self:inspect().active then return true end end,
            config.reportCloseTimeoutSeconds)
        if not closed then return {ok = false, code = "B52_REPORT_STILL_OPEN_MANUAL_CONTINUE"} end
        traceContinue(ctx, encounter, "NATIVE_REPORT_CLOSED")
        writer:closeReport()
        return {ok = true, code = "B52_REPORT_CLOSED"}
    end
    return report
end
return ReportController
end
-- END MODULE boss.B52.ReportController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.BlackFortress.ArenaObserver
__factories["boss.BlackFortress.ArenaObserver"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local ArenaObserver = {}
function ArenaObserver.new(env, config)
    local platform = env.services.roblox
    local player, workspace = platform:player(), platform:workspace()
    local observer = {}
    function observer:participating()
        return player:GetAttribute(config.participantAttribute) == true
    end
    function observer:inArenaPosition()
        -- FortressBattle's arena center was not established by the source snapshot.
        -- Do not claim a position-based proof from a guessed bounding box.
        return false
    end
    function observer:inArena()
        return self:participating() and player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true
    end
    function observer:state()
        return {fightState = workspace:GetAttribute(config.fightStateAttribute),
            generation = workspace:GetAttribute(config.generationAttribute),
            active = workspace:GetAttribute(config.activeAttribute),
            participant = player:GetAttribute(config.participantAttribute),
            eliminated = player:GetAttribute(config.eliminatedAttribute),
            inBossFight = player:GetAttribute("InBossFight")}
    end
    return observer
end
return ArenaObserver
end
-- END MODULE boss.BlackFortress.ArenaObserver

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.BlackFortress.BlackFortress
__factories["boss.BlackFortress.BlackFortress"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- BossManager definition for The Black Fortress (FortressBattle / World 76).
local Config = require("boss.BlackFortress.Config")
local ArenaObserver = require("boss.BlackFortress.ArenaObserver")
local CommandController = require("boss.BlackFortress.CommandController")
local ObjectiveController = require("boss.BlackFortress.ObjectiveController")
local IntegrityObserver = require("boss.BlackFortress.IntegrityObserver")
local SquadObserver = require("boss.BlackFortress.SquadObserver")
local FlightController = require("boss.BlackFortress.FlightController")
local CombatController = require("boss.BlackFortress.CombatController")
local ReportController = require("boss.BlackFortress.ReportController")
local RepeatPolicy = require("boss.BlackFortress.RepeatPolicy")
local BlackFortress = {}
function BlackFortress.definition()
    return {bossId = Config.bossId, displayName = Config.displayName, create = function(env)
        local observer = ArenaObserver.new(env, Config)
        local objectives = ObjectiveController.new(env, Config)
        local integrity = IntegrityObserver.new(env)
        local squads = SquadObserver.new(env, Config)
        local repeatPolicy = RepeatPolicy.new(env)
        local report = ReportController.new(env, Config, repeatPolicy, objectives, integrity, squads)
        local flight = FlightController.new(env, Config, observer, objectives, squads)
        return {config = Config, observer = observer, objectives = objectives,
            integrity = integrity, squads = squads, flight = flight,
            report = report, repeatPolicy = repeatPolicy,
            command = CommandController.new(env, Config, observer, report),
            combat = CombatController.new(env, Config, observer, report, flight, integrity, squads)}
    end}
end
return BlackFortress
end
-- END MODULE boss.BlackFortress.BlackFortress

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.BlackFortress.CombatController
__factories["boss.BlackFortress.CombatController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local CombatController = {}
function CombatController.new(env, config, observer, report, flight, integrity, squads)
    local runtime, telemetry = env.runtime, env.services.telemetry
    local combat = {}
    local function emit(name, data) if telemetry then telemetry:emit(name, data) end end
    function combat:run(ctx, encounter)
        local watching, why = report:watch(ctx)
        if not watching then return {code = why} end
        local deadline = runtime:now() + config.maxFightSeconds
        local code = "OUTCOME_NOT_OBSERVED_TIMEOUT"
        local lastState, lastStateAt, lastPilotError = nil, 0, nil
        ctx:deferCleanup(function() flight:release() end)
        while not ctx:isCancelled() and runtime:now() < deadline do
            local evidence = report:inspect()
            if evidence.outcome then code = "OUTCOME_OBSERVED"; break end
            local state = observer:state()
            local key = tostring(state.fightState)..":"..tostring(state.active)..":"..tostring(state.participant)
            if lastState ~= key or runtime:now() - lastStateAt > 25 then
                emit("FORTRESS_STATE", {state = state, integrity = integrity:snapshot(), squad = squads:snapshot()})
                lastState, lastStateAt = key, runtime:now()
            end
            if observer:inArena() then
                local ok, reason = flight:tick()
                if not ok and reason ~= lastPilotError then
                    emit("FORTRESS_STEERING_GATE", {reason = reason}); lastPilotError = reason
                end
            else
                flight:release()
            end
            if not ctx:wait(config.pilotTickSeconds) then break end
        end
        flight:release()
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return {code = "CANCELLED"} end
        return {code = code}
    end
    return combat
end
return CombatController
end
-- END MODULE boss.BlackFortress.CombatController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.BlackFortress.CommandController
__factories["boss.BlackFortress.CommandController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- BlackFortress standalone V1 flow: Hideout -> Boss Command pass -> ONE Solo -> combat.
-- Adaptive report may open in arena OR after exit; never request return before Continue.
local DirectBossTravel = require("main.navigation.DirectBossTravel")
local CommandController = {}

function CommandController.new(env, config, observer, report)
    local platform, runtime = env.services.roblox, env.runtime
    local player, workspace = platform:player(), platform:workspace()
    local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
    local travel = DirectBossTravel.new(env)
    local command = {}
    local function emit(name, data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit(name, data or {}) end
    end
    local function remote(name)
        local storage = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage")
        local folder = storage:FindFirstChild("Remotes") or storage:WaitForChild("Remotes", 10)
        local item = folder and (folder:FindFirstChild(name) or folder:WaitForChild(name, 7))
        return item and item:IsA("RemoteEvent") and item or nil
    end
    local function active(ctx) return runtime:isActive(ctx) and not ctx:isCancelled() end
    local function cooldownLeft()
        local raw = player:GetAttribute("BossStartCooldowns")
        if type(raw) ~= "string" or raw == "" then return 0 end
        local ok, data = pcall(function() return platform:service("HttpService"):JSONDecode(raw) end)
        if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then return 0 end
        return math.max(0, (tonumber(data[config.gameBossKey]) or 0) - workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
    end

    function command:prepare(ctx)
        local watching, why = report:watch(ctx) -- watch BEFORE sending any boss request
        if not watching then return false, why end
        if observer:inArena() then return true, "FORTRESS_ALREADY_IN_ARENA" end
        if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true then return false, "OTHER_BOSS_ACTIVE" end
        if not active(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        local entered = travel:enterHideout(ctx)
        emit("FORTRESS_DIRECT_HIDEOUT", {ok = entered.ok, code = entered.code, reason = entered.reason})
        if not entered.ok then return false, entered.code end
        local positioned = travel:moveToKnownPoint(ctx, config.commandSafePosition, {
            requireHideout = true, radius = 6, settle = 0.85,
        })
        emit("FORTRESS_COMMAND_POSITION", {ok = positioned.ok, code = positioned.code})
        if not positioned.ok then return false, positioned.code end
        return true, "FORTRESS_COMMAND_READY"
    end

    function command:readiness()
        if observer:inArena() then return "READY" end
        if not travel:inHideout() then return "UNKNOWN" end
        local secs = cooldownLeft()
        if secs > 0 then
            secs = math.ceil(secs)
            return string.format("%d:%02d", math.floor(secs / 60), secs % 60)
        end
        -- The server pass remains authoritative for unlock/eligibility.
        return "READY"
    end

    function command:startSolo(ctx, markAttempt)
        if not active(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        if observer:participating() then return true, "FORTRESS_ALREADY_FIGHTING" end
        if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true then return false, "OTHER_BOSS_ACTIVE" end
        if not travel:inHideout() then return false, "NOT_IN_HIDEOUT" end
        if self:readiness() ~= "READY" then return false, "FORTRESS_NOT_READY" end
        local watching, why = report:watch(ctx)
        if not watching then return false, why end
        local hideout, accept = remote("PersonalHideoutRemote"), remote(config.acceptRemote)
        if not hideout or not accept then return false, "FORTRESS_COMMAND_REMOTES_MISSING" end
        local passReply, acceptReply
        local passConnection = hideout.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
            if type(e) == "table" and e.Kind == "BossCommand" and e.Op == "Start"
                and e.BossKey == config.gameBossKey then passReply = e end
        end)
        local acceptConnection = accept.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
            if type(e) == "table" and e.Accepted ~= nil then acceptReply = e end
        end)
        local function finish(ok, code)
            passConnection:Disconnect()
            acceptConnection:Disconnect()
            return ok, code
        end
        local sent, err = pcall(function()
            hideout:FireServer({Action = "StartBoss", BossKey = config.gameBossKey, Solo = true})
        end)
        if not sent then return finish(false, "FORTRESS_PASS_SEND_FAILED: " .. tostring(err)) end
        local gotPass = ctx:await(function() return passReply end, 10)
        if not active(ctx) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
        if not gotPass then return finish(false, "FORTRESS_PASS_TIMEOUT_NO_RETRY") end
        emit("FORTRESS_PASS_RESULT", {ok = gotPass.Ok == true, reason = gotPass.Reason})
        if gotPass.Ok ~= true then return finish(false, "FORTRESS_PASS_REJECTED: " .. tostring(gotPass.Reason)) end
        -- Mark before firing the irreversible Solo request; never blind retry.
        if not markAttempt() then return finish(false, "FORTRESS_SOLO_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED") end
        sent, err = pcall(function() accept:FireServer({Solo = true}) end)
        if not sent then return finish(false, "FORTRESS_SOLO_SEND_FAILED: " .. tostring(err)) end
        local observed = ctx:await(function()
            if acceptReply and acceptReply.Accepted == false then return "REJECTED" end
            if observer:participating() then return "ENTERED" end
        end, config.arenaTimeout)
        if not active(ctx) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
        emit("FORTRESS_SOLO_RESULT", {code = observed or "AMBIGUOUS", accepted = acceptReply and acceptReply.Accepted})
        if observed == "ENTERED" then return finish(true, "FORTRESS_FIGHT_VERIFIED") end
        if observed == "REJECTED" then
            return finish(false, "FORTRESS_SOLO_REJECTED: " .. tostring(acceptReply.Reason))
        end
        return finish(false, "FORTRESS_SOLO_AMBIGUOUS_NO_RETRY")
    end

    function command:close(_) return true end -- No command GUI was opened.

    function command:returnHome(ctx, home)
        if not active(ctx) then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        if type(home) ~= "number" or home < 1 or home % 1 ~= 0 then
            return {ok = false, code = "INVALID_HOME_WORLD"}
        end
        if report:inspect().active then return {ok = false, code = "FORTRESS_REPORT_STILL_OPEN"} end
        -- Preserve standalone V1 lock checks before return, regardless of report location.
        local released = ctx:await(function()
            if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true
                and player:GetAttribute(config.participantAttribute) ~= true then return true end
        end, config.returnLockTimeoutSeconds)
        if not released then
            emit("FORTRESS_RETURN_LOCK_PENDING", {world = home})
            return {ok = false, code = "FORTRESS_RETURN_LOCK_PENDING", reason = "BossFight"}
        end
        local exit = ctx:await(function()
            if player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") == true then return "BOSS_COMMAND_HIDEOUT" end
            if not observer:inArenaPosition() then return "OUTSIDE_ARENA" end
        end, config.exitTimeoutSeconds)
        emit("FORTRESS_ARENA_EXIT", {code = exit or "LOCK_RELEASED_STILL_IN_ARENA"})
        -- As in tested standalone V1, a released lock permits a direct verified travel even
        -- if the game has not repositioned the player outside the arena yet.
        if not ctx:wait(1.5) then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        local request, prepare, result = remote("RequestWorldTravel"), remote("NavPrepareWorlds"), remote("WorldTravelResult")
        if not request or not prepare then return {ok = false, code = "FORTRESS_WORLD_TRAVEL_REMOTES_MISSING"} end
        local position = platform:position()
        if not position then return {ok = false, code = "CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE"} end
        if tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")) == home
            and player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") ~= true
            and not observer:inArenaPosition() then
            return {ok = true, code = "ALREADY_IN_HOME", world = home}
        end
        local reply
        local connection = result and result.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
            if type(e) == "table" and e.Kind == "Result" and tonumber(e.WorldId) == home then reply = e end
        end) or nil
        local function finish(ok, code, reason)
            if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
            emit("FORTRESS_DIRECT_RETURN", {ok = ok, code = code, reason = reason, world = home})
            return {ok = ok, code = code, reason = reason, world = home}
        end
        for attempt = 1, config.returnRetries do
            if not active(ctx) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            reply = nil
            local prior = platform:position()
            if not prior then return finish(false, "CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE") end
            local sent, err = pcall(function() prepare:FireServer("stream", home) end)
            if not sent then return finish(false, "WORLD_PREPARE_SEND_FAILED", tostring(err)) end
            if not ctx:wait(0.12) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            sent, err = pcall(function() request:FireServer(home) end)
            if not sent then return finish(false, "WORLD_REQUEST_SEND_FAILED", tostring(err)) end
            local observed = ctx:await(function()
                if reply and reply.Ok == false then return "REJECTED" end
                local current = platform:position()
                if current and platform:distance(current, prior) > 50
                    and tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")) == home
                    and player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") ~= true
                    and player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true
                    and not observer:inArenaPosition() then return "VERIFIED" end
            end, 17)
            emit("FORTRESS_RETURN_ATTEMPT", {attempt = attempt, code = observed or "AMBIGUOUS",
                reason = reply and reply.Reason})
            if observed == "VERIFIED" then return finish(true, "FORTRESS_HOME_VERIFIED") end
            if observed ~= "REJECTED" then return finish(false, "FORTRESS_RETURN_AMBIGUOUS_NO_RETRY") end
            local why = tostring(reply.Reason or "UNKNOWN")
            if why ~= "BossFight" or attempt == config.returnRetries then
                return finish(false, "FORTRESS_WORLD_RETURN_REJECTED", why)
            end
            if not ctx:wait(12) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            local settled = ctx:await(function()
                if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true then return true end
            end, 40)
            if not settled then return finish(false, "FORTRESS_LOCK_STILL_ACTIVE", "BossFight") end
        end
        return finish(false, "FORTRESS_WORLD_RETURN_EXHAUSTED")
    end
    return command
end
return CommandController
end
-- END MODULE boss.BlackFortress.CommandController
