-- BEGIN MODULE boss.BlackFortress.FlightController
__factories["boss.BlackFortress.FlightController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local PilotControl = require("boss.shared.PilotControl")
local FlightController = {}

function FlightController.new(env, config, observer, objectives, squads)
    local platform, telemetry = env.services.roblox, env.services.telemetry
    local riftHazards=env.services.riftHazards
    local intro, controller, native
    local player=platform:player()
    local flight = {}
    local pilot = PilotControl.new(platform, function(name, data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit("FORTRESS_" .. name, data or {}) end
    end)

    function flight:release()
        pilot:stop()
    end

    local function probe()
        if intro and controller and native then return true end
        local folder = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("ClientModules")
        local introFolder = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("IntroBattle")
        local function load(parent, name)
            local module = parent and parent:FindFirstChild(name)
            if not module or not module:IsA("ModuleScript") then return nil end
            local ok, value = pcall(getfenv(0)["require"], module)
            return ok and type(value) == "table" and value or nil
        end
        local battle = load(introFolder, "Controller")
        local manual = load(folder, "ManualFlightController")
        local flightRuntime = load(folder, "ManualFlightRuntime")
        if not battle or type(battle.Active) ~= "function" then return false, "INTRO_BATTLE_CONTROLLER_UNAVAILABLE" end
        if not manual or type(manual.IsActive) ~= "function" or type(manual.IsIntro) ~= "function"
            or type(manual.AutoPilotOn) ~= "function" then return false, "MANUAL_FLIGHT_CONTROLLER_UNSUPPORTED" end
        if not flightRuntime or type(flightRuntime.Active) ~= "function" or type(flightRuntime.Plane) ~= "function"
            or type(flightRuntime.Flight) ~= "function" or type(flightRuntime.Controls) ~= "function" then
            return false, "MANUAL_FLIGHT_RUNTIME_UNSUPPORTED"
        end
        if type(flightRuntime.SetAim) ~= "function" then return false, "NATIVE_SET_AIM_UNAVAILABLE" end
        intro, controller, native = battle, manual, flightRuntime
        return true
    end

    local function blocked(reason)
        pilot:clear(reason)
        pilot:failed(reason)
        return false, reason
    end

    function flight:tick()
        if not observer:inArena() or squads:snapshot().eliminated
            or player:GetAttribute("BossReviveDowned")==true or player:GetAttribute("BossResultsOpen")==true then
            self:release()
            return false, "NOT_FLYING_PARTICIPANT"
        end
        if not config.autoPilot or not config.directNativeSteering then return blocked("DIRECT_STEERING_DISABLED") end
        local ready, why = probe()
        if not ready then return blocked(why) end
        if not intro.Active() then return blocked("FORTRESS_FLIGHT_NOT_ACTIVE") end
        local arena = platform:workspace():FindFirstChild("IntroBattle")
        local plane,state = PilotControl.bound(native,controller,function(model)
            local hp=model:GetAttribute("CurrentHP")
            return arena and model.Parent==arena and model.Name=="BattlePilotAircraft"
                and model:GetAttribute("IntroPlayer")==true and controller.IsIntro()
                and (type(hp)~="number" or hp>0)
        end)
        if not plane then return blocked("FORTRESS_AIRCRAFT_NOT_BOUND") end
        local target,id = objectives:target(arena)
        if not target or not target.Parent then return blocked(id or "ENEMY_TARGET_NOT_FOUND") end
        local delta = target.Position-state.Sim.Position
        local distance = delta.Magnitude
        if distance<0.01 then return blocked("TARGET_DISTANCE_ZERO") end
        local heading=state.Sim.Rotation.LookVector
        local angle=math.deg(math.acos(math.clamp(heading:Dot(delta.Unit),-1,1)))
        local nativeTarget=state.Target
        local targetMatches=nativeTarget~=nil and (nativeTarget==target or nativeTarget==target.Parent
            or id=="HULL" and nativeTarget.Name=="HostileFortress" and nativeTarget:IsDescendantOf(arena))
        -- Native engine candidates have no Model. Compare the current native
        -- target range to the source-backed engine anchor before allowing input.
        if id:match("^Engine%d+$") and not nativeTarget and type(state.TargetDistance)=="number" then
            targetMatches=math.abs(state.TargetDistance-distance)<=10
        end
        local fire=targetMatches and config.autoFire and state.OnTarget==true
            and angle<=config.gunAimDeg and distance<=config.gunRange
        local missile=targetMatches and config.autoMissile and angle<=24 and distance>12 and distance<=config.missileRange
        local plan={Aim=delta,Target=id,Fire=fire,Missile=missile}
        if riftHazards and type(riftHazards.flightPlan)=="function" then
            local ok,adjusted=pcall(riftHazards.flightPlan,riftHazards,state.Sim,plan)
            if ok and type(adjusted)=="table" then plan=adjusted end
        end
        local _,reason=pilot:apply(native,controller,plane,state,plan,true)
        return reason=="STEERING_VERIFIED",reason
    end
    return flight
end
return FlightController
end
-- END MODULE boss.BlackFortress.FlightController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.BlackFortress.IntegrityObserver
__factories["boss.BlackFortress.IntegrityObserver"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Observes friendly fort integrity but never treats absence of state as zero.
local IntegrityObserver = {}
function IntegrityObserver.new(env)
    local obs = {value = nil, phase = nil, lastWarn = nil}
    local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
    local function emit(name, data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit(name, data) end
    end
    local function numeric(v)
        if type(v) == "number" and v == v then return v end
        return nil
    end
    local function from(t)
        if type(t) ~= "table" then return nil end
        for _, key in ipairs({"FriendlyIntegrity", "FortressIntegrity", "Integrity", "FriendlyHPFraction"}) do
            if numeric(t[key]) then return t[key], key end
        end
        return nil
    end
    function obs:observe(packet)
        local value, field = from(packet)
        if not value and type(packet.State) == "table" then value, field = from(packet.State) end
        if numeric(packet.Phase) then self.phase = packet.Phase end
        if value then
            self.value = value
            local threshold = (value <= 1 and value <= 0.1 and 10)
                or (value <= 1 and value <= 0.25 and 25)
                or (value <= 1 and value <= 0.5 and 50)
            if threshold and (not self.lastWarn or threshold < self.lastWarn) then
                self.lastWarn = threshold
                emit("FORTRESS_FRIENDLY_INTEGRITY_LOW", {value = value, field = field, threshold = threshold})
            end
        end
    end
    function obs:snapshot() return {value = self.value, phase = self.phase} end
    function obs:reset() self.value, self.phase, self.lastWarn = nil, nil, nil end
    return obs
end
return IntegrityObserver
end
-- END MODULE boss.BlackFortress.IntegrityObserver

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.BlackFortress.ObjectiveController
__factories["boss.BlackFortress.ObjectiveController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Deterministic target order. No fabricated packet types or enemy coordinates.
local ObjectiveController = {}
function ObjectiveController.new(env, config)
    local platform = env.services.roblox
    local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
    local obs = {destroyed = {}, lastTarget = nil, enemyModel = nil, engines = {}}
    local function emit(name, data) if telemetry then telemetry:emit(name, data) end end
    local function boolDestroyed(t)
        if type(t) ~= "table" then return false end
        return t.Destroyed == true or t.Dead == true or t.Alive == false
            or (type(t.HP) == "number" and t.HP <= 0)
    end
    function obs:observe(packet)
        local state = type(packet.State) == "table" and packet.State or packet
        if type(state) ~= "table" then return end
        if packet.K == "Component" and type(packet.Id) == "string" and packet.Dead == true then
            self.destroyed[packet.Id] = true
        end
        if type(state.Comp) == "table" then
            for id, fraction in pairs(state.Comp) do
                if type(id) == "string" and type(fraction) == "number" and fraction <= 0 then self.destroyed[id] = true end
            end
        end
        local comps = state.Components or state.ComponentStates or state.Parts
        if type(comps) == "table" then
            for _, component in pairs(comps) do
                if type(component) == "table" then
                    local id = component.Id or component.ID or component.Name
                    if type(id) == "string" and boolDestroyed(component) then self.destroyed[id] = true end
                end
            end
            for id, value in pairs(comps) do
                if type(id) == "string" and boolDestroyed(value) then self.destroyed[id] = true end
            end
        end
        local single = state.Component or state.Objective
        if type(single) == "table" then
            local id = single.Id or single.Name
            if type(id) == "string" and boolDestroyed(single) then self.destroyed[id] = true end
        end
    end
    local engineConfig, carrierConfig, template
    local function engineParts(model)
        local storage = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage")
        if not engineConfig then
            local modules = storage:FindFirstChild("Modules")
            local assets = storage:FindFirstChild("BossModels")
            template = assets and assets:FindFirstChild("CarrierFortress")
            local fortress = modules and modules:FindFirstChild("FortressBattleConfig")
            local carrier = modules and modules:FindFirstChild("CarrierFortressConfig")
            if not template or not fortress or not carrier then return {} end
            local loader = getfenv(0)["require"]
            local ok, fortressData = pcall(loader, fortress)
            local loaded, carrierData = pcall(loader, carrier)
            if not ok or type(fortressData) ~= "table" or type(fortressData.Components) ~= "table"
                or not loaded or type(carrierData) ~= "table" or type(carrierData.ExhaustPoint) ~= "function"
                or type(carrierData.Engines) ~= "table" or type(carrierData.Engines.AbsZStations) ~= "table"
                or type(carrierData.Airframe) ~= "table" then return {} end
            engineConfig, carrierConfig = fortressData.Components, carrierData
        end
        local expectedHull = template:FindFirstChild(carrierConfig.Airframe.PrimaryPartName)
        local hull = model.PrimaryPart
        if not expectedHull or not expectedHull:IsA("BasePart") or not hull or hull.Name ~= expectedHull.Name then return {} end
        local engines = carrierConfig.Engines
        local scale = tonumber(carrierConfig.Airframe.Scale) or 1
        -- CarrierFortressRig.SetPose applies the same authored frame to the hull and
        -- the SmokeTrail parts. Recover that frame from the live hull and the template.
        local hullRest = CFrame.new((expectedHull.Position - template:GetPivot().Position) * scale)
            * expectedHull.CFrame.Rotation
        local authoredFrame = hull.CFrame * hullRest:Inverse()
        local parts, children = {}, model:GetChildren()
        for _, component in ipairs(engineConfig) do
            if component.Kind == "Engine" then
                local index = component.RigIndex or component.Index
                local count = #engines.AbsZStations
                if type(index) == "number" and index >= 1 and index <= count * 2 then
                    local station = engines.AbsZStations[(index - 1) % count + 1]
                    local expected = authoredFrame:PointToWorldSpace(
                        carrierConfig.ExhaustPoint(station, index <= count and -1 or 1) * scale)
                    local closest = 2
                    for _, child in ipairs(children) do
                        if child.Name == engines.SmokePartName and child:IsA("BasePart") then
                            local distance = (child.Position - expected).Magnitude
                            if distance < closest then parts[component.Id], closest = child, distance end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return parts
    end
    local function alive(part)
        if not part then return false end
        for _, key in ipairs({"Destroyed", "Dead"}) do
            if part:GetAttribute(key) == true then return false end
        end
        local hp = part:GetAttribute("HP") or part:GetAttribute("Health")
        return type(hp) ~= "number" or hp > 0
    end
    local function findPart(model, id)
        if not model then return nil end
        local candidate = model:FindFirstChild(id, true)
        if candidate then
            if candidate:IsA("BasePart") then return candidate end
            if candidate:IsA("Model") then return candidate.PrimaryPart or candidate:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true) end
        end
        return nil
    end
    function obs:target(arena)
        local model = arena:FindFirstChild("HostileFortress")
        if not model or not model:IsA("Model") then return nil, "ENEMY_MODEL_NOT_FOUND" end
        if self.enemyModel ~= model then self.enemyModel, self.engines = model, {} end
        if not next(self.engines) and (not self.nextEngineProbe or os.clock() >= self.nextEngineProbe) then
            self.engines = engineParts(model)
            self.nextEngineProbe = os.clock() + config.targetRefreshSeconds
        end
        for _, id in ipairs(config.objectiveOrder) do
            if not self.destroyed[id] then
                local battery = id:match("^Battery(%d+)$")
                local part = battery and findPart(model, "TurretTarget_B" .. battery) or self.engines[id]
                if part and part.Parent == nil then part = nil end
                if alive(part) then
                    if self.lastTarget ~= id then
                        emit("FORTRESS_OBJECTIVE_TARGET", {id = id, found = true})
                        self.lastTarget = id
                    end
                    return part, id
                end
            end
        end
        local part = model.PrimaryPart or model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
        if alive(part) then
            if self.lastTarget ~= "HULL" then
                emit("FORTRESS_OBJECTIVE_TARGET", {id = "HULL", found = true})
                self.lastTarget = "HULL"
            end
            return part, "HULL"
        end
        return nil, "ENEMY_TARGET_NOT_FOUND"
    end
    function obs:reset()
        self.destroyed, self.engines = {}, {}
        self.lastTarget, self.enemyModel, self.nextEngineProbe = nil, nil, nil
    end
    return obs
end
return ObjectiveController
end
-- END MODULE boss.BlackFortress.ObjectiveController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.BlackFortress.RepeatPolicy
__factories["boss.BlackFortress.RepeatPolicy"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local SharedRepeatPolicy = require("boss.shared.RepeatPolicy")
local RepeatPolicy = {}
function RepeatPolicy.new(env)
    return SharedRepeatPolicy.new(env, "Expected confirmed Black Fortress outcome")
end
return RepeatPolicy
end
-- END MODULE boss.BlackFortress.RepeatPolicy

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.BlackFortress.ReportController
__factories["boss.BlackFortress.ReportController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- BlackFortress adaptive report: Outcome -> report (any location) -> Continue -> exit -> return.
-- Port of standalone V1; never treat Outcome alone as a completed report.
local DeferredOutcome = require("boss.shared.DeferredOutcome")
local ReportController = {}

function ReportController.new(env, config, repeatPolicy, objectives, integrity, squads)
    local platform, gui, runtime = env.services.roblox, env.services.gui, env.runtime
    local player = platform:player()
    local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
    local writer = env.state:port("boss")
    local terminal = DeferredOutcome.new(env, config.bossId, "FortressFightGeneration")
    local report = {}
    local confirmedOutcome, outcomeAt = nil, nil
    local lastHealthAt = 0
    local seenReport, firstOpenedAt = false, nil
    local listeningContext, connection, resultsController = nil, nil, nil
    local function emit(name, data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit(name, data or {}) end
    end
    local function loadController()
        if resultsController then return resultsController end
        local folder = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("ClientModules")
        local mod = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("BossResultsController")
        if not mod or not mod:IsA("ModuleScript") then return nil end
        -- The build bundler replaces project requires. Invoke Roblox require only
        -- dynamically for the game's own ModuleScript, as the B21 controller does.
        local loader = getfenv(0)["require"]
        local ok, value = pcall(loader, mod)
        if not ok or type(value) ~= "table" then return nil end
        if type(value.IsOpen) ~= "function" or type(value.Dismiss) ~= "function" then return nil end
        resultsController = value
        return value
    end
    local function officialOpen()
        local ctrl = loadController()
        if ctrl and type(ctrl.IsOpen) == "function" then
            local ok, result = pcall(ctrl.IsOpen)
            if ok and result == true then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function isOpen()
        return player:GetAttribute("BossResultsOpen") == true or officialOpen()
    end
    local function matchingReport(guiRoot)
        if not guiRoot then return nil end
        local isBlackFortress, won, lost = false, false, false
        for _, node in ipairs(guiRoot:GetDescendants()) do
            if node:IsA("TextLabel") then
                local value = string.upper(tostring(node.Text or ""))
                if value:find("BLACK FORTRESS", 1, true) or value:find("FORTRESSBATTLE", 1, true) then isBlackFortress = true end
                if value:find("VICTORY", 1, true) or value:find("FORTRESS IS FALLING", 1, true) then won = true end
                if value:find("MISSION FAILED", 1, true) or value:find("FORTRESS HAS FALLEN", 1, true) then lost = true end
            end
        end
        if isBlackFortress and won ~= lost then return won and "WIN" or "LOSS" end
        return nil
    end

    function report:watch(ctx)
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        if listeningContext == ctx and connection then return true end
        if connection then connection:Disconnect(); connection = nil end
        local folder = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        local remote = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(config.eventRemote)
        if not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then return false, "FORTRESS_EVENT_MISSING" end
        local current = remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(packet)
            if type(packet) ~= "table" or type(packet.K) ~= "string" then return end
            terminal:observe(packet)
            -- The event listener is active before StartBoss; plan impacts immediately.
            objectives:observe(packet)
            integrity:observe(packet)
            squads:observe(packet)
            local kind = packet.K
            if kind == "Outcome" and type(packet.Victory) == "boolean" then
                confirmedOutcome = packet.Victory and "WIN" or "LOSS"
                outcomeAt = runtime:now()
            end
            if kind == "Start" or kind == "Begin" or kind == "Phase" or kind == "Attack"
                or kind == "Ecm" or kind == "Death" or kind == "Resync" or kind == "Health"
                or kind == "End" or kind == "Outcome" then
                if kind == "Health" then
                    if runtime:now() - lastHealthAt < 4 then return end
                    lastHealthAt = runtime:now()
                end
                local detail = {kind = kind}
                for _, field in ipairs({"Phase", "Name", "Reason", "EndReason", "Victory",
                    "Kind", "State", "Index", "From", "To", "HP", "MaxHP", "Generation"}) do
                    local value = packet[field]
                    if type(value) == "string" or type(value) == "number" or type(value) == "boolean" then
                        detail[field] = value
                    end
                end
                if kind == "Attack" and type(packet.Passes) == "table" then
                    detail.passes = #packet.Passes
                    detail.hasDecoy = type(packet.Decoy) == "table"
                    detail.hasBlackSky = type(packet.BlackSky) == "table"
                end
                emit("FORTRESS_EVENT", detail)
            end
        end)
        connection, listeningContext = current, ctx
        ctx:deferCleanup(function()
            if connection == current then
                current:Disconnect()
                connection, listeningContext = nil, nil
            end
        end)
        return true
    end
    function report:cleanup()
        if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
        connection, listeningContext = nil, nil
        -- Keep outcome and report evidence across RETURN/REPORT retries.
    end
    function report:resetOutcome()
        terminal:reset()
        confirmedOutcome, outcomeAt, seenReport, firstOpenedAt = nil, nil, false, nil
        objectives:reset()
        integrity:reset()
        squads:reset()
    end
    function report:verifiedDeferredOutcome(encounter) return terminal:verified(encounter, encounter.outcome) end
    function report:inspect()
        local root = gui:find(env.profile.paths.bossReport)
        local active = isOpen() -- Same verified V2 signal: BossResultsOpen or official controller.IsOpen()
        if active then
            seenReport = true
            firstOpenedAt = firstOpenedAt or runtime:now()
        end
        local guiOutcome = active and matchingReport(root) or nil
        local outcome = confirmedOutcome or guiOutcome
        return {
            active = active, matchesBoss = confirmedOutcome ~= nil or guiOutcome ~= nil,
            outcome = outcome, report = root, seen = seenReport,
            pendingPresentation = confirmedOutcome ~= nil and not seenReport
                and outcomeAt ~= nil and runtime:now() - outcomeAt < config.reportTimeoutSeconds,
        }
    end
    function report:reconcile(encounter)
        local evidence = self:inspect()
        if evidence.matchesBoss and evidence.outcome
            and (not encounter.outcome or encounter.outcome == evidence.outcome) then return true end
        return encounter.outcome ~= nil and seenReport and not evidence.active
    end
    function report:resolve(ctx, encounter)
        local watching, why = self:watch(ctx)
        if not watching then return {ok = false, code = why} end
        -- V2 REQUIREMENT: Outcome alone never authorizes return/Continue.
        local evidence = ctx:await(function()
            local current = self:inspect()
            if current.active and current.matchesBoss and current.outcome then return current end
            if seenReport and not current.active and (encounter.outcome or current.outcome) then
                return current -- manually dismissed report after previously observing it
            end
        end, config.reportTimeoutSeconds)
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        if not evidence then return {ok = false, code = "FORTRESS_REPORT_NOT_OBSERVED"} end
        if evidence.outcome and encounter.outcome and evidence.outcome ~= encounter.outcome then
            return {ok = false, held = true, code = "BOSS_OUTCOME_CONFLICT"}
        end
        local outcome = evidence.outcome or encounter.outcome
        if not outcome then return {ok = false, code = "FORTRESS_OUTCOME_UNVERIFIED"} end
        if not encounter.outcome then
            local accepted = writer:recordBossReport(outcome,
                runtime:epoch() + repeatPolicy:outcomeDelay(outcome))
            if not accepted then return {ok = false, held = true, code = "BOSS_OUTCOME_CONFLICT"} end
            encounter = env.state:snapshot().boss.encounter
        end
        if not evidence.active then
            writer:closeReport()
            return {ok = true, code = "FORTRESS_REPORT_MANUALLY_CLOSED"}
        end
        local at = platform:position()
        local place = player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") == true and "HIDEOUT" or "OTHER"
        if place == "OTHER" and at then
            local dx, dz = at.X - config.arenaCenter.x, at.Z - config.arenaCenter.z
            if dx * dx + dz * dz < config.arenaRadius * config.arenaRadius then
                place = "ARENA"
            end
        end
        emit("FORTRESS_REPORT_OPEN", {outcome = outcome, location = place,
            inBossFight = player:GetAttribute("InBossFight")})
        local controller = loadController()
        if not controller then return {ok = false, code = "FORTRESS_RESULT_CONTROLLER_MISSING_MANUAL_CONTINUE"} end
        if not encounter.continueAttempted then
            local ready = ctx:await(function()
                if not isOpen() then return "MANUALLY_CLOSED" end
                local armed = false
                if type(controller.Debug) == "function" then
                    local ok, message = pcall(controller.Debug)
                    armed = ok and type(message) == "string"
                        and message:find("armed=true", 1, true) ~= nil
                end
                if armed and firstOpenedAt
                    and runtime:now() - firstOpenedAt >= config.reportHoldSeconds then return "ARMED" end
            end, config.reportTimeoutSeconds)
            if ctx:isCancelled() then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
            if ready == "MANUALLY_CLOSED" then
                writer:closeReport()
                return {ok = true, code = "FORTRESS_REPORT_MANUALLY_CLOSED"}
            end
            if ready ~= "ARMED" then return {ok = false, code = "FORTRESS_REPORT_NOT_ARMED_MANUAL_CONTINUE"} end
            if not writer:markContinueAttempt() then return {ok = false, code = "FORTRESS_CONTINUE_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED"} end
            local sent, err = pcall(function() controller.Dismiss("continue") end)
            if not sent then return {ok = false, code = "FORTRESS_CONTINUE_FAILED: " .. tostring(err)} end
            emit("FORTRESS_REPORT_CONTINUE", {code = "CONTINUE_REQUESTED"})
        end
        local closed = ctx:await(function() if not self:inspect().active then return true end end,
            config.reportCloseTimeoutSeconds)
        if not closed then return {ok = false, code = "FORTRESS_REPORT_STILL_OPEN_MANUAL_CONTINUE"} end
        writer:closeReport()
        return {ok = true, code = "FORTRESS_REPORT_CLOSED"}
    end
    return report
end
return ReportController
end
-- END MODULE boss.BlackFortress.ReportController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.BlackFortress.SquadObserver
__factories["boss.BlackFortress.SquadObserver"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Enemy fortress fight has a four-aircraft squad; observe hop/downs, don't fake a respawn.
local SquadObserver = {}
function SquadObserver.new(env, config)
    local platform = env.services.roblox
    local player = platform:player()
    local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
    local obs = {lastSlot = nil, lastModel = nil, changes = 0, down = false}
    local function emit(name, data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit(name, data) end
    end
    local function slotFrom(packet)
        if type(packet) ~= "table" then return nil end
        for _, name in ipairs({"AircraftIndex", "Slot", "SquadSlot", "PlaneIndex"}) do
            if type(packet[name]) == "number" then return packet[name] end
        end
        return nil
    end
    function obs:observe(packet)
        if type(packet) ~= "table" then return end
        local slot = slotFrom(packet) or slotFrom(packet.State)
        if slot and slot ~= self.lastSlot then
            if self.lastSlot ~= nil then self.changes += 1 end
            self.lastSlot = slot
            emit("FORTRESS_AIRCRAFT_SLOT", {slot = slot, hops = self.changes, maxAircraft = config.maxAircraft})
        end
        if packet.K == "Down" or packet.K == "Eliminated" then self.down = true end
        if packet.K == "Release" or packet.K == "Hop" then self.down = false end
    end
    function obs:reset()
        self.lastSlot, self.lastModel, self.changes, self.down = nil, nil, 0, false
    end
    function obs:snapshot() return {slot = self.lastSlot, hops = self.changes,
        down = self.down, eliminated = player:GetAttribute(config.eliminatedAttribute) == true} end
    return obs
end
return SquadObserver
end
-- END MODULE boss.BlackFortress.SquadObserver

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.BossManager
__factories["boss.BossManager"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local Contracts = require("main.core.Contracts")
local FeaturePolicy = require("main.core.FeaturePolicy")
local EncounterRecovery = require("boss.shared.EncounterRecovery")
local BossManager = {}
function BossManager.policy()
    local policy = FeaturePolicy.defaults("BOSS")
    policy.requiresPlatform, policy.readOnlyRecovery = true, true
    return policy
end
function BossManager.new(definitions, scoped, automaticRecovery)
    local env, writer, recovery
    local bosses, metadata, deadlines, deadlineEpochs = {}, {}, {}, {}
    local resumeEncounterId
    local manager = {}
    local function snapshot() return env.state:snapshot().boss end
    local function deferred(code, stage, delay)
        local retryDelay = delay == 0 and env.profile.scheduler.poll or delay or env.profile.boss.reportRetry
        return Contracts.result("DEFERRED", code, {stage = stage, retryAt = env.runtime:now() + retryDelay})
    end
    local function held(code, message)
        return Contracts.result("HELD", code, {stage = snapshot().stage, stopFeature = true, message = message})
    end
    local function cancelled() return Contracts.result("CANCELLED", "BOSS_CANCELLED", {stage = snapshot().stage}) end
    local function bossFor(encounter, bossId)
        return bosses[encounter and encounter.bossId or bossId or (not scoped and snapshot().selectedBossId or nil)]
    end
    local function deadline(id)
        local record = snapshot().bosses[id]
        local untilEpoch = record and record.cooldownUntil
        if deadlineEpochs[id] ~= untilEpoch then
            deadlineEpochs[id] = untilEpoch
            deadlines[id] = bosses[id].repeatPolicy:deadline(untilEpoch)
        end
        return deadlines[id] or 0
    end
    function manager:registerBoss(definition)
        if not env.runtime:isAlive() then return false, "STOPPED" end
        if env.runtime:activeJob() then return false, "BUSY" end
        assert(type(definition) == "table", "Boss definition required")
        Contracts.assertKind(definition.bossId)
        if bosses[definition.bossId] then return false, "BOSS_ALREADY_REGISTERED" end
        assert(type(definition.displayName) == "string" and type(definition.create) == "function", "Invalid boss definition")
        local boss = definition.create(env)
        assert(type(boss) == "table" and type(boss.config) == "table", "Boss configuration required")
        assert(not scoped or not boss.crossPlace, "Cross-place execution requires its existing host")
        assert(boss.config.bossId == definition.bossId, "Boss configuration ID mismatch")
        local required = {
            command = {"prepare", "readiness", "startSolo", "close"}, observer = {"inArena"},
            combat = {"run"}, report = {"inspect", "resolve", "reconcile"},
            repeatPolicy = {"outcomeDelay", "readinessDelay", "deadline", "repeatEnabled"},
        }
        for group, methods in pairs(required) do
            assert(type(boss[group]) == "table", "Missing boss component: " .. group)
            for _, method in ipairs(methods) do assert(type(boss[group][method]) == "function", "Missing boss method: " .. group .. "." .. method) end
        end
        bosses[definition.bossId], metadata[definition.bossId] = boss, {bossId = definition.bossId, displayName = definition.displayName}
        return true
    end
    function manager:selectBoss(id)
        if not env.runtime:isAlive() then return false, "STOPPED" end
        if not bosses[id] then return false, "UNKNOWN_BOSS" end
        return writer:selectBoss(id)
    end
    function manager:chainCompatible(id, debt)
        local boss = bosses[id]
        if not recovery or not boss
            or not (boss.command.reuseVerifiedHideout or boss.command.deferVerifiedHideoutReturn) then return false end
        local live = env.services.encounterEvidence()
        return live.location == "PERSONAL_HIDEOUT" and live.world == debt.world
            and live.character and live.character.ready and writer:chainAvatarMatches(debt.id, live.character)
            and not live.transition and not live.downed
            and not live.inFight and not live.reportOpen and not boss.report:inspect().active
    end
    local function finishReturn(ctx, encounter, boss, request)
        if not encounter.reportClosed then return held("BOSS_RETURN_WITHOUT_REPORT") end
        if boss.report:inspect().active then return held("BOSS_REPORT_STILL_OPEN") end
        boss.command:close(ctx) -- Best effort, restricted to this boss's command GUI.
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return cancelled() end
        if recovery and boss.command.trackedWorldReturn then
            return recovery:reconcile(ctx, request, encounter, boss)
        end
        if recovery then
            local live = env.services.encounterEvidence()
            if live.transition or live.downed or not live.character or not live.character.ready then
                return recovery:wait(ctx, encounter, "RESPAWN_PENDING", "BOSS_RETURN_CHARACTER_UNVERIFIED")
            end
        end
        if recovery and encounter.bossId == "B2SPIRIT" and encounter.outcome == "LOSS" then
            return recovery:wait(ctx, encounter, "RESPAWN_PENDING", "BOSS_FAILED_ENCOUNTER_SETTLING")
        end
        -- Record the intended destination before the existing return path can
        -- submit. A later recovery job observes arrival without replaying it.
        if recovery and not writer:markReturnAttempt(encounter.encounterId, encounter.homeWorld) then
            return recovery:wait(ctx, encounter, "RETURN_PENDING", "BOSS_RETURN_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED")
        end
        -- Prefer the boss-specific verified direct world remote; do not open Worlds GUI.
        local returned
        if boss.command.returnHome then returned = boss.command:returnHome(ctx, encounter.homeWorld) end
        if not boss.command.returnHome or not scoped and not returned then
            returned = env.services.world:returnHome({homeWorld = encounter.homeWorld}, ctx)
        end
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return cancelled() end
        if scoped and (type(returned) ~= "table" or type(returned.ok) ~= "boolean") then
            return held("BOSS_RETURN_UNVERIFIED")
        end
        if not returned.ok then
            local result = deferred("BOSS_RETURN_PENDING", "RETURN")
            result.evidence = returned
            return result
        end
        if type(boss.report.verifyClosed) == "function" and not boss.report:verifyClosed() then
            return held("BOSS_REPORT_STILL_OPEN")
        end
        local function arrivalVerified()
            local live = env.services.encounterEvidence()
            return live.location == "WORLD" and live.world == encounter.homeWorld and not live.transition
                and not live.inFight and not live.reportOpen and live.character and live.character.ready
        end
        if recovery and not arrivalVerified() then
            return recovery:wait(ctx, encounter, "RETURN_PENDING", "BOSS_RETURN_ARRIVAL_UNVERIFIED")
        end
        -- DirectBossTravel does not mutate the WorldService-owned return flag.
        -- A verified return must clear it before completeEncounter checks the invariant.
        local function finish()
            assert(snapshot().encounter.encounterId == encounter.encounterId, "Boss return encounter changed")
            if recovery then assert(arrivalVerified() and not boss.report:inspect().active, "Boss return changed during cleanup") end
            writer:setReturnPending(false)
            writer:completeEncounter(boss.repeatPolicy:repeatEnabled())
        end
        if recovery then ctx:deferCommit(finish) else finish() end
        local remaining = encounter.cooldownUntil and encounter.cooldownUntil - env.runtime:epoch() or 0
        local retryAt = remaining > 0 and env.runtime:now() + remaining or nil
        if encounter.cooldownOnly then
            if retryAt then return Contracts.result("DEFERRED", "BOSS_COOLDOWN", {stage = "COMPLETE", retryAt = retryAt, evidence = returned}) end
            return Contracts.result("COMPLETED", "BOSS_COOLDOWN_RECOVERY_VERIFIED", {stage = "COMPLETE", evidence = returned})
        end
        return Contracts.result("COMPLETED", "BOSS_" .. encounter.outcome .. "_VERIFIED", {
            stage = "COMPLETE", retryAt = retryAt, evidence = {encounterId = encounter.encounterId,
                bossId = encounter.bossId, outcome = encounter.outcome, returnResult = returned}})
    end
    local function resolveReport(ctx, encounter, boss, request)
        if recovery then
            local function respawnBarrier()
                local live = env.services.encounterEvidence()
                if live.transition then return "BOSS_WORLD_TRANSITION_PENDING" end
                if live.downed then return "BOSS_GIVE_UP_OR_REVIVE_PENDING" end
            end
            local barrier = respawnBarrier()
            if barrier then return recovery:wait(ctx, encounter, "RESPAWN_PENDING", barrier) end
            ctx:monitorInterruption(function()
                local pending = respawnBarrier()
                if pending then ctx:interrupt(pending) end
            end)
        end
        local resolved = boss.report:resolve(ctx, encounter)
        if recovery then ctx:monitorInterruption(nil) end
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return cancelled() end
        if resolved.held then return held(resolved.code) end
        if not resolved.ok then return deferred(resolved.code, "REPORT") end
        return finishReturn(ctx, snapshot().encounter, boss, request)
    end
    local function runCombat(ctx, encounter, boss, request, rebound)
        local resourcesAvailable = request.resourcesAvailable or function() return not ctx:isCancelled() end
        while not ctx:isCancelled() do
            writer:setEncounterPhase("COMBAT")
            ctx:reportProgress(rebound and "ACTIVE_ENCOUNTER_REBIND" or "ACTIVE_COMBAT")
            if encounter.phase == "START_PENDING" and boss.command.combatStarted then boss.command:combatStarted() end
            if recovery and boss.combat.suspendsForContinuation and boss.report.watch then boss.report:watch(ctx) end
            local stopWatch = recovery and recovery:watchCombat(ctx, encounter, boss, rebound)
            local result = boss.combat:run(ctx, encounter, rebound)
            if stopWatch then stopWatch() end
            if ctx:isCancelled() then return cancelled() end
            if not recovery or not ctx:isCombatSuspended() then
                if recovery and rebound and result.code == "PILOT_REBIND_PENDING" then
                    return recovery:retryPilot(ctx, encounter)
                end
                writer:setEncounterPhase("REPORT", result.code)
                if result.code == "INPUT_ERROR" or result.code == "INPUT_CLEANUP_FAILED" then
                    return held("BOSS_" .. result.code, "Inspect saved input diagnostics before recovery")
                end
                if recovery and boss.report:inspect().outcome then
                    recovery:terminal(ctx, encounter, "BOSS_RESULT_OBSERVED")
                end
                -- Missing HUD, timeouts and radar success all require report proof.
                return resolveReport(ctx, snapshot().encounter, boss, request)
            end
            local decision = recovery:awaitContinuation(ctx, snapshot().encounter, boss, resourcesAvailable)
            if ctx:isCancelled() then return cancelled() end
            if decision and decision.outcome == "TERMINAL_ENCOUNTER_RECOVERY" then
                return recovery:reconcile(ctx, {resourcesAvailable=resourcesAvailable}, snapshot().encounter, boss)
            end
            if not decision or decision.outcome ~= "RESUME_ACTIVE_ENCOUNTER" then
                return recovery:wait(ctx, encounter, "RECOVERY_HELD", decision and decision.reason or "BOSS_RESPAWN_EVIDENCE_UNRESOLVED")
            end
            if not recovery:rebind(ctx, encounter, decision.reason) then
                return recovery:wait(ctx, encounter, "RECOVERY_HELD", "BOSS_REBIND_REJECTED")
            end
            encounter, rebound = snapshot().encounter, decision.avatar
        end
        return cancelled()
    end
    local function recover(ctx)
        assert(ctx.readOnly, "Boss recovery requires read-only context")
        local current = snapshot()
        local encounter, boss = current.encounter, bossFor(current.encounter)
        if not boss then return held("BOSS_DEFINITION_MISSING") end
        if not encounter or encounter.phase == "COMPLETE" then
            if current.reportPending or current.returnPending or env.state:snapshot().holds.BOSS then return held("BOSS_CHECKPOINT_MISSING") end
            return deferred("BOSS_NO_RECOVERY", "RECOVER")
        end
        if recovery then
            local hold = env.state:snapshot().holds.BOSS
            if not FeaturePolicy.canReconcileBossHold(hold) then
                return Contracts.result("HELD", hold, {stage="RECOVERY_HELD"})
            end
            writer:markRecovery(encounter.encounterId, "RESULT_INSPECTION", "BOSS_RECONCILIATION_REQUESTED", env.runtime:now())
            return deferred("BOSS_RECONCILIATION_REQUESTED", "RECOVER", 0)
        end
        if encounter.reportClosed then
            if boss.report:inspect().active then return held("BOSS_REPORT_STILL_OPEN") end
            writer:clearEncounterHold()
            return deferred("BOSS_RETURN_READY", "RECOVER", 0)
        end
        local evidence = boss.report:inspect()
        if evidence.outcome and encounter.outcome and evidence.outcome ~= encounter.outcome then return held("BOSS_OUTCOME_CONFLICT") end
        if boss.report:reconcile(encounter) then
            if evidence.outcome then
                assert(writer:recordBossReport(evidence.outcome, env.runtime:epoch() + boss.repeatPolicy:outcomeDelay(evidence.outcome)))
            end
            if not evidence.active then writer:closeReport() else writer:setEncounterPhase("REPORT") end
            writer:clearEncounterHold()
            return deferred("BOSS_REPORT_RECONCILED", "RECOVER", 0)
        end
        if not evidence.active and boss.observer:inArena() and (encounter.soloAttempted or encounter.adopted) then
            writer:setEncounterPhase("COMBAT")
            resumeEncounterId = encounter.encounterId
            writer:clearEncounterHold()
            return deferred("BOSS_COMBAT_READY", "RECOVER", 0)
        end
        if not evidence.active and not boss.observer:inArena() and not encounter.soloAttempted and not encounter.adopted then
            writer:abandonBeforeSolo()
            writer:clearEncounterHold()
            return deferred("BOSS_SETUP_RESET", "RECOVER", env.profile.boss.setupRetry)
        end
        return held("BOSS_REPORT_UNVERIFIED")
    end
    local function run(ctx, request)
        if request.stage == "RECOVER" then return recover(ctx) end
        local current = snapshot()
        local encounter = current.encounter
        local id = request.bossId
        if request.stage == "CHAIN_RETURN" then
            local boss = bosses[id]
            if not recovery or not boss then return held("CHAIN_RETURN_CONTROLLER_UNAVAILABLE") end
            encounter = writer:beginChainReturn(request.chainId, env.runtime:now())
            if not encounter then return held("CHAIN_RETURN_OWNERSHIP_CHANGED") end
            return recovery:reconcile(ctx, request, encounter, boss)
        end
        if request.stage == "ENCOUNTER_RECOVERY" then
            local boss = bossFor(encounter)
            if not recovery or not boss or not encounter or encounter.encounterId ~= request.encounterId
                or encounter.bossId ~= ctx.bossId or encounter.phase == "COMPLETE" then
                return held("BOSS_RECOVERY_ENCOUNTER_MISMATCH")
            end
            -- An accepted Solo can arrive after its original acknowledgement
            -- wait. Reattach only with fresh, positive local participation.
            if encounter.phase == "START_PENDING" and encounter.soloAttempted
                and env.state:settingsSnapshot().bossEnabled and request.resourcesAvailable() then
                local live, report = env.services.encounterEvidence(), boss.report:inspect()
                local entered
                if boss.command.entryStatus then
                    entered = boss.command:entryStatus() == "ENTERED"
                else
                    entered = live.inFight and boss.observer:inArena()
                end
                if entered and not live.transition and not live.downed and live.character and live.character.ready
                    and not report.active and not live.reportOpen and not report.outcome then
                    return runCombat(ctx, encounter, boss, request)
                end
            end
            if encounter.phase == "COMBAT" and request.resourcesAvailable() then
                if boss.report.watch then boss.report:watch(ctx) end
                local outcome, reason, avatar = recovery:classify(encounter, boss)
                if outcome == "RESUME_ACTIVE_ENCOUNTER" then
                    if not recovery:rebind(ctx, encounter, reason) then
                        return recovery:wait(ctx, encounter, "RECOVERY_HELD", "BOSS_REBIND_REJECTED")
                    end
                    return runCombat(ctx, snapshot().encounter, boss, request, avatar)
                end
            end
            return recovery:reconcile(ctx, request, encounter, boss)
        end
        if scoped and (not id or ctx.bossId ~= id) then return held("BOSS_DISPATCH_ID_MISMATCH") end
        if not scoped then id = current.selectedBossId end
        local pending = encounter and encounter.phase ~= "COMPLETE" and encounter or nil
        if scoped and (pending or current.reportPending or current.returnPending) then
            return held("BOSS_EXISTING_CHECKPOINT")
        end
        local boss = bossFor(pending, id)
        if not boss then return held("BOSS_DEFINITION_MISSING") end
        if request.chainId then
            local debt = env.state:snapshot().chain
            if not debt or not manager:chainCompatible(id, debt) or not writer:admitChainSuccessor(request.chainId) then
                return deferred("CHAIN_SUCCESSOR_UNVERIFIED", "CHAIN_RETURN_PENDING", 0)
            end
        end
        -- Cross-place raids manage their queue lifecycle without creating
        -- a single-place encounter checkpoint lost on teleport.
        if boss.crossPlace then return boss.crossPlace:run(ctx, request) end
        if current.reportPending or current.returnPending or encounter and encounter.phase ~= "COMPLETE" then
            if not encounter then return held("BOSS_CHECKPOINT_MISSING") end
            if encounter.reportClosed then return finishReturn(ctx, encounter, boss, request) end
            if resumeEncounterId == encounter.encounterId then
                resumeEncounterId = nil
                return runCombat(ctx, encounter, boss, request)
            end
            return resolveReport(ctx, encounter, boss, request)
        end
        if boss.command.trackedWorldReturn and not Contracts.isHomeWorld(request.homeWorld) then
            return held("BOSS_RETURN_TARGET_MISSING")
        end
        local evidence = boss.report:inspect()
        if evidence.active then
            if scoped then return held("BOSS_PREEXISTING_REPORT") end
            if not evidence.matchesBoss then return held("BOSS_FOREIGN_REPORT") end
            encounter = assert(writer:beginEncounter(id, request.homeWorld, env.runtime:epoch(), true))
            return resolveReport(ctx, encounter, boss, request)
        end
        if boss.observer:inArena() then
            if scoped then return held("BOSS_PREEXISTING_ENCOUNTER") end
            encounter = assert(writer:beginEncounter(id, request.homeWorld, env.runtime:epoch(), true))
            return runCombat(ctx, encounter, boss, request)
        end
        local verifiedHome
        if boss.command.deferVerifiedHideoutReturn and recovery and writer:canTransferReturn() then
            local origin = env.services.encounterEvidence()
            verifiedHome = origin.world == request.homeWorld and
                (origin.location == "WORLD" or origin.location == "PERSONAL_HIDEOUT"
                    and writer:verifiedHideoutOrigin(request.homeWorld, ctx, origin.character))
        end
        local prepared, prepareCode = boss.command:prepare(ctx)
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return cancelled() end
        if not prepared then
            if recovery then
                encounter = assert(writer:beginEncounter(id, request.homeWorld, env.runtime:epoch(), false))
                if boss.report.resetOutcome then boss.report:resetOutcome() end
                return recovery:wait(ctx, encounter, "LOCATION_VERIFICATION", prepareCode or "BOSS_SETUP_UNVERIFIED")
            end
            if scoped then return held("BOSS_SETUP_UNVERIFIED", prepareCode) end
            local result = deferred("BOSS_SETUP_PENDING", "SETUP", env.profile.boss.setupRetry)
            result.evidence = {reason = prepareCode}
            return result
        end
        local readiness = boss.command:readiness()
        local cooldownUntil = readiness ~= "READY" and env.runtime:epoch() + boss.repeatPolicy:readinessDelay(readiness) or nil
        writer:observeBoss(id, readiness, env.runtime:epoch(), cooldownUntil)
        if readiness ~= "READY" then
            encounter = assert(writer:beginCooldownReturn(id, request.homeWorld, cooldownUntil))
            return finishReturn(ctx, encounter, boss, request)
        end
        encounter = assert(writer:beginEncounter(id, request.homeWorld, env.runtime:epoch(), false, verifiedHome))
        if boss.report.resetOutcome then boss.report:resetOutcome() end
        local started, startCode = boss.command:startSolo(ctx, function()
            if request.chainId then
                local debt = env.state:snapshot().chain
                if not debt or debt.id ~= request.chainId or not manager:chainCompatible(id, debt)
                    or not request.resourcesAvailable() then return false end
            end
            return writer:markSoloAttempt()
        end)
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return cancelled() end
        if not started and recovery then
            local stage = boss.command.entryStatus and "ENTRY_PENDING" or "RESULT_INSPECTION"
            return recovery:wait(ctx, encounter, stage, startCode or "BOSS_START_UNVERIFIED")
        end
        if not started then return held("BOSS_START_UNVERIFIED", startCode) end
        return runCombat(ctx, snapshot().encounter, boss, request)
    end
    function manager:initialize(environment)
        assert(not env and environment.services, "BossManager requires an explicit platform")
        env, writer = environment, environment.state:port("boss")
        if automaticRecovery and type(env.services.encounterEvidence) == "function" then
            recovery = EncounterRecovery.new(env, writer)
        end
        for _, definition in ipairs(definitions or {}) do assert(self:registerBoss(definition)) end
        local ids = {}; for id in pairs(bosses) do ids[#ids + 1] = id end; table.sort(ids)
        assert(#ids > 0, "At least one inspected boss definition required")
        local current = snapshot()
        if not scoped and not current.selectedBossId then
            assert(writer:selectBoss(current.encounter and current.encounter.bossId or ids[1]))
        end
    end
    function manager:run(ctx, request)
        local ok, result = pcall(run, ctx, request)
        if not ok then result = held("BOSS_EXCEPTION", tostring(result)) end
        if recovery and request.stage ~= "RECOVER" then
            local encounter = snapshot().encounter
            if encounter and encounter.bossId == ctx.bossId and encounter.phase ~= "COMPLETE"
                and result.status ~= "COMPLETED"
                and not (encounter.cooldownOnly and result.code == "BOSS_COOLDOWN") then
                if result.code == "BOSS_EXCEPTION" then
                    local stage = encounter.recovery and encounter.recovery.interruption and "RECOVERY_HELD" or "RESULT_INSPECTION"
                    local deferred = recovery:wait(ctx, encounter, stage, result.code)
                    deferred.message = result.message
                    return deferred
                end
                if result.status == "HELD" and FeaturePolicy.canReconcileBossHold(result.code) then
                    result.stopFeature = nil
                end
                local recorded = encounter.recovery and result.status == "DEFERRED"
                    and encounter.recovery.retryAt == result.retryAt and encounter.recovery.reason == result.code
                if not recorded and (not encounter.recovery or not encounter.recovery.interruption) then
                    local stage = encounter.reportClosed and "RETURN_PENDING" or "REPORT_PENDING"
                    writer:markRecovery(encounter.encounterId, stage, result.code,
                        result.retryAt or env.runtime:now())
                end
            end
        end
        return result
    end
    function manager:poll()
        local current = snapshot()
        if current.encounter and current.encounter.phase ~= "COMPLETE" or current.reportPending or current.returnPending then return end
        if env.state:snapshot().holds.BOSS then return end
        local boss = bossFor()
        if not boss then writer:holdEncounter("BOSS_DEFINITION_MISSING"); return end
        local evidence = boss.report:inspect()
        if evidence.active then
            if not evidence.matchesBoss then writer:holdEncounter("BOSS_FOREIGN_REPORT"); return end
            writer:beginEncounter(current.selectedBossId, env.state:snapshot().config.homeWorld, env.runtime:epoch(), true)
        elseif boss.observer:inArena() then
            local encounter = writer:beginEncounter(current.selectedBossId, env.state:snapshot().config.homeWorld, env.runtime:epoch(), true)
            if encounter then writer:setEncounterPhase("COMBAT"); resumeEncounterId = encounter.encounterId end
        end
    end
    function manager:cooldown()
        local current = snapshot()
        if current.reportPending or current.returnPending then return current.nextCheckAt end
        if not bosses[current.selectedBossId] then return current.nextCheckAt end
        return math.max(current.nextCheckAt, deadline(current.selectedBossId))
    end
    function manager:status()
        local current, available = snapshot(), {}
        for id, boss in pairs(bosses) do
            local record = Contracts.copy(metadata[id])
            record.config, record.status = Contracts.copy(boss.config), Contracts.copy(current.bosses[id] or {})
            available[#available + 1] = record
        end
        table.sort(available, function(a, b) return a.bossId < b.bossId end)
        current.availableBosses = available
        return current
    end
    function manager:cancel()
        local selected = bossFor()
        if selected and selected.crossPlace and selected.crossPlace.cancel then
            selected.crossPlace:cancel()
        end
        local encounter = snapshot().encounter
        if encounter and encounter.phase ~= "COMPLETE" then
            if recovery and not encounter.recovery then
                writer:markRecovery(encounter.encounterId, "INTERRUPTED", "BOSS_ENCOUNTER_CANCELLED", env.runtime:now())
            end
            writer:holdEncounter("BOSS_ENCOUNTER_CANCELLED")
        end
    end
    function manager:cleanup(ctx)
        -- Runtime releases captured humanoids, speed, path connections and held input.
        -- Do not send Continue, SOLO, or teleport during cleanup.
        for _, boss in pairs(bosses) do
            if boss.report.cleanup then boss.report:cleanup(ctx) end
        end
    end
    return manager
end
return BossManager
end
-- END MODULE boss.BossManager

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.CarrierFortress.ArenaObserver
__factories["boss.CarrierFortress.ArenaObserver"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local ArenaObserver={}
function ArenaObserver.new(env,config)
    local platform=env.services.roblox
    local player=platform:player()
    local observer={sessionSeen=false}
    function observer:participating()
        if player:GetAttribute("CarrierParticipant")==true then return true end
        local w=platform:workspace()
        local state=w:GetAttribute("CarrierFightState")
        return player:GetAttribute("InBossFight")==true
            and (self.sessionSeen or state=="Active" or state=="Cinematic")
    end
    function observer:inArenaPosition(pos)
        pos=pos or platform:position()
        if typeof(pos)~="Vector3" then return false end
        local c=config.arenaFallbackCenter
        local d=Vector3.new(pos.X-c.x,0,pos.Z-c.z)
        return d.Magnitude<config.arenaRadius
            and pos.Y>config.arenaMinY and pos.Y<config.arenaMaxY
    end
    function observer:inArena()
        return self:participating() and self:inArenaPosition()
    end
    function observer:state()
        local w=platform:workspace()
        return {phase=w:GetAttribute("CarrierPhase") or player:GetAttribute("CarrierPhase"),
            fightState=w:GetAttribute("CarrierFightState"),
            active=w:GetAttribute("CarrierFightActive"),
            participant=self:participating(),sessionSeen=self.sessionSeen}
    end
    return observer
end
return ArenaObserver
end
-- END MODULE boss.CarrierFortress.ArenaObserver

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.CarrierFortress.CarrierFortress
__factories["boss.CarrierFortress.CarrierFortress"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local Config=require("boss.CarrierFortress.Config")
local ArenaObserver=require("boss.CarrierFortress.ArenaObserver")
local CommandController=require("boss.CarrierFortress.CommandController")
local CombatController=require("boss.CarrierFortress.CombatController")
local MechanicsController=require("boss.CarrierFortress.MechanicsController")
local ReportController=require("boss.CarrierFortress.ReportController")
local RepeatPolicy=require("boss.CarrierFortress.RepeatPolicy")
local CarrierFortress={}
function CarrierFortress.definition()
    return {bossId=Config.bossId,displayName=Config.displayName,create=function(env)
        local observer=ArenaObserver.new(env,Config)
        local mechanics=MechanicsController.new(env,Config,observer)
        local repeatPolicy=RepeatPolicy.new(env)
        local report=ReportController.new(env,Config,repeatPolicy,mechanics,observer)
        return {config=Config,observer=observer,mechanics=mechanics,report=report,
            repeatPolicy=repeatPolicy,command=CommandController.new(env,Config,observer,report),
            combat=CombatController.new(env,Config,observer,report,mechanics)}
    end}
end
return CarrierFortress
end
-- END MODULE boss.CarrierFortress.CarrierFortress

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.CarrierFortress.CombatController
__factories["boss.CarrierFortress.CombatController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local CombatController={}
function CombatController.new(env,config,observer,report,mechanics)
    local runtime,telemetry=env.runtime,env.services.telemetry
    local combat={}
    function combat:nativeEncounter() return report:nativeEncounter() end
    function combat:ownedNativeGeneration() return report:ownedNativeGeneration() end
    local function emit(kind,data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit("CARRIER_"..kind,data or {}) end
    end
    function combat:run(ctx,encounter)
        local ok,why=report:watch(ctx)
        if not ok then return {code=why or "CARRIER_REPORT_WATCH_FAILED"} end
        ok,why=mechanics:start(ctx)
        if not ok then return {code=why or "CARRIER_MECHANICS_START_FAILED"} end
        local deadline=runtime:now()+config.maxFightSeconds
        local nextStatusAt=0
        local result="OUTCOME_NOT_OBSERVED_TIMEOUT"
        while not ctx:isCancelled() and runtime:now()<deadline do
            local evidence=report:inspect()
            if evidence.outcome then result="OUTCOME_OBSERVED";break end
            mechanics:step()
            if runtime:now()>=nextStatusAt then
                emit("CARRIER_STATUS",mechanics:status())
                nextStatusAt=runtime:now()+9
            end
            if not ctx:wait(0.35) then break end
        end
        emit("CARRIER_SUMMARY",mechanics:status())
        mechanics:stop()
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return {code="CANCELLED"} end
        return {code=result}
    end
    return combat
end
return CombatController
end
-- END MODULE boss.CarrierFortress.CombatController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.CarrierFortress.CommandController
__factories["boss.CarrierFortress.CommandController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Carrier Standalone V1 flow: Hideout -> Boss Command pass -> ONE Solo -> combat.
-- Adaptive report may open in arena OR after exit; never request return before Continue.
local DirectBossTravel = require("main.navigation.DirectBossTravel")
local NativeBossEntry = require("boss.shared.NativeBossEntry")
local CommandController = {}

function CommandController.new(env, config, observer, report)
    local platform, runtime = env.services.roblox, env.runtime
    local player, workspace = platform:player(), platform:workspace()
    local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
    local travel = DirectBossTravel.new(env)
    local command = {}
    local function emit(name, data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit(name, data or {}) end
    end
    local function remote(name)
        local storage = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage")
        local folder = storage:FindFirstChild("Remotes") or storage:WaitForChild("Remotes", 10)
        local item = folder and (folder:FindFirstChild(name) or folder:WaitForChild(name, 7))
        return item and item:IsA("RemoteEvent") and item or nil
    end
    local function active(ctx) return runtime:isActive(ctx) and not ctx:isCancelled() end
    local function cooldownLeft()
        local raw = player:GetAttribute("BossStartCooldowns")
        if type(raw) ~= "string" or raw == "" then return 0 end
        local ok, data = pcall(function() return platform:service("HttpService"):JSONDecode(raw) end)
        if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then return 0 end
        return math.max(0, (tonumber(data[config.gameBossKey]) or 0) - workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
    end

    function command:prepare(ctx)
        if observer:inArena() then return true, "CARRIER_ALREADY_IN_ARENA" end
        if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true then return false, "OTHER_BOSS_ACTIVE" end
        if not active(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        -- V3: wait for Carrier cooldown BEFORE issuing Boss Command requests.
        local left = cooldownLeft()
        if left > 0 and config.waitForCooldown then
            if left > config.maxCooldownWaitSeconds then
                emit("CARRIER_COOLDOWN_GATE", {remaining = math.ceil(left), code = "WAIT_LIMIT"})
                return false, "CARRIER_COOLDOWN_ABOVE_WAIT_LIMIT"
            end
            emit("CARRIER_COOLDOWN_WAIT", {remaining = math.ceil(left)})
            local untilTime = runtime:now() + config.maxCooldownWaitSeconds
            local lastTick = runtime:now()
            while active(ctx) and cooldownLeft() > 0 and runtime:now() < untilTime do
                if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true then
                    return false, "OTHER_ENCOUNTER_BECAME_ACTIVE"
                end
                if runtime:now() - lastTick >= 25 then
                    lastTick = runtime:now()
                    emit("CARRIER_COOLDOWN_WAITING", {remaining = math.ceil(cooldownLeft())})
                end
                if not ctx:wait(math.min(3, math.max(0.5, cooldownLeft()))) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
            end
            if not active(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
            if cooldownLeft() > 0 then return false, "CARRIER_COOLDOWN_WAIT_LIMIT_REACHED" end
            emit("CARRIER_COOLDOWN_READY", {remaining = 0})
        end
        local entered = travel:enterHideout(ctx)
        emit("CARRIER_DIRECT_HIDEOUT", {ok = entered.ok, code = entered.code, reason = entered.reason})
        if not entered.ok then return false, entered.code end
        local positioned = travel:moveToKnownPoint(ctx, config.commandSafePosition, {
            requireHideout = true, radius = 6, settle = 0.85,
        })
        emit("CARRIER_COMMAND_POSITION", {ok = positioned.ok, code = positioned.code})
        if not positioned.ok then return false, positioned.code end
        return true, "CARRIER_COMMAND_READY"
    end

    function command:readiness()
        if observer:inArena() then return "READY" end
        if not travel:inHideout() then return "UNKNOWN" end
        local secs = cooldownLeft()
        if secs > 0 then
            secs = math.ceil(secs)
            return string.format("%d:%02d", math.floor(secs / 60), secs % 60)
        end
        -- The server pass remains authoritative for unlock/eligibility.
        return "READY"
    end

    local entry = NativeBossEntry.new(env, config, observer, report, "CarrierCommanderAccept", remote)
    function command:entryStatus() return entry:status() end
    function command:combatStarted() report.entry:combatStarted() end

    function command:startSolo(ctx, markAttempt)
        if not active(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        if observer:participating() then return false, "BOSS_ENTRY_PREEXISTING_PARTICIPATION" end
        if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true then return false, "OTHER_BOSS_ACTIVE" end
        if not travel:inHideout() then return false, "NOT_IN_HIDEOUT" end
        if self:readiness() ~= "READY" then return false, "CARRIER_NOT_READY" end
        local watching, why = report:watch(ctx)
        if not watching then return false, why end
        return entry:start(ctx, markAttempt)
    end

    function command:close(_) return true end -- No command GUI was opened.

    function command:returnHome(ctx, home)
        if not active(ctx) then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        if type(home) ~= "number" or home < 1 or home % 1 ~= 0 then
            return {ok = false, code = "INVALID_HOME_WORLD"}
        end
        if report:inspect().active then return {ok = false, code = "CARRIER_REPORT_STILL_OPEN"} end
        -- Preserve standalone V1 lock checks before return, regardless of report location.
        local released = ctx:await(function()
            if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true
                and player:GetAttribute("CarrierParticipant") ~= true then return true end
        end, config.returnLockTimeoutSeconds)
        if not released then
            emit("CARRIER_RETURN_LOCK_PENDING", {world = home})
            return {ok = false, code = "CARRIER_RETURN_LOCK_PENDING", reason = "BossFight"}
        end
        local exit = ctx:await(function()
            if player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") == true then return "BOSS_COMMAND_HIDEOUT" end
            if not observer:inArenaPosition() then return "OUTSIDE_ARENA" end
        end, config.exitTimeoutSeconds)
        emit("CARRIER_ARENA_EXIT", {code = exit or "LOCK_RELEASED_STILL_IN_ARENA"})
        -- As in tested standalone V1, a released lock permits a direct verified travel even
        -- if the game has not repositioned the player outside the arena yet.
        if not ctx:wait(1.5) then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        local request, prepare, result = remote("RequestWorldTravel"), remote("NavPrepareWorlds"), remote("WorldTravelResult")
        if not request or not prepare then return {ok = false, code = "CARRIER_WORLD_TRAVEL_REMOTES_MISSING"} end
        local position = platform:position()
        if not position then return {ok = false, code = "CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE"} end
        if tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")) == home
            and player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") ~= true
            and not observer:inArenaPosition() then
            return {ok = true, code = "ALREADY_IN_HOME", world = home}
        end
        local reply
        local connection = result and result.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
            if type(e) == "table" and e.Kind == "Result" and tonumber(e.WorldId) == home then reply = e end
        end) or nil
        local function finish(ok, code, reason)
            if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
            emit("CARRIER_DIRECT_RETURN", {ok = ok, code = code, reason = reason, world = home})
            return {ok = ok, code = code, reason = reason, world = home}
        end
        for attempt = 1, config.returnRetries do
            if not active(ctx) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            reply = nil
            local prior = platform:position()
            if not prior then return finish(false, "CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE") end
            local sent, err = pcall(function() prepare:FireServer("stream", home) end)
            if not sent then return finish(false, "WORLD_PREPARE_SEND_FAILED", tostring(err)) end
            if not ctx:wait(0.12) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            sent, err = pcall(function() request:FireServer(home) end)
            if not sent then return finish(false, "WORLD_REQUEST_SEND_FAILED", tostring(err)) end
            local observed = ctx:await(function()
                if reply and reply.Ok == false then return "REJECTED" end
                local current = platform:position()
                if current and platform:distance(current, prior) > 50
                    and tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")) == home
                    and player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") ~= true
                    and player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true
                    and not observer:inArenaPosition() then return "VERIFIED" end
            end, 17)
            emit("CARRIER_RETURN_ATTEMPT", {attempt = attempt, code = observed or "AMBIGUOUS",
                reason = reply and reply.Reason})
            if observed == "VERIFIED" then return finish(true, "CARRIER_HOME_VERIFIED") end
            if observed ~= "REJECTED" then return finish(false, "CARRIER_RETURN_AMBIGUOUS_NO_RETRY") end
            local why = tostring(reply.Reason or "UNKNOWN")
            if why ~= "BossFight" or attempt == config.returnRetries then
                return finish(false, "CARRIER_WORLD_RETURN_REJECTED", why)
            end
            if not ctx:wait(12) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            local settled = ctx:await(function()
                if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true then return true end
            end, 40)
            if not settled then return finish(false, "CARRIER_LOCK_STILL_ACTIVE", "BossFight") end
        end
        return finish(false, "CARRIER_WORLD_RETURN_EXHAUSTED")
    end
    return command
end
return CommandController
end
-- END MODULE boss.CarrierFortress.CommandController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.CarrierFortress.Config
__factories["boss.CarrierFortress.Config"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict

-- Ground objective / rooftop hazard boss; no manual aircraft controller.
return {
    bossId="CARRIER", displayName="Carrier Fortress", gameBossKey="CarrierFortress",
    world=73,
    commandSafePosition={x=-31962.1074,y=344.357483,z=32887.3203},
    arenaFallbackCenter={x=-13120,y=656,z=-18471},arenaRadius=1200,
    arenaMinY=450,arenaMaxY=1800,
    arenaTimeout=48,maxFightSeconds=1000,
    reportTimeoutSeconds=125,reportHoldSeconds=3,
    reportCloseTimeoutSeconds=125,exitTimeoutSeconds=110,

    waitForCooldown=true,maxCooldownWaitSeconds=800,
    autoObjectives=true,directObjectiveTeleport=true,objectiveRetrySeconds=12,
    autoBuildingDodge=true,autoGroundBreakDodge=true,directDodgeTeleport=true,
