-- END MODULE boss.CarrierFortress.Config

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.CarrierFortress.MechanicsController
__factories["boss.CarrierFortress.MechanicsController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Ground mechanics from live-tested Carrier Fortress V2, including early BuildingStrike
-- warning, raycast-confirmed roof evacuation and paused objective movement.
-- Does not fabricate boss hits, objective progress, teleports to unknown rooftops, or reports.
local MechanicsController={}
function MechanicsController.new(env,settings,observer)
    local platform=env.services.roblox
    local P=platform:player()
    local W=platform:workspace()
    local RS=platform:service("ReplicatedStorage")
    local telemetry=env.services.telemetry
    local riftHazards=env.services.riftHazards
    local CENTRE=Vector3.new(-13120,656,-18471)
    local T={running=false,phase=1,sessionSeen=false,generation=nil,
        objective=nil,objectiveProgress=0,delivered=0,carried=false,holding=false,
        objectiveAttempts=0,objectiveMoves=0,objectiveStalls=0,
        fortressHp=nil,fortressMaxHp=nil,cityStrikes=0,lastThreat=nil,
        outcome=nil,combatStarted=false,dodgeCount=0,dodgeFailures=0,
        lastDodge=nil,lastWarning=nil,activeWarnings=0}
    local mechanics={}
    local job
    local completed=false
    local lastObjectiveLog=0
    local lastProgressTime=0
    local lastProgressKey=nil
    local lastProgressValue=nil
    local lastMoveAt=0
    local lastThreatAt=0
    local prevHp=nil
    local lastDamageLog=0
    local nextObjectiveCheck=0
    local lastEvacuatedAt=0
    local lastSafeAnchor=nil
    local lastDodgeGateLog=0
    local lastObjectivePauseLog=0
    local activeThreats={}
    local dodgeStep
    local function log(kind,data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit("CARRIER_"..kind,data or {}) end
    end
    local function stage(s,data)
        log("STAGE",{stage=s,details=data})
    end
    local function root()
        local char=P.Character
        return char,char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    end
    local function fmtPos(v)
        if typeof(v)~="Vector3" then return nil end
        return {x=math.floor(v.X*10)/10,y=math.floor(v.Y*10)/10,z=math.floor(v.Z*10)/10}
    end
    local function inArena(pos)
        return observer:inArenaPosition(pos)
    end
    local function isParticipating()
        return observer:participating()
    end
-- BUILDING DODGE: based on the *early* CarrierSessionUpdate/BuildingStrike event.
-- CarrierFortressClient delays collapse by RunSeconds-4.5s, so the warning is actionable.
-- e.At is a server timestamp, NOT a world coordinate. e.Index selects City.Buildings[Index].
-- No fabricated damage, remote, or battle state. Only PivotTo an observed solid rooftop.

local function flatDist(a,b)
    if typeof(a)~="Vector3" or typeof(b)~="Vector3" then return math.huge end
    return (Vector3.new(a.X,0,a.Z)-Vector3.new(b.X,0,b.Z)).Magnitude
end

local function findCarrierArena()
    local name="BossRuntimeScenes"
    local folder=RS:FindFirstChild("Modules")
    local cfg=folder and folder:FindFirstChild("BossArenaConfig")
    if cfg and cfg:IsA("ModuleScript") then
        local ok,c=pcall(getfenv(0)["require"],cfg)
        if ok and type(c)=="table" and type(c.RuntimeScenesFolder)=="string" then
            name=c.RuntimeScenesFolder
        end
    end
    local scenes=W:FindFirstChild(name)
    if scenes then
        for _,wrapper in ipairs(scenes:GetChildren()) do
            if wrapper.Name:sub(1,#"CarrierFortressFight")=="CarrierFortressFight" then
                local city=wrapper:FindFirstChild("SkyCity")
                if city then return city end
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function cityRaycast(arena,x,z,fromY,length)
    local params=RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances={arena}
    return W:Raycast(Vector3.new(x,fromY,z),Vector3.new(0,-length,0),params)
end

local function solidRoof(arena,x,z)
    if not arena then return nil end
    local h=cityRaycast(arena,x,z,1160,660)
    if not h or not h.Instance:IsA("BasePart") or not h.Instance.CanCollide
        or h.Normal.Y<0.88 or h.Position.Y<645 or h.Position.Y>1000 then return nil end
    -- Four footprint probes; avoid teleporting onto ledges, signs, or tiny decorations.
    for _,offset in ipairs({Vector2.new(5,0),Vector2.new(-5,0),
        Vector2.new(0,5),Vector2.new(0,-5)}) do
        local r=cityRaycast(arena,x+offset.X,z+offset.Y,1160,660)
        if not r or not r.Instance:IsA("BasePart") or not r.Instance.CanCollide
            or r.Normal.Y<0.86 or math.abs(r.Position.Y-h.Position.Y)>3.5 then return nil end
    end
    return h.Position+Vector3.new(0,4.25,0)
end

local function roofUnderPlayer(arena,pos)
    if not arena or typeof(pos)~="Vector3" then return false end
    local r=cityRaycast(arena,pos.X,pos.Z,pos.Y+3,23)
    return r~=nil and r.Instance:IsA("BasePart") and r.Instance.CanCollide
        and r.Normal.Y>0.8 and pos.Y-r.Position.Y>=0 and pos.Y-r.Position.Y<12
end

local function currentThreats()
    local now=os.clock()
    for i=#activeThreats,1,-1 do
        if activeThreats[i].untilAt < now then table.remove(activeThreats,i) end
    end
    local result={}
    for _,th in ipairs(activeThreats) do result[#result+1]=th end
    if riftHazards and type(riftHazards.groundFootprints)=="function" then
        local ok,spots=pcall(riftHazards.groundFootprints,riftHazards,1.6)
        if ok and type(spots)=="table" then
            for _,spot in ipairs(spots) do
                if typeof(spot.p)=="Vector3" and type(spot.r)=="number" then
                    result[#result+1]={kind="GROUND_BREAK",position=spot.p,
                        radius=spot.r+8,index=spot.key,source="RIFT_STRIKES",
                        untilAt=now+0.5,evacuated=false}
                end
            end
        end
    end
    T.activeWarnings=#result
    return result
end

local function anyStrikeActive()
    for _,th in ipairs(currentThreats()) do
        if th.kind=="BUILDING_STRIKE" or th.source=="RIFT_STRIKES" then return true end
    end
    return false
end

local function chooseSafeRoof(arena,here,threat)
    -- Only return points verified to have a solid, horizontal roof beneath them.
    local centre=threat.position or here
    local vx=here.X-centre.X
    local vz=here.Z-centre.Z
    local length=math.sqrt(vx*vx+vz*vz)
    if length<12 then vx,vz=1,0 else vx,vz=vx/length,vz/length end
    local best,bestScore=nil,-math.huge
    local bestSource=nil
    local allThreats=currentThreats() -- stable snapshot for all roof candidates
    local function offer(x,z,source)
        local p=Vector3.new(x,here.Y,z)
        if flatDist(p,CENTRE)>325 or flatDist(p,here)<settings.safeRoofMinDistance then return end
        if threat.position and flatDist(p,threat.position)<(threat.radius or settings.buildingDangerRadius)+45 then return end
        for _,t in ipairs(allThreats) do
            if t.position and flatDist(p,t.position)<(t.radius or 35)+40 then return end
        end
        local roof=solidRoof(arena,x,z)
        if not roof then return end
        local score=flatDist(roof,centre)*0.5+flatDist(roof,here)*0.2
            -math.abs(roof.Y-here.Y)*0.1
        if score>bestScore then best=roof;bestScore=score;bestSource=source or "RAYCAST" end
    end
    -- Favor rooftops away from the marked building, then search the whole city.
    for _,radius in ipairs({125,175,235,290}) do
        for i=0,11 do
            local a=i*math.pi/6
            local dx=math.cos(a)*vx-math.sin(a)*vz
            local dz=math.sin(a)*vx+math.cos(a)*vz
            offer(here.X+dx*radius,here.Z+dz*radius,"RADIAL")
        end
    end
    for _,radius in ipairs({125,215,295}) do
        for i=0,15 do
            local a=i*math.pi/8
            offer(CENTRE.X+math.cos(a)*radius,CENTRE.Z+math.sin(a)*radius,"CENTRE_RING")
        end
    end
    -- City's rooftop layout is sparse; use actual solid roof parts as backup.
    -- Require the same raycast footprint validation as radial candidates.
    for _,part in ipairs(arena:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.CanCollide
            and part.CFrame.UpVector.Y>0.9 and part.Size.X>=12 and part.Size.Z>=12 then
            local top=part.Position+part.CFrame.UpVector*(part.Size.Y*0.5)
            if top.Y>645 and top.Y<1000 then
                offer(top.X,top.Z,"ROOF_PART")
            end
        end
    end
    return best,bestSource
end

local function addThreat(kind,pos,index,seconds,radius,source)
    local t={kind=kind,position=pos,index=index,radius=radius,
        since=os.clock(),untilAt=os.clock()+seconds,source=source,evacuated=false}
    activeThreats[#activeThreats+1]=t
    T.lastWarning={kind=kind,index=index,source=source,position=fmtPos(pos),seconds=seconds}
    T.activeWarnings=#activeThreats
    log("DODGE_WARNING",T.lastWarning)
    local owner = job
    if owner then task.defer(function() if job == owner then dodgeStep() end end) end
end

-- Runs immediately on warning AND periodically, including if player enters later.
dodgeStep=function()
    if not T.running or completed or not job or job:isClosing() or job:isCancelled()
        or P:GetAttribute("CarrierEliminated")==true then return end
    if W:GetAttribute("CarrierFightState")~="Active" or not isParticipating() then return end
    local ch,hrp=root()
    local hum=ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not ch or not hrp or not hum or hum.Health<=0 or not inArena(hrp.Position) then return end
    local threats=currentThreats()
    if #threats==0 then return end
    local arena=findCarrierArena()
    if not arena then
        if os.clock()-lastDodgeGateLog>3 then
            lastDodgeGateLog=os.clock()
            log("DODGE_GATE",{reason="CITY_ARENA_NOT_REPLICATED"})
        end
        return
    end
    for _,th in ipairs(threats) do
        local near=th.position and flatDist(hrp.Position,th.position)<=th.radius
        local fallback=not th.position and th.kind=="BUILDING_STRIKE"
            and settings.evacuateOnUnknownBuilding and roofUnderPlayer(arena,hrp.Position)
        local danger=near or fallback
        local stillAtSafeAnchor=th.evacuated and th.safeAnchor
            and flatDist(hrp.Position,th.safeAnchor)<45
        if danger and not stillAtSafeAnchor and (th.kind~="BUILDING_STRIKE" or settings.autoBuildingDodge)
            and (th.kind~="GROUND_BREAK" or settings.autoGroundBreakDodge) then
            if os.clock()-lastEvacuatedAt<2 then return end
            if fallback and lastSafeAnchor and flatDist(hrp.Position,lastSafeAnchor)<32 then
                -- Unknown building index: don't keep teleporting away from a safe rooftop.
                th.evacuated=true
                return
            end
            local dest,safeMethod=chooseSafeRoof(arena,hrp.Position,th)
            if not dest then
                if os.clock()-lastDodgeGateLog>2 then
                    lastDodgeGateLog=os.clock()
                    log("DODGE_GATE",{reason="NO_VERIFIED_SAFE_ROOF",threat=th.kind,
                        index=th.index,source=th.source,position=fmtPos(hrp.Position)})
                end
                T.dodgeFailures+=1
                return
            end
            lastEvacuatedAt=os.clock()
            local from=hrp.Position
            local ok,err
            if settings.directDodgeTeleport then
                ok,err=pcall(function() ch:PivotTo(CFrame.new(dest)) end)
            else
                ok,err=pcall(function() hum:MoveTo(dest) end)
            end
            if not ok then
                T.dodgeFailures+=1
                log("DODGE_ERROR",{error=tostring(err),index=th.index})
                return
            end
            th.evacuated=true
            th.safeAnchor=dest
            lastSafeAnchor=dest
            T.dodgeCount+=1
            T.lastDodge={kind=th.kind,index=th.index,source=th.source,
                from=fmtPos(from),to=fmtPos(dest),safeMethod=safeMethod,
                mode=settings.directDodgeTeleport and "TP" or "MOVETO"}
            log("DODGE_TELEPORT",T.lastDodge)
            task.delay(.55,function()
                if not T.running then return end
                local _,after=root()
                if not after then return end
                local d=(after.Position-dest).Magnitude
                log("DODGE_VERIFY",{index=th.index,code=d<14 and "REACHED" or "NOT_REACHED",
                    distance=math.floor(d*10)/10,position=fmtPos(after.Position)})
            end)
            return true -- no objective teleport in the same native tick
        end
    end
end

local function onObjective(e)
    if typeof(e.Position)~="Vector3" then
        log("OBJECTIVE_GATE",{reason="MISSING_POSITION",kind=e.Kind2})
        return
    end
    local mode=e.Kind2=="CargoRun" and "CARGO" or "DESIGNATOR"
    T.objective={kind=mode,position=e.Position,to=typeof(e.To)=="Vector3" and e.To or nil,
        radius=tonumber(e.Radius) or 20,
        pickupRadius=tonumber(e.PickupRadius) or 14,
        deliveryRadius=tonumber(e.DeliverRadius) or 16,
        required=tonumber(e.Required) or 1,
        holdSeconds=tonumber(e.HoldSeconds) or 6,
        created=os.clock(),active=true}
    T.objectiveProgress=0;T.carried=false;T.holding=false;T.delivered=0
    lastProgressTime=os.clock();lastProgressKey=nil;lastProgressValue=nil
    nextObjectiveCheck=0
    stage("OBJECTIVE_"..mode,{phase=T.phase,from=fmtPos(e.Position),to=fmtPos(e.To),
        required=T.objective.required,holdSeconds=T.objective.holdSeconds})
end
local function onProgress(e)
    local prevKey=tostring(T.carried)..":"..tostring(T.delivered)
    local prev=T.objectiveProgress
    T.objectiveProgress=tonumber(e.Progress) or T.objectiveProgress
    if e.Carried~=nil then T.carried=e.Carried==true end
    if e.Holding~=nil then T.holding=e.Holding==true end
    if e.Delivered~=nil then T.delivered=tonumber(e.Delivered) or T.delivered end
    local key=tostring(T.carried)..":"..tostring(T.delivered)
    if key~=prevKey or math.abs((T.objectiveProgress or 0)-(prev or 0))>0.04 then
        lastProgressTime=os.clock()
    end
    if os.clock()-lastObjectiveLog>1.8 or key~=prevKey then
        lastObjectiveLog=os.clock()
        log("OBJECTIVE_PROGRESS",{kind=T.objective and T.objective.kind,
            progress=math.floor((T.objectiveProgress or 0)*100),
            carried=T.carried,holding=T.holding,delivered=T.delivered,
            required=T.objective and T.objective.required})
    end
end

local function moveObjective(point,reason)
    if not settings.autoObjectives or not T.objective then return false,"DISABLED" end
    if typeof(point)~="Vector3" then return false,"NO_TARGET" end
    if not inArena(point) then
        log("OBJECTIVE_GATE",{reason="OBJECTIVE_OUTSIDE_ARENA",position=fmtPos(point)})
        return false,"TARGET_OUTSIDE_ARENA"
    end
    local ch,hrp=root()
    local humanoid=ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not ch or not hrp or not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 then return false,"CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE" end
    if not inArena(hrp.Position) then return false,"NOT_INSIDE_CARRIER_ARENA" end
    local target=Vector3.new(point.X,point.Y+3.4,point.Z)
    local flat=(Vector3.new(hrp.Position.X,0,hrp.Position.Z)-Vector3.new(target.X,0,target.Z)).Magnitude
    local vertical=math.abs(hrp.Position.Y-target.Y)
    if flat<4.5 and vertical<7 then return true,"AT_TARGET" end
    if os.clock()-lastMoveAt<1.8 then return false,"MOVE_RATE_LIMIT" end
    lastMoveAt=os.clock()
    if settings.directObjectiveTeleport then
        local ok,err=pcall(function() ch:PivotTo(CFrame.new(target)) end)
        if not ok then return false,"PIVOT_FAILED: "..tostring(err) end
    else
        humanoid:MoveTo(target)
    end
    T.objectiveMoves+=1
    if settings.directObjectiveTeleport then
        task.delay(.55,function()
            if not T.running then return end
            local _,after=root()
            if not after then return end
            local dx=Vector3.new(after.Position.X-target.X,0,after.Position.Z-target.Z).Magnitude
            if dx>10 then log("OBJECTIVE_MOVE_RESULT",{code="NOT_REACHED",distance=math.floor(dx),
                note="Native server correction or invalid roof could have moved the character"}) end
        end)
    end
    log("OBJECTIVE_MOVE",{reason=reason,to=fmtPos(target),from=fmtPos(hrp.Position),
        delta=math.floor(flat),mode=settings.directObjectiveTeleport and "DIRECT" or "MOVETO"})
    return true,"MOVE_SENT"
end
local function objectiveStep()
    local o=T.objective
    if not o or not settings.autoObjectives then return end
    if W:GetAttribute("CarrierFightState")~="Active" then return end
    if settings.autoBuildingDodge and anyStrikeActive() then
        if os.clock()-lastObjectivePauseLog>5 then
            lastObjectivePauseLog=os.clock()
            log("OBJECTIVE_PAUSED",{reason="BUILDING_STRIKE_WARNING",
                note="Prevents objective teleport back onto a collapsing roof"})
        end
        return
    end
    if os.clock()<nextObjectiveCheck then return end
    nextObjectiveCheck=os.clock()+0.65
    if not (P:GetAttribute("InBossFight")==true or P:GetAttribute("CarrierParticipant")==true) then return end
    local target=o.position
    local mode="DESIGNATOR_HOLD"
    if o.kind=="CARGO" then
        if T.carried then
            target=o.to
            mode="CARGO_DELIVER"
            if not target then
                log("OBJECTIVE_GATE",{reason="CARGO_DELIVERY_POSITION_MISSING"})
                return
            end
        else
            target=o.position
            mode="CARGO_PICKUP"
        end
    end
    local ok,why=moveObjective(target,mode)
    if ok and why=="AT_TARGET" and o.kind=="CARGO" and not T.carried
        and os.clock()-lastProgressTime>settings.objectiveRetrySeconds then
        local char=P.Character
        local humanoid=char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid and humanoid.Health>0 then
            humanoid.Jump=true
            T.objectiveAttempts+=1
            log("OBJECTIVE_RETRY",{reason="PICKUP_NO_PROGRESS",attempt=T.objectiveAttempts})
            lastProgressTime=os.clock()
        end
    end
    if os.clock()-lastProgressTime>settings.objectiveRetrySeconds and os.clock()-lastObjectiveLog>3 then
        T.objectiveStalls+=1;lastObjectiveLog=os.clock()
        log("OBJECTIVE_STALL",{kind=o.kind,mode=mode,holding=T.holding,carried=T.carried,
            delivered=T.delivered,progress=T.objectiveProgress,moveResult=why})
    end
end

    function mechanics:onFightStart(e)
        if type(e)=="table" then
            T.generation=e.Generation or T.generation
            T.fortressHp=tonumber(e.CurrentHP) or T.fortressHp
            T.fortressMaxHp=tonumber(e.MaxHP) or T.fortressMaxHp
        end
        T.sessionSeen=true
        observer.sessionSeen=true
        log("SESSION_START",{generation=T.generation,
            active=W:GetAttribute("CarrierFightActive"),participant=isParticipating()})
    end
    function mechanics:onHealth(cur,max,phase,extra)
        T.fortressHp=tonumber(cur) or T.fortressHp
        T.fortressMaxHp=tonumber(max) or T.fortressMaxHp
        if prevHp and T.fortressHp and T.fortressHp<prevHp
            and os.clock()-lastDamageLog>4 then
            lastDamageLog=os.clock()
            log("BOSS_DAMAGE",{phase=T.phase,
                remainingPercent=T.fortressMaxHp and
                    math.floor(T.fortressHp/T.fortressMaxHp*1000)/10 or nil})
        end
        prevHp=T.fortressHp
    end
    function mechanics:observe(e)
        if type(e)~="table" then return end
        local k=e.Kind
        if k=="Phase" then
            T.phase=tonumber(e.Phase) or T.phase
            log("PHASE",{phase=T.phase,name=e.Name})
        elseif k=="Objective" then
            onObjective(e)
        elseif k=="ObjectiveProgress" then
            onProgress(e)
        elseif k=="ObjectiveEnd" then
            log("OBJECTIVE_END",{completed=e.Completed,unlocked=e.Unlocked,
                boost=e.Boost,seconds=e.Seconds,kind=T.objective and T.objective.kind})
            T.objective=nil;T.carried=false;T.holding=false
        elseif k=="Begin" or k=="Launch" then
            T.combatStarted=true
            observer.sessionSeen=true
            log("FIGHT_EVENT",{name=k,phase=T.phase})
        elseif k=="BuildingStrike" then
            T.cityStrikes+=1
            local ix=tonumber(e.Index)
            local pos,source
            if typeof(e.Position)=="Vector3" and inArena(e.Position) then
                pos=e.Position;source="EVENT_POSITION"
            else
                source="ROOF_GEOMETRY_FALLBACK"
            end
            local seconds=math.clamp(tonumber(e.RunSeconds) or 9.5,4,25)
            log("BUILDING_STRIKE",{index=ix,at=e.At,count=T.cityStrikes,
                source=source,position=fmtPos(pos),runSeconds=seconds})
            if settings.autoBuildingDodge then
                addThreat("BUILDING_STRIKE",pos,ix,seconds+2,
                    settings.buildingDangerRadius,source)
            end
        elseif k=="GroundBreak" then
            T.lastThreat=e.Position
            lastThreatAt=os.clock()
            if typeof(e.Position)=="Vector3" then
                log("GROUND_BREAK",{position=fmtPos(e.Position)})
                if settings.autoGroundBreakDodge then
                    addThreat("GROUND_BREAK",e.Position,nil,5,
                        settings.groundBreakDangerRadius,"EVENT_POSITION")
                end
            end
        elseif k=="FallingOut" then
            if e.UserId==P.UserId then log("FALLING_OUT",{phase=T.phase}) end
        elseif k=="FleetWave" or k=="FleetRefill" then
            log("ENEMY_FLEET",{kind=k,count=e.Count})
        elseif k=="End" then
            log("FIGHT_END",{reason=e.Reason,victory=e.Victory})
        elseif k=="Outcome" and not completed then
            completed=true
            T.outcome={victory=e.Victory==true,reason=tostring(e.Reason),rewardEligible=e.RewardEligible}
            log("OUTCOME_EVENT",T.outcome)
        end
    end
    function mechanics:start(ctx)
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return false,"CANCELLED" end
        job=ctx
        T.running=true
        ctx:deferCleanup(function() self:stop() end)
        log("CARRIER_CAPABILITIES",{manualFlightNeeded=false,
            autoObjectives=settings.autoObjectives,
            buildingDodge=settings.autoBuildingDodge,groundDodge=settings.autoGroundBreakDodge})
        return true
    end
    function mechanics:step()
        if not T.running or completed or not job or job:isClosing() or job:isCancelled()
            or P:GetAttribute("CarrierEliminated")==true then return end
        if dodgeStep() then return end -- never move to an objective after Rift evacuation
        objectiveStep()
    end
    function mechanics:status()
        return {phase=T.phase,objective=T.objective and T.objective.kind,
            progress=T.objectiveProgress,carried=T.carried,delivered=T.delivered,
            objectiveMoves=T.objectiveMoves,objectiveStalls=T.objectiveStalls,
            fortressHp=T.fortressHp,fortressMaxHp=T.fortressMaxHp,
            cityStrikes=T.cityStrikes,dodgeCount=T.dodgeCount,
            dodgeFailures=T.dodgeFailures,activeWarnings=T.activeWarnings,
            lastWarning=T.lastWarning,lastDodge=T.lastDodge,outcome=T.outcome}
    end
    function mechanics:stop()
        T.running=false
        job=nil
        table.clear(activeThreats)
        T.activeWarnings=0
    end
    function mechanics:reset()
        self:stop()
        completed=false;T.phase=1;T.sessionSeen=false
        observer.sessionSeen=false
        T.generation=nil;T.objective=nil;T.objectiveProgress=0
        T.delivered=0;T.carried=false;T.holding=false
        T.objectiveAttempts=0;T.objectiveMoves=0;T.objectiveStalls=0
        T.fortressHp=nil;T.fortressMaxHp=nil;T.cityStrikes=0
        T.lastThreat=nil;T.outcome=nil;T.combatStarted=false
        T.dodgeCount=0;T.dodgeFailures=0;T.lastDodge=nil;T.lastWarning=nil
        lastObjectiveLog=0;lastProgressTime=0;lastProgressKey=nil
        lastProgressValue=nil;lastMoveAt=0;lastThreatAt=0;prevHp=nil
        lastDamageLog=0;nextObjectiveCheck=0;lastEvacuatedAt=0
        lastSafeAnchor=nil;lastDodgeGateLog=0;lastObjectivePauseLog=0
    end
    return mechanics
end
return MechanicsController
end
-- END MODULE boss.CarrierFortress.MechanicsController

    return SharedRepeatPolicy.new(env, "Expected confirmed Carrier outcome")

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.CarrierFortress.ReportController
__factories["boss.CarrierFortress.ReportController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Carrier adaptive report: Outcome -> report (arena or hideout) -> Continue -> exit -> return.
-- Port of standalone V1; never treat Outcome alone as a completed report.
local NativeEncounterReport = require("boss.shared.NativeEncounterReport")
local ReportController = {}

function ReportController.new(env, config, repeatPolicy, mechanics, observer)
    local platform, gui, runtime = env.services.roblox, env.services.gui, env.runtime
    local player = platform:player()
    local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
    local writer = env.state:port("boss")
    local report = {}
    local native = NativeEncounterReport.new(env, config.bossId, "Carrier")
    report.entry = native
    local confirmedOutcome, outcomeAt, outcomeReason = nil, nil, nil
    local seenReport, firstOpenedAt = false, nil
    local resultsController
    local function emit(name, data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit(name, data or {}) end
    end
    local function loadController()
        if resultsController then return resultsController end
        local folder = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("ClientModules")
        local mod = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("BossResultsController")
        if not mod or not mod:IsA("ModuleScript") then return nil end
        -- The build bundler replaces project requires. Invoke Roblox require only
        -- dynamically for the game's own ModuleScript, as the B21 controller does.
        local loader = getfenv(0)["require"]
        local ok, value = pcall(loader, mod)
        if not ok or type(value) ~= "table" then return nil end
        if type(value.IsOpen) ~= "function" or type(value.Dismiss) ~= "function" then return nil end
        resultsController = value
        return value
    end
    local function officialOpen()
        local ctrl = loadController()
        if ctrl and type(ctrl.IsOpen) == "function" then
            local ok, result = pcall(ctrl.IsOpen)
            if ok and result == true then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function isOpen()
        return player:GetAttribute("BossResultsOpen") == true or officialOpen()
    end
    local function matchingReport(guiRoot)
        if not guiRoot then return nil end
        local isCarrier, won, lost = false, false, false
        for _,node in ipairs(guiRoot:GetDescendants()) do
            if node:IsA("TextLabel") then
                local value = string.upper(tostring(node.Text or ""))
                if value:find("CARRIER", 1, true) or value:find("THE CARRIER", 1, true) then isCarrier = true end
                if value:find("DEFEATED", 1, true) or value:find("VICTORY", 1, true)
                    or value:find("MISSION COMPLETE", 1, true) then won = true end
                if value:find("MISSION FAILED", 1, true) or value:find("DEFEAT", 1, true) then lost = true end
            end
        end
        if isCarrier and won ~= lost then return won and "WIN" or "LOSS" end
        return nil
    end

    function report:watch(ctx)
        return native:watch(ctx, function(listen)
            local folder = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
            local session = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("CarrierSessionUpdate")
            local start = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("CarrierFightStart")
            local health = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("CarrierHealthUpdate")
            if not session or not session:IsA("RemoteEvent") or not start or not start:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                return false, "CARRIER_EVENTS_MISSING"
            end
            listen(start.OnClientEvent, function(packet)
                if type(packet) ~= "table" or not native:accept(packet, true) then return end
                observer.sessionSeen = true
                mechanics:onFightStart(packet)
            end)
            listen(session.OnClientEvent, function(packet)
                if type(packet) ~= "table" or type(packet.Kind) ~= "string" then return end
                local kind = packet.Kind
                local forward, matched = native:accept(packet, kind == "Begin" or kind == "Launch")
                if forward then mechanics:observe(packet) end
                if matched then native:observeTerminal(packet, kind) end
                if matched and kind == "End" and packet.Reason == "Exited" then native:endSession() end
                if matched and kind == "Outcome" and type(packet.Victory) == "boolean" and not confirmedOutcome then
                    confirmedOutcome = packet.Victory and "WIN" or "LOSS"
                    outcomeReason = tostring(packet.Reason or "")
                    outcomeAt = runtime:now()
                    emit("CARRIER_OUTCOME", {outcome=confirmedOutcome,reason=outcomeReason})
                end
            end)
            if health and health:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                listen(health.OnClientEvent, function(cur,max,phase,extra)
                    if native:accept({}) and observer:participating() then mechanics:onHealth(cur,max,phase,extra) end
                end)
            end
            return true
        end)
    end
    function report:cleanup(ctx)
        native:cleanup(ctx)
        mechanics:stop()
    end
    function report:verifiedDeferredOutcome(encounter) return native:verifiedDefeat(encounter) end
    function report:releaseEncounter(id) native:release(id) end
    function report:nativeEncounter() return native:nativeEncounter() end
    function report:ownedNativeGeneration() return native:ownedNativeGeneration() end
    function report:resetOutcome()
        native:reset()
        confirmedOutcome,outcomeAt,outcomeReason,seenReport,firstOpenedAt=nil,nil,nil,false,nil
        mechanics:reset()
    end
    function report:inspect()
        local root = gui:find(env.profile.paths.bossReport)
        local active = isOpen() -- Same verified V2 signal: BossResultsOpen or official controller.IsOpen()
        if active then
            seenReport = true
            firstOpenedAt = firstOpenedAt or runtime:now()
        end
        local guiOutcome = active and matchingReport(root) or nil
        local outcome = confirmedOutcome or guiOutcome
        local seen = seenReport or confirmedOutcome ~= nil and native:wasReportSeen()
        local specialExit = confirmedOutcome=="LOSS" and outcomeReason=="Exited"
            and not active and native:exited()
        local specialLossPanel = specialExit -- Shared recovery also reconciles native scoreless exits.
        return {
            active = active, matchesBoss = confirmedOutcome ~= nil or guiOutcome ~= nil,
            outcome = outcome, report = root, seen = seen,
            specialLossPanel=specialLossPanel,specialExit=specialExit,
            pendingPresentation = confirmedOutcome ~= nil and not seen and not specialLossPanel
                and outcomeAt ~= nil and runtime:now() - outcomeAt < config.reportTimeoutSeconds,
        }
    end
    function report:reconcile(encounter)
        local evidence = self:inspect()
        if evidence.matchesBoss and evidence.outcome
            and (not encounter.outcome or encounter.outcome == evidence.outcome) then return true end
        return encounter.outcome ~= nil and evidence.seen and not evidence.active
    end
    function report:resolve(ctx, encounter)
        local watching, why = self:watch(ctx)
        if not watching then return {ok = false, code = why} end
        -- V2 REQUIREMENT: Outcome alone never authorizes return/Continue.
        local evidence = ctx:await(function()
            local current = self:inspect()
            if current.active and current.matchesBoss and current.outcome then return current end
            if current.specialLossPanel or current.specialExit then return current end
            if current.seen and not current.active and (encounter.outcome or current.outcome) then
                return current -- manually dismissed report after previously observing it
            end
        end, config.reportTimeoutSeconds)
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        if not evidence then return {ok = false, code = "CARRIER_REPORT_NOT_OBSERVED"} end
        if evidence.outcome and encounter.outcome and evidence.outcome ~= encounter.outcome then
            return {ok = false, held = true, code = "BOSS_OUTCOME_CONFLICT"}
        end
        local outcome = evidence.outcome or encounter.outcome
        if not outcome then return {ok = false, code = "CARRIER_OUTCOME_UNVERIFIED"} end
        if not encounter.outcome then
            local accepted = writer:recordBossReport(outcome,
                runtime:epoch() + repeatPolicy:outcomeDelay(outcome))
            if not accepted then return {ok = false, held = true, code = "BOSS_OUTCOME_CONFLICT"} end
            encounter = env.state:snapshot().boss.encounter
        end
        if not evidence.active then
            if evidence.specialExit then
                emit("CARRIER_EXITED",{reason=outcomeReason,
                    note="Native Exited loss confirmed, fight lock released"})
            end
            writer:closeReport()
            return {ok = true, code = evidence.specialExit and "CARRIER_NATIVE_EXITED"
                or "CARRIER_REPORT_MANUALLY_CLOSED"}
        end
        local at = platform:position()
        local place = player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") == true and "HIDEOUT" or "OTHER"
        if place == "OTHER" and at then
            local center = Vector3.new(config.arenaFallbackCenter.x,
                config.arenaFallbackCenter.y, config.arenaFallbackCenter.z)
            local horizontal = Vector3.new(at.X-center.X,0,at.Z-center.Z)
            if horizontal.Magnitude < config.arenaRadius
                and at.Y > config.arenaMinY and at.Y < config.arenaMaxY then
                place = "ARENA"
            end
        end
        emit("CARRIER_REPORT_OPEN", {outcome = outcome, location = place,
            inBossFight = player:GetAttribute("InBossFight")})
        local controller = loadController()
        if not controller then return {ok = false, code = "CARRIER_RESULT_CONTROLLER_MISSING_MANUAL_CONTINUE"} end
        if not encounter.continueAttempted then
            local ready = ctx:await(function()
                if not isOpen() then return "MANUALLY_CLOSED" end
                local armed = false
                if type(controller.Debug) == "function" then
                    local ok, message = pcall(controller.Debug)
                    armed = ok and type(message) == "string"
                        and message:find("armed=true", 1, true) ~= nil
                end
                if armed and firstOpenedAt
                    and runtime:now() - firstOpenedAt >= config.reportHoldSeconds then return "ARMED" end
            end, config.reportTimeoutSeconds)
            if ctx:isCancelled() then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
            if ready == "MANUALLY_CLOSED" then
                writer:closeReport()
                return {ok = true, code = "CARRIER_REPORT_MANUALLY_CLOSED"}
            end
            if ready ~= "ARMED" then return {ok = false, code = "CARRIER_REPORT_NOT_ARMED_MANUAL_CONTINUE"} end
            if not writer:markContinueAttempt() then return {ok = false, code = "CARRIER_CONTINUE_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED"} end
            local sent, err = pcall(function() controller.Dismiss("continue") end)
            if not sent then return {ok = false, code = "CARRIER_CONTINUE_FAILED: " .. tostring(err)} end
            emit("CARRIER_REPORT_CONTINUE", {code = "CONTINUE_REQUESTED"})
        end
        local closed = ctx:await(function() if not self:inspect().active then return true end end,
            config.reportCloseTimeoutSeconds)
        if not closed then return {ok = false, code = "CARRIER_REPORT_STILL_OPEN_MANUAL_CONTINUE"} end
        writer:closeReport()
        return {ok = true, code = "CARRIER_REPORT_CLOSED"}
    end
    return report
end
return ReportController
end
-- END MODULE boss.CarrierFortress.ReportController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.Ekranoplan.ArenaObserver
__factories["boss.Ekranoplan.ArenaObserver"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local ArenaObserver = {}
function ArenaObserver.new(env, config)
    local platform = env.services.roblox
    local player, workspace = platform:player(), platform:workspace()
    local observer = {}
    function observer:participating()
        return player:GetAttribute("EkranoplanParticipant") == true
    end
    function observer:inArenaPosition()
        local pos = platform:position()
        if not pos then return false end
        local dx, dz = pos.X - config.arenaCenter.x, pos.Z - config.arenaCenter.z
        return math.abs(dx) <= config.deckHalf + 12 and
            math.abs(dz) <= config.deckHalf + 12 and pos.Y >= 4 and pos.Y <= 90
    end
    function observer:onDeck(pos)
        pos = pos or platform:position()
        if not pos then return false end
        local dx, dz = pos.X - config.arenaCenter.x, pos.Z - config.arenaCenter.z
        return math.abs(dx) <= config.deckHalf+5 and math.abs(dz) <= config.deckHalf+5
            and pos.Y >= 12 and pos.Y <= 65
    end
    function observer:inArena()
        return self:participating() or (workspace:GetAttribute("EkranoplanFightActive") == true
            and self:inArenaPosition() and player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true)
    end
    function observer:state()
        return {phase = workspace:GetAttribute("EkranoplanPhase"),
            fightState = workspace:GetAttribute("EkranoplanFightState"),
            active = workspace:GetAttribute("EkranoplanFightActive"),
            participant = player:GetAttribute("EkranoplanParticipant"),
            inBossFight = player:GetAttribute("InBossFight")}
    end
    return observer
end
return ArenaObserver
end
-- END MODULE boss.Ekranoplan.ArenaObserver

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.Ekranoplan.CombatController
__factories["boss.Ekranoplan.CombatController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Preserve tested standalone V1's post-victory hazard tail before report/return.
local CombatController = {}
function CombatController.new(env, config, observer, report, dodge)
    local runtime, telemetry = env.runtime, env.services.telemetry
    local combat = {}
    local function emit(name, payload)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit("EKRANOPLAN_" .. name, payload or {}) end
    end
    function combat:run(ctx, encounter)
        local watching, why = report:watch(ctx)
        if not watching then return {code = why} end
        dodge:start(ctx)
        local deadline = runtime:now() + config.maxFightSeconds
        local previous, lastEmit = nil, 0
        local code = "OUTCOME_NOT_OBSERVED_TIMEOUT"
        while not ctx:isCancelled() and runtime:now() < deadline do
            if report:inspect().outcome then code = "OUTCOME_OBSERVED"; break end
            local state = observer:state()
            local key = tostring(state.fightState).."/"..tostring(state.phase).."/"..
                tostring(state.active).."/"..tostring(state.participant)
            if key ~= previous or runtime:now() - lastEmit > 25 then
                emit("STATE", state)
                previous, lastEmit = key, runtime:now()
            end
            if not ctx:wait(0.4) then break end
        end
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return {code = "CANCELLED"} end
        if code == "OUTCOME_OBSERVED" then
            -- Attack packets already released may land after victory.
            local missiles, surges = dodge:hazardCount()
            if missiles + surges > 0 then
                emit("HAZARD_CLEAR_WAIT", {missiles = missiles, surges = surges})
                local untilTime = runtime:now() + config.hazardClearMaxSeconds
                while not ctx:isCancelled() and runtime:now() < untilTime do
                    missiles, surges = dodge:hazardCount()
                    if missiles + surges == 0 then break end
                    if not ctx:wait(0.25) then break end
                end
                emit("HAZARD_CLEAR", {missiles = missiles, surges = surges})
            end
            emit("DODGE_SUMMARY", dodge:status())
        end
        return {code = code}
    end
    return combat
end
return CombatController
end
-- END MODULE boss.Ekranoplan.CombatController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.Ekranoplan.CommandController
__factories["boss.Ekranoplan.CommandController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Ekranoplan standalone V1 flow: Hideout -> Boss Command pass -> ONE Solo -> combat.
-- Adaptive report may open in arena OR after exit; never request return before Continue.
local DirectBossTravel = require("main.navigation.DirectBossTravel")
local CommandController = {}

function CommandController.new(env, config, observer, report)
    local platform, runtime = env.services.roblox, env.runtime
    local player, workspace = platform:player(), platform:workspace()
    local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
    local travel = DirectBossTravel.new(env)
    local command = {}
    local function emit(name, data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit(name, data or {}) end
    end
    local function remote(name)
        local storage = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage")
        local folder = storage:FindFirstChild("Remotes") or storage:WaitForChild("Remotes", 10)
        local item = folder and (folder:FindFirstChild(name) or folder:WaitForChild(name, 7))
        return item and item:IsA("RemoteEvent") and item or nil
    end
    local function active(ctx) return runtime:isActive(ctx) and not ctx:isCancelled() end
    local function cooldownLeft()
        local raw = player:GetAttribute("BossStartCooldowns")
        if type(raw) ~= "string" or raw == "" then return 0 end
        local ok, data = pcall(function() return platform:service("HttpService"):JSONDecode(raw) end)
        if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then return 0 end
        return math.max(0, (tonumber(data[config.gameBossKey]) or 0) - workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
    end

    function command:prepare(ctx)
        local watching, why = report:watch(ctx) -- watch BEFORE sending any boss request
        if not watching then return false, why end
        if observer:inArena() then return true, "EKRANOPLAN_ALREADY_IN_ARENA" end
        if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true then return false, "OTHER_BOSS_ACTIVE" end
        if not active(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        local entered = travel:enterHideout(ctx)
        emit("EKRANOPLAN_DIRECT_HIDEOUT", {ok = entered.ok, code = entered.code, reason = entered.reason})
        if not entered.ok then return false, entered.code end
        local positioned = travel:moveToKnownPoint(ctx, config.commandSafePosition, {
            requireHideout = true, radius = 6, settle = 0.85,
        })
        emit("EKRANOPLAN_COMMAND_POSITION", {ok = positioned.ok, code = positioned.code})
        if not positioned.ok then return false, positioned.code end
        return true, "EKRANOPLAN_COMMAND_READY"
    end

    function command:readiness()
        if observer:inArena() then return "READY" end
        if not travel:inHideout() then return "UNKNOWN" end
        local secs = cooldownLeft()
        if secs > 0 then
            secs = math.ceil(secs)
            return string.format("%d:%02d", math.floor(secs / 60), secs % 60)
        end
        -- The server pass remains authoritative for unlock/eligibility.
        return "READY"
    end

    function command:startSolo(ctx, markAttempt)
        if not active(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        if observer:participating() then return true, "EKRANOPLAN_ALREADY_FIGHTING" end
        if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true then return false, "OTHER_BOSS_ACTIVE" end
        if not travel:inHideout() then return false, "NOT_IN_HIDEOUT" end
        if self:readiness() ~= "READY" then return false, "EKRANOPLAN_NOT_READY" end
        local watching, why = report:watch(ctx)
        if not watching then return false, why end
        local hideout, accept = remote("PersonalHideoutRemote"), remote("EkranoplanCommanderAccept")
        if not hideout or not accept then return false, "EKRANOPLAN_COMMAND_REMOTES_MISSING" end
        local passReply, acceptReply
        local passConnection = hideout.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
            if type(e) == "table" and e.Kind == "BossCommand" and e.Op == "Start"
                and e.BossKey == config.gameBossKey then passReply = e end
        end)
        local acceptConnection = accept.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
            if type(e) == "table" and e.Accepted ~= nil then acceptReply = e end
        end)
        local function finish(ok, code)
            passConnection:Disconnect()
            acceptConnection:Disconnect()
            return ok, code
        end
        local sent, err = pcall(function()
            hideout:FireServer({Action = "StartBoss", BossKey = config.gameBossKey, Solo = true})
        end)
        if not sent then return finish(false, "EKRANOPLAN_PASS_SEND_FAILED: " .. tostring(err)) end
        local gotPass = ctx:await(function() return passReply end, 10)
        if not active(ctx) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
        if not gotPass then return finish(false, "EKRANOPLAN_PASS_TIMEOUT_NO_RETRY") end
        emit("EKRANOPLAN_PASS_RESULT", {ok = gotPass.Ok == true, reason = gotPass.Reason})
        if gotPass.Ok ~= true then return finish(false, "EKRANOPLAN_PASS_REJECTED: " .. tostring(gotPass.Reason)) end
        -- Mark before firing the irreversible Solo request; never blind retry.
        if not markAttempt() then return finish(false, "EKRANOPLAN_SOLO_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED") end
        sent, err = pcall(function() accept:FireServer({Solo = true}) end)
        if not sent then return finish(false, "EKRANOPLAN_SOLO_SEND_FAILED: " .. tostring(err)) end
        local observed = ctx:await(function()
            if acceptReply and acceptReply.Accepted == false then return "REJECTED" end
            if observer:participating() then return "ENTERED" end
        end, config.arenaTimeout)
        if not active(ctx) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
        emit("EKRANOPLAN_SOLO_RESULT", {code = observed or "AMBIGUOUS", accepted = acceptReply and acceptReply.Accepted})
        if observed == "ENTERED" then return finish(true, "EKRANOPLAN_FIGHT_VERIFIED") end
        if observed == "REJECTED" then
            return finish(false, "EKRANOPLAN_SOLO_REJECTED: " .. tostring(acceptReply.Reason))
        end
        return finish(false, "EKRANOPLAN_SOLO_AMBIGUOUS_NO_RETRY")
    end

    function command:close(_) return true end -- No command GUI was opened.

    function command:returnHome(ctx, home)
        if not active(ctx) then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        if type(home) ~= "number" or home < 1 or home % 1 ~= 0 then
            return {ok = false, code = "INVALID_HOME_WORLD"}
        end
        if report:inspect().active then return {ok = false, code = "EKRANOPLAN_REPORT_STILL_OPEN"} end
        -- Preserve standalone V1 lock checks before return, regardless of report location.
        local released = ctx:await(function()
            if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true
                and player:GetAttribute("EkranoplanParticipant") ~= true then return true end
        end, config.returnLockTimeoutSeconds)
        if not released then
            emit("EKRANOPLAN_RETURN_LOCK_PENDING", {world = home})
            return {ok = false, code = "EKRANOPLAN_RETURN_LOCK_PENDING", reason = "BossFight"}
        end
        local exit = ctx:await(function()
            if player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") == true then return "BOSS_COMMAND_HIDEOUT" end
            if not observer:inArenaPosition() then return "OUTSIDE_ARENA" end
        end, config.exitTimeoutSeconds)
        emit("EKRANOPLAN_ARENA_EXIT", {code = exit or "LOCK_RELEASED_STILL_IN_ARENA"})
        -- As in tested standalone V1, a released lock permits a direct verified travel even
        -- if the game has not repositioned the player outside the arena yet.
        if not ctx:wait(1.5) then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        local request, prepare, result = remote("RequestWorldTravel"), remote("NavPrepareWorlds"), remote("WorldTravelResult")
        if not request or not prepare then return {ok = false, code = "EKRANOPLAN_WORLD_TRAVEL_REMOTES_MISSING"} end
        local position = platform:position()
        if not position then return {ok = false, code = "CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE"} end
        if tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")) == home
            and player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") ~= true
            and not observer:inArenaPosition() then
            return {ok = true, code = "ALREADY_IN_HOME", world = home}
        end
        local reply
        local connection = result and result.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
            if type(e) == "table" and e.Kind == "Result" and tonumber(e.WorldId) == home then reply = e end
        end) or nil
        local function finish(ok, code, reason)
            if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
            emit("EKRANOPLAN_DIRECT_RETURN", {ok = ok, code = code, reason = reason, world = home})
            return {ok = ok, code = code, reason = reason, world = home}
        end
        for attempt = 1, config.returnRetries do
            if not active(ctx) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            reply = nil
            local prior = platform:position()
            if not prior then return finish(false, "CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE") end
            local sent, err = pcall(function() prepare:FireServer("stream", home) end)
            if not sent then return finish(false, "WORLD_PREPARE_SEND_FAILED", tostring(err)) end
            if not ctx:wait(0.12) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            sent, err = pcall(function() request:FireServer(home) end)
            if not sent then return finish(false, "WORLD_REQUEST_SEND_FAILED", tostring(err)) end
            local observed = ctx:await(function()
                if reply and reply.Ok == false then return "REJECTED" end
                local current = platform:position()
                if current and platform:distance(current, prior) > 50
                    and tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")) == home
                    and player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") ~= true
                    and player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true
                    and not observer:inArenaPosition() then return "VERIFIED" end
            end, 17)
            emit("EKRANOPLAN_RETURN_ATTEMPT", {attempt = attempt, code = observed or "AMBIGUOUS",
                reason = reply and reply.Reason})
            if observed == "VERIFIED" then return finish(true, "EKRANOPLAN_HOME_VERIFIED") end
            if observed ~= "REJECTED" then return finish(false, "EKRANOPLAN_RETURN_AMBIGUOUS_NO_RETRY") end
            local why = tostring(reply.Reason or "UNKNOWN")
            if why ~= "BossFight" or attempt == config.returnRetries then
                return finish(false, "EKRANOPLAN_WORLD_RETURN_REJECTED", why)
            end
            if not ctx:wait(12) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            local settled = ctx:await(function()
                if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true then return true end
            end, 40)
            if not settled then return finish(false, "EKRANOPLAN_LOCK_STILL_ACTIVE", "BossFight") end
        end
        return finish(false, "EKRANOPLAN_WORLD_RETURN_EXHAUSTED")
    end
    return command
end
return CommandController
end
-- END MODULE boss.Ekranoplan.CommandController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.Ekranoplan.Config
__factories["boss.Ekranoplan.Config"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- World 37 Ekranoplan deck arena. Values from tested standalone V1.
return {
    bossId = "EKRANOPLAN", displayName = "Ekranoplan", gameBossKey = "Ekranoplan",
    arenaCenter = {x = 28672, y = 18, z = 28672},
    deckHalf = 85, arenaRadius = 125,
    commandSafePosition = {x = -31962.1074, y = 344.357483, z = 32887.3203},
    arenaTimeout = 48, maxFightSeconds = 900,
    reportTimeoutSeconds = 130, reportHoldSeconds = 3,
    reportCloseTimeoutSeconds = 125, exitTimeoutSeconds = 110,
    returnLockTimeoutSeconds = 80, returnRetries = 3,
    autoDodge = true, dodgeLookaheadSeconds = 10,
    dodgeMargin = 11, dodgeMinInterval = 0.75,
    hazardClearMaxSeconds = 10,
}
end
-- END MODULE boss.Ekranoplan.Config

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.Ekranoplan.DodgeController
__factories["boss.Ekranoplan.DodgeController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Port of tested Ekranoplan Standalone V1 deck missile + sea surge dodge.
-- No blind fixed teleport: only confirmed deck raycast candidates are considered.
local DodgeController = {}
function DodgeController.new(env, config, observer)
    local platform, runtime = env.services.roblox, env.runtime
    local player, workspace = platform:player(), platform:workspace()
    local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
    local riftHazards = env.services.riftHazards
    local riftFrame = {}
    local dodge = {}
    local clockT0, attacks, attackSerial, deathCut = nil, {}, 0, nil
    local lastDodgeAt, lastGate, lastGateAt = -math.huge, nil, -math.huge
    local runningContext = nil
    local state = {plans = 0, attempts = 0, verified = 0, rejected = 0,
        missiles = 0, surges = 0, lastGate = "WAITING", lastMove = nil}
    local function emit(name, data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit("EKRANOPLAN_" .. name, data or {}) end
    end
    local function gate(reason, data)
        state.lastGate = reason
        local now = runtime:now()
        if lastGate == reason and now - lastGateAt < 4 then return end
        lastGate, lastGateAt = reason, now
        local row = data or {}
        row.reason = reason
        emit("DODGE_GATE", row)
    end
    local function root()
        local character = player.Character
        return character, character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    end
    local function tauNow()
        if type(clockT0) ~= "number" then return nil end
        return workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - clockT0
    end
    local function countHazards(tau)
        if type(tau) ~= "number" then return 0, 0 end
        local nM, nS = 0, 0
        for _, attack in ipairs(attacks) do
            for _, missile in ipairs(attack.missiles) do
                if missile.kind == "Deck" and type(missile.t1) == "number"
                    and missile.t1 >= tau - 0.5 and missile.t1 < tau + config.dodgeLookaheadSeconds then
                    nM += 1
                end
            end
            local surge = attack.surge
            if surge and type(surge.at) == "number" and type(surge.to) == "number"
                and surge.at >= tau - 1.25 and surge.at <= tau + config.dodgeLookaheadSeconds then
                nS += 1
            end
        end
        return nM + #riftFrame, nS
    end
    local function hazardScore(pos, tau)
        local danger, nearest = 0, math.huge
        local center = config.arenaCenter
        for _, attack in ipairs(attacks) do
            for _, missile in ipairs(attack.missiles) do
                if missile.kind == "Deck" and missile.target and missile.t1
                    and missile.t1 >= tau - 0.4 and missile.t1 <= tau + config.dodgeLookaheadSeconds then
                    local dx, dz = pos.X - missile.target.X, pos.Z - missile.target.Z
                    local distance = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
                    nearest = math.min(nearest, distance)
                    if distance < 24 + config.dodgeMargin then
                        danger += 1 + (24 + config.dodgeMargin - distance) / 20
                    end
                end
            end
            local surge = attack.surge
            if surge and surge.normal and surge.at and surge.to
                and surge.at >= tau - 1.25 and surge.at <= tau + config.dodgeLookaheadSeconds then
                local localPos = Vector3.new(pos.X - center.x, 0, pos.Z - center.z)
                local side = localPos:Dot(surge.normal)
                if side >= config.deckHalf - surge.depth - config.dodgeMargin then
                    danger += 2 + math.max(0, side - (config.deckHalf - surge.depth)) / 30
                end
            end
        end
        for _,spot in ipairs(riftFrame) do
            if typeof(spot.p)=="Vector3" and type(spot.r)=="number"
                and math.abs(pos.Y-spot.p.Y)<=32 then
                local dx,dz=pos.X-spot.p.X,pos.Z-spot.p.Z
                local distance=math.sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz)
                local radius=spot.r+config.dodgeMargin
                nearest=math.min(nearest,distance)
                if distance<radius then danger+=1+(radius-distance)/20 end
            end
        end
        return danger, nearest
    end
    local function groundPosition(x, z, character)
        local hitOrigin = Vector3.new(x, 75, z)
        local params = RaycastParams.new()
        params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        params.RespectCanCollide = true
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character}
        local hit = workspace:Raycast(hitOrigin, Vector3.new(0, -110, 0), params)
        if not hit or not hit.Instance or not hit.Instance.CanCollide then return nil end
        if math.abs(hit.Position.Y - config.arenaCenter.y) > 8 then return nil end
        return Vector3.new(x, hit.Position.Y + 3.4, z)
    end
    local function bestSafeSpot(pos, tau, character)
        local candidates = {-62, -42, -21, 0, 21, 42, 62}
        local best, bestScore = nil, math.huge
        for _, x in ipairs(candidates) do
            for _, z in ipairs(candidates) do
                local worldX = config.arenaCenter.x + x
                local worldZ = config.arenaCenter.z + z
                local candidate = Vector3.new(worldX, pos.Y, worldZ)
                local risk = hazardScore(candidate, tau)
                if risk == 0 then
                    local dx, dz = pos.X - worldX, pos.Z - worldZ
                    local distance = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
                    if distance < bestScore then
                        local ground = groundPosition(worldX, worldZ, character)
                        if ground then best, bestScore = ground, distance end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return best, bestScore
    end
    local function addAttack(packet, source)
        if type(packet) ~= "table" then return end
        local attack = {kind = tostring(packet.Kind or "UNKNOWN"), surge = nil, missiles = {}}
        if type(packet.Surge) == "table" and typeof(packet.Surge.Normal) == "Vector3" then
            local surge = packet.Surge
            attack.surge = {normal = Vector3.new(surge.Normal.X, 0, surge.Normal.Z),
                depth = tonumber(surge.Depth) or 45,
                warnAt = tonumber(surge.WarnAt), at = tonumber(surge.At), to = tonumber(surge.To)}
        end
        if type(packet.Missiles) == "table" then
            for _, missile in ipairs(packet.Missiles) do
                if type(missile) == "table" then
                    table.insert(attack.missiles, {
                        kind = tostring(missile.Kind or "UNKNOWN"),
                        target = typeof(missile.Target) == "Vector3" and missile.Target or nil,
                        t0 = tonumber(missile.T0), t1 = tonumber(missile.T1)})
                end
            end
        end
        if not attack.surge and #attack.missiles == 0 then return end
        attackSerial += 1
        table.insert(attacks, attack)
        emit("ATTACK_TRACK", {index = attackSerial, source = source,
            kind = attack.kind, missiles = #attack.missiles, surge = attack.surge ~= nil,
            surgeAt = attack.surge and attack.surge.at or nil,
            firstImpact = attack.missiles[1] and attack.missiles[1].t1 or nil})
    end
    function dodge:observe(packet)
        if type(packet) ~= "table" or type(packet.K) ~= "string" then return end
        local kind = packet.K
        if kind == "Start" then
            attacks, clockT0, deathCut, attackSerial = {}, nil, nil, 0
        end
        if (kind == "Launch" or kind == "Resync") and type(packet.T0) == "number" then
            clockT0 = packet.T0
            emit("DODGE_CLOCK", {source = kind, t0 = clockT0})
        end
        if kind == "Session" then
            if type(packet.T0) == "number" and not clockT0 then clockT0 = packet.T0 end
            if type(packet.Attacks) == "table" then
                for _, a in ipairs(packet.Attacks) do addAttack(a, "SESSION") end
            end
        end
        if kind == "Attack" then addAttack(packet, "EVENT") end
        if kind == "Death" then
            deathCut = tonumber(packet.At)
            if deathCut then
                for _, a in ipairs(attacks) do
                    local keep = {}
                    for _, missile in ipairs(a.missiles) do
                        if not missile.t0 or missile.t0 <= deathCut then table.insert(keep, missile) end
                    end
                    a.missiles = keep
                    if a.surge and a.surge.at and a.surge.at > deathCut then a.surge = nil end
                end
            end
            emit("DEATH_CUT", {cutAt = deathCut})
        end
    end
    function dodge:reset()
        if runningContext then return end
        clockT0, attacks, attackSerial, deathCut = nil, {}, 0, nil
        lastDodgeAt, lastGate, lastGateAt = -math.huge, nil, -math.huge
        state = {plans = 0, attempts = 0, verified = 0, rejected = 0,
            missiles = 0, surges = 0, lastGate = "WAITING", lastMove = nil}
    end
    function dodge:hazardCount()
        return countHazards(tauNow())
    end
    function dodge:status()
        return {plans = state.plans, attempts = state.attempts,
            verified = state.verified, rejected = state.rejected,
            pendingMissiles = state.missiles, pendingSurges = state.surges,
            lastGate = state.lastGate, lastMove = state.lastMove}
    end
    function dodge:start(ctx)
        if runningContext == ctx then return end
        if runningContext then return end
        runningContext = ctx
        ctx:deferCleanup(function()
            if runningContext == ctx then runningContext = nil end
        end)
        task.spawn(function()
            while runningContext == ctx and not ctx:isCancelled() and runtime:isActive(ctx) do
                local tau = tauNow() or 0
                riftFrame={}
                if riftHazards and type(riftHazards.groundFootprints)=="function" then
                    local ok,spots=pcall(riftHazards.groundFootprints,riftHazards,config.dodgeLookaheadSeconds)
                    if ok and type(spots)=="table" then riftFrame=spots end
                end
                local character, hrp = root()
                local participating = observer:participating()
                local active = workspace:GetAttribute("EkranoplanFightActive") == true
                local nM, nS = countHazards(tau)
                state.missiles, state.surges = nM, nS
                if not config.autoDodge then
                    gate("DISABLED")
                elseif not hrp then
                    gate("NO_CHARACTER")
                elseif not observer:onDeck(hrp.Position) then
                    if participating then gate("NOT_ON_DECK", {y = hrp.Position.Y}) end
                elseif (not participating or player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true)
                    and not (env.state:snapshot().boss.encounter and observer:inArenaPosition()) then
                    gate("NOT_IN_BATTLE")
                elseif nM + nS == 0 then
                    if active then gate("NO_IMMINENT_HAZARD") end
                elseif workspace:GetAttribute("EkranoplanFightState") == "Cinematic" then
                    gate("CINEMATIC")
                else
                    local risk = hazardScore(hrp.Position, tau)
                    if risk == 0 then
                        gate("SAFE_POSITION", {missiles = nM, surges = nS})
                    elseif runtime:now() - lastDodgeAt < config.dodgeMinInterval then
                        gate("DODGE_INTERVAL")
                    else
                        lastDodgeAt = runtime:now()
                        state.plans += 1
                        local spot, distance = bestSafeSpot(hrp.Position, tau, character)
                        emit("DODGE_PLAN", {risk = math.floor(risk * 10) / 10,
                            missiles = nM, surges = nS, spotFound = spot ~= nil,
                            distance = spot and math.floor(distance * 10) / 10 or nil})
                        if spot then
                            state.attempts += 1
                            local ok, err = pcall(function() character:PivotTo(CFrame.new(spot)) end)
                            if not ctx:wait(0.2) then break end
                            local _, current = root()
                            local verified = ok and current and
                                (current.Position - spot).Magnitude < 8 and observer:onDeck(current.Position)
                            if verified then state.verified += 1 else state.rejected += 1 end
                            state.lastMove = verified and "VERIFIED" or "NOT_VERIFIED"
                            emit("DODGE_MOVE", {code = state.lastMove,
                                x = math.floor(spot.X * 10) / 10, z = math.floor(spot.Z * 10) / 10,
                                y = math.floor(spot.Y * 10) / 10,
                                error = not ok and tostring(err) or nil})
                        else
                            gate("NO_SAFE_DECK_POINT")
                        end
                    end
                end
                if not ctx:wait(0.25) then break end
            end
        end)
    end
    return dodge
end
return DodgeController
end
-- END MODULE boss.Ekranoplan.DodgeController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.Ekranoplan.Ekranoplan
__factories["boss.Ekranoplan.Ekranoplan"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Register Ekranoplan after existing bosses, keeping B21 as the default.
local Config = require("boss.Ekranoplan.Config")
local ArenaObserver = require("boss.Ekranoplan.ArenaObserver")
local CommandController = require("boss.Ekranoplan.CommandController")
local CombatController = require("boss.Ekranoplan.CombatController")
local DodgeController = require("boss.Ekranoplan.DodgeController")
local ReportController = require("boss.Ekranoplan.ReportController")
local RepeatPolicy = require("boss.Ekranoplan.RepeatPolicy")
local Ekranoplan = {}
function Ekranoplan.definition()
    return {bossId = Config.bossId, displayName = Config.displayName, create = function(env)
        local observer = ArenaObserver.new(env, Config)
        local dodge = DodgeController.new(env, Config, observer)
        local repeatPolicy = RepeatPolicy.new(env)
        local report = ReportController.new(env, Config, repeatPolicy, dodge)
        return {config = Config, observer = observer, dodge = dodge,
            report = report, repeatPolicy = repeatPolicy,
            command = CommandController.new(env, Config, observer, report),
            combat = CombatController.new(env, Config, observer, report, dodge)}
    end}
end
return Ekranoplan
end
-- END MODULE boss.Ekranoplan.Ekranoplan

    return SharedRepeatPolicy.new(env, "Expected confirmed Ekranoplan outcome")
end
return RepeatPolicy
end
