-- BEGIN MODULE boss.FinalColossus.MainRunnerSource
__factories["boss.FinalColossus.MainRunnerSource"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Exact standalone V3 source segments around the queued Return/Raid code.
return {
    beforeReturn = [========[
--!nocheck
-- FinalColossus Standalone QueueTeleport V3 (Threat-Aware Dodge / Any World / Return)
-- Source basis: Project_PlaneRNG docs/boss_research/bosses/FinalColossus.md,
-- ReplicatedStorage.Modules.FinalBossConfig, FinalBossSeal, FinalBossClient.
-- ONE FILE: main-place entry + raid combat dodge queued on teleport + return-to-origin.
-- Combat dodge checks official Attack / Lightning telegraph shapes and a raycast-verified arena floor.
-- Unknown telegraphs or missing floor are reported and never treated as proven safe.
-- This is an experimental client-side PivotTo dodge, not a guarantee against server hits.

local MAIN_PLACE = 133112767606395
local RAID_PLACE = 130165569233874
local GLOBAL_KEY = "PlaneRNGFinalColossusTestV3"

local function env()
    if type(getgenv) == "function" then
        local ok, e = pcall(getgenv)
        if ok and type(e) == "table" then return e end
    end
    return _G
end

local G = env()
local given = G.PlaneRNGFinalColossusOptions or {}
local function option(name, default)
    if given[name] == nil then return default end
    return given[name]
end
local SETTINGS = {
    difficulty = tostring(option("difficulty", "Normal")),
    autoMoveToSeal = option("autoMoveToSeal", true) == true,
    autoAttune = option("autoAttune", true) == true,
    autoBreakSeal = option("autoBreakSeal", true) == true,
    soloOnly = option("soloOnly", true) == true,
    autoSelectDifficulty = option("autoSelectDifficulty", true) == true,
    autoWaitCooldown = option("autoWaitCooldown", false) == true,
    requireTeleportQueue = option("requireTeleportQueue", true) == true,
    showOverlay = option("showOverlay", true) == true,
    sealTimeoutSeconds = math.clamp(tonumber(option("sealTimeoutSeconds", 180)) or 180, 30, 900),
    maxRecords = 500,
    autoTravelWorld80 = option("autoTravelWorld80", true) == true,
    returnToOrigin = option("returnToOrigin", true) == true,
    autoContinueAfterOutcome = option("autoContinueAfterOutcome", true) == true,
    autoDodge = option("autoDodge", true) == true,
    dodgeMargin = math.clamp(tonumber(option("dodgeMargin", 14)) or 14, 4, 40),
    dodgeCooldown = math.clamp(tonumber(option("dodgeCooldown", 0.3)) or 0.3, 0.1, 2),
    maxDodgeRange = math.clamp(tonumber(option("maxDodgeRange", 180)) or 180, 50, 380),
    originWorld = tonumber(option("originWorld", 0)) or 0, -- only for manual recovery; main reads actual CurrentWorld
}
local DIFFICULTIES = { Normal=true, Hard=true, Nightmare=true, Raid=true }
if not DIFFICULTIES[SETTINGS.difficulty] then SETTINGS.difficulty = "Normal" end

-- Queued THIRD SCRIPT: after game teleports back from the raid to the MAIN place,
-- travel to the ORIGINAL world. Carries homeWorld as literal JSON across processes.
-- This script NEVER starts a new boss fight.
]========],
    between = [========[


-- This is a complete standalone SECOND SCRIPT. queue_on_teleport receives its text,
-- not a function or a reference to getgenv() from the previous place.
]========],
    afterRaid = [========[


-- Instantiate exactly the same raid script either through queue or manual execute.
local Http=game:GetService("HttpService")
local function makeRaidCode()
    local returnCode=RETURN_SOURCE:gsub("__ORIGIN_WORLD_LITERAL__",tostring(SETTINGS.originWorld))
    return RAID_SOURCE:gsub("__OPTIONS_JSON_LITERAL__",function()
        return string.format("%q",Http:JSONEncode(SETTINGS))
    end):gsub("__RETURN_CODE_LITERAL__",function()
        return string.format("%q",returnCode)
    end)
end
local raidCode=makeRaidCode()
if game.PlaceId == RAID_PLACE then
    if type(loadstring) ~= "function" then
        warn("[FINAL V3] Executor tidak menyediakan loadstring untuk manual raid mode")
        return
    end
    local fn, err = loadstring(raidCode)
    if not fn then warn("[FINAL V3] RAID compile error",err); return end
    fn()
    return
end
if game.PlaceId ~= MAIN_PLACE then
    warn("[FINAL V3] Wrong place:",game.PlaceId, "Expected main:", MAIN_PLACE, "or raid:",RAID_PLACE)
    return
end
if G[GLOBAL_KEY] and G[GLOBAL_KEY].running then
    warn("[FINAL V3] Sudah berjalan; hentikan dahulu dengan :stop() jika perlu")
    return
end
if G.PlaneRNGFinalColossusTestV2 and G.PlaneRNGFinalColossusTestV2.running then
    pcall(function() G.PlaneRNGFinalColossusTestV2:stop() end)
end
if G.PlaneRNGFinalColossusTestV1 and G.PlaneRNGFinalColossusTestV1.running then
    pcall(function() G.PlaneRNGFinalColossusTestV1:stop() end)
end
if not game:IsLoaded() then game.Loaded:Wait() end

local P=game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local RS=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local T={running=true,placeId=game.PlaceId,stage="MAIN_BOOT",records={},connections={},startedAt=os.clock(),queueStatus="not_attempted"}
G[GLOBAL_KEY]=T
local function safe(v)
    local k=typeof(v)
    if k=="Vector3" then return string.format("(%.1f, %.1f, %.1f)",v.X,v.Y,v.Z) end
    if k=="Instance" then return v:GetFullName() end
    if k=="table" then return "[table]" end
    return v
end
local function log(code,data)
    local item={time=math.floor(workspace:GetServerTimeNow()*10)/10,
        elapsed=math.floor((os.clock()-T.startedAt)*10)/10,stage=T.stage,
        event=code,detail=data or {}}
    table.insert(T.records,item)
    if #T.records>SETTINGS.maxRecords then table.remove(T.records,1) end
    print("[FINAL V3 MAIN] "..Http:JSONEncode(item))
end
local function stage(s,data)
    if T.stage~=s then T.stage=s; log("STAGE",data) end
end
local function sub(signal,fn)
    local conn=signal:Connect(fn)
    table.insert(T.connections,conn)
end
local overlay
if SETTINGS.showOverlay then
    pcall(function()
        local pg=P:WaitForChild("PlayerGui",15)
        local old=pg:FindFirstChild("BossFinalColossusTestGui")
        if old then old:Destroy() end
        local g=Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        g.Name="BossFinalColossusTestGui";g.ResetOnSpawn=false
        g.DisplayOrder=900;g.IgnoreGuiInset=true;g.Parent=pg
        overlay=Instance.new("TextLabel")
        overlay.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(305,92);overlay.Position=UDim2.new(0,12,0,70)
        overlay.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(18,24,33);overlay.BackgroundTransparency=0.2
        overlay.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(235,242,248)
        overlay.TextSize=13;overlay.Font=Enum.Font.Code
        overlay.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left;overlay.TextYAlignment=Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
        overlay.TextWrapped=true;overlay.Parent=g
    end)
end
local function redraw()
    if overlay and overlay.Parent then
        overlay.Text="FINAL COLOSSUS V3 / MAIN\n"..
            "Stage: "..T.stage.."\n"..
            "Home: "..tostring(T.originWorld or "?").." | World: "..tostring(P:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")).."\n"..
            "Queue: "..tostring(T.queueStatus).."\n"..
            "Difficulty: "..SETTINGS.difficulty.." | Records: "..#T.records
    end
end
function T:status()
    return {running=self.running,stage=self.stage,placeId=game.PlaceId,
        queueStatus=self.queueStatus,originWorld=self.originWorld,records=#self.records,
        sealState=self.seal and self.seal:GetAttribute("SealState"),
        sealLeader=self.seal and self.seal:GetAttribute("SealLeader"),
        attuned=P:GetAttribute("SealAttuned"),
        canBreak=self.seal and self.seal:GetAttribute("SealCanBreak"),
        difficulty=self.seal and self.seal:GetAttribute("SealDifficulty"),
        cooldown=self.cooldown and self.cooldown(),
        prequeueCooldownSeconds=self.prequeueCooldownSeconds,
        currentWorld=P:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")}
end
function T:dump(n)
    n=math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(n) or 120),1,500)
    for i=math.max(1,#self.records-n+1),#self.records do
        print("[FINAL V3 MAIN LOG] "..Http:JSONEncode(self.records[i]))
    end
end
function T:stop()
    if not self.running then return end
    self.running=false
    for _, c in ipairs(self.connections) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
    table.clear(self.connections)
    stage("STOPPED",{note="Does not cancel an already queued teleport script"})
    if overlay and overlay.Parent then overlay.Parent:Destroy() end
end
local function pause(sec)
    local untilTime=os.clock()+sec
    while T.running and os.clock()<untilTime do task.wait(math.min(.2,untilTime-os.clock())) end
    return T.running
end
local function root()
    local c=P.Character
    return c, c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end
local function sealCenter(model)
    local pedestal=model:FindFirstChild("SealPedestal") or model:FindFirstChild("Cylinder")
    local v=model:GetAttribute("SealCentre")
    if typeof(v)~="Vector3" then v=pedestal and pedestal.Position or nil end
    if typeof(v)~="Vector3" then return nil end
    local topY=v.Y
    if pedestal and pedestal:IsA("BasePart") then
        topY=pedestal.Position.Y+pedestal.Size.Y*.5
    end
    return Vector3.new(v.X,topY,v.Z)
end
local function horizontalDistance(a,b)
    local dx=a.X-b.X;local dz=a.Z-b.Z
    return math.sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz)
end
local function cooldown()
    local raw=P:GetAttribute("BossStartCooldowns")
    if type(raw)~="string" then return 0 end
    local ok,map=pcall(function() return Http:JSONDecode(raw) end)
    if not ok or type(map)~="table" then return 0 end
    return math.max(0,(tonumber(map.FinalColossus) or 0)-workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
end
T.cooldown=cooldown
local function locateSeal()
    local s=workspace:FindFirstChild("HANDRIG") or workspace:WaitForChild("HANDRIG",30)
    if not s then return nil,"HANDRIG_NOT_FOUND" end
    local center=sealCenter(s)
    if not center then return nil,"SEAL_CENTER_UNKNOWN" end
    return s,center
end
local function queueFunction()
    if type(queue_on_teleport)=="function" then return queue_on_teleport,"queue_on_teleport" end
    if type(queueonteleport)=="function" then return queueonteleport,"queueonteleport" end
    if type(G.queue_on_teleport)=="function" then return G.queue_on_teleport,"getgenv.queue_on_teleport" end
    if type(G.queueonteleport)=="function" then return G.queueonteleport,"getgenv.queueonteleport" end
    local synTbl=rawget(G,"syn") or syn
    if type(synTbl)=="table" and type(synTbl.queue_on_teleport)=="function" then
        return synTbl.queue_on_teleport,"syn.queue_on_teleport"
    end
    local flux=rawget(G,"fluxus") or fluxus
    if type(flux)=="table" and type(flux.queue_on_teleport)=="function" then
        return flux.queue_on_teleport,"fluxus.queue_on_teleport"
    end
    return nil,nil
end

log("MAIN_INIT",{placeId=game.PlaceId, options=SETTINGS})
local remotes=RS:FindFirstChild("Remotes") or RS:WaitForChild("Remotes",25)
local sealRemote=remotes and (remotes:FindFirstChild("FinalBossSeal") or remotes:WaitForChild("FinalBossSeal",10))
if not sealRemote or not sealRemote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
    stage("ERROR",{reason="FINAL_BOSS_SEAL_REMOTE_MISSING"}); redraw(); return
end
sub(sealRemote.OnClientEvent,function(evt)
    if not T.running or type(evt)~="table" then return end
    if evt.Kind=="Attune" or evt.Kind=="Break" or evt.Kind=="Summon" or evt.Kind=="Countdown" or evt.Kind=="Reseal" or evt.Kind=="Reset" then
        log("SEAL_EVENT",{kind=evt.Kind,userId=evt.UserId,breakAt=safe(evt.BreakAt)})
    end
end)
for _, n in ipairs({"SealAttuned","CurrentWorld","InBossFight"}) do
    sub(P:GetAttributeChangedSignal(n),function()
        if T.running then log("PLAYER_ATTRIBUTE",{name=n,value=safe(P:GetAttribute(n))});redraw() end
    end)
end

for _, name in ipairs({"FinalBossState", "FinalBossActive"}) do
    sub(workspace:GetAttributeChangedSignal(name),function()
        if T.running then log("WORKSPACE_ATTRIBUTE",{name=name,value=safe(workspace:GetAttribute(name))});redraw() end
    end)
end

local function send(payload,why)
    if not T.running then return false end
    local ok,err=pcall(function() sealRemote:FireServer(payload) end)
    log(ok and "REMOTE_SENT" or "REMOTE_FAILED",{reason=why,payload=payload, error=not ok and tostring(err) or nil})
    return ok
end

local function waitForWorld()
    local deadline=os.clock()+15
    repeat
        local n=tonumber(P:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"))
        if n and n>=1 and n%1==0 then return n end
        task.wait(.3)
    until not T.running or os.clock()>=deadline
    return nil
end
local function travelToWorld80(homeWorld)
    if homeWorld==80 then return true,"ALREADY_WORLD_80" end
    if not SETTINGS.autoTravelWorld80 then return false,"AUTO_WORLD_TRAVEL_DISABLED" end
    if P:GetAttribute("InBossFight")==true then return false,"BOSS_LOCK_ACTIVE" end
    if P:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout")==true then
        return false,"HIDEOUT_ACTIVE_ENTER_WORLD_FIRST"
    end
    local remotes=RS:FindFirstChild("Remotes") or RS:WaitForChild("Remotes",20)
    local prepare=remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("NavPrepareWorlds")
    local request=remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("RequestWorldTravel")
    local result=remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("WorldTravelResult")
    if not prepare or not request or not result then return false,"WORLD_TRAVEL_REMOTES_MISSING" end
    local _,hrp=root()
    if not hrp then return false,"CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE" end
    local before=hrp.Position
    local reply=nil
    local con=result.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(evt)
        if type(evt)=="table" and evt.Kind=="Result" and tonumber(evt.WorldId)==80 then reply=evt end
    end)
    stage("TRAVEL_WORLD_80",{from=homeWorld,to=80});redraw()
    local ok,err=pcall(function()
        prepare:FireServer("stream",80)
        task.wait(.15)
        request:FireServer(80)
    end)
    if not ok then con:Disconnect();return false,"WORLD_REQUEST_SEND_FAILED:"..tostring(err) end
    local deadline=os.clock()+22
    while T.running and os.clock()<deadline do
        if reply and reply.Ok==false then
            con:Disconnect()
            return false,"WORLD_TRAVEL_REJECTED:"..tostring(reply.Reason)
        end
        local _,r=root()
        if r and tonumber(P:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"))==80 and
            (r.Position-before).Magnitude>35 and P:GetAttribute("InBossFight")~=true then
            con:Disconnect()
            log("WORLD_80_VERIFIED",{from=homeWorld,to=80,position=safe(r.Position)})
            return true,"WORLD_80_VERIFIED"
        end
        task.wait(.25)
    end
    con:Disconnect()
    return false,"WORLD_TRAVEL_UNVERIFIED_NO_RETRY"
end
local function run()
    stage("CAPTURE_ORIGIN");redraw()
    local original=waitForWorld()
    if not original then stage("ERROR",{reason="ORIGINAL_WORLD_UNAVAILABLE"});redraw();return end
    SETTINGS.originWorld=original
    T.originWorld=original
    log("ORIGIN_SAVED",{world=original,placeId=game.PlaceId})
    if original~=80 then
        local ok,reason=travelToWorld80(original)
        if not ok then
            stage("WORLD_TRAVEL_FAILED",{reason=reason,from=original,to=80})
            T.running=false
            redraw();return
        end
        pause(1)
    end
    stage("FIND_SEAL");redraw()
    local seal,center=locateSeal()
    if not seal then stage("ERROR",{reason=center});redraw();return end
    T.seal=seal
    local currentWorld=tonumber(P:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"))
    if currentWorld~=80 then
        stage("NEED_WORLD_80",{currentWorld=currentWorld});redraw();return
    end
    if P:GetAttribute("InBossFight")==true or
        (workspace:GetAttribute("FinalBossState")~=nil and
        workspace:GetAttribute("FinalBossState")~="Idle") then
        stage("OTHER_FIGHT_ACTIVE",{state=workspace:GetAttribute("FinalBossState")})
        redraw();return
    end
    local existingLeader=tonumber(seal:GetAttribute("SealLeader") or 0) or 0
    if SETTINGS.soloOnly and existingLeader~=0 and existingLeader~=P.UserId then
        stage("OTHER_PARTY_LEADER",{leader=existingLeader});redraw();return
    end
    local c,r=root()
    if not c or not r then
        stage("ERROR",{reason="CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE"});redraw();return
    end
    local distance=horizontalDistance(r.Position,center)
    log("SEAL_FOUND",{center=safe(center),distance=distance,
        state=seal:GetAttribute("SealState"),world=P:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")})
    if distance>16 then
        if not SETTINGS.autoMoveToSeal then
            stage("NEED_MANUAL_SEAL_APPROACH",{distance=distance});redraw();return
        end
        stage("MOVE_TO_SEAL",{distance=distance});redraw()
        local destination=Vector3.new(center.X+8,center.Y+4,center.Z)
        local ok,err=pcall(function() c:PivotTo(CFrame.new(destination)) end)
        if not ok then stage("ERROR",{reason="MOVE_FAILED",error=tostring(err)});redraw();return end
        pause(.6)
        local _,after=root()
        if not after or horizontalDistance(after.Position,center)>18 then
            stage("NEED_MANUAL_SEAL_APPROACH",{reason="POSITION_NOT_VERIFIED"});redraw();return
        end
        log("SEAL_POSITION_VERIFIED",{position=safe(after.Position)})
    end
    -- Admission preflight must occur BEFORE queue_on_teleport. Once queued,
    -- the payload has no portable dequeue API and a cooldown rejection becomes
    -- an ambiguous, permanently blocking cross-place attempt. When not attuned,
    -- idle leader plus an active server cooldown conclusively prevents launch.
    local initialCooldown=cooldown()
    local initialLeader=tonumber(seal:GetAttribute("SealLeader") or 0) or 0
    if initialCooldown>0 and initialLeader==0 and P:GetAttribute("SealAttuned")~=true
        and not SETTINGS.autoWaitCooldown then
        T.prequeueCooldownSeconds=math.ceil(initialCooldown)
        stage("COOLDOWN",{seconds=math.ceil(initialCooldown),preQueue=true})
        T.running=false
        log("COOLDOWN_PREQUEUE",{seconds=math.ceil(initialCooldown),queue=T.queueStatus})
        redraw();return
    end
    raidCode=makeRaidCode() -- embed origin world into both queued stages
    local fn,apiName=queueFunction()
    if fn then
        local ok,err=pcall(function() fn(raidCode) end)
        T.queueStatus=ok and "queued" or "error"
        log(ok and "QUEUE_REGISTERED" or "QUEUE_FAILED",{api=apiName,bytes=#raidCode,error=not ok and tostring(err) or nil})
    else
        T.queueStatus="unsupported"
        log("QUEUE_UNAVAILABLE",{action="Manually re-execute same file in raid place"})
    end
    if SETTINGS.requireTeleportQueue and T.queueStatus~="queued" then
        stage("ERROR",{reason="QUEUE_REQUIRED_FOR_AUTOMATIC_HANDOFF"});redraw();return
    end
    local waitDeadline=os.clock()+SETTINGS.sealTimeoutSeconds
    local nextAttuneAt=0
    local nextDifficultyAt=0
    local nextBreakAt=0
    local attuneTries=0
    local difficultyTries=0
    local breakTries=0
    local lastKey=""
    stage("SEAL_READY");redraw()
    while T.running and os.clock()<waitDeadline do
        local state=tostring(seal:GetAttribute("SealState") or "Dormant")
        local leader=tonumber(seal:GetAttribute("SealLeader") or 0) or 0
        local attuned=P:GetAttribute("SealAttuned")==true
        local canBreak=seal:GetAttribute("SealCanBreak")==true
        local chosen=tostring(seal:GetAttribute("SealDifficulty") or "Normal")
        local cd=cooldown()
        local key=table.concat({state,tostring(leader),tostring(attuned),tostring(canBreak),chosen},"|")
        if key~=lastKey then
            lastKey=key
            log("SEAL_STATE",{state=state,leader=leader,attuned=attuned,canBreak=canBreak,
                difficulty=chosen,cooldown=math.ceil(cd)})
        end
        local _,rr=root()
        if rr and horizontalDistance(rr.Position,center)>18 and state=="Dormant" then
            stage("OUT_OF_RANGE",{distance=horizontalDistance(rr.Position,center)});redraw();return
        end
        if state=="Breaking" or state=="Ritual" or state=="Teleporting" or
            workspace:GetAttribute("FinalBossState")=="Intro" or
            workspace:GetAttribute("FinalBossState")=="Active" then
            stage("WAITING_FOR_RAID_TELEPORT",{state=state,queue=T.queueStatus})
            redraw();return
        end
        if not attuned then
            if not SETTINGS.autoAttune then stage("NEED_MANUAL_ATTUNE");redraw();return end
            if cd>0 and leader==0 then
                if not SETTINGS.autoWaitCooldown then
                    stage("COOLDOWN",{seconds=math.ceil(cd)});redraw();return
                end
                stage("WAIT_COOLDOWN",{seconds=math.ceil(cd)})
            elseif state=="Dormant" or state=="Summoning" or state=="Countdown" then
                if os.clock()>=nextAttuneAt and attuneTries<3 then
                    attuneTries=attuneTries+1
                    stage("ATTUNE_REQUEST",{attempt=attuneTries})
                    send({Kind="Press"},"ATTUNE")
                    nextAttuneAt=os.clock()+9
                end
            end
        elseif leader==P.UserId then
            if state=="Dormant" and SETTINGS.autoSelectDifficulty and chosen~=SETTINGS.difficulty and
                os.clock()>=nextDifficultyAt and difficultyTries<3 then
                difficultyTries=difficultyTries+1
                stage("SET_DIFFICULTY",{want=SETTINGS.difficulty, current=chosen})
                send({Kind="Difficulty",Difficulty=SETTINGS.difficulty},"DIFFICULTY")
                nextDifficultyAt=os.clock()+5
            elseif state=="Dormant" and (chosen==SETTINGS.difficulty or not SETTINGS.autoSelectDifficulty) and canBreak and SETTINGS.autoBreakSeal then
                if breakTries<1 and os.clock()>=nextBreakAt then
                    breakTries=breakTries+1
                    stage("BREAK_REQUEST")
                    -- Important: server sees ONE Press; the UI's 0.35s double-confirm is local only.
                    send({Kind="Press"},"BREAK_THE_SEAL")
                    nextBreakAt=os.clock()+6
                end
            else
                stage("WAIT_SEAL_READY",{state=state,canBreak=canBreak,difficulty=chosen})
            end
        else
            stage("WAIT_PARTY_LEADER",{leader=leader})
        end
        redraw()
        pause(1)
    end
    if T.running then stage("TIMEOUT",{seconds=SETTINGS.sealTimeoutSeconds});redraw() end
end
task.spawn(function()
    local ok,err=pcall(run)
    if not ok then stage("ERROR",{reason=tostring(err)});redraw() end
end)
print("[FINAL V3 MAIN] Status: getgenv().PlaneRNGFinalColossusTestV3:status()")
print("[FINAL V3 MAIN] Logs: getgenv().PlaneRNGFinalColossusTestV3:dump(120)")
]========],
}
end
-- END MODULE boss.FinalColossus.MainRunnerSource

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.FinalColossus.PlaceHandoff
__factories["boss.FinalColossus.PlaceHandoff"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Single tested V3 source is deliberately kept byte-for-byte.  The queued
-- RAID_SOURCE and RETURN_SOURCE are self-contained (Roblox destroys the main
-- place Lua VM on TeleportService cross-place hops).
local Contracts = require("main.core.Contracts")
local RaidAttemptOptions = require("boss.shared.RaidAttemptOptions")
local RaidReturnResumeSource = require("main.adapters.RaidReturnResumeSource")
local RaidOutcomeWitnessSource = require("main.adapters.RaidOutcomeWitnessSource")
local MainRunnerSource = require("boss.FinalColossus.MainRunnerSource")
local RaidRunnerSource = require("boss.FinalColossus.RaidRunnerSource")
local ReturnRunnerSource = require("boss.FinalColossus.ReturnRunnerSource")
local function sourceV3(returnHook, witness)
    return MainRunnerSource.beforeReturn
        .. "local RETURN_SOURCE = [===[\n" .. ReturnRunnerSource .. (returnHook or "") .. "]===]"
        .. MainRunnerSource.between
        .. "local RAID_SOURCE = [====[\n" .. RaidRunnerSource .. (witness or "") .. "]====]"
        .. MainRunnerSource.afterRaid
end
local PlaceHandoff = {}

local function globals()
    if type(getgenv) == "function" then
        local ok, value = pcall(getgenv)
        if ok and type(value) == "table" then return value end
    end
    return _G
end

function PlaceHandoff.new(env, config)
    local adapter = {}
    local lastStartAt = -math.huge
    local g = globals()

    local function result(code, seconds, evidence)
        return Contracts.result("DEFERRED", code, {
            stage = "SETUP", retryAt = env.runtime:now() + (seconds or config.launchRetrySeconds),
            evidence = evidence or {},
        })
    end

    function adapter:cancel()
        local t = globals().PlaneRNGFinalColossusTestV3
        if t and t.running and type(t.stop) == "function" then
            pcall(function() t:stop() end)
        end
        -- queue_on_teleport has no portable dequeue API; a queued payload can
        -- still execute after teleport.  Do not claim cancellation of handoff.
    end

    function adapter:forceReset()
        self:cancel()
        lastStartAt = -math.huge
        return true
    end

    function adapter:status()
        local current = globals().PlaneRNGFinalColossusTestV3
        if current and type(current.status) == "function" then
            local ok, data = pcall(function() return current:status() end)
            if ok then return data end
        end
        return {running = false, stage = "NOT_STARTED"}
    end

    -- Native return only after the Final entry has definitively stopped
    -- BEFORE queue_on_teleport. The existing V3 Return script owns verification.
    -- This does not release a handoff by itself: the journal requires home proof.
    local function returnAfterPrequeue(attempt, player)
        local home=attempt and attempt.originalWorld
        if type(home)~="number" or home<1 or home%1~=0 then return false end
        if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight")==true
            or player:GetAttribute("BossResultsOpen")==true
            or player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout")==true then return false end
        if tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"))==home then return true end
        local existing=globals().PlaneRNGFinalColossusReturnV3
        if existing and existing.running then return false end
        local code=ReturnRunnerSource:gsub("__ORIGIN_WORLD_LITERAL__",tostring(home))
        local loader,err=loadstring(code)
        if not loader then warn("[V6 FINAL RECOVERY] RETURN_SOURCE_COMPILE_FAILED",err);return false end
        local started,reason=pcall(loader)
        if not started then warn("[V6 FINAL RECOVERY] RETURN_SOURCE_FAILED",reason);return false end
        local expires=env.runtime:now()+36
        while env.runtime:now()<expires do
            local instance=globals().PlaneRNGFinalColossusReturnV3
            if instance and instance.stage=="HOME_VERIFIED"
                and tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"))==home then
                return true
            end
            if instance and (instance.stage=="RETURN_REJECTED"
                or instance.stage=="RETURN_UNVERIFIED_NO_RETRY"
                or instance.stage=="RETURN_ERROR") then return false end
            task.wait(.25)
        end
        return false
    end

    function adapter:run(ctx, attempt)
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return Contracts.result("CANCELLED", "FINALCOLOSSUS_CANCELLED", {stage="SETUP"}) end
        if game.PlaceId ~= config.mainPlaceId then
            return result("FINALCOLOSSUS_MAIN_PLACE_REQUIRED", 60, {placeId = game.PlaceId})
        end
        local player = env.services.roblox:player()
        if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true then
            return result("FINALCOLOSSUS_OTHER_BOSS_ACTIVE", 40)
        end
        if player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") == true then
            return result("FINALCOLOSSUS_LEAVE_HIDEOUT_FIRST", 40)
        end
        local current = globals().PlaneRNGFinalColossusTestV3
        if current and current.running and current.placeId == game.PlaceId then
            -- The same executor may retain getgenv() after return to the main
            -- place.  Only clean up once the queued return has been verified.
            local home = globals().PlaneRNGFinalColossusReturnV3
            if home and home.stage == "HOME_VERIFIED" then
                if type(current.stop) == "function" then pcall(function() current:stop() end) end
            else
                return result("FINALCOLOSSUS_V3_ALREADY_RUNNING", 30, {stage = current.stage,
                    currentWorld = player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")})
            end
        end
        if env.runtime:now() - lastStartAt < 5 then
            return result("FINALCOLOSSUS_START_THROTTLED", 10)
        end
        if type(loadstring) ~= "function" then
            return result("FINALCOLOSSUS_LOADSTRING_UNAVAILABLE", 60)
        end
        local options, invalid = RaidAttemptOptions.build(config,
            globals().PlaneRNGFinalColossusOptions, attempt)
        if not options then return result(invalid, 60) end
        options.requireTeleportQueue = true
        local returnHook = nil
        if attempt and attempt.resumeV6 == true then
            returnHook = RaidReturnResumeSource.render(config.bossId, attempt.token,
                player.UserId, config.mainPlaceId, attempt.originalWorld, attempt.buildId)
            if not returnHook then return result("RAID_RESUME_CONTRACT_INVALID", 60) end
        end
        local witness=nil
        if attempt and attempt.resumeV6==true then
            witness=RaidOutcomeWitnessSource.render(config.bossId,attempt.token,
                player.UserId,config.raidPlaceId,options.difficulty)
            if not witness then return result("RAID_WITNESS_CONTRACT_INVALID",60) end
        end
        globals().PlaneRNGFinalColossusOptions = options
        local fn, compileError = loadstring(sourceV3(returnHook, witness))
        if not fn then
            return result("FINALCOLOSSUS_V3_COMPILE_ERROR", 120, {error = tostring(compileError)})
        end
        lastStartAt = env.runtime:now()
        local ok, err = pcall(fn)
        if not ok then
            return result("FINALCOLOSSUS_V3_LAUNCH_ERROR", 120, {error = tostring(err)})
        end
        local status = self:status()
        -- Starting a coroutine is not proof of cross-place handoff. Wait for
        -- the bounded native prequeue decision, never infer acceptance from
        -- a running test object. The timeout remains ambiguous, not abortable.
        local deadline=env.runtime:now()+35
        while status.running and status.queueStatus~="queued"
            and status.stage~="COOLDOWN" and env.runtime:now()<deadline do
            if ctx:isCancelled() then break end
            task.wait(.2)
            status=self:status()
        end
        status=self:status()
        if status.stage=="COOLDOWN" and status.queueStatus=="not_attempted"
            and type(status.prequeueCooldownSeconds)=="number"
            and status.prequeueCooldownSeconds>0 then
            local homeVerified=returnAfterPrequeue(attempt,player)
            print("[V6 FINAL RECOVERY] PREQUEUE_COOLDOWN",
                "remaining",status.prequeueCooldownSeconds,"homeVerified",homeVerified)
            return result("FINALCOLOSSUS_V3_PREQUEUE_COOLDOWN", 60, {
                noPayloadQueued=true,entryStage="COOLDOWN",
                cooldownSeconds=status.prequeueCooldownSeconds,
                homeVerified=homeVerified,
            })
        end
        if status.stage=="WORLD_TRAVEL_FAILED" and status.queueStatus=="not_attempted"
            and not status.running then
            local homeVerified=returnAfterPrequeue(attempt,player)
            return result("FINALCOLOSSUS_V3_PREQUEUE_TRAVEL_FAILED",60,{
                noPayloadQueued=true,entryStage="WORLD_TRAVEL_FAILED",homeVerified=homeVerified})
        end
        if status.queueStatus~="queued" then
            return result("FINALCOLOSSUS_V3_ENTRY_UNCONFIRMED",60,status)
        end
        if env.services.telemetry then
            env.services.telemetry:emit("FINALCOLOSSUS_V3_STARTED", {
                difficulty = options.difficulty, originWorld = player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"),
                source = "TESTED_V3", returnToOrigin = options.returnToOrigin,
            })
        end
        return result("FINALCOLOSSUS_V3_STARTED", 30, {
            stage = status.stage, difficulty = options.difficulty,
            originWorld = player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"),
            note = "Raid outcome and home return handled by V3 queue_on_teleport chain",
        })
    end
    return adapter
end
return PlaceHandoff
end
-- END MODULE boss.FinalColossus.PlaceHandoff

__factories["boss.FinalColossus.RaidRunnerSource"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Exact tested V3 raid observer, teleport dodge, report & leave code.
-- Self-contained after queue_on_teleport: never require main-place modules.
return [========[
--!nocheck
local MAIN_PLACE = 133112767606395
local RAID_PLACE = 130165569233874
local GLOBAL_KEY = "PlaneRNGFinalColossusTestV3"
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Http = game:GetService("HttpService")
local OPTIONS_JSON = __OPTIONS_JSON_LITERAL__

pcall(function() settings = Http:JSONDecode(OPTIONS_JSON) end)
local function env()
    if type(getgenv) == "function" then
        local ok, result = pcall(getgenv)
        if ok and type(result) == "table" then return result end
    end
    return _G
end
local G = env()
for _, oldKey in ipairs({"PlaneRNGFinalColossusTestV2", "PlaneRNGFinalColossusTestV1"}) do
    local old=G[oldKey]

    end
end
if game.PlaceId ~= RAID_PLACE then

end
if G[GLOBAL_KEY] and G[GLOBAL_KEY].running then

        warn("[FINAL V3 RAID] Observer already running, ignoring duplicate injection")

    end
    -- Some executors keep getgenv() across places; clean up the old main-place object.

if not game:IsLoaded() then game.Loaded:Wait() end
local P = Players.LocalPlayer

local T = { running = true, placeId = game.PlaceId, stage = "RAID_BOOT", records = {}, connections = {},
    latestAttack = nil, latestPhase = nil, health = nil, maxHealth = nil,
    result = nil, startedAt = os.clock(), dodgeCount=0, lastDodge=nil,
    threats={}, lastDodgeAt=0, lastDodgeCheck=0 }
G[GLOBAL_KEY] = T
local function safe(x, depth)
    depth = depth or 0
    local k = typeof(x)
    if k == "nil" or k == "boolean" or k == "number" then return x end
    if k == "string" then return x:sub(1, 180) end
    if k == "Vector3" then return {x=math.floor(x.X*10)/10, y=math.floor(x.Y*10)/10, z=math.floor(x.Z*10)/10} end
    if k == "Instance" then return x:GetFullName():sub(1, 180) end
    if k ~= "table" then return tostring(x):sub(1,100) end
    if depth >= 2 then return "[nested table]" end
    local t, n = {}, 0
    for key, val in pairs(x) do
        n = n + 1
        if n > 24 then t.__truncated = true; break end
        if type(key) == "string" or type(key) == "number" then
            t[tostring(key):sub(1,55)] = safe(val, depth+1)
        end
    end
    return t
end
local function log(code, fields)
    local item = {time=math.floor(workspace:GetServerTimeNow()*10)/10,
        elapsed=math.floor((os.clock()-T.startedAt)*10)/10,
        stage=T.stage, event=code, detail=safe(fields or {})}
    table.insert(T.records, item)
    if #T.records > (tonumber(settings.maxRecords) or 500) then table.remove(T.records, 1) end
    local ok, line = pcall(function() return Http:JSONEncode(item) end)
    print("[FINAL V3 RAID] " .. (ok and line or code))
end
local function stage(nextStage, fields)
    if T.stage ~= nextStage then T.stage=nextStage; log("STAGE", fields) end
end
local function sub(signal, fn)
    local conn = signal:Connect(fn)
    table.insert(T.connections, conn)
end
local overlay
if settings.showOverlay ~= false then
    pcall(function()
        local old = P:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 15):FindFirstChild("BossFinalColossusTestGui")

        lbl.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(235,242,248)

end

        overlay.Text = "FINAL COLOSSUS V3 / RAID\n" ..

function T:status()
