-- ===== Raid-only, geometry-aware experimental dodge =====
-- Geometry and floor come from game's FinalBossAttacks.Telegraph / FinalBossConfig.
-- Disc: Target + Radius, multi-disc: Targets, strip: A,B + Width.
-- Lightning: Strikes[{Target,Radius,ImpactAt}]. Unknown layouts => log and skip.
local function rootAndHumanoid()
    local char=P.Character
    return char, char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"),
        char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end
local function findFloor()
    local model=workspace:FindFirstChild("BOSS")
    local part=model and model:FindFirstChild("Part")
    if part and part:IsA("BasePart") and part:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
        T.arenaFloor=part
        return part
    end
    T.arenaFloor=nil
    return nil
end
local function flatDist(a,b)
    local x=a.X-b.X;local z=a.Z-b.Z
    return math.sqrt(x*x+z*z)
end
local function pointSegmentDistance(p,a,b)
    local dx=b.X-a.X;local dz=b.Z-a.Z
    local len=dx*dx+dz*dz
    if len<0.01 then return flatDist(p,a) end
    local t=math.clamp(((p.X-a.X)*dx+(p.Z-a.Z)*dz)/len,0,1)
    return math.sqrt((p.X-a.X-dx*t)^2+(p.Z-a.Z-dz*t)^2)
end
local function appendThreats(payload, kindOverride)
    if type(payload)~="table" then return false,"NOT_TABLE" end
    local kind=tostring(kindOverride or payload.Kind or "UNKNOWN")
    local shapes={}
    local floor=findFloor()
    local scale=floor and math.max(0.25,floor.Size.X/423) or 1
    local radius=tonumber(payload.Radius)
    local width=tonumber(payload.Width)
    -- Config is optional: only use radius/width if exact telegraph payload omitted it.
    if T.bossConfig and type(T.bossConfig.Attacks)=="table" then
        local def=T.bossConfig.Attacks[kind]
        if type(def)=="table" then
            radius=radius or tonumber(def.Radius)
            width=width or tonumber(def.Width)
        end
    end
    local maxRadius=math.max(radius or 0,tonumber(payload.Shockwave) or 0)
    if typeof(payload.Target)=="Vector3" and maxRadius>0 then
        table.insert(shapes,{kind="disc",center=payload.Target,radius=maxRadius})
    end
    if type(payload.Targets)=="table" and radius and radius>0 then
        for _,target in ipairs(payload.Targets) do
            if typeof(target)=="Vector3" then
                table.insert(shapes,{kind="disc",center=target,radius=radius})
            end
        end
    end
    if typeof(payload.A)=="Vector3" and typeof(payload.B)=="Vector3" and width and width>0 then
        table.insert(shapes,{kind="strip",a=payload.A,b=payload.B,halfWidth=width/2})
    end
    if #shapes==0 then return false,"NO_TARGET_GEOMETRY" end
    local now=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
    local impact=tonumber(payload.ImpactAt)
    local gap=tonumber(payload.Gap) or 0
    local remaining=(impact and impact>=now-2 and impact<now+80) and math.max(0,impact-now) or 2.2
    local expires=os.clock()+math.clamp(remaining+math.max(0,gap)*(#shapes-1)+1.0,1.0,15)
    -- Use a bounded list to protect mobile clients from excessive events.
    table.insert(T.threats,{kind=kind,shapes=shapes,expires=expires,scale=scale})
    while #T.threats>32 do table.remove(T.threats,1) end
    return true,#shapes
end
local function clearExpiredThreats()
    local now=os.clock()
    for i=#T.threats,1,-1 do
        if T.threats[i].expires<=now then table.remove(T.threats,i) end
    end
end
-- Returns signed clearance from every known active telegraph, measured in studs.
-- Nonpositive means danger. A separate dodge margin is applied when selecting a spot.
local function clearanceAt(pos)
    local clearance=math.huge
    for _,threat in ipairs(T.threats) do
        for _,shape in ipairs(threat.shapes) do
            local d
            if shape.kind=="disc" then
                d=flatDist(pos,shape.center)-shape.radius
            else
                d=pointSegmentDistance(pos,shape.a,shape.b)-shape.halfWidth
            end
            clearance=math.min(clearance,d)
        end
    end
    return clearance
end
-- Verify the candidate is inside the measured raid floor and has a raycast hit
-- on the actual floor plate; do not claim floating void / destroyed arena as safe.
local function floorLanding(floor,x,z,hum,root)
    if not floor or not floor.Parent or not floor.CanCollide or not floor.CanQuery then return nil end
    local scale=math.max(0.25,floor.Size.X/423)
    local margin=math.max(10*scale,6)
    local p=Vector3.new(x,floor.Position.Y,z)
    local localPos=floor.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(p)
    local halfX=floor.Size.X*0.5-margin
    local halfZ=floor.Size.Z*0.5-margin
    -- Source Arena Min/Max define the playable footprint (may be asymmetric).
    local boundX0=math.max(-halfX,-180*scale+margin)
    local boundX1=math.min(halfX,191*scale-margin)
    local boundZ0=math.max(-halfZ,-146*scale+margin)
    local boundZ1=math.min(halfZ,105*scale-margin)
    if localPos.X<boundX0 or localPos.X>boundX1 or localPos.Z<boundZ0 or localPos.Z>boundZ1 then
        return nil
    end
    local params=RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances={floor}
    local down=workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(x,floor.Position.Y+floor.Size.Y+140*scale,z),
        Vector3.new(0,-(floor.Size.Y+300*scale),0),params)
    if not down or down.Instance~=floor then return nil end
    local rootHeight=math.max(3.5,(root.Size.Y*0.5)+(hum.HipHeight or 0)+0.7)
    return Vector3.new(x,down.Position.Y+rootHeight,z)
end
local function chooseDodgeSpot(floor,root,hum)
    local pos=root.Position
    local scale=math.max(0.25,floor.Size.X/423)
    local margin=(tonumber(settings.dodgeMargin) or 14)*scale
    local maximum=(tonumber(settings.maxDodgeRange) or 180)*scale
    local best,bestCost,bestClearance=nil,math.huge,-math.huge
    local function check(x,z)
        local dx=x-pos.X;local dz=z-pos.Z
        local dist=math.sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz)
        if dist<10*scale or dist>maximum then return end
        local landing=floorLanding(floor,x,z,hum,root)
        if not landing then return end
        local clearance=clearanceAt(landing)
        if clearance<margin then return end
        local centerDist=flatDist(landing,floor.Position)
        local cost=dist+centerDist*0.025-math.min(clearance,75*scale)*0.08
        if cost<bestCost then best,bestCost,bestClearance=landing,cost,clearance end
    end
    local radii={30,50,75,105,145,180,235,280,340}
    local angleOffset=(os.clock()*0.73)%(math.pi*2)
    for _,radius in ipairs(radii) do
        local r=radius*scale
        if r<=maximum then
            for i=0,15 do
                local a=math.pi*2*i/16+angleOffset
                check(pos.X+math.cos(a)*r,pos.Z+math.sin(a)*r)
            end
        end
    end
    -- Additional candidates around verified center. Only use those within max range.
    for _,f in ipairs({0,0.3,0.58}) do
        local r=95*scale*f
        for i=0,7 do
            local a=math.pi*2*i/8
            check(floor.Position.X+math.cos(a)*r,floor.Position.Z+math.sin(a)*r)
        end
    end
    return best,bestClearance
end
local function attemptDodge(reason)
    if not T.running or settings.autoDodge==false or T.result then return end
    clearExpiredThreats()
    if #T.threats==0 then return end
    local char,root,hum=rootAndHumanoid()
    if not char or not root or not hum or hum.Health<=0 or P:GetAttribute("FinalBossEliminated")==true then return end
    local floor=findFloor()
    if not floor then
        if os.clock()-(T.lastNoFloorLog or -100)>4 then
            T.lastNoFloorLog=os.clock()
            log("DODGE_NO_ARENA_FLOOR",{reason="BOSS.Part not present"})
        end
        return
    end
    local currentClearance=clearanceAt(root.Position)
    local margin=(tonumber(settings.dodgeMargin) or 14)*math.max(0.25,floor.Size.X/423)
    if currentClearance>=margin then return end
    if os.clock()-T.lastDodgeAt<(tonumber(settings.dodgeCooldown) or 0.3) then return end
    T.lastDodgeAt=os.clock()  -- throttle both successful and failed attempts
    local destination,clearance=chooseDodgeSpot(floor,root,hum)
    if not destination then
        log("DODGE_NO_SAFE_SPOT",{reason=reason,currentClearance=currentClearance,
            activeThreats=#T.threats,maxRange=settings.maxDodgeRange})
        return
    end
    local previous=root.Position
    local ok,err=pcall(function()
        local cf=char:GetPivot()
        char:PivotTo(CFrame.new(destination)*cf.Rotation)
    end)
    if not ok then
        log("DODGE_TELEPORT_ERROR",{error=tostring(err),attack=T.latestAttack})
        return
    end
    task.wait(0.08)
    local _,after=rootAndHumanoid()
    local moved=after and flatDist(previous,after.Position) or 0
    local endClearance=after and clearanceAt(after.Position) or -math.huge
    local verified=after and flatDist(after.Position,destination)<11 and endClearance>=margin
    T.dodgeCount=T.dodgeCount+(verified and 1 or 0)
    T.lastDodge={attack=T.latestAttack,reason=reason,verified=verified==true,
        from=safe(previous),to=safe(destination),actual=after and safe(after.Position),
        clearance=clearance,moved=moved}
    log(verified and "DODGE_VERIFIED" or "DODGE_NOT_VERIFIED",T.lastDodge)
    redraw()
end
local function onTelegraph(attack,reason)
    if not T.running or settings.autoDodge==false or T.result then return end
    local ok,count=appendThreats(attack)
    if not ok then
        log("DODGE_UNKNOWN_GEOMETRY",{kind=attack and attack.Kind,why=count,
            sample=safe(attack)})
        return
    end
    -- Telegraph event fires before predicted impact; respond immediately.
    task.spawn(function() attemptDodge(reason or tostring(attack.Kind)) end)
end
-- Keep scanning after the first dodge for overlapping attacks or new player motion.
task.spawn(function()
    while T.running do
        if settings.autoDodge~=false and not T.result then
            if os.clock()-T.lastDodgeCheck>=0.17 then
                T.lastDodgeCheck=os.clock()
                if #T.threats>0 then attemptDodge("ACTIVE_THREATS") end
            end
        end
        task.wait(0.17)
    end
end)
-- ====================================================
local function queueFunction()
    if type(queue_on_teleport)=="function" then return queue_on_teleport,"queue_on_teleport" end
    if type(queueonteleport)=="function" then return queueonteleport,"queueonteleport" end
    if type(G.queue_on_teleport)=="function" then return G.queue_on_teleport,"getgenv.queue_on_teleport" end
    if type(G.queueonteleport)=="function" then return G.queueonteleport,"getgenv.queueonteleport" end
    local synTbl=rawget(G,"syn")
    if type(synTbl)=="table" and type(synTbl.queue_on_teleport)=="function" then
        return synTbl.queue_on_teleport,"syn.queue_on_teleport"
    end
    local flux=rawget(G,"fluxus")
    if type(flux)=="table" and type(flux.queue_on_teleport)=="function" then
        return flux.queue_on_teleport,"fluxus.queue_on_teleport"
    end
    return nil,nil
end
local returnCode = __RETURN_CODE_LITERAL__
local originWorld = tonumber(settings.originWorld) or 0
T.originWorld = originWorld
if settings.returnToOrigin ~= false and originWorld>=1 then
    local fn,api=queueFunction()
    if fn then
        local ok,err=pcall(function() fn(returnCode) end)
        log(ok and "RAID_RETURN_QUEUED" or "RAID_RETURN_QUEUE_FAILED",{api=api,homeWorld=originWorld,
            bytes=#returnCode,error=not ok and tostring(err) or nil})
    else
        log("RAID_RETURN_QUEUE_UNAVAILABLE",{homeWorld=originWorld,action="MANUAL_RETURN_NEEDED"})
    end
else
    log("RAID_RETURN_DISABLED",{originWorld=originWorld})
end
log("RAID_ENTERED", {placeId=game.PlaceId, settings=settings})
-- Require can wait for the raid arena floor and delay itself by up to 30 seconds.
-- Bind Remotes immediately so we don't miss FightStart / early SessionUpdate events.
task.spawn(function()
    local config
    local ok, err = pcall(function()
        config=require(RS:WaitForChild("Modules",20):WaitForChild("FinalBossConfig",20))
    end)
    if T.running then
        log("CONFIG", {loaded=ok and type(config)=="table", isRaid=config and config.IsRaidPlace,
            model=config and config.ModelName, error=not ok and tostring(err) or nil})
        if ok and type(config)=="table" then T.bossConfig=config end
    end
end)
local remotes=RS:WaitForChild("Remotes",25)
if remotes then
    local function bindRemote(name, handler)
        local r=remotes:FindFirstChild(name) or remotes:WaitForChild(name,10)
        if r and r:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
            sub(r.OnClientEvent, handler)
            log("REMOTE_BOUND", {name=name})
        else
            log("REMOTE_MISSING", {name=name})
        end
    end
    bindRemote("FinalBossSessionUpdate", function(e)
        if not T.running or type(e)~="table" then return end
        local kind=tostring(e.Kind or "UNKNOWN")
        if type(e.Phase)=="number" then T.latestPhase=e.Phase end
        if kind=="Attack" and type(e.Attack)=="table" then
            T.latestAttack=tostring(e.Attack.Kind or "UNKNOWN")
            log("ATTACK_TELEGRAPH", {attack=safe(e.Attack)})
            onTelegraph(e.Attack,"ATTACK_"..T.latestAttack)
        elseif kind=="Lightning" and type(e.Strikes)=="table" then
            log("LIGHTNING_TELEGRAPH",{strikes=safe(e.Strikes)})
            for _,strike in ipairs(e.Strikes) do
                if type(strike)=="table" then
                    local target=strike.Target
                    local radius=tonumber(strike.Radius)
                    if typeof(target)=="Vector3" and radius and radius>0 then
                        onTelegraph({Kind="Lightning", Target=target, Radius=radius,
                            ImpactAt=strike.ImpactAt},"LIGHTNING")
                    end
                end
            end
        elseif kind=="Outcome" then
            T.result={victory=e.Victory==true, reason=e.Reason or e.EndReason}
            T.outcomeAt=os.clock()
            table.clear(T.threats)
            stage("RESULT", T.result)
            log("SESSION_EVENT", {kind=kind, data=safe(e)})
        elseif kind=="Return" or kind=="Depart" then
            stage(kind:upper(), {data=safe(e)})
        elseif kind=="Phase" or kind=="Begin" or kind=="Start" or kind=="Eliminated" or kind=="Death" or kind=="Intro" or kind=="Abort" or kind=="Seam" or kind=="Transition" then
            log("SESSION_EVENT", {kind=kind, data=safe(e)})
        else
            -- Keep one sample of every unknown event kind to identify raid-only mechanics.
            T.seenKinds=T.seenKinds or {}
            if not T.seenKinds[kind] then
                T.seenKinds[kind]=true
                log("SESSION_OTHER", {kind=kind, data=safe(e)})
            end
        end
        redraw()
    end)
    bindRemote("FinalBossHealthUpdate", function(hp, maxhp, a, b)
        if not T.running then return end
        T.health=tonumber(hp) or hp
        T.maxHealth=tonumber(maxhp) or maxhp
        local now=os.clock()
        if not T.lastHealthLog or now-T.lastHealthLog>=5 then
            T.lastHealthLog=now
            log("HEALTH", {hp=safe(hp), maxhp=safe(maxhp), extra1=safe(a), extra2=safe(b)})
        end
        redraw()
    end)
    bindRemote("FinalBossFightStart", function(data)
        if not T.running then return end
        stage("FIGHT_START", {data=safe(data)})
        redraw()
    end)
end
-- The stock game returns from the raid through FinalBossLeaveFight after the
-- results Continue action. Only request leave AFTER verified Outcome and grace.
-- Never cancel/abandon an active encounter.
if settings.autoContinueAfterOutcome ~= false then
    task.spawn(function()
        while T.running do
            if T.result and T.outcomeAt and T.stage~="RETURN" and T.stage~="DEPART" then
                local elapsed=os.clock()-T.outcomeAt
                if elapsed>=18 and not T.leaveAttempted then
                    local controller
                    pcall(function()
                        local modules=RS:FindFirstChild("ClientModules")
                        if modules and modules:FindFirstChild("BossResultsController") then
                            controller=require(modules.BossResultsController)
                        end
                    end)
                    local armed=false
                    if controller and type(controller.Debug)=="function" then
                        local ok,desc=pcall(controller.Debug)
                        armed=ok and type(desc)=="string" and desc:find("armed=true",1,true)~=nil
                    end
                    if armed and controller and type(controller.Dismiss)=="function" then
                        T.leaveAttempted=true
                        local ok,err=pcall(function() controller.Dismiss("continue") end)
                        log(ok and "RESULT_CONTINUE_REQUESTED" or "RESULT_CONTINUE_ERROR",{error=not ok and tostring(err) or nil})
                    elseif elapsed>=36 then
                        -- Same server remote the raid Continue / Leave UI uses.
                        -- Trigger once only, never retry if ambiguous.
                        local rem=RS:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
                        local leave=rem and rem:FindFirstChild("FinalBossLeaveFight")
                        if leave and leave:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                            T.leaveAttempted=true
                            local ok,err=pcall(function() leave:FireServer() end)
                            log(ok and "RESULT_LEAVE_REQUESTED" or "RESULT_LEAVE_ERROR",{reason="OUTCOME_CONFIRMED",error=not ok and tostring(err) or nil})
                        else
                            log("RESULT_LEAVE_REMOTE_MISSING",{manualContinueRequired=true})
                            T.leaveAttempted=true
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            task.wait(1)
        end
    end)
end
for _, name in ipairs({"FinalBossState", "FinalBossActive", "FinalBossFightGeneration"}) do
    sub(workspace:GetAttributeChangedSignal(name), function()
        if not T.running then return end
        log("WORKSPACE_ATTRIBUTE", {name=name, value=safe(workspace:GetAttribute(name))})
        if name=="FinalBossState" and workspace:GetAttribute(name)=="Active" then stage("COMBAT") end
        redraw()
    end)
end
for _, name in ipairs({"FinalRaidArrival", "FinalRaidPilot", "FinalBossParticipant", "FinalBossEliminated", "BossResultsOpen"}) do
    sub(P:GetAttributeChangedSignal(name), function()
        if not T.running then return end
        log("PLAYER_ATTRIBUTE", {name=name, value=safe(P:GetAttribute(name))})
        redraw()
    end)
end
sub(P.CharacterAdded, function()
    if T.running then log("CHARACTER_ADDED") end
end)
task.spawn(function()
    while T.running do
        if workspace:GetAttribute("FinalBossState")=="Active" and T.stage~="COMBAT" then stage("COMBAT") end
        redraw()
        task.wait(1)
    end
end)
task.spawn(function()
    while T.running do
        task.wait(20)
        if T.running then log("HEARTBEAT", T:status()) end
    end
end)
log("RAID_READY", T:status())
print("[FINAL V3 RAID] Status: getgenv().PlaneRNGFinalColossusTestV3:status()")
print("[FINAL V3 RAID] Logs: getgenv().PlaneRNGFinalColossusTestV3:dump(150)")
print("[FINAL V3 RAID] Experimental teleport dodge enabled for verified circle/strip/lightning telegraphs; no auto-damage.")
]========]
end
-- END MODULE boss.FinalColossus.RaidRunnerSource

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.FinalColossus.ReturnRunnerSource
__factories["boss.FinalColossus.ReturnRunnerSource"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Exact tested V3 code queued when leaving the raid for the main place.
return [========[
--!nocheck
local MAIN_PLACE = 133112767606395
local RAID_PLACE = 130165569233874
local KEY = "PlaneRNGFinalColossusReturnV3"
local Http = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local originWorld = __ORIGIN_WORLD_LITERAL__
local function env()
    local ok, e = pcall(function() return getgenv() end)
    return (ok and type(e)=="table") and e or _G
end
local G=env()
if game.PlaceId ~= MAIN_PLACE then
    warn("[FINAL V3 RETURN] Unexpected PlaceId", game.PlaceId, "Expected main", MAIN_PLACE)
    return
end
if not game:IsLoaded() then game.Loaded:Wait() end
local P=Players.LocalPlayer
while not P do task.wait(.1);P=Players.LocalPlayer end
if type(originWorld)~="number" or originWorld < 1 or originWorld%1 ~= 0 then
    warn("[FINAL V3 RETURN] Origin world missing; manual return required")
    return
end
if G[KEY] and G[KEY].running then return end
local T={running=true,stage="RETURN_BOOT",originWorld=originWorld,records={},startedAt=os.clock()}
G[KEY]=T
local function log(event,data)
    local item={event=event,stage=T.stage,originWorld=originWorld,currentWorld=P:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"),
        time=math.floor(workspace:GetServerTimeNow()*10)/10, detail=data or {}}
    table.insert(T.records,item)
    local ok,line=pcall(function() return Http:JSONEncode(item) end)
    print("[FINAL V3 RETURN] "..(ok and line or event))
end
local function stage(s,d)
    T.stage=s; log("STAGE",d)
end
function T:status()
    return {running=self.running,stage=self.stage,homeWorld=originWorld,
        currentWorld=P:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"),inBossFight=P:GetAttribute("InBossFight"),
        hideout=P:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout"),records=#self.records}
end
function T:dump(n)
    n=math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(n) or 100),1,500)
    for i=math.max(1,#self.records-n+1),#self.records do
        print("[FINAL V3 RETURN LOG] "..Http:JSONEncode(self.records[i]))
    end
end
function T:stop() self.running=false;stage("STOPPED") end
local function root()
    local c=P.Character
    return c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end
local function readyToReturn()
    return P:GetAttribute("InBossFight")~=true and P:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout")~=true
        and P:GetAttribute("BossResultsOpen")~=true and root()~=nil
end
local function run()
    stage("WAIT_MAIN_UNLOCK",{world=originWorld})
    local deadline=os.clock()+110
    while T.running and os.clock()<deadline do
        if readyToReturn() and tonumber(P:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")) then break end
        task.wait(.5)
    end
    if not T.running then return end
    if not readyToReturn() then stage("RETURN_LOCK_PENDING",{reason="FIGHT_OR_REPORT_OR_HIDEOUT"});return end
    local curr=tonumber(P:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"))
    if curr==originWorld then
        stage("HOME_VERIFIED",{alreadyThere=true,world=originWorld});T.running=false;return
    end
    local remotes=RS:FindFirstChild("Remotes") or RS:WaitForChild("Remotes",20)
    local prepare=remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("NavPrepareWorlds")
    local request=remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("RequestWorldTravel")
    local result=remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("WorldTravelResult")
    if not prepare or not request or not result then
        stage("RETURN_ERROR",{reason="WORLD_TRAVEL_REMOTES_MISSING"});return
    end
    local reply=nil
    local conn=result.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
        if type(e)=="table" and e.Kind=="Result" and tonumber(e.WorldId)==originWorld then
            reply=e
        end
    end)
    local before=root()
    local prior=before and before.Position
    if not prior then conn:Disconnect();stage("RETURN_ERROR",{reason="ROOT_MISSING"});return end
    stage("HOME_REQUEST",{from=curr,to=originWorld})
    local sent,err=pcall(function()
        prepare:FireServer("stream",originWorld)
        task.wait(.15)
        request:FireServer(originWorld)
    end)
    if not sent then
        conn:Disconnect();stage("RETURN_ERROR",{reason="REMOTE_SEND_FAILED",error=tostring(err)});return
    end
    local expires=os.clock()+22
    while T.running and os.clock()<expires do
        if reply and reply.Ok==false then
            conn:Disconnect();stage("RETURN_REJECTED",{reason=tostring(reply.Reason)});return
        end
        local r=root()
        if r and tonumber(P:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"))==originWorld and readyToReturn()
            and ((reply and reply.Ok==true) or (r.Position-prior).Magnitude>35) then
            conn:Disconnect()
            stage("HOME_VERIFIED",{world=originWorld,reply=reply and reply.Ok,
                moved=(r.Position-prior).Magnitude})
            T.running=false;return
        end
        task.wait(.25)
    end
    conn:Disconnect()
    stage("RETURN_UNVERIFIED_NO_RETRY",{reply=reply and reply.Ok,world=P:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")})
end
log("RETURN_SCRIPT_STARTED",{homeWorld=originWorld,placeId=game.PlaceId})
task.spawn(function()
    local ok,err=pcall(run)
    if not ok then stage("RETURN_ERROR",{error=tostring(err)}) end
end)
print("[FINAL V3 RETURN] Status: getgenv().PlaneRNGFinalColossusReturnV3:status()")
]========]
end
-- END MODULE boss.FinalColossus.ReturnRunnerSource

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.Fleet.ArenaObserver
__factories["boss.Fleet.ArenaObserver"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local ArenaObserver={}
function ArenaObserver.new(env,config)
    local platform=env.services.roblox
    local player=platform:player()
    local observer={}
    function observer:participating()
        return player:GetAttribute("FleetParticipant")==true
    end
    function observer:inArenaPosition(pos)
        pos=pos or platform:position()
        if typeof(pos)~="Vector3" then return false end
        local c=config.arenaFallbackCenter
        local d=Vector3.new(pos.X-c.x,0,pos.Z-c.z)
        return d.Magnitude<config.arenaRadius and pos.Y>config.arenaMinY and pos.Y<config.arenaMaxY
    end
    function observer:inArena()
        return self:participating() or
            (player:GetAttribute("InBossFight")==true and self:inArenaPosition())
    end
    function observer:state()
        local W=platform:workspace()
        return {phase=player:GetAttribute("FleetPhase") or W:GetAttribute("FleetPhase"),
            fightState=player:GetAttribute("FleetFightState") or W:GetAttribute("FleetFightState"),
            active=player:GetAttribute("InBossFight"),participant=player:GetAttribute("FleetParticipant")}
    end
    return observer
end
return ArenaObserver
end
-- END MODULE boss.Fleet.ArenaObserver

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.Fleet.CombatController
__factories["boss.Fleet.CombatController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local CombatController={}
function CombatController.new(env,config,observer,report,flight)
    local runtime,telemetry=env.runtime,env.services.telemetry
    local combat={revalidatesNativeEnd=true}
    local function emit(name,data) if telemetry then telemetry:emit("FLEET_"..name,data or {}) end end
    function combat:nativeEncounter(expected)
        return report:nativeEncounter(expected)
    end
    function combat:ownedNativeGeneration()
        return report:ownedNativeGeneration()
    end
    function combat:invalidateNativeEnd(key)
        report:invalidateNativeEnd(key)
    end
    function combat:run(ctx,encounter)
        local ok,why=report:watch(ctx)
        if not ok then return {code=why or "FLEET_REPORT_WATCH_FAILED"} end
        ok,why=flight:start(ctx)
        if not ok then return {code=why or "FLEET_FLIGHT_INIT_FAILED"} end
        local deadline=runtime:now()+config.maxFightSeconds
        local nextLog=0
        local result="OUTCOME_NOT_OBSERVED_TIMEOUT"
        while not ctx:isCancelled() and runtime:now()<deadline do
            local evidence=report:inspect()
            if evidence.outcome then result="OUTCOME_OBSERVED";break end
            flight:step()
            if flight:exhausted() then result="FLEET_NATIVE_FLIGHT_NOT_ACTIVE";break end
            if runtime:now()>=nextLog then
                emit("FLIGHT_STATUS",flight:status())
                nextLog=runtime:now()+9
            end
            if not ctx:wait(.35) then break end
        end
        emit("FLIGHT_SUMMARY",flight:status())
        -- Release autopilot before any report or return. Never affect another boss.
        flight:stop()
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return {code="CANCELLED"} end
        return {code=result}
    end
    return combat
end
return CombatController
end
-- END MODULE boss.Fleet.CombatController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.Fleet.CommandController
__factories["boss.Fleet.CommandController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Fleet Standalone V1 flow: Hideout -> Boss Command pass -> ONE Solo -> combat.
-- Adaptive report may open in arena OR after exit; never request return before Continue.
local DirectBossTravel = require("main.navigation.DirectBossTravel")
local CommandController = {}

function CommandController.new(env, config, observer, report)
    local platform, runtime = env.services.roblox, env.runtime
    local player, workspace = platform:player(), platform:workspace()
    local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
    local travel = DirectBossTravel.new(env)
    local command = {}
    local function emit(name, data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit(name, data or {}) end
    end
    local function remote(name)
        local storage = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage")
        local folder = storage:FindFirstChild("Remotes") or storage:WaitForChild("Remotes", 10)
        local item = folder and (folder:FindFirstChild(name) or folder:WaitForChild(name, 7))
        return item and item:IsA("RemoteEvent") and item or nil
    end
    local function active(ctx) return runtime:isActive(ctx) and not ctx:isCancelled() end
    local function cooldownLeft()
        local raw = player:GetAttribute("BossStartCooldowns")
        if type(raw) ~= "string" or raw == "" then return 0 end
        local ok, data = pcall(function() return platform:service("HttpService"):JSONDecode(raw) end)
        if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then return 0 end
        return math.max(0, (tonumber(data[config.gameBossKey]) or 0) - workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
    end

    function command:prepare(ctx)
        local watching, why = report:watch(ctx) -- watch BEFORE sending any boss request
        if not watching then return false, why end
        if observer:inArena() then return true, "FLEET_ALREADY_IN_ARENA" end
        if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true then return false, "OTHER_BOSS_ACTIVE" end
        if not active(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        -- V3: wait for Fleet cooldown BEFORE issuing Boss Command requests.
        local left = cooldownLeft()
        if left > 0 and config.waitForCooldown then
            if left > config.maxCooldownWaitSeconds then
                emit("FLEET_COOLDOWN_GATE", {remaining = math.ceil(left), code = "WAIT_LIMIT"})
                return false, "FLEET_COOLDOWN_ABOVE_WAIT_LIMIT"
            end
            emit("FLEET_COOLDOWN_WAIT", {remaining = math.ceil(left)})
            local untilTime = runtime:now() + config.maxCooldownWaitSeconds
            local lastTick = runtime:now()
            while active(ctx) and cooldownLeft() > 0 and runtime:now() < untilTime do
                if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true then
                    return false, "OTHER_ENCOUNTER_BECAME_ACTIVE"
                end
                if runtime:now() - lastTick >= 25 then
                    lastTick = runtime:now()
                    emit("FLEET_COOLDOWN_WAITING", {remaining = math.ceil(cooldownLeft())})
                end
                if not ctx:wait(math.min(3, math.max(0.5, cooldownLeft()))) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
            end
            if not active(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
            if cooldownLeft() > 0 then return false, "FLEET_COOLDOWN_WAIT_LIMIT_REACHED" end
            emit("FLEET_COOLDOWN_READY", {remaining = 0})
        end
        local entered = travel:enterHideout(ctx)
        emit("FLEET_DIRECT_HIDEOUT", {ok = entered.ok, code = entered.code, reason = entered.reason})
        if not entered.ok then return false, entered.code end
        local positioned = travel:moveToKnownPoint(ctx, config.commandSafePosition, {
            requireHideout = true, radius = 6, settle = 0.85,
        })
        emit("FLEET_COMMAND_POSITION", {ok = positioned.ok, code = positioned.code})
        if not positioned.ok then return false, positioned.code end
        return true, "FLEET_COMMAND_READY"
    end

    function command:readiness()
        if observer:inArena() then return "READY" end
        if not travel:inHideout() then return "UNKNOWN" end
        local secs = cooldownLeft()
        if secs > 0 then
            secs = math.ceil(secs)
            return string.format("%d:%02d", math.floor(secs / 60), secs % 60)
        end
        -- The server pass remains authoritative for unlock/eligibility.
        return "READY"
    end

    function command:startSolo(ctx, markAttempt)
        if not active(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        if observer:participating() then return true, "FLEET_ALREADY_FIGHTING" end
        if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true then return false, "OTHER_BOSS_ACTIVE" end
        if not travel:inHideout() then return false, "NOT_IN_HIDEOUT" end
        if self:readiness() ~= "READY" then return false, "FLEET_NOT_READY" end
        local watching, why = report:watch(ctx)
        if not watching then return false, why end
        local hideout, accept = remote("PersonalHideoutRemote"), remote("FleetCommanderAccept")
        if not hideout or not accept then return false, "FLEET_COMMAND_REMOTES_MISSING" end
        local passReply, acceptReply
        local passConnection = hideout.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
            if type(e) == "table" and e.Kind == "BossCommand" and e.Op == "Start"
                and e.BossKey == config.gameBossKey then passReply = e end
        end)
        local acceptConnection = accept.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
            if type(e) == "table" and e.Accepted ~= nil then acceptReply = e end
        end)
        local function finish(ok, code)
            passConnection:Disconnect()
            acceptConnection:Disconnect()
            return ok, code
        end
        local sent, err = pcall(function()
            hideout:FireServer({Action = "StartBoss", BossKey = config.gameBossKey, Solo = true})
        end)
        if not sent then return finish(false, "FLEET_PASS_SEND_FAILED: " .. tostring(err)) end
        local gotPass = ctx:await(function() return passReply end, 10)
        if not active(ctx) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
        if not gotPass then return finish(false, "FLEET_PASS_TIMEOUT_NO_RETRY") end
        emit("FLEET_PASS_RESULT", {ok = gotPass.Ok == true, reason = gotPass.Reason})
        if gotPass.Ok ~= true then return finish(false, "FLEET_PASS_REJECTED: " .. tostring(gotPass.Reason)) end
        -- Mark before firing the irreversible Solo request; never blind retry.
        if not markAttempt() then return finish(false, "FLEET_SOLO_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED") end
        sent, err = pcall(function() accept:FireServer({Solo = true}) end)
        if not sent then return finish(false, "FLEET_SOLO_SEND_FAILED: " .. tostring(err)) end
        local observed = ctx:await(function()
            if acceptReply and acceptReply.Accepted == false then return "REJECTED" end
            if observer:participating() then return "ENTERED" end
        end, config.arenaTimeout)
        if not active(ctx) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
        emit("FLEET_SOLO_RESULT", {code = observed or "AMBIGUOUS", accepted = acceptReply and acceptReply.Accepted})
        if observed == "ENTERED" then return finish(true, "FLEET_FIGHT_VERIFIED") end
        if observed == "REJECTED" then
            return finish(false, "FLEET_SOLO_REJECTED: " .. tostring(acceptReply.Reason))
        end
        return finish(false, "FLEET_SOLO_AMBIGUOUS_NO_RETRY")
    end

    function command:close(_) return true end -- No command GUI was opened.

    function command:returnHome(ctx, home)
        if not active(ctx) then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        if type(home) ~= "number" or home < 1 or home % 1 ~= 0 then
            return {ok = false, code = "INVALID_HOME_WORLD"}
        end
        if report:inspect().active then return {ok = false, code = "FLEET_REPORT_STILL_OPEN"} end
        -- Preserve standalone V1 lock checks before return, regardless of report location.
        local released = ctx:await(function()
            if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true
                and player:GetAttribute("FleetParticipant") ~= true then return true end
        end, config.returnLockTimeoutSeconds)
        if not released then
            emit("FLEET_RETURN_LOCK_PENDING", {world = home})
            return {ok = false, code = "FLEET_RETURN_LOCK_PENDING", reason = "BossFight"}
        end
        local exit = ctx:await(function()
            if player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") == true then return "BOSS_COMMAND_HIDEOUT" end
            if not observer:inArenaPosition() then return "OUTSIDE_ARENA" end
        end, config.exitTimeoutSeconds)
        emit("FLEET_ARENA_EXIT", {code = exit or "LOCK_RELEASED_STILL_IN_ARENA"})
        -- As in tested standalone V1, a released lock permits a direct verified travel even
        -- if the game has not repositioned the player outside the arena yet.
        if not ctx:wait(1.5) then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        local request, prepare, result = remote("RequestWorldTravel"), remote("NavPrepareWorlds"), remote("WorldTravelResult")
        if not request or not prepare then return {ok = false, code = "FLEET_WORLD_TRAVEL_REMOTES_MISSING"} end
        local position = platform:position()
        if not position then return {ok = false, code = "CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE"} end
        if tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")) == home
            and player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") ~= true
            and not observer:inArenaPosition() then
            return {ok = true, code = "ALREADY_IN_HOME", world = home}
        end
        local reply
        local connection = result and result.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
            if type(e) == "table" and e.Kind == "Result" and tonumber(e.WorldId) == home then reply = e end
        end) or nil
        local function finish(ok, code, reason)
            if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
            emit("FLEET_DIRECT_RETURN", {ok = ok, code = code, reason = reason, world = home})
            return {ok = ok, code = code, reason = reason, world = home}
        end
        for attempt = 1, config.returnRetries do
            if not active(ctx) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            reply = nil
            local prior = platform:position()
            if not prior then return finish(false, "CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE") end
            local sent, err = pcall(function() prepare:FireServer("stream", home) end)
            if not sent then return finish(false, "WORLD_PREPARE_SEND_FAILED", tostring(err)) end
            if not ctx:wait(0.12) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            sent, err = pcall(function() request:FireServer(home) end)
            if not sent then return finish(false, "WORLD_REQUEST_SEND_FAILED", tostring(err)) end
            local observed = ctx:await(function()
                if reply and reply.Ok == false then return "REJECTED" end
                local current = platform:position()
                if current and platform:distance(current, prior) > 50
                    and tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")) == home
                    and player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") ~= true
                    and player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true
                    and not observer:inArenaPosition() then return "VERIFIED" end
            end, 17)
            emit("FLEET_RETURN_ATTEMPT", {attempt = attempt, code = observed or "AMBIGUOUS",
                reason = reply and reply.Reason})
            if observed == "VERIFIED" then return finish(true, "FLEET_HOME_VERIFIED") end
            if observed ~= "REJECTED" then return finish(false, "FLEET_RETURN_AMBIGUOUS_NO_RETRY") end
            local why = tostring(reply.Reason or "UNKNOWN")
            if why ~= "BossFight" or attempt == config.returnRetries then
                return finish(false, "FLEET_WORLD_RETURN_REJECTED", why)
            end
            if not ctx:wait(12) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            local settled = ctx:await(function()
                if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true then return true end
            end, 40)
            if not settled then return finish(false, "FLEET_LOCK_STILL_ACTIVE", "BossFight") end
        end
        return finish(false, "FLEET_WORLD_RETURN_EXHAUSTED")
    end
    return command
end
return CommandController
end
-- END MODULE boss.Fleet.CommandController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.Fleet.Config
__factories["boss.Fleet.Config"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- The Fleet (World 66). Port of the live-tested standalone Fleet V1.
-- Native client Fleet context, direct native steering and transfer QTE.
return {
    bossId="FLEET", displayName="The Fleet", gameBossKey="FleetBoss",
    world=66,
    commandSafePosition={x=-31962.1074,y=344.357483,z=32887.3203},
    arenaFallbackCenter={x=-16384,y=0,z=16384},arenaRadius=6500,
    arenaMinY=-500,arenaMaxY=3500,
    arenaTimeout=48,maxFightSeconds=865,flightStartTimeoutSeconds=55,
    reportTimeoutSeconds=125,reportHoldSeconds=3,
    reportCloseTimeoutSeconds=125,exitTimeoutSeconds=110,
    returnLockTimeoutSeconds=80,returnRetries=3,
    waitForCooldown=true,maxCooldownWaitSeconds=800,
    autoPilot=true,directNativeSteering=true,
    objectivePriority=true,prioritizeAirPhase2=true,
    autoFire=true,autoMissile=true,autoFocus=true,autoQTE=true,autoFlare=true,
}
end
-- END MODULE boss.Fleet.Config

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.Fleet.Fleet
__factories["boss.Fleet.Fleet"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local Config=require("boss.Fleet.Config")
local ArenaObserver=require("boss.Fleet.ArenaObserver")
local CommandController=require("boss.Fleet.CommandController")
local CombatController=require("boss.Fleet.CombatController")
local FlightController=require("boss.Fleet.FlightController")
local ReportController=require("boss.Fleet.ReportController")
local RepeatPolicy=require("boss.Fleet.RepeatPolicy")
local Fleet={}
function Fleet.definition()
    return {bossId=Config.bossId,displayName=Config.displayName,create=function(env)
        local observer=ArenaObserver.new(env,Config)
        local flight=FlightController.new(env,Config,observer)
        local repeatPolicy=RepeatPolicy.new(env)
        local report=ReportController.new(env,Config,repeatPolicy,flight)
        return {config=Config,observer=observer,flight=flight,report=report,
            repeatPolicy=repeatPolicy,command=CommandController.new(env,Config,observer,report),
            combat=CombatController.new(env,Config,observer,report,flight)}
    end}
end
return Fleet
end
-- END MODULE boss.Fleet.Fleet

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.Fleet.FlightController
__factories["boss.Fleet.FlightController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- The Fleet flight port: live-tested Fleet Standalone V1 targeting, direct steering
-- and native QTE callbacks. Never send forged hit/transfer/outcome packets.
local PilotControl=require("boss.shared.PilotControl")
local FlightController={}
function FlightController.new(env,settings,observer)
    local platform=env.services.roblox
    local P=platform:player()
    local RS=platform:service("ReplicatedStorage")
    local RunService=platform:service("RunService")
    local W=platform:workspace()
    local telemetry=env.services.telemetry
    local T={running=false,phase=1,progress=nil,flightActive=false,flightAttempts=0,
        pilotInstalled=false,aimCalls=0,lastTarget=nil,targetRef=nil,targetRole=nil,
        targetDistance=nil,qtePresses=0,qteHits=nil,
        transferState=nil,generation=nil,criticalCount=0,reinforcements=0,
        nativeContextReady=false,focusedRef=nil,flightError=nil,outcome=nil}
    local flight={}
    local completed=false
    local directConn=nil
    local activeSince=nil
    local currentTarget=nil
    local nextTargetPick=0
    local nextFocusAt=0
    local lastTargetLog=0
    local lastGateLog=0
    local flightAccumulator=0
    local mode="APPROACH"
    local modeAt=0
    local side=1
    local nextQTELog=0
    local flightRuntime,flightController,nativeController=nil,nil,nil
    local loaded=false
    local flightWaitUntil=0
    local lastStatusLog=0
    local CENTRE=Vector3.new(-16384,0,16384)
    local function isParticipating() return observer:participating() end
    local function log(kind,data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit("FLEET_"..kind,data or {}) end
    end
    local pilot=PilotControl.new(platform,log)
    local jobContext
    local function loadMod(mod)
        if not mod or not mod:IsA("ModuleScript") then return nil,"MODULE_MISSING" end
        local ok,val=pcall(getfenv(0)["require"],mod)
        if not ok or type(val)~="table" then return nil,tostring(val) end
        return val
    end
    local function nativeContext()
        if not nativeController or type(nativeController.Context)~="function" then return nil end
        local ok,ctx=pcall(nativeController.Context)
        return ok and type(ctx)=="table" and ctx or nil
    end
    function flight:nativeEvidence()
        if not nativeController then
            local modules=RS:FindFirstChild("ClientModules")
            local fleet=modules and modules:FindFirstChild("FleetBoss")
            nativeController=loadMod(fleet and fleet:FindFirstChild("Controller"))
        end
        local readable, context
        if nativeController and type(nativeController.Context)=="function" then
            readable,context=pcall(nativeController.Context)
        end
        local missing=readable==true and context==nil
        if not readable or type(context)~="table" then context=nil end
        local session=context and context.Session
        local pilotState=context and context.Pilot
        local proxy=pilotState and pilotState.Proxy
        return {readable=readable==true, missing=missing,
            generation=session and session.Generation, state=session and session.State,
            eliminated=P:GetAttribute("FleetEliminated")==true or session and session.Eliminated==true,
            leaving=session and session.Leaving==true, participant=isParticipating(),
            worldGeneration=W:GetAttribute("FleetFightGeneration"), worldActive=W:GetAttribute("FleetFightActive"),
            worldState=W:GetAttribute("FleetFightState"), pilot=pilotState and pilotState.State,
            proxyOwned=proxy and proxy.Parent~=nil and tonumber(proxy:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId"))==P.UserId or false,
            transfer=context and context.Transfer and context.Transfer.Sessions
                and context.Transfer.Sessions[P.UserId]~=nil or false}
    end
    local function flightBinding(ctx)
        local nativePilot=ctx and ctx.Pilot
        local session=ctx and ctx.Session
        if not jobContext or jobContext:isCancelled() or not T.running or completed or not isParticipating()
            or P:GetAttribute("BossReviveDowned")==true or P:GetAttribute("BossResultsOpen")==true or not nativePilot or nativePilot.State~="Flying"
            or not session or session.State~="Active" or session.Eliminated or session.Leaving then return nil end
        return PilotControl.bound(flightRuntime,flightController,function(plane)
            return plane==nativePilot.Proxy and tonumber(plane:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId"))==P.UserId
        end)
    end
    local function flightSim()
        if not flightRuntime then return nil end
        local sim=nil
        if type(flightRuntime.Flight)=="function" then
            local ok,f=pcall(flightRuntime.Flight)
            if ok and type(f)=="table" then sim=f.Sim end
        end
        if not sim and type(flightRuntime.Sim)=="function" then
            local ok,s=pcall(flightRuntime.Sim)
            if ok then sim=s end
        end
        if not sim then return nil end
        if typeof(sim.Position)~="Vector3" or typeof(sim.Rotation)~="CFrame" then return nil end
        return sim
    end
    local function releaseFlightControl()
        if directConn then pcall(function() directConn:Disconnect() end); directConn=nil end
        pilot:stop()
        local ctx=nativeContext()
        if ctx and ctx.Session and type(ctx.Session.ClearFocus)=="function" and T.focusedRef then
            pcall(ctx.Session.ClearFocus,ctx.Session)
        end
        T.pilotInstalled=false
    end
    local phaseNames={"APPROACH","AIR SUPERIORITY","BREAK THE SCREEN","CARRIER ASSAULT","FLEET COLLAPSE"}
    local function updatePhase(n,source)
        n=tonumber(n)
        if n and n>=1 and n<=5 and n~=T.phase then
            T.phase=n;currentTarget=nil;nextTargetPick=0;mode="APPROACH"
            log("PHASE",{phase=n,name=phaseNames[n],source=source})
        end
    end
    -- Ship and aircraft targets are taken from the game's live FleetBoss context,
    -- never guessed via model names or artificial damage remotes.
    local function getTargetPoint(ctx,t)
        if not ctx or not t then return nil end
        if t.kind=="SHIP" then
            local ships=ctx.Ships
            if not ships or type(ships.ComponentWorld)~="function" then return nil end
            local ok,pos,radius=pcall(ships.ComponentWorld,ships,t.ref,ctx.Tau)
            if ok and typeof(pos)=="Vector3" then return pos,tonumber(radius) or 20 end
        elseif t.kind=="AIR" then
            local air=ctx.Air
            if not air or type(air.Sample)~="function" then return nil end
            local ok,v=pcall(air.Sample,air,t.id,ctx.Tau)
            if ok and type(v)=="table" and typeof(v.P)=="Vector3" then
                return v.P,35,typeof(v.V)=="Vector3" and v.V or Vector3.new(0,0,0)
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local roleWeights = {
        CIWS=1,AA=2,MissileLauncher=3,Radar=4,MainGun=5,FlightDeck=6,Bridge=7,Propulsion=8,
        Comms=9,Hull=10
    }
    local function roleWeight(role,phase)
        if settings.objectivePriority == false then return roleWeights[role] or 15 end
        if phase>=4 then
            if role=="Bridge" then return 1 end
            if role=="Propulsion" then return 2 end
            if role=="CIWS" then return 4 end
            if role=="AA" then return 5 end
            if role=="MissileLauncher" then return 6 end
            if role=="Radar" then return 7 end
            if role=="FlightDeck" then return 8 end
            return 12
        end
        if phase==3 then
            return ({CIWS=1,AA=2,MissileLauncher=3,Radar=4,FlightDeck=5,MainGun=6,
                Bridge=7,Propulsion=8,Comms=9,Hull=12})[role] or 12
        end
        return roleWeights[role] or 12
    end
    local function getTargets(ctx,pos)
        local candidates={}
        local ships=ctx and ctx.Ships
        if ships and type(ships.List)=="function" and type(ships.Entry)=="function" then
            local ok,ids=pcall(ships.List,ships)
            if ok and type(ids)=="table" then
                for _,shipId in ipairs(ids) do
                    local ok2,entry=pcall(ships.Entry,ships,shipId)
                    if ok2 and type(entry)=="table" and entry.State~=5 and entry.State~=6 then
                        local components=entry.Rig and entry.Rig.Components or nil
                        local hasLive=false
                        if type(components)=="table" then
                            for i=1,#components do
                                local comp=entry.Comp and entry.Comp[i]
                                if comp and comp.State~=3 then
                                    hasLive=true
                                    local ref=shipId*32+i
                                    local infoOK,info=pcall(ships.ComponentInfo,ships,ref)
                                    local role=infoOK and type(info)=="table" and tostring(info.Role) or tostring(components[i].Role or "Component")
                                    local target={kind="SHIP",ref=ref,role=role,ship=shipId,
                                        class=tostring(entry.Class or "")}
                                    local point=getTargetPoint(ctx,target)
                                    if point then
                                        local weight=roleWeight(role,T.phase)
                                        local dist=(point-pos).Magnitude
                                        local carrierBonus=target.class:lower():find("carrier",1,true) and 100 or 0
                                        local score=weight*100000+dist-carrierBonus
                                        target.distance=dist
                                        table.insert(candidates,{t=target,score=score})
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        if not hasLive then
                            local target={kind="SHIP",ref=shipId*32,role="Hull",ship=shipId,
                                class=tostring(entry.Class or "")}
                            local pt=getTargetPoint(ctx,target)
                            if pt then table.insert(candidates,{t=target,score=roleWeight("Hull",T.phase)*100000+(pt-pos).Magnitude}) end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        local air=ctx and ctx.Air
        if air and type(air.Ids)=="function" and type(air.Info)=="function" then
            local ok,ids=pcall(air.Ids,air)
            if ok and type(ids)=="table" then
                for _,id in ipairs(ids) do
                    local ok2,info=pcall(air.Info,air,id)
                    if ok2 and type(info)=="table" and info.Role=="Enemy" and info.State==1 then
                        local t={kind="AIR",ref=1024+id,id=id,role="EnemyAir"}
                        local pt=getTargetPoint(ctx,t)
                        if pt then
                            local dist=(pt-pos).Magnitude
                            local score=(T.phase==2 and settings.prioritizeAirPhase2 and dist<2300) and (dist+100) or 1600000+dist
                            table.insert(candidates,{t=t,score=score})
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        table.sort(candidates,function(a,b) return a.score<b.score end)
        return candidates
    end
    local function chooseTarget(ctx,pos)
        local now=os.clock()
        if currentTarget and now<nextTargetPick then
            if getTargetPoint(ctx,currentTarget) then return currentTarget end
        end
        nextTargetPick=now+0.65
        local candidates=getTargets(ctx,pos)
        local best=candidates[1] and candidates[1].t or nil
        if best and currentTarget and currentTarget.ref==best.ref and getTargetPoint(ctx,currentTarget) then
            best=currentTarget
        end
        if (best and best.ref or nil)~=(currentTarget and currentTarget.ref or nil) then
            mode="APPROACH";modeAt=now
            nextFocusAt=0
            log("OBJECTIVE_TARGET",{kind=best and best.kind or "NONE",ref=best and best.ref,
                role=best and best.role,ship=best and best.ship,phase=T.phase,
                distance=best and math.floor(best.distance or 0),available=#candidates})
        end
        currentTarget=best
        T.targetRef=best and best.ref or nil
        T.targetRole=best and best.role or nil
        return best
    end
    local function focusTarget(ctx,t)
        if not settings.autoFocus or not t or not ctx or not ctx.Session then return end
        if os.clock()<nextFocusAt then return end
        if type(ctx.Session.RequestFocus)~="function" then return end
        nextFocusAt=os.clock()+10
        local ok,err=pcall(ctx.Session.RequestFocus,ctx.Session,t.ref)
        if ok then
            T.focusedRef=t.ref
            log("SQUADRON_FOCUS",{ref=t.ref,role=t.role})
        else
            log("FOCUS_GATE",{error=tostring(err)})
        end
    end
    local riftHazards=env.services.riftHazards
    local function applyHazardFrame(sim,plan)
        if not riftHazards or type(riftHazards.flightPlan)~="function" then return plan end
        local ok,adjusted=pcall(riftHazards.flightPlan,riftHazards,sim,plan)
        return ok and type(adjusted)=="table" and adjusted or plan
    end
    local function pilotFrame(dt)
        local ctx=nativeContext()
        local sim=flightSim()
        if not ctx or not sim then return nil,"NATIVE_CONTEXT_OR_SIM_MISSING" end
        if T.nativeContextReady==false then
            T.nativeContextReady=true
            log("FLEET_CONTEXT_READY",{ships=ctx.Ships~=nil,air=ctx.Air~=nil,
                transfer=ctx.Transfer~=nil,ui=ctx.UI~=nil,pilot=ctx.Pilot~=nil})
        end
        local pos=sim.Position
        local forward=sim.Rotation.LookVector
        local t=chooseTarget(ctx,pos)
        local point,radius,velocity=getTargetPoint(ctx,t)
        if not point then
            local toCentre=Vector3.new(CENTRE.X,360,CENTRE.Z)-pos
            T.targetDistance=nil
            return applyHazardFrame(sim,{Aim=toCentre.Magnitude>3 and toCentre or forward*300,Throttle=.85,Fire=false,Missile=false,mode="SEARCH"})
        end
        focusTarget(ctx,t)
        local dist=(point-pos).Magnitude
        T.targetDistance=math.floor(dist)
        local aim=point-pos
        local now=os.clock()
        local firing=false
        local missile=false
        local throttle=.88
        if t.kind=="AIR" then
            aim=(point+(velocity or Vector3.new(0,0,0))*math.clamp(dist/1600,0,.7))-pos
            firing=dist<1150
            missile=dist>100 and dist<1900
            mode="INTERCEPT"
        else
            -- A high-altitude naval attack pattern avoids diving into the carrier deck.
            local away=Vector3.new(pos.X-point.X,0,pos.Z-point.Z)
            if away.Magnitude<1 then away=Vector3.new(forward.X,0,forward.Z) end
            away=away.Magnitude>1 and away.Unit or Vector3.new(1,0,0)
            if mode=="APPROACH" then
                local desired=point+away*math.min(900,math.max(420,dist*.36))+Vector3.new(0,260,0)
                aim=desired-pos
                if (desired-pos).Magnitude<260 or dist<1250 or now-modeAt>5 then
                    mode="RUN";modeAt=now
                    log("ATTACK_MODE",{mode="RUN",ref=t.ref,distance=math.floor(dist)})
                end
            elseif mode=="RUN" then
                aim=(point+Vector3.new(0,105,0))-pos
                firing=dist<1350
                missile=dist>130 and dist<2250
                throttle=.83
                if dist<260 or now-modeAt>11 then
                    mode="BREAK";modeAt=now;side=-side
                    log("ATTACK_MODE",{mode="BREAK",ref=t.ref,distance=math.floor(dist)})
                end
            else
                local lateral=Vector3.new(-away.Z,0,away.X)*side
                aim=lateral*630+away*480+Vector3.new(0,290,0)
                throttle=1
                if now-modeAt>2.6 then mode="APPROACH";modeAt=now end
            end
        end
        -- Respect Fleet airspace: minimum clearance and maximum ceiling.
        if pos.Y<160 then aim=aim+Vector3.new(0,(210-pos.Y)*3,0) end
        if pos.Y>780 then aim=aim+Vector3.new(0,(700-pos.Y)*3,0) end
        local relative=Vector3.new(pos.X-CENTRE.X,0,pos.Z-CENTRE.Z)
        if relative.Magnitude>2800 then aim=aim-relative.Unit*math.max(100,(relative.Magnitude-2500)*1.8) end
        if aim.Magnitude<1 then aim=forward*400 end
        local direction=aim.Unit
        local face=math.deg(math.acos(math.clamp(forward:Dot(direction),-1,1)))
        if face>22 then firing=false;missile=false end
        firing=settings.autoFire and firing and face<12
        missile=settings.autoMissile and missile and face<22
        return applyHazardFrame(sim,{Aim=aim,Throttle=throttle,Fire=firing,Missile=missile,
            distance=dist,role=t.role,ref=t.ref,face=face,mode=mode,
            Target=t.ref,Maneuver=mode~="RUN"})
    end
    local function qteStep(ctx)
        if not settings.autoQTE or not ctx or not ctx.UI then return end
        local qte=ctx.UI.QTE
        if type(qte)~="table" or qte.Done or qte.Closed then return end
        local active=qte.Prompts and qte.Prompts[qte.Oldest]
        if type(active)~="table" or active.Resolved or type(qte._press)~="function" then return end
        local current=(tonumber(qte.Tau) or 0)+math.clamp(os.clock()-(qte.StepAt or os.clock()),0,.1)*(tonumber(qte.Rate) or 1)
        local at=tonumber(active.At)
        local half=tonumber(active.Half) or .15
        if not at then return end
        if os.clock()>nextQTELog and T.transferState~="QTE" then
            T.transferState="QTE"
            nextQTELog=os.clock()+3
            log("TRANSFER_QTE_ACTIVE",{prompts=#qte.Prompts,oldest=qte.Oldest})
        end
        if current>=at and math.abs(current-at)<=math.max(.015,half*.68) then
            -- Trigger the real client UI _press callback; it records timings and sends
            -- results using the native Transfer module only (no forged success packet).
            local ok,pressed=pcall(qte._press,qte,nil)
            if ok and pressed then
                T.qtePresses+=1
                T.qteHits=tonumber(qte.Hits) or T.qteHits
                log("QTE_PRESS",{index=active.Index,at=at,time=current,delta=math.floor((current-at)*1000)})
            elseif not ok then
                log("QTE_GATE",{reason="NATIVE_PRESS_FAILED",detail=tostring(pressed)})
            end
        end
    end
    local function directStep(dt)
        if not T.running or completed or not isParticipating() or not jobContext or jobContext:isCancelled() then
            pilot:clear("FLEET_ENCOUNTER_INACTIVE")
            return
        end
        local ctx=nativeContext()
        qteStep(ctx)
        local plane,state=flightBinding(ctx)
        if not settings.autoPilot or not settings.directNativeSteering or not plane then
            pilot:clear("FLEET_FLIGHT_OR_TRANSFER")
            return
        end
        flightAccumulator+=dt
        if flightAccumulator<.075 then return end
        dt=flightAccumulator;flightAccumulator=0
        local wanted=pilotFrame(dt)
        if wanted and wanted.ref~=ctx.Pilot.TargetRef then wanted.Fire,wanted.Missile=false,false end
        if pilot:apply(flightRuntime,flightController,plane,state,wanted,true) then T.aimCalls+=1 end
    end
    local function installPilot()
        if directConn or not settings.autoPilot then return end
        if not flightRuntime or type(flightRuntime.SetAim)~="function" then
            log("FLIGHT_GATE",{reason="SET_AIM_UNAVAILABLE"})
            return
        end
        directConn=RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
            local ok,err=pcall(directStep,dt)
            if not ok then pilot:clear("PILOT_UPDATE_ERROR") end
            if not ok and os.clock()-lastGateLog>5 then
                lastGateLog=os.clock();T.flightError=tostring(err)
                log("FLIGHT_GATE",{reason="HEARTBEAT_ERROR",detail=tostring(err)})
            end
        end)
        T.pilotInstalled=true
        log("FLIGHT_PILOT_INSTALL",{nativeSetAim=true,nativeQTE=settings.autoQTE,
            note="Direct steering only; Fleet native Pilot owns transfer/squadron/weapon hit validation"})
    end

    function flight:reset()
        self:stop()
        completed=false
        T.running=true
        T.phase=1;T.progress=nil;T.flightActive=false
        T.pilotInstalled=false;T.aimCalls=0;T.lastTarget=nil
        T.targetRef=nil;T.targetRole=nil;T.targetDistance=nil
        T.qtePresses=0;T.qteHits=nil
        T.transferState=nil;T.generation=nil;T.criticalCount=0
        T.reinforcements=0;T.nativeContextReady=false;T.focusedRef=nil
        T.flightError=nil;T.outcome=nil
        activeSince=nil;currentTarget=nil;nextTargetPick=0
        nextFocusAt=0
        lastTargetLog=0;lastGateLog=0;flightAccumulator=0
        mode="APPROACH";modeAt=0;side=1;nextQTELog=0
        loaded=false;flightWaitUntil=0;lastStatusLog=0
    end
    function flight:observe(e)
        if not T.running or type(e)~="table" then return end
        if e.K=="Batch" and type(e.Items)=="table" then
            for _,it in ipairs(e.Items) do self:observe(it) end
            return
        end
        local k=e.K
        if k=="Session" then
            T.generation=e.Generation or T.generation
            updatePhase(e.Phase or (e.Session and e.Session.Phase),"SESSION")
            log("SESSION",{generation=T.generation,state=e.State,participant=isParticipating()})
        elseif k=="Begin" or k=="Launch" then
            log("FIGHT_EVENT",{event=k,phase=T.phase})
        elseif k=="Phase" then
            updatePhase(e.Phase,"EVENT")
        elseif k=="Progress" then
            T.progress=tonumber(e.Value) or T.progress
            if os.clock()-lastTargetLog>4 then log("PROGRESS",{progress=T.progress,phase=T.phase}) end
        elseif k=="Critical" then
            if e.UserId==P.UserId then
                T.criticalCount+=1;T.transferState="CRITICAL"
                log("TRANSFER_CRITICAL",{from=e.From,to=e.To,deadline=e.Deadline})
            end
        elseif k=="Transfer" then
            if e.UserId==P.UserId then
                T.transferState=e.Success==true and "SUCCESS" or "FAILED"
                currentTarget=nil;nextTargetPick=0
                log("TRANSFER_RESULT",{success=e.Success,from=e.From,to=e.To,reason=e.Reason})
            end
        elseif k=="Reinforcement" then
            T.reinforcements+=1
            log("REINFORCEMENT",{count=T.reinforcements,code=e.State or e.Kind})
        elseif k=="Returned" then
            if e.UserId==P.UserId then log("REINFORCEMENT_RETURNED",{ridden=e.Ridden}) end
        elseif k=="Eliminated" then
            if e.UserId==P.UserId then log("PLAYER_ELIMINATED",{note="Waiting for native outcome / reinforcement"}) end
        elseif k=="Focus" then
            T.focusedRef=e.Ref or T.focusedRef
        elseif k=="Ship" or k=="Component" then
            if os.clock()-lastTargetLog>6 then log("NAVAL_EVENT",{type=k,ship=e.Ship,ref=e.Ref}) end
        elseif k=="End" then
            log("FIGHT_END",{victory=e.Victory,reason=e.Reason})
        elseif k=="Outcome" and not completed then
            completed=true
            pilot:stop()
            T.outcome={victory=e.Victory==true,reason=tostring(e.Reason),rewardEligible=e.RewardEligible}
            log("OUTCOME_EVENT",T.outcome)
        end
    end
    function flight:start(ctx)
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return false,"CANCELLED" end
        if not loaded then
            local cm=RS:FindFirstChild("ClientModules")
            flightRuntime=loadMod(cm and cm:FindFirstChild("ManualFlightRuntime"))
            flightController=loadMod(cm and cm:FindFirstChild("ManualFlightController"))
            local boss=cm and cm:FindFirstChild("FleetBoss")
            nativeController=loadMod(boss and boss:FindFirstChild("Controller"))
            loaded=true
            log("FLIGHT_CAPABILITIES",{runtime=flightRuntime~=nil,
                flightController=flightController~=nil,
                nativeController=nativeController~=nil,
                setAim=flightRuntime~=nil and type(flightRuntime.SetAim)=="function",
                contextApi=nativeController~=nil and type(nativeController.Context)=="function"})
        end
        T.running=true
        flightWaitUntil=os.clock()+settings.flightStartTimeoutSeconds
        jobContext=ctx
        installPilot() -- V1 starts heartbeat before native flight; QTE remains live through transfer.
        ctx:deferCleanup(function() if jobContext==ctx then self:stop() end end)
        return true
    end
    function flight:step()
        if not T.running or completed then return end
        local active=flightBinding(nativeContext())~=nil
        T.flightActive=active
        if active and not activeSince then
            activeSince=os.clock()
            log("FLIGHT_VERIFIED",{nativeControl=true})
        end
        if os.clock()>=lastStatusLog then
            lastStatusLog=os.clock()+9
            local ctx=nativeContext()
            local transfer=ctx and ctx.Transfer and ctx.Transfer.Sessions
                and ctx.Transfer.Sessions[P.UserId]
            log("FLEET_STATUS",{phase=T.phase,progress=T.progress,
                sessionState=ctx and ctx.Session and ctx.Session.State,
                context=ctx~=nil,flightActive=T.flightActive,
                shipRuntime=ctx and ctx.Ships~=nil,
                transferActive=transfer~=nil,targetRole=T.targetRole,
                aimCalls=T.aimCalls,qtePresses=T.qtePresses})
        end
    end
    function flight:exhausted()
        if not T.running or completed or activeSince or os.clock()<=flightWaitUntil then return false end
        local ctx=nativeContext()
        local transfer=ctx and ctx.Transfer and ctx.Transfer.Sessions and ctx.Transfer.Sessions[P.UserId]
        return transfer==nil -- native transfer can temporarily suspend flight.
    end
    function flight:status()
        return {phase=T.phase,progress=T.progress,flightActive=T.flightActive,
            pilotInstalled=T.pilotInstalled,aimCalls=T.aimCalls,
            targetRef=T.targetRef,targetRole=T.targetRole,
            targetDistance=T.targetDistance,
            qtePresses=T.qtePresses,qteHits=T.qteHits,
            transferState=T.transferState,criticalCount=T.criticalCount,
            reinforcements=T.reinforcements,nativeContextReady=T.nativeContextReady,
            flightError=T.flightError,outcome=T.outcome}
    end
    function flight:stop()
        releaseFlightControl()
        jobContext=nil
        T.running=false;T.flightActive=false
    end
    return flight
end
return FlightController
end
-- END MODULE boss.Fleet.FlightController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.Fleet.RepeatPolicy

end
return RepeatPolicy
