-- BEGIN MODULE boss.Fleet.ReportController
__factories["boss.Fleet.ReportController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local DeferredOutcome = require("boss.shared.DeferredOutcome")
-- Fleet adaptive report: Outcome -> report (arena or hideout) -> Continue -> exit -> return.
-- Port of standalone V1; never treat Outcome alone as a completed report.
local ReportController = {}

function ReportController.new(env, config, repeatPolicy, flight)
    local platform, gui, runtime = env.services.roblox, env.services.gui, env.runtime
    local player = platform:player()
    local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
    local writer = env.state:port("boss")
    local report = {}
    local confirmedOutcome, outcomeAt, outcomeReason = nil, nil, nil
    local lossEncounter, lossGeneration, rosterGeneration
    local seenReport, firstOpenedAt = false, nil
    local listeningContext, connections, resultsController = nil, {}, nil
    local encounterId, generation, nativeEnd, pilotEvent, lastDiagnostic
    local function emit(name, data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit(name, data or {}) end
    end
    local function loadController()
        if resultsController then return resultsController end
        local folder = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("ClientModules")
        local mod = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("BossResultsController")
        if not mod or not mod:IsA("ModuleScript") then return nil end
        -- The build bundler replaces project requires. Invoke Roblox require only
        -- dynamically for the game's own ModuleScript, as the B21 controller does.
        local loader = getfenv(0)["require"]
        local ok, value = pcall(loader, mod)
        if not ok or type(value) ~= "table" then return nil end
        if type(value.IsOpen) ~= "function" or type(value.Dismiss) ~= "function" then return nil end
        resultsController = value
        return value
    end
    local function officialOpen()
        local ctrl = loadController()
        if ctrl and type(ctrl.IsOpen) == "function" then
            local ok, result = pcall(ctrl.IsOpen)
            if ok and result == true then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function isOpen(root)
        root = root or gui:find(env.profile.paths.bossReport)
        return player:GetAttribute("BossResultsOpen") == true or officialOpen() or root and root.Enabled == true
    end
    local function matchingReport(guiRoot)
        if not guiRoot then return nil end
        local isFleet, won, lost = false, false, false
        for _,node in ipairs(guiRoot:GetDescendants()) do
            if node:IsA("TextLabel") then
                local value = string.upper(tostring(node.Text or ""))
                if value:find("FLEET", 1, true) or value:find("THE FLEET", 1, true) then isFleet = true end
                if value:find("DEFEATED", 1, true) or value:find("VICTORY", 1, true)
                    or value:find("MISSION COMPLETE", 1, true) then won = true end
                if value:find("MISSION FAILED", 1, true) or value == "DEFEAT" then lost = true end
            end
        end
        if isFleet and won ~= lost then return won and "WIN" or "LOSS" end
        return nil
    end

    local function ownedEncounter()
        local current=env.state:featureSnapshot("BOSS").encounter
        if current and current.bossId==config.bossId and current.phase~="COMPLETE" then return current end
    end
    local function rosterIncludesPlayer(packet)
        for _, row in ipairs(type(packet.Roster)=="table" and packet.Roster or {}) do
            if type(row)=="table" and row.UserId==player.UserId then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function closeConnections()
        for _,conn in ipairs(connections) do conn:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(connections)
        listeningContext,encounterId=nil,nil
    end
    local function listen(remote,fn)
        local connection=remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(fn)
        table.insert(connections,connection)
    end
    function report:watch(ctx)
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return false,"CANCELLED" end
        local current=ownedEncounter()
        local id=current and current.encounterId
        if listeningContext==ctx and id==encounterId and #connections>0 then return true end
        local function bindJob()
            listeningContext=ctx
            ctx:deferCleanup(function()
                if listeningContext==ctx then listeningContext=nil end
            end)
        end
        if id and id==encounterId and #connections>0 then bindJob(); return true end
        closeConnections()
        local folder=platform:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        local remote=folder and folder:FindFirstChild("FleetEvent")
        if not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
            return false,"FLEET_EVENT_MISSING"
        end
        local function process(packet)
            if type(packet)~="table" then return end
            if packet.K=="Batch" and type(packet.Items)=="table" then
                for _,item in ipairs(packet.Items) do process(item) end
                return
            end
            if type(packet.K)~="string" then return end
            local kind=packet.K
            local job=listeningContext
            local forward=id and job and not job:isCancelled() and not job:isClosing() and job.stage~="ENCOUNTER_RECOVERY"
            local evidence=kind=="Session" or kind=="End" or kind=="Outcome"
                or kind=="Returned" or kind=="Transfer" or kind=="Eliminated"
            if not forward and not evidence then return end
            if evidence then
                local owned=ownedEncounter()
                if not id or not owned or owned.encounterId~=id or not (owned.soloAttempted or owned.adopted) then return end
            end
            if forward and kind=="Session" and packet.Generation~=nil and rosterIncludesPlayer(packet) then
                generation=generation or packet.Generation
                if packet.Generation==generation then
                    rosterGeneration=generation
                    lossEncounter,lossGeneration=nil,nil
                end
            end
            if not generation or packet.Generation~=nil and packet.Generation~=generation then return end
            if packet.Generation==nil and (kind=="End" or kind=="Outcome") then
                local live=flight:nativeEvidence()
                local sameContext=live.generation==generation
                if not sameContext and not (kind=="Outcome" and nativeEnd and live.worldGeneration==generation) then return end
            end
            if kind=="Phase" then
                emit("FLEET_PHASE",{phase=packet.Phase})
            elseif kind=="End" then
                nativeEnd=packet.Reason or "UNSPECIFIED"
            elseif kind=="Returned" or kind=="Transfer" or kind=="Eliminated" then
                if packet.UserId==player.UserId then pilotEvent=kind end
            end
            if kind=="Outcome" and type(packet.Victory)=="boolean" then
                lossEncounter=DeferredOutcome.isDefeat(packet) and packet.Generation==generation
                    and rosterGeneration==generation and id or nil
                lossGeneration=lossEncounter and generation or nil
            end
            if kind=="Outcome" and type(packet.Victory)=="boolean" and not confirmedOutcome then
                confirmedOutcome=packet.Victory and "WIN" or "LOSS"
                outcomeReason=tostring(packet.Reason or "")
                outcomeAt=runtime:now()
                emit("FLEET_OUTCOME",{outcome=confirmedOutcome,reason=packet.Reason,generation=generation})
            end
            if forward and (kind~="Outcome" or type(packet.Victory)=="boolean") then
                flight:observe(packet)
            end
        end
        listen(remote,process)
        encounterId=id
        bindJob()
        return true
    end
    function report:releaseEncounter(id)
        if encounterId==id then closeConnections() end
    end
    function report:cleanup(ctx)
        local current=ownedEncounter()
        if not ctx or not current or current.encounterId~=encounterId then closeConnections() end
        flight:stop()
        -- Keep outcome evidence for checkpoint reconciliation.
    end
    function report:verifiedDeferredOutcome(encounter)
        local live=flight:nativeEvidence()
        return seenReport and not encounter.adopted and lossEncounter==encounter.encounterId and lossGeneration==generation
            and (live.worldGeneration==nil or live.worldGeneration==generation)
    end
    function report:deferredLossReleased()
        local live=flight:nativeEvidence()
        if live.readable then return live.missing and not live.participant end
    end
    function report:resetOutcome()
        lossEncounter,lossGeneration,rosterGeneration=nil,nil,nil
        confirmedOutcome,outcomeAt,outcomeReason,seenReport,firstOpenedAt=nil,nil,nil,false,nil
        generation,nativeEnd,pilotEvent,lastDiagnostic=nil,nil,nil,nil
        flight:reset()
    end
    function report:invalidateNativeEnd(key)
        if generation==key then nativeEnd,lossEncounter,lossGeneration=nil,nil,nil end
    end
    function report:ownedNativeGeneration()
        return generation
    end
    function report:nativeEncounter(expected)
        local live=flight:nativeEvidence()
        local participant=live.participant
        local job=listeningContext
        if not generation and participant and job and job.stage~="ENCOUNTER_RECOVERY"
            and not job:isCancelled() and not job:isClosing() then
            generation=live.generation or live.worldActive==true and live.worldGeneration or nil
        end
        local key=expected or generation
        local observed=live.generation
        local active=live.state=="Active" and not live.eliminated and not live.leaving
        local reason,state
        if not key then reason="FLEET_OWNED_GENERATION_UNVERIFIED"
        elseif observed and observed~=key then reason="FLEET_NATIVE_GENERATION_MISMATCH"
        elseif active then
            state="ACTIVE"
            reason=live.proxyOwned and "FLEET_ACTIVE_REBIND_UNSUPPORTED" or "FLEET_ACTIVE_PILOT_UNVERIFIED"
        elseif participant then reason="FLEET_PARTICIPATION_STILL_PRESENT"
        elseif not live.readable then reason="FLEET_NATIVE_CONTEXT_UNAVAILABLE"
        elseif not live.missing then reason="FLEET_NATIVE_TEARDOWN_PENDING"
        elseif nativeEnd and nativeEnd~="Exited" then reason="FLEET_TERMINAL_RESULT_PENDING"
        elseif expected and generation==expected and (nativeEnd=="Exited" or live.worldGeneration==expected
            and live.worldActive==false and live.worldState=="Idle") then
            state="TERMINAL"
        elseif live.worldGeneration~=key then reason="FLEET_WORKSPACE_GENERATION_UNVERIFIED"
        else reason="FLEET_TERMINAL_SIGNAL_MISSING" end

        if expected or reason and ownedEncounter() and runtime:activeJob() and runtime:activeJob().stage=="ENCOUNTER_RECOVERY" then
            local fields={expected=key, observed=observed, worldGeneration=live.worldGeneration, state=live.state,
                worldState=live.worldState, worldActive=live.worldActive, participant=participant, eliminated=live.eliminated,
                pilot=live.pilot, proxyOwned=live.proxyOwned, transfer=live.transfer, nativeEnd=nativeEnd,
                pilotEvent=pilotEvent, outcome=confirmedOutcome, reason=reason or state}
            local signature={}
            for _, field in ipairs({"expected","observed","worldGeneration","state","worldState","worldActive","participant",
                "eliminated","pilot","proxyOwned","transfer","nativeEnd","pilotEvent","outcome","reason"}) do
                signature[#signature+1]=tostring(fields[field])
            end
            signature=table.concat(signature,"/")
            if signature~=lastDiagnostic then
                lastDiagnostic=signature
                if telemetry then emit("FLEET_RECOVERY_EVIDENCE",fields)
                else print("[PlaneRNG Fleet recovery] expected/observed/world generation, session/world state, active, participant, eliminated, pilot, owned proxy, transfer, end, pilot event, outcome, reason", signature) end
            end
        end
        if state=="TERMINAL" then return key,state end
        if observed and observed==key and state=="ACTIVE" then return key,state,nil,reason end
        return observed or generation, (observed or participant and generation) and "PENDING" or nil, nil, reason
    end
    function report:inspect()
        local root = gui:find(env.profile.paths.bossReport)
        local active = isOpen(root)
        local guiOutcome = active and matchingReport(root) or nil
        if active and (confirmedOutcome or guiOutcome) then
            seenReport = true
            firstOpenedAt = firstOpenedAt or runtime:now()
        end
        local outcome = confirmedOutcome or guiOutcome
        local specialLossPanel = outcome=="LOSS" and confirmedOutcome=="LOSS"
            and not active and outcomeAt~=nil
            and runtime:now()-outcomeAt>=8
            and player:GetAttribute("InBossFight")~=true
            and player:GetAttribute("FleetParticipant")~=true
        return {
            active = active, matchesBoss = confirmedOutcome ~= nil or guiOutcome ~= nil,
            outcome = outcome, report = root, seen = seenReport,
            specialLossPanel=specialLossPanel,
            pendingPresentation = confirmedOutcome ~= nil and not seenReport and not specialLossPanel
                and outcomeAt ~= nil and runtime:now() - outcomeAt < config.reportTimeoutSeconds,
        }
    end
    function report:reconcile(encounter)
        local evidence = self:inspect()
        if evidence.matchesBoss and evidence.outcome
            and (not encounter.outcome or encounter.outcome == evidence.outcome) then return true end
        return encounter.outcome ~= nil and seenReport and not evidence.active
    end
    function report:resolve(ctx, encounter)
        local watching, why = self:watch(ctx)
        if not watching then return {ok = false, code = why} end
        -- V2 REQUIREMENT: Outcome alone never authorizes return/Continue.
        local evidence = ctx:await(function()
            local current = self:inspect()
            if current.active and current.matchesBoss and current.outcome then return current end
            if current.specialLossPanel then return current end
            if seenReport and not current.active and (encounter.outcome or current.outcome) then
                return current -- manually dismissed report after previously observing it
            end
        end, config.reportTimeoutSeconds)
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        if not evidence then return {ok = false, code = "FLEET_REPORT_NOT_OBSERVED"} end
        if evidence.outcome and encounter.outcome and evidence.outcome ~= encounter.outcome then
            return {ok = false, held = true, code = "BOSS_OUTCOME_CONFLICT"}
        end
        local outcome = evidence.outcome or encounter.outcome
        if not outcome then return {ok = false, code = "FLEET_OUTCOME_UNVERIFIED"} end
        if not encounter.outcome then
            local accepted = writer:recordBossReport(outcome,
                runtime:epoch() + repeatPolicy:outcomeDelay(outcome))
            if not accepted then return {ok = false, held = true, code = "BOSS_OUTCOME_CONFLICT"} end
            encounter = env.state:snapshot().boss.encounter
        end
        if not evidence.active then
            if evidence.specialLossPanel then
                emit("FLEET_DEFEAT_PANEL",{reason=outcomeReason,
                    note="Native timed loss panel; flight lock released; no BossResultsOpen"})
            end
            writer:closeReport()
            return {ok = true, code = evidence.specialLossPanel
                and "FLEET_DEFEAT_PANEL_COMPLETED" or "FLEET_REPORT_MANUALLY_CLOSED"}
        end
        local at = platform:position()
        local place = player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") == true and "HIDEOUT" or "OTHER"
        if place == "OTHER" and at then
            local center = Vector3.new(config.arenaFallbackCenter.x,
                config.arenaFallbackCenter.y, config.arenaFallbackCenter.z)
            local horizontal = Vector3.new(at.X-center.X,0,at.Z-center.Z)
            if horizontal.Magnitude < config.arenaRadius
                and at.Y > config.arenaMinY and at.Y < config.arenaMaxY then
                place = "ARENA"
            end
        end
        emit("FLEET_REPORT_OPEN", {outcome = outcome, location = place,
            inBossFight = player:GetAttribute("InBossFight")})
        local controller = loadController()
        if not controller then return {ok = false, code = "FLEET_RESULT_CONTROLLER_MISSING_MANUAL_CONTINUE"} end
        if not encounter.continueAttempted then
            local ready = ctx:await(function()
                if not isOpen() then return "MANUALLY_CLOSED" end
                local armed = false
                if type(controller.Debug) == "function" then
                    local ok, message = pcall(controller.Debug)
                    armed = ok and type(message) == "string"
                        and message:find("armed=true", 1, true) ~= nil
                end
                if armed and firstOpenedAt
                    and runtime:now() - firstOpenedAt >= config.reportHoldSeconds then return "ARMED" end
            end, config.reportTimeoutSeconds)
            if ctx:isCancelled() then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
            if ready == "MANUALLY_CLOSED" then
                writer:closeReport()
                return {ok = true, code = "FLEET_REPORT_MANUALLY_CLOSED"}
            end
            if ready ~= "ARMED" then return {ok = false, code = "FLEET_REPORT_NOT_ARMED_MANUAL_CONTINUE"} end
            if not writer:markContinueAttempt() then return {ok = false, code = "FLEET_CONTINUE_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED"} end
            local sent, err = pcall(function() controller.Dismiss("continue") end)
            if not sent then return {ok = false, code = "FLEET_CONTINUE_FAILED: " .. tostring(err)} end
            emit("FLEET_REPORT_CONTINUE", {code = "CONTINUE_REQUESTED"})
        end
        local closed = ctx:await(function() if not self:inspect().active then return true end end,
            config.reportCloseTimeoutSeconds)
        if not closed then return {ok = false, code = "FLEET_REPORT_STILL_OPEN_MANUAL_CONTINUE"} end
        writer:closeReport()
        return {ok = true, code = "FLEET_REPORT_CLOSED"}
    end
    return report
end
return ReportController
end
-- END MODULE boss.Fleet.ReportController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.OmegaSkyTitan.MainRunnerSource
__factories["boss.OmegaSkyTitan.MainRunnerSource"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Exact standalone V2 source segments for the main-place entry & handoff.
return {
    beforeReturn = [==========[--!nocheck
-- PlaneRNG Omega Sky Titan Standalone AutoTest V1
-- Main World: any World -> World109 -> Project Omega -> raid queue.
-- Raid Place: server Plan.Zones -> dodge via floor-verified PivotTo, native Focus, outcome.
-- Return: native game transit back to main place -> restore original CurrentWorld.
-- Source: boss_research/bosses/OmegaSkyTitan_Combat.md + OmegaEntranceController.
-- V2 fix: Auto Continue, return requeue, saved resume state, optional autoexec rescue.
-- Experimental: teleport dodge acceptance and phases 2-6 are not live-verified.
local MAIN_PLACE, RAID_PLACE = 133112767606395, 90793930948305
local Http=game:GetService("HttpService")
local RS=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local function env()
    if type(getgenv)=="function" then
        local ok,g=pcall(getgenv)
        if ok and type(g)=="table" then return g end
    end
    return _G
end
local G=env()
local opts=G.PlaneRNGOmegaOptions or {}
local function opt(key,default)
    return opts[key]==nil and default or opts[key]
end
local S={
    difficulty=tostring(opt("difficulty","Normal")),
    autoTravelWorld109=opt("autoTravelWorld109",true)==true,
    autoMoveToEntrance=opt("autoMoveToEntrance",true)==true,
    autoReady=opt("autoReady",true)==true,
    autoLaunch=opt("autoLaunch",true)==true,
    soloOnly=opt("soloOnly",true)==true,
    requireTeleportQueue=opt("requireTeleportQueue",true)==true,
    returnToOrigin=opt("returnToOrigin",true)==true,
    autoContinueAfterOutcome=opt("autoContinueAfterOutcome",true)==true,
    reportWaitSeconds=math.clamp(tonumber(opt("reportWaitSeconds",20)) or 20,5,90),
    reportHoldSeconds=math.clamp(tonumber(opt("reportHoldSeconds",0.7)) or .7,0,5),
    autoDodge=opt("autoDodge",true)==true,
    autoFocus=opt("autoFocus",true)==true,
    syncSnapshot=opt("syncSnapshot",true)==true,
    dodgeMargin=math.clamp(tonumber(opt("dodgeMargin",13)) or 13,5,35),
    dodgeCooldown=math.clamp(tonumber(opt("dodgeCooldown",.32)) or .32,.16,2),
    dodgeLead=math.clamp(tonumber(opt("dodgeLead",1.8)) or 1.8,.5,5),
    dodgeHorizon=math.clamp(tonumber(opt("dodgeHorizon",3.0)) or 3,1,8),
    impactMargin=math.clamp(tonumber(opt("impactMargin",.35)) or .35,.15,1),
    postStrikeHold=math.clamp(tonumber(opt("postStrikeHold",.18)) or .18,0,.75),
    maxDodgeRange=math.clamp(tonumber(opt("maxDodgeRange",180)) or 180,60,300),
    autoWaitCooldown=opt("autoWaitCooldown",false)==true,
    maxCooldownWait=math.clamp(tonumber(opt("maxCooldownWait",90)) or 90,5,300),
    entryTimeout=math.clamp(tonumber(opt("entryTimeout",85)) or 85,35,180),
    originWorld=tonumber(opt("originWorld",0)) or 0,
    returnOnly=opt("returnOnly",false)==true,
    persistResume=opt("persistResume",true)==true,
}
local ALLOWED_DIFFICULTIES={Normal=true,Hard=true,Nightmare=true,Raid=true}
if not ALLOWED_DIFFICULTIES[S.difficulty] then S.difficulty="Normal" end
local function replace(text,old,value)
    return (string.gsub(text,old,function() return value end))
end

]==========],
    between = [==========[
]==========],
    afterRaid = [==========[
local function buildReturn(origin)
    return replace(RETURN_SOURCE,"__ORIGIN_WORLD__",tostring(origin))
end
local function buildRaid(origin)
    local returnCode=buildReturn(origin)
    local script=replace(RAID_SOURCE,"__ORIGIN_WORLD__",tostring(origin))
    script=replace(script,"__SETTINGS_JSON__",string.format("%q",Http:JSONEncode(S)))
    script=replace(script,"__RETURN_CODE__",string.format("%q",returnCode))
    return script
end
local function queueFunc()
    if type(queue_on_teleport)=="function" then return queue_on_teleport,"queue_on_teleport" end
    if type(queueonteleport)=="function" then return queueonteleport,"queueonteleport" end
    if type(G.queue_on_teleport)=="function" then return G.queue_on_teleport,"getgenv.queue_on_teleport" end
    if type(G.queueonteleport)=="function" then return G.queueonteleport,"getgenv.queueonteleport" end
    local st=rawget(G,"syn")
    if type(st)=="table" and type(st.queue_on_teleport)=="function" then return st.queue_on_teleport,"syn.queue_on_teleport" end
    return nil,"unsupported"
end
local STATE_PATH="PlaneRNG_OmegaV2_State.json"
local RAID_PATH="PlaneRNG_OmegaV2_Raid.lua"
local RETURN_PATH="PlaneRNG_OmegaV2_Return.lua"
local function savedState()
    if type(readfile)~="function" then return nil end
    local ok,res=pcall(function() return Http:JSONDecode(readfile(STATE_PATH)) end)
    if not ok or type(res)~="table" or res.kind~="OMEGA_V2" then return nil end
    if not tonumber(res.expiresAt) or res.expiresAt<os.time() then return nil end
    if not tonumber(res.originWorld) then return nil end
    return res
end
local function persistLaunch(origin,raidCode)
    if not S.persistResume or type(writefile)~="function" then return false,"WRITEFILE_UNAVAILABLE" end
    local ok,err=pcall(function()
        local state={kind="OMEGA_V2",stage="PREPARED",originWorld=origin,difficulty=S.difficulty,
            createdAt=os.time(),expiresAt=os.time()+7200}
        writefile(RAID_PATH,raidCode)
        writefile(RETURN_PATH,buildReturn(origin))
        writefile(STATE_PATH,Http:JSONEncode(state))
    end)
    return ok,ok and nil or tostring(err)
end
if game.PlaceId==MAIN_PLACE then
    local pending=savedState()
    local origin=(S.returnOnly and S.originWorld>0 and S.originWorld) or (pending and tonumber(pending.originWorld)) or S.originWorld
    if (pending and (pending.stage=="RAID_ENTERED" or pending.stage=="OUTCOME")) or S.returnOnly then
        if origin<1 then warn("[OMEGA V2] RETURN_ONLY_NEEDS_ORIGIN_WORLD");return end
        print("[OMEGA V2] RESUME_RETURN",origin,pending and pending.stage)
        local code=buildReturn(origin)
        local fn,err=loadstring(code)
        if not fn then warn("[OMEGA V2] RETURN_COMPILE_FAILED",err);return end
        local ok,why=pcall(fn)
        if not ok then warn("[OMEGA V2] RETURN_BOOT_ERROR",why) end
        return
    end
end
if game.PlaceId==RAID_PLACE then
    local source=buildRaid(S.originWorld)
    local fn,err=loadstring(source)
    if not fn then warn("[OMEGA V2] RAID_SCRIPT_COMPILE_FAILED",err);return end
    local ok,why=pcall(fn)
    if not ok then warn("[OMEGA V2] RAID_SCRIPT_ERROR",why) end
    return
elseif game.PlaceId~=MAIN_PLACE then
    warn("[OMEGA V2] Unsupported PlaceId",game.PlaceId)
    return
end
if not game:IsLoaded() then game.Loaded:Wait() end
local P=Players.LocalPlayer or Players.PlayerAdded:Wait()
local prev=G.PlaneRNGOmegaTestV2
if prev and prev.running and prev.placeId==game.PlaceId then warn("[OMEGA V2] Already running");return end
if prev and prev.running and type(prev.stop)=="function" then pcall(function() prev:stop() end) end
local T={running=true,placeId=game.PlaceId,stage="MAIN_BOOT",records={},originWorld=nil,queueStatus="none",difficulty=S.difficulty,connections={}}
G.PlaneRNGOmegaTestV2=T
local function emit(name,detail)
    T.stage=name
    local item={event=name,detail=detail or {},at=math.floor(workspace:GetServerTimeNow()*100)/100}
    table.insert(T.records,item)
    if #T.records>500 then table.remove(T.records,1) end
    print("[OMEGA V2 MAIN] "..Http:JSONEncode(item))
end
function T:status()
    return {running=self.running,stage=self.stage,currentWorld=P:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"),originWorld=self.originWorld,queue=self.queueStatus,difficulty=self.difficulty,
        entryFinished=self.entryFinished==true,entryExitStage=self.entryExitStage,prequeueHomeVerified=self.prequeueHomeVerified}
end
function T:dump(n)
    for i=math.max(1,#self.records-(tonumber(n) or 80)+1),#self.records do
        print("[OMEGA V2 LOG] "..Http:JSONEncode(self.records[i]))
    end
end
function T:stop()
    self.running=false
    for _,con in ipairs(self.connections) do pcall(function()con:Disconnect() end) end
    table.clear(self.connections)
    emit("STOPPED")
end
local function root()
    local c=P.Character
    return c,c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end
local function waitFor(check,timeout)
    local deadline=os.clock()+timeout
    while T.running and os.clock()<deadline do
        local r=check();if r then return r end
        task.wait(.3)
    end
    return nil
end
local remotes=RS:WaitForChild("Remotes",25)
local function travelOnce(target)
    if tonumber(P:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"))==target then return true end
    if not S.autoTravelWorld109 then return false,"AUTO_TRAVEL_DISABLED" end
    if P:GetAttribute("InBossFight")==true or P:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout")==true then
        return false,"BOSS_OR_HIDEOUT_LOCK"
    end
    local prep=remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("NavPrepareWorlds")
    local req=remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("RequestWorldTravel")
    local result=remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("WorldTravelResult")
    if not (prep and req and result) then return false,"WORLD_REMOTE_MISSING" end
    local _,hrp=root()
    if not hrp then return false,"ROOT_MISSING" end
    local prior=hrp.Position
    local reply=nil
    local con=result.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(evt)
        if type(evt)=="table" and evt.Kind=="Result" and tonumber(evt.WorldId)==target then reply=evt end
    end)
    emit(target==109 and "TRAVEL_WORLD_109" or "PREQUEUE_HOME_TRAVEL",{from=P:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"),to=target})
    local ok,err=pcall(function()
        prep:FireServer("stream",target);task.wait(.17)
        if not T.running then return end
        req:FireServer(target)
    end)
    if not ok then con:Disconnect();return false,"SEND_FAILED:"..tostring(err) end
    local passed=waitFor(function()
        if reply and reply.Ok==false then return "REJECTED:"..tostring(reply.Reason) end
        local _,r=root()
        if r and tonumber(P:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"))==target and
            ((r.Position-prior).Magnitude>35 or (reply and reply.Ok==true)) then return "VERIFIED" end
    end,28)
    con:Disconnect()
    if passed=="VERIFIED" then emit(target==109 and "WORLD_109_VERIFIED" or "PREQUEUE_HOME_TRAVEL_VERIFIED",{to=target});return true end
    return false,passed or "WORLD_TRAVEL_TIMEOUT"
end
-- Respect the server travel cooldown after a Totem return. Only an explicit
-- Cooldown rejection is retryable: all other failures stop without another send.
-- Bounded wait and fresh per-attempt response listener prevent duplicate requests.
local function travel(target)
    local started=os.clock()
    local retryDelays={3,5,8,12,15,20}
    for attempt=1,#retryDelays+1 do
        if not T.running then return false,"WORLD_TRAVEL_CANCELLED" end
        local ok,reason=travelOnce(target)
        if ok then return true end
        if reason~="REJECTED:Cooldown" then return false,reason end
        if attempt>#retryDelays then break end
        local delay=retryDelays[attempt]
        if os.clock()-started+delay>75 then break end
        emit("WORLD_TRAVEL_COOLDOWN_WAIT",{attempt=attempt,seconds=delay,to=target})
        local endAt=os.clock()+delay
        while T.running and os.clock()<endAt do task.wait(math.min(.5,endAt-os.clock())) end
    end
    return false,"WORLD_TRAVEL_COOLDOWN_EXHAUSTED"
end
local function cooldown()
    local raw=P:GetAttribute("BossStartCooldowns")
    if type(raw)~="string" then return 0 end
    local ok,v=pcall(function() return Http:JSONDecode(raw) end)
    if ok and type(v)=="table" then return math.max(0,(tonumber(v.OmegaSkyTitan) or 0)-workspace:GetServerTimeNow()) end
    return 0
end
local function run()
    local home=waitFor(function()
        local n=tonumber(P:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"))
        if n and n>=1 and n%1==0 then return n end
    end,20)
    if not home then emit("ORIGIN_WORLD_MISSING");return end
    T.originWorld=home
    emit("ORIGIN_SAVED",{world=home,placeId=game.PlaceId,difficulty=S.difficulty})
    if home~=109 then
        local ok,why=travel(109)
        if not ok then emit("WORLD_TRAVEL_FAILED",{reason=why});return end
    end
    local entrance=workspace:FindFirstChild("OmegaEntrance") or workspace:WaitForChild("OmegaEntrance",30)
    if not entrance then emit("ENTRANCE_NOT_FOUND");return end
    if tonumber(P:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"))~=109 then emit("NEED_WORLD_109");return end
    if P:GetAttribute("InBossFight")==true then emit("BOSS_LOCK_ACTIVE");return end
    if (entrance:GetAttribute("EntranceState") or "Dormant")~="Dormant" then
        emit("ENTRANCE_BUSY",{state=entrance:GetAttribute("EntranceState")});return
    end
    local anchor=entrance:FindFirstChild("PromptAnchor",true)
    if not anchor or not (anchor:IsA("BasePart") or anchor:IsA("Attachment")) then emit("PROMPT_ANCHOR_MISSING");return end
    local anchorPos=anchor:IsA("Attachment") and anchor.WorldPosition or anchor.Position
    local ch,hrp=root()
    if not ch or not hrp then emit("ROOT_MISSING");return end
    local distance=(hrp.Position-anchorPos).Magnitude
    if distance>17 then
        if not S.autoMoveToEntrance then emit("MOVE_REQUIRED",{distance=distance});return end
        local desired=anchorPos+Vector3.new(7,2,4)
        emit("MOVE_TO_OMEGA_ENTRANCE",{distance=distance})
        local ok,err=pcall(function() ch:PivotTo(CFrame.new(desired)) end)
        if not ok then emit("ENTRANCE_MOVE_ERROR",{error=tostring(err)});return end
        task.wait(.8)
        local _,r=root()
        if not r or (r.Position-anchorPos).Magnitude>22 then emit("ENTRANCE_MOVE_UNVERIFIED");return end
    end
    local remote=remotes and (remotes:FindFirstChild("OmegaEntrance") or remotes:WaitForChild("OmegaEntrance",12))
    if not remote then emit("OMEGA_REMOTE_MISSING");return end
    local left=cooldown()
    if left>0 then
        emit("COOLDOWN_ACTIVE",{remaining=math.ceil(left)})
        if not S.autoWaitCooldown or left>S.maxCooldownWait then return end
        waitFor(function() return cooldown()<=0 end,left+3)
        if cooldown()>0 then emit("COOLDOWN_TIMEOUT");return end
    end
    if not T.running then return end
    local leader=tonumber(entrance:GetAttribute("EntranceLeader")) or 0
    if S.soloOnly and leader~=0 and leader~=P.UserId then emit("OTHER_LEADER_ACTIVE",{leader=leader});return end
    if S.autoReady and P:GetAttribute("OmegaEntranceReady")~=true then
        emit("READY_REQUEST",{kind="Press"})
        local ok,err=pcall(function() remote:FireServer({Kind="Press"}) end)
        if not ok then emit("READY_SEND_FAILED",{error=tostring(err)});return end
        local seen=waitFor(function()
            return P:GetAttribute("OmegaEntranceReady")==true or tonumber(entrance:GetAttribute("EntranceLeader"))==P.UserId
        end,14)
        if not seen then emit("READY_NOT_VERIFIED");return end
    end
    leader=tonumber(entrance:GetAttribute("EntranceLeader")) or 0
    if leader~=P.UserId then emit("LEADER_NOT_SELF",{leader=leader});return end
    if S.soloOnly and (tonumber(entrance:GetAttribute("EntranceReady")) or 0)>1 then
        emit("OTHER_READY_PLAYERS",{count=entrance:GetAttribute("EntranceReady")});return
    end
    local selected=tostring(entrance:GetAttribute("EntranceMode") or "Normal")
    if selected~=S.difficulty then
        emit("DIFFICULTY_REQUEST",{from=selected,to=S.difficulty})
        local ok,err=pcall(function() remote:FireServer({Kind="Mode",Mode=S.difficulty}) end)
        if not ok then emit("DIFFICULTY_SEND_FAILED",{error=tostring(err)});return end
        if not waitFor(function() return entrance:GetAttribute("EntranceMode")==S.difficulty end,9) then
            emit("DIFFICULTY_NOT_VERIFIED",{actual=entrance:GetAttribute("EntranceMode")});return
        end
    end
    emit("DIFFICULTY_VERIFIED",{mode=S.difficulty})
    if not S.autoLaunch then emit("READY_FOR_MANUAL_LAUNCH");return end
    local launchable=waitFor(function()
        if (entrance:GetAttribute("EntranceState") or "Dormant")~="Dormant" then return "BUSY" end
        if entrance:GetAttribute("EntranceCanLaunch")==true then return "READY" end
    end,25)
    if launchable~="READY" then emit("LAUNCH_NOT_READY",{state=entrance:GetAttribute("EntranceState"),canLaunch=entrance:GetAttribute("EntranceCanLaunch")});return end
    local fn,api=queueFunc()
    if fn then
        local code=buildRaid(home)
        local stored,reason=persistLaunch(home,code)
        emit(stored and "RESCUE_FILES_WRITTEN" or "RESCUE_FILES_NOT_WRITTEN",{reason=reason,autoexecRequiredForFallback=true})
        local ok,err=pcall(function() fn(code) end)
        T.queueStatus=ok and "queued" or "error"
        emit(ok and "QUEUE_REGISTERED" or "QUEUE_FAILED",{api=api,bytes=#code,error=not ok and tostring(err) or nil})
    else
        T.queueStatus="unsupported"
        emit("QUEUE_UNAVAILABLE")
        local saved,reason=persistLaunch(home,buildRaid(home))
        emit(saved and "RESCUE_FILES_WRITTEN" or "RESCUE_FILES_NOT_WRITTEN",{reason=reason})
    end
    if S.requireTeleportQueue and T.queueStatus~="queued" then emit("ENTRY_HALTED_QUEUE_REQUIRED");return end
    if not T.running then return end
    if entrance:GetAttribute("EntranceCanLaunch")~=true or entrance:GetAttribute("EntranceState")~="Dormant" then
        emit("LAUNCH_STATE_CHANGED_BEFORE_SEND");return
    end
    emit("LAUNCH_REQUEST",{difficulty=S.difficulty,originWorld=home})
    local ok,err=pcall(function() remote:FireServer({Kind="Press"}) end)
    if not ok then emit("LAUNCH_SEND_FAILED",{error=tostring(err)});return end
    local result=waitFor(function()
        local state=entrance:GetAttribute("EntranceState")
        if state=="Countdown" or state=="Departing" then return state end
        if P:GetAttribute("InBossFight")==true then return "BOSS_STARTED" end
    end,12)
    if result then emit("LAUNCH_ACCEPTED",{state=result})
    else emit("LAUNCH_UNVERIFIED",{state=entrance:GetAttribute("EntranceState"),note="Do not blindly press again"}) end
end
emit("MAIN_INIT",{placeId=game.PlaceId,difficulty=S.difficulty,options={autoTravelWorld109=S.autoTravelWorld109,autoDodge=S.autoDodge,returnToOrigin=S.returnToOrigin}})
task.spawn(function()
    local ok,err=pcall(run)
    if not T.running then return end -- reset cancelled this generation
    if not ok then emit("MAIN_ERROR",{message=tostring(err)}) end
    local exitStage=T.stage
    -- These two observations occur strictly before ready/launch/queue.
    -- Do not interact with another player's party; restore the captured world
    -- via the existing bounded travel path. Failed return is not a failed raid.
    if T.queueStatus=="none" and (exitStage=="OTHER_LEADER_ACTIVE" or exitStage=="ENTRANCE_BUSY") then
        T.entryExitStage=exitStage -- terminal prequeue proof, before home travel
        local home=T.originWorld
        if home and tonumber(P:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"))~=home then
            local returned,reason=travel(home)
            if not T.running then return end
            T.prequeueHomeVerified=returned==true
            emit(returned and "PREQUEUE_BUSY_HOME_VERIFIED" or "PREQUEUE_BUSY_HOME_UNVERIFIED",{world=home,reason=reason})
        else
            T.prequeueHomeVerified=home~=nil and tonumber(P:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"))==home
        end
    end
    if not T.running then return end
    T.entryExitStage=exitStage
    T.entryFinished=true
    if exitStage~="LAUNCH_ACCEPTED" and T.queueStatus=="none" then
        T.running=false
        print("[OMEGA V2 MAIN] ENTRY_FINISHED",exitStage)
    end
end)
print("[OMEGA V2 MAIN] getgenv().PlaneRNGOmegaTestV2:status() | :dump(120)")
]==========],
}
end
