-- BEGIN MODULE boss.OmegaSkyTitan.PlaceHandoff
__factories["boss.OmegaSkyTitan.PlaceHandoff"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Tested standalone Omega V2 is rebuilt byte-for-byte at runtime.
-- Only the main place launches this script; queued raid/return are self-contained.
local Contracts = require("main.core.Contracts")
local RaidAttemptOptions = require("boss.shared.RaidAttemptOptions")
local RaidReturnResumeSource = require("main.adapters.RaidReturnResumeSource")
local RaidOutcomeWitnessSource = require("main.adapters.RaidOutcomeWitnessSource")
local MainRunnerSource = require("boss.OmegaSkyTitan.MainRunnerSource")
local RaidRunnerSource = require("boss.OmegaSkyTitan.RaidRunnerSource")
local ReturnRunnerSource = require("boss.OmegaSkyTitan.ReturnRunnerSource")

local function originalV2(returnHook, witness)
    return MainRunnerSource.beforeReturn
        .. "local RETURN_SOURCE = [=====[" .. ReturnRunnerSource .. (returnHook or "") .. "]=====]"
        .. MainRunnerSource.between
        .. "local RAID_SOURCE = [======[" .. RaidRunnerSource .. (witness or "") .. "]======]"
        .. MainRunnerSource.afterRaid
end

local function globals()
    if type(getgenv) == "function" then
        local ok, value = pcall(getgenv)
        if ok and type(value) == "table" then return value end
    end
    return _G
end

local function isCompleted(g)
    local returning = g.PlaneRNGOmegaReturnV2
    if returning and (returning.completed == true or returning.stage == "HOME_VERIFIED") then
        return true, "RETURN_COMPLETED"
    end
    if type(readfile) == "function" then
        local ok, state = pcall(function()
            return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(readfile("PlaneRNG_OmegaV2_State.json"))
        end)
        if ok and type(state) == "table" and state.kind == "OMEGA_V2"
            and state.stage == "DONE" and (tonumber(state.expiresAt) or 0) >= os.time() then
            return true, "PERSISTED_DONE"
        end
    end
    return false, nil
end

-- The standalone Omega runner checks its own persisted OUTCOME before it
-- creates a new main-place runner. A stale outcome from a PREVIOUS attempt
-- therefore starts ReturnRunner (and retires V6) in place of a new Raid.
-- Reconcile only when physical home state is verified; never turn an
-- in-flight RAID_ENTERED marker into a completed result.
local function reconcilePreviousOmegaState(player, g)
    if type(readfile) ~= "function" then return true end
    local statePath = "PlaneRNG_OmegaV2_State.json"
    local readOk, stored = pcall(readfile, statePath)
    if not readOk then return true end -- file missing: standalone savedState also returns nil
    local http = game:GetService("HttpService")
    local decoded, state = pcall(function() return http:JSONDecode(stored) end)
    if decoded and state == nil then return true end -- JSON null: no prior state
    if not decoded or type(state) ~= "table" then
        return false, "OMEGA_PRIOR_STATE_UNREADABLE"
    end
    if state.kind ~= "OMEGA_V2" or type(state.expiresAt) ~= "number"
        or state.expiresAt < os.time() then return true end
    if state.stage == "DONE" or state.stage == "PREPARED" then return true end
    if state.stage == "RAID_ENTERED" then
        return false, "OMEGA_PRIOR_RAID_OUTCOME_UNRESOLVED"
    end
    if state.stage ~= "OUTCOME" then return true end
    local origin = tonumber(state.originWorld)
    local character = player and player.Character
    local previousReturn = g.PlaneRNGOmegaReturnV2
    if not origin or origin < 1 or tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")) ~= origin
        or player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true
        or player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") == true
        or player:GetAttribute("BossResultsOpen") == true
        or not character or not character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        or (previousReturn and previousReturn.running == true) then
        return false, "OMEGA_PRIOR_RETURN_NOT_VERIFIED"
    end
    if type(writefile) ~= "function" then return false, "OMEGA_PRIOR_STATE_WRITE_UNAVAILABLE" end
    local sameCreatedAt = state.createdAt
    state.stage = "DONE"
    state.doneAt = os.time()
    local wrote, reason = pcall(function()
        writefile(statePath, http:JSONEncode(state))
        local check = http:JSONDecode(readfile(statePath))
        assert(type(check) == "table" and check.kind == "OMEGA_V2"
            and check.stage == "DONE" and tonumber(check.originWorld) == origin
            and check.createdAt == sameCreatedAt, "OMEGA_STATE_READBACK_MISMATCH")
    end)
    if not wrote then
        warn("[OMEGA V2] PREVIOUS_OUTCOME_RECONCILE_FAILED", tostring(reason))
        return false, "OMEGA_PRIOR_STATE_WRITE_UNVERIFIED"
    end
    print("[OMEGA V2] PREVIOUS_OUTCOME_HOME_RECONCILED", origin)
    return true
end

local PlaceHandoff = {}
function PlaceHandoff.new(env, config)
    local adapter = {}
    local launchConsumed = false
    local lastStartAt = -math.huge

    local function deferred(code, delay, evidence)
        return Contracts.result("DEFERRED", code, {
            stage = "SETUP",
            retryAt = env.runtime:now() + (delay or config.launchRetrySeconds),
            evidence = evidence or {},
        })
    end

    function adapter:forceReset()
        self:cancel()
        launchConsumed = false
        lastStartAt = -math.huge
        return true
    end

    function adapter:preflight()
        return reconcilePreviousOmegaState(env.services.roblox:player(), globals())
    end

    function adapter:status()
        local g = globals()
        local main = g.PlaneRNGOmegaTestV2
        local ret = g.PlaneRNGOmegaReturnV2
        -- A completed return handle from a previous Omega cycle may survive
        -- in getgenv() even after the NEW main-place runner starts. Its stale
        -- running=false / HOME_VERIFIED status must not short-circuit the
        -- LAUNCH_ACCEPTED wait, or the V6 journal is wrongly marked UNCERTAIN
        -- while a real raid is already entering. Prefer the active main runner.
        if main and type(main.status) == "function" then
            local ok, value = pcall(function() return main:status() end)
            if ok and type(value) == "table" then return value end
        end
        if ret and type(ret.status) == "function" then
            local ok, value = pcall(function() return ret:status() end)
            if ok and type(value) == "table" then return value end
        end
        return {running = false, stage = "NOT_STARTED"}
    end

    function adapter:cancel()
        local t = globals().PlaneRNGOmegaTestV2
        if t and t.running and type(t.stop) == "function" then
            pcall(function() t:stop() end)
        end
        -- queue_on_teleport has no portable dequeue function. Cancellation of
        -- previously queued raid/return payloads cannot be guaranteed.
        launchConsumed = true
    end

    function adapter:run(ctx, attempt)
        if ctx:isCancelled() then
            return Contracts.result("CANCELLED", "OMEGA_V2_CANCELLED", {stage="SETUP"})
        end
        if game.PlaceId ~= config.mainPlaceId then
            return deferred("OMEGA_MAIN_PLACE_REQUIRED", 60, {placeId=game.PlaceId})
        end
        local player = env.services.roblox:player()
        if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true then return deferred("OMEGA_OTHER_BOSS_ACTIVE", 40) end
        if player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") == true then return deferred("OMEGA_LEAVE_HIDEOUT_FIRST", 40) end

        local g = globals()
        -- A newly reserved managed token is its own one-use authorization.
        -- The central journal cannot admit it while a previous attempt is
        -- unresolved. Native eligibility is still required by the readiness
        -- provider and the original entrance controller.
        local managedRearm = type(attempt) == "table" and attempt.repeatEnabled == true
            and type(attempt.token) == "string" and #attempt.token >= 8
        local rearm = g.PlaneRNGOmegaModuleRearm == true or managedRearm
        if rearm then
            g.PlaneRNGOmegaModuleRearm = nil
            launchConsumed = false
        end
        local finished, reason = isCompleted(g)
        if finished and not rearm then
            return deferred("OMEGA_V2_CYCLE_COMPLETE_REARM_REQUIRED", 3600, {reason=reason})
        end
        if launchConsumed then
            return deferred("OMEGA_V2_ONE_SHOT_ALREADY_LAUNCHED", 3600, self:status())
        end
        local old = g.PlaneRNGOmegaTestV2
        if old and old.running and old.placeId == game.PlaceId then
            return deferred("OMEGA_V2_ALREADY_RUNNING", 30, self:status())
        end
        if env.runtime:now() - lastStartAt < 5 then
            return deferred("OMEGA_V2_START_THROTTLED", 10)
        end
        if type(loadstring) ~= "function" then
            return deferred("OMEGA_V2_LOADSTRING_UNAVAILABLE", 60)
        end

        local options, invalid = RaidAttemptOptions.build(config, g.PlaneRNGOmegaOptions, attempt)
        if not options then return deferred(invalid, 60) end
        local returnHook = nil
        if attempt and attempt.resumeV6 == true then
            returnHook = RaidReturnResumeSource.render(config.bossId, attempt.token,
                player.UserId, config.mainPlaceId, attempt.originalWorld, attempt.buildId)
            if not returnHook then return deferred("RAID_RESUME_CONTRACT_INVALID", 60) end
        end
        -- Modular launches must not enter a separate PlaceId without a return
        -- payload. The source is unchanged; only validated options are supplied.
        options.requireTeleportQueue = true
        options.returnToOrigin = true
        options.autoContinueAfterOutcome = true
        options.persistResume = true
        options.returnOnly = false
        options.originWorld = 0
        local witness=nil
        if attempt and attempt.resumeV6==true then
            witness=RaidOutcomeWitnessSource.render(config.bossId,attempt.token,
                player.UserId,config.raidPlaceId,options.difficulty)
            if not witness then return deferred("RAID_WITNESS_CONTRACT_INVALID",60) end
        end
        g.PlaneRNGOmegaOptions = options

        local fn, err = loadstring(originalV2(returnHook, witness))
        if not fn then
            return deferred("OMEGA_V2_SOURCE_COMPILE_ERROR", 120, {error=tostring(err)})
        end
        lastStartAt = env.runtime:now()
        local ok, why = pcall(fn)
        if not ok then
            return deferred("OMEGA_V2_START_ERROR", 120, {error=tostring(why)})
        end
        local status = self:status()
        -- Starting the standalone coroutine is NOT successful raid admission.
        -- Wait until Omega's own entry controller confirms launch acceptance.
        -- The wait covers bounded server-reported world-travel cooldown retries.
        local deadline=env.runtime:now()+135
        local homeDeadline
        local function prequeueBusy(s)
            return s.queue=="none"
                and (s.entryExitStage=="OTHER_LEADER_ACTIVE" or s.entryExitStage=="ENTRANCE_BUSY")
        end
        local function busyResult(s)
            return Contracts.result("DEFERRED","OMEGA_V2_PREQUEUE_LOBBY_BUSY",{
                stage="SETUP",retryAt=env.runtime:now()+25,
                evidence={noPayloadQueued=true,entryStage=s.entryExitStage,
                    homeVerified=s.prequeueHomeVerified==true},
            })
        end
        while status.stage~="LAUNCH_ACCEPTED" do
            if ctx:isCancelled() then break end
            if prequeueBusy(status) then
                if status.entryFinished==true then return busyResult(status) end
                -- A proven no-queue failure may only be restoring its home.
                -- Give that bounded operation its own deadline, not a fresh
                -- launch authorization. Never retry the party interaction.
                homeDeadline=homeDeadline or env.runtime:now()+110
                if env.runtime:now()>=homeDeadline or not status.running then
                    self:cancel()
                    launchConsumed=false -- this attempt proved no queue
                    return busyResult(status)
                end
            elseif env.runtime:now()>=deadline then
                break
            end
            if status.stage=="WORLD_TRAVEL_FAILED" and status.queue=="none" then
                local runtime=globals().PlaneRNGOmegaTestV2
                local failure=runtime and runtime.records and runtime.records[#runtime.records]
                if runtime and type(runtime.stop)=="function" then pcall(function()runtime:stop()end) end
                return Contracts.result("DEFERRED","OMEGA_V2_PREQUEUE_TRAVEL_FAILED",{
                    stage="SETUP",retryAt=env.runtime:now()+25,
                    evidence={noPayloadQueued=true,entryStage="WORLD_TRAVEL_FAILED",
                        reason=failure and failure.detail and failure.detail.reason},
                })
            end
            if not status.running or ctx:isCancelled() then break end
            task.wait(.25)
            status=self:status()
        end
        if status.stage~="LAUNCH_ACCEPTED" then
            if not ctx:isCancelled() then self:cancel() end
            -- Once the queue may exist, the result is uncertain: do not clear
            -- the journal or repeat until the next place/return is verified.
            return deferred("OMEGA_V2_ENTRY_NOT_CONFIRMED",60,status)
        end
        launchConsumed = true
        if env.services.telemetry then
            env.services.telemetry:emit("OMEGA_V2_STARTED", {
                difficulty=options.difficulty, originWorld=player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"),
                returnToOrigin=true, source="TESTED_V2",
            })
        end
        return deferred("OMEGA_V2_STARTED", 3600, {
            difficulty=options.difficulty,
            originWorld=player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"),
            stage=status.stage,
            note="Outcome, Continue and return are owned by queued Omega V2",
        })
    end
    return adapter
end
return PlaceHandoff
end
-- END MODULE boss.OmegaSkyTitan.PlaceHandoff

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.OmegaSkyTitan.RaidRunnerSource
__factories["boss.OmegaSkyTitan.RaidRunnerSource"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Exact V2 raid code: Plan.Zones, floor checks, PivotTo, Focus,
-- native report Continue and requeue return. Self-contained after teleport.
return [==========[--!nocheck
-- Omega V2 Raid. Read-only telegraph interception + threat aware, floor verified PivotTo dodge.
local MAIN_PLACE, RAID_PLACE = 133112767606395, 90793930948305
local ORIGIN = __ORIGIN_WORLD__
local Http = game:GetService("HttpService")
local SETTINGS=Http:JSONDecode(__SETTINGS_JSON__)
local RETURN_CODE=__RETURN_CODE__
local RS=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local P=game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
if game.PlaceId~=RAID_PLACE then warn("[OMEGA V2 RAID] Unexpected PlaceId",game.PlaceId);return end
if not game:IsLoaded() then game.Loaded:Wait() end
while not P do task.wait(.1);P=game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer end
local G=(type(getgenv)=="function" and getgenv()) or _G
local old=G.PlaneRNGOmegaTestV2
if old and old.running and old.placeId==game.PlaceId then warn("[OMEGA V2 RAID] Already running");return end
if old and old.running and type(old.stop)=="function" then pcall(function() old:stop() end) end
local T={running=true,placeId=game.PlaceId,stage="RAID_INIT",records={},connections={},originWorld=ORIGIN,zoneCount=0,dodges=0,focus="",lastDodge=0,outcome=nil,queueStatus="not_queued",phase=0,foundZones=0,continueStatus="not_started",returnRequeues=0}
G.PlaneRNGOmegaTestV2=T
local function clean(v,depth)
    depth=depth or 0
    if depth>3 then return "..." end
    if typeof(v)=="Vector3" then return {x=math.floor(v.X*100)/100,y=math.floor(v.Y*100)/100,z=math.floor(v.Z*100)/100} end
    if typeof(v)=="CFrame" then return clean(v.Position,depth+1) end
    if type(v)=="table" then
        local out={};local n=0
        for k,x in pairs(v) do n=n+1;if n<=15 then out[tostring(k)]=clean(x,depth+1) end end
        return out
    end
    if type(v)=="string" and #v>160 then return v:sub(1,160) end
    return v
end
local function emit(name,detail)
    local item={event=name,stage=T.stage,sec=math.floor(workspace:GetServerTimeNow()*100)/100,detail=clean(detail or {})}
    table.insert(T.records,item)
    if #T.records>650 then table.remove(T.records,1) end
    print("[OMEGA V2 RAID] "..Http:JSONEncode(item))
end
local STATE_PATH="PlaneRNG_OmegaV2_State.json"
local function persistStage(nextStage)
    if SETTINGS.persistResume==false or type(readfile)~="function" or type(writefile)~="function" then return false,"FILESYSTEM_UNAVAILABLE" end
    local ok,why=pcall(function()
        local state=Http:JSONDecode(readfile(STATE_PATH))
        if type(state)~="table" or tonumber(state.originWorld)~=ORIGIN then error("STORED_ORIGIN_MISMATCH") end
        if tonumber(state.expiresAt) and state.expiresAt<os.time() then error("RESUME_EXPIRED") end
        state.stage=nextStage;state.updatedAt=os.time()
        writefile(STATE_PATH,Http:JSONEncode(state))
    end)
    return ok,ok and nil or tostring(why)
end
local function stage(name,detail) T.stage=name;emit(name,detail) end
local function listen(event,fn)
    local c=event:Connect(fn);table.insert(T.connections,c);return c
end
function T:status()
    return {running=self.running,stage=self.stage,originWorld=self.originWorld,phase=self.phase,
        currentPhaseName=self.raid and self.raid:GetAttribute("PhaseName"),
        hp=self.raid and self.raid:GetAttribute("HP"),
        maxhp=self.raid and self.raid:GetAttribute("MaxHP"),
        difficulty=self.raid and self.raid:GetAttribute("Difficulty"),
        zones=self.zoneCount,dodges=self.dodges,focus=self.focus,
        outcome=self.outcome,queue=self.queueStatus,continueStatus=self.continueStatus,
        returnRequeues=self.returnRequeues,
        grabbed=P:GetAttribute("OmegaGrabbed"),eliminated=P:GetAttribute("OmegaEliminated")}
end
function T:dump(n)
    for i=math.max(1,#self.records-(tonumber(n) or 100)+1),#self.records do
        print("[OMEGA V2 LOG] "..Http:JSONEncode(self.records[i]))
    end
end
function T:stop()
    self.running=false
    for _,c in ipairs(self.connections) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
    table.clear(self.connections)
    stage("STOPPED")
end
local function queueFunc()
    local g=G
    if type(queue_on_teleport)=="function" then return queue_on_teleport,"queue_on_teleport" end
    if type(queueonteleport)=="function" then return queueonteleport,"queueonteleport" end
    if type(g.queue_on_teleport)=="function" then return g.queue_on_teleport,"getgenv.queue_on_teleport" end
    if type(g.queueonteleport)=="function" then return g.queueonteleport,"getgenv.queueonteleport" end
    local synTbl=rawget(g,"syn")
    if type(synTbl)=="table" and type(synTbl.queue_on_teleport)=="function" then return synTbl.queue_on_teleport,"syn.queue_on_teleport" end
    return nil,"unsupported"
end
local queue,api=queueFunc()
local function armReturn(reason)
    if not SETTINGS.returnToOrigin then
        T.queueStatus="disabled";emit("RAID_RETURN_DISABLED");return false
    end
    if not queue then
        T.queueStatus="unavailable";emit("RAID_RETURN_UNAVAILABLE",{reason="QUEUE_MISSING"});return false
    end
    local ok,err=pcall(function() queue(RETURN_CODE) end)
    T.queueStatus=ok and "queued" or "error"
    if reason=="OUTCOME" and ok then T.returnRequeues=T.returnRequeues+1 end
    emit(ok and (reason=="OUTCOME" and "RAID_RETURN_REQUEUED" or "RAID_RETURN_QUEUED") or "RAID_RETURN_QUEUE_FAILED",
        {api=api,reason=reason,homeWorld=ORIGIN,error=not ok and tostring(err) or nil})
    return ok
end
armReturn("RAID_START")
local persisted,why=persistStage("RAID_ENTERED")
emit(persisted and "RESUME_RAID_PERSISTED" or "RESUME_RAID_NOT_PERSISTED",{reason=why})

local remotes=RS:WaitForChild("OmegaRaidRemotes",45)
local raid=workspace:WaitForChild("OmegaRaid",45)
if not remotes or not raid then stage("RAID_MISSING_OBJECTS");return end
T.raid=raid
local plan=remotes:FindFirstChild("Plan") or remotes:WaitForChild("Plan",10)
local outcome=remotes:FindFirstChild("Outcome") or remotes:WaitForChild("Outcome",10)
local focusRemote=remotes:FindFirstChild("Focus") or remotes:WaitForChild("Focus",10)
if not (plan and outcome and focusRemote) then stage("RAID_MISSING_REMOTES");return end
local zoneMap={}
local generation=tonumber(raid:GetAttribute("Generation") or workspace:GetAttribute("OmegaFightGeneration")) or -1
local function fightNow()
    local frozen=raid:GetAttribute("FrozenAt")
    local base=type(frozen)=="number" and frozen>0 and frozen or workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
    return base-(tonumber(raid:GetAttribute("ClockOffset")) or 0)
end
local function root()
    local c=P.Character
    local r=c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local h=c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not r or not h or h.Health<=0 then return nil end
    return c,r,h
end
local function blocked()
    return raid:GetAttribute("State")~="Active"
        or P:GetAttribute("OmegaEliminated")==true
        or P:GetAttribute("OmegaGrabbed")==true
        or P:GetAttribute("BossReviveDowned")~=nil
        or T.outcome~=nil
end
local function contains(z,pos,margin)
    if z.Shape=="All" then return true end
    if typeof(z.Pos)~="Vector3" then return false end
    if pos.Y-z.Pos.Y>40 or pos.Y<z.Pos.Y-30 then return false end
    local dx,dz=pos.X-z.Pos.X,pos.Z-z.Pos.Z
    local r=math.sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz)
    margin=margin or 0
    if z.Shape=="Disc" then return r<=(tonumber(z.Radius) or 0)+margin end
    if z.Shape=="Ring" then
        return r>=math.max(0,(tonumber(z.Inner) or 0)-margin) and r<=(tonumber(z.Outer) or 0)+margin
    end
    if z.Shape=="Rect" then
        local rad=math.rad(tonumber(z.Yaw) or 0)
        local fx,fz=-math.sin(rad),-math.cos(rad)
        local sx,sz=-fz,fx
        local along=math.abs(dx*fx+dz*fz)
        local across=math.abs(dx*sx+dz*sz)
        return along<=(tonumber(z.Length) or 0)/2+margin and across<=(tonumber(z.Width) or 0)/2+margin
    end
    if z.Shape=="Cone" then
        local radius=(tonumber(z.Radius) or 0)+margin
        if r>radius then return false end
        local inner=tonumber(z.Inner)
        if inner and r<math.max(0,inner-margin) then return false end
        if r<1 then return true end
        local rad=math.rad(tonumber(z.Yaw) or 0)
        local fx,fz=-math.sin(rad),-math.cos(rad)
        local dot=(dx*fx+dz*fz)/r
        local angle=math.acos(math.clamp(dot,-1,1))
        local expanded=math.rad(tonumber(z.Half) or 0)+math.atan2(margin,math.max(r,1))
        return angle<=expanded
    end
    return false
end
local function currentZones(now)
    local array={};local nextCount=0
    for id,z in pairs(zoneMap) do
        if type(z.Strike)~="number" or z.Strike<now-SETTINGS.postStrikeHold then
            zoneMap[id]=nil
        elseif z.Strike<=now+SETTINGS.dodgeHorizon then
            nextCount=nextCount+1
            table.insert(array,z)
        end
    end
    T.zoneCount=nextCount
    return array
end
-- Validate actual collidable floor geometry; do not use arena model pivot as deck center.
local function floors()
    local deck=workspace:FindFirstChild("OmegaArena")
    deck=deck and deck:FindFirstChild("Deck")
    local result={}
    if not deck then return result end
    for _,obj in ipairs(deck:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj.Name=="Floor" and obj.CanCollide then
            local sector=obj
            while sector and sector.Parent~=deck do sector=sector.Parent end
            local idx=sector and tonumber(sector.Name:match("^Sector(%d+)$"))
            if not idx or tonumber(workspace.OmegaArena:GetAttribute("Sector"..idx) or 0)==0 then
                table.insert(result,obj)
            end
        end
    end
    return result
end
local RP=RaycastParams.new()
RP.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
RP.IgnoreWater=true
local function onFloor(point,parts)
    if #parts==0 then return nil end
    RP.FilterDescendantsInstances=parts
    local hit=workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(point.X,24,point.Z),Vector3.new(0,-75,0),RP)
    if not hit or not hit.Instance or not hit.Instance.CanCollide then return nil end
    local y=hit.Position.Y+3.25
    if y<-8 or y>16 then return nil end
    return Vector3.new(point.X,y,point.Z)
end
local function insideOctagon(v)
    local apothem=680*math.cos(math.pi/8)-12
    for sector=0,7 do
        local angle=sector*math.pi/4
        local fx,fz=-math.sin(angle),-math.cos(angle)
        if v.X*fx+v.Z*fz>apothem then return false end
    end
    return true
end
local function nearbyObstacle(point,c)
    local arena=workspace:FindFirstChild("OmegaArena")
    if not arena then return false end
    local op=OverlapParams.new()
    op.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    op.FilterDescendantsInstances={c,workspace:FindFirstChild("OmegaTelegraphs") or c}
    op.MaxParts=15
    local near=workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(point),Vector3.new(4,5,4),op)
    for _,obj in ipairs(near) do
        if obj.CanCollide and obj.Name~="Floor" then
            -- Ignore trivial nearby visual props unless physically blocking the character.
            if obj:IsDescendantOf(arena) or obj:IsDescendantOf(workspace:FindFirstChild("SkyTitanSolid") or arena) then return true end
        end
    end
    return false
end
local function risk(point,zones,now,arrival)
    local penalty=0;local hard=false
    for _,z in ipairs(zones) do
        if z.Strike>=now-SETTINGS.postStrikeHold and z.Strike<=now+SETTINGS.dodgeHorizon then
            if contains(z,point,SETTINGS.dodgeMargin) then
                -- Strike may land as we arrive; all risks during the near horizon are forbidden.
                penalty=penalty+1
                if z.Shape=="All" or z.Strike<=now+arrival+SETTINGS.impactMargin then hard=true end
            end
        end
    end
    return penalty,hard
end
local lastNoSpot=0
local function dodgeTick()
    if not SETTINGS.autoDodge or blocked() then return end
    if os.clock()-T.lastDodge<SETTINGS.dodgeCooldown then return end
    local c,r,h=root()
    if not r then return end
    local now=fightNow()
    local zones=currentZones(now)
    if #zones==0 then return end
    local threatened=false;local all=false
    for _,z in ipairs(zones) do
        if z.Shape=="All" then all=true end
        if z.Strike<=now+SETTINGS.dodgeLead and contains(z,r.Position,SETTINGS.dodgeMargin) then threatened=true end
    end
    if not threatened then return end
    if all then
        if os.clock()-lastNoSpot>3 then emit("DODGE_ALL_NO_HORIZONTAL_SAFE_SPOT",{zones=#zones});lastNoSpot=os.clock() end
        return
    end
    local parts=floors()
    if #parts==0 then
        if os.clock()-lastNoSpot>3 then emit("DODGE_NO_FLOOR",{});lastNoSpot=os.clock() end
        return
    end
    local best=nil;local bestScore=math.huge;local bestPen=0
    local pos=r.Position
    for radius=20,SETTINGS.maxDodgeRange,20 do
        for a=0,23 do
            local rad=(a/24)*math.pi*2
            local raw=Vector3.new(pos.X+math.cos(rad)*radius,pos.Y,pos.Z+math.sin(rad)*radius)
            if insideOctagon(raw) then
                local cand=onFloor(raw,parts)
                if cand and not nearbyObstacle(cand,c) then
                    local penalty,hard=risk(cand,zones,now,0.28)
                    if not hard and penalty==0 then
                        local score=radius+math.sqrt(cand.X*cand.X+cand.Z*cand.Z)*0.06
                        if score<bestScore then best=cand;bestScore=score;bestPen=penalty end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        if best then break end
    end
    if not best then
        if os.clock()-lastNoSpot>2 then emit("DODGE_NO_SAFE_SPOT",{hazards=#zones,maxRange=SETTINGS.maxDodgeRange});lastNoSpot=os.clock() end
        return
    end
    T.lastDodge=os.clock()
    local before=r.Position
    local ok,err=pcall(function() c:PivotTo(CFrame.new(best,best+r.CFrame.LookVector)) end)
    if not ok then emit("DODGE_FAILED",{error=tostring(err)});return end
    task.delay(0.16,function()
        local _,rr=root()
        if not T.running or not rr then return end
        local moved=(rr.Position-best).Magnitude
        local valid=moved<10 and onFloor(rr.Position,floors())~=nil
        local label=valid and "DODGE_VERIFIED" or "DODGE_NOT_VERIFIED"
        if valid then T.dodges=T.dodges+1 end
        emit(label,{from=before,to=best,actual=rr.Position,offset=moved,hazards=#zones})
    end)
end
local function handlePlan(e)
    if not T.running or type(e)~="table" then return end
    local typ=tostring(e.Type or "")
    if typ=="Reset" then
        generation=tonumber(e.Generation) or generation
        table.clear(zoneMap)
        emit("PLAN_RESET",{generation=generation})
        return
    end
    if generation<0 and tonumber(e.Generation) then
        generation=tonumber(e.Generation)
        emit("GENERATION_LEARNED",{generation=generation})
    end
    if tonumber(e.Generation)~=generation then return end
    if typ=="Zones" then
        local n=0
        if type(e.Zones)=="table" then
            for _,z in ipairs(e.Zones) do
                if type(z)=="table" and type(z.Strike)=="number" then
                    local id=z.Id or tostring(z)
                    zoneMap[id]=z;n=n+1
                end
            end
        end
        T.foundZones=T.foundZones+n
        emit("PLAN_ZONES",{attack=e.Attack,count=n,total=T.foundZones,first=e.Zones and e.Zones[1] and {Shape=e.Zones[1].Shape,Warn=e.Zones[1].Warn,Strike=e.Zones[1].Strike}})
    elseif typ=="CancelZones" or typ=="Cut" then
        local at=tonumber(e.At)
        if at then for id,z in pairs(zoneMap) do if tonumber(z.Strike) and z.Strike>at then zoneMap[id]=nil end end end
        emit("PLAN_CANCEL",{type=typ,at=at})
    elseif typ=="End" or typ=="Death" or typ=="Phase" or typ=="SectorFall" or typ=="Grabbed" or typ=="GrabEnd" or typ=="Eliminated" then
        emit("PLAN_"..string.upper(typ),e)
    end
end
listen(plan.OnClientEvent,handlePlan)
if SETTINGS.syncSnapshot then
    task.spawn(function()
        local snapshotRemote=remotes:FindFirstChild("Snapshot")
        if snapshotRemote and snapshotRemote:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
            local ok,result=pcall(function() return snapshotRemote:InvokeServer() end)
            if ok and type(result)=="table" and T.running then
                local gen=tonumber(result.Generation)
                if gen and gen~=generation then
                    generation=gen
                    table.clear(zoneMap)
                end
                local count=0
                for _,event in ipairs(result.Log or {}) do
                    if type(event)=="table" and (event.Type=="Zones" or event.Type=="CancelZones" or event.Type=="Reset") then
                        handlePlan(event)
                        count=count+1
                    end
                end
                emit("SNAPSHOT_SYNC",{generation=generation,replayed=count})
            else
                emit("SNAPSHOT_UNAVAILABLE",{error=not ok and tostring(result) or "NO_RESULT"})
            end
        end
    end)
end
local function handleContinue()
    if not SETTINGS.autoContinueAfterOutcome then
        T.continueStatus="disabled";emit("CONTINUE_DISABLED");return
    end
    T.continueStatus="waiting_for_report"
    local modules=RS:FindFirstChild("ClientModules") or RS:WaitForChild("ClientModules",12)
    local mod=modules and (modules:FindFirstChild("BossResultsController") or modules:WaitForChild("BossResultsController",8))
    if not mod then T.continueStatus="controller_missing";emit("CONTINUE_CONTROLLER_MISSING");return end
    local ok,controller=pcall(require,mod)
    if not ok or type(controller)~="table" then
        T.continueStatus="controller_error";emit("CONTINUE_CONTROLLER_ERROR",{error=tostring(controller)});return
    end
    local deadline=os.clock()+SETTINGS.reportWaitSeconds
    local openedAt=nil
    while T.running and os.clock()<deadline and T.outcome do
        local open=P:GetAttribute("BossResultsOpen")==true
        if type(controller.IsOpen)=="function" then
            local okOpen,v=pcall(controller.IsOpen)
            if okOpen and v==true then open=true end
        end
        if open then
            if not openedAt then openedAt=os.clock();emit("REPORT_OPEN",{victory=T.outcome.victory}) end
            local debugStr=""
            if type(controller.Debug)=="function" then
                local okDebug,v=pcall(controller.Debug)
                if okDebug then debugStr=tostring(v) end
            end
            if debugStr:find("armed=true",1,true) and os.clock()-openedAt>=SETTINGS.reportHoldSeconds then
                local called,err=pcall(function() controller.Dismiss("continue") end)
                if not called then
                    T.continueStatus="failed";emit("CONTINUE_FAILED",{error=tostring(err)});return
                end
                emit("CONTINUE_REQUESTED",{controller="BossResultsController",armed=true})
                task.wait(.3)
                local stillOpen=P:GetAttribute("BossResultsOpen")==true
                if type(controller.IsOpen)=="function" then
                    local okOpen,v=pcall(controller.IsOpen)
                    if okOpen and v then stillOpen=true end
                end
                T.continueStatus=stillOpen and "unverified" or "verified"
                emit(stillOpen and "CONTINUE_UNVERIFIED" or "CONTINUE_VERIFIED",{nativeReturn="server_controlled"})
                return
            end
        end
        task.wait(.2)
    end
    T.continueStatus="timeout"
    emit("CONTINUE_TIMEOUT",{reportOpened=openedAt~=nil,reportOpen=P:GetAttribute("BossResultsOpen")})
end
listen(outcome.OnClientEvent,function(e)
    if not T.running or type(e)~="table" then return end
    if T.outcome then return end
    T.outcome={victory=e.Victory==true,reason=e.Reason,difficulty=e.Difficulty,phase=e.PhaseReached}
    table.clear(zoneMap)
    stage("OUTCOME_RECEIVED",T.outcome)
    local persisted,why=persistStage("OUTCOME")
    emit(persisted and "RESUME_OUTCOME_PERSISTED" or "RESUME_OUTCOME_NOT_PERSISTED",{reason=why})
    armReturn("OUTCOME") -- requeue shortly before native server return
    emit("NATIVE_RETURN_PENDING",{expectedPlace=MAIN_PLACE,homeWorld=ORIGIN,continueDoesNotTeleport=true})
    task.spawn(function()
        local ok,err=pcall(handleContinue)
        if not ok then T.continueStatus="error";emit("CONTINUE_ERROR",{error=tostring(err)}) end
    end)
end)
for _,name in ipairs({"State","Phase","HP","Difficulty","Result","Generation","DamageAccepted","DamageRefused","GrabUser","FrozenAt","ClockOffset"}) do
    local count=0
    listen(raid:GetAttributeChangedSignal(name),function()
        if not T.running then return end
        count=count+1
        if name~="HP" or count%15==0 then
            emit("RAID_ATTRIBUTE",{name=name,value=raid:GetAttribute(name)})
        end
        if name=="Phase" then T.phase=tonumber(raid:GetAttribute("Phase")) or T.phase end
        if name=="Generation" then
            local new=tonumber(raid:GetAttribute("Generation"))
            if new and new~=generation then generation=new;table.clear(zoneMap);emit("GENERATION_CHANGED",{generation=new}) end
        end
    end)
end
-- Native plane combat is active in PlaneOrbitClient. Change Focus only, do not fabricate damage requests.
local components={"B2","F22","F15R","A10","F14R","F14L","Su57","SR71","F15L"}
local function desiredFocus()
    if (tonumber(raid:GetAttribute("GrabUser")) or 0)~=0 then return "Grip" end
    local phase=tonumber(raid:GetAttribute("Phase")) or 1
    if phase>=6 then return "Reactor" end
    if phase>=5 and (tonumber(raid:GetAttribute("ReactorHP")) or 0)>0 then return "Reactor" end
    if not SETTINGS.autoFocus then return nil end
    for _,key in ipairs(components) do
        if (tonumber(raid:GetAttribute("Down_"..key)) or 0)==0 and phase<6 then return key end
    end
    return "Body"
end
local lastFocus=0
local function focusTick()
    if blocked() or not SETTINGS.autoFocus then return end
    local key=desiredFocus()
    if key and (key~=T.focus or os.clock()-lastFocus>20) then
        local ok,err=pcall(function() focusRemote:FireServer(key) end)
        lastFocus=os.clock()
        if ok then T.focus=key;emit("FOCUS_SENT",{target=key,nativeAttack="PlaneOrbitClient"})
        else emit("FOCUS_FAILED",{target=key,error=tostring(err)}) end
    end
end
stage("RAID_ENTERED",{originWorld=ORIGIN,placeId=game.PlaceId,generation=generation,difficulty=raid:GetAttribute("Difficulty"),state=raid:GetAttribute("State")})
T.phase=tonumber(raid:GetAttribute("Phase")) or 0
local lastSnapshot=0
local hb=game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat
listen(hb,function()
    if not T.running then return end
    -- Throttle raycast-heavy candidate search to 6 times/s.
    if os.clock()-lastSnapshot>0.16 then
        lastSnapshot=os.clock()
        if SETTINGS.autoDodge then
            local ok,err=pcall(dodgeTick)
            if not ok and os.clock()- (T.lastError or 0)>5 then T.lastError=os.clock();emit("DODGE_ERROR",{reason=tostring(err)}) end
        end
        focusTick()
    end
end)
print("[OMEGA V2 RAID] getgenv().PlaneRNGOmegaTestV2:status() | :dump(160)")
]==========]
end
-- END MODULE boss.OmegaSkyTitan.RaidRunnerSource

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.OmegaSkyTitan.ReturnRunnerSource
__factories["boss.OmegaSkyTitan.ReturnRunnerSource"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Exact V2 return code: world restoration, HOME_VERIFIED and PERSIST_DONE.
return [==========[--!nocheck
-- Omega V2 self-contained return script, queued at raid and requeued after Outcome.
-- Backstop: local autoexec rescue file can launch this code if queue is lost.
local MAIN_PLACE=133112767606395
local ORIGIN=__ORIGIN_WORLD__
local Http=game:GetService("HttpService")
local RS=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local STATE_PATH="PlaneRNG_OmegaV2_State.json"
if not game:IsLoaded() then game.Loaded:Wait() end
if game.PlaceId~=MAIN_PLACE then
    warn("[OMEGA V2 RETURN] WRONG_PLACE",game.PlaceId,"expected",MAIN_PLACE)
    return
end
local P=Players.LocalPlayer or Players.PlayerAdded:Wait()
local G=(type(getgenv)=="function" and getgenv()) or _G
local old=G.PlaneRNGOmegaReturnV2
if old and old.running then print("[OMEGA V2 RETURN] ALREADY_RUNNING");return end
local T={running=true,stage="RETURN_BOOT",records={},originWorld=ORIGIN,placeId=game.PlaceId,completed=false}
G.PlaneRNGOmegaReturnV2=T
G.PlaneRNGOmegaTestV2=T -- common status handle after cross-place return
local function emit(event,detail)
    T.stage=event
    local row={event=event,detail=detail or {},time=os.time(),world=P:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"),origin=ORIGIN}
    table.insert(T.records,row)
    if #T.records>320 then table.remove(T.records,1) end
    local ok,txt=pcall(function()return Http:JSONEncode(row)end)
    print("[OMEGA V2 RETURN] "..(ok and txt or event))
end
function T:status()return {running=self.running,stage=self.stage,completed=self.completed,originWorld=ORIGIN,currentWorld=P:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"),inFight=P:GetAttribute("InBossFight"),reportOpen=P:GetAttribute("BossResultsOpen")}
end
function T:dump(n)
    n=math.clamp(tonumber(n) or 90,1,320)
    for i=math.max(1,#self.records-n+1),#self.records do print("[OMEGA V2 RETURN LOG] "..Http:JSONEncode(self.records[i])) end
end
function T:stop()self.running=false;emit("STOPPED")end
local function markDone()
    if type(writefile)~="function" or type(readfile)~="function" then
        emit("PERSIST_DONE_FAILED",{reason="FILESYSTEM_UNAVAILABLE"});return false
    end
    local ok,reason=pcall(function()
        local obj=Http:JSONDecode(readfile(STATE_PATH))
        assert(type(obj)=="table" and obj.kind=="OMEGA_V2"
            and tonumber(obj.originWorld)==ORIGIN, "STORED_ORIGIN_MISMATCH")
        local priorCreatedAt=obj.createdAt
        obj.stage="DONE";obj.doneAt=os.time()
        writefile(STATE_PATH,Http:JSONEncode(obj))
        local verified=Http:JSONDecode(readfile(STATE_PATH))
        assert(type(verified)=="table" and verified.stage=="DONE"
            and tonumber(verified.originWorld)==ORIGIN
            and verified.createdAt==priorCreatedAt, "PERSIST_READBACK_MISMATCH")
    end)
    emit(ok and "PERSIST_DONE" or "PERSIST_DONE_FAILED",not ok and {reason=tostring(reason)} or {})
    return ok
end
local function root()
    local ch=P.Character
    return ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end
local function unlocked()
    return P:GetAttribute("InBossFight")~=true and P:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout")~=true
        and P:GetAttribute("BossResultsOpen")~=true and root()~=nil
end
local function run()
    emit("RETURN_SCRIPT_STARTED",{originWorld=ORIGIN,placeId=game.PlaceId})
    if type(ORIGIN)~="number" or ORIGIN<1 or ORIGIN%1~=0 then
        emit("RETURN_INVALID_ORIGIN");T.running=false;return
    end
    emit("WAIT_MAIN_UNLOCK")
    local deadline=os.clock()+150
    while T.running and os.clock()<deadline do
        if unlocked() and tonumber(P:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")) then break end
        task.wait(.4)
    end
    if not T.running then return end
    if not unlocked() then
        emit("RETURN_LOCK_PENDING",{report=P:GetAttribute("BossResultsOpen"),fight=P:GetAttribute("InBossFight"),hideout=P:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout")})
        T.running=false;return
    end
    local current=tonumber(P:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"))
    if current==ORIGIN then
        T.completed=true;emit("HOME_VERIFIED",{alreadyThere=true,world=ORIGIN});markDone();T.running=false;return
    end
    local remotes=RS:FindFirstChild("Remotes") or RS:WaitForChild("Remotes",25)
    local prep=remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("NavPrepareWorlds")
    local req=remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("RequestWorldTravel")
    local result=remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("WorldTravelResult")
    if not (prep and req and result) then emit("RETURN_REMOTE_MISSING");T.running=false;return end
    local reply=nil
    local conn=result.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
        if type(e)=="table" and e.Kind=="Result" and tonumber(e.WorldId)==ORIGIN then reply=e end
    end)
    for attempt=1,2 do
        if not T.running then break end
        reply=nil
        local r0=root()
        if not r0 then emit("RETURN_ROOT_MISSING");break end
        local before=r0.Position
        emit("HOME_REQUEST",{from=P:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"),to=ORIGIN,attempt=attempt})
        local ok,err=pcall(function()
            prep:FireServer("stream",ORIGIN)
            task.wait(.20)
            req:FireServer(ORIGIN)
        end)
        if not ok then emit("RETURN_SEND_FAILED",{error=tostring(err)});break end
        local untilTime=os.clock()+28
        while T.running and os.clock()<untilTime do
            if reply and reply.Ok==false then
                conn:Disconnect();emit("RETURN_REJECTED",{reason=reply.Reason,attempt=attempt});T.running=false;return
            end
            local r=root()
            local moved=r and (r.Position-before).Magnitude>35
            if unlocked() and tonumber(P:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"))==ORIGIN and r then
                -- World attribute is authoritative; server reply or verified move strengthen confirmation.
                if (reply and reply.Ok==true) or moved then
                    conn:Disconnect();T.completed=true
                    emit("HOME_VERIFIED",{world=ORIGIN,moved=moved,reply=reply and reply.Ok,attempt=attempt})
                    markDone();T.running=false;return
                end
            end
            task.wait(.25)
        end
        emit("RETURN_ATTEMPT_UNVERIFIED",{attempt=attempt,world=P:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"),reply=reply and reply.Ok})
        if attempt<2 then task.wait(2) end
    end
    conn:Disconnect()
    emit("RETURN_UNVERIFIED",{world=P:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")})
    T.running=false
end
task.spawn(function()
    local ok,err=pcall(run)
    if not ok then emit("RETURN_ERROR",{error=tostring(err)});T.running=false end
end)
print("[OMEGA V2 RETURN] Status: getgenv().PlaneRNGOmegaReturnV2:status()")
]==========]
end
-- END MODULE boss.OmegaSkyTitan.ReturnRunnerSource

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.RQ170.ArenaObserver
__factories["boss.RQ170.ArenaObserver"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local ArenaObserver={}
function ArenaObserver.new(env,config)
    local platform=env.services.roblox
    local player=platform:player()
    local observer={}
    function observer:participating()
        return player:GetAttribute("RQ170Participant")==true
    end
    function observer:inArenaPosition(pos)
        pos=pos or platform:position()
        if typeof(pos)~="Vector3" then return false end
        local c=config.arenaFallbackCenter
        local d=Vector3.new(pos.X-c.x,0,pos.Z-c.z)
        return d.Magnitude<config.arenaRadius and pos.Y>config.arenaMinY and pos.Y<config.arenaMaxY
    end
    function observer:inArena()
        return self:participating() or
            (player:GetAttribute("InBossFight")==true and self:inArenaPosition())
    end
    function observer:state()
        local W=platform:workspace()
        return {phase=player:GetAttribute("RQ170Phase") or W:GetAttribute("RQ170Phase"),
            fightState=player:GetAttribute("RQ170FightState") or W:GetAttribute("RQ170FightState"),
            active=player:GetAttribute("InBossFight"),participant=player:GetAttribute("RQ170Participant")}
    end
    return observer
end
return ArenaObserver
end
-- END MODULE boss.RQ170.ArenaObserver

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.RQ170.CombatController
__factories["boss.RQ170.CombatController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local CombatController={}
function CombatController.new(env,config,observer,report,flight)
    local runtime,telemetry=env.runtime,env.services.telemetry
    local combat={}
    local function emit(name,data) if telemetry then telemetry:emit("RQ170_"..name,data or {}) end end
    function combat:run(ctx,encounter)
        local ok,why=report:watch(ctx)
        if not ok then return {code=why or "RQ170_REPORT_WATCH_FAILED"} end
        ok,why=flight:start(ctx)
        if not ok then return {code=why or "RQ170_FLIGHT_INIT_FAILED"} end
        local deadline=runtime:now()+config.maxFightSeconds
        local nextLog=0
        local result="OUTCOME_NOT_OBSERVED_TIMEOUT"
        while not ctx:isCancelled() and runtime:now()<deadline do
            local evidence=report:inspect()
            if evidence.outcome then result="OUTCOME_OBSERVED";break end
            flight:step()
            if flight:exhausted() then result="RQ170_NATIVE_FLIGHT_NOT_ACTIVE";break end
            if runtime:now()>=nextLog then
                emit("FLIGHT_STATUS",flight:status())
                nextLog=runtime:now()+9
            end
            if not ctx:wait(.35) then break end
        end
        emit("FLIGHT_SUMMARY",flight:status())
        -- Release autopilot before any report or return. Never affect another boss.
        flight:stop()
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return {code="CANCELLED"} end
        return {code=result}
    end
    return combat
end
return CombatController
end
-- END MODULE boss.RQ170.CombatController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.RQ170.CommandController
__factories["boss.RQ170.CommandController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- RQ170 standalone V1 flow: Hideout -> Boss Command pass -> ONE Solo -> combat.
-- Adaptive report may open in arena OR after exit; never request return before Continue.
local DirectBossTravel = require("main.navigation.DirectBossTravel")
local CommandController = {}

function CommandController.new(env, config, observer, report)
    local platform, runtime = env.services.roblox, env.runtime
    local player, workspace = platform:player(), platform:workspace()
    local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
    local travel = DirectBossTravel.new(env)
    local command = {}
    local function emit(name, data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit(name, data or {}) end
    end
    local function remote(name)
        local storage = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage")
        local folder = storage:FindFirstChild("Remotes") or storage:WaitForChild("Remotes", 10)
        local item = folder and (folder:FindFirstChild(name) or folder:WaitForChild(name, 7))
        return item and item:IsA("RemoteEvent") and item or nil
    end
    local function active(ctx) return runtime:isActive(ctx) and not ctx:isCancelled() end
    local function cooldownLeft()
        local raw = player:GetAttribute("BossStartCooldowns")
        if type(raw) ~= "string" or raw == "" then return 0 end
        local ok, data = pcall(function() return platform:service("HttpService"):JSONDecode(raw) end)
        if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then return 0 end
        return math.max(0, (tonumber(data[config.gameBossKey]) or 0) - workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
    end

    function command:prepare(ctx)
        local watching, why = report:watch(ctx) -- watch BEFORE sending any boss request
        if not watching then return false, why end
        if observer:inArena() then return true, "RQ170_ALREADY_IN_ARENA" end
        if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true then return false, "OTHER_BOSS_ACTIVE" end
        if not active(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        -- V3: wait for RQ170 cooldown BEFORE issuing Boss Command requests.
        local left = cooldownLeft()
        if left > 0 and config.waitForCooldown then
            if left > config.maxCooldownWaitSeconds then
                emit("RQ170_COOLDOWN_GATE", {remaining = math.ceil(left), code = "WAIT_LIMIT"})
                return false, "RQ170_COOLDOWN_ABOVE_WAIT_LIMIT"
            end
            emit("RQ170_COOLDOWN_WAIT", {remaining = math.ceil(left)})
            local untilTime = runtime:now() + config.maxCooldownWaitSeconds
            local lastTick = runtime:now()
            while active(ctx) and cooldownLeft() > 0 and runtime:now() < untilTime do
                if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true then
                    return false, "OTHER_ENCOUNTER_BECAME_ACTIVE"
                end
                if runtime:now() - lastTick >= 25 then
                    lastTick = runtime:now()
                    emit("RQ170_COOLDOWN_WAITING", {remaining = math.ceil(cooldownLeft())})
                end
                if not ctx:wait(math.min(3, math.max(0.5, cooldownLeft()))) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
            end
            if not active(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
            if cooldownLeft() > 0 then return false, "RQ170_COOLDOWN_WAIT_LIMIT_REACHED" end
            emit("RQ170_COOLDOWN_READY", {remaining = 0})
        end
        local entered = travel:enterHideout(ctx)
        emit("RQ170_DIRECT_HIDEOUT", {ok = entered.ok, code = entered.code, reason = entered.reason})
        if not entered.ok then return false, entered.code end
        local positioned = travel:moveToKnownPoint(ctx, config.commandSafePosition, {
            requireHideout = true, radius = 6, settle = 0.85,
        })
        emit("RQ170_COMMAND_POSITION", {ok = positioned.ok, code = positioned.code})
        if not positioned.ok then return false, positioned.code end
        return true, "RQ170_COMMAND_READY"
    end

    function command:readiness()
        if observer:inArena() then return "READY" end
        if not travel:inHideout() then return "UNKNOWN" end
        local secs = cooldownLeft()
        if secs > 0 then
            secs = math.ceil(secs)
            return string.format("%d:%02d", math.floor(secs / 60), secs % 60)
        end
        -- The server pass remains authoritative for unlock/eligibility.
        return "READY"
    end

    function command:startSolo(ctx, markAttempt)
        if not active(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        if observer:participating() then return true, "RQ170_ALREADY_FIGHTING" end
        if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true then return false, "OTHER_BOSS_ACTIVE" end
        if not travel:inHideout() then return false, "NOT_IN_HIDEOUT" end
        if self:readiness() ~= "READY" then return false, "RQ170_NOT_READY" end
        local watching, why = report:watch(ctx)
        if not watching then return false, why end
        local hideout, accept = remote("PersonalHideoutRemote"), remote("RQ170CommanderAccept")
        if not hideout or not accept then return false, "RQ170_COMMAND_REMOTES_MISSING" end
        local passReply, acceptReply
        local passConnection = hideout.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
            if type(e) == "table" and e.Kind == "BossCommand" and e.Op == "Start"
                and e.BossKey == config.gameBossKey then passReply = e end
        end)
        local acceptConnection = accept.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
            if type(e) == "table" and e.Accepted ~= nil then acceptReply = e end
        end)
        local function finish(ok, code)
            passConnection:Disconnect()
            acceptConnection:Disconnect()
            return ok, code
        end
        local sent, err = pcall(function()
            hideout:FireServer({Action = "StartBoss", BossKey = config.gameBossKey, Solo = true})
        end)
        if not sent then return finish(false, "RQ170_PASS_SEND_FAILED: " .. tostring(err)) end
        local gotPass = ctx:await(function() return passReply end, 10)
        if not active(ctx) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
        if not gotPass then return finish(false, "RQ170_PASS_TIMEOUT_NO_RETRY") end
        emit("RQ170_PASS_RESULT", {ok = gotPass.Ok == true, reason = gotPass.Reason})
        if gotPass.Ok ~= true then return finish(false, "RQ170_PASS_REJECTED: " .. tostring(gotPass.Reason)) end
        -- Mark before firing the irreversible Solo request; never blind retry.
        if not markAttempt() then return finish(false, "RQ170_SOLO_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED") end
        sent, err = pcall(function() accept:FireServer({Solo = true}) end)
        if not sent then return finish(false, "RQ170_SOLO_SEND_FAILED: " .. tostring(err)) end
        local observed = ctx:await(function()
            if acceptReply and acceptReply.Accepted == false then return "REJECTED" end
            if observer:participating() then return "ENTERED" end
        end, config.arenaTimeout)
        if not active(ctx) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
        emit("RQ170_SOLO_RESULT", {code = observed or "AMBIGUOUS", accepted = acceptReply and acceptReply.Accepted})
        if observed == "ENTERED" then return finish(true, "RQ170_FIGHT_VERIFIED") end
        if observed == "REJECTED" then
            return finish(false, "RQ170_SOLO_REJECTED: " .. tostring(acceptReply.Reason))
        end
        return finish(false, "RQ170_SOLO_AMBIGUOUS_NO_RETRY")
    end

    function command:close(_) return true end -- No command GUI was opened.

    function command:returnHome(ctx, home)
        if not active(ctx) then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        if type(home) ~= "number" or home < 1 or home % 1 ~= 0 then
            return {ok = false, code = "INVALID_HOME_WORLD"}
        end
        if report:inspect().active then return {ok = false, code = "RQ170_REPORT_STILL_OPEN"} end
        -- Preserve standalone V1 lock checks before return, regardless of report location.
        local released = ctx:await(function()
            if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true
                and player:GetAttribute("RQ170Participant") ~= true then return true end
        end, config.returnLockTimeoutSeconds)
        if not released then
            emit("RQ170_RETURN_LOCK_PENDING", {world = home})
            return {ok = false, code = "RQ170_RETURN_LOCK_PENDING", reason = "BossFight"}
        end
        local exit = ctx:await(function()
            if player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") == true then return "BOSS_COMMAND_HIDEOUT" end
            if not observer:inArenaPosition() then return "OUTSIDE_ARENA" end
        end, config.exitTimeoutSeconds)
        emit("RQ170_ARENA_EXIT", {code = exit or "LOCK_RELEASED_STILL_IN_ARENA"})
        -- As in tested standalone V1, a released lock permits a direct verified travel even
        -- if the game has not repositioned the player outside the arena yet.
        if not ctx:wait(1.5) then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        local request, prepare, result = remote("RequestWorldTravel"), remote("NavPrepareWorlds"), remote("WorldTravelResult")
        if not request or not prepare then return {ok = false, code = "RQ170_WORLD_TRAVEL_REMOTES_MISSING"} end
        local position = platform:position()
        if not position then return {ok = false, code = "CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE"} end
        if tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")) == home
            and player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") ~= true
            and not observer:inArenaPosition() then
            return {ok = true, code = "ALREADY_IN_HOME", world = home}
        end
        local reply
        local connection = result and result.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
            if type(e) == "table" and e.Kind == "Result" and tonumber(e.WorldId) == home then reply = e end
        end) or nil
        local function finish(ok, code, reason)
            if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
            emit("RQ170_DIRECT_RETURN", {ok = ok, code = code, reason = reason, world = home})
            return {ok = ok, code = code, reason = reason, world = home}
        end
        for attempt = 1, config.returnRetries do
            if not active(ctx) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            reply = nil
            local prior = platform:position()
            if not prior then return finish(false, "CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE") end
            local sent, err = pcall(function() prepare:FireServer("stream", home) end)
            if not sent then return finish(false, "WORLD_PREPARE_SEND_FAILED", tostring(err)) end
            if not ctx:wait(0.12) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            sent, err = pcall(function() request:FireServer(home) end)
            if not sent then return finish(false, "WORLD_REQUEST_SEND_FAILED", tostring(err)) end
            local observed = ctx:await(function()
                if reply and reply.Ok == false then return "REJECTED" end
                local current = platform:position()
                if current and platform:distance(current, prior) > 50
                    and tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")) == home
                    and player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") ~= true
                    and player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true
                    and not observer:inArenaPosition() then return "VERIFIED" end
            end, 17)
            emit("RQ170_RETURN_ATTEMPT", {attempt = attempt, code = observed or "AMBIGUOUS",
                reason = reply and reply.Reason})
            if observed == "VERIFIED" then return finish(true, "RQ170_HOME_VERIFIED") end
            if observed ~= "REJECTED" then return finish(false, "RQ170_RETURN_AMBIGUOUS_NO_RETRY") end
            local why = tostring(reply.Reason or "UNKNOWN")
            if why ~= "BossFight" or attempt == config.returnRetries then
                return finish(false, "RQ170_WORLD_RETURN_REJECTED", why)
            end
            if not ctx:wait(12) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            local settled = ctx:await(function()
                if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true then return true end
            end, 40)
            if not settled then return finish(false, "RQ170_LOCK_STILL_ACTIVE", "BossFight") end
        end
        return finish(false, "RQ170_WORLD_RETURN_EXHAUSTED")
    end
    return command
end
return CommandController
end
-- END MODULE boss.RQ170.CommandController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.RQ170.Config

    world=86,
    commandSafePosition={x=-31962.1074,y=344.357483,z=32887.3203},

    waitForCooldown=true,maxCooldownWaitSeconds=720,
