-- BEGIN MODULE boss.RQ170.FlightController
__factories["boss.RQ170.FlightController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Port of the live-tested RQ170 standalone V1 flight logic.
-- Keep native flight: RQ170 game client activates ManualFlightController after cinematic.
-- Target Sentinel model (not decoys); relay as fallback during blackout when signal weak.
local PilotControl=require("boss.shared.PilotControl")
local FlightController={}
function FlightController.new(env,settings,observer)
    local platform=env.services.roblox
    local RS=platform:service("ReplicatedStorage")
    local W=platform:workspace()
    local telemetry=env.services.telemetry
    local T={running=false,phase=0,flightActive=false,autoPilotInstalled=false,
        targetKind=nil,targetDistance=nil,shots=0,signal=nil,signalTier=nil,
        stealth=nil,pilotHP=nil,intel=nil,relaysDown=0,activeScan=nil,escape=nil,
        decoys=nil,bossHP=nil,maxHP=nil,sessionGeneration=nil}
    local flight={}
    local completed=false
    local flightRuntime,flightController,nativeController=nil,nil,nil
    local activeSince,flightWaitUntil,lastFlightLog=nil,0,0
    local lastTargetLog=0
    local lastSignalLog,lastTier=0,nil
    local relayDestroyed={}
    local activeScan=nil
    local pilotState={turn=1,breakUntil=0,lastGoal=nil,lastAt=nil}
    local lastNoTargetLog=0
    local ARENA_CENTER=Vector3.new(-49152,2600,0)
    local loaded=false
    local function log(name,data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit("RQ170_"..name,data or {}) end
    end
    local function phaseUpdate(value,source)
        local n=tonumber(value)
        if n and n>=1 and n<=3 and n~=T.phase then
            T.phase=n
            local names={"RECONNAISSANCE","SYSTEM BLACKOUT","EMERGENCY EXTRACTION"}
            log("PHASE",{phase=n,name=names[n],source=source})
        end
    end
    local function loadMod(mod)
        if not mod or not mod:IsA("ModuleScript") then return nil,"MODULE_MISSING" end
        -- Runtime Roblox ModuleScript require, not a project bundle require.
        local nativeRequire=getfenv(0)["require"]
        local ok,value=pcall(nativeRequire,mod)
        if not ok or type(value)~="table" then return nil,tostring(value) end
        return value
    end
    local pilot=PilotControl.new(platform,log)
    local jobContext
    local player=platform:player()
    local function flightBinding()
        if not jobContext or jobContext:isCancelled() or not T.running or completed
            or not observer:participating() or player:GetAttribute("BossReviveDowned")==true or player:GetAttribute("BossResultsOpen")==true
            or not nativeController or type(nativeController.Active)~="function" or not nativeController.Active() then
            return nil
        end
        local scene=W:FindFirstChild("RQ170Sentinel")
        return PilotControl.bound(flightRuntime,flightController,function(plane)
            local hp=plane:GetAttribute("CurrentHP")
            return scene and plane.Name=="RQ170PilotAircraft" and plane:IsDescendantOf(scene)
                and (type(hp)~="number" or hp>0)
        end)
    end
    local function flightSim()
        if not flightRuntime or type(flightRuntime.Sim)~="function" then return nil end
        local ok,sim=pcall(flightRuntime.Sim)
        if not ok or not sim then return nil end
        local valid=pcall(function()
            assert(typeof(sim.Position)=="Vector3" and typeof(sim.Rotation)=="CFrame")
        end)
        return valid and sim or nil
    end
    local function sentinelPosition()
        local scene=W:FindFirstChild("RQ170Sentinel")
        if not scene then return nil,"SCENE_MISSING" end
        local model=scene:FindFirstChild("RQ170Sentinel")
        if model and model:IsA("Model") then
            local ok,pivot=pcall(function() return model:GetPivot() end)
            if ok and typeof(pivot)=="CFrame" then return pivot.Position,"NATIVE_MODEL",model end
        end
        return nil,"SENTINEL_MODEL_MISSING"
    end
    local function relayPosition()
        if T.phase~=2 or not settings.prioritizeRelays or T.relaysDown>=settings.relayUntilDown then
            return nil,"RELAY_NOT_NEEDED"
        end
        local scene=W:FindFirstChild("RQ170Sentinel")
        local folder=scene and scene:FindFirstChild("RQ170Relays")
        if not folder then return nil,"RELAY_SCENE_MISSING" end
        local best,bestId,bestDistance,bestModel
        local sim=flightSim()
        local pos=sim and sim.Position
        for _,model in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
            local id=model.Name:match("^Relay_(R%d+)$")
            if id and not relayDestroyed[id] and model:IsA("Model") then
                local ok,pivot=pcall(function() return model:GetPivot() end)
                if ok and typeof(pivot)=="CFrame" then
                    local point=pivot.Position
                    local distance=pos and (point-pos).Magnitude or math.huge
                    if not best or distance<bestDistance then
                        best,bestId,bestDistance,bestModel=point,id,distance,model
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return best,bestId or "RELAY_NOT_FOUND",bestModel
    end
    local function debugStatus()
        if nativeController and type(nativeController.Debug)=="function" then
            local ok,value=pcall(nativeController.Debug)
            if ok and type(value)=="table" then
                T.signal=tonumber(value.Signal) or T.signal
                T.signalTier=type(value.Tier)=="string" and value.Tier or T.signalTier
                T.stealth=tonumber(value.Stealth) or T.stealth
                T.pilotHP=tonumber(value.PilotHP) or T.pilotHP
                T.intel=tonumber(value.Intel) or T.intel
                T.relaysDown=math.max(T.relaysDown,tonumber(value.Relays) or 0)
                T.escape=value.Escape or T.escape
                T.decoys=value.Decoys
                T.activeScan=value.Scan or activeScan
                phaseUpdate(value.ServerPhase,"NATIVE_DEBUG")
                local now=os.clock()
                if value.Tier~=lastTier or now-lastSignalLog>6 then
                    lastSignalLog=now;lastTier=value.Tier
                    log("SIGNAL_STATUS",{signal=T.signal,tier=T.signalTier,
                        stealth=T.stealth,relays=T.relaysDown,intel=T.intel,
                        scan=value.Scan,escape=value.Escape,decoys=T.decoys})
                end
                return value
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local riftHazards=env.services.riftHazards
    local function applyHazardFrame(sim,plan)
        if not riftHazards or type(riftHazards.flightPlan)~="function" then return plan end
        local ok,adjusted=pcall(riftHazards.flightPlan,riftHazards,sim,plan)
        return ok and type(adjusted)=="table" and adjusted or plan
    end
    local function pilotFrame(dt)
        if not T.running or completed or not observer:participating() then return nil end
        local sim=flightSim()
        if not sim then return nil end
        local pos=sim.Position
        local forward=sim.Rotation.LookVector
        local native=debugStatus()
        local now=os.clock()
        local goal,source,targetModel=sentinelPosition()
        local nativePosition=native and PilotControl.position(native.BossAt)
        if nativePosition then goal,source=nativePosition,"NATIVE_BOSS_FRAME" end
        local targetKind="SENTINEL"
        local relayGoal,relayId,relayModel=relayPosition()
        local tier=T.signalTier
        local signal=tonumber(T.signal)
        local marked=signal and signal>=25
        local closeToSentinel=goal and (goal-pos).Magnitude<=370
        if relayGoal and not (marked or closeToSentinel) then
            goal,source,targetKind,targetModel=relayGoal,relayId,"RELAY",relayModel
        end
        if not goal then
            if now-lastNoTargetLog>5 then
                lastNoTargetLog=now
                log("FLIGHT_GATE",{reason=source,phase=T.phase,signal=signal,tier=tier,relays=T.relaysDown})
            end
            return applyHazardFrame(sim,{Aim=forward*260+Vector3.new(0,pos.Y<2900 and 120 or 0,0),
                Throttle=.76,Fire=false,Missile=false})
        end
        if pilotState.lastModel~=targetModel or pilotState.lastSource~=source then
            pilotState.lastAt,pilotState.velocity=nil,nil
        end
        if not pilotState.lastAt or now-pilotState.lastAt>=0.075 then
            pilotState.velocity=pilotState.lastAt and (goal-pilotState.lastGoal)/(now-pilotState.lastAt) or Vector3.zero
            pilotState.lastGoal,pilotState.lastAt,pilotState.lastModel,pilotState.lastSource=goal,now,targetModel,source
        end
        local velocity=pilotState.velocity
        if velocity.Magnitude>900 then velocity=velocity.Unit*900 end
        local gap=goal-pos
        local distance=gap.Magnitude
        local direct=distance>1 and gap.Unit or forward
        local lead=math.clamp(distance/570,.12,1.15)
        local aim=goal+velocity*lead-pos
        if aim.Magnitude<.1 then aim=direct end
        local angle=math.deg(math.acos(math.clamp(forward:Dot(direct),-1,1)))
        local bossCanTrack=targetKind=="SENTINEL" and (marked or closeToSentinel)
        local gunReady=targetKind=="RELAY" or (bossCanTrack and signal~=nil and signal>=settings.minGunSignal)
        local missileReady=targetKind=="RELAY" or (bossCanTrack
            and signal~=nil and signal>=settings.minMissileSignal and tier=="STRONG")
        local fire=settings.autoFire and gunReady and targetModel~=nil and distance<=305 and angle<=7
        local missile=settings.autoFire and targetModel~=nil and missileReady and distance<=850
            and angle<=22

        local near=distance<125
        if near and not pilotState.near then
            pilotState.breakUntil=now+1.45
            pilotState.turn=-pilotState.turn
        end
        pilotState.near=near
        if now<pilotState.breakUntil then
            aim=forward*180+sim.Rotation.RightVector*pilotState.turn*140+Vector3.new(0,110,0)
            fire=false;missile=false
        end
        if pos.Y<2980 then aim=aim+Vector3.new(0,460,0)
        elseif pos.Y>3950 then aim=aim+Vector3.new(0,-440,0) end
        local radial=Vector3.new(pos.X-ARENA_CENTER.X,0,pos.Z-ARENA_CENTER.Z)
        if radial.Magnitude>3200 then
            aim=ARENA_CENTER+Vector3.new(0,600,0)-pos
            fire=false;missile=false
        end
        T.targetKind=targetKind;T.targetDistance=math.floor(distance)
        if now-lastTargetLog>=4 then
            lastTargetLog=now
            log("FLIGHT_TARGET",{target=targetKind,id=source,distance=math.floor(distance),
                angle=math.floor(angle),signal=signal,tier=tier,phase=T.phase,
                relayDown=T.relaysDown,fire=fire,missile=missile})
        end
        return applyHazardFrame(sim,{Aim=aim,Throttle=distance>700 and 1 or .85,Fire=fire,Missile=missile,
            Target=targetKind=="RELAY" and source or targetKind,TargetModel=targetModel,Maneuver=now<pilotState.breakUntil or radial.Magnitude>3200})
    end
    function flight:reset()
        self:stop()
        completed=false
        T.phase=0;T.signal=nil;T.signalTier=nil;T.stealth=nil
        T.pilotHP=nil;T.intel=nil;T.relaysDown=0;T.activeScan=nil;T.escape=nil;T.decoys=nil
        T.bossHP=nil;T.maxHP=nil;T.sessionGeneration=nil
        T.targetKind=nil;T.targetDistance=nil;T.shots=0
        T.flightActive=false;T.autoPilotInstalled=false
        table.clear(relayDestroyed)
        activeScan=nil;activeSince=nil;flightWaitUntil=0;lastFlightLog=0
        lastTargetLog=0;lastSignalLog=0;lastTier=nil
        lastNoTargetLog=0
        pilotState.turn=1;pilotState.breakUntil=0;pilotState.near=false;pilotState.lastGoal=nil;pilotState.lastAt=nil
        T.running=true
    end
    function flight:observe(e)
        if not T.running or type(e)~="table" then return end
        if e.K=="Session" then
            T.sessionGeneration=e.Generation or T.sessionGeneration
            if type(e.State)=="table" then
                phaseUpdate(e.State.Phase,"SESSION")
                T.bossHP=tonumber(e.State.HP) or T.bossHP
                T.maxHP=tonumber(e.State.MaxHP) or T.maxHP
                T.intel=tonumber(e.State.Intel) or T.intel
            end
        elseif e.K=="State" then
            phaseUpdate(e.Phase,"STATE")
            T.bossHP=tonumber(e.HP) or T.bossHP
            T.maxHP=tonumber(e.MaxHP) or T.maxHP
            T.intel=tonumber(e.Intel) or T.intel
        elseif e.K=="Phase" then
            phaseUpdate(e.Phase,"EVENT")
            log("PHASE_EVENT",{phase=e.Phase,name=e.Name})
        elseif e.K=="Scan" then
            if e.State=="Start" then
                activeScan={kind=e.Kind,mark=e.Mark,at=e.At,endsAt=e.EndsAt}
            else activeScan=nil end
            T.activeScan=activeScan
            log("SCAN_EVENT",{kind=e.Kind,mark=e.Mark,state=e.State,by=e.By})
        elseif e.K=="Relay" then
            if type(e.Id)=="string" then relayDestroyed[e.Id]=true end
            T.relaysDown=math.max(T.relaysDown,tonumber(e.Down) or 0)
            log("RELAY_EVENT",{id=e.Id,down=e.Down})
        elseif e.K=="Escape" then
            T.escape=e.Until or e.EndsAt or e.At
            log("ESCAPE_EVENT",{state=e.State,at=e.At,untilAt=e.Until,seconds=e.Seconds})
        elseif e.K=="Zone" then
            log("ZONE_EVENT",{lock=e.Lock,kind=e.Kind})
        elseif e.K=="Hit" then
            log("HIT",{target=e.T,kind=e.Kind,hp=e.HP,killed=e.Killed})
        elseif e.K=="Outcome" then
            completed=true
            pilot:stop()
            log("FLIGHT_OUTCOME",{victory=e.Victory,reason=e.Reason})
        end
    end
    function flight:start(ctx)
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return false,"CANCELLED" end
        T.running=true
        if not loaded then
            local folder=RS:FindFirstChild("ClientModules")
            flightRuntime=loadMod(folder and folder:FindFirstChild("ManualFlightRuntime"))
            flightController=loadMod(folder and folder:FindFirstChild("ManualFlightController"))
            local rq=folder and folder:FindFirstChild("RQ170")
            nativeController=loadMod(rq and rq:FindFirstChild("Controller"))
            loaded=true
            log("FLIGHT_CAPABILITIES",{runtime=flightRuntime~=nil,
                controller=flightController~=nil,native=nativeController~=nil,
                autoPilotApi=flightController~=nil and type(flightController.SetAutoPilot)=="function",
                nativeActiveApi=nativeController~=nil and type(nativeController.Active)=="function",
                nativeDebugApi=nativeController~=nil and type(nativeController.Debug)=="function"})
        end
        flightWaitUntil=os.clock()+settings.flightStartTimeoutSeconds
        jobContext=ctx
        ctx:deferCleanup(function() if jobContext==ctx then self:stop() end end)
        return true
    end
    function flight:step()
        if not T.running or completed then return end
        local plane=flightBinding()
        local active=plane~=nil
        T.flightActive=active
        if active then
            if not activeSince then
                activeSince=os.clock()
                log("FLIGHT_VERIFIED",{nativeControl=true,autoPilot=settings.autoPilot})
            end
            if settings.autoPilot then
                T.autoPilotInstalled=pilot:install(flightRuntime,flightController,plane,flightBinding,pilotFrame)
            end
        else
            pilot:clear("FLIGHT_HANDOFF_PENDING")
            T.autoPilotInstalled=false
        end
        if nativeController and type(nativeController.Debug)=="function" and os.clock()>=lastFlightLog then
            lastFlightLog=os.clock()+9
            local ok,d=pcall(nativeController.Debug)
            if ok and type(d)=="table" then
                T.shots=tonumber(d.Shots) or T.shots
                log("FLIGHT_STATUS",{pilotState=d.PilotState,pilotHP=d.PilotHP,
                    distance=d.Distance,shots=d.Shots,reported=d.Reported,
                    missiles=d.Missiles,signal=d.Signal,tier=d.Tier,
                    stealth=d.Stealth,relays=d.Relays,intel=d.Intel,
                    scan=d.Scan,escape=d.Escape,decoys=d.Decoys,dark=d.Dark,
                    serverPhase=d.ServerPhase,autoPilot=T.autoPilotInstalled,target=T.targetKind})
            end
        end
    end
    function flight:exhausted()
        return T.running and not completed and not activeSince and os.clock()>flightWaitUntil
    end
    function flight:status()
        return {phase=T.phase,bossHP=T.bossHP,maxHP=T.maxHP,
            flightActive=T.flightActive,autoPilotInstalled=T.autoPilotInstalled,
            signal=T.signal,tier=T.signalTier,stealth=T.stealth,
            pilotHP=T.pilotHP,intel=T.intel,relaysDown=T.relaysDown,
            scan=T.activeScan,escape=T.escape,decoys=T.decoys,
            targetKind=T.targetKind,targetDistance=T.targetDistance,shots=T.shots}
    end
    function flight:stop()
        T.running=false
        T.autoPilotInstalled=false
        pilot:stop()
        jobContext=nil
    end
    return flight
end
return FlightController
end
-- END MODULE boss.RQ170.FlightController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.RQ170.RQ170
__factories["boss.RQ170.RQ170"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local Config=require("boss.RQ170.Config")
local ArenaObserver=require("boss.RQ170.ArenaObserver")
local CommandController=require("boss.RQ170.CommandController")
local CombatController=require("boss.RQ170.CombatController")
local FlightController=require("boss.RQ170.FlightController")
local ReportController=require("boss.RQ170.ReportController")
local RepeatPolicy=require("boss.RQ170.RepeatPolicy")
local RQ170={}
function RQ170.definition()
    return {bossId=Config.bossId,displayName=Config.displayName,create=function(env)
        local observer=ArenaObserver.new(env,Config)
        local flight=FlightController.new(env,Config,observer)
        local repeatPolicy=RepeatPolicy.new(env)
        local report=ReportController.new(env,Config,repeatPolicy,flight)
        return {config=Config,observer=observer,flight=flight,report=report,
            repeatPolicy=repeatPolicy,command=CommandController.new(env,Config,observer,report),
            combat=CombatController.new(env,Config,observer,report,flight)}
    end}
end
return RQ170
end
-- END MODULE boss.RQ170.RQ170

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.RQ170.RepeatPolicy
__factories["boss.RQ170.RepeatPolicy"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local SharedRepeatPolicy = require("boss.shared.RepeatPolicy")
local RepeatPolicy = {}
function RepeatPolicy.new(env)
    return SharedRepeatPolicy.new(env, "Expected confirmed RQ170 outcome")
end
return RepeatPolicy
end
-- END MODULE boss.RQ170.RepeatPolicy

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.RQ170.ReportController
__factories["boss.RQ170.ReportController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- RQ170 adaptive report: Outcome -> report (arena or hideout) -> Continue -> exit -> return.
-- Port of standalone V1; never treat Outcome alone as a completed report.
local DeferredOutcome = require("boss.shared.DeferredOutcome")
local ReportController = {}

function ReportController.new(env, config, repeatPolicy, flight)
    local platform, gui, runtime = env.services.roblox, env.services.gui, env.runtime
    local player = platform:player()
    local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
    local writer = env.state:port("boss")
    local terminal = DeferredOutcome.new(env, config.bossId, "RQ170FightGeneration")
    local report = {}
    local confirmedOutcome, outcomeAt = nil, nil
    local lastHealthAt = 0
    local seenReport, firstOpenedAt = false, nil
    local listeningContext, connections, resultsController = nil, {}, nil
    local observedRQ170, generation = false, nil
    local function emit(name, data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit(name, data or {}) end
    end
    local function loadController()
        if resultsController then return resultsController end
        local folder = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("ClientModules")
        local mod = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("BossResultsController")
        if not mod or not mod:IsA("ModuleScript") then return nil end
        -- The build bundler replaces project requires. Invoke Roblox require only
        -- dynamically for the game's own ModuleScript, as the B21 controller does.
        local loader = getfenv(0)["require"]
        local ok, value = pcall(loader, mod)
        if not ok or type(value) ~= "table" then return nil end
        if type(value.IsOpen) ~= "function" or type(value.Dismiss) ~= "function" then return nil end
        resultsController = value
        return value
    end
    local function officialOpen()
        local ctrl = loadController()
        if ctrl and type(ctrl.IsOpen) == "function" then
            local ok, result = pcall(ctrl.IsOpen)
            if ok and result == true then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function isOpen()
        return player:GetAttribute("BossResultsOpen") == true or officialOpen()
    end
    local function matchingReport(guiRoot)
        if not guiRoot then return nil end
        local isRQ170, won, lost = false, false, false
        for _,node in ipairs(guiRoot:GetDescendants()) do
            if node:IsA("TextLabel") then
                local value = string.upper(tostring(node.Text or ""))
                if value:find("RQ170", 1, true) or value:find("RQ-170", 1, true) or value:find("SENTINEL", 1, true) then isRQ170 = true end
                if value:find("DEFEATED", 1, true) or value:find("VICTORY", 1, true)
                    or value:find("MISSION COMPLETE", 1, true) then won = true end
                if value:find("MISSION FAILED", 1, true) or value:find("DEFEAT", 1, true) then lost = true end
            end
        end
        if isRQ170 and won ~= lost then return won and "WIN" or "LOSS" end
        return nil
    end

    local function observerRQ170Active()
        return player:GetAttribute("RQ170Participant")==true
            or player:GetAttribute("RQ170FightState")=="Active"
            or platform:workspace():GetAttribute("RQ170FightState")=="Active"
    end
    local function closeConnections()
        for _,conn in ipairs(connections) do conn:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(connections)
        listeningContext=nil
    end
    local function listen(remote,fn)
        local connection=remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(fn)
        table.insert(connections,connection)
    end
    function report:watch(ctx)
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return false,"CANCELLED" end
        if listeningContext==ctx and #connections>0 then return true end
        closeConnections()
        local folder=platform:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        local remote=folder and folder:FindFirstChild("RQ170Event")
        if not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
            return false,"RQ170_EVENT_MISSING"
        end
        listen(remote,function(packet)
            if type(packet)~="table" or type(packet.K)~="string" then return end
            -- Only collect evidence for our RQ170 encounter. Do not steal an unrelated
            -- boss's Outcome (shared game client events may remain connected).
            local current=observerRQ170Active()
            if packet.K=="Session" or packet.K=="Launch" or packet.K=="Begin" then
                if current then
                    observedRQ170=true
                    generation=packet.Generation or generation
                end
            end
            if not observedRQ170 and not current then return end
            if generation~=nil and packet.Generation~=nil
                and packet.Generation~=generation then return end
            terminal:observe(packet)
            flight:observe(packet)
            if packet.K=="Phase" then
                emit("RQ170_PHASE",{phase=packet.Phase})
            elseif packet.K=="Outcome" then
                confirmedOutcome=packet.Victory==true and "WIN" or "LOSS"
                outcomeAt=runtime:now()
                emit("RQ170_OUTCOME",{outcome=confirmedOutcome,reason=packet.Reason})
            end
        end)
        listeningContext=ctx
        ctx:deferCleanup(function()
            if listeningContext==ctx then closeConnections() end
        end)
        return true
    end
    function report:cleanup()
        closeConnections()
        flight:stop()
        -- Keep outcome evidence for checkpoint reconciliation.
    end
    function report:resetOutcome()
        terminal:reset()
        confirmedOutcome,outcomeAt,seenReport,firstOpenedAt=nil,nil,false,nil
        observedRQ170=false;generation=nil
        flight:reset()
    end
    function report:verifiedDeferredOutcome(encounter) return terminal:verified(encounter, encounter.outcome) end
    function report:inspect()
        local root = gui:find(env.profile.paths.bossReport)
        local active = isOpen() -- Same verified V2 signal: BossResultsOpen or official controller.IsOpen()
        if active then
            seenReport = true
            firstOpenedAt = firstOpenedAt or runtime:now()
        end
        local guiOutcome = active and matchingReport(root) or nil
        local outcome = confirmedOutcome or guiOutcome
        return {
            active = active, matchesBoss = confirmedOutcome ~= nil or guiOutcome ~= nil,
            outcome = outcome, report = root, seen = seenReport,
            pendingPresentation = confirmedOutcome ~= nil and not seenReport
                and outcomeAt ~= nil and runtime:now() - outcomeAt < config.reportTimeoutSeconds,
        }
    end
    function report:reconcile(encounter)
        local evidence = self:inspect()
        if evidence.matchesBoss and evidence.outcome
            and (not encounter.outcome or encounter.outcome == evidence.outcome) then return true end
        return encounter.outcome ~= nil and seenReport and not evidence.active
    end
    function report:resolve(ctx, encounter)
        local watching, why = self:watch(ctx)
        if not watching then return {ok = false, code = why} end
        -- V2 REQUIREMENT: Outcome alone never authorizes return/Continue.
        local evidence = ctx:await(function()
            local current = self:inspect()
            if current.active and current.matchesBoss and current.outcome then return current end
            if seenReport and not current.active and (encounter.outcome or current.outcome) then
                return current -- manually dismissed report after previously observing it
            end
        end, config.reportTimeoutSeconds)
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        if not evidence then return {ok = false, code = "RQ170_REPORT_NOT_OBSERVED"} end
        if evidence.outcome and encounter.outcome and evidence.outcome ~= encounter.outcome then
            return {ok = false, held = true, code = "BOSS_OUTCOME_CONFLICT"}
        end
        local outcome = evidence.outcome or encounter.outcome
        if not outcome then return {ok = false, code = "RQ170_OUTCOME_UNVERIFIED"} end
        if not encounter.outcome then
            local accepted = writer:recordBossReport(outcome,
                runtime:epoch() + repeatPolicy:outcomeDelay(outcome))
            if not accepted then return {ok = false, held = true, code = "BOSS_OUTCOME_CONFLICT"} end
            encounter = env.state:snapshot().boss.encounter
        end
        if not evidence.active then
            writer:closeReport()
            return {ok = true, code = "RQ170_REPORT_MANUALLY_CLOSED"}
        end
        local at = platform:position()
        local place = player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") == true and "HIDEOUT" or "OTHER"
        if place == "OTHER" and at then
            local center = Vector3.new(config.arenaFallbackCenter.x,
                config.arenaFallbackCenter.y, config.arenaFallbackCenter.z)
            local horizontal = Vector3.new(at.X-center.X,0,at.Z-center.Z)
            if horizontal.Magnitude < config.arenaRadius
                and at.Y > config.arenaMinY and at.Y < config.arenaMaxY then
                place = "ARENA"
            end
        end
        emit("RQ170_REPORT_OPEN", {outcome = outcome, location = place,
            inBossFight = player:GetAttribute("InBossFight")})
        local controller = loadController()
        if not controller then return {ok = false, code = "RQ170_RESULT_CONTROLLER_MISSING_MANUAL_CONTINUE"} end
        if not encounter.continueAttempted then
            local ready = ctx:await(function()
                if not isOpen() then return "MANUALLY_CLOSED" end
                local armed = false
                if type(controller.Debug) == "function" then
                    local ok, message = pcall(controller.Debug)
                    armed = ok and type(message) == "string"
                        and message:find("armed=true", 1, true) ~= nil
                end
                if armed and firstOpenedAt
                    and runtime:now() - firstOpenedAt >= config.reportHoldSeconds then return "ARMED" end
            end, config.reportTimeoutSeconds)
            if ctx:isCancelled() then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
            if ready == "MANUALLY_CLOSED" then
                writer:closeReport()
                return {ok = true, code = "RQ170_REPORT_MANUALLY_CLOSED"}
            end
            if ready ~= "ARMED" then return {ok = false, code = "RQ170_REPORT_NOT_ARMED_MANUAL_CONTINUE"} end
            if not writer:markContinueAttempt() then return {ok = false, code = "RQ170_CONTINUE_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED"} end
            local sent, err = pcall(function() controller.Dismiss("continue") end)
            if not sent then return {ok = false, code = "RQ170_CONTINUE_FAILED: " .. tostring(err)} end
            emit("RQ170_REPORT_CONTINUE", {code = "CONTINUE_REQUESTED"})
        end
        local closed = ctx:await(function() if not self:inspect().active then return true end end,
            config.reportCloseTimeoutSeconds)
        if not closed then return {ok = false, code = "RQ170_REPORT_STILL_OPEN_MANUAL_CONTINUE"} end
        writer:closeReport()
        return {ok = true, code = "RQ170_REPORT_CLOSED"}
    end
    return report
end
return ReportController
end
-- END MODULE boss.RQ170.ReportController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.RedBaron.ArenaObserver
__factories["boss.RedBaron.ArenaObserver"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local ArenaObserver = {}
function ArenaObserver.new(env, config)
    local platform = env.services.roblox
    local player = platform:player()
    local workspace = platform:workspace()
    local observer = {}
    function observer:inArenaPosition()
        local pos = platform:position()
        if not pos then return false end
        local dX, dZ = pos.X - config.arenaCenter.x, pos.Z - config.arenaCenter.z
        return (dX * dX + dZ * dZ) < config.arenaRadius * config.arenaRadius
    end
    function observer:participating()
        return player:GetAttribute("RedBaronParticipant") == true
            or (player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true
                and workspace:GetAttribute("RedBaronFightActive") == true)
    end
    function observer:inArena()
        -- Prefer server replicated participation evidence. Pure position alone is
        -- insufficient to adopt an unrelated encounter.
        return self:participating() or
            (workspace:GetAttribute("RedBaronFightActive") == true and self:inArenaPosition())
    end
    function observer:phase() return workspace:GetAttribute("RedBaronPhase") end
    function observer:state()
        return {phase = self:phase(), fightState = workspace:GetAttribute("RedBaronFightState"),
            active = workspace:GetAttribute("RedBaronFightActive"),
            participant = player:GetAttribute("RedBaronParticipant"),
            inBossFight = player:GetAttribute("InBossFight")}
    end
    return observer
end
return ArenaObserver
end
-- END MODULE boss.RedBaron.ArenaObserver

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.RedBaron.CombatController
__factories["boss.RedBaron.CombatController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Red Baron V2 has no proven manual dodge route. Let the game's squadron fight
-- while this controller observes attack/phase/outcome, without moving the player.
local CombatController = {}
function CombatController.new(env, config, observer, report)
    local runtime = env.runtime
    local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
    local combat = {}
    function combat:run(ctx, encounter)
        local ready, why = report:watch(ctx)
        if not ready then return {code = why} end
        local lastKey, lastLog = nil, 0
        local deadline = runtime:now() + config.maxFightSeconds
        local code = "OUTCOME_NOT_OBSERVED_TIMEOUT"
        while not ctx:isCancelled() and runtime:now() < deadline do
            local result = report:inspect()
            if result.outcome then code = "OUTCOME_OBSERVED"; break end
            local state = observer:state()
            local key = tostring(state.fightState) .. "/" .. tostring(state.phase) .. "/"
                .. tostring(state.active) .. "/" .. tostring(state.participant)
            if key ~= lastKey or runtime:now() - lastLog >= 25 then
                if telemetry then telemetry:emit("RB_STATE", state) end
                lastKey, lastLog = key, runtime:now()
            end
            if not ctx:wait(0.4) then break end
        end
        if ctx:isCancelled() then code = "CANCELLED" end
        return {code = code}
    end
    return combat
end
return CombatController
end
-- END MODULE boss.RedBaron.CombatController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.RedBaron.CommandController
__factories["boss.RedBaron.CommandController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Red Baron V2 flow: Hideout -> Boss Command pass -> ONE Solo -> combat.
-- In-arena report is handled by ReportController before return is requested.
local DirectBossTravel = require("main.navigation.DirectBossTravel")
local CommandController = {}

function CommandController.new(env, config, observer, report)
    local platform, runtime = env.services.roblox, env.runtime
    local player, workspace = platform:player(), platform:workspace()
    local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
    local travel = DirectBossTravel.new(env)
    local command = {}
    local function emit(name, data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit(name, data or {}) end
    end
    local function remote(name)
        local folder = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        local item = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(name)
        return item and item:IsA("RemoteEvent") and item or nil
    end
    local function active(ctx) return runtime:isActive(ctx) and not ctx:isCancelled() end
    local function cooldownLeft()
        local raw = player:GetAttribute("BossStartCooldowns")
        if type(raw) ~= "string" or raw == "" then return 0 end
        local ok, data = pcall(function() return platform:service("HttpService"):JSONDecode(raw) end)
        if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then return 0 end
        return math.max(0, (tonumber(data[config.gameBossKey]) or 0) - workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
    end

    function command:prepare(ctx)
        local watching, why = report:watch(ctx) -- watch BEFORE sending any boss request
        if not watching then return false, why end
        if observer:inArena() then return true, "RB_ALREADY_IN_ARENA" end
        if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true then return false, "OTHER_BOSS_ACTIVE" end
        if not active(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        local entered = travel:enterHideout(ctx)
        emit("RB_DIRECT_HIDEOUT", {ok = entered.ok, code = entered.code, reason = entered.reason})
        if not entered.ok then return false, entered.code end
        local positioned = travel:moveToKnownPoint(ctx, config.commandSafePosition, {
            requireHideout = true, radius = 6, settle = 0.85,
        })
        emit("RB_COMMAND_POSITION", {ok = positioned.ok, code = positioned.code})
        if not positioned.ok then return false, positioned.code end
        return true, "RB_COMMAND_READY"
    end

    function command:readiness()
        if observer:inArena() then return "READY" end
        if not travel:inHideout() then return "UNKNOWN" end
        local secs = cooldownLeft()
        if secs > 0 then
            secs = math.ceil(secs)
            return string.format("%d:%02d", math.floor(secs / 60), secs % 60)
        end
        -- The server pass remains authoritative for unlock/eligibility.
        return "READY"
    end

    function command:startSolo(ctx, markAttempt)
        if not active(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        if observer:participating() then return true, "RB_ALREADY_FIGHTING" end
        if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true then return false, "OTHER_BOSS_ACTIVE" end
        if not travel:inHideout() then return false, "NOT_IN_HIDEOUT" end
        if self:readiness() ~= "READY" then return false, "RB_NOT_READY" end
        local watching, why = report:watch(ctx)
        if not watching then return false, why end
        local hideout, accept = remote("PersonalHideoutRemote"), remote("RedBaronCommanderAccept")
        if not hideout or not accept then return false, "RB_COMMAND_REMOTES_MISSING" end
        local passReply, acceptReply
        local passConnection = hideout.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
            if type(e) == "table" and e.Kind == "BossCommand" and e.Op == "Start"
                and e.BossKey == config.gameBossKey then passReply = e end
        end)
        local acceptConnection = accept.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
            if type(e) == "table" and e.Accepted ~= nil then acceptReply = e end
        end)
        local function finish(ok, code)
            passConnection:Disconnect()
            acceptConnection:Disconnect()
            return ok, code
        end
        local sent, err = pcall(function()
            hideout:FireServer({Action = "StartBoss", BossKey = config.gameBossKey, Solo = true})
        end)
        if not sent then return finish(false, "RB_PASS_SEND_FAILED: " .. tostring(err)) end
        local gotPass = ctx:await(function() return passReply end, 10)
        if not active(ctx) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
        if not gotPass then return finish(false, "RB_PASS_TIMEOUT_NO_RETRY") end
        emit("RB_PASS_RESULT", {ok = gotPass.Ok == true, reason = gotPass.Reason})
        if gotPass.Ok ~= true then return finish(false, "RB_PASS_REJECTED: " .. tostring(gotPass.Reason)) end
        -- Mark before firing the irreversible Solo request; never blind retry.
        if not markAttempt() then return finish(false, "RB_SOLO_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED") end
        sent, err = pcall(function() accept:FireServer({Solo = true}) end)
        if not sent then return finish(false, "RB_SOLO_SEND_FAILED: " .. tostring(err)) end
        local observed = ctx:await(function()
            if acceptReply and acceptReply.Accepted == false then return "REJECTED" end
            if observer:participating() then return "ENTERED" end
        end, config.arenaTimeout)
        if not active(ctx) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
        emit("RB_SOLO_RESULT", {code = observed or "AMBIGUOUS", accepted = acceptReply and acceptReply.Accepted})
        if observed == "ENTERED" then return finish(true, "RB_FIGHT_VERIFIED") end
        if observed == "REJECTED" then
            return finish(false, "RB_SOLO_REJECTED: " .. tostring(acceptReply.Reason))
        end
        return finish(false, "RB_SOLO_AMBIGUOUS_NO_RETRY")
    end

    function command:close(_) return true end -- No command GUI was opened.

    function command:returnHome(ctx, home)
        if not active(ctx) then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        if type(home) ~= "number" or home < 1 or home % 1 ~= 0 then
            return {ok = false, code = "INVALID_HOME_WORLD"}
        end
        if report:inspect().active then return {ok = false, code = "RB_REPORT_STILL_OPEN"} end
        -- Red Baron V2: never return while the server still marks this fight active.
        local released = ctx:await(function()
            if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true
                and player:GetAttribute("RedBaronParticipant") ~= true then return true end
        end, config.returnLockTimeoutSeconds)
        if not released then
            emit("RB_RETURN_LOCK_PENDING", {world = home})
            return {ok = false, code = "RB_RETURN_LOCK_PENDING", reason = "BossFight"}
        end
        local exit = ctx:await(function()
            if player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") == true then return "BOSS_COMMAND_HIDEOUT" end
            if not observer:inArenaPosition() then return "OUTSIDE_ARENA" end
        end, config.exitTimeoutSeconds)
        emit("RB_ARENA_EXIT", {code = exit or "LOCK_RELEASED_STILL_IN_ARENA"})
        -- As in tested V2, a released lock permits a direct verified travel even
        -- if the game has not repositioned the player outside the arena yet.
        if not ctx:wait(1.5) then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        local request, prepare, result = remote("RequestWorldTravel"), remote("NavPrepareWorlds"), remote("WorldTravelResult")
        if not request or not prepare then return {ok = false, code = "RB_WORLD_TRAVEL_REMOTES_MISSING"} end
        local position = platform:position()
        if not position then return {ok = false, code = "CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE"} end
        if tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")) == home
            and player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") ~= true
            and not observer:inArenaPosition() then
            return {ok = true, code = "ALREADY_IN_HOME", world = home}
        end
        local reply
        local connection = result and result.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
            if type(e) == "table" and e.Kind == "Result" and tonumber(e.WorldId) == home then reply = e end
        end) or nil
        local function finish(ok, code, reason)
            if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
            emit("RB_DIRECT_RETURN", {ok = ok, code = code, reason = reason, world = home})
            return {ok = ok, code = code, reason = reason, world = home}
        end
        for attempt = 1, config.returnRetries do
            if not active(ctx) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            reply = nil
            local prior = platform:position()
            if not prior then return finish(false, "CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE") end
            local sent, err = pcall(function() prepare:FireServer("stream", home) end)
            if not sent then return finish(false, "WORLD_PREPARE_SEND_FAILED", tostring(err)) end
            if not ctx:wait(0.12) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            sent, err = pcall(function() request:FireServer(home) end)
            if not sent then return finish(false, "WORLD_REQUEST_SEND_FAILED", tostring(err)) end
            local observed = ctx:await(function()
                if reply and reply.Ok == false then return "REJECTED" end
                local current = platform:position()
                if current and platform:distance(current, prior) > 50
                    and tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")) == home
                    and player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") ~= true
                    and player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true
                    and not observer:inArenaPosition() then return "VERIFIED" end
            end, 17)
            emit("RB_RETURN_ATTEMPT", {attempt = attempt, code = observed or "AMBIGUOUS",
                reason = reply and reply.Reason})
            if observed == "VERIFIED" then return finish(true, "RB_HOME_VERIFIED") end
            if observed ~= "REJECTED" then return finish(false, "RB_RETURN_AMBIGUOUS_NO_RETRY") end
            local why = tostring(reply.Reason or "UNKNOWN")
            if why ~= "BossFight" or attempt == config.returnRetries then
                return finish(false, "RB_WORLD_RETURN_REJECTED", why)
            end
            if not ctx:wait(12) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            local settled = ctx:await(function()
                if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true then return true end
            end, 40)
            if not settled then return finish(false, "RB_LOCK_STILL_ACTIVE", "BossFight") end
        end
        return finish(false, "RB_WORLD_RETURN_EXHAUSTED")
    end
    return command
end
return CommandController
end
-- END MODULE boss.RedBaron.CommandController

local Config = {
    bossId = "RED_BARON", displayName = "Red Baron", gameBossKey = "RedBaron",
    arenaCenter = {x = 8192, z = -24576}, arenaRadius = 650,
    commandSafePosition = {x = -31962.1074, y = 344.357483, z = 32887.3203},
    arenaTimeout = 48, maxFightSeconds = 690,
    reportTimeoutSeconds = 75, reportHoldSeconds = 3,
    reportCloseTimeoutSeconds = 125, exitTimeoutSeconds = 65,
    returnLockTimeoutSeconds = 80, returnRetries = 3,
}

__factories["boss.RedBaron.RedBaron"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Registration entrypoint for BossManager; preserves the validated V2 flow.
local Config = require("boss.RedBaron.Config")
local ArenaObserver = require("boss.RedBaron.ArenaObserver")
local CommandController = require("boss.RedBaron.CommandController")
local CombatController = require("boss.RedBaron.CombatController")

        local observer = ArenaObserver.new(env, Config)
        local repeatPolicy = RepeatPolicy.new(env)

        return {
            config = Config, observer = observer, repeatPolicy = repeatPolicy, report = report,
            command = CommandController.new(env, Config, observer, report),
            combat = CombatController.new(env, Config, observer, report),
        }
    end}
end
return RedBaron
end

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.RedBaron.ReportController
__factories["boss.RedBaron.ReportController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local DeferredOutcome = require("boss.shared.DeferredOutcome")
-- Red Baron IN-ARENA report; preserve V2 Outcome -> report -> Continue -> exit.
local ReportController = {}

function ReportController.new(env, config, repeatPolicy)
    local platform, gui, runtime = env.services.roblox, env.services.gui, env.runtime
    local player = platform:player()
    local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
    local writer = env.state:port("boss")
    local report = {}
    local terminal = DeferredOutcome.new(env, config.bossId, "RedBaronFightGeneration")
    local confirmedOutcome, outcomeAt = nil, nil
    local seenReport, firstOpenedAt = false, nil
    local listeningContext, connection, resultsController = nil, nil, nil
    local function emit(name, data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit(name, data or {}) end
    end
    local function loadController()
        if resultsController then return resultsController end
        local folder = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("ClientModules")
        local mod = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("BossResultsController")
        if not mod or not mod:IsA("ModuleScript") then return nil end
        -- The build bundler replaces project requires. Invoke Roblox require only
        -- dynamically for the game's own ModuleScript, as the B21 controller does.
        local loader = getfenv(0)["require"]
        local ok, value = pcall(loader, mod)
        if not ok or type(value) ~= "table" then return nil end
        if type(value.IsOpen) ~= "function" or type(value.Dismiss) ~= "function" then return nil end
        resultsController = value
        return value
    end
    local function officialOpen()
        local ctrl = loadController()
        if ctrl and type(ctrl.IsOpen) == "function" then
            local ok, result = pcall(ctrl.IsOpen)
            if ok and result == true then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function isOpen()
        return player:GetAttribute("BossResultsOpen") == true or officialOpen()
    end
    local function matchingReport(guiRoot)
        if not guiRoot then return nil end
        local red, won, lost = false, false, false
        for _, node in ipairs(guiRoot:GetDescendants()) do
            if node:IsA("TextLabel") then
                local value = string.upper(tostring(node.Text or ""))
                if value:find("RED BARON", 1, true) then red = true end
                if value:find("DEFEATED", 1, true) or value:find("VICTORY", 1, true) then won = true end
                if value:find("MISSION FAILED", 1, true) then lost = true end
            end
        end
        if red and won ~= lost then return won and "WIN" or "LOSS" end
        return nil
    end

    function report:watch(ctx)
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        if listeningContext == ctx and connection then return true end
        if connection then connection:Disconnect(); connection = nil end
        local folder = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        local remote = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("RedBaronEvent")
        if not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then return false, "REDBARON_EVENT_MISSING" end
        local current = remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(packet)
            if type(packet) ~= "table" or type(packet.K) ~= "string" then return end
            terminal:observe(packet)
            local kind = packet.K
            if kind == "Outcome" and type(packet.Victory) == "boolean" then
                confirmedOutcome = packet.Victory and "WIN" or "LOSS"
                outcomeAt = runtime:now()
            end
            if kind == "Start" or kind == "Begin" or kind == "Phase" or kind == "Attack"
                or kind == "End" or kind == "Outcome" then
                local detail = {kind = kind}
                for _, field in ipairs({"Phase", "Name", "Reason", "EndReason", "Victory"}) do
                    local value = packet[field]
                    if type(value) == "string" or type(value) == "number" or type(value) == "boolean" then
                        detail[field] = value
                    end
                end
                if kind == "Attack" and type(packet.Target) == "table" then
                    detail.targetSelf = packet.Target.UserId == player.UserId
                    if type(packet.Target.Slot) == "number" then detail.slot = packet.Target.Slot end
                end
                emit("RB_EVENT", detail)
            end
        end)
        connection, listeningContext = current, ctx
        ctx:deferCleanup(function()
            if connection == current then
                current:Disconnect()
                connection, listeningContext = nil, nil
            end
        end)
        return true
    end
    function report:cleanup()
        if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
        connection, listeningContext = nil, nil
        -- Keep outcome and report evidence across RETURN/REPORT retries.
    end
    function report:verifiedDeferredOutcome(encounter)
        return terminal:verified(encounter, "LOSS")
    end
    function report:resetOutcome()
        terminal:reset()
        confirmedOutcome, outcomeAt, seenReport, firstOpenedAt = nil, nil, false, nil
    end
    function report:inspect()
        local root = gui:find(env.profile.paths.bossReport)
        local active = isOpen() -- Same verified V2 signal: BossResultsOpen or official controller.IsOpen()
        if active then
            seenReport = true
            firstOpenedAt = firstOpenedAt or runtime:now()
        end
        local guiOutcome = active and matchingReport(root) or nil
        local outcome = confirmedOutcome or guiOutcome
        return {
            active = active, matchesBoss = confirmedOutcome ~= nil or guiOutcome ~= nil,
            outcome = outcome, report = root, seen = seenReport,
            pendingPresentation = confirmedOutcome ~= nil and not seenReport
                and outcomeAt ~= nil and runtime:now() - outcomeAt < config.reportTimeoutSeconds,
        }
    end
    function report:reconcile(encounter)
        local evidence = self:inspect()
        if evidence.matchesBoss and evidence.outcome
            and (not encounter.outcome or encounter.outcome == evidence.outcome) then return true end
        return encounter.outcome ~= nil and seenReport and not evidence.active
    end
    function report:resolve(ctx, encounter)
        local watching, why = self:watch(ctx)
        if not watching then return {ok = false, code = why} end
        -- V2 REQUIREMENT: Outcome alone never authorizes return/Continue.
        local evidence = ctx:await(function()
            local current = self:inspect()
            if current.active and current.matchesBoss and current.outcome then return current end
            if seenReport and not current.active and (encounter.outcome or current.outcome) then
                return current -- manually dismissed report after previously observing it
            end
        end, config.reportTimeoutSeconds)
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        if not evidence then return {ok = false, code = "RB_REPORT_NOT_OBSERVED"} end
        if evidence.outcome and encounter.outcome and evidence.outcome ~= encounter.outcome then
            return {ok = false, held = true, code = "BOSS_OUTCOME_CONFLICT"}
        end
        local outcome = evidence.outcome or encounter.outcome
        if not outcome then return {ok = false, code = "RB_OUTCOME_UNVERIFIED"} end
        if not encounter.outcome then
            local accepted = writer:recordBossReport(outcome,
                runtime:epoch() + repeatPolicy:outcomeDelay(outcome))
            if not accepted then return {ok = false, held = true, code = "BOSS_OUTCOME_CONFLICT"} end
            encounter = env.state:snapshot().boss.encounter
        end
        if not evidence.active then
            writer:closeReport()
            return {ok = true, code = "RB_REPORT_MANUALLY_CLOSED"}
        end
        emit("RB_REPORT_OPEN", {outcome = outcome, inBossFight = player:GetAttribute("InBossFight")})
        local controller = loadController()
        if not controller then return {ok = false, code = "RB_RESULT_CONTROLLER_MISSING_MANUAL_CONTINUE"} end
        if not encounter.continueAttempted then
            local ready = ctx:await(function()
                if not isOpen() then return "MANUALLY_CLOSED" end
                local armed = false
                if type(controller.Debug) == "function" then
                    local ok, message = pcall(controller.Debug)
                    armed = ok and type(message) == "string"
                        and message:find("armed=true", 1, true) ~= nil
                end
                if armed and firstOpenedAt
                    and runtime:now() - firstOpenedAt >= config.reportHoldSeconds then return "ARMED" end
            end, config.reportTimeoutSeconds)
            if ctx:isCancelled() then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
            if ready == "MANUALLY_CLOSED" then
                writer:closeReport()
                return {ok = true, code = "RB_REPORT_MANUALLY_CLOSED"}
            end
            if ready ~= "ARMED" then return {ok = false, code = "RB_REPORT_NOT_ARMED_MANUAL_CONTINUE"} end
            if not writer:markContinueAttempt() then return {ok = false, code = "RB_CONTINUE_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED"} end
            local sent, err = pcall(function() controller.Dismiss("continue") end)
            if not sent then return {ok = false, code = "RB_CONTINUE_FAILED: " .. tostring(err)} end
            emit("RB_REPORT_CONTINUE", {code = "CONTINUE_REQUESTED"})
        end
        local closed = ctx:await(function() if not self:inspect().active then return true end end,
            config.reportCloseTimeoutSeconds)
        if not closed then return {ok = false, code = "RB_REPORT_STILL_OPEN_MANUAL_CONTINUE"} end
        writer:closeReport()
        return {ok = true, code = "RB_REPORT_CLOSED"}
    end
    return report
end
return ReportController
end
-- END MODULE boss.RedBaron.ReportController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.SR71.ArenaObserver
__factories["boss.SR71.ArenaObserver"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local ArenaObserver={}
function ArenaObserver.new(env,config)
    local platform=env.services.roblox
    local player=platform:player()
    local observer={}
    function observer:participating()
        return player:GetAttribute("SR71Participant")==true
    end
    function observer:inArenaPosition(pos)
        pos=pos or platform:position()
        if typeof(pos)~="Vector3" then return false end
        local c=config.arenaFallbackCenter
        return (pos-Vector3.new(c.x,c.y,c.z)).Magnitude<config.arenaRadius
    end
    function observer:inArena()
        return self:participating() or
            (player:GetAttribute("InBossFight")==true and self:inArenaPosition())
    end
    function observer:state()
        local W=platform:workspace()
        return {phase=player:GetAttribute("SR71Phase") or W:GetAttribute("SR71Phase"),
            fightState=player:GetAttribute("SR71FightState") or W:GetAttribute("SR71FightState"),
            active=player:GetAttribute("InBossFight"),participant=player:GetAttribute("SR71Participant")}
    end
    return observer
end
return ArenaObserver
end
-- END MODULE boss.SR71.ArenaObserver

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.SR71.CombatController
__factories["boss.SR71.CombatController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local CombatController={}
function CombatController.new(env,config,observer,report,flight)
    local runtime,telemetry=env.runtime,env.services.telemetry
    local combat={}
    local function emit(name,data) if telemetry then telemetry:emit("SR71_"..name,data or {}) end end
    function combat:run(ctx,encounter)
        local ok,why=report:watch(ctx)
        if not ok then return {code=why or "SR71_REPORT_WATCH_FAILED"} end
        ok,why=flight:start(ctx)
        if not ok then return {code=why or "SR71_FLIGHT_INIT_FAILED"} end
        local deadline=runtime:now()+config.maxFightSeconds
        local nextLog=0
        local result="OUTCOME_NOT_OBSERVED_TIMEOUT"
        while not ctx:isCancelled() and runtime:now()<deadline do
            local evidence=report:inspect()
            if evidence.outcome then result="OUTCOME_OBSERVED";break end
            flight:step()
            if flight:exhausted() then result="SR71_NATIVE_FLIGHT_NOT_ACTIVE";break end
            if runtime:now()>=nextLog then
                emit("FLIGHT_STATUS",flight:status())
                nextLog=runtime:now()+9
            end
            if not ctx:wait(.35) then break end
        end
        emit("FLIGHT_SUMMARY",flight:status())
        -- Release autopilot before any report or return. Never affect another boss.
        flight:stop()
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return {code="CANCELLED"} end
        return {code=result}
    end
    return combat
end
return CombatController
end
-- END MODULE boss.SR71.CombatController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.SR71.CommandController
__factories["boss.SR71.CommandController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- SR71 standalone V1 flow: Hideout -> Boss Command pass -> ONE Solo -> combat.
-- Adaptive report may open in arena OR after exit; never request return before Continue.
local DirectBossTravel = require("main.navigation.DirectBossTravel")
local CommandController = {}

function CommandController.new(env, config, observer, report)
    local platform, runtime = env.services.roblox, env.runtime
    local player, workspace = platform:player(), platform:workspace()
    local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
    local travel = DirectBossTravel.new(env)
    local command = {}
    local function emit(name, data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit(name, data or {}) end
    end
    local function remote(name)
        local storage = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage")
        local folder = storage:FindFirstChild("Remotes") or storage:WaitForChild("Remotes", 10)
        local item = folder and (folder:FindFirstChild(name) or folder:WaitForChild(name, 7))
        return item and item:IsA("RemoteEvent") and item or nil
    end
    local function active(ctx) return runtime:isActive(ctx) and not ctx:isCancelled() end
    local function cooldownLeft()
        local raw = player:GetAttribute("BossStartCooldowns")
        if type(raw) ~= "string" or raw == "" then return 0 end
        local ok, data = pcall(function() return platform:service("HttpService"):JSONDecode(raw) end)
        if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then return 0 end
        return math.max(0, (tonumber(data[config.gameBossKey]) or 0) - workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
    end

    function command:prepare(ctx)
        local watching, why = report:watch(ctx) -- watch BEFORE sending any boss request
        if not watching then return false, why end
        if observer:inArena() then return true, "SR71_ALREADY_IN_ARENA" end
        if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true then return false, "OTHER_BOSS_ACTIVE" end
        if not active(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        -- V3: wait for SR71 cooldown BEFORE issuing Boss Command requests.
        local left = cooldownLeft()
        if left > 0 and config.waitForCooldown then
            if left > config.maxCooldownWaitSeconds then
                emit("SR71_COOLDOWN_GATE", {remaining = math.ceil(left), code = "WAIT_LIMIT"})
                return false, "SR71_COOLDOWN_ABOVE_WAIT_LIMIT"
            end
            emit("SR71_COOLDOWN_WAIT", {remaining = math.ceil(left)})
            local untilTime = runtime:now() + config.maxCooldownWaitSeconds
            local lastTick = runtime:now()
            while active(ctx) and cooldownLeft() > 0 and runtime:now() < untilTime do
                if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true then
                    return false, "OTHER_ENCOUNTER_BECAME_ACTIVE"
                end
                if runtime:now() - lastTick >= 25 then
                    lastTick = runtime:now()
                    emit("SR71_COOLDOWN_WAITING", {remaining = math.ceil(cooldownLeft())})
                end
                if not ctx:wait(math.min(3, math.max(0.5, cooldownLeft()))) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
            end
            if not active(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
            if cooldownLeft() > 0 then return false, "SR71_COOLDOWN_WAIT_LIMIT_REACHED" end
            emit("SR71_COOLDOWN_READY", {remaining = 0})
        end
        local entered = travel:enterHideout(ctx)
        emit("SR71_DIRECT_HIDEOUT", {ok = entered.ok, code = entered.code, reason = entered.reason})
        if not entered.ok then return false, entered.code end
        local positioned = travel:moveToKnownPoint(ctx, config.commandSafePosition, {
            requireHideout = true, radius = 6, settle = 0.85,
        })
        emit("SR71_COMMAND_POSITION", {ok = positioned.ok, code = positioned.code})
        if not positioned.ok then return false, positioned.code end
        return true, "SR71_COMMAND_READY"
    end

    function command:readiness()
        if observer:inArena() then return "READY" end
        if not travel:inHideout() then return "UNKNOWN" end
        local secs = cooldownLeft()
        if secs > 0 then
            secs = math.ceil(secs)
            return string.format("%d:%02d", math.floor(secs / 60), secs % 60)
        end
        -- The server pass remains authoritative for unlock/eligibility.
        return "READY"
    end

    function command:startSolo(ctx, markAttempt)
        if not active(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        if observer:participating() then return true, "SR71_ALREADY_FIGHTING" end
        if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true then return false, "OTHER_BOSS_ACTIVE" end
        if not travel:inHideout() then return false, "NOT_IN_HIDEOUT" end
        if self:readiness() ~= "READY" then return false, "SR71_NOT_READY" end
        local watching, why = report:watch(ctx)
        if not watching then return false, why end
        local hideout, accept = remote("PersonalHideoutRemote"), remote("SR71CommanderAccept")
        if not hideout or not accept then return false, "SR71_COMMAND_REMOTES_MISSING" end
        local passReply, acceptReply
        local passConnection = hideout.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
            if type(e) == "table" and e.Kind == "BossCommand" and e.Op == "Start"
                and e.BossKey == config.gameBossKey then passReply = e end
        end)
        local acceptConnection = accept.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
            if type(e) == "table" and e.Accepted ~= nil then acceptReply = e end
        end)
        local function finish(ok, code)
            passConnection:Disconnect()
            acceptConnection:Disconnect()
            return ok, code
        end
        local sent, err = pcall(function()
            hideout:FireServer({Action = "StartBoss", BossKey = config.gameBossKey, Solo = true})
        end)
        if not sent then return finish(false, "SR71_PASS_SEND_FAILED: " .. tostring(err)) end
        local gotPass = ctx:await(function() return passReply end, 10)
        if not active(ctx) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
        if not gotPass then return finish(false, "SR71_PASS_TIMEOUT_NO_RETRY") end
        emit("SR71_PASS_RESULT", {ok = gotPass.Ok == true, reason = gotPass.Reason})
        if gotPass.Ok ~= true then return finish(false, "SR71_PASS_REJECTED: " .. tostring(gotPass.Reason)) end
        -- Mark before firing the irreversible Solo request; never blind retry.
        if not markAttempt() then return finish(false, "SR71_SOLO_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED") end
        sent, err = pcall(function() accept:FireServer({Solo = true}) end)
        if not sent then return finish(false, "SR71_SOLO_SEND_FAILED: " .. tostring(err)) end
        local observed = ctx:await(function()
            if acceptReply and acceptReply.Accepted == false then return "REJECTED" end
            if observer:participating() then return "ENTERED" end
        end, config.arenaTimeout)
        if not active(ctx) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
        emit("SR71_SOLO_RESULT", {code = observed or "AMBIGUOUS", accepted = acceptReply and acceptReply.Accepted})
        if observed == "ENTERED" then return finish(true, "SR71_FIGHT_VERIFIED") end
        if observed == "REJECTED" then
            return finish(false, "SR71_SOLO_REJECTED: " .. tostring(acceptReply.Reason))
        end
        return finish(false, "SR71_SOLO_AMBIGUOUS_NO_RETRY")
    end

    function command:close(_) return true end -- No command GUI was opened.

    function command:returnHome(ctx, home)
        if not active(ctx) then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        if type(home) ~= "number" or home < 1 or home % 1 ~= 0 then
            return {ok = false, code = "INVALID_HOME_WORLD"}
        end
        if report:inspect().active then return {ok = false, code = "SR71_REPORT_STILL_OPEN"} end
        -- Preserve standalone V1 lock checks before return, regardless of report location.
        local released = ctx:await(function()
            if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true
                and player:GetAttribute("SR71Participant") ~= true then return true end
        end, config.returnLockTimeoutSeconds)
        if not released then
            emit("SR71_RETURN_LOCK_PENDING", {world = home})
            return {ok = false, code = "SR71_RETURN_LOCK_PENDING", reason = "BossFight"}
        end
        local exit = ctx:await(function()
            if player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") == true then return "BOSS_COMMAND_HIDEOUT" end
            if not observer:inArenaPosition() then return "OUTSIDE_ARENA" end
        end, config.exitTimeoutSeconds)
        emit("SR71_ARENA_EXIT", {code = exit or "LOCK_RELEASED_STILL_IN_ARENA"})
        -- As in tested standalone V1, a released lock permits a direct verified travel even
        -- if the game has not repositioned the player outside the arena yet.
        if not ctx:wait(1.5) then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        local request, prepare, result = remote("RequestWorldTravel"), remote("NavPrepareWorlds"), remote("WorldTravelResult")
        if not request or not prepare then return {ok = false, code = "SR71_WORLD_TRAVEL_REMOTES_MISSING"} end
        local position = platform:position()
        if not position then return {ok = false, code = "CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE"} end
        if tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")) == home
            and player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") ~= true
            and not observer:inArenaPosition() then
            return {ok = true, code = "ALREADY_IN_HOME", world = home}
        end
        local reply
        local connection = result and result.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
            if type(e) == "table" and e.Kind == "Result" and tonumber(e.WorldId) == home then reply = e end
        end) or nil
        local function finish(ok, code, reason)
            if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
            emit("SR71_DIRECT_RETURN", {ok = ok, code = code, reason = reason, world = home})
            return {ok = ok, code = code, reason = reason, world = home}
        end
        for attempt = 1, config.returnRetries do
            if not active(ctx) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            reply = nil
            local prior = platform:position()
            if not prior then return finish(false, "CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE") end
            local sent, err = pcall(function() prepare:FireServer("stream", home) end)
            if not sent then return finish(false, "WORLD_PREPARE_SEND_FAILED", tostring(err)) end
            if not ctx:wait(0.12) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            sent, err = pcall(function() request:FireServer(home) end)
            if not sent then return finish(false, "WORLD_REQUEST_SEND_FAILED", tostring(err)) end
            local observed = ctx:await(function()
                if reply and reply.Ok == false then return "REJECTED" end
                local current = platform:position()
                if current and platform:distance(current, prior) > 50
                    and tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")) == home
                    and player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") ~= true
                    and player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true
                    and not observer:inArenaPosition() then return "VERIFIED" end
            end, 17)
            emit("SR71_RETURN_ATTEMPT", {attempt = attempt, code = observed or "AMBIGUOUS",
                reason = reply and reply.Reason})
            if observed == "VERIFIED" then return finish(true, "SR71_HOME_VERIFIED") end
            if observed ~= "REJECTED" then return finish(false, "SR71_RETURN_AMBIGUOUS_NO_RETRY") end
            local why = tostring(reply.Reason or "UNKNOWN")
            if why ~= "BossFight" or attempt == config.returnRetries then
                return finish(false, "SR71_WORLD_RETURN_REJECTED", why)
            end
            if not ctx:wait(12) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            local settled = ctx:await(function()
                if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true then return true end
            end, 40)
            if not settled then return finish(false, "SR71_LOCK_STILL_ACTIVE", "BossFight") end
        end
        return finish(false, "SR71_WORLD_RETURN_EXHAUSTED")
    end
    return command
end
return CommandController
end
-- END MODULE boss.SR71.CommandController

    world=54,
