-- BEGIN MODULE boss.SR71.FlightController
__factories["boss.SR71.FlightController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Native SR71 flight activation is game-owned; autopilot V1 pursues Blackbird/Tanker.
local PilotControl=require("boss.shared.PilotControl")
local FlightController={}
function FlightController.new(env,settings,observer)
    local platform=env.services.roblox
    local RS=platform:service("ReplicatedStorage")
    local W=platform:workspace()
    local P=platform:player()
    local telemetry=env.services.telemetry
    local T={running=false,phase=0,flightActive=false,autoPilotInstalled=false,
        targetKind=nil,targetDistance=nil,shots=0,refuelState=nil,escape=nil,
        bossHP=nil,maxHP=nil,sessionGeneration=nil}
    local flight={}
    local completed=false
    local flightRuntime,flightController,nativeController=nil,nil,nil
    local activeSince,flightWaitUntil,lastFlightLog=nil,0,0
    local lastTargetLog=0
    local lastTargetKind=nil
    local function log(name,data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit("SR71_"..name,data or {}) end
    end
    local function isParticipating() return observer:participating() end
    local function phaseUpdate(x,sourceName)
        local n=tonumber(x)
        if n and n>=1 and n<=5 and n~=T.phase then
            T.phase=n
            log("PHASE",{phase=n,source=sourceName})
        end
    end
    local function loadMod(mod)
        if not mod or not mod:IsA("ModuleScript") then return nil,"MODULE_MISSING" end
        -- Bundler uses string-literal requires for project modules; native game module
        -- requires must resolve dynamically via the original Roblox loader.
        local nativeRequire=getfenv(0)["require"]
        local ok,x=pcall(nativeRequire,mod)
        if not ok or type(x)~="table" then return nil,tostring(x) end
        return x
    end
    local pilot=PilotControl.new(platform,log)
    local jobContext
    local player=P
    local function flightBinding()
        if not jobContext or jobContext:isCancelled() or not T.running or completed
            or not observer:participating() or player:GetAttribute("BossReviveDowned")==true or player:GetAttribute("BossResultsOpen")==true
            or not nativeController or type(nativeController.Active)~="function" or not nativeController.Active() then
            return nil
        end
        local scene=W:FindFirstChild("SR71Interception")
        return PilotControl.bound(flightRuntime,flightController,function(plane)
            local hp=plane:GetAttribute("CurrentHP")
            return scene and plane.Name=="SR71PilotAircraft" and plane:IsDescendantOf(scene)
                and (type(hp)~="number" or hp>0)
        end)
    end
local function flightSim()
    if not flightRuntime or type(flightRuntime.Sim)~="function" then return nil end
    local ok,sim=pcall(flightRuntime.Sim)
    if not ok or not sim then return nil end
    local valid=pcall(function()
        assert(typeof(sim.Position)=="Vector3" and typeof(sim.Rotation)=="CFrame")
    end)
    return valid and sim or nil
end
local function findModel(name)
    local arena=W:FindFirstChild("SR71Interception")
    if not arena then return nil end
    local model=arena:FindFirstChild(name,true)
    if model and model:IsA("Model") and model.PrimaryPart then return model end
    return nil
end
local function chooseTarget()
    local tankerWanted=settings.prioritizeTanker and
        (T.refuelState=="Refuel" or T.refuelState=="Approach")
    if tankerWanted then
        local tanker=findModel("SR71Tanker")
        if tanker then return tanker,"TANKER" end
    end
    local boss=findModel("SR71Blackbird")
    if boss then return boss,"BLACKBIRD" end
    return nil,nil
end
local pilotState={turn=1,breakUntil=0}
local riftHazards=env.services.riftHazards
    local function applyHazardFrame(sim,plan)
        if not riftHazards or type(riftHazards.flightPlan)~="function" then return plan end
        local ok,adjusted=pcall(riftHazards.flightPlan,riftHazards,sim,plan)
        return ok and type(adjusted)=="table" and adjusted or plan
    end
    local function pilotFrame(dt)
    if not T.running or completed or not isParticipating() then return nil end
    local sim=flightSim()
    if not sim then return nil end
    local pos,forward=sim.Position,sim.Rotation.LookVector
    local model,kind=chooseTarget()
    if not model then
        return applyHazardFrame(sim,{Aim=forward,Throttle=.9,Fire=false,Missile=false})
    end
    local targetModel=model
    local goal=model.PrimaryPart.Position
    if kind=="BLACKBIRD" and nativeController and type(nativeController.Debug)=="function" then
        local ok,native=pcall(nativeController.Debug)
        if ok and type(native)=="table" then goal=PilotControl.position(native.BossAt) or goal end
    end
    local now=os.clock()
    if model~=pilotState.lastModel then pilotState.lastTime=nil; pilotState.velocity=nil end
    if not pilotState.lastTime or now-pilotState.lastTime>=0.075 then
        pilotState.velocity=pilotState.lastTime and (goal-pilotState.lastPos)/(now-pilotState.lastTime) or Vector3.zero
        pilotState.lastModel,pilotState.lastPos,pilotState.lastTime=model,goal,now
    end
    local velocity=pilotState.velocity
    local gap=goal-pos
    local distance=gap.Magnitude
    local direction=distance>1 and gap.Unit or forward
    local aim=gap
    -- Intercept lead is bounded to avoid aiming far outside the arena.
    local lead=math.clamp(distance/650,.15,1.4)
    if velocity.Magnitude>1500 then velocity=velocity.Unit*1500 end
    aim=goal+velocity*lead-pos
    if aim.Magnitude<.1 then aim=direction end
    local angle=math.deg(math.acos(math.clamp(forward:Dot(direction),-1,1)))
    local fire=settings.autoFire and distance<340 and angle<5
    local missile=settings.autoFire and distance<900 and angle<20

    local near=distance<95
    if near and not pilotState.near then
        -- Collision avoidance: break upward and to the side, then resume chase.
        pilotState.breakUntil=now+1.6
        pilotState.turn=-pilotState.turn
    end
    pilotState.near=near
    if now<pilotState.breakUntil then
        aim=forward*150+sim.Rotation.RightVector*pilotState.turn*95+Vector3.new(0,80,0)
        fire=false; missile=false
    end
    -- Constrain flight to the published SR71 arena floor and ceiling.
    if pos.Y<5360 then aim=aim.Unit+Vector3.new(0,.8,0)
    elseif pos.Y>7460 then aim=aim.Unit-Vector3.new(0,.8,0) end
    -- Prevent drifting outside the 5200-stud encounter radius.
    local centre=Vector3.new(40960,6000,40960)
    local horiz=Vector3.new(pos.X-centre.X,0,pos.Z-centre.Z)
    if horiz.Magnitude>4850 then
        aim=(centre-pos)+Vector3.new(0,100,0)
        fire=false;missile=false
    end
    if kind~=lastTargetKind or now-lastTargetLog>5 then
        lastTargetKind=kind; lastTargetLog=now
        T.targetDistance=math.floor(distance)
        T.targetKind=kind
        log("FLIGHT_TARGET",{target=kind,range=math.floor(distance),
            angle=math.floor(angle),phase=T.phase,refuel=T.refuelState,
            mode=now<pilotState.breakUntil and "BREAK" or "CHASE",
            fire=fire,missile=missile})
    end
    return applyHazardFrame(sim,{Aim=aim,Throttle=distance>750 and 1 or .85,Fire=fire,Missile=missile,
            Target=kind,TargetModel=targetModel,Maneuver=now<pilotState.breakUntil or horiz.Magnitude>4850})
end
    function flight:reset()
        self:stop()
        completed=false
        T.phase=0;T.refuelState=nil;T.escape=nil;T.bossHP=nil;T.maxHP=nil
        T.sessionGeneration=nil;T.targetKind=nil;T.targetDistance=nil;T.shots=0
        T.flightActive=false;T.autoPilotInstalled=false
        activeSince=nil;flightWaitUntil=0;lastFlightLog=0
        lastTargetLog=0;lastTargetKind=nil
        pilotState.turn=1;pilotState.near=false;pilotState.breakUntil=0
        pilotState.lastModel=nil;pilotState.lastPos=nil;pilotState.lastTime=nil
        T.running=true
    end
    function flight:observe(e)
        if not T.running or type(e)~="table" then return end
        if e.K=="Session" then
            T.sessionGeneration=e.Generation or T.sessionGeneration
            if type(e.State)=="table" then
                phaseUpdate(e.State.Phase,"SESSION")
                T.bossHP=tonumber(e.State.HP) or T.bossHP
                T.maxHP=tonumber(e.State.MaxHP) or T.maxHP
                T.escape=tonumber(e.State.Escape) or T.escape
                if type(e.State.Refuel)=="table" then
                    T.refuelState=e.State.Refuel.State or T.refuelState
                end
            end
        elseif e.K=="State" then
            phaseUpdate(e.Phase,"STATE")
            T.bossHP=tonumber(e.HP) or T.bossHP
            T.maxHP=tonumber(e.MaxHP) or T.maxHP
            T.escape=tonumber(e.Escape) or T.escape
            if type(e.Refuel)=="table" then T.refuelState=e.Refuel.State or T.refuelState end
        elseif e.K=="Phase" then
            phaseUpdate(e.Phase,"EVENT")
        elseif e.K=="Refuel" then
            local state=e.State or (type(e.Refuel)=="table" and e.Refuel.State)
            if state then
                T.refuelState=state
                log("REFUEL",{state=state,at=e.At,tanker=e.Tanker})
            end
        elseif e.K=="Ecm" or e.K=="Escape" then
            log("MECHANIC",{event=e.K,active=e.Active,escape=e.Escape})
        elseif e.K=="Outcome" then
            completed=true
            pilot:stop()
            log("FLIGHT_OUTCOME",{victory=e.Victory,reason=e.Reason})
        end
    end
    local loaded=false
    function flight:start(ctx)
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return false,"CANCELLED" end
        T.running=true
        if not loaded then
            local folder=RS:FindFirstChild("ClientModules")
            flightRuntime=loadMod(folder and folder:FindFirstChild("ManualFlightRuntime"))
            flightController=loadMod(folder and folder:FindFirstChild("ManualFlightController"))
            local sf=folder and folder:FindFirstChild("SR71")
            nativeController=loadMod(sf and sf:FindFirstChild("Controller"))
            loaded=true
            log("FLIGHT_CAPABILITIES",{runtime=flightRuntime~=nil,
                controller=flightController~=nil,native=nativeController~=nil,
                autoPilotApi=flightController~=nil and type(flightController.SetAutoPilot)=="function"})
        end
        flightWaitUntil=os.clock()+settings.flightStartTimeoutSeconds
        jobContext=ctx
        ctx:deferCleanup(function() if jobContext==ctx then self:stop() end end)
        return true
    end
    function flight:step()
        if not T.running or completed then return end
        local plane=flightBinding()
        local active=plane~=nil
        T.flightActive=active
        if active then
            if not activeSince then
                activeSince=os.clock()
                log("FLIGHT_VERIFIED",{nativeControl=true,autoPilot=settings.autoPilot})
            end
            if settings.autoPilot then
                T.autoPilotInstalled=pilot:install(flightRuntime,flightController,plane,flightBinding,pilotFrame)
            end
        else
            pilot:clear("FLIGHT_HANDOFF_PENDING")
            T.autoPilotInstalled=false
        end
        if nativeController and type(nativeController.Debug)=="function"
            and os.clock()>=lastFlightLog then
            lastFlightLog=os.clock()+9
            local ok,d=pcall(nativeController.Debug)
            if ok and type(d)=="table" then
                T.shots=tonumber(d.Shots) or T.shots
                log("FLIGHT_STATUS",{pilotState=d.PilotState,pilotHP=d.PilotHP,
                    distance=d.Distance,shots=d.Shots,missiles=d.Missiles,
                    ecm=d.Ecm,refuel=d.Refuel,escape=d.Escape,
                    serverPhase=d.ServerPhase,autoPilot=T.autoPilotInstalled})
            end
        end
    end
    function flight:exhausted()
        return T.running and not completed and not activeSince
            and os.clock()>flightWaitUntil
    end
    function flight:status()
        return {phase=T.phase,bossHP=T.bossHP,escape=T.escape,
            flightActive=T.flightActive,autoPilotInstalled=T.autoPilotInstalled,
            refuelState=T.refuelState,targetKind=T.targetKind,
            targetDistance=T.targetDistance,shots=T.shots}
    end
    function flight:stop()
        T.running=false
        T.autoPilotInstalled=false
        pilot:stop()
        jobContext=nil
    end
    return flight
end
return FlightController
end
-- END MODULE boss.SR71.FlightController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.SR71.RepeatPolicy

--!nonstrict
local SharedRepeatPolicy = require("boss.shared.RepeatPolicy")
local RepeatPolicy = {}

    return SharedRepeatPolicy.new(env, "Expected confirmed SR71 outcome")
end
return RepeatPolicy
end

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.SR71.ReportController
__factories["boss.SR71.ReportController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- SR71 adaptive report: Outcome -> report (arena or hideout) -> Continue -> exit -> return.
-- Port of standalone V1; never treat Outcome alone as a completed report.
local DeferredOutcome = require("boss.shared.DeferredOutcome")
local ReportController = {}

function ReportController.new(env, config, repeatPolicy, flight)
    local platform, gui, runtime = env.services.roblox, env.services.gui, env.runtime
    local player = platform:player()
    local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
    local writer = env.state:port("boss")
    local terminal = DeferredOutcome.new(env, config.bossId, "SR71FightGeneration")
    local report = {}
    local confirmedOutcome, outcomeAt = nil, nil
    local lastHealthAt = 0
    local seenReport, firstOpenedAt = false, nil
    local listeningContext, connections, resultsController = nil, {}, nil
    local observedSR71, generation = false, nil
    local function emit(name, data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit(name, data or {}) end
    end
    local function loadController()
        if resultsController then return resultsController end
        local folder = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("ClientModules")
        local mod = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("BossResultsController")
        if not mod or not mod:IsA("ModuleScript") then return nil end
        -- The build bundler replaces project requires. Invoke Roblox require only
        -- dynamically for the game's own ModuleScript, as the B21 controller does.
        local loader = getfenv(0)["require"]
        local ok, value = pcall(loader, mod)
        if not ok or type(value) ~= "table" then return nil end
        if type(value.IsOpen) ~= "function" or type(value.Dismiss) ~= "function" then return nil end
        resultsController = value
        return value
    end
    local function officialOpen()
        local ctrl = loadController()
        if ctrl and type(ctrl.IsOpen) == "function" then
            local ok, result = pcall(ctrl.IsOpen)
            if ok and result == true then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function isOpen()
        return player:GetAttribute("BossResultsOpen") == true or officialOpen()
    end
    local function matchingReport(guiRoot)
        if not guiRoot then return nil end
        local isSR71, won, lost = false, false, false
        for _,node in ipairs(guiRoot:GetDescendants()) do
            if node:IsA("TextLabel") then
                local value = string.upper(tostring(node.Text or ""))
                if value:find("SR71", 1, true) or value:find("SR-71", 1, true) or value:find("BLACKBIRD", 1, true) then isSR71 = true end
                if value:find("DEFEATED", 1, true) or value:find("VICTORY", 1, true)
                    or value:find("MISSION COMPLETE", 1, true) then won = true end
                if value:find("MISSION FAILED", 1, true) or value:find("DEFEAT", 1, true) then lost = true end
            end
        end
        if isSR71 and won ~= lost then return won and "WIN" or "LOSS" end
        return nil
    end

    local function observerSR71Active()
        return player:GetAttribute("SR71Participant")==true
            or player:GetAttribute("SR71FightState")=="Active"
            or platform:workspace():GetAttribute("SR71FightState")=="Active"
    end
    local function closeConnections()
        for _,conn in ipairs(connections) do conn:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(connections)
        listeningContext=nil
    end
    local function listen(remote,fn)
        local connection=remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(fn)
        table.insert(connections,connection)
    end
    function report:watch(ctx)
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return false,"CANCELLED" end
        if listeningContext==ctx and #connections>0 then return true end
        closeConnections()
        local folder=platform:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        local remote=folder and folder:FindFirstChild("SR71Event")
        if not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
            return false,"SR71_EVENT_MISSING"
        end
        listen(remote,function(packet)
            if type(packet)~="table" or type(packet.K)~="string" then return end
            -- Only collect evidence for our SR71 encounter. Do not steal an unrelated
            -- boss's Outcome (shared game client events may remain connected).
            local current=observerSR71Active()
            if packet.K=="Session" or packet.K=="Launch" or packet.K=="Begin" then
                if current then
                    observedSR71=true
                    generation=packet.Generation or generation
                end
            end
            if not observedSR71 and not current then return end
            if generation~=nil and packet.Generation~=nil
                and packet.Generation~=generation then return end
            terminal:observe(packet)
            flight:observe(packet)
            if packet.K=="Phase" then
                emit("SR71_PHASE",{phase=packet.Phase})
            elseif packet.K=="Refuel" then
                emit("SR71_REFUEL",{state=packet.State,at=packet.At})
            elseif packet.K=="Outcome" then
                confirmedOutcome=packet.Victory==true and "WIN" or "LOSS"
                outcomeAt=runtime:now()
                emit("SR71_OUTCOME",{outcome=confirmedOutcome,reason=packet.Reason})
            end
        end)
        listeningContext=ctx
        ctx:deferCleanup(function()
            if listeningContext==ctx then closeConnections() end
        end)
        return true
    end
    function report:cleanup()
        closeConnections()
        flight:stop()
        -- Keep outcome evidence for checkpoint reconciliation.
    end
    function report:resetOutcome()
        terminal:reset()
        confirmedOutcome,outcomeAt,seenReport,firstOpenedAt=nil,nil,false,nil
        observedSR71=false;generation=nil
        flight:reset()
    end
    function report:verifiedDeferredOutcome(encounter) return terminal:verified(encounter, encounter.outcome) end
    function report:inspect()
        local root = gui:find(env.profile.paths.bossReport)
        local active = isOpen() -- Same verified V2 signal: BossResultsOpen or official controller.IsOpen()
        if active then
            seenReport = true
            firstOpenedAt = firstOpenedAt or runtime:now()
        end
        local guiOutcome = active and matchingReport(root) or nil
        local outcome = confirmedOutcome or guiOutcome
        return {
            active = active, matchesBoss = confirmedOutcome ~= nil or guiOutcome ~= nil,
            outcome = outcome, report = root, seen = seenReport,
            pendingPresentation = confirmedOutcome ~= nil and not seenReport
                and outcomeAt ~= nil and runtime:now() - outcomeAt < config.reportTimeoutSeconds,
        }
    end
    function report:reconcile(encounter)
        local evidence = self:inspect()
        if evidence.matchesBoss and evidence.outcome
            and (not encounter.outcome or encounter.outcome == evidence.outcome) then return true end
        return encounter.outcome ~= nil and seenReport and not evidence.active
    end
    function report:resolve(ctx, encounter)
        local watching, why = self:watch(ctx)
        if not watching then return {ok = false, code = why} end
        -- V2 REQUIREMENT: Outcome alone never authorizes return/Continue.
        local evidence = ctx:await(function()
            local current = self:inspect()
            if current.active and current.matchesBoss and current.outcome then return current end
            if seenReport and not current.active and (encounter.outcome or current.outcome) then
                return current -- manually dismissed report after previously observing it
            end
        end, config.reportTimeoutSeconds)
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        if not evidence then return {ok = false, code = "SR71_REPORT_NOT_OBSERVED"} end
        if evidence.outcome and encounter.outcome and evidence.outcome ~= encounter.outcome then
            return {ok = false, held = true, code = "BOSS_OUTCOME_CONFLICT"}
        end
        local outcome = evidence.outcome or encounter.outcome
        if not outcome then return {ok = false, code = "SR71_OUTCOME_UNVERIFIED"} end
        if not encounter.outcome then
            local accepted = writer:recordBossReport(outcome,
                runtime:epoch() + repeatPolicy:outcomeDelay(outcome))
            if not accepted then return {ok = false, held = true, code = "BOSS_OUTCOME_CONFLICT"} end
            encounter = env.state:snapshot().boss.encounter
        end
        if not evidence.active then
            writer:closeReport()
            return {ok = true, code = "SR71_REPORT_MANUALLY_CLOSED"}
        end
        local at = platform:position()
        local place = player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") == true and "HIDEOUT" or "OTHER"
        if place == "OTHER" and at then
            local center = Vector3.new(config.arenaFallbackCenter.x,
                config.arenaFallbackCenter.y, config.arenaFallbackCenter.z)
            if (at - center).Magnitude < config.arenaRadius then
                place = "ARENA"
            end
        end
        emit("SR71_REPORT_OPEN", {outcome = outcome, location = place,
            inBossFight = player:GetAttribute("InBossFight")})
        local controller = loadController()
        if not controller then return {ok = false, code = "SR71_RESULT_CONTROLLER_MISSING_MANUAL_CONTINUE"} end
        if not encounter.continueAttempted then
            local ready = ctx:await(function()
                if not isOpen() then return "MANUALLY_CLOSED" end
                local armed = false
                if type(controller.Debug) == "function" then
                    local ok, message = pcall(controller.Debug)
                    armed = ok and type(message) == "string"
                        and message:find("armed=true", 1, true) ~= nil
                end
                if armed and firstOpenedAt
                    and runtime:now() - firstOpenedAt >= config.reportHoldSeconds then return "ARMED" end
            end, config.reportTimeoutSeconds)
            if ctx:isCancelled() then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
            if ready == "MANUALLY_CLOSED" then
                writer:closeReport()
                return {ok = true, code = "SR71_REPORT_MANUALLY_CLOSED"}
            end
            if ready ~= "ARMED" then return {ok = false, code = "SR71_REPORT_NOT_ARMED_MANUAL_CONTINUE"} end
            if not writer:markContinueAttempt() then return {ok = false, code = "SR71_CONTINUE_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED"} end
            local sent, err = pcall(function() controller.Dismiss("continue") end)
            if not sent then return {ok = false, code = "SR71_CONTINUE_FAILED: " .. tostring(err)} end
            emit("SR71_REPORT_CONTINUE", {code = "CONTINUE_REQUESTED"})
        end
        local closed = ctx:await(function() if not self:inspect().active then return true end end,
            config.reportCloseTimeoutSeconds)
        if not closed then return {ok = false, code = "SR71_REPORT_STILL_OPEN_MANUAL_CONTINUE"} end
        writer:closeReport()
        return {ok = true, code = "SR71_REPORT_CLOSED"}
    end
    return report
end
return ReportController
end
-- END MODULE boss.SR71.ReportController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.SR71.SR71
__factories["boss.SR71.SR71"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local Config=require("boss.SR71.Config")
local ArenaObserver=require("boss.SR71.ArenaObserver")
local CommandController=require("boss.SR71.CommandController")
local CombatController=require("boss.SR71.CombatController")
local FlightController=require("boss.SR71.FlightController")
local ReportController=require("boss.SR71.ReportController")
local RepeatPolicy=require("boss.SR71.RepeatPolicy")
local SR71={}
function SR71.definition()
    return {bossId=Config.bossId,displayName=Config.displayName,create=function(env)
        local observer=ArenaObserver.new(env,Config)
        local flight=FlightController.new(env,Config,observer)
        local repeatPolicy=RepeatPolicy.new(env)
        local report=ReportController.new(env,Config,repeatPolicy,flight)
        return {config=Config,observer=observer,flight=flight,report=report,
            repeatPolicy=repeatPolicy,command=CommandController.new(env,Config,observer,report),
            combat=CombatController.new(env,Config,observer,report,flight)}
    end}
end
return SR71
end
-- END MODULE boss.SR71.SR71

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.Tu95.ArenaObserver
__factories["boss.Tu95.ArenaObserver"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local ArenaObserver = {}
function ArenaObserver.new(env, config)
    local platform = env.services.roblox
    local player, workspace = platform:player(), platform:workspace()
    local observer = {}
    function observer:participating()
        -- Workspace fight state may belong to another player.
        return player:GetAttribute("Tu95Participant") == true
    end
    function observer:inArenaPosition()
        local pos = platform:position()
        if not pos then return false end
        local dx, dz = pos.X - config.arenaCenter.x, pos.Z - config.arenaCenter.z
        return dx*dx + dz*dz < (config.arenaRadius+8)^2
            and pos.Y > -65 and pos.Y < 215
    end
    function observer:inArena()
        return self:participating() or
            (workspace:GetAttribute("Tu95FightActive") == true
                and self:inArenaPosition()
                and player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true)
    end
    function observer:state()
        return {phase = workspace:GetAttribute("Tu95Phase"),
            fightState = workspace:GetAttribute("Tu95FightState"),
            active = workspace:GetAttribute("Tu95FightActive"),
            participant = player:GetAttribute("Tu95Participant"),
            inBossFight = player:GetAttribute("InBossFight"),
            intercepting = player:GetAttribute("Tu95Intercepting")}
    end
    return observer
end
return ArenaObserver
end
-- END MODULE boss.Tu95.ArenaObserver

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.Tu95.CombatController
__factories["boss.Tu95.CombatController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Run Tu95 combat/defense observations; no repeat Solo attempts.
local CombatController = {}
function CombatController.new(env, config, observer, report, interceptor)
    local runtime, telemetry = env.runtime, env.services.telemetry
    local combat = {}
    function combat:run(ctx, encounter)
        local watching, why = report:watch(ctx)
        if not watching then return {code = why} end
        interceptor:start(ctx)
        local deadline = runtime:now() + config.maxFightSeconds
        local previous, lastEmit = nil, 0
        local code = "OUTCOME_NOT_OBSERVED_TIMEOUT"
        while not ctx:isCancelled() and runtime:now() < deadline do
            if report:inspect().outcome then code = "OUTCOME_OBSERVED"; break end
            local state = observer:state()
            local key = tostring(state.fightState).."/"..tostring(state.phase).."/"
                ..tostring(state.active).."/"..tostring(state.participant)
            if key ~= previous or runtime:now()-lastEmit > 25 then
                if telemetry then telemetry:emit("TU95_STATE", state) end
                previous, lastEmit = key, runtime:now()
            end
            if not ctx:wait(0.4) then break end
        end
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return {code = "CANCELLED"} end
        return {code = code}
    end
    return combat
end
return CombatController
end
-- END MODULE boss.Tu95.CombatController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.Tu95.CommandController
__factories["boss.Tu95.CommandController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Tu95 standalone V1 flow: Hideout -> Boss Command pass -> ONE Solo -> combat.
-- Adaptive report may open in arena OR after exit; never request return before Continue.
local DirectBossTravel = require("main.navigation.DirectBossTravel")
local CommandController = {}

function CommandController.new(env, config, observer, report)
    local platform, runtime = env.services.roblox, env.runtime
    local player, workspace = platform:player(), platform:workspace()
    local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
    local travel = DirectBossTravel.new(env)
    local command = {}
    local function emit(name, data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit(name, data or {}) end
    end
    local function remote(name)
        local storage = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage")
        local folder = storage:FindFirstChild("Remotes") or storage:WaitForChild("Remotes", 10)
        local item = folder and (folder:FindFirstChild(name) or folder:WaitForChild(name, 7))
        return item and item:IsA("RemoteEvent") and item or nil
    end
    local function active(ctx) return runtime:isActive(ctx) and not ctx:isCancelled() end
    local function cooldownLeft()
        local raw = player:GetAttribute("BossStartCooldowns")
        if type(raw) ~= "string" or raw == "" then return 0 end
        local ok, data = pcall(function() return platform:service("HttpService"):JSONDecode(raw) end)
        if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then return 0 end
        return math.max(0, (tonumber(data[config.gameBossKey]) or 0) - workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
    end

    function command:prepare(ctx)
        local watching, why = report:watch(ctx) -- watch BEFORE sending any boss request
        if not watching then return false, why end
        if observer:inArena() then return true, "TU95_ALREADY_IN_ARENA" end
        if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true then return false, "OTHER_BOSS_ACTIVE" end
        if not active(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        local entered = travel:enterHideout(ctx)
        emit("TU95_DIRECT_HIDEOUT", {ok = entered.ok, code = entered.code, reason = entered.reason})
        if not entered.ok then return false, entered.code end
        local positioned = travel:moveToKnownPoint(ctx, config.commandSafePosition, {
            requireHideout = true, radius = 6, settle = 0.85,
        })
        emit("TU95_COMMAND_POSITION", {ok = positioned.ok, code = positioned.code})
        if not positioned.ok then return false, positioned.code end
        return true, "TU95_COMMAND_READY"
    end

    function command:readiness()
        if observer:inArena() then return "READY" end
        if not travel:inHideout() then return "UNKNOWN" end
        local secs = cooldownLeft()
        if secs > 0 then
            secs = math.ceil(secs)
            return string.format("%d:%02d", math.floor(secs / 60), secs % 60)
        end
        -- The server pass remains authoritative for unlock/eligibility.
        return "READY"
    end

    function command:startSolo(ctx, markAttempt)
        if not active(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        if observer:participating() then return true, "TU95_ALREADY_FIGHTING" end
        if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true then return false, "OTHER_BOSS_ACTIVE" end
        if not travel:inHideout() then return false, "NOT_IN_HIDEOUT" end
        if self:readiness() ~= "READY" then return false, "TU95_NOT_READY" end
        local watching, why = report:watch(ctx)
        if not watching then return false, why end
        local hideout, accept = remote("PersonalHideoutRemote"), remote("Tu95CommanderAccept")
        if not hideout or not accept then return false, "TU95_COMMAND_REMOTES_MISSING" end
        local passReply, acceptReply
        local passConnection = hideout.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
            if type(e) == "table" and e.Kind == "BossCommand" and e.Op == "Start"
                and e.BossKey == config.gameBossKey then passReply = e end
        end)
        local acceptConnection = accept.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
            if type(e) == "table" and e.Accepted ~= nil then acceptReply = e end
        end)
        local function finish(ok, code)
            passConnection:Disconnect()
            acceptConnection:Disconnect()
            return ok, code
        end
        local sent, err = pcall(function()
            hideout:FireServer({Action = "StartBoss", BossKey = config.gameBossKey, Solo = true})
        end)
        if not sent then return finish(false, "TU95_PASS_SEND_FAILED: " .. tostring(err)) end
        local gotPass = ctx:await(function() return passReply end, 10)
        if not active(ctx) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
        if not gotPass then return finish(false, "TU95_PASS_TIMEOUT_NO_RETRY") end
        emit("TU95_PASS_RESULT", {ok = gotPass.Ok == true, reason = gotPass.Reason})
        if gotPass.Ok ~= true then return finish(false, "TU95_PASS_REJECTED: " .. tostring(gotPass.Reason)) end
        -- Mark before firing the irreversible Solo request; never blind retry.
        if not markAttempt() then return finish(false, "TU95_SOLO_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED") end
        sent, err = pcall(function() accept:FireServer({Solo = true}) end)
        if not sent then return finish(false, "TU95_SOLO_SEND_FAILED: " .. tostring(err)) end
        local observed = ctx:await(function()
            if acceptReply and acceptReply.Accepted == false then return "REJECTED" end
            if observer:participating() then return "ENTERED" end
        end, config.arenaTimeout)
        if not active(ctx) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
        emit("TU95_SOLO_RESULT", {code = observed or "AMBIGUOUS", accepted = acceptReply and acceptReply.Accepted})
        if observed == "ENTERED" then return finish(true, "TU95_FIGHT_VERIFIED") end
        if observed == "REJECTED" then
            return finish(false, "TU95_SOLO_REJECTED: " .. tostring(acceptReply.Reason))
        end
        return finish(false, "TU95_SOLO_AMBIGUOUS_NO_RETRY")
    end

    function command:close(_) return true end -- No command GUI was opened.

    function command:returnHome(ctx, home)
        if not active(ctx) then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        if type(home) ~= "number" or home < 1 or home % 1 ~= 0 then
            return {ok = false, code = "INVALID_HOME_WORLD"}
        end
        if report:inspect().active then return {ok = false, code = "TU95_REPORT_STILL_OPEN"} end
        -- Preserve standalone V1 lock checks before return, regardless of report location.
        local released = ctx:await(function()
            if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true
                and player:GetAttribute("Tu95Participant") ~= true then return true end
        end, config.returnLockTimeoutSeconds)
        if not released then
            emit("TU95_RETURN_LOCK_PENDING", {world = home})
            return {ok = false, code = "TU95_RETURN_LOCK_PENDING", reason = "BossFight"}
        end
        local exit = ctx:await(function()
            if player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") == true then return "BOSS_COMMAND_HIDEOUT" end
            if not observer:inArenaPosition() then return "OUTSIDE_ARENA" end
        end, config.exitTimeoutSeconds)
        emit("TU95_ARENA_EXIT", {code = exit or "LOCK_RELEASED_STILL_IN_ARENA"})
        -- As in tested standalone V1, a released lock permits a direct verified travel even
        -- if the game has not repositioned the player outside the arena yet.
        if not ctx:wait(1.5) then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        local request, prepare, result = remote("RequestWorldTravel"), remote("NavPrepareWorlds"), remote("WorldTravelResult")
        if not request or not prepare then return {ok = false, code = "TU95_WORLD_TRAVEL_REMOTES_MISSING"} end
        local position = platform:position()
        if not position then return {ok = false, code = "CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE"} end
        if tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")) == home
            and player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") ~= true
            and not observer:inArenaPosition() then
            return {ok = true, code = "ALREADY_IN_HOME", world = home}
        end
        local reply
        local connection = result and result.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
            if type(e) == "table" and e.Kind == "Result" and tonumber(e.WorldId) == home then reply = e end
        end) or nil
        local function finish(ok, code, reason)
            if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
            emit("TU95_DIRECT_RETURN", {ok = ok, code = code, reason = reason, world = home})
            return {ok = ok, code = code, reason = reason, world = home}
        end
        for attempt = 1, config.returnRetries do
            if not active(ctx) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            reply = nil
            local prior = platform:position()
            if not prior then return finish(false, "CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE") end
            local sent, err = pcall(function() prepare:FireServer("stream", home) end)
            if not sent then return finish(false, "WORLD_PREPARE_SEND_FAILED", tostring(err)) end
            if not ctx:wait(0.12) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            sent, err = pcall(function() request:FireServer(home) end)
            if not sent then return finish(false, "WORLD_REQUEST_SEND_FAILED", tostring(err)) end
            local observed = ctx:await(function()
                if reply and reply.Ok == false then return "REJECTED" end
                local current = platform:position()
                if current and platform:distance(current, prior) > 50
                    and tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")) == home
                    and player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") ~= true
                    and player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true
                    and not observer:inArenaPosition() then return "VERIFIED" end
            end, 17)
            emit("TU95_RETURN_ATTEMPT", {attempt = attempt, code = observed or "AMBIGUOUS",
                reason = reply and reply.Reason})
            if observed == "VERIFIED" then return finish(true, "TU95_HOME_VERIFIED") end
            if observed ~= "REJECTED" then return finish(false, "TU95_RETURN_AMBIGUOUS_NO_RETRY") end
            local why = tostring(reply.Reason or "UNKNOWN")
            if why ~= "BossFight" or attempt == config.returnRetries then
                return finish(false, "TU95_WORLD_RETURN_REJECTED", why)
            end
            if not ctx:wait(12) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            local settled = ctx:await(function()
                if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true then return true end
            end, 40)
            if not settled then return finish(false, "TU95_LOCK_STILL_ACTIVE", "BossFight") end
        end
        return finish(false, "TU95_WORLD_RETURN_EXHAUSTED")
    end
    return command
end
return CommandController
end
-- END MODULE boss.Tu95.CommandController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.Tu95.Config
__factories["boss.Tu95.Config"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Tu-95 Bear World 25. Coordinates and command names from tested standalone V1.
return {
    bossId = "TU95", displayName = "Tu-95 Bear", gameBossKey = "Tu95",
    arenaCenter = {x = 32768, y = 1, z = -12288},
    arenaRadius = 175,
    commandSafePosition = {x = -31962.1074, y = 344.357483, z = 32887.3203},
    arenaTimeout = 48, maxFightSeconds = 900,
    reportTimeoutSeconds = 110, reportHoldSeconds = 3,
    reportCloseTimeoutSeconds = 125, exitTimeoutSeconds = 85,

    autoIntercept = true, interceptMinInterval = 4,
    maxInterceptRequests = 12, interceptMissileDelay = 1.1,
}
end

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.Tu95.InterceptController
__factories["boss.Tu95.InterceptController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Tu95 standalone V1 missile-tracking and bounded Intercept behavior.
-- Operates only when Tu95Participant and InBossFight are true.
local InterceptController = {}
function InterceptController.new(env, config, observer)
    local platform, runtime = env.services.roblox, env.runtime
    local player, workspace = platform:player(), platform:workspace()
    local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
    local controller = {}
    local missiles, resolved = {}, {}
    local state = {ordered = false, requests = 0, refused = 0, lastRequest = -math.huge,
        launched = 0, intercepted = 0, impacted = 0, lost = 0,
        gate = nil, lastGate = nil, lastGateAt = -math.huge,
        lastAckAt = -math.huge, integrity = nil, strategicStage = nil,
        escapeAt = nil, ended = false, lastPhase = nil, lastAttack = nil}
    local runningContext = nil
    local orderRemote = nil
    local function emit(kind, data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit("TU95_" .. kind, data or {}) end
    end
    local function liveCount()
        local n=0
        for _ in pairs(missiles) do n += 1 end
        return n
    end
    local function gate(reason, data)
        state.gate = reason
        local now = runtime:now()
        if state.lastGate == reason and now - state.lastGateAt < 4 then return end
        state.lastGate, state.lastGateAt = reason, now
        local row = data or {}
        row.reason = reason
        emit("INTERCEPT_GATE", row)
    end
    local function onMissile(e, source)
        if type(e) ~= "table" then return end
        local id = e.Id
        if type(id) ~= "string" and type(id) ~= "number" then
            gate("MISSILE_NO_ID", {source = source}); return
        end
        local key, stage = tostring(id), tostring(e.Stage or "Launched")
        local terminal = stage == "Intercepted" or stage == "Impact" or stage == "Lost"
        if terminal then
            if not resolved[key] then
                if stage == "Intercepted" then state.intercepted += 1
                elseif stage == "Impact" then state.impacted += 1
                elseif stage == "Lost" then state.lost += 1 end
            end
            resolved[key], missiles[key] = true, nil
        elseif not resolved[key] and not missiles[key] then
            missiles[key] = {seenAt = runtime:now(), impactAt = tonumber(e.ImpactAt), target = e.TargetId}
            state.launched += 1
        end
        local integrity = tonumber(e.Integrity)
        if integrity then state.integrity = integrity end
        emit("MISSILE_TRACK", {source = source, id = key, stage = stage,
            impactAt = tonumber(e.ImpactAt), targetId = e.TargetId,
            live = liveCount(), integrity = integrity})
    end
    function controller:observe(e)
        if type(e) ~= "table" or type(e.K) ~= "string" then return end
        local k = e.K
        if k == "Missile" then onMissile(e, "EVENT") end
        if k == "Session" and type(e.Missiles) == "table" then
            for _, missile in ipairs(e.Missiles) do onMissile(missile, "SESSION") end
        end
        if k == "End" or k == "Death" or k == "Outcome" then state.ended = true end
        if k == "Order" then
            if e.State == "On" then state.ordered = true
            elseif e.State == "Off" then state.ordered = false
            elseif e.State == "Refused" then state.refused += 1 end
            state.lastAckAt = runtime:now()
            emit("INTERCEPT_ACK", {state = e.State, ordered = state.ordered, refused = state.refused})
        end
        if k == "Session" and type(e.Order) == "table" and e.Order.State then
            state.ordered = e.Order.State == "On"
        end
        if (k == "Installation" or k == "Session" or k == "Missile")
            and type(e.Integrity) == "number" and state.integrity ~= e.Integrity then
            state.integrity = e.Integrity
            emit("INSTALLATION", {integrity = e.Integrity, source = k})
        end
        if k == "Strategic" then
            state.strategicStage = tostring(e.Stage or "UNKNOWN")
            emit("STRATEGIC", {stage = state.strategicStage,
                launcher = type(e.Launcher) == "table" and e.Launcher.Integrity or nil,
                countdown = e.CountdownAt})
        end
        if k == "Escape" then
            state.escapeAt = e.EscapeAt
            emit("ESCAPE", {startAt = e.StartAt, escapeAt = e.EscapeAt})
        end
        if k == "Phase" or (k == "Session" and e.Phase) then
            state.lastPhase = e.Phase
        end
        if k == "Attack" then state.lastAttack = tostring(e.Kind or "UNKNOWN") end
    end
    function controller:reset()
        if runningContext then return end
        missiles, resolved = {}, {}
        state = {ordered = false, requests = 0, refused = 0, lastRequest = -math.huge,
            launched = 0, intercepted = 0, impacted = 0, lost = 0,
            gate = nil, lastGate = nil, lastGateAt = -math.huge,
            lastAckAt = -math.huge, integrity = nil, strategicStage = nil,
            escapeAt = nil, ended = false, lastPhase = nil, lastAttack = nil}
    end
    function controller:status()
        return {liveMissiles = liveCount(), ordered = state.ordered,
            requests = state.requests, refused = state.refused, intercepted = state.intercepted,
            impacted = state.impacted, launched = state.launched, installationIntegrity = state.integrity,
            strategicStage = state.strategicStage, gate = state.gate}
    end
    function controller:start(ctx)
        if runningContext == ctx then return end
        if runningContext then return end -- single worker, never create a second fire loop
        runningContext = ctx
        local folder = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        orderRemote = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("Tu95Order")
        if not orderRemote or not orderRemote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
            orderRemote = nil
            emit("INTERCEPT_WARNING", {reason = "TU95_ORDER_REMOTE_MISSING"})
        end
        ctx:deferCleanup(function()
            if runningContext == ctx then runningContext = nil end
            orderRemote = nil
        end)
        task.spawn(function()
            while runningContext == ctx and not ctx:isCancelled()
                and runtime:isActive(ctx) and not state.ended do
                if not config.autoIntercept then
                    gate("DISABLED")
                elseif not orderRemote then
                    gate("ORDER_REMOTE_MISSING")
                elseif not observer:participating() or player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true then
                    gate("NOT_PARTICIPATING")
                elseif liveCount() == 0 then
                    gate("NO_LIVE_MISSILES")
                elseif state.ordered or player:GetAttribute("Tu95Intercepting") == true then
                    gate("ALREADY_INTERCEPTING")
                elseif state.requests >= config.maxInterceptRequests then
                    gate("REQUEST_LIMIT")
                else
                    local now, eligible = runtime:now(), false
                    for _, missile in pairs(missiles) do
                        if now - missile.seenAt >= config.interceptMissileDelay then
                            eligible = true; break
                        end
                    end
                    if not eligible then
                        gate("MISSILE_NOT_ELIGIBLE_YET")
                    elseif now - state.lastRequest < config.interceptMinInterval then
                        gate("INTERVAL_WAIT")
                    elseif workspace:GetAttribute("Tu95FightState") ~= "Active" then
                        gate("FIGHT_NOT_ACTIVE", {state = workspace:GetAttribute("Tu95FightState")})
                    else
                        state.requests += 1
                        state.lastRequest = now
                        emit("INTERCEPT_REQUEST", {request = state.requests,
                            liveMissiles = liveCount(), command = "Intercept"})
                        local ok, err = pcall(function() orderRemote:FireServer("Intercept") end)
                        if not ok then emit("INTERCEPT_SEND_ERROR", {reason = tostring(err)}) end
                    end
                end
                if not ctx:wait(0.4) then break end
            end
        end)
    end
    return controller
end
return InterceptController
end
-- END MODULE boss.Tu95.InterceptController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.Tu95.RepeatPolicy
__factories["boss.Tu95.RepeatPolicy"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local SharedRepeatPolicy = require("boss.shared.RepeatPolicy")
local RepeatPolicy = {}
function RepeatPolicy.new(env)
    return SharedRepeatPolicy.new(env, "Expected confirmed Tu95 outcome")
end
return RepeatPolicy
end
-- END MODULE boss.Tu95.RepeatPolicy

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.Tu95.ReportController
__factories["boss.Tu95.ReportController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local DeferredOutcome = require("boss.shared.DeferredOutcome")
-- Tu95 adaptive report: Outcome -> report (arena or hideout) -> Continue -> exit -> return.
-- Port of standalone V1; never treat Outcome alone as a completed report.
local ReportController = {}

function ReportController.new(env, config, repeatPolicy, interceptController)
    local platform, gui, runtime = env.services.roblox, env.services.gui, env.runtime
    local player = platform:player()
    local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
    local writer = env.state:port("boss")
    local report = {}
    local terminal = DeferredOutcome.new(env, config.bossId, "Tu95FightGeneration")
    local confirmedOutcome, outcomeAt = nil, nil
    local lastHealthAt = 0
    local seenReport, firstOpenedAt = false, nil
    local listeningContext, connection, resultsController = nil, nil, nil
    local function emit(name, data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit(name, data or {}) end
    end
    local function loadController()
        if resultsController then return resultsController end
        local folder = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("ClientModules")
        local mod = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("BossResultsController")
        if not mod or not mod:IsA("ModuleScript") then return nil end
        -- The build bundler replaces project requires. Invoke Roblox require only
        -- dynamically for the game's own ModuleScript, as the B21 controller does.
        local loader = getfenv(0)["require"]
        local ok, value = pcall(loader, mod)
        if not ok or type(value) ~= "table" then return nil end
        if type(value.IsOpen) ~= "function" or type(value.Dismiss) ~= "function" then return nil end
        resultsController = value
        return value
    end
    local function officialOpen()
        local ctrl = loadController()
        if ctrl and type(ctrl.IsOpen) == "function" then
            local ok, result = pcall(ctrl.IsOpen)
            if ok and result == true then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function isOpen()
        return player:GetAttribute("BossResultsOpen") == true or officialOpen()
    end
    local function matchingReport(guiRoot)
        if not guiRoot then return nil end
        local isTu95, won, lost = false, false, false
        for _, node in ipairs(guiRoot:GetDescendants()) do
            if node:IsA("TextLabel") then
                local value = string.upper(tostring(node.Text or ""))
                if value:find("TU-95", 1, true) or value:find("TU95", 1, true)
                    or value:find("BEAR", 1, true) then isTu95 = true end
                if value:find("DEFEATED", 1, true) or value:find("VICTORY", 1, true) then won = true end
                if value:find("MISSION FAILED", 1, true) then lost = true end
            end
        end
        if isTu95 and won ~= lost then return won and "WIN" or "LOSS" end
        return nil
    end

    function report:watch(ctx)
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        if listeningContext == ctx and connection then return true end
        if connection then connection:Disconnect(); connection = nil end
        local folder = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        local remote = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("Tu95Event")
        if not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then return false, "TU95_EVENT_MISSING" end
        local current = remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(packet)
            if type(packet) ~= "table" or type(packet.K) ~= "string" then return end
            terminal:observe(packet)
            -- Watch before Solo; track cruise missiles even during first cinematic.
            interceptController:observe(packet)
            local kind = packet.K
            if kind == "Outcome" and type(packet.Victory) == "boolean" then
                confirmedOutcome = packet.Victory and "WIN" or "LOSS"
                outcomeAt = runtime:now()
            end
            if kind == "Start" or kind == "Launch" or kind == "Session"
                or kind == "Begin" or kind == "Resync" or kind == "Phase"
                or kind == "Health" or kind == "Attack" or kind == "Order"
                or kind == "Missile" or kind == "Installation" or kind == "Volley"
                or kind == "Strategic" or kind == "Escape" or kind == "Expose"
                or kind == "Engine" or kind == "Launcher" or kind == "Bay"
                or kind == "Eliminated" or kind == "Death" or kind == "End"
                or kind == "Outcome" then
                if kind == "Health" then
                    if runtime:now() - lastHealthAt < 4 then return end
                    lastHealthAt = runtime:now()
                end
                local detail = {kind = kind}
                for _, field in ipairs({"Phase", "Name", "Kind", "State", "Stage",
                    "At", "HP", "MaxHP", "TimeLeft", "T0", "Reason", "Victory",
                    "Generation", "Outcome", "RewardEligible", "Integrity", "Count",
                    "Id", "TargetId"}) do
                    local value = packet[field]
                    if type(value) == "string" then
                        detail[field] = value:sub(1, 80)
                    elseif type(value) == "number" or type(value) == "boolean" then
                        detail[field] = value
                    end
                end
                emit("TU95_EVENT", detail)
            end
        end)
        connection, listeningContext = current, ctx
        ctx:deferCleanup(function()
            if connection == current then
                current:Disconnect()
                connection, listeningContext = nil, nil
            end
        end)
        return true
    end
    function report:cleanup()
        if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
        connection, listeningContext = nil, nil
        -- Keep outcome and report evidence across RETURN/REPORT retries.
    end
    function report:verifiedDeferredOutcome(encounter)
        return terminal:verified(encounter, "LOSS")
    end
    function report:resetOutcome()
        terminal:reset()
        confirmedOutcome, outcomeAt, seenReport, firstOpenedAt = nil, nil, false, nil
        interceptController:reset()
    end
    function report:inspect()
        local root = gui:find(env.profile.paths.bossReport)
        local active = isOpen() -- Same verified V2 signal: BossResultsOpen or official controller.IsOpen()
        if active then
            seenReport = true
            firstOpenedAt = firstOpenedAt or runtime:now()
        end
        local guiOutcome = active and matchingReport(root) or nil
        local outcome = confirmedOutcome or guiOutcome
        return {
            active = active, matchesBoss = confirmedOutcome ~= nil or guiOutcome ~= nil,
            outcome = outcome, report = root, seen = seenReport,
            pendingPresentation = confirmedOutcome ~= nil and not seenReport
                and outcomeAt ~= nil and runtime:now() - outcomeAt < config.reportTimeoutSeconds,
        }
    end
    function report:reconcile(encounter)
        local evidence = self:inspect()
        if evidence.matchesBoss and evidence.outcome
            and (not encounter.outcome or encounter.outcome == evidence.outcome) then return true end
        return encounter.outcome ~= nil and seenReport and not evidence.active
    end
    function report:resolve(ctx, encounter)
        local watching, why = self:watch(ctx)
        if not watching then return {ok = false, code = why} end
        -- V2 REQUIREMENT: Outcome alone never authorizes return/Continue.
        local evidence = ctx:await(function()
            local current = self:inspect()
            if current.active and current.matchesBoss and current.outcome then return current end
            if seenReport and not current.active and (encounter.outcome or current.outcome) then
                return current -- manually dismissed report after previously observing it
            end
        end, config.reportTimeoutSeconds)
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        if not evidence then return {ok = false, code = "TU95_REPORT_NOT_OBSERVED"} end
        if evidence.outcome and encounter.outcome and evidence.outcome ~= encounter.outcome then
            return {ok = false, held = true, code = "BOSS_OUTCOME_CONFLICT"}
        end
        local outcome = evidence.outcome or encounter.outcome
        if not outcome then return {ok = false, code = "TU95_OUTCOME_UNVERIFIED"} end
        if not encounter.outcome then
            local accepted = writer:recordBossReport(outcome,
                runtime:epoch() + repeatPolicy:outcomeDelay(outcome))
            if not accepted then return {ok = false, held = true, code = "BOSS_OUTCOME_CONFLICT"} end
            encounter = env.state:snapshot().boss.encounter
        end
        if not evidence.active then
            writer:closeReport()
            return {ok = true, code = "TU95_REPORT_MANUALLY_CLOSED"}
        end
        local at = platform:position()
        local place = player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") == true and "HIDEOUT" or "OTHER"
        if place == "OTHER" and at then
            local dx, dz = at.X - config.arenaCenter.x, at.Z - config.arenaCenter.z
            if dx * dx + dz * dz < config.arenaRadius * config.arenaRadius then
                place = "ARENA"
            end
        end
        emit("TU95_REPORT_OPEN", {outcome = outcome, location = place,
            inBossFight = player:GetAttribute("InBossFight")})
        local controller = loadController()
        if not controller then return {ok = false, code = "TU95_RESULT_CONTROLLER_MISSING_MANUAL_CONTINUE"} end
        if not encounter.continueAttempted then
            local ready = ctx:await(function()
                if not isOpen() then return "MANUALLY_CLOSED" end
                local armed = false
                if type(controller.Debug) == "function" then
                    local ok, message = pcall(controller.Debug)
                    armed = ok and type(message) == "string"
                        and message:find("armed=true", 1, true) ~= nil
                end
                if armed and firstOpenedAt
                    and runtime:now() - firstOpenedAt >= config.reportHoldSeconds then return "ARMED" end
            end, config.reportTimeoutSeconds)
            if ctx:isCancelled() then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
            if ready == "MANUALLY_CLOSED" then
                writer:closeReport()
                return {ok = true, code = "TU95_REPORT_MANUALLY_CLOSED"}
            end
            if ready ~= "ARMED" then return {ok = false, code = "TU95_REPORT_NOT_ARMED_MANUAL_CONTINUE"} end
            if not writer:markContinueAttempt() then return {ok = false, code = "TU95_CONTINUE_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED"} end
            local sent, err = pcall(function() controller.Dismiss("continue") end)
            if not sent then return {ok = false, code = "TU95_CONTINUE_FAILED: " .. tostring(err)} end
            emit("TU95_REPORT_CONTINUE", {code = "CONTINUE_REQUESTED"})
        end
        local closed = ctx:await(function() if not self:inspect().active then return true end end,
            config.reportCloseTimeoutSeconds)
        if not closed then return {ok = false, code = "TU95_REPORT_STILL_OPEN_MANUAL_CONTINUE"} end
        writer:closeReport()
        return {ok = true, code = "TU95_REPORT_CLOSED"}
    end
    return report
end
return ReportController
end
-- END MODULE boss.Tu95.ReportController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.Tu95.Tu95
__factories["boss.Tu95.Tu95"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Install Tu95 after other boss registrations, preserving original default B21.

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.U2.ArenaObserver
__factories["boss.U2.ArenaObserver"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local ArenaObserver={}
function ArenaObserver.new(env,config)
    local platform=env.services.roblox
    local player=platform:player()
    local observer={}
    function observer:participating()
        return player:GetAttribute("U2Participant")==true
    end
    function observer:inArenaPosition(pos)
        pos=pos or platform:position()
        if typeof(pos)~="Vector3" then return false end
        local c=config.arenaFallbackCenter
        local d=Vector3.new(pos.X-c.x,0,pos.Z-c.z)
        return d.Magnitude<config.arenaRadius and pos.Y>config.arenaMinY and pos.Y<config.arenaMaxY
    end
    function observer:inArena()
        return self:participating() or
            (player:GetAttribute("InBossFight")==true and self:inArenaPosition())
    end
    function observer:state()
        local W=platform:workspace()
        return {phase=player:GetAttribute("U2Phase") or W:GetAttribute("U2Phase"),
            fightState=player:GetAttribute("U2FightState") or W:GetAttribute("U2FightState"),
            active=player:GetAttribute("InBossFight"),participant=player:GetAttribute("U2Participant")}
    end
    return observer
end
return ArenaObserver
end
-- END MODULE boss.U2.ArenaObserver

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.U2.CombatController
__factories["boss.U2.CombatController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local CombatController={}
function CombatController.new(env,config,observer,report,flight)
    local runtime,telemetry=env.runtime,env.services.telemetry
    local combat={}
    local function emit(name,data) if telemetry then telemetry:emit("U2_"..name,data or {}) end end
    function combat:run(ctx,encounter)
        local ok,why=report:watch(ctx)
        if not ok then return {code=why or "U2_REPORT_WATCH_FAILED"} end
        ok,why=flight:start(ctx)
        if not ok then return {code=why or "U2_FLIGHT_INIT_FAILED"} end
        local deadline=runtime:now()+config.maxFightSeconds
        local nextLog=0
        local result="OUTCOME_NOT_OBSERVED_TIMEOUT"
        while not ctx:isCancelled() and runtime:now()<deadline do
            local evidence=report:inspect()
            if evidence.outcome then result="OUTCOME_OBSERVED";break end
            flight:step()
            if flight:exhausted() then result="U2_NATIVE_FLIGHT_NOT_ACTIVE";break end
            if runtime:now()>=nextLog then
                emit("FLIGHT_STATUS",flight:status())
                nextLog=runtime:now()+9
            end
            if not ctx:wait(.35) then break end
        end
        emit("FLIGHT_SUMMARY",flight:status())
        -- Release autopilot before any report or return. Never affect another boss.
        flight:stop()
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return {code="CANCELLED"} end
        return {code=result}
    end
    return combat
end
return CombatController
end
-- END MODULE boss.U2.CombatController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.U2.CommandController
__factories["boss.U2.CommandController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- U2 standalone V1 flow: Hideout -> Boss Command pass -> ONE Solo -> combat.
-- Adaptive report may open in arena OR after exit; never request return before Continue.
local DirectBossTravel = require("main.navigation.DirectBossTravel")
local CommandController = {}

function CommandController.new(env, config, observer, report)
    local platform, runtime = env.services.roblox, env.runtime
    local player, workspace = platform:player(), platform:workspace()
    local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
    local travel = DirectBossTravel.new(env)
    local command = {}
    local function emit(name, data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit(name, data or {}) end
    end
    local function remote(name)
        local storage = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage")
        local folder = storage:FindFirstChild("Remotes") or storage:WaitForChild("Remotes", 10)
        local item = folder and (folder:FindFirstChild(name) or folder:WaitForChild(name, 7))
        return item and item:IsA("RemoteEvent") and item or nil
    end
    local function active(ctx) return runtime:isActive(ctx) and not ctx:isCancelled() end
    local function cooldownLeft()
        local raw = player:GetAttribute("BossStartCooldowns")
        if type(raw) ~= "string" or raw == "" then return 0 end
        local ok, data = pcall(function() return platform:service("HttpService"):JSONDecode(raw) end)
        if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then return 0 end
        return math.max(0, (tonumber(data[config.gameBossKey]) or 0) - workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
    end

    function command:prepare(ctx)
        local watching, why = report:watch(ctx) -- watch BEFORE sending any boss request
        if not watching then return false, why end
        if observer:inArena() then return true, "U2_ALREADY_IN_ARENA" end
        if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true then return false, "OTHER_BOSS_ACTIVE" end
        if not active(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        -- V3: wait for U2 cooldown BEFORE issuing Boss Command requests.
        local left = cooldownLeft()
        if left > 0 and config.waitForCooldown then
            if left > config.maxCooldownWaitSeconds then
                emit("U2_COOLDOWN_GATE", {remaining = math.ceil(left), code = "WAIT_LIMIT"})
                return false, "U2_COOLDOWN_ABOVE_WAIT_LIMIT"
            end
            emit("U2_COOLDOWN_WAIT", {remaining = math.ceil(left)})
            local untilTime = runtime:now() + config.maxCooldownWaitSeconds
            local lastTick = runtime:now()
            while active(ctx) and cooldownLeft() > 0 and runtime:now() < untilTime do
                if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true then
                    return false, "OTHER_ENCOUNTER_BECAME_ACTIVE"
                end
                if runtime:now() - lastTick >= 25 then
                    lastTick = runtime:now()
                    emit("U2_COOLDOWN_WAITING", {remaining = math.ceil(cooldownLeft())})
                end
                if not ctx:wait(math.min(3, math.max(0.5, cooldownLeft()))) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
            end
            if not active(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
            if cooldownLeft() > 0 then return false, "U2_COOLDOWN_WAIT_LIMIT_REACHED" end
            emit("U2_COOLDOWN_READY", {remaining = 0})
        end
        local entered = travel:enterHideout(ctx)
        emit("U2_DIRECT_HIDEOUT", {ok = entered.ok, code = entered.code, reason = entered.reason})
        if not entered.ok then return false, entered.code end
        local positioned = travel:moveToKnownPoint(ctx, config.commandSafePosition, {
            requireHideout = true, radius = 6, settle = 0.85,
        })
        emit("U2_COMMAND_POSITION", {ok = positioned.ok, code = positioned.code})
        if not positioned.ok then return false, positioned.code end
        return true, "U2_COMMAND_READY"
    end

    function command:readiness()
        if observer:inArena() then return "READY" end
        if not travel:inHideout() then return "UNKNOWN" end
        local secs = cooldownLeft()
        if secs > 0 then
            secs = math.ceil(secs)
            return string.format("%d:%02d", math.floor(secs / 60), secs % 60)
        end
        -- The server pass remains authoritative for unlock/eligibility.
        return "READY"
    end

    function command:startSolo(ctx, markAttempt)
        if not active(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        if observer:participating() then return true, "U2_ALREADY_FIGHTING" end
        if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true then return false, "OTHER_BOSS_ACTIVE" end
        if not travel:inHideout() then return false, "NOT_IN_HIDEOUT" end
        if self:readiness() ~= "READY" then return false, "U2_NOT_READY" end
        local watching, why = report:watch(ctx)
        if not watching then return false, why end
        local hideout, accept = remote("PersonalHideoutRemote"), remote("U2CommanderAccept")
        if not hideout or not accept then return false, "U2_COMMAND_REMOTES_MISSING" end
        local passReply, acceptReply
        local passConnection = hideout.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
            if type(e) == "table" and e.Kind == "BossCommand" and e.Op == "Start"
                and e.BossKey == config.gameBossKey then passReply = e end
        end)
        local acceptConnection = accept.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
            if type(e) == "table" and e.Accepted ~= nil then acceptReply = e end
        end)
        local function finish(ok, code)
            passConnection:Disconnect()
            acceptConnection:Disconnect()
            return ok, code
        end
        local sent, err = pcall(function()
            hideout:FireServer({Action = "StartBoss", BossKey = config.gameBossKey, Solo = true})
        end)
        if not sent then return finish(false, "U2_PASS_SEND_FAILED: " .. tostring(err)) end
        local gotPass = ctx:await(function() return passReply end, 10)
        if not active(ctx) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
        if not gotPass then return finish(false, "U2_PASS_TIMEOUT_NO_RETRY") end
        emit("U2_PASS_RESULT", {ok = gotPass.Ok == true, reason = gotPass.Reason})
        if gotPass.Ok ~= true then return finish(false, "U2_PASS_REJECTED: " .. tostring(gotPass.Reason)) end
        -- Mark before firing the irreversible Solo request; never blind retry.
        if not markAttempt() then return finish(false, "U2_SOLO_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED") end
        sent, err = pcall(function() accept:FireServer({Solo = true}) end)
        if not sent then return finish(false, "U2_SOLO_SEND_FAILED: " .. tostring(err)) end
        local observed = ctx:await(function()
            if acceptReply and acceptReply.Accepted == false then return "REJECTED" end
            if observer:participating() then return "ENTERED" end
        end, config.arenaTimeout)
        if not active(ctx) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
        emit("U2_SOLO_RESULT", {code = observed or "AMBIGUOUS", accepted = acceptReply and acceptReply.Accepted})
        if observed == "ENTERED" then return finish(true, "U2_FIGHT_VERIFIED") end
        if observed == "REJECTED" then
            return finish(false, "U2_SOLO_REJECTED: " .. tostring(acceptReply.Reason))
        end
        return finish(false, "U2_SOLO_AMBIGUOUS_NO_RETRY")
    end

    function command:close(_) return true end -- No command GUI was opened.

    function command:returnHome(ctx, home)
        if not active(ctx) then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        if type(home) ~= "number" or home < 1 or home % 1 ~= 0 then
            return {ok = false, code = "INVALID_HOME_WORLD"}
        end
        if report:inspect().active then return {ok = false, code = "U2_REPORT_STILL_OPEN"} end
        -- Preserve standalone V1 lock checks before return, regardless of report location.
        local released = ctx:await(function()
            if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true
                and player:GetAttribute("U2Participant") ~= true then return true end
        end, config.returnLockTimeoutSeconds)
        if not released then
            emit("U2_RETURN_LOCK_PENDING", {world = home})
            return {ok = false, code = "U2_RETURN_LOCK_PENDING", reason = "BossFight"}
        end
        local exit = ctx:await(function()
            if player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") == true then return "BOSS_COMMAND_HIDEOUT" end
            if not observer:inArenaPosition() then return "OUTSIDE_ARENA" end
        end, config.exitTimeoutSeconds)
        emit("U2_ARENA_EXIT", {code = exit or "LOCK_RELEASED_STILL_IN_ARENA"})
        -- As in tested standalone V1, a released lock permits a direct verified travel even
        -- if the game has not repositioned the player outside the arena yet.
        if not ctx:wait(1.5) then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        local request, prepare, result = remote("RequestWorldTravel"), remote("NavPrepareWorlds"), remote("WorldTravelResult")
        if not request or not prepare then return {ok = false, code = "U2_WORLD_TRAVEL_REMOTES_MISSING"} end
        local position = platform:position()
        if not position then return {ok = false, code = "CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE"} end
        if tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")) == home
            and player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") ~= true
            and not observer:inArenaPosition() then
            return {ok = true, code = "ALREADY_IN_HOME", world = home}
        end
        local reply
        local connection = result and result.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
            if type(e) == "table" and e.Kind == "Result" and tonumber(e.WorldId) == home then reply = e end
        end) or nil
        local function finish(ok, code, reason)
            if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
            emit("U2_DIRECT_RETURN", {ok = ok, code = code, reason = reason, world = home})
            return {ok = ok, code = code, reason = reason, world = home}
        end
        for attempt = 1, config.returnRetries do
            if not active(ctx) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            reply = nil
            local prior = platform:position()
            if not prior then return finish(false, "CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE") end
            local sent, err = pcall(function() prepare:FireServer("stream", home) end)
            if not sent then return finish(false, "WORLD_PREPARE_SEND_FAILED", tostring(err)) end
            if not ctx:wait(0.12) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            sent, err = pcall(function() request:FireServer(home) end)
            if not sent then return finish(false, "WORLD_REQUEST_SEND_FAILED", tostring(err)) end
            local observed = ctx:await(function()
                if reply and reply.Ok == false then return "REJECTED" end
                local current = platform:position()
                if current and platform:distance(current, prior) > 50
                    and tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")) == home
                    and player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") ~= true
                    and player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true
                    and not observer:inArenaPosition() then return "VERIFIED" end
            end, 17)
            emit("U2_RETURN_ATTEMPT", {attempt = attempt, code = observed or "AMBIGUOUS",
                reason = reply and reply.Reason})
            if observed == "VERIFIED" then return finish(true, "U2_HOME_VERIFIED") end
            if observed ~= "REJECTED" then return finish(false, "U2_RETURN_AMBIGUOUS_NO_RETRY") end
            local why = tostring(reply.Reason or "UNKNOWN")
            if why ~= "BossFight" or attempt == config.returnRetries then
                return finish(false, "U2_WORLD_RETURN_REJECTED", why)
            end
            if not ctx:wait(12) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            local settled = ctx:await(function()
                if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true then return true end
            end, 40)
            if not settled then return finish(false, "U2_LOCK_STILL_ACTIVE", "BossFight") end
        end
        return finish(false, "U2_WORLD_RETURN_EXHAUSTED")
    end
    return command
end
return CommandController
end
-- END MODULE boss.U2.CommandController
