-- BEGIN MODULE boss.U2.FlightController
__factories["boss.U2.FlightController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Port of the live-tested U2 Standalone AutoTest V3 Direct Native Steering.
-- Avoid moving back to V1/V2's passive SetAutoPilot-only implementation.
-- The native U2 client activates flight after cinematic; we write native aim and controls.
local PilotControl=require("boss.shared.PilotControl")
local FlightController={}
function FlightController.new(env,settings,observer)
    local platform=env.services.roblox
    local RS=platform:service("ReplicatedStorage")
    local RunService=platform:service("RunService")
    local W=platform:workspace()
    local telemetry=env.services.telemetry
    local T={running=false,phase=0,bossHP=nil,maxHP=nil,pilotHP=nil,recon=nil,
        surveyActive=false,sweepActive=false,capsuleState=nil,releaseImminent=false,
        altitude=nil,bossAltitude=nil,glare=nil,gunReported=nil,
        flightActive=false,targetKind=nil,targetDistance=nil,
        shots=0,sessionGeneration=nil,bossTrackSource=nil,bossWorldDistance=nil,
        visualProjectionGap=nil,directSteeringInstalled=false,directAimCalls=0,
        directSteeringError=nil}
    local flight={}
    local completed=false
    local connections={}
    local flightRuntime,flightController,nativeController=nil,nil,nil
    local activeSince,jobContext
    local directConn=nil
    local directFlightAccumulator=0
    local lastTargetLog=0
    local lastObjectiveLog=0
    local lastObjective=nil
    local bossRealPosition,bossRealAt,bossVisualProjected,bossDebugClock
    local lastBossTrackLog=0
    local flightWaitUntil=0
    local lastStatusLog=0
    local loaded=false
    local function isParticipating() return observer:participating() end
    local function log(name,data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit("U2_"..name,data or {}) end
    end
    local pilot=PilotControl.new(platform,log)
    local ARENA_CENTER = Vector3.new(49152, 1200, 0)
    local function releaseFlightControl()
        if directConn then
            pcall(function() directConn:Disconnect() end)
            directConn=nil
            T.directSteeringInstalled=false
        end
        pilot:stop()
    end

    local function phaseUpdate(x,sourceName)
        local n=tonumber(x)
        if n and n>=1 and n<=3 and n~=T.phase then
            T.phase=n
            local names={"ABOVE THE CLOUDS","EYES ON TARGET","FINAL INTERCEPTION"}
            log("PHASE",{phase=n,name=names[n],source=sourceName})
        end
    end
    local function loadMod(mod)
        if not mod or not mod:IsA("ModuleScript") then return nil,"MODULE_MISSING" end
        local nativeRequire=getfenv(0)["require"]
        local ok,x=pcall(nativeRequire,mod)
        if not ok or type(x)~="table" then return nil,tostring(x) end
        return x
    end
    local function updateMission(e,origin)
        if type(e)~="table" then return end
        if e.Run ~= nil then
            T.surveyActive=type(e.Run)=="table"
        end
        if e.Sweep ~= nil then
            T.sweepActive=type(e.Sweep)=="table"
        end
        if e.Release ~= nil then
            T.releaseImminent=type(e.Release)=="table"
        end
        if type(e.Capsule)=="table" and e.Capsule.State then
            T.capsuleState=e.Capsule.State
        end
        if type(e.Recon)=="number" then T.recon=e.Recon end
        phaseUpdate(e.Phase,origin)
    end
    local function flightBinding()
        if not jobContext or jobContext:isCancelled() or not T.running or completed or not isParticipating()
            or platform:player():GetAttribute("BossReviveDowned")==true
            or platform:player():GetAttribute("BossResultsOpen")==true
            or not nativeController or type(nativeController.Active)~="function" or not nativeController.Active() then return nil end
        local scene=W:FindFirstChild("U2Skyglass")
        return PilotControl.bound(flightRuntime,flightController,function(plane)
            local hp=plane:GetAttribute("CurrentHP")
            return scene and plane.Name=="U2PilotAircraft" and plane:IsDescendantOf(scene)
                and (type(hp)~="number" or hp>0)
        end)
    end
    local function flightSim()
        if not flightRuntime then return nil end
        local sim=nil
        -- U-2 native Pilot reads ManualFlightRuntime.Flight().Sim.  Keep the
        -- optional Sim() API for compatibility but do not depend on it.
        if type(flightRuntime.Flight)=="function" then
            local ok,flight=pcall(flightRuntime.Flight)
            if ok and type(flight)=="table" then sim=flight.Sim end
        end
        if not sim and type(flightRuntime.Sim)=="function" then
            local ok,s=pcall(flightRuntime.Sim)
            if ok then sim=s end
        end
        if not sim then return nil end
        local valid=pcall(function()
            assert(typeof(sim.Position)=="Vector3" and typeof(sim.Rotation)=="CFrame")
        end)
        return valid and sim or nil
    end
    -- Native U2.Controller creates workspace.U2Skyglass and places a model named
    -- U2DragonLady inside it. Weakpoint Attachments use Camera1, Sensor1/2, Comms1.
    local function skyglass()
        return W:FindFirstChild("U2Skyglass")
    end
    local function dragonModel()
        local scene=skyglass()
        local model=scene and scene:FindFirstChild("U2DragonLady")
        if model and model:IsA("Model") then return model end
        return nil
    end
    local function positionOf(model)
        if not model or not model.Parent then return nil end
        local ok,cf=pcall(function() return model:GetPivot() end)
        return ok and typeof(cf)=="CFrame" and cf.Position or nil
    end
    local function weakPosition(model,kind)
        if not model then return nil end
        local ids=kind=="Sensor" and {"Sensor1","Sensor2"} or {kind.."1"}
        local best,bestDistance
        local sim=flightSim()
        for _,name in ipairs(ids) do
            local part=model:FindFirstChild(name,true)
            if part and part:IsA("Attachment") then
                local p=part.WorldPosition
                local distance=sim and (sim.Position-p).Magnitude or math.huge
                if not best or distance<bestDistance then
                    best,bestDistance=p,distance
                end
            end
        end
        return best
    end
    local function capsulePosition()
        local scene=skyglass()
        local model=scene and scene:FindFirstChild("U2DataCapsule")
        if not model or not model:IsA("Model") then return nil end
        return positionOf(model),model
    end
    -- The U2 visual aircraft is a camera-relative projection when it is farther
    -- than 360 studs away. Its Model:GetPivot() is NOT a reliable world target.
    -- Native U2.Controller.Debug().BossAt reports BossFrame.Position instead.
    local function parseBossAt(value)
        if typeof(value)=="Vector3" then return value end
        if type(value)~="string" then return nil end
        local components=string.split(value,",")
        if #components~=3 then return nil end
        local x,y,z=tonumber(components[1]),tonumber(components[2]),tonumber(components[3])
        if not x or not y or not z then return nil end
        if math.abs(x)>1e7 or math.abs(y)>1e7 or math.abs(z)>1e7 then return nil end
        return Vector3.new(x,y,z)
    end
    local function trueBossPosition()
        if bossRealPosition and bossRealAt and os.clock()-bossRealAt<=2 then
            return bossRealPosition,"NATIVE_BOSS_AT"
        end
        -- Only allow the visible pivot if U2's controller explicitly confirms
        -- the model is NOT being projected toward the player.
        local model=dragonModel()
        local point=model and positionOf(model)
        if point and bossVisualProjected==false then return point,"VISUAL_UNPROJECTED" end
        return nil,"BOSS_WORLD_POSITION_UNAVAILABLE"
    end
    local function chooseObjective()
        -- Capsule can remain after the boss is down; do not depend on U2's model
        -- being present before selecting the released data objective.
        if settings.objectivePriority and settings.prioritizeCapsule
            and T.capsuleState=="Deployed" then
            local p,model=capsulePosition()
            if p then return p,"U2DataCapsule","CAPSULE",model end
        end
        local point,source=trueBossPosition()
        if not point then return nil,source,"NONE" end
        local model=dragonModel()
        local sim=flightSim()
        local distance=sim and (point-sim.Position).Magnitude or math.huge
        -- Exposed weakpoint attachments live on the VISUAL model. They can only
        -- be targeted directly after its native projection has stopped.
        if settings.objectivePriority and model and bossVisualProjected==false
            and distance<=310 and (positionOf(model)-point).Magnitude<=45 then
            local weakType
            if T.releaseImminent then weakType="Comms"
            elseif T.surveyActive then weakType="Camera"
            elseif T.sweepActive then weakType="Sensor" end
            if weakType then
                local weak=weakPosition(model,weakType)
                if weak then return weak,weakType,"WEAK",model end
            end
        end
        -- Always pursue the real U-2 BossFrame when distant. The model may be
        -- hundreds or thousands of studs away from it due to projection.
        return point,source,"BOSS",model
    end
    local function debugStatus()
        if nativeController and type(nativeController.Debug)=="function" then
            local ok,value=pcall(nativeController.Debug)
            if ok and type(value)=="table" then
                T.pilotHP=tonumber(value.PilotHP) or T.pilotHP
                T.altitude=tonumber(value.PilotFt) or T.altitude
                T.bossAltitude=tonumber(value.BossFt) or T.bossAltitude
                T.recon=tonumber(value.Recon) or T.recon
                T.glare=tonumber(value.Glare) or T.glare
                T.gunReported=tonumber(value.Reported) or T.gunReported
                local worldBoss=parseBossAt(value.BossAt)
                if worldBoss then
                    bossRealPosition=worldBoss
                    bossRealAt=os.clock()
                    bossDebugClock=value.Clock
                end
                if type(value.Projected)=="boolean" then
                    bossVisualProjected=value.Projected
                end
                local actual,actualSource=trueBossPosition()
                local visualModel=dragonModel()
                local visual=visualModel and positionOf(visualModel)
                if actual and visual then
                    T.visualProjectionGap=math.floor((visual-actual).Magnitude)
                end
                T.bossTrackSource=actualSource
                local sim=flightSim()
                if actual and sim then
                    T.bossWorldDistance=math.floor((sim.Position-actual).Magnitude)
                end
                phaseUpdate(value.ServerPhase,"NATIVE_DEBUG")
                if os.clock()-lastBossTrackLog>=4 then
                    lastBossTrackLog=os.clock()
                    log("BOSS_WORLD_TRACK",{
                        source=actualSource, debugBossAt=value.BossAt,
                        worldDistance=T.bossWorldDistance,visualProjectionGap=T.visualProjectionGap,
                        projected=value.Projected, nativeDistance=value.Distance,
                        visualPresent=visual~=nil,
                    })
                end
                if value.Capsule then T.capsuleState=value.Capsule end
                local now=os.clock()
                if now-lastObjectiveLog>7 then
                    lastObjectiveLog=now
                    log("MISSION_STATUS",{recon=T.recon,capsule=T.capsuleState,
                        survey=T.surveyActive,sweep=T.sweepActive,
                        release=T.releaseImminent,bossFt=T.bossAltitude,
                        pilotFt=T.altitude,glare=T.glare,pilotHP=T.pilotHP,
                        pilotShots=value.Shots,reported=value.Reported,
                        bossDrawn=value.Drawn,bossBlocked=value.Blocked,
                        devAuto=value.Auto,brokenClouds=value.Broke})
                end
                T.shots=tonumber(value.Shots) or T.shots
                return value
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local pilotState={turn=1,breakUntil=0,lastGoal=nil,lastAt=nil,lastSource=nil}
    local lastNoTargetLog=0
    local riftHazards=env.services.riftHazards
    local function applyHazardFrame(sim,plan)
        if not riftHazards or type(riftHazards.flightPlan)~="function" then return plan end
        local ok,adjusted=pcall(riftHazards.flightPlan,riftHazards,sim,plan)
        return ok and type(adjusted)=="table" and adjusted or plan
    end
    local function pilotFrame(dt)
        if not T.running or completed or not isParticipating() then return nil end
        local sim=flightSim()
        if not sim then return nil end
        local pos=sim.Position
        local forward=sim.Rotation.LookVector
        local now=os.clock()
        debugStatus()
        local goal,source,kind,targetModel=chooseObjective()
        if not goal then
            if now-lastNoTargetLog>5 then
                lastNoTargetLog=now
                log("FLIGHT_GATE",{reason=source,phase=T.phase,
                    projected=bossVisualProjected,bossTrackSource=T.bossTrackSource,
                    visualProjectionGap=T.visualProjectionGap})
            end
            return applyHazardFrame(sim,{Aim=forward*260+Vector3.new(0,pos.Y<1800 and 130 or 0,0),
                Throttle=.82,Fire=false,Missile=false})
        end
        local velocity=Vector3.zero
        if pilotState.lastGoal and pilotState.lastAt and source==pilotState.lastSource then
            local secs=now-pilotState.lastAt
            if secs>.05 then velocity=(goal-pilotState.lastGoal)/secs end
        end
        pilotState.lastGoal=goal
        pilotState.lastAt=now
        pilotState.lastSource=source
        if velocity.Magnitude>300 then velocity=velocity.Unit*300 end
        local delta=goal-pos
        local distance=delta.Magnitude
        local direct=distance>1 and delta.Unit or forward
        local lead=math.clamp(distance/480,.12,1.35)
        local aim=goal+velocity*lead-pos
        if aim.Magnitude<.1 then aim=direct end
        local angle=math.deg(math.acos(math.clamp(forward:Dot(direct),-1,1)))
        -- U2Config Combat: gun range 320, missile range 900. Keep the native flight
        -- controller as the only source of weapon inputs. Never send U2Hit directly.
        local gun=settings.autoFire and distance<=305 and angle<=5
        local missile=settings.autoFire and settings.autoMissile and distance<=850 and
            angle<=21
        local near=distance<130
        if near and not pilotState.near then
            pilotState.breakUntil=now+1.4
            pilotState.turn=-pilotState.turn
        end
        pilotState.near=near
        if now<pilotState.breakUntil then
            aim=forward*200+sim.Rotation.RightVector*pilotState.turn*165+Vector3.new(0,125,0)
            gun=false;missile=false
        end
        -- High-altitude interception: when boss is well above, climb FIRST.
        -- This is a directional command, not a teleport or physics write.
        if settings.climbFirst and kind=="BOSS" and goal.Y-pos.Y>200 then
            local horizontal=Vector3.new(aim.X,0,aim.Z)
            local vertical=math.max(aim.Y, math.min(goal.Y-pos.Y, 900))
            aim=horizontal*0.45+Vector3.new(0,vertical*1.4,0)
        end
        -- Native flight box floor/ceiling = arena Y 1200+160 to 1200+3100.
        if pos.Y<1660 then aim=aim+Vector3.new(0,850,0)
        elseif pos.Y>4150 then aim=aim+Vector3.new(0,-650,0) end
        local radial=Vector3.new(pos.X-ARENA_CENTER.X,0,pos.Z-ARENA_CENTER.Z)
        if radial.Magnitude>5450 then
            -- Return toward interior only when actually close to the arena edge.
            -- V1 used 4900, which could override pursuit while boss remained in bounds.
            aim=ARENA_CENTER+Vector3.new(0,2450,0)-pos
            gun=false;missile=false
        end
        T.targetKind=kind
        T.targetDistance=math.floor(distance)
        if now-lastTargetLog>=3.5 or source~=lastObjective then
            lastTargetLog=now
            lastObjective=source
            log("FLIGHT_TARGET",{target=kind,part=source,
                distance=math.floor(distance),angle=math.floor(angle),
                phase=T.phase,altitude=math.floor(pos.Y),
                survey=T.surveyActive,sweep=T.sweepActive,
                capsule=T.capsuleState,release=T.releaseImminent,
                fire=gun,missile=missile,
                trackSource=T.bossTrackSource,projectionGap=T.visualProjectionGap})
        end
        return applyHazardFrame(sim,{Aim=aim,Throttle=distance>750 and 1 or .86,Fire=gun and targetModel~=nil,Missile=missile and targetModel~=nil,
            Target=kind=="WEAK" and source or kind,TargetModel=targetModel,Maneuver=now<pilotState.breakUntil or radial.Magnitude>5450})
    end

    local function directFlightStep(dt)
        local plane,state=flightBinding()
        if not plane then pilot:clear("U2_FLIGHT_HANDOFF_PENDING"); return end
        directFlightAccumulator+=dt
        if directFlightAccumulator<0.08 then return end
        directFlightAccumulator=0
        local applied=pilot:apply(flightRuntime,flightController,plane,state,pilotFrame(),true)
        if applied then T.directAimCalls+=1 end
    end
    local function ensureDirectPilot()
        if directConn or not settings.directNativeSteering then return end
        if not flightRuntime or type(flightRuntime.SetAim)~="function" then
            log("DIRECT_FLIGHT_GATE",{reason="NATIVE_SET_AIM_UNAVAILABLE"})
            return
        end
        directConn=RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
            local ok,err=pcall(directFlightStep,dt)
            if not ok then pilot:clear("PILOT_UPDATE_ERROR") end
            if not ok and T.directSteeringError~=tostring(err) then
                T.directSteeringError=tostring(err)
                log("DIRECT_FLIGHT_GATE",{reason="HEARTBEAT_ERROR",detail=T.directSteeringError})
            end
        end)
        table.insert(connections,directConn)
        T.directSteeringInstalled=true
        log("DIRECT_FLIGHT_INSTALL",{nativeSetAim=true,nativeControls=type(flightRuntime.Controls)=="function"})
    end
    function flight:reset()
        self:stop()
        completed=false
        T.phase=0;T.bossHP=nil;T.maxHP=nil;T.pilotHP=nil;T.recon=nil
        T.surveyActive=false;T.sweepActive=false;T.capsuleState=nil;T.releaseImminent=false
        T.altitude=nil;T.bossAltitude=nil;T.glare=nil;T.gunReported=nil
        T.flightActive=false;T.targetKind=nil
        T.targetDistance=nil;T.shots=0;T.sessionGeneration=nil
        T.bossTrackSource=nil;T.bossWorldDistance=nil;T.visualProjectionGap=nil
        T.directSteeringInstalled=false;T.directAimCalls=0
        T.directSteeringError=nil
        bossRealPosition=nil;bossRealAt=nil;bossVisualProjected=nil;bossDebugClock=nil
        lastBossTrackLog=0;lastTargetLog=0
        lastObjectiveLog=0;lastObjective=nil
        activeSince=nil;flightWaitUntil=0;lastStatusLog=0
        directFlightAccumulator=0
        pilotState.turn=1;pilotState.breakUntil=0;pilotState.near=false;pilotState.lastGoal=nil
        pilotState.lastAt=nil;pilotState.lastSource=nil
        T.running=true
    end
    function flight:observe(e)
        if not T.running or type(e)~="table" or type(e.K)~="string" then return end
        local k=e.K
        if k=="Session" then
            T.sessionGeneration=e.Generation or T.sessionGeneration
            if type(e.State)=="table" then
                updateMission(e.State,"SESSION")
                T.bossHP=tonumber(e.State.HP) or T.bossHP
                T.maxHP=tonumber(e.State.MaxHP) or T.maxHP
            end
            log("SESSION",{generation=T.sessionGeneration,phase=T.phase,
                participant=isParticipating()})
        elseif k=="Launch" or k=="Begin" then
            log("FIGHT_EVENT",{event=k,clock=e.T0})
            if k=="Begin" then updateMission(e,"BEGIN") end
        elseif k=="State" then
            updateMission(e,"STATE")
            T.bossHP=tonumber(e.HP) or T.bossHP
            T.maxHP=tonumber(e.MaxHP) or T.maxHP
        elseif k=="Phase" then
            phaseUpdate(e.Phase,"EVENT")
            log("PHASE_EVENT",{phase=e.Phase,name=e.Name})
        elseif k=="Run" then
            if e.State=="Exposing" then T.surveyActive=true
            elseif e.State=="Failed" or e.State=="Captured" or e.State=="Abandoned" then
                T.surveyActive=false end
            log("SURVEY_EVENT",{state=e.State,site=e.Site,kind=e.Kind})
        elseif k=="Sweep" then
            T.sweepActive=e.State=="Active"
            log("SWEEP_EVENT",{state=e.State})
        elseif k=="Capsule" then
            T.capsuleState=e.State or T.capsuleState
            T.releaseImminent=e.State=="Imminent"
            log("CAPSULE_EVENT",{state=e.State,at=e.At})
        elseif k=="Hit" then
            log("HIT",{target=e.T,weak=e.W,kind=e.K,damage=e.Damage,hp=e.HP,killed=e.Killed})
        elseif k=="Downed" then
            log("BOSS_DOWNED",{note="U2 may still release a data capsule"})
        elseif k=="End" then
            log("FIGHT_END",{victory=e.Victory,reason=e.Reason})
        elseif k=="Outcome" then
            completed=true
            pilot:stop()
            log("OUTCOME_EVENT",{victory=e.Victory,reason=e.Reason,
                eligible=e.RewardEligible,partial=e.Partial})
        end
    end
    function flight:start(ctx)
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return false,"CANCELLED" end
        if not loaded then
            local folder=RS:FindFirstChild("ClientModules")
            flightRuntime=loadMod(folder and folder:FindFirstChild("ManualFlightRuntime"))
            flightController=loadMod(folder and folder:FindFirstChild("ManualFlightController"))
            local u2=folder and folder:FindFirstChild("U2")
            nativeController=loadMod(u2 and u2:FindFirstChild("Controller"))
            loaded=true
            log("FLIGHT_CAPABILITIES",{
                runtime=flightRuntime~=nil,controller=flightController~=nil,
                native=nativeController~=nil,
                autoPilotApi=flightController~=nil and type(flightController.SetAutoPilot)=="function",
                nativeActiveApi=nativeController~=nil and type(nativeController.Active)=="function",
                nativeDebugApi=nativeController~=nil and type(nativeController.Debug)=="function",
                nativeSetAim=flightRuntime~=nil and type(flightRuntime.SetAim)=="function",
                nativeControls=flightRuntime~=nil and type(flightRuntime.Controls)=="function"})
        end
        T.running=true
        flightWaitUntil=os.clock()+settings.flightStartTimeoutSeconds
        jobContext=ctx
        ctx:deferCleanup(function() if jobContext==ctx then self:stop() end end)
        return true
    end
    function flight:step()
        if not T.running or completed then return end
        local active=flightBinding()~=nil
        T.flightActive=active
        if active then
            if not activeSince then
                activeSince=os.clock()
                log("FLIGHT_VERIFIED",{nativeControl=true,autoPilot=settings.autoPilot})
            end
            if settings.autoPilot then ensureDirectPilot() end
        end
        if nativeController and type(nativeController.Debug)=="function" and os.clock()>=lastStatusLog then
            lastStatusLog=os.clock()+9
            local ok,d=pcall(nativeController.Debug)
            if ok and type(d)=="table" then
                log("FLIGHT_STATUS",{pilotState=d.PilotState,pilotHP=d.PilotHP,
                    distance=d.Distance,shots=d.Shots,reported=d.Reported,
                    missiles=d.Missiles,glare=d.Glare,bossFt=d.BossFt,
                    pilotFt=d.PilotFt,recon=d.Recon,capsule=d.Capsule,
                    bossDrawn=d.Drawn,blocked=d.Blocked,serverPhase=d.ServerPhase,
                    directSteering=T.directSteeringInstalled,
                    aimCalls=T.directAimCalls,target=T.targetKind})
            end
        end
    end
    function flight:exhausted()
        return T.running and not completed and not activeSince and os.clock()>flightWaitUntil
    end
    function flight:status()
        return {phase=T.phase,bossHP=T.bossHP,maxHP=T.maxHP,
            flightActive=T.flightActive,
            directSteeringInstalled=T.directSteeringInstalled,directAimCalls=T.directAimCalls,
            directSteeringError=T.directSteeringError,
            altitude=T.altitude,bossAltitude=T.bossAltitude,
            pilotHP=T.pilotHP,recon=T.recon,surveyActive=T.surveyActive,
            sweepActive=T.sweepActive,releaseImminent=T.releaseImminent,
            capsuleState=T.capsuleState,bossTrackSource=T.bossTrackSource,
            bossWorldDistance=T.bossWorldDistance,visualProjectionGap=T.visualProjectionGap,
            targetKind=T.targetKind,targetDistance=T.targetDistance,shots=T.shots}
    end
    function flight:stop()
        releaseFlightControl()
        jobContext=nil
        table.clear(connections)
        T.running=false
        T.flightActive=false
    end
    return flight
end
return FlightController
end
-- END MODULE boss.U2.FlightController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.U2.RepeatPolicy
__factories["boss.U2.RepeatPolicy"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local SharedRepeatPolicy = require("boss.shared.RepeatPolicy")
local RepeatPolicy = {}
function RepeatPolicy.new(env)
    return SharedRepeatPolicy.new(env, "Expected confirmed U2 outcome")
end
return RepeatPolicy
end
-- END MODULE boss.U2.RepeatPolicy

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.U2.ReportController
__factories["boss.U2.ReportController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local DeferredOutcome = require("boss.shared.DeferredOutcome")
-- U2 adaptive report: Outcome -> report (arena or hideout) -> Continue -> exit -> return.
-- Port of standalone V1; never treat Outcome alone as a completed report.
local ReportController = {}

function ReportController.new(env, config, repeatPolicy, flight)
    local platform, gui, runtime = env.services.roblox, env.services.gui, env.runtime
    local player = platform:player()
    local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
    local writer = env.state:port("boss")
    local report = {}
    local terminal = DeferredOutcome.new(env, config.bossId, "U2FightGeneration")
    local confirmedOutcome, outcomeAt = nil, nil
    local lastHealthAt = 0
    local seenReport, firstOpenedAt = false, nil
    local listeningContext, connections, resultsController = nil, {}, nil
    local observedU2, generation = false, nil
    local function emit(name, data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit(name, data or {}) end
    end
    local function loadController()
        if resultsController then return resultsController end
        local folder = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("ClientModules")
        local mod = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("BossResultsController")
        if not mod or not mod:IsA("ModuleScript") then return nil end
        -- The build bundler replaces project requires. Invoke Roblox require only
        -- dynamically for the game's own ModuleScript, as the B21 controller does.
        local loader = getfenv(0)["require"]
        local ok, value = pcall(loader, mod)
        if not ok or type(value) ~= "table" then return nil end
        if type(value.IsOpen) ~= "function" or type(value.Dismiss) ~= "function" then return nil end
        resultsController = value
        return value
    end
    local function officialOpen()
        local ctrl = loadController()
        if ctrl and type(ctrl.IsOpen) == "function" then
            local ok, result = pcall(ctrl.IsOpen)
            if ok and result == true then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function isOpen()
        return player:GetAttribute("BossResultsOpen") == true or officialOpen()
    end
    local function matchingReport(guiRoot)
        if not guiRoot then return nil end
        local isU2, won, lost = false, false, false
        for _,node in ipairs(guiRoot:GetDescendants()) do
            if node:IsA("TextLabel") then
                local value = string.upper(tostring(node.Text or ""))
                if value:find("U2", 1, true) or value:find("U-2", 1, true) or value:find("DRAGON LADY", 1, true) then isU2 = true end
                if value:find("DEFEATED", 1, true) or value:find("VICTORY", 1, true)
                    or value:find("MISSION COMPLETE", 1, true) then won = true end
                if value:find("MISSION FAILED", 1, true) or value:find("DEFEAT", 1, true) then lost = true end
            end
        end
        if isU2 and won ~= lost then return won and "WIN" or "LOSS" end
        return nil
    end

    local function observerU2Active()
        return player:GetAttribute("U2Participant")==true
            or player:GetAttribute("U2FightState")=="Active"
            or platform:workspace():GetAttribute("U2FightState")=="Active"
    end
    local function closeConnections()
        for _,conn in ipairs(connections) do conn:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(connections)
        listeningContext=nil
    end
    local function listen(remote,fn)
        local connection=remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(fn)
        table.insert(connections,connection)
    end
    function report:watch(ctx)
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return false,"CANCELLED" end
        if listeningContext==ctx and #connections>0 then return true end
        closeConnections()
        local folder=platform:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        local remote=folder and folder:FindFirstChild("U2Event")
        if not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
            return false,"U2_EVENT_MISSING"
        end
        listen(remote,function(packet)
            if type(packet)~="table" or type(packet.K)~="string" then return end
            terminal:observe(packet)
            -- Only collect evidence for our U2 encounter. Do not steal an unrelated
            -- boss's Outcome (shared game client events may remain connected).
            local current=observerU2Active()
            if packet.K=="Session" or packet.K=="Launch" or packet.K=="Begin" then
                if current then
                    observedU2=true
                    generation=packet.Generation or generation
                end
            end
            if not observedU2 and not current then return end
            if generation~=nil and packet.Generation~=nil
                and packet.Generation~=generation then return end
            flight:observe(packet)
            if packet.K=="Phase" then
                emit("U2_PHASE",{phase=packet.Phase})
            elseif packet.K=="Outcome" then
                confirmedOutcome=packet.Victory==true and "WIN" or "LOSS"
                outcomeAt=runtime:now()
                emit("U2_OUTCOME",{outcome=confirmedOutcome,reason=packet.Reason})
            end
        end)
        listeningContext=ctx
        ctx:deferCleanup(function()
            if listeningContext==ctx then closeConnections() end
        end)
        return true
    end
    function report:cleanup()
        closeConnections()
        flight:stop()
        -- Keep outcome evidence for checkpoint reconciliation.
    end
    function report:verifiedDeferredOutcome(encounter)
        return terminal:verified(encounter, "LOSS")
    end
    function report:resetOutcome()
        terminal:reset()
        confirmedOutcome,outcomeAt,seenReport,firstOpenedAt=nil,nil,false,nil
        observedU2=false;generation=nil
        flight:reset()
    end
    function report:inspect()
        local root = gui:find(env.profile.paths.bossReport)
        local active = isOpen() -- Same verified V2 signal: BossResultsOpen or official controller.IsOpen()
        if active then
            seenReport = true
            firstOpenedAt = firstOpenedAt or runtime:now()
        end
        local guiOutcome = active and matchingReport(root) or nil
        local outcome = confirmedOutcome or guiOutcome
        return {
            active = active, matchesBoss = confirmedOutcome ~= nil or guiOutcome ~= nil,
            outcome = outcome, report = root, seen = seenReport,
            pendingPresentation = confirmedOutcome ~= nil and not seenReport
                and outcomeAt ~= nil and runtime:now() - outcomeAt < config.reportTimeoutSeconds,
        }
    end
    function report:reconcile(encounter)
        local evidence = self:inspect()
        if evidence.matchesBoss and evidence.outcome
            and (not encounter.outcome or encounter.outcome == evidence.outcome) then return true end
        return encounter.outcome ~= nil and seenReport and not evidence.active
    end
    function report:resolve(ctx, encounter)
        local watching, why = self:watch(ctx)
        if not watching then return {ok = false, code = why} end
        -- V2 REQUIREMENT: Outcome alone never authorizes return/Continue.
        local evidence = ctx:await(function()
            local current = self:inspect()
            if current.active and current.matchesBoss and current.outcome then return current end
            if seenReport and not current.active and (encounter.outcome or current.outcome) then
                return current -- manually dismissed report after previously observing it
            end
        end, config.reportTimeoutSeconds)
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        if not evidence then return {ok = false, code = "U2_REPORT_NOT_OBSERVED"} end
        if evidence.outcome and encounter.outcome and evidence.outcome ~= encounter.outcome then
            return {ok = false, held = true, code = "BOSS_OUTCOME_CONFLICT"}
        end
        local outcome = evidence.outcome or encounter.outcome
        if not outcome then return {ok = false, code = "U2_OUTCOME_UNVERIFIED"} end
        if not encounter.outcome then
            local accepted = writer:recordBossReport(outcome,
                runtime:epoch() + repeatPolicy:outcomeDelay(outcome))
            if not accepted then return {ok = false, held = true, code = "BOSS_OUTCOME_CONFLICT"} end
            encounter = env.state:snapshot().boss.encounter
        end
        if not evidence.active then
            writer:closeReport()
            return {ok = true, code = "U2_REPORT_MANUALLY_CLOSED"}
        end
        local at = platform:position()
        local place = player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") == true and "HIDEOUT" or "OTHER"
        if place == "OTHER" and at then
            local center = Vector3.new(config.arenaFallbackCenter.x,
                config.arenaFallbackCenter.y, config.arenaFallbackCenter.z)
            local horizontal = Vector3.new(at.X-center.X,0,at.Z-center.Z)
            if horizontal.Magnitude < config.arenaRadius
                and at.Y > config.arenaMinY and at.Y < config.arenaMaxY then
                place = "ARENA"
            end
        end
        emit("U2_REPORT_OPEN", {outcome = outcome, location = place,
            inBossFight = player:GetAttribute("InBossFight")})
        local controller = loadController()
        if not controller then return {ok = false, code = "U2_RESULT_CONTROLLER_MISSING_MANUAL_CONTINUE"} end
        if not encounter.continueAttempted then
            local ready = ctx:await(function()
                if not isOpen() then return "MANUALLY_CLOSED" end
                local armed = false
                if type(controller.Debug) == "function" then
                    local ok, message = pcall(controller.Debug)
                    armed = ok and type(message) == "string"
                        and message:find("armed=true", 1, true) ~= nil
                end
                if armed and firstOpenedAt
                    and runtime:now() - firstOpenedAt >= config.reportHoldSeconds then return "ARMED" end
            end, config.reportTimeoutSeconds)
            if ctx:isCancelled() then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
            if ready == "MANUALLY_CLOSED" then
                writer:closeReport()
                return {ok = true, code = "U2_REPORT_MANUALLY_CLOSED"}
            end
            if ready ~= "ARMED" then return {ok = false, code = "U2_REPORT_NOT_ARMED_MANUAL_CONTINUE"} end
            if not writer:markContinueAttempt() then return {ok = false, code = "U2_CONTINUE_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED"} end
            local sent, err = pcall(function() controller.Dismiss("continue") end)
            if not sent then return {ok = false, code = "U2_CONTINUE_FAILED: " .. tostring(err)} end
            emit("U2_REPORT_CONTINUE", {code = "CONTINUE_REQUESTED"})
        end
        local closed = ctx:await(function() if not self:inspect().active then return true end end,
            config.reportCloseTimeoutSeconds)
        if not closed then return {ok = false, code = "U2_REPORT_STILL_OPEN_MANUAL_CONTINUE"} end
        writer:closeReport()
        return {ok = true, code = "U2_REPORT_CLOSED"}
    end
    return report
end
return ReportController
end
-- END MODULE boss.U2.ReportController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.U2.U2
__factories["boss.U2.U2"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local Config=require("boss.U2.Config")
local ArenaObserver=require("boss.U2.ArenaObserver")
local CommandController=require("boss.U2.CommandController")
local CombatController=require("boss.U2.CombatController")
local FlightController=require("boss.U2.FlightController")
local ReportController=require("boss.U2.ReportController")
local RepeatPolicy=require("boss.U2.RepeatPolicy")
local U2={}
function U2.definition()
    return {bossId=Config.bossId,displayName=Config.displayName,create=function(env)
        local observer=ArenaObserver.new(env,Config)
        local flight=FlightController.new(env,Config,observer)
        local repeatPolicy=RepeatPolicy.new(env)
        local report=ReportController.new(env,Config,repeatPolicy,flight)
        return {config=Config,observer=observer,flight=flight,report=report,
            repeatPolicy=repeatPolicy,command=CommandController.new(env,Config,observer,report),
            combat=CombatController.new(env,Config,observer,report,flight)}
    end}
end
return U2
end

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.Vulcan.ArenaObserver
__factories["boss.Vulcan.ArenaObserver"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Distinguish private Vulcan participation from global battle activity.
local ArenaObserver = {}
function ArenaObserver.new(env, config)
    local platform = env.services.roblox
    local player, workspace = platform:player(), platform:workspace()
    local observer = {}
    function observer:participating()
        return player:GetAttribute("VulcanParticipant") == true
    end
    function observer:inArenaPosition()
        local p = platform:position()
        if not p then return false end
        local dx, dz = p.X - config.arenaCenter.x, p.Z - config.arenaCenter.z
        return dx * dx + dz * dz < config.arenaRadius * config.arenaRadius
    end
    function observer:inArena()
        return self:participating() or (workspace:GetAttribute("VulcanFightActive") == true
            and self:inArenaPosition() and player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true)
    end
    function observer:state()
        return {phase = workspace:GetAttribute("VulcanPhase"),
            fightState = workspace:GetAttribute("VulcanFightState"),
            active = workspace:GetAttribute("VulcanFightActive"),
            participant = player:GetAttribute("VulcanParticipant"),
            inBossFight = player:GetAttribute("InBossFight")}
    end
    return observer
end
return ArenaObserver
end
-- END MODULE boss.Vulcan.ArenaObserver

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.Vulcan.CombatController
__factories["boss.Vulcan.CombatController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Keep Vulcan V3 dodge live throughout fight, including in-flight bombs after Victory.
local CombatController = {}
function CombatController.new(env, config, observer, report, dodge)
    local runtime, telemetry = env.runtime, env.services.telemetry
    local combat = {}
    function combat:run(ctx, encounter)
        local watching, why = report:watch(ctx)
        if not watching then return {code = why} end
        dodge:start(ctx)
        local lastKey, lastLog = nil, 0
        local deadline = runtime:now() + config.maxFightSeconds
        local code = "OUTCOME_NOT_OBSERVED_TIMEOUT"
        while not ctx:isCancelled() and runtime:now() < deadline do
            local evidence = report:inspect()
            if evidence.outcome then code = "OUTCOME_OBSERVED"; break end
            local state = observer:state()
            local key = tostring(state.fightState) .. "/" .. tostring(state.phase) .. "/"
                .. tostring(state.active) .. "/" .. tostring(state.participant)
            if key ~= lastKey or runtime:now() - lastLog >= 25 then
                if telemetry then telemetry:emit("VULCAN_STATE", state) end
                lastKey, lastLog = key, runtime:now()
            end
            if not ctx:wait(0.4) then break end
        end
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return {code = "CANCELLED"} end
        if code == "OUTCOME_OBSERVED" then
            -- Outcome does not make already released bombs disappear.
            dodge:waitForReleasedBombs(ctx)
        end
        return {code = code}
    end
    return combat
end
return CombatController
end
-- END MODULE boss.Vulcan.CombatController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.Vulcan.CommandController
__factories["boss.Vulcan.CommandController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Vulcan standalone V1 flow: Hideout -> Boss Command pass -> ONE Solo -> combat.
-- Adaptive report may open in arena OR after exit; never request return before Continue.
local DirectBossTravel = require("main.navigation.DirectBossTravel")
local CommandController = {}

function CommandController.new(env, config, observer, report)
    local platform, runtime = env.services.roblox, env.runtime
    local player, workspace = platform:player(), platform:workspace()
    local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
    local travel = DirectBossTravel.new(env)
    local command = {}
    local function emit(name, data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit(name, data or {}) end
    end
    local function remote(name)
        local storage = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage")
        local folder = storage:FindFirstChild("Remotes") or storage:WaitForChild("Remotes", 10)
        local item = folder and (folder:FindFirstChild(name) or folder:WaitForChild(name, 7))
        return item and item:IsA("RemoteEvent") and item or nil
    end
    local function active(ctx) return runtime:isActive(ctx) and not ctx:isCancelled() end
    local function cooldownLeft()
        local raw = player:GetAttribute("BossStartCooldowns")
        if type(raw) ~= "string" or raw == "" then return 0 end
        local ok, data = pcall(function() return platform:service("HttpService"):JSONDecode(raw) end)
        if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then return 0 end
        return math.max(0, (tonumber(data[config.gameBossKey]) or 0) - workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
    end

    function command:prepare(ctx)
        local watching, why = report:watch(ctx) -- watch BEFORE sending any boss request
        if not watching then return false, why end
        if observer:inArena() then return true, "VULCAN_ALREADY_IN_ARENA" end
        if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true then return false, "OTHER_BOSS_ACTIVE" end
        if not active(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        local entered = travel:enterHideout(ctx)
        emit("VULCAN_DIRECT_HIDEOUT", {ok = entered.ok, code = entered.code, reason = entered.reason})
        if not entered.ok then return false, entered.code end
        local positioned = travel:moveToKnownPoint(ctx, config.commandSafePosition, {
            requireHideout = true, radius = 6, settle = 0.85,
        })
        emit("VULCAN_COMMAND_POSITION", {ok = positioned.ok, code = positioned.code})
        if not positioned.ok then return false, positioned.code end
        return true, "VULCAN_COMMAND_READY"
    end

    function command:readiness()
        if observer:inArena() then return "READY" end
        if not travel:inHideout() then return "UNKNOWN" end
        local secs = cooldownLeft()
        if secs > 0 then
            secs = math.ceil(secs)
            return string.format("%d:%02d", math.floor(secs / 60), secs % 60)
        end
        -- The server pass remains authoritative for unlock/eligibility.
        return "READY"
    end

    function command:startSolo(ctx, markAttempt)
        if not active(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        if observer:participating() then return true, "VULCAN_ALREADY_FIGHTING" end
        if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true then return false, "OTHER_BOSS_ACTIVE" end
        if not travel:inHideout() then return false, "NOT_IN_HIDEOUT" end
        if self:readiness() ~= "READY" then return false, "VULCAN_NOT_READY" end
        local watching, why = report:watch(ctx)
        if not watching then return false, why end
        local hideout, accept = remote("PersonalHideoutRemote"), remote("VulcanCommanderAccept")
        if not hideout or not accept then return false, "VULCAN_COMMAND_REMOTES_MISSING" end
        local passReply, acceptReply
        local passConnection = hideout.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
            if type(e) == "table" and e.Kind == "BossCommand" and e.Op == "Start"
                and e.BossKey == config.gameBossKey then passReply = e end
        end)
        local acceptConnection = accept.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
            if type(e) == "table" and e.Accepted ~= nil then acceptReply = e end
        end)
        local function finish(ok, code)
            passConnection:Disconnect()
            acceptConnection:Disconnect()
            return ok, code
        end
        local sent, err = pcall(function()
            hideout:FireServer({Action = "StartBoss", BossKey = config.gameBossKey, Solo = true})
        end)
        if not sent then return finish(false, "VULCAN_PASS_SEND_FAILED: " .. tostring(err)) end
        local gotPass = ctx:await(function() return passReply end, 10)
        if not active(ctx) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
        if not gotPass then return finish(false, "VULCAN_PASS_TIMEOUT_NO_RETRY") end
        emit("VULCAN_PASS_RESULT", {ok = gotPass.Ok == true, reason = gotPass.Reason})
        if gotPass.Ok ~= true then return finish(false, "VULCAN_PASS_REJECTED: " .. tostring(gotPass.Reason)) end
        -- Mark before firing the irreversible Solo request; never blind retry.
        if not markAttempt() then return finish(false, "VULCAN_SOLO_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED") end
        sent, err = pcall(function() accept:FireServer({Solo = true}) end)
        if not sent then return finish(false, "VULCAN_SOLO_SEND_FAILED: " .. tostring(err)) end
        local observed = ctx:await(function()
            if acceptReply and acceptReply.Accepted == false then return "REJECTED" end
            if observer:participating() then return "ENTERED" end
        end, config.arenaTimeout)
        if not active(ctx) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
        emit("VULCAN_SOLO_RESULT", {code = observed or "AMBIGUOUS", accepted = acceptReply and acceptReply.Accepted})
        if observed == "ENTERED" then return finish(true, "VULCAN_FIGHT_VERIFIED") end
        if observed == "REJECTED" then
            return finish(false, "VULCAN_SOLO_REJECTED: " .. tostring(acceptReply.Reason))
        end
        return finish(false, "VULCAN_SOLO_AMBIGUOUS_NO_RETRY")
    end

    function command:close(_) return true end -- No command GUI was opened.

    function command:returnHome(ctx, home)
        if not active(ctx) then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        if type(home) ~= "number" or home < 1 or home % 1 ~= 0 then
            return {ok = false, code = "INVALID_HOME_WORLD"}
        end
        if report:inspect().active then return {ok = false, code = "VULCAN_REPORT_STILL_OPEN"} end
        -- Preserve standalone V1 lock checks before return, regardless of report location.
        local released = ctx:await(function()
            if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true
                and player:GetAttribute("VulcanParticipant") ~= true then return true end
        end, config.returnLockTimeoutSeconds)
        if not released then
            emit("VULCAN_RETURN_LOCK_PENDING", {world = home})
            return {ok = false, code = "VULCAN_RETURN_LOCK_PENDING", reason = "BossFight"}
        end
        local exit = ctx:await(function()
            if player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") == true then return "BOSS_COMMAND_HIDEOUT" end
            if not observer:inArenaPosition() then return "OUTSIDE_ARENA" end
        end, config.exitTimeoutSeconds)
        emit("VULCAN_ARENA_EXIT", {code = exit or "LOCK_RELEASED_STILL_IN_ARENA"})
        -- As in tested standalone V1, a released lock permits a direct verified travel even
        -- if the game has not repositioned the player outside the arena yet.
        if not ctx:wait(1.5) then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        local request, prepare, result = remote("RequestWorldTravel"), remote("NavPrepareWorlds"), remote("WorldTravelResult")
        if not request or not prepare then return {ok = false, code = "VULCAN_WORLD_TRAVEL_REMOTES_MISSING"} end
        local position = platform:position()
        if not position then return {ok = false, code = "CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE"} end
        if tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")) == home
            and player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") ~= true
            and not observer:inArenaPosition() then
            return {ok = true, code = "ALREADY_IN_HOME", world = home}
        end
        local reply
        local connection = result and result.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
            if type(e) == "table" and e.Kind == "Result" and tonumber(e.WorldId) == home then reply = e end
        end) or nil
        local function finish(ok, code, reason)
            if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
            emit("VULCAN_DIRECT_RETURN", {ok = ok, code = code, reason = reason, world = home})
            return {ok = ok, code = code, reason = reason, world = home}
        end
        for attempt = 1, config.returnRetries do
            if not active(ctx) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            reply = nil
            local prior = platform:position()
            if not prior then return finish(false, "CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE") end
            local sent, err = pcall(function() prepare:FireServer("stream", home) end)
            if not sent then return finish(false, "WORLD_PREPARE_SEND_FAILED", tostring(err)) end
            if not ctx:wait(0.12) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            sent, err = pcall(function() request:FireServer(home) end)
            if not sent then return finish(false, "WORLD_REQUEST_SEND_FAILED", tostring(err)) end
            local observed = ctx:await(function()
                if reply and reply.Ok == false then return "REJECTED" end
                local current = platform:position()
                if current and platform:distance(current, prior) > 50
                    and tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")) == home
                    and player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") ~= true
                    and player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true
                    and not observer:inArenaPosition() then return "VERIFIED" end
            end, 17)
            emit("VULCAN_RETURN_ATTEMPT", {attempt = attempt, code = observed or "AMBIGUOUS",
                reason = reply and reply.Reason})
            if observed == "VERIFIED" then return finish(true, "VULCAN_HOME_VERIFIED") end
            if observed ~= "REJECTED" then return finish(false, "VULCAN_RETURN_AMBIGUOUS_NO_RETRY") end
            local why = tostring(reply.Reason or "UNKNOWN")
            if why ~= "BossFight" or attempt == config.returnRetries then
                return finish(false, "VULCAN_WORLD_RETURN_REJECTED", why)
            end
            if not ctx:wait(12) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            local settled = ctx:await(function()
                if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true then return true end
            end, 40)
            if not settled then return finish(false, "VULCAN_LOCK_STILL_ACTIVE", "BossFight") end
        end
        return finish(false, "VULCAN_WORLD_RETURN_EXHAUSTED")
    end
    return command
end
return CommandController
end
-- END MODULE boss.Vulcan.CommandController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.Vulcan.Config
__factories["boss.Vulcan.Config"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Avro Vulcan / World 30. Port of successful standalone V3 (bomb dodge).
return {
    bossId = "VULCAN", displayName = "Avro Vulcan", gameBossKey = "Vulcan",
    arenaCenter = {x = 0.5, y = 1, z = -16384}, arenaRadius = 550,
    arenaFloorHalfX = 399.5, arenaFloorHalfZ = 356,
    commandSafePosition = {x = -31962.1074, y = 344.357483, z = 32887.3203},
    arenaTimeout = 48, maxFightSeconds = 1020,
    reportTimeoutSeconds = 110, reportHoldSeconds = 3,
    reportCloseTimeoutSeconds = 125, exitTimeoutSeconds = 85,
    returnLockTimeoutSeconds = 80, returnRetries = 3,
    autoDodge = true,
    dodgeMargin = 16, dodgeLookaheadSeconds = 36,
    dodgeMinInterval = 0.38, dodgeMaxStep = 215,
    dodgeBombClearTimeout = 13,
}
end
