-- BEGIN MODULE boss.Vulcan.DodgeController
__factories["boss.Vulcan.DodgeController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Proven standalone V3 bomb-impact dodge, extracted for BossManager jobs.
-- Uses VulcanEvent Attack.Passes[*].Bombs[*].P/T1/T0 and BlastRadius.
-- Does not modify B21's radar focus or any other boss controller.
local DodgeController = {}

function DodgeController.new(env, config, observer)
    local platform, runtime = env.services.roblox, env.runtime
    local player, workspace = platform:player(), platform:workspace()
    local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
    local riftHazards = env.services.riftHazards
    local center = config.arenaCenter
    local danger = {clockT0 = nil, bombs = {}, moves = 0, scanned = 0,
        lastMove = -math.huge, lastWarning = -math.huge, activeCount = 0,
        lastGate = nil, lastReportedGate = nil, lastGateAt = -math.huge, gateCounts = {}}
    local controller = {}
    local runningContext
    local completed = false

    local function emit(name, data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit(name, data or {}) end
    end
    local function root()
        local character = player.Character
        return character, character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    end
    local function inDodgeArena(p)
        return p and math.abs(p.X - center.x) < config.arenaFloorHalfX - 22
            and math.abs(p.Z - center.z) < config.arenaFloorHalfZ - 22
            and p.Y > center.y - 28 and p.Y < center.y + 245
    end
    local function planarDistance(a, b)
        local dx, dz = a.X - b.X, a.Z - b.Z
        return math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
    end
    local function bombClock()
        if not danger.clockT0 then return nil end
        return workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - danger.clockT0
    end
    local function dodgeGate(reason, extra)
        danger.lastGate = reason
        danger.gateCounts[reason] = (danger.gateCounts[reason] or 0) + 1
        local now = os.clock()
        if reason == danger.lastReportedGate and now - danger.lastGateAt < 3 then return end
        danger.lastReportedGate, danger.lastGateAt = reason, now
        local row = extra or {}
        row.reason, row.tracked = reason, #danger.bombs
        emit("VULCAN_DODGE_GATE", row)
    end
    local function trackBombPasses(e)
        if type(e.Passes) ~= "table" then return end
        local count, nearby, soonest = 0, 0, math.huge
        local _, hrp = root()
        for _, pass in ipairs(e.Passes) do
            if type(pass) == "table" and type(pass.Bombs) == "table" then
                local radius = math.clamp(tonumber(pass.BlastRadius) or 16, 8, 80)
                for _, bomb in ipairs(pass.Bombs) do
                    if type(bomb) == "table" and typeof(bomb.P) == "Vector3"
                        and type(bomb.T1) == "number" and bomb.T1 == bomb.T1 then
                        danger.bombs[#danger.bombs + 1] = {
                            position = bomb.P, impact = bomb.T1, release = bomb.T0,
                            radius = radius, attack = tostring(e.Kind or "UNKNOWN"),
                        }
                        count, soonest = count + 1, math.min(soonest, bomb.T1)
                        if hrp and planarDistance(hrp.Position, bomb.P)
                            < radius + config.dodgeMargin then nearby = nearby + 1 end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        if #danger.bombs > 1300 then
            local tail = {}
            for i = math.max(1, #danger.bombs - 950), #danger.bombs do
                tail[#tail + 1] = danger.bombs[i]
            end
            danger.bombs = tail
        end
        local tau = bombClock()
        emit("VULCAN_DODGE_PLAN", {attack = tostring(e.Kind), newBombs = count,
            withinBlastMargin = nearby, tracked = #danger.bombs,
            clockReady = danger.clockT0 ~= nil,
            nearestImpactSeconds = soonest < math.huge and tau
                and math.floor((soonest - tau) * 10) / 10 or nil,
            insideDodgeArena = hrp and inDodgeArena(hrp.Position) or false,
            inBossFight = player:GetAttribute("InBossFight"),
            participant = observer:participating(),
            inHideout = player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout")})
    end
    local function activeBombs(nowTau)
        local active = {}
        if not nowTau then return active end
        for i = #danger.bombs, 1, -1 do
            local bomb = danger.bombs[i]
            if bomb.impact < nowTau - 1.2 then
                table.remove(danger.bombs, i)
            elseif bomb.impact <= nowTau + config.dodgeLookaheadSeconds then
                active[#active + 1] = bomb
            end
        end
        if riftHazards and type(riftHazards.groundFootprints)=="function" then
            local ok,spots=pcall(riftHazards.groundFootprints,riftHazards,config.dodgeLookaheadSeconds)
            if ok and type(spots)=="table" then
                local _,part=root()
                for _,spot in ipairs(spots) do
                    if part and typeof(spot.p)=="Vector3" and type(spot.r)=="number"
                        and math.abs(part.Position.Y-spot.p.Y)<=32 then
                        active[#active+1]={position=spot.p,radius=spot.r,
                            impact=nowTau+math.max(0,(spot.impact or workspace:GetServerTimeNow())-workspace:GetServerTimeNow()),
                            source=spot.name or "RIFT_STRIKE"}
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        danger.activeCount = #active
        return active
    end
    local function clearanceFromBombs(pos, bombs)
        local nearest = math.huge
        for _, bomb in ipairs(bombs) do
            local gap = planarDistance(pos, bomb.position) - bomb.radius - config.dodgeMargin
            if gap < nearest then nearest = gap end
        end
        return nearest
    end
    local function groundTarget(character, x, z, rootY)
        local params = RaycastParams.new()
        params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character}
        params.IgnoreWater = true
        local hit = workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(x, center.y + 80, z),
            Vector3.new(0, -155, 0), params)
        if not hit or hit.Normal.Y < 0.65 or not hit.Instance.CanCollide then return nil end
        if math.abs(hit.Position.Y - center.y) > 10 then return nil end
        local offset = math.clamp(rootY - center.y, 2.7, 4.8)
        return Vector3.new(x, hit.Position.Y + offset, z)
    end
    local function bestSafePosition(character, here, bombs)
        local best, bestScore, bestGap = nil, -math.huge, -math.huge
        local radii = {38, 65, 95, 125, 160, 195, config.dodgeMaxStep}
        for _, radius in ipairs(radii) do
            if radius <= config.dodgeMaxStep then
                for index = 0, 15 do
                    local angle = math.pi * 2 * index / 16
                    local x = here.X + math.cos(angle) * radius
                    local z = here.Z + math.sin(angle) * radius
                    if math.abs(x - center.x) < config.arenaFloorHalfX - 34
                        and math.abs(z - center.z) < config.arenaFloorHalfZ - 34 then
                        local gap = clearanceFromBombs(Vector3.new(x, here.Y, z), bombs)
                        if gap > 0 then
                            local score = 70 + math.min(gap, 90) * 0.22 - radius * 0.17
                            if score > bestScore then
                                local target = groundTarget(character, x, z, here.Y)
                                if target then
                                    best, bestScore, bestGap = target, score, gap
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return best, bestGap
    end

    function controller:observe(e)
        if type(e) ~= "table" or type(e.K) ~= "string" then return end
        local k = e.K
        if type(e.T0) == "number" and (not danger.clockT0 or k == "Resync") then
            danger.clockT0 = e.T0
            emit("VULCAN_DODGE_CLOCK", {source = k, t0 = e.T0})
        end
        if k == "Attack" then
            trackBombPasses(e)
        elseif k == "Outcome" then
            completed = true
        elseif k == "Death" and type(e.At) == "number" then
            local kept, canceled = {}, 0
            for _, b in ipairs(danger.bombs) do
                if type(b.release) == "number" and b.release > e.At then
                    canceled = canceled + 1
                else
                    kept[#kept + 1] = b
                end
            end
            danger.bombs = kept
            emit("VULCAN_DODGE_DEATH_CUT", {at = e.At, canceled = canceled, stillInFlight = #kept})
        end
    end

    local function dodgeStep(ctx)
        if ctx:isCancelled() or not config.autoDodge then return end
        local character, hrp = root()
        if not character or not hrp then dodgeGate("NO_CHARACTER"); return end
        local pos = hrp.Position
        if not inDodgeArena(pos) then
            dodgeGate("OUTSIDE_ARENA", {x = math.floor(pos.X), y = math.floor(pos.Y), z = math.floor(pos.Z)})
            return
        end
        local participant = observer:participating()
        local bossLock = player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true
        -- Preserve V3: stale Hideout flag must not block a confirmed arena participant.
        if not participant and not bossLock
            and (not completed or player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") == true) then
            dodgeGate("NOT_PARTICIPATING")
            return
        end
        local tau = bombClock() or 0 -- Rift timestamps use the server epoch directly.
        local bombs = activeBombs(tau)
        if #bombs == 0 then
            local nextImpact = math.huge
            for _, b in ipairs(danger.bombs) do nextImpact = math.min(nextImpact, b.impact) end
            dodgeGate("WAITING_FOR_WINDOW", {tau = math.floor(tau*10)/10,
                nextImpactIn = nextImpact < math.huge and math.floor((nextImpact - tau)*10)/10 or nil})
            return
        end
        danger.scanned = danger.scanned + 1
        local gap = clearanceFromBombs(pos, bombs)
        if gap > 0 then
            dodgeGate("SAFE_POSITION", {gap = math.floor(gap * 10)/10, upcoming = #bombs})
            return
        end
        if os.clock() - danger.lastMove < config.dodgeMinInterval then return end
        local target, targetGap = bestSafePosition(character, pos, bombs)
        if not target then
            danger.lastMove = os.clock()
            dodgeGate("NO_SAFE_POINT", {gap = math.floor(gap*10)/10, upcoming = #bombs})
            return
        end
        danger.lastMove = os.clock()
        local orientation = hrp.CFrame - hrp.Position
        dodgeGate("MOVE_ATTEMPT", {gap = math.floor(gap*10)/10, upcoming = #bombs,
            hideoutFlag = player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout")})
        local ok, why = pcall(function() character:PivotTo(CFrame.new(target) * orientation) end)
        if not ok then emit("VULCAN_DODGE_MOVE_ERROR", {reason = tostring(why)}); return end
        if not ctx:wait(0.11) then return end
        local _, after = root()
        local verified = after and planarDistance(after.Position, target) < 9
        if verified then danger.moves = danger.moves + 1 end
        local dt = math.huge
        for _, b in ipairs(bombs) do dt = math.min(dt, b.impact - tau) end
        emit("VULCAN_DODGE_MOVE", {verified = verified == true, bombs = #bombs,
            threatGap = math.floor(gap * 10)/10,
            safeGap = math.floor(targetGap * 10)/10,
            distance = math.floor(planarDistance(pos, target) + 0.5),
            postDistance = after and math.floor(planarDistance(after.Position, target) + 0.5) or nil,
            timeToNearestImpact = math.floor(dt*10)/10})
    end

    function controller:start(ctx)
        if not config.autoDodge or runningContext == ctx then return end
        runningContext = ctx
        ctx:deferCleanup(function()
            if runningContext == ctx then runningContext = nil end
        end)
        -- One scoped loop; no character/teleport activity after job cleanup.
        task.spawn(function()
            while runningContext == ctx and not ctx:isCancelled() do
                local ok, reason = pcall(dodgeStep, ctx)
                if not ok and os.clock() - danger.lastWarning > 2 then
                    danger.lastWarning = os.clock()
                    emit("VULCAN_DODGE_SCAN_ERROR", {reason = tostring(reason)})
                end
                task.wait(0.13)
            end
        end)
    end
    function controller:waitForReleasedBombs(ctx)
        if not config.autoDodge or #danger.bombs == 0 then return end
        local deadline = runtime:now() + config.dodgeBombClearTimeout
        local initial = #danger.bombs
        emit("VULCAN_BOMB_CLEAR_WAIT", {tracked = initial})
        while not ctx:isCancelled() and runtime:now() < deadline do
            local tau = bombClock()
            if not tau then break end
            local latest = -math.huge
            for _, b in ipairs(danger.bombs) do latest = math.max(latest, b.impact) end
            if latest < tau - 1.2 then
                emit("VULCAN_BOMB_CLEAR", {trackedAtOutcome = initial, remaining = 0})
                return
            end
            if not ctx:wait(0.18) then break end
        end
        emit("VULCAN_BOMB_CLEAR_TIMEOUT", {trackedAtOutcome = initial,
            pending = #danger.bombs, note = "Continue report; dodge remains active"})
    end
    function controller:reset()
        if runningContext ~= nil then return false, "DODGE_ACTIVE" end
        danger.clockT0, danger.bombs, danger.activeCount = nil, {}, 0
        completed = false
        danger.moves, danger.scanned, danger.lastMove = 0, 0, -math.huge
        danger.lastGate, danger.lastReportedGate, danger.lastGateAt = nil, nil, -math.huge
        danger.gateCounts = {}
        return true
    end
    function controller:status()
        return {tracked = #danger.bombs, active = danger.activeCount,
            moves = danger.moves, clockReady = danger.clockT0 ~= nil,
            lastGate = danger.lastGate, gateCounts = danger.gateCounts}
    end
    return controller
end
return DodgeController
end
-- END MODULE boss.Vulcan.DodgeController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.Vulcan.RepeatPolicy
__factories["boss.Vulcan.RepeatPolicy"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local SharedRepeatPolicy = require("boss.shared.RepeatPolicy")
local RepeatPolicy = {}
function RepeatPolicy.new(env)
    return SharedRepeatPolicy.new(env, "Expected confirmed Vulcan outcome")
end
return RepeatPolicy
end
-- END MODULE boss.Vulcan.RepeatPolicy

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.Vulcan.ReportController
__factories["boss.Vulcan.ReportController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local DeferredOutcome = require("boss.shared.DeferredOutcome")
-- Vulcan adaptive report: Outcome -> report (any location) -> Continue -> exit -> return.
-- Port of standalone V1; never treat Outcome alone as a completed report.
local ReportController = {}

function ReportController.new(env, config, repeatPolicy, dodge)
    local platform, gui, runtime = env.services.roblox, env.services.gui, env.runtime
    local player = platform:player()
    local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
    local writer = env.state:port("boss")
    local report = {}
    local terminal = DeferredOutcome.new(env, config.bossId, "VulcanFightGeneration")
    local confirmedOutcome, outcomeAt = nil, nil
    local lastHealthAt = 0
    local seenReport, firstOpenedAt = false, nil
    local listeningContext, connection, resultsController = nil, nil, nil
    local function emit(name, data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit(name, data or {}) end
    end
    local function loadController()
        if resultsController then return resultsController end
        local folder = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("ClientModules")
        local mod = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("BossResultsController")
        if not mod or not mod:IsA("ModuleScript") then return nil end
        -- The build bundler replaces project requires. Invoke Roblox require only
        -- dynamically for the game's own ModuleScript, as the B21 controller does.
        local loader = getfenv(0)["require"]
        local ok, value = pcall(loader, mod)
        if not ok or type(value) ~= "table" then return nil end
        if type(value.IsOpen) ~= "function" or type(value.Dismiss) ~= "function" then return nil end
        resultsController = value
        return value
    end
    local function officialOpen()
        local ctrl = loadController()
        if ctrl and type(ctrl.IsOpen) == "function" then
            local ok, result = pcall(ctrl.IsOpen)
            if ok and result == true then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function isOpen()
        return player:GetAttribute("BossResultsOpen") == true or officialOpen()
    end
    local function matchingReport(guiRoot)
        if not guiRoot then return nil end
        local isVulcan, won, lost = false, false, false
        for _, node in ipairs(guiRoot:GetDescendants()) do
            if node:IsA("TextLabel") then
                local value = string.upper(tostring(node.Text or ""))
                if value:find("VULCAN", 1, true) then isVulcan = true end
                if value:find("DEFEATED", 1, true) or value:find("VICTORY", 1, true) then won = true end
                if value:find("MISSION FAILED", 1, true) then lost = true end
            end
        end
        if isVulcan and won ~= lost then return won and "WIN" or "LOSS" end
        return nil
    end

    function report:watch(ctx)
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        if listeningContext == ctx and connection then return true end
        if connection then connection:Disconnect(); connection = nil end
        local folder = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        local remote = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("VulcanEvent")
        if not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then return false, "VULCAN_EVENT_MISSING" end
        local current = remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(packet)
            if type(packet) ~= "table" or type(packet.K) ~= "string" then return end
            terminal:observe(packet)
            -- The event listener is active before StartBoss; plan impacts immediately.
            dodge:observe(packet)
            local kind = packet.K
            if kind == "Outcome" and type(packet.Victory) == "boolean" then
                confirmedOutcome = packet.Victory and "WIN" or "LOSS"
                outcomeAt = runtime:now()
            end
            if kind == "Start" or kind == "Begin" or kind == "Phase" or kind == "Attack"
                or kind == "Ecm" or kind == "Death" or kind == "Resync" or kind == "Health"
                or kind == "End" or kind == "Outcome" then
                if kind == "Health" then
                    if runtime:now() - lastHealthAt < 4 then return end
                    lastHealthAt = runtime:now()
                end
                local detail = {kind = kind}
                for _, field in ipairs({"Phase", "Name", "Reason", "EndReason", "Victory",
                    "Kind", "State", "Index", "From", "To", "HP", "MaxHP", "Generation"}) do
                    local value = packet[field]
                    if type(value) == "string" or type(value) == "number" or type(value) == "boolean" then
                        detail[field] = value
                    end
                end
                if kind == "Attack" and type(packet.Passes) == "table" then
                    detail.passes = #packet.Passes
                    detail.hasDecoy = type(packet.Decoy) == "table"
                    detail.hasBlackSky = type(packet.BlackSky) == "table"
                end
                emit("VULCAN_EVENT", detail)
            end
        end)
        connection, listeningContext = current, ctx
        ctx:deferCleanup(function()
            if connection == current then
                current:Disconnect()
                connection, listeningContext = nil, nil
            end
        end)
        return true
    end
    function report:cleanup()
        if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
        connection, listeningContext = nil, nil
        -- Keep outcome and report evidence across RETURN/REPORT retries.
    end
    function report:verifiedDeferredOutcome(encounter)
        return terminal:verified(encounter, "LOSS")
    end
    function report:resetOutcome()
        terminal:reset()
        confirmedOutcome, outcomeAt, seenReport, firstOpenedAt = nil, nil, false, nil
        dodge:reset()
    end
    function report:inspect()
        local root = gui:find(env.profile.paths.bossReport)
        local active = isOpen() -- Same verified V2 signal: BossResultsOpen or official controller.IsOpen()
        if active then
            seenReport = true
            firstOpenedAt = firstOpenedAt or runtime:now()
        end
        local guiOutcome = active and matchingReport(root) or nil
        local outcome = confirmedOutcome or guiOutcome
        return {
            active = active, matchesBoss = confirmedOutcome ~= nil or guiOutcome ~= nil,
            outcome = outcome, report = root, seen = seenReport,
            pendingPresentation = confirmedOutcome ~= nil and not seenReport
                and outcomeAt ~= nil and runtime:now() - outcomeAt < config.reportTimeoutSeconds,
        }
    end
    function report:reconcile(encounter)
        local evidence = self:inspect()
        if evidence.matchesBoss and evidence.outcome
            and (not encounter.outcome or encounter.outcome == evidence.outcome) then return true end
        return encounter.outcome ~= nil and seenReport and not evidence.active
    end
    function report:resolve(ctx, encounter)
        local watching, why = self:watch(ctx)
        if not watching then return {ok = false, code = why} end
        -- V2 REQUIREMENT: Outcome alone never authorizes return/Continue.
        local evidence = ctx:await(function()
            local current = self:inspect()
            if current.active and current.matchesBoss and current.outcome then return current end
            if seenReport and not current.active and (encounter.outcome or current.outcome) then
                return current -- manually dismissed report after previously observing it
            end
        end, config.reportTimeoutSeconds)
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        if not evidence then return {ok = false, code = "VULCAN_REPORT_NOT_OBSERVED"} end
        if evidence.outcome and encounter.outcome and evidence.outcome ~= encounter.outcome then
            return {ok = false, held = true, code = "BOSS_OUTCOME_CONFLICT"}
        end
        local outcome = evidence.outcome or encounter.outcome
        if not outcome then return {ok = false, code = "VULCAN_OUTCOME_UNVERIFIED"} end
        if not encounter.outcome then
            local accepted = writer:recordBossReport(outcome,
                runtime:epoch() + repeatPolicy:outcomeDelay(outcome))
            if not accepted then return {ok = false, held = true, code = "BOSS_OUTCOME_CONFLICT"} end
            encounter = env.state:snapshot().boss.encounter
        end
        if not evidence.active then
            writer:closeReport()
            return {ok = true, code = "VULCAN_REPORT_MANUALLY_CLOSED"}
        end
        local at = platform:position()
        local place = player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") == true and "HIDEOUT" or "OTHER"
        if place == "OTHER" and at then
            local dx, dz = at.X - config.arenaCenter.x, at.Z - config.arenaCenter.z
            if dx * dx + dz * dz < config.arenaRadius * config.arenaRadius then
                place = "ARENA"
            end
        end
        emit("VULCAN_REPORT_OPEN", {outcome = outcome, location = place,
            inBossFight = player:GetAttribute("InBossFight")})
        local controller = loadController()
        if not controller then return {ok = false, code = "VULCAN_RESULT_CONTROLLER_MISSING_MANUAL_CONTINUE"} end
        if not encounter.continueAttempted then
            local ready = ctx:await(function()
                if not isOpen() then return "MANUALLY_CLOSED" end
                local armed = false
                if type(controller.Debug) == "function" then
                    local ok, message = pcall(controller.Debug)
                    armed = ok and type(message) == "string"
                        and message:find("armed=true", 1, true) ~= nil
                end
                if armed and firstOpenedAt
                    and runtime:now() - firstOpenedAt >= config.reportHoldSeconds then return "ARMED" end
            end, config.reportTimeoutSeconds)
            if ctx:isCancelled() then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
            if ready == "MANUALLY_CLOSED" then
                writer:closeReport()
                return {ok = true, code = "VULCAN_REPORT_MANUALLY_CLOSED"}
            end
            if ready ~= "ARMED" then return {ok = false, code = "VULCAN_REPORT_NOT_ARMED_MANUAL_CONTINUE"} end
            if not writer:markContinueAttempt() then return {ok = false, code = "VULCAN_CONTINUE_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED"} end
            local sent, err = pcall(function() controller.Dismiss("continue") end)
            if not sent then return {ok = false, code = "VULCAN_CONTINUE_FAILED: " .. tostring(err)} end
            emit("VULCAN_REPORT_CONTINUE", {code = "CONTINUE_REQUESTED"})
        end
        local closed = ctx:await(function() if not self:inspect().active then return true end end,
            config.reportCloseTimeoutSeconds)
        if not closed then return {ok = false, code = "VULCAN_REPORT_STILL_OPEN_MANUAL_CONTINUE"} end
        writer:closeReport()
        return {ok = true, code = "VULCAN_REPORT_CLOSED"}
    end
    return report
end
return ReportController
end
-- END MODULE boss.Vulcan.ReportController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.Vulcan.Vulcan
__factories["boss.Vulcan.Vulcan"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- BossManager registration. B21, Red Baron and B-17 are untouched.
local Config = require("boss.Vulcan.Config")
local ArenaObserver = require("boss.Vulcan.ArenaObserver")
local CommandController = require("boss.Vulcan.CommandController")
local CombatController = require("boss.Vulcan.CombatController")
local DodgeController = require("boss.Vulcan.DodgeController")
local ReportController = require("boss.Vulcan.ReportController")
local RepeatPolicy = require("boss.Vulcan.RepeatPolicy")
local Vulcan = {}
function Vulcan.definition()
    return {bossId = Config.bossId, displayName = Config.displayName, create = function(env)
        local observer = ArenaObserver.new(env, Config)
        local dodge = DodgeController.new(env, Config, observer)
        local repeatPolicy = RepeatPolicy.new(env)
        local report = ReportController.new(env, Config, repeatPolicy, dodge)
        return {config = Config, observer = observer, dodge = dodge,
            report = report, repeatPolicy = repeatPolicy,
            command = CommandController.new(env, Config, observer, report),
            combat = CombatController.new(env, Config, observer, report, dodge)}
    end}
end
return Vulcan
end
-- END MODULE boss.Vulcan.Vulcan

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.Zeppelin.ArenaObserver
__factories["boss.Zeppelin.ArenaObserver"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local ArenaObserver={}
function ArenaObserver.new(env, config)
    local platform=env.services.roblox
    local player, world=platform:player(),platform:workspace()
    local observer={}
    function observer:participating()
        return player:GetAttribute("ZeppelinParticipant")==true
    end
    function observer:inArenaPosition(pos)
        pos=pos or platform:position()
        if typeof(pos)~="Vector3" then return false end
        local center=player:GetAttribute("ZeppelinFlightCentre")
        if typeof(center)~="Vector3" then center=world:GetAttribute("ZeppelinFlightCentre") end
        if typeof(center)~="Vector3" then
            center=Vector3.new(config.arenaFallbackCenter.x,config.arenaFallbackCenter.y,config.arenaFallbackCenter.z)
        end
        return (pos-center).Magnitude<config.arenaRadius
    end
    function observer:inArena()
        return self:participating() or
            (player:GetAttribute("InBossFight")==true and self:inArenaPosition())
    end
    function observer:state()
        return {
            phase=player:GetAttribute("ZeppelinRaidPhase") or world:GetAttribute("ZeppelinRaidPhase"),
            fightState=player:GetAttribute("ZeppelinFightState") or world:GetAttribute("ZeppelinFightState"),
            active=player:GetAttribute("InBossFight"),
            participant=player:GetAttribute("ZeppelinParticipant"),
            inBossFight=player:GetAttribute("InBossFight"),
            flightActive=player:GetAttribute("ZeppelinFlightActive") or world:GetAttribute("ZeppelinFlightActive")
        }
    end
    return observer
end
return ArenaObserver
end
-- END MODULE boss.Zeppelin.ArenaObserver

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.Zeppelin.CombatController
__factories["boss.Zeppelin.CombatController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local CombatController={}
function CombatController.new(env,config,observer,report,flight)
    local runtime,telemetry=env.runtime,env.services.telemetry
    local combat={supportsContinuation=true, suspendsForContinuation=true, revalidatesNativeEnd=true}
    local function emit(kind,fields)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit("ZEPPELIN_"..kind,fields or {}) end
    end
    function combat:nativeEncounter()
        local id, state = flight:nativeEncounter()
        local ended = report:nativeEndSessionId()
        if ended and (not id or id == ended and state == "ENDING") then return ended, "TERMINAL" end
        return id, state
    end
    function combat:invalidateNativeEnd(sessionId)
        report:invalidateNativeEnd(sessionId)
    end
    function combat:run(ctx,encounter,rebound)
        local watching,why=report:watch(ctx)
        if not watching then return {code=why or "ZEPPELIN_REPORT_WATCH_FAILED"} end
        local started,reason=flight:start(ctx,encounter,rebound)
        if not started then
            emit("FLIGHT_GATE",{reason=reason})
            return {code=reason or "ZEPPELIN_FLIGHT_INIT_FAILED"}
        end
        local untilTime=runtime:now()+config.maxFightSeconds
        local rebindDeadline = rebound and math.min(untilTime, runtime:now()+30)
        local previous,lastLog=nil,0
        local code="OUTCOME_NOT_OBSERVED_TIMEOUT"
        while not ctx:isCancelled() and not ctx:isCombatSuspended() and runtime:now()<untilTime do
            local observed=report:inspect()
            if observed.outcome then code="OUTCOME_OBSERVED";break end
            flight:step()
            if ctx:isCombatSuspended() then break end
            local state=observer:state()
            local key=tostring(state.fightState).."/"..tostring(state.phase).."/"..tostring(state.flightActive)
            if key~=previous or runtime:now()-lastLog>=12 then
                emit("STATE",state)
                previous,lastLog=key,runtime:now()
            end
            if rebindDeadline and runtime:now() >= rebindDeadline and not flight:status().rebound then
                code="PILOT_REBIND_PENDING"
                break
            end
            if flight:exhausted() then
                -- The flight is not verified; do not send Solo again or guess a victory.
                emit("FLIGHT_FAILED",flight:status())
                code="ZEPPELIN_TAKEOFF_NOT_VERIFIED"
                break
            end
            if not ctx:wait(.12) then break end
        end
        emit("FLIGHT_SUMMARY",flight:status())
        -- Release owned pilot inputs before report and return.
        if not ctx:isCombatSuspended() then flight:stop() end
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return {code="CANCELLED"} end
        return {code=code}
    end
    return combat
end
return CombatController
end
-- END MODULE boss.Zeppelin.CombatController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.Zeppelin.CommandController
__factories["boss.Zeppelin.CommandController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Zeppelin standalone V1 flow: Hideout -> Boss Command pass -> ONE Solo -> combat.
-- Adaptive report may open in arena OR after exit; never request return before Continue.
local DirectBossTravel = require("main.navigation.DirectBossTravel")
local CommandController = {}

function CommandController.new(env, config, observer, report)
    local platform, runtime = env.services.roblox, env.runtime
    local player, workspace = platform:player(), platform:workspace()
    local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
    local travel = DirectBossTravel.new(env)
    local command = {}
    local function emit(name, data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit(name, data or {}) end
    end
    local function remote(name)
        local storage = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage")
        local folder = storage:FindFirstChild("Remotes") or storage:WaitForChild("Remotes", 10)
        local item = folder and (folder:FindFirstChild(name) or folder:WaitForChild(name, 7))
        return item and item:IsA("RemoteEvent") and item or nil
    end
    local function active(ctx) return runtime:isActive(ctx) and not ctx:isCancelled() end
    local function cooldownLeft()
        local raw = player:GetAttribute("BossStartCooldowns")
        if type(raw) ~= "string" or raw == "" then return 0 end
        local ok, data = pcall(function() return platform:service("HttpService"):JSONDecode(raw) end)
        if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then return 0 end
        return math.max(0, (tonumber(data[config.gameBossKey]) or 0) - workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
    end

    function command:prepare(ctx)
        local watching, why = report:watch(ctx) -- watch BEFORE sending any boss request
        if not watching then return false, why end
        if observer:inArena() then return true, "ZEPPELIN_ALREADY_IN_ARENA" end
        if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true then return false, "OTHER_BOSS_ACTIVE" end
        if not active(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        -- V3: wait for Zeppelin cooldown BEFORE issuing Boss Command requests.
        local left = cooldownLeft()
        if left > 0 and config.waitForCooldown then
            if left > config.maxCooldownWaitSeconds then
                emit("ZEPPELIN_COOLDOWN_GATE", {remaining = math.ceil(left), code = "WAIT_LIMIT"})
                return false, "ZEPPELIN_COOLDOWN_ABOVE_WAIT_LIMIT"
            end
            emit("ZEPPELIN_COOLDOWN_WAIT", {remaining = math.ceil(left)})
            local untilTime = runtime:now() + config.maxCooldownWaitSeconds
            local lastTick = runtime:now()
            while active(ctx) and cooldownLeft() > 0 and runtime:now() < untilTime do
                if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true then
                    return false, "OTHER_ENCOUNTER_BECAME_ACTIVE"
                end
                if runtime:now() - lastTick >= 25 then
                    lastTick = runtime:now()
                    emit("ZEPPELIN_COOLDOWN_WAITING", {remaining = math.ceil(cooldownLeft())})
                end
                if not ctx:wait(math.min(3, math.max(0.5, cooldownLeft()))) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
            end
            if not active(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
            if cooldownLeft() > 0 then return false, "ZEPPELIN_COOLDOWN_WAIT_LIMIT_REACHED" end
            emit("ZEPPELIN_COOLDOWN_READY", {remaining = 0})
        end
        local entered = travel:enterHideout(ctx)
        emit("ZEPPELIN_DIRECT_HIDEOUT", {ok = entered.ok, code = entered.code, reason = entered.reason})
        if not entered.ok then return false, entered.code end
        local positioned = travel:moveToKnownPoint(ctx, config.commandSafePosition, {
            requireHideout = true, radius = 6, settle = 0.85,
        })
        emit("ZEPPELIN_COMMAND_POSITION", {ok = positioned.ok, code = positioned.code})
        if not positioned.ok then return false, positioned.code end
        return true, "ZEPPELIN_COMMAND_READY"
    end

    function command:readiness()
        if observer:inArena() then return "READY" end
        if not travel:inHideout() then return "UNKNOWN" end
        local secs = cooldownLeft()
        if secs > 0 then
            secs = math.ceil(secs)
            return string.format("%d:%02d", math.floor(secs / 60), secs % 60)
        end
        -- The server pass remains authoritative for unlock/eligibility.
        return "READY"
    end

    function command:startSolo(ctx, markAttempt)
        if not active(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        if observer:participating() then return true, "ZEPPELIN_ALREADY_FIGHTING" end
        if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true then return false, "OTHER_BOSS_ACTIVE" end
        if not travel:inHideout() then return false, "NOT_IN_HIDEOUT" end
        if self:readiness() ~= "READY" then return false, "ZEPPELIN_NOT_READY" end
        local watching, why = report:watch(ctx)
        if not watching then return false, why end
        local hideout, accept = remote("PersonalHideoutRemote"), remote("BossCommanderAccept")
        if not hideout or not accept then return false, "ZEPPELIN_COMMAND_REMOTES_MISSING" end
        local passReply, acceptReply
        local passConnection = hideout.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
            if type(e) == "table" and e.Kind == "BossCommand" and e.Op == "Start"
                and e.BossKey == config.gameBossKey then passReply = e end
        end)
        local acceptConnection = accept.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
            if type(e) == "table" and e.Accepted ~= nil then acceptReply = e end
        end)
        local function finish(ok, code)
            passConnection:Disconnect()
            acceptConnection:Disconnect()
            return ok, code
        end
        local sent, err = pcall(function()
            hideout:FireServer({Action = "StartBoss", BossKey = config.gameBossKey, Solo = true})
        end)
        if not sent then return finish(false, "ZEPPELIN_PASS_SEND_FAILED: " .. tostring(err)) end
        local gotPass = ctx:await(function() return passReply end, 10)
        if not active(ctx) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
        if not gotPass then return finish(false, "ZEPPELIN_PASS_TIMEOUT_NO_RETRY") end
        emit("ZEPPELIN_PASS_RESULT", {ok = gotPass.Ok == true, reason = gotPass.Reason})
        if gotPass.Ok ~= true then return finish(false, "ZEPPELIN_PASS_REJECTED: " .. tostring(gotPass.Reason)) end
        -- Mark before firing the irreversible Solo request; never blind retry.
        if not markAttempt() then return finish(false, "ZEPPELIN_SOLO_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED") end
        sent, err = pcall(function() accept:FireServer({Solo = true}) end)
        if not sent then return finish(false, "ZEPPELIN_SOLO_SEND_FAILED: " .. tostring(err)) end
        local observed = ctx:await(function()
            if acceptReply and acceptReply.Accepted == false then return "REJECTED" end
            if observer:participating() then return "ENTERED" end
        end, config.arenaTimeout)
        if not active(ctx) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
        emit("ZEPPELIN_SOLO_RESULT", {code = observed or "AMBIGUOUS", accepted = acceptReply and acceptReply.Accepted})
        if observed == "ENTERED" then return finish(true, "ZEPPELIN_FIGHT_VERIFIED") end
        if observed == "REJECTED" then
            return finish(false, "ZEPPELIN_SOLO_REJECTED: " .. tostring(acceptReply.Reason))
        end
        return finish(false, "ZEPPELIN_SOLO_AMBIGUOUS_NO_RETRY")
    end

    function command:close(_) return true end -- No command GUI was opened.

    function command:returnHome(ctx, home)
        if not active(ctx) then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        if type(home) ~= "number" or home < 1 or home % 1 ~= 0 then
            return {ok = false, code = "INVALID_HOME_WORLD"}
        end
        if report:inspect().active then return {ok = false, code = "ZEPPELIN_REPORT_STILL_OPEN"} end
        -- Preserve standalone V1 lock checks before return, regardless of report location.
        local released = ctx:await(function()
            if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true
                and player:GetAttribute("ZeppelinParticipant") ~= true then return true end
        end, config.returnLockTimeoutSeconds)
        if not released then
            emit("ZEPPELIN_RETURN_LOCK_PENDING", {world = home})
            return {ok = false, code = "ZEPPELIN_RETURN_LOCK_PENDING", reason = "BossFight"}
        end
        local exit = ctx:await(function()
            if player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") == true then return "BOSS_COMMAND_HIDEOUT" end
            if not observer:inArenaPosition() then return "OUTSIDE_ARENA" end
        end, config.exitTimeoutSeconds)
        emit("ZEPPELIN_ARENA_EXIT", {code = exit or "LOCK_RELEASED_STILL_IN_ARENA"})
        -- As in tested standalone V1, a released lock permits a direct verified travel even
        -- if the game has not repositioned the player outside the arena yet.
        if not ctx:wait(1.5) then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        local request, prepare, result = remote("RequestWorldTravel"), remote("NavPrepareWorlds"), remote("WorldTravelResult")
        if not request or not prepare then return {ok = false, code = "ZEPPELIN_WORLD_TRAVEL_REMOTES_MISSING"} end
        local position = platform:position()
        if not position then return {ok = false, code = "CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE"} end
        if tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")) == home
            and player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") ~= true
            and not observer:inArenaPosition() then
            return {ok = true, code = "ALREADY_IN_HOME", world = home}
        end
        local reply
        local connection = result and result.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(e)
            if type(e) == "table" and e.Kind == "Result" and tonumber(e.WorldId) == home then reply = e end
        end) or nil
        local function finish(ok, code, reason)
            if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
            emit("ZEPPELIN_DIRECT_RETURN", {ok = ok, code = code, reason = reason, world = home})
            return {ok = ok, code = code, reason = reason, world = home}
        end
        for attempt = 1, config.returnRetries do
            if not active(ctx) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            reply = nil
            local prior = platform:position()
            if not prior then return finish(false, "CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE") end
            local sent, err = pcall(function() prepare:FireServer("stream", home) end)
            if not sent then return finish(false, "WORLD_PREPARE_SEND_FAILED", tostring(err)) end
            if not ctx:wait(0.12) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            sent, err = pcall(function() request:FireServer(home) end)
            if not sent then return finish(false, "WORLD_REQUEST_SEND_FAILED", tostring(err)) end
            local observed = ctx:await(function()
                if reply and reply.Ok == false then return "REJECTED" end
                local current = platform:position()
                if current and platform:distance(current, prior) > 50
                    and tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")) == home
                    and player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") ~= true
                    and player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true
                    and not observer:inArenaPosition() then return "VERIFIED" end
            end, 17)
            emit("ZEPPELIN_RETURN_ATTEMPT", {attempt = attempt, code = observed or "AMBIGUOUS",
                reason = reply and reply.Reason})
            if observed == "VERIFIED" then return finish(true, "ZEPPELIN_HOME_VERIFIED") end
            if observed ~= "REJECTED" then return finish(false, "ZEPPELIN_RETURN_AMBIGUOUS_NO_RETRY") end
            local why = tostring(reply.Reason or "UNKNOWN")
            if why ~= "BossFight" or attempt == config.returnRetries then
                return finish(false, "ZEPPELIN_WORLD_RETURN_REJECTED", why)
            end
            if not ctx:wait(12) then return finish(false, "CANCELLED") end
            local settled = ctx:await(function()
                if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true then return true end
            end, 40)
            if not settled then return finish(false, "ZEPPELIN_LOCK_STILL_ACTIVE", "BossFight") end
        end
        return finish(false, "ZEPPELIN_WORLD_RETURN_EXHAUSTED")
    end
    return command
end
return CommandController
end
-- END MODULE boss.Zeppelin.CommandController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.Zeppelin.Config
__factories["boss.Zeppelin.Config"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Zeppelin (World 3). Config ported from live-tested Standalone ObjectiveFirst V3.
return {
    bossId = "ZEPPELIN", displayName = "Zeppelin", gameBossKey = "ZeppelinBoss",
    gameBossId = "World2Zeppelin",
    commandSafePosition = {x=-31962.1074, y=344.357483, z=32887.3203},
    arenaFallbackCenter = {x=6000, y=2000, z=0}, arenaRadius = 1800,
    arenaTimeout = 48, maxFightSeconds = 480,
    reportTimeoutSeconds = 125, reportHoldSeconds = 3,
    reportCloseTimeoutSeconds = 125, exitTimeoutSeconds = 110,
    returnLockTimeoutSeconds = 80, returnRetries = 3,
    waitForCooldown = true, maxCooldownWaitSeconds = 720,
    autoTakeOff = true, objectivePriority = true, squadronFocus = true,
    takeOffRetrySeconds = 3, maxTakeOffAttempts = 8,
}
end

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.Zeppelin.FlightController
__factories["boss.Zeppelin.FlightController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Zeppelin V3 objective-first pilot. This deliberately leaves all other boss pilots untouched.
-- Original steering logic preserved from live-tested Zeppelin_Standalone_AutoTest_V3_ObjectiveFirst.
local PilotControl=require("boss.shared.PilotControl")
local FlightController={}
function FlightController.new(env,config,observer)
    local platform=env.services.roblox
    local riftHazards=env.services.riftHazards
    local RS=platform:service("ReplicatedStorage")
    local P,W=platform:player(),platform:workspace()
    local telemetry=env.services.telemetry
    local settings=config
    local T={running=false,phase=0,destroyed={},partCount=0,
             takeOffAttempts=0,takeOffLastResult=nil,objectivePilotInstalled=false,
             sessionId=nil,sessionState=nil}
    local completed=false
    local flightRuntime,flightController,nativeController,nativePilot,spectateController=nil,nil,nil,nil,nil
    local raidConfig=nil
    local nextTakeOffAt,lastTakeOffGate,lastTakeOffStatus=0,nil,nil
    local seenFlightAt,flightStatusAt,lastFocusAt=nil,0,0
    local flight={}
    local function log(kind,data, encounterScoped)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit(encounterScoped and kind or "ZEPPELIN_"..kind,data or {}) end
    end
    local pilot=PilotControl.new(platform,log)
    local jobContext, avatar, rebind
    local function ownsCharacter()
        if not jobContext or jobContext:isCancelled() or jobContext:isCombatSuspended() then return false end
        local current = platform:character()
        return current.ready and avatar and current.character == avatar.character and current.humanoid == avatar.humanoid
    end
    local function progress(name, reason, state)
        log(name, {encounterId=rebind.encounterId,bossId=config.bossId,
            characterGeneration=rebind.generation,reason=reason}, true)
        jobContext:reportProgress(state)
    end
    local function isParticipating() return observer:participating() end
    local function phaseUpdate(value,source)
        value=tonumber(value)
        if value and value>=1 and value<=3 and value~=T.phase then
            T.phase=value
            log("PHASE",{phase=value,source=source})
        end
    end
local function manualActive()
    if flightController and type(flightController.IsActive) == "function" then
        local ok, result = pcall(flightController.IsActive)
        if ok then return result == true end
    end
    return false
end

local function pilotActive()
    if nativePilot and type(nativePilot.Active) == "function" then
        local ok, result = pcall(nativePilot.Active)
        if ok then return result == true end
    end
    return false
end

local function nativeSession()
    if nativeController and type(nativeController.Session) == "function" then
        local ok, session = pcall(nativeController.Session)
        if ok and type(session) == "table" then return session end
    end
end

local function nativeSessionDetails()
    local session = nativeSession()
    local hasSession, hasFortress = session and not session.Dead and not session.Ending, false
    if nativeController and type(nativeController.Fortress) == "function" then
        local ok, fortress = pcall(nativeController.Fortress)
        hasFortress = ok and fortress ~= nil
    end
    return hasSession, hasFortress
end

local function readFlight()
    local attrActive = P:GetAttribute("ZeppelinFlightActive") == true
        or W:GetAttribute("ZeppelinFlightActive") == true
    local focus = P:GetAttribute("ZeppelinSquadronFocus")
    if focus == nil then focus = W:GetAttribute("ZeppelinSquadronFocus") end
    if type(focus) ~= "string" then focus = nil end
    local targetName,plane,state
    local controllerActive=manualActive()
    if controllerActive and pilotActive() and isParticipating() and ownsCharacter()
        and P:GetAttribute("BossReviveDowned")~=true and P:GetAttribute("BossResultsOpen")~=true then
        local visuals=W:FindFirstChild("PlayerPlaneVisuals")
        local owned=visuals and visuals:FindFirstChild(tostring(P.UserId))
        -- ZeppelinRaid.Pilot.takeControl resumes one of the local player's visual aircraft.
        plane,state=PilotControl.bound(flightRuntime,flightController,function(model)
            local hp=model:GetAttribute("CurrentHP")
            return model.Parent==owned and model:GetAttribute("DuelId")==nil
                and model:GetAttribute("PlaneCrashing")~=true and model:GetAttribute("Repairing")~=true
                and (type(hp)~="number" or hp>0)
        end)
        local target=state and state.Target
        if typeof(target)=="Instance" then targetName=target:GetAttribute("ZeppelinPart") or target.Name end
    end
    local active=plane~=nil
    return active, focus, targetName, controllerActive, attrActive, pilotActive(), plane, state
end

local function recoverNativeTakeOff(active)
    if active or not settings.autoTakeOff or completed or not ownsCharacter() then return end
    local now = os.clock()
    if now < nextTakeOffAt then return end

    local phaseState = P:GetAttribute("ZeppelinFightState") or W:GetAttribute("ZeppelinFightState")
    local session = nativeSession()
    local confirmedActive = session and session.Active == true
        or T.sessionState == "Active" or phaseState == "Active"
    local cinematic = W:GetAttribute("BossCinematicActive") == true
    local hasSession, hasFortress = nativeSessionDetails()
    local clientEnemies = W:FindFirstChild("ClientEnemies")
    local airship = clientEnemies and clientEnemies:FindFirstChild("ActiveZeppelinBoss")
    local airshipReady = airship ~= nil and airship:IsA("Model") and airship.PrimaryPart ~= nil
    local reason
    if not isParticipating() then reason = "NOT_PARTICIPANT"
    elseif not confirmedActive then reason = "SESSION_NOT_ACTIVE"
    elseif cinematic then reason = "CINEMATIC_ACTIVE"
    elseif not nativeController or type(nativeController.TakeOff) ~= "function" then reason = "NATIVE_CONTROLLER_MISSING"
    elseif not hasSession then reason = "NATIVE_SESSION_MISSING"
    elseif not hasFortress and not airshipReady then reason = "AIRSHIP_MODEL_NOT_READY"
    elseif T.takeOffAttempts >= settings.maxTakeOffAttempts then reason = "ATTEMPT_LIMIT"
    end

    if reason then
        if reason ~= lastTakeOffGate or now - (T.lastGateAt or 0) > 10 then
            lastTakeOffGate = reason
            T.lastGateAt = now
            log("FLIGHT_GATE", {reason = reason, state = phaseState,
                nativeSession = hasSession, fortress = hasFortress,
                airshipModelReady = airshipReady, cinematic = cinematic,
                attempts = T.takeOffAttempts})
        end
        nextTakeOffAt = now + 2
        return
    end

    lastTakeOffGate = nil
    T.takeOffAttempts = T.takeOffAttempts + 1
    nextTakeOffAt = now + settings.takeOffRetrySeconds
    local ok, result = pcall(nativeController.TakeOff)
    T.takeOffLastResult = not ok and "ERROR" or (result == true and "ACCEPTED" or "REFUSED")
    local refusal
    if spectateController and type(spectateController.LastFlyRefusal) == "function" then
        local good, message = pcall(spectateController.LastFlyRefusal)
        if good and message ~= nil then refusal = tostring(message) end
    end
    log("FLIGHT_TAKEOFF", {attempt = T.takeOffAttempts,
        result = T.takeOffLastResult, error = not ok and tostring(result) or nil,
        refusal = refusal, nativePilotActive = pilotActive(),
        note = "A successful call is not proof flight has started"})
end
-- ===== V3: objective-first Zeppelin flight =====
-- Attack-run steering keeps the phase's Zeppelin component priority.
-- The native provider stays registered for the game's own autopilot toggle.
local autoState = {
    installed = false, session = nil, fortress = nil, target = nil, targetId = nil,
    phase = nil, mode = "Approach", side = 1, nextPick = 0,
    runUntil = 0, breakUntil = 0, breakDir = nil, runIn = nil,
    lastReport = 0, lastFocusSend = 0,
}

local function gamePhase(fortress)
    if fortress and type(fortress.PhaseIndex) == "function" then
        local ok, p = pcall(function() return fortress:PhaseIndex() end)
        if ok and type(p) == "number" and p >= 1 and p <= 3 then
            phaseUpdate(p, "FORTRESS_PHASE")
            return p
        end
    end
    if T.phase >= 1 and T.phase <= 3 then return T.phase end
    if not rebind then return 1 end
end

local function validPart(model, phase)
    if typeof(model) ~= "Instance" or not model:IsA("Model") or not model.Parent
        or not model.PrimaryPart then return nil end
    local id = model:GetAttribute("ZeppelinPart")
    if type(id) ~= "string" or T.destroyed[id] then return nil end
    if not raidConfig or type(raidConfig.PartById) ~= "table" then return nil end
    local row = raidConfig.PartById[id]
    if not row or row.Objective ~= phase then return nil end
    if model:GetAttribute("Crashing") == true then return nil end
    -- If the server/game has already excluded the model from Fortress:Targets(),
    -- the picker will not see it, even if its HP attributes are stale.
    return id, row
end

local function availableTargets(fortress, phase)
    if not fortress or type(fortress.Targets) ~= "function" then return {} end
    local ok, targets = pcall(function() return fortress:Targets() end)
    if not ok or type(targets) ~= "table" then return {} end
    local list = {}
    for _, model in ipairs(targets) do
        local id, row = validPart(model, phase)
        if id then table.insert(list, {model=model, id=id, row=row}) end
    end
    return list
end

local function flightStatus()
    if not flightRuntime or type(flightRuntime.Sim) ~= "function" then return nil end
    local ok, sim = pcall(flightRuntime.Sim)
    if not ok or sim == nil then return nil end
    local valid, position, rotation = pcall(function() return sim.Position, sim.Rotation end)
    if not valid or typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(rotation) ~= "CFrame" then return nil end
    return sim
end

local function choosePart(fortress, sim, phase)
    local list = availableTargets(fortress, phase)
    for _, target in ipairs(list) do
        if target.model == autoState.target then
            return target.model, target.id, target.row, #list
        end
    end
    local best, bestDist
    for _, target in ipairs(list) do
        local distance = (target.model.PrimaryPart.Position - sim.Position).Magnitude
        if not best or distance < bestDist then best, bestDist = target, distance end
    end
    return best and best.model, best and best.id, best and best.row, #list
end

local function floorCeilingAttr(name)
    local value = P:GetAttribute(name)
    if type(value) ~= "number" then value = W:GetAttribute(name) end
    return type(value) == "number" and value or nil
end

local function calcSteering(dt)
    if not T.running or completed or not isParticipating() then return nil end
    local fortress = autoState.fortress
    if not fortress or not fortress.Model or not fortress.Model.Parent then return nil end
    local sim = flightStatus()
    if not sim then return nil end
    local position = sim.Position
    local forward = sim.Rotation.LookVector
    local now = os.clock()
    local phase = gamePhase(fortress)
    if not phase then return nil end
    if autoState.phase ~= phase then
        autoState.phase = phase
        autoState.target, autoState.targetId = nil, nil
        autoState.mode, autoState.runIn = "Approach", nil
        autoState.nextPick = 0
        log("OBJECTIVE_PHASE", {phase=phase, kind=({"Gun","Engine","Core"})[phase]})
    end
    if now >= autoState.nextPick or autoState.target and not validPart(autoState.target,phase) then
        autoState.nextPick = now + 0.45
        local nextModel, nextId, row, count = choosePart(fortress, sim, phase)
        if nextModel ~= autoState.target then
            autoState.target, autoState.targetId = nextModel, nextId
            autoState.mode, autoState.runIn = "Approach", nil
            autoState.breakDir = nil
            T.objectiveTarget, T.objectiveKind, T.objectivePhase = nextId,
                row and row.Kind or nil, phase
            log("OBJECTIVE_TARGET", {id=nextId, kind=row and row.Kind,
                phase=phase, candidates=count, escortPriority=false})
        end
        if count == 0 and now - autoState.lastReport > 5 then
            autoState.lastReport = now
            log("OBJECTIVE_GATE", {reason="NO_OPEN_PHASE_COMPONENT", phase=phase,
                note="No escort or hull fallback: waiting for next server phase/parts"})
        end
    end
    local target = autoState.target
    local aim = nil
    local throttle = .85
    local firing = false
    local missile = false
    local floor = floorCeilingAttr("ZeppelinFlightFloor")
    local ceiling = floorCeilingAttr("ZeppelinFlightCeiling")
    if target and target.Parent and target.PrimaryPart then
        local goal = target.PrimaryPart.Position
        local line = goal - position
        local distance = line.Magnitude
        if distance < 0.1 then return {Fire=false, Throttle=.75, Aim=forward} end
        local angle = math.deg(math.acos(math.clamp(forward:Dot(line.Unit), -1, 1)))
        local outward, axis
        if type(fortress.Outward) == "function" then
            local ok, result, along = pcall(function() return fortress:Outward(goal) end)
            if ok then outward, axis = result, along end
        end
        if typeof(outward) ~= "Vector3" or outward.Magnitude < .01 then
            outward = (position-goal).Magnitude > .01 and (position-goal).Unit or Vector3.new(0,1,0)
        end
        if typeof(axis) ~= "Vector3" or axis.Magnitude < .01 then axis=Vector3.new(0,0,1) end
        if autoState.mode == "Approach" then
            if not autoState.runIn then
                local angleR = math.rad(35)
                autoState.runIn = (outward*math.cos(angleR) + axis*autoState.side*math.sin(angleR)).Unit*300
            end
            local via = goal + autoState.runIn
            if floor and ceiling and floor + 150 < ceiling then
                via = Vector3.new(via.X, math.clamp(via.Y, floor + 90, ceiling - 50), via.Z)
            end
            aim = via-position
            throttle = .9
            if aim.Magnitude < 90 or (distance < 320 and angle < 38) then
                autoState.mode="Run"
                autoState.runUntil=now+7
            end
        elseif autoState.mode == "Run" then
            aim = line
            throttle=.6
            firing = angle < 5 and distance < 240
            missile=angle < 12 and distance < 380
            if distance < 85 or now >= autoState.runUntil then
                firing,missile=false,false
                autoState.mode="Break"
                autoState.breakUntil=now+1.8
                autoState.side=-autoState.side
                autoState.breakDir=(outward + axis*autoState.side*.8 + Vector3.new(0,.15,0)).Unit
            end
        else
            aim = autoState.breakDir or outward
            throttle=1
            if now >= autoState.breakUntil then
                autoState.mode="Approach"
                autoState.runIn=nil
            end
        end
        if now-autoState.lastReport >= 5 then
            autoState.lastReport=now
            log("OBJECTIVE_AIM", {id=autoState.targetId, phase=phase, mode=autoState.mode,
                distance=math.floor(distance), angle=math.floor(angle), fire=firing,
                missile=missile, selectedTargetFromRuntime=T.runtimeSelectedTarget})
        end
    else
        -- No valid objective: fly outward away from the airship, do not fight escorts.
        local away = position - fortress.Model:GetPivot().Position
        aim = away.Magnitude > .01 and (away.Unit*170 + Vector3.new(0,35,0)) or Vector3.new(1,.2,0)
        throttle=.75
    end
    if aim.Magnitude < .001 then aim=forward end
    if floor and position.Y < floor+75 then
        aim=(aim.Unit + Vector3.new(0,math.clamp((floor+75-position.Y)/45,.25,1.4),0)).Unit
    elseif ceiling and position.Y>ceiling-50 then
        aim=(aim.Unit - Vector3.new(0,.6,0)).Unit
    end
    return {Aim=aim, Fire=firing, Missile=missile, Throttle=throttle, Target=target and autoState.targetId,
        TargetModel=target, Maneuver=autoState.mode~="Run"}
end

local function steerObjective(plane,state)
    if not plane or not settings.objectivePriority or not raidConfig then
        pilot:clear("ZEPPELIN_FLIGHT_OR_OBJECTIVE_UNAVAILABLE")
        autoState.installed,T.objectivePilotInstalled=false,false
        return
    end
    if not nativeController or not ownsCharacter() then return end
    local ok, fortress=pcall(nativeController.Fortress)
    if not ok or not fortress then
        pilot:clear("ZEPPELIN_FORTRESS_UNAVAILABLE")
        autoState.installed,T.objectivePilotInstalled=false,false
        return
    end
    local session
    if type(nativeController.Session) == "function" then
        local got, currentSession = pcall(nativeController.Session)
        if got then session = currentSession end
    end
    if autoState.fortress~=fortress or autoState.session~=session then
        autoState.fortress,autoState.session=fortress,session
        autoState.target,autoState.targetId,autoState.nextPick=nil,nil,0
        autoState.phase,autoState.mode,autoState.runIn=nil,"Approach",nil
    end
    local plan = calcSteering()
    if riftHazards and type(riftHazards.flightPlan)=="function" then
        local limits={floor=floorCeilingAttr("ZeppelinFlightFloor"),ceiling=floorCeilingAttr("ZeppelinFlightCeiling")}
        local ok,amended=pcall(riftHazards.flightPlan,riftHazards,state.Sim,plan,limits)
        if ok and type(amended)=="table" then plan=amended end
    end
    if not ownsCharacter() then return end
    local applied=pilot:apply(flightRuntime,flightController,plane,state,plan,true,ownsCharacter)
    autoState.installed,T.objectivePilotInstalled=applied~=nil,applied~=nil
end

local function maybeFocusSquadron()
    if not settings.squadronFocus or not autoState.installed or not autoState.targetId
        or completed or not isParticipating() then return end
    local now = os.clock()
    if now-autoState.lastFocusSend < 3.3 then return end
    local sim=flightStatus()
    if not sim or not autoState.target or not autoState.target.PrimaryPart then return end
    local distance=(autoState.target.PrimaryPart.Position-sim.Position).Magnitude
    if distance>900 then return end
    local focusRemote=RS:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
    focusRemote=focusRemote and focusRemote:FindFirstChild("ZeppelinRaidEvent")
    if not focusRemote or not focusRemote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then return end
    local accepted=pcall(function()
        focusRemote:FireServer({Kind="Focus", Part=autoState.targetId})
    end)
    autoState.lastFocusSend=now
    local ack=P:GetAttribute("ZeppelinSquadronFocus")
    log("OBJECTIVE_FOCUS", {id=autoState.targetId, requestSent=accepted,
        serverFocus=ack, range=math.floor(distance)})
end
-- ===== end V3 objective pilot =====

    function flight:reset()
        self:stop()
        T.phase=0; T.destroyed={}; T.partCount=0; T.sessionId=nil; T.sessionState=nil
        T.takeOffAttempts=0; T.takeOffLastResult=nil
        T.objectiveTarget=nil; T.objectiveKind=nil; T.objectivePhase=nil
        T.lastGateAt=nil;T.completed=false
        completed=false;nextTakeOffAt=0;lastTakeOffGate=nil;seenFlightAt=nil
        autoState.installed=false;autoState.session=nil;autoState.fortress=nil
        autoState.target=nil;autoState.targetId=nil;autoState.phase=nil
        autoState.lastFocusSend=0
        T.running=true
    end
    function flight:observe(kind,e)
        if not T.running or type(e)~="table" then return end
        if kind=="FightStart" then
            T.sessionId=e.SessionId
            phaseUpdate(e.Phase or 1,"FIGHT_START")
        elseif kind=="Session" then
            T.sessionState=e.State or T.sessionState
        elseif kind=="Health" then
            phaseUpdate(e.Phase,"HEALTH")
        elseif kind=="Raid" then
            if e.Kind=="Phase" then phaseUpdate(e.Phase,"RAID_EVENT")
            elseif e.Kind=="Part" and type(e.Id)=="string" then
                if not T.destroyed[e.Id] then
                    T.destroyed[e.Id]=true
                    T.partCount=T.partCount+1
                end
                log("PART_DESTROYED",{id=e.Id,parts=T.partCount,phase=T.phase})
            end
        elseif kind=="FightEnd" then
            completed=true
            pilot:stop()
            log("OBJECTIVE_OUTCOME",{victory=e.Victory,reason=e.Reason,parts=T.partCount})
        end
    end
    local initialized=false
    local function loadNative()
        if initialized then return true end
        local folder=RS:FindFirstChild("ClientModules")
        local raidFolder=folder and folder:FindFirstChild("ZeppelinRaid")
        local loader=getfenv(0)["require"]
        local function loadModule(mod)
            if not mod or not mod:IsA("ModuleScript") then return nil,"MISSING" end
            local ok,value=pcall(loader,mod)
            if not ok or type(value)~="table" then return nil,tostring(value) end
            return value
        end
        flightRuntime=loadModule(folder and folder:FindFirstChild("ManualFlightRuntime"))
        flightController=loadModule(folder and folder:FindFirstChild("ManualFlightController"))
        nativeController=loadModule(raidFolder and raidFolder:FindFirstChild("Controller"))
        nativePilot=loadModule(raidFolder and raidFolder:FindFirstChild("Pilot"))
        spectateController=loadModule(folder and folder:FindFirstChild("SpectateController"))
        raidConfig=loadModule(RS:FindFirstChild("Modules") and RS.Modules:FindFirstChild("ZeppelinRaidConfig"))
        initialized=(flightRuntime~=nil and flightController~=nil
            and nativeController~=nil and nativePilot~=nil and raidConfig~=nil)
        log("FLIGHT_CAPABILITIES",{manualControllerLoaded=flightController~=nil,
            raidControllerLoaded=nativeController~=nil,
            pilotLoaded=nativePilot~=nil,configLoaded=raidConfig~=nil})
        return true
    end
    function flight:nativeEncounter()
        if not nativeController then loadNative() end
        local session = nativeSession()
        if not session or session.SessionId == nil then return nil end
        if session.Ending or session.Dead then return session.SessionId, "ENDING" end
        if session.Active == true then return session.SessionId, "ACTIVE" end
        return session.SessionId, "PENDING"
    end
    function flight:start(ctx, encounter, rebound)
        if ctx:isCancelled() or ctx:isCombatSuspended() then return false,"CANCELLED" end
        jobContext, avatar = ctx, rebound or platform:character()
        local boundAvatar = avatar
        ctx:deferCleanup(function()
            if jobContext == ctx and avatar == boundAvatar then self:stop() end
        end)
        T.running=true
        loadNative()
        if not ownsCharacter() then return false,"ZEPPELIN_CHARACTER_NOT_READY" end
        if rebound then
            local session = nativeSession()
            phaseUpdate(session and session.Phase,"NATIVE_REBIND")
            T.sessionId = rebound.nativeSessionId
            T.takeOffAttempts, nextTakeOffAt, seenFlightAt = 0, 0, nil
            autoState.phase, autoState.runIn, autoState.nextPick = nil, nil, 0
            rebind = {encounterId=encounter.encounterId, generation=encounter.characterGeneration}
            progress("PILOT_REBIND_PENDING", "NATIVE_FLIGHT_HANDOFF", "ACTIVE_ENCOUNTER_REBIND")
        end
        return true
    end
    function flight:step()
        if not T.running or completed or not ownsCharacter() then return end
        if not initialized then loadNative() end
        if not ownsCharacter() then return end
        local session = nativeSession()
        if rebind and (not session or session.Active ~= true)
            or session and (session.Dead or session.Ending or T.sessionId and session.SessionId ~= T.sessionId) then
            pilot:clear("NATIVE_SESSION_CHANGED")
            T.flightActive=false
            return
        end
        local phaseAttr=P:GetAttribute("ZeppelinRaidPhase") or W:GetAttribute("ZeppelinRaidPhase")
        phaseUpdate(session and session.Phase or phaseAttr,"NATIVE_PHASE")
        local sampled,active,focus,target,manualOn,attrOn,pilotOn,plane,state=pcall(readFlight)
        if not ownsCharacter() then return end
        if not sampled then
            pilot:clear("NATIVE_FLIGHT_SNAPSHOT_UNAVAILABLE")
            T.flightActive=false
            return
        end
        recoverNativeTakeOff(active or manualOn)
        if not ownsCharacter() then return end
        if rebind and active and not rebind.bound then
            rebind.bound = true
            progress("PILOT_REBOUND", "NATIVE_FLIGHT_VERIFIED", "ACTIVE_ENCOUNTER_REBIND")
        end
        steerObjective(plane,state)
        if not ownsCharacter() then return end
        if rebind and rebind.bound and T.objectivePilotInstalled and not rebind.resumed then
            rebind.resumed = true
            progress("COMBAT_RESUMED", "STEERING_RESTORED", "ACTIVE_COMBAT")
        end
        maybeFocusSquadron()
        T.flightActive=active;T.manualFlightActive=manualOn
        T.targetFocus=focus;T.runtimeSelectedTarget=target
        if active and not seenFlightAt then
            seenFlightAt=os.clock()
            log("FLIGHT_VERIFIED",{manualControllerActive=manualOn,attributeActive=attrOn,
                pilotActive=pilotOn})
        end
    end
    function flight:exhausted()
        return T.running and not completed and not rebind and not T.flightActive
            and T.takeOffAttempts>=settings.maxTakeOffAttempts
            and os.clock()>=nextTakeOffAt
    end
    function flight:status()
        return {phase=T.phase,partsDestroyed=T.partCount,
            flightActive=T.flightActive,manualFlightActive=T.manualFlightActive,
            takeOffAttempts=T.takeOffAttempts,lastTakeOff=T.takeOffLastResult,
            objectiveInstalled=T.objectivePilotInstalled,
            objectiveTarget=T.objectiveTarget,objectiveKind=T.objectiveKind,
            sessionId=T.sessionId, rebound=rebind and rebind.resumed}
    end
    function flight:stop()
        jobContext, avatar, rebind = nil, nil, nil
        T.objectivePilotInstalled, T.running, T.flightActive = false, false, false
        pilot:stop()
        autoState.installed=false
        autoState.fortress=nil
        autoState.target=nil
    end
    return flight
end
return FlightController
end
-- END MODULE boss.Zeppelin.FlightController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.Zeppelin.RepeatPolicy
__factories["boss.Zeppelin.RepeatPolicy"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local SharedRepeatPolicy = require("boss.shared.RepeatPolicy")
local RepeatPolicy = {}
function RepeatPolicy.new(env)
    return SharedRepeatPolicy.new(env, "Expected confirmed Zeppelin outcome")
end
return RepeatPolicy
end
-- END MODULE boss.Zeppelin.RepeatPolicy

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.Zeppelin.ReportController
__factories["boss.Zeppelin.ReportController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local DeferredOutcome = require("boss.shared.DeferredOutcome")
-- Zeppelin adaptive report: Outcome -> report (arena or hideout) -> Continue -> exit -> return.
-- Port of standalone V1; never treat Outcome alone as a completed report.
local ReportController = {}

function ReportController.new(env, config, repeatPolicy, flight)
    local platform, gui, runtime = env.services.roblox, env.services.gui, env.runtime
    local player = platform:player()
    local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
    local writer = env.state:port("boss")
    local report = {}
    local confirmedOutcome, outcomeAt = nil, nil
    local lastHealthAt = 0
    local seenReport, firstOpenedAt = false, nil
    local listeningContext, connections, resultsController = nil, {}, nil
    local sessionId, endedSessionId, startEncounter, victoryEncounter, lossEncounter
    local watchToken
    local function emit(name, data)
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit(name, data or {}) end
    end
    local function loadController()
        if resultsController then return resultsController end
        local folder = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("ClientModules")
        local mod = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("BossResultsController")
        if not mod or not mod:IsA("ModuleScript") then return nil end
        -- The build bundler replaces project requires. Invoke Roblox require only
        -- dynamically for the game's own ModuleScript, as the B21 controller does.
        local loader = getfenv(0)["require"]
        local ok, value = pcall(loader, mod)
        if not ok or type(value) ~= "table" then return nil end
        if type(value.IsOpen) ~= "function" or type(value.Dismiss) ~= "function" then return nil end
        resultsController = value
        return value
    end
    local function officialOpen()
        local ctrl = loadController()
        if ctrl and type(ctrl.IsOpen) == "function" then
            local ok, result = pcall(ctrl.IsOpen)
            if ok and result == true then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function isOpen()
        return player:GetAttribute("BossResultsOpen") == true or officialOpen()
    end
    local function matchingReport(guiRoot)
        if not guiRoot then return nil end
        local isZeppelin, won, lost = false, false, false
        for _,node in ipairs(guiRoot:GetDescendants()) do
            if node:IsA("TextLabel") then
                local value = string.upper(tostring(node.Text or ""))
                if value:find("ZEPPELIN", 1, true) or value:find("AIRSHIP", 1, true) then isZeppelin = true end
                if value:find("DEFEATED", 1, true) or value:find("VICTORY", 1, true)
                    or value:find("ESCORT COMPLETE", 1, true) then won = true end
                if value:find("MISSION FAILED", 1, true) or value:find("DEFEAT", 1, true) then lost = true end
            end
        end
        if isZeppelin and won ~= lost then return won and "WIN" or "LOSS" end
        return nil
    end

    local function closeConnections()
        watchToken=nil
        for _,conn in ipairs(connections) do conn:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(connections)
        listeningContext=nil
    end
    local function listen(remote,fn)
        local token=watchToken
        local connection=remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(packet)
            if watchToken==token and listeningContext and not listeningContext:isCancelled()
                and not listeningContext:isClosing() then fn(packet) end
        end)
        table.insert(connections,connection)
    end
    function report:watch(ctx)
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return false,"CANCELLED" end
        if listeningContext==ctx and #connections>0 then return true end
        closeConnections()
        local folder=platform:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        local names={"BossFightStart","BossFightEnd","BossSessionUpdate",
                     "BossHealthUpdate","ZeppelinRaidEvent"}
        local remotes={}
        for _,name in ipairs(names) do
            local remote=folder and folder:FindFirstChild(name)
            if not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                return false,"ZEPPELIN_EVENT_MISSING:"..name
            end
            remotes[name]=remote
        end
        watchToken={}
        listeningContext=ctx
        listen(remotes.BossFightStart,function(packet)
            if type(packet)~="table" or packet.BossId~=config.gameBossId then return end
            if sessionId~=nil and sessionId~=packet.SessionId then return end
            sessionId=packet.SessionId
            local encounter=type(env.state.snapshot)=="function" and env.state:snapshot().boss.encounter
            if sessionId~=nil and encounter and encounter.bossId==config.bossId and encounter.soloAttempted then
                startEncounter=encounter.encounterId
            end
            flight:observe("FightStart",packet)
            emit("ZEPPELIN_FIGHT_START",{sessionId=sessionId,phase=packet.Phase})
        end)
        listen(remotes.BossSessionUpdate,function(packet)
            if type(packet)~="table" or sessionId==nil
                or packet.SessionId~=sessionId then return end
            if packet.State=="Active" then self:invalidateNativeEnd(sessionId) end
            flight:observe("Session",packet)
            if packet.State~=nil then emit("ZEPPELIN_SESSION",{state=packet.State}) end
        end)
        listen(remotes.BossHealthUpdate,function(packet)
            if type(packet)~="table" or packet.BossId~=config.gameBossId then return end
            if sessionId~=nil and packet.SessionId~=nil and packet.SessionId~=sessionId then return end
            flight:observe("Health",packet)
            if runtime:now()-lastHealthAt>4 or packet.CurrentHP==0 then
                lastHealthAt=runtime:now()
                emit("ZEPPELIN_HEALTH",{hp=packet.CurrentHP,maxHP=packet.MaxHP,phase=packet.Phase})
            end
        end)
        listen(remotes.ZeppelinRaidEvent,function(packet)
            if type(packet)~="table" then return end
            if sessionId~=nil and packet.SessionId~=nil and packet.SessionId~=sessionId then return end
            if platform:player():GetAttribute("ZeppelinParticipant")~=true then return end
            flight:observe("Raid",packet)
            if packet.Kind=="Phase" or packet.Kind=="Part" or packet.Kind=="Wave" then
                emit("ZEPPELIN_RAID_EVENT",{kind=packet.Kind,id=packet.Id,phase=packet.Phase})
            end
        end)
