        listen(remotes.BossFightEnd,function(packet)
            if type(packet)~="table" or packet.BossId~=config.gameBossId then return end
            if sessionId~=nil and packet.SessionId~=nil and packet.SessionId~=sessionId then return end
            -- The native UI treats Exited as a departure without a report.
            -- Keep it only when the packet identifies the owned session.
            if packet.Reason=="Exited" and sessionId~=nil and packet.SessionId==sessionId then
                endedSessionId=sessionId
            end
            if type(packet.Victory)=="boolean" then
                confirmedOutcome=packet.Victory and "WIN" or "LOSS"
                victoryEncounter=packet.Victory and sessionId~=nil and packet.SessionId==sessionId and startEncounter or nil
                lossEncounter=DeferredOutcome.isDefeat(packet) and sessionId~=nil and packet.SessionId==sessionId
                    and startEncounter or nil
                outcomeAt=runtime:now()
                emit("ZEPPELIN_OUTCOME",{outcome=confirmedOutcome,reason=packet.Reason})
            else
                emit("ZEPPELIN_UNSCORED_FIGHT_END",{sessionId=packet.SessionId,reason=packet.Reason})
            end
            if confirmedOutcome then flight:observe("FightEnd",packet) end
        end)
        ctx:deferCleanup(function()
            if listeningContext==ctx then closeConnections() end
        end)
        return true
    end
    function report:cleanup()
        closeConnections()
        flight:stop()
        -- Keep outcome evidence for checkpoint reconciliation.
    end
    function report:resetOutcome()
        confirmedOutcome,outcomeAt,seenReport,firstOpenedAt=nil,nil,false,nil
        sessionId,endedSessionId,startEncounter,victoryEncounter,lossEncounter=nil,nil,nil,nil,nil
        flight:reset()
    end
    function report:verifiedDeferredOutcome(encounter)
        if encounter.outcome == "LOSS" then return lossEncounter == encounter.encounterId end
        return victoryEncounter == encounter.encounterId
    end
    function report:nativeEndSessionId() return endedSessionId end
    function report:invalidateNativeEnd(id)
        if endedSessionId == id then endedSessionId = nil end
        if sessionId == id then lossEncounter = nil end
    end
    function report:inspect()
        local root = gui:find(env.profile.paths.bossReport)
        local active = isOpen() -- Same verified V2 signal: BossResultsOpen or official controller.IsOpen()
        if active then
            seenReport = true
            firstOpenedAt = firstOpenedAt or runtime:now()
        end
        local guiOutcome = active and matchingReport(root) or nil
        local outcome = confirmedOutcome or guiOutcome
        return {
            active = active, matchesBoss = confirmedOutcome ~= nil or guiOutcome ~= nil,
            outcome = outcome, report = root, seen = seenReport,
            pendingPresentation = confirmedOutcome ~= nil and not seenReport
                and outcomeAt ~= nil and runtime:now() - outcomeAt < config.reportTimeoutSeconds,
        }
    end
    function report:reconcile(encounter)
        local evidence = self:inspect()
        if evidence.matchesBoss and evidence.outcome
            and (not encounter.outcome or encounter.outcome == evidence.outcome) then return true end
        return encounter.outcome ~= nil and seenReport and not evidence.active
    end
    function report:resolve(ctx, encounter)
        local watching, why = self:watch(ctx)
        if not watching then return {ok = false, code = why} end
        -- V2 REQUIREMENT: Outcome alone never authorizes return/Continue.
        local evidence = ctx:await(function()
            local current = self:inspect()
            if current.active and current.matchesBoss and current.outcome then return current end
            if seenReport and not current.active and (encounter.outcome or current.outcome) then
                return current -- manually dismissed report after previously observing it
            end
        end, config.reportTimeoutSeconds)
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
        if not evidence then return {ok = false, code = "ZEPPELIN_REPORT_NOT_OBSERVED"} end
        if evidence.outcome and encounter.outcome and evidence.outcome ~= encounter.outcome then
            return {ok = false, held = true, code = "BOSS_OUTCOME_CONFLICT"}
        end
        local outcome = evidence.outcome or encounter.outcome
        if not outcome then return {ok = false, code = "ZEPPELIN_OUTCOME_UNVERIFIED"} end
        if not encounter.outcome then
            local accepted = writer:recordBossReport(outcome,
                runtime:epoch() + repeatPolicy:outcomeDelay(outcome))
            if not accepted then return {ok = false, held = true, code = "BOSS_OUTCOME_CONFLICT"} end
            encounter = env.state:snapshot().boss.encounter
        end
        if not evidence.active then
            writer:closeReport()
            return {ok = true, code = "ZEPPELIN_REPORT_MANUALLY_CLOSED"}
        end
        local at = platform:position()
        local place = player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") == true and "HIDEOUT" or "OTHER"
        if place == "OTHER" and at then
            local center = player:GetAttribute("ZeppelinFlightCentre")
            if typeof(center) ~= "Vector3" then
                center = platform:workspace():GetAttribute("ZeppelinFlightCentre")
            end
            if typeof(center) ~= "Vector3" then
                center = Vector3.new(config.arenaFallbackCenter.x,
                    config.arenaFallbackCenter.y, config.arenaFallbackCenter.z)
            end
            if (at - center).Magnitude < config.arenaRadius then
                place = "ARENA"
            end
        end
        emit("ZEPPELIN_REPORT_OPEN", {outcome = outcome, location = place,
            inBossFight = player:GetAttribute("InBossFight")})
        local controller = loadController()
        if not controller then return {ok = false, code = "ZEPPELIN_RESULT_CONTROLLER_MISSING_MANUAL_CONTINUE"} end
        if not encounter.continueAttempted then
            local ready = ctx:await(function()
                if not isOpen() then return "MANUALLY_CLOSED" end
                local armed = false
                if type(controller.Debug) == "function" then
                    local ok, message = pcall(controller.Debug)
                    armed = ok and type(message) == "string"
                        and message:find("armed=true", 1, true) ~= nil
                end
                if armed and firstOpenedAt
                    and runtime:now() - firstOpenedAt >= config.reportHoldSeconds then return "ARMED" end
            end, config.reportTimeoutSeconds)
            if ctx:isCancelled() then return {ok = false, code = "CANCELLED"} end
            if ready == "MANUALLY_CLOSED" then
                writer:closeReport()
                return {ok = true, code = "ZEPPELIN_REPORT_MANUALLY_CLOSED"}
            end
            if ready ~= "ARMED" then return {ok = false, code = "ZEPPELIN_REPORT_NOT_ARMED_MANUAL_CONTINUE"} end
            if not writer:markContinueAttempt() then return {ok = false, code = "ZEPPELIN_CONTINUE_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED"} end
            local sent, err = pcall(function() controller.Dismiss("continue") end)
            if not sent then return {ok = false, code = "ZEPPELIN_CONTINUE_FAILED: " .. tostring(err)} end
            emit("ZEPPELIN_REPORT_CONTINUE", {code = "CONTINUE_REQUESTED"})
        end
        local closed = ctx:await(function() if not self:inspect().active then return true end end,
            config.reportCloseTimeoutSeconds)
        if not closed then return {ok = false, code = "ZEPPELIN_REPORT_STILL_OPEN_MANUAL_CONTINUE"} end
        writer:closeReport()
        return {ok = true, code = "ZEPPELIN_REPORT_CLOSED"}
    end
    return report
end
return ReportController
end
-- END MODULE boss.Zeppelin.ReportController

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.Zeppelin.Zeppelin
__factories["boss.Zeppelin.Zeppelin"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local Config=require("boss.Zeppelin.Config")
local ArenaObserver=require("boss.Zeppelin.ArenaObserver")
local CommandController=require("boss.Zeppelin.CommandController")
local CombatController=require("boss.Zeppelin.CombatController")
local FlightController=require("boss.Zeppelin.FlightController")
local ReportController=require("boss.Zeppelin.ReportController")
local RepeatPolicy=require("boss.Zeppelin.RepeatPolicy")
local Zeppelin={}
function Zeppelin.definition()
    return {bossId=Config.bossId, displayName=Config.displayName, create=function(env)
        local observer=ArenaObserver.new(env,Config)
        local flight=FlightController.new(env,Config,observer)
        local repeatPolicy=RepeatPolicy.new(env)
        local report=ReportController.new(env,Config,repeatPolicy,flight)
        return {config=Config,observer=observer,flight=flight,report=report,
            repeatPolicy=repeatPolicy,
            command=CommandController.new(env,Config,observer,report),
            combat=CombatController.new(env,Config,observer,report,flight)}
    end}
end
return Zeppelin
end
-- END MODULE boss.Zeppelin.Zeppelin

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.shared.DeferredOutcome
__factories["boss.shared.DeferredOutcome"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Additional evidence for handing off return ownership. Existing report resolution
-- can still use its native presentation fallbacks.
local DeferredOutcome = {}

function DeferredOutcome.isDefeat(packet)
    local reason = packet.Reason or packet.EndReason
    return packet.Victory == false and reason ~= "Exited" and reason ~= "Reset"
        and reason ~= "Respawn" and reason ~= "Downed" and reason ~= "Aborted"
end

function DeferredOutcome.new(env, bossId, generationAttribute)
    local platform = env.services.roblox
    local baseline, generation, armedEncounter, won, witnessed, lost
    local function currentGeneration()
        if type(platform.workspace) == "function" then
            return platform:workspace():GetAttribute(generationAttribute)
        end
    end
    local tracker = {}
    function tracker:reset()
        baseline, generation, armedEncounter, won, witnessed, lost = currentGeneration(), nil, nil, false, false, false
    end
    function tracker:observe(packet)
        local id = packet.Generation
        local kind = packet.K
        if id == nil or kind ~= "Start" and kind ~= "Session" and kind ~= "Launch"
            and kind ~= "Begin" and kind ~= "Outcome" then return end
        local encounter = type(env.state.snapshot) == "function" and env.state:snapshot().boss.encounter
        if not encounter or encounter.bossId ~= bossId or not encounter.soloAttempted
            or encounter.phase == "COMPLETE" then return end
        local current = currentGeneration()
        if kind ~= "Outcome" then
            if not generation and id ~= baseline and (current == nil or current == id) then
                generation, armedEncounter, witnessed = id, encounter.encounterId, current == id
            end
            if generation == id and current == id then witnessed = true end
            if generation == id then lost = false end
        elseif type(packet.Victory) == "boolean" and generation == id and armedEncounter == encounter.encounterId then
            local matched = current == id or witnessed and current == nil
            won = packet.Victory and matched
            lost = DeferredOutcome.isDefeat(packet) and matched
        end
    end
    function tracker:verified(encounter, outcome)
        local current = currentGeneration()
        return (outcome == "LOSS" and lost or outcome == "WIN" and won) == true
            and armedEncounter == encounter.encounterId
            and (current == nil or current == generation)
    end
    return tracker
end

return DeferredOutcome
end
-- END MODULE boss.shared.DeferredOutcome

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.shared.EncounterRecovery
__factories["boss.shared.EncounterRecovery"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local Contracts = require("main.core.Contracts")
local DirectBossTravel = require("main.navigation.DirectBossTravel")
local EncounterRecovery = {}
-- These client controllers explicitly finish their current session on
-- CharacterAdded and export Active() over that session reference.
local resetTerminals = {F117="F117", RQ170="RQ170", SR71="SR71", U2="U2"}

local function nativeResetActive(platform, bossId)
    local name = resetTerminals[bossId]
    if not name then return nil end
    local modules = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("ClientModules")
    local folder = modules and modules:FindFirstChild(name)
    local module = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("Controller")
    if not module or not module:IsA("ModuleScript") then return nil end
    local ok, controller = pcall(getfenv(0)["require"], module)
    if not ok or type(controller) ~= "table" or type(controller.Active) ~= "function" then return nil end
    local queried, active = pcall(controller.Active)
    if queried and type(active) == "boolean" then return active end
end

function EncounterRecovery.new(env, writer)
    local platform, runtime = env.services.roblox, env.runtime
    local player = platform:player()
    local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
    local original, stability, rechecks, returnObservation
    local lossDiagnosticEncounter, lossDiagnostics
    local resumeWindow = 5
    local firstRecheck = 0.6
    local respawnEvidencePending = {BOSS_RESPAWN_EVIDENCE_UNRESOLVED=true, BOSS_RESPAWN_PENDING=true,
        BOSS_CONTINUATION_NOT_READY=true, BOSS_SAME_SESSION_UNVERIFIED=true}
    for _, id in ipairs({"B52", "CARRIER", "AIRRAID"}) do
        respawnEvidencePending[id .. "_NATIVE_GENERATION_UNVERIFIED"] = true
        respawnEvidencePending[id .. "_NATIVE_END_OR_OUTCOME_UNOBSERVED"] = true
        respawnEvidencePending[id .. "_NATIVE_PARTICIPATION_ACTIVE"] = true
    end
    local service = {}
    local function emit(name, encounter, reason, destination, evidence, navigation)
        local generation = original and original.id == encounter.encounterId and original.generation
            or encounter.characterGeneration or 1
        if telemetry then
            pcall(telemetry.emit, telemetry, name, {bossId=encounter.bossId, encounterId=encounter.encounterId,
                reason=reason, outcome=encounter.outcome, characterGeneration=generation, destination=destination,
                location=evidence and evidence.location, observedWorld=evidence and evidence.world,
                positionWorld=evidence and evidence.positionWorld, inPersonalHideout=evidence and evidence.inPersonalHideout,
                hideoutHost=evidence and evidence.hideoutHost, hideoutSiteHost=evidence and evidence.hideoutSiteHost,
                atLiveHideoutSite=evidence and evidence.atLiveHideoutSite,
                jobId=navigation and navigation.jobId, nativeGeneration=navigation and navigation.generation,
                characterReady=evidence and evidence.character and evidence.character.ready})
        elseif destination then
            print("[PlaneRNG recovery]", name, encounter.bossId, encounter.encounterId, reason,
                "destination", destination, "observed", evidence and evidence.location, evidence and evidence.world,
                "position world", evidence and evidence.positionWorld,
                "root", evidence and evidence.character and evidence.character.position,
                "live bunker", evidence and evidence.atLiveHideoutSite,
                "personal hideout", evidence and evidence.inPersonalHideout,
                "hideout host", evidence and evidence.hideoutHost, "site host", evidence and evidence.hideoutSiteHost,
                "job", navigation and navigation.jobId, "native generation", navigation and navigation.generation,
                "character ready", evidence and evidence.character and evidence.character.ready)
        else
            print("[PlaneRNG recovery]", name, encounter.bossId, encounter.encounterId, reason)
        end
    end
    local function noteLoss(name, encounter, reason, evidence)
        if lossDiagnosticEncounter ~= encounter.encounterId then
            lossDiagnosticEncounter, lossDiagnostics = encounter.encounterId, {}
        end
        if lossDiagnostics[name] == reason then return end
        lossDiagnostics[name] = reason
        emit(name, encounter, reason, encounter.homeWorld, evidence)
    end
    local function snapshot() return env.state:snapshot().boss.encounter end
    local function reasonFor(result)
        return type(result.code) == "string" and result.code or "UNKNOWN"
    end
    local function navigationOwner(ctx, boss)
        return {jobId=ctx.jobId, generation=type(boss.report.ownedNativeGeneration) == "function"
            and boss.report:ownedNativeGeneration() or nil}
    end

    function service:wait(ctx, encounter, stage, reason, progress)
        local previous = snapshot()
        previous = previous and previous.recovery
        if not previous or previous.stage ~= stage or previous.reason ~= reason then
            emit(stage, encounter, reason)
        end
        ctx:reportProgress(stage)
        local adaptive = stage == "RESPAWN_PENDING" or stage == "RETURN_PENDING" or stage == "ENTRY_PENDING"
            or stage == "RETURN_SAME_WORLD_LOCATION_RECONCILIATION"
            or stage == "RECOVERY_HELD" and (respawnEvidencePending[reason] == true
                or encounter.bossId == "FLEET" and reason:match("^FLEET_"))
        local delay = env.profile.boss.reportRetry
        if adaptive then
            local id = encounter.encounterId
            local step = not progress and rechecks and rechecks.id == id and rechecks.stage == stage
                and math.min(rechecks.step + 1, 5) or 0
            rechecks = {id=id, stage=stage, step=step}
            delay = math.min(math.max(firstRecheck, delay), firstRecheck * 2^step)
        else
            rechecks = nil
        end
        local retryAt = runtime:now() + delay
        writer:markRecovery(encounter.encounterId, stage, reason, retryAt, nil, nil, adaptive)
        return Contracts.result("DEFERRED", reason, {stage=stage, retryAt=retryAt})
    end

    local function native(boss, id, expected)
        if type(boss.combat.nativeEncounter) == "function" then
            local ok, key, state, observedAt, reason = pcall(boss.combat.nativeEncounter, boss.combat, expected)
            if ok then return key, state, observedAt, reason end
        else
            local active = nativeResetActive(platform, id)
            if active ~= nil then return nil, active and "ACTIVE" or "INACTIVE" end
        end
    end

    function service:watchCombat(ctx, encounter, boss, rebound)
        local subject = rebound or platform:character()
        local ticket = original
        if not ticket or ticket.id ~= encounter.encounterId then
            ticket = {id=encounter.encounterId, generation=encounter.characterGeneration or 1}
            original = ticket
        end
        ticket.character, ticket.humanoid = subject.character, subject.humanoid
        ticket.pending, ticket.respawnSeen = nil, nil
        ticket.witnessed = boss.observer:inArena()
        stability = nil
        local links, absentSince, lastProbe = {}, nil, -math.huge
        local wasFlying = player:GetAttribute("ManualFlightActive") == true
        local watching = true
        local function disconnect()
            watching = false
            for _, link in ipairs(links) do link:Disconnect() end
            links = {}
        end
        local function owns()
            local current = snapshot()
            return watching and original == ticket and runtime:isActive(ctx) and not ctx:isCancelled() and not ctx:isClosing()
                and current and current.encounterId == encounter.encounterId and current.phase == "COMBAT"
        end
        local function witnessNative()
            local key, state = native(boss, encounter.bossId)
            if not ticket.pending and (state == "ACTIVE" or state == "PENDING") then
                ticket.key = ticket.key or key
            end
            if state == "ACTIVE" then
                if not ticket.key or ticket.key == key then ticket.nativeActive = true end
            elseif state == "TERMINAL" and key and key == ticket.key then
                ticket.nativeEnded = true
            end
            return state == "ACTIVE" and key ~= nil and ticket.key == key
        end
        local function interrupt(reason, characterChanged)
            if not owns() or ticket.pending then return end
            local pending = {reason=reason, characterChanged=characterChanged, startedAt=runtime:now()}
            ticket.pending = pending
            local stage = characterChanged and "ACTIVE_ENCOUNTER_REBIND" or "RESULT_INSPECTION"
            writer:markRecovery(encounter.encounterId, stage, reason, runtime:now(), reason)
            ctx:reportProgress(stage)
            if characterChanged then
                if reason == "CHARACTER_DIED" then emit("CHARACTER_DIED", encounter, reason) end
                emit("CHARACTER_REPLACED", encounter, reason)
                emit("CHARACTER_RESET_DETECTED", encounter, reason)
                emit("RESPAWN_RECONCILIATION_STARTED", encounter, reason)
            end
            emit("ENCOUNTER_INTERRUPTED", encounter, reason)
            local stopped, clean
            if characterChanged and boss.combat.suspendsForContinuation then
                stopped, clean = ctx:suspendCombat()
            else
                stopped, clean = ctx:interrupt(reason)
            end
            if stopped then emit(clean and "INPUTS_RELEASED" or "RESUME_FAILED", encounter, reason) end
        end
        local function connect(signal, callback)
            if signal then links[#links + 1] = signal:Connect(callback) end
        end
        ctx:deferCleanup(disconnect)
        ctx:monitorInterruption(function()
            if runtime:now() - lastProbe < 0.25 or not owns() or ticket.pending then return end
            lastProbe = runtime:now()
            local current = platform:character()
            if subject.character and current.character ~= subject.character then
                return interrupt(current.character and "CHARACTER_REPLACED" or "CHARACTER_REMOVED", true)
            end
            if subject.humanoid and (current.humanoid ~= subject.humanoid or current.health and current.health <= 0) then
                return interrupt(current.humanoid == subject.humanoid and "CHARACTER_DIED" or "CHARACTER_REPLACED", true)
            end
            local nativeStillActive = witnessNative()
            local flying = player:GetAttribute("ManualFlightActive") == true
            wasFlying = wasFlying or flying
            if not nativeStillActive and not boss.observer:inArena() and player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true then
                absentSince = absentSince or lastProbe
                if lastProbe - absentSince >= 0.75 then
                    local report = boss.report:inspect()
                    if not report.active and not report.outcome then
                        local reason = ticket.nativeEnded and "NATIVE_ENCOUNTER_ENDED"
                            or wasFlying and not flying and "PILOT_AND_PARTICIPATION_LOST" or "PARTICIPATION_LOST"
                        interrupt(reason)
                    end
                end
            else absentSince = nil end
        end, true)
        connect(subject.humanoid and subject.humanoid.Died, function() interrupt("CHARACTER_DIED", true) end)
        connect(player.CharacterRemoving, function(character)
            if subject.character == character then interrupt("CHARACTER_REMOVED", true) end
        end)
        connect(player.CharacterAdded, function(character)
            if subject.character and character ~= subject.character then interrupt("CHARACTER_REPLACED", true) end
        end)
        witnessNative()
        if boss.combat.suspendsForContinuation and not subject.ready then
            interrupt("CHARACTER_NOT_READY", true)
        end
        return function()
            ctx:monitorInterruption(nil)
            disconnect()
        end
    end

    local function stable(encounter, evidence)
        local avatar = evidence.character
        if not avatar or not avatar.ready or not avatar.character or not avatar.humanoid
            or evidence.transition or evidence.downed then stability = nil; return false end
        if not stability or stability.id ~= encounter.encounterId or stability.character ~= avatar.character
            or stability.humanoid ~= avatar.humanoid or stability.root ~= avatar.root
            or stability.location ~= evidence.location or stability.world ~= evidence.world
            or stability.revision ~= encounter.recoveryEvidenceRevision then
            stability = {id=encounter.encounterId, character=avatar.character, humanoid=avatar.humanoid,
                root=avatar.root, location=evidence.location, world=evidence.world,
                revision=encounter.recoveryEvidenceRevision, since=runtime:now()}
            if original and original.id == encounter.encounterId and original.character
                and avatar.character ~= original.character and not original.respawnSeen then
                original.respawnSeen = true
                emit("CHARACTER_RESPAWNED", encounter, evidence.location)
            end
            return false, true
        end
        return runtime:now() - stability.since >= 0.5
    end

    function service:classify(encounter, boss)
        local report = boss.report:inspect()
        local evidence = env.services.encounterEvidence()
        if report.outcome and report.matchesBoss or encounter.outcome or encounter.reportClosed then
            return "TERMINAL_ENCOUNTER_RECOVERY", "BOSS_RESULT_OBSERVED"
        end
        if report.active or evidence.reportOpen then
            stability = nil
            return nil, "BOSS_REPORT_UNRESOLVED"
        end
        local ticket = original
        if not ticket or ticket.id ~= encounter.encounterId or encounter.phase ~= "COMBAT" then return nil end
        local avatar = evidence.character
        local replaced = avatar and avatar.ready and avatar.character and avatar.humanoid
            and (avatar.character ~= ticket.character or avatar.humanoid ~= ticket.humanoid)
        if replaced and (not ticket.pending or not ticket.pending.characterChanged) then
            -- The job may have unwound on participation loss or a controller error
            -- before CharacterAdded reached its listener.
            ticket.pending = {characterChanged=true, reason="CHARACTER_REPLACED",
                startedAt=ticket.pending and ticket.pending.startedAt or runtime:now()}
            emit("CHARACTER_REPLACED", encounter, ticket.pending.reason)
            emit("RESPAWN_RECONCILIATION_STARTED", encounter, ticket.pending.reason)
            writer:markRecovery(encounter.encounterId, "ACTIVE_ENCOUNTER_REBIND", ticket.pending.reason,
                runtime:now(), ticket.pending.reason)
        end
        if not ticket.pending then return nil end
        if not ticket.key and type(boss.combat.ownedNativeGeneration) == "function" then
            ticket.key = boss.combat:ownedNativeGeneration()
        end
        local key, state, observedAt, nativeReason = native(boss, encounter.bossId, ticket.key)
        local sameSession = key ~= nil and key == ticket.key
        local nativeEnded = sameSession and state == "TERMINAL"
        local revalidate = boss.combat.revalidatesNativeEnd
        if revalidate then
            if not nativeEnded and writer:invalidateNativeEnd(encounter.encounterId) then
                if sameSession and (state == "ACTIVE" or state == "PENDING") then
                    boss.combat:invalidateNativeEnd(key)
                end
                emit("ENCOUNTER_TERMINAL_INVALIDATED", encounter, sameSession and state or "NATIVE_EXIT_UNVERIFIED")
                encounter = snapshot()
            end
        elseif nativeEnded then ticket.nativeEnded = true end
        if nativeEnded or not revalidate and ticket.nativeEnded then
            return "TERMINAL_ENCOUNTER_RECOVERY", "BOSS_NATIVE_SESSION_ENDED"
        end
        if not ticket.pending.characterChanged and not revalidate then return nil end
        local retryReady = (ticket.pending.bindingRetry or not ticket.pending.characterChanged)
            and avatar and avatar.ready and not replaced
        if not revalidate and replaced and state == "INACTIVE" and ticket.witnessed and ticket.nativeActive then
            return "TERMINAL_ENCOUNTER_RECOVERY", "BOSS_NATIVE_SESSION_ENDED"
        end
        if not (replaced or retryReady) or evidence.transition or evidence.downed then
            stability = nil
            return nil, "BOSS_RESPAWN_PENDING"
        end
        if sameSession and state == "ACTIVE"
            and not (encounter.recovery and encounter.recovery.resolution)
            and (not observedAt or observedAt > ticket.pending.startedAt) then
            if not ticket.pending.activeSeen then
                ticket.pending.activeSeen = true
                emit("NATIVE_ENCOUNTER_STILL_ACTIVE", encounter, ticket.pending.reason)
            end
            if not env.state:settingsSnapshot().bossEnabled then return nil, "BOSS_CONTINUATION_DISABLED" end
            if boss.combat.supportsContinuation and boss.observer:participating()
                and stable(encounter, evidence) then
                avatar.nativeSessionId = key
                return "RESUME_ACTIVE_ENCOUNTER", ticket.pending.reason, avatar
            end
            return nil, nativeReason or "BOSS_CONTINUATION_NOT_READY"
        end
        return nil, nativeReason or "BOSS_SAME_SESSION_UNVERIFIED"
    end

    function service:awaitContinuation(ctx, encounter, boss, resourcesAvailable)
        return ctx:await(function()
            if resourcesAvailable and not resourcesAvailable() then
                return {reason="BOSS_RECOVERY_RESOURCES_BUSY"}
            end
            local outcome, reason, avatar = self:classify(encounter, boss)
            if outcome then return {outcome=outcome, reason=reason, avatar=avatar} end
        end, resumeWindow)
    end

    function service:rebind(ctx, encounter, reason)
        local newAvatar = original.pending.characterChanged and not original.pending.bindingRetry
        local generation = original.generation + (newAvatar and 1 or 0)
        if not ctx:resumeCombat() or not writer:resumeEncounter(encounter.encounterId, generation) then
            emit("RESUME_FAILED", encounter, "BOSS_REBIND_REJECTED")
            return false
        end
        original.generation = generation
        emit("ENCOUNTER_CONTINUATION_SUPPORTED", encounter, reason)
        emit("CHARACTER_REBOUND", encounter, reason)
        ctx:reportProgress("ACTIVE_ENCOUNTER_REBIND")
        return true
    end

    function service:retryPilot(ctx, encounter)
        local reason = "PILOT_REBIND_PENDING"
        original.pending = {characterChanged=true, bindingRetry=true, reason=reason, startedAt=runtime:now()}
        writer:markRecovery(encounter.encounterId, "ACTIVE_ENCOUNTER_REBIND", reason, runtime:now(), reason)
        return self:wait(ctx, encounter, "RECOVERY_HELD", reason)
    end

    function service:terminal(ctx, encounter, reason)
        if not encounter.recovery or not encounter.recovery.resolution then
            emit("ENCOUNTER_TERMINAL_VERIFIED", encounter, reason)
        end
        ctx:reportProgress("TERMINAL_RESULT_RECOVERY")
        writer:markRecovery(encounter.encounterId, "TERMINAL_RESULT_RECOVERY", reason, runtime:now(),
            nil, "TERMINAL_ENCOUNTER_RECOVERY")
    end

    local function sameAvatar(a, b)
        return a and b and a.ready and a.character == b.character and a.humanoid == b.humanoid and a.root == b.root
    end

    function service:returnWorld(ctx, request, encounter, boss, evidence, exited)
        local id, target = encounter.encounterId, encounter.homeWorld
        local debt = env.state:snapshot().chain
        local zeppelin = encounter.bossId == "ZEPPELIN"
        local navigation = navigationOwner(ctx, boss)
        local function note(name, why, observed)
            emit(name, encounter, why, target, observed or evidence, navigation)
        end
        local function waiting(why, diagnostic, observed, stage, progress)
            local current = snapshot()
            if not current.recovery or current.recovery.reason ~= why then
                note(diagnostic or "RETURN_RECOVERY_BLOCKED", why, observed)
            end
            return self:wait(ctx, encounter, stage or "RETURN_PENDING", why, progress)
        end
        if not Contracts.isHomeWorld(target) then
            return nil, waiting("BOSS_RETURN_TARGET_MISSING")
        end
        -- Historical markers predate submission tracking. A lost/ambiguous send
        -- still owns the destination, so reconcile it by observation alone.
        local legacy = encounter.returnAttempt and not encounter.worldReturn
        local nativeDestination = boss.command.nativeLossDestination
        local existing = encounter.worldReturn
        local destination = existing and existing.destination or "WORLD"
        local unsent = existing and not encounter.returnAttempt and existing.submissions == 0
            and (existing.stage == "RETURN_REQUIRED" or existing.stage == "RETURN_REQUEST_NOT_SENT")
        if (not existing or unsent) and (not legacy or encounter.returnAttempt == "PERSONAL_HIDEOUT")
            and nativeDestination and exited(evidence) then
            local observed = nativeDestination(boss.command, encounter, evidence)
            if observed or evidence.location == "WORLD" then destination = observed or "WORLD" end
        end
        if legacy and encounter.returnAttempt ~= target and destination ~= encounter.returnAttempt then
            if encounter.returnAttempt ~= "PERSONAL_HIDEOUT" or evidence.location ~= "PERSONAL_HIDEOUT" then
                return nil, waiting("BOSS_LEGACY_RETURN_TARGET_UNRESOLVED")
            end
            legacy = false -- The earlier Hideout arrival is independently verified.
        end
        if not encounter.worldReturn then
            assert(writer:requireWorldReturn(id, destination))
            if legacy then
                assert(writer:recordWorldReturn(id, "RETURN_UNRESOLVED", "LEGACY_SUBMISSION_UNKNOWN"))
            end
            note("RETURN_TARGET_RESOLVED", "ENCOUNTER_HOME_WORLD")
            encounter = snapshot()
        elseif unsent and destination ~= (existing.destination or "WORLD") then
            assert(writer:requireWorldReturn(id, destination))
            encounter = snapshot()
        end
        local personalHideout = destination == "PERSONAL_HIDEOUT"
        local reconcileSameWorld = boss.command.reconcileSameWorldReturn or encounter.chainReturnOnly
            or not personalHideout and not zeppelin and debt and debt.successor and debt.homeWorld == target
        local function atDestination(live)
            return (live.location == "WORLD" and live.world == target
                or personalHideout and live.location == "PERSONAL_HIDEOUT") and exited(live)
        end
        local operation = encounter.worldReturn
        if atDestination(evidence) then
            if reconcileSameWorld and boss.command.returnExitSettle
                and runtime:now() - stability.since < boss.command.returnExitSettle then
                return nil, waiting("BOSS_RETURN_DESTINATION_SETTLING", "RETURN_LOCATION_OBSERVED", evidence, nil, true)
            end
            return operation.submissions == 0 and not legacy and operation.stage ~= "RETURN_UNRESOLVED"
                and "RETURN_ALREADY_AT_DESTINATION" or "RETURN_ARRIVAL_VERIFIED"
        end
        if encounter.chainReturnOnly and debt and debt.observeOnly then
            return nil, waiting("CHAIN_RESTORED_OPERATION_UNCERTAIN")
        end
        local sameWorldStage = "RETURN_SAME_WORLD_LOCATION_RECONCILIATION"
        local function replanDifferentWorld()
            if reconcileSameWorld then
                return writer:replanAlreadyThere(id, evidence.world)
            end
            return writer:recordWorldReturn(id, "RETURN_REQUEST_NOT_SENT", "VERIFIED_DIFFERENT_WORLD")
        end
        if operation.stage == "RETURN_REQUEST_REJECTED" then
            if not (zeppelin or reconcileSameWorld) or operation.nativeRejection ~= "AlreadyThere" then
                return nil, waiting("BOSS_RETURN_REJECTED", "RETURN_REQUEST_REJECTED")
            end
            if not exited(evidence) then return nil, waiting("BOSS_EXIT_UNVERIFIED") end
            if evidence.world == target then
                assert(writer:recordWorldReturn(id, sameWorldStage, "AlreadyThere"))
                note(sameWorldStage, "AlreadyThere")
            elseif reconcileSameWorld and evidence.location == "WORLD" then
                if not replanDifferentWorld() then return nil, waiting("BOSS_ALREADY_THERE_ORIGIN_ALREADY_RETRIED") end
                note("RETURN_REQUEST_NOT_SENT", "VERIFIED_DIFFERENT_WORLD")
            else
                return nil, waiting("BOSS_ALREADY_THERE_DESTINATION_UNVERIFIED")
            end
            operation = snapshot().worldReturn
        end
        if operation.stage == sameWorldStage then
            local function reconcileLocation(why, progress)
                return nil, waiting(why, nil, nil, sameWorldStage, progress)
            end
            if not exited(evidence) then return reconcileLocation("BOSS_EXIT_UNVERIFIED") end
            if evidence.world ~= target then
                if evidence.location ~= "WORLD" then return reconcileLocation("BOSS_ALREADY_THERE_DESTINATION_UNVERIFIED") end
                if operation.hideoutEnterAttempted and not operation.hideoutExitAttempted then
                    return reconcileLocation("BOSS_HIDEOUT_ENTER_ARRIVAL_UNVERIFIED")
                end
                -- A settled, physically verified different world is a new origin.
                if not replanDifferentWorld() then return reconcileLocation("BOSS_ALREADY_THERE_ORIGIN_ALREADY_RETRIED") end
                if reconcileSameWorld then note("RETURN_REQUEST_NOT_SENT", "VERIFIED_DIFFERENT_WORLD") end
                operation = snapshot().worldReturn
            else
                if operation.hideoutExitAttempted then return reconcileLocation("BOSS_HIDEOUT_EXIT_ARRIVAL_UNVERIFIED") end
                if evidence.location ~= "PERSONAL_HIDEOUT" and evidence.location ~= "UNVERIFIED_HIDEOUT" then
                    return reconcileLocation("BOSS_SAME_WORLD_LOCATION_UNVERIFIED")
                end
                if operation.hideoutEnterAttempted and evidence.location ~= "PERSONAL_HIDEOUT" then
                    return reconcileLocation("BOSS_HIDEOUT_ENTER_ARRIVAL_UNVERIFIED")
                end
                local world = env.services.world
                if not world or type(world.exitHideout) ~= "function" then
                    return reconcileLocation("BOSS_HIDEOUT_EXIT_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE")
                end
                local function sameHideout(live)
                    return request.resourcesAvailable() and exited(live) and live.world == target
                        and live.location == evidence.location and sameAvatar(live.character, evidence.character)
                end
                local result = world:exitHideout(ctx, function()
                    return sameHideout(env.services.encounterEvidence())
                end, function() return writer:reserveReturnHideoutAction(id, "EXIT") end)
                if snapshot().worldReturn.hideoutExitAttempted then
                    note("RETURN_HIDEOUT_EXIT_ATTEMPTED", result.code)
                    return reconcileLocation("BOSS_HIDEOUT_EXIT_ARRIVAL_UNVERIFIED", true)
                end
                if result.code ~= "BOSS_HIDEOUT_EXIT_NO_NATIVE_SESSION" then return reconcileLocation(result.code) end
                if reconcileSameWorld then return reconcileLocation("BOSS_HIDEOUT_EXIT_NO_NATIVE_SESSION") end
                if evidence.location ~= "UNVERIFIED_HIDEOUT" or evidence.inPersonalHideout
                    or evidence.hideoutHost ~= nil or evidence.hideoutSiteHost ~= nil then
                    return reconcileLocation("BOSS_HIDEOUT_EXIT_SESSION_UNVERIFIED")
                end
                local entered = DirectBossTravel.new(env):enterHideout(ctx, {beforeSubmit=function()
                    local live = env.services.encounterEvidence()
                    return sameHideout(live) and live.atLiveHideoutSite and not live.inPersonalHideout
                        and live.hideoutHost == nil and live.hideoutSiteHost == nil
                        and writer:reserveReturnHideoutAction(id, "ENTER")
                end})
                if snapshot().worldReturn.hideoutEnterAttempted then note("RETURN_HIDEOUT_ENTER_ATTEMPTED", entered.code) end
                return reconcileLocation(entered.ok and "BOSS_HIDEOUT_ENTER_SETTLING" or entered.code, entered.ok)
            end
        end
        if operation.stage == "RETURN_IN_PROGRESS" or operation.stage == "RETURN_REQUEST_SUBMITTED"
            or operation.stage == "RETURN_UNRESOLVED" then
            if operation.reason == "NATIVE_RETURN_REJECTED" then
                return nil, waiting("BOSS_RETURN_REJECTED", "RETURN_REQUEST_REJECTED")
            end
            local why = operation.reason == "LEGACY_SUBMISSION_UNKNOWN" and "BOSS_RETURN_SUBMISSION_UNKNOWN"
                or operation.reason == "WORLD_REQUEST_SEND_FAILED" and "BOSS_RETURN_SUBMISSION_UNCERTAIN"
                or "BOSS_RETURN_ARRIVAL_UNVERIFIED"
            return nil, waiting(why, "RETURN_REQUEST_ALREADY_PENDING")
        end
        if not exited(evidence) then return nil, waiting("BOSS_EXIT_UNVERIFIED") end
        local alreadyThere = operation.nativeRejection == "AlreadyThere"
        if alreadyThere and (evidence.location ~= "WORLD" or evidence.world == target) then
            return nil, waiting("BOSS_ALREADY_THERE_NEW_ORIGIN_UNVERIFIED")
        end
        if alreadyThere and reconcileSameWorld and evidence.world ~= operation.alreadyThereReplanOrigin then
            return nil, waiting("BOSS_ALREADY_THERE_REPLANNED_ORIGIN_CHANGED")
        end
        local canDepart = evidence.location == "WORLD" or evidence.location == "PERSONAL_HIDEOUT"
            or evidence.location == "UNVERIFIED_HIDEOUT" and evidence.atHideoutSite or evidence.positionWorld ~= nil
        if personalHideout then canDepart = nativeDestination(boss.command, encounter, evidence) == destination end
        if not canDepart then
            assert(writer:recordWorldReturn(id, "RETURN_REQUEST_NOT_SENT", "BOSS_RETURN_ORIGIN_UNVERIFIED"))
            return nil, waiting("BOSS_RETURN_ORIGIN_UNVERIFIED", "RETURN_REQUEST_NOT_SENT")
        end
        if not request.resourcesAvailable() then return nil, waiting("BOSS_RECOVERY_RESOURCES_BUSY") end
        local exitSettle = boss.command.returnExitSettle
        if exitSettle and runtime:now() - stability.since < exitSettle then
            return nil, waiting("BOSS_RETURN_EXIT_SETTLING", nil, nil, nil, true)
        end

        ctx:reportProgress("RETURN_REQUEST_NOT_SENT")
        note("RETURN_LOCATION_MISMATCH", "RETURN_REQUIRED")
        local arrival
        local options = {
            arrived = function()
                local live = env.services.encounterEvidence()
                if not atDestination(live) then return false end
                arrival = live
                return true
            end,
            beforeSubmit = function()
                local live = env.services.encounterEvidence()
                if not request.resourcesAvailable() or not exited(live) then return false, "BOSS_RETURN_EXIT_CHANGED" end
                if not sameAvatar(live.character, evidence.character)
                    or live.location ~= evidence.location or live.world ~= evidence.world
                    or live.positionWorld ~= evidence.positionWorld
                    or personalHideout and nativeDestination(boss.command, encounter, live) ~= destination then
                    return false, "BOSS_RETURN_ORIGIN_CHANGED"
                end
                if not writer:recordWorldReturn(id, "RETURN_IN_PROGRESS", "SUBMISSION_STARTED") then
                    return false, "BOSS_RETURN_ALREADY_PENDING"
                end
                return true
            end,
            onSubmitted = function()
                assert(writer:recordWorldReturn(id, "RETURN_REQUEST_SUBMITTED", "REMOTE_DISPATCHED"))
                note("RETURN_REQUEST_SUBMITTED", "REMOTE_DISPATCHED")
                ctx:reportProgress("RETURN_REQUEST_SUBMITTED")
            end,
        }
        local travel = DirectBossTravel.new(env)
        local returned
        if personalHideout then returned = travel:enterHideout(ctx, options)
        else returned = travel:travelWorld(ctx, target, options) end
        local current = snapshot().worldReturn
        if not current then return nil, waiting("BOSS_NATIVE_EXIT_UNVERIFIED") end
        if returned.nativeResponse then
            assert(writer:recordWorldReturnResponse(id, returned.nativeResponse))
            local response = returned.nativeResponse
            note("RETURN_NATIVE_RESPONSE", response.reason or (response.accepted and "ACCEPTED" or "UNKNOWN"))
        end
        if returned.ok then
            -- Start the settling window with the verified location sample.
            -- Completion still requires a fresh observation of the same avatar.
            stable(snapshot(), arrival)
            return nil, waiting("BOSS_RETURN_DESTINATION_SETTLING", "RETURN_LOCATION_OBSERVED", arrival, nil, true)
        end
        local sent = current.stage == "RETURN_REQUEST_SUBMITTED" or current.stage == "RETURN_IN_PROGRESS"
        if not sent then
            assert(writer:recordWorldReturn(id, "RETURN_REQUEST_NOT_SENT", returned.code))
            return nil, waiting(returned.code, "RETURN_REQUEST_NOT_SENT")
        end
        -- An explicit native BossFight rejection proves that the previous
        -- request could not start travel. A later pass must verify exit again.
        if returned.code == "DIRECT_WORLD_REJECTED" or returned.code == "DIRECT_HIDEOUT_REJECTED" then
            assert(writer:recordWorldReturn(id, "RETURN_REQUEST_REJECTED", returned.reason))
            note("RETURN_REQUEST_REJECTED", returned.reason, env.services.encounterEvidence())
            if returned.code == "DIRECT_WORLD_REJECTED" and returned.reason == "BossFight"
                and current.submissions < (boss.config.returnRetries or 1) then
                assert(writer:recordWorldReturn(id, "RETURN_REQUEST_NOT_SENT", "PREVIOUS_REQUEST_REJECTED_BOSS_FIGHT"))
                return nil, waiting("BOSS_RETURN_LOCK_REJECTED", "RETURN_REQUEST_NOT_SENT", nil,
                    boss.command.legacyReturnLockRetry and "RETURN_LOCK_RETRY" or nil)
            end
            local why = returned.reason == "AlreadyThere" and (zeppelin or reconcileSameWorld)
                and "BOSS_ALREADY_THERE_LOCATION_CHECK_REQUIRED" or "BOSS_RETURN_REJECTED"
            return nil, self:wait(ctx, encounter, "RETURN_PENDING", why, why == "BOSS_ALREADY_THERE_LOCATION_CHECK_REQUIRED")
        end
        assert(writer:recordWorldReturn(id, "RETURN_UNRESOLVED", returned.code))
        local why = returned.code == "WORLD_REQUEST_SEND_FAILED" and "BOSS_RETURN_SUBMISSION_UNCERTAIN"
            or "BOSS_RETURN_ARRIVAL_UNVERIFIED"
        return nil, waiting(why, "RETURN_RECOVERY_BLOCKED", nil, nil, true)
    end

    function service:reconcile(ctx, request, encounter, boss)
        local function waiting(stage, why, progress) return self:wait(ctx, encounter, stage, why, progress) end
        if not request.resourcesAvailable() then return waiting("RECOVERY_HELD", "BOSS_RECOVERY_RESOURCES_BUSY") end
        local outcome, reason = self:classify(encounter, boss)
        local ticket = original and original.id == encounter.encounterId and original
        if outcome == "TERMINAL_ENCOUNTER_RECOVERY" then
            self:terminal(ctx, encounter, reason)
        end
        -- Re-evaluate external ownership while an existing controller waits for
        -- an armed report or an arrival. Cancellation keeps its attempt marker.
        local reportWindow, resolvingReport
        ctx:monitorInterruption(function()
            if not request.resourcesAvailable() then
                ctx:interrupt("BOSS_RECOVERY_RESOURCES_BUSY")
            elseif resolvingReport then
                local live = env.services.encounterEvidence()
                local current = boss.report:inspect()
                if live.transition or live.downed then
                    ctx:interrupt(live.transition and "BOSS_WORLD_TRANSITION_PENDING" or "BOSS_GIVE_UP_OR_REVIVE_PENDING")
                elseif reportWindow and current.active and current.report ~= reportWindow then
                    ctx:interrupt("BOSS_REPORT_CHANGED")
                end
            end
        end)
        if type(boss.report.watch) == "function" then boss.report:watch(ctx) end
        local report = boss.report:inspect()
        if report.outcome and encounter.outcome and report.outcome ~= encounter.outcome then
            return Contracts.result("HELD", "BOSS_OUTCOME_CONFLICT", {stage="RECOVERY_HELD"})
        end
        if (report.outcome == "LOSS" or encounter.outcome == "LOSS") and not encounter.reportClosed then
            noteLoss("BOSS_LOSS_RESULT_PENDING", encounter, "BOSS_REPORT_UNRESOLVED")
        end
        local evidence = env.services.encounterEvidence()
        if boss.command.reconcileSameWorldReturn then
            local avatar = evidence.character
            local previous = returnObservation
            local current = {encounterId=encounter.encounterId, character=avatar and avatar.character,
                root=avatar and avatar.root, ready=avatar and avatar.ready,
                location=evidence.location, world=evidence.world, transitioning=evidence.transition}
            if not previous or previous.encounterId ~= current.encounterId
                or previous.character ~= current.character or previous.root ~= current.root
                or previous.ready ~= current.ready or previous.location ~= current.location
                or previous.world ~= current.world or previous.transitioning ~= current.transitioning then
                returnObservation = current
                emit("BOSS_RETURN_LOCATION_SAMPLE", encounter, "RECOVERY_OWNER_OBSERVATION", encounter.homeWorld, evidence,
                    navigationOwner(ctx, boss))
            end
        end
        if evidence.transition or evidence.downed then
            stability = nil
            return waiting("RESPAWN_PENDING", evidence.transition and "BOSS_WORLD_TRANSITION_PENDING" or "BOSS_GIVE_UP_OR_REVIVE_PENDING")
        end
        if report.active or report.specialLossPanel and not encounter.reportClosed then
            if encounter.reportClosed or not report.matchesBoss or not report.outcome
                or encounter.continueAttempted then return waiting("REPORT_PENDING", "BOSS_REPORT_UNRESOLVED") end
            local ok, why = boss.report:reconcile(encounter)
            if not ok then return waiting("REPORT_PENDING", why or "BOSS_REPORT_UNVERIFIED") end
            reportWindow, resolvingReport = report.report, true
            ctx:reportProgress("REPORT_PENDING")
            local result = boss.report:resolve(ctx, encounter)
            reportWindow, resolvingReport = nil, false
            if ctx:isCancelled() then return waiting("REPORT_PENDING", ctx:cancelReason()) end
            if result.held and result.code ~= "BOSS_REPORT_CHANGED" then
                return Contracts.result("HELD", result.code, {stage="RECOVERY_HELD"})
            end
            if not result.ok then return waiting("REPORT_PENDING", reasonFor(result)) end
            emit("REPORT_DISMISS_VERIFIED", encounter, result.code)
            encounter, report, evidence = snapshot(), boss.report:inspect(), env.services.encounterEvidence()
        end
        if report.active or evidence.reportOpen or report.pendingPresentation and not encounter.continueAttempted then
            return waiting("REPORT_PENDING", "BOSS_REPORT_UNRESOLVED")
        end
        if not encounter.reportClosed and (report.seen or encounter.continueAttempted)
            and (report.outcome or encounter.outcome) and boss.report:reconcile(encounter) then
            if not encounter.outcome then
                assert(writer:recordBossReport(report.outcome, runtime:epoch() + boss.repeatPolicy:outcomeDelay(report.outcome)))
            end
            writer:closeReport()
            emit("REPORT_DISMISS_VERIFIED", encounter, "OBSERVED_CLOSED")
            encounter = snapshot()
        end
        local rejected
        if encounter.phase == "START_PENDING" and encounter.soloAttempted and boss.command.entryStatus
            and not report.outcome and not encounter.outcome and not encounter.reportClosed then
            local status, entryReason = boss.command:entryStatus()
            if status ~= "REJECTED" then
                return waiting("ENTRY_PENDING", entryReason or "BOSS_ENTRY_UNRESOLVED")
            end
            rejected = writer:recordSoloRejection(encounter.encounterId, entryReason)
            if not rejected then return waiting("ENTRY_PENDING", "BOSS_ENTRY_REJECTION_UNVERIFIED") end
        end
        local settled, newSample = stable(encounter, evidence)
        if not settled then return waiting("RESPAWN_PENDING", "BOSS_CHARACTER_NOT_SETTLED", newSample) end
        if not outcome and ticket and ticket.pending and ticket.pending.characterChanged then
            return waiting("RECOVERY_HELD", reason or "BOSS_CONTINUATION_NOT_READY")
        end
        local function atArena()
            return boss.observer:inArena()
                or type(boss.observer.inArenaPosition) == "function" and boss.observer:inArenaPosition()
        end
        if evidence.inFight or atArena() then return waiting("RESULT_INSPECTION", "BOSS_EXIT_UNVERIFIED") end
        if type(boss.report.nativeReturnSettled) == "function" and not boss.report:nativeReturnSettled() then
            return waiting("RETURN_PENDING", "BOSS_NATIVE_RETURN_PENDING")
        end
        local setup = (not encounter.soloAttempted or rejected) and not encounter.adopted and not encounter.cooldownOnly
        local interrupted = not setup and not encounter.reportClosed
        local chain = env.state:snapshot().chain
        if interrupted then
            if report.outcome or encounter.outcome or not ticket
                or outcome ~= "TERMINAL_ENCOUNTER_RECOVERY" or reason ~= "BOSS_NATIVE_SESSION_ENDED" then
                return waiting("REPORT_PENDING", "BOSS_TERMINAL_RESULT_UNVERIFIED")
            end
        elseif setup and evidence.location ~= "PERSONAL_HIDEOUT"
            and not (evidence.location == "WORLD" and
                (boss.command.entryStatus and evidence.world == encounter.homeWorld
                    or chain and chain.successor)) then
            -- An unacknowledged preparation may have sent Enter. Observe the
            -- intended destination before authorizing another start.
            return waiting("LOCATION_VERIFICATION", "BOSS_SETUP_ARRIVAL_UNVERIFIED")
        end

        local location = evidence.location
        local tracked = boss.command.trackedWorldReturn and not setup
        local returnResult
        local revalidate = boss.combat.revalidatesNativeEnd
        local function exited(live)
            if interrupted and revalidate
                and select(2, self:classify(snapshot(), boss)) ~= "BOSS_NATIVE_SESSION_ENDED" then return false end
            if not live.character or not live.character.ready or live.transition or live.downed
                or live.inFight or live.reportOpen or atArena() then return false end
            local status = boss.report:inspect()
            if status.active or status.pendingPresentation and not encounter.continueAttempted then return false end
            if type(boss.report.verifyClosed) == "function" and not boss.report:verifyClosed() then return false end
            if type(boss.report.nativeReturnSettled) == "function" and not boss.report:nativeReturnSettled() then return false end
            local _, state = native(boss, encounter.bossId)
            if state == "ACTIVE" or revalidate and state == "PENDING" then return false end
            return not interrupted or revalidate or select(2, self:classify(encounter, boss)) == "BOSS_NATIVE_SESSION_ENDED"
        end
        local function deferredExitReady()
            if not boss.command.deferredExitReady then return true end
            return boss.command:deferredExitReady(encounter)
        end
        local loss = encounter.outcome == "LOSS"
        local outcomeAllowed = encounter.outcome == "WIN" or loss and boss.command.deferVerifiedHideoutLoss
        local canDefer = tracked and boss.command.deferVerifiedHideoutReturn and outcomeAllowed
            and encounter.reportClosed and not interrupted
            and (encounter.verifiedHome or chain)
            and not encounter.returnTransferDeclined and not encounter.chainReturnOnly and not encounter.returnAttempt
            and not encounter.worldReturn and (loss or not (encounter.recovery and encounter.recovery.interruption))
            and location == "PERSONAL_HIDEOUT" and not evidence.transition and exited(evidence)
            and writer:canTransferReturn()
        local exitReady, pendingNativeCleanup, refusal
        if canDefer then exitReady, pendingNativeCleanup, refusal = deferredExitReady() end
        if pendingNativeCleanup then return waiting("RETURN_PENDING", pendingNativeCleanup) end
        if exitReady then
            if boss.command.deferredExitReady and (loss or not boss.command.deferredLossOnlyExitCheck)
                and runtime:now() - stability.since < (boss.command.returnExitSettle or 1.5) then
                return waiting("RETURN_PENDING", "BOSS_RETURN_EXIT_SETTLING", true)
            end
            if loss then
                noteLoss("BOSS_LOSS_CLEANUP_VERIFIED", encounter, "NATIVE_TERMINAL_EXIT_VERIFIED", evidence)
                noteLoss("BOSS_DEFERRED_LOSS_ELIGIBLE", encounter, "OWNED_HIDEOUT_VERIFIED", evidence)
            end
            ctx:reportProgress("CHAIN_SETTLEMENT_CHECK")
            ctx:deferCommit(function()
                local live = env.services.encounterEvidence()
                local transferred, transferReason
                if live.location == location and live.world == evidence.world
                    and sameAvatar(live.character, evidence.character) and request.resourcesAvailable() and exited(live)
                    and deferredExitReady() then
                    transferred, transferReason = writer:transferReturn(encounter.encounterId,
                        ctx.instanceId..":"..encounter.encounterId, live.world, live.character, encounter.outcome)
                end
                if transferred then
                    if boss.report.releaseEncounter then boss.report:releaseEncounter(encounter.encounterId) end
                    writer:clearEncounterHold()
                    original, stability, rechecks, returnObservation = nil, nil, nil, nil
                    emit("BOSS_RETURN_DEFERRED", encounter, "CHAIN_OWNS_HOME_WORLD", encounter.homeWorld, live)
                    if loss then noteLoss("BOSS_DEFERRED_LOSS_COMMITTED", encounter, "CHAIN_OWNS_HOME_WORLD", live) end
                else
                    writer:declineReturnTransfer(encounter.encounterId)
                    if loss then noteLoss("BOSS_DEFERRED_LOSS_REFUSED", encounter,
                        transferReason or "BOSS_CHAIN_COMMIT_EVIDENCE_CHANGED", live) end
                end
            end)
            return Contracts.result("DEFERRED", "CHAIN_SETTLEMENT_CHECK", {stage="CHAIN_SETTLEMENT_CHECK",
                retryAt=runtime:now()+firstRecheck, evidence={encounterId=encounter.encounterId,
                    outcome=encounter.outcome, cooldownUntil=encounter.cooldownUntil}})
        end
        if tracked then
            if loss and not encounter.returnTransferDeclined and not encounter.worldReturn then
                refusal = refusal or (not outcomeAllowed and "BOSS_LOSS_DEFERRAL_UNSUPPORTED"
                    or location == "WORLD" and (evidence.world == encounter.homeWorld
                        and "BOSS_ALREADY_AT_ORIGINAL_HOME" or "BOSS_NATIVE_WORLD_RELOCATION")
                    or location ~= "PERSONAL_HIDEOUT" and "OWNED_HIDEOUT_UNVERIFIED"
                    or not (encounter.verifiedHome or chain) and "ORIGINAL_HOME_UNVERIFIED"
                    or not writer:canTransferReturn() and "BOSS_CHAIN_TRANSFER_UNAVAILABLE"
                    or "BOSS_CHAIN_EXIT_OR_RETURN_UNRESOLVED")
                noteLoss("BOSS_DEFERRED_LOSS_REFUSED", encounter, refusal, evidence)
            end
            if loss and not encounter.worldReturn then
                noteLoss("BOSS_LOSS_RETURN_FALLBACK", encounter, "TRACKED_RETURN_REQUIRED", evidence)
            end
            local pending
            returnResult, pending = self:returnWorld(ctx, request, encounter, boss, evidence, exited)
            if pending then return pending end
            if not exited(evidence) then return waiting("RETURN_PENDING", "BOSS_EXIT_UNVERIFIED") end
        end
        local attempt = encounter.returnAttempt
        if not tracked and attempt and (attempt == "PERSONAL_HIDEOUT" and location ~= attempt
            or type(attempt) == "number" and (location ~= "WORLD" or evidence.world ~= attempt)) then
            return waiting("RETURN_PENDING", "BOSS_RETURN_ARRIVAL_UNVERIFIED")
        end
        if not tracked and location == "UNVERIFIED_HIDEOUT" and evidence.atHideoutSite and not attempt then
            -- Stay under the current recovery job and record the destination
            -- before reusing the existing ownership-protected Enter flow.
            if not request.resourcesAvailable() then return waiting("RECOVERY_HELD", "BOSS_RECOVERY_RESOURCES_BUSY") end
            assert(writer:markReturnAttempt(encounter.encounterId, "PERSONAL_HIDEOUT"))
            ctx:reportProgress("LOCATION_VERIFICATION")
            local entered = DirectBossTravel.new(env):enterHideout(ctx)
            return waiting("LOCATION_VERIFICATION", entered.ok and "BOSS_HIDEOUT_SETTLING" or entered.code)
        end
        if location ~= "WORLD" and location ~= "PERSONAL_HIDEOUT" then
            return waiting("LOCATION_VERIFICATION", "BOSS_LOCATION_UNVERIFIED")
        end
        if type(boss.report.verifyClosed) == "function" and not boss.report:verifyClosed() then
            return waiting("REPORT_PENDING", "BOSS_REPORT_UNRESOLVED")
        end
        emit("ENCOUNTER_EXIT_VERIFIED", encounter, location)
        emit("LOCATION_VERIFIED", encounter, location)
        local code = encounter.chainReturnOnly and "CHAIN_RETURN_VERIFIED"
            or setup and "BOSS_SETUP_RECOVERY_VERIFIED" or interrupted and "BOSS_INTERRUPTED_VERIFIED"
            or encounter.cooldownOnly and "BOSS_COOLDOWN_RECOVERY_VERIFIED"
            or "BOSS_" .. encounter.outcome .. "_VERIFIED"
        local cooldown = encounter.cooldownUntil and encounter.cooldownUntil - runtime:epoch() or 0
        local delay = math.max(setup and env.profile.boss.setupRetry or 0, cooldown)
        local retryAt = delay > 0 and runtime:now() + delay or nil
        ctx:reportProgress("CLEANUP_PENDING")
        ctx:deferCommit(function()
            local current = snapshot()
            assert(current and current.encounterId == encounter.encounterId, "Recovery encounter changed")
            local settled = env.services.encounterEvidence()
            assert(not settled.transition and not settled.downed and not settled.inFight and not settled.reportOpen
                and settled.character and settled.character.ready and settled.character.character == evidence.character.character
                and settled.character.humanoid == evidence.character.humanoid and settled.character.root == evidence.character.root
                and settled.location == location and settled.world == evidence.world
                and not atArena() and not boss.report:inspect().active and request.resourcesAvailable()
                and (not rejected or boss.command:entryStatus() == "REJECTED")
                and (not tracked or exited(settled) and (current.worldReturn.destination == "PERSONAL_HIDEOUT"
                    and settled.location == "PERSONAL_HIDEOUT" or settled.location == "WORLD" and settled.world == encounter.homeWorld))
                and (not interrupted or select(2, self:classify(encounter, boss)) == "BOSS_NATIVE_SESSION_ENDED"), "Recovery evidence changed during cleanup")
            if type(boss.report.releaseEncounter) == "function" then boss.report:releaseEncounter(encounter.encounterId) end
            if returnResult then
                assert(writer:recordWorldReturn(encounter.encounterId, returnResult, "DESTINATION_VERIFIED"))
                emit(returnResult, encounter, "DESTINATION_VERIFIED", encounter.homeWorld, settled, navigationOwner(ctx, boss))
            end
            if setup then writer:abandonBeforeSolo()
            elseif interrupted then writer:completeInterrupted(encounter.encounterId)
            else
                writer:setReturnPending(false)
                writer:completeEncounter(boss.repeatPolicy:repeatEnabled())
            end
            if tracked then
                assert(writer:completeWorldReturn(encounter.encounterId))
                emit("RETURN_COMPLETED", encounter, code, encounter.homeWorld, settled, navigationOwner(ctx, boss))
            end
            writer:clearEncounterHold()
            original, stability, rechecks, returnObservation = nil, nil, nil, nil
            emit("RECOVERY_VERIFIED", encounter, code)
            if tracked then emit("RECOVERY_COMPLETED", encounter, code, encounter.homeWorld, settled) end
        end)
        return Contracts.result("COMPLETED", code, {stage="RECOVERY_VERIFIED", retryAt=retryAt,
            evidence={encounterId=encounter.encounterId, bossId=encounter.bossId, outcome=encounter.outcome,
                location=location, world=evidence.world, homeWorld=encounter.homeWorld, worldReturn=returnResult}})
    end
    return service
end

return EncounterRecovery
end
-- END MODULE boss.shared.EncounterRecovery

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.shared.NativeBossEntry
__factories["boss.shared.NativeBossEntry"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Shared Boss Command pass and Solo submission used by these native channels.
local NativeBossEntry = {}

function NativeBossEntry.new(env, config, observer, report, commander, remote)
    local player = env.services.roblox:player()
    local entry = {}
    local function active(ctx) return env.runtime:isActive(ctx) and not ctx:isCancelled() end

    function entry:status()
        local status, reason = report.entry:entryStatus()
        -- A live B-52 avatar can already be on the escort deck while the
        -- native hideout attribute still reads true.
        if status == "ENTERED" and not observer:inArenaPosition() then
            return "PENDING", "BOSS_ENTRY_ARENA_ARRIVAL_UNVERIFIED"
        end
        return status, reason
    end

    function entry:start(ctx, markAttempt)
        if not active(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        local watcher = report.entry
        local function failed(code)
            watcher:failed(code)
            return false, code
        end
        local hideout, accept = remote("PersonalHideoutRemote"), remote(commander)
        if not hideout or not accept then return failed("BOSS_ENTRY_REMOTES_MISSING") end
        if not active(ctx) or player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true then return failed("BOSS_ENTRY_PREFLIGHT_CHANGED") end

        local passReply, listening
        local pass = hideout.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(packet)
            if type(packet) == "table" and packet.Kind == "BossCommand" and packet.Op == "Start"
                and packet.BossKey == config.gameBossKey then passReply = packet end
        end)
        listening = true
        local function disconnect()
            if listening then listening = false; pass:Disconnect() end
        end
        ctx:deferCleanup(disconnect)
        local sent, err = pcall(function()
            hideout:FireServer({Action = "StartBoss", BossKey = config.gameBossKey, Solo = true})
        end)
        if not sent then disconnect(); return failed("BOSS_ENTRY_PASS_SEND_FAILED: " .. tostring(err)) end
        local reply = ctx:await(function() return passReply end, 10)
        disconnect()
        if not active(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        if not reply then return failed("BOSS_ENTRY_PASS_UNACKNOWLEDGED") end
        if reply.Ok ~= true then return failed("BOSS_ENTRY_PASS_REJECTED: " .. tostring(reply.Reason)) end
        if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true then return failed("BOSS_ENTRY_PREFLIGHT_CHANGED") end
        if not watcher:armEntry(accept.OnClientEvent) or not markAttempt() then
            return failed("BOSS_ENTRY_SOLO_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED")
        end

        -- Mark before the native call. A throwing call has an unknown outcome.
        watcher:beginDispatch()
        sent, err = pcall(function() accept:FireServer({Solo = true}) end)
        if not sent then
            local code = "BOSS_ENTRY_SUBMISSION_UNCERTAIN: " .. tostring(err)
            watcher:pending(code)
            return false, code
        end
        watcher:submitted()
        local status, reason
        ctx:await(function()
            status, reason = self:status()
            if status == "ENTERED" or status == "REJECTED" then return true end
        end, config.arenaTimeout)
        if not active(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        if status == "ENTERED" then return true, reason end
        if status == "REJECTED" then return failed("BOSS_ENTRY_REJECTED: " .. reason) end
        reason = reason or "BOSS_ENTRY_ACK_UNVERIFIED"
        watcher:pending(reason)
        return false, reason
    end
    return entry
end

return NativeBossEntry
end
-- END MODULE boss.shared.NativeBossEntry

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.shared.NativeEncounterReport
__factories["boss.shared.NativeEncounterReport"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local DeferredOutcome = require("boss.shared.DeferredOutcome")
-- Retain passive terminal evidence across job cancellation. Mechanics callbacks
-- remain bound to the live encounter job.
local NativeEncounterReport = {}

function NativeEncounterReport.new(env, bossId, prefix)
    local platform = env.services.roblox
    local panelName = env.profile.paths.bossReport[1]
    local encounterId, generation, ended, panelSeen, entry, defeat, numberedEnd
    local connections, job = {}, nil
    local observation = {}

    local function owned()
        local encounter = env.state:snapshot().boss.encounter
        if encounter and encounter.bossId == bossId and encounter.phase ~= "COMPLETE" then return encounter end
    end
    local function worldGeneration()
        return platform:workspace():GetAttribute(prefix .. "FightGeneration")
    end
    local function participating()
        local player = platform:player()
        return player:GetAttribute(prefix .. "Participant") == true or player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true
    end
    local function emit(code, reason, nativeGeneration)
        local data = {bossId=bossId, encounterId=encounterId, reason=reason, generation=nativeGeneration}
        if env.services.telemetry then env.services.telemetry:emit(code, data)
        else print("[PlaneRNG entry]", code, bossId, encounterId, reason, nativeGeneration) end
    end
    local function close()
        for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
        connections = {}
        encounterId, job = nil, nil
    end
    function observation:reset()
        close()
        generation, ended, panelSeen, entry, defeat, numberedEnd = nil, nil, false, nil, nil, nil
    end
    function observation:release(id)
        if id == encounterId then close() end
    end
    function observation:cleanup(ctx)
        local encounter = owned()
        if not ctx or not encounter or encounter.encounterId ~= encounterId then close() end
    end
    function observation:watch(ctx, connect)
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        local encounter = owned()
        if not encounter then
            emit("BOSS_ENTRY_UNOWNED", "BOSS_REPORT_ENCOUNTER_UNOWNED")
            return false, "BOSS_REPORT_ENCOUNTER_UNOWNED"
        end
        local id = encounter.encounterId
        if id ~= encounterId then
            close()
            encounterId = id
            local ok, reason = connect(function(signal, callback)
                connections[#connections+1] = signal:Connect(callback)
            end)
            if not ok then close(); return false, reason end
            local gui = platform:playerGui()
            if gui and gui.ChildAdded then
                connections[#connections+1] = gui.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
                    if child.Name == panelName and child:IsA("ScreenGui") and child.Enabled
                        and generation ~= nil then panelSeen = true end
                end)
            end
        end
        if job ~= ctx then
            job = ctx
            ctx:deferCleanup(function() if job == ctx then job = nil end end)
        end
        return true
    end
    function observation:armEntry(signal)
        local encounter = owned()
        if not encounter or encounter.encounterId ~= encounterId or entry then return false end
        entry = {baseline=worldGeneration(), starts={}}
        connections[#connections+1] = signal:Connect(function(packet)
            local current = owned()
            if not current or current.encounterId ~= encounterId or not entry or not entry.dispatched
                or entry.reply or type(packet) ~= "table" or type(packet.Accepted) ~= "boolean" then return end
            entry.reply = packet
            emit(packet.Accepted and "BOSS_ENTRY_ACKNOWLEDGED" or "BOSS_ENTRY_REJECTED",
                packet.Reason or (packet.Accepted and "COMMANDER_ACCEPTED" or "COMMANDER_REJECTED"))
        end)
        emit("BOSS_ENTRY_REQUESTED", "SOLO")
        return true
    end
    function observation:beginDispatch() entry.dispatched = true end
    function observation:submitted() emit("BOSS_ENTRY_SUBMITTED", "SOLO") end
    local function observeGeneration()
        if not entry or not entry.dispatched or generation then return end
        local current = worldGeneration()
        if current ~= nil and current ~= entry.baseline
            and (entry.starts[current] or entry.unnumberedStart and not entry.numberedStart
                or entry.reply and entry.reply.Accepted and not entry.numberedStart
                    and platform:workspace():GetAttribute(prefix .. "FightActive") == true
                    and platform:player():GetAttribute(prefix .. "Participant") == true) then
            generation = current
            emit("BOSS_NATIVE_SESSION_FOUND", "NATIVE_GENERATION_MATCHED", generation)
        end
    end
    function observation:entryStatus()
        if not entry or not entry.dispatched then return "NOT_SENT", "BOSS_ENTRY_NOT_SENT" end
        observeGeneration()
        local player = platform:player()
        if entry.reply and entry.reply.Accepted == false then
            if not generation and not participating() then
                return "REJECTED", tostring(entry.reply.Reason or "COMMANDER_REJECTED")
            end
            return "PENDING", "BOSS_ENTRY_REJECTION_CONFLICT"
        end
        if generation == nil then return "PENDING", "BOSS_ENTRY_SESSION_UNVERIFIED" end
        if worldGeneration() ~= generation or player:GetAttribute(prefix .. "Participant") ~= true then
            return "PENDING", "BOSS_ENTRY_PARTICIPATION_UNVERIFIED"
        end
        local avatar = platform:character()
        if not avatar.ready or player.GameplayPaused == true then
            return "PENDING", "BOSS_ENTRY_CHARACTER_UNSETTLED"
        end
        return "ENTERED", "BOSS_PARTICIPATION_VERIFIED"
    end
    function observation:combatStarted()
        emit("BOSS_PARTICIPATION_VERIFIED", "NATIVE_PARTICIPANT", generation)
        emit("BOSS_COMBAT_STARTED", "NATIVE_ENTRY_VERIFIED", generation)
    end
    function observation:pending(reason) emit("BOSS_ENTRY_PENDING", reason, generation) end
    function observation:failed(reason) emit("BOSS_ENTRY_FAILED", reason, generation) end
    function observation:accept(packet, starts)
        local encounter = owned()
        if not encounter or encounter.encounterId ~= encounterId
            or not (encounter.soloAttempted or encounter.adopted) then return false end
        local activeJob = job ~= nil and not job:isClosing() and not job:isCancelled()
        local forward = activeJob and (job.stage ~= "ENCOUNTER_RECOVERY" or encounter.phase == "COMBAT")
        if entry and entry.dispatched and starts and not generation then
            if packet.Generation ~= nil then
                if packet.Generation ~= entry.baseline then
                    entry.numberedStart = true
                    entry.starts[packet.Generation] = true
                end
            else entry.unnumberedStart = true end
        end
        observeGeneration()
        if not entry and not generation and forward and encounter.adopted then
            if starts then generation = packet.Generation end
            if not generation and participating() then generation = worldGeneration() end
        end
        if packet.Generation ~= nil and generation ~= nil and packet.Generation ~= generation then return false end
        local matched = generation ~= nil and (packet.Generation == generation
            or packet.Generation == nil and worldGeneration() == generation)
        if starts and matched then defeat, numberedEnd = nil, nil end
        return forward and matched, matched
    end
    function observation:observeTerminal(packet, kind)
        if generation == nil or packet.Generation ~= generation then return end
        if kind == "End" then numberedEnd = generation
        elseif kind == "Outcome" and type(packet.Victory) == "boolean" then
            defeat = DeferredOutcome.isDefeat(packet) and generation or nil
        end
    end
    function observation:verifiedDefeat(encounter)
        local current = worldGeneration()
        return entry ~= nil and entry.dispatched and encounter.encounterId == encounterId
            and defeat ~= nil and defeat == generation and (current == nil or current == generation)
    end
    function observation:numberedExit()
        return numberedEnd ~= nil and numberedEnd == generation and not participating()
    end
    function observation:endSession()
        ended = true
    end
    function observation:wasReportSeen() return panelSeen end
    function observation:exited() return ended == true and not participating() end
    function observation:nativeEncounter()
        local encounter = owned()
        if not encounter or encounter.encounterId ~= encounterId then return nil end
        if not generation then return nil, nil, nil, bossId .. "_NATIVE_GENERATION_UNVERIFIED" end
