        if participating() then return generation, "ACTIVE", nil, bossId .. "_NATIVE_PARTICIPATION_ACTIVE" end
        if ended then return generation, "TERMINAL" end
        return generation, nil, nil, bossId .. "_NATIVE_END_OR_OUTCOME_UNOBSERVED"
    end
    function observation:ownedNativeGeneration() return generation end
    return observation
end

return NativeEncounterReport
end
-- END MODULE boss.shared.NativeEncounterReport

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.shared.PilotControl
__factories["boss.shared.PilotControl"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local PilotWeapons = require("boss.shared.PilotWeapons")
local PilotControl = {}

function PilotControl.bound(runtime, controller, expected)
    if not runtime or type(runtime.Flight) ~= "function" or type(runtime.Active) ~= "function"
        or type(runtime.Plane) ~= "function" or not controller or type(controller.IsActive) ~= "function"
        or not controller.IsActive() or not runtime.Active() then return nil end
    local state, plane=runtime.Flight(), runtime.Plane()
    local sim=type(state)=="table" and state.Sim
    if not plane or not plane.Parent or not sim or state.Plane~=plane or not expected(plane)
        or typeof(sim.Position)~="Vector3" or typeof(sim.Rotation)~="CFrame" then return nil end
    return plane,state
end

function PilotControl.position(value)
    if typeof(value)=="Vector3" then return value end
    if type(value)~="string" then return nil end
    local x,y,z=value:match("^%s*([^,]+),([^,]+),([^,]+)%s*$")
    x,y,z=tonumber(x),tonumber(y),tonumber(z)
    if x and y and z and math.max(math.abs(x),math.abs(y),math.abs(z))<1e7 then
        return Vector3.new(x,y,z)
    end
end

local function angle(a,b)
    return math.deg(math.acos(math.clamp(a:Dot(b),-1,1)))
end

function PilotControl.new(platform, log)
    local weapons=PilotWeapons.new(platform,log)
    local pilot={}
    local previous, target, lastRequest, activePlane, activeControls, activeSim, owner, ownerRuntime, ownerPlane, ownership
    local lastFailure, lastFailureAt, lastCallbackAt, installedAt

    function pilot:failed(reason)
        local now=os.clock()
        if reason~=lastFailure or now-lastFailureAt>=4 then
            log("STEERING_FAILED",{reason=reason})
            lastFailure,lastFailureAt=reason,now
        end
    end

    function pilot:clear(reason)
        local stopped = weapons:stop(reason)
        previous,target,lastRequest,activePlane,activeControls,activeSim=nil,nil,nil,nil,nil,nil
        return stopped
    end

    function pilot:stop()
        ownership=nil
        local released = self:clear("ENCOUNTER_STOPPED")
        if owner then
            local ok, plane=pcall(ownerRuntime.Plane)
            if ok and (not plane or plane==ownerPlane) then
                pcall(owner._setAuto,false)
                pcall(owner.SetAutoPilot,nil)
            end
        end
        owner,ownerRuntime,ownerPlane=nil,nil,nil
        lastFailure,lastFailureAt,lastCallbackAt,installedAt=nil,nil,nil,nil
        assert(released, "PILOT_GUN_RELEASE_UNVERIFIED")
    end

    function pilot:apply(runtime, controller, plane, state, plan, direct, stillCurrent)
        if stillCurrent and not stillCurrent() then return nil,"STALE_CHARACTER" end
        if not plan or typeof(plan.Aim)~="Vector3" or plan.Aim.Magnitude<0.05 then
            self:clear("NO_AIM")
            return nil,"NO_AIM"
        end
        if activePlane~=plane or activeControls~=state.Controls or activeSim~=state.Sim then
            if not self:clear("AIRCRAFT_CHANGED") then return nil,"GUN_RELEASE_UNVERIFIED" end
            activePlane,activeControls,activeSim=plane,state.Controls,state.Sim
            log("FLIGHT_RUNTIME_ACTIVE",{runtime="ManualFlightRuntime",aircraft=plane.Name,
                interface=direct and "SetAim" or "SetAutoPilot"})
        end
        if direct then
            if type(controller.AutoPilotOn)~="function" or controller.AutoPilotOn() then
                self:clear("NATIVE_AUTOPILOT")
                self:failed("NATIVE_AUTOPILOT_HAS_CONTROL")
                return nil,"NATIVE_AUTOPILOT_HAS_CONTROL"
            end
            local ok,result=pcall(runtime.SetAim,plan.Aim.Unit)
            if stillCurrent and not stillCurrent() then return nil,"STALE_CHARACTER" end
            if not ok or result==false then
                self:clear("SET_AIM_REJECTED")
                self:failed("SET_AIM_REJECTED")
                return nil,"SET_AIM_REJECTED"
            end
        end
        local now,aim,heading=os.clock(),plan.Aim.Unit,state.Sim.Rotation.LookVector
        if target~=plan.Target then
            if not weapons:stop("TARGET_CHANGED") then return nil,"GUN_RELEASE_UNVERIFIED" end
            previous,lastRequest,target=nil,nil,plan.Target
            log("TARGET_SELECTED",{target=target})
        end
        local reason="STEERING_AWAITING_HEADING"
        if target and previous and not plan.Maneuver then
            local change=angle(previous.heading,heading)
            local gain=previous.error-angle(heading,previous.aim)
            if change>=0.5 and gain>=0.5 then
                reason="STEERING_VERIFIED"
                if not previous.verified then
                    log("STEERING_VERIFIED",{target=target,headingChange=change,alignmentGain=gain})
                    previous.verified=true
                end
                if now-previous.at>1 then previous=nil end
            elseif now-previous.at>=0.75 then
                if angle(heading,aim)>5 and not previous.verified then
                    reason="HEADING_NOT_RESPONDING"
                    self:failed(reason)
                end
                previous=nil
            end
        elseif plan.Maneuver then previous=nil end
        if target and not previous and not plan.Maneuver then
            previous={aim=aim,heading=heading,error=angle(heading,aim),at=now}
        end
        if not lastRequest or now-lastRequest>=4 then
            lastRequest=now
            log("STEERING_REQUESTED",{target=target,aim=aim,maneuver=plan.Maneuver==true})
        end
        local fire=weapons:step(state,plan,direct,now)
        return {Aim=plan.Aim,Throttle=plan.Throttle,Fire=fire},reason
    end

    -- Use only when the encounter's native controller has no autopilot provider.
    function pilot:install(runtime, controller, plane, sample, planner)
        if ownerPlane==plane then
            local on=controller.AutoPilotOn()
            if not on then self:clear("AUTOPILOT_TOGGLED_OFF") end
            if on and os.clock()-(lastCallbackAt or installedAt)>0.75 then self:failed("CALLBACK_NOT_RUNNING") end
            return on
        end
        local replacing=owner==controller and ownerRuntime==runtime
        if owner and not replacing then self:stop() end
        if type(controller.SetAutoPilot)~="function" or type(controller._setAuto)~="function"
            or type(controller.AutoPilotOn)~="function" or (not replacing and controller.AutoPilotOn()) then
            self:failed("CALLBACK_ACTIVATION_UNAVAILABLE_OR_ALREADY_OWNED")
            return false
        end
        local token={}
        local callback=function(dt)
            if ownership~=token then return nil end
            local ok, result=pcall(function()
                local active,state=sample()
                if not active then self:clear("FLIGHT_HANDOFF_LOST"); return nil end
                ownerPlane=active
                lastCallbackAt=os.clock()
                return self:apply(runtime,controller,active,state,planner(dt),false)
            end)
            if ok then return result end
            self:clear("CALLBACK_ERROR")
            self:failed(tostring(result))
            return nil
        end
        local ok,result=pcall(controller.SetAutoPilot,callback)
        if not ok or result==false then self:failed("CALLBACK_REGISTRATION_REJECTED"); return false end
        owner,ownerRuntime,ownerPlane,ownership=controller,runtime,plane,token
        lastCallbackAt,installedAt=nil,os.clock()
        local enabled=pcall(controller._setAuto,true)
        if not enabled or not controller.AutoPilotOn() then
            self:stop()
            self:failed("CALLBACK_NOT_ENABLED")
            return false
        end
        return true
    end
    return pilot
end
return PilotControl
end
-- END MODULE boss.shared.PilotControl

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.shared.PilotWeapons
__factories["boss.shared.PilotWeapons"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local PilotWeapons = {}

function PilotWeapons.new(platform, log)
    local weapons = {}
    local mode, held, arm, retryAt, block = "IDLE", nil, nil, 0, nil

    local function transition(nextMode)
        if mode == nextMode then return end
        log("WEAPON_MODE_CHANGED", {from=mode, mode=nextMode})
        mode = nextMode
    end

    local function stopGun()
        if mode ~= "GUN_ACTIVE" then return true end
        if held then
            local ok, result = pcall(held.button, held.x, held.y, false)
            if not ok or result == false then
                if block ~= "GUN_RELEASE_FAILED" then log("WEAPON_INPUT_BLOCKED", {reason="GUN_RELEASE_FAILED"}) end
                block = "GUN_RELEASE_FAILED"
                return false
            end
            held = nil
        end
        log("GUN_STOPPED")
        transition("IDLE")
        return true
    end

    local function releaseMissile(reason)
        if not arm then return end
        if arm.controls.MissileArmUntil == arm.deadline then
            arm.controls.MissileArmUntil, arm.controls.AutoMissile = 0, false
        end
        arm = nil
        log("MISSILE_RELEASED", {reason=reason})
    end

    function weapons:stop(reason)
        releaseMissile(reason or "ENCOUNTER_STOPPED")
        local stopped = stopGun()
        if stopped then transition("IDLE"); block=nil end
        retryAt = 0
        return stopped
    end

    function weapons:step(state, plan, direct, now)
        local controls = state.Controls
        if type(controls) ~= "table" or not plan.Target then
            self:stop("TARGET_OR_CONTROLS_LOST")
            return false
        end
        if held and block == "GUN_RELEASE_FAILED" then
            stopGun()
            return false
        end
        local match = not plan.TargetModel or state.Target == plan.TargetModel
        local wantsGun = plan.Fire == true and match and state.HasGuns == true and state.GunReady == true and state.OnTarget == true
        local missileState = state.MissileState
        local cooling = missileState == "reloading" or missileState == "launching"
        local nativeArm = tonumber(controls.MissileArmUntil)
        local missileReady = plan.Missile == true and match and state.BossMissiles ~= false
            and missileState == "ready" and nativeArm ~= nil
        if arm then
            if arm.controls == controls and arm.target == plan.Target and cooling then
                transition("MISSILE_FIRING")
                releaseMissile("NATIVE_LAUNCH_OR_RELOAD_OBSERVED")
                transition("MISSILE_COOLDOWN")
                log("MISSILE_COOLDOWN", {nativeState=missileState})
            elseif arm.controls ~= controls or arm.target ~= plan.Target or not missileReady
                or now >= arm.deadline or nativeArm ~= arm.deadline then
                releaseMissile("ARM_EXPIRED_OR_SOLUTION_LOST")
                retryAt = now + 0.75
                transition("IDLE")
            end
            return false
        end
        -- Native player input is sampled before the callback. Leave manually armed
        -- missiles alone and give a released gun one native sample before arming.
        if nativeArm and nativeArm > now then
            if stopGun() then transition("WEAPON_BLOCKED") end
            return false
        end
        if missileReady and now >= retryAt and not (controls.Fire and mode ~= "GUN_ACTIVE") then
            if mode == "GUN_ACTIVE" then
                stopGun()
                return false
            end
            arm = {controls=controls, deadline=now+0.35, target=plan.Target}
            controls.MissileArmUntil, controls.AutoMissile = arm.deadline, true
            transition("MISSILE_ARMING")
            log("MISSILE_REQUESTED", {target=plan.Target})
            block = nil
            return false
        end
        if wantsGun and missileState ~= "launching" then
            if mode == "GUN_ACTIVE" then return not direct end
            if direct then
                local button = platform:capability("mouseButton")
                local camera = platform:workspace().CurrentCamera
                local point = camera and camera.ViewportSize * 0.5
                local ok, result
                if button and point then ok, result=pcall(button,point.X,point.Y,true) end
                if not ok or result == false then
                    transition("WEAPON_BLOCKED")
                    if block ~= "GUN_INPUT_UNAVAILABLE" then
                        block = "GUN_INPUT_UNAVAILABLE"
                        log("WEAPON_INPUT_BLOCKED", {reason=block})
                    end
                    return false
                end
                held = {button=button,x=point.X,y=point.Y}
            end
            block=nil
            transition("GUN_ACTIVE")
            log("GUN_STARTED", {target=plan.Target, input="REQUESTED"})
            return not direct
        end
        if not stopGun() then return false end
        local reason
        if plan.Fire and match and state.HasGuns~=true then reason="NATIVE_GUN_UNAVAILABLE"
        elseif plan.Missile and match and (state.BossMissiles==false or not nativeArm) then reason="NATIVE_MISSILE_UNAVAILABLE" end
        if reason then
            transition("WEAPON_BLOCKED")
            if block~=reason then log("WEAPON_INPUT_BLOCKED",{reason=reason}) end
            block=reason
        elseif not cooling then transition("IDLE"); block=nil end
        return false
    end
    return weapons
end
return PilotWeapons
end
-- END MODULE boss.shared.PilotWeapons

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.shared.RaidAttemptOptions
__factories["boss.shared.RaidAttemptOptions"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- A managed attempt freezes only the fields owned by the scheduler.
-- Unmanaged standalone launches continue to use their original global options.
local Contracts = require("main.core.Contracts")
local RaidAttemptOptions = {}

function RaidAttemptOptions.build(config, current, attempt)
    local values = {}
    for key, value in pairs(config.defaultOptions) do values[key] = value end
    if type(current) == "table" then
        for key, value in pairs(current) do
            if config.defaultOptions[key] ~= nil then values[key] = value end
        end
    end
    if attempt ~= nil then
        if type(attempt) ~= "table" or not config.isDifficulty(attempt.difficulty) then
            return nil, "RAID_FROZEN_DIFFICULTY_INVALID"
        end
        if attempt.raidId ~= nil and attempt.raidId ~= config.bossId then
            return nil, "RAID_FROZEN_ROUTE_MISMATCH"
        end
        if attempt.originalWorld ~= nil and not Contracts.isHomeWorld(attempt.originalWorld) then
            return nil, "RAID_FROZEN_ORIGIN_INVALID"
        end
        if attempt.token ~= nil and (type(attempt.token) ~= "string" or #attempt.token < 8) then
            return nil, "RAID_FROZEN_TOKEN_INVALID"
        end
        -- Do not permit old standalone globals to overwrite scheduler-owned options.
        values.difficulty = attempt.difficulty
        values.returnToOrigin = true
        values.autoContinueAfterOutcome = true
        values.requireTeleportQueue = true
        if attempt.originalWorld ~= nil then values.originWorld = attempt.originalWorld end
    elseif not config.isDifficulty(values.difficulty) then
        values.difficulty = config.defaultDifficulty
    end
    return values
end

return RaidAttemptOptions
end
-- END MODULE boss.shared.RaidAttemptOptions

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.shared.RepeatPolicy
__factories["boss.shared.RepeatPolicy"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local RepeatPolicy = {}

function RepeatPolicy.new(env, outcomeError)
    local policy = {}

    function policy:outcomeDelay(outcome)
        assert(outcome == "WIN" or outcome == "LOSS", outcomeError)
        return outcome == "WIN" and env.profile.boss.winRetry or env.profile.boss.lossRetry
    end

    function policy:readinessDelay(readiness)
        local minutes, seconds = tostring(readiness):match("^(%d+):(%d%d)$")
        if minutes and tonumber(seconds) < 60 then
            return math.max(2, tonumber(minutes) * 60 + tonumber(seconds) + 1)
        end
        return env.profile.boss.unknownRetry
    end

    function policy:deadline(untilEpoch)
        return env.runtime:now() + math.max(0, (untilEpoch or env.runtime:epoch()) - env.runtime:epoch())
    end

    function policy:repeatEnabled()
        return env.state:snapshot().config.bossRepeat
    end

    return policy
end

return RepeatPolicy
end
-- END MODULE boss.shared.RepeatPolicy

-- BEGIN MODULE luck.v6.TotemController
__factories["luck.v6.TotemController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local Contracts = require("main.core.Contracts")
local FeaturePolicy = require("main.core.FeaturePolicy")
local LocationEvidence = require("main.world.LocationEvidence")
local TotemController = {}

function TotemController.policy()
    local policy = FeaturePolicy.defaults("TOTEM")
    policy.requiresPlatform, policy.readOnlyRecovery = true, true
    return policy
end

local function compact(text)
    return tostring(text or ""):lower():gsub("<.->", ""):gsub("%s+", "")
end

function TotemController.new()
    local env, services, writer, profile, runtime
    local lease, leaseContext
    local restoredSuccessMonotonic
    local controller = {}
    local function snapshot() return env.state:snapshot().totem end
    local function active(ctx) return runtime:isActive(ctx) and not ctx:isCancelled() and not ctx:isClosing() end
    local function window() return services.gui:find(profile.paths.totemWindow) end
    local function opened() return services.gui:visible(window()) end
    local function same(expected) return expected ~= nil and expected == window() and services.gui:belongs(expected) end
    local function cooldownEstimate()
        return profile.totem.normalCooldownSeconds / env.state:snapshot().config.TotemCooldownMultiplier
    end
    local function estimatedReadyAt()
        local current = snapshot()
        local successNow = current.lastSuccessMonotonic or restoredSuccessMonotonic
        return successNow and successNow + cooldownEstimate() or nil
    end
    local function nextCheckAt()
        local now, estimated = runtime:now(), estimatedReadyAt()
        -- Bound the interval to catch early READY; an expired estimate never authorizes Proceed.
        local delay = estimated and estimated > now and math.min(profile.totem.retry, estimated - now) or profile.totem.retry
        return now + delay
    end
    local function cancelled(stage)
        return Contracts.result("CANCELLED", "TOTEM_CANCELLED", {stage = stage or snapshot().stage})
    end
    local function deferred(code, stage, delay)
        -- An exact now() retry expires before Scheduler.validateResult calls now()
        -- again, converting a valid quarantine handoff into JOB_EXCEPTION.
        local requested = delay == nil and profile.totem.retry or delay
        local safeDelay = math.max(1, requested)
        return Contracts.result("DEFERRED", code, {stage = stage or "RUN", retryAt = runtime:now() + safeDelay})
    end
    -- Only an explicit server cooldown rejection is transient. Timeouts and
    -- unknown rejections must retain the original fail-closed behavior.
    local function isTravelCooldown(reason)
        return type(reason) == "string" and reason:lower():find("cooldown", 1, true) ~= nil
    end
    -- Never assume an injected world service exposes :observe(). A genuine
    -- home verification needs BOTH the native CurrentWorld attribute and a
    -- geometric world witness. For worlds other than 1/15 the Roblox location
    -- observer generally returns region UNKNOWN; WorldZoneBounds supplies the
    -- independent location witness instead of a misleading worldId shortcut.
    local warnedWorldObserver = false
    local function observedPosition()
        local service = services.world
        if service and type(service.observe) == "function" then
            local ok, location = pcall(service.observe, service)
            if ok and type(location) == "table" then return location end
        end
        if not warnedWorldObserver then
            warnedWorldObserver = true
            print("[V6 TOTEM] WORLD_OBSERVER_FALLBACK", "worldObserve", tostring(service and type(service.observe)))
        end
        local platform = services.roblox
        if platform and type(platform.observeLocation) == "function" then
            local ok, location = pcall(platform.observeLocation, platform, profile, runtime:now())
            if ok and type(location) == "table" then return location end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function verifiedHome(home)
        if not Contracts.isHomeWorld(home) then return false end
        local player = services.roblox:player()
        if not player or player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld") ~= home then return false end
        local location = observedPosition()
        if not location then return false end
        if location.worldId == home then return true end
        local ok, matches = pcall(LocationEvidence.matchesWorld, services.roblox, location, home)
        return ok and matches == true
    end
    local function travelRetryDelay()
        return math.max(6, tonumber(profile.totem.travelCooldownRetry) or 12)
    end
    local function hold(code, stopFeature, message)
        writer:hold(code)
        return Contracts.result("HELD", code, {stage = "HELD", stopFeature = stopFeature == true,
            message = message, evidence = {transaction = snapshot().transaction, lastStatus = snapshot().lastStatus}})
    end
    local function readStatus()
        local current = window()
        if not current then return nil end
        local function parse(label)
            if not label or not label:IsA("TextLabel") then return nil end
            local record = services.gui:readText(label, {replicated = true, screenName = "SacrificeGui"})
            local text = record and record.value or ""
            if text:find("OFFERING OPEN", 1, true) then return "OFFERING OPEN" end
            if text:find("PILLAR DORMANT", 1, true) then return "PILLAR DORMANT" end
        end
        local status = parse(services.gui:path(current, profile.totem.titlePath))
        if status then return status end
        local subtree = current:FindFirstChild("Status")
        if subtree then
            for _, label in ipairs(subtree:GetDescendants()) do
                status = parse(label)
                if status then return status end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function tenSelected()
        local current, full, cost = window(), false, false
        if not current then return false end
        for _, label in ipairs(current:GetDescendants()) do
            if label:IsA("TextLabel") then
                local text = compact(label.Text)
                if text:find("10/10", 1, true) and text:find("full", 1, true) then full = true end
                if text:find("10aircraft", 1, true) and text:find("destroyed", 1, true) then cost = true end
            end
        end
        return full and cost
    end
    -- The confirmation frame may be nested or reparented within SacrificeGui.
    -- All candidates must belong to the same screen, and Proceed must be an
    -- active, visible GUI button accompanied by an explicit 10-aircraft warning.
    -- Never treat a mere disappearance of the window as proof of an offering.
    local function overlayCandidates()
        local current = window()
        if not current then return {} end
        local results, seen = {}, {}
        local function add(candidate, direct)
            if candidate and (direct or candidate.Name == "ConfirmOverlay") and not seen[candidate] then
                seen[candidate] = true
                results[#results + 1] = candidate
            end
        end
        add(current:FindFirstChild("ConfirmOverlay"), true)
        local function scan(root)
            if not root then return end
            for _, candidate in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do add(candidate) end
        end
        scan(current)
        local screen = type(services.gui.screen) == "function" and services.gui:screen(current) or nil
        if screen and screen ~= current then scan(screen) end
        return results
    end
    local function overlayWarningMatches(text)
        local value = compact(text)
        if value:find("offer10aircraft", 1, true) then return true end
        local amount = value:find("10", 1, true) ~= nil
        local aircraft = value:find("aircraft", 1, true) or value:find("planes", 1, true)
        local action = value:find("offer", 1, true) or value:find("sacrif", 1, true)
            or value:find("destroy", 1, true)
        return amount and aircraft and action and true or false
    end
    local function overlayReady()
        if not tenSelected() then return nil end
        for _, overlay in ipairs(overlayCandidates()) do
            if services.gui:visible(overlay) then
                local proceed = overlay:FindFirstChild("Proceed", true)
                if proceed and proceed:IsA("GuiButton") and proceed.Active and services.gui:visible(proceed) then
                    for _, label in ipairs(overlay:GetDescendants()) do
                        if (label:IsA("TextLabel") or label:IsA("TextButton")) and overlayWarningMatches(label.Text) then
                            return proceed
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function controls()
        local current = window()
        local equip = services.gui:find(profile.paths.equipBest)
        local fill = services.gui:path(current, profile.totem.fillPath)
        local offer = services.gui:path(current, profile.totem.actionPath)
        if equip and equip:IsA("GuiButton") and fill and fill:IsA("GuiButton") and offer and offer:IsA("GuiButton") then
            return {equip = equip, fill = fill, offer = offer}
        end
    end
    local function stableStatus(ctx, expected)
        if not ctx:wait(profile.totem.stableDelay) then return nil end
        local previous, samples = nil, 0
        return ctx:await(function()
            if not same(expected) or not opened() then return nil end
            local value = readStatus()
            if value and value == previous then samples = samples + 1 else previous, samples = value, 1 end
            if value and samples >= profile.totem.stableSamples then return value end
        end, profile.totem.stableTimeout)
    end
    local function releaseMovement()
        if lease then
            local current = lease
            lease, leaseContext = nil, nil
            local released, code = services.movement:release(current)
            assert(released, code or "Movement cleanup failed")
        end
    end
    local function openTotem(ctx)
        if opened() then return true end
        local code
        lease, code = services.movement:acquire(ctx)
        if not lease then return false, code end
        leaseContext = ctx
        local anchor = services.roblox:landmark(profile.landmarks.world15TotemSafe)
        local initial = services.roblox:character()
        if not initial.ready then return false, "TOTEM_CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE" end
        -- One ownership-scoped relocation to the old tested landing point;
        -- no WorldNav GUI dependency or repeating client movement loop.
        local relocated, relocateCode = services.movement:relocate(ctx, lease, anchor, initial.root)
        if not relocated then return false, "TOTEM_DIRECT_RELOCATE_" .. tostring(relocateCode) end
        local positioned = ctx:await(function()
            if not active(ctx) then return nil end
            local current = services.roblox:character()
            if current.character ~= initial.character or current.root ~= initial.root then return nil end
            if current.position and services.roblox:distance(current.position, anchor) <= 8 then return true end
        end, 4)
        if not active(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        if not positioned then return false, "TOTEM_DIRECT_POSITION_UNVERIFIED" end
        local visible = ctx:await(opened, profile.totem.openTimeout)
        if not active(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        if not visible then return false, "TOTEM_UI_NOT_OPEN" end
        services.movement:stop(ctx, lease)
        return true
    end
    -- The native Proceed can close SacrificeGui before its title becomes
    -- PILLAR DORMANT. Verify through a fresh server response too; never
    -- re-send Proceed as a fallback or infer success from a closed window.
    local function newProceedProof(ctx, attemptEpoch, recovery)
        local ok, remote = pcall(function()
            local folder = services.roblox:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
            return folder and folder:FindFirstChild("PillarSacrifice")
        end)
        if not ok or not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
            return nil, "TOTEM_PROOF_REMOTE_UNAVAILABLE"
        end
        local witnessed, rejected, lastQueryAt, awaitingState = false, nil, -math.huge, false
        local firstAvailableAt, lastAvailableAt, availableSamples, availableReset = nil, nil, 0, nil
        local lastState, stateSamples = nil, 0
        local function validCooldown(state)
            return type(state) == "table" and state.Available == false
                and state.WorldUnlocked ~= false
                and tonumber(state.NextResetAt) ~= nil
                and tonumber(state.NextResetAt) > attemptEpoch
        end
        local linked, connection = pcall(function()
            return remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(packet)
                if type(packet) ~= "table" then return end
                -- Only accept a fresh Result while the current Proceed is armed.
                if not recovery and packet.Action == "Result" then
                    if packet.Success == true then
                        witnessed = "TOTEM_NATIVE_RESULT_SUCCESS"
                    elseif packet.Success == false then
                        rejected = "TOTEM_NATIVE_RESULT_REJECTED"
                    end
                elseif packet.Action == "State" and awaitingState then
                    awaitingState = false
                    lastState, stateSamples = packet, stateSamples + 1
                    if validCooldown(packet) then
                        witnessed = "TOTEM_SERVER_COOLDOWN_AFTER_PROCEED"
                        availableSamples, availableReset = 0, nil
                    elseif packet.Available == true and packet.WorldUnlocked == true
                        and tonumber(packet.NextResetAt) and tonumber(packet.NextResetAt) > runtime:epoch() then
                        local reset = tonumber(packet.NextResetAt)
                        local now = runtime:now()
                        if availableReset ~= reset then
                            firstAvailableAt, availableSamples, availableReset = now, 0, reset
                        end
                        availableSamples, lastAvailableAt = availableSamples + 1, now
                    else
                        firstAvailableAt, availableSamples, availableReset = nil, 0, nil
                    end
                end
            end)
        end)
        if not linked or not connection then return nil, "TOTEM_PROOF_LISTENER_UNAVAILABLE" end
        ctx:deferCleanup(function() pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end) end)
        local observer = {}
        function observer:check()
            if witnessed then return witnessed end
            if rejected then return nil end
            local now = runtime:now()
            if now - lastQueryAt >= 2 then
                lastQueryAt, awaitingState = now, true
                local sent = pcall(function() remote:FireServer({Action = "Query"}) end)
                if not sent then awaitingState = false end
            end
            return witnessed
        end
        function observer:rejected() return rejected end
        function observer:availableEvidence()
            -- A fresh native AVAILABLE is a *negative* witness, not proof the
            -- old Proceed never reached the server. Require two independently
            -- queried States separated in time and before the same reset.
            if witnessed or availableSamples < 2 or not firstAvailableAt or not lastAvailableAt
                or lastAvailableAt - firstAvailableAt < 1.5
                or not availableReset or availableReset <= runtime:epoch() then return nil end
            return {available = true, resetAt = availableReset, observedAt = runtime:epoch(),
                samples = availableSamples}
        end
        function observer:diagnostics()
            return {stateSamples=stateSamples, availableSamples=availableSamples,
                lastAvailable=lastState and tostring(lastState.Available) or "nil",
                nextResetAt=lastState and tostring(lastState.NextResetAt) or "nil",
                resultRejected=tostring(rejected), success=tostring(witnessed)}
        end
        return observer
    end

    -- Select ONE Proceed signal, never fire a second signal when server proof
    -- remains uncertain. GUI frameworks may bind MouseButton1Click rather than
    -- Activated. Only change from the old Activated default with positive
    -- connection evidence for Click and zero connections for Activated.
    local function proceedEvent(button)
        local inspect = services.roblox:capability("getConnections")
        local activatedCount, clickCount = nil, nil
        if type(inspect) == "function" then
            local function count(signal)
                local ok, listeners = pcall(inspect, signal)
                if not ok or type(listeners) ~= "table" then return nil end
                local total = 0
                for _, conn in pairs(listeners) do
                    if type(conn) == "table" or type(conn) == "userdata" then
                        local enabledOk, enabled = pcall(function() return conn.Enabled end)
                        if not enabledOk or enabled ~= false then total = total + 1 end
                    end
                end
                return total
            end
            activatedCount, clickCount = count(button.Activated), count(button.MouseButton1Click)
        end
        local event = activatedCount == 0 and clickCount and clickCount > 0
            and "MouseButton1Click" or "Activated"
        print("[V6 TOTEM] PROCEED_EVENT_SELECTED", event,
            "activatedConnections", tostring(activatedCount),
            "clickConnections", tostring(clickCount), "singleDispatch", "true")
        return event
    end
    local function dispatch(ctx, target, verify, timeout, expected, event)
        return services.input:dispatch(ctx, {
            kind = "GUI", target = target, mode = "raw", event = event or "Activated",
            verify = verify, timeout = timeout,
            valid = expected and function() return same(expected), "TOTEM_WINDOW_CHANGED" end or nil,
        })
    end
    -- Return-only observation. A hidden Window does not prove that the
    -- outer CloseButton or a reparented confirmation has been dismissed.
    local function returnGuiState()
        if not services.roblox:playerGui() then return "UNKNOWN" end
        local screen = services.gui:find({"SacrificeGui"})
        if not screen or not services.gui:visible(screen) then return "CLOSED" end
        local close = services.gui:find(profile.paths.totemClose)
        if services.gui:visible(window()) or services.gui:visible(close)
            or services.gui:visible(services.gui:find({"SacrificeGui", "Root", "Board"})) then
            return "OPEN"
        end
        for _, node in ipairs(screen:GetDescendants()) do
            if node.Name == "ConfirmOverlay" and services.gui:visible(node) then return "OPEN" end
        end
        return "CLOSED"
    end
    local function returnGuiClosed() return returnGuiState() == "CLOSED" end
    local function stableReturnClosed(ctx)
        if not active(ctx) or not returnGuiClosed() then return false end
        if not ctx:wait(0.35) then return false end
        return active(ctx) and returnGuiClosed()
    end
    local function closeReturnGui(ctx)
        if stableReturnClosed(ctx) then return true end
        -- Only reversible close/cancel actions; no Offer or Proceed dispatch.
        local screen = services.gui:find({"SacrificeGui"})
        if not screen or not services.gui:visible(screen) then return false, "TOTEM_CLOSE_STATE_UNVERIFIED" end
        local function dismiss(resolve, verify, timeout, allowMouse)
            for _, event in ipairs({"Activated", "MouseButton1Click"}) do
                if not active(ctx) then return false end
                if verify() then return true end
                local button = resolve()
                if button and button:IsA("GuiButton") and services.gui:visible(button) then
                    local result = dispatch(ctx, button, verify, timeout, nil, event)
                    print("[V6 TOTEM] DELTA_DISMISS", button.Name, event, tostring(result.code), returnGuiState())
                    if verify() then return true end
                end
            end
            local button = resolve()
            if allowMouse and active(ctx) and button and services.gui:visible(button)
                and type(services.roblox:capability("mouseMove")) == "function"
                and type(services.roblox:capability("mouseButton")) == "function" then
                local result = services.input:dispatch(ctx, {kind="MOUSE", target=button, purpose="CLOSE",
                    verify=verify, timeout=profile.totem.closeMouseTimeout})
                print("[V6 TOTEM] DELTA_DISMISS_MOUSE", tostring(result.code))
            end
            return active(ctx) and verify()
        end
        for _, node in ipairs(screen:GetDescendants()) do
            if node.Name == "ConfirmOverlay" and services.gui:visible(node) then
                local ok = dismiss(function() return node:FindFirstChild("Cancel", true) or node:FindFirstChild("Back", true) end,
                    function() return not services.gui:visible(node) end, 3, false)
                if not ok then return false, "TOTEM_CLOSE_CONFIRMATION_UNVERIFIED" end
            end
        end
        if stableReturnClosed(ctx) then return true end
        dismiss(function() return services.gui:find(profile.paths.totemClose) end,
            returnGuiClosed, profile.totem.closeEventTimeout, true)
        if stableReturnClosed(ctx) then return true end
        -- A manual close during this grace window is also accepted. The next
        -- owned recovery will check again without dispatching another offering.
        ctx:await(returnGuiClosed, 3)
        if stableReturnClosed(ctx) then return true end
        return false, "TOTEM_CLOSE_UNVERIFIED"
    end
    local function retryVerifiedReturn(ctx, code, detail)
        if not active(ctx) then return cancelled("RETURN") end
        -- Keep the irreversible proof intact; don't disable the feature.
        -- The existing scheduler's owned postProceedReturnRescue is selected
        -- before normal jobs, even when the Totem toggle is off.
        writer:setReturnPending(true)
        writer:scheduleCheck(runtime:now() + 12)
        print("[V6 TOTEM] DELTA_RETURN_RETRY", code, tostring(detail), returnGuiState())
        return hold(code, false, detail)
    end
    local function finishReturn(ctx)
        local current = snapshot()
        local transaction = current.transaction
        if not transaction or not transaction.safeToClose or not Contracts.isHomeWorld(transaction.homeWorld)
            or current.proceedPending or transaction.phase == "COMPLETE" or transaction.phase == "ABANDONED"
            or not ((transaction.proceedAttempted and transaction.offeringVerified)
                or (transaction.dormantOnly and not transaction.proceedAttempted)) then
            return hold("TOTEM_RETURN_CHECKPOINT_MISSING", true)
        end
        writer:setReturnPending(true)
        -- Only after durable proof, permit stale title cleanup. The dormant-only
        -- path still requires the observed dormant status when the Window is open.
        if opened() and not transaction.offeringVerified and readStatus() ~= "PILLAR DORMANT" then
            return retryVerifiedReturn(ctx, "TOTEM_CLOSE_STATUS_UNVERIFIED")
        end
        local closed, closeCode = closeReturnGui(ctx)
        if not active(ctx) then return cancelled("CLOSE_RETURN") end
        if not closed then return retryVerifiedReturn(ctx, closeCode or "TOTEM_CLOSE_UNVERIFIED") end
        writer:setTransactionStage("RETURN")
        releaseMovement()
        -- Recheck after release: an animation or a replacement GUI could reopen.
        if not stableReturnClosed(ctx) then return retryVerifiedReturn(ctx, "TOTEM_CLOSE_REOPENED") end
        local returned
        if verifiedHome(transaction.homeWorld) then
            returned = {ok = true, code = "TOTEM_ALREADY_HOME_VERIFIED"}
        else
            returned = services.world:returnHome({homeWorld = transaction.homeWorld}, ctx)
            if not active(ctx) then return cancelled("RETURN") end
            print("[V6 TOTEM] DELTA_RETURN_RESULT", tostring(returned and returned.code), "world",
                tostring(services.roblox:player() and services.roblox:player():GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")))
            -- A late arrival is checked via the original strict home witness;
            -- never infer arrival merely from the travel return value.
            if not (returned and returned.ok) and not verifiedHome(transaction.homeWorld) then
                return retryVerifiedReturn(ctx, "TOTEM_RETURN_UNVERIFIED", tostring(returned and returned.code))
            end
        end
        if not verifiedHome(transaction.homeWorld) then
            return retryVerifiedReturn(ctx, "TOTEM_RETURN_HOME_UNVERIFIED", tostring(returned and returned.code))
        end
        if not stableReturnClosed(ctx) or not verifiedHome(transaction.homeWorld) then
            return retryVerifiedReturn(ctx, "TOTEM_RETURN_FINAL_STATE_UNVERIFIED")
        end
        -- WorldService can clear the pending bit earlier; only finalize once
        -- both the GUI and independent world evidence are verified here.
        writer:setReturnPending(false)
        writer:completeTransaction()
        local retryAt = nextCheckAt()
        if transaction.dormantOnly then
            return Contracts.result("DEFERRED", "TOTEM_DORMANT", {stage = "COMPLETE", retryAt = retryAt})
        end
        return Contracts.result("COMPLETED", "TOTEM_OFFERING_VERIFIED", {stage = "COMPLETE", evidence = returned, retryAt = retryAt})
    end
    -- Reversible failure path: do not repeat Offer or click Proceed. Cancel
    -- a visible confirmation, close the window, verify home, THEN release the
    -- pre-Proceed transaction and impose a bounded retry deadline.
    local function preProceedAbort(ctx, reason)
        local tx = snapshot().transaction
        if not tx or not Contracts.isHomeWorld(tx.homeWorld)
            or tx.proceedAttempted or tx.offeringVerified or tx.safeToClose
            or snapshot().proceedPending then
            return hold("TOTEM_ABORT_UNSAFE_CHECKPOINT", true)
        end
        local armed, armCode = writer:armPreProceedRecovery()
        if not armed then return hold("TOTEM_ABORT_" .. tostring(armCode), true) end
        local function unable(code)
            writer:scheduleCheck(runtime:now() + 20)
            return hold(code, false)
        end
        local current = window()
        if opened() then
            for _, overlay in ipairs(overlayCandidates()) do
                if services.gui:visible(overlay) then
                    local cancel = overlay:FindFirstChild("Cancel", true)
                        or overlay:FindFirstChild("Back", true)
                    if not cancel or not cancel:IsA("GuiButton") or not services.gui:visible(cancel)
                        or not cancel.Active then return unable("TOTEM_ABORT_CANCEL_UNAVAILABLE") end
                    local result = dispatch(ctx, cancel,
                        function() return not services.gui:visible(overlay) end, 3)
                    if not active(ctx) then return cancelled("ABORTING") end
                    if not result.ok or services.gui:visible(overlay) then
                        return unable("TOTEM_ABORT_CANCEL_UNVERIFIED")
                    end
                end
            end
            local close = services.gui:find(profile.paths.totemClose)
            if not close or not close:IsA("GuiButton") or not services.gui:visible(close) then
                return unable("TOTEM_ABORT_CLOSE_UNAVAILABLE")
            end
            local result = dispatch(ctx, close, function() return not opened() end, 3)
            if not active(ctx) then return cancelled("ABORTING") end
            if not result.ok or opened() then return unable("TOTEM_ABORT_CLOSE_UNVERIFIED") end
        end
        -- If the window vanished without proof its ScreenGui closed, never
        -- assume the late confirmation has disappeared.
        local screen = services.gui:find({"SacrificeGui"})
        if screen and services.gui:visible(screen) then
            for _, descendant in ipairs(screen:GetDescendants()) do
                if descendant.Name == "ConfirmOverlay" and services.gui:visible(descendant) then
                    return unable("TOTEM_ABORT_LATE_OVERLAY_VISIBLE")
                end
            end
        end
        releaseMovement()
        local homeVerified = verifiedHome(tx.homeWorld)
        if not homeVerified then
            local returned = services.world:returnHome({homeWorld = tx.homeWorld}, ctx)
            if not active(ctx) then return cancelled("ABORT_RETURN") end
            homeVerified = returned.ok and verifiedHome(tx.homeWorld)
            if not homeVerified then return unable("TOTEM_ABORT_RETURN_UNVERIFIED") end
        end
        local retryAt = runtime:now() + math.max(30, profile.totem.retry)
        -- A previous interrupted RETURN may leave a saved pending bit.
        -- Reconcile that bit only after observing the original world again.
        if snapshot().returnPending then writer:setReturnPending(false) end
        local released = writer:abandonBeforeProceed(retryAt)
        if not released then return unable("TOTEM_ABORT_RELEASE_UNVERIFIED") end
        print("[V6 HELD RECOVERY] TOTEM_PREPROCEED_ABORTED", tostring(reason),
            "home", tostring(tx.homeWorld), "retryScheduled", tostring(retryAt))
        return Contracts.result("DEFERRED", "TOTEM_PREPROCEED_ABORTED", {
            stage = "ABORTED", retryAt = retryAt, evidence = {reason = reason, homeVerified = true},
        })
    end
    -- Isolate an ambiguous irreversible Proceed instead of erasing its
    -- checkpoint. Only a verified native State permits a non-repeating
    -- Cancel/Close/Return, and only verified Home releases unrelated jobs.
    local function quarantineProceed(ctx)
        local tx = snapshot().transaction
        if not tx or not tx.proceedAttempted or not snapshot().proceedPending
            or (tx.quarantine ~= "PREPARED" and tx.quarantine ~= "RETURN_AUTHORIZED") then
            return hold("TOTEM_QUARANTINE_CHECKPOINT_UNSAFE", true)
        end
        local proof, proofCode = newProceedProof(ctx, tx.startedAt or runtime:epoch(), true)
        if not proof then return hold(proofCode, true) end
        local evidence = ctx:await(function()
            local success = proof:check()
            if success then return {success=success} end
            return proof:availableEvidence()
        end, profile.totem.proceedRecoveryTimeout or 12)
        if not active(ctx) then return cancelled("PROCEED_QUARANTINE") end
        if evidence and evidence.success then
            print("[V6 TOTEM] QUARANTINE_LATE_SUCCESS", evidence.success)
            writer:observe("PILLAR DORMANT", runtime:epoch())
            writer:verifyOffering(runtime:epoch(), runtime:now())
            return finishReturn(ctx)
        end
        if not evidence or not evidence.available then
            print("[V6 TOTEM] QUARANTINE_NATIVE_UNVERIFIED", proof:diagnostics().lastAvailable)
            writer:scheduleCheck(runtime:now() + 20)
            return hold("TOTEM_PROCEED_UNVERIFIED", true)
        end
        local ok, code = writer:authorizeProceedQuarantineReturn(evidence.resetAt, evidence.observedAt)
        if not ok then return hold(code, true) end
        if opened() then
            for _, overlay in ipairs(overlayCandidates()) do
                if services.gui:visible(overlay) then
                    local cancel = overlay:FindFirstChild("Cancel", true)
                        or overlay:FindFirstChild("Back", true)
                    if not cancel or not cancel:IsA("GuiButton") or not cancel.Active
                        or not services.gui:visible(cancel) then
                        writer:scheduleCheck(runtime:now() + 20)
                        return hold("TOTEM_QUARANTINE_CANCEL_UNAVAILABLE", true)
                    end
                    local cancelledInput = dispatch(ctx, cancel,
                        function() return not services.gui:visible(overlay) end, 3)
                    if not active(ctx) then return cancelled("QUARANTINE_CLOSE") end
                    if not cancelledInput.ok or services.gui:visible(overlay) then
                        writer:scheduleCheck(runtime:now() + 20)
                        return hold("TOTEM_QUARANTINE_CANCEL_UNVERIFIED", true)
                    end
                end
            end
            local close = services.gui:find(profile.paths.totemClose)
            if not close or not close:IsA("GuiButton") or not services.gui:visible(close) then
                writer:scheduleCheck(runtime:now() + 20)
                return hold("TOTEM_QUARANTINE_CLOSE_UNAVAILABLE", true)
            end
            local closed = dispatch(ctx, close, function() return not opened() end, 3)
            if not active(ctx) then return cancelled("QUARANTINE_CLOSE") end
            if not closed.ok or opened() then
                writer:scheduleCheck(runtime:now() + 20)
                return hold("TOTEM_QUARANTINE_CLOSE_UNVERIFIED", true)
            end
        end
        local screen = services.gui:find({"SacrificeGui"})
        if screen and services.gui:visible(screen) then
            for _, descendant in ipairs(screen:GetDescendants()) do
                if descendant.Name == "ConfirmOverlay" and services.gui:visible(descendant) then
                    writer:scheduleCheck(runtime:now() + 20)
                    return hold("TOTEM_QUARANTINE_OVERLAY_STILL_VISIBLE", true)
                end
            end
        end
        releaseMovement()
        if not verifiedHome(tx.homeWorld) then
            local returned = services.world:returnHome({homeWorld=tx.homeWorld}, ctx)
            if not active(ctx) then return cancelled("QUARANTINE_RETURN") end
            if not returned.ok then
                writer:scheduleCheck(runtime:now() + 20)
                return hold("TOTEM_QUARANTINE_RETURN_UNVERIFIED", true)
            end
        end
        if not verifiedHome(tx.homeWorld) then
            writer:scheduleCheck(runtime:now() + 20)
            return hold("TOTEM_QUARANTINE_HOME_UNVERIFIED", true)
        end
        local completed, reason = writer:completeProceedQuarantine(tx.homeWorld)
        if not completed then return hold(reason, true) end
        print("[V6 TOTEM] PROCEED_QUARANTINED", "home", tostring(tx.homeWorld),
            "available", tostring(evidence.available), "resetAt", tostring(evidence.resetAt),
            "noRepeat", "true")
        return deferred("TOTEM_PROCEED_QUARANTINED", "PROCEED_QUARANTINED", profile.totem.retry)
    end
    local function recover(ctx)
        assert(ctx.readOnly, "Recovery requires a read-only context")
        local current = snapshot()
        local transaction = current.transaction
        if not current.proceedPending and not current.returnPending and not current.manualHold
            and not env.state:snapshot().holds.TOTEM then return deferred("TOTEM_NO_RECOVERY", "RECOVER") end
        if current.proceedPending then
            -- Read-only reconciliation for a Proceed already sent in a prior job.
            -- A closed GUI alone cannot prove anything, but server cooldown
            -- after the recorded attempt can corroborate successful offering.
            if not transaction or not transaction.proceedAttempted or not transaction.startedAt then
                return hold("TOTEM_PROCEED_UNVERIFIED", true)
            end
            local proof, proofCode = newProceedProof(ctx, transaction.startedAt, true)
            if not proof then return hold(proofCode, true) end
            local confirmed = ctx:await(function() return proof:check() end, 10)
            if not active(ctx) then return cancelled("RECOVER") end
            if not confirmed then
                local available = proof:availableEvidence()
                local d = proof:diagnostics()
                print("[V6 TOTEM] PROCEED_RECONCILE", "available", d.lastAvailable,
                    "samples", tostring(d.availableSamples), "nextResetAt", d.nextResetAt,
                    "attemptMode", tostring(transaction.proceedMode or "LEGACY_UNKNOWN"))
                if available then
                    local armed, reason = writer:armProceedQuarantine(available.resetAt, available.observedAt)
                    if armed then
                        print("[V6 TOTEM] QUARANTINE_ARMED", "resetAt", tostring(available.resetAt))
                        return deferred("TOTEM_QUARANTINE_READY", "RECOVER", 0)
                    end
                    print("[V6 TOTEM] QUARANTINE_REFUSED", tostring(reason))
                end
                return hold("TOTEM_PROCEED_UNVERIFIED", true)
            end
            print("[V6 TOTEM] PROCEED_RECOVERED", tostring(confirmed))
            writer:observe("PILLAR DORMANT", runtime:epoch())
            writer:verifyOffering(runtime:epoch(), runtime:now())
            return deferred("TOTEM_RECOVERY_VERIFIED", "RECOVER", 0)
        end
        if current.returnPending and transaction and transaction.safeToClose then
            if returnGuiClosed() or readStatus() == "PILLAR DORMANT" or transaction.offeringVerified then
                writer:reconcileReturn()
                return deferred("TOTEM_RETURN_READY", "RECOVER", 0)
            end
            return hold("TOTEM_CLOSE_STATUS_UNVERIFIED", true)
        end
        local tx = snapshot().transaction
        if not opened() and tx and not tx.proceedAttempted and not snapshot().returnPending
            and verifiedHome(tx.homeWorld)
            and writer:abandonBeforeProceed(runtime:now() + profile.totem.retry) then
            return deferred("TOTEM_PREPROCEED_HOME_RECONCILED", "RECOVER")
        end
        return hold("TOTEM_INSPECTION_REQUIRED")
    end
    -- Rescue for a legacy travel rejection, before a transaction was ever
    -- opened. No offering, GUI interaction, or travel is performed here.
    local function recoverPretravelHold(ctx)
        local t = snapshot()
        local home = env.state:snapshot().config.homeWorld
        local tx = t.transaction
        local pretravelException = t.debugReason == "TOTEM_EXCEPTION" and tx == nil
        if not (t.debugReason == "TOTEM_TRAVEL_DIRECT_WORLD_REJECTED" or pretravelException)
            or opened() or not verifiedHome(home) then
            return Contracts.result("HELD", "TOTEM_PRETRAVEL_HOME_UNVERIFIED", {
                stage = "RECOVER", evidence = {reason = t.debugReason, home = home},
            })
        end
        if not active(ctx) then return cancelled("RECOVER") end
        local retryAt = runtime:now() + travelRetryDelay()
        local ok, why = writer:releaseTravelRejectedHold(retryAt)
        if not ok then
            return Contracts.result("HELD", "TOTEM_PRETRAVEL_RECONCILE_REFUSED", {
                stage = "RECOVER", message = tostring(why),
            })
        end
        local delay, gated = writer:recordTravelCooldown(travelRetryDelay(), 96, runtime:now(), runtime:epoch())
        print("[V6 TOTEM] TRAVEL_HOLD_RECOVERED", "home", tostring(home),
            "retryIn", tostring(delay), "from", tostring(t.debugReason))
        return Contracts.result("DEFERRED", "TOTEM_PRETRAVEL_HOLD_RECOVERED", {
            stage = "RECOVER", retryAt = gated,
        })
    end
    local function postRaidSettle(request)
        -- The queued return script records its *native* verified home arrival
        -- immediately before relaunching the V6 scheduler in the home place.
        -- Let the just-returned client settle without touching a server remote.
        -- This gate is only used for the matching user/world, and expires by itself.
        local ok, shared = pcall(function()
            return type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv() or _G
        end)
        local record = ok and type(shared) == "table" and shared.PlaneRNGV6PostRaidHome or nil
        if type(record) ~= "table" then return nil end
        local player = services.roblox:player()
        if not player or player.UserId ~= record.userId
            or record.homeWorld ~= request.homeWorld
            or not Contracts.isHomeWorld(record.homeWorld) then return nil end
        local age = runtime:now() - (tonumber(record.atMonotonic) or -math.huge)
        if age < 0 or age >= 8 then return nil end
        -- Require native CurrentWorld to match before allowing the later retry.
        -- The controller's standard WorldService still verifies actual travel.
        local remaining = math.max(1, 8 - age)
        print("[V6 TOTEM] POST_RAID_HOME_SETTLE", "retryIn", tostring(math.ceil(remaining)),
            "home", tostring(request.homeWorld), "raid", tostring(record.raidId),
            "world", tostring(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")))
        return deferred("TOTEM_POST_RAID_HOME_SETTLE", "WORLD_15", remaining)
    end
    local function run(ctx, request)
        if request.stage == "RECOVER" and request.postProceedReturnRescue then
            if ctx.readOnly then return hold("TOTEM_RETURN_REQUIRES_OWNED_RECOVERY", true) end
            if not writer:reconcileReturn() then return hold("TOTEM_RETURN_CHECKPOINT_MISSING", true) end
            return finishReturn(ctx)
        end
        if request.stage == "RECOVER" and request.proceedQuarantineRescue then
            if ctx.readOnly then return hold("TOTEM_QUARANTINE_REQUIRES_OWNED_RECOVERY", true) end
            return quarantineProceed(ctx)
        end
        if request.stage == "RECOVER" and request.preTravelRescue then
            return recoverPretravelHold(ctx)
        end
        if request.stage == "RECOVER" then
            if not ctx.readOnly then return preProceedAbort(ctx, "AUTO_RESCUE") end
            return recover(ctx)
        end
        if snapshot().proceedPending then return hold("TOTEM_PROCEED_UNVERIFIED", true) end
        if request.stage == "RETURN" or snapshot().returnPending then return finishReturn(ctx) end
        local previous = snapshot().transaction
        if previous and previous.phase ~= "COMPLETE" and previous.phase ~= "ABANDONED" then
            return hold("TOTEM_TRANSACTION_PENDING")
        end
        local settling = postRaidSettle(request)
        if settling then return settling end
        writer:setStage("WORLD_15")
        local travelled = services.world:travel(15, ctx)
        if not active(ctx) then return cancelled("WORLD_15") end
        if not travelled.ok then
            print("[V6 TOTEM] TRAVEL_REJECTED", "code", tostring(travelled.code),
                "serverReason", tostring(travelled.reason),
                "requestedWorld", tostring(travelled.requestedWorld))
            -- No transaction or Proceed exists at this point. A native,
            -- explicit Cooldown rejection and independently verified home
            -- location may be deferred. Never re-send travel inside one job.
            if travelled.code == "DIRECT_WORLD_REJECTED"
                and isTravelCooldown(travelled.reason) and verifiedHome(request.homeWorld) then
                writer:setStage("WAIT_WORLD_TRAVEL_COOLDOWN")
                local delay, due = writer:recordTravelCooldown(travelRetryDelay(), 96, runtime:now(), runtime:epoch())
                print("[V6 TOTEM] TRAVEL_COOLDOWN_DEFERRED", "retryIn", tostring(delay),
                    "home", tostring(request.homeWorld), "priority", "P1", "travelBlocked", "true")
                return Contracts.result("DEFERRED", "TOTEM_WORLD_TRAVEL_COOLDOWN", {
                    stage = "WORLD_15", retryAt = due,
                })
            end
            if travelled.code == "DIRECT_WORLD_REJECTED" and isTravelCooldown(travelled.reason) then
                local location = observedPosition()
                local player = services.roblox:player()
                print("[V6 TOTEM] TRAVEL_COOLDOWN_HOME_UNVERIFIED", "home", tostring(request.homeWorld),
                    "attribute", tostring(player and player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")),
                    "observedWorld", tostring(location and location.worldId),
                    "region", tostring(location and location.region))
            end
            return hold("TOTEM_TRAVEL_" .. tostring(travelled.code or "UNVERIFIED"), false,
                tostring(travelled.reason or travelled.waitCode or "UNKNOWN"))
        end
        writer:clearTravelCooldown()
        writer:setStage("APPROACH")
        local open, openCode = openTotem(ctx)
        if not active(ctx) then return cancelled("APPROACH") end
        if not open then return hold("TOTEM_APPROACH_" .. tostring(openCode or "UNVERIFIED"), false) end
        local expected = window()
        writer:setStage("INSPECT")
        local status = stableStatus(ctx, expected)
        if not active(ctx) then return cancelled("INSPECT") end
        if not status then return hold("TOTEM_STATUS_UNKNOWN") end
        writer:observe(status, runtime:epoch())
        if status == "PILLAR DORMANT" then
            assert(writer:beginTransaction(request.homeWorld, runtime:epoch(), true))
            if not ctx:wait(profile.totem.dormantDisplay) then return cancelled("CLOSE_RETURN") end
            return finishReturn(ctx)
        end
        if tenSelected() then
            -- Force Reset clears V6 state, not native selection in SacrificeGui.
            -- Never re-send Proceed under an ambiguous previous attempt.
            print("[V6 TOTEM] SELECTION_FULL_FROM_PRIOR_ATTEMPT", "action", "CLEAR_UI_MANUALLY_BEFORE_RETRY")
            return hold("TOTEM_SELECTION_ALREADY_FULL")
        end
        local available = ctx:await(controls, profile.totem.controlsTimeout)
        if not active(ctx) then return cancelled("INSPECT") end
        if not available or not same(expected) then return hold("TOTEM_CONTROLS_INCOMPLETE") end
        assert(writer:beginTransaction(request.homeWorld, runtime:epoch(), false))
        local equipped = dispatch(ctx, available.equip)
        if not active(ctx) then return cancelled("EQUIP") end
        if not equipped.ok then return preProceedAbort(ctx, "TOTEM_EQUIP_FAILED") end
        if not ctx:wait(profile.totem.equipDelay) then return cancelled("EQUIP") end
        if not same(expected) or readStatus() ~= "OFFERING OPEN" then return preProceedAbort(ctx, "TOTEM_STATUS_CHANGED_AFTER_EQUIP") end
        writer:setTransactionStage("FILL")
        available = controls()
        if not available then return preProceedAbort(ctx, "TOTEM_CONTROLS_INCOMPLETE") end
        local filled = dispatch(ctx, available.fill, function() return same(expected) and tenSelected() end, profile.totem.fillTimeout, expected)
        if not active(ctx) then return cancelled("FILL") end
        if not filled.ok then return preProceedAbort(ctx, "TOTEM_FILL_UNVERIFIED") end
        -- 10/10 can render before callbacks/animations settle. Avoid racing MAKE OFFERING.
        -- Unit fixtures set confirmDelay=0 and retain their original timing.
        local preOfferDelay = (tonumber(profile.totem.confirmDelay) or 0) > 0
            and math.max(0, tonumber(profile.totem.preOfferSettleDelay) or 0) or 0
        if preOfferDelay > 0 and not ctx:wait(preOfferDelay) then return cancelled("FILL_SETTLE") end
        if not active(ctx) then return cancelled("FILL_SETTLE") end
        if not same(expected) or not tenSelected() or readStatus() ~= "OFFERING OPEN" then
            return preProceedAbort(ctx, "TOTEM_FILL_SETTLE_CHANGED")
        end
        writer:setTransactionStage("OFFER")
        available = controls()
        if not available or not same(expected) or readStatus() ~= "OFFERING OPEN" then return preProceedAbort(ctx, "TOTEM_OFFER_NOT_READY") end
        print("[V6 TOTEM] OFFER_DISPATCHING", "selected10", tostring(tenSelected()))
        local offered = dispatch(ctx, available.offer, overlayReady, profile.totem.overlayTimeout, expected)
        if not active(ctx) then return cancelled("OFFER") end
        -- A dispatched Offer can legitimately produce its GUI asynchronously.
        -- Give the original event a short passive grace period; NEVER dispatch
        -- Offer a second time merely because a confirmation frame is late.
        if not offered.ok and offered.dispatched then
            local late = ctx:await(overlayReady, profile.totem.overlayGraceTimeout or 4)
            if not active(ctx) then return cancelled("OFFER") end
            if late then offered = {ok = true, verified = true, evidence = "LATE_OVERLAY"} end
        end
        if not offered.ok then
            local candidates = overlayCandidates()
            print("[V6 TOTEM] OVERLAY_UNVERIFIED", "inputCode", tostring(offered.code),
                "dispatched", tostring(offered.dispatched), "candidates", tostring(#candidates),
                "selected10", tostring(tenSelected()), "windowOpen", tostring(opened()))
            return preProceedAbort(ctx, "TOTEM_OVERLAY_UNVERIFIED")
        end
        print("[V6 TOTEM] OFFER_OVERLAY_VERIFIED", "source", tostring(offered.evidence or offered.code))
        if not ctx:wait(profile.totem.confirmDelay) then return cancelled("OFFER") end
        if not active(ctx) then return cancelled("OFFER") end
        local proceed = overlayReady()
        local stableSamples = 1
        if (tonumber(profile.totem.confirmDelay) or 0) > 0 then
            local required = math.max(1, tonumber(profile.totem.confirmStableSamples) or 3)
            -- Passive stable-overlay inspection; never dispatch another Offer event.
            proceed = ctx:await(function()
                if not active(ctx) or not same(expected) or readStatus() ~= "OFFERING OPEN"
                    or not tenSelected() then
                    stableSamples = 0
                    return nil
                end
                local found = overlayReady()
                if found and found == proceed then
                    stableSamples = stableSamples + 1
                else
                    stableSamples = found and 1 or 0
                end
                proceed = found
                return found and stableSamples >= required and found or nil
            end, profile.totem.confirmStableTimeout or 4)
        end
        if not active(ctx) then return cancelled("OFFER") end
        if not same(expected) or readStatus() ~= "OFFERING OPEN" or not tenSelected() or not proceed then
            return preProceedAbort(ctx, "TOTEM_FINAL_CHECK_FAILED")
        end
        print("[V6 TOTEM] CONFIRM_UI_STABLE", "samples", tostring(stableSamples),
            "selected10", tostring(tenSelected()), "proceedActive", tostring(proceed.Active))
        -- Arm a read-only server witness BEFORE the one irreversible Proceed.
        -- Keep the journaled one-attempt semantics even if the UI vanishes.
        local proof, proofCode = newProceedProof(ctx, runtime:epoch(), false)
        if not proof then return hold(proofCode, true) end
        if not writer:markProceedAttempt() then return hold("TOTEM_PROCEED_UNVERIFIED", true) end
        local inputEvent = proceedEvent(proceed)
        local confirmed = dispatch(ctx, proceed, function()
            local verified = proof:check()
            if verified then return verified end
            if same(expected) and readStatus() == "PILLAR DORMANT" then return "TOTEM_GUI_DORMANT" end
            return nil
        end, profile.totem.proceedTimeout, nil, inputEvent) -- Never send a second Proceed event on unknown proof.
        if not active(ctx) then return cancelled("PROCEED_PENDING") end
        -- GUI_NOT_INTERACTABLE / GUI_INVALID mean no signal was invoked.
        -- A GUI_SIGNAL_FAILED exception is *not* proof of non-delivery.
        if not confirmed.dispatched then
            local reverted = writer:revertUndeliveredProceed(confirmed.code)
            if reverted then
                print("[V6 TOTEM] PROCEED_NOT_SENT", tostring(confirmed.code), "safeAbort", "true")
                return preProceedAbort(ctx, "TOTEM_PROCEED_NOT_SENT")
            end
        else
            writer:markProceedDispatch(true)
        end
        if proof:rejected() then return hold("TOTEM_PROCEED_REJECTED", true) end
        if not confirmed.ok or not confirmed.verified then
            local d = proof:diagnostics()
            print("[V6 TOTEM] PROCEED_INPUT_UNVERIFIED", "dispatched", tostring(confirmed.dispatched),
                "code", tostring(confirmed.code), "nativeAvailable", d.lastAvailable,
                "availableSamples", tostring(d.availableSamples), "resetAt", d.nextResetAt,
                "inputEvent", inputEvent, "inputStage", tostring(confirmed.diagnostics and confirmed.diagnostics.stage),
                "inputMethod", tostring(confirmed.diagnostics and confirmed.diagnostics.method))
            local liveProceed = overlayReady()
            print("[V6 TOTEM] PROCEED_UI_AFTER_TIMEOUT", "overlayProceedVisible", tostring(liveProceed ~= nil),
                "selected10", tostring(tenSelected()), "offeringStatus", tostring(readStatus()),
                "windowOpen", tostring(opened()))
            local availability = proof:availableEvidence()
            if availability then
                local armed = writer:armProceedQuarantine(availability.resetAt, availability.observedAt)
                if armed then
                    print("[V6 TOTEM] QUARANTINE_ARMED", "source", "RUN")
                    -- No second Proceed: queued owned rescue must re-query native.
                    return deferred("TOTEM_QUARANTINE_READY", "RECOVER", 0)
                end
            end
            return hold("TOTEM_PROCEED_UNVERIFIED", true)
        end
        -- Persist the irreversible success BEFORE advertising it or touching
        -- cleanup/return. A later exception can only resume RETURN, never Offer.
        writer:observe("PILLAR DORMANT", runtime:epoch())
        writer:verifyOffering(runtime:epoch(), runtime:now())
        print("[V6 TOTEM] PROCEED_VERIFIED", tostring(confirmed.evidence), "checkpoint", "RETURN_PENDING")
        return finishReturn(ctx)
    end

    function controller:initialize(environment)
        assert(not env, "Totem already initialized")
        assert(environment.services, "Totem requires platform services")
        env, services, profile, runtime = environment, environment.services, environment.profile, environment.runtime
        writer = env.state:port("totem")
        assert(Contracts.isFinite(profile.totem.normalCooldownSeconds) and profile.totem.normalCooldownSeconds > 0,
            "Invalid normal Totem cooldown estimate")
        assert(Contracts.isFinite(profile.totem.retry) and profile.totem.retry > 0, "Invalid Totem check interval")
        local successAt = snapshot().lastSuccessAt
        if successAt then
            restoredSuccessMonotonic = runtime:now() - math.max(0, runtime:epoch() - successAt)
        end
    end
    function controller:run(ctx, request)
        local function detail(err)
            local value = tostring(err)
            if type(debug) == "table" and type(debug.traceback) == "function" then
                local traced, traceback = pcall(debug.traceback, value, 2)
                if traced and type(traceback) == "string" then return traceback end
            end
            return value
        end
        local ok, result = xpcall(function() return run(ctx, request) end, detail)
        if not ok then
            local current = snapshot()
            local tx = current.transaction
            print("[V6 TOTEM] EXCEPTION_DETAIL", "requestStage", tostring(request and request.stage),
                "txPhase", tostring(tx and tx.phase), "offeringVerified", tostring(tx and tx.offeringVerified),
                "proceedPending", tostring(current.proceedPending),
                "returnPending", tostring(current.returnPending), "error", tostring(result))
            -- Fail *into* the existing owned post-Proceed RETURN rescue. It
            -- never issues another Offer/Proceed. Backoff avoids a hot loop if
            -- the same platform cleanup exception repeats each cycle.
            if tx and tx.safeToClose and tx.phase ~= "COMPLETE" and tx.phase ~= "ABANDONED"
                and not current.proceedPending and Contracts.isHomeWorld(tx.homeWorld)
                and ((tx.proceedAttempted and tx.offeringVerified) or (tx.dormantOnly and not tx.proceedAttempted)) then
                writer:setReturnPending(true)
                writer:scheduleCheck(runtime:now() + 15)
                return hold("TOTEM_RETURN_EXCEPTION", false, tostring(result))
            end
            return hold("TOTEM_EXCEPTION", true, tostring(result))
        end
        return result
    end
    function controller:cancel()
        local current = snapshot()
        local transaction = current.transaction
        if current.proceedPending then writer:hold("TOTEM_PROCEED_UNVERIFIED")
        elseif transaction and transaction.phase ~= "COMPLETE" and transaction.phase ~= "ABANDONED" and not transaction.safeToClose then
            writer:hold("TOTEM_TRANSACTION_CANCELLED")
        end
    end
    function controller:cleanup(ctx)
        -- Runtime owns lease cleanup; never close a GUI, send Proceed, or return here.
        if ctx == nil or leaseContext == ctx then lease, leaseContext = nil, nil end
    end
    function controller:status()
        local current = snapshot()
        current.cooldownEstimateSeconds, current.estimatedReadyAt = cooldownEstimate(), estimatedReadyAt()
        current.cooldownSource = "MANUAL_UNVERIFIED"
        return current
    end
    function controller:cooldown() return snapshot().nextCheckAt end
    function controller:poll()
        local current = snapshot()
        local tx = current.transaction
        if tx and tx.quarantine == "ISOLATED" and not verifiedHome(tx.homeWorld) then
            -- Persisted isolation may outlive a manual teleport or respawn.
            -- Never grant cross-feature travel unless home is still verified.
            writer:revokeProceedQuarantine()
            writer:scheduleCheck(runtime:now() + 20)
            print("[V6 TOTEM] QUARANTINE_HOME_CHANGED", "safeBlock", "true")
            return
        end
        if current.manualHold and tx and not tx.proceedAttempted
            and not current.proceedPending and not current.returnPending and not opened()
            and verifiedHome(tx.homeWorld) then
            writer:abandonBeforeProceed(runtime:now() + profile.totem.retry)
        elseif not current.manualHold and not current.proceedPending and not current.returnPending
            and not env.state:snapshot().holds.TOTEM and not current.recovery and opened() then
            local tx = current.transaction
            if not tx or tx.phase == "COMPLETE" or tx.phase == "ABANDONED" then
                local status = readStatus()
                if status then
                    -- Only schedule an inspection on a visible transition; RUN still requires stable samples.
                    writer:observe(status, runtime:epoch())
                    if status == "OFFERING OPEN" and current.lastStatus ~= status then writer:scheduleCheck(runtime:now()) end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return controller
end

return TotemController
end
-- END MODULE luck.v6.TotemController

-- BEGIN MODULE main.adapters.FinalColossusCooldownEvidence
__factories["main.adapters.FinalColossusCooldownEvidence"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Read-only, native Final Colossus entry cooldown. Uses the same replicated
-- BossStartCooldowns timestamp / GetServerTimeNow contract as standalone V3.
-- This does not prove the seal is available or that a raid can start.
local Contracts = require("main.core.Contracts")
local FinalColossusCooldownEvidence = {}

function FinalColossusCooldownEvidence.inspect(player, http, world)
    if not player then return nil, "FINAL_COOLDOWN_PLAYER_UNAVAILABLE" end
    local okAttr, raw = pcall(function() return player:GetAttribute("BossStartCooldowns") end)
    if not okAttr then return nil, "FINAL_COOLDOWN_ATTRIBUTE_UNAVAILABLE" end
    -- A missing snapshot is not proof of zero cooldown: preserve the V3
    -- entry-preconditions-only fallback and let V3 perform its native checks.
    if raw == nil or raw == "" then return nil, "FINAL_COOLDOWN_SNAPSHOT_MISSING" end
    if type(raw) ~= "string" then return {unknown=true}, "FINAL_COOLDOWN_SNAPSHOT_INVALID" end
    local ok, map = pcall(function() return http:JSONDecode(raw) end)
    if not ok or type(map) ~= "table" then
        return {unknown=true}, "FINAL_COOLDOWN_SNAPSHOT_INVALID"
    end
    local expiry = map.FinalColossus
    if expiry == nil then
        -- Native snapshots may omit entries when no cooldown is registered.
        return {remaining=0, source="FinalColossusNativeCooldown.SPARSE"}
    end
    expiry = tonumber(expiry)
    if not Contracts.isFinite(expiry) or expiry < 0 then
        return {unknown=true}, "FINAL_COOLDOWN_ENTRY_INVALID"
    end
    local clockOk, serverNow = pcall(function() return world:GetServerTimeNow() end)
    if not clockOk or not Contracts.isFinite(serverNow) or serverNow < 0 then
        return {unknown=true}, "FINAL_COOLDOWN_SERVER_CLOCK_UNAVAILABLE"
    end
    return {remaining=math.max(0,expiry-serverNow), serverDeadline=expiry,
        source="LocalPlayer.BossStartCooldowns.FinalColossus"}
end

function FinalColossusCooldownEvidence.sample(query, native, failure)
    local now = query.now
    if not Contracts.isFinite(now) then return nil end
    if native and native.unknown then
        return {kind="RAID",bossId="FINALCOLOSSUS",raidId="FINALCOLOSSUS",
            difficulty=query.difficulty,state="UNKNOWN",verified=false,
            reason=failure or "FINAL_COOLDOWN_UNVERIFIED",source="BossStartCooldowns",
            observedAt=now, validUntil=now+2, nextCheckAt=now+2}
    end
    if native and native.remaining and native.remaining>0 then
        local delay=math.max(0.25,math.min(native.remaining,5))
