        return {kind="RAID",bossId="FINALCOLOSSUS",raidId="FINALCOLOSSUS",
            difficulty=query.difficulty,state="COOLDOWN",verified=true,
            reason="FINALCOLOSSUS_SERVER_COOLDOWN",source=native.source,
            observedAt=now,validUntil=now+delay,nextCheckAt=now+delay}
    end
end
return FinalColossusCooldownEvidence
end
-- END MODULE main.adapters.FinalColossusCooldownEvidence

-- BEGIN MODULE main.adapters.GuiAdapter
__factories["main.adapters.GuiAdapter"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local GuiAdapter = {}

function GuiAdapter.normalize(text)
    return tostring(text or ""):upper():gsub("<.->", ""):gsub("%s+", " ")
        :gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
end

function GuiAdapter.new(platform, runtime)
    local gui = {}
    function gui:path(root, path)
        local current = root
        for _, name in ipairs(path) do current = current and current:FindFirstChild(name) end
        return current
    end
    function gui:find(path) return self:path(platform:playerGui(), path) end
    function gui:belongs(target)
        local root = platform:playerGui()
        return target ~= nil and root ~= nil and target:IsDescendantOf(root)
    end
    function gui:screen(target)
        return target and target:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui") or nil
    end
    function gui:visible(target)
        if not self:belongs(target) then return false end
        local root, current = platform:playerGui(), target
        while current and current ~= root do
            if current:IsA("GuiObject") and not current.Visible then return false end
            if (current:IsA("ScreenGui") or current:IsA("SurfaceGui")) and not current.Enabled then return false end
            current = current.Parent
        end
        return current == root
    end
    function gui:canActivate(target, mode)
        if not self:belongs(target) or not target:IsA("GuiButton") then return false end
        if mode == "raw" then return true end -- explicit V5.7 event-only escape hatch
        if not target.Active then return false end
        if self:visible(target) then return true end
        local screen = self:screen(target)
        return mode == "boss-offscreen" and screen ~= nil and screen.Enabled
            and screen.Name == "HideoutBossCommand" and target.Visible
    end
    function gui:readText(target, policy)
        policy = policy or {}
        if not self:belongs(target) or not (target:IsA("TextLabel") or target:IsA("TextButton")) then
            return nil, "TEXT_UNAVAILABLE"
        end
        local source = "gui-visible"
        if policy.replicated then
            local screen = self:screen(target)
            if not screen or not screen.Enabled or (policy.screenName and screen.Name ~= policy.screenName) then
                return nil, "SCREEN_INACTIVE"
            end
            source = "gui-replicated"
        elseif not self:visible(target) then return nil, "GUI_HIDDEN" end
        return {
            value = GuiAdapter.normalize(target.Text), raw = target.Text,
            source = source, confidence = "VERIFIED", observedAt = runtime:now(),
        }
    end
    return gui
end

return GuiAdapter
end
-- END MODULE main.adapters.GuiAdapter

-- BEGIN MODULE main.adapters.InputDriver
__factories["main.adapters.InputDriver"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local InputDriver = {}

function InputDriver.new(platform, gui, runtime, profile, interaction)
    local driver = {}
    function driver:canActivateGui() return interaction:capabilities().gui end
    function driver:canBraceB52()
        return type(platform:capability("b52BraceTap")) == "function"
            or type(platform:capability("b52BraceKey")) == "function"
    end
    local function result(ok, code, dispatched, verified, evidence)
        return {ok = ok, code = code, dispatched = dispatched or false, verified = verified or false, evidence = evidence}
    end
    local function active(context)
        return runtime:isActive(context) and not context:isCancelled() and not context:isClosing()
    end
    local function releaseScope(context, callback)
        local attempted, cleanupError = false, nil
        local function release()
            if not attempted then
                attempted = true
                local ok, err = pcall(callback)
                if not ok then cleanupError = tostring(err) end
            end
            -- Preserve failure for Runtime's cleanup report without resending held input.
            if cleanupError then error(cleanupError, 0) end
        end
        context:deferCleanup(release)
        return release
    end
    local function promptReady(prompt)
        if not prompt or not prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") or not prompt.Enabled
            or not prompt:IsDescendantOf(platform:workspace()) then return false, "PROMPT_INACTIVE" end
        local part = prompt:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BasePart")
        local character = platform:character()
        if not part or not character.ready then return false, "CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE" end
        if platform:distance(character.position, part.Position) > prompt.MaxActivationDistance then
            return false, "PROMPT_OUT_OF_RANGE"
        end
        return true
    end
    local function verify(context, action, timeout)
        local deadline = runtime:now() + (timeout or action.timeout or 3)
        while active(context) do
            local evidence = action.verify()
            if not active(context) then return nil, "CANCELLED" end
            if evidence ~= nil and evidence ~= false then return evidence end
            if action.valid then
                local valid, code = action.valid()
                if not valid then return nil, code or "TARGET_CHANGED" end
            end
            local remaining = deadline - runtime:now()
            if remaining <= 0 then return nil, "INTERACTION_UNVERIFIED" end
            context:wait(math.min(profile.scheduler.poll, remaining))
        end
        return nil, "CANCELLED"
    end

    function driver:dispatch(context, action)
        if context and context.readOnly then return result(false, "READ_ONLY_CONTEXT") end
        if not active(context) then return result(false, "CANCELLED") end
        local dispatched, finishInput = false, nil
        local detail = {stage = "PREPARE", holdEndAttempts = 0}
        local ok, value = xpcall(function()
            local target = action.target
            if action.kind == "GUI" then
                if not gui:canActivate(target, action.mode) then return result(false, "GUI_NOT_INTERACTABLE") end
                local event = action.event or "Activated"
                if event ~= "Activated" and event ~= "MouseButton1Click" then return result(false, "INVALID_GUI_EVENT") end
                local sent = interaction:gui(target, event)
                dispatched = sent.dispatched
                detail.method = sent.method
                if not sent.ok then return result(false, sent.code, dispatched) end
            elseif action.kind == "PROMPT" then
                local ready, code = promptReady(target)
                if not ready then return result(false, code) end
                if action.directPrompt == true then
                    -- Explicit opt-in only. B21's established radar hold remains unchanged.
                    local sent = interaction:prompt(target, {
                        allowLegacyFallback = false,
                        wait = function(seconds) return context:wait(seconds) end,
                        valid = function()
                            if not active(context) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
                            local ready, code = promptReady(target)
                            if not ready then return false, code end
                            if action.holdValid then return action.holdValid() end
                            return true
                        end,
                        onSent = action.onSent,
                    })
                    dispatched = sent.dispatched
                    detail.stage, detail.method = sent.code, sent.method
                    detail.exception = sent.detail
                    if not sent.ok then return result(false, sent.code, dispatched) end
                else
                    detail.method = "LEGACY_PROMPT_HOLD"
                -- Preserve the local prompt visibility preparation from V5.7.
                pcall(function()
                    target.RequiresLineOfSight = false
                    target.Exclusivity = platform:enum("ProximityPromptExclusivity", "AlwaysShow")
                end)
                finishInput = releaseScope(context, function()
                    detail.holdEndAttempts = detail.holdEndAttempts + 1
                    target:InputHoldEnd()
                    detail.holdEndOK = true
                end)
                detail.holdDuration = math.max(target.HoldDuration, 0)
                detail.startedAt = runtime:now()
                local holdUntil = detail.startedAt + detail.holdDuration + 0.25
                detail.deadline = holdUntil
                dispatched = true
                detail.stage = "HOLD_BEGIN"
                target:InputHoldBegin()
                if action.onSent then pcall(action.onSent, "HOLD_BEGIN") end
                detail.stage = "HOLD_VALIDATION"
                if action.holdValid then
                    while active(context) and runtime:now() < holdUntil do
                        local valid, holdCode = action.holdValid()
                        if not valid then
                            finishInput()
                            return result(false, holdCode or "TARGET_CHANGED", dispatched)
                        end
                        -- Validation can yield or consume the rest of the hold budget.
                        detail.remaining = holdUntil - runtime:now()
                        if detail.remaining <= 0 then break end
                        context:wait(math.min(profile.scheduler.poll, detail.remaining))
                    end
                else
                    local remaining = holdUntil - runtime:now()
                    detail.remaining = remaining
                    if remaining > 0 then context:wait(remaining) end
                end
                detail.stage = "HOLD_END"
                finishInput()
                end
            elseif action.kind == "B52_BRACE" then
                local player = platform:player()
                local character = platform:character()
                local brace = platform:playerGui()
                brace = brace and brace:FindFirstChild("B52Brace")
                local root = brace and brace:FindFirstChild("Root")
                local title = root and root:FindFirstChild("Title")
                if context.bossId ~= "B52" or not character.ready or not brace or not brace.Enabled
                    or not title or title.Text ~= "BRACE!"
                    or player:GetAttribute("B52Participant") ~= true then
                    return result(false, "B52_BRACE_NOT_ACTIVE")
                end
                if not action.character or not action.humanoid or action.target ~= brace or action.character ~= character.character
                    or action.humanoid ~= character.humanoid then
                    return result(false, "B52_BRACE_OWNER_CHANGED")
                end
                local tap = platform:capability("b52BraceTap")
                if type(tap) == "function" then
                    detail.method, detail.stage = "B52_SPACE_TAP", "KEY_TAP"
                    dispatched = true
                    local accepted, reason = tap()
                    if accepted == false then
                        return result(false, reason or "B52_BRACE_KEY_TAP_REJECTED")
                    end
                else
                    local key = platform:capability("b52BraceKey")
                    if type(key) ~= "function" then return result(false, "B52_HOST_BRACE_KEY_UNAVAILABLE") end
                    detail.method, detail.stage = "B52_SPACE", "KEY_DOWN"
                    local releaseNeeded = true
                    finishInput = releaseScope(context, function()
                        if releaseNeeded then
                            local released, reason = key(false)
                            if released == false then error(reason or "B52_BRACE_KEY_UP_REJECTED") end
                        end
                    end)
                    dispatched = true
                    local accepted, reason = key(true)
                    if accepted == false then
                        releaseNeeded, dispatched = false, false
                        return result(false, reason or "B52_BRACE_KEY_DOWN_REJECTED")
                    end
                    context:wait(0.05)
                    finishInput()
                end
                local current = platform:character()
                if not current.ready or current.character ~= character.character
                    or current.humanoid ~= character.humanoid then
                    return result(false, "B52_BRACE_OWNER_CHANGED", dispatched)
                end
            elseif action.kind == "MOUSE" then
                if not gui:canActivate(target, "raw") or not gui:visible(target) then return result(false, "GUI_NOT_INTERACTABLE") end
                local screen = gui:screen(target)
                local permitted = action.purpose == "WORLDS" and target == gui:find(profile.paths.worldsButton)
                    or action.purpose == "CLOSE" and target.Name == "CloseButton"
                    and screen and screen.Name == "SacrificeGui"
                if not permitted then return result(false, "MOUSE_TARGET_NOT_PERMITTED") end
                local position, size = target.AbsolutePosition, target.AbsoluteSize
                if size.X <= 0 or size.Y <= 0 then return result(false, "GUI_ZERO_SIZE") end
                local move, button = platform:capability("mouseMove"), platform:capability("mouseButton")
                if not move or not button then return result(false, "CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE") end
                local x, y = math.floor(position.X + size.X / 2), math.floor(position.Y + size.Y / 2)
                dispatched = true
                move(x, y)
                context:wait(0.12)
                if not active(context) then return result(false, "CANCELLED", dispatched) end
                if not gui:canActivate(target, "raw") or not gui:visible(target) then return result(false, "TARGET_CHANGED", dispatched) end
                finishInput = releaseScope(context, function() button(x, y, false) end)
                button(x, y, true)
                context:wait(0.12)
                finishInput()
            else return result(false, "INVALID_INPUT_KIND") end
            if not active(context) then return result(false, "CANCELLED", dispatched) end
            if not action.verify then return result(true, "INPUT_DISPATCHED", dispatched) end
            detail.stage = "VERIFY"
            local evidence, code = verify(context, action)
            if not evidence and code == "INTERACTION_UNVERIFIED" and action.kind == "PROMPT" and action.allowFallback
                and detail.method == "LEGACY_PROMPT_HOLD" then
                local fallback = platform:capability("firePrompt")
                local ready = promptReady(target)
                if active(context) and ready and fallback then
                    fallback(target) -- exactly one fallback per dispatch; no driver retry loop
                    if action.onSent then pcall(action.onSent, "FALLBACK") end
                    evidence, code = verify(context, action, action.fallbackTimeout or 4)
                end
            end
            if evidence then return result(true, "INTERACTION_VERIFIED", dispatched, true, evidence) end
            return result(false, code, dispatched)
        end, function(err)
            detail.exception = tostring(err)
            detail.traceback = debug and debug.traceback and debug.traceback(tostring(err), 2) or tostring(err)
            return detail.traceback
        end)
        -- Release held input immediately on error as well as via the job cleanup scope.
        if finishInput then
            local cleaned, err = pcall(finishInput)
            if not cleaned then
                detail.cleanupException = tostring(err)
                local failed = result(false, "INPUT_CLEANUP_FAILED", dispatched, false, detail)
                failed.diagnostics = detail
                return failed
            end
        end
        if not ok then
            local failed = result(false, "INPUT_ERROR", dispatched, false, detail)
            failed.diagnostics = detail
            return failed
        end
        value.diagnostics = detail
        return value
    end
    return driver
end

return InputDriver
end
-- END MODULE main.adapters.InputDriver

-- BEGIN MODULE main.adapters.PotassiumRaidHost
__factories["main.adapters.PotassiumRaidHost"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local RaidCatalog = require("main.config.RaidCatalog")
local StandaloneRaidBridge = require("main.adapters.StandaloneRaidBridge")

local PotassiumRaidHost = {}

local function hasQueue(lookup, raidId)
    if type(lookup("queue_on_teleport")) == "function" or type(lookup("queueonteleport")) == "function" then
        return true
    end
    local syn = lookup("syn")
    if type(syn) == "table" and type(syn.queue_on_teleport) == "function" then return true end
    local fluxus = lookup("fluxus")
    return raidId == "FINALCOLOSSUS" and type(fluxus) == "table"
        and type(fluxus.queue_on_teleport) == "function"
end

function PotassiumRaidHost.bind(host, options, inspector, lookup)
    local backend = options.host or {}
    local adapter = options.raidAdapter
    if adapter == nil and options.standaloneRaidEnabled == true then
        local built = StandaloneRaidBridge.new(options.raidEvidence,
            {buildId=options.standaloneBuildId,standaloneMode=true,
                inspect=function()return inspector:inspect()end})
        adapter = built
    end
    local storage = type(options.raidStorage) == "table" and options.raidStorage or nil
    local mintToken = options.mintToken
    if mintToken == nil then
        local ok, http = pcall(function() return game:GetService("HttpService") end)
        if ok and http and type(http.GenerateGUID) == "function" then
            mintToken = function() return http:GenerateGUID(false) end
        end
    end

    local function relay(method)
        if not inspector then return nil end
        if type(backend[method]) == "function" then
            return function(...) return backend[method](backend, ...) end
        end
        if type(adapter) == "table" and type(adapter[method]) == "function" then
            return function(...) return adapter[method](adapter, ...) end
        end
    end

    local verify = relay("verifyRaidEvent")
    if verify then
        function host:verifyRaidEvent(event, record)
            local evidence = inspector:inspect()
            local atOrigin = event.type == "ORIGIN_ARRIVED" or event.type == "RETURN_VERIFIED"
                or event.type == "EXPIRED_RESOLVED"
            local expectedPlace = atOrigin and record.sourcePlaceId or record.destinationPlaceId
            if type(evidence) ~= "table" or evidence.placeId ~= expectedPlace then return nil end
            if atOrigin and (evidence.world ~= record.originalWorld or evidence.schedulerSafe ~= true
                or (inspector ~= backend and evidence.location ~= "WORLD")) then return nil end
            return verify(event, record)
        end
    end
    local subscribe = relay("subscribeRaidEvents")
    if subscribe then
        function host:subscribeRaidEvents(callback) return subscribe(callback) end
    end

    function host:raidUnavailableReason(raidId)
        if not RaidCatalog.contains(raidId) then return "UNKNOWN_RAID_ROUTE" end
        if not inspector then return "RAID_PHYSICAL_INSPECTOR_UNAVAILABLE" end
        if type(lookup("loadstring")) ~= "function" then return "RAID_RUNNER_LOADSTRING_UNAVAILABLE" end
        if not hasQueue(lookup, raidId) then return "RAID_TELEPORT_QUEUE_UNAVAILABLE" end
        if type(storage) ~= "table" or type(storage.read) ~= "function"
            or type(storage.compareAndSwap) ~= "function" then
            return options.standaloneRaidEnabled and "RAID_LOCAL_JOURNAL_UNAVAILABLE"
                or "RAID_SHARED_CAS_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE"
        end
        if type(mintToken) ~= "function" then return "HANDOFF_TOKEN_UNAVAILABLE" end
        if type(adapter) ~= "table" then return "RAID_STANDALONE_BRIDGE_UNAVAILABLE" end
        if type(adapter.supports) == "function" then
            local ok, supported, reason = pcall(adapter.supports, adapter, raidId)
            if not ok or supported ~= true then return reason or "RAID_NATIVE_LIFECYCLE_UNVERIFIED" end
        end
    end

    -- The settings file adapter is only a local read/write check. Raid stores
    -- must coordinate a compare-and-swap across the source and queued contexts.
    return adapter, storage or {}, mintToken
end

return PotassiumRaidHost
end
-- END MODULE main.adapters.PotassiumRaidHost

-- BEGIN MODULE main.adapters.ProjectBossDefinitions
__factories["main.adapters.ProjectBossDefinitions"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Local definitions. The cross-place runners are observed through LiveHost.
local function nativeReleased(platform, folderName, probeName)
    local modules = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("ClientModules")
    local folder = modules and modules:FindFirstChild(folderName)
    local script = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("Controller")
    if not script or not script:IsA("ModuleScript") then return nil end
    local loaded, controller = pcall(getfenv(0)["require"], script)
    local probe = loaded and type(controller) == "table" and controller[probeName]
    if type(probe) ~= "function" then return nil end
    local ok, value = pcall(probe)
    if not ok then return nil end
    if probeName == "Active" then
        if type(value) == "boolean" then return not value end
    elseif value == nil or type(value) == "table" then return value == nil end
end

local function trackedReturn(definition, legacyReturnLockRetry, chainPolicy)
    local create = definition.create
    function definition.create(env)
        local boss = create(env)
        boss.command.trackedWorldReturn = true
        boss.command.legacyReturnLockRetry = legacyReturnLockRetry
        boss.command.reuseVerifiedHideout = chainPolicy ~= nil
        boss.command.deferVerifiedHideoutReturn = chainPolicy ~= nil
        if chainPolicy then
            local platform = env.services.roblox
            boss.command.deferVerifiedHideoutLoss = true
            boss.command.deferredLossOnlyExitCheck = chainPolicy.lossOnly
            function boss.command:deferredExitReady(encounter)
                local loss = encounter.outcome == "LOSS"
                if not loss and chainPolicy.lossOnly then return true end
                if (loss or chainPolicy.correlatedWin) and not boss.report:verifiedDeferredOutcome(encounter) then
                    return false, nil, "BOSS_CHAIN_TERMINAL_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED"
                end
                local world = platform:workspace()
                local player = platform:player()
                local folder = chainPolicy.nativeFolder or loss and (chainPolicy.lossNativeFolder or chainPolicy.lossDebug)
                local probe = chainPolicy.session and "Session" or loss and chainPolicy.lossDebug and "Debug" or "Active"
                local released
                if folder then released = nativeReleased(platform, folder, probe)
                elseif loss and boss.report.deferredLossReleased then released = boss.report:deferredLossReleased() end
                if (folder or loss and boss.report.deferredLossReleased) and released == nil then
                    return false, nil, "BOSS_CHAIN_NATIVE_TEARDOWN_UNVERIFIED"
                end
                if player:GetAttribute("BossFilmHold") == true
                    or loss and world:GetAttribute("BossCinematicActive") == true
                    or chainPolicy.camera and world:GetAttribute(chainPolicy.camera) == true
                    or chainPolicy.cleanupAttribute and world:GetAttribute(chainPolicy.cleanupAttribute) ~= nil
                    or loss and chainPolicy.lossPlayerHold and player:GetAttribute(chainPolicy.lossPlayerHold) == true
                    or released == false then
                    return false, "BOSS_CHAIN_NATIVE_CLEANUP_PENDING"
                end
                if not loss and chainPolicy.requireNativeExit and not boss.report.entry:exited()
                    or loss and chainPolicy.lossNumberedExit and not boss.report.entry:numberedExit() then
                    return false, nil, "BOSS_CHAIN_NATIVE_EXIT_UNVERIFIED"
                end
                return true
            end
        end
        if legacyReturnLockRetry then boss.command.returnExitSettle = 1.5 end
        return boss
    end
    return definition
end

return {
    AC130 = function() return trackedReturn(require("boss.AC130.AC130").definition(), true,
        {camera = "AC130CameraOwned", lossDebug = "AC130"}) end,
    AIRRAID = function() return trackedReturn(require("boss.AirRaid.AirRaid").definition(), true,
        {camera = "AirRaidCameraOwned", requireNativeExit = true, lossDebug = "AirRaid", lossNumberedExit = true}) end,
    B17 = function() return trackedReturn(require("boss.B17.B17").definition(), true,
        {camera = "B17CameraOwned", lossDebug = "B17"}) end,
    B21_RAIDER = function() return trackedReturn(require("boss.B21.B21Raider").definition(), nil,
        {camera = "B21CameraOwned", correlatedWin = true, lossDebug = "B21"}) end,
    B29 = function() return trackedReturn(require("boss.B29.B29").definition(), true,
        {camera = "B29CameraOwned", lossDebug = "B29"}) end,
    B2SPIRIT = function() return trackedReturn(require("boss.B2Spirit.B2Spirit").definition(), true,

    B52 = function() return trackedReturn(require("boss.B52.B52").definition(), true,

    BLACKFORTRESS = function() return trackedReturn(require("boss.BlackFortress.BlackFortress").definition(), true,

    CARRIER = function() return trackedReturn(require("boss.CarrierFortress.CarrierFortress").definition(), true,

-- BEGIN MODULE main.adapters.ProjectBossEvidence
__factories["main.adapters.ProjectBossEvidence"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local Contracts = require("main.core.Contracts")
local DirectBossTravel = require("main.navigation.DirectBossTravel")
local LocationEvidence = require("main.world.LocationEvidence")
local ProjectBossEvidence = {}

-- Keys used by both BossStartCooldowns and the native Boss Command rows.
local bossKeys = {
    AC130 = "AC130", AIRRAID = "AirRaid", B17 = "B17", B21_RAIDER = "B21", B29 = "B29",
    B2SPIRIT = "B2Spirit", B52 = "B52", BLACKFORTRESS = "FortressBattle", CARRIER = "CarrierFortress",
    EKRANOPLAN = "Ekranoplan",
    F117 = "F117", FLEET = "FleetBoss", RED_BARON = "RedBaron", RQ170 = "RQ170",
    SR71 = "SR71", TU95 = "Tu95", U2 = "U2", VULCAN = "Vulcan", ZEPPELIN = "ZeppelinBoss",
}

local cooldownBoard = {"HideoutBossScreen1", "Holder", "Centre", "Page"}
local boardChip = {"Chip", "Text"}

local function cooldown(platform, player, key)
    local raw = player:GetAttribute("BossStartCooldowns")
    if raw == nil or raw == "" then return nil, "BOSS_COOLDOWN_ATTRIBUTE_MISSING" end
    if type(raw) ~= "string" then return nil, "BOSS_COOLDOWN_ATTRIBUTE_INVALID" end
    local ok, decoded = pcall(function() return platform:service("HttpService"):JSONDecode(raw) end)
    if not ok or type(decoded) ~= "table" then return nil, "BOSS_COOLDOWN_ATTRIBUTE_INVALID" end
    -- The native Boss Command client treats omitted entries in its snapshot as zero.
    -- Only a separate positive status observation can establish READY from a sparse snapshot.
    if decoded[key] == nil then return 0, nil, true end
    local expires = tonumber(decoded[key])
    if not Contracts.isFinite(expires) or expires < 0 then return nil, "BOSS_COOLDOWN_ENTRY_INVALID" end
    local clockOk, serverNow = pcall(function() return platform:workspace():GetServerTimeNow() end)
    if not clockOk or not Contracts.isFinite(serverNow) then return nil, "BOSS_SERVER_CLOCK_UNAVAILABLE" end
    return expires - serverNow
end

local function commandStatus(gui, profile, key, ownHideout)
    local rowPath = key == "B21" and profile.b21.rowPath or {"List", "Boss_" .. key}
    local source = table.concat(profile.paths.bossPage, "/") .. "/" .. table.concat(rowPath, "/")
        .. "/" .. table.concat(profile.b21.chipPath, "/")
    if type(gui.path) ~= "function" or type(gui.readText) ~= "function" then
        return nil, source, "BOSS_COMMAND_GUI_READER_UNAVAILABLE"
    end
    local page = gui:find(profile.paths.bossPage)
    local row = page and gui:path(page, rowPath)
    local label = row and gui:path(row, profile.b21.chipPath)
    local chip = label and gui:readText(label)
    if chip and chip.confidence == "VERIFIED" and chip.value ~= "" then return chip.value, source end
    if ownHideout then
        local boardRow = "Row_" .. key
        local boardSource = table.concat(cooldownBoard, "/") .. "/" .. boardRow .. "/Chip/Text"
        local board = gui:find(cooldownBoard)
        row = board and gui:path(board, {boardRow})
        label = row and gui:path(row, boardChip)
        chip = label and gui:readText(label)
        if chip and chip.confidence == "VERIFIED" and chip.value ~= "" then return chip.value, boardSource end
        source = source .. " or " .. boardSource
    end
    return nil, source, "BOSS_COMMAND_STATUS_MISSING_OR_HIDDEN"
end

function ProjectBossEvidence.new(services, profile, env, inspectOrigin)
    local platform, gui = services.roblox, services.gui
    local provider = {}
    local nextTripAt = 0
    local function hideoutLocation(now)
        if type(platform.observeLocation) ~= "function" then return nil end
        return LocationEvidence.hideout(platform, platform:observeLocation(profile, now))
    end
    local function observationOrigin(player, now)
        if type(platform.observeLocation) ~= "function" or type(platform.character) ~= "function"
            or not platform:character().ready or player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") == true
            or player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true or player:GetAttribute("B21Participant") == true
            or player:GetAttribute("B2Participant") == true or player:GetAttribute("ZeppelinParticipant") == true then return nil end
        local report = gui:find(profile.paths.bossReport)
        if report and report.Enabled == true then return nil end
        local world, location = player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"), platform:observeLocation(profile, now)
        local position, arena = location.position, profile.b21.arenaBounds
        if not position or not Contracts.isHomeWorld(world) or LocationEvidence.hideout(platform, location) then return nil end
        if position.x > arena.minX and position.x < arena.maxX and position.z > arena.minZ and position.z < arena.maxZ then return nil end
        if inspectOrigin then
            if not inspectOrigin(world) then return nil end
        elseif location.worldId and world ~= location.worldId then return nil end
        return world
    end
    function provider:observe(query)
        local function sample(state, reason, source, due)
            local deadline = query.now + (due or 1)
            return {kind = "BOSS", bossId = query.bossId, configurationRevision = query.configurationRevision,
                state = state, reason = reason, source = source, verified = state ~= "UNKNOWN",
                observedAt = query.now, validUntil = deadline, nextCheckAt = deadline}
        end
        local key = bossKeys[query.bossId]
        if not key then return sample("UNKNOWN", "BOSS_EVIDENCE_KEY_UNAVAILABLE", "ProjectBossEvidence") end
        local player = platform:player()
        if not player then return sample("UNKNOWN", "BOSS_PLAYER_UNAVAILABLE", "LocalPlayer") end
        if key == "B21" and player:GetAttribute("B21Participant") == true then
            return sample("BLOCKED", "BOSS_PREEXISTING_ENCOUNTER", "LocalPlayer.B21Participant")
        end
        if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true then
            return sample("BLOCKED", "BOSS_FIGHT_ALREADY_ACTIVE", "LocalPlayer.InBossFight")
        end
        if player.GameplayPaused == true or player:GetAttribute("BossReviveDowned") == true
            or (type(platform.character) == "function" and not platform:character().ready) then
            return sample("BLOCKED", "BOSS_RESPAWN_TRANSITION", "LocalPlayer")
        end
        local report = gui:find(profile.paths.bossReport)
        if player:GetAttribute("BossResultsOpen") == true or report and report.Enabled == true then
            return sample("BLOCKED", "BOSS_REPORT_ALREADY_OPEN", table.concat(profile.paths.bossReport, "/"))
        end
        local insideHideout = player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") == true
        local owner = tonumber(player:GetAttribute("HideoutHost"))
        if insideHideout and owner and owner ~= player.UserId then
            return sample("BLOCKED", "BOSS_COMMAND_FOREIGN_HIDEOUT", "LocalPlayer.HideoutHost")
        end
        local hideout = hideoutLocation(query.now)
        if hideout == "UNVERIFIED_HIDEOUT" then
            return sample("UNKNOWN", "BOSS_PERSONAL_HIDEOUT_UNVERIFIED", "LocalPlayer.HideoutHost + position")
        end
        local ownHideout = hideout == "PERSONAL_HIDEOUT"
        local text, chipSource, missing = commandStatus(gui, profile, key, ownHideout)
        if text == "CLOSED" or text == "NOT OPEN" or text == "OFFLINE"
            or (type(text) == "string" and text:match("^WORLD %d+$")) then
            return sample("BLOCKED", "BOSS_COMMAND_" .. (text:match("^WORLD ") and "LOCKED" or text:gsub(" ", "_")), chipSource)
        end

        local cooldownSource = "LocalPlayer.BossStartCooldowns[" .. key .. "]"
        local remaining, why, sparse = cooldown(platform, player, key)
        if remaining and remaining > 0 then
            return sample("COOLDOWN", "BOSS_REPLICATED_COOLDOWN", cooldownSource, math.min(1, remaining))
        end
        -- Both native views show bossStatus, including unlock, closure and command availability.
        if text == "READY" then
            if why then return sample("UNKNOWN", why, cooldownSource) end
            return sample("READY", "BOSS_COMMAND_READY", chipSource .. " + "
                .. (sparse and "LocalPlayer.BossStartCooldowns (sparse snapshot)" or cooldownSource))
        end
        if type(text) == "string" and text:match("^%d+:%d%d$") then
            return sample("UNKNOWN", why or "BOSS_COMMAND_COOLDOWN_CONFLICT", chipSource .. " + " .. cooldownSource)
        end
        local evidence = sample("UNKNOWN", text and text ~= "" and "BOSS_COMMAND_STATUS_UNRECOGNIZED" or missing, chipSource)
        if env and missing == "BOSS_COMMAND_STATUS_MISSING_OR_HIDDEN"
            and query.settings and query.settings.bossEnabled and query.now >= nextTripAt
            and observationOrigin(player, query.now) then evidence.needsHideout = true end
        return evidence
    end
    provider.peek = provider.observe

    if env then
        function provider:observeHideout(context, request, observe)
            local runtime, state = env.runtime, env.state
            local function result(status, code, evidence, retryAt)
                return Contracts.result(status, code, {stage = request.stage, evidence = evidence, retryAt = retryAt})
            end
            request.reportProgress("BOSS_OBSERVATION_ENTER_HIDEOUT")
            local player = platform:player()
            local origin = player and observationOrigin(player, runtime:now())
            local settings = state:settingsSnapshot()
            local selected = false
            for _, candidate in ipairs(settings.bossCandidates) do
                if candidate.id == request.probeBossId then selected = candidate.enabled; break end
            end
            local witness = observe({kind = "BOSS", bossId = request.probeBossId, now = runtime:now(), settings = settings})
            if not origin or not selected or not witness or not witness.needsHideout or not settings.bossEnabled
                or not request.resourcesAvailable() then return result("COMPLETED", "BOSS_HIDEOUT_OBSERVATION_SKIPPED") end

            nextTripAt = runtime:now() + profile.boss.setupRetry
            local before = platform:character()
            local verifiedOrigin = LocationEvidence.matchesWorld(platform,
                platform:observeLocation(profile, runtime:now()), origin)
            local travel = DirectBossTravel.new(env)
            local entered = travel:enterHideout(context)
            if context:isCancelled() then return result("CANCELLED", "BOSS_HIDEOUT_OBSERVATION_CANCELLED") end
            if not entered.ok then
                if entered.code == "DIRECT_HIDEOUT_REJECTED" or entered.code == "DIRECT_HIDEOUT_REMOTE_MISSING" then
                    nextTripAt = runtime:now() + profile.boss.setupRetry
                    return result("DEFERRED", "BOSS_HIDEOUT_OBSERVATION_RETRY", entered, nextTripAt)
                end
                return result("HELD", "BOSS_HIDEOUT_OBSERVATION_ENTRY_UNVERIFIED", entered)
            end
            request.reportProgress("BOSS_OBSERVATION_READ_COMMAND")
            local decision = context:await(function()
                if not request.resourcesAvailable() or hideoutLocation(runtime:now()) ~= "PERSONAL_HIDEOUT" then return "PAUSE" end
                local current = state:settingsSnapshot()
                if not current.bossEnabled then return "RETURN" end
                local boss = state:featureSnapshot("BOSS")
                local now, awaiting, ready = runtime:now(), false, false
                for _, candidate in ipairs(current.bossCandidates) do
                    if candidate.enabled and now >= math.max(boss.nextCheckAt, boss.candidateRetryAt[candidate.id] or 0) then
                        local sample = observe({kind = "BOSS", bossId = candidate.id, now = now, settings = current})
                        if sample and sample.state == "READY" and sample.verified then ready = true end
                        if not sample or sample.state == "UNKNOWN" then awaiting = true end
                    end
                end
                if ready then return "READY" end
                if not awaiting then return "RETURN" end
            end, profile.b21.commandStreamWait)
            if context:isCancelled() then return result("CANCELLED", "BOSS_HIDEOUT_OBSERVATION_CANCELLED") end
            if decision == "READY" then
                local after = platform:character()
                if verifiedOrigin and after.character == before.character
                    and after.root == before.root and after.humanoid == before.humanoid then
                    state:port("boss"):rememberHideoutOrigin(origin, context, after)
                end
                return result("COMPLETED", "BOSS_HIDEOUT_OBSERVED_READY")
            end
            if decision == "PAUSE" or not request.resourcesAvailable() or hideoutLocation(runtime:now()) ~= "PERSONAL_HIDEOUT" then
                return result("COMPLETED", "BOSS_HIDEOUT_OBSERVATION_PAUSED")
            end
            request.reportProgress("BOSS_OBSERVATION_RETURN_HOME")
            if not request.resourcesAvailable() then return result("COMPLETED", "BOSS_HIDEOUT_OBSERVATION_PAUSED") end
            local returned = travel:travelWorld(context, origin)
            if context:isCancelled() then return result("CANCELLED", "BOSS_HIDEOUT_OBSERVATION_CANCELLED") end
            if not returned.ok then return result("HELD", "BOSS_HIDEOUT_OBSERVATION_RETURN_UNVERIFIED", returned) end
            nextTripAt = runtime:now() + profile.boss.setupRetry
            return result("COMPLETED", "BOSS_HIDEOUT_OBSERVATION_RETURNED", returned)
        end
    end
    return provider
end

return ProjectBossEvidence
end
-- END MODULE main.adapters.ProjectBossEvidence

-- BEGIN MODULE main.adapters.ProjectFeatureAdapters
__factories["main.adapters.ProjectFeatureAdapters"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local Contracts = require("main.core.Contracts")
local BossManager = require("boss.BossManager")
local TotemController = require("luck.v6.TotemController")
local DungeonController = require("dungeon.ManagedController")
local MovementService = require("main.navigation.MovementService")
local ProjectBossDefinitions = require("main.adapters.ProjectBossDefinitions")
local ProjectFeatureAdapters = {}

local exclusions = {
    FINALCOLOSSUS = {mode = "EXTERNAL", reason = "FINALCOLOSSUS_V3_HANDOFF_ONLY"},
    OMEGASKYTITAN = {mode = "EXTERNAL", reason = "OMEGA_V2_HANDOFF_ONLY"},
    SANDWORM = {mode = "EXTERNAL", reason = "SANDWORM_V38_HANDOFF_ONLY"},
}

local function unavailable(reason) return {mode = "UNAVAILABLE", reason = reason} end
local function hasMethod(object, method)
    return type(object) == "table" and type(object[method]) == "function"
end

local function readiness(source, kind, unavailableBoss)
    local provider = {}
    local function sample(method, query)
        local mode, reason
        if unavailableBoss then mode, reason = unavailableBoss(query.bossId) end
        if mode then
            return {kind = kind, bossId = query.bossId, state = "BLOCKED", reason = reason,
                observedAt = query.now, validUntil = query.now + 1, nextCheckAt = query.now + 1}
        end
        local observed = source[method](source, query)
        if type(observed) ~= "table" or observed.kind ~= kind or observed.bossId ~= query.bossId then return nil end
        local evidence = Contracts.copy(observed)
        if observed.verified ~= true and (kind ~= "BOSS" or observed.state ~= "UNKNOWN") then
            evidence.state, evidence.reason = "UNKNOWN", "HOST_EVIDENCE_UNVERIFIED"
        elseif kind == "TOTEM" and observed.state == "READY" and observed.offeringEligible ~= true then
            if observed.offeringEligible == false then
                evidence.state, evidence.reason = "BLOCKED", "TOTEM_OFFER_INELIGIBLE"
            else
                evidence.state, evidence.reason = "UNKNOWN", "TOTEM_ELIGIBILITY_UNCONFIRMED"
            end
        end
        return evidence
    end
    function provider:observe(query) return sample("observe", query) end
    if hasMethod(source, "peek") then function provider:peek(query) return sample("peek", query) end end
    -- FeatureAdapters deduplicates subscriptions by source identity.
    provider.notifications = source
    return provider
end

local function scopedServices(bindServices)
    local boundRuntime, services, reason
    return function(env)
        if boundRuntime == env.runtime then return services, reason end
        boundRuntime, services, reason = env.runtime, nil, nil
        local ok, attached, why = pcall(bindServices, {
            runtime = env.runtime, state = env.state, profile = env.profile, movement = env.movement,
        })
        if not ok then
            reason = "PROJECT_SERVICE_BIND_FAILED: " .. tostring(attached)
            return nil, reason
        end
        if type(attached) ~= "table" then
            reason = type(why) == "string" and why or "PROJECT_SERVICE_TABLE_REQUIRED"
            return nil, reason
        end
        local requirements = {{"roblox", "player"}, {"roblox", "workspace"}, {"roblox", "service"},
            {"gui", "find"}, {"input", "dispatch"}}
        for _, required in ipairs(requirements) do
            local service, method = required[1], required[2]
            if not hasMethod(attached[service], method) then
                reason = "PROJECT_SERVICE_METHOD_MISSING: " .. service .. "." .. method
                return nil, reason
            end
        end
        local movement = MovementService.new(attached.roblox, env.runtime, env.movement, env.profile)
        local worldService = attached.world
        if not worldService and type(attached.bindWorld) == "function" then
            local built, value = pcall(attached.bindWorld, movement)
            if not built then
                reason = "PROJECT_WORLD_BIND_FAILED: " .. tostring(value)
                return nil, reason
            end
            worldService = value
        end
        for _, method in ipairs({"travel", "returnHome"}) do
            if not hasMethod(worldService, method) then
                reason = "PROJECT_SERVICE_METHOD_MISSING: world." .. method
                return nil, reason
            end
        end
        local function active(context)
            return env.runtime:isActive(context) and not context.readOnly
                and not context:isClosing() and not context:isCancelled()
        end
        local function denied() return {ok = false, code = "PROJECT_JOB_SCOPE_REQUIRED"} end
        local input, world = {}, {}
        function input:dispatch(context, action)
            if not active(context) then return denied() end
            return attached.input:dispatch(context, action)
        end
        if hasMethod(attached.input, "canActivateGui") then
            function input:canActivateGui() return attached.input:canActivateGui() end
        end
        if hasMethod(attached.input, "canBraceB52") then
            function input:canBraceB52() return attached.input:canBraceB52() end
        end
        function world:travel(worldId, context, options)
            if not active(context) then return denied() end
            return worldService:travel(worldId, context, options)
        end
        function world:returnHome(request, context)
            if not active(context) then return denied() end
            return worldService:returnHome(request, context)
        end
        if hasMethod(worldService, "exitHideout") then
            function world:exitHideout(context, validate, reserve)
                if not active(context) then return denied() end
                return worldService:exitHideout(context, validate, reserve)
            end
        end
        services = {
            roblox = attached.roblox, gui = attached.gui, input = input,
            world = world, interaction = attached.interaction, telemetry = attached.telemetry,
            movement = movement, capabilityReason = attached.capabilityReason,
            encounterEvidence = attached.encounterEvidence,
            revivePending = attached.revivePending,
            bossCapabilityReason = attached.bossCapabilityReason,
            bossNativeReason = attached.bossNativeReason,
            bossHostReason = attached.bossHostReason,
        }
        return services
    end
end

local function controller(kind, implementation, bind, unavailableBoss, shippedBosses, observeHideout)
    local bridge, bound = {}, nil
    function bridge:initialize(env)
        local services, reason = bind(env)
        if not services then return false, reason end
        local missing = services.capabilityReason
        if shippedBosses and hasMethod(services, "bossCapabilityReason") then missing = services:bossCapabilityReason() end
        if missing then return false, missing end
        env.services = services
        local instance, unavailableReason = implementation(services, env.profile, env)
        if not instance then return false, unavailableReason or "PROJECT_CONTROLLER_UNAVAILABLE" end
        bound = instance
        return bound:initialize(env)
    end
    function bridge:run(context, request)
        request.reportProgress(kind .. "_" .. request.stage)
        if request.stage == "OBSERVE_HIDEOUT" and observeHideout then return observeHideout(context, request) end
        local result = bound:run(context, request)
        if kind == "TOTEM" and result.status == "DEFERRED" and
            (result.code == "TOTEM_TRAVEL_PENDING" or result.code == "TOTEM_UI_NOT_OPEN") then
            return Contracts.result("HELD", result.code, {stage = result.stage, evidence = result})
        end
        return result
    end
    function bridge:cancel(context, reason)
        if bound and context.stage ~= "OBSERVE_HIDEOUT" then return bound:cancel(context, reason) end
    end
    function bridge:cleanup(context, result)
        if not bound or context and context.stage == "OBSERVE_HIDEOUT" then return end
        local instance = bound
        if context == nil then bound = nil end
        return instance:cleanup(context, result)
    end
    function bridge:status() return bound and bound:status() end
    if kind == "BOSS" then
        function bridge:chainCompatible(id, debt) return bound and bound:chainCompatible(id, debt) end
    end
    if unavailableBoss then function bridge:availability(id) return unavailableBoss(id) end end
    return bridge
end

function ProjectFeatureAdapters.new(options)
    options = options or {}
    local features = {
        BOSS = unavailable("PROJECT_SERVICES_UNAVAILABLE"), TOTEM = unavailable("PROJECT_SERVICES_UNAVAILABLE"),
        DUNGEON = {mode = "EXTERNAL", reason = "STABLE_DUNGEON_OWN_RUNTIME", observer = options.dungeonObserver},
        RIFT = {mode = "EXTERNAL", reason = "STANDALONE_RIFT_OWN_RUNTIME", observer = options.riftObserver},
    }
    -- .14h: the RIFT job is owned by the same central scheduler as Totem/Boss/Raid.
    if options.riftFeature then features.RIFT = options.riftFeature end
    if type(options.bindServices) ~= "function" then return features end
    local bind = scopedServices(options.bindServices)
    -- V6 .14h.8: the old stable Dungeon engine is now one managed P3 job.
    if hasMethod(options.dungeonEvidence, "observe") then
        local function implementation(services)
            return DungeonController.new(services, {totemEvidence=options.totemEvidence})
        end
        features.DUNGEON = {controller=controller("DUNGEON", implementation, bind),
            readiness=options.dungeonEvidence}
    end
    features.BOSS = unavailable("BOSS_AUTHORITATIVE_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED")
    local source = options.bossEvidence
    local createEvidence = source == nil and type(options.createBossEvidence) == "function" and options.createBossEvidence
    local bundledEvidence
    if createEvidence then
        source = {}
        function source:observe(query) return bundledEvidence and bundledEvidence:observe(query) end
        function source:peek(query) return bundledEvidence and bundledEvidence:peek(query) end
    end
    if hasMethod(source, "observe") then
        local definitions, capabilityReasons = {}, {}
        local function define(id, build)
            Contracts.assertKind(id)
            assert(not exclusions[id], "Boss requires its existing host: " .. id)
            assert(not definitions[id], "Duplicate supported boss: " .. id)
            definitions[id] = build
        end
        if options.bossDefinitions then
            for _, definition in ipairs(options.bossDefinitions) do
                define(definition.bossId, function() return definition end)
            end
        elseif options.bossIds then
            for _, id in ipairs(options.bossIds) do
                define(id, assert(ProjectBossDefinitions[id], "Boss definition unavailable: " .. tostring(id)))
            end
        else
            for id, build in pairs(ProjectBossDefinitions) do define(id, build) end
        end
        local function unavailableBoss(id)
            local exclusion = exclusions[id]
            if exclusion then return exclusion.mode, exclusion.reason end
            if not definitions[id] then return "UNAVAILABLE", "BOSS_HOST_DEFINITION_UNAVAILABLE" end
            if capabilityReasons[id] then return "UNAVAILABLE", capabilityReasons[id] end
        end
        local useRecovery = not options.bossDefinitions or options.encounterRecovery == true
        local function implementation(services, profile, env)
            local selected = {}
            capabilityReasons = {}
            local promptAvailable = hasMethod(services.interaction, "prompt")
            if not promptAvailable then
                capabilityReasons.AIRRAID = "AIRRAID_HOST_PROMPT_UNAVAILABLE"
                capabilityReasons.B52 = "B52_HOST_REPAIR_PROMPT_UNAVAILABLE"
            elseif not hasMethod(services.input, "canBraceB52") or not services.input:canBraceB52() then
                capabilityReasons.B52 = "B52_HOST_BRACE_KEY_UNAVAILABLE"
            end
            local firstUnavailable
            for id, build in pairs(definitions) do
                if hasMethod(services, "bossHostReason") then
                    capabilityReasons[id] = services.bossHostReason(id) or capabilityReasons[id]
                end
                if not capabilityReasons[id] and hasMethod(services, "bossNativeReason") then
                    capabilityReasons[id] = services.bossNativeReason(id)
                end
                if not unavailableBoss(id) then selected[#selected + 1] = build() end
                firstUnavailable = firstUnavailable or capabilityReasons[id]
            end
            if #selected == 0 then return nil, firstUnavailable end
            if createEvidence then bundledEvidence = createEvidence(services, profile, env) end
            return BossManager.new(selected, true, useRecovery)
        end
        local policy = BossManager.policy()
        policy.encounterRecovery = useRecovery
        policy.requiresPlatform = false -- The bridge supplies services from the authorized host.
        policy.hideoutObservation = createEvidence and options.hideoutObservation == true or false
        local bossReadiness = readiness(source, "BOSS", unavailableBoss)
        local function observeHideout(context, request)
            return bundledEvidence:observeHideout(context, request, function(query) return bossReadiness:observe(query) end)
        end
        features.BOSS = {controller = controller("BOSS", implementation, bind, unavailableBoss,
            not options.bossDefinitions, policy.hideoutObservation and observeHideout), readiness = bossReadiness, policy = policy}
    end
    features.TOTEM = unavailable("TOTEM_AUTHORITATIVE_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED")
    if hasMethod(options.totemEvidence, "observe") then
        local policy = TotemController.policy()
        policy.requiresPlatform = false
        local function implementation(services)
            for _, name in ipairs({"visible", "belongs", "path", "readText"}) do
                if not hasMethod(services.gui, name) then
                    return nil, "PROJECT_SERVICE_METHOD_MISSING: gui." .. name
                end
            end
            return TotemController.new()
        end
        features.TOTEM = {controller = controller("TOTEM", implementation, bind),
            readiness = readiness(options.totemEvidence, "TOTEM"), policy = policy}
    end
    return features
end

return ProjectFeatureAdapters
end
-- END MODULE main.adapters.ProjectFeatureAdapters

-- BEGIN MODULE main.adapters.ProjectHostServices
__factories["main.adapters.ProjectHostServices"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local RobloxAdapter = require("main.adapters.RobloxAdapter")
local GuiAdapter = require("main.adapters.GuiAdapter")
local InputDriver = require("main.adapters.InputDriver")
local DirectInteraction = require("main.core.DirectInteraction")
local WorldService = require("main.world.WorldService")
local LocationEvidence = require("main.world.LocationEvidence")
local Contracts = require("main.core.Contracts")
local Profile = require("main.config.Profile")
local mainPlaceId = require("boss.FinalColossus.Config").mainPlaceId
local ProjectHostServices = {}

-- Delta compatibility: discover only exported functions; explicit overrides
-- (including false) win. Availability does not prove runtime behavior.
function ProjectHostServices.potassiumCapabilities(overrides, lookup)
    local capabilities = Contracts.copy(overrides or {})
    local identify = lookup("identifyexecutor")
    if type(identify) ~= "function" then identify = lookup("getexecutorname") end
    local name = "UNKNOWN_EXECUTOR"
    if type(identify) == "function" then
        local ok, value = pcall(identify)
        if ok and type(value) == "string" and #value > 0 then name = value end
    end
    local lower = string.lower(name)
    if lower:find("delta", 1, true) then
        for key, api in pairs({fireSignal="firesignal", getConnections="getconnections",
            replicateSignal="replicatesignal", firePrompt="fireproximityprompt"}) do
            if capabilities[key] == nil then
                local fn = lookup(api)
                capabilities[key] = type(fn) == "function" and fn or false
            end
        end
        -- No PC keyboard or mouse mapping on mobile; retain explicit overrides only.
        return capabilities, name
    end
    if name ~= "Potassium" then return capabilities, name end
    -- Potassium exports firesignal as an executor capability. It was omitted
    -- from this binder even though DirectInteraction expects fireSignal.
    -- Respect explicit host overrides, including false.
    if capabilities.fireSignal == nil then capabilities.fireSignal = lookup("firesignal") end
    if capabilities.getConnections == nil then capabilities.getConnections = lookup("getconnections") end
    if capabilities.replicateSignal == nil then capabilities.replicateSignal = lookup("replicatesignal") end
    if capabilities.b52BraceKey == nil then
        local press, release = lookup("keypress"), lookup("keyrelease")
        local focused = lookup("isrbxactive")
        local function unfocused()
            if type(focused) ~= "function" then return false end
            local ok, active = pcall(focused)
            return ok and active == false
        end
        if capabilities.b52BraceTap == nil then
            local tap = lookup("keytap")
            if type(tap) == "function" then
                capabilities.b52BraceTap = function()
                    if unfocused() then return false, "B52_BRACE_WINDOW_UNFOCUSED" end
                    return tap(0x20)
                end
            end
        end
        if type(press) == "function" and type(release) == "function" then
            capabilities.b52BraceKey = function(down)
                if not down then return release(0x20) end
                if unfocused() then return false, "B52_BRACE_WINDOW_UNFOCUSED" end
                -- Potassium itself focus-gates both operations, even without the probe.
                return press(0x20)
            end
        end
    end
    return capabilities, name
end

local bossRemotes = {
    AIRRAID = {"AirRaidCommanderAccept", "AirRaidEvent"},
    B52 = {"B52CommanderAccept", "B52Event", "B52RepairStep"},
    CARRIER = {"CarrierCommanderAccept", "CarrierFightStart", "CarrierSessionUpdate"},
}

local encounterAttributes = {"InBossFight", "BossResultsOpen", "BossReviveDowned",
    "AC130Participant", "AirRaidParticipant", "B17Participant", "B21Participant", "B29Participant",
    "B2Participant", "B52Participant", "CarrierParticipant", "EkranoplanParticipant", "F117Participant",
    "FinalBossParticipant", "FleetParticipant", "FortressParticipant", "RedBaronParticipant", "RQ170Participant",
    "SR71Participant", "Tu95Participant", "U2Participant", "VulcanParticipant", "ZeppelinParticipant"}

function ProjectHostServices.new(player, capabilities, hostName)
    capabilities = capabilities or {}
    local allowed = {}
    for _, name in ipairs({"fireSignal", "getConnections", "replicateSignal", "firePrompt", "mouseMove", "mouseButton", "b52BraceKey", "b52BraceTap"}) do
        allowed[name] = type(capabilities[name]) == "function" and capabilities[name] or false
    end
    local platform = RobloxAdapter.new({player = player, capabilities = allowed})
    local host = {}
    local function revivePending(gui)
        local downed = player:GetAttribute("BossReviveDowned")
        if downed == true or type(downed) == "string" and downed ~= "" then return true end
        local overlay = gui and gui:FindFirstChild("BossReviveOverlay")
        local giveUp = overlay and overlay.Enabled == true and overlay:FindFirstChild("GiveUp", true)
        return giveUp and giveUp.Visible == true or false
    end
    local function bind(scope)
        local runtime, profile = scope.runtime, scope.profile
        local gui = GuiAdapter.new(platform, runtime)
        local interaction = DirectInteraction.new(platform)
        local input = InputDriver.new(platform, gui, runtime, profile, interaction)
        local function nativeResults()
            -- Shipped boss reports already use this native controller to Continue.
            -- Use the same ModuleScript and loader as the report controllers.
            local ok, controller = pcall(function()
                local modules = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("ClientModules")
                local module = modules and modules:FindFirstChild("BossResultsController")
                if module and module:IsA("ModuleScript") then return getfenv(0)["require"](module) end
            end)
            if ok and type(controller) == "table" and type(controller.IsOpen) == "function"
                and type(controller.Dismiss) == "function" then return controller end
        end
        local function bossCapabilityReason()
            if allowed.fireSignal or nativeResults() then return nil end
            return "HOST_GUI_ACTIVATION_UNAVAILABLE"
        end
        local function bossNativeReason(id)
            local required = bossRemotes[id]
            if not required then return nil end
            local folder = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
            for _, name in ipairs(required) do
                local remote = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(name)
                if not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then return "BOSS_NATIVE_REMOTE_UNAVAILABLE_" .. name end
            end
            local results = nativeResults()
            if not results or type(results.Debug) ~= "function" then return "BOSS_NATIVE_REPORT_UNAVAILABLE" end
        end
        local function bossHostReason(id)
            if not hostName or hostName == "Potassium" then return nil end
            if id == "AIRRAID" and not allowed.replicateSignal then return "AIRRAID_UNSUPPORTED_HOST" end
            if id == "B52" and not (allowed.replicateSignal and (allowed.b52BraceTap or allowed.b52BraceKey)) then
                return "B52_UNSUPPORTED_HOST"
            end
        end
        return {
            roblox = platform, gui = gui, input = input,
            encounterEvidence = function() return host:encounterEvidence() end,
            revivePending = function() return revivePending(platform:playerGui()) end,
            interaction = allowed.replicateSignal and interaction or nil,
            capabilityReason = not allowed.fireSignal and "HOST_GUI_ACTIVATION_UNAVAILABLE" or nil,
            bossCapabilityReason = bossCapabilityReason,
            bossNativeReason = bossNativeReason,
            bossHostReason = bossHostReason,
            bindWorld = function(movement)
                return WorldService.new(platform, gui, input, movement, runtime, scope.state, profile)
            end,
        }
    end
    local profile = Profile.new()
    local teleportPending, teleportConnection = false, nil
    function host:watchTransitions()
        if not teleportConnection and player.OnTeleport then
            teleportConnection = player.OnTeleport:Connect(function(state) teleportPending = state.Name ~= "Failed" end)
        end
    end
    function host:stopWatchingTransitions()
        if teleportConnection then teleportConnection:Disconnect(); teleportConnection = nil end
    end
    function host:transitionPending()
        return teleportPending or player.GameplayPaused == true
    end
    function host:subscribeEncounterChanges(callback)
        local links, characterLinks = {}, {}
        local watchedCharacter
        local function connect(list, signal, listener)
            if signal then list[#list + 1] = signal:Connect(listener) end
        end
        local function disconnect(list)
            for _, link in ipairs(list) do link:Disconnect() end
        end
        local function watchCharacter(character)
            disconnect(characterLinks)
            characterLinks = {}
            watchedCharacter = character
            if not character then return end
            local function changed(child)
                if child.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" or child:IsA("Humanoid") then callback() end
            end
            connect(characterLinks, character.ChildAdded, changed)
            connect(characterLinks, character.ChildRemoved, changed)
        end
        watchCharacter(player.Character)
        connect(links, player.CharacterAdded, function(character)
            watchCharacter(character)
            callback()
        end)
        connect(links, player.CharacterRemoving, function(character)
            if watchedCharacter == character then watchCharacter(nil) end
            callback()
        end)
        if type(player.GetAttributeChangedSignal) == "function" then
            for _, name in ipairs({"CurrentWorld", "InPersonalHideout", "HideoutHost", "InBossFight",
                "BossResultsOpen", "BossReviveDowned", "B52Participant", "AirRaidParticipant", "CarrierParticipant",
                "PrototypeDungeonRun"}) do
                connect(links, player:GetAttributeChangedSignal(name), callback)
            end
            connect(links, player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("BossFilmHold"), callback)
        end
        local world = platform:workspace()
        if type(world.GetAttributeChangedSignal) == "function" then
            connect(links, world:GetAttributeChangedSignal("B52CameraOwned"), callback)
            for _, prefix in ipairs({"B52", "AirRaid", "Carrier"}) do
                connect(links, world:GetAttributeChangedSignal(prefix .. "FightGeneration"), callback)
                connect(links, world:GetAttributeChangedSignal(prefix .. "FightActive"), callback)
            end
        end
        if type(player.GetPropertyChangedSignal) == "function" then
            connect(links, player:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GameplayPaused"), callback)
        end
        connect(links, player.OnTeleport, callback)
        return function()
            disconnect(links)
            disconnect(characterLinks)
        end
    end
    function host:inspect()
        local world = player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")
        local result = {placeId = game.PlaceId, world = world, schedulerSafe = false, location = "UNKNOWN", jobId = game.JobId}
        if game.PlaceId ~= mainPlaceId or not Contracts.isHomeWorld(world) then return result end
        -- Even if CurrentWorld is still 4, a live dungeon is NOT a safe
        -- origin for Totem, Raid or another dungeon job.
        if player:GetAttribute("PrototypeDungeonRun") ~= nil then
            result.location = "DUNGEON_ARENA"
            return result
        end
        if self:transitionPending() or not platform:character().ready
            or player:GetAttribute("BossReviveDowned") == true then
            result.location = "RESPAWN_TRANSITION"
            return result
        end
        local gui = platform:playerGui()
        if not gui then return result end
        if revivePending(gui) then result.location = "RESPAWN_TRANSITION"; return result end
        local report = gui:FindFirstChild(profile.paths.bossReport[1])
        if player:GetAttribute("BossResultsOpen") == true or report and report.Enabled == true then
            result.location = "RESULT_PENDING"
            return result
        end
        for _, name in ipairs(encounterAttributes) do
            if player:GetAttribute(name) == true then
                result.location = "BOSS_ARENA"
                return result
            end
        end
        local location = platform:observeLocation(profile, 0)
        local hideout = LocationEvidence.hideout(platform, location)
        if hideout then
            result.location, result.schedulerSafe = hideout, hideout == "PERSONAL_HIDEOUT"
            return result
        end
        local pos, arena = location.position, profile.b21.arenaBounds
        if pos and pos.x > arena.minX and pos.x < arena.maxX and pos.z > arena.minZ and pos.z < arena.maxZ then
            result.location = "BOSS_ARENA"
            return result
        end
        if LocationEvidence.matchesWorld(platform, location, world) then
            result.location, result.schedulerSafe = "WORLD", true
        end
        return result
    end
    function host:encounterEvidence()
        local evidence = self:inspect()
        local character = platform:character()
        local gui = platform:playerGui()
        local report = gui and gui:FindFirstChild(profile.paths.bossReport[1])
        evidence.character = character
        evidence.transition = game.PlaceId ~= mainPlaceId or self:transitionPending()
        evidence.downed = revivePending(gui)
        evidence.reportOpen = player:GetAttribute("BossResultsOpen") == true or report and report.Enabled == true
        evidence.inFight = evidence.location == "BOSS_ARENA"
        for _, name in ipairs(encounterAttributes) do
            if name ~= "BossReviveDowned" and name ~= "BossResultsOpen" and player:GetAttribute(name) == true then
                evidence.inFight = true
                break
            end
        end
        if evidence.location == "UNVERIFIED_HIDEOUT" or evidence.location == "PERSONAL_HIDEOUT" then
            local _, atSite, liveSite = LocationEvidence.hideout(platform, platform:observeLocation(profile, 0))
            evidence.atHideoutSite = atSite
            evidence.atLiveHideoutSite = liveSite ~= nil
            evidence.inPersonalHideout = player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") == true
            evidence.hideoutHost = player:GetAttribute("HideoutHost")
            evidence.hideoutSiteHost = liveSite and liveSite:GetAttribute("HideoutHost")
        elseif evidence.location == "UNKNOWN" and character.ready and not evidence.transition and not evidence.inFight then
            evidence.positionWorld = LocationEvidence.worldAtPosition(platform, platform:observeLocation(profile, 0))
        end
        return evidence
    end
    return bind, host
end

return ProjectHostServices
end
-- END MODULE main.adapters.ProjectHostServices

-- BEGIN MODULE main.adapters.ProjectTotemEvidence
__factories["main.adapters.ProjectTotemEvidence"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Native, query-only Totem readiness. This observes the server's PillarSacrifice
-- State packet; it never submits Quote, Offer, or any destructive interaction.
-- The confirmed Dungeon/Luck F15 V2.6.1 reference uses the same Query -> State
-- contract from any World. Do not replace this with a client cooldown estimate.
local ProjectTotemEvidence = {}

function ProjectTotemEvidence.new(player, options)
    options = options or {}
    local clock = options.clock or os.clock
    local retry = options.retrySeconds or 8
    local timeout = options.timeoutSeconds or 8
    local readyTTL = options.readyTTL or 5
    local cooldownTTL = options.cooldownTTL or 12
    local subscribers, serial, listener = {}, 0, nil
    local last, pending, nextAllowed = nil, false, 0
    local alive = true

    local function unknown(reason)
        local t = clock()
        return {kind = "TOTEM", state = "UNKNOWN", verified = false, reason = reason,
            observedAt = t, validUntil = t + 1.5, nextCheckAt = t + 1.2,
            source = "PillarSacrifice.Query"}
    end
    local function notify()
        for _, callback in pairs(subscribers) do
            pcall(callback)
        end
    end
    local function remote()
        local ok, rs = pcall(function() return game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage") end)
        if not ok or not rs then return nil end
        local folder = rs:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        local instance = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("PillarSacrifice")
        if instance and instance:IsA("RemoteEvent") then return instance end
    end
    local function onPacket(packet)
        if not alive or not pending or type(packet) ~= "table" or packet.Action ~= "State" then return end
        local t = clock()
        pending = false
        nextAllowed = t + 1
        if type(packet.Available) ~= "boolean" then
            last = unknown("TOTEM_STATE_INVALID")
        else
            local state, reason, eligible, ttl
            if packet.Available and packet.WorldUnlocked ~= false then
                state, reason, eligible, ttl = "READY", "TOTEM_SERVER_AVAILABLE", true, readyTTL
            elseif packet.Available then
                state, reason, eligible, ttl = "UNKNOWN", "TOTEM_SERVER_STATE_CONTRADICTORY", false, 2
            elseif packet.WorldUnlocked == false then
                state, reason, eligible, ttl = "BLOCKED", "TOTEM_WORLD_LOCKED", false, cooldownTTL
            else
                state, reason, eligible, ttl = "COOLDOWN", "TOTEM_SERVER_COOLDOWN", false, cooldownTTL
            end
            last = {kind = "TOTEM", state = state, verified = state ~= "UNKNOWN", reason = reason,
                offeringEligible = eligible, observedAt = t, validUntil = t + ttl,
                nextCheckAt = t + ttl, source = "PillarSacrifice.State"}
        end
        notify()
    end
    local function beginQuery()
        local t = clock()
        if not alive or pending or t < nextAllowed then return end
        local instance = remote()
        if not instance then
            nextAllowed = t + retry
            last = unknown("TOTEM_QUERY_REMOTE_UNAVAILABLE")
            return
        end
        if not listener then
            local ok, connected = pcall(function() return instance.OnClientEvent:Connect(onPacket) end)
            if not ok or not connected then
                nextAllowed = t + retry
                last = unknown("TOTEM_QUERY_LISTENER_UNAVAILABLE")
                return
            end
            listener = connected
        end
        pending = true
        serial = serial + 1
        local issued = serial
        nextAllowed = t + timeout
        local sent = pcall(function() instance:FireServer({Action = "Query"}) end)
        if not sent then
            pending = false
            nextAllowed = clock() + retry
            last = unknown("TOTEM_QUERY_FAILED")
            return
        end
        -- Never wait inside the scheduler's readiness observation.
        task.delay(timeout, function()
            if not alive or not pending or serial ~= issued then return end
            pending = false
            nextAllowed = clock() + retry
            last = unknown("TOTEM_QUERY_TIMEOUT")
            notify()
        end)
    end

    local source = {}
    function source:observe(query)
        if type(query) ~= "table" or query.kind ~= "TOTEM" then return nil end
        local t = clock()
        if last and last.verified and t < last.validUntil then return last end
        beginQuery()
        return last and last.observedAt <= t and t < last.validUntil and last or unknown(
            pending and "TOTEM_QUERY_PENDING" or "TOTEM_SERVER_STATE_UNAVAILABLE")
    end
    function source:peek(query)
        if type(query) ~= "table" or query.kind ~= "TOTEM" then return nil end
        local t = clock()
        return last and last.observedAt <= t and t < last.validUntil and last or nil
    end
    function source:subscribe(callback)
        if type(callback) ~= "function" then return function() end end
        local key = {}
        subscribers[key] = callback
        return function() subscribers[key] = nil end
    end
    -- Dungeon completion requests a new native Query before any repeat.
    -- This invalidates only the cached observation, never the Totem transaction
    -- or server cooldown; State.schedule respects any travel retry window.
    function source:refreshAfterDungeon()
        if not alive then return false end
        -- Invalidate any prior READY/COOLDOWN sample even when an earlier
        -- query remains pending. Never let a pre-Dungeon cache authorize P3.
        last = nil
        if not pending then
            nextAllowed = 0
            beginQuery()
        end
        notify()
        return true
    end
    function source:destroy()
        alive = false
        pending = false
        serial = serial + 1
        subscribers = {}
        if listener then pcall(function() listener:Disconnect() end); listener = nil end
    end
    return source
end

return ProjectTotemEvidence
end
-- END MODULE main.adapters.ProjectTotemEvidence

-- BEGIN MODULE main.adapters.RaidOutcomeWitnessSource
__factories["main.adapters.RaidOutcomeWitnessSource"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Appended *after* the unmodified standalone raid observer source.
-- It reads the original observer's native outcome field and persists that result
-- with the frozen V6 token; no timer or return event creates an outcome.
local Witness={}
function Witness.render(raidId,token,userId,raidPlaceId,difficulty)
    if (raidId~="FINALCOLOSSUS" and raidId~="OMEGASKYTITAN") or type(token)~="string"
        or #token<8 or type(userId)~="number" or type(raidPlaceId)~="number"
        or type(difficulty)~="string" then return nil end
    local handle=raidId=="FINALCOLOSSUS" and "PlaneRNGFinalColossusTestV3" or "PlaneRNGOmegaTestV2"
    local field=raidId=="FINALCOLOSSUS" and "result" or "outcome"
    return string.format([====[
-- V6 optional standalone native-result witness (no combat modifications).
task.spawn(function()
    local ok,err=pcall(function()
        local expectedRaid=%q
        local expectedToken=%q
        local expectedUser=%d
        local expectedPlace=%d
        local expectedDifficulty=%q
        if game.PlaceId~=expectedPlace then return end
        local player=game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
        if not player or player.UserId~=expectedUser then return end
        local path="PlaneRNG_V6_Alpha_RaidHandoff_"..expectedUser..".json"
        local http=game:GetService("HttpService")
        local shared=(type(getgenv)=="function" and getgenv()) or _G
        local deadline=os.clock()+3600
        while os.clock()<deadline do
            local runner=shared[%q]
            local native=runner and runner[%q]
            if type(native)=="table" and type(native.victory)=="boolean" then
                if native.difficulty~=nil and tostring(native.difficulty)~=expectedDifficulty then
                    warn("[V6 RAID WITNESS] Native difficulty mismatch");return
                end
                if type(readfile)~="function" or type(writefile)~="function" then
                    warn("[V6 RAID WITNESS] Journal file API unavailable");return
                end
                local loaded,data=pcall(function()return http:JSONDecode(readfile(path))end)
                if not loaded or type(data)~="table" or data.userId~=expectedUser
                    or data.raidId~=expectedRaid or data.token~=expectedToken
                    or data.destinationPlaceId~=expectedPlace or data.difficulty~=expectedDifficulty
                    or (data.status~="DISPATCHING" and data.status~="SUBMITTED"
                        and data.status~="PREPARED" and data.status~="UNCERTAIN") then
                    warn("[V6 RAID WITNESS] Attempt does not match current journal");return
                end
                data.status="RESULT_OBSERVED"
                data.outcome=native.victory and "WIN" or "LOSS"
                data.nativeResultSource=%q
