                data.resultObservedAt=os.time()
                local wrote=pcall(writefile,path,http:JSONEncode(data))
                if wrote then
                    print("[V6 RAID WITNESS] Native outcome recorded",expectedRaid,data.outcome)
                else warn("[V6 RAID WITNESS] Native outcome write failed") end
                return
            end
            task.wait(.2)
        end
        warn("[V6 RAID WITNESS] Native outcome not observed")
    end)
    if not ok then warn("[V6 RAID WITNESS] Failed",err) end
end)
]====],raidId,token,userId,raidPlaceId,difficulty,handle,field,
        raidId=="FINALCOLOSSUS" and "FinalBossSessionUpdate.Outcome" or "OmegaOutcome.OnClientEvent")
end
return Witness
end
-- END MODULE main.adapters.RaidOutcomeWitnessSource

-- BEGIN MODULE main.adapters.RaidReturnResumeSource
__factories["main.adapters.RaidReturnResumeSource"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Optional self-contained continuation appended to the original standalone return.
-- Home verification and native outcome are two independent facts. V6 reconciles
-- the local attempt journal and blocks Repeat when either fact is missing.
local RaidReturnResumeSource = {}

function RaidReturnResumeSource.render(raidId, token, userId, originPlace, originWorld, buildId)
    if type(raidId) ~= "string" or type(token) ~= "string" or #token < 8
        or type(userId) ~= "number" or type(originPlace) ~= "number"
        or type(originWorld) ~= "number" or type(buildId) ~= "string" then return nil end
    local handle = raidId == "FINALCOLOSSUS" and "PlaneRNGFinalColossusReturnV3"
        or raidId == "OMEGASKYTITAN" and "PlaneRNGOmegaReturnV2" or nil
    if not handle then return nil end
    return string.format([=[
-- Managed Alpha return bootstrap. This code is inert until the standalone
-- return runner reports completion. It NEVER certifies a native raid outcome.
task.spawn(function()
    local ok, reason = pcall(function()
        local expectedRaid = %q
        local expectedUserId = %d
        local expectedPlace = %d
        local expectedWorld = %d
        local expectedBuild = %q
        local token = %q
        local handleName = %q
        if game.PlaceId ~= expectedPlace then return end
        local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
        if not player or player.UserId ~= expectedUserId then return end
        local shared = (type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv()) or _G
        local deadline = os.clock() + 240
        while os.clock() < deadline do
            local status = shared[handleName]
            if status and (status.stage == "HOME_VERIFIED" or status.completed == true) then
                if tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")) ~= expectedWorld
                    or player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true
                    or player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") == true
                    or player:GetAttribute("BossResultsOpen") == true then return end
                local character = player.Character
                if not character or not character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
                -- Persist observed home arrival for the matching frozen attempt.
                -- Returning home is NOT proof of WIN/LOSS. An absent native result
                -- remains an unresolved journal and blocks automatic repeat.
                if type(readfile)=="function" and type(writefile)=="function" then
                    local path="PlaneRNG_V6_Alpha_RaidHandoff_"..expectedUserId..".json"
                    local http=game:GetService("HttpService")
                    local readOk,record=pcall(function()return http:JSONDecode(readfile(path))end)
                    if readOk and type(record)=="table" and record.token==token
                        and record.userId==expectedUserId and record.raidId==expectedRaid
                        and record.sourcePlaceId==expectedPlace and record.originalWorld==expectedWorld
                        and (record.status=="RESULT_OBSERVED" or record.status=="SUBMITTED"
                            or record.status=="DISPATCHING" or record.status=="PREPARED"
                            or record.status=="UNCERTAIN") then
                        record.status="RETURN_VERIFIED"
                        record.returnVerifiedAt=os.time()
                        local saved=pcall(writefile,path,http:JSONEncode(record))
                        if not saved then warn("[V6 RAID RESUME] Home journal write failed") end
                    else warn("[V6 RAID RESUME] Matching attempt journal unavailable") end
                end
                -- Cross-place return synchronization marker. This is not
                -- a claim of Raid WIN/LOSS or server travel permission.
                shared.PlaneRNGV6PostRaidHome = {raidId=expectedRaid,
                    userId=expectedUserId, homeWorld=expectedWorld,
                    atMonotonic=os.clock(), token=token}
                if type(readfile) ~= "function" or type(loadstring) ~= "function" then
                    warn("[V6 RAID RESUME] File or compiler capability unavailable")
                    return
                end
                local readOk, bundle = pcall(readfile, "PlaneRNG_V6_v0.1_Alpha_Delta.luau")
                if not readOk or type(bundle) ~= "string" then
                    warn("[V6 RAID RESUME] Matching bundle not found in Delta workspace")
                    return
                end
                if not bundle:find(expectedBuild, 1, true) then
                    warn("[V6 RAID RESUME] Bundle version differs from queued raid", expectedBuild)
                    return
                end
                if shared.PlaneRNGV6StandaloneResumeToken == token then return end
                shared.PlaneRNGV6StandaloneResumeToken = token
                local entry, err = loadstring(bundle)
                if not entry then
                    shared.PlaneRNGV6StandaloneResumeToken = nil
                    warn("[V6 RAID RESUME] Compile error", err)
                    return
                end
                local ran, why = pcall(entry)
                if not ran then
                    shared.PlaneRNGV6StandaloneResumeToken = nil
                    warn("[V6 RAID RESUME] Startup error", why)
                elseif type(shared.PlaneRNGV6Alpha)~="table"
                    or shared.PlaneRNGV6Alpha.buildId~=expectedBuild then
                    shared.PlaneRNGV6StandaloneResumeToken = nil
                    warn("[V6 RAID RESUME] V6 fresh startup not verified")
                end
                return
            end
            task.wait(.5)
        end
    end)
    if not ok then warn("[V6 RAID RESUME] Observation failed", reason) end
end)
]=], raidId, userId, originPlace, originWorld, buildId, token, handle)
end

return RaidReturnResumeSource
end
-- END MODULE main.adapters.RaidReturnResumeSource

-- BEGIN MODULE main.adapters.RiftSchedulerBridge
__factories["main.adapters.RiftSchedulerBridge"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- PlaneRNG V6 .14h.1 - RIFT managed adapter. Native Rift 3.2.4 encounters (18 Commander controllers).
-- No independent Rift scan loop or owner outside the central V6 scheduler.
local Contracts = require("main.core.Contracts")
local ManagedRunner = require("rift.ManagedRunner")
local RiftBridge = {}
local function validRift(model, minimum)
    local anchor = model:FindFirstChild("Anchor")
    if not anchor or not anchor:IsA("BasePart") then return false end
    local state = tostring(anchor:GetAttribute("State") or "Open")
    if state == "Collapsing" or state == "Sealed" or state == "Closed" or state == "Expired" then return false end
    local world = tonumber(anchor:GetAttribute("WorldId"))
    if not world then return false end
    local expires = tonumber(anchor:GetAttribute("ExpiresAt"))
    if expires and (expires - workspace:GetServerTimeNow()) < minimum then return false end
    return true
end
function RiftBridge.new(options)
    options = options or {}
    local bridge = {active = nil, last = nil, generation = 0, nextAt = 0, completed = 0,
        lastEvent = nil, lastFailure = nil, lastSession=nil}
    local function snapshot()
        local t=bridge.active
        return {running=t~=nil and t.running==true, stage=t and t.stage or "IDLE",
            completed=bridge.completed, nextAt=bridge.nextAt, last=bridge.last,
            lastFailure=bridge.lastFailure, lastEvent=bridge.lastEvent,
            encounter=t and t.boss or nil, rift=t and t.currentRift or nil}
    end
    local provider = {}
    local function observe(_, query)
        local now=query.now
        local function sample(state, reason, delay)
            delay=math.max(0.5,delay or 1)
            return {kind="RIFT",state=state,reason=reason,verified=true,
                observedAt=now,validUntil=now+delay,nextCheckAt=now+delay}
        end
        if bridge.active or now < bridge.nextAt then
            return sample("COOLDOWN",bridge.active and "RIFT_JOB_ACTIVE" or "RIFT_RETRY_WAIT", 1)
        end
        local player=game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
        if not player or not tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"))
            or player:GetAttribute("InBossFight")==true
            or player:GetAttribute("RiftTier")~=nil
            or player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout")==true
            or player:GetAttribute("BossResultsOpen")==true then
            return sample("BLOCKED","RIFT_PLAYER_NOT_IDLE",1)
        end
        local gui=player:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
        local report=gui and gui:FindFirstChild("BossResultsGui")
        if report and report:IsA("ScreenGui") and report.Enabled then
            return sample("BLOCKED","RIFT_REPORT_OPEN",1)
        end
        -- All visible natural Rifts are eligible; saved legacy filters are ignored.
        local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Rifts")
        if not folder then return sample("UNKNOWN","RIFT_FOLDER_NOT_LOADED",1.5) end
        local found=false
        for _, model in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
            if validRift(model, 35) then
                found=true
                break
            end
        end
        if found then return sample("READY","NATURAL_RIFT_OBSERVED",1.5) end
        return sample("UNKNOWN","NO_ELIGIBLE_NATURAL_RIFT",1.5)
    end
    function provider:observe(query) return observe(self,query) end
    function provider:peek(query) return observe(self,query) end
    local controller = {}
    function controller:initialize() return true end
    function controller:cooldown() return bridge.nextAt end
    function controller:status() return snapshot() end
    function controller:run(context,request)
        if context:isCancelled() then return Contracts.result("CANCELLED","RIFT_JOB_CANCELLED") end
        if bridge.active then return Contracts.result("DEFERRED","RIFT_PREVIOUS_JOB_ACTIVE",{retryAt=os.clock()+5}) end
        local generation=bridge.generation
        -- Rift's stable standalone defaults always apply. Old saved targetTier,
        -- targetBoss, targetWorld and advanced preferences cannot silently filter it.
        local opts={homeWorld=request.homeWorld,autoRepeat=false,manualAssist=false}
        -- managed scheduling does repeats, never the standalone loop
        local function markActive(t)
            if generation~=bridge.generation or context:isCancelled() then
                t:stop()
            else
                bridge.active=t
            end
        end
        local function onEvent(e)
            if generation==bridge.generation then bridge.lastEvent=e.event end
        end
        print("[V6 .14h RIFT] JOB_START", "home", tostring(request.homeWorld))
        local ok,session=pcall(ManagedRunner.execute,context,opts,markActive,onEvent)
        if generation~=bridge.generation or context:isCancelled() then
            if ok and type(session)=="table" then pcall(session.stop,session) end
            return Contracts.result("CANCELLED","RIFT_RESET_SUPERSEDED")
        end
        bridge.failedActive=not ok and bridge.active or nil
        if bridge.failedActive then pcall(bridge.failedActive.stop,bridge.failedActive) end
        bridge.active=nil
        local now=os.clock()
        if not ok or type(session)~="table" then
            local interrupted=bridge.failedActive
            bridge.failedActive=nil
            if interrupted and (interrupted.enteredRift or interrupted.sessionStarted) then
                bridge.lastFailure="RIFT_EXCEPTION_AFTER_ENTRY"
                return Contracts.result("HELD","RIFT_EXCEPTION_AFTER_ENTRY",{stage="RECOVERY_REQUIRED"})
            end
            bridge.lastFailure=ok and "RIFT_STARTUP_UNVERIFIED" or tostring(session)
            bridge.nextAt=now+10
            print("[V6 .14h RIFT] START_UNVERIFIED",bridge.lastFailure)
            return Contracts.result("DEFERRED","RIFT_STARTUP_UNVERIFIED",{retryAt=bridge.nextAt})
        end
        bridge.lastSession=session
        bridge.last={stage=session.stage,boss=session.boss,outcome=session.outcome,
            rift=session.enteredRift or session.currentRift,completed=session.completed,
            reportClosed=session.reportClosed,origin=session.originWorld}
        local cooldown=60 -- conservative after verified Rift; server cooldown remains authoritative
        if session.completed==true and session.stage=="COMPLETE_OBSERVED" then
            if session.recoveredWithoutCombatAdapter==true then
                bridge.nextAt=now+300
                bridge.lastFailure="RIFT_ADAPTER_FAILED_RECOVERED"
                print("[V6 .14h RIFT] DEGRADED_ADAPTER_RECOVERED",tostring(session.boss),
                    tostring(session.outcome),"retryAfter",300)
                return Contracts.result("DEFERRED","RIFT_COMBAT_ADAPTER_RECOVERED",{
                    stage="RETURN_VERIFIED",retryAt=bridge.nextAt,
                    evidence={boss=session.boss,outcome=session.outcome,rift=session.enteredRift,
                        returnedWorld=session.originWorld,reportClosed=session.reportClosed}})
            end
            bridge.completed=bridge.completed+1
            bridge.nextAt=now+cooldown
            bridge.lastFailure=nil
            print("[V6 .14h RIFT] CYCLE_VERIFIED",bridge.completed,tostring(session.boss),tostring(session.outcome),"retryAfter",cooldown)
            return Contracts.result("COMPLETED","RIFT_CYCLE_VERIFIED",{
                stage="RETURN_VERIFIED",retryAt=bridge.nextAt,
                evidence={boss=session.boss,outcome=session.outcome,rift=session.enteredRift,
                    returnedWorld=session.originWorld,reportClosed=session.reportClosed}})
        end
        local errorStage=tostring(session.stage or "UNKNOWN")
        local refused=session.refused
        if refused then
            local duration=tonumber(tostring(refused):match("%((%d+)s%)"))
            local wait=math.max(5,math.min(300,(duration or 58)+2))
            bridge.nextAt=now+wait
            bridge.lastFailure="RIFT_SERVER_REFUSED:"..tostring(refused)
            print("[V6 .14h RIFT] SERVER_RETRY",wait,tostring(refused))
            return Contracts.result("DEFERRED","RIFT_SERVER_COOLDOWN_OR_REFUSAL",{
                stage="ENTRY_RETRY",retryAt=bridge.nextAt})
        end
        if not session.enteredRift and not session.sessionStarted then
            bridge.nextAt=now+15
            bridge.lastFailure=errorStage
            return Contracts.result("DEFERRED","RIFT_ENTRY_RETRY",{
                stage="ENTRY_RETRY",retryAt=bridge.nextAt})
        end
        -- Once joined/launched, an unresolved outcome/Report/Return cannot be treated as safe idle.
        bridge.lastFailure=errorStage
        print("[V6 .14h RIFT] RECOVERY_HELD",errorStage)
        return Contracts.result("HELD","RIFT_TERMINAL_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE",{
            stage=errorStage,evidence={rift=session.enteredRift,boss=session.boss,outcome=session.outcome}})
    end
    function controller:cancel(_,reason)
        if bridge.active then pcall(bridge.active.stop,bridge.active) end
    end
    function controller:cleanup()
        if bridge.active then
            pcall(bridge.active.stop,bridge.active)
            bridge.active=nil
        end
    end
    function bridge:forceReset()
        self.generation=self.generation+1
        if self.active then pcall(self.active.stop,self.active) end
        self.active=nil
        self.nextAt=0
        self.last=nil
        self.lastSession=nil
        self.failedActive=nil
        self.completed=0
        self.lastFailure=nil
        self.lastEvent=nil
        print("[V6 .14h RIFT] FORCE_RESET_LOCAL", "serverCooldownUnchanged", true)
        return true
    end
    -- Safety verification for a disabled Rift's *stale* terminal hold.
    -- This NEVER dismisses results, changes native server state or touches
    -- an active encounter; it merely corroborates that local ownership ended.
    function bridge:verifyDisabledTerminalIdle(homeWorld)
        if self.active or self.failedActive then return false, "RIFT_ADAPTER_ACTIVE" end
        if self.lastFailure ~= "EXIT_UNVERIFIED" and self.lastFailure ~= "RIFT_TERMINAL_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE" then
            return false, "RIFT_LAST_FAILURE_NOT_TERMINAL"
        end
        local session = self.lastSession
        if not session or not (session.enteredRift or session.sessionStarted) then
            return false, "RIFT_SESSION_NOT_WITNESSED"
        end
        if (session.outcome ~= "WIN" and session.outcome ~= "LOSS")
            or session.reportSeen ~= true or session.reportClosed ~= true
            or session.reportIdentity ~= true or session.conflictingOutcome
            or session.cleanupFailed or session.combatRunning then
            return false, "RIFT_TERMINAL_REPORT_UNVERIFIED"
        end
        if type(homeWorld) ~= "number" or homeWorld < 1 then
            return false, "RIFT_HOME_NOT_CONFIGURED"
        end
        local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
        if not player or tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")) ~= homeWorld then
            return false, "RIFT_HOME_NOT_VERIFIED"
        end
        if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true or player:GetAttribute("RiftTier") ~= nil
            or player:GetAttribute("BossResultsOpen") == true
            or player:GetAttribute("BossReviveDowned") == true
            or player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") == true then
            return false, "RIFT_NATIVE_FIGHT_STILL_ACTIVE"
        end
        local character=player.Character
        local hum=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return false, "RIFT_CHARACTER_NOT_ALIVE" end
        local gui=player:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
        local report=gui and gui:FindFirstChild("BossResultsGui")
        if report and report:IsA("ScreenGui") and report.Enabled then
            return false, "RIFT_REPORT_STILL_OPEN"
        end
        return true, "RIFT_TERMINAL_IDLE_VERIFIED"
    end
    function bridge:status() return snapshot() end
    function bridge:dump(n)
        local source=self.active or self.lastSession
        if source and type(source.dump)=="function" then return source:dump(n or 150) end
        print("[V6 .14h RIFT] No Rift encounter logs in this runtime")
    end
    bridge.feature={controller=controller,readiness=provider,
        policy={priority=300,recoveryPriority=30,requiresPlatform=false}}
    return bridge
end
return RiftBridge
end
-- END MODULE main.adapters.RiftSchedulerBridge

-- BEGIN MODULE main.adapters.RobloxAdapter
__factories["main.adapters.RobloxAdapter"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- All platform access is lazy. Requiring/constructing this module has no client effects.
local RobloxAdapter = {}
local sharedMovementOwners = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})

function RobloxAdapter.new(options)
    options = options or {}
    local services = {}
    local movementOwners = options.movementOwners or sharedMovementOwners
    local adapter = {}

    function adapter:service(name)
        if services[name] then return services[name] end
        local value = options.services and options.services[name]
        if not value then
            if options.getService then value = options.getService(name)
            else value = game:GetService(name) end
        end
        assert(value, "Missing platform service: " .. name)
        services[name] = value
        return value
    end
    function adapter:enum(family, name)
        if options.enum then return options.enum(family, name) end
        return Enum[family][name]
    end
    function adapter:vector(x, y, z)
        if options.vector then return options.vector(x, y, z) end
        return Vector3.new(x, y, z)
    end
    function adapter:landmark(value) return self:vector(value.x, value.y, value.z) end
    function adapter:player() return options.player or self:service("Players").LocalPlayer end
    function adapter:playerGui()
        local player = self:player()
        return player and player:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui") or nil
    end
    function adapter:workspace() return self:service("Workspace") end
    function adapter:findWorld(name, recursive)
        return self:workspace():FindFirstChild(name, recursive)
    end
    function adapter:character()
        local player = self:player()
        local character = player and player.Character
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        return {
            character = character, root = root, humanoid = humanoid,
            position = root and root.Position or nil,
            health = humanoid and humanoid.Health or 0,
            ready = root ~= nil and humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0,
        }
    end
    function adapter:position() return self:character().position end
    function adapter:distance(a, b) return (a - b).Magnitude end
    function adapter:claimMovement(humanoid, owner)
        if movementOwners[humanoid] and movementOwners[humanoid] ~= owner then return false end
        movementOwners[humanoid] = owner
        return true
    end
    function adapter:ownsMovement(humanoid, owner) return movementOwners[humanoid] == owner end
    function adapter:releaseMovement(humanoid, owner)
        if movementOwners[humanoid] ~= owner then return false end
        movementOwners[humanoid] = nil
        return true
    end
    function adapter:computePath(origin, goal, settings)
        local started = self.measureNow and self.measureNow() or os.clock()
        local ok, path = pcall(function()
            local value = self:service("PathfindingService"):CreatePath(settings)
            value:ComputeAsync(origin, goal)
            return value
        end)
        if self.telemetry then self.telemetry:sample("pathfinding", self.measureNow() - started) end
        if not ok then return nil, "PATH_ERROR", tostring(path) end
        if path.Status ~= self:enum("PathStatus", "Success") then return nil, "NO_PATH" end
        return path
    end
    function adapter:isJump(waypoint)
        return waypoint.Action == self:enum("PathWaypointAction", "Jump")
    end
    function adapter:raycast(origin, direction, exclude)
        local started = self.measureNow and self.measureNow() or os.clock()
        -- Raycast does not yield. Reuse parameters within this adapter's serial movement flow.
        local params = services.raycastParams
        if not params then
            params = options.raycastParams and options.raycastParams() or RaycastParams.new()
            services.raycastParams = params
        end
        params.FilterType = self:enum("RaycastFilterType", "Exclude")
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances = exclude or {}
        params.RespectCanCollide = true
        local hit = self:workspace():Raycast(origin, direction, params)
        if self.telemetry then self.telemetry:sample("raycast", self.measureNow() - started) end
        return hit
    end
    function adapter:observeLocation(profile, observedAt)
        local position = self:position()
        local record = {region = "UNKNOWN", confidence = "UNKNOWN", source = "position-region", observedAt = observedAt}
        if not position then return record end
        record.position = {x = position.X, y = position.Y, z = position.Z}
        local bounds = profile.navigation.hideoutBounds
        if position.X < bounds.maxX and position.Z > bounds.minZ
            and position.Y > bounds.minY and position.Y < bounds.maxY then
            record.region, record.confidence = "HIDEOUT", "VERIFIED"
        elseif self:distance(position, self:landmark(profile.landmarks.world1Hatch)) <= profile.navigation.world1Radius then
            record.region, record.worldId, record.confidence = "WORLD_1", 1, "VERIFIED"
        elseif self:distance(position, self:landmark(profile.landmarks.world15Totem)) <= profile.navigation.world15Radius then
            record.region, record.worldId, record.confidence = "WORLD_15", 15, "VERIFIED"
        end
        return record
    end
    function adapter:capability(name)
        if options.capabilities and options.capabilities[name] ~= nil then
            return options.capabilities[name] or nil
        end
        -- Inject an explicit false to disable a capability in an offline host.
        if name == "replicateSignal" then
            local scope = getfenv(0)
            local direct = scope and scope["replicatesignal"]
            if type(direct) ~= "function" and type(scope["getgenv"]) == "function" then
                local shared = scope["getgenv"]()
                direct = shared and shared.replicatesignal
            end
            return type(direct) == "function" and direct or nil
        end
        if name == "fireSignal" then return type(firesignal) == "function" and firesignal or nil end
        if name == "firePrompt" then return type(fireproximityprompt) == "function" and fireproximityprompt or nil end
        if name == "b52BraceKey" then
            return function(down) self:service("VirtualInputManager"):SendKeyEvent(down, Enum.KeyCode.Space, false, game) end
        end
        if name == "mouseMove" then
            return function(x, y) self:service("VirtualInputManager"):SendMouseMoveEvent(x, y, game) end
        end
        if name == "mouseButton" then
            return function(x, y, down)
                self:service("VirtualInputManager"):SendMouseButtonEvent(x, y, 0, down, game, 0)
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    return adapter
end

return RobloxAdapter
end
-- END MODULE main.adapters.RobloxAdapter

-- BEGIN MODULE main.adapters.StandaloneRaidBridge
__factories["main.adapters.StandaloneRaidBridge"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Launch-only delegation to the existing tested standalone PlaceHandoff paths.
-- Readiness and lifecycle proofs belong to the supplied authoritative provider;
-- do not create READY or terminal events from local timers or standalone logs.
local RaidCatalog = require("main.config.RaidCatalog")
local FinalHandoff = require("boss.FinalColossus.PlaceHandoff")
local OmegaHandoff = require("boss.OmegaSkyTitan.PlaceHandoff")
local FinalCooldown = require("main.adapters.FinalColossusCooldownEvidence")
local SandwormHandoff = require("boss.Sandworm.PlaceHandoff")
local StandaloneRaidBridge = {}

function StandaloneRaidBridge.new(evidence, options)
    options = options or {}
    local standalone = options.standaloneMode == true
    if not standalone and (type(evidence) ~= "table" or type(evidence.observe) ~= "function"
        or type(evidence.verifyRaidEvent) ~= "function") then
        return nil, "RAID_AUTHORITATIVE_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED"
    end
    local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    if not player then return nil, "RAID_LOCAL_PLAYER_UNAVAILABLE" end
    local env = {
        runtime = {now = os.clock},
        services = {roblox = {player = function() return player end}},
    }
    local routes = {
        FINALCOLOSSUS = FinalHandoff.new(env, RaidCatalog.FINALCOLOSSUS),
        OMEGASKYTITAN = OmegaHandoff.new(env, RaidCatalog.OMEGASKYTITAN),
        SANDWORM = SandwormHandoff.new(env, RaidCatalog.SANDWORM),
    }
    local bridge = {}
    local launching = {}
    function bridge:cooldown(raidId)
        if not standalone or raidId ~= "FINALCOLOSSUS" then return nil end
        local ok, native, reason = pcall(FinalCooldown.inspect, player,
            game:GetService("HttpService"), workspace)
        if not ok then return {unknown=true}, "FINAL_COOLDOWN_INSPECTION_FAILED" end
        return native, reason
    end
    function bridge:supports(id)
        if not RaidCatalog.contains(id) then return false, "UNKNOWN_RAID_ROUTE" end
        if standalone then return true end
        if id=="SANDWORM" then return false,"SANDWORM_MANAGED_STANDALONE_REQUIRED" end
        if type(evidence.supports) == "function" then
            return evidence:supports(id)
        end
        return false, "RAID_NATIVE_LIFECYCLE_UNVERIFIED"
    end
    function bridge:observe(query)
        if type(query) ~= "table" or not RaidCatalog.contains(query.raidId) then return nil end
        if standalone then
            -- READY here means only that initiating the original standalone is safe
            -- in the main place. Native entry checks decide raid admission.
            local inspect = options.inspect
            local ok,location=pcall(inspect)
            if not ok or type(location)~="table" or location.schedulerSafe~=true
                or location.placeId~=RaidCatalog[query.raidId].mainPlaceId
                or (location.location~=nil and location.location~="WORLD") then return nil end
            local now=query.now
            if query.raidId=="FINALCOLOSSUS" then
                local native, reason=self:cooldown(query.raidId)
                local sample=FinalCooldown.sample(query,native,reason)
                if sample then return sample end
            end
            if query.raidId=="SANDWORM" then
                local delay,state,reason=5,"READY","SANDWORM_ENTRY_PRECONDITIONS"
                local remaining,why=SandwormHandoff.cooldown(player)
                if player:GetAttribute("World124Unlocked")~=true or player:GetAttribute("SandwormEntranceAllowed")~=true then
                    state,reason="BLOCKED","SANDWORM_ENTRANCE_UNAVAILABLE"
                elseif why then return nil
                elseif (player:GetAttribute("DataState")~=nil and player:GetAttribute("DataState")~="Loaded")
                    or (tonumber(player:GetAttribute("EquippedPlaneCount")) or 1)<1 then
                    state,reason="BLOCKED","SANDWORM_PLAYER_NOT_READY"
                elseif remaining and remaining>0 then
                    state,reason,delay="COOLDOWN","SANDWORM_SERVER_COOLDOWN",math.max(.25,math.min(remaining,5))
                end
                return {kind="RAID",bossId=query.raidId,raidId=query.raidId,difficulty=query.difficulty,
                    state=state,verified=true,source="SandwormEntranceConfig.BossStartCooldowns",
                    reason=reason,observedAt=now,validUntil=now+delay,nextCheckAt=now+delay}
            end
            return {kind="RAID",bossId=query.raidId,raidId=query.raidId,
                difficulty=query.difficulty,state="READY",verified=true,
                source="STANDALONE_ENTRY_PRECONDITIONS_ONLY",observedAt=now,
                validUntil=now+10,nextCheckAt=now+10}
        end
        local ok, result = pcall(evidence.observe, evidence, query)
        if not ok or type(result) ~= "table" or result.verified ~= true
            or result.raidId ~= query.raidId or result.difficulty ~= query.difficulty then return nil end
        return result
    end
    if not standalone and type(evidence.peek) == "function" then
        function bridge:peek(query)
            local ok, result = pcall(evidence.peek, evidence, query)
            if not ok or type(result) ~= "table" or result.verified ~= true
                or result.raidId ~= query.raidId or result.difficulty ~= query.difficulty then return nil end
            return result
        end
    end
    if not standalone and type(evidence.subscribe) == "function" then
        function bridge:subscribe(callback) return evidence:subscribe(callback) end
    end
    function bridge:verifyRaidEvent(event, record)
        if standalone then return nil end
        return evidence:verifyRaidEvent(event, record)
    end
    if not standalone and type(evidence.subscribeRaidEvents) == "function" then
        function bridge:subscribeRaidEvents(callback) return evidence:subscribeRaidEvents(callback) end
    end
    -- Check runner-local persisted state BEFORE V6 reserves a new raid token.
    -- Otherwise a stale OUTCOME makes the runner execute a return-only payload,
    -- and V6 incorrectly records a fresh attempt with no native outcome.
    -- Operator reset also releases adapter closure state (Omega's one-use
    -- launchConsumed and per-runner start throttles). It cannot dequeue native
    -- queue_on_teleport payloads already submitted to the executor.
    function bridge:forceReset()
        local warnings = {}
        launching = {}
        for _, id in ipairs({"OMEGASKYTITAN", "FINALCOLOSSUS", "SANDWORM"}) do
            local route = routes[id]
            if route and type(route.forceReset) == "function" then
                local called, ok = pcall(route.forceReset, route)
                if not called or ok ~= true then warnings[#warnings + 1] = id end
            end
        end
        if #warnings == 0 then return true end
        return false, table.concat(warnings, ",")
    end

    function bridge:preflight(raidId)
        local route = routes[raidId]
        if route and type(route.preflight) == "function" then
            return route:preflight()
        end
        return true
    end

    function bridge:launch(context, record)
        if type(record) ~= "table" or not RaidCatalog.contains(record.raidId)
            or type(record.token) ~= "string" or record.submission ~= "DISPATCHING"
            or launching[record.token] or context:isCancelled() then return false end
        local supported = self:supports(record.raidId)
        if not supported then return false end
        local route = routes[record.raidId]
        launching[record.token] = true
        local attempt = {
            raidId = record.raidId, token = record.token,
            difficulty = record.difficulty, originalWorld = record.originalWorld,
            repeatEnabled = record.repeatEnabled, resumeV6 = true,
            buildId = options.buildId,
        }
        local ok, result = pcall(route.run, route, context, attempt)
        if not ok or type(result) ~= "table" then return false end
        if record.raidId=="FINALCOLOSSUS" and result.code=="FINALCOLOSSUS_V3_PREQUEUE_COOLDOWN"
            and type(result.evidence)=="table" and result.evidence.noPayloadQueued==true
            and result.evidence.entryStage=="COOLDOWN"
            and type(result.evidence.cooldownSeconds)=="number"
            and result.evidence.cooldownSeconds>0 then
            return false,"FINALCOLOSSUS_V3_PREQUEUE_COOLDOWN",true,
                result.evidence.cooldownSeconds
        end
        if record.raidId=="FINALCOLOSSUS" and result.code=="FINALCOLOSSUS_V3_PREQUEUE_TRAVEL_FAILED"
            and type(result.evidence)=="table" and result.evidence.noPayloadQueued==true
            and result.evidence.entryStage=="WORLD_TRAVEL_FAILED" then
            return false,"FINALCOLOSSUS_V3_PREQUEUE_TRAVEL_FAILED",true
        end
        if record.raidId=="OMEGASKYTITAN" and result.code=="OMEGA_V2_PREQUEUE_LOBBY_BUSY"
            and type(result.evidence)=="table" and result.evidence.noPayloadQueued==true
            and (result.evidence.entryStage=="OTHER_LEADER_ACTIVE" or result.evidence.entryStage=="ENTRANCE_BUSY") then
            return false,"OMEGA_V2_PREQUEUE_LOBBY_BUSY",true,nil,result.evidence.entryStage
        end
        if record.raidId=="OMEGASKYTITAN" and result.code=="OMEGA_V2_PREQUEUE_TRAVEL_FAILED"
            and type(result.evidence)=="table" and result.evidence.noPayloadQueued==true
            and result.evidence.entryStage=="WORLD_TRAVEL_FAILED" then
            return false,"OMEGA_V2_PREQUEUE_TRAVEL_FAILED",true
        end
        if record.raidId=="SANDWORM" and result.code=="SANDWORM_V38_PREQUEUE_FAILED"
            and type(result.evidence)=="table" and result.evidence.noPayloadQueued==true
            and result.evidence.entryStage=="SANDWORM_PREQUEUE_FAILED" then
            launching[record.token]=nil
            return false,result.code,true,result.evidence.retrySeconds,result.evidence.entryStage
        end
        return (record.raidId == "SANDWORM" and result.code == "SANDWORM_V38_STARTED")
            or (record.raidId == "FINALCOLOSSUS" and result.code == "FINALCOLOSSUS_V3_STARTED")
            or (record.raidId == "OMEGASKYTITAN" and result.code == "OMEGA_V2_STARTED")
    end
    return bridge
end

return StandaloneRaidBridge
end
-- END MODULE main.adapters.StandaloneRaidBridge

-- BEGIN MODULE main.core.Contracts
__factories["main.core.Contracts"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local Contracts = {}

Contracts.Status = {
    COMPLETED = "COMPLETED", DEFERRED = "DEFERRED", HELD = "HELD",
    CANCELLED = "CANCELLED", FAILED = "FAILED",
}
Contracts.Kind = { TOTEM = "TOTEM", BOSS = "BOSS" }

function Contracts.isFinite(value)
    return type(value) == "number" and value == value
        and value > -math.huge and value < math.huge
end

function Contracts.isHomeWorld(value)
    return Contracts.isFinite(value) and value >= 1 and value % 1 == 0
end

function Contracts.assertKind(kind)
    assert(type(kind) == "string" and #kind <= 64 and kind:match("^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$"), "Invalid feature ID")
end

function Contracts.copyBossCandidates(value)
    if type(value) ~= "table" then return nil end
    local count, seen = 0, {}
    for index, candidate in pairs(value) do
        if not Contracts.isFinite(index) or index % 1 ~= 0 or index < 1 or index > #value
            or type(candidate) ~= "table" or type(candidate.enabled) ~= "boolean"
            or not pcall(Contracts.assertKind, candidate.id) or seen[candidate.id] then return nil end
        seen[candidate.id] = true
        count = count + 1
    end
    if count ~= #value then return nil end
    local candidates, selected = {}, nil
    for index, candidate in ipairs(value) do
        candidates[index] = {id = candidate.id, enabled = candidate.enabled}
        if not selected and candidate.enabled then selected = candidate.id end
    end
    return candidates, selected
end

-- Configuration records contain only acyclic data.
function Contracts.sameData(a, b)
    if a == b then return true end
    if type(a) ~= "table" or type(b) ~= "table" then return false end
    for key, value in pairs(a) do
        if not Contracts.sameData(value, b[key]) then return false end
    end
    for key in pairs(b) do
        if a[key] == nil then return false end
    end
    return true
end

function Contracts.copy(value, seen)
    if type(value) ~= "table" then return value end
    seen = seen or {}
    if seen[value] then return seen[value] end
    local result = {}
    seen[value] = result
    for key, item in pairs(value) do result[key] = Contracts.copy(item, seen) end
    return result
end

function Contracts.signal()
    local listeners = {}
    local signal = {}
    function signal:subscribe(callback)
        assert(type(callback) == "function", "Listener required")
        local token = {}
        listeners[token] = callback
        return function() listeners[token] = nil end
    end
    function signal:emit(event)
        local pending = Contracts.copy(listeners)
        for token, callback in pairs(pending) do
            if listeners[token] then pcall(callback, Contracts.copy(event)) end
        end
    end
    return signal
end

function Contracts.validateResult(result, now)
    assert(type(result) == "table", "Job must return a JobResult")
    assert(Contracts.Status[result.status] ~= nil, "Invalid job status")
    assert(type(result.code) == "string" and #result.code > 0, "Job code required")
    assert(type(result.stage) == "string" and #result.stage > 0, "Job stage required")
    if result.stopFeature ~= nil then assert(type(result.stopFeature) == "boolean", "stopFeature must be boolean") end
    if result.retryAt ~= nil then
        assert(Contracts.isFinite(result.retryAt) and result.retryAt >= now,
            "retryAt must be a current/future monotonic deadline")
    end
    if result.status == "DEFERRED" then
        assert(result.retryAt ~= nil, "DEFERRED requires retryAt")
    end
    if result.status == "HELD" or result.status == "FAILED" or result.status == "CANCELLED" then
        assert(result.retryAt == nil, "Terminal/held results cannot request automatic retry")
    end
    return result
end

function Contracts.result(status, code, fields)
    local result = Contracts.copy(fields or {})
    result.status, result.code = status, code
    result.stage = result.stage or "RUN"
    return result
end

return Contracts
end
-- END MODULE main.core.Contracts

-- BEGIN MODULE main.core.DeferredHomeJournal
__factories["main.core.DeferredHomeJournal"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local Contracts = require("main.core.Contracts")
local DeferredHomeJournal = {}

function DeferredHomeJournal.new(storage)
    if type(storage) ~= "table" or type(storage.read) ~= "function"
        or type(storage.compareAndSwap) ~= "function" then return nil end
    local key = "plane-rng-v6-deferred-home"
    local tag
    local journal = {}
    function journal:load()
        local ok, record, revision, reason = pcall(storage.read, storage, key)
        if not ok or reason then return nil, "CHAIN_JOURNAL_UNREADABLE" end
        tag = revision
        if record == nil then return nil end
        if type(record) ~= "table" or record.schemaVersion ~= 1 then return nil, "CHAIN_JOURNAL_INVALID" end
        if record.homeWorld == nil and record.id == nil and record.bossId == nil
            and record.attempted == nil and record.successor == nil then return nil end
        if not Contracts.isHomeWorld(record.homeWorld) or type(record.id) ~= "string" or record.id == ""
            or not pcall(Contracts.assertKind, record.bossId) or type(record.attempted) ~= "boolean"
            or type(record.successor) ~= "boolean" then return nil, "CHAIN_JOURNAL_INVALID" end
        return {id=record.id, homeWorld=record.homeWorld, bossId=record.bossId, restored=true,
            observeOnly=record.attempted or record.successor, attempted=record.attempted, successor=record.successor}
    end
    function journal:save(chain)
        local record = {schemaVersion=1}
        if chain then
            record.id, record.homeWorld, record.bossId = chain.id, chain.homeWorld, chain.bossId
            record.attempted, record.successor = chain.attempted == true, chain.successor == true
        end
        local ok, accepted, revision = pcall(storage.compareAndSwap, storage, key, tag, record)
        if not ok or accepted ~= true then return false end
        tag = revision
        return true
    end
    return journal
end

return DeferredHomeJournal
end
-- END MODULE main.core.DeferredHomeJournal

-- BEGIN MODULE main.core.DirectInteraction
__factories["main.core.DirectInteraction"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Camera-independent dispatch shared by prompt owners and GUI InputDriver.
-- A dispatch is never proof of success: consumers MUST verify server/GUI state.
local DirectInteraction = {}

local function result(ok, code, sent, method, detail)
    return {ok=ok, code=code, dispatched=sent==true, verified=false,
        method=method, detail=detail}
end

function DirectInteraction.new(platform)
    local service = {}
    local function signal()
        local provided = platform:capability("replicateSignal")
        if type(provided)=="function" then return provided end
        return nil
    end
    function service:capabilities()
        return {prompt=signal()~=nil, gui=platform:capability("fireSignal")~=nil}
    end
    function service:gui(target, event)
        if not target or not target:IsA("GuiButton") or not target.Parent then
            return result(false, "GUI_INVALID", false, "GUI_SIGNAL")
        end
        if event~="Activated" and event~="MouseButton1Click" then
            return result(false, "GUI_EVENT_INVALID", false, "GUI_SIGNAL")
        end
        local send=platform:capability("fireSignal")
        if not send then return result(false, "GUI_SIGNAL_UNAVAILABLE", false, "GUI_SIGNAL") end
        local ok,why=pcall(function() send(target[event]) end)
        return result(ok, ok and "GUI_DISPATCHED" or "GUI_SIGNAL_FAILED", ok, "GUI_SIGNAL", why and tostring(why))
    end
    -- opts: player, wait(seconds)->boolean, valid()->boolean, allowLegacyFallback.
    -- The V4 procedure is BeginReplicated -> hold -> TriggerReplicated -> EndReplicated.
    -- InputHoldBegin is ONLY a compatibility fallback when the executor lacks replicateSignal.
    function service:prompt(prompt, opts)
        opts=opts or {}
        if not prompt or not prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") or not prompt.Parent or not prompt.Enabled then
            return result(false, "PROMPT_INACTIVE", false, "DIRECT_PROMPT")
        end
        local valid=opts.valid or function() return true end
        local ready,reason=valid()
        if not ready then return result(false, reason or "PROMPT_NOT_READY", false, "DIRECT_PROMPT") end
        local fn=signal()
        local method=fn and "REPLICATED_PROMPT_HOLD" or "LEGACY_PROMPT_HOLD"
        if not fn and not opts.allowLegacyFallback then
            return result(false, "DIRECT_PROMPT_CAPABILITY_MISSING", false, method)
        end
        local player=opts.player or platform:player()
        local started=false
        local function stopHold()
            if not started then return true end
            started=false
            if fn then return pcall(function() fn(prompt.ButtonHoldEndedActionReplicated,player) end) end
            return pcall(function() prompt:InputHoldEnd() end)
        end
        local dispatched=false
        local ok,why=pcall(function()
            if fn then fn(prompt.ButtonHoldBeganActionReplicated,player)
            else prompt:InputHoldBegin() end
            started=true
            dispatched=true
            if opts.onSent then pcall(opts.onSent,"HOLD_BEGIN") end
            local deadline=os.clock()+math.max(0,tonumber(prompt.HoldDuration) or 0)+0.15
            while os.clock()<deadline do
                if not prompt.Parent or not prompt.Enabled then error("PROMPT_DISABLED_DURING_HOLD") end
                local still,whyValid=valid()
                if not still then error(whyValid or "HOLD_CANCELLED") end
                local seconds=math.min(0.05,deadline-os.clock())
                if seconds>0 then
                    if opts.wait then
                        if opts.wait(seconds)==false then error("CANCELLED") end
                    else task.wait(seconds) end
                end
            end
            local still,whyValid=valid()
            if not still then error(whyValid or "HOLD_CANCELLED") end
            if fn then fn(prompt.TriggeredActionReplicated,player) end
            if opts.onSent then pcall(opts.onSent,"TRIGGER") end
        end)
        local released,releaseError=stopHold()
        if not released then
            return result(false,"PROMPT_RELEASE_FAILED",dispatched,method,tostring(releaseError))
        end
        local detail = not ok and tostring(why) or nil
        return result(ok,ok and "PROMPT_DISPATCHED" or "PROMPT_DISPATCH_FAILED",
            dispatched,method,detail)
    end
    return service
end
return DirectInteraction
end
-- END MODULE main.core.DirectInteraction

-- BEGIN MODULE main.core.FeatureAdapters
__factories["main.core.FeatureAdapters"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local FeatureAdapters = {}

local defaults = {
    BOSS = {mode = "UNAVAILABLE", reason = "BOSS_HOST_ADAPTER_REQUIRED"},
    RAID = {mode = "UNAVAILABLE", reason = "RAID_RUNNER_BRIDGE_UNAVAILABLE"},
    DUNGEON = {mode = "EXTERNAL", reason = "STABLE_DUNGEON_EXTERNAL"},
    TOTEM = {mode = "UNAVAILABLE", reason = "TOTEM_HOST_ADAPTER_REQUIRED"},
    RIFT = {mode = "EXTERNAL", reason = "STANDALONE_RIFT_EXTERNAL"},
}

local function lifecycle(controller)
    local feature = {run = function(_, context, request) return controller:run(context, request) end}
    for _, method in ipairs({"initialize", "cancel", "cleanup", "status", "cooldown"}) do
        local callback = controller[method]
        assert(callback == nil or type(callback) == "function", "Invalid adapter lifecycle: " .. method)
        if callback then feature[method] = function(_, ...) return callback(controller, ...) end
        elseif method == "cooldown" then feature[method] = function() return 0 end
        else feature[method] = function() end end
    end
    if type(controller.availability) == "function" then
        function feature:availability(bossId) return controller:availability(bossId) end
    end
    if type(controller.chainCompatible) == "function" then
        function feature:chainCompatible(bossId, debt) return controller:chainCompatible(bossId, debt) end
    end
    return feature
end

function FeatureAdapters.new(specifications, fallback, host)
    local entries, providers = {}, {}
    if fallback then providers[fallback] = true end
    for kind, spec in pairs(specifications or {}) do
        assert(defaults[kind] and type(spec) == "table", "Unknown central feature adapter")
        local controller, provider = spec.controller, spec.readiness or fallback
        if controller then
            if type(controller) ~= "table" or type(controller.run) ~= "function" then
                entries[kind] = {mode = "UNAVAILABLE", reason = "CONTROLLER_RUN_UNAVAILABLE"}
            elseif type(provider) ~= "table" or type(provider.observe) ~= "function" then
                entries[kind] = {mode = "UNAVAILABLE", reason = "READINESS_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE"}
            else
                entries[kind] = {feature = lifecycle(controller), readiness = provider, policy = spec.policy}
            end
        else
            assert(spec.mode == "UNAVAILABLE" or spec.mode == "EXTERNAL", "Set an unavailable adapter mode")
            assert(type(spec.reason) == "string" and #spec.reason > 0, "Adapter reason required")
            local observer = spec.observer
            assert(observer == nil or spec.mode == "EXTERNAL" and type(observer) == "table"
                and type(observer.status) == "function", "External observer requires status()")
            entries[kind] = {mode = spec.mode, reason = spec.reason, observer = observer}
            if observer then providers[observer] = true end
        end
    end

    local adapters = {}
    function adapters:attach(driver)
        for _, kind in ipairs({"BOSS", "RAID", "DUNGEON", "TOTEM", "RIFT"}) do
            local entry = entries[kind] or defaults[kind]
            local ok, code, detail
            if entry.feature then
                ok, code, detail = driver:registerFeature(kind, entry.feature, entry.policy)
                if ok then providers[entry.readiness.notifications or entry.readiness] = true end
                if not ok and (code == "PLATFORM_REQUIRED" or code == "FEATURE_CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE") then
                    ok, code = driver:declareFeature(kind, "UNAVAILABLE", detail or code)
                end
            else ok, code = driver:declareFeature(kind, entry.mode, entry.reason) end
            if not ok then return false, code, detail end
        end
        return true
    end
    local function readinessSource(query)
        local entry = entries[query.kind]
        return entry and entry.readiness or fallback
    end
    function adapters:observe(query)
        local provider = readinessSource(query)
        if provider then return provider:observe(query) end
    end
    function adapters:peek(query)
        local provider = readinessSource(query)
        if provider and type(provider.peek) == "function" then return provider:peek(query) end
    end
    function adapters:externalStatus()
        local results = {}
        for kind, entry in pairs(entries) do
            if entry.observer then
                local ok, status = pcall(entry.observer.status, entry.observer)
                if not ok or type(status) ~= "table" or type(status.running) ~= "boolean" or status.uncertain == true then
                    results[kind] = {state = "UNKNOWN", reason = "EXTERNAL_OWNERSHIP_UNVERIFIED"}
                else
                    results[kind] = {state = status.running and "RUNNING" or "IDLE",
                        operationId = type(status.operationId) == "string" and status.operationId or nil,
                        stage = type(status.stage) == "string" and status.stage or nil,
                        reason = type(status.reason) == "string" and status.reason or nil}
                end
            end
        end
        return results
    end
    function adapters:subscribe(callback)
        local disconnects = {}
        local function subscribe(source, method)
            if type(method) ~= "function" then return end
            local ok, disconnect = pcall(method, source, callback)
            if ok and type(disconnect) == "function" then disconnects[#disconnects + 1] = disconnect end
        end
        for provider in pairs(providers) do subscribe(provider, provider.subscribe) end
        subscribe(host, host.subscribeResources)
        return function()
            for _, disconnect in ipairs(disconnects) do pcall(disconnect) end
        end
    end
    return adapters
end

return FeatureAdapters
end
-- END MODULE main.core.FeatureAdapters

-- BEGIN MODULE main.core.FeaturePolicy
__factories["main.core.FeaturePolicy"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Priority algorithm is feature-agnostic. Reserved V5.7 policies are data installed once.
local FeaturePolicy = {}

-- All supported gameplay jobs interact with the same player. World travel,
-- teleport, and GUI/server interactions have shared authority across features.
local resources = {"MOVEMENT", "INTERACTION", "WORLD_TRANSITION"}

function FeaturePolicy.activityPriority(id)
    if id == "TOTEM" then return 100 end
    if id == "BOSS" or id == "RAID" then return 200 end
    return 300
end

function FeaturePolicy.defaults(id)
    local priority = FeaturePolicy.activityPriority(id)
    if id == "TOTEM" then return {priority = priority, recoveryPriority = 20, countChecks = true} end
    if id == "BOSS" then return {priority = priority, recoveryPriority = 10} end
    return {priority = priority, recoveryPriority = 30}
end

function FeaturePolicy.resources()
    return {resources[1], resources[2], resources[3]}
end

function FeaturePolicy.canReconcileBossHold(code)
    return code == nil or code == "BOSS_ENCOUNTER_CANCELLED" or code == "BOSS_REPORT_STILL_OPEN"
        or code == "BOSS_REPORT_CHANGED" or code == "BOSS_RETURN_UNVERIFIED"
end

function FeaturePolicy.plan(entry, feature, now, cooldown)
    local recoveryStage = feature.reportPending and "REPORT" or feature.returnPending and "RETURN"
        or feature.recovery and feature.recovery.stage
    local readyAt = math.max(feature.nextCheckAt or 0, cooldown or 0)
    if recoveryStage then
        return {
            kind = entry.id, stage = recoveryStage, recovery = true,
            rank = entry.policy.recoveryPriority, ready = feature.enabled and now >= readyAt,
            reason = entry.id .. (feature.enabled and "_RECOVERY_WAIT" or "_RECOVERY_DISABLED"),
        }
    end
    local due = feature.enabled and now >= readyAt
    return {kind = entry.id, stage = "RUN", recovery = false, rank = entry.policy.priority, ready = due}
end

function FeaturePolicy.precedes(a, b)
    if a.recovery ~= b.recovery then return a.recovery end
    if a.rank ~= b.rank then return a.rank < b.rank end
    return a.kind < b.kind
end

function FeaturePolicy.select(plans, lastPeerByRank)
    -- For equal-priority jobs, rotate only within their own tier. Recovery
    -- outranks normal work and is never shuffled by the activity cursor.
    table.sort(plans, function(a, b)
        if a.recovery ~= b.recovery or a.rank ~= b.rank then
            return FeaturePolicy.precedes(a, b)
        end
        local lastPeer = lastPeerByRank and lastPeerByRank[a.rank]
        if not a.recovery and lastPeer then
            local aWrapped, bWrapped = a.kind <= lastPeer, b.kind <= lastPeer
            if aWrapped ~= bWrapped then return not aWrapped end
        end
        return a.kind < b.kind
    end)
    for _, plan in ipairs(plans) do
        if plan.recovery then
            if not plan.ready then return nil, plan.reason end
            return plan
        end
        if plan.ready then return plan end
    end
    return nil, "IDLE"
end

function FeaturePolicy.canComplete(feature)
    if not feature.enabled or feature.reportPending or feature.returnPending or feature.recovery then return true end
    return false
end

return FeaturePolicy
end
-- END MODULE main.core.FeaturePolicy

-- BEGIN MODULE main.core.FeatureRegistry
__factories["main.core.FeatureRegistry"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local Contracts = require("main.core.Contracts")
local FeaturePolicy = require("main.core.FeaturePolicy")
local TotemTravelPriorityPolicy = require("main.core.TotemTravelPriorityPolicy")
local FeatureRegistry = {}
local methods = {"initialize", "run", "cancel", "cleanup", "status", "cooldown"}

local function featureState(snapshot, id)
    if id == "BOSS" then return snapshot.boss, snapshot.config.bossEnabled end
    if id == "TOTEM" then return snapshot.totem, snapshot.config.totemEnabled end
    local feature = snapshot.features[id]
    return feature, feature.enabled
end

local function pending(feature)
    local encounter, tx = feature.encounter, feature.transaction
    return feature.reportPending or feature.returnPending or feature.proceedPending or feature.recovery
        or feature.manualHold or encounter and encounter.phase ~= "COMPLETE"
        or tx and tx.phase ~= "COMPLETE" and tx.phase ~= "ABANDONED"
end

function FeatureRegistry.new(state, runtime, profile, environment)
    local entries = {}
    local lastPeerByRank = {} -- independent round-robin cursors for each priority tier
    local stopped, initializing = false, false
    local lastTravelWaitEpoch = nil
    local lastPostRaidWaitToken = nil
    local schedulerWriter = state:port("scheduler")
    local registry = {}
    local function define(id, policy)
        state:registerFeature(id)
        entries[id] = {id = id, policy = Contracts.copy(policy or FeaturePolicy.defaults(id))}
    end
    define("TOTEM")
    define("BOSS")
    for id in pairs(state:snapshot().features) do define(id) end
    function registry:declare(id, mode, reason)
        Contracts.assertKind(id)
        if not entries[id] then define(id) end
        entries[id].mode, entries[id].reason = mode, reason
        return true
    end
    local function lifecycle(entry, phase, result)
        state:port("feature", entry.id):setStatus({phase = phase, lastResult = Contracts.copy(result)})
    end
    local function dispose(entry, reason)
        if not entry.module then return true end
        if entry.disposed then return entry.disposeError == nil, entry.disposeError end
        entry.disposed = true
        local ok, err = pcall(function() entry.module:cleanup(nil, {code = reason}) end)
        if not ok then
            entry.disposeError = tostring(err)
            schedulerWriter:hold(entry.id, "FEATURE_SHUTDOWN_CLEANUP_FAILED")
        end
        return ok, err
    end
    local function register(id, module, policy)
        Contracts.assertKind(id)
        if stopped or not runtime:isAlive() then return false, "STOPPED" end
        if runtime:activeJob() then return false, "BUSY" end
        if entries[id] and entries[id].module then return false, "FEATURE_ALREADY_REGISTERED" end
        assert(type(module) == "table", "Feature module required")
        for _, name in ipairs(methods) do assert(type(module[name]) == "function", "Missing lifecycle: " .. name) end
        local selected = Contracts.copy(entries[id] and entries[id].policy or FeaturePolicy.defaults(id))
        for key, value in pairs(policy or {}) do selected[key] = Contracts.copy(value) end
        assert(Contracts.isFinite(selected.priority) and Contracts.isFinite(selected.recoveryPriority), "Invalid feature priority")
        local env = environment and environment() or {}
        if selected.requiresPlatform and not env.services then return false, "PLATFORM_REQUIRED" end
        if not entries[id] then define(id, selected) end
        env.state, env.runtime, env.profile = state, runtime, profile
        env.writer = state:port("feature", id)
        if stopped or not runtime:isAlive() then return false, "STOPPED" end
        local ok, accepted, capabilityReason = pcall(function() return module:initialize(env) end)
        if ok and accepted == false and not stopped and runtime:isAlive() then
            local cleaned = pcall(function() module:cleanup(nil, {code = "FEATURE_CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE"}) end)
            if not cleaned then
                schedulerWriter:hold(id, "FEATURE_INITIALIZE_CLEANUP_FAILED")
                return false, "FEATURE_INITIALIZE_CLEANUP_FAILED"
            end
            return false, "FEATURE_CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE", capabilityReason
        end
        if not ok or stopped or not runtime:isAlive() then
            local reason = ok and "SHUTDOWN" or "INITIALIZE_FAILED"
            local cleaned = pcall(function() module:cleanup(nil, {code = reason}) end)
            if not cleaned then schedulerWriter:hold(id, "FEATURE_INITIALIZE_CLEANUP_FAILED") end
            if ok then
                lifecycle(entries[id], "STOPPED")
                return false, cleaned and "STOPPED" or "FEATURE_INITIALIZE_CLEANUP_FAILED"
            end
            lifecycle(entries[id], "INITIALIZE_FAILED", {message = tostring(accepted)})
            return false, "FEATURE_INITIALIZE_FAILED", tostring(accepted)
        end
        entries[id].module, entries[id].policy = module, selected
        entries[id].disposed = false
        entries[id].disposeError = nil
        lifecycle(entries[id], "INITIALIZED")
        return true
    end
    function registry:register(id, module, policy)
        if initializing then return false, "FEATURE_INITIALIZATION_PENDING" end
        initializing = true
        local ok, registered, code, detail = pcall(register, id, module, policy)
        initializing = false
        if not ok then error(registered, 0) end
        return registered, code, detail
    end
    function registry:registerLegacy(id, handler)
        assert(type(handler) == "function", "Job handler must be callable")
        assert(not runtime:activeJob(), "Cannot replace handlers during a job")
        Contracts.assertKind(id)
        if stopped or not runtime:isAlive() then return false, "STOPPED" end
        if entries[id] and entries[id].module then return false, "FEATURE_ALREADY_REGISTERED" end
        local feature = {}
        function feature:initialize() end
        function feature:run(ctx, request) return handler(ctx, request) end
        function feature:cancel() end
        function feature:cleanup() end
        function feature:status() return state:featureSnapshot(id) end
        function feature:cooldown() return state:featureSnapshot(id).nextCheckAt end
        return self:register(id, feature)
    end
    function registry:unregister(id)
        if runtime:activeJob() then return false, "BUSY" end
        local entry = entries[id]
        if not entry or not entry.module then return false, "FEATURE_NOT_REGISTERED" end
        local feature = state:featureSnapshot(id)
        if feature.enabled or feature.returnPending or feature.proceedPending or feature.reportPending or feature.recovery
            or feature.manualHold or feature.hold then return false, "FEATURE_NOT_IDLE" end
        local ok, err = dispose(entry, "UNREGISTER")
        if not ok then return false, "FEATURE_CLEANUP_FAILED", tostring(err) end
        entry.module = nil
        lifecycle(entry, "UNREGISTERED")
        return true
    end
    function registry:has(id) return entries[id] ~= nil and entries[id].module ~= nil end
    function registry:status(id)
        local entry = entries[id]
        if not entry then return nil, "FEATURE_NOT_REGISTERED" end
        local snapshot = state:featureSnapshot(id)
        if entry.module then
            local ok, value = pcall(function() return entry.module:status() end)
            snapshot.detail = ok and Contracts.copy(value) or {code = "FEATURE_STATUS_FAILED", message = tostring(value)}
        end
        snapshot.id, snapshot.registered, snapshot.policy = id, entry.module ~= nil, Contracts.copy(entry.policy)
        return snapshot
    end
    function registry:list()
        local ids, result = {}, {}
        for id in pairs(entries) do ids[#ids + 1] = id end
        table.sort(ids)
        for _, id in ipairs(ids) do result[#result + 1] = self:status(id) end
        return result
    end
    function registry:readinessSnapshot(snapshot, now, checkpoint)
        -- Observe recorded state only. Feature probes may call into the platform.
        local records = {}
        local globalBlock
        if stopped or not runtime:isAlive() or not snapshot.runtime.alive then globalBlock = "STOPPED"
        elseif initializing then globalBlock = "FEATURE_INITIALIZATION_PENDING"
        elseif next(snapshot.holds) or snapshot.totem.manualHold then globalBlock = "HELD"
        elseif snapshot.totem.proceedPending then globalBlock = "TOTEM_PROCEED_PENDING"
        elseif not Contracts.isHomeWorld(snapshot.config.homeWorld) then globalBlock = "HOME_REQUIRED" end

        for id, entry in pairs(entries) do
            local feature, enabled = featureState(snapshot, id)
            local deadline = feature.nextCheckAt
            local recovery = feature.reportPending and "REPORT" or feature.returnPending and "RETURN"
                or feature.recovery and feature.recovery.stage
            local owns = checkpoint.ownership ~= "RELEASED" and checkpoint.kind == id
            local readiness, reason
            if owns then
                readiness = (recovery or checkpoint.stage == "RECOVER") and "RECOVERING" or "RUNNING"
                reason = checkpoint.phase
            elseif not enabled then readiness, reason = "DISABLED", "TOGGLE_OFF"
            elseif not entry.module or entry.disposed then readiness, reason = "BLOCKED", "FEATURE_UNAVAILABLE"
            elseif globalBlock then readiness, reason = "BLOCKED", snapshot.holds[id] or globalBlock
            elseif checkpoint.ownership ~= "RELEASED" then readiness, reason = "BLOCKED", "JOB_OWNED"
            elseif recovery then readiness, reason = "RECOVERING", recovery .. "_PENDING"
            elseif deadline and now < deadline then readiness, reason = "COOLDOWN", "LOCAL_RETRY_DEADLINE"
            else readiness, reason = "UNKNOWN", "SERVER_READINESS_UNOBSERVED" end
            records[id] = {
                enabled = enabled == true, registered = entry.module ~= nil,
                priority = entry.policy.priority, recoveryPriority = entry.policy.recoveryPriority,
                state = readiness, reason = reason, ownsJob = owns, stage = feature.stage,
                nextCheckAt = deadline, remaining = deadline and math.max(0, deadline - now) or nil,
            }
        end
        return records
    end
    function registry:poll()
        if stopped or initializing or runtime:activeJob() or not runtime:isAlive() then return end
        local ids = {}
        for id in pairs(entries) do ids[#ids + 1] = id end
        table.sort(ids)
        for _, id in ipairs(ids) do
            local entry = entries[id]
            if entry.module and entry.module.poll then
                local ok = pcall(function() entry.module:poll() end)
                if not ok then schedulerWriter:hold(id, "FEATURE_POLL_FAILED") end
            end
        end
    end

    local function liveBarrier(snapshot)
        if snapshot.chainError then return snapshot.chainError end
        if next(snapshot.holds) or snapshot.totem.manualHold then return "HELD" end
        if snapshot.totem.proceedPending then return "TOTEM_PROCEED_PENDING" end
        if pending(snapshot.totem) or pending(snapshot.boss) then return "UNRESOLVED_PENDING" end
        for _, feature in pairs(snapshot.features) do
            if pending(feature) then return "UNRESOLVED_PENDING" end
        end
    end
    function registry:liveBarrier() return liveBarrier(state:snapshot()) end
    function registry:recordRaidReturn()
        lastPeerByRank[FeaturePolicy.activityPriority("RAID")] = "RAID"
    end
    function registry:chainReturn(options)
        local snapshot = state:snapshot()
        local debt = snapshot.chain
        if not debt then return nil, "IDLE" end
        local blocked = liveBarrier(snapshot)
        if blocked then return nil, blocked end
        local entry, resources = entries.BOSS, FeaturePolicy.resources()
        if not entry or not entry.module or entry.disposed or not entry.policy.encounterRecovery
            or not entry.module.chainCompatible then return nil, "CHAIN_RETURN_CONTROLLER_UNAVAILABLE" end
        local conflict = options.resourceBlock and options.resourceBlock(resources)
        if conflict then return nil, conflict end
        return {kind="BOSS", bossId=debt.bossId, stage="CHAIN_RETURN", chainId=debt.id,
            chainReturn=true, recovery=true, resources=resources}
    end

    local function liveDue(feature, bossId)
        return math.max(feature.nextCheckAt or 0, bossId and feature.candidateRetryAt and feature.candidateRetryAt[bossId] or 0)
    end

    local function recoveryPending(snapshot)
        local entry, encounter = entries.BOSS, snapshot.boss.encounter
        if not entry or not entry.module or entry.disposed or not entry.policy.encounterRecovery
            or not encounter or encounter.phase == "COMPLETE" or not encounter.recovery then return nil end
        for id, code in pairs(snapshot.holds) do
            if id ~= "BOSS" or not FeaturePolicy.canReconcileBossHold(code) then return nil end
        end
        if snapshot.totem.manualHold or pending(snapshot.totem) then return nil end
        for _, feature in pairs(snapshot.features) do if pending(feature) then return nil end end
        return encounter
    end
    function registry:encounterRecovery(options)
        if options.recover then return nil end
        local snapshot = state:snapshot()
        if snapshot.chainError then return nil, snapshot.chainError end
        local encounter = recoveryPending(snapshot)
        if not encounter then return nil end
        local resources = FeaturePolicy.resources()
        local conflict = options.resourceBlock and options.resourceBlock(resources)
        local due = encounter.recovery.retryAt
        if conflict then
            if encounter.recovery.evidenceRecheck and due and due > runtime:now() then options.noteDeadline(due) end
            return nil, conflict
        end
        if due and due > runtime:now() then
            options.noteDeadline(due)
            return nil, "BOSS_RECOVERY_WAIT"
        end
        return {kind="BOSS", stage="ENCOUNTER_RECOVERY", recovery=true, encounterId=encounter.encounterId,
            bossId=encounter.bossId, resources=resources}
    end

    -- A durable verified offering is allowed to resume its *return only*.
    -- Before this route existed, TotemController's postProceedReturnRescue
    -- branch was unreachable and a transient return exception held P1 forever.
    -- Never resend Offer/Proceed or infer native success without a checkpoint.
    local function canRescueTotem(snapshot)
        local tx = snapshot.totem.transaction
        local postProceedReturn = tx ~= nil
            and tx.safeToClose == true
            and snapshot.totem.returnPending == true
            and not snapshot.totem.proceedPending
            and tx.phase ~= "COMPLETE" and tx.phase ~= "ABANDONED"
            and Contracts.isHomeWorld(tx.homeWorld)
            and ((tx.proceedAttempted == true and tx.offeringVerified == true)
                or (tx.dormantOnly == true and not tx.proceedAttempted))
        -- Uncertain Proceed is *never* resent. The existing quarantine flow
        -- only obtains fresh server evidence, then closes and returns if safe.
        local proceedQuarantine = tx ~= nil
            and tx.proceedAttempted == true and not tx.offeringVerified
            and not tx.safeToClose and snapshot.totem.proceedPending == true
            and (tx.quarantine == "PREPARED" or tx.quarantine == "RETURN_AUTHORIZED")
            and Contracts.isHomeWorld(tx.homeWorld)
        local pretravel = not postProceedReturn and not proceedQuarantine
            and snapshot.totem.manualHold == true
            and snapshot.totem.debugReason == "TOTEM_TRAVEL_DIRECT_WORLD_REJECTED"
            and snapshot.totem.stage == "HELD"
            and not snapshot.totem.proceedPending and not snapshot.totem.returnPending
            and not snapshot.totem.recovery
            and (not tx or tx.phase == "COMPLETE" or tx.phase == "ABANDONED")
            and (not snapshot.holds.TOTEM
                or snapshot.holds.TOTEM == "TOTEM_TRAVEL_DIRECT_WORLD_REJECTED")
        if not pretravel and not postProceedReturn and not proceedQuarantine then
            if not tx or tx.proceedAttempted or tx.offeringVerified or tx.safeToClose
                or snapshot.totem.proceedPending
                or (snapshot.totem.returnPending and tx.phase ~= "ABORTING")
                or tx.phase == "COMPLETE" or tx.phase == "ABANDONED" then return false end
            if not (snapshot.totem.manualHold or snapshot.holds.TOTEM or tx.phase == "ABORTING") then return false end
        end
        if not entries.TOTEM or not entries.TOTEM.module or entries.TOTEM.disposed then return false end
        if snapshot.chain or snapshot.boss.reportPending or snapshot.boss.returnPending
            or snapshot.boss.recovery or snapshot.boss.encounter
            and snapshot.boss.encounter.phase ~= "COMPLETE" then return false end
        for id in pairs(snapshot.holds) do if id ~= "TOTEM" then return false end end
        for _, feature in pairs(snapshot.features) do
            if pending(feature) then return false end
        end
        return true, pretravel, postProceedReturn, proceedQuarantine
    end
    local function selectLive(snapshot, options)
        local resources = FeaturePolicy.resources()
        local conflict = options.resourceBlock and options.resourceBlock(resources)
        if conflict then return nil, conflict end
        if options.recover then
            local entry = entries[options.recover]
            if not entry or not entry.module or entry.disposed or not entry.policy.readOnlyRecovery then
                return nil, "RECOVERY_NOT_SUPPORTED"
            end
            local feature = featureState(snapshot, entry.id)
            if not pending(feature) and not snapshot.holds[entry.id] then return nil, "NO_RECOVERY_PENDING" end
            local encounter = feature.encounter
            return {kind = entry.id, stage = "RECOVER", readOnly = true, recovery = true,
                bossId = encounter and encounter.phase ~= "COMPLETE" and encounter.bossId or nil,
                resources = resources}
        end
        -- RESCUE is not an ordinary RUN: it owns only reversible UI close
        -- and a verified return home, never a new offering. Backoff prevents
        -- a missing Cancel/Close button from producing a hot retry loop.
        local rescueAllowed, preTravelRescue, postProceedReturnRescue, proceedQuarantineRescue = canRescueTotem(snapshot)
        if rescueAllowed then
            local due = snapshot.totem.nextCheckAt or 0
            if due > runtime:now() then
                if options.noteDeadline then options.noteDeadline(due) end
                return nil, "TOTEM_RECOVERY_BACKOFF"
            end
            return {kind = "TOTEM", stage = "RECOVER", recovery = true,
                preProceedRescue = true, preTravelRescue = preTravelRescue,
                postProceedReturnRescue = postProceedReturnRescue,
                proceedQuarantineRescue = proceedQuarantineRescue,
                readOnly = false, resources = resources}
        end
        local blocked = liveBarrier(snapshot)
        if blocked then return nil, blocked end
        local sharedOk, shared = pcall(function()
            return type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv() or _G
        end)
        local marker = sharedOk and type(shared) == "table" and shared.PlaneRNGV6PostRaidHome or nil
        local settleUntil, settleReason = TotemTravelPriorityPolicy.postRaidWait(snapshot, runtime:now(), marker)
        if settleUntil then
            if options.noteDeadline then options.noteDeadline(settleUntil) end
            if lastPostRaidWaitToken ~= marker.token then
                lastPostRaidWaitToken = marker.token
                print("[V6 SCHEDULER] TOTEM_POST_RAID_SETTLE_WAIT",
                    "retryIn", tostring(math.ceil(settleUntil - runtime:now())),
                    "raid", tostring(marker.raidId), "raidDeferred", "true")
            end
            return nil, settleReason
        end
        lastPostRaidWaitToken = nil
        local debt = snapshot.chain
        if debt and (debt.restored or debt.draining or debt.successor
            or not snapshot.config.bossRepeat or not snapshot.config.bossEnabled) then
            return registry:chainReturn(options)
        end
        -- A native World-15 travel cooldown can be refreshed by the next Raid's
        -- world transitions. Give the previously READY Totem its actual retry
        -- boundary before handing P2 a new cross-place job. This is a WAIT,
        -- never a global HELD, and expires using the server-rejection gate.
        local waitUntil, waitReason = TotemTravelPriorityPolicy.wait(
            snapshot, runtime:now(), runtime:epoch())
        if waitUntil then
            if options.noteDeadline then options.noteDeadline(waitUntil) end
            if lastTravelWaitEpoch ~= snapshot.totem.travelRetryUntilEpoch then
                lastTravelWaitEpoch = snapshot.totem.travelRetryUntilEpoch
                print("[V6 SCHEDULER] TOTEM_TRAVEL_PRIORITY_WAIT",
                    "retryIn", tostring(math.ceil(waitUntil - runtime:now())),
                    "reason", "SERVER_WORLD_TRAVEL_COOLDOWN", "raidDeferred", "true")
            end
            return nil, waitReason
        end
        lastTravelWaitEpoch = nil
        local settings = state:settingsSnapshot()
        local plans = {}
        for id, entry in pairs(entries) do
            local _, enabled = featureState(snapshot, id)
            if enabled and entry.module and not entry.disposed then
                plans[#plans + 1] = {kind = id, stage = "RUN", rank = FeaturePolicy.activityPriority(id),
                    peer = id, resources = resources}
            end
        end
        table.sort(plans, function(a, b)
            if a.rank ~= b.rank then return a.rank < b.rank end
            local lastPeer = lastPeerByRank[a.rank]
            if lastPeer then
                local aWrapped, bWrapped = a.peer <= lastPeer, b.peer <= lastPeer
                if aWrapped ~= bWrapped then return not aWrapped end
