            end
            return a.peer < b.peer
        end)
        local observationPlan
        -- Auto Raid must not outrun an enabled Totem whose server Query is still
        -- unresolved. This does not preempt a running job or change Boss policy.
        local totemUnverified = snapshot.config.totemEnabled and
            (not entries.TOTEM.module or entries.TOTEM.disposed == true)
        -- P1 preflight: the Totem's *local* nextCheckAt only limits when its
        -- controller may RUN; it must not prevent a read-only server Query.
        -- Previously, if Dungeon was due before that time, the Totem was
        -- skipped entirely and P3 could teleport while P1 was already READY.
        -- Refresh authoritative evidence before admitting any lower-tier job.
        local hasLowerTier = false
        for _, candidate in ipairs(plans) do
            if candidate.kind ~= "TOTEM" then hasLowerTier = true; break end
        end
        if hasLowerTier and snapshot.config.totemEnabled and not totemUnverified
            and liveDue(snapshot.totem) > runtime:now() then
            local evidence = options.live:observe("TOTEM", nil, options.revision,
                options.checkDispatch, options.noteDeadline, resources, settings)
            local current, code = options.checkDispatch()
            if not current then return nil, code end
            if evidence and evidence.state == "READY" and options.live:isReady("TOTEM", nil, evidence) then
                -- A proven server READY outranks a stale local polling deadline.
                -- Clear only the Totem's non-travel check deadline. The global
                -- native travel-rejection gate has already been handled above.
                schedulerWriter:schedule("TOTEM", runtime:now())
                if options.noteDeadline then options.noteDeadline(runtime:now() + 0.05) end
                print("[V6 SCHEDULER] TOTEM_P1_READY_EARLY", "localCheckWasLater", "true",
                    "P3Deferred", "true")
                return nil, "TOTEM_P1_READY_EARLY"
            end
            -- READY but already consumed is not fresh authorization to RUN;
            -- UNKNOWN/pending can never authorize Dungeon/Raid/Rift either.
            -- A verified COOLDOWN or BLOCKED packet safely permits P2/P3.
            totemUnverified = not evidence or evidence.state == "UNKNOWN"
                or evidence.state == "READY"
        end
        local function nextActivity(plan)
            if not debt then return plan end
            local module = entries[plan.kind].module
            if plan.kind == "BOSS" and module.chainCompatible
                and module:chainCompatible(plan.bossId, debt) then
                plan.chainId = debt.id
                return plan
            end
            return registry:chainReturn(options)
        end
        local function probe(plan, feature, bossId)
            local due = liveDue(feature, bossId)
            if due > runtime:now() then
                options.noteDeadline(due)
                return
            end
            local sample = options.live:observe(plan.kind, bossId, options.revision,
                options.checkDispatch, options.noteDeadline, plan.resources, settings)
            if options.live:isReady(plan.kind, bossId, sample) then
                plan.bossId, plan.observation = bossId, sample
                return plan
            end
            if not observationPlan and bossId and entries[plan.kind].policy.hideoutObservation
                and options.live:needsObservation(sample) then
                observationPlan = {kind = plan.kind, stage = "OBSERVE_HIDEOUT", probeBossId = bossId,
                    probe = sample, resources = resources}
            end
            return nil, sample
        end
        local raidIds = {}
        for _, candidate in ipairs(snapshot.config.raidCandidates) do raidIds[candidate.id] = true end
        for _, plan in ipairs(plans) do
            local feature = featureState(snapshot, plan.kind)
            -- After a Dungeon cycle, P1 gets a fresh server Query before P3
            -- is allowed to start another Solo; never skip an UNKNOWN Totem.
            if (plan.kind == "RAID" or plan.kind == "DUNGEON" or plan.kind == "RIFT") and totemUnverified then
                return nil, "TOTEM_PRIORITY_READINESS_PENDING"
            end
            if plan.kind == "BOSS" or plan.kind == "RAID" then
                local candidates = plan.kind == "RAID" and snapshot.config.raidCandidates or feature.candidates
                for _, candidate in ipairs(candidates) do
                    if candidate.enabled and (plan.kind == "RAID" or not raidIds[candidate.id]) then
                        local selected = probe(plan, feature, candidate.id)
                        local current, code = options.checkDispatch()
                        if not current then return nil, code end
                        if selected then return nextActivity(selected) end
                    end
                end
            else
                local selected, sample = probe(plan, feature)
                local current, code = options.checkDispatch()
                if not current then return nil, code end
                if selected then return nextActivity(selected) end
                if plan.kind == "TOTEM" and liveDue(feature) <= runtime:now()
                    and (not sample or sample.state == "UNKNOWN"
                        or sample.state == "READY" and not options.live:isReady("TOTEM", nil, sample)) then
                    -- A prior job may have consumed an otherwise cached READY.
                    -- Wait for fresh native evidence instead of starting P3.
                    totemUnverified = true
                end
            end
        end
        if debt then return registry:chainReturn(options) end
        return observationPlan, not observationPlan and "IDLE" or nil
    end

    function registry:validateLive(plan, options)
        local conflict = options.resourceBlock and options.resourceBlock(plan.resources)
        if conflict then return false, conflict end
        if plan.readOnly then return true end
        local snapshot = state:snapshot()
        if plan.preProceedRescue then
            -- Never bypass a raid, boss recovery, unknown hold, or Proceed.
            return canRescueTotem(snapshot), "TOTEM_RESCUE_CONDITION_CHANGED"
        end
        if plan.chainId then
            local debt = snapshot.chain
            if not debt or debt.id ~= plan.chainId then return false, "CHAIN_CHANGED" end
            if plan.chainReturn then
                local barrier = liveBarrier(snapshot)
                return not barrier, barrier
            end
            if debt.draining or debt.successor or not entries.BOSS.module:chainCompatible(plan.bossId, debt) then
                return false, "CHAIN_LOCATION_CHANGED"
            end
        end
        if plan.encounterId then
            local encounter = recoveryPending(snapshot)
            return encounter ~= nil and encounter.encounterId == plan.encounterId, "RECOVERY_ENCOUNTER_CHANGED"
        end
        local blocked = liveBarrier(snapshot)
        if blocked then return false, blocked end
        local feature = featureState(snapshot, plan.kind)
        if liveDue(feature, plan.bossId or plan.probeBossId) > runtime:now() then return false, "LOCAL_RETRY_PENDING" end
        if plan.probe then
            if not options.live:needsObservation(plan.probe) then return false, "READINESS_STALE" end
            return true
        end
        if not options.live:isReady(plan.kind, plan.bossId, plan.observation) then return false, "READINESS_STALE" end
        return true
    end

    function registry:liveReadiness(snapshot, checkpoint, readiness, revision, pause, resourceBlock)
        local now = runtime:now()
        local resourceReason, resource, owner
        if resourceBlock then resourceReason, resource, owner = resourceBlock(FeaturePolicy.resources()) end
        local safety = liveBarrier(snapshot)
        if not safety and not Contracts.isHomeWorld(snapshot.config.homeWorld) then safety = "HOME_REQUIRED" end
        local records, settings = {}, state:settingsSnapshot()
        local function record(entry, feature, enabled, bossId)
            local registered = entry.module ~= nil and not entry.disposed
            local due = liveDue(feature, bossId)
            local preview = bossId and enabled and registered and not safety and not pause and not resourceReason
                and due <= now and settings or nil
            local result = readiness:record(entry.id, bossId, revision, preview)
            result.observedState = due <= now and result.state or "COOLDOWN"
            result.kind, result.bossId, result.enabled = entry.id, bossId, enabled
            result.resources, result.priority = FeaturePolicy.resources(), FeaturePolicy.activityPriority(entry.id)
            result.registered = registered
            result.availability = result.registered and "MANAGED" or entry.mode or "UNAVAILABLE"
            result.availabilityReason = not result.registered and (entry.reason or "FEATURE_UNAVAILABLE") or nil
            if bossId and registered and type(entry.module.availability) == "function" then
                local ok, mode, reason = pcall(entry.module.availability, entry.module, bossId)
                if ok and (mode == "UNAVAILABLE" or mode == "EXTERNAL") then
                    result.availability, result.availabilityReason = mode, reason
                end
            end
            result.stage = feature.stage
            result.recoveryEligible = registered and entry.policy.readOnlyRecovery == true
                and (pending(feature) and true or snapshot.holds[entry.id] ~= nil)
            local owns = checkpoint.ownership ~= "RELEASED" and checkpoint.kind == entry.id
                and (not bossId or checkpoint.bossId == bossId)
            if owns then result.state, result.reason = "RUNNING", checkpoint.phase
            elseif not enabled then result.state, result.reason = "BLOCKED", "TOGGLE_OFF"
            elseif result.availability ~= "MANAGED" then result.state, result.reason = "BLOCKED", result.availabilityReason
            elseif safety or pause or resourceReason or checkpoint.ownership ~= "RELEASED" then
                result.state, result.reason = "BLOCKED", safety or pause or resourceReason or "JOB_OWNED"
                if result.reason == resourceReason then result.blockedResource, result.externalOwner = resource, owner end
            elseif due > now then result.state, result.reason, result.nextCheckAt = "COOLDOWN", "LOCAL_RETRY_DEADLINE", due end
            return result
        end
        for id, entry in pairs(entries) do
            local feature, enabled = featureState(snapshot, id)
            records[id] = record(entry, feature, enabled == true)
            if id == "BOSS" or id == "RAID" then
                local candidates = {}
                local ready, earliest, first
                for _, candidate in ipairs(id == "RAID" and snapshot.config.raidCandidates or feature.candidates) do
                    local current = record(entry, feature, enabled == true and candidate.enabled, candidate.id)
                    current.candidateEnabled = candidate.enabled
                    candidates[#candidates + 1] = current
                    if current.enabled then
                        first = first or current
                        if current.state == "READY" then ready = ready or current end
                        if current.nextCheckAt and current.nextCheckAt > now then
                            earliest = math.min(earliest or current.nextCheckAt, current.nextCheckAt)
                        end
                    end
                end
                local summary = records[id]
                if summary.state == "UNKNOWN" then
                    local chosen = ready or first
                    summary.state = chosen and chosen.state or "BLOCKED"
                    summary.reason = chosen and chosen.reason or (not chosen and "NO_ENABLED_CANDIDATES" or nil)
                    summary.observedAt, summary.validUntil = chosen and chosen.observedAt, chosen and chosen.validUntil
                    summary.nextCheckAt = earliest
                end
                summary.candidates = candidates
            end
        end
        return records, safety or pause or resourceReason or (checkpoint.ownership ~= "RELEASED" and "JOB_OWNED" or nil)
    end

    function registry:select(options)
        local snapshot = state:snapshot()
        if stopped or not runtime:isAlive() or not snapshot.runtime.alive then return nil, "STOPPED" end
        if initializing then return nil, "FEATURE_INITIALIZATION_PENDING" end
        if runtime:activeJob() or snapshot.runtime.busy then return nil, "BUSY" end
        if not snapshot.chain and not Contracts.isHomeWorld(snapshot.config.homeWorld) then return nil, "HOME_REQUIRED" end
        if options and options.live then return selectLive(snapshot, options) end
        if options and options.recover then
            local entry = entries[options.recover]
            if not entry or not entry.module or not entry.policy.readOnlyRecovery then return nil, "RECOVERY_NOT_SUPPORTED" end
            return {kind = entry.id, stage = "RECOVER", readOnly = true, recovery = true}
        end
        self:poll()
        snapshot = state:snapshot()
        if stopped or not runtime:isAlive() or not snapshot.runtime.alive then return nil, "STOPPED" end
        if initializing or runtime:activeJob() or snapshot.runtime.busy then return nil, "BUSY" end
        if next(snapshot.holds) or snapshot.totem.manualHold then return nil, "HELD" end
        if snapshot.totem.proceedPending then return nil, "TOTEM_PROCEED_PENDING" end
        local plans = {}
        for id, entry in pairs(entries) do
            local cooldown = 0
            if entry.module then
                local ok, value = pcall(function() return entry.module:cooldown() end)
                if not ok or not Contracts.isFinite(value) or value < 0 then
                    schedulerWriter:hold(id, "FEATURE_COOLDOWN_FAILED")
                    return nil, "HELD"
                end
                cooldown = value
            end
            plans[#plans + 1] = FeaturePolicy.plan(entry, state:featureSnapshot(id), runtime:now(), cooldown)
        end
        return FeaturePolicy.select(plans, lastPeerByRank)
    end
    function registry:begin(plan, context, request)
        local entry = assert(entries[plan.kind])
        assert(entry.module, "Feature not registered")
        entry.cancelledJob = nil
        entry.runningJob = context
        -- Recovery is allowed to finish before any new job; normal jobs advance
        -- only their own tier's cursor (Boss/Raid P2; Rift/Dungeon P3).
        if plan.stage == "RUN" and plan.rank then
            lastPeerByRank[plan.rank] = plan.peer or plan.kind
        end
        lifecycle(entry, "RUNNING")
        local result
        -- Registered before feature resources so module cleanup runs after local releases.
        context:deferCleanup(function()
            local ok, err = pcall(function() entry.module:cleanup(context, result) end)
            entry.runningJob = nil
            local disposed, disposeError = true, nil
            if stopped then disposed, disposeError = dispose(entry, "SHUTDOWN") end
            if not ok then error(tostring(err), 0) end
            if not disposed then error(tostring(disposeError), 0) end
        end)
        if entry.policy.countChecks and plan.stage == "RUN" then
            schedulerWriter:recordTotemCheck(runtime:epoch(), runtime:now() + profile.totem.initialRetry)
        end
        result = entry.module:run(context, request)
        return result
    end
    function registry:cancel(id, context, reason)
        local entry = entries[id]
        if not entry or not entry.module or not context or entry.runningJob ~= context
            or context:isClosed() or context:isClosing()
            or entry.cancelledJob == context then return end
        entry.cancelledJob = context
        lifecycle(entry, "CANCELLING")
        local pending, failure = true, nil
        context:deferCleanup(function()
            if pending then error("CANCEL_CALLBACK_UNRESOLVED", 0) end
            if failure then error(failure, 0) end
        end)
        local ok, err = pcall(function() entry.module:cancel(context, reason) end)
        pending = false
        if not ok then failure = tostring(err) end
    end
    function registry:apply(id, result, livePlan)
        local entry = assert(entries[id])
        local feature = state:featureSnapshot(id)
        if result.status == "COMPLETED" and (feature.reportPending or feature.returnPending
            or feature.proceedPending or feature.recovery or feature.manualHold or feature.hold
            or livePlan and pending(feature)) then
            result = Contracts.result("HELD", "CHECKPOINT_UNVERIFIED", {stage = result.stage, evidence = result})
        end
        if result.status == "DEFERRED" or result.status == "COMPLETED" and result.retryAt ~= nil then
            -- Observation travel has its own retry limit. It must not delay a fresh READY sample.
            if not (livePlan and (livePlan.probe or livePlan.encounterId and result.status == "DEFERRED")) then schedulerWriter:schedule(id, result.retryAt, livePlan and livePlan.bossId) end
        elseif result.status == "HELD" then schedulerWriter:hold(id, result.code)
        elseif result.status == "FAILED" then schedulerWriter:stopFeature(id, result.code) end
        if result.stopFeature then schedulerWriter:stopFeature(id, result.code) end
        if not livePlan and result.status == "COMPLETED" and result.retryAt == nil
            and not FeaturePolicy.canComplete(state:featureSnapshot(id)) then
            schedulerWriter:hold(id, "MISSING_NEXT_CHECK")
            result = Contracts.result("HELD", "MISSING_NEXT_CHECK", {stage = result.stage})
        end
        lifecycle(entry, result.status, result)
        return result
    end
    function registry:shutdown()
        stopped = true
        local context, errors = runtime:activeJob(), {}
        if initializing then errors[#errors + 1] = "FEATURE_INITIALIZATION_PENDING" end
        for id, entry in pairs(entries) do
            if entry.module and (not context or context.kind ~= id) then
                local ok, err = dispose(entry, "SHUTDOWN")
                if not ok then errors[#errors + 1] = tostring(err) end
            end
        end
        return #errors == 0, errors
    end
    return registry
end

return FeatureRegistry
end
-- END MODULE main.core.FeatureRegistry

-- BEGIN MODULE main.core.AntiAFKF15
__factories["main.core.AntiAFKF15"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- PlaneRNG V6 background Anti-AFK (F15). Adapted from src/main/stable/AntiAFK_F15.lua.
-- Tested mechanism: one F15 down/up via VirtualInputManager; game/Roblox idle reset
-- observed live in Potassium. This module never calls game remotes or schedules jobs.
local AntiAFKF15 = {}

function AntiAFKF15.new(options)
    options = options or {}
    local player = assert(options.player, "F15_PLAYER_REQUIRED")
    local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local now = options.now or os.clock
    local interval = tonumber(options.interval) or 75
    interval = math.max(30, math.min(120, interval))
    local state = {
        started = false, stopped = false, busy = false,
        enabled = options.enabled ~= false,
        interval = interval, nextAt = now() + 5,
        pulses = 0, inputEvents = 0,
        lastStatus = "F15_WAITING", lastBefore = nil, lastAfter = nil,
        lastInputBefore = nil, lastInputAfter = nil,
        lastRobloxBefore = nil, lastRobloxAfter = nil,
    }
    local controller = {}
    local function safeAttribute(key)
        local ok, value = pcall(player.GetAttribute, player, key)
        if ok then return tonumber(value) end
    end
    local function permitted()
        if not state.enabled or state.stopped then return false, "DISABLED" end
        if type(options.isAutomationEnabled) == "function" then
            local ok, active = pcall(options.isAutomationEnabled)
            if not ok or active ~= true then return false, "AUTOMATION_OFF" end
        end
        if type(options.isCriticalJob) == "function" then
            local ok, hold = pcall(options.isCriticalJob)
            if not ok or hold then return false, "CRITICAL_JOB" end
        end
        return true
    end
    local function emit(...)
        print("[V6 ANTI-AFK F15]", ...)
    end
    local function pulse()
        local allowed, reason = permitted()
        if not allowed then return false, reason end
        if state.busy then return false, "PULSE_IN_PROGRESS" end
        state.busy = true
        local before = safeAttribute("AntiAfkIdleSeconds")
        local inputBefore = safeAttribute("AntiAfkIdleByInput")
        local robloxBefore = safeAttribute("AntiAfkIdleByRoblox")
        local received = 0
        local listener
        local connected, connectError = pcall(function()
            listener = UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
                if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F15 and processed == false then
                    received += 1
                end
            end)
        end)
        if not connected then
            state.lastStatus = "F15_LISTENER_FAILED"
            emit(state.lastStatus, tostring(connectError))
            state.nextAt, state.busy = now() + interval, false
            return false, state.lastStatus
        end
        local vimOk, vim = pcall(game.GetService, game, "VirtualInputManager")
        local pressOk, pressError = false, "VIRTUAL_INPUT_UNAVAILABLE"
        local releaseOk, releaseError = false, "VIRTUAL_INPUT_UNAVAILABLE"
        if vimOk and vim then
            pressOk, pressError = pcall(function()
                vim:SendKeyEvent(true, Enum.KeyCode.F15, false, game)
            end)
            if pressOk then task.wait(0.09) end
            -- Always attempt release, including if the press raises an error.
            releaseOk, releaseError = pcall(function()
                vim:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.F15, false, game)
            end)
        end
        task.wait(2.7)
        if listener then pcall(function() listener:Disconnect() end) end
        state.busy = false
        if state.stopped then return false, "STOPPED" end
        local after = safeAttribute("AntiAfkIdleSeconds")
        local inputAfter = safeAttribute("AntiAfkIdleByInput")
        local robloxAfter = safeAttribute("AntiAfkIdleByRoblox")
        state.pulses += 1
        state.inputEvents += received
        state.lastBefore, state.lastAfter = before, after
        state.lastInputBefore, state.lastInputAfter = inputBefore, inputAfter
        state.lastRobloxBefore, state.lastRobloxAfter = robloxBefore, robloxAfter
        if not pressOk or not releaseOk then
            state.lastStatus = "F15_INPUT_FAILED"
            warn("[V6 ANTI-AFK F15]", state.lastStatus,
                tostring(pressError), tostring(releaseError))
        elseif received == 0 then
            state.lastStatus = "F15_NOT_OBSERVED"
        elseif before ~= nil and before >= 8 and after ~= nil and after <= 6
            and (inputAfter == nil or inputAfter <= 6) then
            state.lastStatus = "GAME_IDLE_RESET_VERIFIED"
        else
            state.lastStatus = "F15_RECEIVED_RESET_UNVERIFIED"
        end
        emit(state.lastStatus, "idle", tostring(before), "->", tostring(after),
            "input", tostring(inputBefore), "->", tostring(inputAfter),
            "roblox", tostring(robloxBefore), "->", tostring(robloxAfter),
            "F15", received, "pulse", state.pulses)
        state.nextAt = now() + interval
        return state.lastStatus == "GAME_IDLE_RESET_VERIFIED", state.lastStatus
    end
    function controller:start()
        if state.stopped then return false, "STOPPED" end
        if state.started then return true end
        state.started = true
        emit("START", "interval", interval, "enabled", state.enabled)
        task.spawn(function()
            while not state.stopped do
                if not state.busy and now() >= state.nextAt then
                    local allowed = permitted()
                    if allowed then
                        local ok, err = pcall(pulse)
                        if not ok then
                            state.busy = false
                            state.lastStatus = "F15_UNEXPECTED_ERROR"
                            warn("[V6 ANTI-AFK F15]", state.lastStatus, tostring(err))
                            state.nextAt = now() + interval
                        end
                    else
                        state.nextAt = now() + 5
                    end
                end
                task.wait(1)
            end
        end)
        return true
    end
    function controller:testPulse()
        local allowed, reason = permitted()
        if not allowed then return false, reason end
        if state.busy then return false, "PULSE_IN_PROGRESS" end
        -- Immediate one-shot test shares the same guard, listener, and verification.
        -- Move the periodic deadline forward first so it cannot double-dispatch.
        state.nextAt = now() + interval
        local ok, result, code = pcall(pulse)
        if not ok then
            state.busy = false
            state.lastStatus = "F15_UNEXPECTED_ERROR"
            warn("[V6 ANTI-AFK F15]", state.lastStatus, tostring(result))
            state.nextAt = now() + interval
            return false, state.lastStatus
        end
        return result, code
    end
    function controller:status()
        return {
            enabled = state.enabled, started = state.started, stopped = state.stopped,
            busy = state.busy, interval = state.interval, nextAt = state.nextAt,
            pulses = state.pulses, inputEvents = state.inputEvents,
            lastStatus = state.lastStatus, lastBefore = state.lastBefore,
            lastAfter = state.lastAfter, lastInputBefore = state.lastInputBefore,
            lastInputAfter = state.lastInputAfter,
            lastRobloxBefore = state.lastRobloxBefore,
            lastRobloxAfter = state.lastRobloxAfter,
        }
    end
    function controller:stop()
        state.stopped = true
        state.enabled = false
        return true
    end
    return controller
end
return AntiAFKF15
end
-- END MODULE main.core.AntiAFKF15
-- BEGIN MODULE main.core.LiveHost
__factories["main.core.LiveHost"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local Contracts = require("main.core.Contracts")
local LiveScheduler = require("main.core.LiveScheduler")
local FeatureAdapters = require("main.core.FeatureAdapters")
local SettingsStore = require("main.core.SettingsStore")
local RaidHandoffState = require("main.core.RaidHandoffState")
local StandaloneRaidJournal = require("main.core.StandaloneRaidJournal")
local UniversalRecoveryPolicy = require("main.core.UniversalRecoveryPolicy")
local RaidIsolationPolicy = require("main.core.RaidIsolationPolicy")
local StandaloneRaidForceReset = require("main.core.StandaloneRaidForceReset")
local FinalColossus = require("boss.FinalColossus.Config")
local OmegaSkyTitan = require("boss.OmegaSkyTitan.Config")
local BossCatalog = require("main.config.BossCatalog")
local RaidCatalog = require("main.config.RaidCatalog")
local ConfigurationBinding = require("main.gui.ConfigurationBinding")
local ConfigurationPanel = require("main.gui.ConfigurationPanel")
local LiveHost = {}
local toggleSettings = {BOSS = "bossEnabled", RAID = "raidEnabled", DUNGEON = "dungeonEnabled",
    TOTEM = "totemEnabled", RIFT = "riftEnabled"}

local function route(config)
    return {sourcePlaceId = config.mainPlaceId, destinationPlaceId = config.raidPlaceId,
        isDifficulty = config.isDifficulty}
end
local defaultRoutes = {
    [FinalColossus.bossId] = route(FinalColossus),
    [OmegaSkyTitan.bossId] = route(OmegaSkyTitan),
    [RaidCatalog.SANDWORM.bossId] = route(RaidCatalog.SANDWORM),
}

function LiveHost.new(options)
    local clock, timer, host, provider = options.clock, options.timer, options.host, options.readiness
    local autoInspect, inspectInterval = options.autoInspect == true, options.pollInterval or 5
    assert(type(host) == "table" and type(host.inspect) == "function", "Supported host inspection required")
    assert(host.attach == nil or type(host.attach) == "function", "Invalid host attach")
    assert(provider == nil or type(provider) == "table" and type(provider.observe) == "function", "Invalid readiness provider")
    local features = {}
    for kind, spec in pairs(options.features or {}) do features[kind] = spec end
    local settings = SettingsStore.new({
        clock = clock, timer = timer, storage = options.storage, defaults = options.settings,
        debounce = options.debounce, key = options.settingsKey,
    })
    local standaloneMode=options.standaloneRaidEnabled==true
    local handoff=(standaloneMode and StandaloneRaidJournal or RaidHandoffState).new({
        clock=clock,storage=options.raidStorage or options.storage,
        routes=options.raidRoutes or defaultRoutes,ttl=options.handoffTTL,
        mintToken=options.mintToken,key=options.raidKey,
        host=host,userId=options.userId,archiveStorage=options.raidArchiveStorage,
    })
    assert((options.settingsKey or "plane-rng-v6-settings") ~= (options.raidKey or "plane-rng-v6-raid-handoff"),
        "Settings and raid handoff need distinct storage keys")
    local app = {}
    local runRaid
    local riftBridge = options.riftBridge
    local bridge = options.raidAdapter
    local hasRaidBridge = type(bridge) == "table" and type(bridge.observe) == "function"
        and type(bridge.launch) == "function"
    local function bridgeStatus(id)
        if not hasRaidBridge then
            if type(host.raidUnavailableReason) == "function" then
                local ok, reason = pcall(host.raidUnavailableReason, host, id)
                if ok and type(reason) == "string" and reason ~= "" then return reason end
            end
            return "RAID_RUNNER_BRIDGE_UNAVAILABLE"
        end
        if not standaloneMode and type(host.verifyRaidEvent) ~= "function" then return "HANDOFF_VERIFIER_UNAVAILABLE" end
        if type(options.mintToken) ~= "function" then return "HANDOFF_TOKEN_UNAVAILABLE" end
        local code = handoff:status().code
        if code then return code end
        if not handoff:isManagedRaid(id) then return "UNKNOWN_RAID_ROUTE" end
        if type(bridge.supports) == "function" then
            local ok, supported, why = pcall(bridge.supports, bridge, id)
            if not ok or supported ~= true then
                return ok and type(why) == "string" and why or "RAID_ROUTE_UNSUPPORTED"
            end
        end
    end
    local function difficulty(settingsSnapshot, raidId)
        local configured = settingsSnapshot.preferences and settingsSnapshot.preferences.raidDifficulty
        return configured and configured[raidId] or RaidCatalog[raidId].defaultDifficulty
    end
    if hasRaidBridge then
        local raidReadiness = {}
        local function observe(method, query)
            local id = query.bossId
            if not RaidCatalog.contains(id) or bridgeStatus(id) then return nil end
            local selected = difficulty(query.settings or {}, id)
            query.raidId, query.difficulty = id, selected
            local sample = bridge[method](bridge, query)
            if type(sample) == "table" and sample.verified == true and sample.raidId == id
                and sample.difficulty == selected then return sample end
        end
        function raidReadiness:observe(query) return observe("observe", query) end
        if type(bridge.peek) == "function" then
            function raidReadiness:peek(query) return observe("peek", query) end
        end
        if type(bridge.subscribe) == "function" then
            function raidReadiness:subscribe(callback) return bridge:subscribe(callback) end
        end
        features.RAID = {readiness = raidReadiness, controller = {
            run = function(_, context, request) return runRaid(context, request) end,
            availability = function(_, id)
                local reason = bridgeStatus(id)
                if reason then return "UNAVAILABLE", reason end
            end,
        }}
    end
    local adapters = FeatureAdapters.new(features, provider, host)
    local gui = ConfigurationBinding.new(app, clock, timer, options.guiRefreshInterval)
    local statusChanged = Contracts.signal()
    local driver, requested, transitioning, placeSafe, readinessFloor, inspectCode, attachHold, lastRaidReturn
    local stopAfterChain
    -- A disabled Rift must never keep a stale, fully terminal local hold that
    -- starves Raid. Only reconcile that one hold with native evidence.
    local function reconcileDisabledRiftHold(origin)
        if not driver or not riftBridge or type(riftBridge.verifyDisabledTerminalIdle) ~= "function" then return end
        local snapshot=driver:snapshot()
        local rift=snapshot.features and snapshot.features.RIFT
        if not rift or rift.enabled or snapshot.holds.RIFT ~= "RIFT_TERMINAL_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE" then return end
        local checkpoint=driver:checkpoint()
        if checkpoint.ownership ~= "RELEASED" or snapshot.runtime.busy then return end
        local safe,reason=riftBridge:verifyDisabledTerminalIdle(snapshot.config.homeWorld)
        if not safe then
            print("[V6 RIFT OFF] HOLD_RETAINED",tostring(reason),"origin",tostring(origin))
            return
        end
        local ok,code=driver:releaseDisabledRiftHold(true)
        if ok then
            print("[V6 RIFT OFF] LOCAL_HOLD_RELEASED",tostring(origin),"P1_TOTEM_P2_RAID_RECHECK")
        else
            print("[V6 RIFT OFF] HOLD_RETAINED",tostring(code),"origin",tostring(origin))
        end
    end
    local transitionEpoch = 0
    local nextInspection = 0
    local nextRaidReconcile, lastRaidRecoveredToken, lastRaidReviewToken = 0, nil, nil
    local lastRaidIsolatedToken
    local inspectedPlace, raidDisconnect, raidGeneration, raidObserverCode, raidEventCode = nil, nil, 0

    local readiness = {}
    local function blockedCandidate(bossId)
        if bossId and handoff:blocksRaid(bossId) then return "RAID_HANDOFF_UNAVAILABLE" end
        if not standaloneMode and bossId and handoff:isManagedRaid(bossId) and type(host.verifyRaidEvent) ~= "function" then
            return "HANDOFF_VERIFIER_UNAVAILABLE"
        end
    end
    function readiness:observe(query)
        if not placeSafe then return nil end
        local blocked = blockedCandidate(query.bossId)
        if blocked then
            local now = clock.now()
            local due = now + (options.pollInterval or 5)
            return {state = "BLOCKED", reason = blocked, observedAt = now, validUntil = due, nextCheckAt = due}
        end
        local observation = adapters:observe(query)
        if not placeSafe or blockedCandidate(query.bossId) or type(observation) ~= "table"
            or not Contracts.isFinite(observation.observedAt)
            or observation.observedAt < readinessFloor then return nil end
        return observation
    end
    function readiness:subscribe(callback) return adapters:subscribe(callback) end
    function readiness:peek(query)
        if not placeSafe or blockedCandidate(query.bossId) then return nil end
        local observation = adapters:peek(query)
        if type(observation) == "table" and Contracts.isFinite(observation.observedAt)
            and observation.observedAt >= readinessFloor then return observation end
    end

    local function resourceBlock(required)
        local statuses = adapters:externalStatus()
        for _, kind in ipairs({"DUNGEON", "RIFT", "TOTEM", "BOSS", "RAID"}) do
            local external = statuses[kind]
            if external and external.state == "RUNNING" then return "EXTERNAL_RESOURCE_BUSY", required[1], kind end
            if external and external.state == "UNKNOWN" then return external.reason, required[1], kind end
        end
        if type(host.resourceOwners) ~= "function" then return nil end
        local ok, owners = pcall(host.resourceOwners, host)
        if not ok or type(owners) ~= "table" then return "RESOURCE_STATE_UNVERIFIED" end
        for _, resource in ipairs(required) do
            local owner = owners[resource]
            if owner ~= nil then
                if type(owner) ~= "string" or owner == "" then return "RESOURCE_STATE_UNVERIFIED", resource end
                return "EXTERNAL_RESOURCE_BUSY", resource, owner
            end
        end
    end

    local function inspect()
        local ok, evidence = pcall(host.inspect, host)
        if not ok or type(evidence) ~= "table" or not Contracts.isHomeWorld(evidence.placeId)
            then return nil, "HOST_INSPECTION_FAILED" end
        inspectedPlace = evidence.placeId
        if not Contracts.isHomeWorld(evidence.world) then return nil, "HOST_INSPECTION_FAILED" end
        return evidence
    end
    local function safePlace(evidence)
        return evidence ~= nil and evidence.schedulerSafe == true and not handoff:isRaidPlace(evidence.placeId)
    end
    local function isolatedRaidHold(plan)
        -- Quarantine is limited to a verified HOME return with missing native
        -- outcome. An ambiguous in-flight/expired handoff still blocks globally.
        if not standaloneMode or not requested or transitioning or not placeSafe
            or not driver then return false end
        local status = handoff:status()
        if status.code ~= "RAID_NATIVE_OUTCOME_MISSING" then return false end
        local ok, evidence = pcall(host.inspect, host)
        local checkpoint = driver:checkpoint()
        local permitted = ok and RaidIsolationPolicy.allowOtherJobs(status, evidence, checkpoint, plan)
        if permitted and status.record.token ~= lastRaidIsolatedToken then
            lastRaidIsolatedToken = status.record.token
            print("[V6 RAID RECOVERY] ISOLATED_MISSING_OUTCOME", status.record.raidId,
                "TOTEM_BOSS_ALLOWED RAID_REPEAT_BLOCKED")
        end
        return permitted
    end
    local function currentPause(plan)
        if not requested or not placeSafe then return "HOST_STATE_UNVERIFIED" end
        local blocked = handoff:pauseReason()
        if blocked and isolatedRaidHold(plan) then return nil end
        return blocked
    end
    local function updateInspection(wasSafe)
        local evidence, code = inspect()
        placeSafe = requested and safePlace(evidence)
        inspectCode = code or (not placeSafe and "HOST_STATE_UNVERIFIED" or nil)
        nextInspection = clock.now() + inspectInterval
        if not placeSafe then return end
        if not wasSafe then
            readinessFloor = clock.now()
            driver:invalidateReadiness()
        end
    end
    local function logRaidAutoRecovery()
        local recent=handoff:status().lastAutoRecovery
        if recent and recent.token~=lastRaidRecoveredToken then
            lastRaidRecoveredToken=recent.token
            if driver and recent.raidId=="SANDWORM" and (recent.code=="SANDWORM_INTERRUPTED_NO_OUTCOME"
                or recent.code=="SANDWORM_RETURN_INTERRUPTED") then driver:recordRaidReturn() end
            print("[V6 RAID RECOVERY]", recent.code, recent.raidId,
                "home", recent.originalWorld)
            statusChanged:emit({kind="RAID_RECOVERED"})
        end
    end
    local function reconcileSafeRaidJournal(noteDeadline)
        if not standaloneMode or not requested or transitioning or not placeSafe then return end
        local state=handoff:status()
        local record=state.record
        if state.code or not record or
            (record.status~="PREPARED" and record.status~="PREQUEUE_FAILED"
                and record.status~="RESULT_OBSERVED") then return end
        if clock.now()>=nextRaidReconcile
            and driver and driver:checkpoint().ownership=="RELEASED" then
            nextRaidReconcile=clock.now()+inspectInterval
            handoff:refresh()
            logRaidAutoRecovery()
        end
        if handoff:status().record and noteDeadline then noteDeadline(nextRaidReconcile) end
    end
    local function pauseReason(plan, noteDeadline)
        if not (plan and (plan.encounterId or plan.chainReturn)) then
            -- Reconcile only provably unlaunched attempts while idle. In-flight
            -- or expired SUBMITTED attempts must remain blocked.
            reconcileSafeRaidJournal(noteDeadline)
        end
        local blocked = currentPause(plan)
        if plan and (plan.encounterId or plan.chainReturn) then
            if not requested or transitioning then return "HOST_TRANSITION_PENDING" end
            local raidBlock = handoff:pauseReason()
            if raidBlock and not isolatedRaidHold(plan) then return raidBlock end
            local priorPlace = inspectedPlace
            local evidence = inspect()
            inspectedPlace = priorPlace
            if not evidence or evidence.placeId ~= priorPlace or handoff:isRaidPlace(evidence.placeId) then
                return "RECOVERY_PLACE_UNVERIFIED"
            end
            return nil
        end
        if not autoInspect or not requested then return blocked end
        if transitioning then return blocked or "HOST_TRANSITION_PENDING" end
        local retry = not plan and blocked == "HOST_STATE_UNVERIFIED" and clock.now() >= nextInspection
            and driver:checkpoint().ownership == "RELEASED"
        if retry or (plan and not plan.readOnly and not blocked) then
            -- Reuse the scheduler wake while waiting. Reinspect before a writable job
            -- takes ownership, never during its expected gameplay transitions.
            local wasSafe, previousCode = placeSafe, inspectCode
            updateInspection(wasSafe)
            if placeSafe ~= wasSafe or inspectCode ~= previousCode then statusChanged:emit({kind = "HOST"}) end
            blocked = currentPause(plan)
        end
        if blocked == "HOST_STATE_UNVERIFIED" and noteDeadline then noteDeadline(nextInspection) end
        return blocked
    end
    local function activate(wasSafe)
        updateInspection(wasSafe)
        if not placeSafe and (not autoInspect or handoff:isRaidPlace(inspectedPlace)) then return true end
        local ok, reason = driver:start()
        if ok then driver:notify() end
        return ok, reason
    end

    local function runTransition(operation, ...)
        if transitioning then return false, "HOST_TRANSITION_PENDING" end
        transitioning = true
        local enteredEpoch = transitionEpoch
        local ok, result, detail = pcall(operation, ...)
        if enteredEpoch ~= transitionEpoch then return false, "TRANSITION_FORCE_RESET_SUPERSEDED" end
        transitioning = false
        if not ok then
            placeSafe = false
            statusChanged:emit({kind = "HOST"})
            return false, "HOST_TRANSITION_FAILED", tostring(result)
        end
        statusChanged:emit({kind = "HOST"})
        return result, detail
    end

    local function recordRaidReturn()
        local completed = handoff:status().lastVerifiedReturn
        if completed and completed.token ~= lastRaidReturn then
            lastRaidReturn = completed.token
            driver:recordRaidReturn()
        end
    end

    local function refresh()
        local wasSafe = placeSafe
        placeSafe = false
        handoff:refresh()
        logRaidAutoRecovery()
        if standaloneMode then
            local pending=handoff:status()
            if pending.record and pending.expired
                and pending.record.token~=lastRaidReviewToken then
                lastRaidReviewToken=pending.record.token
                warn("[V6 RAID RECOVERY] EXPIRED_AMBIGUOUS_ATTEMPT_RETAINED",
                    pending.record.raidId, pending.record.status,
                    "manual review required; no auto-clear")
            end
        end
        recordRaidReturn()
        return activate(wasSafe)
    end

    local function subscribeRaidObserver()
        if type(host.subscribeRaidEvents) ~= "function" or type(host.verifyRaidEvent) ~= "function" then return end
        raidGeneration = raidGeneration + 1
        local current = raidGeneration
        local ok, disconnect = pcall(host.subscribeRaidEvents, host, function(event)
            if not requested or current ~= raidGeneration then return false, "HOST_STOPPED" end
            return app:recordRaidEvent(event)
        end)
        if ok and type(disconnect) == "function" then
            if requested and current == raidGeneration then raidDisconnect, raidObserverCode = disconnect, nil
            else pcall(disconnect) end
        elseif requested and current == raidGeneration then
            raidObserverCode = "HANDOFF_OBSERVER_FAILED"
        end
    end

    function app:initialize()
        if attachHold then return false, "HOST_ATTACH_CLEANUP_FAILED", attachHold end
        if transitioning then return false, "HOST_TRANSITION_PENDING" end
        if driver and requested then return true, driver end
        requested = true
        local ok, code, detail = runTransition(function()
            if not driver then
                local restored = settings:load()
                local candidate = LiveScheduler.new({
                    clock = clock, timer = timer, readiness = readiness, settings = restored, host = host,
                    chainStorage = options.chainStorage, travelRetryStorage = options.travelRetryStorage,
                    pauseReason = pauseReason, resourceBlock = resourceBlock, profile = options.profile, sleep = options.sleep,
                    allowSettingsWhileBusy = true,
                    prepareRaid = function(raidId, context) return self:prepareRaid(raidId, context) end,
                    pollInterval = options.pollInterval, minWakeInterval = options.minWakeInterval,
                    instanceId = options.instanceId,
                })
                local normal, attached, attachCode = pcall(function()
                    local accepted, reason = adapters:attach(candidate)
                    if not accepted then return false, reason end
                    if host.attach then return host:attach(candidate, self) end
                    return true
                end)
                if not normal or attached ~= true then
                    local cleaned, errors = candidate:dispose()
                    if not cleaned then attachHold = errors; return false, "HOST_ATTACH_CLEANUP_FAILED" end
                    return false, attachCode or "HOST_ATTACH_FAILED"
                end
                settings:bind(candidate)
                driver = candidate
                driver:onJobStarted(function(event) statusChanged:emit({kind = "JOB_STARTED", checkpoint = event.checkpoint}) end)
                driver:onJobProgress(function(event) statusChanged:emit({kind = "JOB_PROGRESS", checkpoint = event.checkpoint}) end)
                driver:onJobCompleted(function(event)
                    reconcileDisabledRiftHold("JOB_COMPLETED")
                    statusChanged:emit({kind = "JOB_COMPLETED", checkpoint = event.checkpoint})
                    if stopAfterChain and not driver:snapshot().chain then stopAfterChain = nil; app:stop() end
                end)
            end
            local started, reason = refresh()
            if not started then return false, reason end
            return true, driver
        end)
        if not ok then requested, placeSafe = false, false
        elseif requested then subscribeRaidObserver() end
        return ok, code, detail
    end

    function app:refresh()
        if not driver or not requested then return false, "HOST_STOPPED" end
        return runTransition(refresh)
    end
    -- One-click UNIVERSAL FORCE RESET. Operator explicitly discards ALL
    -- client scheduler/recovery state, even when the prior raid has a result.
    -- Native server actions already submitted are NOT undone.
    function app:resetScheduler()
        if not driver then return false, "RESET_RUNTIME_NOT_LOADED" end
        transitionEpoch = transitionEpoch + 1
        transitioning = false
        local wasRequested = requested
        requested = true
        -- Stop selecting jobs before clearing the old handoff. Starting a new
        -- driver generation first could observe/act on the stale Raid record.
        local beforeReset = driver:status()
        local activeKind = beforeReset and beforeReset.checkpoint
            and beforeReset.checkpoint.kind or "UNKNOWN"
        print("[V6 FORCE RESET] DUNGEON_LOCAL_SCOPE", "activeKind", tostring(activeKind),
            "nativeRun", tostring(game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
                :GetAttribute("PrototypeDungeonRun")),
            "serverRunUnaffected", true)
        driver:stop()
        -- Stop the current Rift session and clear its retry cache before rearming.
        -- Native party/outcome/cooldown state is NEVER fabricated or bypassed.
        if riftBridge and type(riftBridge.forceReset)=="function" then
            local resetOk,resetCode=pcall(riftBridge.forceReset,riftBridge)
            if not resetOk then warn("[V6 FORCE RESET] RIFT_CLEANUP_WARNING",tostring(resetCode)) end
        end
        local raidOk, raidWarning = handoff:forceClear()
        -- Route-local one-shot/throttle flags and standalone rescue state live
        -- outside the V6 scheduler journal; clear them before rearming jobs.
        local bridgeOk, bridgeWarning = true, nil
        if bridge and type(bridge.forceReset) == "function" then
            local called, result, detail = pcall(bridge.forceReset, bridge)
            bridgeOk, bridgeWarning = called and result == true, called and detail or result
        end
        local standaloneOk, standaloneReport = StandaloneRaidForceReset.clear()
        print("[V6 FORCE RESET] STANDALONE_RAIDS", "OMEGA_FINAL_SANDWORM",
            "handles", standaloneReport.handlesCleared, "files", standaloneReport.filesCleared,
            "warnings", #standaloneReport.warnings)
        if not bridgeOk then warn("[V6 FORCE RESET] RAID_BRIDGE_WARNING", tostring(bridgeWarning)) end
        for _, warning in ipairs(standaloneReport.warnings) do
            warn("[V6 FORCE RESET] STANDALONE_WARNING", warning)
        end
        readinessFloor = clock.now()
        nextRaidReconcile, lastRaidIsolatedToken, lastRaidReviewToken = 0, nil, nil
        lastRaidRecoveredToken, lastRaidReturn, raidEventCode = nil, nil, nil
        stopAfterChain = nil
        -- Reset the location cache without claiming we teleported home.
        local origin = inspect()
        placeSafe = requested and safePlace(origin)
        local ok, code, count = driver:forceReset()
        print("[V6 FORCE RESET] LOCAL_STATE_DISCARDED",
            "nativeTravelCooldownPreserved", "SERVER_CONTROLLED")
        if driver and requested then driver:invalidateReadiness(); driver:notify() end
        if not wasRequested then subscribeRaidObserver() end
        statusChanged:emit({kind = "SCHEDULER_FORCE_RESET", clearedHolds = count,
            raidStorageWarning = raidWarning, standaloneReset = standaloneReport})
        if not raidOk or not bridgeOk or not standaloneOk then
            if not raidOk then warn("[V6 FORCE RESET] RAID_JOURNAL_STORAGE_WARNING", tostring(raidWarning)) end
            return true, "SCHEDULER_FORCE_RESET_STORAGE_WARNING"
        end
        return ok, code
    end
    -- Explicit read-only Totem recovery. This never sends Proceed or overrides
    -- a held transaction: it only queries native server evidence.
    function app:recoverTotem()
        if not driver or not requested then return false, "HOST_STOPPED" end
        if not placeSafe then return false, "HOST_LOCATION_UNVERIFIED" end
        return driver:requestRecovery("TOTEM")
    end
    -- Explicit operator opt-in for a Raid that was exited manually.
    -- Never inferred from TTL, never clears without a verified archive.
    function app:abandonInterruptedRaid(confirmation)
        if confirmation ~= "I_LEFT_THE_RAID" then return false, "RAID_ABANDON_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED" end
        if not standaloneMode or not driver or not requested then return false, "RAID_ABANDON_UNAVAILABLE" end
        if transitioning then return false, "HOST_TRANSITION_PENDING" end
        return runTransition(function()
            local snapshot = driver:snapshot()
            local encounter = snapshot.boss and snapshot.boss.encounter
            if driver:checkpoint().ownership ~= "RELEASED" or snapshot.chain
                or encounter and encounter.phase ~= "COMPLETE" then
                return false, "RAID_ABANDON_OTHER_JOB_ACTIVE"
            end
            local record = handoff:status().record
            if not record then return false, "RAID_ABANDON_NO_ATTEMPT" end
            local atHome, code = inspect()
            if not atHome or not safePlace(atHome) or atHome.placeId ~= record.sourcePlaceId
                or atHome.world ~= record.originalWorld
                or (atHome.location ~= nil and atHome.location ~= "WORLD") then
                return false, code or "RAID_ABANDON_HOME_UNVERIFIED"
            end
            local ok, reason = handoff:abandonInterrupted(record.token)
            if ok then
                logRaidAutoRecovery()
                driver:invalidateReadiness()
                driver:notify()
            end
            return ok, reason
        end)
    end
    function app:stop()
        if driver and requested and driver:drainChain() then
            stopAfterChain = true
            return false, "CHAIN_RETURN_PENDING"
        end
        requested, placeSafe = false, false
        raidGeneration = raidGeneration + 1
        local disconnect = raidDisconnect
        raidDisconnect = nil
        if disconnect then pcall(disconnect) end
        if driver then driver:stop() end
        statusChanged:emit({kind = "HOST"})
        return settings:flush()
    end

    function app:setPreferences(value)
        if not driver then return false, "HOST_NOT_INITIALIZED" end
        return driver:setPreferences(value)
    end
    local function raidStatus()
        local status = handoff:status()
        if (status.phase == "RESULT_VERIFIED" or status.phase == "RETURN_INITIATED")
            and inspectedPlace == status.record.sourcePlaceId then
            status.phase = "RETURN_PENDING"
        end
        local missing
        if not standaloneMode and type(host.verifyRaidEvent) ~= "function" then missing = "HANDOFF_VERIFIER_UNAVAILABLE"
        elseif type(options.mintToken) ~= "function" then missing = "HANDOFF_TOKEN_UNAVAILABLE" end
        if missing and status.phase == "IDLE" then status.phase = "UNAVAILABLE" end
        status.observerCode, status.eventCode = raidObserverCode or missing, raidEventCode
        return status
    end
    function app:configuration()
        if not driver then return nil, "HOST_NOT_INITIALIZED" end
        local pause = currentPause()
        local status = driver:status()
        local preferences = driver:settingsSnapshot()
        local features, domainBlock = driver:featureReadiness(pause)
        for kind, field in pairs(toggleSettings) do features[kind].requestedEnabled = preferences[field] end
        for kind, external in pairs(adapters:externalStatus()) do features[kind].external = external end
        local snapshot = status.encounterBossId and driver:snapshot()
        local encounter = snapshot and snapshot.boss.encounter
        local recovery = encounter and encounter.recovery
        if encounter and snapshot.holds.BOSS and snapshot.holds.BOSS ~= "BOSS_ENCOUNTER_CANCELLED" then
            recovery = {stage="RECOVERY_HELD", reason=snapshot.holds.BOSS}
        end
        if recovery then recovery.bossId, recovery.encounterId = encounter.bossId, encounter.encounterId end
        local chain = driver:snapshot().chain
        if chain then
            chain.stage = chain.restored and "RESTORED_RETURN" or chain.draining and "FINAL_RETURN"
                or chain.successor and "SUCCESSOR_OWNED" or "RETURN_DEFERRED"
            chain.currentActivity = status.checkpoint.ownership == "OWNED" and status.checkpoint.bossId or nil
        end
        local raid = raidStatus()
        local attempt = raid.record
        local raidFeature = features.RAID
        if not hasRaidBridge and type(host.raidUnavailableReason) == "function"
            and raidFeature.availability == "UNAVAILABLE" then
            local commonReason
            for _, candidate in ipairs(raidFeature.candidates) do
                candidate.availabilityReason = bridgeStatus(candidate.bossId)
                if candidate.enabled then candidate.reason = candidate.availabilityReason end
                if commonReason == nil then commonReason = candidate.availabilityReason
                elseif commonReason ~= candidate.availabilityReason then commonReason = "RAID_NATIVE_CAPABILITIES_UNVERIFIED" end
            end
            raidFeature.availabilityReason = commonReason or raidFeature.availabilityReason
            if preferences.raidEnabled then raidFeature.reason = raidFeature.availabilityReason end
        end
        if status.checkpoint.kind == "RAID" then status.checkpoint.raidId = status.checkpoint.bossId end
        if raid.lastVerifiedReturn and raid.lastVerifiedReturn.outcome then
            raidFeature.lastVerifiedResult = {raidId = raid.lastVerifiedReturn.raidId,
                outcome = raid.lastVerifiedReturn.outcome, difficulty = raid.lastVerifiedReturn.difficulty}
        end
        if attempt then
            raidFeature.raidId = attempt.raidId
            raidFeature.state = ({PREPARED = "HANDOFF_PENDING", ARRIVED = "PARTICIPATION_PENDING",
                RESULT_PENDING = "RESULT_PENDING",
                PARTICIPATION_VERIFIED = "RUNNING", RESULT_VERIFIED = "RETURNING",
                RETURN_INITIATED = "RETURNING", ORIGIN_ARRIVED = "RETURNING",
                RETURN_PENDING = "RETURNING", RECOVERY_REQUIRED = "RECOVERING"})[raid.phase] or raidFeature.state
            raidFeature.reason = raid.eventCode or raid.code
            for _, candidate in ipairs(raidFeature.candidates) do
                if candidate.bossId == attempt.raidId then
                    candidate.state, candidate.reason = raidFeature.state, raidFeature.reason
                end
            end
        elseif raidFeature.state == "RUNNING" then
            raidFeature.state, raidFeature.raidId = "STARTING", status.checkpoint.raidId
        elseif not preferences.raidEnabled then
            raidFeature.state = "DISABLED"
        end
        local recoveryOverview=UniversalRecoveryPolicy.overview(
            driver:snapshot(), raid, clock.epoch(), 60)
        return {revision = status.configurationRevision, settings = preferences, chain = chain,
            universalRecovery = recoveryOverview,
            encounterRecovery = recovery,
            features = features, bossCatalog = Contracts.copy(BossCatalog), raidCatalog = Contracts.copy(RaidCatalog.ids),
            checkpoint = status.checkpoint, blockReason = pause or domainBlock, nextWakeAt = status.nextWakeAt,
            lastDecision = status.lastDecision, running = status.running, observedAt = status.observedAt,
            persistence = settings:status(), handoff = raid}
    end
    function app:onStatusChanged(callback) return statusChanged:subscribe(callback) end
    function app:mountConfigurationView(view)
        if not driver then return nil, "HOST_NOT_INITIALIZED" end
        return gui:mount(view)
    end
    function app:mountPCGui(parent) return ConfigurationPanel.mountPC(self, parent) end
    function app:mountMobileGui(parent) return ConfigurationPanel.mountMobile(self, parent) end
    function app:onConfigurationChanged(callback)
        if not driver then return nil, "HOST_NOT_INITIALIZED" end
        return driver:onConfigurationChanged(callback)
    end
    function app:setFeatureEnabled(kind, enabled)
        if not driver then return false, "HOST_NOT_INITIALIZED" end
        if type(enabled) ~= "boolean" or type(kind) ~= "string" or not driver:status().features[kind] then
            return false, "INVALID_FEATURE_TOGGLE"
        end
        local ok, code = driver:setEnabled(kind, enabled)
        if ok and kind == "RIFT" and not enabled then
            -- Active fights are NOT cancelled by a toggle; wait for their job
            -- to finish, then use onJobCompleted's independent verification.
            reconcileDisabledRiftHold("TOGGLE_OFF")
        end
        return ok, code
    end
    function app:setBossCandidates(list, expectedRevision)
        if not driver then return false, "HOST_NOT_INITIALIZED" end
        return driver:setBossCandidates(list, expectedRevision)
    end
    function app:editBossCandidates(action, id, value, expectedRevision)
        if not driver then return false, "HOST_NOT_INITIALIZED" end
        local revision = driver:configurationRevision()
        if expectedRevision ~= nil and expectedRevision ~= revision then return false, "CONFIGURATION_CHANGED" end
        if not pcall(Contracts.assertKind, id) then return false, "INVALID_BOSS_ID" end
        local list = driver:settingsSnapshot().bossCandidates
        local index
        for position, candidate in ipairs(list) do if candidate.id == id then index = position; break end end
        local function validPosition(position, last)
            return Contracts.isHomeWorld(position) and position <= last
        end
        if action == "ADD" then
            if index then return false, "BOSS_ALREADY_LISTED" end
            local position = value == nil and #list + 1 or value
            if not validPosition(position, #list + 1) then return false, "INVALID_BOSS_POSITION" end
            table.insert(list, position, {id = id, enabled = true})
        elseif not index then return false, "BOSS_NOT_LISTED"
        elseif action == "REMOVE" then table.remove(list, index)
        elseif action == "MOVE" then
            if not validPosition(value, #list) then return false, "INVALID_BOSS_POSITION" end
            local candidate = table.remove(list, index)
            table.insert(list, value, candidate)
        elseif action == "SET_ENABLED" then
            if type(value) ~= "boolean" then return false, "INVALID_BOSS_ENABLED" end
            list[index].enabled = value
        else return false, "INVALID_BOSS_EDIT" end
        return driver:setBossCandidates(list, revision)
    end
    function app:setHomeWorld(world)
        if not driver then return false, "HOST_NOT_INITIALIZED" end
        return driver:setHomeWorld(world)
    end
    function app:setBossRepeat(enabled)
        if not driver then return false, "HOST_NOT_INITIALIZED" end
        if type(enabled) ~= "boolean" then return false, "INVALID_BOSS_REPEAT" end
        driver:setBossRepeat(enabled)
        return true
    end
    function app:setRaidCandidates(list, expectedRevision)
        if not driver then return false, "HOST_NOT_INITIALIZED" end
        return driver:setRaidCandidates(list, expectedRevision)
    end
    function app:setRaidRepeat(enabled)
        if not driver then return false, "HOST_NOT_INITIALIZED" end
        if type(enabled) ~= "boolean" then return false, "INVALID_RAID_REPEAT" end
        driver:setRaidRepeat(enabled)
        local active = handoff:status().record
        if not enabled and active and active.managed then
            driver:setEnabled("RAID", false)
        end
        return true
    end
    function app:setTotemCooldownMultiplier(value)
        if not driver then return false, "HOST_NOT_INITIALIZED" end
        return driver:setTotemCooldownMultiplier(value)
    end
    function app:flushSettings() return settings:flush() end
    function app:status()
        local overview=driver and UniversalRecoveryPolicy.overview(
            driver:snapshot(),handoff:status(),clock.epoch(),60) or nil
        return {initialized = driver ~= nil, schedulerSafe = placeSafe == true, inspectCode = inspectCode,
            settings = settings:status(), handoff = raidStatus(),universalRecovery=overview}
    end

    local function prepareRaid(raidId, context, attempt)
        if not driver or not requested or not placeSafe then return false, "HOST_STATE_UNVERIFIED" end
        if not standaloneMode and type(host.verifyRaidEvent) ~= "function" then return false, "HANDOFF_VERIFIER_UNAVAILABLE" end
        if context and (context.kind ~= "RAID" or context.bossId ~= raidId) then return false, "RAID_JOB_MISMATCH" end
        local function canPrepare()
            if not requested then return false, "HOST_STOPPED" end
            return driver:canPrepareHandoff(context)
        end
        return runTransition(function()
            local origin, reason = inspect()
            if not origin then return false, reason end
            if attempt and (origin.schedulerSafe ~= true or (origin.location ~= nil and origin.location ~= "WORLD")) then
                return false, "RAID_ORIGINAL_WORLD_UNVERIFIED"
            end
            local allowed, blocked = canPrepare()
            if not allowed then return false, blocked end
            if attempt and not attempt.repeatEnabled then
                driver:setEnabled("RAID", false)
            end
            if attempt then
                local saved = settings:flush()
                if not saved then
                    return false, attempt.repeatEnabled and "RAID_SETTINGS_NOT_SAVED"
                        or "RAID_ONE_SHOT_SETTINGS_NOT_SAVED"
                end
            end
            local ok, record = handoff:prepare(raidId, origin, attempt)
            if not ok then return false, record end
            raidEventCode = nil
            -- Crossing the place boundary may drop this context and its debounce timer.
            settings:flush()
            allowed, blocked = canPrepare()
            if not allowed then return false, blocked end
            driver:notify()
            return true, record
        end)
    end
    function app:prepareRaid(raidId, context) return prepareRaid(raidId, context) end

    runRaid = function(context, request)
        local id = request.raidId
        local function defer(code, stage)
            return Contracts.result("DEFERRED", code, {stage = stage, retryAt = clock.now() + (options.pollInterval or 5)})
        end
        local blocked = bridgeStatus(id)
        if blocked then return defer(blocked, "ENTRY_PREPARATION") end
        local attempt = {difficulty = difficulty(request.settings, id), repeatEnabled = request.settings.raidRepeat == true}
        request.reportProgress("ENTRY_PREPARATION")
        -- Repeat must not reserve a new cross-place handoff while native Final
        -- Colossus cooldown is active. Other READY jobs remain schedulable.
        if standaloneMode and id=="FINALCOLOSSUS" and type(bridge.cooldown)=="function" then
            local native=bridge:cooldown(id)
            if native and native.unknown then
                return defer("FINALCOLOSSUS_COOLDOWN_UNVERIFIED", "ENTRY_PREPARATION")
            end
            if native and native.remaining and native.remaining>0 then
                return defer("FINALCOLOSSUS_SERVER_COOLDOWN", "ENTRY_PREPARATION")
            end
        end
        -- Reconcile runner-local stale OUTCOME BEFORE reserving a V6 journal.
        -- A pending previous return is a preflight block, not a new submission.
        if standaloneMode and type(bridge.preflight) == "function" then
            local checked, allowed, why = pcall(bridge.preflight, bridge, id)
            if not checked or allowed ~= true then
                return defer(checked and (why or "RAID_PREFLIGHT_BLOCKED")
                    or "RAID_PREFLIGHT_EXCEPTION", "ENTRY_PREPARATION")
            end
        end
        local prepared, record = prepareRaid(id, context, attempt)
        if not prepared then return defer(record, "ENTRY_PREPARATION") end
        -- Recheck after saving PREPARED, before DISPATCHING. If cooldown
        -- appeared in this interval, abort only the still-unlaunched token.
        if standaloneMode and id=="FINALCOLOSSUS" and type(bridge.cooldown)=="function" then
            local native=bridge:cooldown(id)
            if native and (native.unknown or native.remaining and native.remaining>0) then
                local cleared, reason=handoff:abortPrepared(record.token)
                return defer(cleared and (native.unknown and "FINALCOLOSSUS_COOLDOWN_UNVERIFIED"
                    or "FINALCOLOSSUS_SERVER_COOLDOWN")
                    or (reason or "RAID_PREPARED_COOLDOWN_HOME_UNVERIFIED"), "ENTRY_PREPARATION")
            end
        end
        -- The world may have changed between the initial preflight and the
        -- PREPARED reservation. Recheck while the token can still be aborted.
        if standaloneMode and type(bridge.preflight) == "function" then
            local checked, allowed, why = pcall(bridge.preflight, bridge, id)
            if not checked or allowed ~= true then
                local cleared, abortReason = handoff:abortPrepared(record.token)
                return defer(cleared and (checked and (why or "RAID_PREFLIGHT_BLOCKED")
                    or "RAID_PREFLIGHT_EXCEPTION")
                    or (abortReason or "RAID_PREFLIGHT_ABORT_UNVERIFIED"), "ENTRY_PREPARATION")
            end
        end
        if context:isCancelled() or not requested or not driver:canPrepareHandoff(context) then
            -- No launch function has been invoked. Release the PREPARED
            -- reservation only when the physical origin is still verified.
            local cleared,abortCode=handoff:abortPrepared(record.token)
            return defer(cleared and "RAID_PREPARED_ABORTED" or
                (abortCode or "RAID_HANDOFF_RESERVED"), "ENTRY_PREPARATION")
        end
        local dispatching, reason = handoff:recordSubmission(record.token, "DISPATCHING")
        if not dispatching then return defer(reason, "HANDOFF_PENDING") end
        request.reportProgress("HANDOFF_PENDING")
        record.submission = "DISPATCHING"
        local ok, submitted, launchReason, noQueue, retrySeconds, entryFailure = pcall(bridge.launch,
            bridge, context, Contracts.copy(record))
        -- An old route returning after Force Reset must not modify the new journal.
        if context:isCancelled() then
            -- A cancelled Sandworm entry that proves NO queue may retire its
            -- own token, never a newer Force Reset generation's record.
            if id=="SANDWORM" and ok and submitted==false and noQueue==true
                and launchReason=="SANDWORM_V38_PREQUEUE_FAILED" and entryFailure=="SANDWORM_PREQUEUE_FAILED" then
                local pending=handoff:status().record
                if pending and pending.token==record.token and pending.status=="DISPATCHING" then
                    handoff:abortUnlaunched(record.token,{noPayloadQueued=true,entryStage=entryFailure})
                end
            end
            return Contracts.result("CANCELLED", "RAID_ENTRY_CANCELLED", {stage="HANDOFF_PENDING"})
        end
        local verified = handoff:status().lastVerifiedReturn
        if verified and verified.token == record.token then
            return Contracts.result("COMPLETED", "RAID_RETURN_VERIFIED", {stage = "COMPLETED", evidence = verified})
        end
        local accepted = ok and submitted == true
        local prequeueStage
        if standaloneMode and ok and submitted==false and noQueue==true then
            if id=="SANDWORM" and launchReason=="SANDWORM_V38_PREQUEUE_FAILED"
                and entryFailure=="SANDWORM_PREQUEUE_FAILED" then
                prequeueStage=entryFailure
            elseif launchReason=="OMEGA_V2_PREQUEUE_TRAVEL_FAILED"
                or launchReason=="FINALCOLOSSUS_V3_PREQUEUE_TRAVEL_FAILED" then
                prequeueStage="WORLD_TRAVEL_FAILED"
            elseif launchReason=="FINALCOLOSSUS_V3_PREQUEUE_COOLDOWN" then
                prequeueStage="COOLDOWN"
            elseif launchReason=="OMEGA_V2_PREQUEUE_LOBBY_BUSY"
                and (entryFailure=="OTHER_LEADER_ACTIVE" or entryFailure=="ENTRANCE_BUSY") then
                prequeueStage=entryFailure
            end
        end
        if prequeueStage then
            local cleared,reason=handoff:abortUnlaunched(record.token,{
                noPayloadQueued=true,entryStage=prequeueStage})
            if cleared then
                print("[V6 RAID RECOVERY] PROVEN_PREQUEUE_ABORT", id, prequeueStage)
                local delay=(prequeueStage=="COOLDOWN" and type(retrySeconds)=="number"
                    and math.min(900,math.max(30,retrySeconds+2)))
                    or (prequeueStage=="SANDWORM_PREQUEUE_FAILED" and type(retrySeconds)=="number"
                        and math.min(120,math.max(30,retrySeconds))) or 25
                return Contracts.result("DEFERRED", "RAID_PREQUEUE_RETRY", {
                    stage="ENTRY_PREPARATION",retryAt=clock.now()+delay})
            end
            local pending=handoff:status().record
            if pending and pending.token==record.token and pending.status=="PREQUEUE_FAILED" then
                -- A durable no-queue proof is stored. Home verification may
                -- finish on the next reconciliation, including after restart.
                return defer(reason or "RAID_PREQUEUE_HOME_UNVERIFIED", "HANDOFF_PENDING")
            end
            launchReason=reason or launchReason
        end
        handoff:recordSubmission(record.token, accepted and "SUBMITTED" or "UNCERTAIN")
        return defer(accepted and "RAID_HANDOFF_SUBMITTED" or
            (launchReason or "RAID_SUBMISSION_UNCERTAIN"), "HANDOFF_PENDING")
    end

    function app:recordRaidEvent(event)
        if not driver or not requested then return false, "HOST_STOPPED" end
        event = Contracts.copy(event)
        local ok, detail = runTransition(function()
            local result, code = handoff:recordEvent(event, function(observed, record)
                if type(host.verifyRaidEvent) ~= "function" then return nil end
                return host:verifyRaidEvent(observed, record)
            end)
            if result and (event.type == "RETURN_VERIFIED" or event.type == "EXPIRED_RESOLVED") then
                recordRaidReturn()
                placeSafe = false
                local started, startCode = activate(false)
                if not started then code = code or startCode end
            end
            driver:notify()
            return result, code
        end)
        raidEventCode = detail
        statusChanged:emit({kind = "RAID"})
        return ok, detail
    end

    return app
end

return LiveHost
end
-- END MODULE main.core.LiveHost

-- BEGIN MODULE main.core.LiveScheduler
__factories["main.core.LiveScheduler"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local Contracts = require("main.core.Contracts")
local State = require("main.core.State")
local Runtime = require("main.core.Runtime")
local FeatureRegistry = require("main.core.FeatureRegistry")
local FeaturePolicy = require("main.core.FeaturePolicy")
local Scheduler = require("main.core.Scheduler")
local MovementOwnership = require("main.core.MovementOwnership")
local Readiness = require("main.core.Readiness")
local DeferredHomeJournal = require("main.core.DeferredHomeJournal")
local WorldTravelRetryJournal = require("main.core.WorldTravelRetryJournal")
local SettingsSchema = require("main.core.SettingsSchema")
local Profile = require("main.config.Profile")
local LiveScheduler = {}

function LiveScheduler.new(options)
    local clock, timer = options.clock, options.timer
    assert(type(clock) == "table" and type(clock.now) == "function" and type(clock.epoch) == "function",
        "Inject monotonic and epoch clocks")
    assert(type(timer) == "table" and type(timer.scheduleAt) == "function", "Inject a one-shot timer")
    local minimum = options.minWakeInterval or 0.05
    local fallback = options.pollInterval or 5
    assert(Contracts.isFinite(minimum) and minimum > 0 and Contracts.isFinite(fallback) and fallback >= minimum,
        "Invalid live scheduling intervals")

    local profile = options.profile or Profile.new()
    local settings = Contracts.copy(options.settings or {})
    settings.raidCandidates = assert(SettingsSchema.raidCandidates(settings.raidCandidates or {}), "Invalid raid candidates")
    local state = State.new({settings = settings, journal = options.journal, clock = clock,
        travelRetryJournal = WorldTravelRetryJournal.new({clock = clock, storage = options.travelRetryStorage}),
        chainJournal = DeferredHomeJournal.new(options.chainStorage),
        allowSettingsWhileBusy = options.allowSettingsWhileBusy})
    local runtime = Runtime.new({clock = clock, sleep = options.sleep, poll = profile.scheduler.poll,
        instanceId = options.instanceId})
    local movement = MovementOwnership.new(runtime)
    local registry = FeatureRegistry.new(state, runtime, profile, function()
        return {movement = movement, prepareRaid = options.prepareRaid}
    end)
    local scheduler = Scheduler.new(state, runtime, profile, registry, options.pauseReason)
    local readiness = Readiness.new(options.readiness, runtime)
    local commands = state:port("commands")
    local schedulerWriter = state:port("scheduler")
    local driver = {}
    local running, inFlight, dirty, generation = false, false, false, 0
    local wake, pendingRecovery, disconnectReadiness, disconnectEncounter, timerError, jobError, subscribing
    local pump

    local function arm(deadline)
        if wake and wake.deadline > runtime:now() and wake.deadline <= deadline then return true end
        local nextWake = {deadline = deadline}
        local arming, calledEarly = true, false
        local ok, cancel = pcall(timer.scheduleAt, timer, deadline, function()
            if arming then calledEarly = true; return end
            if not running or wake ~= nextWake then return end
            wake = nil
            pump()
        end)
        arming = false
        if not ok or type(cancel) ~= "function" or calledEarly then
            if ok and type(cancel) == "function" then pcall(cancel) end
            timerError = ok and "INVALID_TIMER" or tostring(cancel)
            return false, "TIMER_FAILED"
        end
        local previous = wake
        nextWake.cancel, wake, timerError = cancel, nextWake, nil
        if previous then pcall(previous.cancel) end
        return true
    end

    function driver:notify()
        if not running then return false, "STOPPED" end
        if inFlight then dirty = true; return true end
        return arm(runtime:now() + minimum)
    end

    pump = function()
        inFlight, dirty = true, false
        local currentGeneration = generation
        local recover = pendingRecovery
        pendingRecovery = nil
        local deadline
        local _, reason, detail = scheduler:step({
            live = readiness, recover = recover,
            isCurrent = function() return running and generation == currentGeneration end,
            noteDeadline = function(value) deadline = math.min(deadline or value, value) end,
            resourceBlock = options.resourceBlock,
        })
        if currentGeneration ~= generation then return end
        jobError = reason == "SCHEDULER_EXCEPTION" and detail or nil
        inFlight = false
        if not running then return end
