        local now = runtime:now()
        local nextWakeAt = now + fallback
        if dirty or reason == "CONFIGURATION_CHANGED" or reason == "READINESS_STALE" then
            nextWakeAt = now + minimum
        elseif deadline then
            nextWakeAt = math.min(nextWakeAt, math.max(now + minimum, deadline))
        end
        -- One retry covers a transient timer error after the prior timer fired.
        if not arm(nextWakeAt) then arm(nextWakeAt) end
    end

    state:onConfigurationChanged(function() driver:notify() end)
    scheduler:onJobCompleted(function() driver:notify() end)

    function driver:start()
        if not runtime:isAlive() then return false, "STOPPED" end
        if subscribing and not running then return false, "SUBSCRIPTION_TRANSITION_PENDING" end
        if running then
            if not inFlight and (not wake or wake.deadline <= runtime:now()) then return self:notify() end
            return true
        end
        running, generation = true, generation + 1
        local ok, code = self:notify()
        if not ok then running = false; return false, code end
        local currentGeneration = generation
        local provider = options.readiness
        local function subscribe(source, method, callback)
            if type(method) ~= "function" or not running or generation ~= currentGeneration then return nil end
            subscribing = true
            local subscribed, disconnect = pcall(method, source, function()
                if running and generation == currentGeneration then callback() end
            end)
            subscribing = false
            if subscribed and type(disconnect) == "function" then
                if running and generation == currentGeneration then return disconnect end
                pcall(disconnect)
            end
        end
        disconnectReadiness = subscribe(provider, provider.subscribe, function() self:notify() end)
        local host = options.host
        disconnectEncounter = host and subscribe(host, host.subscribeEncounterChanges, function()
            local recheckAt = runtime:now() + math.max(minimum, 0.6)
            if not schedulerWriter:advanceEncounterRecovery(recheckAt) then return end
            if inFlight then dirty = true else arm(recheckAt) end
        end)
        if not running then return false, "STOPPED" end
        return true
    end

    local function cancelActive(kind, reason)
        local context = runtime:activeJob()
        if not context or context:isClosing() or kind and context.kind ~= kind then return false end
        if not runtime:cancelActive(context.kind, reason) then return false end
        registry:cancel(context.kind, context, reason)
        return true
    end

    function driver:stop()
        if not running then return true end
        running, generation = false, generation + 1
        local previousWake, disconnect, disconnectRecovery = wake, disconnectReadiness, disconnectEncounter
        wake, pendingRecovery, disconnectReadiness, disconnectEncounter = nil, nil, nil, nil
        if previousWake then pcall(previousWake.cancel) end
        if disconnect then pcall(disconnect) end
        if disconnectRecovery then pcall(disconnectRecovery) end
        cancelActive(nil, "LIVE_SCHEDULER_STOPPED")
        return true
    end
    function driver:dispose()
        if inFlight then return false, "BUSY" end
        if state:snapshot().chain then return false, "CHAIN_RETURN_PENDING" end
        self:stop()
        runtime:shutdown()
        local cleaned, errors = registry:shutdown()
        local blocked = registry:liveBarrier()
        if blocked then errors[#errors + 1] = blocked end
        return cleaned and not blocked, errors
    end

    function driver:forceReset()
        -- Never ask for safe-home, idle ownership or verified transactions.
        -- Retire the old generation and re-arm from the first P1 selection.
        self:stop()
        local cleanupOk, cleanupCode = runtime:forceDropActive()
        local ok, code, cleared = schedulerWriter:forceReset()
        scheduler:forceResetDecision()
        inFlight, dirty, pendingRecovery, timerError, jobError = false, false, nil, nil, nil
        readiness:forceReset()
        local started, startCode = self:start()
        if not started then
            return true, "SCHEDULER_FORCE_RESET_RESTART_WARNING", cleared
        end
        if not cleanupOk then
            return true, "SCHEDULER_FORCE_RESET_CLEANUP_WARNING", cleared
        end
        return ok, code, cleared
    end

    function driver:canResetScheduler()
        if not running or not runtime:isAlive() then return false, "RESET_RUNTIME_STOPPED" end
        if inFlight or subscribing or pendingRecovery or runtime:activeJob() then
            return false, "RESET_JOB_ACTIVE"
        end
        if scheduler:checkpoint().ownership ~= "RELEASED" then return false, "RESET_JOB_ACTIVE" end
        local snapshot = state:snapshot()
        if snapshot.chain or snapshot.chainError then return false, "RESET_CHAIN_RETURN_PENDING" end
        local tx = snapshot.totem.transaction
        if snapshot.totem.proceedPending or snapshot.totem.returnPending or snapshot.totem.recovery
            or tx and tx.phase ~= "COMPLETE" and tx.phase ~= "ABANDONED" then
            return false, "RESET_TOTEM_TRANSACTION_PENDING"
        end
        if snapshot.totem.manualHold and snapshot.totem.debugReason ~= "TOTEM_TRAVEL_DIRECT_WORLD_REJECTED" then
            return false, "RESET_TOTEM_MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED"
        end
        local boss = snapshot.boss
        if boss.reportPending or boss.returnPending or boss.recovery
            or boss.encounter and boss.encounter.phase ~= "COMPLETE" then
            return false, "RESET_BOSS_RECOVERY_PENDING"
        end
        for kind, feature in pairs(snapshot.features) do
            if feature.returnPending or feature.proceedPending or feature.reportPending
                or feature.manualHold or feature.recovery then
                return false, "RESET_FEATURE_RECOVERY_PENDING_" .. kind
            end
        end
        return true
    end
    function driver:resetScheduler()
        local safe, reason = self:canResetScheduler()
        if not safe then return false, reason end
        local ok, code, count = schedulerWriter:resetIdleHolds()
        if not ok then return false, code end
        scheduler:resetDecision()
        pendingRecovery, timerError, jobError = nil, nil, nil
        readiness:invalidate()
        -- Configuration revision invalidates any previously sampled plans;
        -- force a new scheduler pass, beginning with native Totem P1 readiness.
        self:notify()
        return true, code, count
    end

    function driver:requestRecovery(kind)
        Contracts.assertKind(kind)
        if not running then return false, "STOPPED" end
        if inFlight or pendingRecovery then return false, "BUSY" end
        pendingRecovery = kind
        local ok, code = self:notify()
        if not ok then pendingRecovery = nil end
        return ok, code
    end

    function driver:registerFeature(kind, module, policy)
        if inFlight then return false, "BUSY" end
        local ok, code, detail = registry:register(kind, module, policy)
        if ok then self:notify() end
        return ok, code, detail
    end
    function driver:declareFeature(kind, mode, reason)
        if inFlight then return false, "BUSY" end
        return registry:declare(kind, mode, reason)
    end
    function driver:registerJob(kind, handler)
        if inFlight then return false, "BUSY" end
        local ok, code, detail = scheduler:register(kind, handler)
        if ok then self:notify() end
        return ok, code, detail
    end
    function driver:setBossCandidates(candidates, expectedRevision)
        local copy = Contracts.copyBossCandidates(candidates)
        if not copy then return false, "INVALID_BOSS_CANDIDATES" end
        for _, candidate in ipairs(copy) do
            if SettingsSchema.isRaidId(candidate.id) then return false, "RAID_REQUIRES_AUTO_RAID" end
        end
        return commands:setBossCandidates(copy, expectedRevision)
    end
    function driver:setRaidCandidates(candidates, expectedRevision)
        local copy = SettingsSchema.raidCandidates(candidates)
        if not copy then return false, "INVALID_RAID_CANDIDATES" end
        return commands:setRaidCandidates(copy, expectedRevision)
    end
    function driver:setRaidRepeat(value) return commands:setRaidRepeat(value) end
    function driver:setEnabled(kind, enabled)
        -- The active job normally keeps ownership until its native result.
        -- Dungeon is a narrow exception AFTER a confirmed Home, or BEFORE
        -- any Solo request: OFF can cancel the already-idle job immediately.
        local ok, code = commands:setEnabled(kind, enabled)
        if ok and kind == "DUNGEON" and not enabled then
            local activeJob = runtime:activeJob()
            if activeJob and activeJob.kind == "DUNGEON" then
                local feature = registry:status("DUNGEON")
                local detail = feature and feature.detail or nil
                local nativeIdle = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
                    :GetAttribute("PrototypeDungeonRun") == nil
                local safeToCancel = nativeIdle and type(detail) == "table"
                    and (detail.homeObserved == true or detail.soloAttempted == false)
                if safeToCancel then
                    print("[V6 DUNGEON] TOGGLE_OFF_IDLE_CANCEL", "homeObserved",
                        tostring(detail.homeObserved), "soloAttempted", tostring(detail.soloAttempted))
                    cancelActive("DUNGEON", "DUNGEON_TOGGLE_OFF_NATIVE_IDLE")
                else
                    print("[V6 DUNGEON] TOGGLE_OFF_PENDING_NATIVE_SETTLEMENT",
                        "nativeRun", tostring(not nativeIdle),
                        "homeObserved", tostring(detail and detail.homeObserved))
                end
            end
        end
        return ok, code
    end
    function driver:setHomeWorld(world) return commands:setHomeWorld(world) end
    function driver:setBossRepeat(value) return commands:setBossRepeat(value) end
    function driver:setTotemCooldownMultiplier(value) return commands:setTotemCooldownMultiplier(value) end
    function driver:setPreferences(value)
        local validated, field = SettingsSchema.preferences(value)
        if not validated then return false, "INVALID_PREFERENCE", field end
        return commands:setPreferences(validated)
    end
    function driver:releaseHold(kind)
        local ok, code = commands:releaseHold(kind)
        if ok then self:notify() end
        return ok, code
    end
    function driver:releaseDisabledRiftHold(nativeVerified)
        local checkpoint = self:checkpoint()
        if checkpoint.ownership ~= "RELEASED" or runtime:activeJob() then
            return false, "RIFT_SCHEDULER_OWNED"
        end
        local ok, code = commands:releaseDisabledRiftHold(nativeVerified)
        if ok then
            scheduler:resetDecision()
            readiness:invalidate()
            self:notify() -- reselect from P1 Totem, then Boss/Raid before Rift
        end
        return ok, code
    end
    function driver:onJobCompleted(callback) return scheduler:onJobCompleted(callback) end
    function driver:onJobStarted(callback) return scheduler:onJobStarted(callback) end
    function driver:onJobProgress(callback) return scheduler:onJobProgress(callback) end
    function driver:onConfigurationChanged(callback) return state:onConfigurationChanged(callback) end
    function driver:configurationRevision() return state:configurationRevision() end
    function driver:snapshot() return state:snapshot() end
    function driver:settingsSnapshot() return state:settingsSnapshot() end
    function driver:canPrepareHandoff(context)
        if state:snapshot().chain then return false, "CHAIN_RETURN_PENDING" end
        if context then
            if not runtime:isActive(context) or context:isClosing() or context:isCancelled() or context.readOnly then
                return false, "STALE_JOB"
            end
        elseif self:checkpoint().ownership ~= "RELEASED" then
            return false, "BUSY"
        end
        local blocked = registry:liveBarrier()
        if not blocked and options.resourceBlock then blocked = options.resourceBlock(FeaturePolicy.resources()) end
        return not blocked, blocked
    end
    function driver:exportSession() return state:exportSession() end
    function driver:checkpoint() return scheduler:checkpoint() end
    function driver:invalidateReadiness() readiness:invalidate() end
    function driver:drainChain()
        if not schedulerWriter:drainChain() then return false end
        self:notify()
        return true
    end
    function driver:recordRaidReturn() registry:recordRaidReturn() end
    function driver:featureReadiness(pause)
        return registry:liveReadiness(state:snapshot(), scheduler:checkpoint(), readiness,
            state:configurationRevision(), pause, options.resourceBlock)
    end
    function driver:status()
        local status = scheduler:readiness()
        status.running, status.inFlight = running, inFlight
        status.nextWakeAt = wake and wake.deadline
        status.timerError, status.jobError = timerError, jobError
        return status
    end

    return driver
end

return LiveScheduler
end
-- END MODULE main.core.LiveScheduler

-- BEGIN MODULE main.core.MovementOwnership
__factories["main.core.MovementOwnership"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Owns permission only. No character movement or Roblox API calls in Phase 1.
local MovementOwnership = {}

function MovementOwnership.new(runtime)
    local owner, ownerContext, onRelease, generation = nil, nil, nil, 0
    local releasing = false
    local releaseErrors = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
    local movement = {}

    function movement:isOwner(lease)
        return not releasing and owner ~= nil and owner == lease and runtime:isActive(ownerContext)
    end
    function movement:canAct(lease)
        return self:isOwner(lease) and not ownerContext:isCancelled()
            and not ownerContext:isClosing() and not ownerContext.readOnly
    end
    function movement:release(lease)
        if owner ~= lease or owner == nil then return false, "STALE_LEASE" end
        if releasing then return false, "RELEASING" end
        releasing = true
        local callback = onRelease
        local ok, err = true, nil
        if callback then ok, err = pcall(callback, lease) end
        owner, ownerContext, onRelease = nil, nil, nil
        releasing = false
        if not ok then releaseErrors[lease] = tostring(err); error(err, 0) end
        return true
    end
    function movement:acquire(context, cleanup)
        if context and context.readOnly then return nil, "READ_ONLY_CONTEXT" end
        if not runtime:isActive(context) or context:isCancelled() or context:isClosing() then
            return nil, "STALE_JOB"
        end
        if owner then return nil, "MOVEMENT_BUSY" end
        assert(cleanup == nil or type(cleanup) == "function", "Invalid movement cleanup")
        generation = generation + 1
        local lease = {
            instanceId = context.instanceId, jobId = context.jobId, generation = generation,
        }
        owner, ownerContext, onRelease = lease, context, cleanup
        context:deferCleanup(function()
            if owner == lease then self:release(lease)
            elseif releaseErrors[lease] then error(releaseErrors[lease], 0) end
        end)
        return lease
    end
    function movement:perform(lease, callback, ...)
        if not self:canAct(lease) then return false, "STALE_OR_CANCELLED_LEASE" end
        assert(type(callback) == "function", "Movement effect callback required")
        return true, callback(...)
    end

    return movement
end

return MovementOwnership
end
-- END MODULE main.core.MovementOwnership

-- BEGIN MODULE main.core.RaidHandoffState
__factories["main.core.RaidHandoffState"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local Contracts = require("main.core.Contracts")
local RaidHandoffState = {}

local phases = {PREPARED = true, ARRIVED = true, RESULT_VERIFIED = true, RETURN_INITIATED = true,
    PARTICIPATION_VERIFIED = true, RESULT_PENDING = true, ORIGIN_ARRIVED = true, RETURN_VERIFIED = true}
local previousPhase = {
    ARRIVED = {PREPARED = true}, PARTICIPATION_VERIFIED = {ARRIVED = true},
    RESULT_PENDING = {PARTICIPATION_VERIFIED = true},
    RESULT_VERIFIED = {ARRIVED = true, PARTICIPATION_VERIFIED = true, RESULT_PENDING = true},
    RETURN_INITIATED = {RESULT_VERIFIED = true},
    ORIGIN_ARRIVED = {RESULT_VERIFIED = true, RETURN_INITIATED = true},
    RETURN_VERIFIED = {RESULT_VERIFIED = true, RETURN_INITIATED = true, ORIGIN_ARRIVED = true},
}
local submissionStates = {RESERVED = true, DISPATCHING = true, SUBMITTED = true, UNCERTAIN = true}
local function tokenValid(token)
    return type(token) == "string" and #token >= 1 and #token <= 128
end
local function timeValid(value) return Contracts.isFinite(value) and value >= 0 end

function RaidHandoffState.new(options)
    local storage, clock, routes = options.storage, options.clock, Contracts.copy(options.routes or {})
    local key = options.key or "plane-rng-v6-raid-handoff"
    local ttl = options.ttl or 3600
    assert(Contracts.isFinite(ttl) and ttl > 0, "Invalid raid handoff lifetime")
    for id, route in pairs(routes) do
        Contracts.assertKind(id)
        assert(Contracts.isHomeWorld(route.sourcePlaceId) and Contracts.isHomeWorld(route.destinationPlaceId)
            and route.sourcePlaceId ~= route.destinationPlaceId, "Invalid raid route")
    end
    local available = storage and type(storage.read) == "function" and type(storage.compareAndSwap) == "function"
    local tracker = {}
    local record, tag, busy, readCode = nil, nil, false, "HANDOFF_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE"
    local verifiedReturn

    local function validated(raw)
        if type(raw) ~= "table" then return nil end
        local route = routes[raw.raidId]
        if not route or raw.sourcePlaceId ~= route.sourcePlaceId or raw.destinationPlaceId ~= route.destinationPlaceId
            or not tokenValid(raw.token) or not Contracts.isHomeWorld(raw.originalWorld)
            or not timeValid(raw.createdAt) or not timeValid(raw.expiresAt) or raw.expiresAt <= raw.createdAt
            or not phases[raw.status] then return nil end
        if raw.managed == true then
            if type(route.isDifficulty) ~= "function" or not route.isDifficulty(raw.difficulty)
                or type(raw.repeatEnabled) ~= "boolean" or not submissionStates[raw.submission] then return nil end
            if raw.status ~= "PREPARED" and raw.status ~= "ARRIVED" then
                if not tokenValid(raw.nativeSessionId) then return nil end
                if raw.status ~= "PARTICIPATION_VERIFIED" and raw.status ~= "RESULT_PENDING"
                    and raw.outcome ~= "WIN" and raw.outcome ~= "LOSS" then return nil end
            end
        elseif raw.status == "PARTICIPATION_VERIFIED" or raw.status == "RESULT_PENDING" then return nil end
        return {
            raidId = raw.raidId, token = raw.token, sourcePlaceId = raw.sourcePlaceId,
            destinationPlaceId = raw.destinationPlaceId, originalWorld = raw.originalWorld,
            createdAt = raw.createdAt, expiresAt = raw.expiresAt, status = raw.status,
            managed = raw.managed == true or nil, difficulty = raw.managed and raw.difficulty or nil,
            repeatEnabled = raw.managed and raw.repeatEnabled,
            submission = raw.managed and raw.submission or nil,
            nativeSessionId = raw.managed and raw.nativeSessionId or nil,
            outcome = raw.managed and raw.outcome or nil,
        }
    end

    local function commit(nextRecord)
        local ok, saved, nextTag = pcall(storage.compareAndSwap, storage, key, tag, Contracts.copy(nextRecord))
        if ok and saved == true then
            record, tag = nextRecord, nextTag
            return true
        end
        readCode = ok and nextTag == "WRITE_CONFLICT" and "HANDOFF_WRITE_CONFLICT" or "HANDOFF_WRITE_FAILED"
        return false, readCode
    end

    local function locked(operation, ...)
        if busy then return false, "HANDOFF_BUSY" end
        busy = true
        local ok, result, detail = pcall(operation, ...)
        busy = false
        if not ok then return false, "HANDOFF_HOST_ERROR" end
        return result, detail
    end

    local function refresh()
        if not available then return false, readCode end
        local ok, raw, currentTag, code = pcall(storage.read, storage, key)
        if not ok or code then
            readCode = "HANDOFF_READ_FAILED"
            return false, readCode
        end
        local current = raw ~= nil and validated(raw) or nil
        if raw ~= nil and not current then
            readCode = "HANDOFF_CORRUPT"
            return false, readCode
        end
        record, tag, readCode = current, currentTag, nil
        if record and record.status == "RETURN_VERIFIED" then
            verifiedReturn = record
            return commit(nil)
        end
        return true
    end
    function tracker:forceClear()
        local warning
        if available then
            local ok, _, latestTag, code = pcall(storage.read, storage, key)
            if ok and not code then
                local wrote, saved, newTag = pcall(storage.compareAndSwap, storage, key, latestTag, nil)
                if wrote and saved == true then tag = newTag
                else warning = "HANDOFF_FORCE_CLEAR_WRITE_FAILED" end
            else warning = "HANDOFF_FORCE_CLEAR_READ_FAILED" end
        else warning = "HANDOFF_FORCE_CLEAR_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE" end
        record, readCode, verifiedReturn, busy = nil, nil, nil, false
        return warning == nil, warning
    end
    function tracker:refresh() return locked(refresh) end

    local function expired(value) return clock.epoch() >= value.expiresAt end
    function tracker:pauseReason()
        if busy or readCode == "HANDOFF_WRITE_CONFLICT" or readCode == "HANDOFF_CORRUPT"
            or readCode == "HANDOFF_READ_FAILED" then return "RAID_HANDOFF_RECONCILING" end
        if record and record.status ~= "RETURN_VERIFIED" then
            return expired(record) and "RAID_HANDOFF_EXPIRED_UNRESOLVED" or "RAID_HANDOFF_ACTIVE"
        end
    end
    function tracker:blocksRaid(raidId)
        return routes[raidId] ~= nil and (type(options.mintToken) ~= "function" or readCode ~= nil
            or record ~= nil and record.status ~= "RETURN_VERIFIED")
    end
    function tracker:isManagedRaid(raidId) return routes[raidId] ~= nil end
    function tracker:expiredAt()
        if record and record.status ~= "RETURN_VERIFIED" and expired(record) then return record.expiresAt end
    end
    function tracker:isRaidPlace(placeId)
        for _, route in pairs(routes) do
            if route.destinationPlaceId == placeId then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    function tracker:status()
        local isExpired = record and expired(record) or false
        local phase = record and record.status or verifiedReturn and "RETURN_VERIFIED" or "IDLE"
        if phase ~= "RETURN_VERIFIED" then
            if isExpired or readCode and readCode ~= "HANDOFF_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE" then phase = "RECOVERY_REQUIRED"
            elseif readCode then phase = "UNAVAILABLE" end
        end
        return {record = Contracts.copy(record), expired = isExpired, phase = phase,
            lastVerifiedReturn = Contracts.copy(verifiedReturn), code = readCode, busy = busy}
    end

    local function prepare(raidId, place, attempt)
        local route = routes[raidId]
        if not route then return false, "UNKNOWN_RAID_ROUTE" end
        if readCode then return false, readCode end
        if record then return false, expired(record) and "HANDOFF_EXPIRED_UNRESOLVED" or "HANDOFF_EXISTS" end
        if type(place) ~= "table" or place.schedulerSafe ~= true or place.placeId ~= route.sourcePlaceId
            or not Contracts.isHomeWorld(place.world) then return false, "INVALID_RAID_ORIGIN" end
        if type(options.mintToken) ~= "function" then return false, "HANDOFF_TOKEN_UNAVAILABLE" end
        if attempt and (type(route.isDifficulty) ~= "function" or not route.isDifficulty(attempt.difficulty)) then
            return false, "INVALID_RAID_DIFFICULTY"
        end
        local now, token = clock.epoch(), options.mintToken()
        local nextRecord = validated({
            raidId = raidId, token = token, sourcePlaceId = route.sourcePlaceId,
            destinationPlaceId = route.destinationPlaceId, originalWorld = place.world,
            createdAt = now, expiresAt = now + ttl, status = "PREPARED",
            managed = attempt ~= nil or nil, difficulty = attempt and attempt.difficulty,
            repeatEnabled = attempt and attempt.repeatEnabled, submission = attempt and "RESERVED",
        })
        if not nextRecord then return false, "INVALID_HANDOFF_TOKEN" end
        local committed, code = commit(nextRecord)
        if not committed then return false, code end
        verifiedReturn = nil
        return true, Contracts.copy(record)
    end
    function tracker:prepare(raidId, place, attempt) return locked(prepare, raidId, place, attempt) end

    function tracker:recordSubmission(token, stage)
        return locked(function()
            if not record or record.token ~= token or not record.managed or readCode then
                return false, "HANDOFF_SUBMISSION_UNAVAILABLE"
            end
            if record.status ~= "PREPARED" or expired(record)
                or not (stage == "DISPATCHING" and record.submission == "RESERVED"
                    or (stage == "SUBMITTED" or stage == "UNCERTAIN") and record.submission == "DISPATCHING") then
                return false, "HANDOFF_SUBMISSION_OUT_OF_ORDER"
            end
            local nextRecord = Contracts.copy(record)
            nextRecord.submission = stage
            return commit(nextRecord)
        end)
    end

    local function recordEvent(event, verify)
        if type(event) ~= "table" or not record or event.token ~= record.token or event.raidId ~= record.raidId then
            return false, "HANDOFF_TOKEN_MISMATCH"
        end
        if readCode then return false, readCode end
        local current, kind = record, event.type
        local reconcile = kind == "EXPIRED_RESOLVED"
        if reconcile ~= expired(current) then
            return false, reconcile and "HANDOFF_STILL_VALID" or "HANDOFF_EXPIRED"
        end
        if not reconcile and (not previousPhase[kind] or not previousPhase[kind][current.status]) then
            return false, "HANDOFF_EVENT_OUT_OF_ORDER"
        end
        if (kind == "PARTICIPATION_VERIFIED" or kind == "RESULT_PENDING") and not current.managed
            or current.managed and (kind == "ARRIVED" and current.submission == "RESERVED"
                or kind == "RESULT_VERIFIED" and current.status == "ARRIVED") then
            return false, "HANDOFF_EVENT_OUT_OF_ORDER"
        end
        local returning = reconcile or kind == "RETURN_VERIFIED"
        local atOrigin = returning or kind == "ORIGIN_ARRIVED"
        local placeId = atOrigin and current.sourcePlaceId or current.destinationPlaceId
        if type(verify) ~= "function" then return false, "HANDOFF_VERIFIER_UNAVAILABLE" end
        local proof = verify(Contracts.copy(event), Contracts.copy(current))
        if type(proof) ~= "table" or proof.verified ~= true or proof.placeId ~= placeId
            or atOrigin and proof.world ~= current.originalWorld or returning and proof.schedulerSafe ~= true then
            return false, "HANDOFF_EVIDENCE_UNVERIFIED"
        end
        if not reconcile and expired(current) then return false, "HANDOFF_EXPIRED" end
        if reconcile then return commit(nil) end
        local nextRecord = Contracts.copy(current)
        if kind == "ARRIVED" and current.managed then
            nextRecord.submission = "SUBMITTED"
        elseif kind == "PARTICIPATION_VERIFIED" then
            if proof.nativeParticipation ~= true or proof.difficulty ~= current.difficulty
                or not tokenValid(proof.nativeSessionId) then return false, "RAID_PARTICIPATION_UNVERIFIED" end
            nextRecord.nativeSessionId = proof.nativeSessionId
        elseif kind == "RESULT_PENDING" then
            if proof.nativeSessionId ~= current.nativeSessionId or proof.nativeFinished ~= true then
                return false, "RAID_TERMINATION_UNVERIFIED"
            end
        elseif kind == "RESULT_VERIFIED" and current.managed then
            if proof.nativeSessionId ~= current.nativeSessionId or proof.outcome ~= "WIN" and proof.outcome ~= "LOSS" then
                return false, "RAID_RESULT_UNVERIFIED"
            end
            nextRecord.outcome = proof.outcome
        end
        nextRecord.status = kind
        local committed, code = commit(nextRecord)
        if not committed then return false, code end
        if returning then
            -- Leave a verified terminal record if deleting it fails. A new context can clear it.
            verifiedReturn = nextRecord
            local cleared, clearCode = commit(nil)
            return true, not cleared and clearCode or nil
        end
        return true
    end
    function tracker:recordEvent(event, verify) return locked(recordEvent, event, verify) end

    return tracker
end

return RaidHandoffState
end
-- END MODULE main.core.RaidHandoffState

-- BEGIN MODULE main.core.RaidIsolationPolicy
__factories["main.core.RaidIsolationPolicy"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Raid-specific quarantine: an independently verified native HOME return
-- without an outcome must not stall unrelated Totem/Boss work. The Raid
-- journal remains intact and blocks ALL new Raid handoffs until reconciled.
-- No time-based inference from an expired SUBMITTED/UNCERTAIN attempt.
local RaidIsolationPolicy = {}

function RaidIsolationPolicy.allowOtherJobs(status, evidence, checkpoint, plan)
    if plan and plan.kind == "RAID" then return false end
    if type(status) ~= "table" or status.code ~= "RAID_NATIVE_OUTCOME_MISSING" then return false end
    local record = status.record
    if type(record) ~= "table" or record.status ~= "RETURN_VERIFIED"
        or record.outcome ~= nil then return false end
    if type(checkpoint) ~= "table" or checkpoint.ownership ~= "RELEASED"
        or checkpoint.encounterId ~= nil then return false end
    return type(evidence) == "table" and evidence.schedulerSafe == true
        and evidence.placeId == record.sourcePlaceId
        and evidence.world == record.originalWorld
        and (evidence.location == nil or evidence.location == "WORLD")
end

return RaidIsolationPolicy
end
-- END MODULE main.core.RaidIsolationPolicy

-- BEGIN MODULE main.core.Readiness
__factories["main.core.Readiness"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local Contracts = require("main.core.Contracts")
local Readiness = {}

Readiness.Status = {
    READY = "READY", COOLDOWN = "COOLDOWN", BLOCKED = "BLOCKED",
    RUNNING = "RUNNING", UNKNOWN = "UNKNOWN",
}

local function verifiedSample(sample, kind, bossId, revision, now)
    if type(sample) ~= "table" or not Readiness.Status[sample.state] or sample.enabled == false
        or sample.kind ~= nil and sample.kind ~= kind or sample.bossId ~= nil and sample.bossId ~= bossId
        or sample.configurationRevision ~= nil and sample.configurationRevision ~= revision then return nil end
    local observedAt, validUntil, nextCheckAt = sample.observedAt, sample.validUntil, sample.nextCheckAt
    if not Contracts.isFinite(observedAt) or observedAt < 0 or observedAt > now
        or not Contracts.isFinite(validUntil) or validUntil <= observedAt
        or not Contracts.isFinite(nextCheckAt) or nextCheckAt < observedAt then return nil end
    return {state = sample.state, observedAt = observedAt, validUntil = validUntil, nextCheckAt = nextCheckAt,
        needsHideout = sample.state == "UNKNOWN" and sample.needsHideout == true or nil,
        reason = type(sample.reason) == "string" and #sample.reason <= 128 and sample.reason or nil}
end

function Readiness.new(provider, runtime)
    assert(type(provider) == "table" and type(provider.observe) == "function", "Readiness provider required")
    local readiness = {}
    local used, observations = {}, {}
    local function key(kind, bossId) return bossId and kind .. ":" .. bossId or kind end

    function readiness:observe(kind, bossId, revision, checkDispatch, noteDeadline, resources, settings)
        local function isCancelled() return not checkDispatch() end
        local ok, sample = pcall(provider.observe, provider, {
            kind = kind, bossId = bossId, now = runtime:now(), configurationRevision = revision,
            isCancelled = isCancelled, enabled = true, resources = Contracts.copy(resources),
            settings = Contracts.copy(settings),
        })
        if isCancelled() then return nil end
        local id = key(kind, bossId)
        local record = {revision = revision, reason = ok and "SERVER_READINESS_UNOBSERVED" or "PROBE_FAILED"}
        observations[id] = record
        if not ok or sample == nil then return nil end
        local now = runtime:now()
        local verified = verifiedSample(sample, kind, bossId, revision, now)
        if not verified then
            record.reason = "INVALID_READINESS"
            return nil
        end
        if verified.validUntil > now then noteDeadline(verified.validUntil) end
        if verified.nextCheckAt > now then noteDeadline(verified.nextCheckAt) end
        record.sample = verified
        return verified
    end

    function readiness:isReady(kind, bossId, sample)
        if not sample or sample.state ~= "READY" then return false end
        local now = runtime:now()
        if now >= sample.validUntil or now >= sample.nextCheckAt then return false end
        local last = used[key(kind, bossId)]
        return not last or (sample.observedAt > last.observedAt and sample.observedAt >= last.finishedAt)
    end
    function readiness:needsObservation(sample)
        local now = runtime:now()
        return sample and sample.needsHideout and now < sample.validUntil and now < sample.nextCheckAt
    end
    function readiness:record(kind, bossId, revision, preview)
        local record = observations[key(kind, bossId)]
        if record and record.revision ~= revision then record = nil end
        local sample = record and record.sample
        local now = runtime:now()
        if preview and type(provider.peek) == "function" then
            local ok, value = pcall(provider.peek, provider, {kind = kind, bossId = bossId, enabled = true,
                configurationRevision = revision, now = now, settings = Contracts.copy(preview)})
            local seen = ok and verifiedSample(value, kind, bossId, revision, now)
            if seen and (not sample or seen.observedAt > sample.observedAt) then sample = seen end
        end
        if not sample then return {state = "UNKNOWN", reason = record and record.reason or "SERVER_READINESS_UNOBSERVED"} end
        sample = Contracts.copy(sample)
        local due = math.min(sample.validUntil, sample.nextCheckAt)
        if now >= due then
            sample.state, sample.reason, sample.nextCheckAt = "UNKNOWN", "READINESS_EXPIRED", nil
            sample.needsHideout = nil
        else
            sample.nextCheckAt = due
            if sample.state == "READY" and not self:isReady(kind, bossId, sample) then
                sample.state, sample.reason = "UNKNOWN", "FRESH_READY_REQUIRED"
            end
        end
        return sample
    end
    function readiness:invalidate() observations = {} end
    -- Operator reset starts a fresh scheduling generation, including consumed
    -- readiness markers whose jobs were cancelled before normal release.
    function readiness:forceReset()
        observations, used = {}, {}
    end
    function readiness:consume(kind, bossId, sample)
        used[key(kind, bossId)] = {observedAt = sample.observedAt, finishedAt = math.huge}
    end
    function readiness:release(kind, bossId, finishedAt)
        local record = used[key(kind, bossId)]
        if record then record.finishedAt = finishedAt end
    end
    return readiness
end

return Readiness
end
-- END MODULE main.core.Readiness

-- BEGIN MODULE main.core.Runtime
__factories["main.core.Runtime"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local Contracts = require("main.core.Contracts")
local Runtime = {}
local instanceSequence = 0

function Runtime.new(options)
    options = options or {}
    local clock = options.clock or {now = os.clock, epoch = os.time}
    assert(type(clock.now) == "function" and type(clock.epoch) == "function", "Clock required")
    local sleep = options.sleep
    local poll = options.poll or 0.12
    assert(Contracts.isFinite(poll) and poll > 0, "Invalid polling interval")
    instanceSequence = instanceSequence + 1
    local instanceId = options.instanceId or ("PlaneRNGV6:" .. instanceSequence)
    assert(type(instanceId) == "string" and #instanceId > 0, "Instance ID required")
    local active, closeActive, alive, sequence = nil, nil, true, 0
    local checkpoint
    local runtime = {instanceId = instanceId}

    function runtime:now() return clock.now() end
    function runtime:epoch() return clock.epoch() end
    function runtime:isAlive() return alive end
    function runtime:activeJob() return active end
    function runtime:checkpoint()
        if not checkpoint then return nil end
        local copy = Contracts.copy(checkpoint)
        if active:isClosing() then copy.phase = "CLEANING_UP"
        elseif active:isCancelled() then copy.phase = "CANCELLING"
        elseif copy.wait then copy.phase = "WAITING_FOR_TRANSITION" end
        copy.waitOverdue = copy.wait ~= nil and copy.wait.condition == "PREDICATE"
            and self:now() > copy.wait.deadline
        return copy
    end
    function runtime:isActive(context)
        return active ~= nil and active == context and not context:isClosed()
    end

    function runtime:createJob(kind, jobOptions)
        Contracts.assertKind(kind)
        if not alive then return nil, "STOPPED" end
        if active then return nil, "BUSY" end
        sequence = sequence + 1
        local startedAt = self:now()
        local cancelled, reason, closed, closing = false, nil, false, false
        local cleanups, cleanupErrors = {}, {}
        local monitor, combatBoundary, commit
        local combatSuspended = false
        local members = {
            instanceId = instanceId, jobId = sequence, kind = kind, startedAt = startedAt,
            stage = jobOptions and jobOptions.stage or "RUN",
            readOnly = jobOptions and jobOptions.readOnly == true or false,
            bossId = jobOptions and jobOptions.bossId,
            chainEntryId = jobOptions and jobOptions.chainEntryId,
        }
        local progress = {
            instanceId = instanceId, jobId = sequence, kind = kind, stage = members.stage, bossId = members.bossId,
            phase = members.readOnly and "RECOVERING" or "RUNNING",
            ownership = "OWNED", startedAt = startedAt, lastProgressAt = startedAt,
        }
        local context = setmetatable({}, {
            __index = members,
            __newindex = function() error("JobContext is read-only", 2) end,
            __metatable = "JobContext",
        })

        function members:isCancelled()
            return cancelled or not alive or closed or active ~= self
        end
        function members:cancelReason() return reason end
        function members:isClosed() return closed end
        function members:isClosing() return closing end
        function members:reportProgress(stage)
            if self:isCancelled() or closing then return false, "STALE_JOB" end
            if type(stage) ~= "string" or #stage == 0 or #stage > 64 then return false, "INVALID_PROGRESS_STAGE" end
            progress.stage, progress.lastProgressAt = stage, runtime:now()
            return true
        end
        function members:cancel(why)
            if closed or cancelled then return false end
            cancelled, reason = true, why or "CANCELLED"
            return true
        end
        local function cleanFrom(first)
            for index = #cleanups, first, -1 do
                local callback = cleanups[index]
                cleanups[index] = false
                if callback then
                    local ok, err = pcall(callback)
                    if not ok then cleanupErrors[#cleanupErrors + 1] = tostring(err) end
                end
            end
        end
        function members:monitorInterruption(probe, stopCombat)
            monitor = probe
            combatBoundary = stopCombat and #cleanups + 1 or nil
        end
        function members:interrupt(why)
            if closing or not self:cancel(why) then return false end
            if combatBoundary then cleanFrom(combatBoundary) end
            return true, #cleanupErrors == 0
        end
        function members:isCombatSuspended() return combatSuspended end
        function members:suspendCombat()
            if closing or self:isCancelled() or combatSuspended or not combatBoundary then return false end
            combatSuspended = true
            cleanFrom(combatBoundary)
            return true, #cleanupErrors == 0
        end
        function members:resumeCombat()
            if self:isCancelled() or closing or #cleanupErrors > 0 then return false end
            combatSuspended = false
            return true
        end
        function members:deferCommit(callback)
            assert(not closed and not closing and not self:isCancelled() and not self.readOnly and not commit, "Invalid job commit")
            commit = callback
        end
        local function checkMonitor()
            if monitor and not context:isCancelled() then monitor() end
        end
        function members:deferCleanup(callback)
            assert(not closed and not closing, "Cleanup scope already closing")
            assert(type(callback) == "function", "Cleanup must be callable")
            cleanups[#cleanups + 1] = callback
        end
        local function sleepUntil(ctx, deadline)
            checkMonitor()
            while not ctx:isCancelled() and runtime:now() < deadline do
                assert(type(sleep) == "function", "Inject sleep before using JobContext.wait")
                local remaining = deadline - runtime:now()
                if remaining <= 0 then break end
                sleep(math.min(poll, remaining))
                checkMonitor()
            end
            if ctx:isCancelled() then return false, reason or "CANCELLED" end
            return true
        end
        local function beginWait(condition, deadline)
            local previous = progress.wait
            progress.wait = {condition = condition, deadline = deadline}
            return previous
        end
        local function finishWait(previous)
            progress.wait = previous
            progress.lastProgressAt = runtime:now()
        end
        function members:wait(seconds)
            assert(Contracts.isFinite(seconds) and seconds >= 0, "Invalid wait duration")
            local deadline = runtime:now() + seconds
            local previous = beginWait("ELAPSED_TIME", deadline)
            local ok, code = sleepUntil(self, deadline)
            finishWait(previous)
            return ok, code
        end
        function members:await(predicate, seconds)
            assert(type(predicate) == "function", "Predicate required")
            assert(Contracts.isFinite(seconds) and seconds >= 0, "Invalid await duration")
            local deadline = runtime:now() + seconds
            local previous = beginWait("PREDICATE", deadline)
            checkMonitor()
            while not self:isCancelled() do
                local value = predicate()
                checkMonitor()
                -- The predicate may itself yield and be cancelled.
                if self:isCancelled() then break end
                if value ~= nil and value ~= false then
                    finishWait(previous)
                    return value
                end
                local remaining = deadline - runtime:now()
                if remaining <= 0 then
                    finishWait(previous)
                    return nil, "TIMEOUT"
                end
                sleepUntil(self, math.min(deadline, runtime:now() + poll))
            end
            finishWait(previous)
            return nil, reason or "CANCELLED"
        end
        -- Only Runtime closes a job; handlers receive no close authority.
        local function close(allowCommit)
            if closed or closing then return {} end
            closing = true
            cleanFrom(1)
            if commit and allowCommit and not cancelled and #cleanupErrors == 0 then
                local ok, err = pcall(commit)
                if not ok then cleanupErrors[#cleanupErrors + 1] = tostring(err) end
            end
            cleanups, closed, closing = {}, true, false
            return cleanupErrors
        end
        active, checkpoint = context, progress
        closeActive = close
        return context
    end

    function runtime:cancelActive(kind, reason)
        if active and (kind == nil or active.kind == kind) then
            return active:interrupt(reason)
        end
        return false
    end

    function runtime:closeJob(context, allowCommit)
        if active == nil or active ~= context then return false, {"STALE_JOB"} end
        if context:isClosing() then return false, {"CLOSING"} end
        local errors = closeActive(allowCommit)
        active, closeActive, checkpoint = nil, nil, nil
        return true, errors
    end

    -- Explicit operator force reset: old contexts cannot reclaim a fresh job.
    -- Cleanup is attempted, but stale native actions already sent to the game
    -- cannot be rolled back by a client-side scheduler reset.
    function runtime:forceDropActive()
        if not active then return true end
        local old = active
        self:cancelActive(nil, "UNIVERSAL_FORCE_RESET")
        local ok, errors = pcall(closeActive, false)
        active, closeActive, checkpoint = nil, nil, nil
        if not ok then return false, "RESET_CLEANUP_EXCEPTION" end
        if type(errors) == "table" and #errors > 0 then
            return false, "RESET_CLEANUP_WARNING"
        end
        return true
    end

    function runtime:shutdown(reason)
        alive = false
        self:cancelActive(nil, reason or "SHUTDOWN")
        -- Keep the active scope until its handler returns and cleanup completes.
    end

    return runtime
end

return Runtime
end
-- END MODULE main.core.Runtime

-- BEGIN MODULE main.core.Scheduler
__factories["main.core.Scheduler"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local Contracts = require("main.core.Contracts")
local FeatureRegistry = require("main.core.FeatureRegistry")
local Scheduler = {}

function Scheduler.new(state, runtime, profile, registry, pauseReason)
    registry = registry or FeatureRegistry.new(state, runtime, profile)
    local writer = state:port("scheduler")
    local scheduler = {}
    local stepping = false
    local decisionEpoch = 0
    local lastDecision
    local completed = Contracts.signal()
    local startedEvent = Contracts.signal()
    local progressed = Contracts.signal()
    function scheduler:register(kind, handler) return registry:registerLegacy(kind, handler) end
    function scheduler:onJobCompleted(callback) return completed:subscribe(callback) end
    function scheduler:onJobStarted(callback) return startedEvent:subscribe(callback) end
    function scheduler:onJobProgress(callback) return progressed:subscribe(callback) end
    function scheduler:checkpoint()
        local checkpoint = runtime:checkpoint() or writer:checkpoint() or {phase = "IDLE", ownership = "RELEASED"}
        local encounter = state:snapshot().boss.encounter
        if encounter and encounter.phase ~= "COMPLETE" then
            local recovery = encounter.recovery
            checkpoint.encounterId = encounter.encounterId
            checkpoint.encounterOwnership = "OWNED"
            checkpoint.encounterBossId = encounter.bossId
            checkpoint.characterGeneration = encounter.characterGeneration or 1
            if encounter.worldReturn then
                checkpoint.returnStage = encounter.worldReturn.stage
                checkpoint.returnTarget = encounter.worldReturn.target
            end
            checkpoint.encounterStage = recovery and recovery.resolution == "TERMINAL_ENCOUNTER_RECOVERY" and "TERMINAL_RESULT_RECOVERY"
                or checkpoint.ownership == "OWNED" and checkpoint.stage == "ACTIVE_ENCOUNTER_REBIND" and "ACTIVE_ENCOUNTER_REBIND"
                or recovery and "UNRESOLVED_EVIDENCE"
                or encounter.phase == "COMBAT" and "ACTIVE_COMBAT"
                or encounter.phase
        end
        return checkpoint
    end
    function scheduler:readiness()
        local now = runtime:now()
        local snapshot = state:snapshot()
        local checkpoint = self:checkpoint()
        local features = registry:readinessSnapshot(snapshot, now, checkpoint)
        local nextRecordedDeadline
        for _, feature in pairs(features) do
            if feature.state == "COOLDOWN" and (not nextRecordedDeadline or feature.nextCheckAt < nextRecordedDeadline) then
                nextRecordedDeadline = feature.nextCheckAt
            end
        end
        local encounter = snapshot.boss.encounter
        local encounterBossId = encounter and encounter.phase ~= "COMPLETE" and encounter.bossId or nil
        return {
            observedAt = now, activeBossId = checkpoint.kind == "BOSS" and checkpoint.ownership ~= "RELEASED"
                and (checkpoint.bossId or encounterBossId) or nil,
            encounterBossId = encounterBossId,
            selectedBossId = snapshot.boss.selectedBossId, features = features, checkpoint = checkpoint,
            bossCandidates = snapshot.boss.candidates,
            configurationRevision = state:configurationRevision(),
            nextRecordedDeadline = nextRecordedDeadline, lastDecision = Contracts.copy(lastDecision),
        }
    end
    local function selectPlan(options)
        if options and options.live then
            local recovery, reason = registry:encounterRecovery(options)
            if recovery or reason then return recovery, reason end
        end
        local blocked = pauseReason and pauseReason(nil, options and options.noteDeadline)
        if blocked == "HOST_STATE_UNVERIFIED" and options and options.live and state:snapshot().chain then
            return registry:chainReturn(options)
        end
        if blocked then return nil, blocked end
        return registry:select(options)
    end
    local function selectionOptions(options)
        local revision = state:configurationRevision()
        local function checkDispatch()
            if options and options.isCurrent and not options.isCurrent() then return false, "STOPPED" end
            if revision ~= state:configurationRevision() then return false, "CONFIGURATION_CHANGED" end
            return true
        end
        if options and options.live then
            return {
                live = options.live, recover = options.recover, noteDeadline = options.noteDeadline,
                revision = revision, checkDispatch = checkDispatch, resourceBlock = options.resourceBlock,
            }, checkDispatch, revision
        end
        return options, checkDispatch, revision
    end
    local function runStep(options)
        local selection, checkDispatch, revision = selectionOptions(options)
        local current, code = checkDispatch()
        if not current then return nil, code end
        local plan, reason = selectPlan(selection)
        if not plan then return nil, reason end
        if not registry:has(plan.kind) then return nil, "JOB_NOT_REGISTERED" end
        -- A feature probe can yield while the external pause condition changes.
        local blocked = pauseReason and pauseReason(plan, selection and selection.noteDeadline)
        if blocked then return nil, blocked end
        current, code = checkDispatch()
        if not current then return nil, code end
        local live = selection and selection.live
        if live then
            local valid, invalid = registry:validateLive(plan, selection)
            if not valid then return nil, invalid end
        end
        local context, createError = runtime:createJob(plan.kind,
            {readOnly = plan.readOnly, stage = plan.stage, bossId = plan.bossId,
                chainEntryId = not plan.chainReturn and plan.chainId or nil})
        if not context then return nil, createError end
        current, code = checkDispatch()
        if current and live then current, code = registry:validateLive(plan, selection) end
        if not current then
            runtime:closeJob(context)
            return nil, code
        end
        local started, startError = writer:beginJob(context)
        if not started then runtime:closeJob(context); return nil, startError end
        local snapshot = state:snapshot()
        local request = {
            kind = plan.kind, stage = plan.stage, readOnly = plan.readOnly == true,
            bossId = plan.bossId, configurationRevision = revision,
            raidId = plan.kind == "RAID" and plan.bossId or nil,
            resources = Contracts.copy(plan.resources), settings = live and state:settingsSnapshot() or nil,
            homeWorld = snapshot.chain and snapshot.chain.homeWorld or snapshot.config.homeWorld,
            chainId = plan.chainId,
            -- Carry the exact recovery subtype selected by FeatureRegistry.
            -- The legacy pretravel rescue is never a new offering attempt.
            preTravelRescue = plan.preTravelRescue == true,
            postProceedReturnRescue = plan.postProceedReturnRescue == true,
            proceedQuarantineRescue = plan.proceedQuarantineRescue == true,
            snapshot = function() return state:snapshot() end,
        }
        if live then
            request.reportProgress = function(stage)
                local ok, code = context:reportProgress(stage)
                if ok then progressed:emit({checkpoint = runtime:checkpoint()}) end
                return ok, code
            end
        end
        if live and (plan.probe or plan.encounterId or plan.kind == "BOSS") then
            request.probeBossId, request.encounterId = plan.probeBossId, plan.encounterId
            request.resourcesAvailable = function()
                local encounter = plan.kind == "BOSS" and not plan.probe and state:snapshot().boss.encounter
                local owned = encounter and encounter.bossId == plan.bossId and encounter.phase ~= "COMPLETE"
                local pausePlan = (plan.encounterId or plan.chainReturn) and plan or owned and {encounterId=encounter.encounterId}
                return not context:isCancelled() and not (pauseReason and pauseReason(pausePlan or nil))
                    and not (selection.resourceBlock and selection.resourceBlock(plan.resources))
            end
        end
        if live and plan.observation then live:consume(plan.kind, plan.bossId, plan.observation) end
        startedEvent:emit({checkpoint = runtime:checkpoint()})
        local ok, result = pcall(function()
            if context:isCancelled() then
                return Contracts.result("CANCELLED", "JOB_CANCELLED", {stage = plan.stage})
            end
            return Contracts.validateResult(registry:begin(plan, context, request), runtime:now())
        end)
        -- A changed GUI toggle/config revision must NOT abandon a live
        -- scheduler writer: doing so leaves busy=true and activeContext set.
        -- Force Reset drops the old context, which is the authoritative test
        -- that prevents a stale job from writing into the new generation.
        if not runtime:isActive(context) then
            return nil, "RESET_SUPERSEDED"
        end
        current, code = checkDispatch()
        if not current and code == "CONFIGURATION_CHANGED" then
            print("[V6 SCHEDULER] INFLIGHT_CONFIG_CHANGED_SETTLE", tostring(plan.kind))
        end
        if context:isCancelled() then
            local notified, cancelError = pcall(registry.cancel, registry, plan.kind, context, context:cancelReason())
            result = Contracts.result("CANCELLED", "JOB_CANCELLED", {
                stage = ok and result.stage or plan.stage, message = context:cancelReason(),
            })
            if not notified then
                result = Contracts.result("HELD", "CANCEL_CALLBACK_FAILED", {
                    stage = plan.stage, message = tostring(cancelError),
                })
            end
        elseif not ok then
            print("[V6 SCHEDULER] JOB_EXCEPTION_DETAIL", "kind", tostring(plan.kind),
                "stage", tostring(plan.stage), "error", tostring(result))
            local checkpoint = runtime:checkpoint()
            result = Contracts.result(live and "HELD" or "FAILED", "JOB_EXCEPTION",
                {stage = checkpoint and checkpoint.stage or plan.stage, message = tostring(result)})
        end
        local _, cleanupErrors = runtime:closeJob(context, ok and (result.status == "COMPLETED" or result.status == "DEFERRED"))
        if #cleanupErrors > 0 then
            result = Contracts.result("HELD", "CLEANUP_FAILED", {stage = plan.stage, evidence = cleanupErrors})
        elseif result.code == "CHAIN_SETTLEMENT_CHECK" then
            local debt = state:snapshot().chain
            if debt and debt.encounterId == result.evidence.encounterId then
                local cooldown = result.evidence.cooldownUntil
                local remaining = cooldown and cooldown - runtime:epoch() or 0
                result = Contracts.result("COMPLETED", "BOSS_RETURN_DEFERRED",
                    {stage="CHAIN_RETURN_DEFERRED", evidence=result.evidence,
                        retryAt=remaining > 0 and runtime:now() + remaining or nil})
            end
        end
        local applied, outcome = pcall(registry.apply, registry, plan.kind, result, live and plan)
        if applied then
            result = outcome
        else
            result = Contracts.result("HELD", "CHECKPOINT_COMMIT_FAILED", {
                stage = plan.stage, message = tostring(outcome),
            })
            writer:hold(plan.kind, result.code)
        end
        local finishedAt = runtime:now()
        local finished, finishError = writer:finishJob(context, result, finishedAt)
        if not finished then return nil, finishError end
        if live and plan.observation then live:release(plan.kind, plan.bossId, finishedAt) end
        if live and result.status == "COMPLETED" and not plan.probe then live:invalidate() end
        return Contracts.copy(result), plan
    end
    local function exclusive(operation, options, recordDecision)
        -- Reserve before feature probes, which may yield or reenter the scheduler.
        if stepping then return nil, "BUSY" end
        stepping = true
        local thisEpoch = decisionEpoch
        local ok, first, second = pcall(operation, options)
        if thisEpoch ~= decisionEpoch then return nil, "RESET_SUPERSEDED" end
        if not ok then
            stepping = false
            if recordDecision then lastDecision = {code = "SCHEDULER_EXCEPTION"} end
            return nil, "SCHEDULER_EXCEPTION", tostring(first)
        end
        if recordDecision then
            lastDecision = first and {code = first.code, status = first.status, stage = first.stage, kind = second.kind}
                or {code = second}
            if first then completed:emit({result = first, checkpoint = writer:checkpoint()}) end
        end
        stepping = false
        return first, second
    end
    function scheduler:forceResetDecision()
        decisionEpoch = decisionEpoch + 1
        stepping, lastDecision = false, nil
        return true
    end
    function scheduler:resetDecision()
        if stepping then return false, "BUSY" end
        lastDecision = nil
        return true
    end
    function scheduler:select(options) return exclusive(selectPlan, options) end
    function scheduler:step(options) return exclusive(runStep, options, true) end
    return scheduler
end

return Scheduler
end
-- END MODULE main.core.Scheduler

-- BEGIN MODULE main.core.SettingsSchema
__factories["main.core.SettingsSchema"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local Contracts = require("main.core.Contracts")
local SettingsSchema = {version = 1}
local RaidCatalog = require("main.config.RaidCatalog")
local raidIds = RaidCatalog.ids

function SettingsSchema.isRaidId(id)
    return RaidCatalog.contains(id)
end

function SettingsSchema.raidCandidates(value)
    local candidates = Contracts.copyBossCandidates(value)
    if not candidates then return nil end
    local seen = {}
    for _, candidate in ipairs(candidates) do
        if not SettingsSchema.isRaidId(candidate.id) then return nil end
        seen[candidate.id] = true
    end
    for _, id in ipairs(raidIds) do
        if not seen[id] then candidates[#candidates + 1] = {id = id, enabled = false} end
    end
    return candidates
end

local function boolean(value) return type(value) == "boolean" end
local function filter(value) return type(value) == "string" and #value > 0 and #value <= 64 end
local function positive(value) return Contracts.isFinite(value) and value > 0 end
local function nonnegative(value) return Contracts.isFinite(value) and value >= 0 end
local function difficulty(value)
    return value == "Normal" or value == "Hard" or value == "Nightmare" or value == "Raid"
end
local fields = {
    bossEnabled = boolean, totemEnabled = boolean, dungeonEnabled = boolean, riftEnabled = boolean,
    raidEnabled = boolean, raidRepeat = boolean, bossRepeat = boolean, homeWorld = Contracts.isHomeWorld,
    TotemCooldownMultiplier = function(value) return value == 1 or value == 2 end,
    bossCandidates = Contracts.copyBossCandidates,
    raidCandidates = SettingsSchema.raidCandidates,
}
local sections = {
    raidDifficulty = {FINALCOLOSSUS = difficulty, OMEGASKYTITAN = difficulty, SANDWORM = RaidCatalog.SANDWORM.isDifficulty},
    dungeon = {targetWave = Contracts.isHomeWorld},
    rift = {
        targetTier = filter, targetBoss = filter, targetWorld = Contracts.isHomeWorld, preferHigherClass = boolean,
        autoTravel = boolean, autoApproach = boolean, autoJoin = boolean, directTP = boolean, safeReposition = boolean,
        manualAssist = boolean, manualAssistTimeout = positive, maxPromptDistance = positive,
        settleWorldSeconds = nonnegative, promptHoldPadding = nonnegative, promptReadyTimeout = positive,
        promptWaitInterval = positive, promptConfirmSeconds = positive, maxTravelSeconds = positive,
        minTimeRemaining = nonnegative, scanInterval = positive, logLimit = Contracts.isHomeWorld,
        autoRepeat = boolean, -- .14h: main scheduler controls repeats; retained for UI compatibility
    },
}

function SettingsSchema.hasPreference(section, field)
    return sections[section] ~= nil and sections[section][field] ~= nil
end

function SettingsSchema.preferences(raw)
    if type(raw) ~= "table" then return nil, "preferences" end
    local result = {}
    for section, schema in pairs(sections) do
        local values = raw[section]
        if section == "raidDifficulty" and raw.bossDifficulty ~= nil then
            if type(raw.bossDifficulty) ~= "table" or values ~= nil and type(values) ~= "table" then
                return nil, section
            end
            values = Contracts.copy(values or {})
            for id, value in pairs(raw.bossDifficulty) do
                if values[id] == nil then values[id] = value end
            end
        end
        if values ~= nil then
            if type(values) ~= "table" then return nil, section end
            local copy = {}
            for key, check in pairs(schema) do
                local value = values[key]
                if value ~= nil then
                    if not check(value) then return nil, section .. "." .. key end
                    copy[key] = value
                end
            end
            result[section] = copy
        end
    end
    return result
end

function SettingsSchema.normalize(raw, defaults)
    if type(raw) ~= "table" then return nil, "settings" end
    local result = Contracts.copy(defaults or {})
    for key, check in pairs(fields) do
        local value = raw[key]
        if value ~= nil then
            local validated = check(value)
            if not validated then return nil, key end
            result[key] = (key == "bossCandidates" or key == "raidCandidates") and validated or value
        end
    end
    local localBosses, legacyRaids = {}, {}
    for _, candidate in ipairs(result.bossCandidates or {}) do
        local group = SettingsSchema.isRaidId(candidate.id) and legacyRaids or localBosses
        group[#group + 1] = candidate
    end
    result.bossCandidates = localBosses
    if raw.raidCandidates == nil and #legacyRaids > 0 then
        result.raidCandidates = SettingsSchema.raidCandidates(legacyRaids)
        if raw.raidEnabled == nil then result.raidEnabled = false end
    else result.raidCandidates = SettingsSchema.raidCandidates(result.raidCandidates or {}) end
    if raw.preferences ~= nil then
        local copy, field = SettingsSchema.preferences(raw.preferences)
        if not copy then return nil, field end
        result.preferences = copy
    end
    -- The Dungeon GUI existed before the runner; show the stable default W40
    -- when the saved preference has never been set. Preserve any saved target.
    result.preferences = result.preferences or {}
    result.preferences.dungeon = result.preferences.dungeon or {}
    if result.preferences.dungeon.targetWave == nil then
        result.preferences.dungeon.targetWave = 40
    end
    if not result.homeWorld and (result.bossEnabled or result.totemEnabled
        or result.dungeonEnabled or result.riftEnabled or result.raidEnabled) then return nil, "homeWorld" end
    return result
end

function SettingsSchema.decode(record, defaults)
    if type(record) ~= "table" then return nil, "CORRUPT_SETTINGS" end
    local version = record.schemaVersion
    if version == SettingsSchema.version then
        local settings, field = SettingsSchema.normalize(record.settings, defaults)
        return settings, settings and "LOADED" or "CORRUPT_SETTINGS", field
    end
    if version ~= nil and version ~= 0 then return nil, "UNSUPPORTED_SETTINGS_VERSION" end
    local legacy = record.settings or record
    if type(legacy) ~= "table" then return nil, "CORRUPT_SETTINGS" end
    local migrated = {}
    for key in pairs(fields) do migrated[key] = legacy[key] end
    migrated.preferences = legacy.preferences
    if migrated.bossCandidates == nil and legacy.selectedBossId ~= nil then
        migrated.bossCandidates = {{id = legacy.selectedBossId, enabled = true}}
    end
    local settings, field = SettingsSchema.normalize(migrated, defaults)
    return settings, settings and "MIGRATED" or "CORRUPT_SETTINGS", field
end

return SettingsSchema
end
-- END MODULE main.core.SettingsSchema

-- BEGIN MODULE main.core.SettingsStore
__factories["main.core.SettingsStore"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local Contracts = require("main.core.Contracts")
local Schema = require("main.core.SettingsSchema")
local SettingsStore = {}

function SettingsStore.new(options)
    local clock, timer, storage = options.clock, options.timer, options.storage
    local key = options.key or "plane-rng-v6-settings"
    local debounce = options.debounce or 0.25
    assert(Contracts.isFinite(debounce) and debounce > 0, "Invalid autosave debounce")
    local defaults, field = Schema.normalize(options.defaults or {})
    assert(defaults, "Invalid default setting: " .. tostring(field))
    local store = {}
    local loaded, loadCode, loadDetail, tag, writable
    local source, observed, observedRevision, savedRevision, pending, writing, wake, saveCode

    function store:load()
        if loaded then return Contracts.copy(loaded), loadCode, loadDetail end
        loadCode = "STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE"
        if storage and type(storage.read) == "function" then
            local ok, raw, currentTag, code = pcall(storage.read, storage, key)
            if ok then
                tag = currentTag
                writable = type(storage.compareAndSwap) == "function" and (not code
                    or code == "CORRUPT_SETTINGS" and tag ~= nil)
                if code then loadCode = code
                elseif raw == nil then loadCode = "MISSING_SETTINGS"
                else loaded, loadCode, loadDetail = Schema.decode(raw, defaults) end
                if loadCode == "UNSUPPORTED_SETTINGS_VERSION" then writable = false end
            else
                loadCode, loadDetail = "SETTINGS_READ_FAILED", tostring(raw)
            end
        end
        loaded = loaded or defaults
        return Contracts.copy(loaded), loadCode, loadDetail
    end

    local function cancelWake()
        local old = wake
        wake = nil
        if old then pcall(old.cancel) end
    end

    local function arm()
        if not pending or not writable or writing then return end
        cancelWake()
        local token = {}
        local ok, cancel = pcall(timer.scheduleAt, timer, math.max(pending.dueAt, clock.now() + debounce), function()
            if wake ~= token then return end
            wake = nil
            store:flush()
        end)
        if not ok or type(cancel) ~= "function" then saveCode = "SETTINGS_TIMER_FAILED"; return end
        token.cancel, wake = cancel, token
    end

    function store:flush()
        if writing then return false, "SETTINGS_WRITE_BUSY" end
        if not pending then return true end
        if not writable then return false, saveCode or "SETTINGS_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE" end
        cancelWake()
        local current = pending
        writing = true
        local ok, committed, nextTag = pcall(storage.compareAndSwap, storage, key, tag, {
            schemaVersion = Schema.version, settings = Contracts.copy(current.settings),
        })
        writing = false
        if ok and committed == true then
            tag, savedRevision, saveCode = nextTag, current.revision, nil
            if pending == current then pending = nil end
        else
            saveCode = ok and nextTag == "WRITE_CONFLICT" and "WRITE_CONFLICT" or "SETTINGS_WRITE_FAILED"
            if saveCode == "WRITE_CONFLICT" then writable = false end
        end
        if pending ~= current then
            arm()
        elseif saveCode == "SETTINGS_WRITE_FAILED" and not current.retried then
            current.retried = true
            arm()
        end
        return saveCode == nil, saveCode
    end

    function store:bind(driver)
        assert(not source, "SettingsStore is already bound")
        self:load()
        source = driver
        observed = assert(Schema.normalize(driver:settingsSnapshot()))
        observedRevision = driver:configurationRevision()
        driver:onConfigurationChanged(function()
            local revision = driver:configurationRevision()
            if revision <= observedRevision then return end
            observedRevision = revision
            local current = Schema.normalize(driver:settingsSnapshot())
            if not current then saveCode = "INVALID_SETTINGS"; return end
            if Contracts.sameData(current, observed) then return end
            observed = current
            pending = {settings = current, revision = revision, dueAt = clock.now() + debounce}
            arm()
        end)
    end

    function store:status()
        return {loadCode = loadCode, loadDetail = loadDetail, saveCode = saveCode,
            writable = writable == true, writing = writing == true, savedRevision = savedRevision,
            pendingRevision = pending and pending.revision}
    end

    return store
end

return SettingsStore
end
-- END MODULE main.core.SettingsStore

-- BEGIN MODULE main.core.StandaloneRaidForceReset
__factories["main.core.StandaloneRaidForceReset"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Explicit operator discard of standalone *client* raid state.
-- Does not cancel native raids or already queued teleport payloads.
local Reset = {}

local RUNNERS = {
    "PlaneRNGOmegaTestV2", "PlaneRNGOmegaReturnV2",
    "PlaneRNGFinalColossusTestV3", "PlaneRNGFinalColossusReturnV3",
    "PlaneRNGFinalColossusTestV2", "PlaneRNGFinalColossusTestV1",
    "SandwormEntryV1", "SandwormCombatV1", "SandwormHomeV2", "SandwormUnifiedV1",
}
local OMEGA_FILES = {
    {path = "PlaneRNG_OmegaV2_State.json", replacement = "null"},
    {path = "PlaneRNG_OmegaV2_Raid.lua", replacement = "-- V6 universal reset: retired rescue payload\n"},
    {path = "PlaneRNG_OmegaV2_Return.lua", replacement = "-- V6 universal reset: retired rescue payload\n"},
}

local function globals()
    if type(getgenv) == "function" then
        local ok, value = pcall(getgenv)
        if ok and type(value) == "table" then return value end
    end
    return _G
end

local function retireRunner(g, key, report)
    local instance = g[key]
    if instance == nil then return end
    if type(instance) == "table" then
        local stop=key:sub(1,8)=="Sandworm" and (instance.destroy or instance.stop) or instance.stop
        if type(stop) == "function" then
            local ok, err = pcall(stop, instance)
            if not ok then report.warnings[#report.warnings + 1] = key .. ":STOP_FAILED:" .. tostring(err) end
        end
        -- Some legacy handles have no :stop() or have already exited. In
        -- either case the active handle must not be reused for a fresh run.
        instance.running = false
    end
    g[key] = nil
    report.handlesCleared = report.handlesCleared + 1
end

local function clearOmegaFile(entry, report)
    local path, replacement = entry.path, entry.replacement
    if type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(readfile) ~= "function" then
        report.warnings[#report.warnings + 1] = path .. ":STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE"
        return
    end
    -- Make the old payload inert even on executors without delfile. A
    -- persisted JSON null is ignored by Omega savedState() and preflight().
    local ok, err = pcall(function()
        writefile(path, replacement)
        assert(readfile(path) == replacement, "READBACK_MISMATCH")
    end)
    if ok then
        report.filesCleared = report.filesCleared + 1
    else
        report.warnings[#report.warnings + 1] = path .. ":" .. tostring(err)
    end
end

function Reset.clear()
    local g = globals()
    local report = {handlesCleared = 0, filesCleared = 0, warnings = {}}
    -- Stop all live standalone runners *before* retiring their rescue files.
    -- Keep user options (difficulty, dodge, selected raids) unchanged.
    for _, key in ipairs(RUNNERS) do retireRunner(g, key, report) end
    g.PlaneRNGOmegaModuleRearm = nil
    g.PlaneRNGV6StandaloneResumeToken = nil
    g.SandwormManagedResumeToken = nil
    g.SandwormUnifiedV1Handoff = nil
    if type(g.PlaneRNGV6PostRaidHome)=="table" and g.PlaneRNGV6PostRaidHome.raidId=="SANDWORM" then
        g.PlaneRNGV6PostRaidHome=nil
    end
    for _, entry in ipairs(OMEGA_FILES) do clearOmegaFile(entry, report) end
    return #report.warnings == 0, report
end

return Reset
end
-- END MODULE main.core.StandaloneRaidForceReset

-- BEGIN MODULE main.core.StandaloneRaidJournal
__factories["main.core.StandaloneRaidJournal"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- One-client, fail-closed journal for the original self-contained standalone raid scripts.
-- Unlike RaidHandoffState this is NOT an atomic cross-process CAS protocol.
-- A completed return is accepted only with a matching attempt token, a client-observed
-- native outcome, and independently inspected safe arrival in the original world.
local Contracts = require("main.core.Contracts")
local UniversalRecoveryPolicy = require("main.core.UniversalRecoveryPolicy")
local StandaloneRaidJournal = {}
local states = {PREPARED=true, DISPATCHING=true, PREQUEUE_FAILED=true,
    SUBMITTED=true, UNCERTAIN=true, RESULT_OBSERVED=true, RETURN_VERIFIED=true}
local steps = {RESERVED=true, DISPATCHING=true, SUBMITTED=true, UNCERTAIN=true}

function StandaloneRaidJournal.new(options)
    local storage, routes, clock, host = options.storage, options.routes, options.clock, options.host
    local archiveStorage = options.archiveStorage
    local archiveKey = options.archiveKey or "plane-rng-v6-abandoned-raid-archive"
    local mintToken, userId = options.mintToken, options.userId
    local key = options.key or "plane-rng-v6-standalone-raid"
    local ttl = options.ttl or 7200
    -- PREPARED is durable proof that dispatch has not been entered yet. Delay
    -- automatic cleanup to avoid racing the active entry coroutine.
    local preparedGrace = options.preparedGrace or 60
    local journal, tag, errorCode, lastReturn, lastAutoRecovery, busy
    local available = type(storage)=="table" and type(storage.read)=="function"
        and type(storage.compareAndSwap)=="function"
    errorCode = available and "RAID_JOURNAL_NOT_READ" or "RAID_LOCAL_JOURNAL_UNAVAILABLE"
    local instance = {}
    local function valid(record)
        if type(record)~="table" or type(record.raidId)~="string" then return nil end
        local route=routes[record.raidId]
        if not route or record.sourcePlaceId~=route.sourcePlaceId
            or record.destinationPlaceId~=route.destinationPlaceId
            or record.userId~=userId or type(record.token)~="string" or #record.token<8
            or not Contracts.isHomeWorld(record.originalWorld)
            or not Contracts.isFinite(record.createdAt) or not Contracts.isFinite(record.expiresAt)
            or record.expiresAt<=record.createdAt or not states[record.status]
            or type(record.repeatEnabled)~="boolean"
            or type(route.isDifficulty)~="function" or not route.isDifficulty(record.difficulty)
            or not steps[record.submission] then return nil end
        if record.status=="PREQUEUE_FAILED" then
            local failure=record.prequeueFailure
            if record.submission~="DISPATCHING" or type(failure)~="table"
                or failure.noPayloadQueued~=true
                or (failure.entryStage~="WORLD_TRAVEL_FAILED" and failure.entryStage~="COOLDOWN"
                    and failure.entryStage~="OTHER_LEADER_ACTIVE" and failure.entryStage~="ENTRANCE_BUSY"
                    and not (record.raidId=="SANDWORM" and failure.entryStage=="SANDWORM_PREQUEUE_FAILED"))
                or not Contracts.isFinite(failure.recordedAt)
                or failure.recordedAt<record.createdAt then return nil end
        end
        if record.status=="RESULT_OBSERVED" or record.status=="RETURN_VERIFIED" then
            if record.raidId=="SANDWORM" and record.outcome~=nil
                and (record.nativeResultSource~="SandwormRaidRemotes.Event.Outcome"
                    or not Contracts.isFinite(record.resultObservedAt) or record.resultObservedAt<record.createdAt) then return nil end
            if record.outcome~="WIN" and record.outcome~="LOSS" then
                -- Permit a home return with no native result, but never clear or repeat.
                if record.status~="RETURN_VERIFIED" then return nil end
            end
        end
        return Contracts.copy(record)
