    end
    local function load()
        if not available then return nil, nil, "RAID_LOCAL_JOURNAL_UNAVAILABLE" end
        local ok, data, version, code = pcall(storage.read, storage, key)
        if not ok or code then return nil,nil,"RAID_LOCAL_JOURNAL_READ_FAILED" end
        if data~=nil then
            data=valid(data)
            if not data then return nil,version,"RAID_LOCAL_JOURNAL_UNRECOGNIZED" end
        end
        return data,version,nil
    end
    local function write(value)
        if not available then return false,"RAID_LOCAL_JOURNAL_UNAVAILABLE" end
        local ok,saved,newTag=pcall(storage.compareAndSwap,storage,key,tag,Contracts.copy(value))
        if not ok or saved~=true then
            errorCode="RAID_LOCAL_JOURNAL_WRITE_UNVERIFIED"
            return false,errorCode
        end
        journal,tag,errorCode=Contracts.copy(value),newTag,nil
        return true
    end
    local function guard(fn,...)
        if busy then return false,"RAID_JOURNAL_BUSY" end
        busy=true
        local ok,a,b=pcall(fn,...)
        busy=false
        if not ok then return false,"RAID_JOURNAL_HOST_EXCEPTION" end
        return a,b
    end
    local function safeOriginalWorld(record)
        local ok,location=pcall(host.inspect,host)
        return ok and type(location)=="table" and location.schedulerSafe==true
            and location.placeId==record.sourcePlaceId
            and location.world==record.originalWorld
            and (location.location==nil or location.location=="WORLD")
    end
    local function safeSandwormMain(record)
        if record.raidId~="SANDWORM" then return false end
        local ok,location=pcall(host.inspect,host)
        if not ok or type(location)~="table" or location.schedulerSafe~=true
            or location.placeId~=record.sourcePlaceId or location.location~="WORLD"
            or not Contracts.isHomeWorld(location.world) then return false end
        return true,location
    end
    local function sandwormReturnActive(record,location)
        local ok,shared=pcall(function()return type(getgenv)=="function" and getgenv() or _G end)
        local r=ok and type(shared)=="table" and shared.SandwormHomeV2 or nil
        return type(r)=="table" and r.managedToken==record.token and r.active==true
            and r.jobId==location.jobId
    end
    local function sandwormInterrupted(record)
        local safe,location=safeSandwormMain(record)
        if not safe or sandwormReturnActive(record,location) then return false end
        if record.status=="PREQUEUE_FAILED" and record.prequeueFailure and record.prequeueFailure.noPayloadQueued then return true end
        if record.status=="PREPARED" then return clock.epoch()>=record.createdAt+preparedGrace end
        if record.status~="SUBMITTED" and record.status~="DISPATCHING" and record.status~="UNCERTAIN"
            and record.status~="RESULT_OBSERVED" and record.status~="RETURN_VERIFIED" then return false end
        -- A matching raid arrival followed by a physical safe main world proves
        -- that this local client left the raid. It does NOT establish victory.
        local arrived=Contracts.isFinite(record.sandwormEnteredAt) and record.sandwormEnteredAt>=record.createdAt
        local differentJob=type(record.sourceJobId)=="string" and #record.sourceJobId>0
            and type(location.jobId)=="string" and #location.jobId>0 and location.jobId~=record.sourceJobId
        -- Fresh main server after a forced disconnect before the raid witness:
        -- allow a grace interval, never infer from TTL alone or from same-server entry.
        return arrived or (differentJob and clock.epoch()>=record.createdAt+90)
    end
    local function refresh()
        local data,version,code=load()
        if code then errorCode=code;return false,code end
        journal,tag,errorCode=data,version,nil
        if not data then return true end
        -- Only PREPARED proves the launch path was never entered. A persisted
        -- PREQUEUE_FAILED record contains a separate observed no-queue proof.
        -- SUBMITTED / DISPATCHING / UNCERTAIN may have crossed a place boundary
        -- and MUST NEVER be auto-abandoned merely because their TTL expired.
        local policy=UniversalRecoveryPolicy.raid(data,nil,clock.epoch(),preparedGrace)
        local recoveryCode=policy.action=="RECONCILE_HOME"
            and data.status~="RETURN_VERIFIED" and policy.reason or nil
        if recoveryCode then
            if not safeOriginalWorld(data) and not (data.raidId=="SANDWORM" and sandwormInterrupted(data)) then return true end
            local cleared,reason=write(nil)
            if not cleared then return false,reason end
            lastAutoRecovery={raidId=data.raidId, token=data.token, code=recoveryCode,
                originalWorld=data.originalWorld, recoveredAt=clock.epoch()}
            return true
        end
        -- The Raid return bootstrap may fail to write RETURN_VERIFIED after a
        -- verified native result, even though the player has safely arrived
        -- back in the original world. Reconcile those two INDEPENDENT facts
        -- without claiming a result from the home arrival itself.
        -- A missing native witness, another world, an active fight, or a CAS
        -- failure still leaves the original journal intact and blocks repeat.
        local verifiedNativeResult = data.status=="RESULT_OBSERVED"
            and (data.outcome=="WIN" or data.outcome=="LOSS")
            and Contracts.isFinite(data.resultObservedAt)
            and data.resultObservedAt>=data.createdAt
            and ((data.raidId=="FINALCOLOSSUS"
                and data.nativeResultSource=="FinalBossSessionUpdate.Outcome")
                or (data.raidId=="OMEGASKYTITAN"
                and data.nativeResultSource=="OmegaOutcome.OnClientEvent")
                or (data.raidId=="SANDWORM"
                and data.nativeResultSource=="SandwormRaidRemotes.Event.Outcome"))
        if verifiedNativeResult and safeOriginalWorld(data) then
            local completed=Contracts.copy(data)
            completed.status="RETURN_VERIFIED"
            completed.returnVerifiedAt=clock.epoch()
            completed.returnEvidence="MAIN_HOST_SAFE_ORIGINAL_WORLD"
            local saved,reason=write(completed)
            if not saved then return false,reason end
            data=completed
        end
        -- Sandworm-specific recovery: only a released scheduler invokes refresh;
        -- safe main arrival plus witnessed raid entry (or changed server after
        -- grace) retires an interrupted attempt, without making a WIN/LOSS.
        if data.raidId=="SANDWORM" and sandwormInterrupted(data)
            and (data.status~="RETURN_VERIFIED" or data.outcome==nil or not safeOriginalWorld(data)) then
            local code=data.outcome and "SANDWORM_RETURN_INTERRUPTED" or "SANDWORM_INTERRUPTED_NO_OUTCOME"
            local cleared,reason=write(nil)
            if not cleared then return false,reason end
            lastAutoRecovery={raidId=data.raidId,token=data.token,code=code,
                originalWorld=data.originalWorld,recoveredAt=clock.epoch()}
            return true
        end
        if data.status~="RETURN_VERIFIED" then return true end
        if data.outcome~="WIN" and data.outcome~="LOSS" then
            errorCode="RAID_NATIVE_OUTCOME_MISSING"
            return false,errorCode
        end
        if not safeOriginalWorld(data) then
            errorCode="RAID_HOME_ARRIVAL_NOT_VERIFIED"
            return false,errorCode
        end
        local cleared,reason=write(nil)
        if not cleared then return false,reason end
        lastReturn=data
        if data.returnEvidence=="MAIN_HOST_SAFE_ORIGINAL_WORLD" then
            lastAutoRecovery={raidId=data.raidId,token=data.token,
                code="RAID_NATIVE_RESULT_HOME_RECONCILED",originalWorld=data.originalWorld,
                recoveredAt=clock.epoch()}
        end
        return true
    end
    function instance:forceClear()
        local warning
        if available then
            local ok, raw, latestTag, code = pcall(storage.read, storage, key)
            if ok and not code then
                local wrote, saved, newTag = pcall(storage.compareAndSwap, storage, key, latestTag, nil)
                if wrote and saved == true then tag = newTag
                else warning = "RAID_FORCE_CLEAR_WRITE_FAILED" end
            else warning = "RAID_FORCE_CLEAR_READ_FAILED" end
        else warning = "RAID_FORCE_CLEAR_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE" end
        journal, errorCode, lastReturn, lastAutoRecovery, busy = nil, nil, nil, nil, false
        return warning == nil, warning
    end
    function instance:refresh() return guard(refresh) end
    function instance:isRaidPlace(placeId)
        for _,r in pairs(routes) do if r.destinationPlaceId==placeId then return true end end
        return false
    end
    function instance:isManagedRaid(id) return routes[id]~=nil end
    function instance:pauseReason()
        if errorCode then return "RAID_STANDALONE_RECOVERY_REQUIRED" end
        if journal then return "RAID_STANDALONE_HANDOFF_ACTIVE" end
    end
    function instance:blocksRaid(id)
        return routes[id]~=nil and (errorCode~=nil or journal~=nil)
    end
    function instance:expiredAt()
        if journal and clock.epoch()>=journal.expiresAt then return journal.expiresAt end
    end
    function instance:status()
        local expired=journal and clock.epoch()>=journal.expiresAt or false
        local phase=journal and journal.status or lastReturn and "RETURN_VERIFIED" or "IDLE"
        if errorCode or expired then phase="RECOVERY_REQUIRED" end
        return {record=Contracts.copy(journal), expired=expired, phase=phase,
            lastVerifiedReturn=Contracts.copy(lastReturn),
            lastAutoRecovery=Contracts.copy(lastAutoRecovery),code=errorCode,busy=busy}
    end
    function instance:prepare(id,origin,attempt)
        return guard(function()
            local route=routes[id]
            if not route then return false,"UNKNOWN_RAID_ROUTE" end
            if errorCode then return false,errorCode end
            if journal then return false,"RAID_PREVIOUS_ATTEMPT_UNRESOLVED" end
            if type(mintToken)~="function" then return false,"HANDOFF_TOKEN_UNAVAILABLE" end
            if type(origin)~="table" or origin.schedulerSafe~=true or origin.placeId~=route.sourcePlaceId
                or (origin.location~=nil and origin.location~="WORLD")
                or not Contracts.isHomeWorld(origin.world) then return false,"RAID_ORIGIN_UNVERIFIED" end
            if type(attempt)~="table" or not route.isDifficulty(attempt.difficulty)
                or type(attempt.repeatEnabled)~="boolean" then return false,"RAID_ATTEMPT_INVALID" end
            local token=mintToken()
            local record=valid({raidId=id,token=token,userId=userId,
                sourcePlaceId=route.sourcePlaceId,destinationPlaceId=route.destinationPlaceId,
                originalWorld=origin.world,createdAt=clock.epoch(),expiresAt=clock.epoch()+ttl,
                status="PREPARED",managed=true,difficulty=attempt.difficulty,
                sourceJobId=id=="SANDWORM" and origin.jobId or nil,
                repeatEnabled=attempt.repeatEnabled,submission="RESERVED"})
            if not record then return false,"RAID_ATTEMPT_TOKEN_INVALID" end
            local ok,why=write(record)
            return ok,ok and Contracts.copy(record) or why
        end)
    end
    function instance:recordSubmission(token,stage)
        return guard(function()
            if errorCode or not journal or journal.token~=token then return false,"RAID_ATTEMPT_NOT_FOUND" end
            local statesAllowed={DISPATCHING={PREPARED=true},SUBMITTED={DISPATCHING=true},UNCERTAIN={DISPATCHING=true}}
            if not (statesAllowed[stage] and statesAllowed[stage][journal.status]) then
                return false,"RAID_SUBMISSION_OUT_OF_ORDER"
            end
            local nextRecord=Contracts.copy(journal)
            nextRecord.status=stage
            nextRecord.submission=stage
            return write(nextRecord)
        end)
    end
    function instance:abortPrepared(token)
        return guard(function()
            if errorCode or not journal or journal.token~=token or journal.status~="PREPARED"
                then return false,"RAID_PREPARED_ABORT_PRECONDITION_FAILED" end
            if not safeOriginalWorld(journal) then return false,"RAID_PREPARED_HOME_UNVERIFIED" end
            return write(nil)
        end)
    end
    function instance:abortUnlaunched(token, proof)
        return guard(function()
            if errorCode or not journal or journal.token~=token or journal.status~="DISPATCHING"
                then return false,"RAID_ABORT_PRECONDITION_FAILED" end
            if type(proof)~="table" or proof.noPayloadQueued~=true
                or (proof.entryStage~="WORLD_TRAVEL_FAILED" and proof.entryStage~="COOLDOWN"
                    and proof.entryStage~="OTHER_LEADER_ACTIVE" and proof.entryStage~="ENTRANCE_BUSY"
                    and not (journal.raidId=="SANDWORM" and proof.entryStage=="SANDWORM_PREQUEUE_FAILED")) then
                return false,"RAID_PREQUEUE_PROOF_MISSING"
            end
            -- Persist the native no-queue failure BEFORE attempting home
            -- inspection. If the client resets between these two operations,
            -- refresh() can safely reconcile it on the next verified home.
            local nextRecord=Contracts.copy(journal)
            nextRecord.status="PREQUEUE_FAILED"
            nextRecord.prequeueFailure={noPayloadQueued=true,
                entryStage=proof.entryStage, recordedAt=clock.epoch()}
            local saved,saveCode=write(nextRecord)
            if not saved then return false,saveCode end
            if not safeOriginalWorld(nextRecord) and not (nextRecord.raidId=="SANDWORM" and safeSandwormMain(nextRecord)) then
                return false,"RAID_PREQUEUE_HOME_UNVERIFIED"
            end
            local cleared,reason=write(nil)
            if cleared then
                lastAutoRecovery={raidId=nextRecord.raidId,token=token,
                    code="RAID_ABANDONED_PROVEN_PREQUEUE_FAILURE",
                    originalWorld=nextRecord.originalWorld,recoveredAt=clock.epoch()}
            end
            return cleared,reason
        end)
    end
    -- EXPLICIT operator abandonment only. Never automatic, never a WIN/LOSS.
    -- The unmodified source attempt is persisted and read back BEFORE clearing
    -- the active journal. On any archive/write/identity failure, fail closed.
    local function sameArchivedAttempt(left, right)
        return type(left) == "table" and type(right) == "table"
            and left.token == right.token and left.userId == right.userId
            and left.raidId == right.raidId and left.sourcePlaceId == right.sourcePlaceId
            and left.destinationPlaceId == right.destinationPlaceId
            and left.originalWorld == right.originalWorld
            and left.status == right.status and left.submission == right.submission
            and left.createdAt == right.createdAt and left.outcome == right.outcome
    end
    local function archiveInterrupted(record)
        if type(archiveStorage) ~= "table" or type(archiveStorage.read) ~= "function"
            or type(archiveStorage.compareAndSwap) ~= "function" then
            return false, "RAID_ARCHIVE_UNAVAILABLE"
        end
        local ok, snapshot, archiveTag, readCode = pcall(archiveStorage.read, archiveStorage, archiveKey)
        if not ok or readCode then return false, "RAID_ARCHIVE_READ_FAILED" end
        if snapshot ~= nil and (type(snapshot) ~= "table" or snapshot.schemaVersion ~= 1
            or type(snapshot.attempts) ~= "table") then return false, "RAID_ARCHIVE_UNRECOGNIZED" end
        snapshot = snapshot or {schemaVersion=1,attempts={}}
        local found = false
        for _,item in ipairs(snapshot.attempts) do
            if type(item) ~= "table" or type(item.record) ~= "table"
                or type(item.record.token) ~= "string" then return false, "RAID_ARCHIVE_UNRECOGNIZED" end
            if item.record.token == record.token then
                if not sameArchivedAttempt(item.record, record) then
                    return false, "RAID_ARCHIVE_TOKEN_CONFLICT"
                end
                found = true
            end
        end
        if not found then
            if #snapshot.attempts >= 100 then return false, "RAID_ARCHIVE_FULL" end
            table.insert(snapshot.attempts, {record=Contracts.copy(record),
                archivedAt=clock.epoch(),reason="USER_CONFIRMED_INTERRUPTED_RAID"})
            local wrote, saved = pcall(archiveStorage.compareAndSwap,
                archiveStorage, archiveKey, archiveTag, snapshot)
            if not wrote or saved ~= true then return false, "RAID_ARCHIVE_WRITE_FAILED" end
        end
        local checked, saved, _, savedCode = pcall(archiveStorage.read, archiveStorage, archiveKey)
        if not checked or savedCode or type(saved) ~= "table" or type(saved.attempts) ~= "table" then
            return false, "RAID_ARCHIVE_VERIFY_FAILED"
        end
        for _,item in ipairs(saved.attempts) do
            if type(item) == "table" and type(item.record) == "table"
                and item.record.token == record.token
                and sameArchivedAttempt(item.record, record)
                and item.reason == "USER_CONFIRMED_INTERRUPTED_RAID" then return true end
        end
        return false, "RAID_ARCHIVE_VERIFY_FAILED"
    end
    function instance:abandonInterrupted(expectedToken)
        return guard(function()
            if type(expectedToken) ~= "string" or not journal
                or expectedToken ~= journal.token then return false, "RAID_ABANDON_TOKEN_MISMATCH" end
            if journal.outcome ~= nil or (journal.status ~= "RETURN_VERIFIED"
                and journal.status ~= "DISPATCHING" and journal.status ~= "SUBMITTED"
                and journal.status ~= "UNCERTAIN") then return false, "RAID_ABANDON_STATUS_UNSAFE" end
            if not safeOriginalWorld(journal) then return false, "RAID_ABANDON_HOME_UNVERIFIED" end
            if journal.status ~= "RETURN_VERIFIED" and clock.epoch() < journal.createdAt + 90 then
                return false, "RAID_ABANDON_TOO_RECENT"
            end
            -- Reload from the durable source immediately before archiving.
            local fresh, version, code = load()
            if code or not fresh or fresh.token ~= expectedToken
                or fresh.status ~= journal.status or fresh.outcome ~= journal.outcome then
                return false, "RAID_ABANDON_JOURNAL_CHANGED"
            end
            journal,tag=fresh,version
            local archived, archiveCode = archiveInterrupted(fresh)
            if not archived then return false, archiveCode end
            local cleared, clearCode = write(nil)
            if not cleared then return false, clearCode end
            lastAutoRecovery={raidId=fresh.raidId,token=fresh.token,
                code="RAID_USER_ABANDONED_ARCHIVED",originalWorld=fresh.originalWorld,
                recoveredAt=clock.epoch()}
            return true, "RAID_USER_ABANDONED_ARCHIVED"
        end)
    end
    function instance:recordEvent() return false,"RAID_STANDALONE_EVENTS_FROM_NATIVE_WITNESS" end
    return instance
end
return StandaloneRaidJournal
end
-- END MODULE main.core.StandaloneRaidJournal

-- BEGIN MODULE main.core.State
__factories["main.core.State"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local Contracts = require("main.core.Contracts")
local State = {}

local function boolean(value, fallback)
    if value == nil then return fallback end
    assert(type(value) == "boolean", "Expected boolean")
    return value
end

local function counter(value)
    value = value or 0
    assert(Contracts.isFinite(value) and value >= 0 and value % 1 == 0, "Invalid counter")
    return value
end

local function timestamp(value)
    if value ~= nil then assert(Contracts.isFinite(value) and value >= 0, "Invalid timestamp") end
    return value
end

local function cooldownMultiplier(value)
    assert(value == 1 or value == 2, "TotemCooldownMultiplier must be 1 (Normal) or 2 (Gamepass)")
    return value
end

local preferenceToggles = {BOSS = "bossEnabled", TOTEM = "totemEnabled",
    DUNGEON = "dungeonEnabled", RIFT = "riftEnabled", RAID = "raidEnabled"}

function State.new(options)
    options = options or {}
    local journal = Contracts.copy(options.journal or {})
    assert(journal.schemaVersion == nil or journal.schemaVersion == 1, "Unknown journal schema")
    local savedTotem, savedBoss = journal.totem or {}, journal.boss or {}
    local schedulerClock = options.clock or {now = os.clock, epoch = os.time}
    local travelRetryJournal = options.travelRetryJournal
    local restoredTravel, travelLoadCode
    if travelRetryJournal then restoredTravel, travelLoadCode = travelRetryJournal:load() end
    -- Only a short-lived, advisory travel gate is restored. Never restore
    -- monotonic timestamps from a previous Roblox process or infer success.
    local epochNow, monotonicNow = schedulerClock.epoch(), schedulerClock.now()
    local travelStrikes, travelLastReject, travelDueEpoch, travelDueNow = 0, 0, 0, 0
    if restoredTravel then
        local previous = restoredTravel.lastRejectEpoch
        if previous <= epochNow + 5 and epochNow - previous <= 300 then
            travelStrikes, travelLastReject = restoredTravel.strikes, previous
            if restoredTravel.dueEpoch > epochNow then
                local remaining = math.min(restoredTravel.dueEpoch - epochNow, 180)
                travelDueEpoch, travelDueNow = epochNow + remaining, monotonicNow + remaining
            end
        end
    end
    if travelLoadCode and travelLoadCode ~= "STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE" then
        print("[V6 SCHEDULER] TRAVEL_RETRY_RESTORE_WARNING", tostring(travelLoadCode))
    end
    if travelDueNow > 0 then
        print("[V6 SCHEDULER] TOTEM_TRAVEL_RETRY_RESTORED", "remaining", tostring(travelDueNow - monotonicNow))
    end
    local settings = options.settings or {}
    local chainJournal = options.chainJournal
    local chain, chainError, chainAvatar, hideoutOrigin
    if chainJournal then chain, chainError = chainJournal:load() end
    local multiplier = settings.TotemCooldownMultiplier
    if multiplier == nil then multiplier = journal.TotemCooldownMultiplier end
    if multiplier == nil then multiplier = 1 end
    local homeWorld = journal.homeWorld
    if settings.homeWorld ~= nil then homeWorld = settings.homeWorld end
    assert(homeWorld == nil or Contracts.isHomeWorld(homeWorld), "Invalid home world")
    local configuredBosses = settings.bossCandidates
    if configuredBosses == nil then configuredBosses = savedBoss.candidates end
    if configuredBosses == nil then
        configuredBosses = savedBoss.selectedBossId ~= nil and {{id = savedBoss.selectedBossId, enabled = true}} or {}
    end
    local candidates, selectedBossId = Contracts.copyBossCandidates(configuredBosses)
    assert(candidates, "Invalid boss candidates")
    local data = {
        config = {
            homeWorld = homeWorld,
            totemEnabled = false, bossEnabled = false,
            bossRepeat = boolean(settings.bossRepeat, boolean(journal.bossRepeat, false)),
            raidRepeat = boolean(settings.raidRepeat, false),
            raidCandidates = assert(Contracts.copyBossCandidates(settings.raidCandidates or {})),
            TotemCooldownMultiplier = cooldownMultiplier(multiplier),
            preferences = Contracts.copy(settings.preferences or {}),
        },
        runtime = {alive = true, busy = false, lastResult = nil},
        totem = {
            -- Legacy hour buckets are deliberately ignored; they are not cooldown evidence.
            lastCheckAt = timestamp(savedTotem.lastCheckAt),
            lastSuccessAt = timestamp(savedTotem.lastSuccessAt),
            checks = counter(journal.totemChecks), nextCheckAt = travelDueNow,
            travelRetryUntilEpoch = travelDueEpoch, travelRetryStrikes = travelStrikes,
            travelLastRejectEpoch = travelLastReject,
            proceedPending = boolean(savedTotem.proceedPending, false),
            returnPending = boolean(savedTotem.returnPending, false),
            manualHold = boolean(savedTotem.manualHold, false),
            stage = savedTotem.stage or "IDLE",
            transaction = savedTotem.transaction,
            transactionSequence = counter(savedTotem.transactionSequence),
            lastStatus = savedTotem.lastStatus,
            lastStatusAt = timestamp(savedTotem.lastStatusAt),
            debugReason = savedTotem.debugReason,
            checkpoint = savedTotem.checkpoint, recovery = savedTotem.recovery,
        },
        boss = {
            nextCheckAt = 0,
            candidates = candidates, selectedBossId = selectedBossId, candidateRetryAt = {},
            encounter = savedBoss.encounter, encounterSequence = counter(savedBoss.encounterSequence),
            bosses = savedBoss.bosses or {},
            reportPending = boolean(savedBoss.reportPending, false),
            returnPending = boolean(savedBoss.returnPending, false),
            cycleId = counter(savedBoss.cycleId),
            attempts = counter(savedBoss.attempts), wins = 0, losses = 0,
            countedOutcomes = savedBoss.countedOutcomes or {},
            stage = savedBoss.stage or "IDLE",
            checkpoint = savedBoss.checkpoint, recovery = savedBoss.recovery,
        },
        world = {}, holds = journal.holds or {}, features = journal.features or {},
        chain = chain, chainError = chainError,
    }
    assert(type(data.features) == "table", "Invalid feature journal")
    assert(type(data.boss.bosses) == "table", "Invalid boss journal")
    for id, record in pairs(data.boss.bosses) do
        Contracts.assertKind(id)
        assert(type(record) == "table", "Invalid boss status")
        timestamp(record.cooldownUntil)
        timestamp(record.observedAt)
    end
    local encounter = data.boss.encounter
    if encounter then
        local phases = {START_PENDING = true, COMBAT = true, REPORT = true, RETURN = true, COMPLETE = true}
        assert(type(encounter) == "table" and type(encounter.encounterId) == "string"
            and phases[encounter.phase] and Contracts.isHomeWorld(encounter.homeWorld), "Invalid boss encounter")
        Contracts.assertKind(encounter.bossId)
        for _, key in ipairs({"soloAttempted", "continueAttempted", "reportClosed", "cooldownOnly", "adopted", "abandoned"}) do
            encounter[key] = boolean(encounter[key], false)
        end
        assert(encounter.outcome == nil or encounter.outcome == "WIN" or encounter.outcome == "LOSS", "Invalid boss outcome")
        timestamp(encounter.startedAt); timestamp(encounter.cooldownUntil); timestamp(encounter.lastDeiceAt)
        encounter.completedPhases = encounter.completedPhases or {}
        assert(type(encounter.completedPhases) == "table", "Invalid combat checkpoint")
        for key, value in pairs(encounter.completedPhases) do
            assert((key == "2" or key == "3") and type(value) == "boolean", "Invalid radar checkpoint")
        end
        assert(encounter.observedCombatPhase == nil or encounter.observedCombatPhase == 1
            or encounter.observedCombatPhase == 2 or encounter.observedCombatPhase == 3, "Invalid observed combat phase")
        assert(encounter.deiceTransactions == nil or type(encounter.deiceTransactions) == "table"
            and #encounter.deiceTransactions <= 16, "Invalid De-Ice history")
        if not encounter.cooldownOnly then
            assert(counter(encounter.cycleId) > 0 and encounter.cycleId == data.boss.cycleId, "Invalid encounter cycle")
        end
        assert(not encounter.reportClosed or encounter.cooldownOnly or encounter.outcome, "Missing report evidence")
        assert(not encounter.continueAttempted or encounter.outcome, "Continue without report evidence")
        assert(not encounter.cooldownOnly or not encounter.soloAttempted and not encounter.continueAttempted and not encounter.outcome,
            "Contradictory cooldown encounter")
        assert(encounter.phase ~= "RETURN" or encounter.reportClosed, "Return before report closure")
        assert(data.boss.encounterSequence > 0, "Missing encounter sequence")
        if encounter.phase ~= "COMPLETE" then
            if encounter.reportClosed or encounter.cooldownOnly then data.boss.returnPending = true
            else data.boss.reportPending = true end
        end
    end
    for id, feature in pairs(data.features) do
        Contracts.assertKind(id)
        assert(id ~= "TOTEM" and id ~= "BOSS" and type(feature) == "table", "Invalid dynamic feature")
        feature.enabled, feature.nextCheckAt = false, 0
    end
    local transaction = data.totem.transaction
    if transaction then
        assert(type(transaction) == "table" and type(transaction.id) == "string"
            and type(transaction.phase) == "string", "Invalid Totem checkpoint")
        assert(transaction.homeWorld == nil or Contracts.isHomeWorld(transaction.homeWorld), "Invalid transaction home")
        transaction.proceedAttempted = boolean(transaction.proceedAttempted, false)
        transaction.offeringVerified = boolean(transaction.offeringVerified, false)
        if transaction.proceedMode ~= nil then
            assert(transaction.proceedMode == "ARMED" or transaction.proceedMode == "DISPATCHED"
                or transaction.proceedMode == "UNKNOWN", "Invalid Proceed mode")
        end
        if transaction.quarantine ~= nil then
            assert(transaction.quarantine == "PREPARED" or transaction.quarantine == "RETURN_AUTHORIZED"
                or transaction.quarantine == "ISOLATED", "Invalid Proceed quarantine")
            assert(transaction.proceedAttempted and not transaction.offeringVerified,
                "Quarantine requires unresolved Proceed")
            if transaction.quarantine == "ISOLATED" then
                assert(Contracts.isHomeWorld(transaction.quarantineVerifiedHome)
                    and transaction.quarantineVerifiedHome == transaction.homeWorld,
                    "Quarantine requires recorded home verification")
            end
        end
        transaction.safeToClose = boolean(transaction.safeToClose, false)
        assert(not (transaction.offeringVerified and data.totem.proceedPending), "Contradictory Proceed checkpoint")
        if transaction.proceedAttempted and not transaction.offeringVerified then data.totem.proceedPending = true end
    elseif data.totem.proceedPending then
        data.totem.transaction = {id = "legacy-pending", phase = "PROCEED_PENDING", proceedAttempted = true, homeWorld = homeWorld}
    end
    assert(type(data.totem.stage) == "string" and type(data.boss.stage) == "string", "Invalid stage")
    assert(type(data.holds) == "table" and type(data.boss.countedOutcomes) == "table", "Invalid journal")
    for kind, code in pairs(data.holds) do
        Contracts.assertKind(kind)
        assert(type(code) == "string" and #code > 0, "Invalid hold code")
    end
    for id, outcome in pairs(data.boss.countedOutcomes) do
        assert(counter(id) > 0 and id <= data.boss.cycleId, "Invalid outcome cycle")
        assert(outcome == "WIN" or outcome == "LOSS", "Invalid outcome")
        if outcome == "WIN" then data.boss.wins = data.boss.wins + 1
        else data.boss.losses = data.boss.losses + 1 end
    end
    if encounter and encounter.outcome then
        assert(data.boss.countedOutcomes[encounter.cycleId] == encounter.outcome, "Contradictory encounter statistics")
    end
    if journal.worldTracker then
        assert(Contracts.isHomeWorld(journal.worldTracker.currentWorld), "Invalid tracker world")
        data.world.tracker = {
            currentWorld = journal.worldTracker.currentWorld, source = "session", confidence = "INFERRED",
        }
    end
    local ports = {commands = {}, scheduler = {}, totem = {}, boss = {}, world = {}}
    local state = {}
    local userEnabled = {}
    local activeContext
    local configurationRevision = 0
    local configurationChanged = Contracts.signal()
    local function advanceConfiguration()
        local revision = configurationRevision + 1
        configurationRevision = revision
        configurationChanged:emit(revision)
        return revision
    end
    local function setSetting(group, key, value)
        if group[key] == value then return end
        group[key] = value
        advanceConfiguration()
    end
    local function domain(kind)
        Contracts.assertKind(kind)
        if kind == "TOTEM" then return data.totem end
        if kind == "BOSS" then return data.boss end
        local item = assert(data.features[kind], "Feature state not registered: " .. kind)
        return item
    end
    local function enabledKey(kind)
        Contracts.assertKind(kind)
        if kind == "TOTEM" then return "totemEnabled" end
        if kind == "BOSS" then return "bossEnabled" end
        return nil
    end
    local function setFlag(group, key, value)
        assert(type(value) == "boolean", "Expected boolean")
        group[key] = value
    end
    local function setStage(group, value)
        assert(type(value) == "string" and #value > 0, "Stage required")
        group.stage = value
    end

    function state:snapshot() return Contracts.copy(data) end
    function state:settingsSnapshot()
        local result = Contracts.copy({
            homeWorld = data.config.homeWorld, bossCandidates = data.boss.candidates,
            bossRepeat = data.config.bossRepeat, TotemCooldownMultiplier = data.config.TotemCooldownMultiplier,
            raidRepeat = data.config.raidRepeat, raidCandidates = data.config.raidCandidates,
            preferences = data.config.preferences,
        })
        for kind, field in pairs(preferenceToggles) do result[field] = userEnabled[kind] == true end
        return result
    end
    function state:configurationRevision() return configurationRevision end
    function state:onConfigurationChanged(callback) return configurationChanged:subscribe(callback) end
    function state:registerFeature(id)
        Contracts.assertKind(id)
        if id ~= "TOTEM" and id ~= "BOSS" and not data.features[id] then
            data.features[id] = {enabled = false, nextCheckAt = 0, stage = "IDLE"}
        end
    end
    function state:featureSnapshot(id)
        local item = Contracts.copy(domain(id))
        local key = enabledKey(id)
        if key then item.enabled = data.config[key] end
        item.hold = data.holds[id]
        return item
    end
    function state:port(owner, id)
        if owner == "feature" then
            local item = domain(id)
            local writer = {}
            function writer:setStage(value) setStage(item, value) end
            function writer:setRecovery(stage)
                assert(stage == nil or type(stage) == "string" and #stage > 0, "Invalid recovery stage")
                item.recovery = stage and {stage = stage} or nil
            end
            function writer:setReturnPending(value) setFlag(item, "returnPending", value) end
            function writer:setStatus(value) item.lifecycle = Contracts.copy(value) end
            function writer:setCheckpoint(value)
                assert(value == nil or type(value) == "table", "Checkpoint must be a data table")
                item.checkpoint = Contracts.copy(value)
            end
            function writer:snapshot() return state:featureSnapshot(id) end
            return writer
        end
        assert(ports[owner] ~= nil, "Unknown state owner")
        -- Return a fresh capability table; callers cannot replace another port's methods.
        local result = {}
        for key, callback in pairs(ports[owner]) do result[key] = callback end
        return result
    end
    function state:exportSession()
        return Contracts.copy({
            schemaVersion = 1, homeWorld = data.config.homeWorld,
            bossRepeat = data.config.bossRepeat,
            TotemCooldownMultiplier = data.config.TotemCooldownMultiplier,
            totemChecks = data.totem.checks,
            totem = {
                proceedPending = data.totem.proceedPending,
                returnPending = data.totem.returnPending,
                manualHold = data.totem.manualHold, stage = data.totem.stage,
                transaction = data.totem.transaction, transactionSequence = data.totem.transactionSequence,
                lastStatus = data.totem.lastStatus, debugReason = data.totem.debugReason,
                lastCheckAt = data.totem.lastCheckAt, lastSuccessAt = data.totem.lastSuccessAt,
                lastStatusAt = data.totem.lastStatusAt,
                travelRetryUntilEpoch = data.totem.travelRetryUntilEpoch,
                travelRetryStrikes = data.totem.travelRetryStrikes,
                checkpoint = data.totem.checkpoint, recovery = data.totem.recovery,
            },
            boss = {
                candidates = data.boss.candidates, selectedBossId = data.boss.selectedBossId, bosses = data.boss.bosses,
                encounter = data.boss.encounter, encounterSequence = data.boss.encounterSequence,
                reportPending = data.boss.reportPending,
                returnPending = data.boss.returnPending, stage = data.boss.stage,
                cycleId = data.boss.cycleId, attempts = data.boss.attempts,
                countedOutcomes = data.boss.countedOutcomes,
                checkpoint = data.boss.checkpoint, recovery = data.boss.recovery,
            },
            holds = data.holds,
            worldTracker = data.world.tracker,
            features = data.features,
        })
    end

    function ports.commands:setHomeWorld(value)
        if data.runtime.busy and not options.allowSettingsWhileBusy then return false, "BUSY" end
        if not Contracts.isHomeWorld(value) then return false, "INVALID_HOME_WORLD" end
        setSetting(data.config, "homeWorld", value)
        return true
    end
    function ports.commands:setEnabled(kind, value)
        local key = enabledKey(kind)
        assert(type(value) == "boolean", "Expected boolean")
        if value and not Contracts.isHomeWorld(data.config.homeWorld) then
            return false, "HOME_REQUIRED"
        end
        local group = key and data.config or domain(kind)
        key = key or "enabled"
        local intentChanged = preferenceToggles[kind] and (userEnabled[kind] == true) ~= value
        if preferenceToggles[kind] then userEnabled[kind] = value end
        if group[key] ~= value or intentChanged then
            group[key] = value
            advanceConfiguration()
        end
        return true
    end
    function ports.commands:setPreferences(value)
        assert(type(value) == "table", "Validated preferences required")
        if not Contracts.sameData(data.config.preferences, value) then
            setSetting(data.config, "preferences", Contracts.copy(value))
        end
        return true
    end
    function ports.commands:setBossRepeat(value)
        assert(type(value) == "boolean", "Expected boolean")
        setSetting(data.config, "bossRepeat", value)
    end
    function ports.commands:setRaidRepeat(value)
        assert(type(value) == "boolean", "Expected boolean")
        setSetting(data.config, "raidRepeat", value)
        return true
    end
    function ports.commands:setRaidCandidates(value, expectedRevision)
        if expectedRevision ~= nil and expectedRevision ~= configurationRevision then
            return false, "CONFIGURATION_CHANGED"
        end
        local candidates = Contracts.copyBossCandidates(value)
        if not candidates then return false, "INVALID_RAID_CANDIDATES" end
        if not Contracts.sameData(data.config.raidCandidates, candidates) then
            setSetting(data.config, "raidCandidates", candidates)
        end
        return true, configurationRevision
    end
    local function setBossCandidates(value, expectedRevision, resetLegacyDeadline)
        if expectedRevision ~= nil and expectedRevision ~= configurationRevision then
            return false, "CONFIGURATION_CHANGED"
        end
        local candidates, selected = Contracts.copyBossCandidates(value)
        if not candidates then return false, "INVALID_BOSS_CANDIDATES" end
        local unchanged = #candidates == #data.boss.candidates
        if unchanged then
            for index, candidate in ipairs(candidates) do
                local previous = data.boss.candidates[index]
                if candidate.id ~= previous.id or candidate.enabled ~= previous.enabled then
                    unchanged = false
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        local deadlineChanged = resetLegacyDeadline and data.boss.nextCheckAt ~= 0
        if unchanged and not deadlineChanged then return true, configurationRevision end
        if deadlineChanged then data.boss.nextCheckAt = 0 end
        data.boss.candidates, data.boss.selectedBossId = candidates, selected
        return true, advanceConfiguration()
    end
    function ports.commands:setBossCandidates(value, expectedRevision)
        return setBossCandidates(value, expectedRevision, false)
    end
    function ports.commands:setTotemCooldownMultiplier(value)
        if data.runtime.busy and not options.allowSettingsWhileBusy then return false, "BUSY" end
        if value ~= 1 and value ~= 2 then return false, "INVALID_TOTEM_COOLDOWN_MULTIPLIER" end
        if data.config.TotemCooldownMultiplier ~= value then
            -- Reinspect on a manual change; preserve every transaction/recovery barrier.
            local tx = data.totem.transaction
            if not data.totem.proceedPending and not data.totem.returnPending and not data.totem.manualHold
                and not data.holds.TOTEM and not data.totem.recovery
                and (not tx or tx.phase == "COMPLETE" or tx.phase == "ABANDONED") then
                if data.totem.travelRetryUntilEpoch <= schedulerClock.epoch() then
                    data.totem.nextCheckAt = 0
                end
            end
            setSetting(data.config, "TotemCooldownMultiplier", value)
        end
        return true
    end
    function ports.commands:releaseHold(kind)
        local item = domain(kind)
        if item.returnPending or item.proceedPending or item.reportPending or item.manualHold or item.recovery then
            return false, "UNRESOLVED_PENDING"
        end
        data.holds[kind] = nil
        return true
    end
    -- Rift's disabled toggle may reconcile a *stale local* terminal hold only
    -- after an independent, native idle + home verification by the bridge.
    -- Never clear Boss/Raid/Totem holds or an active Rift checkpoint here.
    function ports.commands:releaseDisabledRiftHold(nativeVerified)
        if nativeVerified ~= true then return false, "RIFT_NATIVE_IDLE_UNVERIFIED" end
        local rift = domain("RIFT")
        if rift.enabled then return false, "RIFT_STILL_ENABLED" end
        if data.runtime.busy or activeContext then return false, "RIFT_JOB_ACTIVE" end
        if rift.returnPending or rift.proceedPending or rift.reportPending
            or rift.manualHold or rift.recovery then
            return false, "RIFT_RECOVERY_PENDING"
        end
        if data.holds.RIFT ~= "RIFT_TERMINAL_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE" then
            return false, data.holds.RIFT and "RIFT_HOLD_NOT_RECONCILABLE" or "RIFT_NO_HOLD"
        end
        data.holds.RIFT = nil
        if rift.stage == "HELD" then rift.stage = "IDLE" end
        rift.stopReason = nil
        advanceConfiguration()
        return true, "RIFT_DISABLED_HOLD_RELEASED"
    end

    function ports.scheduler:beginJob(context)
        if not data.runtime.alive then return false, "STOPPED" end
        if data.runtime.busy then return false, "BUSY" end
        activeContext = context
        data.runtime.busy = true
        data.runtime.activeInstanceId = context.instanceId
        data.runtime.activeJobId, data.runtime.activeKind = context.jobId, context.kind
        data.runtime.activeBossId = context.bossId
        return true
    end
    function ports.scheduler:recordTotemCheck(checkedAt, retryAt)
        data.totem.lastCheckAt = timestamp(assert(checkedAt, "Check timestamp required"))
        data.totem.checks = data.totem.checks + 1
        self:schedule("TOTEM", retryAt)
    end
    function ports.scheduler:schedule(kind, retryAt, bossId)
        assert(Contracts.isFinite(retryAt) and retryAt >= 0, "Invalid retry deadline")
        -- Totem remains P1, but no caller may undo an active server travel
        -- cooldown by scheduling a shorter readiness or GUI inspection poll.
        if kind == "TOTEM" and data.totem.travelRetryUntilEpoch > schedulerClock.epoch() then
            retryAt = math.max(retryAt, data.totem.nextCheckAt)
        end
        if (kind == "BOSS" or kind == "RAID") and bossId then
            local item = domain(kind)
            item.candidateRetryAt = item.candidateRetryAt or {}
            item.candidateRetryAt[bossId] = retryAt
        else domain(kind).nextCheckAt = retryAt end
    end
    function ports.scheduler:advanceEncounterRecovery(recheckAt)
        local encounter = data.boss.encounter
        local recovery = encounter and encounter.recovery
        if not recovery or not recovery.evidenceRecheck or encounter.phase == "COMPLETE" then return false end
        encounter.recoveryEvidenceRevision = (encounter.recoveryEvidenceRevision or 0) + 1
        if recheckAt < recovery.retryAt then recovery.retryAt = recheckAt end
        return true
    end
    function ports.scheduler:hold(kind, code)
        Contracts.assertKind(kind)
        assert(type(code) == "string" and #code > 0, "Hold code required")
        data.holds[kind] = code
    end
    -- Operator reset: discard ONLY scheduler bookkeeping. Native outcomes,
    -- completed transactions, persistent travel backoff and gameplay evidence
    -- are not writable from this port. The host must verify safe home first.
    function ports.scheduler:resetIdleHolds()
        if data.runtime.busy or activeContext then return false, "RESET_JOB_ACTIVE" end
        if data.chain or data.chainError then return false, "RESET_CHAIN_RETURN_PENDING" end
        local tx = data.totem.transaction
        if data.totem.proceedPending or data.totem.returnPending or data.totem.recovery
            or tx and tx.phase ~= "COMPLETE" and tx.phase ~= "ABANDONED" then
            return false, "RESET_TOTEM_TRANSACTION_PENDING"
        end
        if data.totem.manualHold and data.totem.debugReason ~= "TOTEM_TRAVEL_DIRECT_WORLD_REJECTED" then
            return false, "RESET_TOTEM_MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED"
        end
        local encounter = data.boss.encounter
        if data.boss.reportPending or data.boss.returnPending or data.boss.recovery
            or encounter and encounter.phase ~= "COMPLETE" then
            return false, "RESET_BOSS_RECOVERY_PENDING"
        end
        for kind, feature in pairs(data.features) do
            if feature.returnPending or feature.proceedPending or feature.reportPending
                or feature.manualHold or feature.recovery then
                return false, "RESET_FEATURE_RECOVERY_PENDING_" .. kind
            end
        end
        -- Preserve an existing server travel rejection delay: a reset must
        -- never create a teleport spam loop or bypass native cooldown.
        data.totem.nextCheckAt = data.totem.travelRetryUntilEpoch > schedulerClock.epoch()
            and data.totem.nextCheckAt or 0
        if data.totem.manualHold then
            data.totem.manualHold, data.totem.debugReason = false, nil
        end
        if data.totem.stage == "HELD" then data.totem.stage = "IDLE" end
        data.boss.nextCheckAt, data.boss.candidateRetryAt = 0, {}
        if data.boss.stage == "HELD" then data.boss.stage = "IDLE" end
        for kind, field in pairs(preferenceToggles) do
            -- Restore the operator's original enabled intent if a scheduler
            -- failure had internally stopped the feature. An explicit OFF
            -- remains OFF and settings/preferences are not erased.
            if userEnabled[kind] == true then
                if kind == "BOSS" or kind == "TOTEM" then data.config[field] = true
                elseif data.features[kind] then data.features[kind].enabled = true end
            end
        end
        for _, feature in pairs(data.features) do
            feature.nextCheckAt, feature.candidateRetryAt = 0, {}
            if feature.stage == "HELD" then feature.stage = "IDLE" end
            feature.stopReason = nil
        end
        local cleared = 0
        for kind in pairs(data.holds) do
            data.holds[kind] = nil
            cleared = cleared + 1
        end
        data.runtime.lastResult, data.runtime.lastCheckpoint = nil, nil
        advanceConfiguration()
        return true, "SCHEDULER_RESET", cleared
    end
    -- UNIVERSAL RESET: intentionally ignores held, active and unresolved state.
    -- This is a user-requested local discard, NOT a verified game outcome.
    function ports.scheduler:forceReset()
        local cleared = 0
        for kind in pairs(data.holds) do data.holds[kind] = nil; cleared = cleared + 1 end
        activeContext = nil
        data.runtime.busy = false
        data.runtime.activeInstanceId, data.runtime.activeJobId = nil, nil
        data.runtime.activeKind, data.runtime.activeBossId = nil, nil
        data.runtime.lastResult, data.runtime.lastCheckpoint = nil, nil
        data.chain, data.chainError, chainAvatar, hideoutOrigin = nil, nil, nil, nil
        local chainSaved = chainJournal == nil or chainJournal:save(nil)
        local retrySaved = true
        if travelRetryJournal then retrySaved = travelRetryJournal:clear() end
        data.totem.nextCheckAt, data.totem.travelRetryUntilEpoch = 0, 0
        data.totem.travelRetryStrikes, data.totem.travelLastRejectEpoch = 0, 0
        data.totem.proceedPending, data.totem.returnPending = false, false
        data.totem.manualHold, data.totem.debugReason = false, nil
        data.totem.transaction, data.totem.recovery = nil, nil
        data.totem.checkpoint, data.totem.stage = nil, "IDLE"
        data.boss.reportPending, data.boss.returnPending = false, false
        data.boss.encounter, data.boss.recovery = nil, nil
        data.boss.checkpoint, data.boss.stage = nil, "IDLE"
        data.boss.nextCheckAt, data.boss.candidateRetryAt = 0, {}
        for _, feature in pairs(data.features) do
            feature.returnPending, feature.proceedPending, feature.reportPending = false, false, false
            feature.manualHold, feature.recovery = false, nil
            feature.checkpoint, feature.stopReason = nil, nil
            feature.nextCheckAt, feature.candidateRetryAt = 0, {}
            feature.stage = "IDLE"
        end
        -- Preserve the user's toggles, target list, preferences and verified
        -- success history; undo temporary scheduler-owned toggle changes.
        for kind, field in pairs(preferenceToggles) do
            if userEnabled[kind] ~= nil then
                if kind == "BOSS" or kind == "TOTEM" then data.config[field] = userEnabled[kind]
                elseif data.features[kind] then data.features[kind].enabled = userEnabled[kind] end
            end
        end
        advanceConfiguration()
        return true, chainSaved and retrySaved and "SCHEDULER_FORCE_RESET"
            or "SCHEDULER_FORCE_RESET_STORAGE_WARNING", cleared
    end

    function ports.scheduler:stopFeature(kind, code)
        local key = enabledKey(kind)
        if key then setSetting(data.config, key, false)
        else setSetting(domain(kind), "enabled", false) end
        domain(kind).stopReason = code
    end
    function ports.scheduler:checkpoint()
        if activeContext then
            return {
                instanceId = activeContext.instanceId, jobId = activeContext.jobId, kind = activeContext.kind,
                stage = activeContext.stage, startedAt = activeContext.startedAt, bossId = activeContext.bossId,
                phase = "FINALIZING", ownership = "COMMIT_RESERVED",
            }
        end
        return Contracts.copy(data.runtime.lastCheckpoint)
    end
    function ports.scheduler:finishJob(context, result, finishedAt)
        if not data.runtime.busy or activeContext ~= context then return false, "STALE_JOB" end
        if not context:isClosed() then return false, "JOB_NOT_CLOSED" end
        activeContext = nil
        data.runtime.busy = false
        data.runtime.activeInstanceId = nil
        data.runtime.activeJobId, data.runtime.activeKind, data.runtime.activeBossId = nil, nil, nil
        data.runtime.lastResult = Contracts.copy(result)
        data.runtime.lastCheckpoint = {
            instanceId = context.instanceId, jobId = context.jobId, kind = context.kind, bossId = context.bossId,
            stage = result.stage, ownership = "RELEASED",
            startedAt = context.startedAt, lastProgressAt = finishedAt,
            phase = result.status == "COMPLETED" and "COMPLETED"
                or result.status == "DEFERRED" and "WAITING" or "FAILED",
            outcome = result.status, code = result.code, retryAt = result.retryAt,
        }
        return true
    end
    function ports.scheduler:shutdown()
        data.runtime.alive = false
        setSetting(data.config, "totemEnabled", false)
        setSetting(data.config, "bossEnabled", false)
        for _, feature in pairs(data.features) do setSetting(feature, "enabled", false) end
    end

    function ports.totem:setProceedPending(value) setFlag(data.totem, "proceedPending", value) end
    function ports.totem:setReturnPending(value) setFlag(data.totem, "returnPending", value) end
    function ports.totem:setManualHold(value) setFlag(data.totem, "manualHold", value) end
    function ports.totem:setStage(value) setStage(data.totem, value) end
    function ports.totem:markSuccess(successAt, successNow)
        data.totem.lastSuccessAt = timestamp(assert(successAt, "Success timestamp required"))
        data.totem.lastSuccessMonotonic = timestamp(successNow)
        data.totem.proceedPending = false
    end
    function ports.totem:observe(status, observedAt)
        data.totem.lastStatus, data.totem.lastStatusAt = status, timestamp(observedAt)
    end
    function ports.totem:scheduleCheck(retryAt)
        timestamp(assert(retryAt, "Check deadline required"))
        if data.totem.travelRetryUntilEpoch > schedulerClock.epoch() then
            retryAt = math.max(retryAt, data.totem.nextCheckAt)
        end
        data.totem.nextCheckAt = retryAt
    end
    function ports.totem:recordTravelCooldown(baseDelay, maximumDelay, monotonicNow, currentEpoch)
        assert(Contracts.isFinite(baseDelay) and baseDelay > 0
            and Contracts.isFinite(maximumDelay) and maximumDelay >= baseDelay, "Invalid travel backoff")
        local epoch, now = currentEpoch or schedulerClock.epoch(), monotonicNow or schedulerClock.now()
        assert(Contracts.isFinite(epoch) and epoch >= 0 and Contracts.isFinite(now) and now >= 0,
            "Invalid scheduler time")
        local since = epoch - data.totem.travelLastRejectEpoch
        local strikes = (since < 0 or since > 300) and 0 or data.totem.travelRetryStrikes
        strikes = math.min(strikes + 1, 8)
        local delay = math.min(maximumDelay, baseDelay * (2 ^ (strikes - 1)))
        data.totem.travelRetryStrikes, data.totem.travelLastRejectEpoch = strikes, epoch
        data.totem.travelRetryUntilEpoch = epoch + delay
        data.totem.nextCheckAt = now + delay
        if travelRetryJournal then
            local ok, reason = travelRetryJournal:save(epoch + delay, epoch, strikes)
            if not ok then print("[V6 SCHEDULER] TRAVEL_RETRY_SAVE_WARNING", tostring(reason)) end
        end
        return delay, data.totem.nextCheckAt
    end
    function ports.totem:clearTravelCooldown()
        if data.totem.travelRetryStrikes == 0 and data.totem.travelRetryUntilEpoch == 0 then return true end
        data.totem.travelRetryStrikes, data.totem.travelLastRejectEpoch = 0, 0
        data.totem.travelRetryUntilEpoch = 0
        if travelRetryJournal then
            local ok, reason = travelRetryJournal:clear()
            if not ok then print("[V6 SCHEDULER] TRAVEL_RETRY_CLEAR_WARNING", tostring(reason)) end
            return ok, reason
        end
        return true
    end
    function ports.totem:hold(code)
        data.totem.manualHold, data.totem.debugReason, data.totem.stage = true, code, "HELD"
    end
    local function clearTotemHold()
        if data.holds.TOTEM and data.holds.TOTEM:match("^TOTEM_") then data.holds.TOTEM = nil end
        data.totem.manualHold, data.totem.debugReason = false, nil
    end
    -- Narrow recovery for a previously saved world-travel rejection. No
    -- offering transaction was started, and the owner must verify Home World
    -- before invoking this method. Never clear an unrelated global hold.
    function ports.totem:releaseTravelRejectedHold(retryAt)
        timestamp(assert(retryAt, "Retry deadline required"))
        local tx = data.totem.transaction
        local pretravelException = data.totem.debugReason == "TOTEM_EXCEPTION" and tx == nil
        if not (data.totem.debugReason == "TOTEM_TRAVEL_DIRECT_WORLD_REJECTED" or pretravelException)
            or data.totem.stage ~= "HELD" or not data.totem.manualHold
            or data.totem.proceedPending or data.totem.returnPending
            or data.totem.recovery
            or tx and tx.phase ~= "COMPLETE" and tx.phase ~= "ABANDONED"
            or data.holds.TOTEM and data.holds.TOTEM ~= "TOTEM_TRAVEL_DIRECT_WORLD_REJECTED"
                and not (pretravelException and data.holds.TOTEM == "TOTEM_EXCEPTION") then
            return false, "TOTEM_TRAVEL_HOLD_NOT_SAFE"
        end
        clearTotemHold()
        data.totem.nextCheckAt, data.totem.stage = retryAt, "IDLE"
        return true
    end
    function ports.totem:beginTransaction(home, startedAt, dormantOnly)
        assert(Contracts.isHomeWorld(home), "Transaction home required")
        local previous = data.totem.transaction
        if data.totem.proceedPending or data.totem.returnPending or data.totem.manualHold or data.holds.TOTEM
            or previous and previous.phase ~= "COMPLETE" and previous.phase ~= "ABANDONED" then
            return nil, "TRANSACTION_PENDING"
        end
        data.totem.transactionSequence = data.totem.transactionSequence + 1
        local tx = {
            id = "TOTEM:" .. data.totem.transactionSequence, homeWorld = home, startedAt = timestamp(startedAt),
            phase = dormantOnly and "CLOSE_RETURN" or "EQUIP", proceedAttempted = false,
            dormantOnly = dormantOnly == true, safeToClose = dormantOnly == true,
        }
        data.totem.transaction = tx
        if dormantOnly then data.totem.returnPending = true end
        return Contracts.copy(tx)
    end
    function ports.totem:setTransactionStage(phase)
        local tx = assert(data.totem.transaction, "No transaction")
        assert(type(phase) == "string" and #phase > 0, "Phase required")
        tx.phase, data.totem.stage = phase, phase
    end
    function ports.totem:markProceedAttempt()
        local tx = assert(data.totem.transaction, "No transaction")
        if tx.proceedAttempted or data.totem.proceedPending then return false, "PROCEED_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED" end
        if tx.phase ~= "OFFER" or tx.dormantOnly then return false, "INVALID_PROCEED_STAGE" end
        tx.proceedAttempted, tx.phase, tx.proceedMode = true, "PROCEED_PENDING", "ARMED"
        data.totem.proceedPending, data.totem.stage = true, "PROCEED_PENDING"
        return true
    end
    -- The GUI driver reports whether a native event was actually dispatched.
    -- Unknown/exceptional states remain irreversible; only guaranteed pre-send
    -- rejections may revert ARMED to a reversible pre-Proceed checkpoint.
    function ports.totem:markProceedDispatch(dispatched)
        local tx = data.totem.transaction
        if not tx or not tx.proceedAttempted or not data.totem.proceedPending
            or tx.offeringVerified then return false, "PROCEED_CHECKPOINT_MISMATCH" end
        if dispatched then tx.proceedMode = "DISPATCHED"
        else tx.proceedMode = "UNKNOWN" end
        return true
    end
    local safeNotSent = {
        GUI_NOT_INTERACTABLE = true, GUI_INVALID = true,
        GUI_EVENT_INVALID = true, GUI_SIGNAL_UNAVAILABLE = true,
        INVALID_GUI_EVENT = true,
    }
    function ports.totem:revertUndeliveredProceed(code)
        local tx = data.totem.transaction
        if not safeNotSent[code] or not tx or not tx.proceedAttempted
            or tx.proceedMode ~= "ARMED" or not data.totem.proceedPending
            or tx.quarantine or tx.offeringVerified or tx.safeToClose then
            return false, "PROCEED_DISPATCH_NOT_PROVEN_ABSENT"
        end
        tx.proceedAttempted, tx.proceedMode, tx.phase = false, nil, "OFFER"
        data.totem.proceedPending, data.totem.stage = false, "OFFER"
        return true
    end
    -- Native AVAILABLE is *not* evidence of a failed offering. It authorizes
    -- only a no-retry rescue that isolates the unresolved Totem checkpoint.
    function ports.totem:armProceedQuarantine(resetAt, observedAt)
        local tx = data.totem.transaction
        if not tx or not tx.proceedAttempted or not data.totem.proceedPending
            or tx.offeringVerified or tx.safeToClose or tx.quarantine == "ISOLATED"
            or not Contracts.isFinite(resetAt) or not Contracts.isFinite(observedAt)
            or resetAt <= observedAt or not Contracts.isHomeWorld(tx.homeWorld)
            or data.holds.TOTEM and data.holds.TOTEM ~= "TOTEM_PROCEED_UNVERIFIED"
            then return false, "PROCEED_QUARANTINE_NOT_SAFE" end
        tx.quarantine, tx.quarantineResetAt, tx.quarantineObservedAt = "PREPARED", resetAt, observedAt
        tx.phase, data.totem.stage = "PROCEED_PENDING", "PROCEED_PENDING"
        return true
    end
    function ports.totem:authorizeProceedQuarantineReturn(resetAt, observedAt)
        local tx = data.totem.transaction
        if not tx or not tx.proceedAttempted or not data.totem.proceedPending
            or tx.offeringVerified or tx.safeToClose
            or (tx.quarantine ~= "PREPARED" and tx.quarantine ~= "RETURN_AUTHORIZED")
            or tx.quarantineResetAt ~= resetAt or observedAt >= resetAt then
            return false, "PROCEED_QUARANTINE_EVIDENCE_CHANGED" end
        tx.quarantine, tx.quarantineObservedAt = "RETURN_AUTHORIZED", observedAt
        return true
    end
    function ports.totem:revokeProceedQuarantine()
        local tx = data.totem.transaction
        if not tx or tx.quarantine ~= "ISOLATED" then return false end
        tx.quarantine, tx.quarantineVerifiedHome = "PREPARED", nil
        tx.phase, data.totem.stage = "PROCEED_PENDING", "PROCEED_PENDING"
        return true
    end
    function ports.totem:completeProceedQuarantine(home)
        local tx = data.totem.transaction
        if not tx or tx.quarantine ~= "RETURN_AUTHORIZED" or tx.homeWorld ~= home
            or not tx.proceedAttempted or not data.totem.proceedPending
            or data.totem.returnPending or tx.offeringVerified or tx.safeToClose then
            return false, "PROCEED_QUARANTINE_RETURN_UNVERIFIED" end
        tx.quarantine, tx.quarantineVerifiedHome = "ISOLATED", home
        tx.phase, data.totem.stage = "PROCEED_QUARANTINED", "PROCEED_QUARANTINED"
        data.totem.manualHold, data.totem.debugReason = true, "TOTEM_PROCEED_UNVERIFIED"
        data.holds.TOTEM = "TOTEM_PROCEED_UNVERIFIED"
        return true
    end
    function ports.totem:verifyOffering(successAt, successNow)
        local tx = assert(data.totem.transaction, "No transaction")
        assert(tx.proceedAttempted and successAt ~= nil, "No Proceed to reconcile")
        tx.offeringVerified, tx.safeToClose, tx.phase = true, true, "CLOSE_RETURN"
        tx.quarantine, tx.quarantineVerifiedHome = nil, nil
        self:markSuccess(successAt, successNow)
        data.totem.returnPending, data.totem.stage = true, "CLOSE_RETURN"
        clearTotemHold()
    end
    -- Narrow escape hatch for a transaction that has NOT reached Proceed.
    -- The transaction remains incomplete while its GUI is closed and the
    -- verified return is performed.  No irreversible action is replayed.
    function ports.totem:armPreProceedRecovery()
        local tx = data.totem.transaction
        if not tx or tx.proceedAttempted or tx.offeringVerified or tx.safeToClose
            or data.totem.proceedPending
            or (data.totem.returnPending and tx.phase ~= "ABORTING")
            or tx.phase == "COMPLETE" or tx.phase == "ABANDONED" then
            return false, "TOTEM_IRREVERSIBLE_OR_MISSING_TRANSACTION"
        end
        if data.holds.TOTEM and not data.holds.TOTEM:match("^TOTEM_") then
            return false, "TOTEM_FOREIGN_HOLD"
        end
        tx.phase, data.totem.stage = "ABORTING", "ABORTING"
        -- Clear only this pre-Proceed hold to allow an owned RETURN. All
        -- other holds and the incomplete transaction remain authoritative.
        clearTotemHold()
        return true
    end
    function ports.totem:abandonBeforeProceed(retryAt)
        local tx = data.totem.transaction
        if data.totem.proceedPending or data.totem.returnPending
            or tx and (tx.proceedAttempted or tx.offeringVerified or tx.safeToClose) then
            return false, "PROCEED_OR_RETURN_UNRESOLVED"
        end
        if tx then tx.phase = "ABANDONED" end
        clearTotemHold()
        data.totem.nextCheckAt, data.totem.stage = retryAt, "IDLE"
        return true
    end
    function ports.totem:reconcileReturn()
        local tx = data.totem.transaction
        if not tx or not tx.safeToClose or data.totem.proceedPending then return false end
        clearTotemHold()
        return true
    end
    function ports.totem:completeTransaction()
        local tx = assert(data.totem.transaction, "No transaction")
        assert(tx.safeToClose and not data.totem.returnPending and not data.totem.proceedPending, "Return unverified")
        tx.phase, tx.returnComplete = "COMPLETE", true
        data.totem.stage = "COMPLETE"
        clearTotemHold()
    end
    function ports.boss:setReportPending(value) setFlag(data.boss, "reportPending", value) end
    function ports.boss:setReturnPending(value) setFlag(data.boss, "returnPending", value) end
    function ports.boss:setStage(value) setStage(data.boss, value) end
    function ports.boss:selectBoss(id)
        Contracts.assertKind(id)
        if data.runtime.busy then return false, "BUSY" end
        local current = data.boss.encounter
        if not data.boss.selectedBossId and (not current or current.bossId == id) then
            ports.commands:setBossCandidates({{id = id, enabled = true}})
            return true
        end
        if data.boss.reportPending or data.boss.returnPending or data.boss.recovery or data.holds.BOSS
            or current and current.phase ~= "COMPLETE" then return false, "BOSS_ENCOUNTER_PENDING" end
        setBossCandidates({{id = id, enabled = true}}, nil, true)
        return true
    end
    function ports.boss:observeBoss(id, readiness, observedAt, cooldownUntil)
        Contracts.assertKind(id)
        assert(type(readiness) == "string", "Boss readiness required")
        data.boss.bosses[id] = {readiness = readiness, observedAt = timestamp(observedAt),
            cooldownUntil = timestamp(cooldownUntil)}
    end
    function ports.boss:beginEncounter(id, home, startedAt, adopted, verifiedHome)
        Contracts.assertKind(id)
        assert(Contracts.isHomeWorld(home), "Encounter home required")
        local previous = data.boss.encounter
        if previous and previous.phase ~= "COMPLETE" then return nil, "BOSS_ENCOUNTER_PENDING" end
        local cycle, code = self:beginCycle()
        if not cycle then return nil, code end
        data.boss.encounterSequence = data.boss.encounterSequence + 1
        data.boss.encounter = {
            bossId = id, encounterId = id .. ":" .. data.boss.encounterSequence,
            cycleId = cycle, homeWorld = home, startedAt = timestamp(startedAt),
            phase = adopted and "REPORT" or "START_PENDING", adopted = adopted == true,
            soloAttempted = false, continueAttempted = false, reportClosed = false,
            completedPhases = {}, verifiedHome = verifiedHome == true,
        }
        data.boss.reportPending, data.boss.stage = true, data.boss.encounter.phase
        return Contracts.copy(data.boss.encounter)
    end
    function ports.boss:beginCooldownReturn(id, home, cooldownUntil)
        Contracts.assertKind(id)
        assert(Contracts.isHomeWorld(home), "Cooldown return home required")
        local previous = data.boss.encounter
        if data.boss.reportPending or data.boss.returnPending or previous and previous.phase ~= "COMPLETE" then
            return nil, "BOSS_ENCOUNTER_PENDING"
        end
        data.boss.encounterSequence = data.boss.encounterSequence + 1
        data.boss.encounter = {bossId = id, encounterId = id .. ":" .. data.boss.encounterSequence,
            homeWorld = home, cooldownOnly = true, reportClosed = true, phase = "RETURN",
            cooldownUntil = timestamp(cooldownUntil), completedPhases = {}}
        data.boss.returnPending, data.boss.stage = true, "RETURN"
        return Contracts.copy(data.boss.encounter)
    end
    function ports.boss:setEncounterPhase(phase, code)
        local current = assert(data.boss.encounter, "No boss encounter")
        assert(phase == "COMBAT" or phase == "REPORT", "Invalid combat/report phase")
        current.phase, current.lastCombatCode, data.boss.stage = phase, code, phase
        data.boss.reportPending = true
    end
    function ports.boss:markRecovery(encounterId, stage, reason, retryAt, interruption, resolution, evidenceRecheck)
        local current = data.boss.encounter
        if not current or current.encounterId ~= encounterId or current.phase == "COMPLETE" then return false end
        local recovery = current.recovery or {}
        recovery.stage, recovery.reason, recovery.retryAt = stage, reason, retryAt
        recovery.evidenceRecheck = evidenceRecheck or nil
        recovery.interruption = recovery.interruption or interruption
        recovery.resolution = resolution or recovery.resolution
        current.recovery = recovery
        return true
    end
    function ports.boss:markReturnAttempt(encounterId, destination)
        local current = data.boss.encounter
        if not current or current.encounterId ~= encounterId or current.returnAttempt then return false end
        current.returnAttempt = destination
        return true
    end
    function ports.boss:invalidateNativeEnd(encounterId)
        local current = data.boss.encounter
        local recovery = current and current.recovery
        if not current or current.encounterId ~= encounterId or current.phase ~= "COMBAT"
            or current.outcome or current.reportClosed or current.returnAttempt
            or not recovery or recovery.resolution ~= "TERMINAL_ENCOUNTER_RECOVERY" then return false end
        local operation = current.worldReturn
        if operation and operation.stage ~= "RETURN_REQUIRED" and operation.stage ~= "RETURN_REQUEST_NOT_SENT" then
            return false
        end
        recovery.resolution, current.worldReturn, data.boss.returnPending = nil, nil, false
        return true
    end
    function ports.boss:requireWorldReturn(encounterId, destination)
        local current = data.boss.encounter
        if destination and destination ~= "WORLD" and destination ~= "PERSONAL_HIDEOUT"
            or not current or current.encounterId ~= encounterId or current.phase == "COMPLETE"
            or not Contracts.isHomeWorld(current.homeWorld)
            or not (current.reportClosed or current.recovery
                and current.recovery.resolution == "TERMINAL_ENCOUNTER_RECOVERY") then return false end
        local operation = current.worldReturn
        if not operation then
            current.worldReturn = {target=current.homeWorld, destination=destination or "WORLD", stage="RETURN_REQUIRED", submissions=0}
        elseif destination and destination ~= operation.destination then
            if current.returnAttempt or operation.submissions ~= 0
                or operation.stage ~= "RETURN_REQUIRED" and operation.stage ~= "RETURN_REQUEST_NOT_SENT" then return false end
            operation.destination = destination
        end
        data.boss.returnPending = true
        return true
    end
    local returnTransitions = {
        RETURN_REQUIRED = {RETURN_REQUEST_NOT_SENT=true, RETURN_IN_PROGRESS=true, RETURN_UNRESOLVED=true},
        RETURN_REQUEST_NOT_SENT = {RETURN_REQUEST_NOT_SENT=true, RETURN_IN_PROGRESS=true},
        RETURN_IN_PROGRESS = {RETURN_REQUEST_SUBMITTED=true, RETURN_UNRESOLVED=true},
        RETURN_REQUEST_SUBMITTED = {RETURN_UNRESOLVED=true, RETURN_REQUEST_NOT_SENT=true, RETURN_REQUEST_REJECTED=true},
        RETURN_REQUEST_REJECTED = {RETURN_SAME_WORLD_LOCATION_RECONCILIATION=true, RETURN_REQUEST_NOT_SENT=true},
        RETURN_SAME_WORLD_LOCATION_RECONCILIATION = {RETURN_REQUEST_NOT_SENT=true},
    }
    function ports.boss:recordWorldReturn(encounterId, stage, reason)
        local current = data.boss.encounter
        local operation = current and current.worldReturn
        if not operation or current.encounterId ~= encounterId or current.phase == "COMPLETE" then return false end
        local transitions = returnTransitions[operation.stage]
        local arrived = stage == "RETURN_ARRIVAL_VERIFIED" or stage == "RETURN_ALREADY_AT_DESTINATION"
        if not arrived and not (transitions and transitions[stage]) then return false end
        if stage == "RETURN_IN_PROGRESS" and data.chain and not data.chain.attempted then
            local debt = Contracts.copy(data.chain)
            debt.attempted = true
            if not chainJournal:save(debt) then return false, "CHAIN_JOURNAL_WRITE_FAILED" end
            data.chain = debt
        end
        operation.stage, operation.reason = stage, reason
        if stage == "RETURN_REQUEST_REJECTED" then operation.nativeRejection = reason end
        if stage == "RETURN_IN_PROGRESS" then
            operation.submissions = operation.submissions + 1
            operation.nativeResponse = nil
            current.returnAttempt = operation.destination == "PERSONAL_HIDEOUT" and "PERSONAL_HIDEOUT" or operation.target
        end
        return true
    end
    function ports.boss:recordWorldReturnResponse(encounterId, reply)
        local current = data.boss.encounter
        local operation = current and current.worldReturn
        if not operation or current.encounterId ~= encounterId or operation.stage ~= "RETURN_REQUEST_SUBMITTED" then return false end
        operation.nativeResponse = Contracts.copy(reply)
        return true
    end
    function ports.boss:replanAlreadyThere(encounterId, origin)
        local current = data.boss.encounter
        local operation = current and current.worldReturn
        if not operation or current.encounterId ~= encounterId
            or operation.stage ~= "RETURN_REQUEST_REJECTED"
                and operation.stage ~= "RETURN_SAME_WORLD_LOCATION_RECONCILIATION"
            or operation.nativeRejection ~= "AlreadyThere" or operation.alreadyThereReplanOrigin
            or not Contracts.isHomeWorld(origin) or origin == operation.target then return false end
        if not self:recordWorldReturn(encounterId, "RETURN_REQUEST_NOT_SENT", "VERIFIED_DIFFERENT_WORLD") then return false end
        operation.alreadyThereReplanOrigin = origin
        return true
    end
    function ports.boss:completeWorldReturn(encounterId)
        local current = data.boss.encounter
        local operation = current and current.worldReturn
        if not operation or current.encounterId ~= encounterId or current.phase ~= "COMPLETE"
            or data.boss.returnPending or (operation.stage ~= "RETURN_ARRIVAL_VERIFIED"
                and operation.stage ~= "RETURN_ALREADY_AT_DESTINATION") then return false end
        if data.chain and current.homeWorld == data.chain.homeWorld and operation.destination == "WORLD" then
            if not chainJournal:save(nil) then return false, "CHAIN_JOURNAL_WRITE_FAILED" end
            data.chain, chainAvatar = nil, nil
        end
        operation.completion = "RETURN_COMPLETED"
        return true
    end
    function ports.boss:reserveReturnHideoutAction(encounterId, action)
        local current = data.boss.encounter
        local operation = current and current.worldReturn
        local field = action == "EXIT" and "hideoutExitAttempted" or action == "ENTER" and "hideoutEnterAttempted"
        if not field or not operation or current.encounterId ~= encounterId or operation[field]
            or operation.stage ~= "RETURN_SAME_WORLD_LOCATION_RECONCILIATION" then return false end
        operation[field] = true
        return true
    end
    function ports.boss:resumeEncounter(encounterId, generation)
        local current = data.boss.encounter
        if not current or current.encounterId ~= encounterId or current.phase ~= "COMBAT"
            or current.outcome or current.reportClosed or current.returnAttempt or current.worldReturn then return false end
        current.recovery, current.characterGeneration = nil, generation
        return true
    end
    function ports.boss:completeInterrupted(encounterId)
        local current = assert(data.boss.encounter, "No boss encounter")
        assert(current.encounterId == encounterId and current.recovery and current.recovery.interruption
            and not current.outcome and not current.reportClosed, "Unverified interrupted encounter")
        current.phase, current.interrupted, current.recovery = "COMPLETE", true, nil
        data.boss.reportPending, data.boss.returnPending, data.boss.stage = false, false, "COMPLETE"
        if not data.config.bossRepeat then setSetting(data.config, "bossEnabled", false) end
    end
    function ports.boss:markSoloAttempt()
        local current = assert(data.boss.encounter, "No boss encounter")
        if current.soloAttempted or current.phase ~= "START_PENDING" or current.adopted then return false end
        current.soloAttempted = true
        return true
    end
    function ports.boss:recordSoloRejection(encounterId, reason)
        local current = data.boss.encounter
        if not current or current.encounterId ~= encounterId or current.phase ~= "START_PENDING"
            or not current.soloAttempted or current.adopted or current.outcome then return false end
        assert(type(reason) == "string" and reason ~= "", "Native Solo rejection reason required")
        current.soloRejection = reason
        return true
    end
    function ports.boss:recordRadar(phase, observedAt)
        local current = assert(data.boss.encounter, "No boss encounter")
        assert(current.phase == "COMBAT" and (phase == 2 or phase == 3), "Invalid radar phase")
        current.completedPhases[tostring(phase)] = true
        current.lastDeiceAt = timestamp(observedAt)
    end
    function ports.boss:recordDeiceTransaction(transaction)
        local current = assert(data.boss.encounter, "No boss encounter")
        assert(current.phase == "COMBAT" and (transaction.phase == 2 or transaction.phase == 3), "Invalid De-Ice transaction")
        current.deiceTransactions = current.deiceTransactions or {}
