        if #current.deiceTransactions >= 16 then table.remove(current.deiceTransactions, 1) end
        current.deiceTransactions[#current.deiceTransactions + 1] = Contracts.copy(transaction)
        current.observedCombatPhase = math.max(current.observedCombatPhase or 1,
            transaction.start.phase or 1, transaction.finish.phase or 1)
    end
    function ports.boss:recordBossReport(outcome, cooldownUntil)
        local current = assert(data.boss.encounter, "No boss encounter")
        if current.cooldownOnly or current.outcome and current.outcome ~= outcome then return false, "OUTCOME_CONFLICT" end
        local recorded, code = self:recordOutcome(current.cycleId, outcome)
        if not recorded then return false, code end
        current.outcome = outcome
        current.cooldownUntil = current.cooldownUntil or timestamp(cooldownUntil)
        local status = data.boss.bosses[current.bossId] or {}
        status.cooldownUntil, status.lastOutcome = current.cooldownUntil, outcome
        data.boss.bosses[current.bossId] = status
        return true
    end
    function ports.boss:markContinueAttempt()
        local current = assert(data.boss.encounter, "No boss encounter")
        if not current.outcome or current.continueAttempted or current.reportClosed or current.cooldownOnly then return false end
        current.continueAttempted = true
        return true
    end
    function ports.boss:closeReport()
        local current = assert(data.boss.encounter, "No boss encounter")
        assert(current.outcome and not current.cooldownOnly, "Report outcome required")
        current.reportClosed, current.phase = true, "RETURN"
        data.boss.reportPending, data.boss.returnPending, data.boss.stage = false, true, "RETURN"
    end
    function ports.boss:completeEncounter(repeatEnabled)
        local current = assert(data.boss.encounter, "No boss encounter")
        assert(current.reportClosed and not data.boss.reportPending and not data.boss.returnPending, "Encounter return unverified")
        if not current.cooldownOnly and not current.chainReturnOnly then
            assert(self:completeCycle(current.cycleId))
            if repeatEnabled == false then setSetting(data.config, "bossEnabled", false) end
        end
        current.phase, current.recovery, data.boss.stage = "COMPLETE", nil, "COMPLETE"
    end
    function ports.boss:canTransferReturn()
        local debt = data.chain
        return chainJournal ~= nil and not data.chainError and data.config.bossEnabled and data.config.bossRepeat
            -- No arbitrary encounter-count cap. Durable settlement and verified ownership
            -- still determine whether a deferred Home World return may be transferred.
            and (not debt or not debt.draining and not debt.restored and not debt.attempted)
    end
    function ports.boss:transferReturn(encounterId, chainId, world, avatar, outcome)
        local current, debt = data.boss.encounter, data.chain
        if not avatar or not avatar.ready or not avatar.character or not avatar.root or not avatar.humanoid
            or not self:canTransferReturn() or not current or current.encounterId ~= encounterId
            or current.phase ~= "RETURN" or current.chainReturnOnly or current.returnAttempt or current.worldReturn
            or (outcome ~= "WIN" and outcome ~= "LOSS") or current.outcome ~= outcome
            or not current.reportClosed or data.boss.reportPending
            or current.cycleId ~= data.boss.cycleId or data.boss.countedOutcomes[current.cycleId] ~= outcome
            or not debt and not current.verifiedHome or debt and debt.homeWorld ~= current.homeWorld then return false end
        -- The total chain length is unlimited, but keep only a bounded recent
        -- diagnostic history to prevent session memory from growing forever.
        local activities = Contracts.copy(debt and debt.activities or {})
        activities[#activities + 1] = {bossId=current.bossId, encounterId=encounterId}
        if #activities > 32 then table.remove(activities, 1) end
        local replacement = {id=debt and debt.id or chainId, homeWorld=current.homeWorld, bossId=current.bossId,
            completed=(debt and debt.completed or 0) + 1, activities=activities,
            encounterId=encounterId, location="PERSONAL_HIDEOUT", world=world}
        if not chainJournal:save(replacement) then return false, "CHAIN_JOURNAL_WRITE_FAILED" end
        data.chain, chainAvatar = replacement, avatar
        data.boss.returnPending = false
        self:completeEncounter(true)
        current.returnTransferred = replacement.id
        return true
    end
    function ports.boss:admitChainSuccessor(id)
        local debt = data.chain
        if not debt or debt.id ~= id or debt.draining or debt.restored or debt.successor then return false end
        local nextDebt = Contracts.copy(debt)
        nextDebt.successor = true
        if not chainJournal:save(nextDebt) then debt.draining = true; return false end
        data.chain = nextDebt
        return true
    end
    function ports.boss:chainAvatarMatches(id, avatar)
        return data.chain and data.chain.id == id and chainAvatar and avatar
            and avatar.character == chainAvatar.character and avatar.root == chainAvatar.root
            and avatar.humanoid == chainAvatar.humanoid
    end
    function ports.boss:rememberHideoutOrigin(world, ctx, avatar)
        if chainJournal and avatar and avatar.ready and Contracts.isHomeWorld(world) then
            hideoutOrigin = {world=world, jobId=ctx.jobId, instanceId=ctx.instanceId,
                character=avatar.character, root=avatar.root, humanoid=avatar.humanoid}
        end
    end
    function ports.boss:verifiedHideoutOrigin(world, ctx, avatar)
        local origin = hideoutOrigin
        return origin and avatar and avatar.ready and origin.world == world and origin.instanceId == ctx.instanceId
            and origin.jobId + 1 == ctx.jobId and origin.character == avatar.character
            and origin.root == avatar.root and origin.humanoid == avatar.humanoid
    end
    function ports.boss:declineReturnTransfer(id)
        local current = data.boss.encounter
        if current and current.encounterId == id then current.returnTransferDeclined = true end
    end
    function ports.boss:beginChainReturn(id, now)
        local debt, current = data.chain, data.boss.encounter
        if not debt or debt.id ~= id or current and current.phase ~= "COMPLETE" then return nil end
        debt.draining = true
        current = {encounterId="CHAIN:"..id, bossId=debt.bossId, homeWorld=debt.homeWorld,
            phase="RETURN", reportClosed=true, adopted=true, chainReturnOnly=true}
        data.boss.encounter, data.boss.returnPending, data.boss.stage = current, true, "RETURN"
        assert(self:markRecovery(current.encounterId, "RETURN_PENDING", "CHAIN_RETURN_REQUIRED", now))
        return Contracts.copy(current)
    end
    function ports.scheduler:drainChain()
        if not data.chain then return false end
        data.chain.draining = true
        return true
    end
    function ports.boss:clearEncounterHold()
        if data.holds.BOSS and data.holds.BOSS:match("^BOSS_") then data.holds.BOSS = nil end
    end
    function ports.boss:holdEncounter(code)
        assert(type(code) == "string" and code:match("^BOSS_"), "Boss hold code required")
        data.holds.BOSS = code
    end
    function ports.boss:abandonBeforeSolo()
        local current = assert(data.boss.encounter, "No boss encounter")
        assert((not current.soloAttempted or current.phase == "START_PENDING" and current.soloRejection)
            and not current.adopted and not current.outcome, "Encounter start unresolved")
        current.phase, current.recovery, current.abandoned = "COMPLETE", nil, true
        data.boss.reportPending, data.boss.stage = false, "IDLE"
    end
    function ports.boss:beginCycle()
        if data.boss.reportPending or data.boss.returnPending then return nil, "PENDING_CYCLE" end
        data.boss.cycleId = data.boss.cycleId + 1
        data.boss.attempts = data.boss.attempts + 1
        return data.boss.cycleId
    end
    function ports.boss:recordOutcome(cycleId, outcome)
        assert(outcome == "WIN" or outcome == "LOSS", "Invalid outcome")
        if cycleId ~= data.boss.cycleId or cycleId < 1 then return false, "STALE_CYCLE" end
        local previous = data.boss.countedOutcomes[cycleId]
        if previous then return previous == outcome, previous == outcome and "ALREADY_RECORDED" or "OUTCOME_CONFLICT" end
        data.boss.countedOutcomes[cycleId] = outcome
        data.boss.lastOutcome = outcome
        if outcome == "WIN" then data.boss.wins = data.boss.wins + 1
        else data.boss.losses = data.boss.losses + 1 end
        return true
    end
    function ports.boss:completeCycle(cycleId)
        if cycleId ~= data.boss.cycleId or not data.boss.countedOutcomes[cycleId] then
            return false, "UNVERIFIED_OUTCOME"
        end
        if data.boss.reportPending or data.boss.returnPending then return false, "PENDING_CYCLE" end
        data.boss.stage = "COMPLETE"
        if not data.config.bossRepeat then setSetting(data.config, "bossEnabled", false) end
        return true
    end
    function ports.world:observe(record)
        assert(type(record) == "table" and type(record.region) == "string", "Location record required")
        data.world.observed = Contracts.copy(record)
    end
    function ports.world:track(world, source, confidence, observedAt)
        assert(Contracts.isHomeWorld(world), "Invalid tracker world")
        assert(type(source) == "string" and #source > 0, "Tracker source required")
        assert(confidence == "VERIFIED" or confidence == "INFERRED", "Invalid tracker confidence")
        data.world.tracker = {currentWorld = world, source = source, confidence = confidence, observedAt = observedAt}
    end
    function ports.world:recordTravel(record) data.world.lastTravel = Contracts.copy(record) end
    function ports.world:recordReturn(record) data.world.lastReturn = Contracts.copy(record) end

    -- Feature intent comes from explicit settings. Runtime journals start with toggles off.
    for kind, field in pairs(preferenceToggles) do
        if settings[field] ~= nil then
            state:registerFeature(kind)
            assert(ports.commands:setEnabled(kind, settings[field]))
        end
    end
    return state
end

return State
end
-- END MODULE main.core.State

-- BEGIN MODULE main.core.TotemTravelPriorityPolicy
__factories["main.core.TotemTravelPriorityPolicy"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- .14a: a native world-travel Cooldown must not repeatedly lose P1 to a new
-- cross-place Raid. This is a bounded per-attempt WAIT, not a HELD and not
-- evidence that the offering was submitted. The Totem retries normally when
-- its stored travel gate expires; it never sends an extra remote from here.
local Policy = {}
function Policy.wait(snapshot, now, epoch)
    if type(snapshot) ~= "table" or type(snapshot.config) ~= "table"
        or snapshot.config.totemEnabled ~= true then return nil end
    local t = snapshot.totem
    if type(t) ~= "table" or t.manualHold or t.proceedPending or t.returnPending
        or t.transaction ~= nil or t.recovery then return nil end
    local dueEpoch = tonumber(t.travelRetryUntilEpoch)
    if not dueEpoch or dueEpoch <= 0 then return nil end
    -- The server gate is saved in epoch seconds, while the next scheduled
    -- Totem retry uses the monotonic runtime clock. os.time() rounds to whole
    -- seconds: its epoch gate can expire slightly BEFORE nextCheckAt.
    -- If P3 is admitted in that gap, Dungeon starts a new Solo and prevents
    -- the previously READY P1 Totem from attempting World 15 again.
    -- Wait for BOTH clocks. Once both expire, the normal readiness Query
    -- decides whether Totem is READY, COOLDOWN, BLOCKED, or UNKNOWN.
    local epochLeft = math.max(0, dueEpoch - epoch)
    local monotonicLeft = math.max(0, (tonumber(t.nextCheckAt) or 0) - now)
    local left = math.min(180, math.max(epochLeft, monotonicLeft))
    if left <= 0 then return nil end
    -- State rebuilds nextCheckAt from the saved epoch on startup, so this
    -- monotonic deadline is always local to the current runtime. Cap the wait
    -- to the existing native backoff; do not extend or resend the travel.
    return now + left, "TOTEM_TRAVEL_PRIORITY_WAIT"
end
-- A just-completed standalone Raid can return control to V6 before native
-- world travel is ready again. The queued return script records a short-lived
-- home witness; wait at scheduler level so Raid/Boss P2 cannot steal P1.
function Policy.postRaidWait(snapshot, now, marker)
    if type(snapshot) ~= "table" or type(snapshot.config) ~= "table"
        or snapshot.config.totemEnabled ~= true or type(marker) ~= "table"
        or marker.homeWorld ~= snapshot.config.homeWorld then return nil end
    local t = snapshot.totem
    if type(t) ~= "table" or t.manualHold or t.proceedPending or t.returnPending
        or t.transaction ~= nil or t.recovery then return nil end
    local age = now - (tonumber(marker.atMonotonic) or -math.huge)
    if age < 0 or age >= 8 then return nil end
    return now + (8 - age), "TOTEM_POST_RAID_SETTLE_WAIT"
end
return Policy
end
-- END MODULE main.core.TotemTravelPriorityPolicy

-- BEGIN MODULE main.core.UniversalRecoveryPolicy
__factories["main.core.UniversalRecoveryPolicy"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Shared recovery policy used by both the saved raid journal and host diagnostics.
-- This module is READ-ONLY: it cannot clear records, send interactions, or infer
-- an outcome. Execution remains owned by the Totem, Boss, or Raid controller.
local RecoveryPolicy = {}

function RecoveryPolicy.raid(record, errorCode, now, preparedGrace)
    if errorCode then return {action="HOLD",reason=errorCode,owner="RAID"} end
    if not record then return {action="IDLE",reason="RAID_IDLE",owner="RAID"} end
    if record.status=="PREPARED" then
        if now >= record.createdAt+(preparedGrace or 60) then
            return {action="RECONCILE_HOME",reason="RAID_ABANDONED_PREPARED",owner="RAID"}
        end
        return {action="WAIT",reason="RAID_PREPARED_GRACE",owner="RAID"}
    end
    if record.status=="PREQUEUE_FAILED" and record.prequeueFailure
        and record.prequeueFailure.noPayloadQueued==true then
        return {action="RECONCILE_HOME",reason="RAID_ABANDONED_PROVEN_PREQUEUE_FAILURE",owner="RAID"}
    end
    if record.status=="RETURN_VERIFIED" then
        if record.outcome=="WIN" or record.outcome=="LOSS" then
            return {action="RECONCILE_HOME",reason="RAID_RESULT_AND_RETURN_OBSERVED",owner="RAID"}
        end
        return {action="HOLD",reason="RAID_NATIVE_OUTCOME_MISSING",owner="RAID"}
    end
    -- No TTL, standalone stage or local arrival is enough to clear an attempt
    -- that may have queued cross-place code.
    return {action="HOLD",reason="RAID_HANDOFF_OUTCOME_UNRESOLVED",owner="RAID"}
end

function RecoveryPolicy.totem(snapshot)
    local t=snapshot and snapshot.totem or {}
    local tx=t.transaction
    if t.proceedPending or tx and tx.proceedAttempted and not tx.offeringVerified then
        return {action="HOLD",reason="TOTEM_PROCEED_UNVERIFIED",owner="TOTEM"}
    end
    if t.manualHold and t.debugReason=="TOTEM_TRAVEL_DIRECT_WORLD_REJECTED"
        and not t.proceedPending and not t.returnPending
        and (not tx or tx.phase=="COMPLETE" or tx.phase=="ABANDONED") then
        return {action="OWNED_RECOVERY",reason="TOTEM_PRETRAVEL_HOLD_RECOVERY",owner="TOTEM"}
    end
    if tx and not tx.proceedAttempted and not tx.offeringVerified
        and (t.manualHold or snapshot and snapshot.holds and snapshot.holds.TOTEM
            or tx.phase=="ABORTING") then
        return {action="OWNED_RECOVERY",reason="TOTEM_PREPROCEED_RESCUE",owner="TOTEM"}
    end
    if t.returnPending then return {action="OWNED_RECOVERY",reason="TOTEM_RETURN_PENDING",owner="TOTEM"} end
    if t.manualHold or snapshot and snapshot.holds and snapshot.holds.TOTEM then
        return {action="HOLD",reason="TOTEM_TRANSACTION_UNRESOLVED",owner="TOTEM"}
    end
    return {action="IDLE",reason="TOTEM_NO_PENDING_TRANSACTION",owner="TOTEM"}
end

function RecoveryPolicy.boss(snapshot)
    local b=snapshot and snapshot.boss or {}
    local e=b.encounter
    if e and e.phase~="COMPLETE" then
        if e.recovery then return {action="OWNED_RECOVERY",reason="BOSS_ENCOUNTER_RECOVERY",owner="BOSS"} end
        return {action="HOLD",reason="BOSS_ENCOUNTER_UNRESOLVED",owner="BOSS"}
    end
    if b.reportPending or b.returnPending then
        return {action="OWNED_RECOVERY",reason="BOSS_RETURN_OR_REPORT_PENDING",owner="BOSS"}
    end
    if snapshot and snapshot.holds and snapshot.holds.BOSS then
        return {action="HOLD",reason=snapshot.holds.BOSS,owner="BOSS"}
    end
    return {action="IDLE",reason="BOSS_NO_PENDING_ENCOUNTER",owner="BOSS"}
end

function RecoveryPolicy.overview(snapshot, raidStatus, now, preparedGrace)
    raidStatus=raidStatus or {}
    return {
        RAID=RecoveryPolicy.raid(raidStatus.record,raidStatus.code,now or 0,preparedGrace),
        TOTEM=RecoveryPolicy.totem(snapshot),
        BOSS=RecoveryPolicy.boss(snapshot),
    }
end
return RecoveryPolicy
end
-- END MODULE main.core.UniversalRecoveryPolicy

-- BEGIN MODULE main.core.WorldTravelRetryJournal
__factories["main.core.WorldTravelRetryJournal"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- One-client, advisory travel gate. This is NOT a transaction/raid journal:
-- an invalid/missing record may shorten a cooldown wait, but may never
-- authorize a Proceed, resolve a HELD, or release an in-flight handoff.
local Contracts = require("main.core.Contracts")
local WorldTravelRetryJournal = {}

function WorldTravelRetryJournal.new(options)
    options = options or {}
    local clock, storage = options.clock, options.storage
    assert(type(clock) == "table" and type(clock.epoch) == "function", "Clock required")
    local journal = {}
    local tag, loaded = nil, false
    local lastError
    local function read()
        if not storage or type(storage.read) ~= "function" then return nil, "STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE" end
        local ok, value, nextTag, reason = pcall(storage.read, storage, "v6-world-travel-retry")
        if not ok then return nil, "RETRY_READ_FAILED" end
        tag = nextTag
        if reason then return nil, "RETRY_" .. tostring(reason) end
        if value == nil then return nil, nil end
        if type(value) ~= "table" or value.schemaVersion ~= 1 or value.kind ~= "TOTEM"
            or not Contracts.isFinite(value.dueEpoch) or value.dueEpoch < 0
            or not Contracts.isFinite(value.lastRejectEpoch) or value.lastRejectEpoch < 0
            or not Contracts.isFinite(value.strikes) or value.strikes < 0 or value.strikes > 8
            or value.strikes % 1 ~= 0 then return nil, "INVALID_RETRY_RECORD" end
        return value
    end
    function journal:load()
        if loaded then return nil, "ALREADY_LOADED" end
        loaded = true
        local value, reason = read()
        lastError = reason
        return value, reason
    end
    local function commit(dueEpoch, lastRejectEpoch, strikes)
        if not loaded then journal:load() end
        if not storage or type(storage.compareAndSwap) ~= "function" then
            lastError = "STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE"
            return false, lastError
        end
        local record = {schemaVersion = 1, kind = "TOTEM", dueEpoch = dueEpoch,
            lastRejectEpoch = lastRejectEpoch, strikes = strikes}
        local ok, accepted, nextTag = pcall(storage.compareAndSwap, storage,
            "v6-world-travel-retry", tag, record)
        if ok and accepted == true then
            tag, lastError = nextTag, nil
            return true
        end
        lastError = ok and tostring(nextTag or "RETRY_WRITE_FAILED") or "RETRY_WRITE_FAILED"
        return false, lastError
    end
    function journal:save(dueEpoch, lastRejectEpoch, strikes)
        return commit(dueEpoch, lastRejectEpoch, strikes)
    end
    function journal:clear()
        return commit(0, 0, 0)
    end
    function journal:status() return {available = storage ~= nil, error = lastError} end
    return journal
end

return WorldTravelRetryJournal
end
-- END MODULE main.core.WorldTravelRetryJournal

-- BEGIN MODULE main.gui.ConfigurationBinding
__factories["main.gui.ConfigurationBinding"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local Contracts = require("main.core.Contracts")
local SettingsSchema = require("main.core.SettingsSchema")
local ConfigurationBinding = {}

local commands = {
    setFeatureEnabled = true, setBossCandidates = true, editBossCandidates = true,
    setRaidCandidates = true, setRaidRepeat = true,
    setHomeWorld = true, setBossRepeat = true, setTotemCooldownMultiplier = true,
    setPreferences = true, flushSettings = true, resetScheduler = true,
}

local function snapshot(app)
    local state, code = app:configuration()
    if not state then return nil, code end
    local checkpoint = state.checkpoint
    if checkpoint.kind == "BOSS" and checkpoint.ownership ~= "RELEASED" then
        state.activeBossId = checkpoint.bossId
    end
    for _, candidate in ipairs(state.features.BOSS.candidates or {}) do
        if candidate.enabled and candidate.bossId ~= state.activeBossId then
            state.nextConfiguredBossId = state.nextConfiguredBossId or candidate.bossId
            if candidate.state == "READY" or candidate.reason == "JOB_OWNED" and candidate.observedState == "READY" then
                state.nextEligibleBossId = candidate.bossId
                break
            end
        end
    end
    return state
end

function ConfigurationBinding.new(app, clock, timer, interval)
    interval = interval or 0.5
    assert(Contracts.isFinite(interval) and interval >= 0.25 and interval <= 5, "Invalid GUI refresh interval")
    local views, disconnects = {}, {}
    local binding = {}
    local wake, refresh

    local function visible(view)
        return type(view.isVisible) ~= "function" or view:isVisible()
    end
    local function hasVisibleView()
        for view in pairs(views) do if visible(view) then return true end end
        return false
    end

    local function report(view, success, code)
        if type(view.report) == "function" then pcall(view.report, view, success, code) end
    end
    local function cancelWake()
        local current = wake
        wake = nil
        if current then pcall(current.cancel) end
    end
    local function arm(delay)
        if not hasVisibleView() then return end
        local deadline = clock.now() + delay
        if wake and wake.deadline <= deadline then return end
        local token = {deadline = deadline}
        local scheduling, calledInline = true, false
        local ok, cancel = pcall(timer.scheduleAt, timer, deadline, function()
            if scheduling then calledInline = true; return end
            if wake ~= token then return end
            wake = nil
            refresh()
            arm(interval)
        end)
        scheduling = false
        if not ok or type(cancel) ~= "function" or calledInline then
            if ok and type(cancel) == "function" then pcall(cancel) end
            for view in pairs(views) do report(view, false, "GUI_REFRESH_TIMER_FAILED") end
            return
        end
        local previous = wake
        token.cancel, wake = cancel, token
        if previous then pcall(previous.cancel) end
    end

    refresh = function()
        local ok, state, code = pcall(snapshot, app)
        local mounted = {}
        for view, handle in pairs(views) do mounted[view] = handle end
        for view, handle in pairs(mounted) do
            -- Membership can change during a view callback.
            if views[view] == handle and visible(view) then
                if not ok or not state then report(view, false, ok and code or "GUI_SNAPSHOT_FAILED")
                elseif not pcall(view.render, view, Contracts.copy(state)) then report(view, false, "GUI_RENDER_FAILED") end
            end
        end
    end

    local function preference(section, field, value, revision)
        if not SettingsSchema.hasPreference(section, field) then return false, "INVALID_PREFERENCE" end
        local state, code = app:configuration()
        if not state then return false, code end
        if revision ~= nil and revision ~= state.revision then return false, "CONFIGURATION_CHANGED" end
        local settings = state.settings.preferences
        settings[section] = settings[section] or {}
        settings[section][field] = value
        return app:setPreferences(settings)
    end

    function binding:mount(view)
        if type(view) ~= "table" or type(view.render) ~= "function" then return nil, "INVALID_CONFIGURATION_VIEW" end
        if views[view] then return views[view] end
        local first = next(views) == nil
        local handle = {}
        views[view] = handle
        if first then
            local function notify() arm(0.05) end
            disconnects = {app:onConfigurationChanged(notify), app:onStatusChanged(notify)}
        end
        function handle:visibilityChanged()
            if views[view] ~= self then return false end
            if visible(view) then
                refresh()
                arm(interval)
            elseif not hasVisibleView() then cancelWake() end
            return true
        end
        function handle:close()
            if views[view] ~= self then return false end
            views[view] = nil
            if not next(views) then
                cancelWake()
                local listeners = disconnects
                disconnects = {}
                for _, disconnect in ipairs(listeners) do pcall(disconnect) end
            elseif not hasVisibleView() then cancelWake() end
            if type(view.unmount) == "function" then pcall(view.unmount, view) end
            return true
        end
        function handle:command(name, ...)
            if views[view] ~= self then return false, "GUI_CLOSED" end
            local ok, success, code, detail
            if name == "setPreference" then ok, success, code, detail = pcall(preference, ...)
            elseif commands[name] then ok, success, code, detail = pcall(app[name], app, ...)
            else return false, "GUI_UNKNOWN_COMMAND" end
            if not ok then success, code, detail = false, "GUI_COMMAND_FAILED", nil end
            if views[view] == self then report(view, success == true, code) end
            arm(0.05)
            return success, code, detail
        end
        refresh()
        arm(interval)
        return handle
    end
    return binding
end

return ConfigurationBinding
end
-- END MODULE main.gui.ConfigurationBinding

-- BEGIN MODULE main.gui.ConfigurationPanel
__factories["main.gui.ConfigurationPanel"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local RaidCatalog = require("main.config.RaidCatalog")
local ConfigurationPanel = {}
local mounted = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})

local names = {
    AC130 = "AC-130 Spectre", AIRRAID = "Air Raid", B17 = "B-17 Flying Fortress", B21_RAIDER = "B-21 Raider",
    B29 = "B-29 Superfortress", B2SPIRIT = "B-2 Spirit", B52 = "B-52 Stratofortress", BLACKFORTRESS = "Black Fortress",
    CARRIER = "Carrier Fortress", EKRANOPLAN = "Ekranoplan", F117 = "F-117 Nighthawk", FINALCOLOSSUS = "Final Colossus",
    FLEET = "The Fleet", OMEGASKYTITAN = "Omega Sky Titan", SANDWORM = "The Sundering Sands", RED_BARON = "Red Baron", RQ170 = "RQ-170 Sentinel",
    SR71 = "SR-71 Blackbird", TU95 = "Tu-95 Bear", U2 = "U-2 Dragon Lady", VULCAN = "Avro Vulcan", ZEPPELIN = "Zeppelin",
    BOSS = "Auto Boss", RAID = "Auto Raid", DUNGEON = "Auto Dungeon", TOTEM = "Auto Luck Totem", RIFT = "Auto Rift",
}
local states = {READY = "Ready", RUNNING = "Running", COOLDOWN = "Cooldown", BLOCKED = "Blocked",
    UNKNOWN = "Unknown", UNAVAILABLE = "Unavailable", EXTERNAL = "External", IDLE = "Idle",
    DISABLED = "Disabled", STARTING = "Starting", HANDOFF_PENDING = "Handoff pending",
    PARTICIPATION_PENDING = "Participation pending", RESULT_PENDING = "Result pending",
    RETURNING = "Returning", RECOVERING = "Recovering"}
local raidPhases = {IDLE = "Idle", PREPARED = "Handoff prepared", ARRIVED = "Destination arrival verified",
    PARTICIPATION_VERIFIED = "Participation and difficulty verified", RESULT_PENDING = "Result pending",
    RESULT_VERIFIED = "Raid result verified", RETURN_PENDING = "Return pending", RETURN_INITIATED = "Return initiated",
    ORIGIN_ARRIVED = "Original world reached", RETURN_VERIFIED = "Home return verified",
    RECOVERY_REQUIRED = "Recovery required", UNAVAILABLE = "Unavailable"}

local function describe(record, now)
    if not record then return "Unknown" end
    if record.availability == "EXTERNAL" and record.external then
        return "External / " .. (states[record.external.state] or record.external.state)
    end
    if states[record.availability] then return states[record.availability] end
    if record.state == "COOLDOWN" and record.nextCheckAt then
        return "Cooldown · check " .. math.max(0, math.ceil(record.nextCheckAt - now)) .. "s"
    end
    return states[record.state] or "Unknown"
end

local function persistenceText(status)
    if status.saveCode then return "Settings: Save failed" end
    if not status.writable then return "Settings: Storage unavailable" end
    if status.writing then return "Settings: Saving" end
    if status.pendingRevision then return "Settings: Save pending" end
    if status.savedRevision then return "Settings: Saved" end
    if status.loadCode == "CORRUPT_SETTINGS" or status.loadCode == "SETTINGS_READ_FAILED" then return "Settings: Load failed" end
    return status.loadCode == "LOADED" and "Settings: Restored" or "Settings: Ready"
end

local function construct(root, mobile)
    local inputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    mobile = mobile or inputService.TouchEnabled and not inputService.KeyboardEnabled
    local bg, surface = Color3.fromRGB(20, 25, 33), Color3.fromRGB(33, 41, 53)
    local accent, ink = Color3.fromRGB(32, 88, 78), Color3.fromRGB(237, 242, 248)
    local muted, warning = Color3.fromRGB(166, 179, 198), Color3.fromRGB(245, 185, 125)
    local rowHeight = mobile and 36 or 30
    local view, updates, connections = {}, {}, {}
    local latest, handle

    local function element(class, parent, name)
        local item = Instance.new(class)
        item.Name, item.Parent = name, parent
        return item
    end
    local function frame(parent, name)
        local item = element("Frame", parent, name)
        item.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        return item
    end
    local function round(item)
        element("UICorner", item, "Corner").CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7)
    end
    local function style(item, value, color)
        item.Text, item.TextSize, item.TextColor3 = value, mobile and 14 or 13, color or ink
        item.Font, item.TextTruncate = Enum.Font.Gotham, Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
    end
    local function label(parent, name, value, color)
        local item = element("TextLabel", parent, name)
        style(item, value, color)
        item.BackgroundTransparency, item.TextXAlignment = 1, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        return item
    end
    local function button(parent, name, value, action)
        local item = element("TextButton", parent, name)
        style(item, value)
        item.BackgroundColor3, item.BorderSizePixel = surface, 0
        round(item)
        item.Activated:Connect(action)
        return item
    end
    local function right(item, offset, width, height, y)
        item.AnchorPoint, item.Position, item.Size = Vector2.new(1, 0),
            UDim2.new(1, -offset, 0, y or 0), UDim2.fromOffset(width, height)
    end
    local function layout(parent, gap)
        local list = element("UIListLayout", parent, "Layout")
        list.SortOrder, list.Padding = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, UDim.new(0, gap)
        return list
    end
    local function stack(parent, name, order)
        local item = frame(parent, name)
        item.Size, item.AutomaticSize, item.LayoutOrder = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, order
        layout(item, 4)
        return item
    end
    local function row(parent, name, order, height)
        local item = frame(parent, name)
        item.LayoutOrder, item.Size = order, UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height or rowHeight)
        return item
    end
    local function line(parent, name, value, order, height, color)
        local item = label(parent, name, value, color)
        item.LayoutOrder, item.Size = order, UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height or 20)
        return item
    end
    local function track(update) updates[#updates + 1] = update end
    local function invoke(name, ...)
        if handle then return handle:command(name, ...) end
    end

    local viewport = frame(root, "Viewport")
    viewport.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    local panel = frame(viewport, "Panel")
    panel.BackgroundTransparency, panel.BackgroundColor3, panel.BorderSizePixel = 0, bg, 0
    panel.ClipsDescendants, panel.Size = true, UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -16)
    local minWidth, minHeight, maxWidth, maxHeight = 320, 235, 680, 760
    local desiredWidth, desiredHeight = mobile and 380 or 388, mobile and 440 or 456
    round(panel)
    local header = frame(panel, "Header")
    header.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 38)
    local title = label(header, "Title", "PlaneRNG V6")
    title.Active, title.Font, title.TextSize = true, Enum.Font.GothamBold, 16
    title.Position, title.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 0), UDim2.new(1, -94, 1, 0)

    local mode, panelX, panelY, dockX, dockY = "open"
    local margin, dockWidth, dockHeight = 8, 108, 34
    local panelWidth, panelHeight = desiredWidth, desiredHeight
    local dockMoved, drag = false, nil
    local function clampPoint(x, y, width, height)
        local area = viewport.AbsoluteSize
        return math.clamp(x, margin, math.max(margin, area.X - width - margin)),
            math.clamp(y, margin, math.max(margin, area.Y - height - margin))
    end
    local dock = button(viewport, "Reopen", "PlaneRNG +", function()
        if dockMoved then dockMoved = false; return end
        view:show()
    end)
    dock.Visible, dock.Size = false, UDim2.fromOffset(dockWidth, dockHeight)
    local function fit()
        local area = viewport.AbsoluteSize
        if area.X < 1 or area.Y < 1 then return end
        panelWidth = math.max(1, math.min(desiredWidth, area.X - margin * 2))
        panelHeight = math.max(1, math.min(desiredHeight, area.Y - margin * 2))
        panelX, panelY = clampPoint(panelX or area.X - panelWidth - 14, panelY or 18, panelWidth, panelHeight)
        dockX, dockY = clampPoint(dockX or panelX, dockY or panelY, dockWidth, dockHeight)
        panel.Position, panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(panelX, panelY), UDim2.fromOffset(panelWidth, panelHeight)
        dock.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(dockX, dockY)
    end
    local function show(newMode)
        if mode == newMode then return end
        mode, drag, dockMoved = newMode, nil, false
        if newMode ~= "open" then dockX, dockY = panelX, panelY end
        panel.Visible, dock.Visible = newMode == "open", newMode ~= "open"
        dock.Text = newMode == "closed" and "Open PlaneRNG" or "PlaneRNG +"
        fit()
        if handle then handle:visibilityChanged() end
    end
    function view:show() show("open") end
    function view:isVisible() return mode == "open" end
    local minimize = button(header, "Minimize", "−", function() show("minimized") end)
    local close = button(header, "Close", "×", function() show("closed") end)
    minimize.TextSize, close.TextSize = 20, 20
    right(minimize, 46, 34, 32, 4)
    right(close, 8, 34, 32, 4)

    local tabs = frame(panel, "Tabs")
    tabs.Position, tabs.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 42), UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 30)
    local pages, tabButtons = {}, {}
    local function switch(name)
        for tabName, page in pairs(pages) do
            page.Visible = tabName == name
            tabButtons[tabName].BackgroundColor3 = tabName == name and accent or surface
        end
        fit()
    end
    for index, name in ipairs({"Bosses", "Raids", "Features", "Settings"}) do
        local tab = button(tabs, name, name == "Raids" and "Auto Raid" or name, function() switch(name) end)
        tab.Position, tab.Size = UDim2.fromScale((index - 1) / 4, 0), UDim2.new(1 / 4, -4, 1, 0)
        tabButtons[name] = tab
        local page = element("ScrollingFrame", panel, name .. "Page")
        page.Position, page.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 79), UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -127)
        page.AutomaticCanvasSize, page.CanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
        page.ScrollingDirection, page.ScrollBarThickness = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y, 4
        page.BackgroundTransparency, page.BorderSizePixel = 1, 0
        local padding = element("UIPadding", page, "Padding")
        padding.PaddingRight, padding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 6), UDim.new(0, 3)
        local pageLayout = layout(page, 4)
        pageLayout.Name = name .. "Layout"
        pages[name] = page
    end
    switch("Bosses")
    local feedback = label(panel, "Feedback", "", warning)
    feedback.Position, feedback.Size = UDim2.new(0, 10, 1, -45), UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 17)
    local footer = frame(panel, "Footer")
    footer.Position, footer.Size = UDim2.new(0, 10, 1, -25), UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 19)
    local scheduler, point = label(footer, "Scheduler", "", muted), label(footer, "Checkpoint", "", muted)
    scheduler.Size = UDim2.new(0.53, -4, 1, 0)
    point.Position, point.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.53, 0), UDim2.new(0.47, -17, 1, 0)
    local resize = label(panel, "ResizeHandle", "◢", muted)
    resize.Active, resize.TextXAlignment = true, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    resize.Position, resize.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, -24), UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24)
    track(function(state)
        local checkpoint = state.checkpoint
        local busy = checkpoint.ownership ~= "RELEASED"
        scheduler.Text = "Scheduler: " .. (busy and "Running" or not state.running and "Paused"
            or state.blockReason and "Blocked" or "Waiting")
        point.Text = "Checkpoint: " .. (checkpoint.waitOverdue and "Stalled" or checkpoint.outcome == "HELD" and "Held"
            or busy and "Owned" or "Released")
    end)

    local function toggleRow(parent, name, caption, order, read, write, feature)
        local item = row(parent, name .. "Row", order)
        local titleLabel = label(item, name .. "Label", caption)
        titleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -65, feature and 0.6 or 1, 0)
        local status
        if feature then
            status = label(item, name .. "Status", "", muted)
            status.Position, status.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.6), UDim2.new(1, -65, 0.4, 0)
            status.TextSize = 11
        end
        local toggle = button(item, name, "OFF", function() if latest then write(read(latest)) end end)
        right(toggle, 0, 55, rowHeight)
        track(function(state)
            local value = read(state)
            toggle.Text = value == nil and "Default" or (value and "ON" or "OFF")
            toggle.BackgroundColor3 = value and (not status or state.features[name].availability == "MANAGED")
                and accent or surface
            if status then status.Text = describe(state.features[name], state.observedAt) end
        end)
    end
    local function featureToggle(parent, kind, order, simple)
        -- Rift has no user-facing filters or status label: a single managed ON/OFF toggle.
        toggleRow(parent, kind, names[kind], order, function(state) return state.features[kind].requestedEnabled == true end,
            function(value) invoke("setFeatureEnabled", kind, not value) end, not simple)
    end
    local function textInput(parent, name, caption, order, read, action, numeric, optional)
        local item = row(parent, name .. "Row", order)
        local titleLabel = label(item, name .. "Label", caption)
        titleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -140, 1, 0)
        local box = element("TextBox", item, name)
        style(box, "")
        box.PlaceholderText, box.ClearTextOnFocus = optional and "Default" or "", false
        box.BackgroundColor3, box.BorderSizePixel = surface, 0
        round(box)
        right(box, 46, 87, rowHeight)
        local savedText
        local function submit()
            if not latest then return end
            local contents = box.Text:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
            local value = contents
            if contents == "" and optional then value = nil
            elseif numeric then
                value = tonumber(contents)
                if not value then feedback.Text = "Enter a number for " .. caption:lower(); return end
            end
            if action(value, latest) then savedText = box.Text end
        end
        right(button(item, "Apply" .. name, "Set", submit), 0, 41, rowHeight)
        box.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter) if enter then submit() end end)
        track(function(state)
            if not box:IsFocused() and (savedText == nil or box.Text == savedText) then
                local value = read(state)
                savedText = value == nil and "" or tostring(value)
                if box.Text ~= savedText then box.Text = savedText end
            end
        end)
    end
    local function section(parent, name, order, onOpen)
        local container = stack(parent, name .. "Section", order)
        local contents = stack(container, name .. "Contents", 2)
        contents.Visible = false
        local toggle
        toggle = button(container, name, name .. " +", function()
            contents.Visible = not contents.Visible
            toggle.Text = name .. (contents.Visible and " −" or " +")
            if contents.Visible and onOpen then onOpen(contents) end
        end)
        toggle.LayoutOrder, toggle.Size = 1, UDim2.fromOffset(118, rowHeight)
        return contents
    end

    local bosses = pages.Bosses
    featureToggle(bosses, "BOSS", 1)
    toggleRow(bosses, "BossRepeat", "Boss Repeat", 2, function(state) return state.settings.bossRepeat end,
        function(value) invoke("setBossRepeat", not value) end)
    local active = line(bosses, "ActiveBoss", "", 3)
    local nextBoss = line(bosses, "NextBoss", "", 4, 18, muted)
    track(function(state)
        active.Text = "Active boss: " .. (names[state.activeBossId] or state.activeBossId or "None")
            .. (state.activeBossId and (state.encounterRecovery and " / Recovering" or " / Running") or "")
        local id = state.nextEligibleBossId
        if id then
            nextBoss.Text = "Next: " .. (names[id] or id)
                .. (state.checkpoint.ownership ~= "RELEASED" and " / recheck after release" or "")
        else nextBoss.Text = state.nextConfiguredBossId and "Next: Awaiting readiness" or "Next: None" end
    end)
    local selectedBar = row(bosses, "SelectedHeading", 5)
    label(selectedBar, "SelectedBosses", "Selected bosses").Size = UDim2.new(1, -100, 1, 0)
    local picker = stack(bosses, "BossPicker", 6)
    picker.Visible = false
    local search = element("TextBox", picker, "BossSearch")
    style(search, "")
    search.PlaceholderText, search.ClearTextOnFocus, search.BorderSizePixel = "Search bosses", false, 0
    search.BackgroundColor3, search.Size, search.LayoutOrder = surface, UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, rowHeight), 1
    round(search)
    local pickerPage, pageSize = 1, 5
    local options, choices, refreshPicker = {}, {}, nil
    local addBoss = button(selectedBar, "AddBoss", "Add boss +", function()
        picker.Visible = not picker.Visible
        if picker.Visible then refreshPicker() end
    end)
    right(addBoss, 0, 93, rowHeight)
    for index = 1, pageSize do
        local item = button(picker, "BossOption" .. index, "", function()
            local choice = choices[(pickerPage - 1) * pageSize + index]
            if not choice or not latest then return end
            if choice.disabled then invoke("editBossCandidates", "SET_ENABLED", choice.id, true, latest.revision)
            else invoke("editBossCandidates", "ADD", choice.id, nil, latest.revision) end
        end)
        item.LayoutOrder, item.Size = index + 1, UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, rowHeight)
        options[index] = item
    end
    local pager = row(picker, "BossPages", 7)
    local pageLabel = label(pager, "BossPage", "", muted)
    pageLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -77, 1, 0)
    local prev = button(pager, "BossPrevious", "<", function() pickerPage = pickerPage - 1; refreshPicker() end)
    local nextPage = button(pager, "BossNext", ">", function() pickerPage = pickerPage + 1; refreshPicker() end)
    right(prev, 35, 30, rowHeight)
    right(nextPage, 0, 30, rowHeight)
    refreshPicker = function()
        if not latest or not picker.Visible then return end
        local filter = search.Text:lower():match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
        local selected = {}
        for _, candidate in ipairs(latest.settings.bossCandidates) do selected[candidate.id] = candidate.enabled end
        choices = {}
        for _, id in ipairs(latest.bossCatalog) do
            local name = names[id] or id
            if selected[id] ~= true and (name:lower():find(filter, 1, true) or id:lower():find(filter, 1, true)) then
                choices[#choices + 1] = {id = id, disabled = selected[id] == false}
            end
        end
        local total = math.max(1, math.ceil(#choices / pageSize))
        pickerPage = math.clamp(pickerPage, 1, total)
        for index, item in ipairs(options) do
            local choice = choices[(pickerPage - 1) * pageSize + index]
            item.Visible = choice ~= nil
            if choice then item.Text = (choice.disabled and "Enable " or "+ ") .. (names[choice.id] or choice.id) end
        end
        pageLabel.Text = #choices == 0 and "No matching bosses" or string.format("%d / %d", pickerPage, total)
        prev.Visible, nextPage.Visible = pickerPage > 1, pickerPage < total
    end
    search:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function() pickerPage = 1; refreshPicker() end)

    local selection = stack(bosses, "BossSelection", 7)
    local empty = line(selection, "EmptyBosses", "No bosses selected", 0, 22, muted)
    local selectedRows, candidateKey = {}, nil
    track(function(state)
        local candidates = state.settings.bossCandidates
        local signature, present = {}, {}
        for index, candidate in ipairs(candidates) do
            local id = candidate.id
            signature[index], present[id] = id .. tostring(candidate.enabled), true
            local entry = selectedRows[id]
            if not entry then
                local item = row(selection, id .. "Row", index)
                local name = label(item, id .. "Name", "")
                name.Size = UDim2.new(1, -155, 1, 0)
                local status = label(item, id .. "Status", "", muted)
                status.TextSize = 12
                right(status, 32, 119, rowHeight)
                local remove = button(item, id .. "Remove", "×", function()
                    invoke("editBossCandidates", "REMOVE", id, nil, latest.revision)
                end)
                remove.TextSize = 17
                right(remove, 0, 28, rowHeight)
                entry = {row = item, name = name, status = status}
                selectedRows[id] = entry
            end
            entry.row.LayoutOrder, entry.name.Text = index, index .. ". " .. (names[id] or id)
            local record = state.features.BOSS.candidates[index]
            entry.status.Text = candidate.enabled and describe(record, state.observedAt) or "Disabled"
            local stateName = record and record.state
            entry.status.TextColor3 = candidate.enabled and (stateName == "RUNNING" or stateName == "READY") and ink or muted
        end
        for id, entry in pairs(selectedRows) do
            if not present[id] then entry.row:Destroy(); selectedRows[id] = nil end
        end
        empty.Visible = #candidates == 0
        local key = table.concat(signature, "|")
        if key ~= candidateKey then candidateKey = key; refreshPicker() end
    end)

    local features = pages.Features
    featureToggle(features, "DUNGEON", 1)
    local function preference(parent, sectionName, field, caption, order, numeric, widgetName)
        textInput(parent, widgetName or field, caption, order, function(state)
            return (state.settings.preferences[sectionName] or {})[field]
        end, function(value, state)
            return invoke("setPreference", sectionName, field, value, state.revision)
        end, numeric, true)
    end
    preference(features, "dungeon", "targetWave", "Target wave", 2, true, "TargetWave")
    featureToggle(features, "TOTEM", 3)
    local multiplier = row(features, "TotemMultiplierRow", 4)
    label(multiplier, "TotemCooldownLabel", "Cooldown multiplier").Size = UDim2.new(1, -66, 1, 0)
    local multiplierButton = button(multiplier, "TotemMultiplier", "1x", function()
        if latest then invoke("setTotemCooldownMultiplier", latest.settings.TotemCooldownMultiplier == 2 and 1 or 2) end
    end)
    right(multiplierButton, 0, 55, rowHeight)
    track(function(state) multiplierButton.Text = state.settings.TotemCooldownMultiplier == 2 and "2x" or "1x" end)
    -- V6 .14h.1: Rift is fully automatic. All 18 encounters are eligible;
    -- natural Rift selection, cooldown, report, return and retry belong to scheduler.
    featureToggle(features, "RIFT", 5, true)

    local raids = pages.Raids
    featureToggle(raids, "RAID", 1)
    toggleRow(raids, "RaidRepeat", "Raid Repeat", 2, function(state) return state.settings.raidRepeat end,
        function(value) invoke("setRaidRepeat", not value) end)
    local raidSelection = section(raids, "Raid Selection & Priority", 3)
    local raidDifficulty = section(raids, "Difficulty", 4)
    local raidStatusPanel = section(raids, "Raid Status", 5)
    for index, id in ipairs(RaidCatalog.ids) do
        local function change(move)
            if not latest then return end
            local ordered = {}
            for position, candidate in ipairs(latest.settings.raidCandidates) do
                ordered[position] = {id = candidate.id, enabled = candidate.enabled}
            end
            for position, candidate in ipairs(ordered) do
                if candidate.id == id then
                    if move then
                        if position == 1 then return end
                        ordered[position - 1], ordered[position] = ordered[position], ordered[position - 1]
                    else candidate.enabled = not candidate.enabled end
                    return invoke("setRaidCandidates", ordered, latest.revision)
                end
            end
        end
        local item = row(raidSelection, id .. "RaidRow", index)
        label(item, id .. "RaidTitle", names[id]).Size = UDim2.new(1, -101, 1, 0)
        local up = button(item, id .. "RaidUp", "Up", function() change(true) end)
        right(up, 48, 43, rowHeight)
        local enabled = button(item, id .. "RaidEnabled", "", function() change(false) end)
        right(enabled, 0, 45, rowHeight)
        local status = line(raidStatusPanel, id .. "RaidStatus", "", index, 0, muted)
        status.TextWrapped, status.AutomaticSize = true, Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
        track(function(state)
            for position, record in ipairs(state.features.RAID.candidates or {}) do
                if record.bossId == id then
                    item.LayoutOrder, up.Visible = position, position > 1
                    enabled.Text = record.candidateEnabled and "ON" or "OFF"
                    local active = state.features.RAID.raidId == id
                    status.Text = names[id] .. " / " .. (active and states[record.state] or describe(record, state.observedAt))
                        .. " / " .. (record.availabilityReason or record.reason or "Ready evidence recorded")
                    break
                end
            end
        end)
        local config = RaidCatalog[id]
        local function selected(state) return (state.settings.preferences.raidDifficulty or {})[id] or config.defaultDifficulty end
        local option = row(raidDifficulty, id .. "Preference", index)
        label(option, id .. "Title", names[id]).Size = UDim2.new(1, -109, 1, 0)
        local choice = button(option, id .. "Difficulty", "", function()
            if not latest then return end
            local choices = config.difficultyChoices
            local current = table.find(choices, selected(latest)) or 1
            invoke("setPreference", "raidDifficulty", id, choices[current % #choices + 1], latest.revision)
        end)
        right(choice, 0, 102, rowHeight)
        track(function(state) choice.Text = selected(state) end)
    end
    local handoffLabel = line(raidStatusPanel, "RaidHandoffStatus", "", #RaidCatalog.ids + 1, 0, muted)
    handoffLabel.TextWrapped, handoffLabel.AutomaticSize = true, Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    track(function(state)
        local handoff = state.handoff
        local attempt, completed = handoff.record, handoff.lastVerifiedReturn
        local phase = raidPhases[handoff.phase] or handoff.phase
        handoffLabel.Text = (attempt and ((names[attempt.raidId] or attempt.raidId)
            .. " / " .. (attempt.difficulty or "Unknown") .. " / ") or "")
            .. phase .. (attempt and attempt.submission and " / " .. attempt.submission or "")
            .. (completed and completed.outcome and "\nLast verified result: " .. (names[completed.raidId] or completed.raidId)
                .. " / " .. completed.outcome or "")
    end)

    local settings = pages.Settings
    textInput(settings, "HomeWorld", "Home world", 1, function(state) return state.settings.homeWorld end,
        function(value) return invoke("setHomeWorld", value) end, true)
    local storageLabel = line(settings, "Storage", "", 2, 22, muted)
    track(function(state) storageLabel.Text = persistenceText(state.persistence) end)
    local resetTools = stack(settings, "SchedulerResetTools", 3)
    local advanced = section(settings, "Advanced", 4)
    local save = button(advanced, "SaveSettings", "Save now", function() invoke("flushSettings") end)
    save.LayoutOrder, save.Size = 3, UDim2.fromOffset(90, rowHeight)
    -- One click, unconditional local force reset. No second-tap gate.
    local reset = button(resetTools, "ResetScheduler", "RESET UNIVERSAL", function()
        invoke("resetScheduler")
    end)
    reset.LayoutOrder, reset.Size = 1, UDim2.fromOffset(156, rowHeight)
    local resetNote = line(resetTools, "ResetNote",
        "Force-clears ALL local scheduler holds and recovery. Server actions/cooldowns cannot be undone.", 2, 0, muted)
    resetNote.TextWrapped, resetNote.AutomaticSize = true, Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    local updateDiagnostics, lastCommandError
    local diagnostics = section(settings, "Diagnostics", 5, function() if latest then updateDiagnostics(latest) end end)
    local raw = line(diagnostics, "DiagnosticDetails", "", 1, 0, muted)
    local raid = line(diagnostics, "Raid", "", 2, 0, muted)
    for _, item in ipairs({raw, raid}) do
        item.TextTruncate, item.TextWrapped, item.AutomaticSize = Enum.TextTruncate.None, true, Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    end
    local function suffix(value) return value and " / " .. value or "" end
    updateDiagnostics = function(state)
        if not diagnostics.Visible then return end
        local checkpoint, persistence = state.checkpoint, state.persistence
        local info = {
            "Scheduler: " .. (state.blockReason or state.lastDecision and state.lastDecision.code or "IDLE"),
            "Checkpoint: " .. checkpoint.phase .. " / " .. checkpoint.ownership,
        }
        if state.encounterRecovery then
            local recovery = state.encounterRecovery
            info[#info + 1] = "Encounter recovery: " .. (names[recovery.bossId] or recovery.bossId)
                .. " / " .. recovery.stage .. suffix(recovery.reason)
        end
        if checkpoint.stage or checkpoint.code then
            info[#info + 1] = (checkpoint.waitOverdue and "Stalled: " or "Stage: ") .. (checkpoint.stage or "–")
                .. suffix(checkpoint.code)
        end
        for _, kind in ipairs({"BOSS", "RAID", "DUNGEON", "TOTEM", "RIFT"}) do
            local feature = state.features[kind]
            info[#info + 1] = names[kind] .. ": " .. feature.availability .. " / " .. feature.state
                .. suffix(feature.availabilityReason)
                .. suffix(feature.reason ~= feature.availabilityReason and feature.reason)
            local external = feature.external
            if external then info[#info + 1] = "External: " .. external.state .. suffix(external.stage) .. suffix(external.reason) end
        end
        for _, record in ipairs(state.features.BOSS.candidates or {}) do
            local unavailable = record.availability ~= "MANAGED"
            info[#info + 1] = record.bossId .. ": " .. (unavailable and record.availability or record.state)
                .. suffix(unavailable and record.availabilityReason or record.reason)
        end
        info[#info + 1] = "Settings: " .. (persistence.saveCode or persistence.loadCode or "UNKNOWN")
        if lastCommandError then info[#info + 1] = "Command: " .. lastCommandError end
        raw.Text = table.concat(info, "\n")
        local handoff = state.handoff
        raid.Text = "Raid: " .. (raidPhases[handoff.phase] or handoff.phase)
            .. suffix(handoff.eventCode or handoff.observerCode or handoff.code)
    end
    track(updateDiagnostics)

    local function beginDrag(input, mini, resizing)
        local kind = input.UserInputType
        if kind ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and kind ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
        if drag then return end
        if mini then dockMoved = false end
        fit()
        if not panelX then return end
        drag = {input = input, touch = kind == Enum.UserInputType.Touch, mini = mini, resizing = resizing,
            width = panelWidth, height = panelHeight, desiredWidth = desiredWidth, desiredHeight = desiredHeight,
            startX = input.Position.X, startY = input.Position.Y, x = mini and dockX or panelX, y = mini and dockY or panelY}
    end
    title.InputBegan:Connect(function(input) beginDrag(input, false) end)
    header.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        -- The header's right edge belongs to the window controls.
        if input.Position.X < header.AbsolutePosition.X + header.AbsoluteSize.X - 82 then beginDrag(input, false) end
    end)
    dock.InputBegan:Connect(function(input) beginDrag(input, true) end)
    resize.InputBegan:Connect(function(input) beginDrag(input, false, true) end)
    viewport:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(fit)
    fit()
    connections[#connections + 1] = inputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if not drag or (drag.touch and input ~= drag.input)
            or (not drag.touch and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement) then return end
        local dx, dy = input.Position.X - drag.startX, input.Position.Y - drag.startY
        if not drag.moved and math.abs(dx) + math.abs(dy) < 5 then return end
        drag.moved = true
        if drag.resizing then
            local area = viewport.AbsoluteSize
            local availableWidth = math.max(1, math.min(maxWidth, area.X - margin * 2))
            local availableHeight = math.max(1, math.min(maxHeight, area.Y - margin * 2))
            desiredWidth = dx == 0 and drag.desiredWidth
                or math.clamp(drag.width + dx, math.min(minWidth, availableWidth), availableWidth)
            desiredHeight = dy == 0 and drag.desiredHeight
                or math.clamp(drag.height + dy, math.min(minHeight, availableHeight), availableHeight)
        elseif drag.mini then
            dockX, dockY = clampPoint(drag.x + dx, drag.y + dy, dockWidth, dockHeight)
            dockMoved = true
        else panelX, panelY = clampPoint(drag.x + dx, drag.y + dy, panelWidth, panelHeight) end
        fit()
    end)
    connections[#connections + 1] = inputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if drag and (drag.input == input or not drag.touch and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then
            drag = nil
        end
    end)
    connections[#connections + 1] = inputService.WindowFocusReleased:Connect(function() drag = nil end)

    function view:render(state)
        latest = state
        for _, update in ipairs(updates) do update(state) end
    end
    local commandErrors = {HOME_REQUIRED = "Set a home world first.", INVALID_HOME_WORLD = "Enter a valid home world.",
        INVALID_PREFERENCE = "Enter a valid value.", CONFIGURATION_CHANGED = "Settings changed. Try again."}
    function view:report(ok, code)
        feedback.Text = ok and (code == "SCHEDULER_FORCE_RESET" and "UNIVERSAL RESET DONE; scheduler restarting."
            or code == "SCHEDULER_FORCE_RESET_STORAGE_WARNING" and "RESET DONE locally; RAID/CHAIN storage warning (see console)."
            or code == "SCHEDULER_FORCE_RESET_CLEANUP_WARNING" and "RESET DONE; cleanup warning (see console)."
            or code == "SCHEDULER_FORCE_RESET_RESTART_WARNING" and "RESET DONE; scheduler restart warning." or "")
            or commandErrors[code] or (code and "Reset/command refused: " .. tostring(code))
                or "Could not apply that change."
        lastCommandError = not ok and (code or "GUI_COMMAND_FAILED") or nil
        if latest then updateDiagnostics(latest) end
    end
    function view:disconnect()
        for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
        connections = {}
    end
    return view, function(value) handle = value end
end

local function mount(app, parent, profile)
    if parent == nil then return nil, "GUI_PARENT_REQUIRED" end
    local layouts = mounted[parent] or {}
    mounted[parent] = layouts
    local existing = layouts[profile]
    if existing and existing.app == app and existing.root.Parent == parent then
        existing.view:show()
        return existing.handle, existing.root
    end
    if existing then existing.handle:close() end
    mounted[parent] = layouts
    local root
    local ok, view, setHandle = pcall(function()
        root = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        root.Name, root.ResetOnSpawn = "PlaneRNGV6" .. profile, false
        root.Parent = parent
        return construct(root, profile == "Mobile")
    end)
    if not ok then
        if root then pcall(function() root:Destroy() end) end
        if not next(layouts) then mounted[parent] = nil end
        return nil, "GUI_MOUNT_FAILED"
    end
    local closing = false
    function view:unmount()
        self:disconnect()
        layouts[profile] = nil
        if not next(layouts) then mounted[parent] = nil end
        if not closing then root:Destroy() end
    end
    local didMount, handle, code = pcall(app.mountConfigurationView, app, view)
    if not didMount or not handle then
        view:unmount()
        return nil, didMount and code or "GUI_MOUNT_FAILED"
    end
    setHandle(handle)
    layouts[profile] = {app = app, root = root, handle = handle, view = view}
    root.Destroying:Connect(function()
        closing = true
        handle:close()
    end)
    return handle, root
end

function ConfigurationPanel.mountPC(app, parent) return mount(app, parent, "PC") end
function ConfigurationPanel.mountMobile(app, parent) return mount(app, parent, "Mobile") end

return ConfigurationPanel
end
-- END MODULE main.gui.ConfigurationPanel

-- BEGIN MODULE main.navigation.DirectBossTravel
__factories["main.navigation.DirectBossTravel"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Direct, GUI-free navigation for boss jobs.
-- Uses the game's own remotes; never retries an ambiguous teleport.
local LocationEvidence = require("main.world.LocationEvidence")
local DirectBossTravel = {}

function DirectBossTravel.new(env)
    local platform, runtime = env.services.roblox, env.runtime
    local player = platform:player()
    local remotes = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
    local travel = {}

    local function active(ctx)
        return runtime:isActive(ctx) and not ctx:isCancelled() and not ctx.readOnly
            and not (ctx.isClosing and ctx:isClosing())
    end
    local function trace(ctx, action, reason, destination)
        if ctx.bossId ~= "B52" and ctx.stage ~= "OBSERVE_HIDEOUT" then return end
        local encounter = env.state:snapshot().boss.encounter
        local avatar = platform:character()
        local generation = ctx.bossId == "B52" and platform:workspace():GetAttribute("B52FightGeneration") or nil
        local encounterId = active(ctx) and encounter and encounter.bossId == ctx.bossId
            and encounter.phase ~= "COMPLETE" and encounter.encounterId or nil
        local position = avatar.position
        local world = player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")
        if env.services.telemetry then
            pcall(env.services.telemetry.emit, env.services.telemetry, "BOSS_NAVIGATION_ACTION",
                {action=action, reason=reason, bossId=ctx.bossId,
                jobId=ctx.jobId, stage=ctx.stage, encounterId=encounterId, nativeGeneration=generation,
                world=world, position=position, characterReady=avatar.ready, destination=destination})
        else
            print("[PlaneRNG navigation]", action, reason, "job", ctx.jobId, "stage", ctx.stage,
                "encounter", encounterId, "native generation", generation, "from", world, position,
                "character ready", avatar.ready, "destination", destination)
        end
    end
    local function response(ok, code, extra)
        local result = extra or {}
        result.ok, result.code = ok, code
        return result
    end
    local function nativeResponse(packet)
        return packet and {accepted=packet.Ok, reason=packet.Reason and tostring(packet.Reason) or nil} or nil
    end
    local function isHideout()
        return LocationEvidence.hideout(platform, platform:observeLocation(env.profile, runtime:now())) == "PERSONAL_HIDEOUT"
    end
    local function stillAtChainHideout(ctx)
        if not ctx.chainEntryId then return true end
        local debt = env.state:snapshot().chain
        if not debt or debt.id ~= ctx.chainEntryId or not debt.successor then return false end
        local live = env.services.encounterEvidence()
        return live.location == "PERSONAL_HIDEOUT" and live.world == debt.world and not live.inFight
            and not live.transition and not live.downed and not live.reportOpen and live.character and live.character.ready
            and env.state:port("boss"):chainAvatarMatches(ctx.chainEntryId, live.character)
    end
    local function remote(name)
        local item = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild(name)
        return item and item:IsA("RemoteEvent") and item or nil
    end
    local function listen(ctx, event, callback)
        local connection = event.OnClientEvent:Connect(callback)
        local function disconnect()
            if not connection then return end
            connection:Disconnect()
            connection = nil
        end
        ctx:deferCleanup(disconnect)
        return disconnect
    end
    local function await(ctx, predicate, timeout)
        return ctx:await(function()
            if not active(ctx) then return nil end
            return predicate()
        end, timeout)
    end

    local function isBossArena()
        local position, bounds = platform:position(), env.profile.b21 and env.profile.b21.arenaBounds
        return position ~= nil and bounds ~= nil
            and position.X > bounds.minX and position.X < bounds.maxX
            and position.Z > bounds.minZ and position.Z < bounds.maxZ
    end

    function travel:inHideout() return isHideout() end

    function travel:enterHideout(ctx, options)
        if not active(ctx) then
            trace(ctx, "HIDEOUT_ENTER", "STALE_NAVIGATION_OWNER", "PERSONAL_HIDEOUT")
            return response(false, "CANCELLED")
        end
        if ctx.chainEntryId and not options then
            return stillAtChainHideout(ctx) and isHideout() and response(true, "HIDEOUT_ALREADY_ENTERED")
                or response(false, "CHAIN_HIDEOUT_CHANGED")
        end
        if options and options.arrived then
            if options.arrived() then return response(true, "HIDEOUT_ALREADY_ENTERED") end
        elseif isHideout() then return response(true, "HIDEOUT_ALREADY_ENTERED") end
        local event = remote("PersonalHideoutRemote")
        if not event then return response(false, "DIRECT_HIDEOUT_REMOTE_MISSING") end
        local reply, sending
        local disconnect = listen(ctx, event, function(packet)
            if (not options or sending) and not reply and type(packet) == "table" and packet.Kind == "Result"
                and packet.Action == "Enter" and type(packet.Ok) == "boolean" then
                reply = packet
            end
        end)
        if options then
            local allowed, why = options.beforeSubmit()
            if not allowed then
                disconnect()
                return response(false, why or "HIDEOUT_ENTER_PRECONDITION_CHANGED")
            end
        end
        if not active(ctx) then
            disconnect()
            trace(ctx, "HIDEOUT_ENTER", "STALE_NAVIGATION_OWNER", "PERSONAL_HIDEOUT")
            return response(false, "CANCELLED")
        end
        -- Register listener BEFORE the irreversible server request.
        trace(ctx, "HIDEOUT_ENTER", "DISPATCH", "PERSONAL_HIDEOUT")
        if not active(ctx) then disconnect(); return response(false, "CANCELLED") end
        sending = true
        local sent, errorMessage = pcall(function()
            event:FireServer({Action = "Enter"})
        end)
        if not sent then
            disconnect()
            return response(false, "HIDEOUT_ENTER_SEND_FAILED", {message = tostring(errorMessage)})
        end
        if options and options.onSubmitted then options.onSubmitted() end
        local observed = await(ctx, function()
            if reply and reply.Ok == false then return "REJECTED" end
            if options and options.arrived then return options.arrived() and "VERIFIED" or nil end
            if reply and reply.Ok == true and isHideout() then
                return "VERIFIED"
            end
        end, 15)
        disconnect()
        if options and options.arrived then
            local extra = {nativeResponse=nativeResponse(reply)}
            if reply and reply.Ok == false then
                extra.reason = tostring(reply.Reason or "UNKNOWN")
                return response(false, "DIRECT_HIDEOUT_REJECTED", extra)
            end
            if observed == "VERIFIED" then return response(true, "DIRECT_HIDEOUT_VERIFIED", extra) end
            return response(false, active(ctx) and "DIRECT_HIDEOUT_AMBIGUOUS" or "CANCELLED", extra)
        end
        if observed == "VERIFIED" then
            if not ctx:wait(0.35) then return response(false, "CANCELLED") end
            if isHideout() then return response(true, "DIRECT_HIDEOUT_VERIFIED") end
        end
        if observed == "REJECTED" then
            return response(false, "DIRECT_HIDEOUT_REJECTED", {reason = tostring(reply.Reason)})
        end
        -- No fallback Enter or hatch traversal after an unverified request.
        return response(false, active(ctx) and "DIRECT_HIDEOUT_AMBIGUOUS" or "CANCELLED")
    end

    function travel:moveToKnownPoint(ctx, pose, opts)
        opts = opts or {}
        if not active(ctx) then
            trace(ctx, "COMMAND_POSITION", "STALE_NAVIGATION_OWNER", pose)
            return response(false, "CANCELLED")
        end
        if opts.requireHideout and not isHideout() then return response(false, "NOT_IN_HIDEOUT") end
        if not stillAtChainHideout(ctx) then return response(false, "CHAIN_HIDEOUT_CHANGED") end
        local c = platform:character()
        if not c.ready then return response(false, "CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE") end
        if type(pose) ~= "table" or type(pose.x) ~= "number"
            or type(pose.y) ~= "number" or type(pose.z) ~= "number" then
            return response(false, "INVALID_DESTINATION")
        end
        local destination = platform:vector(pose.x, pose.y, pose.z)
        local distance = platform:distance(c.position, destination)
        local radius = opts.radius or 5
        if distance > radius then
            local live = platform:character()
            if not live.ready or live.character ~= c.character or live.root ~= c.root
                or opts.requireHideout and not isHideout() or not active(ctx) then
                trace(ctx, "COMMAND_POSITION", "NAVIGATION_ORIGIN_CHANGED", destination)
                return response(false, "DIRECT_POSITION_ORIGIN_CHANGED")
            end
            -- The fixed location was explicitly tested for B21 Boss Command.
            -- Only a single local PivotTo is sent, with no blind retry.
            trace(ctx, "COMMAND_POSITION", "PIVOT", destination)
            if not active(ctx) then return response(false, "CANCELLED") end
            if not stillAtChainHideout(ctx) then return response(false, "CHAIN_HIDEOUT_CHANGED") end
            local ok, why = pcall(function()
                c.character:PivotTo(CFrame.new(destination))
            end)
            if not ok then return response(false, "DIRECT_POSITION_WRITE_FAILED", {message = tostring(why)}) end
            if not ctx:wait(opts.settle or 0.8) then return response(false, "CANCELLED") end
        end
        local after = platform:character()
        if not after.ready or after.character ~= c.character
            or platform:distance(after.position, destination) > radius
            or (opts.requireHideout and not isHideout()) or not stillAtChainHideout(ctx) then
            return response(false, "DIRECT_POSITION_UNVERIFIED")
        end
        return response(true, distance <= radius and "ALREADY_NEAR_COMMAND" or "DIRECT_COMMAND_POSITION_VERIFIED")
    end

    function travel:travelWorld(ctx, targetWorld, options)
        if not active(ctx) then return response(false, "CANCELLED") end
        if not (type(targetWorld) == "number" and targetWorld >= 1 and targetWorld % 1 == 0) then
            return response(false, "INVALID_TARGET_WORLD")
        end
        -- Boss reports may be dismissed before the server releases the combat lock.
        -- Do not request WorldTravel while InBossFight is still true. Leaving the
        -- fight via B21LeaveFight is NOT a safe substitute (it can forfeit rewards).
        if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true then
            local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
            if telemetry then telemetry:emit("B21_RETURN_LOCK_WAIT", {world = targetWorld}) end
            local released = await(ctx, function()
                if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true then return true end
            end, 65)
            if not released then
                if telemetry then telemetry:emit("B21_RETURN_LOCK_PENDING", {world = targetWorld}) end
                return response(false, active(ctx) and "BOSS_FIGHT_LOCK_PENDING" or "CANCELLED",
                    {reason = "BossFight", inBossFight = player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true})
            end
            if telemetry then telemetry:emit("B21_RETURN_LOCK_RELEASED", {world = targetWorld}) end
            -- Allow time for server-side world-travel validation to observe exit.
            if not ctx:wait(1.5) then return response(false, "CANCELLED") end
        end
        if options and options.arrived() then return response(true, "ALREADY_IN_WORLD") end
        local prepare, request, result = remote("NavPrepareWorlds"), remote("RequestWorldTravel"), remote("WorldTravelResult")
        if not prepare or not request then return response(false, "DIRECT_WORLD_REMOTES_MISSING") end
        local before = platform:position()
        if not options and tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")) == targetWorld
            and player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") ~= true
            and not LocationEvidence.hideout(platform, platform:observeLocation(env.profile, runtime:now()))
            and not isBossArena() then
            return response(true, "ALREADY_IN_WORLD")
        end
        if not before then return response(false, "CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE") end
        local serverReply
        local sending = false
        local disconnect = result and listen(ctx, result, function(packet)
            if (not options or sending and not serverReply) and type(packet) == "table" and packet.Kind == "Result"
                and tonumber(packet.WorldId) == targetWorld and type(packet.Ok) == "boolean" then serverReply = packet end
        end) or nil
        local sent, errorMessage = pcall(function()
            prepare:FireServer("stream", targetWorld)
        end)
        if not sent then
            if disconnect then disconnect() end
            return response(false, "WORLD_PREPARE_SEND_FAILED", {message = tostring(errorMessage)})
        end
        if not ctx:wait(0.12) then
            if disconnect then disconnect() end
            return response(false, "CANCELLED")
        end
        if options then
            if options.arrived() then
                if disconnect then disconnect() end
                return response(true, "ALREADY_IN_WORLD")
            end
            if remote("RequestWorldTravel") ~= request then
                if disconnect then disconnect() end
                return response(false, "DIRECT_WORLD_REQUEST_CHANGED")
            end
            local allowed, why = options.beforeSubmit()
            if not allowed then
                if disconnect then disconnect() end
                return response(false, why)
            end
        end
        if not active(ctx) then
            if disconnect then disconnect() end
            trace(ctx, "WORLD_TRAVEL", "STALE_NAVIGATION_OWNER", targetWorld)
            return response(false, "CANCELLED")
        end
        trace(ctx, "WORLD_TRAVEL", "DISPATCH", targetWorld)
        if not active(ctx) then
            if disconnect then disconnect() end
            return response(false, "CANCELLED")
        end
        sending = true
        sent, errorMessage = pcall(function() request:FireServer(targetWorld) end)
        if not sent then
            if disconnect then disconnect() end
            return response(false, "WORLD_REQUEST_SEND_FAILED", {message = tostring(errorMessage)})
        end
        if options then options.onSubmitted() end
        local nextArrivalProbe = -math.huge
        local observed = await(ctx, function()
            if serverReply and serverReply.Ok == false then return "REJECTED" end
            if options then
                local now = runtime:now()
                if now < nextArrivalProbe then return nil end
                nextArrivalProbe = now + 0.5
                return options.arrived() and "VERIFIED" or nil
            end
            local pos = platform:position()
            local moved = pos and platform:distance(pos, before) > 50
            local notHideout = not LocationEvidence.hideout(platform, platform:observeLocation(env.profile, runtime:now()))
            if tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")) == targetWorld
                and notHideout and not isBossArena() and moved then
                return "VERIFIED"
            end
        end, 15)
        if disconnect then disconnect() end
        local extra = {nativeResponse=options and nativeResponse(serverReply) or nil}
        if observed == "VERIFIED" then
