            extra.world = targetWorld
            return response(true, "DIRECT_WORLD_VERIFIED", extra)
        end
        if observed == "REJECTED" or options and serverReply and serverReply.Ok == false then
            extra.reason = tostring(serverReply.Reason or "UNKNOWN")
            return response(false, "DIRECT_WORLD_REJECTED", extra)
        end
        -- Avoid second travel request after ambiguity.
        return response(false, active(ctx) and "DIRECT_WORLD_AMBIGUOUS" or "CANCELLED", extra)
    end

    return travel
end

return DirectBossTravel
end
-- END MODULE main.navigation.DirectBossTravel

-- BEGIN MODULE main.navigation.MovementService
__factories["main.navigation.MovementService"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local Contracts = require("main.core.Contracts")
local MovementService = {}

function MovementService.new(platform, runtime, ownership, profile)
    local sessions = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
    local movement = {}
    local function outcome(ok, code, fields)
        local value = fields or {}
        value.ok, value.code = ok, code
        return value
    end
    local function validVector(value)
        return value ~= nil and Contracts.isFinite(value.X) and Contracts.isFinite(value.Y) and Contracts.isFinite(value.Z)
    end
    local function guard(context, lease)
        if context and context.readOnly then return nil, "READ_ONLY_CONTEXT" end
        local session = sessions[lease]
        if not runtime:isActive(context) or context:isCancelled() or context:isClosing() then return nil, "CANCELLED" end
        if not ownership:canAct(lease) or not session or session.context ~= context then return nil, "STALE_LEASE" end
        if not platform:ownsMovement(session.humanoid, lease) then return nil, "PLATFORM_MOVEMENT_BUSY" end
        local current = platform:character()
        if current.character ~= session.character or current.root ~= session.root or current.humanoid ~= session.humanoid then
            return nil, "CHARACTER_CHANGED"
        end
        if not current.ready then return nil, current.health <= 0 and "DEAD" or "CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE" end
        return session, nil, current
    end
    function movement:acquire(context)
        if context and context.readOnly then return nil, "READ_ONLY_CONTEXT" end
        if not runtime:isActive(context) or context:isCancelled() or context:isClosing() then return nil, "CANCELLED" end
        local character = platform:character()
        if not character.ready then return nil, "CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE" end
        local lease
        local session = {
            context = context, character = character.character, root = character.root, humanoid = character.humanoid,
        }
        local function cleanup()
            local errors = {}
            local ownsPlatform = session.claimed and platform:ownsMovement(session.humanoid, lease)
            -- Captured references only: never stop a new character after respawn.
            local stopped, err = pcall(function()
                if ownsPlatform and session.root.Parent and session.humanoid.Parent then session.humanoid:MoveTo(session.root.Position) end
            end)
            if not stopped then errors[#errors + 1] = tostring(err) end
            local restored, speedError = pcall(function()
                if ownsPlatform and session.originalSpeed ~= nil and session.humanoid.Parent then
                    session.humanoid.WalkSpeed = session.originalSpeed
                end
            end)
            if not restored then errors[#errors + 1] = tostring(speedError) end
            if session.claimed then platform:releaseMovement(session.humanoid, lease) end
            sessions[lease] = nil
            if #errors > 0 then error(table.concat(errors, "; "), 0) end
        end
        local code
        lease, code = ownership:acquire(context, cleanup)
        if not lease then return nil, code end
        sessions[lease] = session
        if not platform:claimMovement(session.humanoid, lease) then
            ownership:release(lease)
            return nil, "PLATFORM_MOVEMENT_BUSY"
        end
        session.claimed = true
        return lease
    end
    function movement:release(lease) return ownership:release(lease) end
    function movement:moveTo(context, lease, goal, force)
        local session, code = guard(context, lease)
        if not session then return false, code end
        if not validVector(goal) then return false, "INVALID_GOAL" end
        if not force and session.lastGoal and platform:distance(session.lastGoal, goal) < 0.05 then return true, "UNCHANGED" end
        local permitted, value = ownership:perform(lease, function() session.humanoid:MoveTo(goal) end)
        if not permitted then return false, value end
        session.lastGoal = goal
        return true, "MOVING"
    end
    function movement:relocate(context, lease, goal, expectedRoot)
        local session, code, current = guard(context, lease)
        if not session then return false, code end
        if current.root ~= expectedRoot then return false, "CHARACTER_CHANGED" end
        if not validVector(goal) then return false, "INVALID_GOAL" end
        return ownership:perform(lease, function()
            local pivot = session.character:GetPivot()
            session.character:PivotTo(pivot + (goal - current.position))
        end)
    end
    function movement:jump(context, lease)
        local session, code = guard(context, lease)
        if not session then return false, code end
        return ownership:perform(lease, function() session.humanoid.Jump = true end)
    end
    function movement:setSpeed(context, lease, speed)
        local session, code = guard(context, lease)
        if not session then return false, code end
        if not Contracts.isFinite(speed) or speed <= 0 then return false, "INVALID_SPEED" end
        if session.originalSpeed == nil then session.originalSpeed = session.humanoid.WalkSpeed end
        return ownership:perform(lease, function()
            if session.humanoid.WalkSpeed < speed then session.humanoid.WalkSpeed = speed end
        end)
    end
    function movement:stop(context, lease)
        local session = sessions[lease]
        if not session or session.context ~= context or not ownership:isOwner(lease) then return false, "STALE_LEASE" end
        if not platform:ownsMovement(session.humanoid, lease) then return false, "PLATFORM_MOVEMENT_BUSY" end
        if session.root.Parent and session.humanoid.Parent then session.humanoid:MoveTo(session.root.Position) end
        session.lastGoal = nil
        return true
    end
    function movement:stopOwned(context)
        for lease, session in pairs(sessions) do
            if session.context == context and ownership:isOwner(lease) then return self:stop(context, lease) end
        end
        return true, "NO_MOVEMENT_LEASE"
    end
    function movement:ground(raw, options)
        options = options or {}
        local arena = options.mode == "radar"
        local exclude = {}
        local character = platform:character().character
        if character then exclude[#exclude + 1] = character end
        for _, item in ipairs(options.exclude or {}) do exclude[#exclude + 1] = item end
        local hit = platform:raycast(raw + platform:vector(0, arena and 24 or 18, 0),
            platform:vector(0, arena and -90 or -60, 0), exclude)
        if not hit or hit.Normal.Y < (arena and 0.65 or 0.7) then return nil end
        return hit.Position + platform:vector(0, 3, 0)
    end
    function movement:directSafe(origin, goal, options)
        options = options or {}
        if not validVector(origin) or not validVector(goal) then return false end
        if math.abs(goal.Y - origin.Y) > 6 then return false end
        local delta = goal - origin
        local flat = platform:vector(delta.X, 0, delta.Z)
        local side = flat.Magnitude > 0.01 and platform:vector(-flat.Z, 0, flat.X).Unit * 2 or platform:vector(0, 0, 0)
        local exclude = {platform:character().character}
        for _, item in ipairs(options.corridorExclude or {}) do exclude[#exclude + 1] = item end
        -- Width and two heights: a single center ray misses narrow posts and low obstacles.
        for _, offset in ipairs({side, side * -1, platform:vector(0, -1, 0), platform:vector(0, 2, 0)}) do
            if platform:raycast(origin + offset, delta, exclude) then return false end
        end
        local samples = math.max(1, math.ceil(flat.Magnitude / (profile.radar.directGroundStep or 4)))
        for i = 1, samples do
            local sample = origin:Lerp(goal, i / samples)
            local ground = self:ground(sample, {mode = "radar", exclude = options.exclude})
            if not ground or math.abs(ground.Y - sample.Y) > 3 then return false end
        end
        return true
    end
    function movement:followDirect(context, lease, goal, options)
        local deadline, progressAt, previous = options.deadline, runtime:now(), platform:position()
        local target
        while runtime:now() < deadline do
            local session, code = guard(context, lease)
            if not session then return outcome(false, code) end
            if options.valid then
                local valid, validCode = options.valid()
                if not valid then return outcome(false, validCode) end
            end
            session, code = guard(context, lease)
            if not session then return outcome(false, code) end
            if options.interrupt then
                local reason = options.interrupt()
                if reason then return outcome(false, reason) end
            end
            local reached = options.stop()
            session, code = guard(context, lease)
            if not session then return outcome(false, code) end
            if reached then return outcome(true, "REACHED") end
            local position = platform:position()
            local delta = goal - position
            if delta.Magnitude < 0.1 then return outcome(false, "GOAL_UNVERIFIED") end
            if not target or platform:distance(position, target) <= 1 then
                target = position + delta.Unit * math.min(delta.Magnitude, profile.radar.directSegment or 8)
                if not self:directSafe(position, target, options) then return outcome(false, "DIRECT_BLOCKED") end
                local moved, moveCode = self:moveTo(context, lease, target)
                if not moved then return outcome(false, moveCode) end
            end
            if platform:distance(position, previous) >= 1 then previous, progressAt = position, runtime:now() end
            if runtime:now() - progressAt > profile.radar.progressTimeout then return outcome(false, "STUCK") end
            local remaining = deadline - runtime:now()
            if remaining <= 0 then break end
            if not context:wait(math.min(profile.navigation.radarPoll, remaining)) then return outcome(false, "CANCELLED") end
        end
        return outcome(false, "RADAR_TIMEOUT")
    end
    function movement:followPath(context, lease, path, options)
        options = options or {}
        local radar = options.mode == "radar"
        local poll = radar and profile.navigation.radarPoll or profile.navigation.hideoutPoll
        local progressTimeout = radar and profile.radar.progressTimeout or profile.navigation.hideoutProgressTimeout
        local waypointTimeout = profile.radar.waypointTimeout
        local deadline = math.min(options.deadline or math.huge, runtime:now() + (options.timeout or 85))
        local blocked, index, connection, disconnectError = false, 1, nil, nil
        local function disconnect()
            if connection then
                local old = connection
                connection = nil
                local cleaned, err = pcall(function() old:Disconnect() end)
                if not cleaned then disconnectError = tostring(err) end
            end
            if disconnectError then error(disconnectError, 0) end
        end
        local function check()
            if not runtime:isActive(context) or context:isCancelled() then return "CANCELLED" end
            if runtime:now() >= deadline then return "TIMEOUT" end
            if options.interrupt then
                local reason = options.interrupt()
                if reason then return reason end
            end
            if options.valid then
                local valid, code = options.valid()
                if not runtime:isActive(context) or context:isCancelled() then return "CANCELLED" end
                if not valid then return code or "TARGET_CHANGED" end
            end
            if options.stop then
                local reached = options.stop()
                if not runtime:isActive(context) or context:isCancelled() then return "CANCELLED" end
                if reached then return "REACHED" end
            end
            local session, code = guard(context, lease)
            if not session then return code end
            if blocked then return "BLOCKED" end
            return nil
        end
        local ok, result = pcall(function()
            local points = path:GetWaypoints()
            context:deferCleanup(disconnect)
            connection = path.Blocked:Connect(function(blockedIndex)
                if blockedIndex >= index then blocked = true end
            end)
            local condition = check()
            if condition then return outcome(condition == "REACHED", condition) end
            if #points < 2 then return outcome(false, "NO_WAYPOINTS") end
            for nextIndex = 2, #points do
                index = nextIndex
                condition = check()
                if condition then return outcome(condition == "REACHED", condition) end
                if platform:isJump(points[index]) then
                    local jumped, jumpCode = self:jump(context, lease)
                    if not jumped then return outcome(false, jumpCode) end
                end
                local moved, moveCode = self:moveTo(context, lease, points[index].Position, true)
                if not moved then return outcome(false, moveCode) end
                local previous, progressAt, started = platform:position(), runtime:now(), runtime:now()
                while true do
                    condition = check()
                    if condition then return outcome(condition == "REACHED", condition) end
                    local position = platform:position()
                    if platform:distance(position, points[index].Position) <= (options.waypointReach or (radar and 4 or 3.5)) then break end
                    if platform:distance(position, previous) >= 1 then previous, progressAt = position, runtime:now() end
                    if runtime:now() - progressAt > progressTimeout then return outcome(false, "STUCK") end
                    if runtime:now() - started > waypointTimeout then return outcome(false, "WAYPOINT_TIMEOUT") end
                    context:wait(math.min(poll, math.max(0, deadline - runtime:now())))
                end
            end
            condition = check()
            if condition then return outcome(condition == "REACHED", condition) end
            -- A goal/stop predicate is required to distinguish final arrival from path completion.
            return outcome(false, "GOAL_UNVERIFIED")
        end)
        local cleaned, cleanupError = pcall(disconnect)
        if not cleaned then return outcome(false, "PATH_CLEANUP_FAILED", {message = tostring(cleanupError)}) end
        if not ok then return outcome(false, "NAVIGATION_ERROR", {message = tostring(result)}) end
        return result
    end
    function movement:navigate(context, lease, goal, options)
        options = options or {}
        local radar = options.mode == "radar"
        local attempts = options.attempts or (radar and profile.radar.attempts or profile.navigation.commandAttempts)
        local deadline = runtime:now() + (options.timeout or profile.navigation.commandTimeout)
        local last = outcome(false, "NO_PATH")
        local function stop()
            if options.stop and options.stop() then return true end
            local current = platform:position()
            return current and platform:distance(current, goal) <= (options.reach or (radar and 4 or 3.5))
        end
        for attempt = 1, attempts do
            local session, code, current = guard(context, lease)
            if not session then return outcome(false, code, {attempts = attempt - 1}) end
            local reached = stop()
            if not runtime:isActive(context) or context:isCancelled() then return outcome(false, "CANCELLED") end
            if reached then return outcome(true, "REACHED", {attempts = attempt - 1}) end
            if runtime:now() >= deadline then return outcome(false, "TIMEOUT", {attempts = attempt - 1}) end
            if options.valid then
                local valid, validCode = options.valid()
                if not runtime:isActive(context) or context:isCancelled() then return outcome(false, "CANCELLED") end
                if not valid then return outcome(false, validCode or "TARGET_CHANGED") end
            end
            local path, pathCode = platform:computePath(current.position, goal, {
                AgentRadius = 2, AgentHeight = 5, AgentCanJump = true,
                WaypointSpacing = radar and profile.radar.waypointSpacing or profile.navigation.hideoutWaypointSpacing,
            })
            -- ComputeAsync may yield: revalidate identity, cancellation, and the deadline.
            session, code = guard(context, lease)
            if not session then return outcome(false, code, {attempts = attempt}) end
            if runtime:now() >= deadline then return outcome(false, "TIMEOUT", {attempts = attempt}) end
            if path then
                last = self:followPath(context, lease, path, {
                    mode = options.mode, deadline = deadline, timeout = options.segmentTimeout or 85,
                    stop = stop, valid = options.valid,
                })
            else last = outcome(false, pathCode or "NO_PATH") end
            last.attempts = attempt
            if last.ok then return last end
            if last.code ~= "STUCK" and last.code ~= "BLOCKED" and last.code ~= "WAYPOINT_TIMEOUT"
                and last.code ~= "NO_PATH" and last.code ~= "PATH_ERROR" and last.code ~= "GOAL_UNVERIFIED" then break end
            self:stop(context, lease)
            if attempt < attempts then
                local pause = radar and 0 or (attempt <= 3 and 2 or 0.8)
                context:wait(math.min(pause, math.max(0, deadline - runtime:now())))
            end
        end
        self:stop(context, lease)
        return last
    end
    return movement
end

return MovementService
end
-- END MODULE main.navigation.MovementService

-- BEGIN MODULE main.world.LocationEvidence
__factories["main.world.LocationEvidence"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local Contracts = require("main.core.Contracts")
local LocationEvidence = {}

function LocationEvidence.hideout(platform, location)
    local player = platform:player()
    local owner = player:GetAttribute("HideoutHost")
    local flagged = player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout") == true
    local position = location.position
    local atSite = location.region == "HIDEOUT" and location.confidence == "VERIFIED"
    local workspace = position and platform:workspace()
    local site = workspace and workspace:FindFirstChild("Bunker")
    local offset = site and site:GetAttribute("SiteOffset")
    local liveSite = position ~= nil and typeof(offset) == "Vector3"
    if liveSite then
        -- PersonalHideoutBaseConfig.Site bounds relative to the live bunker offset.
        local x, y, z = position.x - offset.X, position.y - offset.Y, position.z - offset.Z
        atSite = x >= -462 and x <= 1504 and y >= 300 and y <= 437 and z >= 230.8 and z <= 641.8
    end
    local siteOwner = site and site:GetAttribute("HideoutHost")
    if flagged and tonumber(owner) == player.UserId and atSite and platform:character().ready
        and (siteOwner == nil or tonumber(siteOwner) == player.UserId) then
        return "PERSONAL_HIDEOUT", true, liveSite and site or nil
    end
    if flagged or owner ~= nil or atSite or location.region == "HIDEOUT" then
        return "UNVERIFIED_HIDEOUT", atSite, liveSite and atSite and site or nil
    end
end

local function matchesBounds(position, bounds, world)
    local center = bounds and bounds:GetAttribute(("W%dP"):format(world))
    local size = bounds and bounds:GetAttribute(("W%dS"):format(world))
    if typeof(center) == "Vector3" and typeof(size) == "Vector3" and Contracts.isFinite(size.X)
        and Contracts.isFinite(size.Z) and size.X > 0 and size.Z > 0 then
        return math.abs(position.x - center.X) <= size.X / 2 and math.abs(position.z - center.Z) <= size.Z / 2
    end
end

function LocationEvidence.matchesWorld(platform, location, world)
    local position = location.position
    if not position or not Contracts.isHomeWorld(world) then return false end
    local bounds = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("WorldZoneBounds")
    local match = matchesBounds(position, bounds, world)
    if match ~= nil then return match end
    return location.confidence == "VERIFIED" and location.worldId == world
end

-- A stale CurrentWorld can disagree with the respawn position. Geometry alone
-- can establish a safe origin, while arrival still requires both witnesses.
function LocationEvidence.worldAtPosition(platform, location)
    if not location.position then return nil end
    local bounds = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("WorldZoneBounds")
    local matched
    if bounds and type(bounds.GetAttributes) == "function" then
        for name in pairs(bounds:GetAttributes()) do
            local world = tonumber(name:match("^W(%d+)P$"))
            if world and matchesBounds(location.position, bounds, world) then
                if matched then return nil end
                matched = world
            end
        end
    end
    return matched or location.confidence == "VERIFIED" and location.worldId or nil
end

return LocationEvidence
end
-- END MODULE main.world.LocationEvidence

-- BEGIN MODULE main.world.WorldService
__factories["main.world.WorldService"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local Contracts = require("main.core.Contracts")
local LocationEvidence = require("main.world.LocationEvidence")
local WorldService = {}

function WorldService.new(platform, gui, input, movement, runtime, state, profile)
    local writer = state:port("world")
    local started, root, nav, heartbeat, faulted = false, nil, nil, nil, false
    local transitioning = false
    local rootConnections, navConnections = {}, {}
    local watched = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
    local pending, generation, ignoreNext, lastPoll = nil, 0, nil, -math.huge
    local world = {}
    local function active(context)
        return runtime:isActive(context) and not context:isCancelled() and not context:isClosing()
    end
    local function failure(code, extra)
        local record = extra or {}
        record.ok, record.accepted, record.verified = false, false, false
        record.code, record.quality = code, record.quality or "UNVERIFIED"
        return record
    end
    local function disconnectAll(connections)
        local errors, remaining = {}, {}
        for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
            local ok, err = pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end)
            if not ok then
                errors[#errors + 1] = tostring(err)
                remaining[#remaining + 1] = connection
            end
        end
        return errors, remaining
    end
    function world:observe()
        local record = platform:observeLocation(profile, runtime:now())
        writer:observe(record)
        return record
    end
    function world:waypoint(number)
        local target = gui:find(profile.paths.worldsGui)
        return target and target:FindFirstChild("Waypoint" .. tostring(number), true) or nil
    end
    local bind
    local function watchButton(button)
        if not started then return end
        if watched[button] or not button:IsA("GuiButton") then return end
        local number = tonumber(button.Name:match("^Waypoint(%d+)$"))
        if not Contracts.isHomeWorld(number) then return end
        watched[button] = true
        navConnections[#navConnections + 1] = button.Activated:Connect(function()
            if not started or not runtime:isAlive() then return end
            if ignoreNext == button then ignoreNext = nil; return end
            generation = generation + 1
            local character = platform:character()
            pending = {
                world = number, before = character.position, character = character.character,
                expires = runtime:now() + profile.navigation.trackerTimeout, generation = generation,
            }
        end)
    end
    bind = function()
        local errors, remainingRoot = disconnectAll(rootConnections)
        local navErrors, remainingNav = disconnectAll(navConnections)
        rootConnections, navConnections = remainingRoot, remainingNav
        -- A disconnect failure must be visible; never silently grow duplicate observers.
        if #errors > 0 or #navErrors > 0 then
            started, faulted = false, true
            error("TRACKER_DISCONNECT_FAILED", 0)
        end
        watched = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
        root, nav = platform:playerGui(), gui:find(profile.paths.worldsGui)
        if not root then return end
        local function changed(object)
            if started and object.Name == profile.paths.worldsGui[1] then bind() end
        end
        rootConnections[#rootConnections + 1] = root.ChildAdded:Connect(changed)
        rootConnections[#rootConnections + 1] = root.ChildRemoved:Connect(changed)
        if nav and nav:IsA("ScreenGui") then
            for _, item in ipairs(nav:GetDescendants()) do watchButton(item) end
            navConnections[#navConnections + 1] = nav.DescendantAdded:Connect(watchButton)
        end
    end
    function world:poll()
        if not started or not runtime:isAlive() then return false, "STOPPED" end
        if platform:playerGui() ~= root or gui:find(profile.paths.worldsGui) ~= nav then bind() end
        local record = self:observe()
        if pending then
            local current = platform:character()
            if runtime:now() >= pending.expires or current.character ~= pending.character then pending = nil
            elseif pending.before and current.position
                and platform:distance(current.position, pending.before) > profile.navigation.trackerDisplacement then
                local expected = pending.world
                local matched = expected == 1 and record.worldId == 1 or expected == 15 and record.worldId == 15
                local generic = expected ~= 1 and expected ~= 15 and record.region == "UNKNOWN"
                if matched or generic then
                    writer:track(expected, "waypoint", matched and "VERIFIED" or "INFERRED", runtime:now())
                end
                pending = nil
            end
        end
        return true
    end
    function world:start()
        if transitioning then return false, "TRACKER_TRANSITION_PENDING" end
        if started then return true end
        if faulted then return false, "TRACKER_DISCONNECT_FAILED" end
        if not runtime:isAlive() then return false, "STOPPED" end
        transitioning = true
        started = true
        local ok, err = pcall(function()
            bind()
            heartbeat = platform:service("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                if started and runtime:isAlive() and runtime:now() - lastPoll >= profile.navigation.trackerPoll then
                    lastPoll = runtime:now()
                    self:poll()
                end
            end)
            self:poll()
        end)
        transitioning = false
        if not ok then self:stop(); return false, tostring(err) end
        if not runtime:isAlive() then
            local stopped, code, detail = self:stop()
            if not stopped then return false, code, detail end
            return false, "STOPPED"
        end
        return true
    end
    function world:stop()
        if transitioning then return false, "TRACKER_TRANSITION_PENDING" end
        transitioning = true
        started, pending, ignoreNext = false, nil, nil
        generation = generation + 1
        local all = {}
        for _, connection in ipairs(rootConnections) do all[#all + 1] = connection end
        for _, connection in ipairs(navConnections) do all[#all + 1] = connection end
        if heartbeat then all[#all + 1] = heartbeat end
        local errors, remaining = disconnectAll(all)
        -- Keep failed handles so a subsequent stop can retry without reconnecting.
        rootConnections, navConnections, heartbeat, root, nav = remaining, {}, nil, nil, nil
        faulted = #errors > 0
        transitioning = false
        if faulted then return false, "TRACKER_DISCONNECT_FAILED", errors end
        return true
    end
    local function permitted(context, number, purpose)
        if context and context.readOnly then return false, "READ_ONLY_CONTEXT" end
        if not active(context) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        local snapshot = state:snapshot()
        if snapshot.totem.proceedPending then return false, "TOTEM_PROCEED_PENDING" end
        if snapshot.totem.manualHold or next(snapshot.holds) then return false, "HELD" end
        if snapshot.boss.reportPending then return false, "BOSS_REPORT_PENDING" end
        if snapshot.boss.returnPending and (context.kind ~= "BOSS" or purpose ~= "RETURN") then
            return false, "BOSS_RETURN_PENDING"
        end
        if snapshot.totem.returnPending and (context.kind ~= "TOTEM" or purpose ~= "RETURN") then
            return false, "TOTEM_RETURN_PENDING"
        end
        for id, feature in pairs(snapshot.features) do
            if feature.recovery and feature.recovery.stage ~= "RETURN" then return false, id .. "_RECOVERY_PENDING" end
            if (feature.returnPending or feature.recovery) and (context.kind ~= id or purpose ~= "RETURN") then
                return false, id .. "_RECOVERY_PENDING"
            end
        end
        if not Contracts.isHomeWorld(number) then return false, "INVALID_WORLD" end
        return true
    end
    function world:openWorlds(number, context, options)
        options = options or {}
        local allowed, denied = permitted(context, number, options.purpose)
        if not allowed then return failure(denied) end
        local function opened() return gui:visible(self:waypoint(number)) and true or nil end
        if opened() then return {ok = true, code = "WORLDS_OPEN"} end
        local modes = {"Activated", "MouseButton1Click", "MOUSE"}
        local last
        for index, event in ipairs(modes) do
            allowed, denied = permitted(context, number, options.purpose)
            if not allowed then return failure(denied) end
            local button = gui:find(profile.paths.worldsButton)
            if not gui:visible(button) then return failure("WORLDS_BUTTON_HIDDEN") end
            last = input:dispatch(context, {
                kind = event == "MOUSE" and "MOUSE" or "GUI", event = event,
                mode = "raw", purpose = "WORLDS", target = button,
                verify = opened, timeout = profile.navigation.worldsWait[index],
                valid = function() return permitted(context, number, options.purpose) end,
            })
            if last.ok and last.verified then return {ok = true, code = "WORLDS_OPEN", method = event} end
            if last.code == "CANCELLED" then return failure("CANCELLED") end
        end
        return failure("WORLDS_OPEN_UNVERIFIED", {evidence = last})
    end
    -- Totem uses the project's established native world-travel protocol, not
    -- WorldNav GUI button activation. Only a verified arrival can begin offering.
    -- Keep the existing GUI travel path for BOSS/other contexts unchanged.
    local function directTotemTravel(number, context, before, purpose)
        local folder = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        local prepare = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("NavPrepareWorlds")
        local request = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("RequestWorldTravel")
        local result = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("WorldTravelResult")
        if not prepare or not request or not result
            or not prepare:IsA("RemoteEvent") or not request:IsA("RemoteEvent")
            or not result:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
            return failure("DIRECT_WORLD_REMOTES_MISSING", {requestedWorld = number})
        end
        if not before.ready then return failure("CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE", {requestedWorld = number}) end
        local reply
        local listener = result.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(packet)
            if type(packet) == "table" and packet.Kind == "Result"
                and tonumber(packet.WorldId) == number and type(packet.Ok) == "boolean" then
                reply = packet
            end
        end)
        local function finish(record)
            local ok, err = pcall(function() listener:Disconnect() end)
            if not ok then
                return failure("DIRECT_WORLD_LISTENER_CLEANUP_FAILED", {
                    requestedWorld = number, evidence = record, message = tostring(err),
                })
            end
            return record
        end
        local sent, err = pcall(function() prepare:FireServer("stream", number) end)
        if not sent then return finish(failure("DIRECT_WORLD_PREPARE_FAILED", {
            requestedWorld = number, message = tostring(err),
        })) end
        if not context:wait(0.12) or not active(context) then
            return finish(failure("CANCELLED", {requestedWorld = number}))
        end
        local allowed, denied = permitted(context, number, purpose)
        if not allowed then return finish(failure(denied, {requestedWorld = number})) end
        if platform:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes") ~= folder
            or folder:FindFirstChild("RequestWorldTravel") ~= request then
            return finish(failure("DIRECT_WORLD_REMOTE_CHANGED", {requestedWorld = number}))
        end
        sent, err = pcall(function() request:FireServer(number) end)
        if not sent then return finish(failure("DIRECT_WORLD_REQUEST_FAILED", {
            requestedWorld = number, message = tostring(err),
        })) end
        -- Send once only. On timeout or ambiguous arrival, do not resend a
        -- world-travel request; leave a checkpoint for explicit recovery.
        local arrival, waitCode = context:await(function()
            if reply and reply.Ok == false then
                return {rejected = true, reason = tostring(reply.Reason or "UNKNOWN")}
            end
            local current = platform:character()
            if not current.ready or current.character ~= before.character then return nil end
            if not current.position or not before.position
                or platform:distance(current.position, before.position) <= profile.navigation.teleportDisplacement then
                return nil
            end
            local location = world:observe()
            local matched = LocationEvidence.matchesWorld(platform, location, number)
            if matched and (location.worldId == number
                or platform:player():GetAttribute("CurrentWorld") == number) then
                return {quality = "VERIFIED", location = location}
            end
            -- Non-landmark worlds preserve the legacy INFERRED return contract,
            -- but require a target-world attribute plus actual displacement.
            if number ~= 1 and number ~= 15 and location.region == "UNKNOWN"
                and platform:player():GetAttribute("CurrentWorld") == number then
                return {quality = "INFERRED", location = location}
            end
            return nil
        end, profile.navigation.teleportTimeout)
        if not active(context) then return finish(failure("CANCELLED", {requestedWorld = number})) end
        if arrival and arrival.rejected then
            return finish(failure("DIRECT_WORLD_REJECTED", {
                requestedWorld = number, reason = arrival.reason,
            }))
        end
        if not arrival then
            return finish(failure("DIRECT_WORLD_ARRIVAL_UNVERIFIED", {
                requestedWorld = number, waitCode = waitCode,
                serverAcknowledged = reply and reply.Ok == true or false,
            }))
        end
        local accepted = arrival.quality == "VERIFIED" or profile.navigation.acceptInferredReturn
        local record = {
            ok = accepted, accepted = accepted, verified = arrival.quality == "VERIFIED",
            quality = arrival.quality, requestedWorld = number,
            code = accepted and "DIRECT_WORLD_TRAVEL_ACCEPTED" or "INFERRED_NOT_ACCEPTED",
            evidence = arrival.location, observedAt = runtime:now(),
        }
        if accepted then writer:track(number, "direct-totem-world-service", arrival.quality, runtime:now()) end
        return finish(record)
    end
    function world:travel(number, context, options)
        options = options or {}
        local allowed, denied = permitted(context, number, options.purpose)
        if not allowed then return failure(denied, {requestedWorld = number}) end
        local current = self:observe()
        if (number == 1 or number == 15) and current.worldId == number then
            local record = {
                ok = true, accepted = true, verified = true, code = "ALREADY_THERE", quality = "VERIFIED",
                requestedWorld = number, evidence = current, observedAt = runtime:now(),
            }
            writer:recordTravel(record)
            return record
        end
        local stopped, stopCode = movement:stopOwned(context)
        if not stopped then return failure(stopCode) end
        -- Dungeon uses the verified native world request from stable V2.6.1;
        -- its job still holds central WORLD_TRANSITION ownership.
        if context.kind == "TOTEM" or context.kind == "DUNGEON" then
            local direct = directTotemTravel(number, context, platform:character(), options.purpose)
            writer:recordTravel(direct)
            return direct
        end
        local opened = self:openWorlds(number, context, options)
        if not opened.ok then writer:recordTravel(opened); return opened end
        allowed, denied = permitted(context, number, options.purpose)
        if not allowed then return failure(denied, {requestedWorld = number}) end
        local target, before = self:waypoint(number), platform:character()
        if not gui:visible(target) then return failure("WAYPOINT_UNAVAILABLE", {requestedWorld = number}) end
        if not before.ready then return failure("CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE", {requestedWorld = number}) end
        -- Explicit dispatch captures its own baseline before any Activated listeners run.
        pending, generation = nil, generation + 1
        local marker = generation
        ignoreNext = target
        local function valid()
            if generation ~= marker then return false, "WORLD_SELECTION_CHANGED" end
            if platform:character().character ~= before.character then return false, "CHARACTER_CHANGED" end
            return permitted(context, number, options.purpose)
        end
        local interaction = input:dispatch(context, {
            kind = "GUI", target = target, mode = "raw", valid = valid,
            timeout = profile.navigation.teleportTimeout,
            verify = function()
                local stillValid = valid()
                if not stillValid then return nil end
                local position = platform:position()
                if not position or platform:distance(position, before.position) <= profile.navigation.teleportDisplacement then return nil end
                local location = self:observe()
                local matched = number == 1 and location.worldId == 1 or number == 15 and location.worldId == 15
                if matched or number ~= 1 and number ~= 15 and location.region == "UNKNOWN" then
                    return {location = location, quality = matched and "VERIFIED" or "INFERRED"}
                end
                return nil
            end,
        })
        ignoreNext = nil
        local record
        if interaction.ok and interaction.verified then
            local quality = interaction.evidence.quality
            local accepted = quality == "VERIFIED" or profile.navigation.acceptInferredReturn
            record = {
                ok = accepted, accepted = accepted, verified = quality == "VERIFIED", quality = quality,
                code = accepted and "TRAVEL_ACCEPTED" or "INFERRED_NOT_ACCEPTED",
                requestedWorld = number, evidence = interaction.evidence, observedAt = runtime:now(),
            }
            generation, pending = generation + 1, nil
            writer:track(number, "world-service", quality, runtime:now())
        else
            record = failure(interaction.code, {requestedWorld = number, evidence = interaction, observedAt = runtime:now()})
        end
        writer:recordTravel(record)
        return record
    end
    function world:captureOriginal(context)
        if not active(context) then return nil, "CANCELLED" end
        local home = state:snapshot().config.homeWorld
        if home then return {homeWorld = home, source = "configured-home"} end
        local observed = self:observe()
        if observed.worldId then return {homeWorld = observed.worldId, source = observed.source} end
        local tracker = state:snapshot().world.tracker
        if tracker then return {homeWorld = tracker.currentWorld, source = "tracker-last-selection"} end
        return nil, "HOME_REQUIRED"
    end
    function world:returnHome(request, context)
        if context and context.readOnly then return failure("READ_ONLY_CONTEXT") end
        if not active(context) then return failure("CANCELLED") end
        local home = request and request.homeWorld
        if not Contracts.isHomeWorld(home) then return failure("HOME_REQUIRED") end
        local allowed, denied = permitted(context, home, "RETURN")
        if not allowed then return failure(denied) end
        local domain = context.kind == "BOSS" and state:port("boss")
            or context.kind == "TOTEM" and state:port("totem") or state:port("feature", context.kind)
        domain:setReturnPending(true)
        local attempts = context.kind == "BOSS" and profile.boss.returnAttempts or profile.totem.returnAttempts
        local last
        for attempt = 1, attempts do
            if not active(context) then last = failure("CANCELLED"); break end
            last = self:travel(home, context, {purpose = "RETURN"})
            last.attempts = attempt
            if last.ok then domain:setReturnPending(false); break end
            if last.code == "CANCELLED" or last.code == "TOTEM_PROCEED_PENDING"
                or last.code == "HELD" or last.code == "BOSS_REPORT_PENDING"
                or last.code == "INFERRED_NOT_ACCEPTED" then break end
            if attempt < attempts then context:wait(profile.boss.returnRetryDelay) end
        end
        writer:recordReturn(last)
        return last
    end
    function world:enterHideout(context)
        local allowed, code = permitted(context, 1)
        if not allowed then return failure(code) end
        local observed = self:observe()
        if LocationEvidence.hideout(platform, observed) == "PERSONAL_HIDEOUT" then return {ok = true, code = "ALREADY_IN_HIDEOUT", evidence = observed} end
        if observed.worldId ~= 1 then
            local travelled = self:travel(1, context)
            if not travelled.ok then return travelled end
        end
        local hatch = platform:findWorld(profile.names.hideoutHatch)
        if not hatch or not hatch:IsA("BasePart") then return failure("HATCH_UNAVAILABLE") end
        local lease, acquireError = movement:acquire(context)
        if not lease then return failure(acquireError) end
        local ok, result = pcall(function()
            local character = platform:character()
            if platform:distance(character.position, hatch.Position) > profile.navigation.hatchPathDistance then
                local goal = platform:vector(hatch.Position.X, character.position.Y, hatch.Position.Z)
                local reached = movement:navigate(context, lease, goal, {
                    mode = "hideout", attempts = 1, timeout = profile.navigation.hatchPathTimeout,
                    valid = function() return hatch.Parent ~= nil, "HATCH_CHANGED" end,
                    stop = function()
                        local position = platform:position()
                        return LocationEvidence.hideout(platform, self:observe()) == "PERSONAL_HIDEOUT" or position
                            and platform:distance(position, hatch.Position) <= profile.navigation.hatchReach
                    end,
                })
                if not reached.ok and LocationEvidence.hideout(platform, self:observe()) ~= "PERSONAL_HIDEOUT" then return failure(reached.code) end
            end
            local deadline, lastMove = runtime:now() + profile.navigation.hatchTimeout, -math.huge
            while active(context) and runtime:now() < deadline do
                local location = self:observe()
                if LocationEvidence.hideout(platform, location) == "PERSONAL_HIDEOUT" then
                    if not context:wait(profile.navigation.hideoutSettle) then return failure("CANCELLED") end
                    local settled = self:observe()
                    if LocationEvidence.hideout(platform, settled) ~= "PERSONAL_HIDEOUT" then return failure("HIDEOUT_UNVERIFIED", {evidence = settled}) end
                    return {ok = true, code = "HIDEOUT_ENTERED", evidence = settled}
                end
                if not hatch.Parent then return failure("HATCH_CHANGED") end
                if runtime:now() - lastMove >= profile.navigation.hatchMoveInterval then
                    local position = platform:position()
                    if not position then return failure("CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE") end
                    local moved, moveCode = movement:moveTo(context, lease,
                        platform:vector(hatch.Position.X, position.Y, hatch.Position.Z), true)
                    if not moved then return failure(moveCode) end
                    lastMove = runtime:now()
                end
                context:wait(math.min(profile.scheduler.poll, math.max(0, deadline - runtime:now())))
            end
            return failure(active(context) and "HATCH_UNVERIFIED" or "CANCELLED")
        end)
        local cleaned, released, releaseCode = pcall(function() return movement:release(lease) end)
        if not cleaned or not released then return failure("MOVEMENT_CLEANUP_FAILED", {message = tostring(releaseCode or released)}) end
        if not ok then return failure("HIDEOUT_ERROR", {message = tostring(result)}) end
        return result
    end
    function world:exitHideout(context, validate, reserve)
        if context.readOnly or context.kind ~= "BOSS" or not active(context) then return failure("HIDEOUT_EXIT_SCOPE_REQUIRED") end
        local _, _, site = LocationEvidence.hideout(platform, platform:observeLocation(profile, runtime:now()))
        if not site then return failure("BOSS_HIDEOUT_EXIT_SITE_UNVERIFIED") end
        -- The native East Door invokes this public client method, which owns the
        -- curtain and dispatches LeaveBase through the native Hideout session.
        local modules = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("ClientModules")
        local module = modules and modules:FindFirstChild("PersonalHideoutBaseClient")
        if not module or not module:IsA("ModuleScript") then return failure("BOSS_HIDEOUT_EXIT_CONTROLLER_UNAVAILABLE") end
        local loaded, controller = pcall(getfenv(0)["require"], module)
        if not loaded or type(controller) ~= "table" or type(controller.Host) ~= "function"
            or type(controller.HopLeave) ~= "function" then return failure("BOSS_HIDEOUT_EXIT_CONTROLLER_UNAVAILABLE") end
        local _, _, liveSite = LocationEvidence.hideout(platform, platform:observeLocation(profile, runtime:now()))
        if not active(context) or not validate() or liveSite ~= site then return failure("BOSS_HIDEOUT_EXIT_CHANGED") end
        local read, host = pcall(controller.Host)
        if not read then return failure("BOSS_HIDEOUT_EXIT_SESSION_UNAVAILABLE") end
        if host == nil then return failure("BOSS_HIDEOUT_EXIT_NO_NATIVE_SESSION") end
        local owner, siteOwner = platform:player():GetAttribute("HideoutHost"), site:GetAttribute("HideoutHost")
        if not tonumber(host) or owner ~= nil and tonumber(owner) ~= tonumber(host)
            or siteOwner ~= nil and tonumber(siteOwner) ~= tonumber(host) then
            return failure("BOSS_HIDEOUT_EXIT_SESSION_UNVERIFIED")
        end
        if not active(context) or not validate() then return failure("BOSS_HIDEOUT_EXIT_CHANGED") end
        if not reserve() then return failure("BOSS_HIDEOUT_EXIT_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED") end
        local dispatched = pcall(controller.HopLeave)
        if not dispatched then return failure("BOSS_HIDEOUT_EXIT_SUBMISSION_UNCERTAIN") end
        return {ok=true, code="BOSS_HIDEOUT_NATIVE_EXIT_INVOKED"}
    end
    return world
end

return WorldService
end
-- END MODULE main.world.WorldService

-- BEGIN MODULE pc.V6AlphaEntry
__factories["pc.V6AlphaEntry"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local AntiAFKF15 = require("main.core.AntiAFKF15")
local LiveHost = require("main.core.LiveHost")
local ProjectFeatureAdapters = require("main.adapters.ProjectFeatureAdapters")
local RiftSchedulerBridge = require("main.adapters.RiftSchedulerBridge")
local DungeonReadiness = require("dungeon.Readiness")
local ProjectHostServices = require("main.adapters.ProjectHostServices")
local PotassiumRaidHost = require("main.adapters.PotassiumRaidHost")
local ProjectBossEvidence = require("main.adapters.ProjectBossEvidence")
local ProjectTotemEvidence = require("main.adapters.ProjectTotemEvidence")
local RaidCatalog = require("main.config.RaidCatalog")
local prefix = "[PlaneRNG V6 Delta v0.1 Alpha]"
local buildId = "v6-alpha-delta-20261125.14h.9-sandworm-v38-totem-return-v2"
local shared = type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv() or _G
-- Some executors preserve getgenv across Roblox PlaceId transitions. A
-- genuinely completed standalone return must NOT reopen the stale main-place
-- scheduler. Verify the token in the same file before allowing a fresh boot.
local function matchingReturnToken()
    local token=shared.PlaneRNGV6StandaloneResumeToken
    if type(readfile)~="function" then return nil end
    local player=game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    if not player or game.PlaceId~=133112767606395 then return nil end
    if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight")==true or player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout")==true
        or player:GetAttribute("BossResultsOpen")==true then return nil end
    local http=game:GetService("HttpService")
    local path="PlaneRNG_V6_Alpha_RaidHandoff_"..player.UserId..".json"
    local ok,record=pcall(function()return http:JSONDecode(readfile(path))end)
    if not ok or type(record)~="table" or record.userId~=player.UserId
        or type(record.token)~="string" or #record.token<8 or record.sourcePlaceId~=game.PlaceId then return nil end
    if record.raidId=="SANDWORM" then
        local previous=shared.PlaneRNGV6Alpha
        if type(previous)=="table" and previous.resumeToken==record.token and previous.bootJobId==game.JobId then return nil end
        local home=shared.SandwormHomeV2
        if type(home)=="table" and home.managedToken==record.token and home.jobId==game.JobId and home.active==true then return nil end
        local entered=type(record.createdAt)=="number" and type(record.sandwormEnteredAt)=="number" and record.sandwormEnteredAt>=record.createdAt
        local moved=type(record.sourceJobId)=="string" and #record.sourceJobId>0
            and type(game.JobId)=="string" and #game.JobId>0 and game.JobId~=record.sourceJobId
        -- A different source server permits a FRESH VM to inspect recovery;
        -- the journal still waits for its own 90s proof window if not entered.
        if entered or moved then return record.token end
    end
    if type(token)~="string" or #token<8 or record.token~=token or record.status~="RETURN_VERIFIED"
        or record.originalWorld~=tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")) then return nil end
    return token
end
local resuming=matchingReturnToken()
local previous = shared.PlaneRNGV6Alpha
if previous and resuming then
    print(prefix,"Verified standalone return; retiring old runtime",resuming)
    if type(previous.stop)=="function" then
        local ok,stopped=pcall(previous.stop,previous)
        if not ok or stopped~=true then
            warn(prefix,"Previous runtime could not stop; refusing duplicate Scheduler")
            return previous
        end
    elseif type(previous.open)=="function" then
        warn(prefix,"Old runtime cannot be stopped; refusing duplicate Scheduler")
        return previous
    end
    shared.PlaneRNGV6Alpha={}
elseif previous then
    if type(previous.open) ~= "function" then
        warn(prefix, "Initialization is already in progress")
        return previous
    end
    if previous.buildId == buildId then
        print(prefix, "Runtime build", buildId, "already loaded")
        previous:open()
        return previous
    end
    local ok, status = pcall(function() return previous.app:configuration() end)
    local point = ok and status and status.checkpoint
    local handoff = ok and status and status.handoff
    local bossReturned = point and point.phase == "COMPLETED"
        and (point.code == "BOSS_WIN_VERIFIED" or point.code == "BOSS_LOSS_VERIFIED")
    if not point or status.chain or (handoff and handoff.record and handoff.phase ~= "RETURN_VERIFIED")
        or (handoff and handoff.phase == "RECOVERY_REQUIRED")
        or (point.phase ~= "IDLE" and not bossReturned and point.code ~= "CHAIN_RETURN_VERIFIED")
        or point.ownership ~= "RELEASED"
        or type(previous.stop) ~= "function" then
        warn(prefix, "Reload requires the existing Alpha runtime to be idle.")
        return previous
    end
    shared.PlaneRNGV6Alpha = {}
    local stopped, flushed, code = pcall(previous.stop, previous)
    if not stopped or not flushed then
        shared.PlaneRNGV6Alpha = previous
        warn(prefix, "Reload could not stop and save the previous runtime", code or flushed)
        return previous
    end
    local viewOk, view = pcall(previous.open, previous)
    if viewOk and type(view) == "table" and type(view.close) == "function" then pcall(view.close, view) end
end

local function boot()
    local options = shared.PlaneRNGV6AlphaHost or {}
    if options.mobile == nil then options.mobile = true end
    if options.antiAfkEnabled == nil then options.antiAfkEnabled = false end
    -- .13f preview: standalone delegation is enabled, but the saved Auto Raid
    -- toggle remains OFF unless the user explicitly enables it in the GUI.
    if options.standaloneRaidEnabled == nil then options.standaloneRaidEnabled = true end
    local backend = options.host or {}
    local players = game:GetService("Players")
    local player = assert(players.LocalPlayer, "LOCAL_PLAYER_UNAVAILABLE")
    local parent = assert(player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 10), "PLAYER_GUI_UNAVAILABLE")
    assert(type(task.delay) == "function" and type(task.cancel) == "function", "TASK_TIMER_UNAVAILABLE")
    local clock = {now = os.clock, epoch = os.time}
    local timer = {}
    function timer:scheduleAt(deadline, callback)
        local thread = task.delay(math.max(0, deadline - clock.now()), callback)
        return function() pcall(task.cancel, thread) end
    end

    local function fileStorage(path)
        if type(isfile) ~= "function" or type(readfile) ~= "function" or type(writefile) ~= "function" then return nil end
        local http = game:GetService("HttpService")
        local function raw() if isfile(path) then return readfile(path) end end
        local storage = {}
        function storage:read()
            local value = raw()
            if not value then return nil, nil end
            local ok, decoded = pcall(http.JSONDecode, http, value)
            if not ok then return nil, value, "CORRUPT_STORAGE" end
            return decoded, value
        end
        function storage:compareAndSwap(_, expected, document)
            if raw() ~= expected then return false, "WRITE_CONFLICT" end
            local value = http:JSONEncode(document)
            writefile(path, value)
            if raw() ~= value then return false, "WRITE_UNVERIFIED" end
            return true, value
        end
        return storage
    end
    local storage = options.storage or fileStorage("PlaneRNG_V6_Alpha_Settings.json")
    local travelRetryStorage = options.travelRetryStorage
    if travelRetryStorage == nil then
        travelRetryStorage = fileStorage("PlaneRNG_V6_Alpha_WorldTravelRetry_" .. player.UserId .. ".json")
    end
    local chainStorage = options.chainStorage
    if chainStorage == nil then chainStorage = fileStorage("PlaneRNG_V6_Alpha_DeferredHome_" .. player.UserId .. ".json") end
    -- Local one-client journal for the standalone's native-result witness.
    -- NOT atomic cross-client CAS; never claim authoritative raid identity.
    if options.standaloneRaidEnabled == true and options.raidStorage == nil then
        options.raidStorage = fileStorage("PlaneRNG_V6_Alpha_RaidHandoff_" .. player.UserId .. ".json")
        if options.raidStorage then
            warn(prefix, "Standalone raid uses a local one-client journal; shared storage between places must be verified live")
        end
    end
    local raidArchiveStorage = options.raidArchiveStorage
    if options.standaloneRaidEnabled == true and raidArchiveStorage == nil then
        raidArchiveStorage = fileStorage("PlaneRNG_V6_Alpha_AbandonedRaid_" .. player.UserId .. ".json")
    end
    if not storage then
        warn(prefix, "Settings persistence unavailable. Requires isfile, readfile, and writefile, or injected storage.")
    end
    local scope = type(getfenv) == "function" and getfenv(0) or shared
    local function lookup(name)
        return scope[name] or shared[name]
    end
    local capabilities, hostName = ProjectHostServices.potassiumCapabilities(options.capabilities, lookup)
    print(prefix, "Executor", tostring(hostName), "mobile GUI", options.mobile == true,
        "F15 Anti-AFK", options.antiAfkEnabled == true and "OPT_IN_UNVERIFIED" or "DISABLED")
    for _, key in ipairs({"fireSignal", "getConnections", "replicateSignal", "firePrompt", "b52BraceKey", "b52BraceTap"}) do
        print(prefix, "Capability", key, type(capabilities[key]) == "function" and "PRESENT_UNVERIFIED" or "UNAVAILABLE")
    end
    print(prefix, "Workspace APIs", type(isfile)=="function" and type(readfile)=="function" and type(writefile)=="function",
        "Teleport queue", type(lookup("queue_on_teleport"))=="function" or type(lookup("queueonteleport"))=="function")
    print(prefix, "GUI activation capability:", type(capabilities.fireSignal) == "function" and "AVAILABLE" or "UNAVAILABLE")
    local bundledBind, bundledHost = ProjectHostServices.new(player, capabilities, hostName)
    local bindServices = options.bindServices
    if type(bindServices) ~= "function" then
        bindServices = bundledBind
        print(prefix, "Using the bundled project service binder.")
        if type(capabilities.replicateSignal) ~= "function" then
            warn(prefix, "Air Raid direct prompt unavailable. Supply authorized capabilities.replicateSignal.")
        end
    end
    -- The bundled provider queries authoritative PillarSacrifice State without
    -- relying on an inferred cooldown or a visible on-screen Totem GUI.
    local bundledTotemEvidence
    local suppliedTotemEvidence = options.totemEvidence
    if not suppliedTotemEvidence then
        bundledTotemEvidence = ProjectTotemEvidence.new(player, {clock = clock.now})
        suppliedTotemEvidence = bundledTotemEvidence
        print(prefix, "Totem readiness provider: native PillarSacrifice Query")
    end

    local lastEvidence = {}
    local function diagnostics(source)
        if type(source) ~= "table" or type(source.observe) ~= "function" then return nil end
        local provider = {}
        local function inspect(method, query)
            local value = source[method](source, query)
            local label = query.bossId or query.kind
            local state = type(value) == "table" and value.state or "UNKNOWN"
            local verified = type(value) == "table" and value.verified == true
            local reason = type(value) == "table" and value.reason or ""
            local evidenceSource = type(value) == "table" and value.source or ""
            local signature = table.concat({tostring(state), tostring(verified), tostring(reason), tostring(evidenceSource)}, "/")
            if lastEvidence[label] ~= signature then
                lastEvidence[label] = signature
                print(prefix, "Host evidence", label, state, "verified", verified, reason, evidenceSource)
            end
            return value
        end
        function provider:observe(query) return inspect("observe", query) end
        if type(source.peek) == "function" then function provider:peek(query) return inspect("peek", query) end end
        if type(source.observeHideout) == "function" then
            function provider:observeHideout(...) return source:observeHideout(...) end
        end
        if type(source.subscribe) == "function" then
            function provider:subscribe(callback) return source:subscribe(callback) end
        end
        -- Keep the native, query-only P1 refresh capability available to
        -- the managed Dungeon adapter (diagnostics would otherwise hide it).
        if type(source.refreshAfterDungeon) == "function" then
            function provider:refreshAfterDungeon() return source:refreshAfterDungeon() end
        end
        return provider
    end
    local bossEvidence = diagnostics(options.bossEvidence)
    local totemEvidence = suppliedTotemEvidence == options.bossEvidence and bossEvidence or diagnostics(suppliedTotemEvidence)
    local inspector = type(backend.inspect) == "function" and backend or bundledHost
    local nativeInspector = inspector == bundledHost
    local function verifiedOrigin(world)
        local evidence = bundledHost:inspect()
        return evidence.schedulerSafe and evidence.world == world
    end
    local host = {}
    function host:inspect()
        if not inspector then
            return {placeId = game.PlaceId, world = player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"), schedulerSafe = false}
        end
        return inspector:inspect()
    end
    for _, method in ipairs({"resourceOwners", "subscribeResources"}) do
        local callback = backend[method]
        if type(callback) == "function" then
            host[method] = function(_, ...) return callback(backend, ...) end
        end
    end
    options.standaloneBuildId = buildId
    local raidAdapter, raidStorage, mintToken = PotassiumRaidHost.bind(host, options, inspector, lookup)
    -- Preflight never launches a raid or changes saved handoff state. It
    -- checks local entry prerequisites, NOT native raid server eligibility.
    for _, raidId in ipairs(RaidCatalog.ids) do
        local reason = host:raidUnavailableReason(raidId)
        local verifier = options.standaloneRaidEnabled and "CLIENT_NATIVE_OUTCOME_WITNESS"
            or type(host.verifyRaidEvent) == "function" and "AVAILABLE" or "UNAVAILABLE"
        print(prefix, "Raid preflight", raidId, reason or "PREREQUISITES_PRESENT", "verifier", verifier)
    end
    if nativeInspector then
        local externalOwners = host.resourceOwners
        function host:resourceOwners()
            if bundledHost:transitionPending() then return {WORLD_TRANSITION = "ROBLOX_TRANSITION"} end
            if externalOwners then return externalOwners(self) end
            return {}
        end
    end
    if nativeInspector and type(bundledHost.subscribeEncounterChanges) == "function" then
        function host:subscribeEncounterChanges(callback) return bundledHost:subscribeEncounterChanges(callback) end
    elseif type(backend.subscribeEncounterChanges) == "function" then
        function host:subscribeEncounterChanges(callback) return backend:subscribeEncounterChanges(callback) end
    end
    local riftBridge = RiftSchedulerBridge.new()
    local dungeonEvidence = DungeonReadiness.new(player, clock.now)
    local app = LiveHost.new({
        host = host, clock = clock, timer = timer, sleep = task.wait,
        -- Reduce the idle fallback from 5s to 1s. Job-completion and native
        -- readiness notifications remain event-driven; no active job is preempted.
        -- User-provided options.pollInterval can override this default.
        pollInterval = options.pollInterval or 1,
        autoInspect = type(inspector) == "table",
        storage = storage, chainStorage = chainStorage, raidStorage = raidStorage,
        raidArchiveStorage = raidArchiveStorage,
        travelRetryStorage = travelRetryStorage, mintToken = mintToken,
        raidAdapter=raidAdapter,standaloneRaidEnabled=options.standaloneRaidEnabled==true,
        riftBridge=riftBridge,
        userId=player.UserId,
        settings = options.settings,
        features = ProjectFeatureAdapters.new({
            bindServices = bindServices, bossIds = options.bossIds,
            bossEvidence = bossEvidence, totemEvidence = totemEvidence,
            hideoutObservation = true,
            createBossEvidence = function(services, profile, env)
                return diagnostics(ProjectBossEvidence.new(services, profile, env, nativeInspector and verifiedOrigin))
            end,
            dungeonObserver = options.dungeonObserver, riftObserver = options.riftObserver,
            dungeonEvidence = dungeonEvidence,
            riftFeature = riftBridge.feature,
        }),
    })
    if nativeInspector then bundledHost:watchTransitions() end
    local ok, driver, detail = app:initialize()
    if not ok then
        if nativeInspector then bundledHost:stopWatchingTransitions() end
        error(tostring(driver) .. " " .. tostring(detail or ""), 0)
    end
    -- Background-only F15 heartbeat. No scheduler ownership, gameplay remote, or UI input.
    local antiAfk = AntiAFKF15.new({
        player = player, now = clock.now,
        interval = options.antiAfkInterval or 75,
        enabled = options.antiAfkEnabled ~= false,
        isAutomationEnabled = function()
            local settings = driver:settingsSnapshot()
            if not settings or driver:status().running ~= true then return false end
            return settings.totemEnabled == true or settings.bossEnabled == true
                or settings.raidEnabled == true or settings.dungeonEnabled == true
                or settings.riftEnabled == true
        end,
        isCriticalJob = function()
            local point = driver:checkpoint()
            -- Do not send synthetic input during Totem confirmations or a Raid handoff.
            return point and point.ownership == "OWNED"
                and (point.kind == "TOTEM" or point.kind == "RAID")
        end,
    })
    local alpha = {app = app, buildId = buildId, rift = riftBridge, bootJobId=game.JobId, resumeToken=resuming}
    function alpha:antiAfkStatus() return antiAfk:status() end
    function alpha:antiAfkTestPulse() return antiAfk:testPulse() end
    local function dump()
        local status = app:configuration()
        for _, kind in ipairs({"BOSS", "RAID", "DUNGEON", "TOTEM", "RIFT"}) do
            local feature = status.features[kind]
            print(prefix, kind, feature.availability, feature.availabilityReason or feature.reason, feature.state)
        end
        print(prefix, "Raid", status.handoff.phase, status.handoff.observerCode or status.handoff.code or "")
        for _,kind in ipairs({"TOTEM","BOSS","RAID"}) do
            local decision=status.universalRecovery and status.universalRecovery[kind]
            if decision and decision.action~="IDLE" then
                print("[V6 UNIVERSAL RECOVERY]",kind,decision.action,decision.reason)
            end
        end
        print(prefix, "Settings", status.persistence.saveCode or status.persistence.loadCode)
        return status
    end
    function alpha:open()
        local mount = options.mobile and app.mountMobileGui or app.mountPCGui
        local view, code = mount(app, parent)
        if not view then warn(prefix, "GUI mount failed:", code) end
        return view, code
    end
    function alpha:status() return dump() end
    -- Read-only summary of all three recovery owners; does not clear state.
    function alpha:recoveryStatus()
        local snapshot=app:configuration()
        return snapshot and snapshot.universalRecovery
    end
    function alpha:abandonInterruptedRaid(confirmation)
        local ok, code = app:abandonInterruptedRaid(confirmation)
        print(prefix, "RAID_ABANDON_REQUEST", tostring(ok), tostring(code or ""))
        return ok, code
    end
    function alpha:resetScheduler()
        local ok, code = app:resetScheduler()
        print(prefix, "SCHEDULER_FORCE_RESET_REQUEST", tostring(ok), tostring(code or ""))
        return ok, code
    end
    function alpha:recoverTotem()
        local ok, code = app:recoverTotem()
        print(prefix, "TOTEM_RECOVERY_REQUEST", tostring(ok), tostring(code or ""))
        return ok, code
    end
    function alpha:stop()
        local stopped, code = app:stop()
        if stopped then antiAfk:stop() end
        if nativeInspector then bundledHost:stopWatchingTransitions() end
        if bundledTotemEvidence then bundledTotemEvidence:destroy() end
        if not stopped then warn(prefix, "Stopped; settings flush:", code)
        else print(prefix, "Stopped") end
        return stopped, code
    end
    local lastSafe
    local function logHostStatus()
        local status = app:status()
        if lastSafe == status.schedulerSafe then return end
        lastSafe = status.schedulerSafe
        if lastSafe then print(prefix, "Automatic scheduling ready.")
        elseif inspector then print(prefix, "Waiting for verified host state.", status.inspectCode)
        else warn(prefix, "Authorized host inspection unavailable.") end
    end
    -- Diagnostic only: measure real idle handoff latency. This cannot be
    -- mistaken for a new readiness promise or a completed native action.
    local lastJobFinishedAt, lastJobFinishedKind, lastJobFinishedCode
    app:onStatusChanged(function(event)
        if event.kind == "HOST" then logHostStatus() end
        if event.kind == "JOB_STARTED" and lastJobFinishedAt then
            local gap = clock.now() - lastJobFinishedAt
            if gap >= 2 then
                print(prefix, "SCHEDULER_GAP", string.format("%.2fs", gap),
                    "previous", lastJobFinishedKind or "UNKNOWN", lastJobFinishedCode or "UNKNOWN")
            end
            lastJobFinishedAt, lastJobFinishedKind, lastJobFinishedCode = nil, nil, nil
        end
        local point = event.checkpoint
        if point and event.kind ~= "JOB_COMPLETED" then
            print(prefix, event.kind, point.jobId, point.bossId or point.kind, point.phase, point.stage)
        end
    end)
    driver:onJobCompleted(function(event)
        local result, point = event.result, event.checkpoint
        lastJobFinishedAt, lastJobFinishedKind, lastJobFinishedCode = clock.now(),
            point.bossId or point.kind, result.code
        local emit = (result.status == "FAILED" or result.status == "HELD") and warn or print
        emit(prefix, "JOB_COMPLETED", point.jobId, point.bossId or point.kind, result.status, result.code)
        if result.status == "COMPLETED" and result.stage == "RECOVERY_VERIFIED" then
            print(prefix, "CHECKPOINT_RELEASED", point.jobId, point.bossId, result.evidence.encounterId)
            if driver:settingsSnapshot().bossEnabled then
                print(prefix, "READINESS_RECHECK_SCHEDULED", point.bossId, result.evidence.encounterId)
            end
        end
    end)
    print(prefix, "Runtime build", buildId)
    if bindServices == bundledBind then
        local boss = app:configuration().features.BOSS
        if boss.availabilityReason == "HOST_GUI_ACTIVATION_UNAVAILABLE" then
            warn(prefix, "Boss activation needs BossResultsController.IsOpen and .Dismiss or an authorized capabilities.fireSignal callback.")
        elseif boss.registered and (not options.capabilities or type(options.capabilities.fireSignal) ~= "function") then
            print(prefix, "Boss activation uses native BossResultsController.")
        end
    end
    logHostStatus()
    alpha:open()
    antiAfk:start()
    dump()
    return alpha
end

shared.PlaneRNGV6Alpha = {}
local success, result = pcall(boot)
if not success then
    shared.PlaneRNGV6Alpha = nil
    warn(prefix, "Initialization failed:", result)
    error(result, 0)
end
shared.PlaneRNGV6Alpha = result
return result
end
-- END MODULE pc.V6AlphaEntry

-- Candidate dispatch, no gameplay side effects.

Registry.specs[#Registry.specs+1]={id="FLEET",module="rift.combat.FLEET",prefix="Fleet",participant="FleetParticipant",aliases={"THE FLEET","FLEET"},events={"FleetEvent"},nativeId=nil,specialEnd=false}
Registry.specs[#Registry.specs+1]={id="RED_BARON",module="rift.combat.RED_BARON",prefix="RedBaron",participant="RedBaronParticipant",aliases={"RED BARON","RED BARON"},events={"RedBaronEvent"},nativeId=nil,specialEnd=false}

Registry.specs[#Registry.specs+1]={id="TU95",module="rift.combat.TU95",prefix="Tu95",participant="Tu95Participant",aliases={"TU-95 BEAR","TU-95"},events={"Tu95Event"},nativeId=nil,specialEnd=false}
Registry.specs[#Registry.specs+1]={id="U2",module="rift.combat.U2",prefix="U2",participant="U2Participant",aliases={"U-2 DRAGON LADY","U-2"},events={"U2Event"},nativeId=nil,specialEnd=false}
Registry.specs[#Registry.specs+1]={id="VULCAN",module="rift.combat.VULCAN",prefix="Vulcan",participant="VulcanParticipant",aliases={"AVRO VULCAN","VULCAN"},events={"VulcanEvent"},nativeId=nil,specialEnd=false}
Registry.specs[#Registry.specs+1]={id="ZEPPELIN",module="rift.combat.ZEPPELIN",prefix="Zeppelin",participant="ZeppelinParticipant",aliases={"ZEPPELIN","ZEPPELIN"},events={"BossFightStart","BossFightEnd"},nativeId="World2Zeppelin",specialEnd=true}
function Registry.select(attrs)
    local candidate,count=nil,0
    for _,spec in ipairs(Registry.specs) do
        if attrs[spec.participant]==true then candidate=spec;count=count+1 end
    end
    local total=0
    for name,v in pairs(attrs) do if name:match("Participant$") and v~=false and v~="" then total=total+1 end end
    if count==1 and total==1 then return candidate,"UNIQUE_PARTICIPANT" end
    return nil,total>1 and "AMBIGUOUS_PARTICIPANTS" or "UNKNOWN_PARTICIPANT"
end
function Registry.matchesTitle(spec,title)
    local normal=title:upper():gsub("[^%w]","")
    for _,alias in ipairs(spec.aliases) do if normal:find(alias:gsub("[^%w]",""),1,true) then return true end end
    return false
end
return Registry
end

-- BEGIN MODULE rift.HazardController
__factories["rift.HazardController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- PlaneRNG Rift Hazard V2: client-consumer backed geometry and time.
-- Strikes: server provided Strikes[i].Position, packet.At, packet.Radius.
-- Sky: native RiftSkyFx telegraph anchors (not guessed from Seed or HRP).
-- Only native Commander/flight owners issue movement; no remote calls.
local HazardController={}
local KNOWN={TierStrike=true,Shockwave=true,Glitch=true,VoidWarp=true,Sky=true}
local POSITION_FIELDS={"Position","Center","TargetPosition","ImpactPosition","StrikePosition","Point","Location","Pos"}
local TWO_PI=math.pi*2
local function finite(n)
    return type(n)=="number" and n==n and n>-1e8 and n<1e8
end
local function vector(v)
    if typeof(v)=="Vector3" then
        if finite(v.X) and finite(v.Y) and finite(v.Z) then return v end
    elseif typeof(v)=="CFrame" then
        return vector(v.Position)
    elseif type(v)=="table" then
        local x,y,z=tonumber(v.X or v.x or v[1]),tonumber(v.Y or v.y or v[2]),tonumber(v.Z or v.z or v[3])
        if finite(x) and finite(y) and finite(z) then return Vector3.new(x,y,z) end
    end
    return nil
end
local function positionOf(value)
    local direct=vector(value)
    if direct then return direct end
    if type(value)~="table" then return nil end
    for _,field in ipairs(POSITION_FIELDS) do
        local p=vector(value[field])
        if p then return p end
    end
    return nil
end
local function number(value,fallback)
    local n=tonumber(value)
    return finite(n) and n or fallback
end
local function radiusOf(value,default)
    local n=number(value,nil)
    return n and n>=1 and n<=120 and n or default
end
local function flat(a,b)
    local x,z=a.X-b.X,a.Z-b.Z
    return math.sqrt(x*x+z*z)
end
local function dataKeys(tableValue)
    local keys={}
    if type(tableValue)=="table" then
        for key in pairs(tableValue) do
            if type(key)=="string" then keys[#keys+1]=key end
        end
        table.sort(keys)
    end
    return keys
end
-- Unix-epoch server timestamps (~1.8 billion) must not go through the
-- spatial finite() guard (which rejects values >= 1e8).
local function validServerTime(n)
    return type(n)=="number" and n==n and n>0 and n<1e12
end
local function serverNow()
    local ok,value=pcall(function() return workspace:GetServerTimeNow() end)
    return ok and validServerTime(value) and value or os.clock()
end
local function visualAnchor(part)
    if not part:IsA("BasePart") or not part.Anchored or part.Size.Magnitude>2.0 then return nil end
    -- Native Sky's warning circle has three CylinderHandleAdornments on a tiny Part.
    local rings,largest=0,0
    for _,child in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("CylinderHandleAdornment") then
            rings=rings+1
            local r=number(child.Radius,nil)
            if r and r>largest and r<=121 then largest=r end
        end
    end
    if rings<2 or largest<1 then return nil end
    return {at=part.Position,radius=math.clamp(largest-0.7,1,120),source="NATIVE_SKY_FX"}
end
local function length3(a,b) return (a-b).Magnitude end

function HazardController.new(options)
    assert(type(options)=="table" and type(options.log)=="function")
    local H={pending={},seen={},enabled=true,packets=0,dodges=0,skipped=0,
        visualCount=0,flightEvades=0,lastDodgeAt=0,lastLog={},
        knownFx=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"}),flightLast=nil,scanAt=0}
    local function emit(kind,data,interval)
        local now=os.clock()
        if interval and H.lastLog[kind] and now-H.lastLog[kind]<interval then return end
        H.lastLog[kind]=now
        options.log(kind,data)
    end
    local function prune()
        local now=serverNow()
        for i=#H.pending,1,-1 do
            if H.pending[i].expires<now then table.remove(H.pending,i) end
        end
        return now
    end
    local function activeSkyEntries()
        local waves={}
        for _,entry in ipairs(H.pending) do
