            if entry.kind=="Sky" and #entry.locations<entry.count then
                waves[#waves+1]=entry
            end
        end
        return waves
    end
    function H:scanSky()
        local now=prune()
        if now-self.scanAt<0.085 then return end
        self.scanAt=now
        local waves=activeSkyEntries()
        if #waves==0 then return end
        local folder=workspace:FindFirstChild("RiftSkyFx")
        if not folder then return end
        -- The same folder can contain ground strike effects. New native warning anchors
        -- are consumed only while a Sky packet is awaiting its Count anchors.
        local children=folder:GetChildren()
        if #children>600 then emit("RIFT_HAZARD_FX_SATURATED",{children=#children},8) end
        for i=1,math.min(#children,600) do
            local part=children[i]
            if not self.knownFx[part] then
                local record=visualAnchor(part)
                if record then
                    self.knownFx[part]=true
                    local wave=waves[1]
                    if not wave then break end
                    record.hitAt=math.max(wave.at,now)+#wave.locations*0.14
                    record.instance=part
                    wave.locations[#wave.locations+1]=record
                    self.visualCount=self.visualCount+1
                    emit("RIFT_HAZARD_SKY_FX_ANCHOR",{tier=wave.tier,point=#wave.locations,
                        expected=wave.count,radius=record.radius},1)
                    if #wave.locations>=wave.count then table.remove(waves,1) end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    function H:observe(packet)
        if not self.enabled or type(packet)~="table" then return end
        local kind=tostring(packet.Kind or "UNKNOWN")
        if not KNOWN[kind] and (kind=="Enrage" or type(packet.Strikes)~="table") then
            emit("RIFT_HAZARD_UNKNOWN_KIND",{kind=kind},12)
            return
        end
        local now=prune()
        self.packets=self.packets+1
        if not self.seen[kind] then
            self.seen[kind]=true
            local first=type(packet.Strikes)=="table" and packet.Strikes[1] or nil
            emit("RIFT_HAZARD_V2_SCHEMA",{kind=kind,tier=packet.Tier,keys=dataKeys(packet),
                strikeFields=dataKeys(first),count=packet.Count,style=packet.Style,
                radius=packet.Radius,at=packet.At})
        end
        local rawAt=tonumber(packet.At)
        local packetAt=validServerTime(rawAt) and rawAt or now+0.6
        if packetAt<now-1.5 or packetAt>now+25 then
            emit("RIFT_HAZARD_TIME_OUT_OF_RANGE",{kind=kind,offset=packetAt-now},6)
            packetAt=now+0.6
        end
        local r=radiusOf(packet.Radius,nil)
        local entry={kind=kind,tier=packet.Tier,style=packet.Style,locations={},
            at=packetAt,expires=math.max(now+0.6,packetAt+0.85),
            count=0,received=now,tries=0,serial=self.packets}
        if kind=="Sky" then
            entry.count=math.clamp(math.floor(number(packet.Count,1)),1,64)
            entry.expires=math.max(now+1.25,packetAt+0.14*(entry.count-1)+0.65)
            -- Baseline native FX already present at packet reception must not be
            -- attributed to the new wave, especially on overlapping high mutations.
            local folder=workspace:FindFirstChild("RiftSkyFx")
            if folder then
                for _,p in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
                    if visualAnchor(p) then self.knownFx[p]=true end
                end
            end
        else
            local strikes=packet.Strikes
            if type(strikes)=="table" then
                for _,s in ipairs(strikes) do
                    if #entry.locations>=64 then break end
                    if typeof(s)=="Vector3" or type(s)=="table" then
                        local fake=type(s)=="table" and (s.Fake==true)
                        local center=positionOf(s)
                        local sr=type(s)=="table" and radiusOf(s.Radius,r) or r
                        if center and sr and not fake then
                            entry.locations[#entry.locations+1]={at=center,radius=sr,hitAt=packetAt,
                                activeUntil=packetAt+0.55,source="STRIKES_POSITION"}
                            if type(s)=="table" and type(s.Burn)=="table" then
                                local extra=radiusOf(s.Burn.Radius,nil)
                                local duration=number(s.Burn.Seconds,0)
                                if extra and duration>0 then
                                    local untilTime=packetAt+math.min(duration,15)
                                    entry.expires=math.max(entry.expires,untilTime)
                                    entry.locations[#entry.locations+1]={at=center,radius=extra,hitAt=packetAt,
                                        activeUntil=untilTime,source="STRIKES_BURN"}
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if #entry.locations==0 and type(strikes)~="table" and r then
                local center=positionOf(packet)
                if center then entry.locations[1]={at=center,radius=r,hitAt=packetAt,activeUntil=packetAt+0.55,source="PACKET_POSITION"} end
            end
            if #entry.locations==0 then
                self.skipped=self.skipped+1
                emit("RIFT_HAZARD_NO_VERIFIED_POSITION",{kind=kind,tier=packet.Tier,
                    strikesType=typeof(strikes)},8)
                return
            end
            entry.count=#entry.locations
        end
        if #self.pending>=36 then
            -- Never silently consider an overwritten wave safe.
            emit("RIFT_HAZARD_CAPACITY_LIMIT",{pending=#self.pending,kind=kind},3)
            table.remove(self.pending,1)
        end
        self.pending[#self.pending+1]=entry
        emit("RIFT_HAZARD_V2_WAVE",{kind=kind,tier=packet.Tier,count=entry.count,
            points=#entry.locations,at=entry.at,source=kind=="Sky" and "WAIT_NATIVE_FX" or "SERVER_STRIKES"},0.7)
    end
    -- Share only observed, time-bounded server Strikes with the existing on-foot
    -- combat owner. B-2 can fuse them with native bomb/zone risk using ONE lease.
    -- There is no separate movement request from this method.
    function H:groundFootprints(lookahead)
        if not self.enabled then return {} end
        local now=prune()
        lookahead=tonumber(lookahead) or 1.6
        lookahead=math.clamp(lookahead,0.2,3)
        local footprints={}
        for _,entry in ipairs(self.pending) do
            if entry.kind~="Sky" and now<=entry.expires then
                for index,spot in ipairs(entry.locations) do
                    local hit=spot.hitAt or entry.at
                    local endAt=spot.activeUntil or math.min(entry.expires,hit+0.55)
                    if hit-now<=lookahead and now<=endAt then
                        footprints[#footprints+1]={
                            p=spot.at,r=spot.radius,impact=hit,
                            name="RIFT_"..entry.kind,
                            id="RIFT:"..tostring(entry.serial)..":"..tostring(index),
                            key="RIFT:"..tostring(entry.serial)..":"..tostring(index),
                            untilTime=endAt,
                            source=spot.source
                        }
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return footprints
    end
    local function groundSpots(H,position,now)
        local spots={}
        for _,entry in ipairs(H.pending) do
            if entry.kind~="Sky" and entry.expires>=now then
                for _,spot in ipairs(entry.locations) do
                    if math.abs(position.Y-spot.at.Y)<=32 then spots[#spots+1]=spot end
                end
            end
        end
        return spots
    end
    -- Called only by the CombatController, with its own lease when B-21 owns combat.
    function H:step(nativeContext,nativeLease)
        if not self.enabled then return end
        self:scanSky()
        if not options.inCombat() or not options.scoped() then return end
        local adapter=options.adapter()
        if not adapter then return end
        if adapter.boss.flight or adapter.boss.pilot or adapter.boss.autoPilot then return end
        -- A native movement owner must never compete with the Rift monitor.
        -- B-2/B-21 already use their cooperative path. Six additional owners
        -- consume groundFootprints in their own native logic. Passive observers
        -- (B17, RedBaron, Tu95) retain independent Rift movement.
        local ownerMethods={B2SPIRIT="mechanics",AC130="dodge",VULCAN="dodge",
            EKRANOPLAN="dodge",B29="atomicCover",CARRIER="mechanics",B52="repair"}
        local id=adapter.spec.id
        if id=="B21_RAIDER" and not nativeLease then return end
        local owner=ownerMethods[id]
        -- B-52 explicitly calls its Rift branch from the idle repair tick.
        -- The monitor is not allowed to issue moves concurrently with repair.
        local idleRepair=id=="B52" and nativeLease=="B52_IDLE" and nativeContext~=nil
        if owner and adapter.boss[owner] and not idleRepair then return end
        if idleRepair then nativeLease=nil end
        local ctx=nativeContext or options.context()
        if not ctx or ctx:isCancelled() or ctx:isClosing() then return end
        if nativeContext and nativeLease and type(nativeLease)~="table" then return end
        local root,hum=options.character()
        if not root or not hum or hum.Health<=0 or hum.Sit then return end
        local movement=adapter.movement
        if not movement then return end
        local now=serverNow()
        if now-self.lastDodgeAt<0.35 then return end
        local pos=root.Position
        local spots=groundSpots(self,pos,now)
        if #spots==0 then return end
        local threats,closest={},nil
        for _,spot in ipairs(spots) do
            local d=flat(pos,spot.at)
            if d<=spot.radius+5 then
                threats[#threats+1]=spot
                if not closest or d<closest.dist then closest={spot=spot,dist=d} end
            end
        end
        if #threats==0 then return end
        local function safe(goal)
            for _,s in ipairs(spots) do
                if flat(goal,s.at)<=s.radius+6 then return false end
            end
            return true
        end
        -- Evaluate 16 orientations at increasing radii; never stop at the first
        -- destination that clears only one of many simultaneous waves.
        local best,bestScore=nil,-math.huge
        local vx,vz=pos.X-closest.spot.at.X,pos.Z-closest.spot.at.Z
        local startAngle=math.atan2(vz,vx)
        for _,distance in ipairs({14,24,36,50,68}) do
            for j=0,15 do
                local angle=startAngle+(j-8)*TWO_PI/16
                local raw=pos+Vector3.new(math.cos(angle)*distance,0,math.sin(angle)*distance)
                local ground=movement:ground(raw,{mode="radar"})
                if ground and math.abs(ground.Y-pos.Y)<=5 and safe(ground) then
                    local physical=movement:directSafe(pos,ground)
                    if physical then
                        local clearance=math.huge
                        for _,s in ipairs(spots) do
                            clearance=math.min(clearance,flat(ground,s.at)-(s.radius+6))
                        end
                        local score=math.min(clearance,22)-distance*0.11
                        if score>bestScore then best,bestScore=ground,score end
                    end
                end
            end
            if best then break end
        end
        if not best then
            emit("RIFT_HAZARD_V2_NO_SAFE_GROUND",{boss=adapter.spec.id,threats=#threats},5)
            return
        end
        local lease,why=nativeLease,nil
        if not lease then
            lease,why=movement:acquire(ctx)
            if not lease then
                emit("RIFT_HAZARD_NATIVE_MOVEMENT_PRIORITY",{boss=adapter.spec.id,reason=why},5)
                return
            end
        end
        local ok,result,code=pcall(function() return movement:relocate(ctx,lease,best,root) end)
        local released=true
        if not nativeLease then
            local releaseOK,releaseResult=pcall(function() return movement:release(lease) end)
            released=releaseOK and releaseResult==true
        end
        self.lastDodgeAt=now
        local verified=root.Parent and (root.Position-best).Magnitude<=3.5
        if ok and result and released and verified then
            self.dodges=self.dodges+1
            emit("RIFT_HAZARD_V2_DODGE_VERIFIED",{boss=adapter.spec.id,
                threats=#threats,distance=math.floor(flat(pos,best))},0.5)
        else
            emit("RIFT_HAZARD_V2_DODGE_FAILED",{boss=adapter.spec.id,
                reason=ok and tostring(code or "POSITION_UNVERIFIED") or tostring(result),released=released},3)
        end
    end
    -- The existing native flight pilot calls this in its planning callback.
    -- No second SetAim writer, no teleport, and no other flight controller is modified.
    function H:flightPlan(sim,plan,flightLimits)
        if not self.enabled or type(plan)~="table" or not sim or not options.scoped() or not options.inCombat() then return plan end
        if typeof(sim.Position)~="Vector3" or typeof(sim.Rotation)~="CFrame" then return plan end
        self:scanSky()
        local now=serverNow()
        local pos=sim.Position
        local prior=self.flightLast
        local velocity=Vector3.zero
        if prior then
            local elapsed=now-prior.at
            if elapsed>=0.03 and elapsed<=0.75 then
                velocity=(pos-prior.pos)/elapsed
                if velocity.Magnitude>600 then velocity=velocity.Unit*600 end
            else
                velocity=prior.vel or velocity
            end
        end
        self.flightLast={pos=pos,at=now,vel=velocity}
        local hazards={}
        for _,entry in ipairs(self.pending) do
            if entry.kind=="Sky" and now<=entry.expires then
                for _,spot in ipairs(entry.locations) do
                    local impact=number(spot.hitAt,entry.at)
                    local remaining=impact-now
                    if remaining>=-0.2 and remaining<=1.8 then
                        local projected=pos+velocity*math.max(remaining,0)
                        local hitRadius=spot.radius*1.15+12
                        local delta=projected-spot.at
                        if delta.Magnitude<=hitRadius+math.min(25,velocity.Magnitude*0.05) then
                            hazards[#hazards+1]={spot=spot,t=remaining,dist=delta.Magnitude,r=hitRadius}
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        if #hazards==0 then return plan end
        -- Aircraft turn rather than teleport. Score candidate headings against the
        -- entire near-term impact set, including overlapping high mutation waves.
        local forward=sim.Rotation.LookVector
        local right=sim.Rotation.RightVector
        local up=sim.Rotation.UpVector
        -- Preserve published native flight boxes; avoiding one Sky strike must
        -- never deliberately steer the plane outside its encounter arena.
        local adapter=options.adapter()
        local bossId=adapter and adapter.spec.id
        local boxes={
            U2={floor=1660,ceiling=4150,center=Vector3.new(49152,0,0),radius=5450},
            SR71={floor=5360,ceiling=7460,center=Vector3.new(40960,0,40960),radius=4850},
            RQ170={floor=2980,ceiling=3950,center=Vector3.new(-49152,0,0),radius=3200},
            F117={floor=3370,ceiling=4370,center=Vector3.new(0,0,-49152),radius=5000},
            FLEET={floor=160,ceiling=780,center=Vector3.new(-16384,0,16384),radius=2800},
        }
        local box=boxes[bossId]
        if type(flightLimits)=="table" and finite(flightLimits.floor) and finite(flightLimits.ceiling)
            and flightLimits.floor<flightLimits.ceiling then
            box={floor=flightLimits.floor,ceiling=flightLimits.ceiling,
                center=flightLimits.center,radius=flightLimits.radius}
        end
        local candidates={right,-right,up,-up,(right+up).Unit,(-right+up).Unit,
            (right-up).Unit,(-right-up).Unit,forward+right,forward-right}
        local best,bestScore=nil,-math.huge
        for _,direction in ipairs(candidates) do
            if direction.Magnitude>0.05 then
                local dir=direction.Unit
                local minClearance=math.huge
                for _,h in ipairs(hazards) do
                    local t=math.clamp(h.t,0.12,1.8)
                    -- Scoring is advisory: the flight physics can turn slower than
                    -- this estimate, so never claim a guaranteed safe trajectory.
                    local distance=math.min(300,math.max(65,velocity.Magnitude)*t*0.65)
                    local projected=pos+velocity*t*0.3+dir*distance
                    minClearance=math.min(minClearance,(projected-h.spot.at).Magnitude-h.r)
                end
                local score=minClearance+math.max(0,dir:Dot(forward))*12
                if box then
                    -- Scaled short-horizon estimate, constrained near altitude
                    -- and radial boundaries before overriding native guidance.
                    local future=pos+velocity*0.24+dir*170
                    if future.Y<box.floor+45 or future.Y>box.ceiling-45 then
                        score=score-2000
                    end
                    if box.center and box.radius then
                        local radial=Vector3.new(future.X-box.center.X,0,future.Z-box.center.Z)
                        if radial.Magnitude>box.radius-60 then score=score-2000 end
                    end
                end
                if score>bestScore then best,bestScore=dir,score end
            end
        end
        if not best or bestScore< -1000 then
            emit("RIFT_HAZARD_V2_FLIGHT_NATIVE_BOUNDARY",{boss=bossId,threats=#hazards},3)
            return plan
        end
        local amended={}
        for k,v in pairs(plan) do amended[k]=v end
        amended.Aim=(best*430+forward*85)
        amended.Throttle=1
        amended.Fire=false
        amended.Missile=false
        amended.Maneuver=true
        amended.Target="RIFT_HAZARD_EVADE"
        amended.TargetModel=nil
        self.flightEvades=self.flightEvades+1
        emit("RIFT_HAZARD_V2_FLIGHT_EVADE",{count=#hazards,clearance=math.floor(bestScore),
            boss=options.adapter() and options.adapter().spec.id},1.3)
        return amended
    end
    function H:radarPriority(phase,radarName)
        if #self.pending>0 then
            emit("RIFT_HAZARD_RADAR_PRIORITY",{phase=phase,radar=radarName,reason="NATIVE_MAINTENANCE"},7)
        end
    end
    function H:reset()
        self.pending={};self.seen={};self.lastLog={}
        self.knownFx=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
        self.scanAt=0;self.flightLast=nil;self.lastDodgeAt=0
    end
    function H:stop() self.enabled=false;self:reset() end
    function H:status()
        return {packets=self.packets,dodges=self.dodges,flightEvades=self.flightEvades,
            visualPoints=self.visualCount,unresolved=self.skipped,pending=#self.pending}
    end
    return H
end
return HazardController
end
-- END MODULE rift.HazardController

-- BEGIN MODULE rift.ManagedRunner
__factories["rift.ManagedRunner"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- V6 .14h: Rift V3.2.4 one-cycle runner. Scheduler owns all cross-feature resources.
local ManagedRunner = {}
-- Explicit lazy require map: every Rift controller is resolvable by the static bundler.
-- Requiring the selected boss happens only inside the owned Rift job.
local CombatDefinitions = {
    AC130 = function() return require("rift.combat.AC130") end,
    B17 = function() return require("rift.combat.B17") end,
    B21_RAIDER = function() return require("rift.combat.B21_RAIDER") end,
    B29 = function() return require("rift.combat.B29") end,
    B2SPIRIT = function() return require("rift.combat.B2SPIRIT") end,
    B52 = function() return require("rift.combat.B52") end,
    BLACKFORTRESS = function() return require("rift.combat.BLACKFORTRESS") end,
    CARRIER = function() return require("rift.combat.CARRIER") end,
    EKRANOPLAN = function() return require("rift.combat.EKRANOPLAN") end,
    F117 = function() return require("rift.combat.F117") end,
    FLEET = function() return require("rift.combat.FLEET") end,
    RED_BARON = function() return require("rift.combat.RED_BARON") end,
    RQ170 = function() return require("rift.combat.RQ170") end,
    SR71 = function() return require("rift.combat.SR71") end,
    TU95 = function() return require("rift.combat.TU95") end,
    U2 = function() return require("rift.combat.U2") end,
    VULCAN = function() return require("rift.combat.VULCAN") end,
    ZEPPELIN = function() return require("rift.combat.ZEPPELIN") end,
}
function ManagedRunner.execute(context, runnerOptions, onStart, onEvent)
    local schedulerManaged = true
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
    local player = Players.LocalPlayer

    local defaults = {
        autoTravel = true,
        autoApproach = true,
        autoJoin = true,
        directTP = true,               -- only to validated ground near prompt, not through visual gate
        safeReposition = true,
        maxPromptDistance = 16,        -- stricter than native 18 studs
        settleWorldSeconds = 1.3,
        promptHoldPadding = 0.20,
        promptReadyTimeout = 25,      -- Rift has an Opening phase; disabled prompt is not fatal
        promptWaitInterval = 0.25,
        promptConfirmSeconds = 3,
        manualAssist = false,         -- never occupy global scheduler waiting for manual action
        manualAssistTimeout = 85,
        maxTravelSeconds = 25,
        minTimeRemaining = 35,
        scanInterval = 2.5,
        targetTier = nil,
        targetBoss = nil,
        targetWorld = nil,
        preferHigherClass = true,
        autoRepeat = false,           -- scheduler owns repeat, this job owns one encounter
        repeatInterval = 3,         -- pause between independently verified encounters
        autoContinueReport = true,  -- one native Dismiss per verified report, never blind spam
        reportReadyHold = 4,        -- wait for report UI to finish animating
        reportContinueTimeout = 75, -- warning if game does not close report (manual action possible)
        experimentalCommanderCombat = true,
        identifyTimeout = 15,
        exitEvidenceTimeout = 25,
        encounterTimeout = 1200,
        launchTimeout = 55,
        returnHome = true,
        logLimit = 500,
    }
    local config = {}
    local userConfig = runnerOptions
    for key,value in pairs(defaults) do config[key] = value end
    if type(userConfig) == "table" then
        for key,value in pairs(userConfig) do config[key] = value end
    end

    if type(config.targetBoss)=="string" and (config.targetBoss:upper():gsub("[%s_-]", "")=="AIRRAID") then
        warn("[RIFT V3.2.4] AIRRAID_NOT_A_RIFT_ENCOUNTER; remove targetBoss filter")
        return
    end

    config.autoRepeat = false -- always release scheduler after one verified encounter
    config.manualAssist = false
    config.schedulerManaged = true
    if tonumber(runnerOptions and runnerOptions.homeWorld) then
        -- Validated V6 home world, not arbitrary temporary Rift portal world.
        config.returnHome = true
    end
    config.autoContinueReport = config.autoContinueReport ~= false
    config.repeatInterval = math.clamp(tonumber(config.repeatInterval) or 3,1,30)
    config.reportReadyHold = math.clamp(tonumber(config.reportReadyHold) or 3,2,12)
    config.reportContinueTimeout = math.clamp(tonumber(config.reportContinueTimeout) or 75,10,180)
    config.identifyTimeout=math.clamp(tonumber(config.identifyTimeout) or 15,5,60)
    config.exitEvidenceTimeout=math.clamp(tonumber(config.exitEvidenceTimeout) or 25,15,90)
    config.launchTimeout=math.clamp(tonumber(config.launchTimeout) or 55,20,120)
    config.encounterTimeout=math.clamp(tonumber(config.encounterTimeout) or 1200,60,1200)
    if not tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")) then warn("[RIFT V3.2.4] WORLD_UNVERIFIED"); return end
    for name,v in pairs(player:GetAttributes()) do
        if name:match("Participant$") and v~=false and v~="" then warn("[RIFT V3.2.4] PARTICIPANT_ACTIVE",name); return end
    end
    local startupGui=player:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
    local startupReport=startupGui and startupGui:FindFirstChild("BossResultsGui")
    if startupReport and startupReport:IsA("ScreenGui") and startupReport.Enabled then warn("[RIFT V3.2.4] REPORT_ACTIVE");return end
    if game.PlaceId~=133112767606395 then warn("[RIFT V3.2.4] MAIN_PLACE_REQUIRED"); return end
    if player:GetAttribute("InBossFight")==true or player:GetAttribute("RiftTier")~=nil or player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout")==true or player:GetAttribute("BossResultsOpen")==true then warn("[RIFT V3.2.4] IDLE_MAIN_WORLD_REQUIRED");return end
    local T = {
        originPlace=game.PlaceId,
        running = true,
        stage = "BOOT",
        records = {},
        connections = {},
        failedUntil = {},
        originWorld = tonumber(runnerOptions and runnerOptions.homeWorld) or tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")),
        currentRift = nil,
        joinedRift = nil,
        enteredRift = nil,
        sessionStarted = false,
        refused = nil,
        completed = false,
        completedCount = 0,
        attemptCount = 0,
        lastEncounter = nil,
        config = config,
    }
    -- Runtime is owned by the main V6 RIFT job. No competing global scheduler.
    if onStart then onStart(T) end
    local started = os.clock()

    local function printable(value)
        if typeof(value) == "Vector3" then
            return {x = math.floor(value.X*100)/100, y = math.floor(value.Y*100)/100, z = math.floor(value.Z*100)/100}
        end
        if type(value) == "table" then
            local copy = {}
            for k,v in pairs(value) do
                if typeof(v) == "Vector3" then
                    copy[k] = printable(v)
                elseif type(v) == "string" or type(v) == "number" or type(v) == "boolean" then
                    copy[k] = v
                elseif type(v) == "table" then
                    copy[k] = printable(v)
                else
                    copy[k] = tostring(v)
                end
            end
            return copy
        end
        return value
    end
    local function log(event, details)
        local entry = { event=event, t=math.floor((os.clock()-started)*10)/10, stage=T.stage, detail=printable(details or {}) }
        T.records[#T.records+1] = entry
        if onEvent then pcall(onEvent,entry) end
        if #T.records > (tonumber(config.logLimit) or 500) then table.remove(T.records,1) end
        local ok, encoded = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONEncode(entry) end)
        if ok then print("[RIFT V3.2.4] " .. encoded) else print("[RIFT V3.2.4]",event) end
    end
    function T:status()
        return {
            running=self.running, stage=self.stage, originWorld=self.originWorld,
            world=player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"), rift=self.currentRift,
            joinedRift=self.joinedRift, enteredRift=self.enteredRift, riftTier=player:GetAttribute("RiftTier"),
            inFight=player:GetAttribute("InBossFight"), sessionStarted=self.sessionStarted,
            supportedEncounterCount=18, autoRepeat=config.autoRepeat,
            autoContinueReport=config.autoContinueReport, completedCount=self.completedCount,
            attemptCount=self.attemptCount, lastEncounter=self.lastEncounter,
            completed=self.completed, boss=self.boss, adapterBound=self.adapter~=nil,
            outcome=self.outcome, reportSeen=self.reportSeen, reportClosed=self.reportClosed,
            reportIdentity=self.reportIdentity,reportIdentitySource=self.reportIdentitySource,
            reportContinueAttempted=self.reportContinueAttempted,
            arenaExitObserved=self.arenaExitObserved, scopedCombatObserved=self.scopedCombatObserved,
            combatRunning=self.combatRunning,adapterFailed=self.adapterFailed,
            recoveredWithoutCombatAdapter=self.recoveredWithoutCombatAdapter,
            hazard=self.hazardController and self.hazardController:status(),
        }
    end
    function T:dump(n)
        local from = math.max(1,#self.records-(tonumber(n) or 100)+1)
        for i=from,#self.records do
            local ok,s=pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONEncode(self.records[i]) end)
            print("[RIFT V3.2.4 LOG] "..(ok and s or tostring(self.records[i].event)))
        end
    end
    function T:stop()
        if not self.running and not self.combatRunning then return end
        self.running=false
        if self.hazardController then self.hazardController:stop() end
        if self.combatRuntime then self.combatRuntime:shutdown("MANUAL_STOP") end
        self.stage="STOPPED"
        for _,c in ipairs(self.connections) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
        table.clear(self.connections)
        local ch=player.Character
        local hum=ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then pcall(function() hum:MoveTo(ch:GetPivot().Position) end) end
        log("STOPPED",{note="Does not send Rift Leave; use native Leave button to leave an active party"})
    end

    function T:reset()
        self:stop()
        if self.combatRunning then return false,"COMBAT_CLEANUP_PENDING" end
        return true,"STOPPED_REEXECUTE_WHEN_IDLE"
    end

    local function getRoot()
        local ch=player.Character
        return ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"), ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    end
    local function inFight()
        return player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true or player:GetAttribute("RiftTier") ~= nil
    end
    local function aliveRift(c)
        if not c or not c.anchor or not c.anchor.Parent then return false end
        local s=tostring(c.anchor:GetAttribute("State") or "Open")
        return s ~= "Collapsing" and s ~= "Sealed" and s ~= "Closed" and s ~= "Expired"
    end
    local function listRifts()
        local folder=workspace:FindFirstChild("Rifts")
        local found={}
        if not folder then return found end
        for _,m in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
            local anchor=m:FindFirstChild("Anchor")
            if anchor and anchor:IsA("BasePart") then
                local world=tonumber(anchor:GetAttribute("WorldId"))
                local e=tonumber(anchor:GetAttribute("ExpiresAt"))
                local remain=e and e-workspace:GetServerTimeNow() or nil
                local boss=anchor:GetAttribute("BossId") or anchor:GetAttribute("BossKey") or anchor:GetAttribute("Boss")
                local c={
                    id=tostring(m.Name), model=m, anchor=anchor,
                    world=world, tier=tostring(anchor:GetAttribute("Tier") or "DEFAULT"),
                    class=tostring(anchor:GetAttribute("Class") or "Common"),
                    boss=boss and tostring(boss) or nil, state=tostring(anchor:GetAttribute("State") or "Open"),
                    remaining=remain,
                }
                if aliveRift(c) then found[#found+1]=c end
            end
        end
        return found
    end
    local classRank={Common=1,Rare=2,Epic=3,Legendary=4,Mythic=5,Secret=6}
    local function validCandidate(c)
        if not c.world then return false end
        if config.targetWorld and c.world ~= tonumber(config.targetWorld) then return false end
        if config.targetTier and string.upper(c.tier) ~= string.upper(tostring(config.targetTier)) then return false end
        if config.targetBoss and (not c.boss or string.lower(c.boss) ~= string.lower(tostring(config.targetBoss))) then return false end
        if c.remaining and c.remaining < (tonumber(config.minTimeRemaining) or 35) then return false end
        if (T.failedUntil[c.id] or 0) > os.clock() then return false end
        return true
    end
    local function chooseRift()
        local world=tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"))
        local root=getRoot()
        local choices={}
        for _,c in ipairs(listRifts()) do
            if validCandidate(c) then
                local score=0
                if c.world == world then score=score+500 end
                if config.preferHigherClass then score=score+(classRank[c.class] or 0)*35 end
                if c.remaining then score=score+math.min(100,c.remaining/5) end
                if root and c.world==world then score=score-math.min(400,(root.Position-c.anchor.Position).Magnitude/8) end
                c.score=score
                choices[#choices+1]=c
            end
        end
        table.sort(choices,function(a,b) return a.score>b.score end)
        return choices[1],#choices
    end
    function T:scan()
        local results={}
        for _,c in ipairs(listRifts()) do
            results[#results+1]={id=c.id,world=c.world,tier=c.tier,class=c.class,boss=c.boss,
                remaining=c.remaining,state=c.state,position=printable(c.anchor.Position),eligible=validCandidate(c)}
        end
        return results
    end

    local remotes=RS:FindFirstChild("Remotes") or RS:WaitForChild("Remotes",15)
    local riftEvent=remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("RiftEvent")
    local worldResult=remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("WorldTravelResult")
    local travelReply=nil
    if worldResult then
        table.insert(T.connections,worldResult.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(p)
            if type(p)=="table" and p.Kind=="Result" then travelReply=p end
        end))
    end
    if riftEvent then
        table.insert(T.connections,riftEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(p)
            if not T.running or type(p)~="table" then return end
            local kind=p.Kind
            if kind=="Announce" or kind=="Forming" or kind=="Party" or kind=="Left" or kind=="Launch" or kind=="Refused" or kind=="Hold" or kind=="Collapse" or kind=="Entered" then
                local id=p.RiftId and tostring(p.RiftId) or nil
                local details={kind=kind,id=id,world=p.WorldId,tier=p.Tier,boss=p.BossId or p.Boss,
                    reason=p.Reason,count=p.Count,gatherEndsAt=p.GatherEndsAt,userId=p.UserId}
                log("RIFT_EVENT",details)
                if kind=="Party" and id and T.enteredRift==id then T.joinedRift=id;T.stage="PARTY_CONFIRMED" end
                -- A launch event can be observed for a Rift we never joined. Only count
                -- our own session when an Entered/Party for this player was confirmed.
                if kind=="Launch" and id and (T.joinedRift==id or T.enteredRift==id) then
                    T.sessionStarted=true;T.stage="LAUNCH_CONFIRMED"
                elseif kind=="Launch" then
                    log("UNCONFIRMED_LAUNCH_IGNORED",{id=id,expected=T.currentRift})
                end
                if kind=="Left" and tonumber(p.UserId)==player.UserId and (not id or id==T.enteredRift) then T.joinedRift=nil;T.enteredRift=nil;T.partyLeft=true end
                if kind=="Refused" and (not id or id==T.currentRift) then T.refused=p.Reason or "SERVER_REFUSED";T.stage="ENTRY_REFUSED" end
                if kind=="Entered" and tonumber(p.UserId)==player.UserId and id and (not T.currentRift or id==T.currentRift) then
                    T.enteredRift=id
                    log("PORTAL_ENTERED",{id=id,method="SERVER_EVENT",localUser=true})
                elseif kind=="Entered" and id==T.currentRift then
                    log("OTHER_PLAYER_ENTERED",{id=id,userId=p.UserId,localUser=false})
                end
            end
        end))
    else
        log("RIFT_EVENT_MISSING",{note="Cannot confirm party/launch reliably"})
    end

    table.insert(T.connections,player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("RiftTier"):Connect(function()
        log("RIFT_TIER_CHANGED",{tier=player:GetAttribute("RiftTier"),inFight=player:GetAttribute("InBossFight")})
        if player:GetAttribute("RiftTier")~=nil then
            if T.enteredRift and tostring(player:GetAttribute("RiftId"))==T.enteredRift then
                T.sessionStarted=true;T.stage="RIFT_COMBAT_DETECTED"
            else
                log("RIFT_TIER_UNSCOPED",{note="RiftTier alone does not prove entry to selected Rift"})
            end
        end
    end))

    table.insert(T.connections,player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("InBossFight"):Connect(function()
        log("BOSS_FIGHT_CHANGED",{inFight=player:GetAttribute("InBossFight"),tier=player:GetAttribute("RiftTier")})
    end))

    local function waitWorld(target,timeout)
        local start=os.clock()
        while T.running and os.clock()-start<timeout do
            local root=getRoot()
            if tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"))==target and root then return true end
            task.wait(.2)
        end
        return false
    end
    local function travelWorld(target)
        if not T.running or context:isCancelled() then return false,"MANAGED_JOB_CANCELLED" end
        if tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"))==target then return true end
        if not config.autoTravel then return false,"AUTO_TRAVEL_DISABLED" end
        if inFight() or player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout")==true then return false,"PLAYER_LOCKED" end
        local prep=remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("NavPrepareWorlds")
        local request=remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("RequestWorldTravel")
        if not (prep and request and worldResult) then return false,"TRAVEL_REMOTES_MISSING" end
        travelReply=nil
        T.stage="TRAVEL_WORLD"
        log("WORLD_TRAVEL_REQUEST",{from=player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"),to=target})
        local ok,err=pcall(function()
            prep:FireServer("stream",target)
            task.wait(.2)
            if not T.running then error("STOPPED_BEFORE_TRAVEL") end
            request:FireServer(target)
        end)
        if not ok then return false,"TRAVEL_SEND_FAILED:"..tostring(err) end
        local deadline=os.clock()+(tonumber(config.maxTravelSeconds) or 25)
        while T.running and os.clock()<deadline do
            if type(travelReply)=="table" and tonumber(travelReply.WorldId)==target and travelReply.Ok==false then
                return false,"REJECTED:"..tostring(travelReply.Reason)
            end
            if tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"))==target and waitWorld(target,.3) then
                log("WORLD_TRAVEL_VERIFIED",{world=target,serverOk=travelReply and travelReply.Ok})
                return true
            end
            task.wait(.2)
        end
        return false,"WORLD_TRAVEL_TIMEOUT"
    end

    -- V4: Join is driven by the verified in-world ProximityPrompt.
    -- Diagnostic run identified: workspace.Rifts.<id>.Anchor.RiftPrompt;
     -- ActionText = "Enter Rift", HoldDuration = 0.6, MaxActivationDistance = 18, LOS=false.
     -- The gate visuals and the separate RiftPartyGui are NOT the input action.
    local function getPrompt(c)
        local anchor = c.anchor
        local prompt = anchor and anchor:FindFirstChild("RiftPrompt")
        if not prompt or not prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then return nil, "RIFT_PROMPT_MISSING" end
        -- The server starts Rifts in Opening state. Prompt.Enabled can be false
        -- for several seconds after Announce; readiness is checked separately.
        if prompt.ActionText ~= "Enter Rift" and prompt.ActionText ~= "Join Rift" then
            return nil, "UNEXPECTED_PROMPT:" .. tostring(prompt.ActionText)
        end
        return prompt
    end

    -- V5: Wait for the actual server-owned entry prompt to become enabled.
    -- The RiftConfig Lifetime.OpeningSeconds is 6; a 1-2 second travel can arrive
    -- before the prompt is ready. No movement or entry request happens while disabled.
    local function waitForPromptReady(c)
        T.stage="WAIT_RIFT_PROMPT_READY"
        local began=os.clock()
        local timeout=tonumber(config.promptReadyTimeout) or 25
        local lastSummary=nil
        local lastPrinted=-100
        while T.running and os.clock()-began<timeout do
            if tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"))~=c.world then return nil,"WRONG_WORLD" end
            if not aliveRift(c) then return nil,"RIFT_CLOSED" end
            -- Re-resolve after world streaming or model refresh.
            local folder=workspace:FindFirstChild("Rifts")
            local model=folder and folder:FindFirstChild(c.id)
            local anchor=model and model:FindFirstChild("Anchor")
            if anchor and anchor:IsA("BasePart") then
                c.model=model
                c.anchor=anchor
            end
            local prompt,reason=getPrompt(c)
            local state=tostring(c.anchor:GetAttribute("State") or "UNKNOWN")
            local enabled=prompt and prompt.Enabled==true or false
            if prompt and enabled then
                log("PROMPT_READY",{id=c.id,waited=math.floor((os.clock()-began)*10)/10,
                    riftState=state,enabled=true,range=prompt.MaxActivationDistance,
                    hold=prompt.HoldDuration})
                return prompt,"READY"
            end
            local summary=state.."/"..tostring(reason or (enabled and "READY" or "RIFT_PROMPT_DISABLED"))
            local elapsed=os.clock()-began
            if summary~=lastSummary or elapsed-lastPrinted>2 then
                log("PROMPT_WAIT",{id=c.id,riftState=state,promptExists=prompt~=nil,
                    enabled=enabled,reason=reason or "RIFT_PROMPT_DISABLED",
                    waited=math.floor(elapsed*10)/10,
                    remaining=c.remaining and math.max(0,c.remaining-elapsed) or nil})
                lastSummary=summary
                lastPrinted=elapsed
            end
            task.wait(tonumber(config.promptWaitInterval) or .25)
        end
        if not T.running then return nil,"STOPPED" end
        return nil,"PROMPT_READY_TIMEOUT"
    end

    local function groundBelow(position)
        local ignored = {}
        if player.Character then ignored[#ignored+1] = player.Character end
        local rf = workspace:FindFirstChild("Rifts")
        if rf then ignored[#ignored+1] = rf end
        local visuals = workspace:FindFirstChild("RiftVisuals")
        if visuals then ignored[#ignored+1] = visuals end
        local params = RaycastParams.new()
        params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignored
        params.IgnoreWater = true
        -- Only a validated, upward-facing collidable surface is an eligible landing.
        local hit = workspace:Raycast(position + Vector3.new(0,22,0), Vector3.new(0,-90,0),params)
        if not hit or hit.Normal.Y < 0.65 then return nil end
        if hit.Instance ~= workspace.Terrain and
           (not hit.Instance:IsA("BasePart") or not hit.Instance.CanCollide) then
            return nil
        end
        return Vector3.new(position.X,hit.Position.Y + 3.1,position.Z)
    end

    local function joinedNow(c)
        return T.enteredRift == c.id or T.joinedRift == c.id or
               (T.currentRift == c.id and T.sessionStarted)
    end

    local function waitSignal(c,seconds)
        local deadline=os.clock()+seconds
        while T.running and os.clock()<deadline do
            if joinedNow(c) then return true,"SERVER_ACCEPTED" end
            if T.refused then return false,"SERVER_REFUSED:" .. tostring(T.refused) end
            if not aliveRift(c) then
                -- Collapse can follow Launch; check signals first, before treating collapse as failure.
                if joinedNow(c) then return true,"SERVER_ACCEPTED" end
                return false,"RIFT_CLOSED"
            end
            task.wait(.12)
        end
        return joinedNow(c),"NO_ENTRY_EVENT"
    end

    local function safeRepositionToPrompt(c,prompt)
        if not T.running or context:isCancelled() then return false,"MANAGED_JOB_CANCELLED" end
        local root,hum=getRoot()
        local char=player.Character
        if not (root and hum and char and hum.Health>0) then return false,"NO_ALIVE_CHARACTER" end
        local distance = (root.Position - c.anchor.Position).Magnitude
        local nativeRange=prompt.MaxActivationDistance
        local desiredRange=math.min(tonumber(config.maxPromptDistance) or 16,nativeRange-1)
        log("PROMPT_DISTANCE",{id=c.id,distance=distance,range=nativeRange,hold=prompt.HoldDuration,
            enabled=prompt.Enabled,action=prompt.ActionText,los=prompt.RequiresLineOfSight})
        if distance<=desiredRange then return true,"ALREADY_IN_RANGE" end
        if not config.autoApproach or not config.directTP or not config.safeReposition then
            return false,"NOT_IN_RANGE_NO_DIRECT_TP"
        end
        if inFight() then return false,"PLAYER_IN_FIGHT" end
        if tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")) ~= c.world then return false,"WRONG_WORLD" end
        if not aliveRift(c) then return false,"RIFT_CLOSED" end

        local origin=char:GetPivot()
        local a=c.anchor.Position
        local direction=Vector3.new(root.Position.X-a.X,0,root.Position.Z-a.Z)
        if direction.Magnitude < .2 then
            direction=Vector3.new(c.anchor.CFrame.LookVector.X,0,c.anchor.CFrame.LookVector.Z)
        end
        if direction.Magnitude < .2 then direction=Vector3.new(1,0,0) end
        direction=direction.Unit
        -- Do not target the vertical visual center. Only look for solid ground
        -- around the actual server-owned Anchor, within activation distance.
        local target=nil
        local tested=0
        for _,radius in ipairs({8,5,11,2}) do
            for _,angle in ipairs({0,math.pi/2,-math.pi/2,math.pi}) do
                local d = (CFrame.fromAxisAngle(Vector3.yAxis,angle)):VectorToWorldSpace(direction)
                local pos=groundBelow(a+d*radius)
                tested=tested+1
                if pos and (pos-a).Magnitude <= desiredRange then
                    target=pos
                    break
                end
            end
            if target then break end
        end
        log("SAFE_PROMPT_POSITION",{id=c.id,anchor=a,candidates=tested,found=target~=nil,destination=target})
        if not target then return false,"NO_VERIFIED_GROUND_NEAR_PROMPT" end
        local ok,err=pcall(function()
            char:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(target,Vector3.new(a.X,target.Y,a.Z)))
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero
            root.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero
        end)
        if not ok then return false,"SAFE_TP_FAILED:" .. tostring(err) end
        task.wait(.4)
        if not T.running or context:isCancelled() then return false,"MANAGED_JOB_CANCELLED" end
        root,hum=getRoot()
        if not root or not hum or hum.Health<=0 then return false,"CHARACTER_LOST_AFTER_TP" end
        local actualDist=(root.Position-c.anchor.Position).Magnitude
        local errorPos=(root.Position-target).Magnitude
        log("SAFE_PROMPT_TP_RESULT",{id=c.id,position=root.Position,distance=actualDist,deviation=errorPos})
        if actualDist > nativeRange then
            pcall(function() char:PivotTo(origin) end)
            return false,"NOT_IN_PROMPT_RANGE_AFTER_TP"
        end
        if errorPos>8 then
            pcall(function() char:PivotTo(origin) end)
            return false,"POSITION_NOT_STABLE"
        end
        return true,"IN_PROMPT_RANGE"
    end

    local function activatePrompt(c,prompt)
        if not T.running or context:isCancelled() then return false,"MANAGED_JOB_CANCELLED" end
        local root=getRoot()
        if not root then return false,"NO_ROOT" end
        local dist=(root.Position-c.anchor.Position).Magnitude
        if dist>prompt.MaxActivationDistance then return false,"TOO_FAR" end
        if not prompt.Enabled then return false,"PROMPT_DISABLED" end
        T.stage="ACTIVATE_RIFT_PROMPT"
        local callable = type(fireproximityprompt)=="function" and fireproximityprompt or nil
        if callable then
            log("PROMPT_TRIGGER_ATTEMPT",{id=c.id,method="fireproximityprompt",distance=dist})
            local ok,err=pcall(function() callable(prompt) end)
            log("PROMPT_TRIGGER_CALL",{id=c.id,method="fireproximityprompt",ok=ok,error=ok and nil or tostring(err)})
            if ok then
                local joined,why=waitSignal(c,tonumber(config.promptConfirmSeconds) or 3)
                if joined then return true,"SERVER_ACCEPTED" end
                -- pcall(true) only proves the executor function returned without error.
                -- It does NOT prove that the server accepted the Enter Rift action.
                -- For an explicit refusal, closed portal, or cancelled session, never
                -- dispatch a second activation.
                if why~="NO_ENTRY_EVENT" then return false,why end
                log("PROMPT_FALLBACK_ARMED",{id=c.id,primary="fireproximityprompt",
                    reason="NO_ENTRY_EVENT",method="InputHoldBegin/End"})
            else
                log("PROMPT_FALLBACK_ARMED",{id=c.id,primary="fireproximityprompt",
                    reason="CALL_ERROR",method="InputHoldBegin/End"})
            end
        end
        -- Re-check state after the first attempt. An Entered/Party event can arrive
        -- while switching to the native engine method; do not trigger twice then.
        if joinedNow(c) then return true,"SERVER_ACCEPTED" end
        if not T.running then return false,"STOPPED" end
        if T.refused then return false,"SERVER_REFUSED:"..tostring(T.refused) end
        if not aliveRift(c) then return false,"RIFT_CLOSED" end
        root=getRoot()
        if not root then return false,"NO_ROOT_AFTER_PRIMARY" end
        if (root.Position-c.anchor.Position).Magnitude > prompt.MaxActivationDistance then
            return false,"TOO_FAR_AFTER_PRIMARY"
        end
        if not prompt.Enabled then return false,"PROMPT_DISABLED_AFTER_PRIMARY" end
        log("PROMPT_TRIGGER_ATTEMPT",{id=c.id,method="InputHoldBegin/End",
            hold=prompt.HoldDuration})
        local began=false
        local ok,err=pcall(function()
            if not T.running or context:isCancelled() then error("MANAGED_JOB_CANCELLED") end
            prompt:InputHoldBegin()
            began=true
            task.wait(math.max(.1,(tonumber(prompt.HoldDuration) or 0) +
                (tonumber(config.promptHoldPadding) or .2)))
        end)
        -- Always release if hold started, including after a wait error.
        local released,releaseErr=pcall(function()
            if began then prompt:InputHoldEnd() end
        end)
        log("PROMPT_TRIGGER_CALL",{id=c.id,method="InputHoldBegin/End",
            ok=ok and released,error=not ok and tostring(err) or
                (not released and tostring(releaseErr) or nil)})
        if not ok or not released then
            return false,"PROMPT_NATIVE_HOLD_ERROR:"..tostring(not ok and err or releaseErr)
        end
        local joined,why=waitSignal(c,tonumber(config.promptConfirmSeconds) or 3)
        if joined then log("PROMPT_FALLBACK_ACCEPTED",{id=c.id,method="InputHoldBegin/End"}) end
        return joined,why
    end

    local function waitForManualPrompt(c,prompt,reason)
        if not config.manualAssist then return false,reason end
        T.stage="MANUAL_PROMPT_ASSIST"
        log("MANUAL_PROMPT_ASSIST",{id=c.id,reason=reason,
            instruction="Stand within 18 studs of the Rift and hold the native Enter Rift prompt for 0.6s; script will detect entry."})
        local deadline=os.clock()+(tonumber(config.manualAssistTimeout) or 85)
        while T.running and os.clock()<deadline do
            if joinedNow(c) then return true,"SERVER_ACCEPTED_MANUAL" end
            if T.refused then return false,"SERVER_REFUSED:"..tostring(T.refused) end
            if not aliveRift(c) then return false,"RIFT_CLOSED" end
            task.wait(.2)
        end
        return false,"MANUAL_PROMPT_TIMEOUT:"..tostring(reason)
    end

    local function approachRift(c)
        if not config.autoJoin then return false,"AUTO_JOIN_DISABLED" end
        if not aliveRift(c) then return false,"RIFT_CLOSED" end
        T.refused=nil
        T.stage="RIFT_PROMPT_LOOKUP"
        -- The prompt can be present but disabled while the Rift opens. If it
        -- exists, move to a verified safe interaction spot *before* waiting:
        -- this also covers a game that enables prompts only near the player.
        local initial,initialReason=getPrompt(c)
        if initial then
            log("PROMPT_FOUND",{id=c.id,path=initial:GetFullName(),action=initial.ActionText,
                enabled=initial.Enabled,range=initial.MaxActivationDistance,
                hold=initial.HoldDuration,los=initial.RequiresLineOfSight})
            local positioned,positionReason=safeRepositionToPrompt(c,initial)
            if not positioned then
                log("PROMPT_APPROACH_FAILED",{id=c.id,reason=positionReason})
                return waitForManualPrompt(c,initial,positionReason)
            end
        else
            log("PROMPT_PENDING",{id=c.id,reason=initialReason})
        end
        local prompt,why=waitForPromptReady(c)
        if not prompt then
            log("PROMPT_LOOKUP_FAILED",{id=c.id,reason=why,riftState=c.anchor:GetAttribute("State")})
            return waitForManualPrompt(c,nil,why)
        end
        if not initial or initial~=prompt then
            log("PROMPT_FOUND",{id=c.id,path=prompt:GetFullName(),action=prompt.ActionText,
                enabled=prompt.Enabled,range=prompt.MaxActivationDistance,
                hold=prompt.HoldDuration,los=prompt.RequiresLineOfSight})
        end
        -- Recheck after streaming/state changes; if we moved already this is a no-op.
        local ready,readyReason=safeRepositionToPrompt(c,prompt)
        if not ready then
            log("PROMPT_APPROACH_FAILED",{id=c.id,reason=readyReason})
            return waitForManualPrompt(c,prompt,readyReason)
        end
        local accepted,result=activatePrompt(c,prompt)
        if not accepted and result=="PROMPT_DISABLED" then
            log("PROMPT_CHANGED_AFTER_MOVE",{id=c.id,note="Retry readiness once; the server may have changed Rift state"})
            local latest,why2=waitForPromptReady(c)
            if latest then
                accepted,result=activatePrompt(c,latest)
            else
                result=why2
            end
        end
        if not accepted then return waitForManualPrompt(c,prompt,result) end
        log("ENTRY_VERIFIED",{id=c.id,method=T.enteredRift==c.id and "RiftEvent.Entered" or
            (T.joinedRift==c.id and "RiftEvent.Party" or "RiftEvent.Launch")})
        return true,"SERVER_ACCEPTED"
    end

    local function executeCandidate(c)
        if not T.running or context:isCancelled() then return false,"MANAGED_JOB_CANCELLED" end
        T.currentRift=c.id
        T.selectedTier=c.tier
        T.attemptCount=T.attemptCount+1
        T.stage="RIFT_SELECTED"
        log("RIFT_SELECTED",{id=c.id,world=c.world,class=c.class,tier=c.tier,boss=c.boss,remaining=c.remaining})
        local ok,reason=travelWorld(c.world)
        if not ok then return false,"TRAVEL:"..tostring(reason) end
        -- World attributes may change before Roblox finishes placing the character.
        task.wait(tonumber(config.settleWorldSeconds) or 1.3)
        if not T.running or context:isCancelled() then return false,"MANAGED_JOB_CANCELLED" end
        if tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"))~=c.world then return false,"WORLD_CHANGED_DURING_SETTLE" end
        -- Re-resolve the anchor after changing world. Streaming may have rebuilt it.
        local folder=workspace:FindFirstChild("Rifts")
        local model=folder and folder:FindFirstChild(c.id)
        local anchor=model and model:FindFirstChild("Anchor")
        if not (anchor and anchor:IsA("BasePart")) then return false,"ANCHOR_NOT_STREAMED" end
        c.anchor=anchor
        c.model=model
        if not aliveRift(c) then return false,"RIFT_CLOSED" end
        if not config.autoJoin then return true,"ENTRY_DISABLED" end
        local accepted,why=approachRift(c)
        if not accepted then return false,why end
        return true,"ENTRY_VERIFIED"
    end


    -- One local Rift attempt owns one Commander combat adapter. No BossManager, Solo, or V6 writes.
    local Registry=require("rift.EncounterRegistry")
    assert(#Registry.specs==18,"RIFT_V3_1_EXPECTED_18_ENCOUNTERS")
    for _,riftBoss in ipairs(Registry.specs) do
        assert(riftBoss.id~="AIRRAID", "AIRRAID_MUST_NOT_BE_IN_RIFT")
    end

    local function attrActive(name)
        local v=player:GetAttribute(name)
        return v~=nil and v~=false and v~=""
    end
    local function reportGui()
        local pg=player:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
        local g=pg and pg:FindFirstChild("BossResultsGui")
        return g,(g and g:IsA("ScreenGui") and g.Enabled==true) or player:GetAttribute("BossResultsOpen")==true
    end
    local function participantNames()
        local found={}
        for name,v in pairs(player:GetAttributes()) do
            if name:match("Participant$") and v~=false and v~="" then found[#found+1]=name end
        end
        table.sort(found)
        return found
    end
    local function scopedRift()
        local id=player:GetAttribute("RiftId")
        return T.enteredRift and id~=nil and tostring(id)==T.enteredRift
    end
    local function setOutcome(value,source)
        if T.outcome and T.outcome~=value then
            if not T.conflictingOutcome then log("OUTCOME_CONFLICT",{first=T.outcome,second=value,source=source}) end
            T.conflictingOutcome=true
        elseif not T.outcome then
            T.outcome=value;T.outcomeSource=source;T.outcomeObservedAt=os.clock()
            log("OUTCOME_OBSERVED",{boss=T.boss,outcome=value,source=source,id=T.enteredRift})
        end
    end
    local function selectLocalBoss()
        return Registry.select(player:GetAttributes())
    end
    local function generationFor(spec)
        local k=spec.prefix.."FightGeneration"
        return player:GetAttribute(k) or workspace:GetAttribute(k)
    end
    local function inspectPacket(spec,packet,eventName)
        if not T.running or not T.sessionStarted or type(packet)~="table" or not scopedRift() then return end
        local candidate=selectLocalBoss()
        if not candidate or candidate.id~=spec.id or (T.boss and T.boss~=spec.id) then return end
        if spec.nativeId and packet.BossId and packet.BossId~=spec.nativeId then return end
        local g=generationFor(spec)
        if packet.Generation~=nil and g~=nil and packet.Generation~=g then return end
        if T.boundGeneration and packet.Generation~=nil and T.boundGeneration~=packet.Generation then return end
        if spec.id=="B2SPIRIT" and eventName=="B2FightStart" and packet.BossId==spec.nativeId and packet.ArenaCentre~=nil and packet.SessionId~=nil then
            T.b2Start=packet
        end
        if spec.id=="ZEPPELIN" and eventName=="BossFightStart" and packet.BossId==spec.nativeId and packet.SessionId~=nil and packet.Victory==nil then
            if not T.zeppelinStart and packet.K~="Outcome" then T.zeppelinStart=packet end
        end
        local phase=tonumber(packet.Phase)
        if phase and phase~=T.eventPhase then T.eventPhase=phase;log("BOSS_PHASE",{boss=spec.id,phase=phase}) end
        local terminal=packet.K=="Outcome" or (spec.specialEnd and (eventName=="B2FightEnd" or eventName=="BossFightEnd") and packet.BossId==spec.nativeId and type(packet.Victory)=="boolean")
        if terminal and type(packet.Victory)=="boolean" then
            local reason=packet.Reason or packet.EndReason
            if not packet.Victory and (reason=="Exited" or reason=="Reset" or reason=="Respawn" or reason=="Downed" or reason=="Aborted") then
                log("NON_TERMINAL_END",{boss=spec.id,reason=reason});return
            end
            if packet.SessionId and T.b2Start and spec.id=="B2SPIRIT" and packet.SessionId~=T.b2Start.SessionId then return end
            if packet.SessionId and T.zeppelinStart and spec.id=="ZEPPELIN" and packet.SessionId~=T.zeppelinStart.SessionId then return end
            -- A scoped native outcome is separate from proof of report closure or reward grant.
            setOutcome(packet.Victory and "WIN" or "LOSS","SCOPED_NATIVE_OUTCOME")
        end
    end
    for _,spec in ipairs(Registry.specs) do
        for _,name in ipairs(spec.events) do
            local remote=remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild(name)
            if remote and remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                local currentSpec,source=spec,name
                table.insert(T.connections,remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(packet) inspectPacket(currentSpec,packet,source) end))
            end
        end
    end
    -- V2: native Sky visual positions plus server Strikes coordinates.
    -- Aircraft avoidance is injected into the pilot owner's existing frame,
    -- while B-21's radar and native dodge keep their single movement lease.
    local HazardController=require("rift.HazardController")
    T.hazardController=HazardController.new({
        log=log,
        scoped=function() return T.running and scopedRift() end,
        inCombat=function() return player:GetAttribute("InBossFight")==true and not T.outcome end,
        adapter=function() return T.adapter end,
        context=function() return T.combatContext end,
        phase=function() return T.eventPhase end,
        character=getRoot,
    })
    local hazardEvent=remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("RiftHazard")
    if hazardEvent and hazardEvent:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
        table.insert(T.connections,hazardEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(packet)
            if T.running and T.sessionStarted and scopedRift() and type(packet)=="table" then
                T.hazardController:observe(packet)
            end
        end))
    else
        log("RIFT_HAZARD_REMOTE_UNAVAILABLE",{reason="RiftHazard remote missing"})
    end

    local function makeCombatAdapter(spec)
        local profile=require("main.config.Profile").new()
        local runtime=require("main.core.Runtime").new({sleep=task.wait,poll=.12})
        local platform=require("main.adapters.RobloxAdapter").new({player=player})
        local gui=require("main.adapters.GuiAdapter").new(platform,runtime)
        local ownership=require("main.core.MovementOwnership").new(runtime)
        local movement=require("main.navigation.MovementService").new(platform,runtime,ownership,profile)
        local interaction=require("main.core.DirectInteraction").new(platform)
        local input=require("main.adapters.InputDriver").new(platform,gui,runtime,profile,interaction)
        local encounter={encounterId="RIFT:"..T.enteredRift,bossId=spec.id,phase="COMBAT",adopted=true,
            soloAttempted=false,completedPhases={},homeWorld=T.originWorld,characterGeneration=1}
        -- This in-memory port records local mechanics only. It never touches V6's state or reports Solo submitted.
        local state,writer={},{}
        function state:snapshot() return {boss={encounter=encounter}} end
        -- Fleet ReportController uses the same StateStore feature API as Solo.
        -- This is a scoped in-memory snapshot, not the global V6 Boss state.
        function state:featureSnapshot(id)
            assert(id=="BOSS","Unknown Rift feature snapshot: "..tostring(id))
            return {encounter=encounter}
        end
        function state:port(owner) assert(owner=="boss","Unknown Rift state port");return writer end
        function writer:recordRadar(phase,at)
            encounter.completedPhases[phase]=true;encounter.lastDeiceAt=at
            log("BOSS_RADAR_VERIFIED",{boss=spec.id,phase=phase});return true
        end
        function writer:recordDeiceTransaction(data)
            log("BOSS_RADAR_TRANSACTION",{boss=spec.id,phase=data.phase,action=data.action,code=data.code,completed=data.completed});return true
        end
        -- No report writer, scheduler, settings store, world service, or BossCommand entry in the adapter.
        local telemetry,lastEmitted={},{}
        function telemetry:emit(name,detail,interval)
            local now=os.clock()
            local delay=math.max(.1,tonumber(interval) or .2)
            if lastEmitted[name] and now-lastEmitted[name]<delay then return end
            lastEmitted[name]=now
            -- A bad detail payload must never terminate a combat controller.
            pcall(log,"COMBAT_"..tostring(name),detail or {})
        end
        function telemetry:sample() end
        function telemetry:flush() end
        function telemetry:startFrames() return function() end end
        local e={runtime=runtime,profile=profile,state=state,services={roblox=platform,gui=gui,movement=movement,
            interaction=interaction,input=input,telemetry=telemetry,riftHazards=T.hazardController,revivePending=function()
                return attrActive("BossReviveDowned")
            end}}
        if spec.id=="FLEET" then
            log("FLEET_COMPAT_STATE_READY",{featureSnapshot=true,encounterId=encounter.encounterId})
        end
        local load=assert(CombatDefinitions[spec.id],"RIFT_COMBAT_MODULE_NOT_REGISTERED")
        local module=load()
        assert(type(module)=="table" and type(module.definition)=="function","RIFT_COMBAT_DEFINITION_INVALID")
        local definition=module.definition()
        log("COMBAT_MODULE_LOADED",{boss=spec.id,module=spec.module})
        local boss=definition.create(e)
        assert(boss.command==nil and boss.combat and boss.observer and boss.report,"Combat-only adapter required")
        local nativeInspect=boss.report.inspect
        local function nativeEvidence()
            local ok,evidence=pcall(nativeInspect,boss.report)
            if ok and type(evidence)=="table" then return evidence end
            if not T.nativeInspectError then T.nativeInspectError=true;log("NATIVE_REPORT_INSPECT_ERROR",{boss=spec.id,error=tostring(evidence)}) end
            return {}
        end
        -- The Commander mechanics may use report state to stop. Only the Rift lifecycle may finalize outcome.
        function boss.report:inspect()
            local evidence=nativeEvidence()
            local _,open=reportGui()
            evidence.active=open or T.conflictingOutcome==true or not T.running
            evidence.outcome=T.outcome
            return evidence
        end
        return {boss=boss,encounter=encounter,runtime=runtime,spec=spec,
            movement=movement,nativeEvidence=nativeEvidence}
    end
    local function physicalArena(adapter)
        if not adapter or not getRoot() then return nil end
        local obs=adapter.boss.observer
        if adapter.spec.id=="BLACKFORTRESS" then return nil end -- source explicitly has no established arena geometry
        if adapter.spec.id=="B2SPIRIT" and (type(obs.center)~="function" or obs:center()==nil) then return nil end
        local fn=obs.inArenaPosition or (adapter.spec.id=="B21_RAIDER" and obs.inArena)
        if not fn then return nil end
        local ok,value=pcall(fn,obs)
        if ok and type(value)=="boolean" then return value end
        return nil
    end
    local function bindBoss(spec)
        if T.adapter or T.adapterFailed then return end
        local ok,value=xpcall(function() return makeCombatAdapter(spec) end,function(e) return tostring(e) end)
        if not ok then
            T.adapterFailed=true;log("COMBAT_ADAPTER_ERROR",{boss=spec.id,error=value});return
        end
        T.adapter=value
        -- Reuse the B2 geometry packet only if witnessed in this exact local Rift scope.
        if spec.id=="B2SPIRIT" and T.b2Start and value.boss.mechanics then
            local applied,err=pcall(value.boss.mechanics.observeStart,value.boss.mechanics,T.b2Start)
            if not applied then log("B2_START_NOT_ADOPTED",{reason=tostring(err)}) end
        end
        log("COMBAT_ADAPTER_BOUND",{boss=spec.id,entry="ADOPTED_RIFT",commanderEntry=false})
    end
    local function startCombat(adapter)
        if T.combatStarted or not adapter or not config.experimentalCommanderCombat then return end
        local spec=adapter.spec
        local root,hum=getRoot()
        if not root or not hum or hum.Health<=0 or player.GameplayPaused==true then return end
        if not scopedRift() or player:GetAttribute(spec.participant)~=true or player:GetAttribute("InBossFight")~=true then return end
        local current=generationFor(spec)
        if T.boundGeneration and current and current~=T.boundGeneration then return end
        if spec.id=="B21_RAIDER" and physicalArena(adapter)~=true then return end
        T.combatStarted=true;T.combatRunning=true;T.combatRuntime=adapter.runtime
        task.spawn(function()
            local ctx
            local ok,result=xpcall(function()
                ctx=assert(adapter.runtime:createJob("RIFT",{bossId=spec.id}))
                T.combatContext=ctx
                if not T.running then ctx:cancel("STOPPED");return {code="CANCELLED"} end
                local boss=adapter.boss
                if boss.report.watch then
                    local watching,why=boss.report:watch(ctx)
                    if not watching then return {code=why or "NATIVE_REPORT_WATCH_FAILED"} end
                end
                if spec.id=="ZEPPELIN" and T.zeppelinStart and boss.flight then
                    boss.flight:observe("FightStart",T.zeppelinStart)
                end
                log("COMMANDER_COMPAT_COMBAT_START",{boss=spec.id,generation=current,
                    additionalRiftHazards="V2_NATIVE_SKY_AND_STRIKES"})
                return boss.combat:run(ctx,adapter.encounter)
            end,function(e) return tostring(e) end)
            if ctx then
                local closed,errors=adapter.runtime:closeJob(ctx,false)
                if not closed or (type(errors)=="table" and #errors>0) then T.cleanupFailed=true;log("COMBAT_CLEANUP_FAILED",{errors=errors}) end
            end
            adapter.runtime:shutdown("COMBAT_FINISHED")
            if adapter.boss.report.cleanup then
                local clean,err=pcall(adapter.boss.report.cleanup,adapter.boss.report)
                if not clean then T.cleanupFailed=true;log("REPORT_CLEANUP_FAILED",{error=tostring(err)}) end
            end
            T.combatContext=nil;T.combatRuntime=nil;T.combatRunning=false
            log("COMMANDER_COMPAT_COMBAT_END",{boss=spec.id,ok=ok,result=ok and result or tostring(result)})
            if not ok then T.combatError=tostring(result) end
        end)
    end
    local function inspectReport(g,spec)
        if not g or not spec then return end
        local identity,win,loss,shown=false,false,false,false
        local tier=tostring(T.selectedTier or ""):upper()
        for _,item in ipairs(g:GetDescendants()) do
            if item:IsA("TextLabel") and item.Visible then
                local text=tostring(item.Text):upper()
                if Registry.matchesTitle(spec,text) then
                    if text:find("RIFT",1,true) and text:find("ENCOUNTER",1,true) then identity=true end
                    if item.Name=="Title" then
                        if tier~="" and tier~="DEFAULT" and text:sub(1,#tier+1)==tier.." " and text:find("DEFEATED",1,true) then identity=true end
                        if text:find("DEFEATED",1,true) then win=true end
                    end
                end
                if item.Name=="Title" and text=="MISSION FAILED" then loss=true end
                if text=="REWARDS" then shown=true end
            end
        end
        -- Titles are not consistent across all native flight/ground boss reports.
        -- If the title itself cannot identify the boss, correlate the report to
        -- the current *server-accepted* Rift and its scoped native outcome.
        -- A report that was already visible before that outcome is NOT eligible.
        if not identity and not T.reportIdentity
            and T.sessionStarted==true and T.enteredRift~=nil
            and T.spec==spec and T.boss==spec.id
            and T.scopedCombatObserved==true and T.combatStarted==true
            and T.outcomeSource=="SCOPED_NATIVE_OUTCOME"
            and (T.outcome=="WIN" or T.outcome=="LOSS")
            and T.outcomeObservedAt~=nil
            and os.clock()-T.outcomeObservedAt>=0
            and os.clock()-T.outcomeObservedAt<=120
            and not T.reportPreOutcomeSeen
            and not T.conflictingOutcome
            and g:IsA("ScreenGui") and g.Enabled==true then
            identity=true
            T.reportIdentitySource="SCOPED_NATIVE_OUTCOME_GUI_CORRELATED"
            log("REPORT_IDENTITY_CORRELATED",{boss=spec.id,id=T.enteredRift,
                outcome=T.outcome,source=T.outcomeSource,method=T.reportIdentitySource})
        elseif identity and not T.reportIdentity then
            T.reportIdentitySource="MATCHING_REPORT_TITLE"
        end
        T.reportIdentity=T.reportIdentity or identity
        T.rewardsShown=T.rewardsShown or shown
        if T.reportIdentity then
            if win and not loss then setOutcome("WIN","RIFT_REPORT_TITLE") end
            if loss and not win then setOutcome("LOSS","RIFT_REPORT_TITLE") end
        end
    end
    -- Native Battle Report: Dismiss only after scoped report/result/rewards are stable.
    -- The handler is intentionally one-shot; an uncertain dispatch is never repeated blindly.
    local resultsController=nil
    local controllerLoadAttempted=false
    local function getResultsController()
        if resultsController then return resultsController end
        if controllerLoadAttempted then return nil end
        controllerLoadAttempted=true
        local folder=RS:FindFirstChild("ClientModules")
        local module=folder and folder:FindFirstChild("BossResultsController")
        if not (module and module:IsA("ModuleScript")) then
            log("REPORT_CONTROLLER_UNAVAILABLE",{reason="MODULE_MISSING"})
            return nil
        end
        local loader=getfenv and getfenv(0) and getfenv(0)["require"]
        local ok,result=pcall(loader,module)
        if ok and type(result)=="table" and type(result.Dismiss)=="function" then
            resultsController=result
        else
            log("REPORT_CONTROLLER_UNAVAILABLE",{reason=ok and "DISMISS_MISSING" or tostring(result)})
        end
        return resultsController
    end
    local function reportContinueButton(g)
        if not (g and g:IsA("ScreenGui") and g.Enabled) then return nil end
        for _,node in ipairs(g:GetDescendants()) do
            if node:IsA("GuiButton") and node.Visible and node.Active then
                local text=tostring(node:IsA("TextButton") and node.Text or ""):upper()
                local name=node.Name:upper()
                if name=="CONTINUE" or name=="CONTINUEBUTTON" or name=="CLOSEBUTTON" or
                   text=="CONTINUE" or text=="CLOSE" or text=="DONE" then
                    local visible=true
                    local parent=node.Parent
                    while parent and parent~=g do
                        if parent:IsA("GuiObject") and not parent.Visible then visible=false;break end
                        parent=parent.Parent
                    end
                    if visible then return node end
                end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function tryAutoContinue(g,open)
        if not config.autoContinueReport or not open or T.reportContinueAttempted or not T.running then return end
        if not (T.reportIdentity and T.outcome and not T.conflictingOutcome) then return end
        T.reportReadyAt=T.reportReadyAt or os.clock()
        if os.clock()-T.reportReadyAt<config.reportReadyHold then return end
        local controller=getResultsController()
        local nativeOpenVerified=false
        if controller and type(controller.IsOpen)=="function" then
            local ok,isOpen=pcall(controller.IsOpen)
            nativeOpenVerified=ok and isOpen==true
            if ok and not isOpen then
                -- Don't dismiss a stale report or one the native controller doesn't own.
                if not T.reportNotReadyLogged then
                    T.reportNotReadyLogged=true
                    log("REPORT_NATIVE_NOT_OPEN",{guiOpen=open})
                end
                return
            end
        end
        if controller and type(controller.Debug)=="function" then
            local ok,debugValue=pcall(controller.Debug)
            if ok and type(debugValue)=="string" and debugValue:find("armed=false",1,true) then
                if not T.reportNotReadyLogged then
                    T.reportNotReadyLogged=true
                    log("REPORT_NATIVE_NOT_ARMED",{boss=T.boss})
                end
                return
            end
        end
        -- Some flight-boss result layouts do not expose a visible REWARDS
        -- TextLabel even though the native results controller is armed.
        -- NEVER infer readiness from WIN alone: require native IsOpen or a
        -- visible Continue control, and give the UI an extra settling period.
        if T.outcome=="WIN" and not T.rewardsShown then
            local buttonReady=reportContinueButton(g)~=nil
            if not nativeOpenVerified and not buttonReady then
                if not T.reportRewardsNotObservedLogged then
                    T.reportRewardsNotObservedLogged=true
                    log("REPORT_WAIT_REWARDS_OR_NATIVE_READY",{boss=T.boss,
                        nativeOpen=nativeOpenVerified,continueVisible=buttonReady})
                end
                return
            end
            if os.clock()-T.reportReadyAt<config.reportReadyHold+2 then return end
            if not T.reportNativeReadyLogged then
                T.reportNativeReadyLogged=true
                log("REPORT_NATIVE_READY_WITHOUT_REWARDS_LABEL",{boss=T.boss,
                    nativeOpen=nativeOpenVerified,continueVisible=buttonReady})
            end
        end
        local method,success,reason
        if controller then
            method="NATIVE_DISMISS"
            -- Set BEFORE dispatch, so a late callback cannot send it twice.
            T.reportContinueAttempted=true
            T.reportContinueAt=os.clock()
            success,reason=pcall(controller.Dismiss,"continue")
        else
            local button=reportContinueButton(g)
            if not button then
                if not T.reportNoButtonLogged then
                    T.reportNoButtonLogged=true
                    log("REPORT_CONTINUE_UNAVAILABLE",{boss=T.boss,reason="NATIVE_CONTROLLER_AND_BUTTON_MISSING"})
                end
                return
            end
            local fire=type(firesignal)=="function" and firesignal or nil
            if not fire then
                if not T.reportNoButtonLogged then
                    T.reportNoButtonLogged=true
                    log("REPORT_CONTINUE_UNAVAILABLE",{boss=T.boss,reason="GUI_SIGNAL_CAPABILITY_MISSING"})
                end
                return
            end
            method="GUI_SIGNAL_ACTIVATED"
            T.reportContinueAttempted=true
            T.reportContinueAt=os.clock()
            success,reason=pcall(fire,button.Activated)
        end
