        log("REPORT_CONTINUE_REQUESTED",{boss=T.boss,method=method,dispatched=success,
            error=success and nil or tostring(reason),oneShot=true})
    end

    local function cleanupAdapter()
        local adapter=T.adapter
        if not adapter or T.combatRunning then return end
        adapter.runtime:shutdown("RIFT_MONITOR_END")
        if adapter.boss.report.cleanup then pcall(adapter.boss.report.cleanup,adapter.boss.report) end
    end
    local function monitorEncounter()
        local deadline=os.clock()+config.encounterTimeout
        local lastSignature,clearSince,lastActiveAt,unknownLogged
        local idDeadline=os.clock()+config.identifyTimeout
        while T.running and os.clock()<deadline do
            local parts=participantNames()
            local g,open=reportGui()
            local active=player:GetAttribute("InBossFight")==true or #parts>0 or player:GetAttribute("B21FightActive")==true
            local scoped=scopedRift()
            local noRift=not attrActive("RiftId") and not attrActive("RiftTier")
            local candidate,why=selectLocalBoss()
            if scoped and active and candidate then
                -- Prove that this exact Rift had a real native combat session.
                -- Some flight bosses (RQ-170 in particular) are never physically
                -- inside the Commander observer's static arena cylinder.
                T.scopedCombatObserved=true
                if not T.boss then
                    T.boss=candidate.id;T.spec=candidate;T.boundGeneration=generationFor(candidate)
                    log("BOSS_IDENTIFIED",{boss=T.boss,id=T.enteredRift,participant=candidate.participant,generation=T.boundGeneration})
                elseif T.boss~=candidate.id then
                    T.conflictingOutcome=true;log("ENCOUNTER_IDENTITY_CONFLICT",{first=T.boss,second=candidate.id})
                    if T.combatRuntime then T.combatRuntime:cancelActive(nil,"RIFT_IDENTITY_CHANGED") end
                end
                if T.spec and not T.conflictingOutcome then
                    bindBoss(T.spec)
                    if not open and not T.outcome then startCombat(T.adapter) end
                end
            elseif os.clock()>=idDeadline and not T.boss and not unknownLogged then
                unknownLogged=true;log("UNKNOWN_BOSS_MANUAL",{participants=parts,reason=why})
            end
            if active or scoped or open then lastActiveAt=os.clock() end
            -- Cooperative Rift hazard dodge runs only when explicit spatial geometry exists.
            -- No movement when packet contains Kind/Tier/Seed without verified positions.
            if T.hazardController and not open then
                local ok,err=pcall(T.hazardController.step,T.hazardController)
                if not ok and not T.hazardStepFailed then
                    T.hazardStepFailed=true;log("RIFT_HAZARD_STEP_ERROR",{reason=tostring(err)})
                end
            end
            local arena=physicalArena(T.adapter)
            if type(arena)=="boolean" then T.arenaEvidenceAvailable=true end
            if arena==true then T.arenaEntered=true end
            if T.arenaEntered and arena==false and getRoot() then T.arenaExitObserved=true end
            if open then
                if not T.outcome then T.reportPreOutcomeSeen=true end
                T.reportSeen=true;T.reportClosed=false;T.stage="REPORT_OPEN"
                inspectReport(g,T.spec)
                if T.reportIdentity and T.outcome then
                    if not T.continueHint then
                        T.continueHint=true
                        log("REPORT_READY",{boss=T.boss,outcome=T.outcome,rewardsShown=T.rewardsShown,
                            identitySource=T.reportIdentitySource,
                            autoContinue=config.autoContinueReport,rewardGrant="UNVERIFIED"})
                    end
                    tryAutoContinue(g,open)
                    if T.reportContinueAttempted and not T.reportContinueWarning and
                        os.clock()-(T.reportContinueAt or os.clock())>=config.reportContinueTimeout then
                        T.reportContinueWarning=true
                        log("REPORT_CONTINUE_UNVERIFIED",{boss=T.boss,
                            reason="REPORT_STILL_OPEN_AFTER_ONE_DISPATCH",manualContinuePossible=true})
                    end
                end
            elseif T.reportSeen then
                if not T.reportClosed then
                    T.reportClosed=true
                    log("REPORT_CLOSED_VERIFIED",{boss=T.boss,autoDispatched=T.reportContinueAttempted==true})
                end
            end
            -- Stop mechanics only after report or a correlated end; never drop ownership merely on portal collapse.
            if T.combatRuntime and (open or T.conflictingOutcome or (not active and noRift)) then
                T.combatRuntime:cancelActive(nil,"RIFT_COMBAT_ENDED_OR_REPORT")
            end
            local signature=table.concat({tostring(active),tostring(scoped),tostring(open),tostring(arena),tostring(T.outcome),table.concat(parts,",")},"|")
            if signature~=lastSignature then
                lastSignature=signature;log("LIFECYCLE_STATE",{boss=T.boss,active=active,riftScoped=scoped,report=open,inArena=arena,participants=parts,outcome=T.outcome})
            end
            if not open then
                if active then T.stage="COMBAT" elseif T.reportSeen then T.stage="EXIT_PENDING" else T.stage="OUTCOME_PENDING" end
            end
            local root,hum=getRoot()
            local quiet=not active and noRift and not open and root and hum and hum.Health>0 and not player.GameplayPaused
                and not attrActive("InPersonalHideout") and not attrActive("BossReviveDowned") and not T.combatRunning
                and game.PlaceId==T.originPlace and tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"))==T.encounterWorld
            if quiet then
                clearSince=clearSince or os.clock()
                -- Some Commander observers (notably Black Fortress) have no usable
                -- physical arena geometry. When none is available, use correlated
                -- report closure and fully cleared native combat/Rift flags, in a
                -- verified stable world. Collapse alone never authorizes completion.
                local geometryExit=T.arenaEvidenceAvailable and T.arenaEntered
                    and T.arenaExitObserved and arena==false
                local nativeExit=not T.arenaEvidenceAvailable and arena==nil and T.adapter~=nil
                -- Flight combat can be outside a Commander's fixed arena volume
                -- for its ENTIRE lifetime. In that case inArenaPosition() reports
                -- false before, during and after combat. The old geometryExit test
                -- was impossible, falsely holding Auto Repeat after a real WIN.
                -- Allow a stricter native-only exit ONLY when we personally saw
                -- scoped combat, the observer consistently stayed outside, the
                -- correlated Battle Report opened and closed, all native flags
                -- cleared, and the living player is stable in the encounter world.
                local outsideArenaFlightExit=T.arenaEvidenceAvailable
                    and not T.arenaEntered and arena==false
                    and T.scopedCombatObserved==true and T.adapter~=nil
                -- Terminal report can finish while the character remains physically
                -- inside the old Commander arena. Geometry alone must not hold the
                -- global scheduler after native flags are fully cleared.
                -- A failed combat adapter may also recover its verified terminal
                -- report/return, but is marked degraded so Rift will be deferred.
                local terminalReportWitness=T.scopedCombatObserved==true
                    and T.reportSeen==true and T.reportClosed==true
                    and T.reportIdentity==true and (T.outcome=="WIN" or T.outcome=="LOSS")
                    and not T.conflictingOutcome and not T.cleanupFailed
                local terminalWithoutGeometry=T.adapter~=nil and T.combatStarted==true
                    and terminalReportWitness
                local degradedAdapterRecovery=T.adapterFailed==true and T.adapter==nil
                    and terminalReportWitness
                local quietFor=os.clock()-clearSince
                local basis=nil
                if geometryExit and quietFor>=2 then
                    basis="ARENA_EXIT_AND_NATIVE"
                elseif nativeExit and quietFor>=5 then
                    basis="NATIVE_FLAGS_CLEARED_NO_GEOMETRY"
                elseif outsideArenaFlightExit and quietFor>=6 then
                    basis="SCOPED_COMBAT_REPORT_CLOSED_OUTSIDE_ARENA"
                elseif terminalWithoutGeometry and quietFor>=10 then
                    basis="SCOPED_TERMINAL_REPORT_NATIVE_FLAGS_CLEARED"
                elseif degradedAdapterRecovery and quietFor>=12 then
                    -- Recovery is verified, but combat was unprotected. Warn and
                    -- defer subsequent Rift jobs instead of silently claiming success.
                    T.recoveredWithoutCombatAdapter=true
                    basis="DEGRADED_COMBAT_ADAPTER_TERMINAL_RECOVERY"
                end
                if terminalReportWitness and basis then
                    T.stage="EXIT_VERIFIED"
                    log("EXIT_VERIFIED",{boss=T.boss,outcome=T.outcome,world=T.encounterWorld,
                        basis=basis,scopedCombatObserved=T.scopedCombatObserved,
                        degradedAdapter=T.recoveredWithoutCombatAdapter==true})
                    cleanupAdapter();return true
                end
                if os.clock()-clearSince>=config.exitEvidenceTimeout then
                    T.stage="EXIT_UNVERIFIED";log("EXIT_UNVERIFIED",{boss=T.boss,outcome=T.outcome,
                        reportSeen=T.reportSeen,reportIdentity=T.reportIdentity,
                        arenaEvidenceAvailable=T.arenaEvidenceAvailable,
                        arenaEntered=T.arenaEntered,arenaExitObserved=T.arenaExitObserved,
                        scopedCombatObserved=T.scopedCombatObserved,
                        reason="TERMINAL_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE"});cleanupAdapter();return false
                end
            else clearSince=nil end
            task.wait(.25)
        end
        if T.running then T.stage="ENCOUNTER_TIMEOUT";log("ENCOUNTER_TIMEOUT",{boss=T.boss,outcome=T.outcome,reportSeen=T.reportSeen}) end
        cleanupAdapter();return false
    end

    local function finishEncounter()
        T.encounterWorld=tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"))
        log("RIFT_SESSION_ACTIVE",{id=T.enteredRift,world=T.encounterWorld})
        local verified=monitorEncounter()
        if verified and T.running then
            local returned=true
            if config.returnHome and T.originWorld and T.originWorld~=T.encounterWorld then
                returned=false
                task.wait(1.5)
                if T.running then
                    local ok,why=travelWorld(T.originWorld)
                    returned=ok
                    log("RETURN_RESULT",{ok=ok,reason=why,world=player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"),origin=T.originWorld})
                end
            end
            if returned then
                T.completed=true;T.stage="COMPLETE_OBSERVED"
                log("COMPLETE_OBSERVED",{outcome=T.outcome,boss=T.boss,world=player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"),rewardGrant="UNVERIFIED"})
            else T.stage="RETURN_UNVERIFIED" end
        end
    end

    local function prepareRepeat()
        -- Called ONLY after COMPLETE_OBSERVED, with no active combat and a verified return.
        if not T.completed or T.combatRunning then return false,"ENCOUNTER_NOT_COMPLETE" end
        local oldId=T.enteredRift or T.currentRift
        if oldId then T.failedUntil[oldId]=math.huge end -- prevent reuse of a just consumed portal
        T.lastEncounter={id=oldId,boss=T.boss,outcome=T.outcome,world=T.encounterWorld,
            completedAt=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()}
        T.completedCount=T.completedCount+1
        log("REPEAT_CYCLE_COMPLETE",{count=T.completedCount,id=oldId,boss=T.boss,outcome=T.outcome})
        if T.adapter then cleanupAdapter() end
        if T.hazardController then T.hazardController:reset() end
        -- Session-local evidence must never bleed into the next random Commander.
        for _,field in ipairs({"currentRift","joinedRift","enteredRift","sessionStarted",
            "refused","partyLeft","selectedTier","encounterWorld","boss","spec",
            "boundGeneration","adapter","adapterFailed","combatStarted","combatRunning",
            "combatRuntime","combatError","cleanupFailed","outcome","outcomeSource",
            "conflictingOutcome","reportSeen","reportClosed","reportIdentity","rewardsShown",
            "reportIdentitySource","outcomeObservedAt","reportPreOutcomeSeen",
            "reportRewardsNotObservedLogged","reportNativeReadyLogged",
            "continueHint","reportReadyAt","reportContinueAttempted","reportContinueAt",
            "reportContinueWarning","reportNotReadyLogged","reportNoButtonLogged",
            "arenaEvidenceAvailable","arenaEntered","arenaExitObserved","scopedCombatObserved",
            "eventPhase","b2Start","zeppelinStart","hazardStepFailed","combatContext"}) do
            T[field]=nil
        end
        T.completed=false
        T.stage="WAIT_NATURAL_RIFT"
        log("REPEAT_SEARCH_READY",{completedCount=T.completedCount,world=player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"),
            autoRepeat=config.autoRepeat})
        return true
    end

    local function run()
        log("ENCOUNTER_CATALOG_READY",{count=#Registry.specs,airRaidExcluded=true,source="V3_COMMANDER_COMPAT"})
        log("INIT",{world=T.originWorld,autoTravel=config.autoTravel,autoApproach=config.autoApproach,
            autoJoin=config.autoJoin,directTP=config.directTP,targetTier=config.targetTier,targetBoss=config.targetBoss,
            targetWorld=config.targetWorld,autoRepeat=config.autoRepeat,autoContinueReport=config.autoContinueReport,
            summon="DISABLED_NO_PURCHASES",bossCombat="COMMANDER_CANDIDATES_EXPERIMENTAL"})
        local folder=workspace:FindFirstChild("Rifts") or workspace:WaitForChild("Rifts",25)
        if not folder then
            log("RIFTS_FOLDER_MISSING",{note="Rift may not be enabled/loaded in this place"})
            T.stage="NO_RIFTS_FOLDER"
            T.running=false
            return
        end
        table.insert(T.connections,folder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
            log("RIFT_SPAWNED",{id=child.Name})
        end))
        local lastEmpty=0
        -- A Launch timeout must be owned by a confirmed party, never by the
        -- previous completed cycle or the idle search loop.
        local partyDeadline=nil
        local partyDeadlineRift=nil
        while T.running do
            if context:isCancelled() then
                T:stop()
                break
            end
            if T.partyLeft then T.stage="PARTY_LEFT";T.running=false;log("PARTY_LEFT",{});break end
            if inFight() or T.joinedRift or T.enteredRift or T.sessionStarted then
                if T.joinedRift or T.enteredRift then T.stage="PARTY_OR_COMBAT" end
                if T.sessionStarted then
                    finishEncounter()
                    if T.completed then
                        if config.autoRepeat and T.running then
                            local ok,why=prepareRepeat()
                            if not ok then
                                T.stage="REPEAT_HELD";log("REPEAT_HELD",{reason=why});T.running=false;break
                            end
                            partyDeadline=nil
                            partyDeadlineRift=nil
                            task.wait(config.repeatInterval)
                        else
                            T.running=false
                            break
                        end
                    else
                        -- Never start a new Rift after an unverified outcome, report, exit, or return.
                        if T.running then
                            log("REPEAT_HELD",{stage=T.stage,reason="TERMINAL_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE"})
                        end
                        T.running=false
                        break
                    end
                else
                    -- The first post-repeat tick must NOT arm a Launch timeout
                    -- until the next Rift has actually accepted our entry.
                    local activePartyId=T.enteredRift or T.joinedRift
                    if not activePartyId then
                        T.stage="RIFT_SCOPE_UNVERIFIED"
                        log("RIFT_SCOPE_UNVERIFIED",{reason="FIGHT_FLAG_WITHOUT_JOINED_RIFT"})
                        T.running=false
                        break
                    end
                    if partyDeadlineRift~=activePartyId or not partyDeadline then
                        partyDeadlineRift=activePartyId
                        partyDeadline=os.clock()+config.launchTimeout
                        log("PARTY_LAUNCH_WAIT_STARTED",{id=activePartyId,timeout=config.launchTimeout})
                    end
                    if os.clock()>=partyDeadline or T.partyLeft then
                        T.stage="LAUNCH_UNVERIFIED"
                        log("LAUNCH_UNVERIFIED",{id=T.enteredRift,partyId=partyDeadlineRift,
                            reason="CURRENT_PARTY_LAUNCH_TIMEOUT",timeout=config.launchTimeout})
                        T.running=false
                        break
                    end
                    task.wait(.25)
                end
            else
                local best,count=chooseRift()
                if best then
                    -- A selected new Rift never inherits a previous party timer.
                    partyDeadline=nil
                    partyDeadlineRift=nil
                    log("RIFTS_AVAILABLE",{count=count,chosen=best.id})
                    local ok,why=executeCandidate(best)
                    if ok then
                        log("ENTRY_FLOW_FINISHED",{id=best.id,party=T.joinedRift,reason=why})
                        if why=="ENTRY_DISABLED" then
                            T.stage="ENTRY_DISABLED";T.running=false;break
                        end
                    else
                        log("ENTRY_FLOW_FAILED",{id=best.id,reason=why})
                        T.failedUntil[best.id]=os.clock()+60
                        if not config.autoRepeat then
                            T.stage="ENTRY_NOT_CONFIRMED"
                            T.running=false
                            break
                        end
                    end
                else
                    if schedulerManaged then
                        T.stage="RIFT_NO_CANDIDATE"
                        log("SCHEDULER_RESCAN",{reason="NO_ELIGIBLE_RIFT",releaseOwnership=true})
                        T.running=false
                        break
                    end
                    T.stage="WAIT_NATURAL_RIFT"
                    if os.clock()-lastEmpty>20 then
                        lastEmpty=os.clock()
                        log("WAITING",{world=player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"),visibleRifts=#listRifts(),
                            note="Natural Rifts may take minutes to spawn; no paid summon is sent"})
                    end
                    task.wait(tonumber(config.scanInterval) or 2.5)
                end
            end
        end
        if T.combatRuntime then T.combatRuntime:shutdown("MONITOR_END") end
        cleanupAdapter()
        if not T.completed and T.stage=="TRAVEL_WORLD" then T.stage="RETURN_UNVERIFIED" end
        log("MONITOR_ENDED",{stage=T.stage,completed=T.completed,joined=T.joinedRift})
        for _,con in ipairs(T.connections) do pcall(function() con:Disconnect() end) end
        table.clear(T.connections)
    end

    -- Called synchronously by V6; the active scheduler job is exclusive until exit/return.
    local ok,err=xpcall(run,function(e) return tostring(e) end)
    if not ok then
        T.stage="ERROR"
        log("UNHANDLED_ERROR",{error=tostring(err)})
        T.running=false
        if T.combatRuntime then T.combatRuntime:shutdown("ERROR") end
        cleanupAdapter()
        for _,con in ipairs(T.connections) do pcall(function() con:Disconnect() end) end
        table.clear(T.connections)
    end
    return T
end
return ManagedRunner
end
-- END MODULE rift.ManagedRunner

-- BEGIN MODULE rift.compat.B21CombatController
__factories["rift.compat.B21CombatController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local Contracts = require("main.core.Contracts")
local CombatController = {}
function CombatController.new(env, config, observer, radar, dodge, report, weather)
    local platform, movement, runtime = env.services.roblox, env.services.movement, env.runtime
    local riftHazards=env.services.riftHazards
    local combat = {}
    function combat:run(ctx, encounter)
        if not ctx:await(function() return observer:inArena() and true or nil end, config.arenaTimeout) then
            return {code = "ARENA_UNVERIFIED"}
        end
        if not ctx:await(function() local visuals = observer:folders(); return visuals end, config.visualsTimeout) then
            return {code = "ARENA_NOT_STREAMED"}
        end
        if not ctx:await(function() local _, radars = observer:folders(); return radars end, config.childrenTimeout)
            or not ctx:await(function() local _, _, bombs = observer:folders(); return bombs end, config.childrenTimeout) then
            return {code = "ARENA_NOT_STREAMED"}
        end
        local character = platform:character()
        if not character.ready or ctx:isCancelled() then return {code = "CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE"} end
        local lease, leaseCode = movement:acquire(ctx)
        if not lease then return {code = leaseCode} end
        -- This is the only combat lease. All radar paths, holds, and Dodge calls are serial.
        local speedSet, speedCode = movement:setSpeed(ctx, lease, env.profile.boss.walkSpeed)
        if not speedSet then assert(movement:release(lease)); return {code = speedCode} end
        local session = {
            character = character.character, root = character.root, humanoid = character.humanoid,
            completed = Contracts.copy(encounter.completedPhases or {}),
            -- Old checkpoints may have inferred phases from radar refreeze.
            -- Demand a fresh HUD observation before acting on a phase.
            observedPhase = nil, confirmedPhase = nil,
            nextAttempt = {}, failures = {}, lastDodgeAt = -math.huge,
            lastDeiceAt = runtime:now() - math.max(0, runtime:epoch() - (encounter.lastDeiceAt or 0)),
            deadline = runtime:now() + (config.maxRuntime or env.profile.boss.maxRuntime),
            ending = function()
                local evidence = report:inspect()
                return evidence.active or evidence.outcome ~= nil or observer:reviveState() ~= nil
            end,
        }
        local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
        local stopFrames = telemetry and telemetry:startFrames(ctx, platform)
        -- Radar/Repair owns the movement lease during maintenance. Dodge must
        -- not interrupt a required 1.6s/3s hold or repeatedly starve navigation.
        -- Character death, cancellation and encounter end remain checked by radar.
        session.radarFocus = false
        session.immediateThreat = function()
            return not session.radarFocus and dodge:threat()
        end
        session.navigationInterrupt = function()
            if session.radarFocus or not dodge:threat() then return nil end
            movement:stop(ctx, lease)
            local ok, dodgeCode = dodge:step(ctx, lease, session, true)
            if not ok then return dodgeCode end
            if session.dodgeTarget and dodgeCode == "TARGET_RETAINED" then
                local moved, moveCode = movement:moveTo(ctx, lease, session.dodgeTarget, true)
                if not moved then return moveCode end
            end
            if telemetry then telemetry:emit("DODGE_INTERRUPT", {phase = session.observedPhase, code = dodgeCode}, 0.5) end
            return "DODGE_INTERRUPTED"
        end
        -- Stage through the normal combat tick, only after the first danger scan.
        -- Actionable radar maintenance still takes priority immediately.
        local staged = false
        local code = "COMBAT_TIMEOUT"
        local weatherSnapshot, lastWeatherSignature, nextWeatherLog = nil, nil, 0
        while not ctx:isCancelled() and runtime:now() < session.deadline do
            local evidence = report:inspect()
            if evidence.active or evidence.outcome then code = "AWAIT_REPORT"; break end
            -- Downed/revive is NOT final defeat. Stop movement and wait for the
            -- actual result, manual revive, or a character change.
            local revive = observer:reviveState()
            if revive then
                movement:stop(ctx, lease)
                if telemetry then telemetry:emit("B21_REVIVE_PENDING", {state = revive}, 4) end
                if not ctx:wait(config.combatPoll) then break end
            else
            local current = platform:character()
            if current.character ~= session.character or current.root ~= session.root or current.humanoid ~= session.humanoid
                or not current.ready then code = "CHARACTER_CHANGED"; break end
            if not observer:inArena() then code = "ARENA_LEFT"; break end
            local phase = observer:resolvedPhase(session)
            -- Weather inspection is advisory only; no unverified altitude teleport.
            if weather then
                weatherSnapshot = weather:inspect()
                local signature = weatherSnapshot and (weatherSnapshot.kind .. ":" .. weatherSnapshot.stage) or "UNKNOWN"
                if signature ~= lastWeatherSignature or runtime:now() >= nextWeatherLog then
                    if telemetry then telemetry:emit("B21_WEATHER", weatherSnapshot or {kind = "UNKNOWN"}, 1) end
                    lastWeatherSignature, nextWeatherLog = signature, runtime:now() + 8
                end
            end
            -- Select maintenance FIRST, even if the HUD is absent/offscreen.
            -- Radar selection uses the world prompt + Beacon/Lock, never GUI.
            local item = radar:select(session, false)
            if item then
                if riftHazards then riftHazards:radarPriority(phase,item.part and item.part.Name) end
                session.radarFocus = true
                movement:stop(ctx, lease)
                if telemetry then telemetry:emit("B21_RADAR_PRIORITY", {phase = phase,
                    phaseSource = session.phaseSource, radar = item.part.Name}, 1) end
                local ran, radarOK, radarCode = pcall(radar.step, radar, ctx, lease, session, phase, item)
                session.radarFocus = false
                if not ran then
                    code = "RADAR_STEP_EXCEPTION:" .. tostring(radarOK)
                    break
                end
                if session.fatalInputCode then code = session.fatalInputCode; break end
                if radarCode == "CHARACTER_CHANGED" or radarCode == "DEAD" or radarCode == "CANCELLED" then
                    code = radarCode; break
                end
            else
                -- Only dodge after radar has no actionable maintenance this tick.
                local interruption = session.navigationInterrupt()
                if interruption and interruption ~= "DODGE_INTERRUPTED" then code = interruption; break end
                if interruption ~= "DODGE_INTERRUPTED" then
                    -- Without actionable maintenance, hazard avoidance runs in EVERY
                    -- phase. Optional Phase-I staging must never suppress dodge.
                    local ok, dodgeCode = dodge:step(ctx, lease, session)
                    if not ok then code = dodgeCode; break end
                    -- Native B-21 bomb dodge takes priority. Rift hazard movement
                    -- runs only with no actionable radar and no native bomb threat,
                    -- reusing the already-owned combat lease.
                    if dodgeCode == "SAFE" and riftHazards then
                        local hazardOK,hazardError=pcall(riftHazards.step,riftHazards,ctx,lease)
                        if not hazardOK and telemetry then telemetry:emit("RIFT_HAZARD_B21_STEP_ERROR",{reason=tostring(hazardError)},2) end
                    end
                    if phase == 1 and not staged and dodgeCode == "SAFE" then
                        staged = radar:preposition(ctx, lease, session)
                    end
                end
            end
            if telemetry then telemetry:flush(false) end
            if not ctx:wait(config.combatPoll) then break end
            end -- non-downed branch
        end
        movement:stop(ctx, lease)
        local released, releaseCode = movement:release(lease)
        assert(released, releaseCode or "Combat movement release failed")
        if stopFrames then stopFrames() end
        if telemetry then telemetry:flush(true) end
        return {code = ctx:isCancelled() and "CANCELLED" or code, completedPhases = Contracts.copy(session.completed)}
    end
    return combat
end
return CombatController
end
-- END MODULE rift.compat.B21CombatController

__factories["rift.combat.F117"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local Config=require("boss.F117.Config")
local ArenaObserver=require("boss.F117.ArenaObserver")
local CombatController=require("boss.F117.CombatController")

        local observer=ArenaObserver.new(env,Config)

        local repeatPolicy=RepeatPolicy.new(env)

            repeatPolicy=repeatPolicy,combat=CombatController.new(env,Config,observer,report,flight)}
    end}
end

-- BEGIN MODULE rift.compat.B21RadarController
__factories["rift.compat.B21RadarController"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
local RadarController = {}
function RadarController.new(env, config, observer)
    local platform, movement, runtime = env.services.roblox, env.services.movement, env.runtime
    local radar, navigationSequence = {}, 0
    local function valid(ctx, session, item, phase, staging)
        if ctx:isCancelled() or not runtime:isActive(ctx) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
        local current = platform:character()
        if current.character ~= session.character or current.root ~= session.root or current.humanoid ~= session.humanoid
            or not current.ready then return false, "CHARACTER_CHANGED" end
        if session.ending and session.ending() then return false, "COMBAT_ENDED" end
        local _, folder = observer:folders()
        if not folder or not item.prompt:IsDescendantOf(folder) or item.prompt:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BasePart") ~= item.part then
            return false, "RADAR_REPLACED"
        end
        if not observer:inArena() or observer:resolvedPhase(session) ~= phase then return false, "PHASE_CHANGED" end
        if not staging then
            local state = observer:radarState(item)
            if not (state.status == "FROZEN" and state.action == "deice"
                or state.status == "DOWN" and state.action == "repair") then
                return false, "RADAR_INACTIVE"
            end
        end
        return true
    end
    function radar:select(session, staging)
        local _, states = observer:observe(session)
        session.attemptGenerations = session.attemptGenerations or {}
        for _, item in ipairs(observer:radars(staging)) do
            local state = states[item.prompt]
            if staging then return item end
            if state and state.generation ~= session.attemptGenerations[item.prompt] then
                session.attemptGenerations[item.prompt] = state.generation
                session.nextAttempt[item.prompt], session.failures[item.prompt] = nil, nil
            end
            local eligible = state and (state.status == "FROZEN" and state.action == "deice"
                or state.status == "DOWN" and state.action == "repair" and config.enableRepair == true)
            -- Failure counts only control retry backoff, never eligibility.
            -- A frozen radar remains serviceable in every phase and freeze cycle.
            if eligible and (session.nextAttempt[item.prompt] or 0) <= runtime:now() then return item end
        end
    end
    local function reached(item, staging)
        local reach = staging and math.max(3.5, math.min(7, item.prompt.MaxActivationDistance - 2))
            or math.max(2, item.prompt.MaxActivationDistance - 0.4)
        local position = platform:position()
        return position and platform:distance(position, item.part.Position) <= reach
    end
    -- User-tested direct radar hop. One PivotTo at most per radar maintenance cycle.
    -- Ground and in-arena verification are mandatory; NAV remains a safe fallback
    -- when no ground-verified destination exists.
    local function tryDirectHop(ctx, lease, session, item, phase, staging)
        session.directRadarHops = session.directRadarHops or {}
        local state = observer:radarState(item)
        local cycle = staging and "STAGING" or tostring(phase) .. ":" .. tostring(state.generation)
        if session.directRadarHops[item.prompt] == cycle then return false, "DIRECT_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED" end
        session.directRadarHops[item.prompt] = cycle
        local permitted, reason = valid(ctx, session, item, phase, staging)
        if not permitted then return false, reason end
        if session.immediateThreat and session.immediateThreat() then return false, "DODGE_INTERRUPTED" end
        local before = platform:character()
        if not before.ready then return false, "CHARACTER_CHANGED" end
        local at = item.part.Position
        if item.prompt.Parent and item.prompt.Parent:IsA("Attachment") then
            at = item.prompt.Parent.WorldPosition
        end
        local reference = platform:vector(before.position.X - at.X, 0, before.position.Z - at.Z)
        if reference.Magnitude < 0.01 then reference = platform:vector(1, 0, 0) end
        reference = reference.Unit
        local _, radars, bombs = observer:folders()
        local reach = staging and math.max(3.5, math.min(7, item.prompt.MaxActivationDistance - 2))
            or math.max(2, item.prompt.MaxActivationDistance - 0.4)
        for index = 0, 7 do
            permitted, reason = valid(ctx, session, item, phase, staging)
            if not permitted then return false, reason end
            if session.immediateThreat and session.immediateThreat() then return false, "DODGE_INTERRUPTED" end
            local angle = index * math.pi / 4
            local direction = platform:vector(reference.X * math.cos(angle) - reference.Z * math.sin(angle), 0,
                reference.X * math.sin(angle) + reference.Z * math.cos(angle))
            local destination = movement:ground(at + direction * 4, {mode = "radar", exclude = {radars, bombs}})
            if destination and platform:distance(destination, at) <= reach then
                movement:stop(ctx, lease)
                local wrote, err = pcall(function() session.character:PivotTo(CFrame.new(destination)) end)
                if not wrote then return false, "DIRECT_RADAR_WRITE_FAILED: " .. tostring(err) end
                if not ctx:wait(0.5) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
                local current = platform:character()
                if current.ready and current.character == session.character and observer:inArena()
                    and current.humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air
                    and platform:distance(current.position, destination) <= 5
                    and platform:distance(current.position, at) <= reach then
                    return true, "DIRECT_RADAR_VERIFIED"
                end
                -- Position changed but was not confirmed: never blindly PivotTo again.
                return false, "DIRECT_RADAR_AMBIGUOUS"
            end
        end
        return false, "DIRECT_NO_SAFE_GROUND"
    end

    function radar:travel(ctx, lease, session, item, phase, staging)
        session.navigationGoal = item.part.Position
        local started, telemetry = runtime:now(), env.services.telemetry
        local origin = platform:position()
        navigationSequence = navigationSequence + 1
        local stats = {phase = phase, staging = staging or false, distance = origin and platform:distance(origin, item.part.Position),
            pathComputations = 0, pathMs = 0, waypointCount = 0, mode = "DIRECT", leaseJob = ctx.jobId,
            navId = tostring(ctx.jobId) .. ":" .. navigationSequence, radarPath = observer:radarState(item).radarPath}
        stats.requestedMode = env.profile.navigation.movementMode
        -- Direct radar hop is attempted before walking; do not depend on a HYBRID flag.
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit("NAV_BEGIN", stats) end
        local deadline = math.min(session.deadline, runtime:now() + (staging and env.profile.boss.stageTimeout or 30))
        local function check()
            local permitted, code = valid(ctx, session, item, phase, staging)
            if not permitted then return false, code end
            if runtime:now() >= deadline then return false, "RADAR_TIMEOUT" end
            if session.navigationInterrupt then
                local reason = session.navigationInterrupt()
                if reason then return false, reason end
            end
            return true
        end
        local function travel()
            if not reached(item, staging) then
                local directOk, directCode = tryDirectHop(ctx, lease, session, item, phase, staging)
                if directOk then stats.mode = "TELEPORT"; return true, directCode end
                stats.teleportFallback = directCode
                if directCode == "DIRECT_RADAR_AMBIGUOUS" or directCode == "DODGE_INTERRUPTED"
                    or directCode == "CANCELLED" or directCode == "PHASE_CHANGED" then
                    return false, directCode
                end
            end
            for attempt = 1, env.profile.radar.attempts do
                local permitted, code = check()
                if not permitted then return false, code end
                if reached(item, staging) then return true, "REACHED" end
                local position = platform:position()
                local reference = platform:vector(position.X - item.part.Position.X, 0, position.Z - item.part.Position.Z)
                if reference.Magnitude < 0.01 then reference = platform:vector(1, 0, 0) end
                reference = reference.Unit
                local radius = math.max(2, math.min(5, item.prompt.MaxActivationDistance - 1.5))
                local _, radars, bombs = observer:folders()
                local pathBudget = env.profile.radar.pathBudget or 2
                -- Nearest approach first. Stop at the first usable route, bounded to two computes per attempt.
                for i = 0, pathBudget - 1 do
                    permitted, code = check()
                    if not permitted then return false, code end
                    local angle = ((i + (attempt - 1) * 2) % 8) * math.pi / 4
                    local offset = platform:vector(reference.X * math.cos(angle) - reference.Z * math.sin(angle), 0,
                        reference.X * math.sin(angle) + reference.Z * math.cos(angle))
                    local goal = movement:ground(item.part.Position + offset * radius, {mode = "radar", exclude = {bombs, radars}})
                    if goal and platform:distance(goal, item.part.Position) <= item.prompt.MaxActivationDistance - 0.25 then
                        local options = {mode = "radar", deadline = deadline, exclude = {bombs, radars},
                            waypointReach = staging and 1 or 4,
                            stop = function() return reached(item, staging) end,
                            valid = function() return valid(ctx, session, item, phase, staging) end,
                            interrupt = session.navigationInterrupt}
                        local result = movement:followDirect(ctx, lease, goal, options)
                        if result.code == "DIRECT_BLOCKED" or result.code == "STUCK" then
                            movement:stop(ctx, lease)
                            permitted, code = check()
                            if not permitted then return false, code end
                            stats.mode = "PATH"
                            local computeAt = runtime:now()
                            local path, pathCode = platform:computePath(platform:position(), goal, {AgentRadius = 2, AgentHeight = 5,
                                AgentCanJump = true, WaypointSpacing = env.profile.radar.waypointSpacing})
                            stats.pathComputations, stats.pathMs = stats.pathComputations + 1, stats.pathMs + (runtime:now() - computeAt) * 1000
                            -- ComputeAsync yields; no movement before identity/phase/danger/deadline checks.
                            permitted, code = check()
                            if not permitted then return false, code end
                            if path then
                                stats.waypointCount = stats.waypointCount + #path:GetWaypoints()
                                result = movement:followPath(ctx, lease, path, options)
                            else result = {code = pathCode or "NO_PATH"} end
                        end
                        if result.ok then return true, "REACHED" end
                        if result.code == "PATH_CLEANUP_FAILED" then error(result.code, 0) end
                        if result.code ~= "NO_PATH" and result.code ~= "PATH_ERROR" and result.code ~= "BLOCKED"
                            and result.code ~= "STUCK" and result.code ~= "WAYPOINT_TIMEOUT" and result.code ~= "GOAL_UNVERIFIED"
                            and result.code ~= "NO_WAYPOINTS" then return false, result.code end
                    end
                end
                -- Even immediate NoPath responses must yield before a retry.
                local remaining = deadline - runtime:now()
                if attempt < env.profile.radar.attempts and remaining > 0 then ctx:wait(math.min(env.profile.navigation.radarPoll, remaining)) end
            end
            return false, "RADAR_UNREACHABLE"
        end
        local ran, ok, code = pcall(travel)
        -- A Dodge interruption has already stopped radar and issued the escape MoveTo on this lease.
        if code ~= "DODGE_INTERRUPTED" then movement:stop(ctx, lease) end
        stats.elapsedMs, stats.ok, stats.code = (runtime:now() - started) * 1000, ran and ok or false, ran and code or "NAVIGATION_ERROR"
        stats.remainingDistance = platform:position() and platform:distance(platform:position(), item.part.Position) or nil
        if telemetry then telemetry:emit("NAV_END", stats) end
        if not ran then error(ok, 0) end
        return ok, code
    end
    function radar:preposition(ctx, lease, session)
        local item = self:select(session, true)
        if not item then return false, "RADAR_NOT_STREAMED" end
        return self:travel(ctx, lease, session, item, 1, true)
    end
    function radar:deice(ctx, lease, session, item, phase)
        -- Completion is per maintenance cycle, never latched for the whole phase.
        -- Repeat freezes may happen in the same phase (squall).
        local permitted, code = valid(ctx, session, item, phase, false)
        if not permitted then return false, code end
        if session.immediateThreat and session.immediateThreat() then return false, "DODGE_INTERRUPTED" end
        if not reached(item, false) then return false, "PROMPT_OUT_OF_RANGE" end
        movement:stop(ctx, lease)
        local function snapshot()
            local currentPhase, states = observer:observe(session)
            local state = states[item.prompt] or {status = "UNAVAILABLE", observedAt = runtime:now(), epoch = runtime:epoch()}
            state.phase, state.phaseSource, state.hudPhase = currentPhase, session.phaseSource, session.hudPhase
            return state
        end
        local start = snapshot()
        local action = start.status == "FROZEN" and "DEICE" or start.status == "DOWN" and "REPAIR" or nil
        if start.phase ~= phase or not action then return false, "RADAR_INACTIVE" end
        if action == "REPAIR" and not config.enableRepair then return false, "REPAIR_NOT_ENABLED" end
        local transaction = {phase = phase, action = action, start = start}
        local function sameRadar(state)
            return state.radar == start.radar and state.prompt == start.prompt and state.part == start.part
                and state.beacon == start.beacon and state.lock == start.lock and state.generation == start.generation
        end
        local function observeCompletion()
            local state = snapshot()
            local current = platform:character()
            if current.character == session.character and current.root == session.root and current.humanoid == session.humanoid
                and current.ready and sameRadar(state) and state.phase == phase and state.status == "TRACKING"
                and (not transaction.reconcileDeadline or state.observedAt <= transaction.reconcileDeadline) then
                transaction.proof = transaction.proof or state
            end
            return state
        end
        local function verify()
            observeCompletion()
            return transaction.proof
        end
        -- The game client normally converts prompt hold begin/end into
        -- B21Radar:FireServer("Begin"/"End", radarId). Send that protocol
        -- directly so camera focus and prompt GUI rendering are irrelevant.
        -- One Begin and one End maximum per transaction, with End cleanup even
        -- if the character changes or the job is cancelled mid-hold.
        local result = {code = "DIRECT_RADAR_NOT_SENT", dispatched = false,
            diagnostics = {path = "B21Radar_REMOTE_HOLD", action = action}}
        local id = tonumber((start.radar and start.radar.Name or ""):match("^B21Radar(%d+)$"))
        local remotes = platform:service("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        local remote = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("B21Radar")
        if not id or not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
            result.code = "B21_RADAR_REMOTE_OR_ID_MISSING"
        else
            local beginOK, beginError = pcall(function() remote:FireServer("Begin", id) end)
            if not beginOK then
                result.code = "B21_RADAR_BEGIN_FAILED"
                result.diagnostics.beginError = tostring(beginError)
            else
                result.dispatched = true
                result.diagnostics.radarId = id
                local telemetry = env.services.telemetry
                local started = runtime:now()
                local holdCode = nil
                -- A radar observation can yield or consume the remainder of the hold.
                -- Recalculate remaining time immediately before wait; NEVER pass a
                -- negative/NaN duration into JobContext.wait. Guard the entire hold
                -- so that a successful Begin always has a matching End, including
                -- when observation or telemetry unexpectedly errors.
                local holdOK, holdError = pcall(function()
                    if telemetry then telemetry:emit("B21_DIRECT_RADAR_BEGIN", {id = id, action = action,
                        phase = phase, phaseSource = start.phaseSource}, 0.5) end
                    local duration = math.max(0, tonumber(item.prompt.HoldDuration) or
                        (action == "REPAIR" and 3 or 1.6)) + 0.25
                    local poll = env.profile.scheduler.poll
                    while runtime:isActive(ctx) and not ctx:isCancelled() do
                        local remaining = duration - (runtime:now() - started)
                        if remaining <= 0 then break end
                        local state = observeCompletion()
                        if transaction.proof then break end
                        if not sameRadar(state) then holdCode = "RADAR_REPLACED"; break end
                        local permitted, reason = valid(ctx, session, item, phase, false)
                        if not permitted then holdCode = reason; break end
                        -- Observation may have crossed the deadline; do not rely on
                        -- the remaining value computed at the start of this tick.
                        remaining = duration - (runtime:now() - started)
                        if remaining <= 0 then break end
                        if type(poll) ~= "number" or poll ~= poll or poll <= 0 or poll == math.huge then
                            holdCode = "RADAR_POLL_INVALID"; break
                        end
                        if not ctx:wait(math.min(poll, remaining)) then
                            holdCode = "CANCELLED"; break
                        end
                    end
                end)
                if not holdOK then
                    holdCode = "RADAR_HOLD_EXCEPTION"
                    result.diagnostics.holdError = tostring(holdError)
                end
                -- ALWAYS attempt End after a successful Begin. The server
                -- validates real hold duration, distance and radar state.
                local endOK, endError = pcall(function() remote:FireServer("End", id) end)
                result.diagnostics.holdSeconds = runtime:now() - started
                if telemetry then telemetry:emit("B21_DIRECT_RADAR_END", {id = id, action = action,
                    seconds = result.diagnostics.holdSeconds, sent = endOK}, 0.5) end
                if not endOK then
                    result.code = "INPUT_CLEANUP_FAILED"
                    result.diagnostics.endError = tostring(endError)
                elseif ctx:isCancelled() or not runtime:isActive(ctx) then
                    result.code = "CANCELLED"
                else
                    result.code = holdCode or "DIRECT_RADAR_HOLD_SENT"
                end
            end
        end
        transaction.inputCode, transaction.inputDiagnostics = result.code, result.diagnostics
        if result.code == "B21_RADAR_BEGIN_FAILED" or result.code == "INPUT_CLEANUP_FAILED" then
            session.fatalInputCode = result.code
        end
        -- No input retries in this window: late replication may follow a partial dispatch.
        local reconcileUntil = math.min(session.deadline, runtime:now() + (config.reconcileWindow or 0.75))
        transaction.reconcileDeadline = reconcileUntil
        if result.dispatched and result.code ~= "INPUT_CLEANUP_FAILED" then
            while not transaction.proof and runtime:isActive(ctx) and not ctx:isCancelled() do
                local state = observeCompletion()
                if transaction.proof or not sameRadar(state) or state.phase ~= phase then break end
                local current = platform:character()
                if not current.ready or current.character ~= session.character or current.root ~= session.root
                    or current.humanoid ~= session.humanoid then break end
                local remaining = reconcileUntil - runtime:now()
                if remaining <= 0 then break end
                if not ctx:wait(math.min(env.profile.scheduler.poll, remaining)) then break end
            end
        end
        transaction.finish = observeCompletion()
        local current = platform:character()
        local safe = not ctx:isCancelled() and runtime:isActive(ctx) and current.ready
            and current.character == session.character and current.root == session.root and current.humanoid == session.humanoid
        local verified = transaction.proof ~= nil and safe and result.code ~= "INPUT_CLEANUP_FAILED"
        code = result.code
        if verified then code = action .. "_VERIFIED"
        elseif not safe then
            code = (ctx:isCancelled() or not runtime:isActive(ctx)) and "CANCELLED" or "CHARACTER_CHANGED"
        elseif transaction.finish.phase ~= phase then code = "PHASE_CHANGED" end
        transaction.code, transaction.completed = code, verified and true or false
        session.lastDeiceTransaction = transaction
        local function summary(state)
            return {phase = state.phase, phaseSource = state.phaseSource, hudPhase = state.hudPhase, status = state.status,
                radarPath = state.radarPath, generation = state.generation,
                beaconEnabled = state.beaconEnabled, lockEnabled = state.lockEnabled, promptEnabled = state.promptEnabled,
                observedAt = state.observedAt, epoch = state.epoch}
        end
        env.state:port("boss"):recordDeiceTransaction({phase = phase, action = action, start = summary(start),
            finish = summary(transaction.finish), proof = transaction.proof and summary(transaction.proof),
            code = code, completed = transaction.completed, inputCode = result.code,
            inputDiagnostics = result.diagnostics,
            reconcileDeadline = reconcileUntil,
            inputException = session.fatalInputCode and result.evidence or nil})
        if verified then
            session.completed[tostring(phase)], session.lastDeiceAt = true, runtime:now()
            session.failures[item.prompt] = nil
            session.nextAttempt[item.prompt] = runtime:now() + (config.maintenanceSettle or 1)
            env.state:port("boss"):recordRadar(phase, runtime:epoch())
            observer:observe(session)
            return true, action .. "_VERIFIED"
        end
        return false, code
    end
    function radar:step(ctx, lease, session, phase, item)
        local arrived, code = self:travel(ctx, lease, session, item, phase, false)
        local ok = false
        if arrived then ok, code = self:deice(ctx, lease, session, item, phase) end
        if not ok and code ~= "PHASE_CHANGED" and code ~= "REPAIR_NOT_ENABLED" and code ~= "RADAR_INACTIVE" and code ~= "RADAR_REPLACED" and code ~= "DODGE_INTERRUPTED" then
            session.nextAttempt[item.prompt] = runtime:now() + env.profile.radar.retry
            if code == "RADAR_UNREACHABLE" then
                local failures = (session.failures[item.prompt] or 0) + 1
                if failures >= env.profile.radar.maxFailures then
                    -- This is a temporary navigation backoff, NOT a permanent
                    -- ban on De-ice in the same phase or the same freeze cycle.
                    -- The game can ice a radar again at any time.
                    session.failures[item.prompt] = 0
                    session.nextAttempt[item.prompt] = runtime:now() + env.profile.radar.retry * 3
                    if env.services.telemetry then env.services.telemetry:emit("B21_RADAR_RETRY_RESET", {
                        radar = item.part.Name, failures = failures,
                        retrySeconds = env.profile.radar.retry * 3}, 1) end
                else
                    session.failures[item.prompt] = failures
                end
            end
        end
        return ok, code
    end
    return radar
end
return RadarController
end
-- END MODULE rift.compat.B21RadarController

    if type(readfile)~="function" or type(writefile)~="function" then return nil end

    if not p or p.UserId~=SW_CONTEXT.userId then return nil end
    local path="PlaneRNG_V6_Alpha_RaidHandoff_"..p.UserId..".json"
    local http=game:GetService("HttpService")

        local text=readfile(path)

end

-- Managed V6 local journal guard (one client; no cross-process atomic CAS).
local function swJournal()
    if type(readfile)~="function" or type(writefile)~="function" then return nil end
    local p=game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    if not p or p.UserId~=SW_CONTEXT.userId then return nil end
    local path="PlaneRNG_V6_Alpha_RaidHandoff_"..p.UserId..".json"
    local http=game:GetService("HttpService")

        local text=readfile(path)
        return text,http:JSONDecode(text)
    end)
    if not ok or type(record)~="table" or record.token~=SW_CONTEXT.token
        or record.raidId~="SANDWORM" or record.userId~=p.UserId
        or record.sourcePlaceId~=133112767606395 or record.destinationPlaceId~=126964146155329
        or record.originalWorld~=SW_CONTEXT.originWorld or record.difficulty~=SW_CONTEXT.difficulty
        or type(record.expiresAt)~="number" or os.time()>record.expiresAt

            and record.status~="UNCERTAIN" and record.status~="RESULT_OBSERVED"
            and record.status~="RETURN_VERIFIED") then return nil end
    return record,raw,path,http
end
local function swUpdate(update)
    local record,raw,path,http=swJournal()
    if not record then return false end
    if update(record)~=true then return false end
    local ok, saved=pcall(function()
        if readfile(path)~=raw then return false end
        local value=http:JSONEncode(record)
        writefile(path,value)
        return readfile(path)==value
    end)
    return ok and saved==true
end

    repeat
        remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild('Remotes')
        if remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild('NavPrepareWorlds') and remotes:FindFirstChild('RequestWorldTravel') then break end
        task.wait(.25)
    until not active() or os.clock()-start > 35
    if not active() then obj.active=false;return end

    local request = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild('RequestWorldTravel')

        end)

    if not ok then log('PREPARE_FAILED',err);if conn then conn:Disconnect() end;obj.active=false;return end
    task.wait(.35)
    if not active() then if conn then conn:Disconnect() end;obj.active=false;return end
    if worldNow() == HOME then
        log('HOME_VERIFIED','origin world after prepare');if conn then conn:Disconnect() end;obj.active=false;return
    end
    if remotes:FindFirstChild('RequestWorldTravel') ~= request then
        log('WORLD_REMOTE_CHANGED','No request sent');if conn then conn:Disconnect() end;obj.active=false;return
    end
    log('HOME_TRAVEL_REQUEST','RequestWorldTravel('..tostring(HOME)..'), single attempt')
    if not active() then if conn then conn:Disconnect() end;obj.active=false;return end
    ok,err = pcall(function() request:FireServer(HOME) end)
    if not ok then log('REQUEST_FAILED',err);if conn then conn:Disconnect() end;obj.active=false;return end
    local stopAt = os.clock()+30
    while active() and os.clock()<stopAt and worldNow()~=HOME and not (reply and reply.Ok==false) do task.wait(.25) end
    if not active() then if conn then conn:Disconnect() end;obj.active=false;return end
    if worldNow()==HOME then
        log('HOME_VERIFIED','CurrentWorld='..tostring(HOME))
    elseif reply and reply.Ok==false then
        log('HOME_REJECTED',tostring(reply.Reason))
    else
        log('HOME_UNVERIFIED','Travel submitted but origin world not acknowledged; no spam retry')
    end
    if conn then conn:Disconnect() end
    obj.active=false
end)

local function findQueueApi()
    if type(queue_on_teleport)=="function" then return queue_on_teleport,"queue_on_teleport" end
    if type(queueonteleport)=="function" then return queueonteleport,"queueonteleport" end
    if type(env.queue_on_teleport)=="function" then return env.queue_on_teleport,"getgenv.queue_on_teleport" end
    if type(env.queueonteleport)=="function" then return env.queueonteleport,"getgenv.queueonteleport" end
    local synApi=(type(env.syn)=="table" and env.syn) or (type(syn)=="table" and syn)
    if synApi and type(synApi.queue_on_teleport)=="function" then return synApi.queue_on_teleport,"syn.queue_on_teleport" end
    local flux=(type(env.fluxus)=="table" and env.fluxus) or (type(fluxus)=="table" and fluxus)
    if flux and type(flux.queue_on_teleport)=="function" then return flux.queue_on_teleport,"fluxus.queue_on_teleport" end
    return nil,"missing"
end

local function fmt(x)
    if x == nil then return "-" end
    if type(x) == "number" then return string.format("%.1f", x) end
    return tostring(x)
end
local function trace(code, message)
    if self.destroyed then return end
    local line = string.format("[SandwormCombatV1] %s | %s | %s", os.date("%H:%M:%S"), code, tostring(message or ""))
    table.insert(self.logs, line)
    if #self.logs > 500 then table.remove(self.logs, 1) end
    print(line)
end
local function connect(signal, fn)
    local c = signal:Connect(fn)
    table.insert(self.connections, c)
    return c
end
local function getRaid()
    return workspace:FindFirstChild("SandwormRaid")
end
local function getRaidTime()
    local root = getRaid()
    if not root then return workspace:GetServerTimeNow() end
    local frozen = tonumber(root:GetAttribute("FrozenAt")) or 0
    local offset = tonumber(root:GetAttribute("ClockOffset")) or 0
    return (frozen > 0 and frozen or workspace:GetServerTimeNow()) - offset
end
local function getFlight()
    if not self.flightModule then return nil, nil end
    local ok, flight = pcall(function() return self.flightModule.Flight() end)
    if not ok or type(flight) ~= "table" then return nil, nil end
    local sim = flight.Sim
    if type(sim) ~= "table" or typeof(sim.Position) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(sim.Rotation) ~= "CFrame" then
        return flight, nil
    end
    return flight, sim
end
local function acquireClientModules()
    local cm = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("ClientModules")
    local runtime = cm and cm:FindFirstChild("ManualFlightRuntime")
    if runtime and runtime:IsA("ModuleScript") and not self.flightModule then
        local ok, output = pcall(require, runtime)
        if ok and type(output) == "table" and type(output.Flight) == "function" then
            self.flightModule = output
            trace("FLIGHT_RUNTIME", "ManualFlightRuntime.Flight / SetAim tersedia")
        elseif not ok then
            trace("FLIGHT_UNAVAILABLE", tostring(output))
        end
    end
    -- ManualFlightController owns frame-by-frame Fire/Missile values; native autopilot
    -- callback is required. Writing Controls.Fire every 0.12s alone gets overwritten.
    local ctrlScript=cm and cm:FindFirstChild("ManualFlightController")
    if ctrlScript and ctrlScript:IsA("ModuleScript") and not self.manualController then
        local okay,ctrl=pcall(require,ctrlScript)
        if okay and type(ctrl)=="table" and type(ctrl.SetAutoPilot)=="function"
            and type(ctrl._setAuto)=="function" and type(ctrl.AutoPilotOn)=="function" then
            self.manualController=ctrl
            trace("NATIVE_PILOT_READY","ManualFlightController.SetAutoPilot/_setAuto")
        elseif not okay then
            trace("NATIVE_PILOT_REQUIRE_ERROR",tostring(ctrl))
        end
    end
    local folder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Sandworm")
    if folder and not self.wormBodyModule then
        local wm=folder:FindFirstChild("WormBody")
        if wm and wm:IsA("ModuleScript") then
            local ok,value=pcall(require,wm)
            if ok and type(value)=="table" and type(value.Capsules)=="function" then
                self.wormBodyModule=value
                trace("BODY_SOURCE_READY","WormBody.Capsules; dynamic collision guard enabled")
            end
        end
    end
    if folder and not self.wormPathModule then
        local path=folder:FindFirstChild("WormPath")
        if path and path:IsA("ModuleScript") then
            local ok,value=pcall(require,path)
            if ok and type(value)=="table" and type(value.Evaluate)=="function" then
                self.wormPathModule=value
                trace("PATH_SOURCE_READY","WormPath: client-confirmed SegmentAt/PositionAt")
            end
        end
    end
    if folder and not self.desertField then
        local field=folder:FindFirstChild("DesertField")
        if field and field:IsA("ModuleScript") then
            local ok,val=pcall(require,field)
            if ok and type(val)=="table" then self.desertField=val end
        end
    end
    if folder and not self.raidConfig then
        local conf=folder:FindFirstChild("RaidConfig")
        if conf and conf:IsA("ModuleScript") then
            local ok,val=pcall(require,conf)
            if ok and type(val)=="table" then self.raidConfig=val end
        end
    end
    local mod = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("Controller")
    if mod and mod:IsA("ModuleScript") and not self.gameController then
        local ok, output = pcall(require, mod)
        if ok and type(output) == "table" then
            self.gameController = output
            trace("RAID_CONTROLLER", "Client Controller.Current tersedia=" .. tostring(type(output.Current) == "table"))
        end
    end
end
local function refreshBosses()
    local ctl = self.gameController and self.gameController.Current
    if ctl and type(ctl.WormState) == "table" then self.worms = ctl.WormState end
    if ctl then
        if ctl.State then self.state = ctl.State end
        if ctl.Phase then self.phase = ctl.Phase end
        if ctl.Difficulty then self.difficulty = ctl.Difficulty end
    end
end
local function clearItems(reason)
    self.items = {}; self.countItems = 0; self.lastThreat = nil; self.lastThreatLog = ""
    trace("ITEM_RESET", reason or "Fight/Generation berubah")
end
local function addItem(item, source)
    if type(item) ~= "table" or item.Id == nil or not item.K then return end
    local key = tostring(self.generation) .. ":" .. tostring(item.Id)
    local prior = self.items[key]
    self.items[key] = item
    if not prior then
        local known={Eruption=true,Breach=true,Geyser=true,Topple=true,Ring=true,
            Cloud=true,Rock=true,SweepPath=true,Suction=true,Bite=true,Storm=true}
        if not known[tostring(item.K)] and not self.nav.unknownKinds[tostring(item.K)] then
            self.nav.unknownKinds[tostring(item.K)] = true
            trace("UNMAPPED_HAZARD", "K="..tostring(item.K).." fields="..tostring(item.P and "P " or "")..tostring(item.R and "R " or "")..tostring(item.Path and "Path" or ""))
        end
        self.countItems = self.countItems + 1
        self.counts[item.K] = (self.counts[item.K] or 0) + 1
        if opt.logEvents then
            trace("ITEM", string.format("%s ID=%s W=%s T=%s Warn=%s Dur=%s R=%s [%s]",
                fmt(item.K), fmt(item.Id), fmt(item.W), fmt(item.T), fmt(item.Warn), fmt(item.Dur), fmt(item.R), source))
        end
    end
end
local function syncExistingItems()
    local ctl = self.gameController and self.gameController.Current
    if ctl and ctl.Hazards and type(ctl.Hazards.Items) == "table" then
        for _, packet in pairs(ctl.Hazards.Items) do
            if type(packet) == "table" then addItem(packet.Item, "CLIENT_CACHE") end
        end
    end
end
local function processEvent(pkt)
    if not self.active or type(pkt) ~= "table" then return end
    local k = pkt.K
    if not k then return end
    self.counts["@" .. tostring(k)] = (self.counts["@" .. tostring(k)] or 0) + 1
    if k == "Item" then
        addItem(pkt.I, "REMOTE")
    elseif k == "Fight" then
        clearItems("Fight packet")
        self.worms = {}; self.outcome = nil
    elseif k == "Phase" then
        self.phase = tonumber(pkt.Phase) or self.phase
        trace("PHASE", tostring(self.phase))
    elseif k == "State" then
        self.state = pkt.State or self.state
        self.difficulty = pkt.Difficulty or self.difficulty
        trace("STATE", fmt(self.state) .. " | difficulty=" .. fmt(self.difficulty))
        if self.state == "Results" or self.state == "Idle" then
            if not self.stateResultsAt then self.stateResultsAt = os.clock() end
            trace("RESULT_STATE", "Auto attack stopped during " .. tostring(self.state))
        end
    elseif k == "Bars" then
        if type(pkt.Worms) == "table" then self.worms = pkt.Worms end
    elseif k == "Hull" then
        self.hull = pkt
        local hull=tonumber(pkt.Hull or pkt.HP)
        if hull and self.nav.lastHull and hull<self.nav.lastHull then
            trace("HULL_DAMAGE",string.format("%.1f -> %.1f (-%.1f); nav=%s threat=%s",
                self.nav.lastHull,hull,self.nav.lastHull-hull,tostring(self.nav.mode),tostring(self.nav.threat)))
        end
        if hull then self.nav.lastHull=hull end
        -- Avoid flooding logs with repeated Hull snapshots (~3 per second in V2.1).
        if opt.logEvents and os.clock()-(self.nav.lastHullLogAt or 0)>5 then
            self.nav.lastHullLogAt=os.clock()
            trace("HULL", "Hull snapshot; actual damage is logged separately as HULL_DAMAGE")
        end
    elseif k == "Outcome" then
        self.outcome = pkt
        self.resultAt = os.clock()
        -- Native RaidHud.OnEvent/Outcome.Victory is the only terminal witness.
        -- Do not infer outcome from Results, Idle, HP, Leave or home arrival.
        if type(pkt.Victory)=="boolean" and (pkt.Difficulty==nil or pkt.Difficulty==SW_CONTEXT.difficulty)
            and (self.difficulty=="?" or self.difficulty==SW_CONTEXT.difficulty) then
            local saved=swUpdate(function(r)
                if r.outcome~=nil or r.status=="RETURN_VERIFIED" then return false end
                r.status="RESULT_OBSERVED";r.outcome=pkt.Victory and "WIN" or "LOSS"
                r.nativeResultSource="SandwormRaidRemotes.Event.Outcome"
                r.resultObservedAt=os.time();return true
            end)
            if saved then trace("V6_NATIVE_OUTCOME",pkt.Victory and "WIN" or "LOSS")
            else trace("V6_OUTCOME_WRITE_UNVERIFIED","No fabricated outcome") end
        else trace("V6_OUTCOME_UNVERIFIED","Victory field or difficulty mismatch") end
        trace("OUTCOME", "Native outcome seen: " .. fmt(pkt.Result or pkt.Outcome or pkt.State or pkt.K))
    elseif k == "Eliminated" and tonumber(pkt.U) == player.UserId then
        self.eliminatedAt = os.clock()
        trace("PLAYER_ELIMINATED", "Player out of squad; return fallback armed")
    elseif k == "Seg" or k == "Replan" or k == "Mouth" or k == "Break" or k == "Fracture" or k == "End" then
        if k=="Seg" or k=="Replan" then
            -- Debounce bursts of incoming segments so a busy worm does not
            -- force a full 3-boss forecast scan for EVERY network packet.
            if k=="Replan" then
                self.nav.forecastAt=0
            else
                self.nav.forecastAt=math.min(self.nav.forecastAt or 0,os.clock()+.22)
            end
            if k=="Replan" and self.nav.intercept and self.nav.intercept.boss==tostring(pkt.W) then
                self.nav.intercept=nil
            end
            if k=="Replan" and self.nav.corridor and self.nav.corridor.boss==tostring(pkt.W) then
                self.nav.corridor=nil
                trace("CORRIDOR_INVALIDATED","Worm path replanned: "..tostring(pkt.W))
            end
        end
        if opt.logEvents then
            trace(k:upper(), "W=" .. fmt(pkt.W) .. " Phase=" .. fmt(self.phase))
        end
    end
end
local function horizontal(v)
    return Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z)
end
local function radiusDanger(item, point, predicted, now)
    -- Client-visible ground marker footprint. Server damage volume is UNKNOWN.
    -- Only use these four confirmed marker types for the experimental assist.
    if item.K ~= "Eruption" and item.K ~= "Breach" and item.K ~= "Geyser" and item.K ~= "Topple" then
        return nil
    end
    if typeof(item.P) ~= "Vector3" then return nil end
    local trigger = tonumber(item.T)
    if not trigger then return nil end
    local untilAt = trigger + (tonumber(item.Dur) or 1)
    local eta = trigger - now
    if eta > opt.lookaheadSeconds or untilAt < now - .2 then return nil end
    local center = item.P
    local radius = (tonumber(item.R) or 0) + opt.safetyMargin
    if radius <= opt.safetyMargin then return nil end
    local distance = (horizontal(predicted) - horizontal(center)).Magnitude
    local here = (horizontal(point) - horizontal(center)).Magnitude
    -- In-air movement is not equivalent to the ground marker; treat xz overlap as warning only.
    if distance < radius or (eta < 1 and here < radius) then
        local score = math.max(eta, 0) + distance / math.max(radius, 1) * 0.4
        return { item = item, eta = eta, center = center, radius = radius,
            distance = distance, here = here, score = score }
    end
    return nil
end
local function evaluateThreat()
    local flight, sim = getFlight()
    if not flight or not sim then return nil end
    local now = getRaidTime()
    local position = sim.Position
    local direction = sim.Rotation.LookVector
    local speed = math.max(0, tonumber(sim.Speed) or 0)
    local closest, nearestScore = nil, math.huge
    local count = 0
    for key, item in pairs(self.items) do
        count = count + 1
        local endAt = (tonumber(item.T) or 0) + (tonumber(item.Dur) or 1)
        if endAt + 4 < now then
            self.items[key] = nil
        else
            local eta = math.clamp((tonumber(item.T) or now) - now, 0, 3)
            local predicted = position + direction * speed * eta
            local threat = radiusDanger(item, position, predicted, now)
            if threat and threat.score < nearestScore then
                nearestScore = threat.score; closest = threat
            end
        end
    end
    -- Do not evaluate indefinite or stale caches as a valid threat picture.
    if count > 1000 then clearItems("Cache exceeded 1000 items") end
    return closest
end
local function setAimToward(direction)
    if not self.flightModule or type(self.flightModule.SetAim) ~= "function" then
        return false, "SetAim API missing"
    end
    if typeof(direction) ~= "Vector3" or direction.Magnitude < .1 then
        return false, "Invalid direction"
    end
    local ok, err = pcall(function() self.flightModule.SetAim(direction.Unit) end)
    return ok, ok and "applied" or tostring(err)
end
local function assistOnce(threat)
    if self.mode ~= "ASSIST" or not self.steeringVerified or self.steeringBusy or not threat then return end
    if self.state ~= "Active" or os.clock() - self.lastAssistAt < opt.assistCooldownSeconds then return end
    local flight, sim = getFlight()
    if not flight or not sim or flight.Held then return end
    local dir = horizontal(sim.Position - threat.center)
    if dir.Magnitude < .5 then dir = horizontal(sim.Rotation.LookVector) * -1 end
    if dir.Magnitude < .5 then return end
    local forward = horizontal(sim.Rotation.LookVector)
    if forward.Magnitude < .1 then return end
    -- Native SetAim only, never writing Sim.Position or firing a combat remote.
    -- Aim away from the closest confirmed visual ground marker, not a claimed safe route.
    local aim = (dir.Unit * 1.8 + forward.Unit * .35 + Vector3.new(0, .07, 0))
    local ok, why = setAimToward(aim)
    self.lastAssistAt = os.clock()
    if not ok then
        self.mode = "MONITOR"
        trace("ASSIST_FAILED", why)
    end
end
function self:steerTest(side)
    if self.destroyed or not self.active or self.steeringBusy or self.mode ~= "MONITOR" then
        trace("STEER_TEST_BLOCK", "Test sedang berjalan / ASSIST aktif")
        return false
    end
    if self.state ~= "Active" then trace("STEER_TEST_BLOCK", "State bukan Active: " .. fmt(self.state)); return false end
    local flight, sim = getFlight()
    if not flight or not sim or flight.Held then trace("STEER_TEST_BLOCK", "Pesawat belum Flying"); return false end
    if self.lastThreat then trace("STEER_TEST_BLOCK", "Ada hazard terprediksi; test saat aman"); return false end
    if self.flightModule and self.flightModule.Active then
        local ok, active = pcall(function() return self.flightModule.Active() end)
        if not ok or not active then trace("STEER_TEST_BLOCK", "ManualFlightRuntime tidak active"); return false end
    end
    local angle = math.rad(math.clamp(tonumber(opt.steeringAngleDeg) or 24, 8, 35))
    local sideSign = side == "RIGHT" and -1 or 1
    local originalAim = nil
    if self.flightModule and type(self.flightModule.Aim) == "function" then
        local ok, aim = pcall(function() return self.flightModule.Aim() end)
        if ok and typeof(aim) == "Vector3" then originalAim = aim end
    end
    local beginFrame = sim.Rotation
    local look = beginFrame.LookVector
    local aim = CFrame.fromAxisAngle(Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), sideSign * angle):VectorToWorldSpace(look)
    self.steeringBusy = true
    trace("STEER_TEST_START", side .. " angle=" .. fmt(math.deg(angle)) .. " duration=" .. fmt(opt.steeringTestSeconds))
    task.spawn(function()
        local originalFlight = flight
        local endClock = os.clock() + (tonumber(opt.steeringTestSeconds) or 1.35)
        local lastError = nil
        while self.active and not self.destroyed and os.clock() < endClock do
            local current, currentSim = getFlight()
            if current ~= originalFlight or not currentSim or self.state ~= "Active" then
                lastError = "Flight changed during test"; break
            end
            local ok, why = setAimToward(aim)
            if not ok then lastError = why; break end
            task.wait(.12)
        end
        local current, finalSim = getFlight()
        local delta = 0
        if current == originalFlight and finalSim then
            delta = math.deg(math.acos(math.clamp(beginFrame.LookVector:Dot(finalSim.Rotation.LookVector), -1, 1)))
            if originalAim then setAimToward(originalAim) end
        else
            lastError = lastError or "Flight changed"
        end
        if not self.destroyed then
            if delta >= (tonumber(opt.steerMinChangeDeg) or 4) and not lastError then
                self.steeringVerified = true
                trace("STEER_TEST_PASS", "Aircraft direction change=" .. fmt(delta) .. " deg; test verifies movement response only")
            else
                trace("STEER_TEST_INCONCLUSIVE", "Change=" .. fmt(delta) .. " deg; reason=" .. fmt(lastError))
            end
        end
        self.steeringBusy = false
    end)
    return true
end
function self:toggleAssist()
    if self.destroyed or not self.active then return false end
    if self.mode == "ASSIST" then
        self.mode = "MONITOR"
        trace("ASSIST_OFF", "Manual control restored; no further SetAim calls")
        return false
    end
    if not self.steeringVerified then
        trace("ASSIST_BLOCKED", "Jalankan STEER TEST sampai PASS dahulu")
        return false
    end
    if self.state ~= "Active" then
        trace("ASSIST_BLOCKED", "Hanya saat raid Active")
        return false
    end
    self.mode = "ASSIST"
    trace("ASSIST_ON", "EXPERIMENTAL: hanya ground markers Eruption/Breach/Geyser/Topple; belum ada klaim invulnerability")
    return true
end

-- FullCycle attack AI: native flight/weapon interface only; no fabricated hit events.
local function releaseNativePilot()
    local ctrl=self.manualController
    if self.nativePilotOwned and ctrl then
        pcall(ctrl._setAuto,false)
        pcall(ctrl.SetAutoPilot,nil)
        trace("NATIVE_PILOT_RELEASE","Autopilot callback removed")
    end
    self.nativePilotOwned=false
    self.nativePilotCallback=nil
    self.nativePlan=nil
end
local function ensureNativePilot()
    local ctrl=self.manualController
    if not ctrl then return false end
    local good,on=pcall(ctrl.AutoPilotOn)
    if self.nativePilotOwned and good and on then return true end
    if self.nativePilotOwned then
        self.nativePilotOwned=false
