        self.nativePilotCallback=nil
    end
    if good and on then
        if os.clock()-(self.nativePilotWarnAt or 0)>5 then
            self.nativePilotWarnAt=os.clock()
            trace("NATIVE_PILOT_BUSY","Another native autopilot is active; not replacing it")
        end
        return false
    end
    local callback=function(dt)
        if not self.active or self.destroyed or self.state~="Active"
            or self.outcome or self.eliminatedAt then return nil end
        local plan=self.nativePlan
        if not plan or os.clock()-(plan.issuedAt or 0)>.75 then return nil end
        return {Aim=plan.Aim,Throttle=plan.Throttle,Fire=plan.Fire,Missile=plan.Missile}
    end
    local registered,err=pcall(ctrl.SetAutoPilot,callback)
    if not registered then
        trace("NATIVE_PILOT_FAILED",tostring(err));return false
    end
    local started,why=pcall(ctrl._setAuto,true)
    local verified,enabled=pcall(ctrl.AutoPilotOn)
    if not started or not verified or enabled~=true then
        pcall(ctrl.SetAutoPilot,nil)
        trace("NATIVE_PILOT_FAILED","Could not activate callback: "..tostring(why))
        return false
    end
    self.nativePilotOwned=true
    self.nativePilotCallback=callback
    trace("NATIVE_PILOT_ON","Native callback now owns Aim, Fire and Missile per flight frame")
    return true
end
local function releaseWeapons()
    local flight = self.lastFireFlight or select(1, getFlight())
    if flight and type(flight.Controls)=="table" then
        flight.Controls.Fire = false
        flight.Controls.MissileArmUntil = 0
    end
    self.lastFireFlight=nil
    self.nativePlan=nil
end
local function usableFight()
    return self.active and not self.destroyed and self.state == "Active" and not self.outcome and not self.eliminatedAt and self.gameController
end
-- Sandworm V2.3: visible-surface pursuit + short standoff, Fleet-inspired steering.
-- Reference: boss/Fleet/FlightController.luau. Worm collision geometry from WormBody.Capsules.
-- These client geometries are conservative estimates, NOT verified server damage hitboxes.
local function flat(v) return Vector3.new(v.X,0,v.Z) end
local function safeUnit(v,fallback)
    if typeof(v)=="Vector3" and v.Magnitude>1e-3 then return v.Unit end
    return fallback or Vector3.new(0,0,-1)
end
-- Only DODGE routes are flattened to favor lateral movement.
-- Do not apply this helper to the normal boss pursuit / altitude adjustment.
local function cruiseHeading(dir,forward)
    local horizontal=flat(dir)
    if horizontal.Magnitude<.001 then horizontal=flat(forward) end
    local level=safeUnit(horizontal,Vector3.new(1,0,0))
    return safeUnit(level+Vector3.new(0,math.clamp(dir.Y,-opt.normalDiveLimit,opt.normalClimbLimit),0),level)
end
-- Pursuit retains its needed vertical component, subject to floor and ceiling guards.
local function pursuitHeading(dir,forward)
    local horizontal=flat(dir)
    if horizontal.Magnitude<.001 then horizontal=flat(forward) end
    local level=safeUnit(horizontal,Vector3.new(1,0,0))
    return safeUnit(level+Vector3.new(0,math.clamp(dir.Y,-opt.pursuitDiveLimit,opt.pursuitClimbLimit),0),level)
end
local function segmentDistance(point,a,b)
    local ab=b-a
    local length2=ab:Dot(ab)
    if length2<.0001 then return (point-a).Magnitude end
    local t=math.clamp((point-a):Dot(ab)/length2,0,1)
    return (point-(a+ab*t)).Magnitude
end
local function point2(v)
    if typeof(v)=="Vector2" then return Vector3.new(v.X,0,v.Y) end
    if typeof(v)=="Vector3" then return flat(v) end
    return nil
end
local function headingError(a,b)
    local ua,ub=safeUnit(a),safeUnit(b)
    return math.deg(math.acos(math.clamp(ua:Dot(ub),-1,1)))
end
-- V3.0: two-level target selection. Boss lock survives weak point reshuffles,
-- but switches once its exposure is gone and a genuinely actionable boss appears.
-- A forecast never fabricates a visible target or permits gunfire underground.
local function chooseTarget(sim)
    local nav=self.nav
    local ctl=self.gameController and self.gameController.Current
    if not ctl or type(ctl.Targets)~="function" then return nil,nil end
    local ok,all=pcall(function() return ctl:Targets() end)
    if not ok or type(all)~="table" then return nil,nil end
    local pos=sim.Position
    local forward=sim.Rotation.LookVector
    local now=os.clock()
    local byBoss={}
    local currentTarget=nil
    local currentPos=nil
    local oldScore=math.huge
    for _,t in pairs(all) do
        if type(t)=="table" and typeof(t.Position)=="Vector3" then
            local p=t.Position
            if type(t.Locate)=="function" then
                local good,latest=pcall(t.Locate)
                if good and typeof(latest)=="Vector3" then p=latest end
            end
            local d=(p-pos).Magnitude
            if d>25 and d<3500 then
                local id=tostring(t.Id or "")
                local boss=tostring(t.W or id:match("^[^:]+") or "")
                local kind=tostring(t.Kind or "")
                local priority=(kind=="Core" and -9 or kind=="Seam" and -7 or
                    t.Weak and -6 or kind=="Boss" and -3 or kind=="Body" and 1 or 5)
                local angle=headingError(forward,p-pos)
                local score=priority*1.9+d*.004+angle*.055
                -- Gun target and flight waypoint are separate. Prefer exposed
                -- core/seam targets on the trailing half, not a head shot that
                -- drags the aircraft to the front. No fabricated target IDs.
                local segmentNo=tonumber(id:match(":[SCB](%d+)"))
                if segmentNo then
                    local dimsModule=self.wormBodyModule
                    local okDims,dims=pcall(function()
                        return dimsModule and dimsModule.Dims and dimsModule.Dims(boss)
                    end)
                    if okDims and type(dims)=="table" and tonumber(dims.Count) and dims.Count>0 then
                        local fraction=math.clamp(segmentNo/dims.Count,0,1)
                        if kind=="Core" or kind=="Seam" then
                            score=score-11*fraction
                        elseif kind=="Body" then
                            score=score-4*fraction
                        end
                    end
                end
                if angle<25 then score=score-2 end
                local record=byBoss[boss]
                if not record or score<record.score then
                    byBoss[boss]={target=t,pos=p,score=score,distance=d}
                end
                if id==nav.targetId and boss==nav.focusBoss then
                    currentTarget=t;currentPos=p;oldScore=score
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local focused=nav.focusBoss and byBoss[nav.focusBoss] or nil
    local chosenBoss=nav.focusBoss
    if focused then
        -- Even if Dreadmaw appears closer, don't flip away from a surfaced Harrower.
        nav.lastFocusVisibleAt=now
    else
        local bestBoss,best=nil,math.huge
        for boss,record in pairs(byBoss) do
            if record.score<best then best=record.score;bestBoss=boss end
        end
        local forecast=chosenBoss and nav.forecasts[chosenBoss] or nil
        local nextExposureSoon=forecast and forecast.eta<=opt.forecastHoldThresholdSeconds
        local disappearedFor=now-(nav.lastFocusVisibleAt or 0)
        local focusDead=chosenBoss and type(self.worms[chosenBoss])=="table" and
            self.worms[chosenBoss].Alive==false
        if bestBoss and (not chosenBoss or focusDead or
            (disappearedFor>=opt.bossSwitchGraceSeconds and not nextExposureSoon)) then
            chosenBoss=bestBoss
        elseif not bestBoss and not nextExposureSoon then
            -- When neither is visible, select the next known, reachable emergence;
            -- if no future segment is available, preserve the existing focus.
            local first,score=nil,math.huge
            for name,fc in pairs(nav.forecasts) do
                local travel=(fc.position-pos).Magnitude/math.max(tonumber(sim.Speed) or 160,105)
                local cost=math.max(0,travel-fc.eta)*3+fc.eta*.16+travel*.75
                if name==chosenBoss then cost=cost-1.4 end
                if cost<score then first=name;score=cost end
            end
            if first then chosenBoss=first end
        end
    end
    if chosenBoss~=nav.focusBoss then
        local previous=nav.focusBoss
        nav.focusBoss=chosenBoss
        nav.bossFocusChangedAt=now
        nav.focusUntil=now+opt.bossHoldSeconds
        nav.targetId=nil;nav.targetUntil=0
        nav.intercept=nil
        nav.corridor=nil
        nav.rearBoss=nil;nav.rearHeading=nil;nav.rearSideSign=nil
        nav.rearWaypoint=nil;nav.rearWaypointAt=0;nav.rearWaypointBoss=nil;nav.rearVelocity=Vector3.zero
        trace("BOSS_LOCK",tostring(previous).." -> "..tostring(chosenBoss)..
            (byBoss[chosenBoss] and " surfaced" or " predicted"))
    end
    local picked=nav.focusBoss and byBoss[nav.focusBoss] or nil
    if not picked then
        if nav.lastSurfaceAt>0 and not nav.surfaceLostLogged then
            nav.surfaceLostLogged=true
            trace("SURFACE_LOST","No exposed target on locked boss; prediction/hold fallback")
        end
        return nil,nil
    end
    nav.surfaceLostLogged=false
    if currentTarget and nav.targetId and now<nav.targetUntil and oldScore<picked.score+7.5 then
        picked={target=currentTarget,pos=currentPos,score=oldScore}
    end
    local id=tostring(picked.target.Id or "")
    if id~=nav.targetId then
        nav.targetId=id
        nav.targetBoss=nav.focusBoss
        nav.targetUntil=now+opt.targetHoldSeconds
        trace("TARGET_LOCK",id.." kind="..tostring(picked.target.Kind).." boss="..tostring(nav.focusBoss))
    end
    if nav.intercept then
        -- V3.5: retain the planned approach corridor for the first firing
        -- window. Going straight to the last exposed body segment creates
        -- hard steering reversals exactly when the worm surfaces.
        local ip=nav.intercept
        local stageDistance=(ip.waypoint-sim.Position).Magnitude
        local stageReady=ip.arrivedAt~=nil or stageDistance<=220
        nav.rearSideSign=ip.side
        nav.rearBoss=nav.focusBoss
        if stageReady then
            nav.corridor={boss=nav.focusBoss,position=ip.position,
                heading=ip.heading,side=ip.side,staging=ip.waypoint,
                startedAt=now,lastSeenAt=now,loggedAt=0}
            trace("CORRIDOR_ENGAGE",string.format(
                "boss=%s stageDist=%.0f fromRear=%.0f side=%.0f lock=%.1fs",
                tostring(nav.focusBoss),stageDistance,opt.rearPredictTrail,
                opt.corridorFlankOffset,opt.corridorDwellSeconds))
        else
            trace("CORRIDOR_MISSED",string.format(
                "boss=%s stageDist=%.0f; follow visible boss normally",
                tostring(nav.focusBoss),stageDistance))
        end
        nav.intercept=nil
    end
    nav.lastSurfacePos=picked.pos
    nav.lastSurfaceAt=now
    return picked.target,picked.pos
end

local function floorHeight(x,z)
    local conf=self.raidConfig
    if conf and type(conf.FloorAt)=="function" then
        local ok,val=pcall(conf.FloorAt,x,z)
        if ok and type(val)=="number" then return val end
    end
    local field=self.desertField
    if field and type(field.HeightAt)=="function" then
        local ok,val=pcall(field.HeightAt,x,z)
        if ok and type(val)=="number" then return val+14 end
    end
    return 70 -- fallback, treat unknown terrain conservatively
end
-- Future paths are client-visible and server-replannable. Predict only within
-- the latest received segment; never extrapolate beyond T1 or claim an unseen
-- phase/attack is known. Works for multiple worms without attacking underground.
local function updateEmergenceForecasts()
    local nav=self.nav
    if not opt.predictSurface then nav.forecasts={};return end
    local nowLocal=os.clock()
    if nowLocal<(nav.forecastAt or 0) then return end
    nav.forecastAt=nowLocal+opt.interceptRefreshSeconds
    local ctl=self.gameController and self.gameController.Current
    local field=self.desertField
    local body=self.wormBodyModule
    if not ctl or type(ctl.Tracks)~="table" or not self.wormPathModule or
       not field or type(field.HeightAt)~="function" or not body or type(body.Dims)~="function" then
        nav.forecasts={}
        return
    end
    local time=getRaidTime()
    local nextForecasts={}
    for _,name in ipairs({"Harrower","Dreadmaw","Sovereign"}) do
        local status=self.worms[name]
        if not status or (status.Alive~=false and status.Awake~=false) then
            local track=ctl.Tracks[name]
            local segs=track and track.Segments
            if type(segs)=="table" and #segs>0 and type(track.PositionAt)=="function" then
                local latestEnd=-math.huge
                for _,seg in ipairs(segs) do
                    local e=tonumber(seg.T1)
                    if e and e>latestEnd then latestEnd=e end
                end
                local okDims,dims=pcall(body.Dims,name)
                local radius=(okDims and type(dims)=="table" and tonumber(dims.Radius)) or nil
                if radius and latestEnd>time+.3 then
                    local previousBelow=nil
                    local limit=math.min(time+opt.interceptHorizonSeconds,latestEnd-.02)
                    local t=time
                    while t<=limit do
                        -- Track.PositionAt clamps to segment ends. Check interval coverage
                        -- before sampling to prevent inventing future motion after T1.
                        local covered=false
                        for _,seg in ipairs(segs) do
                            if type(seg.T0)=="number" and type(seg.T1)=="number" and
                               t>=seg.T0 and t<=seg.T1 then covered=true;break end
                        end
                        if covered then
                            local ok,p=pcall(track.PositionAt,track,t)
                            if ok and typeof(p)=="Vector3" then
                                local hfOk,sand=pcall(field.HeightAt,p.X,p.Z)
                                if hfOk and type(sand)=="number" then
                                    local exposed=p.Y > sand-radius*.5
                                    if previousBelow==true and exposed and t>time+.15 then
                                        local nextT=math.min(t+.35,latestEnd-.02)
                                        local nextP=p
                                        local ok2,test=pcall(track.PositionAt,track,nextT)
                                        if ok2 and typeof(test)=="Vector3" then nextP=test end
                                        local motion=flat(nextP-p)
                                        if motion.Magnitude<2 then motion=Vector3.new(1,0,0) end
                                        nextForecasts[name]={boss=name,position=p,heading=motion.Unit,
                                            raidTime=t,eta=t-time,segmentEnd=latestEnd}
                                        break
                                    end
                                    previousBelow=not exposed
                                end
                            end
                        else
                            previousBelow=nil
                        end
                        t=t+opt.interceptScanStep
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    nav.forecasts=nextForecasts
    if nowLocal-(nav.lastForecastLogAt or 0)>5 then
        nav.lastForecastLogAt=nowLocal
        local parts={}
        for name,fc in pairs(nextForecasts) do
            table.insert(parts,name..":"..string.format("%.1fs",fc.eta))
        end
        table.sort(parts)
        trace("SURFACE_FORECAST",#parts>0 and table.concat(parts,", ") or "NO_CONFIRMED_FUTURE_SEGMENT")
    end
end

local function boundsCost(p)
    local border=2520
    local horizontalEdge=math.max(math.abs(p.X),math.abs(p.Z))
    local penalty=0
    if horizontalEdge>2300 then
        penalty=penalty+((horizontalEdge-2300)/110)^2*22
    end
    if horizontalEdge>=border-80 then penalty=penalty+200 end
    local floor=floorHeight(p.X,p.Z)+opt.minClearanceAboveFloor
    if p.Y<floor then penalty=penalty+60+((floor-p.Y)/30)^2*6 end
    if p.Y>opt.maxCruiseAltitude then penalty=penalty+((p.Y-opt.maxCruiseAltitude)/55)^2*10 end
    if p.Y>1480 then penalty=penalty+200 end
    return penalty
end
local function bodyCapsules()
    local ctl=self.gameController and self.gameController.Current
    local module=self.wormBodyModule
    local list={}
    if not ctl then return list end
    if module and type(module.Capsules)=="function" and type(ctl.Tracks)=="table" then
        for _,name in ipairs({"Harrower","Dreadmaw","Sovereign"}) do
            local w=self.worms[name]
            if w and w.Alive and w.Awake~=false then
                local track=ctl.Tracks[name]
                if track then
                    local ok,raw=pcall(module.Capsules,track,name)
                    if ok and type(raw)=="table" then
                        for _,capsule in ipairs(raw) do
                            if typeof(capsule.A)=="Vector3" and typeof(capsule.B)=="Vector3" and type(capsule.R)=="number" then
                                table.insert(list,{A=capsule.A,B=capsule.B,R=capsule.R,who=name,part=capsule.Part})
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    -- If paths haven't initialized, use active rigs as fallback; never assume body absent.
    if #list==0 and type(ctl.Rigs)=="table" then
        for _,name in ipairs({"Harrower","Dreadmaw","Sovereign"}) do
            local w=self.worms[name]
            local rig=ctl.Rigs[name]
            if w and w.Alive and w.Awake~=false and rig and rig.Layout then
                local layout=rig.Layout
                local head=layout.Head
                if typeof(head)=="CFrame" then
                    table.insert(list,{A=head.Position,B=head.Position+head.LookVector*55,R=85,who=name,part="HEAD_FALLBACK"})
                end
                if type(layout.Segments)=="table" then
                    for _,cframe in ipairs(layout.Segments) do
                        if typeof(cframe)=="CFrame" then
                            table.insert(list,{A=cframe.Position,B=cframe.Position,R=75,who=name,part="SEG_FALLBACK"})
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if #list==0 and type(ctl.Targets)=="function" then
        local ok,targets=pcall(function() return ctl:Targets() end)
        if ok and type(targets)=="table" then
            for _,t in pairs(targets) do
                if type(t)=="table" and (t.Kind=="Boss" or t.Kind=="Body") and typeof(t.Position)=="Vector3" then
                    table.insert(list,{A=t.Position,B=t.Position,R=tonumber(t.Radius) or 55,
                        who=tostring(t.W or "UNKNOWN"),part="TARGET_FALLBACK"})
                end
            end
        end
    end
    -- Match WormBody.Contact semantics: buried parts are NOT contact obstacles.
    -- Capsule visible/near-surface filtering matters more than shrinking all radii.
    local exposed={}
    for _,capsule in ipairs(list) do
        local mid=(capsule.A+capsule.B)*.5
        local sandLevel=nil
        if self.desertField and type(self.desertField.HeightAt)=="function" then
            local ok,h=pcall(self.desertField.HeightAt,mid.X,mid.Z)
            if ok and type(h)=="number" then sandLevel=h end
        end
        if sandLevel==nil then
            -- Unknown terrain: retain the capsule conservatively.
            table.insert(exposed,capsule)
        elseif mid.Y+capsule.R>=sandLevel-8 then
            table.insert(exposed,capsule)
        end
    end
    list=exposed
    -- V3.4: predict where exposed capsules will be WHEN the aircraft arrives.
    -- PositionAt(t) is used only while t belongs to a received segment.
    -- A path can be replanned by the server, so refresh every scan and never
    -- extrapolate into unknown future sections.
    local bossShifts={}
    local futureHeads={}
    local raidClock=getRaidTime()
    if type(ctl.Tracks)=="table" then
        for _,name in ipairs({"Harrower","Dreadmaw","Sovereign"}) do
            local track=ctl.Tracks[name]
            if track and type(track.PositionAt)=="function" and type(track.Segments)=="table" then
                local function covered(at)
                    for _,segment in ipairs(track.Segments) do
                        if type(segment.T0)=="number" and type(segment.T1)=="number" and
                            at>=segment.T0 and at<=segment.T1 then return true end
                    end
                    return false
                end
                if covered(raidClock) then
                    local ok0,head0=pcall(track.PositionAt,track,raidClock)
                    if ok0 and typeof(head0)=="Vector3" then
                        local shifts={}
                        local steps=math.ceil(math.max(opt.trajectoryHorizon,
                            opt.rearLaneLookaheadSeconds)/opt.predictionStep)
                        for step=1,steps do
                            local dt=step*opt.predictionStep
                            if covered(raidClock+dt) then
                                local ok1,head1=pcall(track.PositionAt,track,raidClock+dt)
                                if ok1 and typeof(head1)=="Vector3" then
                                    local displacement=head1-head0
                                    if displacement.Magnitude<dt*460 then
                                        shifts[step]=displacement
                                        -- A worm still underground may rise at a known
                                        -- future head position: do not slow into that point.
                                        local alive=self.worms[name]
                                        local dimsOk,dims=false,nil
                                        if module and type(module.Dims)=="function" then
                                            dimsOk,dims=pcall(module.Dims,name)
                                        end
                                        local radius=dimsOk and type(dims)=="table" and
                                            (tonumber(dims.Radius) or tonumber(dims.SegRadius)) or 75
                                        if (not alive or alive.Alive~=false) and
                                            head1.Y+radius>floorHeight(head1.X,head1.Z)-8 and
                                            step%2==0 then
                                            table.insert(futureHeads,{A=head1,B=head1,
                                                R=radius*1.05,who=name,part="HEAD_FUTURE",
                                                forecastTime=dt})
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        bossShifts[name]=shifts
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    -- Estimate capsule drift from successive native samples, without controlling the worm.
    local now=os.clock()
    local history=self.nav.bodyHistory or {}
    self.nav.bodyHistory=history
    for _,capsule in ipairs(list) do
        local key=tostring(capsule.who)..":"..tostring(capsule.part)
        local midpoint=(capsule.A+capsule.B)*.5
        local old=history[key]
        local velocity=Vector3.zero
        if old and now-old.at>.08 and now-old.at<2.0 then
            velocity=(midpoint-old.midpoint)/(now-old.at)
            if velocity.Magnitude>230 then velocity=velocity.Unit*230 end
            if typeof(old.velocity)=="Vector3" then velocity=old.velocity:Lerp(velocity,.55) end
        end
        capsule.velocity=velocity
        capsule.futureShifts=bossShifts[capsule.who]
        history[key]={midpoint=midpoint,at=now,velocity=velocity}
    end
    return list
end
local function bodyPenalty(p,body,futureSeconds)
    local best=0
    local closest=nil
    for _,capsule in ipairs(body) do
        -- Moving worm segments: extra uncertainty grows with prediction horizon.
        local radius=capsule.R+opt.bodyClearance+math.min(56,futureSeconds*16)
        local shift=nil
        local samples=capsule.futureShifts
        if samples and futureSeconds>0.05 and not capsule.forecastTime then
            local step=math.max(1,math.floor(futureSeconds/opt.predictionStep+.5))
            shift=samples[step]
        end
        if capsule.forecastTime then shift=Vector3.zero end
        -- Fallback only when the server has not provided a covering future segment.
        if not shift then
            shift=(capsule.velocity or Vector3.zero)*math.min(futureSeconds,2.4)*.75
        end
        local projected=segmentDistance(p,capsule.A+shift,capsule.B+shift)
        local current=segmentDistance(p,capsule.A,capsule.B)
        -- A moving worm may sweep across the flight lane. Check both future
        -- body location and the swept midpoint over the short future interval.
        local d=math.min(projected,current+futureSeconds*48)
        if futureSeconds>.25 and futureSeconds<1.6 and shift.Magnitude>25 then
            local midpoint=(capsule.A+capsule.B)*.5
            local swept=segmentDistance(p,midpoint,midpoint+shift)
            d=math.min(d,swept+radius*.16)
        end
        if d<radius*1.55 then
            local inc=math.max(0,1-d/radius)
            local penalty=inc>0 and 85+inc*130 or ((radius*1.55-d)/(radius*.55))^2*6
            if penalty>best then best=penalty;closest=capsule end
        end
    end
    return best,closest
end
local function severityFor(it,p,now,future)
    local k=it.K
    local activeAt=tonumber(it.T)
    if not activeAt then return 0 end
    local dur=math.max(.4,tonumber(it.Dur) or 1)
    local at=now+future
    if at<activeAt-.6 or at>activeAt+dur+.4 then return 0 end
    local timeFactor=(at<activeAt) and .25 or 1
    local margin=opt.safetyMargin
    local center=typeof(it.P)=="Vector3" and it.P or nil
    local radius=math.max(0,tonumber(it.R) or 0)
    local d=nil
    local baseWeight=40
    if center and (k=="Eruption" or k=="Breach" or k=="Geyser" or k=="Ring" or k=="Topple") then
        -- Treat ground rings as filled danger discs. No evidence of a safe hollow centre.
        d=(flat(p)-flat(center)).Magnitude
        radius=radius+margin
        baseWeight=(k=="Breach" or k=="Ring") and 85 or 65
        -- H is a visual height hint, not a confirmed server damage volume.
        -- Do not exempt high altitude unless a server-safe altitude is observed.
    elseif center and k=="Cloud" then
        local age=math.max(0,at-activeAt)
        local u=math.clamp(age/math.max(dur,1),0,1)
        local rise=tonumber(it.Rise) or 200
        local location=center+Vector3.new(0,rise*(1-(1-u)^2),0)
        local visualRadius=radius*(.55*math.sqrt(u)+.45)
        d=(p-location).Magnitude
        radius=visualRadius+margin+10
        baseWeight=75
    elseif center and k=="Rock" then
        local age=math.max(0,at-activeAt)
        local velocity=typeof(it.V)=="Vector3" and it.V or Vector3.zero
        local gravity=tonumber(it.G) or 0
        local rock=center+velocity*age-Vector3.new(0,.5*gravity*age*age,0)
        d=(p-rock).Magnitude
        radius=radius+margin+20
        baseWeight=85
    elseif k=="SweepPath" and type(it.Path)=="table" then
        -- Polyline warning: actual contact envelope is unknown.
        local path={}
        for _,raw in ipairs(it.Path) do
            local pt=point2(raw)
            if pt then table.insert(path,pt) end
        end
        if #path>=2 then
            d=math.huge
            for j=1,#path-1 do
                d=math.min(d,segmentDistance(flat(p),path[j],path[j+1]))
            end
            radius=math.max(radius,95)+margin
            baseWeight=95
        end
    elseif k=="Suction" or k=="Bite" then
        -- Runtime packets have W and T but NO P; sample the moving worm head.
        local ctl=self.gameController and self.gameController.Current
        local rig=ctl and ctl.Rigs and ctl.Rigs[it.W]
        local head=rig and rig.Layout and rig.Layout.Head
        if typeof(head)=="CFrame" then
            local headPos=head.Position
            d=(p-headPos).Magnitude
            radius=math.max(radius,tonumber(it.Reach) or 340)+margin
            baseWeight=k=="Bite" and 135 or 105
            -- Orientation of server hit cone is unverified; use a conservative sphere.
        end
    elseif k=="Storm" then
        -- Storm is visual fog; don't invent a universal safe zone.
        return 0
    elseif center and radius>0 then
        -- Forward compatible: unknown radial item types are considered hazards.
        d=(p-center).Magnitude
        radius=radius+margin
        baseWeight=70
    else
        return 0
    end
    if not d or radius<=0 or d>=radius*1.7 then return 0 end
    local penetration=math.max(0,1-d/radius)
    if d<radius then
        return timeFactor*baseWeight*(1+penetration*1.8)
    end
    return timeFactor*baseWeight*.16*((radius*1.7-d)/(radius*.7))^2
end
local function threatCost(p,items,now,future)
    local maxPenalty=0
    local strongest=nil
    for _,it in ipairs(items) do
        local v=severityFor(it,p,now,future)
        if v>maxPenalty then maxPenalty=v;strongest=it end
    end
    return maxPenalty,strongest
end
local function listHazards(now)
    local out={}
    for key,it in pairs(self.items) do
        if type(it)=="table" and type(it.K)=="string" then
            local start=tonumber(it.T) or 0
            local dur=tonumber(it.Dur) or 1
            if start+dur+3<now then
                self.items[key]=nil
            elseif start<now+opt.lookaheadSeconds+1 and start+dur>=now-.6 then
                table.insert(out,it)
            end
        end
    end
    table.sort(out,function(a,b) return (tonumber(a.T) or 0)<(tonumber(b.T) or 0) end)
    while #out>opt.maxHazardsPerScan do table.remove(out) end
    return out
end
-- V3.2: native worm layout identifies head and each body segment.
-- Keep aircraft BEHIND or alongside the trailing exposed section. Weapon
-- targeting remains independent, so native OnTarget and heat rules still apply.
local function rearFormation(sim)
    local nav=self.nav
    local boss=nav.focusBoss
    local ctl=self.gameController and self.gameController.Current
    local rig=ctl and ctl.Rigs and boss and ctl.Rigs[boss]
    local layout=rig and rig.Layout
    local head=layout and layout.Head
    if typeof(head)~="CFrame" then return nil end
    local parts=layout.Segments
    if type(parts)~="table" then parts={} end
    local headPos=head.Position
    local lead=parts[math.min(2,#parts)]
    local rawHeading=typeof(lead)=="CFrame" and flat(headPos-lead.Position) or flat(head.LookVector)
    if rawHeading.Magnitude<2 then rawHeading=flat(head.LookVector) end
    if rawHeading.Magnitude<.001 then return nil end
    local heading=rawHeading.Unit
    if nav.rearBoss~=boss then
        nav.rearBoss=boss;nav.rearHeading=nil;nav.rearSideSign=nil
    end
    if nav.rearHeading and nav.rearHeading:Dot(heading)>0 then
        heading=safeUnit(nav.rearHeading:Lerp(heading,opt.rearHeadingSmoothing),heading)
    end
    nav.rearHeading=heading
    local dims=nil
    if self.wormBodyModule and type(self.wormBodyModule.Dims)=="function" then
        local ok,value=pcall(self.wormBodyModule.Dims,boss)
        if ok and type(value)=="table" then dims=value end
    end
    local radius=tonumber(dims and (dims.SegRadius or dims.Radius)) or 65
    local anchor=nil
    local index=nil
    -- Prefer the last EXPOSED segment, not the buried tail or the head.
    -- Native Targets() uses analogous above-sand checks to determine hit areas.
    for i=#parts,1,-1 do
        local part=parts[i]
        if typeof(part)=="CFrame" then
            local p=part.Position
            local floor=floorHeight(p.X,p.Z)
            if p.Y+radius*.65>floor-8 then
                anchor=p;index=i;break
            end
        end
    end
    if not anchor then
        -- If only head is exposed, stage behind it, not nose-to-nose.
        anchor=headPos-heading*math.max(100,opt.rearPredictTrail*.75)
    end
    local lateral=Vector3.new(-heading.Z,0,heading.X)
    if not nav.rearSideSign then
        nav.rearSideSign=(sim.Position-anchor):Dot(lateral)>=0 and 1 or -1
    end
    local side=lateral*nav.rearSideSign
    -- Keep the aircraft OUTSIDE the boss travel lane, even when the exposed
    -- tail passes close to the head's previously occupied coordinates.
    local flankDistance=radius+opt.bodyClearance+opt.rearFlankPadding
    local rawWaypoint=anchor-heading*opt.rearBehindGap+side*flankDistance
    local sand=floorHeight(rawWaypoint.X,rawWaypoint.Z)
    local y=math.clamp(anchor.Y+17,sand+opt.minClearanceAboveFloor+10,
        sand+opt.maxHeightAboveTerrain-12)
    local sampledWaypoint=Vector3.new(rawWaypoint.X,y,rawWaypoint.Z)
    local sampleClock=os.clock()
    local dt=math.clamp(sampleClock-(nav.rearWaypointAt or 0),.04,.38)
    local waypoint=sampledWaypoint
    local last=nav.rearWaypoint
    local velocity=nav.rearVelocity or Vector3.zero
    if nav.rearWaypointBoss==boss and typeof(last)=="Vector3" then
        local alpha=1-math.exp(-opt.rearWaypointResponse*dt)
        waypoint=last:Lerp(sampledWaypoint,alpha)
        local measured=(waypoint-last)/math.max(dt,.04)
        if measured.Magnitude>260 then measured=measured.Unit*260 end
        velocity=velocity:Lerp(measured,math.clamp(dt*4,.20,.65))
    else
        velocity=Vector3.zero
    end
    nav.rearWaypoint=waypoint
    nav.rearWaypointAt=sampleClock
    nav.rearWaypointBoss=boss
    nav.rearVelocity=velocity
    nav.rearBodyIndex=index
    local headProjection=flat(sim.Position-headPos):Dot(heading)
    return {point=waypoint,head=headPos,heading=heading,side=side,
        radius=radius,headProjection=headProjection,partIndex=index,
        velocity=velocity, laneWidth=radius+opt.bodyClearance+opt.rearLanePadding}
end

local function plannedDirection(sim,target,targetPos,body)
    local nav=self.nav
    local pos=sim.Position
    local forward=sim.Rotation.LookVector
    local now=os.clock()
    local preferred=math.max(opt.approachDistance,opt.breakawayDistance+45)
    local minDistance=opt.breakawayDistance
    nav.rearEngaged=false
    nav.rearRange=nil
    if targetPos then
        local corridor=nav.corridor
        if corridor and corridor.boss==nav.focusBoss then
            local age=now-corridor.startedAt
            local nativeOn=nav.lastPlane and nav.lastPlane.OnTarget==true
            local stillEngaged=age<=opt.corridorDwellSeconds or
                (nativeOn and age<=opt.corridorMaxSeconds)
            local laneHeading=safeUnit(flat(corridor.heading),Vector3.new(1,0,0))
            local laneSide=Vector3.new(-laneHeading.Z,0,laneHeading.X)*corridor.side
            local relative=flat(pos-corridor.position)
            local along=relative:Dot(laneHeading)
            local lateral=relative:Dot(laneSide)
            local attackRange=(targetPos-pos).Magnitude
            -- Do not continue holding a corridor after passing the emergence
            -- head, losing the attack window, or a replan invalidating the boss.
            local targetForward=(targetPos-pos):Dot(forward)
            if stillEngaged and along<95 and attackRange<opt.missileRange+90
               and targetForward>-90 then
                local radius=60
                if self.wormBodyModule and type(self.wormBodyModule.Dims)=="function" then
                    local ok,dims=pcall(self.wormBodyModule.Dims,nav.focusBoss)
                    if ok and type(dims)=="table" then
                        radius=tonumber(dims.Radius or dims.SegRadius) or radius
                    end
                end
                local minSide=radius+opt.bodyClearance+opt.corridorMinLateralMargin
                local desiredSide=math.max(opt.corridorFlankOffset,minSide+14)
                local lateralError=desiredSide-lateral
                -- Preserve an elongated attack lane. Steer at the exposed
                -- target only while there is room to do so without crossing
                -- the worm's swept centerline; body prediction is still run.
                local toBoss=safeUnit(targetPos-pos,laneHeading)
                local forwardDot=flat(targetPos-pos):Dot(laneHeading)
                local aimWeight=forwardDot>35 and
                    (nativeOn and .26 or (lateral>minSide+40 and .62 or .22)) or .08
                local sideCorrection=math.clamp(lateralError/185,-.31,.42)
                local adjusted=safeUnit(laneHeading*(1-aimWeight)+toBoss*aimWeight+
                    laneSide*sideCorrection,laneHeading)
                nav.mode="TRACK_CORRIDOR"
                nav.rearEngaged=true
                nav.rearRange=(corridor.staging-pos).Magnitude
                if now-(corridor.loggedAt or 0)>3.5 then
                    corridor.loggedAt=now
                    trace("CORRIDOR_TRACK",string.format(
                        "boss=%s age=%.1f targetRange=%.0f side=%.0f minSide=%.0f along=%.0f aim=%s",
                        tostring(nav.focusBoss),age,attackRange,lateral,minSide,along,tostring(nativeOn)))
                end
                return adjusted,attackRange
            end
            trace("CORRIDOR_RELEASE",string.format(
                "boss=%s age=%.1f along=%.0f targetRange=%.0f",
                tostring(nav.focusBoss),age,along,attackRange))
            nav.corridor=nil
        end
        local frame=rearFormation(sim)
        if frame then
            local rearDelta=frame.point-pos
            local rearRange=rearDelta.Magnitude
            nav.rearRange=rearRange
            local headOffset=flat(pos-frame.head)
            local headDist=headOffset.Magnitude
            local headLateral=math.abs(headOffset:Dot(frame.side))
            local inFront=frame.headProjection>-opt.rearFrontGuard and
                headDist<math.max(270,frame.radius+opt.bodyClearance+175) and
                headLateral<frame.radius+opt.bodyClearance+95
            if inFront then
                -- Go AROUND the head first; never cut through its body to get behind.
                local bypass=frame.head+frame.side*(frame.radius+opt.bodyClearance+170)-
                    frame.heading*(opt.rearFrontGuard+100)
                local sand=floorHeight(bypass.X,bypass.Z)
                bypass=Vector3.new(bypass.X,math.clamp(pos.Y,sand+opt.minClearanceAboveFloor+15,
                    sand+opt.maxHeightAboveTerrain-15),bypass.Z)
                if nav.mode~="APPROACH" then nav.mode="APPROACH";nav.modeAt=now end
                if now-(nav.rearFrontLastLogAt or 0)>4 then
                    nav.rearFrontLastLogAt=now
                    trace("REAR_FRONT_RECOVERY",string.format("boss=%s front=%.0f rearDist=%.0f",
                        tostring(nav.focusBoss),frame.headProjection,rearRange))
                end
                return safeUnit(bypass-pos,forward),rearRange
            end
            -- A slow airplane MUST NOT occupy the worm's centerline: a later
            -- head/body sweep can catch it even if the present tail is distant.
            -- This is a modest SIDE EXIT, not a repeated global breakaway.
            local projectedSide=flat(pos-frame.head):Dot(frame.side)
            local alongHead=frame.headProjection
            local inLaneGeometry=projectedSide<frame.laneWidth and
                alongHead>-630 and alongHead<180
            -- V3.7: geometry alone is NOT a reason to flee. The old rule
            -- covered 810 studs of worm travel and repeatedly cancelled attack.
            -- Require near-term contact with exposed/predicted body capsules.
            local immediateLaneRisk, futureLaneRisk = 0, 0
            if inLaneGeometry then
                local laneBodies=bodyCapsules()
                immediateLaneRisk=bodyPenalty(pos,laneBodies,0)
                local airSpeed=math.max(tonumber(sim.Speed) or 160,80)
                for _,future in ipairs({.55,1.10}) do
                    local projected=pos+forward*airSpeed*future
                    local risk=bodyPenalty(projected,laneBodies,future)
                    futureLaneRisk=math.max(futureLaneRisk,risk)
                end
            end
            local inWormLane=inLaneGeometry and
                (immediateLaneRisk>=85 or futureLaneRisk>=opt.rearLaneEscapeRisk)
            nav.rearLaneEscape=inWormLane
            if inWormLane then
                local escape=frame.side*math.max(95,frame.laneWidth-projectedSide+80)
                    +frame.heading*70
                if now-(nav.rearLaneLogAt or 0)>2.8 then
                    nav.rearLaneLogAt=now
                    trace("BODY_LANE_ESCAPE",string.format(
                        "boss=%s lateral=%.0f required=%.0f along=%.0f nowRisk=%.0f futureRisk=%.0f",
                        tostring(nav.focusBoss),projectedSide,frame.laneWidth,alongHead,
                        immediateLaneRisk,futureLaneRisk))
                end
                nav.rearEngaged=false
                nav.mode="BREAK"
                nav.modeAt=now
                return safeUnit(escape,forward),rearRange
            end
            -- V3.7: follow the MOVING rear flank, not a fresh waypoint vector.
            -- The last exposed segment can switch instantly; we smooth the anchor
            -- and predict a short distance along its measured velocity.
            local forwardLevel=safeUnit(flat(forward),frame.heading)
            local rearLead=frame.point+frame.velocity*opt.rearTrackLookaheadSeconds
            local leadDelta=rearLead-pos
            local leadDistance=leadDelta.Magnitude
            local atRear=rearRange<=opt.rearTrackRadius+40
            if atRear then
                if nav.mode~="TRACK" then
                    nav.mode="TRACK";nav.modeAt=now
                    trace("NAV_MODE","TRACK_REAR boss="..tostring(nav.focusBoss))
                end
                nav.rearEngaged=true
            elseif rearRange>opt.rearTrackRadius+105 then
                if nav.mode~="APPROACH" then
                    nav.mode="APPROACH";nav.modeAt=now
                    trace("NAV_MODE","APPROACH_REAR boss="..tostring(nav.focusBoss))
                end
                nav.rearEngaged=false
            end
            local direction
            if nav.rearEngaged then
                local error=frame.point-pos
                local lateralError=flat(error):Dot(frame.side)
                local alongError=flat(error):Dot(frame.heading)
                local lateralCorrection=math.clamp(lateralError/245,-.48,.48)
                local alongCorrection=math.clamp(alongError/290,-.28,.32)
                if math.abs(lateralError)<opt.rearTrackDeadband then lateralCorrection=0 end
                if math.abs(alongError)<opt.rearTrackDeadband then alongCorrection=0 end
                local yCorrection=math.clamp(error.Y/200,-.48,.48)
                -- Maintain a smooth path PARALLEL to the worm. Only small
                -- corrections should reposition the plane while firing.
                direction=safeUnit(frame.heading*(1+alongCorrection*.45)+
                    frame.side*lateralCorrection+Vector3.new(0,yCorrection,0),forward)
            else
                -- Approach a point slightly ahead of the MOVING rear flank.
                -- If it has slipped behind the aircraft, start a curved
                -- side turn rather than reversing toward a stale waypoint.
                local toLead=safeUnit(leadDelta,frame.heading)
                direction=safeUnit(toLead*.84+frame.heading*.16,forward)
                local horizontalDot=forwardLevel:Dot(safeUnit(flat(leadDelta),frame.heading))
                if horizontalDot<-.15 and leadDistance<470 then
                    local sideSign=forwardLevel:Cross(safeUnit(flat(leadDelta),frame.heading)).Y
                    local arcSign=math.abs(sideSign)<.08 and (nav.rearSideSign or 1) or (sideSign>=0 and 1 or -1)
                    local arc=CFrame.fromAxisAngle(Vector3.yAxis,math.rad(70)*arcSign):VectorToWorldSpace(forwardLevel)
                    direction=safeUnit(arc+Vector3.new(0,math.clamp(leadDelta.Y/350,-.30,.30),0),forward)
                    if now-(nav.lastTurnArcLogAt or 0)>3 then
                        nav.lastTurnArcLogAt=now
                        trace("REAR_TURN_ARC",string.format("rear=%.0f behind=%.2f side=%s",
                            rearRange,horizontalDot,arcSign>0 and "LEFT" or "RIGHT"))
                    end
                end
            end
            if now-(nav.lastRearResponsiveLogAt or 0)>3.5 then
                nav.lastRearResponsiveLogAt=now
                trace("REAR_RESPONSE",string.format(
                    "boss=%s mode=%s rear=%.0f lead=%.0f velocity=%.0f angle=%.1f tracking=%s",
                    tostring(nav.focusBoss),nav.mode,rearRange,leadDistance,
                    frame.velocity.Magnitude,headingError(forward,direction),tostring(nav.rearEngaged)))
            end
            return direction,rearRange
        end
        -- Layout missing: fall back to existing visible-target handling,
        -- without claiming the position behind the boss was verified.
        local targetId=tostring(target.Id or "")
        if targetId==nav.trackedTargetId and nav.trackPos and nav.trackAt>0 then
            local dt=now-nav.trackAt
            if dt>.07 and dt<1.5 then
                local v=(targetPos-nav.trackPos)/dt
                if v.Magnitude>220 then v=v.Unit*220 end
                nav.targetVelocity=nav.targetVelocity:Lerp(v,.4)
            end
        else
            nav.targetVelocity=Vector3.zero
            nav.trackedTargetId=targetId
        end
        nav.trackPos=targetPos;nav.trackAt=now
        -- Lead helps keep up with brief above-ground windows, but is capped to
        -- avoid chasing the head's long predicted trajectory into the worm body.
        local lead=(nav.targetVelocity or Vector3.zero)*opt.followLeadSeconds
        if lead.Magnitude>85 then lead=lead.Unit*85 end
        local aimPoint=targetPos+lead
        local direct=targetPos-pos
        local dist=direct.Magnitude
        local toTarget=safeUnit(aimPoint-pos,forward)
        local away=safeUnit(flat(pos-targetPos),safeUnit(flat(forward),Vector3.new(1,0,0)))
        local side=Vector3.new(-away.Z,0,away.X)*nav.side
        if dist<=minDistance then
            if nav.mode~="BREAK" then
                nav.mode="BREAK";nav.modeAt=now
                trace("NAV_MODE","BREAK: contact distance="..math.floor(dist))
            end
        elseif nav.mode=="BREAK" then
            if dist>=minDistance+55 and now-nav.modeAt>=.65 then
                nav.mode="TRACK";nav.modeAt=now
                trace("NAV_MODE","TRACK: regained standoff dist="..math.floor(dist))
            end
        elseif dist>preferred+(nav.mode=="TRACK" and 125 or 80) then
            if nav.mode~="APPROACH" then
                nav.mode="APPROACH";nav.modeAt=now
                trace("NAV_MODE","APPROACH exposed boss dist="..math.floor(dist))
            end
        else
            if nav.mode~="TRACK" then
                nav.mode="TRACK";nav.modeAt=now
                trace("NAV_MODE","TRACK exposed boss dist="..math.floor(dist))
            end
        end
        if nav.mode=="BREAK" then
            -- Short lateral exit, not the long 690-stud escape used in V2.2.
            return safeUnit(away*1.3+side*.95,forward),dist
        elseif nav.mode=="TRACK" then
            -- V3.1 CLOSE_STABLE: avoid re-aiming the *flight path* at every
            -- moving weak point when the aircraft is already in attack range.
            -- The gun still fires only on native OnTarget; this is navigation,
            -- NOT an aim lock bypass. True imminent collisions are corrected by
            -- selectSafeAim() below, including when we keep a stable heading.
            local closeBias=math.clamp((minDistance+55-dist)/55,0,1)
            local steer=toTarget+side*(closeBias*.42)+away*(closeBias*.30)
            local trackAngle=headingError(forward,toTarget)
            if dist<preferred+90 and dist>minDistance+25 and trackAngle<=17 then
                -- Preserve the current shot when native reports OnTarget, but
                -- give stronger steering authority to reacquire aim otherwise.
                local aligned=nav.lastPlane and nav.lastPlane.OnTarget==true
                local inertia=aligned and .70 or .36
                steer=forward*inertia+steer*(1-inertia)
                if now-(nav.lastCloseLogAt or 0)>5 then
                    nav.lastCloseLogAt=now
                    trace("CLOSE_STABLE",string.format("boss=%s targetDist=%.0f headingError=%.1f",
                        tostring(nav.focusBoss),dist,trackAngle))
                end
            end
            return safeUnit(steer,forward),dist
        else
            return toTarget,dist
        end
    end
    -- V3.5: stage FAR ENOUGH behind the predicted emergence to obtain a
    -- continuous firing pass. An airplane cannot hover: once staging has
    -- been passed, NEVER reverse course to the waypoint or orbit the head.
    local ip=nav.intercept
    if ip and ip.boss==nav.focusBoss and os.clock()<=ip.expiresAt and ip.eta>-1 then
        local offset=ip.waypoint-pos
        local d=offset.Magnitude
        if d<=opt.interceptHoldRadius then ip.arrivedAt=ip.arrivedAt or now end
        if not ip.arrivedAt then
            if nav.mode~="INTERCEPT" then
                nav.mode="INTERCEPT";nav.modeAt=now
                trace("NAV_MODE","INTERCEPT long-range staging "..ip.boss)
            end
            -- Commit a gentle path aligned to the worm's emergence heading.
            local bend=ip.heading*math.min(d*.08,35)
            return safeUnit(offset+bend,forward),d
        end
        if nav.mode~="INTERCEPT_CORRIDOR" then
            nav.mode="INTERCEPT_CORRIDOR";nav.modeAt=now
            trace("NAV_MODE","INTERCEPT_CORRIDOR; forward passage, no waypoint reverse")
        end
        local laneHeading=safeUnit(flat(ip.heading),safeUnit(flat(forward),Vector3.new(1,0,0)))
        local laneSide=Vector3.new(-laneHeading.Z,0,laneHeading.X)*ip.side
        local lateral=flat(pos-ip.position):Dot(laneSide)
        local desiredSide=math.max(opt.corridorFlankOffset,opt.interceptStandoff*.90)
        local adjust=math.clamp((desiredSide-lateral)/220,-.22,.32)
        local flow=laneHeading+laneSide*adjust
        local cruiseY=floorHeight(pos.X,pos.Z)+opt.preferredHeightAboveTerrain
        local yAdjust=math.clamp((cruiseY-pos.Y)/175,-.30,.30)
        if now-(nav.lastInterceptHoldLogAt or 0)>4 then
            nav.lastInterceptHoldLogAt=now
            trace("STAGE_CORRIDOR",string.format(
                "boss=%s distToEmergence=%.0f side=%.0f eta=%.1f",
                ip.boss,(flat(pos-ip.position)).Magnitude,lateral,ip.eta))
        end
        return safeUnit(flow+Vector3.new(0,yAdjust,0),forward),d
    end
    -- When all worms submerge, briefly orbit the most recently observed surface
    -- opening. Do not fly directly toward a submerged boss coordinate.
    if nav.lastSurfacePos and now-nav.lastSurfaceAt<=opt.surfaceMemorySeconds then
        if nav.mode~="WAIT_SURFACE" then
            nav.mode="WAIT_SURFACE";nav.modeAt=now
            trace("NAV_MODE","WAIT_SURFACE: stay nearby for next exposure")
        end
        local relative=flat(pos-nav.lastSurfacePos)
        local d=relative.Magnitude
        local outward=safeUnit(relative,safeUnit(flat(forward),Vector3.new(1,0,0)))
        local tangent=Vector3.new(-outward.Z,0,outward.X)*nav.side
        local radial=math.clamp((d-preferred)/math.max(preferred,1),-1,1)
        local keep=tangent-radial*outward*.75
        -- Stay near the last exposure instead of climbing to a fixed high Y.
        local cruiseY = floorHeight(pos.X,pos.Z) + opt.preferredHeightAboveTerrain
        local yControl=math.clamp((cruiseY-pos.Y)/110,-.75,.75)
        return safeUnit(keep+Vector3.new(0,yControl,0),forward),d
    end
    if nav.mode~="SEARCH" then nav.mode="SEARCH";nav.modeAt=now end
    local theta=now*.12
    local x,z=math.cos(theta)*760,math.sin(theta)*760
    local orbit=Vector3.new(x,floorHeight(x,z)+opt.preferredHeightAboveTerrain,z)
    return safeUnit(orbit-pos,forward),nil
end
local function turnStep(dir,goal,dt)
    local error=math.acos(math.clamp(safeUnit(dir):Dot(safeUnit(goal)),-1,1))
    if error<.001 then return safeUnit(goal) end
    local step=math.rad(opt.predictedTurnDeg)*dt
    return safeUnit(dir:Lerp(goal,math.min(1,step/error)),dir)
end
local function predictCost(pos,forward,command,speed,items,body,raidNow,horizon)
    local predictedPos=pos
    local heading=forward
    local maxCost=0
    local accumulated=0
    local topThreat=nil
    local topBody=nil
    for index=1,math.ceil((horizon or opt.trajectoryHorizon)/opt.predictionStep) do
        local dt=opt.predictionStep
        local future=index*dt
        heading=turnStep(heading,command,dt)
        predictedPos=predictedPos+heading*speed*dt
        local boundary=boundsCost(predictedPos)
        local worm,wormRef=bodyPenalty(predictedPos,body,future)
        local hazard,hazardRef=threatCost(predictedPos,items,raidNow,future)
        local risk=boundary+worm+hazard
        accumulated=accumulated + risk * (.5+1/(1+future*.22))
        if risk>maxCost then maxCost=risk;topThreat=hazardRef;topBody=wormRef end
    end
    return accumulated,maxCost,topThreat,topBody
end
-- Candidate side + arrival heading are chosen once and retained until a
-- meaningful path replan/position shift. Native SetAutoPilot receives the held
-- desired vector each frame, rather than a series of discrete key inputs.
local function updateInterceptPlan(sim,visible)
    local nav=self.nav
    if visible or not opt.predictSurface then nav.intercept=nil;return end
    local focus=nav.focusBoss
    local fc=focus and nav.forecasts[focus] or nil
    if not fc or fc.eta<-.1 then nav.intercept=nil;return end
    local now=os.clock()
    local held=nav.intercept
    if held and held.boss==focus and
       math.abs(held.raidTime-fc.raidTime)<1.25 and
       (held.position-fc.position).Magnitude<opt.interceptReplanDistance and
       now<=held.expiresAt then
        -- The forecast clock advances in scan-sized increments. Holding only on
        -- exact equality would repeatedly flip the route even with NO replan.
        -- Preserve the waypoint/side while recalculating arrival ETA from our
        -- current aircraft position and the server's current raid clock.
        held.raidTime=fc.raidTime
        held.eta=fc.raidTime-getRaidTime()
        held.travelTime=(held.waypoint-sim.Position).Magnitude/
            math.max(90,tonumber(sim.Speed) or 160)
        held.expiresAt=now+math.max(1,held.eta+2.8)
        return
    end
    local pos=sim.Position
    local speed=math.max(90,tonumber(sim.Speed) or 160)
    local heading=safeUnit(flat(fc.heading),Vector3.new(1,0,0))
    local sides={-1,1}
    local best=nil
    local caps=bodyCapsules()
    local raidTime=getRaidTime()
    local hazards=opt.autoDodge and listHazards(raidTime) or {}
    for _,sideSign in ipairs(sides) do
        local side=Vector3.new(-heading.Z,0,heading.X)*sideSign
        -- Target a longitudinal firing lane, NOT a small orbit around the
        -- point where the worm breaks through the sand.
        local offset=side*math.max(opt.corridorFlankOffset,opt.interceptStandoff*.90)-
            heading*opt.rearPredictTrail
        local provisional=fc.position+offset
        local sand=floorHeight(provisional.X,provisional.Z)
        local y=math.clamp(fc.position.Y+22,
            sand+opt.minClearanceAboveFloor+30,
            sand+opt.maxHeightAboveTerrain-10)
        local waypoint=Vector3.new(provisional.X,y,provisional.Z)
        local to=waypoint-pos
        local dist=to.Magnitude
        local turn=headingError(sim.Rotation.LookVector,to)
        local turnRate=opt.interceptTurnRateDeg
        local effectiveDistance=dist+(math.rad(turn)*speed/math.rad(turnRate))*.38
        local travel=effectiveDistance/speed
        local late=math.max(0,travel-fc.eta)
        local bodyPenaltyHere=bodyPenalty(waypoint,caps,0)
        -- Score the entire approximate approach trajectory, not only the
        -- destination. Dangerous known telegraphs should favor the other side.
        local pathCost,pathPeak=predictCost(pos,sim.Rotation.LookVector,
            safeUnit(to,sim.Rotation.LookVector),speed,hazards,caps,raidTime)
        local score=travel+late*2.2+turn*.019+boundsCost(waypoint)*.05+
            bodyPenaltyHere*.09+math.min(30,pathCost*.018)+math.min(25,pathPeak*.11)
        if held and held.boss==focus and held.side==sideSign then score=score-2.5 end
        if not best or score<best.score then
            best={boss=focus,position=fc.position,raidTime=fc.raidTime,
                eta=fc.raidTime-getRaidTime(),waypoint=waypoint,heading=heading,
                side=sideSign,travelTime=travel,score=score,
                expiresAt=now+math.max(1,fc.eta+2.8)}
        end
    end
    if not best then nav.intercept=nil;return end
    local changed=not held or held.boss~=best.boss or held.side~=best.side or
        (held.waypoint-best.waypoint).Magnitude>=opt.interceptReplanDistance
    if changed then
        trace("INTERCEPT_LOCK",string.format(
            "boss=%s ETA=%.1fs travel=%.1fs side=%s waypoint=(%.0f,%.0f,%.0f)",
            best.boss,best.eta,best.travelTime,best.side>0 and "LEFT" or "RIGHT",
            best.waypoint.X,best.waypoint.Y,best.waypoint.Z))
    end
    nav.intercept=best
end

-- V2.6: calculate full 3D boss pursuit first. ONLY enter lateral-first
-- planning if the proposed trajectory has a meaningful collision/hazard risk.
-- This lets the aircraft climb/descend to the boss as usual, yet prefer
-- left/right on genuine dodges. Native flight handles actual turns.
local function selectSafeAim(sim,wanted,dist)
    local nav=self.nav
    local pos=sim.Position
    local forward=sim.Rotation.LookVector
    local forwardLevel=safeUnit(flat(forward),Vector3.new(0,0,-1))
    local speed=math.clamp(tonumber(sim.Speed) or 175,80,400)
    local now=getRaidTime()
    local items=opt.autoDodge and listHazards(now) or {}
    local body=bodyCapsules()
    local direct=pursuitHeading(wanted,forward)
    -- V3.7: an attack corridor is our DEFAULT route. We only override it
    -- for damage predicted soon, not for a speculative far-horizon crossing.
    -- In particular a predicted body 2-3 seconds away should NOT cause
    -- repeated escape/reacquire loops while the boss is exposed.
    local horizon=math.min(opt.trajectoryHorizon,opt.dodgeImminentSeconds)
    local directTotal,directPeak,directItem,directBody=predictCost(pos,forward,direct,speed,items,body,now,horizon)
    local hazardNow=threatCost(pos,items,now,0)
    local bodyNow,closeBody=bodyPenalty(pos,body,0)
    nav.bodyRisk=bodyNow
    local sweepRisk=0
    for _,dt in ipairs({.35,.75,1.15,1.5}) do
        if dt<=horizon+.01 then
            local planeFuture=pos+forward*speed*dt
            local risk=bodyPenalty(planeFuture,body,dt)
            sweepRisk=math.max(sweepRisk,risk)
        end
    end
    nav.bodySweepRisk=sweepRisk
    if sweepRisk>=opt.rearLaneEscapeRisk and os.clock()-(nav.lastMovingBodyLogAt or 0)>2.5 then
        nav.lastMovingBodyLogAt=os.clock()
        trace("MOVING_BODY_WARNING",string.format(
            "boss=%s bodySweep=%.0f current=%.0f speed=%.0f",
            tostring(nav.focusBoss),sweepRisk,bodyNow,speed))
    end
    local imminent = directPeak>=opt.dodgeImminentRisk or
        hazardNow>=opt.dodgeImminentRisk or bodyNow>=90 or
        sweepRisk>=opt.rearLaneEscapeRisk
    if not imminent then
        if directPeak>25 and os.clock()-(nav.lastDodgeGateLogAt or 0)>5 then
            nav.lastDodgeGateLogAt=os.clock()
            trace("DODGE_GATE",string.format(
                "PURSUIT boss=%s risk=%.0f nearBody=%.0f sweep=%.0f (no imminent contact)",
                tostring(nav.focusBoss),directPeak,bodyNow,sweepRisk))
        end
        -- Normal chase/track/break: retain vertical adjustments and avoid
        -- needlessly flattening the aim to a yaw-only steering command.
        nav.lastChoice=direct
        nav.risk=directPeak
        nav.threat=directItem and tostring(directItem.K)..":"..tostring(directItem.Id) or nil
        nav.lastDodgeRoute="PURSUIT_3D"
        nav.emergencyHeading=nil
        nav.dodgeHoldUntil=0
        if math.abs(direct.Y)>.2 and os.clock()-(nav.lastPursuitPitchLogAt or 0)>5 then
            nav.lastPursuitPitchLogAt=os.clock()
            trace("PURSUIT_PITCH",string.format("mode=%s pitchY=%.2f risk=%.0f dist=%s",
                nav.mode,direct.Y,directPeak,dist and math.floor(dist) or "n/a"))
        end
        return direct,false,directPeak,bodyNow,hazardNow,nav.threat
    end
    local lateralCandidates={cruiseHeading(wanted,forward),cruiseHeading(forward,forward)}
    for _,yaw in ipairs({-85,-65,-45,-25,0,25,45,65,85}) do
        local turned=CFrame.fromAxisAngle(Vector3.yAxis,math.rad(yaw)):VectorToWorldSpace(forwardLevel)
        table.insert(lateralCandidates,cruiseHeading(turned,forward))
    end
    local prev=nav.lastChoice
    local function routeScore(command,isVertical)
        local total,peak,item,worm=predictCost(pos,forward,command,speed,items,body,now,horizon)
        local preference=headingError(wanted,command)*.27+headingError(forward,command)*.12
        if prev and prev:Dot(command)<.92 then preference=preference+5 end
        if os.clock()<nav.planHoldUntil and prev and prev:Dot(command)<.72 then preference=preference+16 end
        if isVertical then preference=preference+12 end
        return total+preference,total,peak,item,worm
    end
    local best=math.huge
    local lateralTotal=math.huge
    local lateralPeak=math.huge
    local bestDir=cruiseHeading(wanted,forward)
    local bestItem,bestBody=nil,nil
    for _,command in ipairs(lateralCandidates) do
        local score,total,peak,item,worm=routeScore(command,false)
        if score<best then
            best=score;lateralTotal=total;lateralPeak=peak
            bestDir=command;bestItem=item;bestBody=worm
        end
    end
    local bestPeak=lateralPeak
    local verticalChosen=false
    -- If ANY side has a tolerable projected peak, stay horizontal even when
    -- another direction is better aligned with the target. This prevents a
    -- vertical escape just because the best-scoring yaw was target-aligned.
    local safeScore=math.huge
    local safeDir,safePeak,safeTotal,safeItem,safeBody=nil,nil,nil,nil,nil
    for _,command in ipairs(lateralCandidates) do
        local score,total,peak,item,worm=routeScore(command,false)
        if peak<opt.verticalEmergencyRisk and score<safeScore then
            safeScore=score;safeDir=command;safePeak=peak;safeTotal=total
            safeItem=item;safeBody=worm
        end
    end
    if safeDir then
        best= safeScore;bestDir=safeDir;bestPeak=safePeak
        lateralPeak=safePeak;lateralTotal=safeTotal
        bestItem=safeItem;bestBody=safeBody
    end
    -- Only test a climb/dive if no lateral candidate is below the risk ceiling.
    -- Vertical has to reduce peak and integrated hazard enough to justify it.
    if not safeDir and lateralPeak>=opt.verticalEmergencyRisk then
        local verticalBest=math.huge
        local verticalTotal=math.huge
        local verticalPeak=math.huge
        local verticalDir=nil
        local verticalItem,verticalBody=nil,nil
        for _,yaw in ipairs({-65,-35,0,35,65}) do
            local turned=CFrame.fromAxisAngle(Vector3.yAxis,math.rad(yaw)):VectorToWorldSpace(forwardLevel)
            for _,pitch in ipairs({-.32,.35,.52}) do
                local command=safeUnit(turned+Vector3.new(0,pitch,0),forward)
                local score,total,peak,item,worm=routeScore(command,true)
                if score<verticalBest then
                    verticalBest=score;verticalTotal=total;verticalPeak=peak
                    verticalDir=command;verticalItem=item;verticalBody=worm
                end
            end
        end
        if verticalDir and
           verticalPeak <= lateralPeak-opt.verticalPeakReduction and
           verticalTotal <= lateralTotal*(1-opt.verticalRequiredGain) then
            bestDir=verticalDir;bestPeak=verticalPeak
            bestItem=verticalItem;bestBody=verticalBody
            verticalChosen=true
        end
    end
    -- Do not replace an effective attack run with a side maneuver that
    -- barely reduces danger. For extreme contact, the least risky route wins.
    local improvement=directPeak-bestPeak
    if improvement<opt.dodgeMinRiskImprovement and directPeak<150 and
        bodyNow<130 and hazardNow<140 and sweepRisk<140 then
        nav.lastChoice=direct
        nav.risk=directPeak
        nav.lastDodgeRoute="PURSUIT_3D"
        return direct,false,directPeak,bodyNow,hazardNow,
            directItem and tostring(directItem.K)..":"..tostring(directItem.Id) or nil
    end
    -- Keep the same escape direction briefly while an actual hazard persists;
    -- otherwise left/right candidate scoring can flip every 0.12 seconds.
    local decisionClock=os.clock()
    if nav.emergencyHeading and decisionClock<(nav.dodgeHoldUntil or 0) then
        local _,heldPeak,heldItem,heldBody=predictCost(pos,forward,
            nav.emergencyHeading,speed,items,body,now,horizon)
        if heldPeak<=bestPeak+15 then
            bestDir=nav.emergencyHeading
            bestPeak=heldPeak
            bestItem=heldItem
            bestBody=heldBody
            verticalChosen=math.abs(bestDir.Y)>.25
        end
    else
        nav.emergencyHeading=bestDir
        nav.dodgeHoldUntil=decisionClock+.70
    end
    if not prev or prev:Dot(bestDir)<.975 then
        nav.planHoldUntil=os.clock()+opt.navHoldSeconds
    end
    nav.lastChoice=bestDir
    nav.risk=bestPeak
    nav.threat=bestItem and tostring(bestItem.K)..":"..tostring(bestItem.Id) or nil
    -- An avoidance plan was required; native heading should react immediately
    -- even when the chosen lateral route is now predicted to be safe.
    local urgent=true
    local clock=os.clock()
    if verticalChosen then
        nav.lastDodgeRoute=bestDir.Y>0 and "EMERGENCY_CLIMB" or "EMERGENCY_DIVE"
        if bestDir.Y>0 then nav.lastEmergencyClimbAt=clock end
        if clock-(nav.lastVerticalLogAt or 0)>2 then
            nav.lastVerticalLogAt=clock
            trace("DODGE_VERTICAL_EMERGENCY",string.format(
                "route=%s lateralPeak=%.0f chosenPeak=%.0f riskGain=%.0f%% pitchY=%.2f",
                nav.lastDodgeRoute,lateralPeak,bestPeak,
                lateralTotal>0 and (1-math.min(1,verticalTotal/lateralTotal))*100 or 0,bestDir.Y))
        end
    else
        nav.lastDodgeRoute="LATERAL"
        if urgent and clock-(nav.lastLateralLogAt or 0)>2 then
            nav.lastLateralLogAt=clock
            local turn=forwardLevel:Cross(safeUnit(flat(bestDir),forwardLevel)).Y
            local side=turn>0.02 and "LEFT" or turn<-.02 and "RIGHT" or "STRAIGHT"
            trace("DODGE_LATERAL",string.format(
                "side=%s peak=%.0f hazardNow=%.0f bodyNow=%.0f pitchY=%.2f",
                side,bestPeak,hazardNow,bodyNow,bestDir.Y))
        end
    end
    if urgent and clock-nav.lastLogAt>1.5 then
        nav.lastLogAt=clock
        trace("AVOID_PLAN",string.format("risk=%.0f immediateBody=%.0f hazard=%s body=%s mode=%s count=%d route=%s",
            bestPeak,bodyNow,bestItem and tostring(bestItem.K)..":"..tostring(bestItem.Id) or "none",
            bestBody and tostring(bestBody.who).."/"..tostring(bestBody.part) or
            closeBody and tostring(closeBody.who).."/"..tostring(closeBody.part) or "none",
            nav.mode,#items,nav.lastDodgeRoute))
    end
    return bestDir,urgent,bestPeak,bodyNow,hazardNow,nav.threat
end
-- V2.7: Follow terrain at low altitude. The soft ceiling is a *navigation*
-- target, never a hard lock; a confirmed emergency vertical dodge can climb
-- temporarily. Preserve the terrain floor and predictive body/hazard planner.
local function keepWithinBounds(dir,sim)
    local p=sim.Position
    local goal=dir
    local terrain=floorHeight(p.X,p.Z)
    local floor=terrain+opt.minClearanceAboveFloor
    local heightAboveTerrain=p.Y-terrain
    local emergencyClimb=self.nav.lastDodgeRoute=="EMERGENCY_CLIMB" and
        os.clock()-(self.nav.lastEmergencyClimbAt or 0)<1.2
    local allowedHeight=emergencyClimb and opt.emergencyHeightAboveTerrain or opt.maxHeightAboveTerrain
    -- Fade out climb near the normal ceiling; don't immediately pitch up to
    -- chase a high weakpoint when already well above the sand.
    if heightAboveTerrain>allowedHeight-70 and goal.Y>0 then
        local climbScale=math.clamp((allowedHeight-heightAboveTerrain)/70,0,1)
        goal=Vector3.new(goal.X,goal.Y*climbScale,goal.Z)
    end
    -- Descend *progressively* above the soft ceiling. This stops repeated
    -- flights to Y=500+ just because the boss model is tall.
    if heightAboveTerrain>allowedHeight then
        local descent=math.clamp((heightAboveTerrain-allowedHeight+25)/75,.35,3.0)
        goal=Vector3.new(goal.X,math.min(goal.Y,0)-descent,goal.Z)
    end
    -- Never keep the emergency climb indefinitely after hazard clearance.
    if heightAboveTerrain>opt.emergencyHeightAboveTerrain+25 then
        goal=goal+Vector3.new(0,-2.5,0)
    end
    if p.Y<floor+50 then
        goal=goal+Vector3.new(0,math.clamp((floor+120-p.Y)/60,1,4),0)
    end
    if p.Y>opt.maxCruiseAltitude-50 then
        goal=goal+Vector3.new(0,-math.clamp((p.Y-opt.maxCruiseAltitude+130)/80,.8,4),0)
    end
    if math.abs(p.X)>2150 then goal=goal+Vector3.new(-math.sign(p.X)*math.clamp((math.abs(p.X)-2050)/100,1,5),0,0) end
    if math.abs(p.Z)>2150 then goal=goal+Vector3.new(0,0,-math.sign(p.Z)*math.clamp((math.abs(p.Z)-2050)/100,1,5)) end
    if os.clock()-(self.nav.lastAltitudeLogAt or 0)>5 then
        self.nav.lastAltitudeLogAt=os.clock()
        trace("ALTITUDE_PLAN",string.format("height=%.0f terrain=%.0f above=%.0f target=%.0f soft=%.0f emergency=%s pitch=%.2f",
            p.Y,terrain,heightAboveTerrain,terrain+opt.preferredHeightAboveTerrain,
            terrain+allowedHeight,tostring(emergencyClimb),goal.Y))
    end
    return safeUnit(goal,sim.Rotation.LookVector)
end
-- V3.7: update pursuit heading continuously within a short rate-limited
-- window; don't wait >1 s for a moving boss. Ignore small jitter.
local function stabilizedHeading(nav,proposed,urgent,targetId,now)
    local current=nav.committedHeading
    local angle=current and headingError(current,proposed) or 180
    local modeChanged=nav.headingMode~=nav.mode
    local targetChanged=nav.headingTarget~=targetId
    local closeTrack=nav.mode=="TRACK" or nav.mode=="TRACK_CORRIDOR"
    local meaningful=angle>=(closeTrack and 4.5 or opt.headingChangeDeg)
    local large=angle>=(closeTrack and 17 or 20)
    local elapsed=now-(nav.lastHeadingCommitAt or 0)
    local minInterval=closeTrack and .15 or .22
    local shouldCommit=not current or urgent or large or
        (modeChanged and meaningful) or
        (targetChanged and angle>10) or
        (elapsed>=minInterval and meaningful and
            (now>=nav.headingHoldUntil or angle>=9))
    if shouldCommit then
        nav.committedHeading=safeUnit(proposed)
        nav.headingHoldUntil=now+opt.headingHoldSeconds
        nav.lastHeadingCommitAt=now
        nav.headingMode=nav.mode
        nav.headingTarget=targetId
        if now-(nav.lastHeadingLog or 0)>3.5 then
            nav.lastHeadingLog=now
            trace("HEADING_COMMIT",string.format(
                "mode=%s angle=%.1f urgent=%s target=%s",
                nav.mode,angle,tostring(urgent),tostring(targetId or "none")))
        end
    end
    return nav.committedHeading or proposed
end

-- In Sandworm.Pilot:_combat, OnTarget is set from ACTUAL aircraft LookVector,
-- native GunConeDeg (3.2 degrees plus target radius), and GunRange (420).
-- Continuous Fire=true outside that window only heats ManualFlightRuntime.Gun.
-- We additionally use native 0..1 heat data to burst-fire before overheat.
local function weaponIntent(flight,sim,target,targetPos,now)
    local nav=self.nav
    local combat=self.raidConfig and self.raidConfig.Combat
    local gunRange=tonumber(combat and combat.GunRange) or opt.gunRange
    local missileRange=tonumber(combat and combat.MissileRange) or opt.missileRange
    local missileCone=tonumber(combat and combat.MissileConeDeg) or 28
    local gun=type(flight.Gun)=="table" and flight.Gun or nil
    local heat=gun and tonumber(gun.Heat) or nil
    local overheated=(gun and gun.Overheated==true) or false
    local nativeLock=(flight.OnTarget==true and (tonumber(flight.TargetDistance) or math.huge)<=gunRange)
    if overheated or (heat and heat>=opt.gunHeatPause) then
        nav.gunCooling=true
    elseif nav.gunCooling and heat and heat<=opt.gunHeatResume and not overheated then
        nav.gunCooling=false
    elseif nav.gunCooling and not gun then
        -- A new flight instance may not expose heat until the runtime initializes.
        nav.gunCooling=false
    end
    local fire=opt.autoAttack==true and target~=nil and nativeLock and
        flight.HasGuns~=false and flight.GunReady~=false and not nav.gunCooling and not overheated

    -- Missile targeting uses native Pilot:_combat's exposed target cone/range,
    -- but independently of gun heat. Native still validates lock & cooldown.
    local d=targetPos and (targetPos-sim.Position).Magnitude or math.huge
    local angle=targetPos and headingError(sim.Rotation.LookVector,targetPos-sim.Position) or 180
    local missileReady=(flight.MissileState=="ready" or flight.MissileState==nil)
    local missile=opt.autoAttack==true and opt.autoMissile==true and target~=nil and
        d>12 and d<=missileRange and angle<=missileCone and
        flight.BossMissiles~=false and missileReady

    if now-(nav.lastGunGateLog or 0)>3.5 then
        nav.lastGunGateLog=now
        trace("GUN_GATE",string.format(
            "fire=%s onTarget=%s range=%s heat=%s cooling=%s overheat=%s missile=%s aim=%.1f",
            tostring(fire),tostring(nativeLock),tostring(flight.TargetDistance),
            heat and string.format("%.2f",heat) or "unknown",tostring(nav.gunCooling),
            tostring(overheated),tostring(missile),angle))
    end
    return fire,missile,heat,nativeLock
end

local function queueReturnHome()
    if self.returnQueued then return true end
    local fn,api=findQueueApi()
    if not fn then trace("RETURN_QUEUE_UNAVAILABLE", "World 125 needs manual travel after native return");return false end
    if not swJournal() then return false end
    local contextJson=HttpService:JSONEncode(SW_CONTEXT)
    local prefix="local SW_CONTEXT=game:GetService('HttpService'):JSONDecode("..string.format("%q",contextJson)..")\n"
    local payload=prefix..HOME_RETURN_SOURCE:gsub('__EXPECTED_USER__',tostring(player.UserId))
        :gsub('__EXPIRES_AT__',tostring(os.time()+7200)).."\n"..SW_CONTEXT.returnHook
    local ok,err=pcall(function() fn(payload) end)
    if not ok then trace('RETURN_QUEUE_FAILED',tostring(err));return false end
    self.returnQueued=true
    trace('RETURN_QUEUE_READY',api..' -> main place -> World '..tostring(opt.homeWorld))
    return true
end
-- V2.9: adjust throttle gradually instead of bouncing from slow TRACK to
-- maximum thrust each time dodge/target state flickers. Only a genuine near-stall
-- bypasses the rate limiter. Boss tracking and aim logic are otherwise unchanged.
local function planCombatThrottle(flight,sim,targetPos,dist,urgent,bodyNow,peak,now,dt)
    local nav=self.nav
    local handling=type(flight.Handling)=="table" and flight.Handling or nil
    local maxSpeed=handling and tonumber(handling.MaxSpeed) or nil
    local minSpeed=handling and tonumber(handling.MinSpeed) or nil
    local handlingValid=maxSpeed and minSpeed and maxSpeed>minSpeed and minSpeed>0
    local actual=tonumber(sim.Speed) or 0
    local desired=opt.speedApproachThrottle
    local reason="APPROACH"
    -- V3.8: chasing and attacking are DISTINCT speed regimes.
    -- Rear distance is measured to the formation waypoint, not a moving weak point.
    -- Earlier releases started braking ~1450 studs away and then clamped chase
    -- throttle, leaving the plane too slow when it finally caught the worm.
    local rearDistance=nav.rearRange
    local headingDelta=nav.smoothAim and headingError(sim.Rotation.LookVector,nav.smoothAim) or 0
    local closeRear=targetPos and rearDistance and
        rearDistance<=opt.rearTrackRadius+45 and headingDelta<=55
    local inRearTrack=closeRear and nav.rearEngaged and
        (nav.mode=="TRACK" or nav.mode=="TRACK_CORRIDOR")
    local corridorShooting=targetPos and nav.mode=="TRACK_CORRIDOR" and
        flight.OnTarget==true
    local nearRear=closeRear or corridorShooting
    local targetAirspeed=handlingValid and minSpeed*opt.speedMinReserveMultiplier or nil
    local remaining=rearDistance or dist

    -- Hysteresis prevents speed-mode oscillation when rear waypoint jitters.
    if targetPos and rearDistance and nav.mode~="BREAK" then
        if rearDistance>=opt.speedPursuitEnterDistance then
            nav.pursuitSpeedActive=true
        elseif rearDistance<=opt.speedPursuitExitDistance then
            nav.pursuitSpeedActive=false
        end
    else
        nav.pursuitSpeedActive=false
    end

    if nav.intercept and not targetPos and
       (nav.mode=="INTERCEPT" or nav.mode=="INTERCEPT_CORRIDOR") then
        local ip=nav.intercept
        if nav.mode=="INTERCEPT_CORRIDOR" then
            desired=math.max(opt.speedTrackThrottle,.30)
            reason="CORRIDOR_ARRIVAL_SPEED"
        elseif ip.travelTime>ip.eta+1 then
            desired=opt.speedPursuitThrottle
            reason="INTERCEPT_CATCHUP"
        elseif ip.eta>ip.travelTime+2 then
            desired=math.max(.42,opt.speedSearchThrottle-.16)
            reason="INTERCEPT_EARLY_BRAKE"
        else
            desired=opt.speedSearchThrottle
            reason="INTERCEPT_SYNC"
        end
    elseif not targetPos or nav.mode=="SEARCH" or nav.mode=="WAIT_SURFACE" then
        desired=opt.speedSearchThrottle
        reason="SEARCH"
    elseif nearRear then
        desired=opt.speedTrackThrottle
        reason="MIN_SPEED_REAR_TRACK"
    elseif nav.pursuitSpeedActive or (remaining and remaining>opt.speedBrakeStartDistance) then
        desired=opt.speedPursuitThrottle
        reason="CHASE_BOSS"
    elseif remaining then
        -- Only begin deceleration near the desired formation, not during chase.
        -- At the braking threshold thrust is still high; it fades smoothly
        -- toward the native MinSpeed tracking target after reaching the rear.
        local span=math.max(1,opt.speedBrakeStartDistance-(opt.rearTrackRadius+45))
        local progress=math.clamp((remaining-(opt.rearTrackRadius+45))/span,0,1)
        desired=opt.speedTrackThrottle+
            (opt.speedPursuitThrottle-opt.speedTrackThrottle)*progress
        reason="FINAL_APPROACH_BRAKE"
    end

    -- A big positional/heading error requires power, even if waypoint appears
