    -- momentarily close. Do not override an actually stable rear attack run.
    local repositioning=targetPos and not nearRear and
        ((rearDistance and rearDistance>opt.rearTrackRadius+110) or headingDelta>70)
    if repositioning then
        desired=math.max(desired,nav.pursuitSpeedActive and opt.speedPursuitThrottle or .72)
        reason=nav.pursuitSpeedActive and "CHASE_BOSS" or "POSITION_RECOVERY"
    end

    -- Native MinSpeed governs the low-speed flight limit. The V3.2 guards
    -- (>=67% MaxSpeed in formation, recovery at 58% MaxSpeed) prevented the
    -- aircraft from EVER slowing near its actual minimum. Do not restore them.
    -- Speed correction is capped and smooth: commanding throttle 0 is allowed
    -- when safely above our target speed; actual airspeed still falls gradually.
    if handlingValid and nearRear and not repositioning then
        local speedError=targetAirspeed-actual
        local normalized=speedError/math.max(maxSpeed-minSpeed,1)
        local correction=math.clamp(normalized*.85,-.18,.24)
        desired=math.clamp(opt.speedTrackThrottle+correction,0,.42)
        reason=inRearTrack and "MIN_SPEED_REAR_TRACK" or "MIN_SPEED_REAR_APPROACH"
    elseif not handlingValid then
        -- No trustworthy native minimum-speed data: keep a conservative floor.
        desired=math.max(desired,.45)
        reason="HANDLING_UNKNOWN"
    end

    -- Only recover when actually near native MinSpeed (not when below a large
    -- MaxSpeed percentage). Recovery has hysteresis to avoid speed pulsing.
    local nearStall=false
    if handlingValid then
        if actual<minSpeed*opt.speedRecoveryEnterMultiplier then
            nav.speedRecovery=true
        elseif actual>minSpeed*opt.speedRecoveryExitMultiplier then
            nav.speedRecovery=false
        end
        nearStall=actual<minSpeed*1.015
    else
        nav.speedRecovery=false
    end
    if nav.speedRecovery then
        desired=math.max(desired,.56)
        reason="MIN_SPEED_RECOVERY"
    end

    local turnAngle=nav.smoothAim and headingError(sim.Rotation.LookVector,nav.smoothAim) or 0
    -- Normal correction toward a moving rear waypoint is not an emergency.
    -- Only a truly large direction change away from stable rear tracking needs
    -- extra power; a small turn should not disable the low-speed engagement.
    if targetPos and turnAngle>105 and not nearRear and not inRearTrack and
       reason~="MIN_SPEED_RECOVERY" then
        desired=math.max(desired,.78)
        reason="TURN_RECOVERY"
    end
    if (nav.bodySweepRisk or 0)>35 or nav.rearLaneEscape then
        -- Staying near native MinSpeed while the worm approaches this lane
        -- turns the aircraft into an obstacle. Move laterally with authority.
        desired=math.max(desired,opt.bodyDangerThrottle)
        reason="MOVING_BODY_ESCAPE"
    end
    if nav.mode=="BREAK" or urgent or (bodyNow or 0)>35 or
       (peak or 0)>opt.verticalEmergencyRisk then
        desired=math.max(desired,.92)
        reason=nav.mode=="BREAK" and "BREAKAWAY" or "DODGE"
    end

    local last=nav.smoothThrottle or tonumber(flight.Controls.Throttle) or desired
    local elapsed=math.clamp(dt,.04,.4)
    local smoothed
    if nearStall then
        -- Real imminent minimum-speed breach, not routine rear tracking.
        smoothed=math.max(last,.90)
        reason="STALL_PREVENT"
    else
        local increasing=desired>last
        local rate=increasing and opt.speedThrottleAccelPerSecond or opt.speedThrottleSlewPerSecond
        if increasing and reason=="CHASE_BOSS" then
            rate=opt.speedPursuitAccelPerSecond
        end
        if increasing and (reason=="BREAKAWAY" or reason=="DODGE" or
            reason=="MIN_SPEED_RECOVERY" or reason=="MOVING_BODY_ESCAPE" or
            reason=="POSITION_RECOVERY") then
            rate=opt.speedThrottleEmergencyAccelPerSecond
        end
        local step=rate*elapsed
        smoothed=math.clamp(desired,last-step,last+step)
    end
    smoothed=math.clamp(smoothed,0,1)
    nav.smoothThrottle=smoothed
    nav.throttleMode=reason
    nav.targetMinSafeSpeed=targetAirspeed
    local important=reason~=(nav.lastSpeedModeLog or "") and
        (reason=="CHASE_BOSS" or reason=="FINAL_APPROACH_BRAKE" or
         reason=="MIN_SPEED_REAR_TRACK" or reason=="MIN_SPEED_RECOVERY" or
         reason=="BREAKAWAY" or reason=="DODGE" or reason=="STALL_PREVENT")
    if now-(nav.lastSpeedLog or 0)>=4 or
       (important and now-(nav.lastSpeedLog or 0)>=1) then
        nav.lastSpeedModeLog=reason
        nav.lastSpeedLog=now
        trace("COMBAT_SPEED",string.format(
            "state=%s throttle=%.3f target=%.3f actual=%.1f min=%s targetSafe=%s max=%s rearRange=%s rear=%s recovery=%s",
            reason,smoothed,desired,actual,
            minSpeed and string.format("%.1f",minSpeed) or "unknown",
            targetAirspeed and string.format("%.1f",targetAirspeed) or "unknown",
            maxSpeed and string.format("%.1f",maxSpeed) or "unknown",
            nav.rearRange and string.format("%.0f",nav.rearRange) or "none",
            tostring(nav.rearEngaged),tostring(nav.speedRecovery)))
        if nav.intercept then
            trace("ARRIVAL_SPEED",string.format("boss=%s eta=%.1f travel=%.1f throttle=%.3f state=%s",
                nav.intercept.boss,nav.intercept.eta,nav.intercept.travelTime,smoothed,reason))
        end
    end
    return smoothed
end

local function autoCombatStep()
    if not usableFight() then releaseWeapons();return end
    local flight,sim=getFlight()
    if not flight or not sim or flight.Held or type(flight.Controls)~="table" then
        releaseWeapons();return
    end
    if not self.flightModule or type(self.flightModule.SetAim)~="function" then releaseWeapons();return end
    local nav=self.nav
    if nav.lastPlane~=flight then
        releaseWeapons()
        nav.lastPlane=flight;nav.smoothAim=nil;nav.lastChoice=nil
        nav.committedHeading=nil;nav.headingHoldUntil=0;nav.gunCooling=false
        nav.smoothThrottle=nil;nav.throttleMode="INITIAL";nav.speedRecovery=false
        nav.pursuitSpeedActive=false
        nav.intercept=nil;nav.forecastAt=0;nav.corridor=nil
        nav.rearBoss=nil;nav.rearHeading=nil;nav.rearSideSign=nil
        nav.rearWaypoint=nil;nav.rearWaypointAt=0;nav.rearWaypointBoss=nil;nav.rearVelocity=Vector3.zero
        nav.rearEngaged=false;nav.rearRange=nil
        nav.lastHeadingCommitAt=0
        nav.rearLaneEscape=false;nav.bodySweepRisk=0
        nav.mode="APPROACH";nav.modeAt=os.clock()
        trace("AIRCRAFT_BOUND","Flight instance changed; navigation reset")
    end
    updateEmergenceForecasts()
    local target,targetPos=chooseTarget(sim)
    updateInterceptPlan(sim,target~=nil)
    self.autoTarget=target and tostring(target.Id or target.Z) or
        self.nav.intercept and ("PREDICT:"..tostring(self.nav.intercept.boss)) or nil
    local desired,dist=plannedDirection(sim,target,targetPos)
    -- TRACK/APPROACH/WAIT_SURFACE may adjust altitude freely. Lateral-first
    -- pitch restriction belongs ONLY inside selectSafeAim() when dodging.
    desired=pursuitHeading(desired,sim.Rotation.LookVector)
    local planned,urgent,peak,bodyNow,hazardNow,threat=selectSafeAim(sim,desired,dist)
    if opt.autoDodge then
        desired=planned
    elseif bodyNow>30 then
        -- Collision avoidance always remains on; optional dodge toggle disables packet hazard avoidance only.
        desired=planned
    end
    desired=keepWithinBounds(desired,sim)
    local now=os.clock()
    -- Replan immediately for predicted danger, meaningful heading/target changes,
    -- otherwise keep one deliberate heading long enough for native turns to settle.
    desired=stabilizedHeading(nav,desired,urgent,
        nav.rearBoss and ("REAR:"..nav.rearBoss) or self.autoTarget,now)
    local dt=math.clamp(now-(nav.lastTickAt>0 and nav.lastTickAt or now-.12),.04,.4)
    nav.lastTickAt=now
    -- Smooth heading like Fleet native flight: damp target jitter, accelerate emergency turns.
    local blend=1-math.exp(-(urgent and 15 or
        ((nav.mode=="TRACK" or nav.mode=="TRACK_CORRIDOR") and 10.0 or 8.5))*dt)
    nav.smoothAim=safeUnit(nav.smoothAim and nav.smoothAim:Lerp(desired,blend) or desired,desired)
    local controls=flight.Controls
    controls.Throttle=planCombatThrottle(flight,sim,targetPos,dist,urgent,bodyNow,peak,now,dt)
    local facing=targetPos and headingError(sim.Rotation.LookVector,targetPos-sim.Position) or 180
    if targetPos and now-(nav.lastRangeLogAt or 0)>6 then
        nav.lastRangeLogAt=now
        local squadRange=self.raidConfig and self.raidConfig.Squads and tonumber(self.raidConfig.Squads.Range) or 900
        trace("SURFACE_ENGAGEMENT",string.format(
            "boss=%s dist=%.0f standoff=%d squadRange=%d gunRange=420 missileRange=1100 mode=%s facing=%.1f°",
            tostring(nav.focusBoss),dist or -1,math.floor(opt.approachDistance),squadRange,nav.mode,facing))
    end
    -- V2.4: do NOT request gunfire unless native OnTarget is true and heat allows.
    -- Native aim uses actual aircraft rotation, not just the desired steering vector.
    local wantFire,wantMissile,gunHeat,nativeLock=weaponIntent(flight,sim,target,targetPos,now)
    self.nativePlan={Aim=nav.smoothAim,Throttle=controls.Throttle,
        Fire=wantFire,Missile=wantMissile,issuedAt=now}
    local nativeOn=ensureNativePilot()
    if nativeOn then
        -- Native controller calls the plan every frame and performs SetAim smoothing.
        -- That same controller overwrites Controls.Fire each frame, so the callback
        -- is ESSENTIAL for sustained gunfire and reliable missile requests.
        controls.Fire=wantFire
        if wantMissile then controls.MissileArmUntil=now+.5 else controls.MissileArmUntil=0 end
    else
        -- Fallback: steering still works but weapon controls may be overwritten.
        -- Log the degraded path instead of falsely reporting guaranteed firing.
        local ok,answer=pcall(self.flightModule.SetAim,nav.smoothAim)
        if not ok or answer==false then
            if now-(self.autoSteeringAt or 0)>3 then
                self.autoSteeringAt=now
                trace("AIM_REJECTED",tostring(answer))
            end
            releaseWeapons();return
        end
        controls.Fire=wantFire
        if wantMissile then controls.MissileArmUntil=now+.5 else controls.MissileArmUntil=0 end
    end
    if now-(self.lastAttackInfoLog or 0)>4.5 then
        self.lastAttackInfoLog=now
        trace("WEAPON_STATUS",string.format(
            "nativePilot=%s fireRequested=%s missileRequested=%s nativeOnTarget=%s nativeDist=%s gunReady=%s heat=%s cooling=%s missileState=%s",
            tostring(nativeOn),tostring(wantFire),tostring(wantMissile),
            tostring(nativeLock),tostring(flight.TargetDistance),
            tostring(flight.GunReady),gunHeat and string.format("%.2f",gunHeat) or "unknown",
            tostring(nav.gunCooling),tostring(flight.MissileState)))
    end
    self.lastFireFlight=flight
    self.attackTicks=self.attackTicks+1
    if opt.logSamples and now-(self.nav.lastCombatLog or 0)>4.5 then
        self.nav.lastCombatLog=now
        trace("FLIGHT_PLAN",string.format("mode=%s target=%s distance=%s face=%.1f° risk=%.0f throttle=%.2f speed=%.1f fireHeld=%s missileArmed=%s",
            nav.mode,tostring(self.autoTarget or "none"),dist and math.floor(dist) or "n/a",
            facing,peak,controls.Throttle,tonumber(sim.Speed) or 0,
            tostring(controls.Fire),tostring(controls.MissileArmUntil>now)))
    end
end
local function getReportController()
    local mods=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild('ClientModules')
    local m=mods and mods:FindFirstChild('BossResultsController')
    if not m or not m:IsA('ModuleScript') then return nil end
    local ok,controller=pcall(require,m)
    if ok and type(controller)=='table' then return controller end
    return nil
end
-- BossResultsController.IsOpen becomes true as soon as Show() constructs
-- the GUI, before its animation and Continue button have finished appearing.
-- Wait for the actual GUI/surface and the armed Continue control.
local function reportUiState()
    local pgui=player:FindFirstChildOfClass('PlayerGui')
    local gui=pgui and pgui:FindFirstChild('BossResultsGui')
    if not gui or not gui:IsA('ScreenGui') or not gui.Enabled then return false,false end
    local surface=gui:FindFirstChild('Surface',true)
    if not surface or not surface:IsA('GuiObject') or not surface.Visible then
        return false,false
    end
    local function visibleChain(obj)
        local node=obj
        while node and node~=gui do
            if node:IsA('GuiObject') and not node.Visible then return false end
            node=node.Parent
        end
        return node==gui
    end
    -- View structure is client-version dependent, so allow the actual Continue
    -- button to be identified by its ancestry or displayed text.
    for _,desc in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do
        if desc:IsA('GuiButton') and desc.Active and visibleChain(desc) then
            local name=string.lower(tostring(desc.Name))
            local parentName=desc.Parent and string.lower(tostring(desc.Parent.Name)) or ''
            local shownText=desc:IsA('TextButton') and string.lower(tostring(desc.Text)) or ''
            if name:find('continue',1,true) or parentName:find('continue',1,true)
                or shownText:find('continue',1,true) then
                return true,true
            end
        end
    end
    return true,false
end
local function autoResultStep()
    if self.state~='Results' and self.state~='Idle' and not self.outcome and not self.eliminatedAt then return end
    releaseWeapons()
    releaseNativePilot()
    local now=os.clock()
    local begun=self.resultAt or self.stateResultsAt or self.eliminatedAt
    if not begun then return end
    local controller=getReportController()
    local reportOpen=false
    if controller and type(controller.IsOpen)=='function' then
        local ok,value=pcall(controller.IsOpen)
        reportOpen=ok and value==true
    end
    local guiVisible,buttonReady=reportUiState()
    if guiVisible and not self.reportVisibleAt then
        self.reportVisibleAt=now
        trace('REPORT_GUI_VISIBLE','BossResultsGui surface visible; waiting for Continue to be ready')
    end
    if guiVisible and buttonReady and not self.reportButtonReadyAt then
        self.reportButtonReadyAt=now
        trace('REPORT_CONTINUE_READY','Continue button is visible and active')
    end
    if opt.autoCloseReport and not self.resultReportClosed then
        local buttonDwell=self.reportButtonReadyAt and now-self.reportButtonReadyAt or 0
        local visibleDwell=self.reportVisibleAt and now-self.reportVisibleAt or 0
        local uiReady=guiVisible and
            ((buttonReady and buttonDwell>=opt.resultCloseDelay) or
             (visibleDwell>=opt.reportButtonWaitTimeout and reportOpen))
        if uiReady and controller and type(controller.Dismiss)=='function' then
            local ok,err=pcall(function() controller.Dismiss('continue') end)
            if ok then
                self.resultReportClosed=true
                self.reportClosedAt=now
                trace('REPORT_CLOSED',string.format(
                    'Visible for %.1fs; Continue ready=%s; BossResultsController.Dismiss(continue)',
                    visibleDwell,tostring(buttonReady)))
            else
                trace('REPORT_CLOSE_FAILED',tostring(err))
            end
        elseif now-(self.lastReportWaitLog or 0)>5 then
            self.lastReportWaitLog=now
            trace('REPORT_WAIT_UI',string.format('controllerOpen=%s guiVisible=%s continueReady=%s visibleFor=%.1fs',
                tostring(reportOpen),tostring(guiVisible),tostring(buttonReady),visibleDwell))
        end
    end
    if not opt.autoReturn or self.returnRequested or self.teleportStarted then return end
    local waitFor=math.max(tonumber(opt.returnFallbackSeconds) or 22,8)
    local afterOutcome = self.outcome and self.resultAt and now-self.resultAt>waitFor
    local afterResults = self.stateResultsAt and now-self.stateResultsAt>math.max(waitFor+8,30)
    local afterElim = self.eliminatedAt and now-self.eliminatedAt>8 and (self.state~='Active')
    if afterOutcome or afterResults or afterElim then
        -- Auto Return must not preempt an expected report. Native server
        -- teleport may still happen independently of this fallback.
        if opt.autoCloseReport and not self.resultReportClosed then
            if now-begun < opt.resultUiTimeout then return end
            if now-(self.lastReportWaitLog or 0)>5 then
                self.lastReportWaitLog=now
                trace('REPORT_TIMEOUT','GUI not dismissible after timeout; allowing native Leave fallback')
            end
        end
        if self.resultReportClosed and now-(self.reportClosedAt or begun)<opt.reportWaitBeforeLeave then
            return
        end
        local ctl=self.gameController and self.gameController.Current
        if ctl and type(ctl.Leave)=='function' then
            local okay,err=pcall(function() ctl:Leave() end)
            if okay then
                self.returnRequested=true
                trace('RETURN_LEAVE_FALLBACK','Native Controller:Leave() after report/timeout; waiting for teleport')
            else
                trace('RETURN_LEAVE_ERROR',tostring(err))
            end
        elseif self.lastAutoLog~='RETURN_WAIT_CONTROLLER' then
            self.lastAutoLog='RETURN_WAIT_CONTROLLER'
            trace('RETURN_WAIT_CONTROLLER','No native Leave controller; waiting for automatic return')
        end
    end
end

function self:status()
    local flight, sim = getFlight()
    local wormSummary = {}
    for _, name in ipairs({"Harrower", "Dreadmaw", "Sovereign"}) do
        local w = self.worms[name]
        if type(w) == "table" then
            local hp = tonumber(w.HP or w.Health)
            local maxhp = tonumber(w.Max or w.MaxHP)
            wormSummary[name] = {alive=w.Alive,awake=w.Awake,percent=(hp and maxhp and maxhp>0) and hp/maxhp*100 or nil}
        end
    end
    return {
        version=VERSION, placeId=game.PlaceId, jobId=game.JobId, mode=self.mode,
        autoAttack=opt.autoAttack, autoDodge=opt.autoDodge, autoMissile=opt.autoMissile,
        autoCloseReport=opt.autoCloseReport, autoReturn=opt.autoReturn, homeWorld=opt.homeWorld,
        autoTarget=self.autoTarget, attackTicks=self.attackTicks, returnQueued=self.returnQueued,
        focusBoss=self.nav.focusBoss,
        rearFormationBoss=self.nav.rearBoss,rearFormationRange=self.nav.rearRange,
        rearFormationSegment=self.nav.rearBodyIndex,
        rearFormationPosition=self.nav.rearWaypoint and tostring(self.nav.rearWaypoint) or nil,
        rearFormationSide=self.nav.rearSideSign,
        movingBodyRisk=self.nav.bodySweepRisk,
        rearLaneEscape=self.nav.rearLaneEscape,
        interceptBoss=self.nav.intercept and self.nav.intercept.boss or nil,
        interceptETA=self.nav.intercept and self.nav.intercept.eta or nil,
        flightMode=self.nav.mode, nativePilotOwned=self.nativePilotOwned,
        predictedRisk=self.nav.risk,
        surfaceFocus=self.nav.focusBoss,visibleSurface=self.nav.lastSurfaceAt>0 and os.clock()-self.nav.lastSurfaceAt<1.5,
        surfaceMemoryAge=self.nav.lastSurfaceAt>0 and os.clock()-self.nav.lastSurfaceAt or nil,
        standoffDistance=opt.approachDistance,breakawayDistance=opt.breakawayDistance,
        preferredHeightAboveTerrain=opt.preferredHeightAboveTerrain,
        maxHeightAboveTerrain=opt.maxHeightAboveTerrain,
        emergencyHeightAboveTerrain=opt.emergencyHeightAboveTerrain,
        bodyRisk=self.nav.bodyRisk, selectedThreat=self.nav.threat,
        bodySourceAvailable=self.wormBodyModule~=nil,
        resultReportClosed=self.resultReportClosed, reportVisible=self.reportVisibleAt~=nil,
        continueButtonReady=self.reportButtonReadyAt~=nil, returnRequested=self.returnRequested,
        state=self.state,phase=self.phase,difficulty=self.difficulty,
        generation=self.generation, flightActive=flight~=nil, steeringVerified=self.steeringVerified,
        planePosition=sim and tostring(sim.Position) or nil,
        planeSpeed=sim and sim.Speed or nil,
        flightThrottle=self.nav.smoothThrottle, throttleState=self.nav.throttleMode,
        speedRecovery=self.nav.speedRecovery,
        attackCorridor=self.nav.corridor and {
            boss=self.nav.corridor.boss,age=os.clock()-self.nav.corridor.startedAt,
            side=self.nav.corridor.side} or nil,
        speedApproachThrottle=opt.speedApproachThrottle,
        speedTrackThrottle=opt.speedTrackThrottle, speedBrakeStartDistance=opt.speedBrakeStartDistance,
        speedPursuitActive=self.nav.pursuitSpeedActive,
        speedPursuitThrottle=opt.speedPursuitThrottle,
        speedTargetMinSafe=self.nav.targetMinSafeSpeed,
        planeIndex=self.hull and self.hull.Index or nil,
        hull=self.hull and self.hull.Hull or nil,
        worms=wormSummary, itemTotal=self.countItems, eventCounts=self.counts,
        lastThreat=self.lastThreat and {
            K=self.lastThreat.item.K,Id=self.lastThreat.item.Id,W=self.lastThreat.item.W,
            secondsUntilImpact=self.lastThreat.eta,dist=self.lastThreat.distance,radius=self.lastThreat.radius
        } or nil,
        nativeOutcome=self.outcome and tostring(self.outcome.Result or self.outcome.Outcome or self.outcome.State or self.outcome.K) or nil,
    }
end
function self:dump(n)
    local begin = math.max(1, #self.logs - math.max(1, tonumber(n) or 140) + 1)
    for i=begin,#self.logs do print(self.logs[i]) end
    local ok, json = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONEncode(self:status()) end)
    print("[SandwormCombatV1] STATUS", ok and json or tostring(json))
end
function self:stop()
    if not self.active then return end
    self.active = false; self.mode = "MONITOR"
    releaseWeapons()
    releaseNativePilot()
    trace("STOP", "FullCycle stopped; Fire/Missiles released")
end
function self:destroy()
    if self.destroyed then return end
    self:stop(); self.destroyed = true
    for _, c in ipairs(self.connections) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
    if self.gui then pcall(function() self.gui:Destroy() end) end
end

if game.PlaceId ~= RAID_PLACE then
    trace("WRONG_PLACE", "Standalone Combat hanya pada destination " .. tostring(RAID_PLACE) .. "; sekarang " .. tostring(game.PlaceId))
    self.active = false
else
    local statusFolder = getRaid()
    local remoteFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("SandwormRaidRemotes")
    local event = remoteFolder and remoteFolder:FindFirstChild("Event")
    if not statusFolder or not event or not event:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
        trace("MISSING_RUNTIME", "Workspace.SandwormRaid / ReplicatedStorage.SandwormRaidRemotes.Event belum tersedia")
        self.active = false
    else
        local function applyAttributes()
            local root = getRaid()
            if not root then return end
            local gen = tonumber(root:GetAttribute("Gen")) or 0
            if gen ~= self.generation then
                self.generation = gen
                if self.generation ~= -1 then clearItems("Gen=" .. fmt(gen)) end
            end
            local nextState = root:GetAttribute("State")
            local nextPhase = tonumber(root:GetAttribute("Phase"))
            if nextState and self.state ~= nextState then
                self.state = nextState
                trace("STATE_ATTR", tostring(nextState))
                if nextState == "Results" or nextState == "Idle" then self.stateResultsAt = self.stateResultsAt or os.clock() end
            end
            if nextPhase and self.phase ~= nextPhase then
                self.phase = nextPhase
                trace("PHASE_ATTR", tostring(nextPhase))
            end
        end
        connect(event.OnClientEvent, processEvent)
        connect(player.OnTeleport, function(state)
            trace('TELEPORT_STATE',tostring(state))
            if state == Enum.TeleportState.InProgress or state == Enum.TeleportState.RequestedFromServer then self.teleportStarted=true end
        end)
        acquireClientModules()
        applyAttributes()
        syncExistingItems()
        queueReturnHome()
        trace("READY", "V" .. VERSION .. " predictive emergence + hard boss lock + native flight; full-cycle; origin="..tostring(opt.homeWorld).."")
        task.spawn(function()
            local checkAt=0
            while self.active and not self.destroyed do
                if os.clock()>=checkAt then
                    checkAt=os.clock()+1
                    if not swJournal() then trace("V6_TOKEN_RETIRED","Stopping managed combat");self:destroy();break end
                end
                local ok, err = pcall(function()
                    applyAttributes()
                    if not self.flightModule or not self.gameController then acquireClientModules() end
                    refreshBosses()
                    syncExistingItems()
                    local threat = evaluateThreat()
                    self.lastThreat = threat
                    local fingerprint = threat and (tostring(threat.item.Id) .. ":" .. tostring(threat.item.K)) or "NONE"
                    if fingerprint ~= self.lastThreatLog then
                        self.lastThreatLog = fingerprint
                        if threat then
                            trace("THREAT_CANDIDATE", string.format("%s ID=%s W=%s eta=%.2fs dist=%.0f radius+=%.0f [marker geometry only]",
                                tostring(threat.item.K), tostring(threat.item.Id), tostring(threat.item.W), threat.eta, threat.distance, threat.radius))
                        end
                    end
                    if self.state == 'Active' and not self.outcome and not self.eliminatedAt then
                        autoCombatStep()
                    else
                        autoResultStep()
                    end
                    self.sampleCount = self.sampleCount + 1
                    if opt.logSamples and os.clock() - self.sampleAt > 8 then
                        self.sampleAt = os.clock()
                        local _, sim = getFlight()
                        trace("SAMPLE", string.format("state=%s phase=%s mode=%s items=%s pos=%s speed=%s",
                            fmt(self.state),fmt(self.phase),self.mode,fmt(self.countItems),
                            sim and tostring(sim.Position) or "NO_FLIGHT",sim and fmt(sim.Speed) or "-"))
                    end
                end)
                if not ok then trace("MONITOR_ERROR", tostring(err)) end
                task.wait(opt.scanSeconds)
            end
        end)
    end
end

__factories["boss.Sandworm.EntrySource"] = function(require)
return [==========[
local UNIFIED_MAIN_PLACE=133112767606395
local UNIFIED_RAID_PLACE=126964146155329
local UNIFIED_VERSION="3.8.0"
local COMBAT_SOURCE=__MANAGED_COMBAT_SOURCE__
local function SandwormUnifiedResolveQueue()
    if type(queue_on_teleport) == "function" then return queue_on_teleport, "queue_on_teleport" end
    if type(queueonteleport) == "function" then return queueonteleport, "queueonteleport" end
    local env = (type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv()) or _G
    if type(env.queue_on_teleport) == "function" then return env.queue_on_teleport, "getgenv.queue_on_teleport" end
    if type(env.queueonteleport) == "function" then return env.queueonteleport, "getgenv.queueonteleport" end
    local synApi = (type(env.syn) == "table" and env.syn) or (type(syn) == "table" and syn)
    if synApi and type(synApi.queue_on_teleport) == "function" then
        return synApi.queue_on_teleport, "syn.queue_on_teleport"
    end
    local flux = (type(env.fluxus) == "table" and env.fluxus) or (type(fluxus) == "table" and fluxus)
    if flux and type(flux.queue_on_teleport) == "function" then
        return flux.queue_on_teleport, "fluxus.queue_on_teleport"
    end
    return nil, "unavailable"
end

local function SandwormUnifiedBuildQueue(context)
    local Http = game:GetService("HttpService")
    local env = (type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv()) or _G
    local handoff = {
        kind = "SANDWORM_UNIFIED_V1_2", version = UNIFIED_VERSION,
        difficulty = tostring(context.difficulty), originWorld = context.originWorld,
        originatingJob = context.originatingJob, userId = context.userId,
        createdAt = os.time(), expiresAt = os.time() + 600,
        token=SW_ATTEMPT.token, returnHook=SW_ATTEMPT.returnHook, buildId=SW_ATTEMPT.buildId,
    }
    local ok, handoffJson = pcall(function()
        return Http:JSONEncode(handoff)
    end)
    if not ok then return nil, handoffJson end
    local prefix = table.concat({
        "-- Sandworm V3.8 queued full-cycle continuation; no external HTTP/file needed",
        "if not game:IsLoaded() then game.Loaded:Wait() end",
        "if game.PlaceId ~= " .. tostring(UNIFIED_RAID_PLACE) .. " then warn('[SandwormUnifiedV1] QUEUE_WRONG_PLACE',game.PlaceId); return end",
        "local __p = game:GetService('Players')",
        "local __start = os.clock()",
        "while not __p.LocalPlayer and os.clock()-__start < 45 do task.wait(0.2) end",
        "if not __p.LocalPlayer then warn('[SandwormUnifiedV1] PLAYER_NOT_READY'); return end",
        "local __http = game:GetService('HttpService')",
        "local __ok, __h = pcall(function() return __http:JSONDecode(" .. string.format("%q", handoffJson) .. ") end)",
        "if not __ok or type(__h) ~= 'table' or __h.userId ~= __p.LocalPlayer.UserId or os.time() > (__h.expiresAt or 0) then warn('[SandwormUnifiedV1] HANDOFF_REJECTED'); return end",
        "local __env = (type(getgenv)=='function' and getgenv()) or _G",
        "local SW_CONTEXT = __h",
        "local __r = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')",
        "local __deadline = os.clock()+60",
        "while os.clock()<__deadline do",
        "  local __folder = __r:FindFirstChild('SandwormRaidRemotes')",
        "  if workspace:FindFirstChild('SandwormRaid') and __folder and __folder:FindFirstChild('Event') then break end",
        "  task.wait(0.25)",
        "end",
        "local __f = __r:FindFirstChild('SandwormRaidRemotes')",
        "if not workspace:FindFirstChild('SandwormRaid') or not __f or not __f:FindFirstChild('Event') then warn('[SandwormUnifiedV1] RAID_RUNTIME_TIMEOUT'); return end",
        "print('[SandwormUnifiedV1] QUEUE_RESUMED','difficulty='..__h.difficulty,'originWorld='..tostring(__h.originWorld))",
        "-- Combat full-cycle begins below",
    }, "\n")
    return prefix .. "\n" .. COMBAT_SOURCE
end

    end

local function fmt(value)
    if value == nil then return "-" end
    return tostring(value)
end
local function trace(code, message)
    if controller.destroyed then return end
    controller.code = code
    controller.message = message or ""
    local line = string.format("[SandwormEntryV1] %s | %s | %s", os.date("%H:%M:%S"), code, tostring(message or ""))
    table.insert(controller.logs, line)
    if #controller.logs > 220 then table.remove(controller.logs, 1) end
    print(line)
end
local function stage(name, details)
    controller.stage = name
    trace(name, details)
end
local function alive(token)
    return not controller.destroyed and controller.active and controller.token == token and SW_GUARD()
end
local function pause(token, seconds)
    local finishAt = os.clock() + seconds
    while alive(token) and os.clock() < finishAt do
        task.wait(math.min(0.18, math.max(0.02, finishAt - os.clock())))
    end
    return alive(token)
end
local function await(token, seconds, predicate)
    local deadline = os.clock() + seconds
    while alive(token) and os.clock() <= deadline do
        local value = predicate()
        if value then return value end
        task.wait(0.20)
    end
    return nil
end
local function fail(code, message)
    controller.active = false
    controller.token = controller.token + 1
    controller.stage = "STOPPED"
    trace(code, message)
    return false
end
local function rootAndHumanoid()
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return nil, nil end
    return char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"), char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end
local function entrances()
    local model = workspace:FindFirstChild(MODEL_NAME)
    local anchor = model and model:FindFirstChild("PromptAnchor")
    local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
    local remote = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild(REMOTE_NAME)
    if not model or not anchor or not anchor:IsA("BasePart") then
        return nil, nil, nil
    end
    if not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
        return model, anchor, nil
    end
    return model, anchor, remote
end
local function remainingCooldown()
    local value = player:GetAttribute("BossStartCooldowns")
    if type(value) ~= "string" then return 0 end
    local ok, decoded = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(value) end)
    if not ok or type(decoded) ~= "table" then return 0 end
    local deadline = tonumber(decoded[BOSS_KEY]) or 0
    return math.max(0, deadline - workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
end
local function snapshot()
    local root, hum = rootAndHumanoid()
    local model, anchor, remote = entrances()
    local distance = root and anchor and (root.Position - anchor.Position).Magnitude or math.huge
    local function attr(name, fallback)
        if not model then return fallback end
        local value = model:GetAttribute(name)
        return value == nil and fallback or value
    end
    return {
        place = game.PlaceId,
        job = game.JobId,
        world = tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")),
        unlocked = player:GetAttribute("World124Unlocked") == true,
        allowed = player:GetAttribute("SandwormEntranceAllowed") == true,
        busy = player:GetAttribute("InBossFight") == true or player:GetAttribute("InPvPMatch") == true,
        dataState = player:GetAttribute("DataState"),
        planes = tonumber(player:GetAttribute("EquippedPlaneCount")),
        ownReady = player:GetAttribute("SandwormEntranceReady") == true,
        refusal = player:GetAttribute("SandwormEntranceReadyRefused"),
        cooldown = remainingCooldown(),
        model = model, anchor = anchor, remote = remote,
        root = root, humanoid = hum, distance = distance,
        state = attr("EntranceState", "Dormant"),
        mode = attr("EntranceMode", "Brutal"),
        leader = tonumber(attr("EntranceLeader", 0)) or 0,
        count = tonumber(attr("EntranceReady", 0)) or 0,
        capacity = tonumber(attr("EntranceCapacity", 6)) or 6,
        canLaunch = attr("EntranceCanLaunch", false) == true,
        countdownEndsAt = tonumber(attr("EntranceCountdownEndsAt", 0)) or 0,
        note = tostring(attr("EntranceNote", "")),
    }
end
local function latestRefusal(before)
    local value = player:GetAttribute("SandwormEntranceReadyRefused")
    if type(value) ~= "string" or value == before then return nil end
    local code, t = value:match("^(%a+)|([%d%.]+)$")
    local timestamp = tonumber(t)
    if code and timestamp and workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - timestamp < 5 then return code end
    return nil
end
local function verifyPreflight(s, requireNear)
    if s.place ~= MAIN_PLACE then return "WRONG_PLACE" end
    if not s.unlocked then return "WORLD_124_LOCKED" end
    if not s.allowed then return "ENTRANCE_NOT_ALLOWED" end
    if s.busy then return "PLAYER_BUSY" end
    if s.dataState ~= nil and s.dataState ~= "Loaded" then return "SAVE_NOT_LOADED" end
    if s.planes ~= nil and s.planes < 1 then return "NO_AIRCRAFT_EQUIPPED" end
    if not s.root or not s.humanoid or s.humanoid.Health <= 0 then return "CHARACTER_UNAVAILABLE" end
    if requireNear then
        if not s.model or not s.anchor or not s.remote then return "ENTRANCE_OBJECTS_MISSING" end
        if s.distance > PROMPT_DISTANCE then return "TOO_FAR_FROM_PROMPT" end
    end
    return nil
end
local function assertOwnership(s, expectedMode)
    local why = verifyPreflight(s, true)
    if why then return why end
    if s.state ~= "Dormant" then return "STATE_" .. tostring(s.state) end
    if s.leader ~= player.UserId then return "LEADERSHIP_LOST" end
    if not s.ownReady or s.count < 1 then return "READY_STATE_LOST" end
    if options.soloOnly and s.count ~= 1 then return "SOLO_GUARD_PARTY_COUNT_" .. tostring(s.count) end
    if expectedMode and s.mode ~= expectedMode then return "MODE_MISMATCH_" .. tostring(s.mode) end
    return nil
end
local function safeFire(token, remote, payload)
    if not alive(token) then return false, "CANCELLED" end
    local current = select(3, entrances())
    if current ~= remote then return false, "REMOTE_REPLACED" end
    local ok, err = pcall(function() remote:FireServer(payload) end)
    if not ok then return false, tostring(err) end
    return true
end
local function travelToWorld(token)
    local s = snapshot()
    if s.world == WORLD then
        trace("WORLD_OK", "Sudah di World 124")
        return true
    end
    if not options.autoWorldTravel then
        trace("WORLD_MANUAL", "CurrentWorld=" .. fmt(s.world) .. "; world travel otomatis dinonaktifkan")
        return true
    end
    stage("WORLD_TRAVEL", "Meminta travel native ke World 124 (satu kali)")
    local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
    local prepare = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("NavPrepareWorlds")
    local request = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("RequestWorldTravel")
    local result = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("WorldTravelResult")
    if not prepare or not prepare:IsA("RemoteEvent") or not request or not request:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
        return fail("WORLD_REMOTES_MISSING", "Pindah manual ke World 124 lalu jalankan START lagi")
    end
    local reply = nil
    local conn = nil
    if result and result:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
        conn = result.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(packet)
            if type(packet) == "table" and packet.Kind == "Result" and tonumber(packet.WorldId) == WORLD
                and type(packet.Ok) == "boolean" then
                reply = packet
            end
        end)
    end
    local function done(ok, code, msg)
        if conn then conn:Disconnect() end
        if ok then trace(code, msg); return true end
        return fail(code, msg)
    end
    -- Native world prepare uses positional arguments, unlike entrance table payloads.
    if not alive(token) then
        if conn then conn:Disconnect() end
        return false
    end
    -- DirectBossTravel.luau reference: NavPrepareWorlds("stream", world), then RequestWorldTravel(world).
    local prepOk, prepErr = pcall(function() prepare:FireServer("stream", WORLD) end)
    if not prepOk then return done(false, "WORLD_PREPARE_FAILED", tostring(prepErr)) end
    if not pause(token, 0.18) then
        if conn then conn:Disconnect() end
        return false
    end
    if snapshot().world == WORLD then return done(true, "WORLD_VERIFIED", "World 124 sudah aktif") end
    if ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes") ~= remotes
        or remotes:FindFirstChild("RequestWorldTravel") ~= request then
        return done(false, "WORLD_REMOTE_CHANGED", "Tidak mengirim world travel")
    end
    local requestOk, requestErr = pcall(function() request:FireServer(WORLD) end)
    if not requestOk then return done(false, "WORLD_REQUEST_FAILED", tostring(requestErr)) end
    local resultState = await(token, options.worldTravelTimeout, function()
        if reply and reply.Ok == false then return "REJECTED" end
        if tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld")) == WORLD then return "ARRIVED" end
        return nil
    end)
    if not alive(token) then
        if conn then conn:Disconnect() end
        return false
    end
    if resultState == "ARRIVED" then return done(true, "WORLD_VERIFIED", "CurrentWorld=124") end
    if resultState == "REJECTED" then
        return done(false, "WORLD_REJECTED", fmt(reply and reply.Reason))
    end
    return done(false, "WORLD_AMBIGUOUS", "Request terkirim, tetapi arrival tidak terverifikasi. Tidak retry otomatis")
end
local function approachEntrance(token)
    local s = snapshot()
    if not s.model or not s.anchor or not s.remote then
        local found = await(token, 12, function()
            local now = snapshot()
            if now.model and now.anchor and now.remote then return true end
            return nil
        end)
        if not found then return fail("ENTRANCE_NOT_LOADED", "Model/anchor/remote belum tersedia") end
        s = snapshot()
    end
    if s.distance <= APPROACH_RADIUS then
        trace("APPROACH_ALREADY", string.format("Sudah dalam radius %.1f studs", s.distance))
        return true
    end
    if not options.autoTeleportApproach then
        return fail("APPROACH_MANUAL_REQUIRED", "Teleport approach OFF; dekati PromptAnchor <=20 studs")
    end
    if s.distance > options.maxTeleportDistance then
        return fail("DIRECT_TP_TOO_FAR", "Jarak " .. math.floor(s.distance) .. " > batas; pindah manual ke World 124 dahulu")
    end
    local problem = verifyPreflight(s, false)
    if problem then return fail("DIRECT_TP_PRECHECK", problem) end
    if s.world ~= WORLD then return fail("DIRECT_TP_WRONG_WORLD", "CurrentWorld harus 124") end
    local character = player.Character
    if not character or not s.root or not s.anchor then
        return fail("DIRECT_TP_CHARACTER_LOST", "Character/root/anchor tidak tersedia")
    end
    -- The existing native entrance requires a character within PROMPT_DISTANCE.
    -- Move the character locally near the anchor, NOT into the raid destination.
    -- Neither a local PivotTo nor distance on the client proves server acceptance;
    -- READY_VERIFIED below is the end-to-end server acknowledgement.
    local anchor = s.anchor
    local goal = anchor.Position - anchor.CFrame.LookVector * 7 + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
    local cast = RaycastParams.new()
    cast.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    cast.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character, s.model }
    local hit = workspace:Raycast(goal + Vector3.new(0, 45, 0), Vector3.new(0, -125, 0), cast)
    if hit then
        goal = Vector3.new(goal.X, math.max(goal.Y, hit.Position.Y + 3.5), goal.Z)
    end
    if (goal - anchor.Position).Magnitude > APPROACH_RADIUS then
        -- A raised floor might be invalid; retain a bounded anchor-relative goal.
        goal = anchor.Position - anchor.CFrame.LookVector * 6 + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
    end
    local face = Vector3.new(anchor.Position.X, goal.Y, anchor.Position.Z)
    if (goal - face).Magnitude < 0.1 then face = goal + Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end
    stage("DIRECT_APPROACH", string.format("Teleport karakter lokal %.1f -> anchor; goalOffset=%.1f", s.distance, (goal-anchor.Position).Magnitude))
    if not alive(token) then return false end
    local ok, err = pcall(function() character:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(goal, face)) end)
    if not ok then return fail("DIRECT_TP_ERROR", tostring(err)) end
    if not pause(token, math.max(0.5, options.teleportSettleSeconds)) then return false end
    local verified = await(token, options.teleportArrivalTimeout, function()
        local now = snapshot()
        if now.world ~= WORLD or now.place ~= MAIN_PLACE then return "WORLD_CHANGED" end
        if not now.anchor or not now.root then return "OBJECT_LOST" end
        if now.distance <= APPROACH_RADIUS then return "NEAR" end
        return nil
    end)
    if not alive(token) then return false end
    if verified ~= "NEAR" then
        return fail("DIRECT_TP_NOT_ACCEPTED", "Position tidak bertahan di radius entrance (" .. fmt(verified) .. "); tidak retry")
    end
    trace("DIRECT_APPROACH_OK", string.format("Character berjarak %.1f studs dari anchor; menunggu Ready ACK untuk validasi server", snapshot().distance))
    return true
end
local function cooldownReady(token)
    local s = snapshot()
    if s.leader ~= 0 or s.cooldown <= 0 then return true end
    if s.cooldown > options.cooldownWaitSeconds then
        return fail("COOLDOWN_LONG", string.format("Cooldown %.0fs; tunggu lalu START kembali", s.cooldown))
    end
    stage("WAIT_COOLDOWN", string.format("Cooldown %.0fs", s.cooldown))
    local seen = await(token, options.cooldownWaitSeconds + 2, function()
        local now = snapshot()
        if now.cooldown <= 0 or now.leader ~= 0 then return true end
        return nil
    end)
    if not seen and alive(token) then return fail("COOLDOWN_NOT_CLEARED", "Batas tunggu tercapai") end
    return seen ~= nil
end
local function chooseDifficulty(token, desired)
    for attempt = 1, 4 do
        local s = snapshot()
        local reason = assertOwnership(s)
        if reason then return fail("MODE_PRECHECK_FAILED", reason) end
        if s.mode == desired then
            trace("MODE_VERIFIED", "Server EntranceMode=" .. desired)
            return true
        end
        local currentIndex = modeIndex(s.mode)
        local nextMode = currentIndex and MODES[currentIndex % #MODES + 1] or MODES[1]
        stage("SELECT_MODE", fmt(s.mode) .. " -> " .. nextMode .. " (target " .. desired .. ")")
        local ok, why = safeFire(token, s.remote, { Kind = "Mode", Mode = nextMode })
        if not ok then return fail("MODE_SEND_FAILED", fmt(why)) end
        local acknowledged = await(token, options.modeAckTimeout, function()
            local after = snapshot()
            if after.mode == nextMode then return "ACK" end
            if after.leader ~= player.UserId or after.state ~= "Dormant" then return "STATE_CHANGED" end
            return nil
        end)
        if not alive(token) then return false end
        if acknowledged ~= "ACK" then
            return fail("MODE_AMBIGUOUS", "Mode dikirim tetapi tidak mendapat ack yang cocok; tidak dikirim ulang")
        end
        if not pause(token, 0.38) then return false end
    end
    return fail("MODE_CYCLE_EXHAUSTED", "Mode target tidak tercapai dalam <=4 langkah")
end
local function run(token)
    if not alive(token) then return end
    local desired = controller.desiredDifficulty
    stage("VERIFY", "MainPlace=" .. fmt(game.PlaceId) .. " target=" .. desired)
    local s = snapshot()
    if s.place ~= MAIN_PLACE then return fail("WRONG_PLACE", "Standalone ENTRY hanya dapat dijalankan di Main Place") end
    if options.requireTeleportQueue then
        local queueFn, apiName = SandwormUnifiedResolveQueue()
        if not queueFn then return fail("QUEUE_UNAVAILABLE", "Potassium queue_on_teleport tidak tersedia; raid tidak akan dimulai") end
        trace("QUEUE_API", apiName .. " tersedia; akan register tepat sebelum launch")
    end
    if controller.originWorld == nil then controller.originWorld = s.world end
    local issue = verifyPreflight(s, false)
    if issue then return fail("PREFLIGHT_FAILED", issue) end
    if not travelToWorld(token) then return end
    if not pause(token, 0.65) then return end -- Allow server world relocation to settle.
    if not approachEntrance(token) then return end
    s = snapshot()
    issue = verifyPreflight(s, true)
    if issue then return fail("PREFLIGHT_FAILED", issue) end
    if s.state ~= "Dormant" then return fail("ENTRANCE_BUSY", "State=" .. fmt(s.state)) end
    if options.soloOnly and s.leader ~= 0 and s.leader ~= player.UserId then
        return fail("OTHER_LEADER", "Ada leader lain; AutoSolo tidak ikut lobby orang lain")
    end
    if not cooldownReady(token) then return end
    s = snapshot()
    if not alive(token) then return end
    if s.leader ~= player.UserId or not s.ownReady then
        if s.leader ~= 0 then return fail("LEADER_CONFLICT", "Tidak bisa ready AutoSolo: leader=" .. fmt(s.leader)) end
        if s.ownReady then return fail("READY_WITHOUT_LEADER", "Sudah ready tetapi tidak ada leader: perlu pemeriksaan manual") end
        issue = verifyPreflight(s, true)
        if issue then return fail("READY_PRECHECK_FAILED", issue) end
        if s.state ~= "Dormant" or s.cooldown > 0 then
            return fail("READY_PRECHECK_FAILED", "State/cooldown berubah")
        end
        stage("READY_REQUEST", "Kirim satu Press untuk Ready Up")
        local refusedBefore = s.refusal
        local ok, err = safeFire(token, s.remote, { Kind = "Press" })
        if not ok then return fail("READY_SEND_FAILED", fmt(err)) end
        local ack = await(token, options.readyAckTimeout, function()
            local n = snapshot()
            local refused = latestRefusal(refusedBefore)
            if refused then return "REFUSED:" .. refused end
            if n.leader == player.UserId and n.ownReady and n.count >= 1 then return "ACK" end
            if n.state ~= "Dormant" then return "STATE_CHANGED" end
            if options.soloOnly and n.leader ~= 0 and n.leader ~= player.UserId then return "OTHER_LEADER" end
            return nil
        end)
        if not alive(token) then return end
        if ack ~= "ACK" then
            if type(ack) == "string" and ack:sub(1, 8) == "REFUSED:" then
                return fail("READY_REFUSED", ack)
            end
            return fail("READY_AMBIGUOUS", "Ready Press dikirim, hasil=" .. fmt(ack) .. "; tidak mengulang Press")
        end
        trace("READY_VERIFIED", "Leader dan Ready sudah diakui oleh atribut")
    else
        trace("READY_ALREADY", "Pemain sudah leader dan ready; tidak mengirim Press")
    end
    if not chooseDifficulty(token, desired) then return end
    stage("WAIT_CAN_LAUNCH", "Menunggu EntranceCanLaunch=true")
    local launchable = await(token, options.canLaunchTimeout, function()
        local n = snapshot()
        local ownership = assertOwnership(n, desired)
        if ownership then return "INVALID:" .. ownership end
        if n.canLaunch then return "ACK" end
        return nil
    end)
    if not alive(token) then return end
    if launchable ~= "ACK" then return fail("CANNOT_LAUNCH", fmt(launchable) .. "; cek syarat server") end
    -- Original client local confirmation is two UI interactions, but only the
    -- SECOND one sends {Kind='Press'}. Here START is explicit user consent.
    -- Never send a speculative "first confirmation Press" (would toggle ready).
    stage("CONFIRM_LAUNCH", "Local confirmation hold 0.55s; akan kirim satu launch Press")
    if not pause(token, 0.55) then return end
    s = snapshot()
    local problem = assertOwnership(s, desired)
    if problem then return fail("LAUNCH_GUARD_FAILED", problem) end
    if not s.canLaunch then return fail("CAN_LAUNCH_LOST", "Server readiness berubah sebelum launch") end
    if s.count > s.capacity then return fail("PARTY_OVER_CAPACITY", "Count melewati kapasitas") end
    -- Queue first, launch second. This handoff is self-contained, no URL/readfile required.
    -- Queue cannot be portably revoked; use destination + user + expiry guards.
    if controller.queueStatus ~= "QUEUED" then
        local queueFn, apiName = SandwormUnifiedResolveQueue()
        if not queueFn then return fail("QUEUE_UNAVAILABLE", "Queue API hilang sebelum Launch; tidak mengirim Press") end
        local payload, payloadError = SandwormUnifiedBuildQueue({
            difficulty = desired,
            originWorld = controller.originWorld,
            originatingJob = game.JobId,
            userId = player.UserId,
        })
        if not payload then return fail("QUEUE_BUILD_FAILED", tostring(payloadError)) end
        controller.queueStatus = "ATTEMPTING" -- an exception does not prove no queue
        local queueOk, queueError = pcall(function() queueFn(payload) end)
        if not queueOk then return fail("QUEUE_FAILED", tostring(queueError)) end
        controller.queueStatus = "QUEUED"
        controller.queueApi = apiName
        controller.queueBytes = #payload
        trace("QUEUE_REGISTERED", apiName .. " | bytes=" .. tostring(#payload) .. " | destination=" .. tostring(RAID_PLACE))
    else
        trace("QUEUE_REUSED", "Continuation sudah terdaftar; tidak mengulang queue")
    end
    if not alive(token) then return end
    stage("LAUNCH_REQUEST", "Satu Press untuk Launch; tanpa retry otomatis")
    local ok, errorText = safeFire(token, s.remote, { Kind = "Press" })
    if not ok then return fail("LAUNCH_SEND_FAILED", fmt(errorText)) end
    local ack = await(token, options.launchAckTimeout, function()
        local n = snapshot()
        if game.PlaceId == RAID_PLACE then return "DESTINATION" end
        if controller.teleportStarted then return "TELEPORTING" end
        if n.state == "Countdown" or n.state == "Departing" then return n.state end
        return nil
    end)
    if not alive(token) then return end
    if not ack then
        return fail("LAUNCH_AMBIGUOUS", "Launch Press terkirim; Countdown/Departing tidak teramati. Jangan ulang otomatis")
    end
    controller.launchAccepted=true
    trace("LAUNCH_ACK", "EntranceState=" .. tostring(ack))
    stage("WAIT_HANDOFF", "Memantau Countdown/Departing dan Roblox teleport")
    local handoff = await(token, options.departingTimeout, function()
        local n = snapshot()
        if game.PlaceId == RAID_PLACE then return "DESTINATION" end
        if controller.teleportStarted then return "TELEPORTING" end
        if n.state == "Departing" then return "DEPARTING" end
        if n.state == "Dormant" then return "RETURNED_TO_DORMANT" end
        return nil
    end)
    if not alive(token) then return end
    if handoff == "DEPARTING" or handoff == "DESTINATION" or handoff == "TELEPORTING" then
        controller.active = false
        controller.token = controller.token + 1
        controller.stage = "HANDOFF"
        trace("HANDOFF_OBSERVED", "Status=" .. tostring(handoff) .. "; destination PlaceId harus dicek setelah teleport")
        return
    end
    return fail("HANDOFF_AMBIGUOUS", "Countdown diobservasi tetapi handoff=" .. fmt(handoff) .. "; tidak retry")
end

function controller:start()
    if self.destroyed or self.active then return end
    if self.queueStatus == "QUEUED" then
        trace("QUEUE_ALREADY_ACTIVE", "Tidak dapat mengulang entry: queue lama belum dapat dibatalkan. Re-execute dengan hati-hati jika teleport gagal.")
        return
    end
    self.desiredDifficulty = options.difficulty
    if not modeIndex(self.desiredDifficulty) then
        trace("INVALID_MODE", fmt(self.desiredDifficulty)); return
    end
    self.token = self.token + 1
    self.active = true
    self.startedAt = os.clock()
    self.teleportStarted = false
    local token = self.token
    task.spawn(function()
        local ok, errorMessage = xpcall(function() run(token) end, function(e) return tostring(e) end)
        if not ok and alive(token) then fail("RUNTIME_ERROR", tostring(errorMessage)) end
    end)
end
function controller:stop()
    if not self.active then return end
    self.active = false
    self.token = self.token + 1
    self.stage = "STOPPED"
    trace("STOPPED_BY_USER", "Tidak mengirim perintah baru. Command yang terlanjur dikirim tidak dibatalkan")
end
function controller:setDifficulty(value)
    if self.active then return false, "Stop dulu sebelum mengubah difficulty" end
    if not modeIndex(value) then return false, "Mode tidak valid" end
    options.difficulty = value
    self.desiredDifficulty = value
    trace("TARGET_MODE", value)
    return true
end
function controller:status()
    local s = snapshot()
    return {
        version = VERSION, stage = self.stage, code = self.code, active = self.active,
        target = options.difficulty, actualMode = s.mode, entranceState = s.state,
        world = s.world, placeId = s.place, distance = s.distance ~= math.huge and s.distance or nil,
        leader = s.leader, ready = s.count, ownReady = s.ownReady,
        canLaunch = s.canLaunch, cooldown = s.cooldown,
        allowed = s.allowed, unlocked = s.unlocked,
        mainPlaceId = MAIN_PLACE, raidPlaceId = RAID_PLACE,
        queueStatus = self.queueStatus, queueApi = self.queueApi,
        queueBytes = self.queueBytes, originWorld = self.originWorld,
    }
end
function controller:dump(n)
    local lines = self.logs
    local startAt = math.max(1, #lines - (tonumber(n) or 100) + 1)
    for i = startAt, #lines do print(lines[i]) end
    print("[SandwormEntryV1] STATUS", HttpService:JSONEncode(self:status()))
end
function controller:destroy()
    self:stop()
    self.destroyed = true
    for _, conn in ipairs(self.events) do pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end) end
    if self.gui then pcall(function() self.gui:Destroy() end) end
end

local function connect(signal, fn)
    local conn=signal:Connect(fn);table.insert(controller.events,conn);return conn
end
connect(player.OnTeleport, function(state)
    trace("TELEPORT_STATE", tostring(state))
    if state == Enum.TeleportState.Started or state == Enum.TeleportState.InProgress then
        controller.teleportStarted = true
        controller.stage = "TELEPORTING"
    end
end)
connect(TeleportService.TeleportInitFailed, function(failedPlayer, teleportResult, message, placeId)
    if failedPlayer ~= player then return end
    trace("TELEPORT_FAILED", tostring(teleportResult) .. " | " .. tostring(message) .. " | " .. tostring(placeId))
    if controller.active then fail("TELEPORT_FAILED", "Perpindahan gagal; tidak mengulang launch") end
end)

return controller
]==========]
end
-- END MODULE boss.Sandworm.EntrySource

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.Sandworm.PlaceHandoff
__factories["boss.Sandworm.PlaceHandoff"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- One scheduler-owned entry. V3.8 combat is queued only after native Ready/Mode.
local Contracts=require("main.core.Contracts")
local EntrySource=require("boss.Sandworm.EntrySource")
local CombatSource=require("boss.Sandworm.CombatSource")
local Resume=require("boss.Sandworm.ReturnResumeSource")
local PlaceHandoff={}
local function globals() return (type(getgenv)=="function" and getgenv()) or _G end
function PlaceHandoff.cooldown(player)
    local ok,raw=pcall(player.GetAttribute,player,"BossStartCooldowns")
    if not ok then return nil,"SANDWORM_COOLDOWN_UNKNOWN" end
    if raw==nil or raw=="" then return nil end
    if type(raw)~="string" then return nil,"SANDWORM_COOLDOWN_UNKNOWN" end
    local decoded,map=pcall(function()return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(raw)end)
    if not decoded or type(map)~="table" then return nil,"SANDWORM_COOLDOWN_UNKNOWN" end
    if map.SunderingSands==nil then return 0 end
    local expiry=tonumber(map.SunderingSands)
    local timed,now=pcall(workspace.GetServerTimeNow,workspace)
    if not Contracts.isFinite(expiry) or not timed or not Contracts.isFinite(now) then
        return nil,"SANDWORM_COOLDOWN_UNKNOWN"
    end
    return math.max(0,expiry-now)
end
function PlaceHandoff.new(env,config)
    local adapter={}
    local runner,activeToken,lastStartAt=nil,nil,-math.huge
    local player=env.services.roblox:player()
    local function result(code,delay,evidence)
        return Contracts.result("DEFERRED",code,{stage="SETUP",
            retryAt=env.runtime:now()+(delay or config.launchRetrySeconds),evidence=evidence or {}})
    end
    function adapter:cancel()
        activeToken=nil
        local old=runner;runner=nil
        if old and type(old.destroy)=="function" then pcall(old.destroy,old) end
    end
    function adapter:forceReset() self:cancel();lastStartAt=-math.huge;return true end
    function adapter:preflight()
        if game.PlaceId~=config.mainPlaceId or player:GetAttribute("InBossFight")==true
            or player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout")==true or player:GetAttribute("BossResultsOpen")==true
            or player:GetAttribute("PrototypeDungeonRun")~=nil or player:GetAttribute("InPvPMatch")==true then return false,"SANDWORM_MAIN_UNSAFE" end
        local ds=player:GetAttribute("DataState")
        local planes=tonumber(player:GetAttribute("EquippedPlaneCount"))
        if ds~=nil and ds~="Loaded" then return false,"SANDWORM_SAVE_NOT_LOADED" end
        if planes~=nil and planes<1 then return false,"SANDWORM_NO_AIRCRAFT" end
        if player:GetAttribute("World124Unlocked")~=true or player:GetAttribute("SandwormEntranceAllowed")~=true then
            return false,"SANDWORM_ENTRANCE_UNAVAILABLE" end
        local remaining,why=PlaceHandoff.cooldown(player)
        if why then return false,why end
        if remaining and remaining>0 then return false,"SANDWORM_SERVER_COOLDOWN" end
        return true
    end
    function adapter:status()
        if runner and type(runner.status)=="function" then
            local ok,s=pcall(runner.status,runner);if ok then return s end
        end
        return {active=false,stage="NOT_STARTED",queueStatus="NOT_QUEUED"}
    end
    local function returnAfterPrequeue(home,guard)
        if not guard() or game.PlaceId~=config.mainPlaceId then return false end
        if tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"))==home then return true end
        local function safe()
            return guard() and game.PlaceId==config.mainPlaceId
                and player:GetAttribute("InBossFight")~=true
                and player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout")~=true
                and player:GetAttribute("BossResultsOpen")~=true
                and player:GetAttribute("InPvPMatch")~=true
                and player:GetAttribute("PrototypeDungeonRun")==nil
        end
        if not safe() then return false end
        local rs=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        local prep=rs and rs:FindFirstChild("NavPrepareWorlds")
        local travel=rs and rs:FindFirstChild("RequestWorldTravel")
        if not prep or not travel or not prep:IsA("RemoteEvent") or not travel:IsA("RemoteEvent") then return false end
        if not pcall(prep.FireServer,prep,"stream",home) then return false end
        task.wait(.35)
        if not safe() or rs:FindFirstChild("RequestWorldTravel")~=travel then return false end
        if tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"))==home then return true end
        if not pcall(travel.FireServer,travel,home) then return false end
        local deadline=env.runtime:now()+12
        while safe() and env.runtime:now()<deadline do
            if tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"))==home then return true end
            task.wait(.25)
        end
        return false
    end
    function adapter:run(ctx,attempt)
        local function noQueue(delay,code)
            return result("SANDWORM_V38_PREQUEUE_FAILED",delay,{noPayloadQueued=true,
                entryStage="SANDWORM_PREQUEUE_FAILED",reason=code,retrySeconds=delay})
        end
        if ctx:isCancelled() then return noQueue(30,"CANCELLED") end
        if type(attempt)~="table" or type(attempt.token)~="string" or #attempt.token<8
            or not config.isDifficulty(attempt.difficulty) or not Contracts.isHomeWorld(attempt.originalWorld)
            or attempt.resumeV6~=true or type(attempt.buildId)~="string" then return noQueue(60,"INVALID_ATTEMPT") end
        local allowed,reason=self:preflight()
        if not allowed then return noQueue(30,reason) end
        if runner then self:cancel() end
        if env.runtime:now()-lastStartAt<5 then return noQueue(30,"START_THROTTLED") end
        local hook=Resume.render(config.bossId,attempt.token,player.UserId,config.mainPlaceId,attempt.originalWorld,attempt.buildId)
        if not hook or type(loadstring)~="function" then return noQueue(60,"RESUME_UNAVAILABLE") end
        local frozen={token=attempt.token,originalWorld=attempt.originalWorld,difficulty=attempt.difficulty,
            buildId=attempt.buildId,returnHook=hook}
        -- The source is a factory; no GUI, global auto-start, or second scheduler.
        local src=EntrySource:gsub("__MANAGED_COMBAT_SOURCE__",function()
            return "[========[\n"..CombatSource.."]========]"
        end)
        local chunk,err=loadstring("return function(SW_ATTEMPT,SW_GUARD)\n"..src.."\nend")
        if not chunk then return noQueue(60,tostring(err)) end
        local ok,factory=pcall(chunk)
        if not ok or type(factory)~="function" then return noQueue(60,"FACTORY_FAILED") end
        activeToken=attempt.token
        local function guard() return activeToken==attempt.token and not ctx:isCancelled() end
        local started,value=pcall(factory,frozen,guard)
        if not started or type(value)~="table" then self:cancel();return noQueue(60,"ENTRY_FACTORY_FAILED") end
        runner=value;lastStartAt=env.runtime:now()
        runner:start()
        local deadline=env.runtime:now()+115
        while guard() and runner==value and value.active and not value.launchAccepted and env.runtime:now()<deadline do
            task.wait(.15)
        end
        local accepted=value.launchAccepted==true
        local queueStatus=value.queueStatus
        local code=value.code
        -- Stop only this generation. A late old coroutine must NEVER cancel
        -- a newer route started after Force Reset.
        if runner==value and activeToken==attempt.token then
            pcall(value.destroy,value)
            if not accepted and queueStatus=="NOT_QUEUED" and guard() then
                local ok,home=pcall(returnAfterPrequeue,attempt.originalWorld,guard)
                print("[V6 SANDWORM] PREQUEUE_RETURN",ok and home==true)
            end
            if runner==value and activeToken==attempt.token then self:cancel() end
        end
        if accepted then return result("SANDWORM_V38_STARTED",3600,{stage="LAUNCH_ACCEPTED",difficulty=attempt.difficulty}) end
        if queueStatus=="NOT_QUEUED" then
            local remaining=PlaceHandoff.cooldown(player)
            local delay=math.max(30,math.min(120,(tonumber(remaining) or 0)+2))
            return noQueue(delay,code)
        end
        return result("SANDWORM_V38_ENTRY_UNCERTAIN",60,{queueStatus=queueStatus,code=code})
    end
    return adapter
end
return PlaceHandoff
end
-- END MODULE boss.Sandworm.PlaceHandoff

-- BEGIN MODULE boss.Sandworm.ReturnResumeSource
__factories["boss.Sandworm.ReturnResumeSource"] = function(require)
--!nonstrict
-- Same V6 return contract as other standalone raids, specialized for interruption.
-- Appended to managed Home source, shares its token guard and physical return runner.
local Resume={}
function Resume.render(raidId,token,userId,originPlace,originWorld,buildId)
    if raidId~="SANDWORM" or type(token)~="string" or #token<8 or type(userId)~="number"
        or originPlace~=133112767606395 or type(originWorld)~="number" or originWorld<1
        or originWorld%1~=0 or type(buildId)~="string" then return nil end
    return [=====[
-- Managed return: no home proof / no WIN inferred from a forced return.
task.spawn(function()
    local okay,err=pcall(function()
        local deadline=os.clock()+240
        local function safeMain()
            local char=player.Character
            local hum=char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            return game.PlaceId==MAIN and player.UserId==SW_CONTEXT.userId
                and tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"))~=nil
                and char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and hum and hum.Health>0
                and player:GetAttribute("InBossFight")~=true
                and player:GetAttribute("InPersonalHideout")~=true
                and player:GetAttribute("BossResultsOpen")~=true
                and player:GetAttribute("InPvPMatch")~=true
                and player:GetAttribute("PrototypeDungeonRun")==nil
                and (player:GetAttribute("DataState")==nil or player:GetAttribute("DataState")=="Loaded")
        end
        while os.clock()<deadline do
            if not swJournal() then return end
            if not obj.active and safeMain() then break end
            task.wait(.5)
        end
        if obj.active or not safeMain() or not swJournal() then return end
        local verified=obj.stage=="HOME_VERIFIED" and tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld"))==HOME
        if verified then
            local saved=swUpdate(function(r)
                if type(r.sandwormEnteredAt)~="number" then return false end
                r.status="RETURN_VERIFIED";r.returnVerifiedAt=os.time();return true
            end)
            if not saved then warn("[V6 SANDWORM RESUME] Home journal write unverified; main inspector will reconcile") end
        end
        -- If native home travel failed, resume only in a physically safe main
        -- context. Main's inspector independently reconciles that interruption.
        local record=swJournal()
        if not record or type(record.sandwormEnteredAt)~="number" then return end
        if type(loadstring)~="function" then return end
        local readOK,bundle=pcall(readfile,"PlaneRNG_V6_v0.1_Alpha_Delta.luau")
        if not readOK or type(bundle)~="string" or not bundle:find(SW_CONTEXT.buildId,1,true) then
            warn("[V6 SANDWORM RESUME] Matching main bundle missing; execute main manually");return
        end
        local token=SW_CONTEXT.token
        if env.PlaneRNGV6StandaloneResumeToken==token or env.SandwormManagedResumeToken==token then return end
        local entry,why=loadstring(bundle)
        if not entry then warn("[V6 SANDWORM RESUME] Compile failed",why);return end
        if not swJournal() then return end
        env.SandwormManagedResumeToken=token
        env.PlaneRNGV6StandaloneResumeToken=token
        if verified then
            env.PlaneRNGV6PostRaidHome={raidId="SANDWORM",userId=player.UserId,homeWorld=HOME,
                atMonotonic=os.clock(),token=token}
        end
        local ran,reason=pcall(entry)
        local alpha=env.PlaneRNGV6Alpha
        if not ran or type(alpha)~="table" or alpha.buildId~=SW_CONTEXT.buildId
            or alpha.resumeToken~=token then
            if env.SandwormManagedResumeToken==token then env.SandwormManagedResumeToken=nil end
            if env.PlaneRNGV6StandaloneResumeToken==token then env.PlaneRNGV6StandaloneResumeToken=nil end
            warn("[V6 SANDWORM RESUME] Fresh main runtime unverified",reason)
        end
    end)
    if not okay then warn("[V6 SANDWORM RESUME] Observation failed",err) end
end)
]=====]
end
return Resume
end
-- END MODULE boss.Sandworm.ReturnResumeSource

return __require("pc.V6AlphaEntry")
]=======]
local name = "PlaneRNG_V6_v0.1_Alpha_Delta.luau"
local saved = false
if type(writefile) == "function" and type(readfile) == "function" then
    local wrote, why = pcall(writefile, name, staged)
    if wrote then
        local readOk, restored = pcall(readfile, name)
        saved = readOk and restored == staged
        if not saved then warn("[V6 STAGE] Workspace readback mismatch; automatic return resume unavailable") end
    else
        warn("[V6 STAGE] Cannot save workspace bundle", why)
    end
else
    warn("[V6 STAGE] Workspace file APIs unavailable; automatic return resume unavailable")
end
if saved then print("[V6 STAGE] Matching bundle saved for return resume") end
if type(loadstring) ~= "function" then error("[V6 STAGE] Delta loadstring unavailable") end
local fn, compileErr = loadstring(staged)
if not fn then error("[V6 STAGE] Bundle compile error: " .. tostring(compileErr)) end
return fn()
